FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/Codecs/Vorbis.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/BuiltinWrappers.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibMedia/Codecs/Vorbis.h>
#include <LibMedia/MediaStream.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/BitReader.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

static constexpr size_t IDENTIFICATION_HEADER_SIZE = 30;
static constexpr size_t COMMON_HEADER_SIZE = 7;
static constexpr u8 MAXIMUM_MODE_COUNT = 64;
// The mode number and the previous window flag must fit in the first byte of a packet, after the packet type bit.
static constexpr u8 MAXIMUM_SUPPORTED_MODE_COUNT = 63;

static bool is_header_of_type(ReadonlyBytes header, u8 type)
{
    return header.size() >= COMMON_HEADER_SIZE && header[0] == type && header.slice(1, 6) == "vorbis"sv.bytes();
}

static DecoderErrorOr<Array<ReadonlyBytes, 3>> split_headers(ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data)
{
    // The three headers in Xiph lacing: a count of all but the last, then all but the last one's sizes.
    if (codec_initialization_data.is_empty() || codec_initialization_data[0] != 2)
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis codec initialization data does not contain three headers"sv);

    size_t offset = 1;
    Array<size_t, 2> laced_sizes {};
    for (auto& size : laced_sizes) {
        while (true) {
            if (offset >= codec_initialization_data.size())
                return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis header sizes are truncated"sv);
            auto lace = codec_initialization_data[offset++];
            size += lace;
            if (lace < 255)
                break;
        }
    }

    auto headers = codec_initialization_data.slice(offset);
    if (laced_sizes[0] + laced_sizes[1] > headers.size())
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis headers are truncated"sv);
    return Array {
        headers.trim(laced_sizes[0]),
        headers.slice(laced_sizes[0], laced_sizes[1]),
        headers.slice(laced_sizes[0] + laced_sizes[1]),
    };
}

DecoderErrorOr<Vorbis::PacketDurationParser> Vorbis::PacketDurationParser::create(ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data)
{
    auto headers = TRY(split_headers(codec_initialization_data));

    // https://xiph.org/vorbis/doc/Vorbis_I_spec.html#x1-630004.2.2
    auto identification_header = headers[0];
    if (identification_header.size() < IDENTIFICATION_HEADER_SIZE || !is_header_of_type(identification_header, 1))
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis identification header is invalid"sv);

    auto read_u32 = [&](size_t offset) {
        u32 value = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(u32); i++)
            value |= static_cast<u32>(identification_header[offset + i]) << (8 * i);
        return value;
    };
    auto version = read_u32(7);
    PacketDurationParser parser;
    parser.m_samples_per_second = read_u32(12);
    auto block_size_exponents = identification_header[28];
    auto short_block_size_exponent = block_size_exponents & 0xF;
    auto long_block_size_exponent = block_size_exponents >> 4;
    auto header_is_valid = [&] {
        if (version != 0 || parser.m_samples_per_second == 0)
            return false;
        return short_block_size_exponent >= 6 && long_block_size_exponent <= 13 && short_block_size_exponent <= long_block_size_exponent;
    }();
    if (!header_is_valid)
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis identification header is invalid"sv);
    parser.m_block_sizes = { static_cast<u16>(1u << short_block_size_exponent), static_cast<u16>(1u << long_block_size_exponent) };

    // https://xiph.org/vorbis/doc/Vorbis_I_spec.html#x1-650004.2.4
    // The modes end the setup header, but finding them from the front means decoding every codebook, floor, residue
    // and mapping before them. Instead, as FFmpeg and liboggz do, walk back from the framing bit through every run of
    // fields that could be a mode, and take the longest one preceded by a matching mode count.
    auto setup_header = headers[2];
    if (!is_header_of_type(setup_header, 5))
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis setup header is invalid"sv);

    // Fields are packed from the least significant bit, so reading the reversed bytes from their most significant
    // bit reads each field backwards from its end.
    Vector<u8> reversed_setup_header;
    reversed_setup_header.resize(setup_header.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < setup_header.size(); i++)
        reversed_setup_header[i] = setup_header[setup_header.size() - 1 - i];

    // The mode fields, plus a mode count and the setup header's packet type and signature before them.
    static constexpr size_t MINIMUM_BITS_BEFORE_A_MODE = 97;

    BitReader reader { reversed_setup_header };
    Optional<size_t> bit_count_through_framing_bit;
    while (reader.bits_remaining() > MINIMUM_BITS_BEFORE_A_MODE) {
        if (reader.read_bit()) {
            bit_count_through_framing_bit = reader.bit_position();
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!bit_count_through_framing_bit.has_value())
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis setup header has no framing bit"sv);

    u8 candidate_mode_count = 0;
    while (reader.bits_remaining() >= MINIMUM_BITS_BEFORE_A_MODE) {
        // Backwards, a mode is its mapping, transform type, window type and block flag. Both types must be zero, and
        // there are at most 64 mappings.
        auto mapping = reader.read_bits<u8>(8);
        auto transform_type = reader.read_bits<u16>(16);
        auto window_type = reader.read_bits<u16>(16);
        if (mapping >= MAXIMUM_MODE_COUNT || transform_type != 0 || window_type != 0)
            break;
        reader.skip_bits(1);
        candidate_mode_count++;
        if (candidate_mode_count > MAXIMUM_MODE_COUNT)
            break;
        auto mode_count_reader = reader;
        if (mode_count_reader.read_bits<u8>(6) + 1u == candidate_mode_count)
            parser.m_mode_count = candidate_mode_count;
    }
    if (parser.m_mode_count == 0)
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis setup header has no modes"sv);
    if (parser.m_mode_count > MAXIMUM_SUPPORTED_MODE_COUNT)
        return DecoderError::not_implemented();

    reader = BitReader { reversed_setup_header };
    reader.skip_bits(bit_count_through_framing_bit.value());
    for (u8 mode = parser.m_mode_count; mode-- > 0;) {
        reader.skip_bits(40);
        if (reader.read_bit())
            parser.m_long_block_modes |= 1ull << mode;
    }

    // https://xiph.org/vorbis/doc/Vorbis_I_spec.html#x1-730004.3.1
    // ilog(mode_count - 1), where ilog(0) is 0.
    if (parser.m_mode_count > 1)
        parser.m_mode_bit_count = count_required_bits(static_cast<u8>(parser.m_mode_count - 1));
    parser.reset();
    return parser;
}

DecoderErrorOr<u32> Vorbis::PacketDurationParser::parse_duration_in_samples(MediaStreamCursor& cursor, size_t packet_size)
{
    if (packet_size == 0)
        return 0;

    // https://xiph.org/vorbis/doc/Vorbis_I_spec.html#x1-730004.3.1
    auto first_byte = TRY(cursor.read_value<u8>());
    if ((first_byte & 1) != 0)
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis packet is not an audio packet"sv);
    auto mode = (first_byte >> 1) & ((1u << m_mode_bit_count) - 1);
    if (mode >= m_mode_count)
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Vorbis packet has an invalid mode"sv);

    auto is_long_block = ((m_long_block_modes >> mode) & 1) != 0;
    auto block_size = m_block_sizes[is_long_block ? 1 : 0];
    auto previous_block_size = m_previous_block_size;
    if (is_long_block) {
        auto previous_window_flag = (first_byte >> (1 + m_mode_bit_count)) & 1;
        previous_block_size = m_block_sizes[previous_window_flag];
    }
    m_previous_block_size = block_size;

    // https://xiph.org/vorbis/doc/Vorbis_I_spec.html#x1-800004.3.8
    // The returned data runs from the center of the previous window to the center of the current one.
    return (previous_block_size / 4u) + (block_size / 4u);
}

void Vorbis::PacketDurationParser::reset()
{
    m_previous_block_size = m_block_sizes[0];
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <LibMedia/Forward.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/DecoderError.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

class Vorbis {
public:
    class PacketDurationParser {
    public:
        static DecoderErrorOr<PacketDurationParser> create(ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data);

        u32 samples_per_second() const { return m_samples_per_second; }
        // A packet's duration depends on the block size of the packet before it.
        DecoderErrorOr<u32> parse_duration_in_samples(MediaStreamCursor&, size_t packet_size);
        void reset();

    private:
        PacketDurationParser() = default;

        u32 m_samples_per_second { 0 };
        Array<u16, 2> m_block_sizes {};
        u8 m_mode_count { 0 };
        u8 m_mode_bit_count { 0 };
        u64 m_long_block_modes { 0 };
        u16 m_previous_block_size { 0 };
    };
};

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/ContainerID.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/GenericShorthands.h>
#include <LibMedia/ContainerID.h>

namespace Media {

Optional<ContainerMimeType> container_mime_type_from_mime_type(StringView type, StringView subtype)
{
    auto media_type = [&]() -> Optional<ContainerMediaType> {
        if (type == "audio"sv)
            return ContainerMediaType::Audio;
        if (type == "video"sv)
            return ContainerMediaType::Video;
        if (type == "application"sv)
            return ContainerMediaType::Application;
        return {};
    }();
    if (!media_type.has_value())
        return {};

    if (subtype == "mp4"sv)
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::ISOBMFF, *media_type };

    // The ISO base media file format under the names its audio-only and QuickTime files go by.
    if (subtype == "x-m4a"sv && *media_type == ContainerMediaType::Audio)
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::ISOBMFF, *media_type };
    if (subtype == "quicktime"sv && *media_type == ContainerMediaType::Video)
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::ISOBMFF, *media_type };

    if (subtype == "webm"sv) {
        if (*media_type == ContainerMediaType::Application)
            return {};
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::WebM, *media_type };
    }

    if (first_is_one_of(subtype, "matroska"sv, "x-matroska"sv)) {
        if (*media_type == ContainerMediaType::Application)
            return {};
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::Matroska, *media_type };
    }

    if (subtype == "ogg"sv)
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::Ogg, *media_type };

    if (*media_type != ContainerMediaType::Audio)
        return {};

    if (first_is_one_of(subtype, "mpeg"sv, "mp3"sv, "x-mp3"sv))
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::MPEGAudio, *media_type };
    if (subtype == "aac"sv)
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::ADTS, *media_type };
    if (subtype == "flac"sv)
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::FLAC, *media_type };
    if (first_is_one_of(subtype, "wav"sv, "wave"sv, "x-wav"sv))
        return ContainerMimeType { ContainerID::WAV, *media_type };

    return {};
}

}

#include <LibMedia/Containers/ADTS/ADTSDemuxer.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/FrameScanTimeline.h>
#include <LibMedia/SeekMode.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/AAC.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodedFrame.h>

namespace Media::ADTS {

namespace {

class FrameScanSource final : public Media::FrameScanSource {
public:
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<Optional<Frame>> next_frame(MediaStreamCursor& cursor, size_t position) const override
    {
        FrameIterator iterator { NonnullRefPtr { cursor }, position, FrameIterator::Resynchronize::Yes };
        auto frame = TRY(absorb_data_errors(iterator.next()));
        if (!frame.has_value())
            return Optional<Frame> {};

        return Frame {
            .position = frame->position,
            .byte_size = frame->header.frame_byte_size,
            .duration = { frame->header.sample_count, frame->header.sample_rate },
        };
    }

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<Optional<size_t>> find_boundary_at_or_after(MediaStreamCursor& cursor, size_t start_byte, size_t upper_bound) const override
    {
        return absorb_data_errors(Reader::find_frame_boundary_at_or_after(NonnullRefPtr { cursor }, start_byte, upper_bound));
    }

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<Optional<size_t>> find_boundary_at_or_before(MediaStreamCursor& cursor, size_t target_byte, size_t lower_bound, size_t upper_bound) const override
    {
        return absorb_data_errors(Reader::find_frame_boundary_at_or_before(NonnullRefPtr { cursor }, target_byte, lower_bound, upper_bound));
    }
};

}

bool ADTSDemuxer::supports_container_mime_type(ContainerMimeType mime_type)
{
    return mime_type.container_id == ContainerID::ADTS && mime_type.media_type == ContainerMediaType::Audio;
}

bool ADTSDemuxer::supports_codec_in_container(ContainerID container_id, CodecID codec_id)
{
    return container_id == ContainerID::ADTS && codec_id == CodecID::AAC;
}

static Audio::ChannelMap channel_map_from_channel_count(u8 channel_count)
{
    switch (channel_count) {
    case 1:
        return Audio::ChannelMap::mono();
    case 2:
        return Audio::ChannelMap::stereo();
    case 4:
        return Audio::ChannelMap::quadrophonic();
    case 6:
        return Audio::ChannelMap::surround_5_1();
    case 8:
        return Audio::ChannelMap::surround_7_1();
    default:
        return Audio::ChannelMap::invalid();
    }
}

static DecoderErrorOr<Track> create_track(Reader const& reader, ReadonlyBytes codec_configuration)
{
    auto const& header = reader.frame_header();

    Track track { TrackType::Audio, 0, Track::Kind::Main, {}, {} };
    track.set_audio_data({ .sample_specification = Audio::SampleSpecification(header.sample_rate, channel_map_from_channel_count(header.channel_count)) });

    auto parameters = Codecs::AAC::parse_configuration_record(codec_configuration, Codecs::AAC::MPEG4_AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION);
    if (!parameters.has_value())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "ADTS frames describe an unusable AAC configuration"sv);
    track.set_parsed_codec(ParsedCodec { *parameters });

    return track;
}

DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Demuxer>> ADTSDemuxer::from_stream(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStream> const& stream)
{
    auto reader = TRY(Reader::from_stream(stream->create_cursor()));
    if (!reader.has_value())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::UnrecognizedFormat, "Found no ADTS frames in the stream"sv);

    auto const& header = reader->frame_header();

    // A stream carrying High Efficiency AAC names the sample rate of its core and leaves the rest to
    // be found in the audio itself, so the record says what the headers say and no more.
    auto codec_configuration = TRY(Codecs::AAC::create_configuration_record(header.audio_object_type, header.sample_rate, header.channel_count));
    auto track = TRY(create_track(*reader, codec_configuration.span()));

    auto demuxer = make_ref_counted<ADTSDemuxer>(stream, *reader, move(track), move(codec_configuration));
    demuxer->start_buffered_scan_thread();
    return demuxer;
}

ADTSDemuxer::ADTSDemuxer(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStream> const& stream, Reader reader, Track track, FixedArray<u8> codec_configuration)
    : m_stream(stream)
    , m_reader(reader)
    , m_track(move(track))
    , m_codec_configuration(move(codec_configuration))
    , m_seek_scanning_cursor(stream->create_cursor())
{
    m_seek_scanning_cursor->set_is_blocking(false);
}

ADTSDemuxer::~ADTSDemuxer()
{
    if (m_buffered_scan_thread != nullptr)
        m_buffered_scan_thread->shutdown();
}

void ADTSDemuxer::start_buffered_scan_thread()
{
    auto scan_cursor = m_stream->create_cursor();
    scan_cursor->set_is_blocking(false);

    DemuxerScanState initial_state;
    initial_state.duration = m_reader.duration();

    m_buffered_scan_thread = DemuxerScanThread<BufferedScanPayload>::start(m_stream, move(initial_state),
        BufferedScanPayload {
            .timeline = make<FrameScanTimeline>(make<FrameScanSource>(), m_reader.first_frame_position(), m_reader.duration(), DurationSource::Estimated, OptionalNone {}),
            .scan_cursor = move(scan_cursor),
        },
        [](MediaStream::Availability const& availability, BufferedScanPayload& payload) {
            auto const& byte_ranges = availability.byte_ranges;
            BufferedRangesScan scan;
            if (!byte_ranges.is_empty())
                scan = payload.timeline->buffered_time_ranges(payload.scan_cursor, byte_ranges, availability.expected_size);
            return DemuxerScanState::create_from_track_scans({ move(scan) }, payload.timeline->duration(), availability.closing_bytes_are_available());
        });
}

ADTSDemuxer::TrackStatus& ADTSDemuxer::track_status()
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_track_status_mutex };
    VERIFY(m_track_status.has_value());
    return *m_track_status;
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> ADTSDemuxer::create_context_for_track(Track const& track)
{
    VERIFY(track == m_track);

    auto cursor = m_stream->create_cursor();
    cursor->set_is_blocking(true);

    MutexLocker locker { m_track_status_mutex };
    VERIFY(!m_track_status.has_value());
    m_track_status = TrackStatus { FrameIterator { move(cursor), m_reader.first_frame_position(), FrameIterator::Resynchronize::Yes }, AK::Duration::zero(), true };
    return {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<Vector<Track>> ADTSDemuxer::get_tracks_for_type(TrackType type)
{
    Vector<Track> tracks;
    if (type == TrackType::Audio)
        tracks.append(m_track);
    return tracks;
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<Track>> ADTSDemuxer::get_preferred_track_for_type(TrackType type)
{
    if (type != TrackType::Audio)
        return Optional<Track> {};
    return Optional<Track> { m_track };
}

DecoderErrorOr<CodedFrame> ADTSDemuxer::get_next_sample_for_track(Track const& track)
{
    VERIFY(track == m_track);
    auto& status = track_status();

    auto frame = TRY(status.iterator.read_next_frame());
    if (!frame.has_value())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "End of stream"sv);

    auto duration = AK::Duration::from_time_units(frame->header.sample_count, 1, frame->header.sample_rate);
    auto timestamp = status.next_timestamp;
    status.next_timestamp += duration;

    Optional<FixedArray<u8>> codec_configuration;
    if (status.needs_codec_configuration) {
        status.needs_codec_configuration = false;
        codec_configuration = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(FixedArray<u8>::create(m_codec_configuration.span()));
    }

    // Every frame can begin decoding, so every frame is a keyframe to seek to.
    return CodedFrame(CodecID::AAC, timestamp, timestamp, duration, FrameFlags::Keyframe, move(frame->data), move(codec_configuration));
}

AK::Duration ADTSDemuxer::select_fast_seek_target_for_track(Track const&, AK::Duration target, SeekMode)
{
    return target;
}

DecoderErrorOr<DemuxerSeekResult> ADTSDemuxer::seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(Track const& track, AK::Duration timestamp, DemuxerSeekOptions options)
{
    VERIFY(track == m_track);
    auto& status = track_status();

    auto seeked = TRY(m_buffered_scan_thread->payload().timeline->seek_to_timestamp(m_seek_scanning_cursor, NonnullRefPtr { status.iterator.cursor() }, *m_stream, timestamp));
    if (has_flag(options, DemuxerSeekOptions::NeedCodecConfiguration))
        status.needs_codec_configuration = true;

    status.iterator = FrameIterator { NonnullRefPtr { status.iterator.cursor() }, static_cast<size_t>(seeked.byte_position), FrameIterator::Resynchronize::Yes };
    status.next_timestamp = seeked.timestamp;
    return DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition;
}

DecoderErrorOr<AK::Duration> ADTSDemuxer::total_duration()
{
    return m_reader.duration();
}

DecoderErrorOr<AK::Duration> ADTSDemuxer::duration_of_track(Track const&)
{
    return total_duration();
}

DemuxerScanState const& ADTSDemuxer::scan_state() const
{
    return m_buffered_scan_thread->main_thread_state();
}

void ADTSDemuxer::set_scan_state_change_handler(ScanStateChangeHandler handler)
{
    m_buffered_scan_thread->set_change_handler([handler = move(handler)] {
        if (handler)
            handler(TimeRanges {});
    });
}

void ADTSDemuxer::set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(Track const&)
{
    track_status().iterator.cursor().abort();
}

void ADTSDemuxer::reset_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(Track const&)
{
    track_status().iterator.cursor().reset_abort();
}

void ADTSDemuxer::set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(Track const&, ReadBlockedChangeHandler handler)
{
    track_status().iterator.cursor().set_blocked_change_handler(move(handler));
}

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/Containers/ADTS/FrameHeader.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibMedia/Containers/ADTS/FrameHeader.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/BitReader.h>

namespace Media::ADTS {

static constexpr u32 SAMPLING_RATES[16] = {
    96000, 88200, 64000, 48000, 44100, 32000, 24000, 22050,
    16000, 12000, 11025, 8000, 7350, 0, 0, 0
};

// Channel configuration zero leaves the channels to be described by a configuration that ADTS does
// not carry, so a frame using it says nothing about its own layout.
static constexpr u8 CHANNEL_COUNTS[8] = { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 };

Optional<FrameHeader> FrameHeader::parse(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    BitReader reader { bytes };
    if (reader.read_bits<u16>(SYNC_CODE_BIT_COUNT) != SYNC_CODE)
        return {};

    auto version = reader.read_bit() ? MPEGVersion::Version2 : MPEGVersion::Version4;

    if (reader.read_bits<u8>(2) != 0)
        return {};

    auto protection_absent = reader.read_bit();
    auto profile = reader.read_bits<u8>(2);

    auto sampling_frequency_index = reader.read_bits<u8>(4);
    auto sample_rate = SAMPLING_RATES[sampling_frequency_index];
    if (sample_rate == 0)
        return {};

    [[maybe_unused]] auto private_bit = reader.read_bit();

    auto channel_configuration = reader.read_bits<u8>(3);
    auto channel_count = CHANNEL_COUNTS[channel_configuration];
    if (channel_count == 0)
        return {};

    [[maybe_unused]] auto originality = reader.read_bit();
    [[maybe_unused]] auto home = reader.read_bit();
    [[maybe_unused]] auto copyright_identification_bit = reader.read_bit();
    [[maybe_unused]] auto copyright_identification_start = reader.read_bit();

    auto frame_byte_size = reader.read_bits<u16>(13);

    [[maybe_unused]] auto buffer_fullness = reader.read_bits<u16>(11);

    auto block_count = static_cast<u8>(reader.read_bits<u8>(2) + 1);

    if (reader.has_overrun())
        return {};

    auto header_byte_size = protection_absent ? SIZE : SIZE + CRC_SIZE;
    if (frame_byte_size <= header_byte_size)
        return {};

    return FrameHeader {
        .version = version,
        .audio_object_type = static_cast<u8>(profile + 1),
        .has_crc = !protection_absent,
        .sample_rate = sample_rate,
        .channel_count = channel_count,
        .block_count = block_count,
        .sample_count = static_cast<u16>(SAMPLES_PER_BLOCK * block_count),
        .frame_byte_size = frame_byte_size,
    };
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/Containers/ADTS/FrameHeader.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>

namespace Media::ADTS {

enum class MPEGVersion : u8 {
    Version2,
    Version4,
};

struct FrameHeader {
    static constexpr size_t SIZE = 7;
    static constexpr size_t CRC_SIZE = 2;
    static constexpr u8 SYNC_CODE_BIT_COUNT = 12;
    static constexpr u16 SYNC_CODE = 0b1111'1111'1111;
    static constexpr u16 SAMPLES_PER_BLOCK = 1024;

    MPEGVersion version { MPEGVersion::Version4 };
    u8 audio_object_type { 0 };
    bool has_crc { false };
    u32 sample_rate { 0 };
    u8 channel_count { 0 };
    u8 block_count { 1 };
    u16 sample_count { 0 };
    u16 frame_byte_size { 0 };

    // A frame carrying more than one block also carries the position of each one, so the frames a
    // reader can walk are the ones it can find the audio in.
    size_t payload_offset() const { return has_crc ? SIZE + CRC_SIZE : SIZE; }

    static constexpr bool has_sync_code(u16 value)
    {
        return (value >> (16 - SYNC_CODE_BIT_COUNT)) == SYNC_CODE;
    }

    static MEDIA_API Optional<FrameHeader> parse(ReadonlyBytes);
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/Containers/ADTS/Reader.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ADTS/Reader.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ID3.h>

namespace Media::ADTS {

static constexpr size_t SYNC_SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE = 4096;
static constexpr size_t FRAME_COUNT_RULING_OUT_A_FALSE_SYNC_CODE = 3;

static constexpr size_t BITRATE_ESTIMATION_SCAN_BYTE_COUNT = 32 * KiB;

static DecoderErrorOr<size_t> read_available(MediaStreamCursor& cursor, size_t position, Bytes buffer)
{
    auto result = [&]() -> DecoderErrorOr<size_t> {
        TRY(cursor.seek_to_position(position));
        return cursor.read_into(buffer);
    }();
    if (result.is_error() && !is_stream_control_flow(result.error().category()))
        return 0;
    return result;
}

static DecoderErrorOr<bool> read_exact(MediaStreamCursor& cursor, size_t position, Bytes buffer)
{
    return TRY(read_available(cursor, position, buffer)) == buffer.size();
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameIterator::Frame>> FrameIterator::read_frame()
{
    Array<u8, FrameHeader::SIZE> frame_header_data;
    if (!TRY(read_exact(*m_cursor, m_position, frame_header_data)))
        return Optional<Frame> {};

    auto header = FrameHeader::parse(frame_header_data);
    if (!header.has_value())
        return Optional<Frame> {};

    Frame frame { m_position, *header };
    m_position += header->frame_byte_size;
    return frame;
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameIterator::Frame>> FrameIterator::next()
{
    auto frame = TRY(read_frame());
    if (frame.has_value() || m_resynchronize == Resynchronize::No)
        return frame;

    auto boundary = TRY(Reader::find_frame_boundary_at_or_after(m_cursor, m_position + 1, NumericLimits<size_t>::max()));
    if (!boundary.has_value())
        return Optional<Frame> {};

    m_position = *boundary;
    return read_frame();
}

DecoderErrorOr<FixedArray<u8>> FrameIterator::read_frame_data(Frame const& frame)
{
    auto payload_offset = frame.header.payload_offset();
    VERIFY(frame.header.frame_byte_size > payload_offset);

    TRY(m_cursor->seek_to_position(frame.position + payload_offset));
    return TRY(m_cursor->read_bytes(frame.header.frame_byte_size - payload_offset));
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameIterator::FrameWithData>> FrameIterator::read_next_frame()
{
    auto frame = TRY(next());
    if (!frame.has_value())
        return Optional<FrameWithData> {};
    auto data = read_frame_data(*frame);
    if (data.is_error()) {
        m_position = frame->position;
        return data.release_error();
    }
    return FrameWithData { frame->header, data.release_value() };
}

static DecoderErrorOr<size_t> skip_identification_tags(MediaStreamCursor& cursor)
{
    size_t position = 0;
    while (true) {
        Array<u8, ID3::VERSION_2_HEADER_SIZE> tag_header;
        if (!TRY(read_exact(cursor, position, tag_header)))
            break;
        auto tag_size = ID3::version_2_tag_size(tag_header);
        if (!tag_size.has_value())
            break;
        position += *tag_size;
    }
    return position;
}

struct FrameScan {
    size_t position { 0 };
    FrameHeader header;
    size_t frame_count { 0 };
    u64 sample_count { 0 };
    size_t byte_count { 0 };
};

static DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameScan>> scan_frames_at(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const& cursor, size_t position)
{
    FrameIterator iterator { cursor, position, FrameIterator::Resynchronize::No };

    FrameScan scan;
    while (scan.frame_count < FRAME_COUNT_RULING_OUT_A_FALSE_SYNC_CODE || scan.byte_count < BITRATE_ESTIMATION_SCAN_BYTE_COUNT) {
        auto frame = TRY(iterator.next());
        if (!frame.has_value())
            break;
        if (scan.frame_count == 0) {
            scan.position = frame->position;
            scan.header = frame->header;
        }
        scan.frame_count++;
        scan.sample_count += frame->header.sample_count;
        scan.byte_count += frame->header.frame_byte_size;
    }

    if (scan.frame_count == 0)
        return Optional<FrameScan> {};
    return scan;
}

// The length of a frame differs from one to the next, and so does the count of blocks within it,
// but the rest of what a header describes holds for all the frames of a stream.
static bool headers_describe_the_same_stream(FrameHeader const& first, FrameHeader const& second)
{
    return first.version == second.version
        && first.audio_object_type == second.audio_object_type
        && first.sample_rate == second.sample_rate
        && first.channel_count == second.channel_count;
}

static DecoderErrorOr<bool> begins_a_frame(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const& cursor, size_t position)
{
    return TRY(FrameIterator(cursor, position, FrameIterator::Resynchronize::No).next()).has_value();
}

static DecoderErrorOr<bool> begins_a_frame_sequence(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const& cursor, size_t position)
{
    FrameIterator iterator { cursor, position, FrameIterator::Resynchronize::No };

    Optional<FrameHeader> previous_header;
    for (size_t frame_count = 0; frame_count < FRAME_COUNT_RULING_OUT_A_FALSE_SYNC_CODE; frame_count++) {
        auto frame = TRY(iterator.next());
        if (!frame.has_value())
            return false;
        if (previous_header.has_value() && !headers_describe_the_same_stream(*previous_header, frame->header))
            return false;
        previous_header = frame->header;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool has_sync_code_at(ReadonlyBytes bytes, size_t index)
{
    if (index + 2 > bytes.size())
        return false;
    return FrameHeader::has_sync_code(static_cast<u16>((bytes[index] << 8) | bytes[index + 1]));
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<size_t>> Reader::find_frame_boundary_at_or_after(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const& cursor, size_t start_byte, size_t upper_bound)
{
    auto scan_position = start_byte;

    Array<u8, SYNC_SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE> buffer;
    while (scan_position + FrameHeader::SIZE <= upper_bound) {
        auto chunk = buffer.span().trim(min(SYNC_SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE, upper_bound - scan_position));
        chunk = chunk.trim(TRY(read_available(*cursor, scan_position, chunk)));
        if (chunk.size() < 2)
            break;

        for (size_t index = 0; index + 1 < chunk.size(); index++) {
            if (!has_sync_code_at(chunk, index))
                continue;
            if (TRY(begins_a_frame_sequence(cursor, scan_position + index)))
                return Optional<size_t> { scan_position + index };
        }

        if (chunk.size() < SYNC_SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE)
            break;
        scan_position += chunk.size() - 1;
    }

    return Optional<size_t> {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<size_t>> Reader::find_frame_boundary_at_or_before(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const& cursor, size_t target_byte, size_t lower_bound, size_t upper_bound)
{
    VERIFY(target_byte <= upper_bound);

    auto chunk_end = min(target_byte + 2, upper_bound);

    Array<u8, SYNC_SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE> buffer;
    while (chunk_end >= lower_bound + 2) {
        auto chunk_start = chunk_end > SYNC_SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE ? chunk_end - SYNC_SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE : 0;
        chunk_start = max(chunk_start, lower_bound);

        auto chunk = buffer.span().trim(chunk_end - chunk_start);
        if (!TRY(read_exact(*cursor, chunk_start, chunk)))
            return Optional<size_t> {};

        for (size_t index = chunk.size(); index-- > 0;) {
            if (!has_sync_code_at(chunk, index))
                continue;
            auto candidate = chunk_start + index;
            if (candidate > target_byte)
                continue;
            if (TRY(begins_a_frame_sequence(cursor, candidate)))
                return Optional<size_t> { candidate };
        }

        if (chunk_start == lower_bound)
            break;
        chunk_end = chunk_start + 1;
    }

    return Optional<size_t> {};
}

static DecoderErrorOr<Optional<size_t>> find_first_frame_position(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const& cursor)
{
    auto position = TRY(skip_identification_tags(*cursor));
    if (TRY(begins_a_frame(cursor, position)))
        return Optional<size_t> { position };
    return Reader::find_frame_boundary_at_or_after(cursor, position, position + Reader::MAXIMUM_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTE_COUNT);
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<Reader>> Reader::from_stream(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const& cursor)
{
    auto position = TRY(find_first_frame_position(cursor));
    if (!position.has_value())
        return Optional<Reader> {};

    auto scan = TRY(scan_frames_at(cursor, *position));
    if (!scan.has_value())
        return Optional<Reader> {};

    Reader reader;
    reader.m_frame_header = scan->header;
    reader.m_first_frame_position = scan->position;

    if (scan->byte_count == 0)
        return reader;

    auto audio_byte_count = scan->byte_count;
    if (auto stream_byte_count = cursor->size(); stream_byte_count.has_value() && *stream_byte_count > reader.m_first_frame_position)
        audio_byte_count = max(audio_byte_count, static_cast<size_t>(*stream_byte_count) - reader.m_first_frame_position);

    auto estimated_sample_count = static_cast<u64>(audio_byte_count) * scan->sample_count / scan->byte_count;
    reader.m_duration = AK::Duration::from_time_units(static_cast<i64>(estimated_sample_count), 1, scan->header.sample_rate);
    return reader;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/FixedArray.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ADTS/FrameHeader.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>
#include <LibMedia/MediaStream.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/DecoderError.h>

namespace Media::ADTS {

class MEDIA_API FrameIterator {
public:
    struct Frame {
        size_t position { 0 };
        FrameHeader header;
    };

    struct FrameWithData {
        FrameHeader header;
        // The audio of the frame, without the framing that ADTS wraps it in. A decoder is configured
        // from the configuration record the header implies, so it is handed the same access units that
        // a stream carrying that record in its container would hand it.
        FixedArray<u8> data;
    };

    // Whether to scan forward for a sync code upon finding an invalid frame.
    enum class Resynchronize : bool {
        No,
        Yes,
    };

    FrameIterator(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> cursor, size_t position, Resynchronize resynchronize)
        : m_cursor(move(cursor))
        , m_position(position)
        , m_resynchronize(resynchronize)
    {
    }

    DecoderErrorOr<Optional<Frame>> next();
    // Moves past the frame only once its data has been read, so an interrupted read can be retried.
    DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameWithData>> read_next_frame();

    size_t position() const { return m_position; }
    MediaStreamCursor& cursor() { return *m_cursor; }

private:
    DecoderErrorOr<Optional<Frame>> read_frame();
    DecoderErrorOr<FixedArray<u8>> read_frame_data(Frame const&);

    NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> m_cursor;
    size_t m_position { 0 };
    Resynchronize m_resynchronize { Resynchronize::No };
};

class MEDIA_API Reader {
public:
    // Junk ahead of the audio is left over from a stream that was cut, so a bound only has to be far
    // enough out to cover that, and it keeps a stream that only claims to hold audio from being read
    // in full. FFmpeg and Firefox both settled on the same distance.
    static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTE_COUNT = 64 * KiB;

    // Finds the position of a frame that begins a run of valid frames, so that a false sync code in
    // the middle of a stream is not mistaken for a frame boundary.
    static DecoderErrorOr<Optional<size_t>> find_frame_boundary_at_or_after(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const&, size_t start_byte, size_t upper_bound);
    static DecoderErrorOr<Optional<size_t>> find_frame_boundary_at_or_before(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const&, size_t target_byte, size_t lower_bound, size_t upper_bound);

    // Returns nothing until enough frames are available to tell audio apart from a false sync code.
    static DecoderErrorOr<Optional<Reader>> from_stream(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const&);

    size_t first_frame_position() const { return m_first_frame_position; }
    FrameHeader const& frame_header() const { return m_frame_header; }

    // ADTS states nothing about the length of the stream, so this is always extrapolated from the
    // bitrate of the frames at the front of it.
    AK::Duration duration() const { return m_duration; }

private:
    size_t m_first_frame_position { 0 };
    FrameHeader m_frame_header;
    AK::Duration m_duration { AK::Duration::zero() };
};

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/EnumBits.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibMedia/MediaStream.h>

namespace Media {

enum class CachedRangeChange : u8 {
    Start = 1 << 0,
    End = 1 << 1,
};

AK_ENUM_BITWISE_OPERATORS(CachedRangeChange);

struct CachedByteRange {
    size_t byte_start { 0 };
    size_t byte_end { 0 };

    constexpr CachedByteRange(size_t start, size_t end)
        : byte_start(start)
        , byte_end(end)
    {
    }
};

// Keeps one entry per buffered byte range from one scan to the next, so that a scan only looks again at the ends
// a range grew or shrank at.
template<typename CachedRange>
class CachedByteRanges {
public:
    // Reconciles the incoming byte ranges with the cached ranges in lockstep; both are sorted by position.
    template<typename OnChanged>
    void update(Vector<MediaStream::ByteRange> const& byte_ranges, OnChanged on_changed)
    {
        size_t cached_index = 0;
        size_t byte_index = 0;
        while (byte_index < byte_ranges.size()) {
            auto const& byte_range = byte_ranges[byte_index];
            if (cached_index < m_ranges.size()) {
                auto& cached = m_ranges[cached_index];
                // If the cached range doesn't have the same start byte as the incoming range, then we need to update
                // the start of the cached range if possible. If that's not possible, then we discard the cached range
                // if it's earlier, or insert a new one if it's later.
                if (cached.byte_start != byte_range.start) {
                    if (cached.byte_end == byte_range.end) {
                        cached.byte_start = byte_range.start;
                        on_changed(cached, CachedRangeChange::Start);
                        cached_index++;
                        byte_index++;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (cached.byte_end < byte_range.end) {
                        cached = CachedRange { byte_range.start, byte_range.end };
                        on_changed(cached, CachedRangeChange::Start | CachedRangeChange::End);
                        cached_index++;
                        byte_index++;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (cached.byte_start < byte_range.start) {
                        m_ranges.remove(cached_index);
                    } else {
                        m_ranges.insert(cached_index, CachedRange { byte_range.start, byte_range.end });
                        auto& inserted = m_ranges[cached_index];
                        on_changed(inserted, CachedRangeChange::Start | CachedRangeChange::End);
                        cached_index++;
                        byte_index++;
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                // If we're here, the cached range's start matches the incoming one, so we only need to update the end.
                if (cached.byte_end != byte_range.end) {
                    cached.byte_end = byte_range.end;
                    on_changed(cached, CachedRangeChange::End);
                }
                cached_index++;
                byte_index++;
            } else {
                // We have new byte ranges on the end with no equivalent cached ranges, append them.
                m_ranges.append(CachedRange { byte_range.start, byte_range.end });
                auto& appended = m_ranges.last();
                on_changed(appended, CachedRangeChange::Start | CachedRangeChange::End);
                cached_index++;
                byte_index++;
            }
        }

        // Remove any leftover cached ranges past the end.
        if (cached_index < m_ranges.size())
            m_ranges.remove(cached_index, m_ranges.size() - cached_index);
    }

    Vector<CachedRange> const& ranges() const { return m_ranges; }

private:
    Vector<CachedRange> m_ranges;
};

}

#include <AK/Checked.h>
#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <LibMedia/Codecs/FLAC.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/FLAC/FLACDemuxer.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodedFrame.h>

namespace Media::FLAC {

// Probing is capped so that a stream whose frames defy every estimate still gets walked to its target.
static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_SEEK_PROBE_COUNT = 16;
// A scan looks for a frame within this distance of a range's ends, which bounds the work a range of junk costs on
// every change to the buffered data. Any frame of the format heads within it.
static constexpr size_t SCAN_WINDOW_BYTE_COUNT = 4 * MiB;

bool FLACDemuxer::supports_container_mime_type(ContainerMimeType mime_type)
{
    return mime_type.container_id == ContainerID::FLAC && mime_type.media_type == ContainerMediaType::Audio;
}

bool FLACDemuxer::supports_codec_in_container(ContainerID container_id, CodecID codec_id)
{
    return container_id == ContainerID::FLAC && codec_id == CodecID::FLAC;
}

static Track create_track(Reader const& reader)
{
    auto const& stream_info = reader.stream_info();
    Track track { TrackType::Audio, 0, Track::Kind::Main, {}, {} };
    track.set_audio_data({ .sample_specification = Audio::SampleSpecification(stream_info.sample_rate, Codecs::FLAC::channel_map(stream_info.channel_count)) });
    track.set_parsed_codec(ParsedCodec { CodecID::FLAC });
    return track;
}

DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Demuxer>> FLACDemuxer::from_stream(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStream> const& stream)
{
    auto reader = TRY(Reader::from_stream(stream->create_cursor()));
    auto demuxer = make_ref_counted<FLACDemuxer>(stream, reader, create_track(reader));
    demuxer->start_buffered_scan_thread();
    return demuxer;
}

FLACDemuxer::FLACDemuxer(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStream> const& stream, Reader reader, Track track)
    : m_stream(stream)
    , m_reader(move(reader))
    , m_track(move(track))
{
}

FLACDemuxer::~FLACDemuxer()
{
    if (m_buffered_scan_thread != nullptr)
        m_buffered_scan_thread->shutdown();
}

void FLACDemuxer::start_buffered_scan_thread()
{
    auto scan_cursor = m_stream->create_cursor();
    scan_cursor->set_is_blocking(false);

    DemuxerScanState initial_state;
    initial_state.duration = m_reader.duration();

    m_buffered_scan_thread = DemuxerScanThread<BufferedScanPayload>::start(m_stream, move(initial_state),
        BufferedScanPayload {
            .scanner = FrameIterator { move(scan_cursor), m_reader.frame_sync(), m_reader.first_frame_position(), FrameIterator::Resynchronize::Yes },
            .scanned_ranges = {},
            .anchors = m_scanned_anchors,
        },
        [reader = m_reader](MediaStream::Availability const& availability, BufferedScanPayload& payload) {
            auto const& stream_info = reader.stream_info();
            payload.scanned_ranges.update(availability.byte_ranges, [&](ScannedByteRange& range, CachedRangeChange change) {
                auto scan_start = max(range.byte_start, reader.first_frame_position());
                auto reaches_stream_end = availability.expected_size.has_value() && range.byte_end >= *availability.expected_size;
                if (has_flag(change, CachedRangeChange::Start) || !range.first_frame.has_value()) {
                    range.first_frame = {};
                    payload.scanner.set_position(scan_start);
                    auto resynced = payload.scanner.resync_forward(min(range.byte_end, scan_start + SCAN_WINDOW_BYTE_COUNT));
                    if (!resynced.is_error() && resynced.value()) {
                        if (auto frame = payload.scanner.read_next_frame(); !frame.is_error())
                            range.first_frame = SeekAnchor { frame.value().header.position, frame.value().header.sample_number };
                    }
                }
                if (has_flag(change, CachedRangeChange::End) || !range.end.has_value()) {
                    range.end = {};
                    auto search_start = max(scan_start, range.byte_end > SCAN_WINDOW_BYTE_COUNT ? range.byte_end - SCAN_WINDOW_BYTE_COUNT : 0);
                    // The last frame of a range is complete only when the stream ends with it.
                    if (auto header = payload.scanner.find_last_header_before(range.byte_end, search_start); header.has_value()) {
                        if (reaches_stream_end)
                            range.end = SeekAnchor { range.byte_end, header->sample_number + header->block_size };
                        else
                            range.end = SeekAnchor { header->position, header->sample_number };
                    }
                    // A sample past the stream's last is a false sync code.
                    if (stream_info.total_sample_count != 0 && range.end.has_value() && range.end->sample > stream_info.total_sample_count)
                        range.end = {};
                }
            });

            auto time_of = [&](u64 sample) { return AK::Duration::from_time_units(AK::clamp_to<i64>(sample), 1, stream_info.sample_rate); };
            BufferedRangesScan scan;
            Vector<SeekAnchor> anchors;
            for (auto const& range : payload.scanned_ranges.ranges()) {
                auto has_samples = range.first_frame.has_value() && range.end.has_value() && range.first_frame->sample < range.end->sample;
                scan.last_byte_range_has_samples = has_samples;
                if (!has_samples)
                    continue;
                scan.time_ranges.add_range(time_of(range.first_frame->sample), time_of(range.end->sample));
                anchors.append(*range.first_frame);
                anchors.append(*range.end);
            }
            {
                MutexLocker locker { payload.anchors->mutex };
                payload.anchors->anchors = move(anchors);
            }
            return DemuxerScanState::create_from_track_scans({ move(scan) }, reader.duration(), availability.closing_bytes_are_available());
        });
}

FLACDemuxer::TrackStatus& FLACDemuxer::track_status()
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_track_status_mutex };
    VERIFY(m_track_status.has_value());
    return *m_track_status;
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> FLACDemuxer::create_context_for_track(Track const& track)
{
    VERIFY(track == m_track);

    auto cursor = m_stream->create_cursor();
    cursor->set_is_blocking(true);

    MutexLocker locker { m_track_status_mutex };
    VERIFY(!m_track_status.has_value());
    m_track_status = TrackStatus { FrameIterator { move(cursor), m_reader.frame_sync(), m_reader.first_frame_position(), FrameIterator::Resynchronize::Yes }, true };
    return {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<Vector<Track>> FLACDemuxer::get_tracks_for_type(TrackType type)
{
    Vector<Track> tracks;
    if (type == TrackType::Audio)
        tracks.append(m_track);
    return tracks;
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<Track>> FLACDemuxer::get_preferred_track_for_type(TrackType type)
{
    if (type != TrackType::Audio)
        return Optional<Track> {};
    return Optional<Track> { m_track };
}

DecoderErrorOr<CodedFrame> FLACDemuxer::get_next_sample_for_track(Track const& track)
{
    VERIFY(track == m_track);
    auto& status = track_status();
    auto sample_rate = m_reader.stream_info().sample_rate;

    auto frame = TRY(status.iterator.read_next_frame());

    Optional<FixedArray<u8>> codec_configuration;
    if (status.needs_codec_configuration) {
        status.needs_codec_configuration = false;
        codec_configuration = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(FixedArray<u8>::create(m_reader.codec_initialization_data()));
    }

    auto timestamp = AK::Duration::from_time_units(AK::clamp_to<i64>(frame.header.sample_number), 1, sample_rate);
    auto duration = AK::Duration::from_time_units(frame.header.block_size, 1, sample_rate);
    return CodedFrame(CodecID::FLAC, timestamp, timestamp, duration, FrameFlags::Keyframe, move(frame.data), move(codec_configuration));
}

AK::Duration FLACDemuxer::select_fast_seek_target_for_track(Track const&, AK::Duration target, SeekMode)
{
    return target;
}

static DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameIterator::Frame>> read_frame_at_or_after(FrameIterator const& iterator, size_t position)
{
    FrameIterator probe = iterator;
    probe.set_position(position);
    if (!TRY(probe.resync_forward()))
        return Optional<FrameIterator::Frame> {};
    auto frame = probe.read_next_frame();
    if (frame.is_error()) {
        if (frame.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream)
            return Optional<FrameIterator::Frame> {};
        return frame.release_error();
    }
    return frame.release_value();
}

DecoderErrorOr<size_t> FLACDemuxer::find_frame_position_for_sample(FrameIterator& iterator, u64 target_sample)
{
    auto const& stream_info = m_reader.stream_info();
    auto stream_size = m_stream->expected_size();

    // The anchors are the frames known to lie closest to the target on either side.
    SeekAnchor low { m_reader.first_frame_position(), 0 };
    Optional<SeekAnchor> high;
    auto consider = [&](SeekAnchor anchor) {
        if (stream_size.has_value() && anchor.byte > *stream_size)
            return;
        if (anchor.sample <= target_sample) {
            if (anchor.sample >= low.sample)
                low = anchor;
        } else if (!high.has_value() || anchor.sample < high->sample) {
            high = anchor;
        }
    };
    if (stream_size.has_value() && stream_info.total_sample_count != 0)
        consider({ static_cast<size_t>(*stream_size), stream_info.total_sample_count });
    for (auto const& point : m_reader.seek_points()) {
        Checked<size_t> byte = m_reader.first_frame_position();
        byte += point.byte_offset;
        if (!byte.has_overflow())
            consider({ byte.value(), point.sample_number });
    }
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_scanned_anchors->mutex };
        for (auto const& anchor : m_scanned_anchors->anchors)
            consider(anchor);
    }
    if (high.has_value() && high->byte <= low.byte)
        high = {};

    u64 underestimate_target_by = stream_info.sample_rate / 2;
    Optional<FrameIterator::Frame> overshot_frame;
    for (size_t probe = 0; probe < MAXIMUM_SEEK_PROBE_COUNT && target_sample - low.sample > underestimate_target_by; probe++) {
        if (high.has_value() && high->byte <= low.byte + 1)
            break;
        auto aim = target_sample - underestimate_target_by;
        size_t guess;
        if (overshot_frame.has_value()) {
            // If we overshot the target, jump back based on the found frame's bitrate.
            auto const& header = overshot_frame->header;
            auto bytes_per_sample = static_cast<double>(overshot_frame->data.size()) / header.block_size;
            auto step_back = static_cast<size_t>(static_cast<double>(header.sample_number - aim) * bytes_per_sample);
            guess = header.position > step_back ? header.position - step_back : 0;
        } else if (high.has_value() && high->sample > low.sample) {
            auto sample_fraction = static_cast<double>(aim - low.sample) / static_cast<double>(high->sample - low.sample);
            guess = low.byte + static_cast<size_t>(static_cast<double>(high->byte - low.byte) * sample_fraction);
        } else {
            break;
        }
        guess = clamp(guess, low.byte + 1, high.has_value() ? high->byte - 1 : NumericLimits<size_t>::max());

        auto frame = TRY(read_frame_at_or_after(iterator, guess));
        if (!frame.has_value())
            break;

        auto const& header = frame->header;
        if (header.sample_number <= target_sample && target_sample < header.sample_number + header.block_size)
            return header.position;
        if (header.sample_number < target_sample) {
            low = SeekAnchor { frame->end_position(), header.sample_number + header.block_size };
            overshot_frame = {};
        } else {
            high = SeekAnchor { header.position, header.sample_number };
            overshot_frame = frame.release_value();
            underestimate_target_by *= 2;
        }
    }

    FrameIterator walker = iterator;
    walker.set_position(low.byte);
    while (true) {
        auto frame = walker.read_next_frame();
        if (frame.is_error()) {
            if (frame.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream)
                return walker.position();
            return frame.release_error();
        }
        if (frame.value().header.sample_number + frame.value().header.block_size > target_sample)
            return frame.value().header.position;
    }
}

DecoderErrorOr<DemuxerSeekResult> FLACDemuxer::seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(Track const& track, AK::Duration timestamp, DemuxerSeekOptions options)
{
    VERIFY(track == m_track);
    auto& status = track_status();

    if (has_flag(options, DemuxerSeekOptions::NeedCodecConfiguration))
        status.needs_codec_configuration = true;

    auto target_sample = static_cast<u64>(max<i64>(0, timestamp.to_time_units(1, m_reader.stream_info().sample_rate)));
    status.iterator.set_position(TRY(find_frame_position_for_sample(status.iterator, target_sample)));
    return DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition;
}

DecoderErrorOr<AK::Duration> FLACDemuxer::total_duration()
{
    return m_reader.duration();
}

DecoderErrorOr<AK::Duration> FLACDemuxer::duration_of_track(Track const&)
{
    return total_duration();
}

DemuxerScanState const& FLACDemuxer::scan_state() const
{
    return m_buffered_scan_thread->main_thread_state();
}

void FLACDemuxer::set_scan_state_change_handler(ScanStateChangeHandler handler)
{
    m_buffered_scan_thread->set_change_handler([handler = move(handler)] {
        if (handler)
            handler(TimeRanges {});
    });
}

void FLACDemuxer::set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(Track const&)
{
    track_status().iterator.cursor().abort();
}

void FLACDemuxer::reset_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(Track const&)
{
    track_status().iterator.cursor().reset_abort();
}

void FLACDemuxer::set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(Track const&, ReadBlockedChangeHandler handler)
{
    track_status().iterator.cursor().set_blocked_change_handler(move(handler));
}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <LibMedia/ContainerID.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/CachedByteRanges.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/FLAC/Reader.h>
#include <LibMedia/Demuxer.h>
#include <LibMedia/DemuxerScanThread.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>
#include <LibMedia/Forward.h>

namespace Media::FLAC {

class MEDIA_API FLACDemuxer final : public Demuxer {
public:
    static DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Demuxer>> from_stream(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStream> const&);
    static bool supports_container_mime_type(ContainerMimeType);
    static bool supports_codec_in_container(ContainerID, CodecID);

    FLACDemuxer(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStream> const&, Reader, Track);
    ~FLACDemuxer();

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<void> create_context_for_track(Track const&) override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<Vector<Track>> get_tracks_for_type(TrackType) override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<Optional<Track>> get_preferred_track_for_type(TrackType) override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<CodedFrame> get_next_sample_for_track(Track const&) override;
    virtual AK::Duration select_fast_seek_target_for_track(Track const&, AK::Duration target, SeekMode) override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<DemuxerSeekResult> seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(Track const&, AK::Duration timestamp, DemuxerSeekOptions) override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<AK::Duration> duration_of_track(Track const&) override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<AK::Duration> total_duration() override;
    virtual DemuxerScanState const& scan_state() const LIFETIME_BOUND override;
    virtual void set_scan_state_change_handler(ScanStateChangeHandler) override;
    virtual void set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(Track const&) override;
    virtual void reset_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(Track const&) override;
    virtual void set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(Track const&, ReadBlockedChangeHandler) override;

private:
    struct SeekAnchor {
        size_t byte { 0 };
        u64 sample { 0 };
    };

    // Frame positions the scan has seen, so that a seek into buffered data probes close by and fetches nothing.
    struct ScannedAnchors : public AtomicRefCounted<ScannedAnchors> {
        Mutex mutex;
        Vector<SeekAnchor> anchors;
    };

    struct ScannedByteRange : public CachedByteRange {
        using CachedByteRange::CachedByteRange;

        Optional<SeekAnchor> first_frame;
        Optional<SeekAnchor> end;
    };

    struct BufferedScanPayload {
        FrameIterator scanner;
        CachedByteRanges<ScannedByteRange> scanned_ranges;
        NonnullRefPtr<ScannedAnchors> anchors;
    };

    struct TrackStatus {
        FrameIterator iterator;
        bool needs_codec_configuration { true };
    };

    void start_buffered_scan_thread();
    TrackStatus& track_status();
    DecoderErrorOr<size_t> find_frame_position_for_sample(FrameIterator&, u64 target_sample);

    NonnullRefPtr<MediaStream> m_stream;
    Reader m_reader;
    Track m_track;
    RefPtr<DemuxerScanThread<BufferedScanPayload>> m_buffered_scan_thread;
    NonnullRefPtr<ScannedAnchors> m_scanned_anchors { make_ref_counted<ScannedAnchors>() };
    Mutex m_track_status_mutex;
    Optional<TrackStatus> m_track_status;
};

}

/*

#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <LibMedia/Codecs/FLAC.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/FLAC/Reader.h>
#include <LibMedia/Containers/ID3.h>

namespace Media::FLAC {

static constexpr size_t SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE = 4 * KiB;
// No frame of the largest block, channel count and bit depth the format allows comes near this.
static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_FRAME_SIZE = 4 * MiB;
// Junk between the metadata and the first frame is covered within this distance.
static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTE_COUNT = 64 * KiB;
static constexpr size_t SEEK_POINT_SIZE = 18;
// A seek point a second for eighteen hours; a table claiming more is not read any further.
static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_SEEK_POINT_COUNT = 64 * KiB;
static constexpr u64 PLACEHOLDER_SEEK_POINT_SAMPLE_NUMBER = NumericLimits<u64>::max();
static constexpr size_t ID3_VERSION_1_TAG_SIZE = 128;

namespace {

enum class MetadataBlockType : u8 {
    StreamInfo = 0,
    SeekTable = 3,
};

}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameHeader>> FrameIterator::parse_header_at(size_t position)
{
    if (m_cursor->seek_to_position(position).is_error())
        return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
    auto frame_info = TRY(Codecs::FLAC::parse_frame_header(*m_cursor, m_sync.sync_code, m_sync.fixed_block_size));
    if (!frame_info.has_value())
        return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
    return FrameHeader { position, m_cursor->position() - position, frame_info->sample_number, frame_info->block_size };
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameHeader>> FrameIterator::find_header_at_or_after(size_t position, size_t bound)
{
    u8 sync_low_byte = m_sync.sync_code & 0xFF;
    // The chunks overlap by a byte so that a sync code split between two is seen.
    Array<u8, SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE + 1> chunk;
    auto chunk_start = position;
    while (chunk_start + 1 < bound) {
        auto chunk_size = min(chunk.size(), bound - chunk_start);
        TRY(m_cursor->seek_to_position(chunk_start));
        auto read_count = TRY(m_cursor->read_into(chunk.span().trim(chunk_size)));
        if (read_count < 2)
            return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < read_count; i++) {
            if (chunk[i] != 0xFF || chunk[i + 1] != sync_low_byte)
                continue;
            if (auto header = TRY(parse_header_at(chunk_start + i)); header.has_value())
                return header;
        }
        chunk_start += read_count - 1;
    }
    return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameHeader>> FrameIterator::find_header_before(size_t bound, size_t lower_bound)
{
    u8 sync_low_byte = m_sync.sync_code & 0xFF;
    Array<u8, SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE + 1> chunk;
    auto chunk_end = bound;
    while (chunk_end > lower_bound + 1) {
        auto chunk_start = chunk_end - lower_bound > chunk.size() ? chunk_end - chunk.size() : lower_bound;
        auto chunk_size = chunk_end - chunk_start;
        TRY(m_cursor->seek_to_position(chunk_start));
        auto read_count = TRY(m_cursor->read_into(chunk.span().trim(chunk_size)));
        if (read_count != chunk_size)
            return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
        for (size_t i = chunk_size - 1; i-- > 0;) {
            if (chunk[i] != 0xFF || chunk[i + 1] != sync_low_byte)
                continue;
            auto header = TRY(parse_header_at(chunk_start + i));
            if (header.has_value() && header->position + header->byte_size <= bound)
                return header;
        }
        if (chunk_start == lower_bound)
            break;
        chunk_end = chunk_start + 1;
    }
    return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
}

// A damaged frame fails its CRC, so the frame after it is told by its place in the sequence instead, with the frame
// after that confirming it.
DecoderErrorOr<bool> FrameIterator::frame_follows(FrameHeader const& header, FrameHeader const& candidate)
{
    if (candidate.sample_number <= header.sample_number)
        return false;
    if (candidate.sample_number == header.sample_number + header.block_size)
        return true;
    auto following = TRY(find_header_at_or_after(candidate.position + candidate.byte_size, candidate.position + MAXIMUM_FRAME_SIZE));
    return following.has_value() && following->sample_number == candidate.sample_number + candidate.block_size;
}

DecoderErrorOr<bool> FrameIterator::resync_forward(size_t bound)
{
    auto header_or_error = find_header_at_or_after(m_position, bound);
    if (header_or_error.is_error()) {
        if (header_or_error.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream)
            return false;
        return header_or_error.release_error();
    }
    if (!header_or_error.value().has_value())
        return false;
    m_position = header_or_error.value()->position;
    return true;
}

DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameIterator::Frame>> FrameIterator::read_frame_at(FrameHeader const& header)
{
    u8 sync_low_byte = m_sync.sync_code & 0xFF;
    auto frame_start = header.position;
    auto limit = frame_start + MAXIMUM_FRAME_SIZE;

    ByteBuffer frame_bytes;
    // The next frame's header cannot begin inside this frame's header or its two CRC bytes.
    auto scan_offset = max<size_t>(header.byte_size, 2);
    while (true) {
        auto read_position = frame_start + frame_bytes.size();
        if (read_position >= limit)
            return Optional<Frame> {};

        auto chunk_size = min<size_t>(SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE, limit - read_position);
        auto scanned_size = frame_bytes.size();
        DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(frame_bytes.try_resize(scanned_size + chunk_size));
        TRY(m_cursor->seek_to_position(read_position));
        auto read_result = m_cursor->read_into(frame_bytes.span().slice(scanned_size));
        if (read_result.is_error()) {
            if (read_result.error().category() != DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream || scanned_size < header.byte_size)
                return read_result.release_error();
            frame_bytes.trim(scanned_size, true);
            break;
        }
        auto read_count = read_result.value();
        frame_bytes.trim(scanned_size + read_count, true);
        if (read_count == 0)
            return Optional<Frame> {};

        for (size_t i = scan_offset; i + 1 < frame_bytes.size(); i++) {
            if (frame_bytes[i] != 0xFF || frame_bytes[i + 1] != sync_low_byte)
                continue;
            auto candidate = TRY(parse_header_at(frame_start + i));
            if (!candidate.has_value())
                continue;
            u16 frame_crc = (frame_bytes[i - 2] << 8) | frame_bytes[i - 1];
            auto frame_is_intact = Codecs::FLAC::compute_frame_crc(frame_bytes.span().trim(i - 2)) == frame_crc;
            if (!frame_is_intact && !TRY(frame_follows(header, *candidate)))
                continue;
            return Frame { header, DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(FixedArray<u8>::create(frame_bytes.span().trim(i))) };
        }
        scan_offset = frame_bytes.size() - 1;
    }

    // The last frame of a stream runs to its end, less a tag written after the audio.
    if (frame_bytes.size() >= header.byte_size + ID3_VERSION_1_TAG_SIZE) {
        auto tag = frame_bytes.span().slice(frame_bytes.size() - ID3_VERSION_1_TAG_SIZE);
        if (StringView { tag.data(), 3 } == "TAG"sv)
            frame_bytes.trim(frame_bytes.size() - ID3_VERSION_1_TAG_SIZE, true);
    }
    return Frame { header, DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(FixedArray<u8>::create(frame_bytes.span())) };
}

Optional<FrameHeader> FrameIterator::find_last_header_before(size_t bound, size_t lower_bound)
{
    auto header_or_error = find_header_before(bound, lower_bound);
    if (header_or_error.is_error())
        return {};
    return header_or_error.release_value();
}

DecoderErrorOr<FrameIterator::Frame> FrameIterator::read_next_frame()
{
    auto position = m_position;
    while (true) {
        Optional<Frame> frame;
        if (auto header = TRY(parse_header_at(position)); header.has_value())
            frame = TRY(read_frame_at(*header));
        if (frame.has_value()) {
            m_position = frame->end_position();
            return frame.release_value();
        }

        // No frame heads the position, or what heads it has no end within a frame's reach, so it was not a header.
        if (m_resynchronize == Resynchronize::No)
            return DecoderError::corrupted("No FLAC frame at the expected position"sv);
        auto next_header = TRY(find_header_at_or_after(position + 1, NumericLimits<size_t>::max()));
        if (!next_header.has_value())
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "End of stream"sv);
        position = next_header->position;
    }
}

// Finds the first frame, which follows the metadata directly unless a writer left junk between them.
static DecoderErrorOr<FrameHeader> find_first_frame(MediaStreamCursor& cursor, size_t position, Codecs::FLAC::StreamInfo const& stream_info, FrameSync& frame_sync)
{
    auto header_at = [&](size_t candidate) -> DecoderErrorOr<Optional<FrameHeader>> {
        if (cursor.seek_to_position(candidate).is_error())
            return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
        auto sync_code_or_error = cursor.read_value<u16>();
        if (sync_code_or_error.is_error() || !Codecs::FLAC::is_sync_code(sync_code_or_error.value()))
            return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
        auto sync_code = sync_code_or_error.value();
        u16 fixed_block_size = (sync_code & 1) != 0 ? 0 : stream_info.maximum_block_size;
        if (cursor.seek_to_position(candidate).is_error())
            return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
        auto frame_info = TRY(Codecs::FLAC::parse_frame_header(cursor, sync_code, fixed_block_size));
        if (!frame_info.has_value())
            return Optional<FrameHeader> {};
        frame_sync = FrameSync { sync_code, fixed_block_size };
        return FrameHeader { candidate, cursor.position() - candidate, frame_info->sample_number, frame_info->block_size };
    };

    if (auto header = TRY(header_at(position)); header.has_value())
        return header.release_value();

    Array<u8, SCAN_CHUNK_SIZE + 1> chunk;
    auto chunk_start = position;
    auto bound = position + MAXIMUM_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTE_COUNT;
    while (chunk_start + 1 < bound) {
        TRY(cursor.seek_to_position(chunk_start));
        auto read_count = TRY(cursor.read_into(chunk.span().trim(min(chunk.size(), bound - chunk_start))));
        if (read_count < 2)
            break;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < read_count; i++) {
            if (chunk[i] != 0xFF || (chunk[i + 1] & 0xFE) != 0xF8)
                continue;
            if (auto header = TRY(header_at(chunk_start + i)); header.has_value())
                return header.release_value();
        }
        chunk_start += read_count - 1;
    }
    return DecoderError::corrupted("No FLAC frame follows the metadata"sv);
}

DecoderErrorOr<Reader> Reader::from_stream(NonnullRefPtr<MediaStreamCursor> const& cursor)
{
    size_t position = 0;
    Array<u8, ID3::VERSION_2_HEADER_SIZE> tag_header;
    TRY(cursor->seek_to_position(0));
    auto tag_header_read = cursor->read_into(tag_header.span());
    if (tag_header_read.is_error() || tag_header_read.value() != tag_header.size())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::UnrecognizedFormat, "Stream is too short to be FLAC"sv);
    if (auto tag_size = ID3::version_2_tag_size(tag_header); tag_size.has_value())
        position = *tag_size;

    Array<u8, 4> marker;
    TRY(cursor->seek_to_position(position));
    auto marker_read = cursor->read_into(marker.span());
    if (marker_read.is_error() || marker_read.value() != marker.size() || StringView { marker.data(), marker.size() } != "fLaC"sv)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::UnrecognizedFormat, "Stream does not begin with the FLAC marker"sv);
    position += marker.size();

    ByteBuffer codec_initialization_data;
    DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(codec_initialization_data.try_append("fLaC"sv.bytes()));
    Optional<Codecs::FLAC::StreamInfo> stream_info;
    Vector<SeekPoint> seek_points;
    while (true) {
        TRY(cursor->seek_to_position(position));
        auto block_header = TRY(cursor->read_value<u32>());
        auto is_last_block = (block_header >> 31) != 0;
        auto block_type = static_cast<MetadataBlockType>((block_header >> 24) & 0x7F);
        size_t block_size = block_header & 0xFFFFFF;
        auto block_body = position + sizeof(u32);

        if (!stream_info.has_value()) {
            if (block_type != MetadataBlockType::StreamInfo || block_size != Codecs::FLAC::STREAM_INFO_SIZE)
                return DecoderError::corrupted("FLAC stream does not begin with STREAMINFO"sv);
            Array<u8, Codecs::FLAC::STREAM_INFO_SIZE> block;
            TRY(cursor->read_until_filled(block.span()));
            stream_info = TRY(Codecs::FLAC::parse_stream_info(block));
            // The decoder's copy stands alone, so it is the last block.
            DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(codec_initialization_data.try_append(Array<u8, 4> { 0x80, 0x00, 0x00, Codecs::FLAC::STREAM_INFO_SIZE }.span()));
            DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(codec_initialization_data.try_append(block.span()));
        } else if (block_type == MetadataBlockType::SeekTable && seek_points.is_empty()) {
            if (block_size % SEEK_POINT_SIZE != 0)
                return DecoderError::corrupted("FLAC SEEKTABLE has a partial seek point"sv);
            auto seek_point_count = min(block_size / SEEK_POINT_SIZE, MAXIMUM_SEEK_POINT_COUNT);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < seek_point_count; i++) {
                auto sample_number = TRY(cursor->read_value<u64>());
                auto byte_offset = TRY(cursor->read_value<u64>());
                TRY(cursor->read_value<u16>()); // The samples in the frame, which the frame itself tells.
                if (sample_number != PLACEHOLDER_SEEK_POINT_SAMPLE_NUMBER)
                    DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(seek_points.try_append({ sample_number, byte_offset }));
            }
        }

        position = block_body + block_size;
        if (is_last_block)
            break;
    }

    FrameSync frame_sync { 0xFFF8, stream_info->maximum_block_size };
    auto first_frame_position = position;
    auto first_frame = find_first_frame(*cursor, position, *stream_info, frame_sync);
    if (!first_frame.is_error())
        first_frame_position = first_frame.value().position;
    else if (first_frame.error().category() != DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream)
        return first_frame.release_error();
    return Reader { *stream_info, frame_sync, first_frame_position, move(seek_points), move(codec_initialization_data) };
}

Reader::Reader(Codecs::FLAC::StreamInfo stream_info, FrameSync frame_sync, size_t first_frame_position, Vector<SeekPoint> seek_points, ByteBuffer codec_initialization_data)
    : m_stream_info(stream_info)
    , m_frame_sync(frame_sync)
    , m_first_frame_position(first_frame_position)
    , m_seek_points(move(seek_points))
    , m_codec_initialization_data(move(codec_initialization_data))
{
}

AK::Duration Reader::duration() const
{
    return AK::Duration::from_time_units(AK::clamp_to<i64>(m_stream_info.total_sample_count), 1, m_stream_info.sample_rate);
}

}

/*
