VideoProducerOutput DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::peek()
{
    auto locker = take_lock();
    VERIFY(!m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    note_consumer_activity_while_locked();
    auto output = peek_while_locked();
    m_downstream_needs_wake = is_waiting_for_data(output.status);
    return output;
}

bool DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::read_is_blocked_while_locked() const
{
    return m_demuxer_read_is_blocked.load() && !m_decoder_has_decode_in_progress;
}

VideoProducerOutput DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::peek_while_locked()
{
    // A read stops being reported as blocked before its unblocked handler sets a checkpoint, so the checkpoint is read
    // first.
    auto checkpoint = m_checkpoint.load();
    if (m_suspension_request == SuspensionRequest::FromConsumer)
        return { nullptr, PipelineStatus::Suspended, checkpoint };
    auto read_is_blocked = read_is_blocked_while_locked();
    if (m_last_processed_seek_id != m_seek_id)
        return { nullptr, read_is_blocked ? PipelineStatus::Blocked : PipelineStatus::Pending, checkpoint };
    if (!m_queue.is_empty())
        return { m_queue.head().frame, PipelineStatus::HaveData, checkpoint };
    if (m_current_halting_status == PipelineStatus::Pending && read_is_blocked)
        return { nullptr, PipelineStatus::Blocked, checkpoint };
    return { nullptr, m_current_halting_status, checkpoint };
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::consume()
{
    // Hold the frame until after the mutex is unlocked, or our pool slot freed callback may reentrantly lock.
    RefPtr<VideoFrame> frame;

    auto locker = take_lock();
    VERIFY(!m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    note_consumer_activity_while_locked();
    if (m_queue.is_empty())
        return;
    frame = m_queue.dequeue().frame;
    wake();
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::enter_halting_state(PipelineStatus status, Optional<DecoderError> error)
{
    VERIFY(!error.has_value() || !is_stream_control_flow(error->category()));

    VERIFY(status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream || status == PipelineStatus::Error);
    m_current_halting_status = status;
    dispatch_wake_if_needed_while_locked();
    if (error.has_value()) {
        invoke_on_main_thread_while_locked([error = error.release_value()](auto const& self) mutable {
            self->dispatch_error(move(error));
        });
    }
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::set_wake_handler(PipelineWakeHandler handler)
{
    m_wake_handler.set(move(handler));
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::dispatch_wake_if_needed_while_locked()
{
    if (!m_downstream_needs_wake)
        return;
    auto seek_id = m_seek_id.load();
    invoke_on_main_thread_while_locked([seek_id](auto& self) {
        if (self->m_seek_id != seek_id)
            return;
        self->m_wake_handler.dispatch();
    });
    m_downstream_needs_wake = false;
}

AK::Duration DecodedVideoProducer::select_fast_seek_target(AK::Duration timestamp, SeekMode mode)
{
    return m_thread_data->select_fast_seek_target(timestamp, mode);
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data)
{
    m_thread_data->seek(timestamp, invalidate_held_data);
}

DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::ThreadData(Core::EventLoop& main_thread_event_loop, NonnullRefPtr<Demuxer> const& demuxer, Track const& track, AK::Duration auto_suspend_idle_timeout)
    : m_main_thread_event_loop(main_thread_event_loop)
    , m_demuxer(demuxer)
    , m_track(track)
    , m_auto_suspend_idle_timeout(auto_suspend_idle_timeout)
{
    set_read_unblocked_handler(nullptr);
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::set_read_unblocked_handler(Function<void()> on_read_unblocked)
{
    m_demuxer->set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(m_track, [this, on_read_unblocked = move(on_read_unblocked)](ReadBlocked blocked) {
        m_demuxer_read_is_blocked.store(blocked == ReadBlocked::Yes);
        if (blocked == ReadBlocked::No && on_read_unblocked)
            on_read_unblocked();
        dispatch_wake_later();
    });
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::set_checkpoint(PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint)
{
    m_checkpoint.store(checkpoint);
    dispatch_wake_later();
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::dispatch_wake_later()
{
    m_main_thread_event_loop.deferred_invoke([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this)] {
        auto locker = self->take_lock();
        self->dispatch_wake_if_needed_while_locked();
    });
}

VideoDecoderSelection DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::select_decoder_for_frame(CodedFrame const& frame, VideoDecoderSelection after) const
{
    return select_video_decoder(parsed_codec_for_coded_frame(frame, m_track.parsed_codec()), after);
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::replace_decoder_once_drained(CodedFrame const& frame, DecodeIntent intent)
{
    m_frame_awaiting_decoder_replacement = frame;
    m_intent_awaiting_decoder_replacement = intent;
    m_decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::receive_into_decoder(CodedFrame const& frame, DecodeIntent intent)
{
    if (m_non_reference_frame_detector.frame_is_non_reference(frame) && intent == DecodeIntent::Reference)
        return {};

    auto receive_result = m_decoder->receive_coded_data(frame, intent);

    if (receive_result.is_error() && receive_result.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented) {
        m_decoder_that_failed_due_to_missing_features = m_decoder_selection;
        replace_decoder_once_drained(frame, intent);
        return {};
    }

    if (receive_result.is_error() && receive_result.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream) {
        dbgln("DecodedVideoProducer: Decoder refused a frame at {} after reaching EOS", frame.presentation_timestamp());
        return {};
    }

    return receive_result;
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::create_decoder_for_frame(CodedFrame const& frame)
{
    auto codec_initialization_data = frame.new_codec_configuration();
    if (!codec_initialization_data.has_value())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "Coded frame starting a decode sequence carries no codec configuration"sv);

    auto selection = select_decoder_for_frame(frame, m_decoder_that_failed_due_to_missing_features);
    m_decoder_that_failed_due_to_missing_features = {};
    if (!selection.has_value())
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Could not find a video decoder for codec {}", frame.codec_id());

    m_decoder = TRY(create_video_decoder(selection, frame.codec_id(), *codec_initialization_data));
    m_decoder_selection = selection;
    // Only the decode thread waits for storage, so a release on the decode thread itself never needs a wake:
    // its next attempt to take output comes after this release in program order.
    m_decoder->set_storage_freed_callback([wait_state = m_wait_state, decode_thread_id = m_decode_thread_id] {
        if (decode_thread_id.is_current_thread())
            return;
        MutexLocker locker { wait_state->mutex };
        wait_state->frame_storage_was_freed = true;
        wait_state->condition.broadcast();
    });
    // A decode that finishes while the decode thread reads coded data is handled as soon as the read returns, either
    // to take its output or to report that the read has become blocked when output runs out.
    m_decoder->set_decode_completed_callback([wait_state = m_wait_state, demuxer = m_demuxer, track = m_track](DecodeCompletion) {
        if (wait_state->output_should_interrupt_demuxer_reads.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed))
            demuxer->set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(track);
    });
    m_decoder_codec_id = frame.codec_id();
    return {};
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::wait_for_another_seek_or_exit(u32 seek_id)
{
    auto locker = take_lock();
    while (m_seek_id == seek_id && !should_break_out_of_loop_while_locked())
        m_wait_state->condition.wait();
}

bool DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::check_if_seek_is_needed_or_allow_demuxer_reads(u32 seek_id)
{
    auto locker = take_lock();
    if (m_seek_id != seek_id || should_break_out_of_loop_while_locked())
        return true;
    m_demuxer->reset_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(m_track);
    m_wait_state->output_should_interrupt_demuxer_reads.store(true, MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    return false;
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::note_whether_decoder_has_decode_in_progress()
{
    VERIFY(m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    auto locker = take_lock();
    m_decoder_has_decode_in_progress = m_decoder != nullptr && m_decoder->has_any_decode_in_progress();
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::receive_coded_frame(CodedFrame const& frame, DecodeIntent intent)
{
    VERIFY(!m_frame_awaiting_decoder_replacement.has_value());
    if (m_decoder == nullptr) [[unlikely]] {
        TRY(create_decoder_for_frame(frame));
    } else {
        auto frame_carries_new_config = frame.new_codec_configuration().has_value();
        auto decoder_needs_replacement = m_decoder_codec_id != frame.codec_id();
        if (!decoder_needs_replacement && frame_carries_new_config) {
            auto selection = select_decoder_for_frame(frame);
            decoder_needs_replacement = selection != m_decoder_selection;
        }
        if (decoder_needs_replacement) [[unlikely]] {
            replace_decoder_once_drained(frame, intent);
            return {};
        }
    }
    return receive_into_decoder(frame, intent);
}

DecoderErrorOr<bool> DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::replace_drained_decoder()
{
    if (!m_frame_awaiting_decoder_replacement.has_value())
        return false;
    auto frame = m_frame_awaiting_decoder_replacement.release_value();
    auto intent = m_intent_awaiting_decoder_replacement;
    m_decoder.clear();
    if (!frame.new_codec_configuration().has_value())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsResubmission, "The frame awaiting a new decoder carries no codec configuration"sv);
    TRY(create_decoder_for_frame(frame));
    TRY(receive_into_decoder(frame, intent));
    return true;
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::release_decoder()
{
    VERIFY(m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    auto locker = take_lock();
    m_decoder.clear();
}

DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::~ThreadData()
{
    m_demuxer->set_read_blocked_change_handler_for_track(m_track, nullptr);
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::set_error_handler(ErrorHandler&& handler)
{
    m_error_handler = move(handler);
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::start()
{
    auto locker = take_lock();
    if (m_requested_state != RequestedState::None)
        return;
    m_requested_state = RequestedState::Running;
    m_last_consumer_activity = MonotonicTime::now();
    wake();
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::suspend()
{
    auto locker = take_lock();
    VERIFY(!m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    if (m_requested_state == RequestedState::Exit)
        return;
    if (m_requested_state == RequestedState::None) {
        m_requested_state = RequestedState::Running;
        m_last_consumer_activity = MonotonicTime::now();
    }
    m_suspension_request = SuspensionRequest::FromConsumer;
    m_demuxer->set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(m_track);
    m_demuxer_read_is_blocked.store(false);
    m_downstream_needs_wake = true;
    dispatch_wake_if_needed_while_locked();
    wake();
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::exit()
{
    auto locker = take_lock();
    m_requested_state = RequestedState::Exit;
    m_demuxer->set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(m_track);
    wake();
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::note_consumer_activity_while_locked() const
{
    m_last_consumer_activity = MonotonicTime::now();
    if (m_suspension_request == SuspensionRequest::Automatic)
        m_suspension_request = SuspensionRequest::None;
}

DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::WaitResult DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::wait_for_frame_storage_while_locked()
{
    if (m_requested_state != RequestedState::Running || m_suspension_request != SuspensionRequest::None)
        return WaitResult::ExitDecodeLoop;

    auto idle_at = m_last_consumer_activity + m_auto_suspend_idle_timeout;
    auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
    if (now < idle_at) {
        if (m_wait_state->condition.wait_for(idle_at - now))
            return WaitResult::ContinueDecoding;
        if (MonotonicTime::now() < idle_at)
            return WaitResult::ContinueDecoding;
    }

    if (m_suspension_request == SuspensionRequest::None)
        m_suspension_request = SuspensionRequest::Automatic;
    return WaitResult::ExitDecodeLoop;
}

DecodedVideoProducer::FrameQueue& DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::queue()
{
    return m_queue;
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data)
{
    auto locker = take_lock();
    VERIFY(!m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    note_consumer_activity_while_locked();
    m_suspension_request = SuspensionRequest::None;
    m_downstream_needs_wake = true;

    auto seek_behavior = m_seek_reason.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);

    if (invalidate_held_data == InvalidateHeldData::Yes) {
        seek_behavior = SeekReason::DataInvalidated;
        m_seek_reason.store(seek_behavior, MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    if (seek_behavior != SeekReason::DataInvalidated && is_within_available_range_while_locked(timestamp)) {
        re_emit_last_frame_if_at_end_of_stream_while_locked();
        if (m_last_processed_seek_id != m_seek_id)
            resolve_seek(m_seek_id.load());
        dispatch_wake_if_needed_while_locked();
        return;
    }

    m_seek_id++;
    m_seek_timestamp = timestamp;
    m_demuxer->set_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(m_track);
    // The aborted read reports that it stopped blocking only once the decode thread wakes.
    m_demuxer_read_is_blocked.store(false);
    wake();
}

AK::Duration DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::select_fast_seek_target(AK::Duration target, SeekMode mode) const
{
    return m_demuxer->select_fast_seek_target_for_track(m_track, target, mode);
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::register_decode_thread()
{
    VERIFY(!m_decode_thread_id.is_valid());
    m_decode_thread_id = AK::ThreadID::current();
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::wait_for_start()
{
    auto locker = take_lock();
    while (m_requested_state == RequestedState::None)
        m_wait_state->condition.wait();
}

bool DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::should_break_out_of_loop_while_locked() const
{
    return m_requested_state == RequestedState::Exit || m_suspension_request == SuspensionRequest::FromConsumer;
}

bool DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::should_thread_exit() const
{
    auto locker = take_lock();
    return m_requested_state == RequestedState::Exit;
}

template<typename Invokee>
void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::invoke_on_main_thread_while_locked(Invokee invokee)
{
    if (m_requested_state == RequestedState::Exit)
        return;
    m_main_thread_event_loop.deferred_invoke([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this), invokee = move(invokee)] mutable {
        invokee(self);
    });
}

bool DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::handle_auto_suspension()
{
    VERIFY(m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    auto locker = take_lock();
    if (m_suspension_request == SuspensionRequest::None)
        return false;
    m_queue.clear();
    m_last_queued_frame = nullptr;
    m_decoder.clear();
    // A seek requested before the consumer suspended us is one that no consumer waits for anymore.
    if (exchange(m_suspension_request, SuspensionRequest::None) == SuspensionRequest::FromConsumer)
        resolve_seek(m_seek_id);
    m_current_halting_status = PipelineStatus::Suspended;
    // The consumer's last peek predates the suspension, so wake it regardless of what it saw.
    m_downstream_needs_wake = true;
    dispatch_wake_if_needed_while_locked();

    while (true) {
        if (m_requested_state == RequestedState::Exit)
            return true;
        if (m_last_processed_seek_id != m_seek_id)
            break;
        m_wait_state->condition.wait();
    }
    m_current_halting_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;

    return true;
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::queue_frame(NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> const& frame)
{
    m_queue.enqueue({ frame });
    m_last_queued_frame = frame;
    dispatch_wake_if_needed_while_locked();
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::dispatch_error(DecoderError&& error)
{
    if (m_error_handler)
        m_error_handler(move(error));
}

bool DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::is_within_available_range_while_locked(AK::Duration timestamp) const
{
    auto is_at_end_of_stream = m_current_halting_status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream;
    if (m_queue.is_empty())
        return is_at_end_of_stream && m_last_queued_frame != nullptr && timestamp >= m_last_queued_frame->timestamp();
    if (timestamp < m_queue.head().frame->timestamp())
        return false;
    return is_at_end_of_stream || timestamp < m_queue.tail().frame->end();
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::re_emit_last_frame_if_at_end_of_stream_while_locked()
{
    if (m_current_halting_status != PipelineStatus::EndOfStream || !m_queue.is_empty() || m_last_queued_frame == nullptr)
        return;
    queue_frame(*m_last_queued_frame);
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::note_frame_passed_by_decoder(AK::Duration timestamp, AK::Duration earliest_target_reachable_without_moving_demuxer)
{
    VERIFY(m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    if (m_latest_frame_passed_by_decoder.has_value() && timestamp < m_latest_frame_passed_by_decoder->timestamp)
        return;
    m_latest_frame_passed_by_decoder = FramePassedByDecoder { timestamp, earliest_target_reachable_without_moving_demuxer };
}

bool DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::decoder_has_passed_a_frame_needed_for(AK::Duration target) const
{
    VERIFY(m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    if (!m_latest_frame_passed_by_decoder.has_value())
        return false;
    return target < m_latest_frame_passed_by_decoder->earliest_target_reachable_without_moving_demuxer;
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::resolve_seek(u32 seek_id)
{
    m_last_processed_seek_id = seek_id;
}

bool DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::seek_to_resubmit_if_decoder_lost_its_state(DecoderError const& error)
{
    if (error.category() != DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsResubmission)
        return false;

    auto locker = take_lock();
    seek_to_resubmit_while_locked();
    return true;
}

bool DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::seek_to_replace_decoder_if_it_cannot_decode_the_stream(DecoderError const& error)
{
    if (error.category() != DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented)
        return false;

    auto locker = take_lock();
    m_decoder_that_failed_due_to_missing_features = m_decoder_selection;
    m_decoder.clear();
    seek_to_resubmit_while_locked();
    return true;
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::seek_to_resubmit_while_locked()
{
    if (m_seek_reason.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed) == SeekReason::Normal)
        m_seek_reason.store(SeekReason::DecoderResetNeeded, MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    auto seek_is_pending = m_last_processed_seek_id != m_seek_id;
    m_seek_id++;
    // Interrupt the decode loop without hiding the held frames from peek().
    if (!seek_is_pending)
        m_last_processed_seek_id = m_seek_id.load();
    m_downstream_needs_wake = true;
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::handle_seek()
{
    VERIFY(m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());

    auto seek_id = m_seek_id.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    auto seek_was_externally_requested = seek_id != m_last_processed_seek_id.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    auto seek_reason = m_seek_reason.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (!seek_was_externally_requested && seek_reason != SeekReason::DecoderResetNeeded)
        return;

    AK::Duration timestamp;
    RefPtr<VideoFrame> last_frame;

    auto resolve_handled_seek_while_locked = [&] {
        resolve_seek(seek_id);
        if (m_seek_id == seek_id)
            m_seek_reason.store(SeekReason::Normal, MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    };

    auto handle_error = [&](DecoderError&& error) {
        auto locker = take_lock();
        m_decoder_needs_keyframe_next_seek = true;
        enter_halting_state(PipelineStatus::Error, move(error));
        resolve_handled_seek_while_locked();
    };

    auto has_clamped_target = false;
    while (true) {
        auto decoder_has_passed_the_target = false;
        {
            auto locker = take_lock();
            seek_id = m_seek_id.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
            seek_was_externally_requested = seek_id != m_last_processed_seek_id;
            seek_reason = m_seek_reason.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);

            timestamp = m_seek_timestamp;
            if (should_break_out_of_loop_while_locked())
                return;
            m_demuxer->reset_blocking_reads_aborted_for_track(m_track);
            m_wait_state->output_should_interrupt_demuxer_reads.store(false, MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
            // Whatever the decoder is still decoding precedes the seek, so it doesn't keep the seek from blocking.
            m_decoder_has_decode_in_progress = false;

            if (seek_reason == SeekReason::Normal) {
                if (is_within_available_range_while_locked(timestamp)) {
                    re_emit_last_frame_if_at_end_of_stream_while_locked();
                    resolve_handled_seek_while_locked();
                    dispatch_wake_if_needed_while_locked();
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                m_decoder_needs_keyframe_next_seek = true;
            }

            if (seek_reason == SeekReason::DecoderResetNeeded && !seek_was_externally_requested && !has_clamped_target) {
                if (m_last_queued_frame != nullptr)
                    timestamp = m_last_queued_frame->end();
            } else {
                decoder_has_passed_the_target = decoder_has_passed_a_frame_needed_for(timestamp);
                // If the demuxer keeps its position, the decoder won't output this frame again.
                if (!m_decoder_needs_keyframe_next_seek && m_last_queued_frame != nullptr && m_last_queued_frame->timestamp() <= timestamp)
                    last_frame = m_last_queued_frame;

                m_queue.clear();
                m_last_queued_frame = nullptr;
            }

            m_current_halting_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;
            // A seek makes the drain pointless, and the demuxer has already given us the frame and its configuration, so
            // start over with a new decoder and have the demuxer provide the configuration again.
            if (m_frame_awaiting_decoder_replacement.has_value()) {
                m_frame_awaiting_decoder_replacement.clear();
                m_decoder.clear();
            }
            m_decoder_is_draining_before_unavailable_data = false;
            if (m_decoder != nullptr)
                m_decoder_that_failed_due_to_missing_features = {};
        }

        auto seek_options = DemuxerSeekOptions::None;
        if (m_decoder == nullptr)
            seek_options |= DemuxerSeekOptions::NeedCodecConfiguration | DemuxerSeekOptions::Force;
        if (m_decoder_needs_keyframe_next_seek || decoder_has_passed_the_target)
            seek_options |= DemuxerSeekOptions::Force;
        auto demuxer_seek_result_or_error = m_demuxer->seek_to_most_recent_keyframe(m_track, timestamp, seek_options);
        if (demuxer_seek_result_or_error.is_error() && demuxer_seek_result_or_error.error().category() != DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream) {
            if (demuxer_seek_result_or_error.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::PermanentlyUnavailable) {
                wait_for_another_seek_or_exit(seek_id);
                return;
            }
            if (demuxer_seek_result_or_error.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted)
                continue;
            handle_error(demuxer_seek_result_or_error.release_error());
            return;
        }

        m_decoder_needs_keyframe_next_seek = false;

        auto demuxer_seek_result = demuxer_seek_result_or_error.value_or(DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition);

        if (demuxer_seek_result == DemuxerSeekResult::MovedPosition) {
            if (m_decoder != nullptr)
                m_decoder->flush();
            m_latest_frame_passed_by_decoder.clear();
            last_frame.clear();
        }

        auto new_seek_id = m_seek_id.load();
        auto decoding_for_output = false;
        auto greatest_coded_timestamp = AK::Duration::zero();

        while (new_seek_id == seek_id) {
            if (check_if_seek_is_needed_or_allow_demuxer_reads(seek_id))
                break;

            while (m_decoder != nullptr && new_seek_id == seek_id) {
                auto frame_result = m_decoder->take_next_output(m_track.video_data().color_metadata, timestamp);
                if (frame_result.is_error()) {
                    if (frame_result.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream) {
                        if (m_decoder_is_draining_before_unavailable_data) {
                            wait_for_another_seek_or_exit(seek_id);
                            return;
                        }
                        auto error_or_decoder_was_replaced = replace_drained_decoder();
                        if (error_or_decoder_was_replaced.is_error()) {
                            if (seek_to_resubmit_if_decoder_lost_its_state(error_or_decoder_was_replaced.error())) {
                                new_seek_id = m_seek_id;
                                continue;
                            }
                            handle_error(error_or_decoder_was_replaced.release_error());
                            return;
                        }
                        if (error_or_decoder_was_replaced.value())
                            continue;

                        // If we've reached EOS without producing any output, restart the seek targeting the last frame
                        // we saw to produce just that last frame.
                        if (!has_clamped_target && !decoding_for_output && greatest_coded_timestamp > AK::Duration::zero()) {
                            auto locker = take_lock();
                            if (m_seek_id == seek_id) {
                                has_clamped_target = true;
                                m_seek_timestamp = greatest_coded_timestamp;
                                m_seek_id++;
                                m_decoder_needs_keyframe_next_seek = true;
                                new_seek_id = m_seek_id;
                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        auto locker = take_lock();
                        resolve_handled_seek_while_locked();
                        if (last_frame != nullptr)
                            queue_frame(last_frame.release_nonnull());
                        return;
                    }

                    if (frame_result.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput)
                        break;

                    if (frame_result.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain) {
                        auto locker = take_lock();
                        if (should_break_out_of_loop_while_locked())
                            return;
                        if (m_seek_id != seek_id) {
                            new_seek_id = m_seek_id;
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (!m_wait_state->frame_storage_was_freed)
                            m_wait_state->condition.wait();
                        m_wait_state->frame_storage_was_freed = false;
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (seek_to_resubmit_if_decoder_lost_its_state(frame_result.error())) {
                        new_seek_id = m_seek_id;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (seek_to_replace_decoder_if_it_cannot_decode_the_stream(frame_result.error())) {
                        new_seek_id = m_seek_id;
                        continue;
                    }
                    handle_error(frame_result.release_error());
                    return;
                }

                auto current_frame = frame_result.release_value();
                note_frame_passed_by_decoder(current_frame->timestamp(), current_frame->timestamp());

                if (current_frame->contains_timestamp(timestamp)) {
                    auto locker = take_lock();
                    resolve_handled_seek_while_locked();
                    queue_frame(current_frame);
                    return;
                }

                if (current_frame->timestamp() > timestamp) {
                    auto locker = take_lock();
                    resolve_handled_seek_while_locked();

                    if (last_frame != nullptr)
                        queue_frame(last_frame.release_nonnull());

                    queue_frame(current_frame);
                    return;
                }

                last_frame = move(current_frame);

                new_seek_id = m_seek_id;
            }
            if (new_seek_id != seek_id)
                break;

            note_whether_decoder_has_decode_in_progress();
            auto coded_frame_result = m_demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(m_track);
            m_wait_state->output_should_interrupt_demuxer_reads.store(false, MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
            if (coded_frame_result.is_error()) {
                auto category = coded_frame_result.error().category();
                if (category == DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream) {
                    if (m_decoder == nullptr) {
                        auto locker = take_lock();
                        resolve_handled_seek_while_locked();
                        return;
                    }
                    m_decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
                } else if (category == DecoderErrorCategory::PermanentlyUnavailable) {
                    if (m_decoder == nullptr) {
                        wait_for_another_seek_or_exit(seek_id);
                        return;
                    }
                    m_decoder_is_draining_before_unavailable_data = true;
                    m_decoder_needs_keyframe_next_seek = true;
                    m_decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
                } else if (category != DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted) {
                    handle_error(coded_frame_result.release_error());
                    return;
                }
                continue;
            }

            auto coded_frame = coded_frame_result.release_value();

            // Request output for any frames that end after the seek target, indicating that they will need to
            // be displayed (eventually, in reordered codecs).
            auto conservative_end_of_coded_frame = VideoFrame::conservative_end_of(coded_frame.presentation_timestamp(), coded_frame.duration());
            if (conservative_end_of_coded_frame >= timestamp)
                decoding_for_output = true;
            // Frames decoded for reference aren't output, so we need to ensure that we re-decode when seeking back into them.
            if (!decoding_for_output)
                note_frame_passed_by_decoder(coded_frame.presentation_timestamp(), conservative_end_of_coded_frame);
            greatest_coded_timestamp = max(greatest_coded_timestamp, coded_frame.presentation_timestamp());

            auto decode_result = receive_coded_frame(coded_frame, decoding_for_output ? DecodeIntent::Output : DecodeIntent::Reference);
            if (decode_result.is_error()) {
                if (seek_to_resubmit_if_decoder_lost_its_state(decode_result.error())) {
                    new_seek_id = m_seek_id;
                    continue;
                }
                handle_error(decode_result.release_error());
                return;
            }

            new_seek_id = m_seek_id;
        }
    }
}

void DecodedVideoProducer::ThreadData::push_data_and_decode_some_frames()
{
    VERIFY(m_decode_thread_id.is_current_thread());

    // FIXME: Check if the PlaybackManager's current time is ahead of the next keyframe, and seek to it if so.
    //        Demuxers currently can't report the next keyframe in a convenient way, so that will need implementing
    //        before this functionality can exist.

    auto set_halting_status_and_wait_for_seek = [this](PipelineStatus status, Optional<DecoderError> error) {
        auto locker = take_lock();
        enter_halting_state(status, move(error));

        while (m_seek_id == m_last_processed_seek_id && !should_break_out_of_loop_while_locked())
            m_wait_state->condition.wait();
    };

    // If a prior seek encountered a decoding error, stop here to ensure that the pipeline state stays Error.
    if (m_current_halting_status != PipelineStatus::Pending) {
        set_halting_status_and_wait_for_seek(m_current_halting_status, {});
        return;
    }

    if (check_if_seek_is_needed_or_allow_demuxer_reads(m_last_processed_seek_id.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed)))
        return;

    auto seek_is_pending = [&] {
        return m_seek_id.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed) != m_last_processed_seek_id.load(MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    };

    while (m_decoder != nullptr) {
        if (seek_is_pending())
            return;

        auto frame_result = m_decoder->take_next_output(m_track.video_data().color_metadata);
        if (frame_result.is_error()) {
            if (frame_result.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput)
                break;
            if (frame_result.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain) {
                auto locker = take_lock();
                if (seek_is_pending())
                    return;
                if (!m_wait_state->frame_storage_was_freed && wait_for_frame_storage_while_locked() == WaitResult::ExitDecodeLoop)
                    return;
                m_wait_state->frame_storage_was_freed = false;
                if (should_break_out_of_loop_while_locked())
                    return;
                continue;
            }
            if (seek_to_resubmit_if_decoder_lost_its_state(frame_result.error()))
                return;
            if (seek_to_replace_decoder_if_it_cannot_decode_the_stream(frame_result.error()))
                return;
            if (frame_result.error().category() == DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream) {
                if (m_decoder_is_draining_before_unavailable_data) {
                    wait_for_another_seek_or_exit(m_last_processed_seek_id);
                    return;
                }
                auto replaced_result = replace_drained_decoder();
                if (replaced_result.is_error()) {
                    if (seek_to_resubmit_if_decoder_lost_its_state(replaced_result.error()))
                        return;
                    set_halting_status_and_wait_for_seek(PipelineStatus::Error, replaced_result.release_error());
                    return;
                }
                if (replaced_result.value())
                    continue;
                set_halting_status_and_wait_for_seek(PipelineStatus::EndOfStream, {});
                return;
            }
            set_halting_status_and_wait_for_seek(PipelineStatus::Error, frame_result.release_error());
            return;
        }
        auto frame = frame_result.release_value();
        note_frame_passed_by_decoder(frame->timestamp(), frame->timestamp());

        auto locker = take_lock();
        queue_frame(frame);
    }

    // A seek can resolve while the decoder drains for a replacement, so the frame awaiting the new decoder is still
    // pending. Only draining further gets it decoded.
    if (m_frame_awaiting_decoder_replacement.has_value())
        return;

    if (seek_is_pending())
        return;

    note_whether_decoder_has_decode_in_progress();
    auto sample_result = m_demuxer->get_next_sample_for_track(m_track);
    m_wait_state->output_should_interrupt_demuxer_reads.store(false, MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (sample_result.is_error()) {
        auto category = sample_result.error().category();
        if (category == DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream) {
            if (m_decoder == nullptr) {
                set_halting_status_and_wait_for_seek(PipelineStatus::EndOfStream, {});
                return;
            }
            m_decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
        } else if (category == DecoderErrorCategory::PermanentlyUnavailable) {
            if (m_decoder == nullptr) {
                wait_for_another_seek_or_exit(m_last_processed_seek_id);
                return;
            }
            m_decoder_is_draining_before_unavailable_data = true;
            m_decoder_needs_keyframe_next_seek = true;
            m_decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
        } else if (category != DecoderErrorCategory::Aborted) {
            set_halting_status_and_wait_for_seek(PipelineStatus::Error, sample_result.release_error());
        }
        return;
    }

    auto coded_frame = sample_result.release_value();
    auto decode_result = receive_coded_frame(coded_frame, DecodeIntent::Output);
    if (decode_result.is_error()) {
        if (seek_to_resubmit_if_decoder_lost_its_state(decode_result.error()))
            return;
        set_halting_status_and_wait_for_seek(PipelineStatus::Error, decode_result.release_error());
    }
}

}

namespace Media {

// Retrieves coded data from a demuxer and decodes it asynchronously into video frames ready for display.
class MEDIA_API DecodedVideoProducer : public VideoProducer {
    class ThreadData;

public:
    struct QueuedFrame {
        NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> frame;
    };
    using FrameQueue = Queue<QueuedFrame>;

    using ErrorHandler = Function<void(DecoderError&&)>;

    static constexpr AK::Duration DEFAULT_AUTO_SUSPEND_IDLE_TIMEOUT = AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(5'000);

    static DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<DecodedVideoProducer>> try_create(Core::EventLoop& main_thread_event_loop, NonnullRefPtr<Demuxer> const&, Track const&, AK::Duration auto_suspend_idle_timeout = DEFAULT_AUTO_SUSPEND_IDLE_TIMEOUT);

    DecodedVideoProducer(NonnullRefPtr<ThreadData> const&);
    ~DecodedVideoProducer();

    void set_error_handler(ErrorHandler&&);

    virtual void start() override;
    virtual void suspend() override;

    virtual VideoProducerOutput peek() override;
    virtual void consume() override;
    virtual void set_wake_handler(PipelineWakeHandler) override;

    // Called once a blocked read is able to continue, after the producer has stopped reporting Blocked. It runs on the
    // thread that delivered the data, under the demuxer's lock, so it must not block or take other locks.
    void set_read_unblocked_handler(Function<void()>);
    // Callable from any thread.
    void set_checkpoint(PipelineCheckpoint);

    AK::Duration select_fast_seek_target(AK::Duration timestamp, SeekMode);
    virtual void seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData = InvalidateHeldData::No) override;

private:
    class ThreadData final : public AtomicRefCounted<ThreadData> {
    public:
        ThreadData(Core::EventLoop& main_thread_event_loop, NonnullRefPtr<Demuxer> const&, Track const&, AK::Duration auto_suspend_idle_timeout);
        ~ThreadData();

        void set_error_handler(ErrorHandler&&);
        void set_wake_handler(PipelineWakeHandler);

        void start();
        void suspend();
        VideoDecoderSelection select_decoder_for_frame(CodedFrame const&, VideoDecoderSelection after = {}) const;
        void replace_decoder_once_drained(CodedFrame const&, DecodeIntent);
        DecoderErrorOr<void> receive_into_decoder(CodedFrame const&, DecodeIntent);
        DecoderErrorOr<void> create_decoder_for_frame(CodedFrame const&);
        DecoderErrorOr<void> receive_coded_frame(CodedFrame const&, DecodeIntent);
        DecoderErrorOr<bool> replace_drained_decoder();
        bool check_if_seek_is_needed_or_allow_demuxer_reads(u32 seek_id);
        void note_whether_decoder_has_decode_in_progress();
        void wait_for_another_seek_or_exit(u32 seek_id);
        void release_decoder();
        void exit();

        FrameQueue& queue();

        VideoProducerOutput peek();
        VideoProducerOutput peek_while_locked();
        void consume();

        void seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData);
        AK::Duration select_fast_seek_target(AK::Duration target, SeekMode) const;
        void set_read_unblocked_handler(Function<void()>);
        void set_checkpoint(PipelineCheckpoint);

        void register_decode_thread();
        void wait_for_start();
        bool should_break_out_of_loop_while_locked() const;
        bool should_thread_exit() const;
        bool handle_auto_suspension();
        template<typename Invokee>
        void invoke_on_main_thread_while_locked(Invokee);
        void queue_frame(NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> const&);
        void dispatch_error(DecoderError&&);
        void handle_seek();
        void resolve_seek(u32 seek_id);
        bool seek_to_resubmit_if_decoder_lost_its_state(DecoderError const&);
        bool seek_to_replace_decoder_if_it_cannot_decode_the_stream(DecoderError const&);
        void seek_to_resubmit_while_locked();
        bool is_within_available_range_while_locked(AK::Duration) const;
        void re_emit_last_frame_if_at_end_of_stream_while_locked();
        void note_frame_passed_by_decoder(AK::Duration timestamp, AK::Duration earliest_target_reachable_without_moving_demuxer);
        bool decoder_has_passed_a_frame_needed_for(AK::Duration target) const;
        void push_data_and_decode_some_frames();

        void enter_halting_state(PipelineStatus, Optional<DecoderError>);

        void dispatch_wake_if_needed_while_locked();
        void dispatch_wake_later();

        [[nodiscard]] MutexLocker<Mutex> take_lock() const { return MutexLocker(m_wait_state->mutex); }
        void wake() const { m_wait_state->condition.broadcast(); }

    private:
        enum class RequestedState : u8 {
            None,
            Running,
            Exit,
        };

        void note_consumer_activity_while_locked() const;
        enum class WaitResult : u8 {
            ContinueDecoding,
            ExitDecodeLoop,
        };
        WaitResult wait_for_frame_storage_while_locked();
        bool read_is_blocked_while_locked() const;

        Core::EventLoop& m_main_thread_event_loop;

        // Shared with the decoder's storage-freed callback, which can outlive this ThreadData through frames still
        // held downstream. The flag records a wake that arrived while the decode thread was outside the mutex,
        // between an unsuccessful attempt to take output and the wait that follows it.
        struct WaitState : public AtomicRefCounted<WaitState> {
            Mutex mutex;
            ConditionVariable condition { mutex };
            bool frame_storage_was_freed { false };
            Atomic<bool> output_should_interrupt_demuxer_reads { false };
        };
        NonnullRefPtr<WaitState> m_wait_state { make_ref_counted<WaitState>() };
        RequestedState m_requested_state { RequestedState::None };

        AK::ThreadID m_decode_thread_id;
        NonnullRefPtr<Demuxer> m_demuxer;
        Track m_track;
        CodecID m_decoder_codec_id { CodecID::Unknown };
        VideoDecoderSelection m_decoder_selection;
        VideoDecoderSelection m_decoder_that_failed_due_to_missing_features;
        Optional<CodedFrame> m_frame_awaiting_decoder_replacement;
        DecodeIntent m_intent_awaiting_decoder_replacement { DecodeIntent::Output };
        OwnPtr<VideoDecoder> m_decoder;
        NonReferenceFrameDetector m_non_reference_frame_detector;
        bool m_decoder_needs_keyframe_next_seek { false };
        bool m_decoder_is_draining_before_unavailable_data { false };
        struct FramePassedByDecoder {
            AK::Duration timestamp;
            AK::Duration earliest_target_reachable_without_moving_demuxer;
        };
        Optional<FramePassedByDecoder> m_latest_frame_passed_by_decoder;

        FrameQueue m_queue;
        RefPtr<VideoFrame> m_last_queued_frame;
        ErrorHandler m_error_handler;
        PipelineStatus m_current_halting_status { PipelineStatus::Pending };
        // Set by the demuxer under its own lock, which may be taken while ours is held.
        Atomic<bool> m_demuxer_read_is_blocked { false };
        Atomic<PipelineCheckpoint> m_checkpoint { 0 };
        bool m_decoder_has_decode_in_progress { false };

        enum class SeekReason : u8 {
            Normal,
            DecoderResetNeeded,
            DataInvalidated,
        };

        Atomic<u32> m_last_processed_seek_id { 0 };
        Atomic<u32> m_seek_id { 0 };
        AK::Duration m_seek_timestamp;
        Atomic<SeekReason> m_seek_reason { SeekReason::Normal };

        SynchronizedWakeHandler m_wake_handler;
        mutable bool m_downstream_needs_wake { true };

        AK::Duration const m_auto_suspend_idle_timeout;
        mutable MonotonicTime m_last_consumer_activity { MonotonicTime::now() };
        enum class SuspensionRequest : u8 {
            None,
            Automatic,
            FromConsumer,
        };
        mutable SuspensionRequest m_suspension_request { SuspensionRequest::None };
    };

    NonnullRefPtr<ThreadData> m_thread_data;
};

/*

#include <LibMedia/Producers/RemoteVideoProducer.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>

namespace Media {

NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoProducer> RemoteVideoProducer::create(Delegates delegates)
{
    VERIFY(delegates.request_start);
    VERIFY(delegates.request_suspend);
    VERIFY(delegates.request_seek);
    return adopt_ref(*new RemoteVideoProducer(move(delegates)));
}

RemoteVideoProducer::RemoteVideoProducer(Delegates delegates)
    : m_delegates(move(delegates))
{
}

RemoteVideoProducer::~RemoteVideoProducer() = default;

void RemoteVideoProducer::stop_consuming()
{
    m_queued_frames.clear();
    m_has_stopped_consuming = true;
}

void RemoteVideoProducer::receive_frame(u64 lend_id, u32 seek_id, NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> frame)
{
    m_newest_received_lend_id = max(m_newest_received_lend_id, lend_id);
    if (m_has_stopped_consuming || seek_id != m_expected_seek_id)
        return;
    if (m_queued_frames.size() >= MAX_QUEUED_FRAME_COUNT) {
        dbgln("RemoteVideoProducer: Releasing a frame received past the limit of {} queued frames", MAX_QUEUED_FRAME_COUNT);
        return;
    }
    m_queued_frames.append(move(frame));
    m_wake_handler.dispatch();
}

void RemoteVideoProducer::receive_status(PipelineStatus status, u32 seek_id, PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint)
{
    if (m_has_stopped_consuming)
        return;
    m_checkpoint = max(m_checkpoint, checkpoint);
    // A peer can send any value for the status.
    if (to_underlying(status) > to_underlying(PipelineStatus::Error))
        status = PipelineStatus::Error;
    m_status = ReceivedStatus { status, seek_id };

    // A suspended producer has let go of its decoder, and resuming seeks past the frames it lent anyway.
    if (status == PipelineStatus::Suspended && seek_id == m_expected_seek_id)
        m_queued_frames.clear();
    m_wake_handler.dispatch();
}

void RemoteVideoProducer::notify_clock_resumed()
{
    if (m_has_stopped_consuming)
        return;
    m_wake_handler.dispatch();
}

void RemoteVideoProducer::start()
{
    m_delegates.request_start();
}

void RemoteVideoProducer::suspend()
{
    m_delegates.request_suspend();
}

void RemoteVideoProducer::set_wake_handler(PipelineWakeHandler handler)
{
    m_wake_handler.set(move(handler));
}

void RemoteVideoProducer::seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data)
{
    if (m_has_stopped_consuming)
        return;
    if (invalidate_held_data == InvalidateHeldData::No && can_satisfy_seek_locally(timestamp))
        return;

    // Released only after the request, so that the sink hears of the seek before their storage is decoded into again.
    auto stale_frames = move(m_queued_frames);
    m_expected_seek_id++;
    m_delegates.request_seek(timestamp, invalidate_held_data, m_newest_received_lend_id);
    stale_frames.clear();
}

bool RemoteVideoProducer::has_end_of_stream_status() const
{
    return m_status.has_value() && m_status->seek_id == m_expected_seek_id && m_status->status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream;
}

bool RemoteVideoProducer::can_satisfy_seek_locally(AK::Duration timestamp) const
{
    if (m_queued_frames.is_empty() || timestamp < m_queued_frames.first()->timestamp())
        return false;
    if (timestamp < m_queued_frames.last()->conservative_end())
        return true;
    return has_end_of_stream_status();
}

VideoProducerOutput RemoteVideoProducer::peek()
{
    if (m_has_stopped_consuming)
        return { nullptr, PipelineStatus::Pending, m_checkpoint };
    if (!m_queued_frames.is_empty())
        return { m_queued_frames.first(), PipelineStatus::HaveData, m_checkpoint };
    if (!m_status.has_value() || m_status->seek_id != m_expected_seek_id)
        return { nullptr, PipelineStatus::Pending, m_checkpoint };
    return { nullptr, m_status->status, m_checkpoint };
}

void RemoteVideoProducer::consume()
{
    if (m_has_stopped_consuming || m_queued_frames.is_empty())
        return;
    m_queued_frames.remove(0);
}

}

// The consumer end of a cross-process video edge.
class MEDIA_API RemoteVideoProducer final
    : public VideoProducer
    , public ThreadSafeWeakable<RemoteVideoProducer> {
public:
    // A frame arriving past this is released.
    static constexpr size_t MAX_QUEUED_FRAME_COUNT = 32;

    struct Delegates {
        Function<void()> request_start;
        Function<void()> request_suspend;
        Function<void(AK::Duration, InvalidateHeldData, u64 newest_received_lend_id)> request_seek;
    };

    static NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoProducer> create(Delegates);
    virtual ~RemoteVideoProducer() override;

    // Dropping the frame releases it back to the sink.
    void receive_frame(u64 lend_id, u32 seek_id, NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>);
    void receive_status(PipelineStatus, u32 seek_id, PipelineCheckpoint);
    void notify_clock_resumed();

    void stop_consuming();

    virtual void start() override;
    virtual void suspend() override;
    virtual VideoProducerOutput peek() override;
    virtual void consume() override;
    virtual void set_wake_handler(PipelineWakeHandler) override;
    virtual void seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData = InvalidateHeldData::No) override;

private:
    explicit RemoteVideoProducer(Delegates);

    struct ReceivedStatus {
        PipelineStatus status { PipelineStatus::Pending };
        u32 seek_id { 0 };
    };

    bool can_satisfy_seek_locally(AK::Duration timestamp) const;
    bool has_end_of_stream_status() const;

    Delegates m_delegates;
    bool m_has_stopped_consuming { false };

    u32 m_expected_seek_id { 0 };
    u64 m_newest_received_lend_id { 0 };
    // Received under the expected seek, oldest first.
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> m_queued_frames;
    Optional<ReceivedStatus> m_status;
    // Checkpoints are independent of seeks, so the newest one received under any seek is passed on.
    PipelineCheckpoint m_checkpoint { 0 };
    SynchronizedWakeHandler m_wake_handler;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/ReadonlyBytesCursor.h
/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#pragma once

#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <LibMedia/MediaStream.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/DecoderError.h>

namespace Media {

class ReadonlyBytesCursor final : public MediaStreamCursor {
public:
    ReadonlyBytesCursor(ReadonlyBytes data)
        : m_data(data)
    {
    }

    virtual void set_is_blocking(bool) override { }

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<void> seek(i64 offset, AK::SeekMode mode) override
    {
        auto target_position = [&] -> size_t {
            switch (mode) {
            case AK::SeekMode::SetPosition:
                return offset;
            case AK::SeekMode::FromCurrentPosition:
                return m_position + offset;
            case AK::SeekMode::FromEndPosition:
                return m_data.size() + offset;
            }
            VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        }();
        if (target_position > m_data.size())
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "End of buffer"sv);

        m_position = target_position;
        return {};
    }

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<size_t> read_into(Bytes bytes) override
    {
        if (m_position >= m_data.size())
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "End of buffer"sv);

        auto to_read = min(bytes.size(), m_data.size() - m_position);
        m_data.slice(m_position, to_read).copy_to(bytes);
        m_position += to_read;
        VERIFY(m_position <= m_data.size());
        return to_read;
    }

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<FixedArray<u8>> read_bytes(size_t size) override
    {
        if (size == 0)
            return FixedArray<u8>();

        if (m_position >= m_data.size() || size > m_data.size() - m_position)
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "End of buffer"sv);

        auto buffer = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(FixedArray<u8>::create(m_data.slice(m_position, size)));
        m_position += size;
        return buffer;
    }

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<void> read_and_discard(size_t size) override
    {
        if (m_position > m_data.size() || size > m_data.size() - m_position)
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "End of buffer"sv);

        m_position += size;
        return {};
    }

    virtual size_t position() const override { return m_position; }
    virtual Optional<u64> size() const override { return m_data.size(); }
    virtual size_t blocking_size() const override { return m_data.size(); }

    void set_data(ReadonlyBytes data) { m_data = data; }

private:
    ReadonlyBytes m_data;
    size_t m_position { 0 };
};

}

static constexpr size_t MINIMUM_RING_SIZE = 4 * MiB;

static constexpr AK::Duration SERVER_SILENCE_UNTIL_TREATED_AS_LOST = AK::Duration::from_seconds(10);
