class VideoDecoderClientConnection;

struct EventLoopThread {
    Core::EventLoop* event_loop { nullptr };
    AK::ThreadID thread_id;
};

}

// Shared by a decoder with the connection that routes its server's answers to it.
struct RemoteVideoDecoder::State : public AtomicRefCounted<State> {
    struct Output {
        NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> frame;
    };

    // A coded frame the server has yet to answer, whose data occupies its range of the ring until then.
    struct SubmissionInFlight {
        u64 ring_serial { 0 };
        u64 offset { 0 };
        u64 size { 0 };
        u32 generation { 0 };
    };

    size_t submissions_in_flight_of_current_generation() const
    {
        size_t count = 0;
        for (auto const& submission : submissions_in_flight) {
            if (submission.generation == generation)
                count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    // The outputs are returned to be dropped after the mutex is released, since releasing their frames takes it.
    [[nodiscard]] Vector<Output> forget_server_while_locked()
    {
        connection_was_lost = true;
        connection = {};
        auto forgotten_outputs = move(outputs);
        server_is_waiting_for_storage = false;
        submissions_in_flight.clear();
        server_decoder_has_any_decode_in_progress = false;
        failure.clear();
        server_decoder_state_changed.broadcast();
        drained = false;
        return forgotten_outputs;
    }

    Mutex mutex;
    ConditionVariable server_decoder_state_changed { mutex };
    ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderClientConnection> connection;
    u64 decoder_id { 0 };
    u32 generation { 0 };
    bool connection_was_lost { false };
    // The server's answers are not wanted anymore, though the frames the decoder handed out still go back to it.
    bool decoder_was_destroyed { false };

    Vector<Output> outputs;
    Vector<SubmissionInFlight> submissions_in_flight;
    bool server_decoder_has_any_decode_in_progress { false };
    Optional<DecoderError> failure;
    bool drained { false };

    // Called under the mutex when the server reports something the decoder's caller is not already waiting for, so
    // that destroying the decoder, which clears it, ends its calls.
    Function<void(DecodeCompletion)> decode_completed_callback;
    bool caller_is_waiting_for_output { false };

    // Set once before any frame is submitted, and called after the mutex is released.
    Function<void()> storage_freed_callback;
    // Set while the server waits for a frame to be released, which our caller is then answered TryAgain for. The server
    // reports nothing else while it waits, so anything it reports for the generation it waited in ends the wait too.
    bool server_is_waiting_for_storage { false };

    // Returns whether the server was waiting for storage, so that the storage freed callback must be called.
    [[nodiscard]] bool clear_server_wait_for_storage_while_locked()
    {
        return exchange(server_is_waiting_for_storage, false);
    }

    // Returns whether the server was waiting for this release, so that the storage freed callback must be called.
    [[nodiscard]] bool release_frame_to_server_while_locked(u64 frame_id)
    {
        connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_release_frame(frame_id);
        });
        return clear_server_wait_for_storage_while_locked();
    }

    bool has_any_decode_in_progress_while_locked() const
    {
        if (submissions_in_flight_of_current_generation() > 0 || server_decoder_has_any_decode_in_progress)
            return true;
        return !outputs.is_empty() || failure.has_value();
    }

    void tell_caller_of_new_state_while_locked(DecodeCompletion completion)
    {
        if (!caller_is_waiting_for_output && decode_completed_callback)
            decode_completed_callback(completion);
    }
};

namespace {

NeverDestroyed<RemoteVideoDecoder::TransportRequester> s_transport_requester;
Core::EventLoop* s_transport_requester_event_loop { nullptr };
AK::ThreadID s_transport_requester_thread_id;

// A request for a transport is in flight until its answer has been turned into a connection, or found to be none.
NeverDestroyed<Mutex> s_transport_request_mutex;
NeverDestroyed<ConditionVariable> s_transport_request_condition { *s_transport_request_mutex };
bool s_transport_request_is_in_flight { false };
u64 s_transport_requests_answered { 0 };

NeverDestroyed<Mutex> s_capabilities_mutex;
NeverDestroyed<HashMap<ParsedCodec, Optional<DecoderCapabilities>>> s_capabilities_by_format;

Atomic<u64> s_next_decoder_id { 1 };

template<typename T>
T run_on_thread(EventLoopThread const& thread, Function<T()> function)
{
    if (thread.thread_id.is_current_thread())
        return function();

    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Mutex mutex;
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA ConditionVariable condition { mutex };
    IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Optional<T> result;
    thread.event_loop->deferred_invoke([&, function = move(function)] {
        auto function_result = function();
        MutexLocker locker { mutex };
        result = move(function_result);
        condition.broadcast();
    });

    MutexLocker locker { mutex };
    while (!result.has_value())
        condition.wait();
    return result.release_value();
}

// The connection's answers are handled here rather than on a busy event loop, since each one can hold up a decode.
// This thread never waits on another.
EventLoopThread const& connection_thread()
{
    static EventLoopThread const connection_thread = [] {
        IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Mutex mutex;
        IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA ConditionVariable condition { mutex };
        IGNORE_USE_IN_ESCAPING_LAMBDA Optional<EventLoopThread> started_thread;
        auto thread = MUST(Threading::Thread::try_create("VideoDecoderIPC"sv, [&]() -> intptr_t {
            Core::EventLoop event_loop;
            {
                MutexLocker locker { mutex };
                started_thread = EventLoopThread { &event_loop, AK::ThreadID::current() };
                condition.broadcast();
            }
            return event_loop.exec();
        }));
        thread->start();
        thread->detach();

        MutexLocker locker { mutex };
        while (!started_thread.has_value())
            condition.wait();
        return *started_thread;
    }();
    return connection_thread;
}

template<typename T>
T run_on_connection_thread(Function<T()> function)
{
    return run_on_thread(connection_thread(), move(function));
}

// The connection to the VideoDecoderServer, used only on the connection thread except through weak references, whose
// targets are reached under the reference's lock.
class VideoDecoderClientConnection final
    : public IPC::ConnectionToServer<VideoDecoderClientEndpoint, VideoDecoderServerEndpoint>
    , public VideoDecoderClientEndpoint
    , public ThreadSafeWeakable<VideoDecoderClientConnection> {
    C_OBJECT_ABSTRACT(VideoDecoderClientConnection);

public:
    static ErrorOr<ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderClientConnection>> acquire()
    {
        VERIFY(!connection_thread().thread_id.is_current_thread());
        if (auto connection = current(); connection.has_value())
            return connection.release_value();

        if (!*s_transport_requester)
            return Error::from_string_literal("No video decoder server transport requester is installed");
        // The requester answers through its thread's event loop, which that thread could not return to while waiting.
        VERIFY(!s_transport_requester_thread_id.is_current_thread());

        MutexLocker locker { *s_transport_request_mutex };
        // A request answered since the check above has already connected.
        if (auto connection = current(); connection.has_value())
            return connection.release_value();
        auto requests_answered = s_transport_requests_answered;
        if (!s_transport_request_is_in_flight) {
            s_transport_request_is_in_flight = true;
            s_transport_requester_event_loop->deferred_invoke([] {
                (*s_transport_requester)(transport_answered);
            });
        }
        while (s_transport_requests_answered == requests_answered)
            s_transport_request_condition->wait();

        if (auto connection = current(); connection.has_value())
            return connection.release_value();
        return Error::from_string_literal("Could not connect to a video decoder server");
    }

    static void transport_answered(ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>> transport)
    {
        VERIFY(s_transport_requester_thread_id.is_current_thread());
        if (transport.is_error()) {
            dbgln("Could not get a transport to a video decoder server: {}", transport.error());
        } else {
            run_on_connection_thread<ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderClientConnection>>([transport = transport.release_value()]() mutable {
                *s_connection = adopt_ref(*new VideoDecoderClientConnection(move(transport)));
                auto connection = (*s_connection)->make_weak_ref();
                MutexLocker locker { *s_current_connection_mutex };
                *s_current_connection = connection;
                return connection;
            });
        }

        MutexLocker locker { *s_transport_request_mutex };
        s_transport_request_is_in_flight = false;
        s_transport_requests_answered++;
        s_transport_request_condition->broadcast();
    }

    // Shuts the connection down on its own thread, where its death is handled, for a caller that found the server
    // unresponsive from any other thread.
    static void disconnect_from_unresponsive_server(ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderClientConnection> connection)
    {
        connection_thread().event_loop->deferred_invoke([connection = move(connection)] {
            // Shutting down revokes the weak reference, so it happens outside the reference's lock.
            RefPtr<VideoDecoderClientConnection> strong_connection;
            connection.with_target([&](auto& target) { strong_connection = target; });
            if (strong_connection)
                strong_connection->shutdown();
        });
    }

    static Optional<Optional<DecoderCapabilities>> query_capabilities(ParsedCodec const& codec)
    {
        auto connection = acquire();
        if (connection.is_error()) {
            dbgln("Could not reach the video decoder server: {}", connection.error());
            return {};
        }
        return run_on_connection_thread<Optional<Optional<DecoderCapabilities>>>([codec]() -> Optional<Optional<DecoderCapabilities>> {
            if (s_connection->is_null())
                return {};
            auto response = (*s_connection)->send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::VideoDecoderServer::DecoderCapabilities>(codec);
            if (!response)
                return {};
            return response->capabilities();
        });
    }

    virtual ~VideoDecoderClientConnection() override
    {
        revoke_weak_refs();
    }

    void register_decoder(u64 decoder_id, NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoDecoder::State> state)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_decoders_mutex };
        m_decoders.set(decoder_id, move(state));
    }

    void unregister_decoder(u64 decoder_id)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_decoders_mutex };
        m_decoders.remove(decoder_id);
    }

private:
    explicit VideoDecoderClientConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
        : IPC::ConnectionToServer<VideoDecoderClientEndpoint, VideoDecoderServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
    {
    }

    static Optional<ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderClientConnection>> current()
    {
        MutexLocker locker { *s_current_connection_mutex };
        return *s_current_connection;
    }

    // Only the connection thread uses this.
    static NeverDestroyed<RefPtr<VideoDecoderClientConnection>> s_connection;
    // The connection that is open, for other threads to reach.
    static NeverDestroyed<Mutex> s_current_connection_mutex;
    static NeverDestroyed<Optional<ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderClientConnection>>> s_current_connection;

    virtual void die() override
    {
        // NB: Forgetting this connection below can drop the last reference to it.
        NonnullRefPtr keep_alive_until_death_is_handled = *this;
        revoke_weak_refs();
        if (*s_connection == this) {
            *s_connection = nullptr;
            MutexLocker locker { *s_current_connection_mutex };
            *s_current_connection = {};
        }

        HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoDecoder::State>> decoders;
        {
            MutexLocker locker { m_decoders_mutex };
            decoders = move(m_decoders);
        }
        for (auto& [decoder_id, state] : decoders) {
            Vector<RemoteVideoDecoder::State::Output> forgotten_outputs;
            MutexLocker locker { state->mutex };
            if (state->decoder_id != decoder_id)
                continue;
            forgotten_outputs = state->forget_server_while_locked();
            state->tell_caller_of_new_state_while_locked(DecodeCompletion::ProducedOutput);
        }
    }

    RefPtr<RemoteVideoDecoder::State> find_decoder(u64 decoder_id)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_decoders_mutex };
        if (auto state = m_decoders.get(decoder_id); state.has_value())
            return *state;
        return nullptr;
    }

    // What the decoder's caller is told of once the mutex is released: new state to take, through the decode completed
    // callback unless it is already waiting, and the end of a wait for storage it was answered TryAgain for, through
    // the storage freed callback.
    struct CallerWakeup {
        bool has_something_to_take { false };
        bool storage_was_freed { false };
    };

    // Returns whether the server reported for a decoder that is still known.
    template<typename Callback>
    bool with_decoder(u64 decoder_id, Callback callback)
    {
        auto state = find_decoder(decoder_id);
        if (!state)
            return false;
        CallerWakeup wakeup;
        {
            MutexLocker locker { state->mutex };
            if (state->decoder_id != decoder_id || state->decoder_was_destroyed)
                return false;
            auto any_decode_was_in_progress = state->has_any_decode_in_progress_while_locked();
            wakeup = callback(*state);
            state->server_decoder_state_changed.broadcast();
            if (wakeup.has_something_to_take)
                state->tell_caller_of_new_state_while_locked(DecodeCompletion::ProducedOutput);
            else if (any_decode_was_in_progress && !state->has_any_decode_in_progress_while_locked())
                state->tell_caller_of_new_state_while_locked(DecodeCompletion::ProducedNothing);
        }
        if (wakeup.storage_was_freed && state->storage_freed_callback)
            state->storage_freed_callback();
        return true;
    }

    // A server that breaks the protocol is treated as lost, so that its decoders start over with a new one.
    void disconnect_misbehaving_server(StringView reason, Error const& error)
    {
        dbgln("The video decoder server misbehaved ({}: {}), disconnecting.", reason, error);
        shutdown();
    }

    virtual void frame_decoded(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation, u64 frame_id, VideoFrameMetadata metadata, VideoFramePixels pixels) override
    {
        auto state = find_decoder(decoder_id);
        if (!state) {
            async_release_frame(frame_id);
            return;
        }

        // A frame can outlive the server it came from, whose replacement must not hear of its release.
        auto release_to_server = [state, decoder_id, frame_id] {
            auto server_was_waiting_for_storage = false;
            {
                MutexLocker locker { state->mutex };
                if (state->decoder_id != decoder_id)
                    return;
                server_was_waiting_for_storage = state->release_frame_to_server_while_locked(frame_id);
            }
            if (server_was_waiting_for_storage && state->storage_freed_callback)
                state->storage_freed_callback();
        };
        auto frame_or_error = create_received_video_frame(metadata, move(pixels), 0, move(release_to_server));
        if (frame_or_error.is_error()) {
            disconnect_misbehaving_server("unusable frame"sv, frame_or_error.release_error());
            return;
        }

        // A frame nobody takes is dropped after the mutex is released, since releasing it takes the mutex.
        RefPtr<VideoFrame> frame = frame_or_error.release_value();
        with_decoder(decoder_id, [&](RemoteVideoDecoder::State& state) -> CallerWakeup {
            if (generation != state.generation)
                return {};
            auto storage_was_freed = state.clear_server_wait_for_storage_while_locked();
            state.outputs.append({ frame.release_nonnull() });
            return { .has_something_to_take = true, .storage_was_freed = storage_was_freed };
        });
    }

    virtual void decoder_waiting_for_storage(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation) override
    {
        with_decoder(decoder_id, [&](RemoteVideoDecoder::State& state) -> CallerWakeup {
            if (generation == state.generation)
                state.server_is_waiting_for_storage = true;
            return {};
        });
    }

    virtual void coded_frame_consumed(u64 decoder_id) override
    {
        with_decoder(decoder_id, [&](RemoteVideoDecoder::State& state) -> CallerWakeup {
            if (!state.submissions_in_flight.is_empty())
                state.submissions_in_flight.remove(0);
            return {};
        });
    }

    virtual void any_decode_in_progress_changed(u64 decoder_id, bool any_decode_is_in_progress) override
    {
        with_decoder(decoder_id, [&](RemoteVideoDecoder::State& state) -> CallerWakeup {
            state.server_decoder_has_any_decode_in_progress = any_decode_is_in_progress;
            return {};
        });
    }

    virtual void decoder_failed(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation, DecoderError error) override
    {
        with_decoder(decoder_id, [&](RemoteVideoDecoder::State& state) -> CallerWakeup {
            if (generation != state.generation)
                return {};
            auto storage_was_freed = state.clear_server_wait_for_storage_while_locked();
            if (!state.failure.has_value())
                state.failure = move(error);
            return { .has_something_to_take = true, .storage_was_freed = storage_was_freed };
        });
    }

    virtual void decoder_drained(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation) override
    {
        with_decoder(decoder_id, [&](RemoteVideoDecoder::State& state) -> CallerWakeup {
            if (generation != state.generation)
                return {};
            auto storage_was_freed = state.clear_server_wait_for_storage_while_locked();
            state.drained = true;
            return { .has_something_to_take = true, .storage_was_freed = storage_was_freed };
        });
    }

    Mutex m_decoders_mutex;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoDecoder::State>> m_decoders;
};

NeverDestroyed<RefPtr<VideoDecoderClientConnection>> VideoDecoderClientConnection::s_connection;
NeverDestroyed<Mutex> VideoDecoderClientConnection::s_current_connection_mutex;
NeverDestroyed<Optional<ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderClientConnection>>> VideoDecoderClientConnection::s_current_connection;

}

void RemoteVideoDecoder::set_transport_requester(TransportRequester requester)
{
    *s_transport_requester = move(requester);
    s_transport_requester_event_loop = &Core::EventLoop::current();
    s_transport_requester_thread_id = AK::ThreadID::current();
}

Optional<DecoderCapabilities> RemoteVideoDecoder::capabilities(ParsedCodec const& codec)
{
    if (track_type_from_codec_id(codec.codec_id()) != TrackType::Video || !*s_transport_requester)
        return {};

    auto support_key = normalize_parsed_codec_for_support_keying(codec);
    {
        MutexLocker locker { *s_capabilities_mutex };
        if (auto cached_capabilities = s_capabilities_by_format->get(support_key); cached_capabilities.has_value())
            return *cached_capabilities;
    }

    auto capabilities = VideoDecoderClientConnection::query_capabilities(support_key);
    // An unanswered query is asked again next time, in case the server can be reached by then.
    if (!capabilities.has_value())
        return {};

    MutexLocker locker { *s_capabilities_mutex };
    s_capabilities_by_format->set(support_key, *capabilities);
    return *capabilities;
}

DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<RemoteVideoDecoder>> RemoteVideoDecoder::try_create(CodecID codec_id, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data)
{
    auto codec_configuration = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(ByteBuffer::copy(codec_initialization_data));
    auto state = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(try_make_ref_counted<State>());
    auto decoder = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(adopt_nonnull_own_or_enomem(new (nothrow) RemoteVideoDecoder(codec_id, move(codec_configuration), move(state))));
    TRY(decoder->start_server_decoder());
    return decoder;
}

RemoteVideoDecoder::RemoteVideoDecoder(CodecID codec_id, ByteBuffer codec_configuration, NonnullRefPtr<State> state)
    : m_codec_id(codec_id)
    , m_codec_configuration(move(codec_configuration))
    , m_state(move(state))
{
}

RemoteVideoDecoder::~RemoteVideoDecoder()
{
    ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderClientConnection> connection;
    u64 decoder_id = 0;
    Vector<State::Output> outputs;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
        connection = m_state->connection;
        decoder_id = m_state->decoder_id;
        outputs = move(m_state->outputs);
        m_state->decoder_was_destroyed = true;
        m_state->decode_completed_callback = nullptr;
    }
    connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
        connection.async_destroy_decoder(decoder_id);
        connection.unregister_decoder(decoder_id);
    });
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> RemoteVideoDecoder::start_server_decoder()
{
    if (!*s_transport_requester)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "This process cannot reach a video decoder server"sv);
    if (m_server_loss_count > MAXIMUM_SERVER_LOSSES)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "The video decoder server was lost too many times"sv);

    auto connection_or_error = VideoDecoderClientConnection::acquire();
    if (connection_or_error.is_error())
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Could not reach the video decoder server: {}", connection_or_error.error());
    auto connection = connection_or_error.release_value();

    auto decoder_id = s_next_decoder_id.fetch_add(1, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    u32 generation = 0;
    Vector<State::Output> forgotten_outputs;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
        forgotten_outputs = m_state->forget_server_while_locked();
        m_state->connection_was_lost = false;
        m_state->connection = connection;
        m_state->decoder_id = decoder_id;
        generation = m_state->generation;
    }
    m_ring = {};
    m_server_loss_was_reported = false;

    auto connection_is_open = false;
    connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
        connection.register_decoder(decoder_id, m_state);
        connection.async_create_decoder(decoder_id, generation, m_codec_id, m_codec_configuration);
        connection_is_open = true;
    });
    if (!connection_is_open) {
        Vector<State::Output> outputs_of_the_unopened_connection;
        MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
        outputs_of_the_unopened_connection = m_state->forget_server_while_locked();
    }
    return {};
}

void RemoteVideoDecoder::set_storage_freed_callback(Function<void()> callback)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
    m_state->storage_freed_callback = move(callback);
}

void RemoteVideoDecoder::set_decode_completed_callback(Function<void(DecodeCompletion)> callback)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
    m_state->decode_completed_callback = move(callback);
}

bool RemoteVideoDecoder::has_any_decode_in_progress() const
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
    return m_state->has_any_decode_in_progress_while_locked();
}

DecoderError RemoteVideoDecoder::report_server_loss()
{
    m_server_loss_was_reported = true;
    m_server_loss_count++;
    return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsResubmission, "The video decoder server was lost"sv);
}

DecoderErrorOr<u64> RemoteVideoDecoder::write_to_ring(ReadonlyBytes data)
{
    auto range_is_free = [&](u64 offset) {
        if (offset + data.size() > m_ring.size())
            return false;
        for (auto const& submission : m_state->submissions_in_flight) {
            if (submission.ring_serial != m_ring_serial)
                continue;
            if (offset < submission.offset + submission.size && submission.offset < offset + data.size())
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    };

    Optional<u64> offset;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
        if (m_ring.is_valid()) {
            if (range_is_free(m_ring_write_offset))
                offset = m_ring_write_offset;
            else if (range_is_free(0))
                offset = 0;
        }
    }

    if (!offset.has_value()) {
        // The frames still in the old ring keep it alive on the server until it has consumed them.
        auto ring_size = max(m_ring.size() * 2, MINIMUM_RING_SIZE);
        while (ring_size < data.size() * 4 && ring_size < MAXIMUM_RING_SIZE)
            ring_size *= 2;
        if (data.size() > ring_size)
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "A coded video frame is too large to submit"sv);
        m_ring = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_with_size(ring_size));
        m_ring_serial++;
        offset = 0;

        MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
        m_state->connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_replace_coded_data_ring(m_state->decoder_id, m_ring);
        });
    }

    data.copy_to(Bytes { m_ring.data<u8>() + *offset, data.size() });
    m_ring_write_offset = *offset + data.size();
    return *offset;
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> RemoteVideoDecoder::receive_coded_data(CodedFrame const& coded_frame, DecodeIntent intent)
{
    if (m_reached_end_of_stream)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "The decoder has been drained"sv);

    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
        if (m_state->connection_was_lost && !m_server_loss_was_reported)
            return report_server_loss();
    }
    if (m_server_loss_was_reported)
        TRY(start_server_decoder());

    if (auto new_codec_configuration = coded_frame.new_codec_configuration(); new_codec_configuration.has_value())
        m_codec_configuration = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(ByteBuffer::copy(*new_codec_configuration));

    auto ring_offset = TRY(write_to_ring(coded_frame.data()));

    Optional<ByteBuffer> new_codec_configuration;
    if (coded_frame.new_codec_configuration().has_value())
        new_codec_configuration = m_codec_configuration;

    MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
    m_state->submissions_in_flight.append({ m_ring_serial, ring_offset, coded_frame.data().size(), m_state->generation });
    m_state->connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
        connection.async_submit_coded_frame(m_state->decoder_id, m_state->generation, ring_offset, coded_frame.data().size(), coded_frame.presentation_timestamp(), coded_frame.decode_timestamp(), coded_frame.duration(), coded_frame.flags(), coded_frame.maximum_scene_luminance(), move(new_codec_configuration), intent, m_output_target);
    });
    return {};
}

void RemoteVideoDecoder::signal_end_of_stream()
{
    m_reached_end_of_stream = true;
    MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
    m_state->drained = false;
    m_state->connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
        connection.async_signal_end_of_stream(m_state->decoder_id, m_state->generation);
    });
}

DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> RemoteVideoDecoder::take_next_output(ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata, Optional<AK::Duration> target)
{
    // The server hears of the target with the next submission, which follows the flush that any new target comes after.
    m_output_target = target;

    Optional<State::Output> output;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
        while (true) {
            if (m_state->connection_was_lost) {
                if (!m_server_loss_was_reported)
                    return report_server_loss();
                // Nothing is decoding until the frames are submitted again.
                if (m_reached_end_of_stream)
                    return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "The decoder has been drained"sv);
                return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput, "The decoder needs its frames submitted again"sv);
            }

            if (!m_state->outputs.is_empty()) {
                output = m_state->outputs.take_first();
                break;
            }
            if (m_state->failure.has_value())
                return m_state->failure.release_value();
            if (m_reached_end_of_stream) {
                if (m_state->drained)
                    return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "The decoder has been drained"sv);
            } else if (m_state->submissions_in_flight_of_current_generation() < MAXIMUM_FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT) {
                return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput, "The video decoder server has no frame ready"sv);
            }
            // Its answer waits on a slot that only our caller's consumers can release, however long they take.
            if (m_state->server_is_waiting_for_storage)
                return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain, "Every slot of the video decoder server is held"sv);
            m_state->caller_is_waiting_for_output = true;
            auto server_answered = m_state->server_decoder_state_changed.wait_for(SERVER_SILENCE_UNTIL_TREATED_AS_LOST);
            m_state->caller_is_waiting_for_output = false;
            if (!server_answered) {
                dbgln("The video decoder server has answered nothing for {} seconds, disconnecting.", SERVER_SILENCE_UNTIL_TREATED_AS_LOST.to_seconds());
                VideoDecoderClientConnection::disconnect_from_unresponsive_server(m_state->connection);
            }
        }
    }

    auto const& frame = output->frame;
    auto color_metadata = container_color_metadata;
    color_metadata.adopt_specified_values(frame->color_metadata());
    return DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(try_make_ref_counted<VideoFrame>(
        frame->timestamp(), frame->duration(), frame->size(),
        frame->bit_depth(), frame->subsampling(), move(color_metadata), frame->storage()));
}

void RemoteVideoDecoder::flush()
{
    m_reached_end_of_stream = false;
    m_output_target = {};

    Vector<State::Output> outputs;
    MutexLocker locker { m_state->mutex };
    m_state->generation++;
    outputs = move(m_state->outputs);
    m_state->failure.clear();
    m_state->drained = false;
    m_state->server_is_waiting_for_storage = false;
    m_state->connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
        connection.async_flush(m_state->decoder_id, m_state->generation);
    });
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibCore/AnonymousBuffer.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecID.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecParameters.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/DecoderCapabilities.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoder.h>

namespace Media {

// Decodes in the VideoDecoderServer. Coded frames are written to a shared-memory ring and submitted without waiting,
// and the server answers each one once it has consumed it. Output is waited for once the current generation's frames
// the server has yet to answer reach the maximum in flight, unless the server waits for one of its slots to be
// released here, which is answered with TryAgain.
//
// If the server is lost, or answers nothing for too long while it is waited on, the next call reports
// NeedsResubmission, and the coded frames submitted after it, starting from a keyframe, go to a new server. A decoder
// that loses its server too many times answers NotImplemented instead, so that its stream falls back to the next
// decoder.
class MEDIA_API RemoteVideoDecoder final : public VideoDecoder {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT = 2;
    static constexpr u32 MAXIMUM_SERVER_LOSSES = 2;

    // The requester is called on the event loop of the thread installing it, and answers through the callback on that
    // thread, at once or later. Decoders are created and asked for capabilities on other threads, which wait for the
    // answer; the installing thread never asks, since it could not return to its event loop while waiting.
    using TransportCallback = Function<void(ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>>)>;
    using TransportRequester = Function<void(TransportCallback)>;
    static void set_transport_requester(TransportRequester);

    static Optional<DecoderCapabilities> capabilities(ParsedCodec const&);
    static DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<RemoteVideoDecoder>> try_create(CodecID, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data);

    virtual ~RemoteVideoDecoder() override;

    virtual void set_storage_freed_callback(Function<void()>) override;
    virtual void set_decode_completed_callback(Function<void(DecodeCompletion)>) override;
    virtual bool has_any_decode_in_progress() const override;

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<void> receive_coded_data(CodedFrame const&, DecodeIntent) override;
    virtual void signal_end_of_stream() override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> take_next_output(ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata, Optional<AK::Duration> target = {}) override;
    virtual void flush() override;

    struct State;

private:
    RemoteVideoDecoder(CodecID, ByteBuffer codec_configuration, NonnullRefPtr<State>);

    DecoderErrorOr<void> start_server_decoder();
    DecoderErrorOr<u64> write_to_ring(ReadonlyBytes);
    DecoderError report_server_loss();

    CodecID const m_codec_id;
    ByteBuffer m_codec_configuration;
    NonnullRefPtr<State> m_state;

    // Only the caller's thread uses these.
    bool m_reached_end_of_stream { false };
    bool m_server_loss_was_reported { false };
    u32 m_server_loss_count { 0 };
    Optional<AK::Duration> m_output_target;
    Core::AnonymousBuffer m_ring;
    u64 m_ring_serial { 0 };
    u64 m_ring_write_offset { 0 };
};

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Format.h>
#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>

namespace Media {

enum class SeekMode : u8 {
    Accurate,
    ApproximateForSpeed,
    FastBefore,
    FastAfter,
};

enum class SeekDecision : u8 {
    Seek,
    // Nothing is seekable, so the playback position stays where it is.
    Skip,
};

constexpr StringView seek_mode_to_string(SeekMode seek_mode)
{
    switch (seek_mode) {
    case SeekMode::Accurate:
        return "Accurate"sv;
    case SeekMode::ApproximateForSpeed:
        return "ApproximateForSpeed"sv;
    case SeekMode::FastBefore:
        return "FastBefore"sv;
    case SeekMode::FastAfter:
        return "FastAfter"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

}

namespace AK {

template<>
struct Formatter<Media::SeekMode> : Formatter<StringView> {
    ErrorOr<void> format(FormatBuilder& builder, Media::SeekMode color_primaries)
    {
        return Formatter<StringView>::format(builder, Media::seek_mode_to_string(color_primaries));
    }
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/Sinks/AudioOutputFactory.h
/*

 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <LibAudio/NullPlaybackStream.h>
#include <LibAudio/OutputSession.h>
#include <LibAudio/PlaybackStream.h>

namespace Media {

// Opens the audio outputs of one source of sound. A playback manager hands its factory to every sink it creates, and a
// sink opens another output with it after losing one.
class AudioOutputFactory final : public AtomicRefCounted<AudioOutputFactory> {
public:
    // The outputs play as part of the session.
    static NonnullRefPtr<AudioOutputFactory> create(NonnullRefPtr<Audio::OutputSession> session)
    {
        return adopt_ref(*new AudioOutputFactory([session = move(session)](Audio::OutputState initial_output_state, u32 target_latency_ms, Audio::PlaybackStream::AudioDataRequestCallback data_request_callback) {
            return Audio::PlaybackStream::create(initial_output_state, target_latency_ms, session, move(data_request_callback));
        }));
    }

    // The outputs discard what they are given, at the pace a device would play it.
    static NonnullRefPtr<AudioOutputFactory> create_null()
    {
        return adopt_ref(*new AudioOutputFactory([](Audio::OutputState initial_output_state, u32 target_latency_ms, Audio::PlaybackStream::AudioDataRequestCallback data_request_callback) {
            auto promise = Audio::PlaybackStream::CreatePromise::construct();
            promise->resolve(Audio::NullPlaybackStream::create(initial_output_state, target_latency_ms, move(data_request_callback)));
            return promise;
        }));
    }

    NonnullRefPtr<Audio::PlaybackStream::CreatePromise> open_output(Audio::OutputState initial_output_state, u32 target_latency_ms, Audio::PlaybackStream::AudioDataRequestCallback data_request_callback) const
    {
        return m_open_output(initial_output_state, target_latency_ms, move(data_request_callback));
    }

private:
    using OpenOutput = Function<NonnullRefPtr<Audio::PlaybackStream::CreatePromise>(Audio::OutputState, u32 target_latency_ms, Audio::PlaybackStream::AudioDataRequestCallback)>;

    explicit AudioOutputFactory(OpenOutput open_output)
        : m_open_output(move(open_output))
    {
    }

    OpenOutput m_open_output;
};

}

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/ConditionVariable.h>
#include <AK/Debug.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibAudio/PlaybackStream.h>
#include <LibCore/Forward.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibMedia/AudioBlockTimingRing.h>
#include <LibMedia/PipelineStatus.h>
#include <LibMedia/Producers/AudioProducer.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/AudioBlock.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/AudioBlockTiming.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

#include "AudioPlaybackSink.h"

namespace Media {

static constexpr size_t OUTPUT_BLOCK_QUEUE_CAPACITY = 4;

static bool audio_processor_will_enqueue(PipelineStatus status)
{
    if (status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream)
        return true;
    return !is_waiting_for_data(status);
}

class AudioPlaybackSink::OutputThreadData : public AtomicRefCounted<OutputThreadData> {
public:
    OutputThreadData(MediaTimeWriter time_writer)
        : m_main_thread_event_loop(Core::EventLoop::current())
        , m_time_writer(move(time_writer))
    {
    }

    ReadonlySpan<float> move_output_to_playback_stream_buffer(Span<float>, MonotonicTime buffer_starts_playing_at);
    i64 hold_clock_at_played_frame_while_locked(MediaTimeReader const&);
    void dispatch_state_if_changed(PipelineStatus, PipelineCheckpoint, u32 seek_id);
    void report_input_status_while_locked(PipelineStatus, PipelineCheckpoint, u32 seek_id);
    void handle_input_suspension_while_locked(u32 seek_id);
    void request_resume_from_suspension_while_locked();
    void request_played_out_check_if_needed_while_locked();
    void signal_output_thread_while_locked();

    AudioBlockTimingRing& block_timings() { return m_time_writer.timing_ring(); }

    ThreadSafeWeakRef<AudioPlaybackSink> m_sink;

    RefPtr<Audio::PlaybackStream> m_playback_stream;
    Audio::SampleSpecification m_sample_specification;
    RefPtr<AudioProducer> m_input;
    Core::EventLoop& m_main_thread_event_loop;

    mutable Mutex m_output_mutex;
    mutable ConditionVariable m_output_condition { m_output_mutex };

    AK::Array<AudioBlock, OUTPUT_BLOCK_QUEUE_CAPACITY> m_blocks;
    size_t m_block_head { 0 };
    size_t m_block_tail { 0 };
    size_t m_block_count { 0 };
    i64 m_next_frame_to_play { 0 };
    MediaTimeWriter m_time_writer;
    float m_playback_rate { 1.0f };
    // Only changed on the main thread, which may read it without the lock.
    StreamState m_stream_state { StreamState::Suspended };
    float m_eos_media_frame_remainder { 0.0f };

    PipelineStatus m_last_pull_status { PipelineStatus::Pending };
    PipelineCheckpoint m_last_pull_checkpoint { 0 };
    PipelineStatus m_last_dispatched_status { PipelineStatus::Pending };
    PipelineCheckpoint m_last_dispatched_checkpoint { 0 };
    i64 m_last_real_data_end_in_frames { 0 };

    Atomic<u32> m_seek_id { 0 };
    // While the input is seeking, it still reports its state from before the seek.
    bool m_input_seek_in_flight { false };
    Atomic<bool, AK::memory_order_relaxed> m_audio_processor_should_exit { false };
    bool m_waiting_for_upstream_data { false };
    bool m_resume_from_suspension_requested { false };
    bool m_played_out_check_requested { false };
    u64 m_output_thread_signal_count { 0 };
};

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<AudioPlaybackSink>> AudioPlaybackSink::try_create(PipelineStateChangeHandler on_state_changed, NonnullRefPtr<AudioOutputFactory> output_factory)
{
    auto time_writer = TRY(MediaTimeWriter::create());
    auto time_reader = TRY(MediaTimeReader::create(time_writer.buffer()));
    auto output_thread_data = TRY(adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) OutputThreadData(move(time_writer))));
    auto sink = TRY(try_make_ref_counted<AudioPlaybackSink>(output_thread_data, move(time_reader), move(on_state_changed), move(output_factory)));
    output_thread_data->m_sink = sink->make_weak_ref();

    auto thread = TRY(Threading::Thread::try_create("Audio Processor"sv,
        [output_thread_data]() -> intptr_t {
            while (!output_thread_data->m_audio_processor_should_exit) {
                RefPtr<AudioProducer> input;
                u64 signal_count_at_start;
                {
                    MutexLocker locker { output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
                    input = output_thread_data->m_input;
                    signal_count_at_start = output_thread_data->m_output_thread_signal_count;
                }

                auto& output_block = output_thread_data->m_blocks[output_thread_data->m_block_tail];

                if (input != nullptr) {
                    u32 seek_id_at_probe;
                    bool input_seek_in_flight;
                    {
                        MutexLocker locker { output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
                        seek_id_at_probe = output_thread_data->m_seek_id;
                        input_seek_in_flight = output_thread_data->m_input_seek_in_flight;
                    }
                    if (!input_seek_in_flight) {
                        auto probe = input->peek();
                        auto status = probe.status;
                        MutexLocker locker { output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
                        if (output_thread_data->m_seek_id == seek_id_at_probe) {
                            if (status == PipelineStatus::Suspended) {
                                output_thread_data->handle_input_suspension_while_locked(seek_id_at_probe);
                            } else {
                                if (audio_processor_will_enqueue(status)) {
                                    output_thread_data->m_last_pull_status = status;
                                    output_thread_data->m_last_pull_checkpoint = probe.checkpoint;
                                    output_thread_data->m_waiting_for_upstream_data = false;
                                }
                                // Nothing is pulled while the playback rate is zero, so the status is reported here.
                                if (output_thread_data->m_playback_rate == 0.0f && seek_id_at_probe != 0) {
                                    output_thread_data->m_last_pull_status = status;
                                    output_thread_data->m_last_pull_checkpoint = probe.checkpoint;
                                    output_thread_data->report_input_status_while_locked(status, probe.checkpoint, seek_id_at_probe);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                u32 seek_id_at_pull;
                {
                    MutexLocker locker { output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
                    if (output_thread_data->m_audio_processor_should_exit)
                        break;
                    // A signal sent since this iteration began may have changed what the probe saw, and it will not be
                    // sent again, so the input must be probed again rather than waited on.
                    if (output_thread_data->m_output_thread_signal_count != signal_count_at_start)
                        continue;
                    if (output_thread_data->m_seek_id == 0) {
                        output_thread_data->m_output_condition.wait();
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (output_thread_data->m_input == nullptr) {
                        output_thread_data->m_output_condition.wait();
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (output_thread_data->m_input_seek_in_flight) {
                        output_thread_data->m_output_condition.wait();
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (output_thread_data->m_block_count == OUTPUT_BLOCK_QUEUE_CAPACITY) {
                        output_thread_data->m_output_condition.wait();
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (output_thread_data->m_waiting_for_upstream_data) {
                        output_thread_data->m_output_condition.wait();
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (output_thread_data->m_playback_rate == 0.0f) {
                        output_thread_data->m_output_condition.wait();
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (output_thread_data->m_audio_processor_should_exit)
                        continue;
                    output_thread_data->m_waiting_for_upstream_data = true;
                    seek_id_at_pull = output_thread_data->m_seek_id;
                    input = output_thread_data->m_input;
                }

                auto output = input->peek();
                auto status = output.status;
                if (status == PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
                    output_block = *output.block;
                    input->consume();
                } else {
                    output_block.clear();
                }

                {
                    MutexLocker locker { output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
                    if (output_thread_data->m_seek_id != seek_id_at_pull)
                        continue;
                    if (status == PipelineStatus::Suspended) {
                        output_thread_data->handle_input_suspension_while_locked(seek_id_at_pull);
                        continue;
                    }
                    output_thread_data->m_last_pull_status = status;
                    output_thread_data->m_last_pull_checkpoint = output.checkpoint;
                    if (status == PipelineStatus::HaveData && output_block.end_frame_index() <= output_thread_data->m_next_frame_to_play) {
                        output_thread_data->m_waiting_for_upstream_data = false;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream) {
                        VERIFY(output_block.is_empty());
                        VERIFY(output_thread_data->m_sample_specification.is_valid());
                        auto channel_count = output_thread_data->m_sample_specification.channel_count();
                        size_t frame_count = 1024 / channel_count;
                        VERIFY(frame_count > 0);
                        auto maybe_previous_timing = output_thread_data->block_timings().latest_timing();
                        auto first_frame_index = max(output_thread_data->m_last_real_data_end_in_frames, output_thread_data->m_next_frame_to_play);
                        if (maybe_previous_timing.has_value())
                            first_frame_index = max(first_frame_index, maybe_previous_timing->end_frame_index());
                        output_block.initialize(output_thread_data->m_sample_specification, first_frame_index, frame_count);
                        for (size_t channel = 0; channel < output_block.channel_count(); channel++)
                            output_block.channel_data(channel).fill(0.0f);

                        auto sample_rate = output_thread_data->m_sample_specification.sample_rate();
                        auto media_frame_count_with_remainder = (frame_count * output_thread_data->m_playback_rate) + output_thread_data->m_eos_media_frame_remainder;
                        auto media_frame_count = static_cast<i64>(media_frame_count_with_remainder);
                        output_thread_data->m_eos_media_frame_remainder = media_frame_count_with_remainder - media_frame_count;
                        auto media_time_start = AK::Duration::from_time_units(first_frame_index, 1, sample_rate);
                        if (maybe_previous_timing.has_value())
                            media_time_start = maybe_previous_timing->media_time_at_frame_index(first_frame_index);
                        output_block.set_media_time_start(media_time_start);
                        output_block.set_media_time_duration(AK::Duration::from_time_units(media_frame_count, 1, sample_rate));
                    }
                    if (!output_block.is_empty()) {
                        VERIFY(audio_processor_will_enqueue(status));
                        output_thread_data->m_block_tail = (output_thread_data->m_block_tail + 1) % OUTPUT_BLOCK_QUEUE_CAPACITY;
                        output_thread_data->m_block_count++;
                        output_thread_data->block_timings().enqueue(output_block.timing());

                        if (output_thread_data->m_playback_stream)
                            output_thread_data->m_playback_stream->notify_data_available();

                        if (status == PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
                            output_thread_data->m_last_real_data_end_in_frames = output_block.end_frame_index();
                            output_thread_data->m_eos_media_frame_remainder = 0.0f;
                        }
                    }

                    if (audio_processor_will_enqueue(status))
                        output_thread_data->m_waiting_for_upstream_data = false;

                    output_thread_data->report_input_status_while_locked(status, output.checkpoint, seek_id_at_pull);
                }
            }

            return 0;
        }));
    thread->start();
    thread->detach();

    return sink;
}

AudioPlaybackSink::AudioPlaybackSink(NonnullRefPtr<OutputThreadData> output_thread_data, MediaTimeReader time_reader, PipelineStateChangeHandler on_state_changed, NonnullRefPtr<AudioOutputFactory> output_factory)
    : m_main_thread_event_loop(Core::EventLoop::current())
    , m_on_state_changed(move(on_state_changed))
    , m_output_factory(move(output_factory))
    , m_output_thread_data(move(output_thread_data))
    , m_time_reader(move(time_reader))
{
    m_played_out_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(0), [this] {
        dispatch_waiting_status_once_played_out();
    });
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::start()
{
    create_playback_stream();
}

AudioPlaybackSink::~AudioPlaybackSink()
{
    RefPtr<AudioProducer> input;
    // The stream's data callback keeps the output thread data alive, so the two would keep each other going.
    RefPtr<Audio::PlaybackStream> playback_stream;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        input = move(m_output_thread_data->m_input);
        playback_stream = move(m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream);
        m_output_thread_data->m_audio_processor_should_exit = true;
        m_output_thread_data->signal_output_thread_while_locked();
    }
    if (input != nullptr)
        input->set_wake_handler(nullptr);
}

ErrorOr<void> AudioPlaybackSink::connect_input(NonnullRefPtr<AudioProducer> const& input)
{
    input->set_wake_handler([&output_thread_data = *m_output_thread_data] {
        // Pure relay: never peek here (that would race the output thread). Just wake it to pull.
        MutexLocker locker { output_thread_data.m_output_mutex };
        output_thread_data.m_waiting_for_upstream_data = false;
        output_thread_data.signal_output_thread_while_locked();
    });
    auto const& sample_specification = m_output_thread_data->m_sample_specification;
    if (sample_specification.is_valid()) {
        if (auto result = input->set_output_sample_specification(sample_specification); result.is_error()) {
            input->set_wake_handler(nullptr);
            return result.release_error();
        }
        if (m_output_thread_data->m_playback_rate != 0.0f)
            input->set_playback_rate(m_output_thread_data->m_playback_rate);
        input->seek(m_time_reader.current_time());
        input->start();
    }
    MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
    VERIFY(m_output_thread_data->m_input == nullptr);
    m_output_thread_data->m_input = input;
    m_output_thread_data->signal_output_thread_while_locked();
    return {};
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::disconnect_input(NonnullRefPtr<AudioProducer> const& input)
{
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        VERIFY(m_output_thread_data->m_input == input);
        m_output_thread_data->m_input = nullptr;
    }
    input->set_wake_handler(nullptr);
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::create_playback_stream()
{
    if (m_started_creating_playback_stream)
        return;

    m_started_creating_playback_stream = true;

    auto data_callback = [output_thread_data = m_output_thread_data](Span<float> buffer, MonotonicTime buffer_starts_playing_at) -> ReadonlySpan<float> {
        return output_thread_data->move_output_to_playback_stream_buffer(buffer, buffer_starts_playing_at);
    };
    constexpr u32 target_latency_ms = 100;

    auto promise = m_output_factory->open_output(Audio::OutputState::Suspended, target_latency_ms, move(data_callback));
    promise->when_resolved([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this)](auto& stream) {
        auto sample_specification = stream->sample_specification();
        self->m_output_thread_data->m_sample_specification = sample_specification;
        auto const& input = self->m_output_thread_data->m_input;
        if (input != nullptr) {
            if (auto result = input->set_output_sample_specification(sample_specification); result.is_error()) {
                if (self->on_audio_output_error)
                    self->on_audio_output_error(result.release_error());
                return;
            }
        }
        {
            MutexLocker locker { self->m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
            self->m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream = stream;
        }
        stream->on_output_lost = [weak_self = self->make_weak_ref()] {
            if (auto self = weak_self.strong_ref())
                self->reopen_playback_stream_after_loss();
        };
        self->set_volume(self->m_volume);

        if (self->m_seek_target_awaiting_discard.has_value()) {
            self->seek(self->m_seek_target_awaiting_discard.release_value());
            if (input != nullptr)
                input->start();
            return;
        }

        if (input != nullptr) {
            input->seek(self->m_time_reader.current_time());
            input->start();
        }

        {
            MutexLocker locker { self->m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
            self->m_output_thread_data->m_seek_id++;
            self->m_output_thread_data->signal_output_thread_while_locked();
        }

        self->update_playback_stream_state();
    });

    promise->when_rejected([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this)](auto& error) {
        if (self->on_audio_output_error)
            self->on_audio_output_error(move(error));
    });
}

ReadonlySpan<float> AudioPlaybackSink::OutputThreadData::move_output_to_playback_stream_buffer(Span<float> buffer, MonotonicTime buffer_starts_playing_at)
{
    VERIFY(buffer.size() > 0);

    MutexLocker locker { m_output_mutex };

    auto first_frame_to_play = m_next_frame_to_play;
    size_t samples_written = 0;
    while (samples_written < buffer.size() && m_block_count > 0) {
        auto const& head_block = m_blocks[m_block_head];
        auto channel_count = head_block.channel_count();
        auto block_start_frame = head_block.first_frame_index();
        auto block_end_frame = block_start_frame + static_cast<i64>(head_block.frame_count());

        if (m_next_frame_to_play >= block_end_frame) {
            m_block_head = (m_block_head + 1) % OUTPUT_BLOCK_QUEUE_CAPACITY;
            m_block_count--;
            continue;
        }

        if (m_next_frame_to_play < block_start_frame) {
            auto silence_samples = static_cast<size_t>(block_start_frame - m_next_frame_to_play) * channel_count;
            auto samples_to_silence = min(silence_samples, buffer.size() - samples_written);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < samples_to_silence; i++)
                buffer[samples_written + i] = 0.0f;
            samples_written += samples_to_silence;
            m_next_frame_to_play += static_cast<i64>(samples_to_silence / channel_count);
            continue;
        }

        auto offset_in_head_frames = static_cast<size_t>(m_next_frame_to_play - block_start_frame);
        auto samples_to_copy = head_block.copy_to_interleaved(buffer.slice(samples_written), offset_in_head_frames);

        samples_written += samples_to_copy;
        m_next_frame_to_play += static_cast<i64>(samples_to_copy / channel_count);

        if ((offset_in_head_frames * channel_count) + samples_to_copy == head_block.sample_count()) {
            m_block_head = (m_block_head + 1) % OUTPUT_BLOCK_QUEUE_CAPACITY;
            m_block_count--;
        }
    }

    if (samples_written < buffer.size())
        buffer = buffer.trim(samples_written);

    if (samples_written > 0)
        m_time_writer.refresh_audio_anchor(buffer_starts_playing_at, first_frame_to_play, m_sample_specification.sample_rate(), MediaTimeProgression::Advancing);

    request_played_out_check_if_needed_while_locked();

    signal_output_thread_while_locked();
    return buffer;
}

i64 AudioPlaybackSink::OutputThreadData::hold_clock_at_played_frame_while_locked(MediaTimeReader const& time_reader)
{
    auto now = MonotonicTime::now();
    auto played_frame = min(time_reader.output_frame_index(now).value_or(m_next_frame_to_play), m_next_frame_to_play);
    auto progression = m_stream_state == StreamState::Suspended ? MediaTimeProgression::Stopped : MediaTimeProgression::Resuming;
    m_time_writer.refresh_audio_anchor(now, played_frame, m_sample_specification.sample_rate(), progression);
    return played_frame;
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::OutputThreadData::handle_input_suspension_while_locked(u32 seek_id)
{
    m_block_head = 0;
    m_block_tail = 0;
    m_block_count = 0;
    m_last_real_data_end_in_frames = m_next_frame_to_play;
    m_waiting_for_upstream_data = true;

    m_last_pull_status = PipelineStatus::Suspended;
    dispatch_state_if_changed(m_last_pull_status, m_last_pull_checkpoint, seek_id);
    request_resume_from_suspension_while_locked();
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::OutputThreadData::request_resume_from_suspension_while_locked()
{
    if (m_resume_from_suspension_requested)
        return;
    m_resume_from_suspension_requested = true;
    m_main_thread_event_loop.deferred_invoke([sink = m_sink] {
        if (auto strong_sink = sink.strong_ref())
            strong_sink->resume_input_from_suspension();
    });
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::OutputThreadData::request_played_out_check_if_needed_while_locked()
{
    if (!is_waiting_for_data(m_last_pull_status))
        return;
    if (m_last_pull_status == m_last_dispatched_status && m_last_pull_checkpoint == m_last_dispatched_checkpoint)
        return;
    if (m_next_frame_to_play < m_last_real_data_end_in_frames)
        return;
    if (m_played_out_check_requested)
        return;
    m_played_out_check_requested = true;
    m_main_thread_event_loop.deferred_invoke([sink = m_sink] {
        if (auto strong_sink = sink.strong_ref())
            strong_sink->dispatch_waiting_status_once_played_out();
    });
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::OutputThreadData::signal_output_thread_while_locked()
{
    m_output_thread_signal_count++;
    m_output_condition.broadcast();
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::OutputThreadData::report_input_status_while_locked(PipelineStatus status, PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint, u32 seek_id)
{
    if (is_waiting_for_data(status)) {
        // The output may run dry due to the input running slightly behind our playback rate, so we need to start the
        // timer here as well to ensure that it triggers even if the PlaybackStream goes idle due to underrun.
        request_played_out_check_if_needed_while_locked();
        return;
    }
    if (!status_change_should_wake(m_last_dispatched_status, status))
        return;
    dispatch_state_if_changed(status, checkpoint, seek_id);
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::OutputThreadData::dispatch_state_if_changed(PipelineStatus status, PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint, u32 seek_id)
{
    if (status == m_last_dispatched_status && checkpoint == m_last_dispatched_checkpoint)
        return;
    m_last_dispatched_status = status;
    m_last_dispatched_checkpoint = checkpoint;
    m_main_thread_event_loop.deferred_invoke([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this), status, checkpoint, seek_id] {
        if (self->m_seek_id != seek_id)
            return;
        auto sink = self->m_sink.strong_ref();
        if (sink && sink->m_on_state_changed)
            sink->m_on_state_changed(status, checkpoint);
    });
}

MediaTimeReader AudioPlaybackSink::time_reader() const
{
    return m_time_reader;
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::dispatch_waiting_status_once_played_out()
{
    auto const& sample_specification = m_output_thread_data->m_sample_specification;
    if (!m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream || !sample_specification.is_valid())
        return;
    if (m_seek_target_awaiting_discard.has_value())
        return;

    MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
    auto& output_thread_data = *m_output_thread_data;
    if (!output_thread_data.m_played_out_check_requested)
        return;
    auto status = output_thread_data.m_last_pull_status;
    if (!is_waiting_for_data(status) || output_thread_data.m_next_frame_to_play < output_thread_data.m_last_real_data_end_in_frames) {
        output_thread_data.m_played_out_check_requested = false;
        return;
    }

    // Until a buffer has anchored the clock, nothing has been written that could still be playing.
    auto played_frame_index = m_time_reader.output_frame_index(MonotonicTime::now()).value_or(output_thread_data.m_next_frame_to_play);
    auto frames_until_played_out = output_thread_data.m_last_real_data_end_in_frames - played_frame_index;
    if (frames_until_played_out > 0) {
        // The played position only advances while the stream is playing, and resuming the stream checks again.
        // Timers are imprecise, so this may fire early, in which case it waits for the remainder.
        if (m_output_thread_data->m_stream_state == StreamState::Playing) {
            auto delay = AK::Duration::from_time_units(frames_until_played_out, 1, sample_specification.sample_rate());
            m_played_out_timer->start(delay);
        }
        return;
    }

    output_thread_data.m_played_out_check_requested = false;
    output_thread_data.dispatch_state_if_changed(status, output_thread_data.m_last_pull_checkpoint, output_thread_data.m_seek_id);
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::resume()
{
    m_playing = true;
    resume_input_from_suspension();
    update_playback_stream_state();
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::pause()
{
    m_playing = false;
    update_playback_stream_state();
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::resume_input_from_suspension()
{
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        m_output_thread_data->m_resume_from_suspension_requested = false;
        if (m_output_thread_data->m_last_pull_status != PipelineStatus::Suspended)
            return;
    }
    if (!m_playing)
        return;

    // Seeking realigns our output frame indices with the media time that the reseeked chain will produce.
    dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "AudioPlaybackSink({:p}): Resuming the suspended input", this);
    seek(m_time_reader.current_time());
}

bool AudioPlaybackSink::playback_is_wanted() const
{
    return m_playing && m_output_thread_data->m_playback_rate != 0.0f;
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::set_stream_state(StreamState state)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
    m_output_thread_data->m_stream_state = state;
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::update_playback_stream_state()
{
    if (!playback_is_wanted()) {
        pause_playback_stream();
        return;
    }
    if (m_seek_target_awaiting_discard.has_value() || !m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream) {
        hold_clock_until_stream_can_resume();
        return;
    }
    resume_playback_stream();
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::hold_clock_until_stream_can_resume()
{
    auto& data = *m_output_thread_data;
    if (data.m_stream_state == StreamState::Resuming)
        return;
    // Only a seek stops a playing stream for playback that is still wanted, and it changes the state itself.
    VERIFY(data.m_stream_state == StreamState::Suspended);
    MutexLocker locker { data.m_output_mutex };
    data.m_stream_state = StreamState::Resuming;
    if (data.m_sample_specification.is_valid())
        (void)data.hold_clock_at_played_frame_while_locked(m_time_reader);
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::reopen_playback_stream_after_loss()
{
    dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "AudioPlaybackSink({:p}): The audio output is gone; opening a new one", this);
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream = nullptr;
        m_output_thread_data->m_stream_state = StreamState::Suspended;
    }
    m_started_creating_playback_stream = false;
    // With no stream this only records the target; the new stream seeks there once it opens, and plays on if we were.
    seek(m_time_reader.current_time());
    create_playback_stream();
}

bool AudioPlaybackSink::playback_stream_is_current(Audio::PlaybackStream const& stream) const
{
    return m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream.ptr() == &stream;
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::resume_playback_stream()
{
    if (m_output_thread_data->m_stream_state == StreamState::Playing)
        return;
    if (!m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream)
        return;

    dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "AudioPlaybackSink({:p}): Resuming the playback stream", this);
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        auto& data = *m_output_thread_data;
        data.m_stream_state = StreamState::Playing;
        data.m_time_writer.refresh_audio_anchor(MonotonicTime::now(), data.m_next_frame_to_play, data.m_sample_specification.sample_rate(), MediaTimeProgression::Resuming);
    }
    auto stream = NonnullRefPtr(*m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream);
    stream->resume()
        ->when_resolved([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this), stream]() {
            self->m_main_thread_event_loop.deferred_invoke([self, stream]() {
                if (!self->playback_stream_is_current(stream))
                    return;
                dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "AudioPlaybackSink({:p}): Playback stream resumed", self.ptr());
                self->dispatch_waiting_status_once_played_out();
            });
        })
        .when_rejected([](auto&& error) {
            warnln("Unexpected error while resuming AudioPlaybackSink: {}", error.string_literal());
        });
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::pause_playback_stream()
{
    auto& data = *m_output_thread_data;
    if (data.m_stream_state == StreamState::Suspended)
        return;

    // A stream that is not playing is already stopped or stopping, so only the clock changes from holding to stopped.
    if (data.m_stream_state == StreamState::Resuming) {
        MutexLocker locker { data.m_output_mutex };
        data.m_stream_state = StreamState::Suspended;
        if (data.m_sample_specification.is_valid())
            (void)data.hold_clock_at_played_frame_while_locked(m_time_reader);
        return;
    }
    if (!data.m_playback_stream)
        return;

    dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "AudioPlaybackSink({:p}): Discarding and suspending the playback stream", this);
    set_stream_state(StreamState::Suspended);
    auto stream = NonnullRefPtr(*m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream);
    stream->discard_buffer_and_suspend()
        ->when_resolved([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this), stream]() {
            // The frames the stream still held were never heard, so the clock stops where the device got to and the
            // input is read again from there.
            i64 played_frame = 0;
            {
                MutexLocker locker { self->m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
                if (self->m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream != stream)
                    return;
                played_frame = self->m_output_thread_data->hold_clock_at_played_frame_while_locked(self->m_time_reader);
            }
            self->m_main_thread_event_loop.deferred_invoke([self, stream, played_frame]() {
                if (!self->playback_stream_is_current(stream) || self->m_seek_target_awaiting_discard.has_value())
                    return;
                self->reseek_input_continuing_at_output_frame(played_frame);
            });
        })
        .when_rejected([](auto&& error) {
            warnln("Unexpected error while pausing AudioPlaybackSink: {}", error.string_literal());
        });
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::reseek_input_keeping_clock()
{
    // A seek whose stream is still stopping has yet to read its data, so it can simply read the new data instead.
    if (m_seek_target_awaiting_discard.has_value()) {
        seek(m_seek_target_awaiting_discard.value());
        return;
    }

    // Continue from what was already written to the stream, so that neither a gap nor a repeat can be heard.
    reseek_input_continuing_at_output_frame({});
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::reseek_input_continuing_at_output_frame(Optional<i64> continue_at_output_frame)
{
    RefPtr<AudioProducer> input;
    AK::Duration timestamp;
    i64 output_frame = 0;
    m_played_out_timer->stop();
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        auto& data = *m_output_thread_data;
        // Without a playback stream, the input will be seeked once the stream is created.
        if (data.m_input == nullptr || !data.m_playback_stream)
            return;
        input = data.m_input;

        output_frame = continue_at_output_frame.value_or(data.m_next_frame_to_play);
        data.m_next_frame_to_play = output_frame;
        timestamp = AK::Duration::from_time_units(output_frame, 1, data.m_sample_specification.sample_rate());
        if (auto timing = data.block_timings().find_timing_for_frame_index(output_frame); timing.has_value())
            timestamp = timing->media_time_at_frame_index(output_frame);

        data.m_seek_id++;
        data.m_block_head = 0;
        data.m_block_tail = 0;
        data.m_block_count = 0;
        data.m_last_real_data_end_in_frames = output_frame;
        data.m_eos_media_frame_remainder = 0.0f;
        data.m_last_pull_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;
        data.m_last_dispatched_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;
        data.m_played_out_check_requested = false;
        data.m_waiting_for_upstream_data = true;
        data.m_input_seek_in_flight = true;
        data.signal_output_thread_while_locked();
    }

    input->seek_continuing_at_output_frame(timestamp, output_frame);

    MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
    m_output_thread_data->m_input_seek_in_flight = false;
    m_output_thread_data->signal_output_thread_while_locked();
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::seek(AK::Duration time)
{
    bool already_discarding_for_seek = m_seek_target_awaiting_discard.has_value();
    m_seek_target_awaiting_discard = time;

    if (!m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream) {
        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        auto& data = *m_output_thread_data;
        data.m_stream_state = playback_is_wanted() ? StreamState::Resuming : StreamState::Suspended;
        data.m_time_writer.seek(time);
        if (data.m_sample_specification.is_valid() && data.m_stream_state == StreamState::Resuming)
            data.m_time_writer.refresh_audio_anchor(MonotonicTime::now(), time.to_time_units(1, data.m_sample_specification.sample_rate()), data.m_sample_specification.sample_rate(), MediaTimeProgression::Resuming);
        return;
    }

    auto seek_target_in_frames = time.to_time_units(1, m_output_thread_data->m_sample_specification.sample_rate());
    m_played_out_timer->stop();
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        m_output_thread_data->m_seek_id++;

        m_output_thread_data->m_next_frame_to_play = seek_target_in_frames;

        m_output_thread_data->m_last_pull_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;
        m_output_thread_data->m_last_dispatched_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;
        m_output_thread_data->m_last_real_data_end_in_frames = seek_target_in_frames;
        m_output_thread_data->m_played_out_check_requested = false;
        m_output_thread_data->m_eos_media_frame_remainder = 0.0f;

        // Discard the stale output ring; upstream no longer signals the move in-band.
        m_output_thread_data->m_block_head = 0;
        m_output_thread_data->m_block_tail = 0;
        m_output_thread_data->m_block_count = 0;
        m_output_thread_data->block_timings().clear();

        m_output_thread_data->m_waiting_for_upstream_data = true;
        m_output_thread_data->m_input_seek_in_flight = m_output_thread_data->m_input != nullptr;
        m_output_thread_data->m_stream_state = playback_is_wanted() ? StreamState::Resuming : StreamState::Suspended;
        m_output_thread_data->m_time_writer.seek(time);
        if (m_output_thread_data->m_stream_state == StreamState::Resuming)
            m_output_thread_data->m_time_writer.refresh_audio_anchor(MonotonicTime::now(), seek_target_in_frames, m_output_thread_data->m_sample_specification.sample_rate(), MediaTimeProgression::Resuming);
    }

    if (m_output_thread_data->m_input != nullptr) {
        m_output_thread_data->m_input->seek(time);

        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        m_output_thread_data->m_input_seek_in_flight = false;
        m_output_thread_data->signal_output_thread_while_locked();
    }

    if (already_discarding_for_seek)
        return;

    dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "AudioPlaybackSink({:p}): Discarding the playback stream's buffer for a seek to {}", this, time);
    auto stream = NonnullRefPtr(*m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream);
    stream->discard_buffer_and_suspend()
        ->when_resolved([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this), stream]() {
            self->m_main_thread_event_loop.deferred_invoke([self, stream]() {
                // The target waits for the stream that replaced this one, which seeks there as it opens.
                if (!self->playback_stream_is_current(stream))
                    return;
                dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "AudioPlaybackSink({:p}): Playback stream stopped for the seek", self.ptr());
                self->m_seek_target_awaiting_discard.clear();
                self->update_playback_stream_state();
                self->dispatch_waiting_status_once_played_out();
            });
        })
        .when_rejected([](auto&& error) {
            warnln("Unexpected error while seeking AudioPlaybackSink: {}", error.string_literal());
        });
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::set_volume(double volume)
{
    m_volume = volume;

    if (m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream) {
        m_output_thread_data->m_playback_stream->set_volume(m_volume)
            ->when_rejected([](Error&&) {
                // FIXME: Do we even need this function to return a promise?
            });
    }
}

void AudioPlaybackSink::set_playback_rate(float rate)
{
    VERIFY(rate >= 0);
    RefPtr<AudioProducer> input;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_output_thread_data->m_output_mutex };
        input = m_output_thread_data->m_input;
        m_output_thread_data->m_playback_rate = rate;
        m_output_thread_data->signal_output_thread_while_locked();
    }

    if (input != nullptr && rate != 0.0f)
        input->set_playback_rate(rate);

    update_playback_stream_state();
}

}
