#include <LibMedia/PipelineStatus.h>
#include <LibMedia/Producers/AudioProducer.h>
#include <LibMedia/Sinks/AudioOutputFactory.h>
#include <LibMedia/Sinks/AudioSink.h>

namespace Media {

class MEDIA_API AudioPlaybackSink final : public AudioSink
    , public MediaClock
    , public ThreadSafeWeakable<AudioPlaybackSink> {
private:
    class OutputThreadData;

public:
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<AudioPlaybackSink>> try_create(PipelineStateChangeHandler on_state_changed, NonnullRefPtr<AudioOutputFactory>);
    AudioPlaybackSink(NonnullRefPtr<OutputThreadData>, MediaTimeReader, PipelineStateChangeHandler, NonnullRefPtr<AudioOutputFactory>);
    virtual ~AudioPlaybackSink() override;

    virtual ErrorOr<void> connect_input(NonnullRefPtr<AudioProducer> const&) override;
    virtual void disconnect_input(NonnullRefPtr<AudioProducer> const&) override;

    void start();

    virtual MediaTimeReader time_reader() const override;
    virtual void resume() override;
    virtual void pause() override;
    virtual void seek(AK::Duration) override;
    // Replaces the queued output with data read again from the input, without moving the clock.
    void reseek_input_keeping_clock();
    void reseek_input_continuing_at_output_frame(Optional<i64> output_frame);

    virtual void set_playback_rate(float) override;

    void set_volume(double);

    Function<void(Error&&)> on_audio_output_error;

private:
    enum class StreamState {
        Suspended,
        // Playback is wanted, but the stream is still stopping for a seek or has yet to open. The clock holds meanwhile.
        Resuming,
        Playing,
    };

    void reopen_playback_stream_after_loss();
    bool playback_stream_is_current(Audio::PlaybackStream const&) const;

    void create_playback_stream();
    bool playback_is_wanted() const;
    void set_stream_state(StreamState);
    void update_playback_stream_state();
    void resume_playback_stream();
    void pause_playback_stream();
    void hold_clock_until_stream_can_resume();
    void resume_input_from_suspension();
    void dispatch_waiting_status_once_played_out();

    Core::EventLoop& m_main_thread_event_loop;
    PipelineStateChangeHandler m_on_state_changed;
    NonnullRefPtr<AudioOutputFactory> m_output_factory;

    bool m_started_creating_playback_stream { false };
    bool m_playing { false };
    double m_volume { 1 };

    Optional<AK::Duration> m_seek_target_awaiting_discard;

    NonnullRefPtr<OutputThreadData> m_output_thread_data;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_played_out_timer;
    MediaTimeReader m_time_reader;
};

}

ErrorOr<void> DisplayingVideoSink::connect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const& input)
{
    VERIFY(m_input == nullptr);
    m_input = input;
    input->set_wake_handler([this] {
        auto output = m_input->peek();
        m_input_checkpoint = output.checkpoint;
        if (output.status == PipelineStatus::Suspended) {
            m_next_frame = nullptr;
            // A ticking sink's update resumes the input if the time is moving, and reports the suspension otherwise.
            if (is_ticking()) {
                update(MonotonicTime::now());
                return;
            }
            m_latest_status = PipelineStatus::Suspended;
            dispatch_latest_state_if_changed();
            report_freshness_if_changed();
            return;
        }
        // Update the sink to dispatch a status if we're still resolving a seek or waiting for data. If we're not, avoid
        // the update so that we don't count dropped frames due to the decoder waiting for room while we're not
        // consuming frames.
        auto status_may_change = [&] {
            if (m_seek_status != SeekStatus::None || m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target)
                return true;
            return is_waiting_for_data(m_latest_status);
        }();
        if (!is_ticking() && !status_may_change)
            return;
        update(MonotonicTime::now());
    });
    if (m_ticking != VideoSinkTicking::Undecided) {
        start_input();
        report_freshness_if_changed();
    }
    return {};
}

void DisplayingVideoSink::start_input()
{
    VERIFY(m_ticking != VideoSinkTicking::Undecided);
    if (!is_ticking()) {
        m_input->suspend();
        return;
    }
    m_next_frame = nullptr;
    m_latest_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;
    m_seek_status = SeekStatus::CatchingUp;
    m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target = true;
    m_input->seek(m_time_reader.current_time());
    m_input->start();
}

void DisplayingVideoSink::disconnect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const& input)
{
    VERIFY(m_input == input);
    m_input->set_wake_handler(nullptr);
    m_input = nullptr;
}

void DisplayingVideoSink::seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data)
{
    begin_seek(timestamp, invalidate_held_data, SeekStatus::InProgress);
    report_freshness_if_changed();
}

void DisplayingVideoSink::begin_seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data, SeekStatus seek_status)
{
    VERIFY(seek_status != SeekStatus::None);
    m_seek_id++;
    m_latest_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;
    m_last_dispatched_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;
    m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target = true;

    // The input is seeked to the current time when ticking starts. Don't seek and possibly unsuspend the input yet.
    if (m_ticking == VideoSinkTicking::Undecided)
        return;

    // If the sink isn't ticking, don't unsuspend the input unnecessarily. Let it catch up later. Data that the seek
    // invalidates may be what the current frame shows, so the seek replaces the frame then.
    if (seek_status == SeekStatus::InProgress && invalidate_held_data == InvalidateHeldData::No && !is_ticking() && m_input != nullptr && m_input->peek().status == PipelineStatus::Suspended) {
        m_next_frame = nullptr;
        m_seek_status = SeekStatus::None;
        m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target = false;
        m_latest_status = PipelineStatus::Suspended;
        defer_latest_status_dispatch();
        return;
    }

    auto can_resolve_seek_within_cached_frames = [&] {
        if (invalidate_held_data == InvalidateHeldData::Yes)
            return false;
        if (m_seek_status != SeekStatus::None)
            return false;
        if (m_cached_frames_are_discontinuous)
            return false;
        if (m_input != nullptr && m_input->peek().status == PipelineStatus::Suspended)
            return false;
        auto available_start = AK::Duration::max();
        auto available_end = AK::Duration::min();
        auto include_frame = [&](RefPtr<VideoFrame> const& frame) {
            if (frame == nullptr)
                return;
            available_start = min(available_start, frame->timestamp());
            available_end = max(available_end, frame->conservative_end());
        };
        include_frame(m_current_frame);
        include_frame(m_next_frame);

        if (timestamp < available_start)
            return false;
        if (timestamp < available_end)
            return true;
        return m_input != nullptr && m_input->peek().status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream;
    }();

    if (can_resolve_seek_within_cached_frames) {
        update(MonotonicTime::now());
        return;
    }

    if (m_input != nullptr)
        m_input->seek(timestamp, invalidate_held_data);
    m_seek_status = seek_status;
    m_next_frame = nullptr;
}

void DisplayingVideoSink::dispatch_latest_state_if_changed()
{
    if (m_latest_status == m_last_dispatched_status && m_input_checkpoint == m_last_dispatched_checkpoint)
        return;
    m_last_dispatched_status = m_latest_status;
    m_last_dispatched_checkpoint = m_input_checkpoint;
    if (m_on_state_changed)
        m_on_state_changed(m_latest_status, m_input_checkpoint);
}

// Dispatches with a deferred invoke to avoid reentrancy. This prevents a seek from resolving while an update or a seek
// is being processed.
void DisplayingVideoSink::defer_latest_status_dispatch()
{
    if (m_latest_status == m_last_dispatched_status && m_input_checkpoint == m_last_dispatched_checkpoint)
        return;
    Core::deferred_invoke([weak_self = make_weak_ref(), seek_id = m_seek_id] {
        auto self = weak_self.strong_ref();
        if (!self)
            return;
        if (seek_id != self->m_seek_id)
            return;
        self->dispatch_latest_state_if_changed();
    });
}

DisplayingVideoSinkUpdateResult DisplayingVideoSink::update(MonotonicTime now)
{
    if (m_input == nullptr || m_ticking == VideoSinkTicking::Undecided)
        return {};
    if (is_ticking())
        m_has_updated_since_ticking_began = true;

    auto time_state = m_time_reader.time_state(now);
    auto current_time = time_state.time;
    auto new_frame_available = false;
    u64 passed_frame_count = 0;
    auto last_passed_frame_was_late = false;
    Optional<AK::Duration> last_passed_timestamp;
    if (m_current_frame)
        last_passed_timestamp = m_current_frame->timestamp();

    auto last_status = PipelineStatus::Pending;
    auto seek_resolved_during_this_update = false;
    while (true) {
        if (m_next_frame == nullptr) {
            auto output = m_input->peek();
            last_status = output.status;
            m_input_checkpoint = output.checkpoint;
            if (output.frame == nullptr) {
                if (is_terminal(last_status) && m_seek_status != SeekStatus::None) {
                    m_seek_status = SeekStatus::None;
                    new_frame_available = true;
                }
                break;
            }
            m_next_frame = move(output.frame);
            m_input->consume();
        }
        if (m_seek_status != SeekStatus::None && resolves_seek(last_status)) {
            m_current_frame.clear();
            last_passed_timestamp.clear();
            m_seek_status = SeekStatus::None;
            seek_resolved_during_this_update = true;
            new_frame_available = true;
        }
        if (m_seek_status != SeekStatus::None)
            break;
        if (m_next_frame->timestamp() > current_time)
            break;

        if (last_passed_timestamp.has_value() && last_passed_timestamp.value() > m_next_frame->timestamp()) {
            m_next_frame.clear();
            continue;
        }

        if (auto frame_size = m_next_frame->size(); frame_size != m_last_dispatched_size) {
            m_last_dispatched_size = frame_size;
            if (m_on_resize)
                m_on_resize(frame_size);
        }

        // Skip presenting frames that are late, unless we're resolving a seek. Seeks should always resolve with a
        // frame regardless of whether it is late.
        if (!seek_resolved_during_this_update && current_time > m_next_frame->conservative_end()) {
            auto next = m_input->peek();
            last_status = next.status;
            m_input_checkpoint = next.checkpoint;
            if (!is_terminal(last_status)) {
                // A passed frame stays on screen until the next one replaces it.
                auto next_frame_is_due = last_status == PipelineStatus::HaveData && next.frame->timestamp() <= current_time;
                if (next_frame_is_due) {
                    if (!m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target) {
                        passed_frame_count++;
                        last_passed_frame_was_late = true;
                    }
                    last_passed_timestamp = m_next_frame->timestamp();
                    m_next_frame = move(next.frame);
                    m_input->consume();
                    m_cached_frames_are_discontinuous = true;
                    continue;
                }
                if (last_status != PipelineStatus::HaveData)
                    break;
            }
        }
        m_current_frame = m_next_frame.release_nonnull();
        m_cached_frames_are_discontinuous = false;
        new_frame_available = true;
        last_passed_timestamp = m_current_frame->timestamp();
        if (m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target)
            passed_frame_count = 1;
        else
            passed_frame_count++;
        last_passed_frame_was_late = false;
    }

    if (last_passed_frame_was_late)
        m_frame_counts.dropped += passed_frame_count;
    else
        m_frame_counts.presented += passed_frame_count;

    auto status_to_dispatch = last_status;

    if (m_current_frame != nullptr && m_seek_status == SeekStatus::None) {
        auto current_frame_end = m_current_frame->conservative_end();
        if (is_terminal(last_status) || m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target)
            current_frame_end = m_current_frame->end();
        if (current_time < current_frame_end)
            status_to_dispatch = PipelineStatus::HaveData;
    }

    if (m_next_frame != nullptr && m_next_frame->timestamp() > current_time)
        status_to_dispatch = PipelineStatus::HaveData;

    if (resolves_seek(status_to_dispatch))
        m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target = false;

    if (last_status == PipelineStatus::Suspended) {
        auto time_is_changing = time_state.is_advancing || m_seek_status != SeekStatus::None;
        if (time_is_changing) {
            m_next_frame = nullptr;
            if (m_seek_status == SeekStatus::None)
                m_seek_status = SeekStatus::CatchingUp;
            m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target = true;
            m_input->seek(current_time);
            status_to_dispatch = PipelineStatus::Pending;
        } else {
            status_to_dispatch = PipelineStatus::Suspended;
        }
    }

    if (new_frame_available && m_on_present_needed)
        m_on_present_needed();

    m_latest_status = status_to_dispatch;
    defer_latest_status_dispatch();

    auto may_require_updates = !is_terminal(status_to_dispatch) && (time_state.is_advancing || m_seek_status != SeekStatus::None);

    // Whoever drives our updates stops once we no longer require them, so ask for a present to restart them.
    auto updates_were_stopped = !m_last_update_may_require_updates;
    m_last_update_may_require_updates = may_require_updates;
    if (may_require_updates && updates_were_stopped && !new_frame_available && m_on_present_needed)
        m_on_present_needed();

    report_freshness_if_changed();
    return {
        .new_frame_available = new_frame_available,
        .may_require_updates = may_require_updates,
    };
}

void DisplayingVideoSink::notify_clock_resumed()
{
    if (is_ticking())
        update(MonotonicTime::now());
}

void DisplayingVideoSink::set_ticking(bool ticking)
{
    auto new_ticking = ticking ? VideoSinkTicking::Yes : VideoSinkTicking::No;
    auto previous_ticking = exchange(m_ticking, new_ticking);
    if (previous_ticking == new_ticking)
        return;
    if (ticking)
        m_has_updated_since_ticking_began = false;
    if (previous_ticking == VideoSinkTicking::Undecided) {
        if (m_input != nullptr)
            start_input();
    } else if (ticking) {
        catch_up_to_clock();
    }
    report_freshness_if_changed();
}

DisplayingVideoSink::Freshness DisplayingVideoSink::freshness() const
{
    return { .is_ticking = is_ticking(), .is_catching_up = is_catching_up(), .frame_is_up_to_date = frame_is_up_to_date() };
}

void DisplayingVideoSink::report_freshness_if_changed()
{
    auto freshness = this->freshness();
    if (freshness == m_reported_freshness)
        return;
    m_reported_freshness = freshness;
    if (m_on_freshness_changed)
        m_on_freshness_changed();
}

void DisplayingVideoSink::catch_up_to_clock()
{
    if (m_ticking == VideoSinkTicking::Undecided || m_seek_status != SeekStatus::None)
        return;
    auto current_time = m_time_reader.current_time();

    // Don't request a seek to the same frame, or we'll wake upstream while suspended for no reason.
    if (m_current_frame != nullptr && m_current_frame->contains_timestamp(current_time))
        return;

    begin_seek(current_time, InvalidateHeldData::No, SeekStatus::CatchingUp);
    report_freshness_if_changed();
}

RefPtr<VideoFrame> DisplayingVideoSink::current_frame() const
{
    return m_current_frame;
}

}

#include <LibMedia/Sinks/VideoSinkTicking.h>

namespace Media {

struct DisplayingVideoSinkUpdateResult {
    bool new_frame_available { false };
    bool may_require_updates { false };
};

struct DisplayingVideoSinkFrameCounts {
    u64 presented { 0 };
    u64 dropped { 0 };

    bool is_zero() const { return presented == 0 && dropped == 0; }
};

class MEDIA_API DisplayingVideoSink final : public VideoSink
    , public ThreadSafeWeakable<DisplayingVideoSink> {
public:
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink>> try_create(MediaTimeReader);

    explicit DisplayingVideoSink(MediaTimeReader);
    virtual ~DisplayingVideoSink() override;

    virtual void set_time_reader(MediaTimeReader) override;
    virtual void set_state_change_handler(PipelineStateChangeHandler) override;
    virtual void set_resize_handler(PipelineResizeHandler) override;

    virtual ErrorOr<void> connect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const&) override;
    virtual void disconnect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const&) override;

    virtual void seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData = InvalidateHeldData::No) override;
    virtual void notify_clock_resumed() override;
    virtual void set_ticking(bool) override;
    bool is_ticking() const { return m_ticking == VideoSinkTicking::Yes; }
    bool ticking_is_decided() const { return m_ticking != VideoSinkTicking::Undecided; }
    // Called when the sink starts or stops ticking, catching up, or having an up-to-date frame.
    void set_on_freshness_changed(Function<void()> handler) { m_on_freshness_changed = move(handler); }
    // Seeks the input to the clock's time if the current frame doesn't show it, whether or not the sink is ticking.
    void catch_up_to_clock();
    // A catch-up that waits for data keeps the last frame shown until the data arrives, so it is not waited for.
    bool is_catching_up() const { return m_seek_status == SeekStatus::CatchingUp && m_latest_status != PipelineStatus::Blocked; }
    // Whether the frame may change if it is ticked.
    bool frame_is_up_to_date() const { return is_ticking() && m_has_updated_since_ticking_began && !is_catching_up(); }

    DisplayingVideoSinkUpdateResult update(MonotonicTime now);
    RefPtr<VideoFrame> current_frame() const;
    DisplayingVideoSinkFrameCounts take_frame_counts() { return exchange(m_frame_counts, {}); }

    void set_on_present_needed(Function<void()> handler) { m_on_present_needed = move(handler); }

private:
    void dispatch_latest_state_if_changed();
    void defer_latest_status_dispatch();
    void report_freshness_if_changed();
    void start_input();

    MediaTimeReader m_time_reader;
    RefPtr<VideoProducer> m_input;

    VideoSinkTicking m_ticking { VideoSinkTicking::Undecided };
    bool m_has_updated_since_ticking_began { false };
    RefPtr<VideoFrame> m_next_frame;
    RefPtr<VideoFrame> m_current_frame;
    bool m_cached_frames_are_discontinuous { false };
    bool m_seek_resolution_is_pending_frame_at_target { false };
    DisplayingVideoSinkFrameCounts m_frame_counts;

    enum class SeekStatus : u8 {
        None,
        // A seek that the sink made to catch its frames up to the clock. A seek from upstream replaces it.
        CatchingUp,
        InProgress,
    };
    SeekStatus m_seek_status { SeekStatus::None };
    void begin_seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData, SeekStatus);

    PipelineStateChangeHandler m_on_state_changed;
    PipelineStatus m_latest_status { PipelineStatus::Pending };
    PipelineStatus m_last_dispatched_status { PipelineStatus::Pending };
    PipelineCheckpoint m_input_checkpoint { 0 };
    PipelineCheckpoint m_last_dispatched_checkpoint { 0 };
    u32 m_seek_id { 0 };

    PipelineResizeHandler m_on_resize;
    Gfx::Size<u32> m_last_dispatched_size;

    Function<void()> m_on_present_needed;
    Function<void()> m_on_freshness_changed;
    struct Freshness {
        bool is_ticking { false };
        bool is_catching_up { false };
        bool frame_is_up_to_date { false };

        bool operator==(Freshness const&) const = default;
    };
    Freshness freshness() const;
    Freshness m_reported_freshness;
    bool m_last_update_may_require_updates { false };
};

}

class RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData : public AtomicRefCounted<RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData> {
public:
    explicit ThreadData(Delegates);
    ~ThreadData();

    ErrorOr<void> connect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const&);
    void disconnect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const&);
    void notify_clock_resumed() const;
    void transmit_seek(InvalidateHeldData) const;
    void transmit_time_reader(MediaTimeReader const&) const;
    void transmit_ticking(bool) const;
    void seek_upstream(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData, u64 newest_received_lend_id);
    void seek_input_directly(AK::Duration timestamp);
    void start_input();
    void suspend_input();
    void consumer_started_input();
    void release_frame(u64 lend_id);

    void pump_thread_loop();
    void request_exit();
    void stop();
    bool has_lent_frames() const;

private:
    struct PublishedStatus {
        PipelineStatus status { PipelineStatus::Pending };
        u32 seek_id { 0 };
        PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint { 0 };

        bool operator==(PublishedStatus const&) const = default;
    };

    void lend_frame(NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> const&, u32 seek_id);
    void publish_status(PublishedStatus);
    bool consumer_may_satisfy_seek_locally(AK::Duration timestamp) const;
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> frames_lent_after_holding(u64 newest_received_lend_id, AK::Duration timestamp) const;
    void wait_on_pump_thread(MutexLocker<Mutex>&);
    void wake_pump_thread();

    Delegates m_delegates;

    mutable Mutex m_mutex;
    ConditionVariable m_wait_condition { m_mutex };
    RefPtr<VideoProducer> m_input;
    bool m_exit_requested { false };
    bool m_pump_thread_exited { false };
    bool m_wake_pending { false };
    // The input may still hold what it had for a previous consumer, so it is only peeked once this consumer has started
    // or suspended it, as it would be in process.
    bool m_consumer_has_started_input { false };
    u32 m_actual_seek_id { 0 };
    // A seek the input was given directly, whose request from the consumer has yet to arrive.
    Optional<AK::Duration> m_direct_seek_timestamp;
    // Still in the input until it has been lent.
    RefPtr<VideoFrame> m_peeked_frame;
    // Lent again under the next seek's stamp before anything newer is taken from the input.
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> m_frames_to_lend_again;
    Optional<PublishedStatus> m_published_status;

    mutable Mutex m_lent_frames_mutex;
    OrderedHashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> m_lent_frames;
    u64 m_next_lend_id { 1 };
};

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoSink>> RemoteVideoSink::create(Delegates delegates)
{
    VERIFY(delegates.send_frame);
    VERIFY(delegates.send_status);
    VERIFY(delegates.notify_clock_resumed);
    VERIFY(delegates.transmit_seek);
    VERIFY(delegates.transmit_time_reader);
    VERIFY(delegates.transmit_ticking);
    auto thread_data = TRY(adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) ThreadData(move(delegates))));
    auto sink = TRY(adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) RemoteVideoSink(thread_data)));
    auto thread = Threading::Thread::construct("Video Pump"sv, [thread_data]() -> intptr_t {
        thread_data->pump_thread_loop();
        return 0;
    });
    thread->start();
    thread->detach();
    return sink;
}

RemoteVideoSink::RemoteVideoSink(NonnullRefPtr<ThreadData> thread_data)
    : m_thread_data(move(thread_data))
{
}

RemoteVideoSink::~RemoteVideoSink()
{
    m_thread_data->request_exit();
}

void RemoteVideoSink::disconnect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const& producer) { m_thread_data->disconnect_input(producer); }

    if (invalidate_held_data == InvalidateHeldData::No && m_consumer_is_ticking)

}

ErrorOr<void> RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::connect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const& producer)
{
    producer->set_wake_handler([this] { wake_pump_thread(); });
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    VERIFY(m_input == nullptr);
    m_input = producer;
    m_wake_pending = true;
    m_wait_condition.broadcast();
    return {};
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::disconnect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const& producer)
{
    producer->set_wake_handler(nullptr);
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    VERIFY(m_input == producer.ptr());
    m_input = nullptr;
    m_direct_seek_timestamp = {};
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::notify_clock_resumed() const
{
    m_delegates.notify_clock_resumed();
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::transmit_seek(InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data) const
{
    m_delegates.transmit_seek(invalidate_held_data);
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::transmit_time_reader(MediaTimeReader const& time_reader) const
{
    m_delegates.transmit_time_reader(time_reader);
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::transmit_ticking(bool ticking) const
{
    m_delegates.transmit_ticking(ticking);
}

Vector<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::frames_lent_after_holding(u64 newest_received_lend_id, AK::Duration timestamp) const
{
    // A frame lent again for an earlier seek is lent twice.
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> frames;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_lent_frames_mutex };
        for (auto const& [lend_id, frame] : m_lent_frames) {
            if (lend_id <= newest_received_lend_id)
                continue;
            if (!frames.contains_slow(frame))
                frames.append(frame);
        }
    }
    quick_sort(frames, [](auto const& a, auto const& b) { return a->timestamp() < b->timestamp(); });
    if (frames.is_empty() || timestamp < frames.first()->timestamp() || timestamp >= frames.last()->conservative_end())
        return {};

    // The frame still in the input is lent again by taking it from the input.
    frames.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& frame) {
        return frame->end() <= timestamp || frame.ptr() == m_peeked_frame.ptr();
    });
    return frames;
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::seek_upstream(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data, u64 newest_received_lend_id)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    auto direct_seek_timestamp = m_direct_seek_timestamp;
    m_direct_seek_timestamp = {};
    m_frames_to_lend_again.clear();
    m_actual_seek_id++;

    auto seek_was_given_directly = direct_seek_timestamp == timestamp && invalidate_held_data == InvalidateHeldData::No;
    if (!seek_was_given_directly) {
        if (invalidate_held_data == InvalidateHeldData::No)
            m_frames_to_lend_again = frames_lent_after_holding(newest_received_lend_id, timestamp);
        if (m_frames_to_lend_again.is_empty() && m_input)
            m_input->seek(timestamp, invalidate_held_data);
    }
    m_wake_pending = true;
    m_wait_condition.broadcast();
}

bool RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::consumer_may_satisfy_seek_locally(AK::Duration timestamp) const
{
    Optional<AK::Duration> earliest_timestamp;
    Optional<AK::Duration> latest_end;
    auto include_frame = [&](VideoFrame const& frame) {
        if (!earliest_timestamp.has_value() || frame.timestamp() < earliest_timestamp.value())
            earliest_timestamp = frame.timestamp();
        if (!latest_end.has_value() || frame.conservative_end() > latest_end.value())
            latest_end = frame.conservative_end();
    };
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_lent_frames_mutex };
        for (auto const& [lend_id, frame] : m_lent_frames)
            include_frame(*frame);
    }
    if (m_peeked_frame)
        include_frame(*m_peeked_frame);
    if (!earliest_timestamp.has_value() || timestamp < earliest_timestamp.value())
        return false;
    if (timestamp < latest_end.value())
        return true;
    return m_published_status.has_value() && m_published_status->seek_id == m_actual_seek_id && m_published_status->status == PipelineStatus::EndOfStream;
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::seek_input_directly(AK::Duration timestamp)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    if (m_input == nullptr || m_direct_seek_timestamp.has_value() || consumer_may_satisfy_seek_locally(timestamp))
        return;
    // Pumping stops until the consumer's request for this seek arrives, so that no frame of the new position is
    // stamped with the seek before it.
    m_direct_seek_timestamp = timestamp;
    m_input->seek(timestamp, InvalidateHeldData::No);
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::start_input()
{
    RefPtr<VideoProducer> input;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        input = m_input;
    }
    if (input)
        input->start();
    consumer_started_input();
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::suspend_input()
{
    RefPtr<VideoProducer> input;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        input = m_input;
    }
    if (input)
        input->suspend();
    consumer_started_input();
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::consumer_started_input()
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    m_consumer_has_started_input = true;
    m_wake_pending = true;
    m_wait_condition.broadcast();
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::release_frame(u64 lend_id)
{
    // The frame is dropped outside the lock, since releasing its storage may wake its decoder.
    Optional<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> released_frame;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_lent_frames_mutex };
        released_frame = m_lent_frames.take(lend_id);
    }
    if (!released_frame.has_value())
        return;
    released_frame.clear();
    wake_pump_thread();
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::wake_pump_thread()
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    m_wake_pending = true;
    m_wait_condition.broadcast();
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::request_exit()
{
    RefPtr<VideoProducer> input;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        m_exit_requested = true;
        input = move(m_input);
        m_frames_to_lend_again.clear();
        m_wake_pending = true;
        m_wait_condition.broadcast();
    }
    if (input)
        input->set_wake_handler(nullptr);
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::stop()
{
    request_exit();
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    while (!m_pump_thread_exited)
        m_wait_condition.wait();
}

bool RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::has_lent_frames() const
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_lent_frames_mutex };
    return !m_lent_frames.is_empty();
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::wait_on_pump_thread(MutexLocker<Mutex>&)
{
    while (!m_wake_pending && !m_exit_requested)
        m_wait_condition.wait();
    m_wake_pending = false;
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::publish_status(PublishedStatus status)
{
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        if (m_published_status == status)
            return;
        m_published_status = status;
    }
    m_delegates.send_status(status.status, status.seek_id, status.checkpoint);
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::lend_frame(NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> const& frame, u32 seek_id)
{
    u64 lend_id = 0;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_lent_frames_mutex };
        lend_id = m_next_lend_id++;
        m_lent_frames.set(lend_id, frame);
    }

    m_delegates.send_frame({
        .lend_id = lend_id,
        .seek_id = seek_id,
        .metadata = VideoFrameMetadata::for_frame(*frame),
        .pixels = frame->storage()->pixels(),
    });
}

void RemoteVideoSink::ThreadData::pump_thread_loop()
{
    // The seek ID a frame was lent under, while it has yet to be consumed from the input.
    Optional<u32> lent_frame_seek_id;
    PipelineCheckpoint input_checkpoint = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (lent_frame_seek_id.has_value()) {
            {
                MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
                m_peeked_frame = nullptr;
                if (m_exit_requested)
                    break;
                if (m_actual_seek_id != lent_frame_seek_id.value()) {
                    // A seek was applied since the peek, so the input's head is re-peeked; if unchanged, it is lent
                    // again under the new stamp and the consumer drops the old copy.
                    lent_frame_seek_id = {};
                    continue;
                }
                if (m_direct_seek_timestamp.has_value()) {
                    wait_on_pump_thread(locker);
                    continue;
                }
                if (m_input)
                    m_input->consume();
            }
            publish_status({ PipelineStatus::Pending, lent_frame_seek_id.value(), input_checkpoint });
            lent_frame_seek_id = {};
            continue;
        }

        u32 seek_id = 0;
        Vector<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> frames_to_lend_again;
        VideoProducerOutput output;
        {
            MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
            if (m_exit_requested)
                break;
            seek_id = m_actual_seek_id;
            frames_to_lend_again = move(m_frames_to_lend_again);
            if (frames_to_lend_again.is_empty()) {
                auto may_lend_another_frame = [&] {
                    MutexLocker lent_frames_locker { m_lent_frames_mutex };
                    return m_lent_frames.size() < MAX_LENT_FRAME_COUNT;
                }();
                if (m_input == nullptr || !m_consumer_has_started_input || !may_lend_another_frame || m_direct_seek_timestamp.has_value()) {
                    wait_on_pump_thread(locker);
                    continue;
                }
                output = m_input->peek();
                input_checkpoint = output.checkpoint;
                if (output.status == PipelineStatus::HaveData)
                    m_peeked_frame = output.frame;
            }
        }

        if (!frames_to_lend_again.is_empty()) {
            for (auto const& frame : frames_to_lend_again)
                lend_frame(frame, seek_id);
            publish_status({ PipelineStatus::Pending, seek_id, input_checkpoint });
            continue;
        }

        if (output.status == PipelineStatus::HaveData) {
            VERIFY(output.frame);
            lend_frame(*output.frame, seek_id);
            lent_frame_seek_id = seek_id;
            continue;
        }

        publish_status({ output.status, seek_id, input_checkpoint });
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        wait_on_pump_thread(locker);
    }

    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    m_peeked_frame = nullptr;
    m_pump_thread_exited = true;
    m_wait_condition.broadcast();
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibCore/AnonymousBuffer.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>
#include <LibMedia/Forward.h>
#include <LibMedia/MediaTime.h>
#include <LibMedia/Sinks/VideoSink.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrameMetadata.h>
#include <LibThreading/Forward.h>

namespace Media {

// The pump end of a cross-process video edge.
class MEDIA_API RemoteVideoSink final : public VideoSink {
public:
    static constexpr size_t MAX_LENT_FRAME_COUNT = 32;

    struct LentFrame {
        u64 lend_id { 0 };
        u32 seek_id { 0 };
        VideoFrameMetadata metadata;
        VideoFramePixels pixels;
    };

    struct Delegates {
        // Called from the pump thread, in the order the frames are lent.
        Function<void(LentFrame)> send_frame;
        // Called from the pump thread, after the frames the status follows.
        Function<void(PipelineStatus, u32 seek_id, PipelineCheckpoint)> send_status;
        Function<void()> notify_clock_resumed;
        // A seek reaches the far-end consumer so that its cached frames are consulted. Unless the frames lent to it
        // could satisfy the seek, the input is seeked before the seek is transmitted, and the consumer's request for
        // the same seek, which passes through the RemoteVideoProducer and across the edge, is then already answered.
        Function<void(InvalidateHeldData)> transmit_seek;
        // Relays a replacement time reader (e.g. after audio is disabled) to the consumer; the initial one rides video_edge_ready.
        Function<void(MediaTimeReader const&)> transmit_time_reader;
        Function<void(bool)> transmit_ticking;
    };

    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoSink>> create(Delegates);
    virtual ~RemoteVideoSink() override;

    virtual ErrorOr<void> connect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const&) override;
    virtual void disconnect_input(NonnullRefPtr<VideoProducer> const&) override;

    virtual void seek(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData = InvalidateHeldData::No) override;
    virtual void notify_clock_resumed() override;
    virtual void set_ticking(bool) override;
    // The newest received lend ID is the last one the consumer had seen when it asked for the seek.
    void seek_upstream(AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData, u64 newest_received_lend_id);
    virtual void set_time_reader(MediaTimeReader) override;
    virtual void set_state_change_handler(PipelineStateChangeHandler) override;
    virtual void set_resize_handler(PipelineResizeHandler) override;
    void start_input();
    void suspend_input();

    void report_remote_status(PipelineStatus, PipelineCheckpoint);
    void report_remote_resize(Gfx::Size<u32>);

    // Callable from any thread.
    void release_frame(u64 lend_id);

    // The frames already lent stay lent until they are released.
    void stop();
    bool has_lent_frames() const;

private:
    class ThreadData;

    explicit RemoteVideoSink(NonnullRefPtr<ThreadData>);

    NonnullRefPtr<ThreadData> m_thread_data;

    PipelineStateChangeHandler m_on_state_changed;
    PipelineResizeHandler m_on_resize;
    // A seek reaches the input directly, ahead of the consumer's request for it, only while the consumer ticks. One
    // that doesn't may leave its suspended input be for the seek.
    bool m_consumer_is_ticking { false };
};

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <LibMedia/PipelineStatus.h>

namespace Media {

// Replacing the handler waits for a dispatch on another thread to finish; the mutex asserts on the same thread.
class SynchronizedWakeHandler {
public:
    void set(PipelineWakeHandler handler)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        m_handler = move(handler);
    }

    void dispatch()
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        if (m_handler)
            m_handler();
    }

private:
    Mutex m_mutex;
    PipelineWakeHandler m_handler;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/TimeRanges.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/BinarySearch.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibMedia/TimeRanges.h>

namespace Media {

void TimeRanges::add_range(AK::Duration start, AK::Duration end, AK::Duration maximum_gap_to_bridge)
{
    if (start >= end)
        return;
    if (m_ranges.is_empty()) {
        m_ranges.append({ start, end });
        return;
    }

    // Find the index we should insert at. This index would point to either the range overlapping the start of the new
    // range, or the range following it if there is no overlap.
    size_t insert_index = 0;
    binary_search(m_ranges, start, &insert_index, [](AK::Duration needle, Range const& range) -> int {
        return needle <=> range.start;
    });
    if (m_ranges[insert_index].end + maximum_gap_to_bridge < start)
        insert_index++;

    // Determine the range of ranges that will be made contiguous by this new range.
    AK::Duration merged_start = start;
    AK::Duration merged_end = end;
    size_t merge_end_index = insert_index;

    if (merge_end_index < m_ranges.size()) {
        merged_start = min(merged_start, m_ranges[merge_end_index].start);

        while (merge_end_index < m_ranges.size() && m_ranges[merge_end_index].start <= merged_end + maximum_gap_to_bridge) {
            merged_end = max(merged_end, m_ranges[merge_end_index].end);
            merge_end_index++;
        }
    }

    // Replace the found range with our new merged range if applicable.
    if (merge_end_index > insert_index) {
        m_ranges[insert_index] = { merged_start, merged_end };
        m_ranges.remove(insert_index + 1, merge_end_index - insert_index - 1);
    } else {
        m_ranges.insert(insert_index, { merged_start, merged_end });
    }
}

static void append_merging_with_last(Vector<TimeRanges::Range>& ranges, TimeRanges::Range const& range, AK::Duration maximum_gap_to_bridge)
{
    if (!ranges.is_empty() && range.start <= ranges.last().end + maximum_gap_to_bridge) {
        ranges.last().end = max(ranges.last().end, range.end);
        return;
    }
    ranges.append(range);
}

static Vector<TimeRanges::Range> merge_sorted_ranges(Vector<TimeRanges::Range> const& a, Vector<TimeRanges::Range> const& b, AK::Duration maximum_gap_to_bridge)
{
    Vector<TimeRanges::Range> result;
    result.ensure_capacity(a.size() + b.size());
    size_t a_index = 0;
    size_t b_index = 0;
    while (a_index < a.size() || b_index < b.size()) {
        if (b_index == b.size() || (a_index < a.size() && a[a_index].start <= b[b_index].start))
            append_merging_with_last(result, a[a_index++], maximum_gap_to_bridge);
        else
            append_merging_with_last(result, b[b_index++], maximum_gap_to_bridge);
    }
    return result;
}

void TimeRanges::add_ranges(Vector<Range> const& ranges, AK::Duration maximum_gap_to_bridge)
{
    // Split the ranges into ascending stretches, then merge neighboring stretches until one remains.
    Vector<Vector<Range>> stretches;
    for (auto const& range : ranges) {
        if (range.start >= range.end)
            continue;
        if (stretches.is_empty() || range.start < stretches.last().last().start)
            stretches.append({});
        append_merging_with_last(stretches.last(), range, maximum_gap_to_bridge);
    }
    if (stretches.is_empty())
        return;
    stretches.append(move(m_ranges));

    while (stretches.size() > 1) {
        Vector<Vector<Range>> merged_stretches;
        merged_stretches.ensure_capacity((stretches.size() + 1) / 2);
        for (size_t index = 0; index + 1 < stretches.size(); index += 2)
            merged_stretches.unchecked_append(merge_sorted_ranges(stretches[index], stretches[index + 1], maximum_gap_to_bridge));
        if (stretches.size() % 2 == 1)
            merged_stretches.unchecked_append(move(stretches.last()));
        stretches = move(merged_stretches);
    }
    m_ranges = move(stretches.first());
}

void TimeRanges::remove_range(AK::Duration start, AK::Duration end)
{
    if (start >= end)
        return;

    Vector<Range> new_ranges;
    for (auto const& range : m_ranges) {
        if (range.end <= start || range.start >= end) {
            new_ranges.append(range);
            continue;
        }

        if (range.start < start)
            new_ranges.append({ range.start, start });
        if (range.end > end)
            new_ranges.append({ end, range.end });
    }
    m_ranges = move(new_ranges);
}

AK::Duration TimeRanges::highest_end_time() const
{
    if (m_ranges.is_empty())
        return AK::Duration::zero();
    return m_ranges.last().end;
}

TimeRanges TimeRanges::coalesced(AK::Duration threshold) const
{
    TimeRanges result;
    if (m_ranges.is_empty())
        return result;

    result.m_ranges.append(m_ranges[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < m_ranges.size(); i++) {
        auto& last = result.m_ranges.last();
        if (m_ranges[i].start - last.end <= threshold) {
            last.end = max(last.end, m_ranges[i].end);
        } else {
            result.m_ranges.append(m_ranges[i]);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

TimeRanges TimeRanges::intersection(TimeRanges const& other) const
{
    TimeRanges result;
    size_t i = 0;
    size_t j = 0;

    while (i < m_ranges.size() && j < other.m_ranges.size()) {
        auto const& a = m_ranges[i];
        auto const& b = other.m_ranges[j];

        auto inter_start = max(a.start, b.start);
        auto inter_end = min(a.end, b.end);

        if (inter_start < inter_end)
            result.m_ranges.append({ inter_start, inter_end });

        // Advance the range that ends first.
        if (a.end < b.end)
            i++;
        else
            j++;
    }

    return result;
}

Optional<TimeRanges::Range> TimeRanges::range_at_or_after(AK::Duration point) const
{
    size_t index = 0;
    binary_search(m_ranges, point, &index, [](AK::Duration needle, Range const& range) -> int {
        return needle <=> range.start;
    });
    if (index >= m_ranges.size())
        return {};
    if (m_ranges[index].end < point)
        index++;
    if (index >= m_ranges.size())
        return {};
    return m_ranges[index];
}

}

namespace IPC {

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Media::TimeRanges::Range const& range)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(range.start));
    TRY(encoder.encode(range.end));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Media::TimeRanges::Range> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto start = TRY(decoder.decode<AK::Duration>());
    auto end = TRY(decoder.decode<AK::Duration>());
    if (end < start)
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC: Invalid time range");
    return Media::TimeRanges::Range { start, end };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Media::TrackBufferedRanges const& track)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(track.track_identifier));
    TRY(encoder.encode(track.time_ranges));
    TRY(encoder.encode(track.reached_end_of_stream));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Media::TrackBufferedRanges> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto identifier = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
    auto ranges = TRY(decoder.decode<Media::TimeRanges>());
    auto reached_end = TRY(decoder.decode<bool>());
    return Media::TrackBufferedRanges { identifier, move(ranges), reached_end };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Media::TimeRanges const& ranges)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(static_cast<u64>(ranges.size())));
    for (auto const& range : ranges)
        TRY(encoder.encode(range));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Media::TimeRanges> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto range_count = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
    Media::TimeRanges ranges;
    for (u64 i = 0; i < range_count; i++) {
        auto range = TRY(decoder.decode<Media::TimeRanges::Range>());
        ranges.add_range(range.start, range.end);
    }
    return ranges;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Format.h>
#include <AK/StringBuilder.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>

namespace Media {

// A sorted, non-overlapping collection of time ranges. Ranges are automatically merged
// when they overlap or are adjacent. This is the backing store for track buffer ranges
// in the Media Source Extensions spec.
class MEDIA_API TimeRanges {
public:
    struct Range {
        AK::Duration start;
        AK::Duration end;

        bool operator==(Range const&) const = default;
    };

    TimeRanges() = default;
    TimeRanges(std::initializer_list<Range> ranges)
    {
        for (auto const& range : ranges)
            add_range(range.start, range.end);
    }

    void add_range(AK::Duration start, AK::Duration end, AK::Duration maximum_gap_to_bridge = AK::Duration::zero());
    // Takes linear time when the ranges are in order, and O(n log n) time in any order.
    void add_ranges(Vector<Range> const&, AK::Duration maximum_gap_to_bridge = AK::Duration::zero());
    void remove_range(AK::Duration start, AK::Duration end);

    size_t size() const { return m_ranges.size(); }
    bool is_empty() const { return m_ranges.is_empty(); }

    Range const& operator[](size_t index) const { return m_ranges[index]; }

    AK::Duration highest_end_time() const;

    // Returns a copy with ranges separated by gaps smaller than the given threshold merged.
    [[nodiscard]] TimeRanges coalesced(AK::Duration threshold) const;

    // Returns the intersection of this set of ranges with another.
    TimeRanges intersection(TimeRanges const& other) const;

    // Returns the range containing the given point, or the nearest range after it.
    Optional<Range> range_at_or_after(AK::Duration point) const;

    bool operator==(TimeRanges const& other) const
    {
        return m_ranges == other.m_ranges;
    }

    auto begin() const { return m_ranges.begin(); }
    auto end() const { return m_ranges.end(); }

private:
    // Sorted by start time, non-overlapping.
    Vector<Range> m_ranges;
};

struct BufferedRanges {
    TimeRanges time_ranges;
    bool resource_is_complete { false };
};

struct BufferedRangesScan {
    TimeRanges time_ranges;
    bool last_byte_range_has_samples { false };
    u64 track_identifier { 0 };
};

struct TrackBufferedRanges {
    u64 track_identifier { 0 };
    TimeRanges time_ranges;
    bool reached_end_of_stream { false };

    bool operator==(TrackBufferedRanges const&) const = default;
};

}

template<>
struct AK::Formatter<Media::TimeRanges::Range> : StandardFormatter {
    ErrorOr<void> format(FormatBuilder& builder, Media::TimeRanges::Range const& range)
    {
        Formatter<AK::Duration> value_formatter;
        TRY(value_formatter.format(builder, range.start));
        TRY(builder.put_literal("-"sv));
        TRY(value_formatter.format(builder, range.end));
        return {};
    }
};

template<>
struct AK::Formatter<Media::TimeRanges> : StandardFormatter {
    ErrorOr<void> format(FormatBuilder& builder, Media::TimeRanges const& ranges)
    {
        TRY(builder.put_literal("["sv));
        for (size_t i = 0; i < ranges.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0)
                TRY(builder.put_literal(", "sv));
            Formatter<Media::TimeRanges::Range> value_formatter;
            TRY(value_formatter.format(builder, ranges[i]));
        }
        return builder.put_literal("]"sv);
    }
};

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/Track.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibMedia/Track.h>

namespace IPC {

// The receiving process does not decode, so the track's codec stays behind.
template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Media::Track const& track)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(track.type()));
    TRY(encoder.encode(static_cast<u64>(track.identifier())));
    TRY(encoder.encode(track.kind()));
    TRY(encoder.encode(track.label()));
    TRY(encoder.encode(track.language()));
    switch (track.type()) {
    case Media::TrackType::Video: {
        auto const& video_data = track.video_data();
        TRY(encoder.encode(video_data.pixel_width));
        TRY(encoder.encode(video_data.pixel_height));
        TRY(encoder.encode(video_data.color_metadata));
        break;
    }
    case Media::TrackType::Audio: {
        auto const& sample_specification = track.audio_data().sample_specification;
        TRY(encoder.encode(sample_specification.sample_rate()));
        auto const& channel_map = sample_specification.channel_map();
        TRY(encoder.encode(channel_map.channel_count()));
        for (u8 i = 0; i < channel_map.channel_count(); i++)
            TRY(encoder.encode(channel_map.channel_at(i)));
        break;
    }
    case Media::TrackType::Subtitles:
    case Media::TrackType::Unknown:
        break;
    }
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Media::Track> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto type = TRY(decoder.decode<Media::TrackType>());
    if (type > Media::TrackType::Unknown)
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC: Invalid track type");
    auto identifier = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
    auto kind = TRY(decoder.decode<Media::Track::Kind>());
    if (kind > Media::Track::Kind::Commentary)
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC: Invalid track kind");
    auto label = TRY(decoder.decode<Utf16String>());
    auto language = TRY(decoder.decode<Utf16String>());

    Media::Track track { type, identifier, kind, label, language };
    switch (type) {
    case Media::TrackType::Video: {
        Media::Track::VideoData video_data;
        video_data.pixel_width = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
        video_data.pixel_height = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
        video_data.color_metadata = TRY(decoder.decode<Media::ColorMetadata>());
        track.set_video_data(video_data);
        break;
    }
    case Media::TrackType::Audio: {
        auto sample_rate = TRY(decoder.decode<u32>());
        auto channel_count = TRY(decoder.decode<u8>());
        if (channel_count > Audio::ChannelMap::capacity())
            return Error::from_string_literal("IPC: Too many audio channels");
        Vector<Audio::Channel, Audio::ChannelMap::capacity()> channels;
        for (u8 i = 0; i < channel_count; i++) {
            auto channel = TRY(decoder.decode<Audio::Channel>());
            if (channel >= Audio::Channel::Count)
                return Error::from_string_literal("IPC: Invalid audio channel");
            channels.append(channel);
        }
        track.set_audio_data({ Audio::SampleSpecification { sample_rate, Audio::ChannelMap { channels } } });
        break;
    }
    case Media::TrackType::Subtitles:
    case Media::TrackType::Unknown:
        break;
    }
    return track;
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Assertions.h>
#include <AK/HashFunctions.h>
#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Traits.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <LibAudio/SampleSpecification.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecParameters.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Color/ColorMetadata.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/TrackType.h>

namespace Media {

class Track {
public:
    struct VideoData {
        u64 pixel_width { 0 };
        u64 pixel_height { 0 };
        ColorMetadata color_metadata;
    };

    struct AudioData {
        Audio::SampleSpecification sample_specification;
    };

    // Derived from the "kind" attributes in:
    // https://dev.w3.org/html5/html-sourcing-inband-tracks/
    enum class Kind : u8 {
        None,
        Alternative,
        Captions,
        Descriptions,
        Main,
        MainDesc,
        Metadata,
        Sign,
        Subtitles,
        Translation,
        Commentary,
    };

    Track(TrackType type, size_t identifier, Kind kind, Utf16String const& label, Utf16String const& language)
        : m_type(type)
        , m_kind(kind)
        , m_identifier(identifier)
        , m_label(label)
        , m_language(language)
    {
        switch (m_type) {
        case TrackType::Video:
            m_track_data.video = {};
            break;
        case TrackType::Audio:
            m_track_data.audio = {};
            break;
        default:
            break;
        }
    }

    ParsedCodec const& parsed_codec() const { return m_parsed_codec; }
    void set_parsed_codec(ParsedCodec parsed_codec) { m_parsed_codec = parsed_codec; }

    TrackType type() const { return m_type; }
    size_t identifier() const { return m_identifier; }
    Kind kind() const { return m_kind; }
    Utf16String const& label() const { return m_label; }
    Utf16String const& language() const { return m_language; }

    void set_video_data(VideoData data)
    {
        VERIFY(m_type == TrackType::Video);
        m_track_data.video = data;
    }

    VideoData const& video_data() const
    {
        VERIFY(m_type == TrackType::Video);
        return m_track_data.video;
    }

    void set_audio_data(AudioData data)
    {
        VERIFY(m_type == TrackType::Audio);
        m_track_data.audio = data;
    }

    AudioData const& audio_data() const
    {
        VERIFY(m_type == TrackType::Audio);
        return m_track_data.audio;
    }

    bool operator==(Track const& other) const
    {
        return m_type == other.m_type && m_identifier == other.m_identifier;
    }

    unsigned hash() const
    {
        return pair_int_hash(to_underlying(m_type), m_identifier);
    }

private:
    static_assert(IsTriviallyCopyable<VideoData>);
    static_assert(IsTriviallyCopyable<AudioData>);

    union TrackData {
        Empty none;
        VideoData video;
        AudioData audio;
    };

    ParsedCodec m_parsed_codec { CodecID::Unknown };
    TrackType m_type { 0 };
    Kind m_kind { Kind::None };
    size_t m_identifier { 0 };
    Utf16String m_label;
    Utf16String m_language;
    TrackData m_track_data { .none = {} };
};

constexpr Utf16View track_kind_to_string(Track::Kind kind)
{
    switch (kind) {
    case Track::Kind::None:
        return u""sv;
    case Track::Kind::Alternative:
        return u"alternative"sv;
    case Track::Kind::Captions:
        return u"captions"sv;
    case Track::Kind::Descriptions:
        return u"descriptions"sv;
    case Track::Kind::Main:
        return u"main"sv;
    case Track::Kind::MainDesc:
        return u"maindesc"sv;
    case Track::Kind::Metadata:
        return u"metadata"sv;
    case Track::Kind::Sign:
        return u"sign"sv;
    case Track::Kind::Subtitles:
        return u"subtitles"sv;
    case Track::Kind::Translation:
        return u"translation"sv;
    case Track::Kind::Commentary:
        return u"commentary"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

}

template<>
struct AK::Traits<Media::Track> : public DefaultTraits<Media::Track> {
    static unsigned hash(Media::Track const& t) { return t.hash(); }
};

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationClientConnection.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>
#include <LibMedia/MediaTime.h>
#include <LibMedia/PipelineStatus.h>
#include <LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationClientConnection.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFramePool.h>

namespace Media {

static u64 allocate_sender_id()
{
    static Atomic<u64> s_next_sender_id { 1 };
    return s_next_sender_id.fetch_add(1, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
}

VideoPresentationClientConnection::VideoPresentationClientConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
    : IPC::ConnectionToServer<VideoPresentationClientEndpoint, VideoPresentationServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
{
}

VideoPresentationClientConnection::~VideoPresentationClientConnection()
{
    revoke_weak_refs();
}

void VideoPresentationClientConnection::die()
{
    revoke_weak_refs();
    m_edge_states.clear();
}

ErrorOr<void> VideoPresentationClientConnection::create_edge(VideoSinkHandle handle, Function<void(NonnullRefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink>)> on_ready)
{
    if (m_edge_states.size() >= MAX_EDGE_COUNT)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Too many video edges");
    auto edge_id = m_next_edge_id++;
    m_edge_states.set(edge_id, EdgeState { .handle = handle, .on_ready = move(on_ready), .consumer = nullptr, .sink = nullptr, .time_reader = {}, .sender_id = allocate_sender_id(), .expected_requested_seek_id = 0, .ticking = {} });
    async_create_video_edge(handle, edge_id);
    return {};
}

void VideoPresentationClientConnection::release_edge(VideoSinkHandle handle)
{
    Optional<u64> edge_id_to_release;
    for (auto& entry : m_edge_states) {
        if (entry.value.handle == handle) {
            edge_id_to_release = entry.key;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!edge_id_to_release.has_value())
        return;
    if (auto consumer = m_edge_states.get(*edge_id_to_release)->consumer)
        consumer->stop_consuming();
    m_edge_states.remove(*edge_id_to_release);
    async_release_video_edge(*edge_id_to_release);
}

void VideoPresentationClientConnection::video_edge_ready(u64 edge_id, MediaTimeReader time_reader)
{
    auto edge_state = m_edge_states.get(edge_id);
    if (!edge_state.has_value())
        return;

    auto weak_connection = make_weak_ref();
    RemoteVideoProducer::Delegates consumer_delegates;
    consumer_delegates.request_start = [weak_connection, edge_id] {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_request_start(edge_id);
        });
    };
    consumer_delegates.request_suspend = [weak_connection, edge_id] {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_request_suspend(edge_id);
        });
    };
    consumer_delegates.request_seek = [weak_connection, edge_id](AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data, u64 newest_received_lend_id) {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_request_seek(edge_id, timestamp, invalidate_held_data, newest_received_lend_id);
        });
    };
    auto consumer = RemoteVideoProducer::create(move(consumer_delegates));

    auto sink = MUST(DisplayingVideoSink::try_create(time_reader));
    edge_state->time_reader = time_reader;
    sink->set_state_change_handler([weak_connection, edge_id](PipelineStatus status, PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint) {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            VERIFY(connection.m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
            u32 requested_seek_id = 0;
            if (auto edge_state = connection.m_edge_states.get(edge_id); edge_state.has_value())
                requested_seek_id = edge_state->expected_requested_seek_id;
            connection.async_notify_sink_status(edge_id, status, requested_seek_id, checkpoint);
        });
    });
    sink->set_resize_handler([weak_connection, edge_id](Gfx::Size<u32> size) {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_notify_sink_resize(edge_id, size.width(), size.height());
        });
    });
    MUST(sink->connect_input(consumer));

    edge_state->consumer = consumer;
    edge_state->sink = sink;
    auto ticking = edge_state->ticking;
    auto on_ready = move(edge_state->on_ready);
    if (on_ready)
        on_ready(sink);
    if (ticking.has_value())
        sink->set_ticking(*ticking);
}

void VideoPresentationClientConnection::set_sink_ticking(u64 edge_id, bool ticking)
{
    auto edge_state = m_edge_states.get(edge_id);
    if (!edge_state.has_value())
        return;
    edge_state->ticking = ticking;
    if (edge_state->sink)
        edge_state->sink->set_ticking(ticking);
}

void VideoPresentationClientConnection::update_edge_time_reader(u64 edge_id, MediaTimeReader time_reader)
{
    auto edge_state = m_edge_states.get(edge_id);
    if (!edge_state.has_value())
        return;
    edge_state->time_reader = time_reader;
    if (edge_state->sink)
        edge_state->sink->set_time_reader(move(time_reader));
}

void VideoPresentationClientConnection::lend_frame(u64 edge_id, u64 lend_id, u32 seek_id, VideoFrameMetadata metadata, VideoFramePixels pixels)
{
    // The frame may be dropped on any thread.
    auto release = [weak_connection = make_weak_ref(), edge_id, lend_id] {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_release_frame(edge_id, lend_id);
        });
    };

    auto edge_state = m_edge_states.get(edge_id);
    if (!edge_state.has_value() || !edge_state->consumer) {
        release();
        return;
    }
    auto frame_or_error = create_received_video_frame(metadata, move(pixels), edge_state->sender_id, move(release));
    if (frame_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("VideoPresentation: Dropping a lent frame that does not fit its storage: {}", frame_or_error.error());
        return;
    }
    auto frame = frame_or_error.release_value();
    // Every frame comes with a fresh mapping of its buffer, which is read in full to upload it.
    frame->pixel_buffer().populate_for_reading();
    edge_state->consumer->receive_frame(lend_id, seek_id, move(frame));
}

void VideoPresentationClientConnection::edge_status_changed(u64 edge_id, PipelineStatus status, u32 seek_id, PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint)
{
    if (auto edge_state = m_edge_states.get(edge_id); edge_state.has_value() && edge_state->consumer)
        edge_state->consumer->receive_status(status, seek_id, checkpoint);
}

void VideoPresentationClientConnection::notify_clock_resumed(u64 edge_id)
{
    if (auto edge_state = m_edge_states.get(edge_id); edge_state.has_value() && edge_state->consumer)
        edge_state->consumer->notify_clock_resumed();
}

void VideoPresentationClientConnection::seek_sink(u64 edge_id, u32 requested_seek_id, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data)
{
    auto edge_state = m_edge_states.get(edge_id);
    if (!edge_state.has_value())
        return;
    edge_state->expected_requested_seek_id = requested_seek_id;
    if (!edge_state->sink || !edge_state->time_reader.has_value())
        return;
    // The edge carries no timestamp so that seeking forward repeatedly doesn't cause the timestamps between the seeks
    // and the time reader to become discontinuous. Otherwise, DisplayingVideoSink::update() may read the time for a
    // seek that has not been processed yet, causing the sink to discard a frame that it needs to consult for the
    // incoming seek. With this fix, the spurious seek to the timestamp that was already read will simply hit the cache
    // anyway, so there is no harm here.
    edge_state->sink->seek(edge_state->time_reader->current_time(), invalidate_held_data);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationClientConnection.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/ThreadSafeWeakable.h>
#include <LibIPC/ConnectionToServer.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>
#include <LibMedia/Producers/RemoteVideoProducer.h>
#include <LibMedia/Sinks/DisplayingVideoSink.h>
#include <LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationClientEndpoint.h>
#include <LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationServerEndpoint.h>
#include <LibMedia/VideoSinkHandle.h>

namespace Media {

// The presentation-client end of the cross-process video presentation channel, hosted in the Compositor. It
// asks the producer-server to create edges, builds the consumer + DisplayingVideoSink for each, and hands the
// sink to the host (via the ready callback passed to create_edge) to tick and draw. Process-agnostic:
// host-specific work happens through that callback, never by referencing Compositor types here.
class MEDIA_API VideoPresentationClientConnection final
    : public IPC::ConnectionToServer<VideoPresentationClientEndpoint, VideoPresentationServerEndpoint>
    , public VideoPresentationClientEndpoint
    , public ThreadSafeWeakable<VideoPresentationClientConnection> {
    C_OBJECT_ABSTRACT(VideoPresentationClientConnection);

public:
    static constexpr size_t MAX_EDGE_COUNT = 64;

    explicit VideoPresentationClientConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>);
    virtual ~VideoPresentationClientConnection() override;

    // Asks the producer-server to create an edge for the given sink, then invokes on_ready with the built
    // DisplayingVideoSink once it arrives. The edge id correlating the request and reply is allocated and kept here.
    ErrorOr<void> create_edge(VideoSinkHandle, Function<void(NonnullRefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink>)> on_ready);
    void release_edge(VideoSinkHandle);

private:
    virtual void die() override;

    virtual void video_edge_ready(u64 edge_id, Media::MediaTimeReader time_reader) override;
    virtual void update_edge_time_reader(u64 edge_id, Media::MediaTimeReader time_reader) override;
    virtual void lend_frame(u64 edge_id, u64 lend_id, u32 seek_id, Media::VideoFrameMetadata metadata, Media::VideoFramePixels pixels) override;
    virtual void edge_status_changed(u64 edge_id, Media::PipelineStatus status, u32 seek_id, Media::PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint) override;
    virtual void notify_clock_resumed(u64 edge_id) override;
    virtual void seek_sink(u64 edge_id, u32 requested_seek_id, InvalidateHeldData) override;
    virtual void set_sink_ticking(u64 edge_id, bool ticking) override;

    struct EdgeState {
        VideoSinkHandle handle;
        Function<void(NonnullRefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink>)> on_ready;
        RefPtr<RemoteVideoProducer> consumer;
        RefPtr<DisplayingVideoSink> sink;
        Optional<MediaTimeReader> time_reader;
        u64 sender_id { 0 };
        u32 expected_requested_seek_id { 0 };
        // Ticking that arrived before the sink did.
        Optional<bool> ticking;
    };

    HashMap<u64, EdgeState> m_edge_states;
    u64 m_next_edge_id { 1 };
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationServer.ipc
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibMedia/InvalidateHeldData.h>
#include <LibMedia/PipelineStatus.h>

endpoint VideoPresentationServer {

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationServerConnection.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/Debug.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>
#include <LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationServerConnection.h>

namespace Media {

VideoPresentationServerConnection::VideoPresentationServerConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
    : IPC::ConnectionFromClient<VideoPresentationClientEndpoint, VideoPresentationServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport), 1)
{
}

VideoPresentationServerConnection::~VideoPresentationServerConnection()
{
    revoke_weak_refs();
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::die()
{
    revoke_weak_refs();
    for (auto& entry : m_edge_states)
        PlaybackManager::release_video_edge({}, entry.value.handle, *entry.value.pump);
    m_edge_states.clear();
    m_released_edge_pumps_with_lent_frames.clear();
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::create_video_edge(VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, u64 edge_id)
{
    if (m_edge_states.contains(edge_id) || m_pending_edge_handles_by_edge_id.contains(edge_id)) {
        did_misbehave("create_video_edge: edge ID already exists");
        return;
    }
    for (auto const& entry : m_edge_states) {
        if (entry.value.handle == video_sink_handle) {
            did_misbehave("create_video_edge: video sink handle already has an edge");
            return;
        }
    }
    for (auto const& entry : m_pending_edge_handles_by_edge_id) {
        if (entry.value == video_sink_handle) {
            did_misbehave("create_video_edge: video sink handle already has a pending edge");
            return;
        }
    }

    if (!PlaybackManager::has_video_sink_handle({}, video_sink_handle)) {
        m_pending_edge_handles_by_edge_id.set(edge_id, video_sink_handle);
        return;
    }
    create_registered_video_edge(video_sink_handle, edge_id);
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::retry_pending_video_edges()
{
    auto pending_edges = move(m_pending_edge_handles_by_edge_id);
    for (auto const& [edge_id, video_sink_handle] : pending_edges) {
        if (PlaybackManager::has_video_sink_handle({}, video_sink_handle))
            create_registered_video_edge(video_sink_handle, edge_id);
        else
            m_pending_edge_handles_by_edge_id.set(edge_id, video_sink_handle);
    }
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::create_registered_video_edge(VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, u64 edge_id)
{
    auto weak_connection = make_weak_ref();

    RemoteVideoSink::Delegates delegates;
    delegates.send_frame = [weak_connection, edge_id](RemoteVideoSink::LentFrame lent_frame) {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_lend_frame(edge_id, lent_frame.lend_id, lent_frame.seek_id, lent_frame.metadata, move(lent_frame.pixels));
        });
    };
    delegates.send_status = [weak_connection, edge_id](PipelineStatus status, u32 seek_id, PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint) {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_edge_status_changed(edge_id, status, seek_id, checkpoint);
        });
    };
    delegates.notify_clock_resumed = [weak_connection, edge_id] {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_notify_clock_resumed(edge_id);
        });
    };
    delegates.transmit_seek = [weak_connection, edge_id](InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data) {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            VERIFY(connection.m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
            auto edge_state = connection.m_edge_states.get(edge_id);
            if (!edge_state.has_value())
                return;
            auto requested_seek_id = ++edge_state->actual_requested_seek_id;
            connection.async_seek_sink(edge_id, requested_seek_id, invalidate_held_data);
        });
    };
    delegates.transmit_time_reader = [weak_connection, edge_id](MediaTimeReader const& time_reader) {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            VERIFY(connection.m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
            if (!connection.m_edge_states.contains(edge_id))
                return;
            connection.async_update_edge_time_reader(edge_id, time_reader);
        });
    };
    delegates.transmit_ticking = [weak_connection, edge_id](bool ticking) {
        weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            VERIFY(connection.m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
            if (!connection.m_edge_states.contains(edge_id))
                return;
            connection.async_set_sink_ticking(edge_id, ticking);
        });
    };

    auto remote_edge_or_error = PlaybackManager::create_video_edge({}, video_sink_handle, move(delegates));
    if (remote_edge_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("VideoPresentation: failed to create video edge: {}", remote_edge_or_error.error());
        return;
    }
    auto remote_edge = remote_edge_or_error.release_value();

    m_edge_states.set(edge_id, EdgeState { remote_edge.sink, video_sink_handle });
    async_video_edge_ready(edge_id, remote_edge.time_reader);
    PlaybackManager::attach_video_edge({}, video_sink_handle, remote_edge.sink);
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::release_video_edge(u64 edge_id)
{
    m_pending_edge_handles_by_edge_id.remove(edge_id);
    auto it = m_edge_states.find(edge_id);
    if (it == m_edge_states.end())
        return;
    auto handle = it->value.handle;
    auto pump = it->value.pump;
    m_edge_states.remove(it);
    PlaybackManager::release_video_edge({}, handle, *pump);

    pump->stop();
    if (pump->has_lent_frames())
        m_released_edge_pumps_with_lent_frames.set(edge_id, move(pump));
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::request_start(u64 edge_id)
{
    if (auto it = m_edge_states.find(edge_id); it != m_edge_states.end())
        it->value.pump->start_input();
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::request_suspend(u64 edge_id)
{
    if (auto it = m_edge_states.find(edge_id); it != m_edge_states.end())
        it->value.pump->suspend_input();
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::request_seek(u64 edge_id, AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData invalidate_held_data, u64 newest_received_lend_id)
{
    if (auto it = m_edge_states.find(edge_id); it != m_edge_states.end())
        it->value.pump->seek_upstream(timestamp, invalidate_held_data, newest_received_lend_id);
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::release_frame(u64 edge_id, u64 lend_id)
{
    if (auto it = m_edge_states.find(edge_id); it != m_edge_states.end()) {
        it->value.pump->release_frame(lend_id);
        return;
    }
    auto released_pump = m_released_edge_pumps_with_lent_frames.get(edge_id);
    if (!released_pump.has_value())
        return;
    released_pump.value()->release_frame(lend_id);
    if (!released_pump.value()->has_lent_frames())
        m_released_edge_pumps_with_lent_frames.remove(edge_id);
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::notify_sink_status(u64 edge_id, PipelineStatus status, u32 requested_seek_id, PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint)
{
    auto it = m_edge_states.find(edge_id);
    if (it == m_edge_states.end())
        return;
    if (requested_seek_id != it->value.actual_requested_seek_id)
        return;
    it->value.pump->report_remote_status(status, checkpoint);
}

void VideoPresentationServerConnection::notify_sink_resize(u64 edge_id, u32 width, u32 height)
{
    auto it = m_edge_states.find(edge_id);
    if (it == m_edge_states.end())
        return;
    it->value.pump->report_remote_resize(Gfx::Size<u32> { width, height });
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationServerConnection.h
/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/ThreadSafeWeakable.h>
#include <LibIPC/ConnectionFromClient.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>
#include <LibMedia/PlaybackManager.h>
#include <LibMedia/Sinks/RemoteVideoSink.h>
#include <LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationClientEndpoint.h>
#include <LibMedia/VideoPresentation/VideoPresentationServerEndpoint.h>
#include <LibMedia/VideoSinkHandle.h>

namespace Media {

// The producer-server end of the cross-process video presentation channel, hosted in the process that owns the
// producers (WebContent today, MediaServer later). It builds a RemoteVideoSink pump per edge on request, ships
// the edge's shared-memory handles to the presentation client, and routes the consumer's demands to the pump.
class MEDIA_API VideoPresentationServerConnection final
    : public IPC::ConnectionFromClient<VideoPresentationClientEndpoint, VideoPresentationServerEndpoint>
    , public ThreadSafeWeakable<VideoPresentationServerConnection> {
    C_OBJECT(VideoPresentationServerConnection);

public:
    virtual ~VideoPresentationServerConnection() override;

    // The presentation client may ask for an edge before the handle's registration reaches this process over another
    // connection; such requests wait here until the host reports a registration.
    void retry_pending_video_edges();

private:
    explicit VideoPresentationServerConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>);

    virtual void die() override;

    virtual void create_video_edge(VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, u64 edge_id) override;
    virtual void release_video_edge(u64 edge_id) override;
    virtual void request_start(u64 edge_id) override;
    virtual void request_suspend(u64 edge_id) override;
    virtual void request_seek(u64 edge_id, AK::Duration timestamp, InvalidateHeldData, u64 newest_received_lend_id) override;
    virtual void release_frame(u64 edge_id, u64 lend_id) override;
    virtual void notify_sink_status(u64 edge_id, PipelineStatus status, u32 requested_seek_id, PipelineCheckpoint checkpoint) override;
    virtual void notify_sink_resize(u64 edge_id, u32 width, u32 height) override;

    struct EdgeState {
        NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoSink> pump;
        VideoSinkHandle handle;
        u32 actual_requested_seek_id { 0 };
    };

    void create_registered_video_edge(VideoSinkHandle, u64 edge_id);

    HashMap<u64, EdgeState> m_edge_states;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<RemoteVideoSink>> m_released_edge_pumps_with_lent_frames;
    HashMap<u64, VideoSinkHandle> m_pending_edge_handles_by_edge_id;
};

}

inline VideoSinkHandle allocate_video_sink_handle()
{
    static Atomic<u64> s_next_handle { 1 };
    return VideoSinkHandle { s_next_handle.fetch_add(1, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed) };
