#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/GenericShorthands.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#include <LibAudio/WindowsChannelMask.h>
#include <LibMedia/WindowsMediaFoundation/WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/AudioBlock.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/AAC.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodedFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/WindowsMediaFoundation/WindowsMediaFoundation.h>

namespace Media::WindowsMediaFoundation {

struct WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::Transform {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    ~Transform()
    {
        if (output_stream_info.has_value())
            transform->ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_NOTIFY_END_STREAMING, 0);
    }

    ComPtr<IMFTransform> transform;
    // Absent until the transform has accepted an output type.
    Optional<OutputStreamInfo> output_stream_info;
    Audio::SampleSpecification output_sample_specification;
    bool outputs_float { true };

    // A packet the transform refused until it has output what it is holding.
    ComPtr<IMFSample> pending_input;
    bool drain_requested { false };
    bool next_input_is_discontinuous { false };
    Vector<AK::Duration, 4> pending_coded_frame_timestamps;
};

namespace {

bool aac_audio_object_type_is_supported(ParsedCodec const& codec)
{
    auto parameters = codec.aac_parameters();
    if (!parameters.has_value())
        return true;
    if (parameters->object_type_indication == Codecs::AAC::MPEG2_LOW_COMPLEXITY_OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION)
        return true;
    if (parameters->object_type_indication != Codecs::AAC::MPEG4_AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION)
        return false;
    if (!parameters->audio_object_type.has_value())
        return true;
    return first_is_one_of(*parameters->audio_object_type,
        Codecs::AAC::LOW_COMPLEXITY_AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE,
        Codecs::AAC::SPECTRAL_BAND_REPLICATION_AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE,
        Codecs::AAC::PARAMETRIC_STEREO_AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE);
}

DecoderErrorOr<ComPtr<IMFMediaType>> create_aac_input_type(Audio::SampleSpecification const& container_sample_specification, ReadonlyBytes audio_specific_config)
{
    // The transform takes the fields of HEAACWAVEINFO that follow its WAVEFORMATEX, then the AudioSpecificConfig. A
    // payload type of zero says that packets are raw access units.
    static constexpr u16 NO_AUDIO_PROFILE_SPECIFIED = 0xFE;
    Vector<u8, 64> user_data;
    user_data.resize(12);
    user_data[2] = NO_AUDIO_PROFILE_SPECIFIED;
    DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(user_data.try_append(audio_specific_config.data(), audio_specific_config.size()));

    ComPtr<IMFMediaType> type;
    if (FAILED(MFCreateMediaType(&type))
        || FAILED(type->SetGUID(MF_MT_MAJOR_TYPE, MFMediaType_Audio))
        || FAILED(type->SetGUID(MF_MT_SUBTYPE, MFAudioFormat_AAC))
        || FAILED(type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_SAMPLES_PER_SECOND, container_sample_specification.sample_rate()))
        || FAILED(type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_NUM_CHANNELS, container_sample_specification.channel_count()))
        || FAILED(type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_BITS_PER_SAMPLE, 16))
        || FAILED(type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_AAC_PAYLOAD_TYPE, 0))
        || FAILED(type->SetBlob(MF_MT_USER_DATA, user_data.data(), user_data.size())))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to create a Media Foundation media type"sv);
    return type;
}

DecoderErrorOr<Audio::ChannelMap> output_channel_map(IMFMediaType& output_type, u32 channel_count)
{
    UINT32 channel_mask = 0;
    if (FAILED(output_type.GetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_CHANNEL_MASK, &channel_mask))) {
        if (channel_count == 1)
            return Audio::ChannelMap::mono();
        if (channel_count == 2)
            return Audio::ChannelMap::stereo();
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation output {} channels without saying where they go", channel_count);
    }

    auto channel_map_or_error = Audio::windows_channel_mask_to_channel_map(channel_mask);
    if (channel_map_or_error.is_error())
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation output an unsupported channel layout: {}", channel_map_or_error.error());
    auto channel_map = channel_map_or_error.release_value();
    if (channel_map.channel_count() != channel_count)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation output a channel layout that does not match its channel count"sv);
    return channel_map;
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> negotiate_output_format(WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::Transform& transform)
{
    auto& media_transform = *transform.transform.Get();
    auto output_type_or_error = set_first_acceptable_output_type(media_transform, [](GUID const& subtype) { return subtype == MFAudioFormat_Float; });
    if (output_type_or_error.is_error()) {
        output_type_or_error = set_first_acceptable_output_type(media_transform, [](GUID const& subtype) { return subtype == MFAudioFormat_PCM; });
        if (output_type_or_error.is_error())
            return output_type_or_error.release_error();
    }
    auto output_type = output_type_or_error.release_value();

    GUID subtype = GUID_NULL;
    UINT32 bits_per_sample = 0;
    UINT32 sample_rate = 0;
    UINT32 channel_count = 0;
    output_type->GetGUID(MF_MT_SUBTYPE, &subtype);
    output_type->GetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_BITS_PER_SAMPLE, &bits_per_sample);
    if (FAILED(output_type->GetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_SAMPLES_PER_SECOND, &sample_rate)) || sample_rate == 0)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "Media Foundation output no sample rate"sv);
    if (FAILED(output_type->GetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_NUM_CHANNELS, &channel_count)) || channel_count == 0 || channel_count > Audio::ChannelMap::capacity())
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation cannot output {} channels", channel_count);

    auto outputs_float = subtype == MFAudioFormat_Float;
    if (bits_per_sample != (outputs_float ? 32 : 16))
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation output {}-bit samples", bits_per_sample);

    auto channel_map = TRY(output_channel_map(*output_type.Get(), channel_count));
    auto stream_info = TRY(output_stream_info(media_transform));

    auto was_streaming = transform.output_stream_info.has_value();
    transform.output_stream_info = stream_info;
    transform.output_sample_specification = Audio::SampleSpecification { sample_rate, channel_map };
    transform.outputs_float = outputs_float;
    if (!was_streaming && FAILED(media_transform.ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_NOTIFY_BEGIN_STREAMING, 0)))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Unknown, "Media Foundation decoder refused to start streaming"sv);
    return {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> submit_input(WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::Transform& transform, ComPtr<IMFSample> sample)
{
    auto result = transform.transform->ProcessInput(0, sample.Get(), 0);
    if (result == MF_E_NOTACCEPTING) {
        transform.pending_input = move(sample);
        return {};
    }
    if (FAILED(result))
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "Media Foundation decoder rejected a packet with result {:#x}", static_cast<u32>(result));
    return {};
}

void drain_unless_input_is_pending(WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::Transform& transform)
{
    if (transform.pending_input || !transform.drain_requested)
        return;
    transform.transform->ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_NOTIFY_END_OF_STREAM, 0);
    transform.transform->ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_COMMAND_DRAIN, 0);
}

void request_drain(WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::Transform& transform)
{
    transform.drain_requested = true;
    drain_unless_input_is_pending(transform);
}

}

Optional<DecoderCapabilities> WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::capabilities(ParsedCodec const& codec)
{
    if (codec.codec_id() != CodecID::AAC || !aac_audio_object_type_is_supported(codec))
        return {};

    // Activating a transform to answer this costs enough that the answer is worth keeping.
    static bool const transform_is_available = [] {
        Audio::SampleSpecification sample_specification { 48'000, Audio::ChannelMap::stereo() };
        auto configuration = Codecs::AAC::create_configuration_record(Codecs::AAC::LOW_COMPLEXITY_AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE, sample_specification.sample_rate(), sample_specification.channel_count());
        if (configuration.is_error())
            return false;
        auto input_type = create_aac_input_type(sample_specification, configuration.value().span());
        if (input_type.is_error())
            return false;
        return !create_decoder_transform(CodecID::AAC, *input_type.value().Get()).is_error();
    }();
    if (!transform_is_available)
        return {};
    return DecoderCapabilities { .smooth = true, .power_efficient = true };
}

DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder>> WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::try_create(CodecID codec_id, Audio::SampleSpecification const& sample_specification, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data)
{
    if (codec_id != CodecID::AAC)
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation has no audio decoder for codec {}", codec_id);

    auto codec_configuration = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(FixedArray<u8>::create(codec_initialization_data));
    return DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(adopt_nonnull_own_or_enomem(new (nothrow) WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder(codec_id, sample_specification, move(codec_configuration))));
}

WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder(CodecID codec_id, Audio::SampleSpecification const& sample_specification, FixedArray<u8>&& codec_configuration)
    : m_codec_id(codec_id)
    , m_container_sample_specification(sample_specification)
    , m_codec_configuration(move(codec_configuration))
{
}

WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::~WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder() = default;

DecoderErrorOr<void> WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::ensure_transform_for_frame(CodedFrame const& coded_frame)
{
    auto new_configuration = coded_frame.new_codec_configuration();
    auto configuration_changed = new_configuration.has_value() && !new_configuration->is_empty() && *new_configuration != m_codec_configuration.span();
    if (m_transform != nullptr && !configuration_changed)
        return {};

    auto configuration = configuration_changed ? *new_configuration : m_codec_configuration.span();
    if (configuration.is_empty())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation cannot decode AAC without an Audio Specific Config"sv);

    auto input_type = TRY(create_aac_input_type(m_container_sample_specification, configuration));
    auto transform = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(adopt_nonnull_own_or_enomem(new (nothrow) Transform));
    transform->transform = TRY(create_decoder_transform(m_codec_id, *input_type.Get()));
    // Some decoders refuse every output format until they have seen input, so this is retried when they ask.
    (void)negotiate_output_format(*transform);

    if (configuration_changed)
        m_codec_configuration = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(FixedArray<u8>::create(configuration));

    if (m_transform == nullptr) {
        m_transform = move(transform);
        return {};
    }
    request_drain(*m_transform);
    m_replacement_transform = move(transform);
    return {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::receive_coded_data(CodedFrame const& coded_frame)
{
    if (m_end_of_stream_signaled)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "Media Foundation decoder has been drained"sv);
    if (m_replacement_transform != nullptr || (m_transform != nullptr && m_transform->pending_input))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain, "Media Foundation decoder has not taken the previous packet yet"sv);
    if (coded_frame.data().size() > NumericLimits<DWORD>::max())
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Coded frame is too large for Media Foundation"sv);

    TRY(ensure_transform_for_frame(coded_frame));

    auto& transform = m_replacement_transform != nullptr ? *m_replacement_transform : *m_transform;
    auto sample = TRY(create_input_sample(coded_frame.data(), coded_frame.decoded_start_timestamp(), coded_frame.duration() + coded_frame.leading_discard() + coded_frame.trailing_discard()));
    if (transform.next_input_is_discontinuous)
        sample->SetUINT32(MFSampleExtension_Discontinuity, TRUE);
    TRY(submit_input(transform, move(sample)));
    transform.next_input_is_discontinuous = false;
    DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(transform.pending_coded_frame_timestamps.try_append(coded_frame.decoded_start_timestamp()));
    m_discard_intervals.add_intervals_for_frame(coded_frame);
    return {};
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::signal_end_of_stream()
{
    m_end_of_stream_signaled = true;
    if (m_replacement_transform != nullptr)
        request_drain(*m_replacement_transform);
    else if (m_transform != nullptr)
        request_drain(*m_transform);
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::switch_to_replacement_transform()
{
    m_transform = m_replacement_transform.release_nonnull();
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::copy_output_sample(Transform& transform, IMFSample& sample)
{
    // The sample is copied, since a block may take only part of it.
    ComPtr<IMFMediaBuffer> buffer;
    if (FAILED(sample.ConvertToContiguousBuffer(&buffer)))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to read a Media Foundation output sample"sv);
    BYTE* data = nullptr;
    DWORD length = 0;
    if (FAILED(buffer->Lock(&data, nullptr, &length)))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to lock a Media Foundation output buffer"sv);
    ScopeGuard unlock_buffer = [&] { buffer->Unlock(); };

    auto const& sample_specification = transform.output_sample_specification;
    auto sample_size = transform.outputs_float ? sizeof(float) : sizeof(i16);
    auto frame_count = length / (sample_size * sample_specification.channel_count());
    auto sample_count = frame_count * sample_specification.channel_count();

    Optional<AK::Duration> previous_output_end;
    if (m_output_timeline_start.has_value())
        previous_output_end = *m_output_timeline_start + AK::Duration::from_time_units(m_frames_output_on_timeline, 1, m_output_sample_specification.sample_rate());
    auto output_start = previous_output_end;
    LONGLONG sample_time = 0;
    if (SUCCEEDED(sample.GetSampleTime(&sample_time)))
        output_start = duration_from_sample_time(sample_time);
    if (!output_start.has_value())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "Media Foundation decoder output a sample with no time"sv);

    // The MFT output's time can be slightly off our input time in both directions, so stamp our output with the latest
    // time before the MFT output's midpoint. Anything before that time is dropped, since the output is monotonic.
    auto output_midpoint = *output_start + AK::Duration::from_time_units(static_cast<i64>(frame_count), 1, sample_specification.sample_rate() * 2);
    Optional<AK::Duration> packet_start;
    while (!transform.pending_coded_frame_timestamps.is_empty() && transform.pending_coded_frame_timestamps.first() <= output_midpoint)
        packet_start = transform.pending_coded_frame_timestamps.take_first();

    if (packet_start.has_value()) {
        m_output_timeline_start = packet_start.release_value();
        m_frames_output_on_timeline = 0;
    } else if (!previous_output_end.has_value()) {
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "Media Foundation decoder produced a sample that matches no packet"sv);
    } else if (m_output_sample_specification.sample_rate() != sample_specification.sample_rate()) {
        m_output_timeline_start = previous_output_end;
        m_frames_output_on_timeline = 0;
    }

    m_output_samples.clear_with_capacity();
    DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(m_output_samples.try_resize(sample_count));
    if (transform.outputs_float) {
        memcpy(m_output_samples.data(), data, sample_count * sizeof(float));
    } else {
        for (size_t index = 0; index < sample_count; index++) {
            i16 value;
            memcpy(&value, data + (index * sizeof(i16)), sizeof(value));
            m_output_samples[index] = static_cast<float>(value) / 32768.0f;
        }
    }

    m_output_sample_specification = sample_specification;
    m_output_frames_written = 0;
    return {};
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::write_output_into_block(AudioBlock& block)
{
    auto const& sample_specification = m_output_sample_specification;
    auto channel_count = sample_specification.channel_count();
    auto sample_rate = sample_specification.sample_rate();
    auto timestamp = *m_output_timeline_start + AK::Duration::from_time_units(m_frames_output_on_timeline, 1, sample_rate);

    auto available_frame_count = (m_output_samples.size() / channel_count) - m_output_frames_written;
    auto frame_count = min(available_frame_count, AudioBlock::max_frame_count(channel_count));
    frame_count = m_discard_intervals.frames_until_next_boundary(timestamp, sample_rate, frame_count);
    block.initialize(sample_specification, timestamp, frame_count);

    for (u8 channel = 0; channel < channel_count; channel++) {
        auto channel_data = block.channel_data(channel);
        for (size_t frame = 0; frame < frame_count; frame++)
            channel_data[frame] = m_output_samples[((m_output_frames_written + frame) * channel_count) + channel];
    }
    m_output_frames_written += frame_count;
    m_frames_output_on_timeline += static_cast<i64>(frame_count);
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::write_next_block(AudioBlock& block)
{
    while (m_transform != nullptr) {
        auto has_unwritten_output = m_output_sample_specification.is_valid() && m_output_frames_written < m_output_samples.size() / m_output_sample_specification.channel_count();
        if (has_unwritten_output) {
            write_output_into_block(block);
            if (m_discard_intervals.should_discard(block))
                continue;
            return {};
        }

        auto& transform = *m_transform;
        auto output = TRY(process_output(*transform.transform.Get(), transform.output_stream_info));
        if (output.has<ComPtr<IMFSample>>()) {
            TRY(copy_output_sample(transform, *output.get<ComPtr<IMFSample>>().Get()));
            continue;
        }
        if (output.has<OutputTypeNeeded>()) {
            TRY(negotiate_output_format(transform));
            continue;
        }

        if (transform.pending_input) {
            TRY(submit_input(transform, move(transform.pending_input)));
            drain_unless_input_is_pending(transform);
            continue;
        }
        // A transform that was asked to drain has now output everything it withheld.
        if (transform.drain_requested && m_replacement_transform != nullptr) {
            switch_to_replacement_transform();
            continue;
        }
        break;
    }

    if (m_end_of_stream_signaled)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "Media Foundation decoder has been drained"sv);
    return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput, "Media Foundation decoder needs more input"sv);
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder::flush()
{
    if (m_replacement_transform != nullptr)
        switch_to_replacement_transform();
    if (m_transform != nullptr) {
        m_transform->transform->ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_COMMAND_FLUSH, 0);
        m_transform->pending_input = nullptr;
        m_transform->drain_requested = false;
        m_transform->next_input_is_discontinuous = true;
        m_transform->pending_coded_frame_timestamps.clear();
    }

    m_end_of_stream_signaled = false;
    m_output_samples.clear_with_capacity();
    m_output_frames_written = 0;
    m_output_timeline_start.clear();
    m_frames_output_on_timeline = 0;
    m_discard_intervals.clear();
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/FixedArray.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/OwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibAudio/SampleSpecification.h>
#include <LibMedia/AudioDiscardIntervals.h>
#include <LibMedia/Export.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/AudioDecoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecID.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecParameters.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/DecoderCapabilities.h>

struct IMFSample;

namespace Media::WindowsMediaFoundation {

// Decodes the audio codecs we cannot ship decoders for through the ones Windows provides as Media Foundation
// transforms.
class MEDIA_API WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder final : public AudioDecoder {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static Optional<DecoderCapabilities> capabilities(ParsedCodec const&);
    static DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder>> try_create(CodecID, Audio::SampleSpecification const&, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data);

    virtual ~WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder() override;

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<void> receive_coded_data(CodedFrame const&) override;
    virtual void signal_end_of_stream() override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<void> write_next_block(AudioBlock&) override;

    virtual void flush() override;

    // Holds everything that names a Media Foundation type, so that the Windows headers stay out of this one.
    struct Transform;

private:
    WindowsMediaFoundationAudioDecoder(CodecID, Audio::SampleSpecification const&, FixedArray<u8>&& codec_configuration);

    DecoderErrorOr<void> ensure_transform_for_frame(CodedFrame const&);
    DecoderErrorOr<void> copy_output_sample(Transform&, IMFSample&);
    void write_output_into_block(AudioBlock&);
    void switch_to_replacement_transform();

    CodecID const m_codec_id;
    Audio::SampleSpecification const m_container_sample_specification;
    FixedArray<u8> m_codec_configuration;

    OwnPtr<Transform> m_transform;
    // Takes over once the transform it replaces has drained what it withheld.
    OwnPtr<Transform> m_replacement_transform;
    bool m_end_of_stream_signaled { false };

    // Each output sample is timed from the packet it was decoded from, and its frames are counted from there.
    Optional<AK::Duration> m_output_timeline_start;
    i64 m_frames_output_on_timeline { 0 };

    // The interleaved samples of the output being written out.
    Vector<float> m_output_samples;
    Audio::SampleSpecification m_output_sample_specification;
    size_t m_output_frames_written { 0 };

    AudioDiscardIntervals m_discard_intervals;
};

}

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/Checked.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/Client.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/RemoteMediaStream.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/RemotePlaybackManager.h>

namespace MediaClient {

static constexpr int IDLE_EXIT_DELAY_MS = 30'000;

// A connection serves the thread that made it, so each agent has one of its own.
static thread_local NeverDestroyed<Client::TransportFactory> s_transport_factory;
static thread_local NeverDestroyed<RefPtr<Client>> s_client;
static Atomic<u64, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed> s_next_generation { 1 };

void Client::set_transport_factory(TransportFactory factory)
{
    *s_transport_factory = move(factory);
    if (!*s_transport_factory)
        *s_client = nullptr;
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Client>> Client::acquire()
{
    if (*s_client)
        return NonnullRefPtr(**s_client);
    if (!*s_transport_factory)
        return Error::from_string_literal("No media server transport factory is installed");

    auto transport = TRY((*s_transport_factory)());
    auto client = TRY(try_make_ref_counted<Client>(move(transport)));
    *s_client = client;
    client->update_idle_timer();
    return client;
}

Client::Client(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
    : IPC::ConnectionToServer<MediaClientEndpoint, MediaServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
    , m_generation(s_next_generation.fetch_add(1))
{
}

Client::~Client() = default;

void Client::die()
{
    verify_event_loop();
    // NB: Forgetting this client below, or running its on_death callback, can drop the last reference to it.
    NonnullRefPtr keep_client_alive_until_death_is_handled = *this;
    if (*s_client == this)
        *s_client = nullptr;

    auto media_streams = move(m_media_streams);
    auto playback_managers = move(m_playback_managers);
    for (auto& [id, playback_manager] : playback_managers)
        playback_manager->connection_lost({});
    auto pending_audio_data_decodes = move(m_pending_audio_data_decodes);
    for (auto& [id, callback] : pending_audio_data_decodes)
        callback(Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Unknown, "The media server is gone"sv));
    auto pending_file_media_support_requests = move(m_pending_file_media_support_requests);
    for (auto& [id, promise] : pending_file_media_support_requests)
        promise->reject(Error::from_string_literal("The media server is gone"));
    auto pending_decoder_capabilities_requests = move(m_pending_decoder_capabilities_requests);
    for (auto& [id, promise] : pending_decoder_capabilities_requests)
        promise->reject(Error::from_string_literal("The media server is gone"));
}

Messages::MediaClient::RequestAudioServerConnectionResponse Client::request_audio_server_connection()
{
    if (!on_request_audio_server_connection) {
        dbgln("A MediaServer asked a non-controller for an AudioServer connection");
        return OptionalNone {};
    }
    auto handle = on_request_audio_server_connection();
    if (handle.is_error()) {
        warnln("Unable to connect a MediaServer to the AudioServer: {}", handle.error());
        return OptionalNone {};
    }
    return handle.release_value();
}

void Client::request_video_decoder_server_connection(u64 request_id)
{
    if (!on_request_video_decoder_server_connection) {
        dbgln("A MediaServer asked a non-controller for a VideoDecoderServer connection");
        async_video_decoder_server_connection_ready(request_id, OptionalNone {});
        return;
    }
    on_request_video_decoder_server_connection([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this), request_id](ErrorOr<IPC::TransportHandle> handle) {
        if (!self->is_open())
            return;
        if (handle.is_error()) {
            warnln("Unable to connect a MediaServer to a VideoDecoderServer: {}", handle.error());
            self->async_video_decoder_server_connection_ready(request_id, OptionalNone {});
            return;
        }
        self->async_video_decoder_server_connection_ready(request_id, handle.release_value());
    });
}

u64 Client::allocate_id()
{
    return m_next_id++;
}

template<typename Reply, typename OtherReplyHandler>
OwnPtr<Reply> Client::wait_for_reply_to(u64 request_id, OtherReplyHandler handle_other_reply)
{
    while (true) {
        auto reply = wait_for_specific_endpoint_message<Reply>();
        if (!reply || reply->request_id() == request_id)
            return reply;
        m_creation_event_loop->deferred_invoke([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this), reply = reply.release_nonnull(), handle_other_reply] mutable {
            handle_other_reply(*self, *reply);
        });
    }
}

Media::MediaSupportInfo Client::query_file_media_support(StringView type, StringView subtype, Optional<String> codecs_parameter)
{
    if (!is_open())
        return {};
    auto request_id = allocate_id();
    async_request_file_media_support(request_id, String::from_utf8_without_validation(type.bytes()), String::from_utf8_without_validation(subtype.bytes()), move(codecs_parameter));
    auto reply = wait_for_reply_to<Messages::MediaClient::FileMediaSupportReported>(request_id, [](Client& client, auto& other_reply) {
        client.file_media_support_reported(other_reply.request_id(), other_reply.take_info());
    });
    if (!reply)
        return {};
    return reply->take_info();
}

Optional<Media::DecoderCapabilities> Client::query_decoder_capabilities(StringView codecs_parameter)
{
    if (!is_open())
        return {};
    auto request_id = allocate_id();
    async_request_decoder_capabilities(request_id, String::from_utf8_without_validation(codecs_parameter.bytes()));
    auto reply = wait_for_reply_to<Messages::MediaClient::DecoderCapabilitiesReported>(request_id, [](Client& client, auto& other_reply) {
        client.decoder_capabilities_reported(other_reply.request_id(), other_reply.take_capabilities());
    });
    if (!reply)
        return {};
    return reply->take_capabilities();
}

NonnullRefPtr<Client::FileMediaSupportPromise> Client::request_file_media_support(String const& type, String const& subtype, Optional<String const&> codecs_parameter)
{
    if (!is_open())
        return FileMediaSupportPromise::rejected(Error::from_string_literal("The media server is gone"));
    auto promise = FileMediaSupportPromise::construct();
    auto request_id = allocate_id();
    m_pending_file_media_support_requests.set(request_id, promise);
    update_idle_timer();
    async_request_file_media_support(request_id, type, subtype, codecs_parameter.copy());
    return promise;
}

void Client::file_media_support_reported(u64 request_id, Media::MediaSupportInfo info)
{
    auto promise = m_pending_file_media_support_requests.take(request_id);
    if (!promise.has_value())
        return;
    update_idle_timer();
    (*promise)->resolve(info);
}

NonnullRefPtr<Client::DecoderCapabilitiesPromise> Client::request_decoder_capabilities(StringView codecs_parameter)
{
    if (!is_open())
        return DecoderCapabilitiesPromise::rejected(Error::from_string_literal("The media server is gone"));
    auto promise = DecoderCapabilitiesPromise::construct();
    auto request_id = allocate_id();
    m_pending_decoder_capabilities_requests.set(request_id, promise);
    update_idle_timer();
    async_request_decoder_capabilities(request_id, String::from_utf8_without_validation(codecs_parameter.bytes()));
    return promise;
}

void Client::decoder_capabilities_reported(u64 request_id, Optional<Media::DecoderCapabilities> capabilities)
{
    auto promise = m_pending_decoder_capabilities_requests.take(request_id);
    if (!promise.has_value())
        return;
    update_idle_timer();
    (*promise)->resolve(capabilities);
}

void Client::decode_audio_data(ReadonlyBytes data, u32 output_sample_rate, DecodeAudioDataCallback callback)
{
    auto shared_data_or_error = Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_with_size(data.size());
    if (shared_data_or_error.is_error() || !is_open()) {
        callback(Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Unable to hand the audio data to the media server"sv));
        return;
    }
    auto shared_data = shared_data_or_error.release_value();
    data.copy_to({ shared_data.data<u8>(), shared_data.size() });

    auto request_id = allocate_id();
    m_pending_audio_data_decodes.set(request_id, move(callback));
    update_idle_timer();
    async_decode_audio_data(request_id, move(shared_data), output_sample_rate);
}

void Client::audio_data_decoded(u64 request_id, u32 sample_rate, u32 channel_count, u64 frame_count, Core::AnonymousBuffer planar_samples)
{
    auto callback = m_pending_audio_data_decodes.take(request_id);
    if (!callback.has_value())
        return;
    update_idle_timer();
    Checked<u64> byte_count = frame_count;
    byte_count *= channel_count;
    byte_count *= sizeof(float);
    if (channel_count == 0 || frame_count == 0 || byte_count.has_overflow() || !planar_samples.is_valid() || planar_samples.size() < byte_count.value()) {
        (*callback)(Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "The media server returned malformed audio"sv));
        return;
    }
    (*callback)(DecodedAudioData { sample_rate, channel_count, frame_count, move(planar_samples) });
}

void Client::audio_data_decode_failed(u64 request_id, Media::DecoderError error)
{
    auto callback = m_pending_audio_data_decodes.take(request_id);
    if (!callback.has_value())
        return;
    update_idle_timer();
    (*callback)(move(error));
}

void Client::register_media_stream(Badge<RemoteMediaStream>, RemoteMediaStream& stream)
{
    m_media_streams.set(stream.id(), &stream);
    update_idle_timer();
}

void Client::unregister_media_stream(Badge<RemoteMediaStream>, RemoteMediaStream& stream)
{
    m_media_streams.remove(stream.id());
    update_idle_timer();
}

void Client::register_playback_manager(Badge<RemotePlaybackManager>, RemotePlaybackManager& playback_manager)
{
    m_playback_managers.set(playback_manager.session_id(), &playback_manager);
    update_idle_timer();
}

void Client::unregister_playback_manager(Badge<RemotePlaybackManager>, RemotePlaybackManager& playback_manager)
{
    m_playback_managers.remove(playback_manager.session_id());
    update_idle_timer();
}

void Client::update_idle_timer()
{
    auto is_idle = [&] {
        if (!m_media_streams.is_empty() || !m_playback_managers.is_empty())
            return false;
        if (!m_pending_audio_data_decodes.is_empty())
            return false;
        return m_pending_file_media_support_requests.is_empty() && m_pending_decoder_capabilities_requests.is_empty();
    }();
    if (!is_idle) {
        if (m_idle_timer)
            m_idle_timer->stop();
        return;
    }
    if (!m_idle_timer) {
        m_idle_timer = Core::Timer::create_single_shot(AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(IDLE_EXIT_DELAY_MS), [this] {
            // Clearing the client reference closes the connection and causes the server to exit.
            if (*s_client == this)
                *s_client = nullptr;
        });
    }
    m_idle_timer->restart();
}

RemotePlaybackManager* Client::find_playback_manager(u64 session_id)
{
    return m_playback_managers.get(session_id).value_or(nullptr);
}

void Client::source_buffer_append_completed(u64 session_id, u64 source_buffer_id, u64 append_generation, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState state)
{
    if (auto* playback_manager = find_playback_manager(session_id))
        playback_manager->source_buffer_append_completed({}, source_buffer_id, append_generation, move(state));
}

void Client::source_buffer_append_failed(u64 session_id, u64 source_buffer_id, u64 append_generation, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState state)
{
    if (auto* playback_manager = find_playback_manager(session_id))
        playback_manager->source_buffer_append_failed({}, source_buffer_id, append_generation, move(state));
}

void Client::source_buffer_removal_completed(u64 session_id, u64 source_buffer_id, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState state)
{
    if (auto* playback_manager = find_playback_manager(session_id))
        playback_manager->source_buffer_removal_completed({}, source_buffer_id, move(state));
}

void Client::verify_event_loop() const
{
    if (Core::EventLoop::is_running())
        VERIFY(&Core::EventLoop::current() == m_creation_event_loop);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaClient/Client.h
/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibCore/AnonymousBuffer.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Forward.h>
#include <LibCore/Promise.h>
#include <LibIPC/ConnectionToServer.h>
#include <LibIPC/TransportHandle.h>
#include <LibMedia/MediaSupport.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/Forward.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/DecoderCapabilities.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/DecoderError.h>
#include <MediaServer/MediaClientEndpoint.h>
#include <MediaServer/MediaServerEndpoint.h>

namespace MediaClient {

class Client final
    : public IPC::ConnectionToServer<MediaClientEndpoint, MediaServerEndpoint>
    , public MediaClientEndpoint {
    C_OBJECT_ABSTRACT(Client);

public:
    using TransportFactory = Function<ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>>()>;

    // Installed by the process that reaches the Browser, which spawns the process's MediaServer and brokers the
    // connection to it on request.
    static void set_transport_factory(TransportFactory);

    // The process's connection to its MediaServer, established on first use and dropped once it has had no
    // sessions for a while. Each connection is a fresh server process, so a holder of state tied to one keeps
    // its generation to notice a replacement.
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Client>> acquire();

    explicit Client(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>);
    virtual ~Client() override;

    u64 generation() const { return m_generation; }

    // Set by the Browser on the controller connection; a server's request for an AudioServer connection goes here.
    Function<ErrorOr<IPC::TransportHandle>()> on_request_audio_server_connection;
    // The answer may be given later, once the Browser can launch a server.
    using VideoDecoderServerConnectionAnswer = Function<void(ErrorOr<IPC::TransportHandle>)>;
    Function<void(VideoDecoderServerConnectionAnswer)> on_request_video_decoder_server_connection;

    // The synchronous queries serve APIs that must answer on the spot; everything else asks through a promise.
    Media::MediaSupportInfo query_file_media_support(StringView type, StringView subtype, Optional<String> codecs_parameter);
    Optional<Media::DecoderCapabilities> query_decoder_capabilities(StringView codecs_parameter);
    using FileMediaSupportPromise = Core::Promise<Media::MediaSupportInfo>;
    NonnullRefPtr<FileMediaSupportPromise> request_file_media_support(String const& type, String const& subtype, Optional<String const&> codecs_parameter);
    using DecoderCapabilitiesPromise = Core::Promise<Optional<Media::DecoderCapabilities>>;
    NonnullRefPtr<DecoderCapabilitiesPromise> request_decoder_capabilities(StringView codecs_parameter);

    // Linear PCM decoded by the server, one channel after another in shared memory.
    struct DecodedAudioData {
        AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

        u32 sample_rate { 0 };
        u32 channel_count { 0 };
        u64 frame_count { 0 };
        Core::AnonymousBuffer planar_samples;

        ReadonlySpan<float> channel(u32 index) const { return { planar_samples.data<float>() + static_cast<size_t>(index) * frame_count, frame_count }; }
    };
    using DecodeAudioDataCallback = Function<void(Media::DecoderErrorOr<DecodedAudioData>)>;
    // The callback runs on this event loop once the server answers, or at once with an error if it cannot be asked.
    void decode_audio_data(ReadonlyBytes, u32 output_sample_rate, DecodeAudioDataCallback);

    u64 allocate_id();

    void register_media_stream(Badge<RemoteMediaStream>, RemoteMediaStream&);
    void unregister_media_stream(Badge<RemoteMediaStream>, RemoteMediaStream&);
    void register_playback_manager(Badge<RemotePlaybackManager>, RemotePlaybackManager&);
    void unregister_playback_manager(Badge<RemotePlaybackManager>, RemotePlaybackManager&);

private:
    virtual void die() override;

    virtual Messages::MediaClient::RequestAudioServerConnectionResponse request_audio_server_connection() override;
    virtual void request_video_decoder_server_connection(u64 request_id) override;
    virtual void file_media_support_reported(u64 request_id, Media::MediaSupportInfo info) override;
    virtual void decoder_capabilities_reported(u64 request_id, Optional<Media::DecoderCapabilities> capabilities) override;
    virtual void audio_data_decoded(u64 request_id, u32 sample_rate, u32 channel_count, u64 frame_count, Core::AnonymousBuffer planar_samples) override;
    virtual void audio_data_decode_failed(u64 request_id, Media::DecoderError error) override;

    virtual void media_stream_data_requested(u64 stream_id, Optional<u64> offset) override;

    virtual void playback_session_clock_changed(u64 session_id, Media::MediaTimeReader time_reader) override;
    virtual void playback_session_media_source_added(u64 session_id, Optional<u64> stream_id, Vector<Media::Track> audio_tracks, Vector<Media::Track> video_tracks, Optional<Media::Track> preferred_audio_track, Optional<Media::Track> preferred_video_track, Optional<UnixDateTime> start_time_realtime, AK::Duration earliest_possible_position, Media::DemuxerScanState scan_state) override;
    virtual void playback_session_media_stream_source_failed(u64 session_id, u64 stream_id, Media::DecoderError error) override;
    virtual void playback_session_duration_changed(u64 session_id, AK::Duration duration) override;
    virtual void playback_session_seek_decided(u64 session_id, u64 seek_request_id, Media::SeekDecision decision) override;
    virtual void playback_session_state_changed(u64 session_id, u64 applied_seek_request_id, Media::PlaybackState state, bool is_playing, Media::AvailableData available_data, bool playback_state_is_settled, AK::Duration current_time) override;
    virtual void playback_session_media_stream_scan_state_changed(u64 session_id, u64 stream_id, Media::DemuxerScanState scan_state) override;
    virtual void playback_session_error(u64 session_id, Media::DecoderError error) override;
    virtual void playback_session_video_resized(u64 session_id, Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, u32 width, u32 height) override;

    virtual void source_buffer_duration_received(u64 session_id, u64 source_buffer_id, double duration) override;
    virtual void source_buffer_first_initialization_segment_received(u64 session_id, u64 source_buffer_id, Vector<Media::Track> audio_tracks, Vector<Media::Track> video_tracks, Vector<Media::Track> text_tracks) override;
    virtual void source_buffer_coded_frames_processed(u64 session_id, u64 source_buffer_id, AK::Duration group_end_timestamp) override;
    virtual void source_buffer_append_completed(u64 session_id, u64 source_buffer_id, u64 append_generation, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState state) override;
    virtual void source_buffer_append_failed(u64 session_id, u64 source_buffer_id, u64 append_generation, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState state) override;
    virtual void source_buffer_removal_completed(u64 session_id, u64 source_buffer_id, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState state) override;

    template<typename Reply, typename OtherReplyHandler>
    OwnPtr<Reply> wait_for_reply_to(u64 request_id, OtherReplyHandler);

    RemotePlaybackManager* find_playback_manager(u64 session_id);
    void update_idle_timer();
    void verify_event_loop() const;

    Core::EventLoop* m_creation_event_loop { &Core::EventLoop::current() };
    u64 m_generation { 0 };
    u64 m_next_id { 1 };

    HashMap<u64, DecodeAudioDataCallback> m_pending_audio_data_decodes;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<FileMediaSupportPromise>> m_pending_file_media_support_requests;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<DecoderCapabilitiesPromise>> m_pending_decoder_capabilities_requests;
    HashMap<u64, RemoteMediaStream*> m_media_streams;
    HashMap<u64, RemotePlaybackManager*> m_playback_managers;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_idle_timer;
};

}

// Coded bytes ride inline in messages, in pieces well under the transport's message size limit.

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaClient/RemoteMediaStream.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibMediaClient/Client.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/RemoteMediaStream.h>

namespace MediaClient {

NonnullRefPtr<RemoteMediaStream> RemoteMediaStream::create()
{
    auto client_or_error = Client::acquire();
    if (client_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("MediaClient: Could not reach the media server for a media stream: {}", client_or_error.error());
        return adopt_ref(*new RemoteMediaStream(nullptr, 0));
    }
    auto client = client_or_error.release_value();
    auto stream = adopt_ref(*new RemoteMediaStream(client, client->allocate_id()));
    client->register_media_stream({}, *stream);
    client->async_create_media_stream(stream->id());
    return stream;
}

RemoteMediaStream::RemoteMediaStream(RefPtr<Client> client, u64 id)
    : m_client(move(client))
    , m_id(id)
{
}

RemoteMediaStream::~RemoteMediaStream()
{
    if (!m_client)
        return;
    m_client->unregister_media_stream({}, *this);
    if (m_client->is_open())
        m_client->async_destroy_media_stream(m_id);
}

void RemoteMediaStream::set_data_request_callback(DataRequestCallback callback)
{
    m_data_request_callback = move(callback);
}

void RemoteMediaStream::add_chunk_at(u64 offset, ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    if (!m_client || !m_client->is_open())
        return;
    for (size_t piece_start = 0; piece_start < bytes.size(); piece_start += MAX_CODED_BYTES_PER_MESSAGE) {
        auto piece = bytes.slice(piece_start, min(MAX_CODED_BYTES_PER_MESSAGE, bytes.size() - piece_start));
        m_client->async_add_media_stream_chunk(m_id, offset + piece_start, piece);
    }
}

void RemoteMediaStream::set_expected_size(u64 size)
{
    if (m_client && m_client->is_open())
        m_client->async_set_media_stream_expected_size(m_id, size);
}

void RemoteMediaStream::set_may_idle(bool may_idle)
{
    if (m_client && m_client->is_open())
        m_client->async_set_media_stream_may_idle(m_id, may_idle);
}

void RemoteMediaStream::close()
{
    if (m_client && m_client->is_open())
        m_client->async_close_media_stream(m_id);
}

void RemoteMediaStream::data_requested(Badge<Client>, Optional<u64> offset)
{
    if (m_data_request_callback)
        m_data_request_callback(offset);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Badge.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/RefCounted.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/Forward.h>

namespace MediaClient {

// The renderer's end of a media stream that the media server demuxes: bytes go to the server as they arrive, and the
// server asks for the offset it needs next.
class RemoteMediaStream : public RefCounted<RemoteMediaStream> {
public:
    static NonnullRefPtr<RemoteMediaStream> create();
    ~RemoteMediaStream();

    u64 id() const { return m_id; }
    bool is_connected() const { return m_client != nullptr; }

    using DataRequestCallback = Function<void(Optional<u64> offset)>;
    void set_data_request_callback(DataRequestCallback);
    void set_may_idle(bool);

    void add_chunk_at(u64 offset, ReadonlyBytes);
    void set_expected_size(u64);
    void close();

    void data_requested(Badge<Client>, Optional<u64> offset);

private:
    RemoteMediaStream(RefPtr<Client>, u64 id);

    RefPtr<Client> m_client;
    u64 m_id { 0 };
    DataRequestCallback m_data_request_callback;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaClient/RemotePlaybackManager.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/AnyOf.h>
#include <AK/Debug.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibMedia/PlaybackManager.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/Client.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/RemoteMediaStream.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/RemotePlaybackManager.h>
#include <LibMediaClient/RemoteSourceBuffer.h>

namespace MediaClient {

static Media::DecoderError media_server_gone_error()
{
    return Media::DecoderError::with_description(Media::DecoderErrorCategory::Unknown, "The media server is gone"sv);
}

NonnullOwnPtr<RemotePlaybackManager> RemotePlaybackManager::create(Audio::PlaybackGroupId audio_group)
{
    auto client_or_error = Client::acquire();
    if (client_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("MediaClient: Could not reach the media server for playback: {}", client_or_error.error());
        return create_without_media_server();
    }
    auto client = client_or_error.release_value();
    auto playback_manager = adopt_own(*new RemotePlaybackManager(client, client->allocate_id()));
    client->register_playback_manager({}, *playback_manager);
    client->async_create_playback_session(playback_manager->session_id(), audio_group);
    return playback_manager;
}

NonnullOwnPtr<RemotePlaybackManager> RemotePlaybackManager::create_without_media_server()
{
    auto playback_manager = adopt_own(*new RemotePlaybackManager(nullptr, 0));
    // The owner installs its error handler after creation, so the failure reaches it from the event loop.
    Core::deferred_invoke([playback_manager = playback_manager->make_weak_ptr()] {
        if (playback_manager)
            playback_manager->handle_connection_lost();
    });
    return playback_manager;
}

RemotePlaybackManager::RemotePlaybackManager(RefPtr<Client> client, u64 session_id)
    : m_client(move(client))
    , m_session_id(session_id)
{
}

RemotePlaybackManager::~RemotePlaybackManager()
{
    for (auto& [id, source_buffer] : m_source_buffers)
        source_buffer->playback_manager_destroyed({});
    if (!m_client)
        return;
    m_client->unregister_playback_manager({}, *this);
    if (m_client->is_open())
        m_client->async_destroy_playback_session(m_session_id);
}

bool RemotePlaybackManager::can_send() const
{
    return m_client && m_client->is_open();
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::set_duration(AK::Duration duration)
{
    m_duration_is_set_by_owner = true;
    m_timeline.duration = duration;
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_set_duration(m_session_id, duration);
    dispatch_seekable_ranges_change();
}

AK::Duration RemotePlaybackManager::current_time() const
{
    AK::Duration time;
    switch (state()) {
    case Media::PlaybackState::Ended:
        return m_timeline.duration;
    case Media::PlaybackState::BeginningSeek:
    case Media::PlaybackState::Seeking:
        time = m_seek_timestamp;
        break;
    default:
        if (m_time_reader.has_value())
            time = m_time_reader->current_time();
        else
            time = m_seek_timestamp;
        break;
    }
    return min(time, m_timeline.duration);
}

Media::VideoSinkHandle RemotePlaybackManager::reserve_video_sink_handle(Media::Track const& track)
{
    auto handle = Media::allocate_video_sink_handle();
    m_video_sinks.set(handle, VideoSink { track });
    bool resume_ended_playback = state() != Media::PlaybackState::Ended;
    advance_seek_request_id();
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_reserve_video_sink(m_session_id, m_latest_seek_request_id, track, handle, resume_ended_playback);
    dispatch_buffered_ranges_change();
    return handle;
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::disable_video_sink_by_handle(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle)
{
    m_video_sinks.remove(handle);
    advance_seek_request_id();
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_disable_video_sink(m_session_id, m_latest_seek_request_id, handle);
    dispatch_buffered_ranges_change();
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::set_video_sink_ticking(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, bool ticking)
{
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_set_video_sink_ticking(m_session_id, handle, ticking);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::set_video_resize_handler(Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, Function<void(Gfx::Size<u32>)> handler)
{
    if (auto sink = m_video_sinks.get(handle); sink.has_value())
        sink->on_resize = move(handler);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::enable_an_audio_track(Media::Track const& track)
{
    // Once the end has been observed here, the element is paused at the duration, so the server must not resume.
    bool resume_ended_playback = state() != Media::PlaybackState::Ended;
    m_enabled_audio_tracks.set(track);
    advance_seek_request_id();
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_set_audio_track_enabled(m_session_id, m_latest_seek_request_id, track, true, resume_ended_playback);
    dispatch_buffered_ranges_change();
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::disable_an_audio_track(Media::Track const& track)
{
    m_enabled_audio_tracks.remove(track);
    advance_seek_request_id();
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_set_audio_track_enabled(m_session_id, m_latest_seek_request_id, track, false, false);
    dispatch_buffered_ranges_change();
}

NonnullRefPtr<RemotePlaybackManager::AddMediaSourcePromise> RemotePlaybackManager::add_media_source(RemoteMediaStream& stream)
{
    auto promise = AddMediaSourcePromise::construct();
    if (!can_send()) {
        promise->reject(media_server_gone_error());
        return promise;
    }
    m_pending_media_stream_sources.set(stream.id(), promise);
    m_client->async_add_media_stream_source(m_session_id, stream.id());
    return promise;
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::start()
{
    // The state the server settles in before starting does not account for the start.
    advance_seek_request_id();
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_start_playback(m_session_id, m_latest_seek_request_id);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::play()
{
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_play(m_session_id);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::pause()
{
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_pause(m_session_id);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::seek(AK::Duration timestamp, Media::SeekMode mode)
{
    m_seek_timestamp = timestamp;
    advance_seek_request_id();
    m_request_id_of_latest_seek = m_latest_seek_request_id;
    for (auto& [id, source_buffer] : m_source_buffers)
        source_buffer->invalidate_evictable_bytes({});
    dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "RemotePlaybackManager({}): Requesting seek {} to {} ({}) in {}", m_session_id, m_latest_seek_request_id, timestamp, mode, state());
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_seek(m_session_id, m_latest_seek_request_id, timestamp, mode);
    auto previous_state = state();
    m_seek_is_beginning = true;
    if (state() != previous_state)
        dispatch_state_change();
}

Media::PlaybackState RemotePlaybackManager::state() const
{
    // The server only reports a seek's state once it has decided that the seek goes ahead.
    if (m_seek_is_beginning && m_state != Media::PlaybackState::Seeking)
        return Media::PlaybackState::BeginningSeek;
    return m_state;
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::set_volume(double volume)
{
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_set_volume(m_session_id, volume);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::set_playback_rate(float rate)
{
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_set_playback_rate(m_session_id, rate);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::set_audio_group(Audio::PlaybackGroupId audio_group)
{
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_set_audio_group(m_session_id, audio_group);
}

bool RemotePlaybackManager::playback_state_is_settled() const
{
    if (!can_send())
        return true;
    // The server reports its state once it has applied each request.
    if (m_latest_reported_seek_request_id != m_latest_seek_request_id)
        return false;
    return m_server_playback_state_is_settled;
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::advance_seek_request_id()
{
    auto was_settled = playback_state_is_settled();
    m_latest_seek_request_id++;
    dispatch_playback_state_settled_change_if_changed(was_settled);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::dispatch_playback_state_settled_change_if_changed(bool was_settled) const
{
    if (playback_state_is_settled() != was_settled && on_playback_state_settled_change)
        on_playback_state_settled_change();
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::dispatch_state_change() const
{
    if (on_playback_state_change)
        on_playback_state_change();
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::dispatch_buffered_ranges_change() const
{
    if (on_buffered_ranges_change)
        on_buffered_ranges_change();
    dispatch_seekable_ranges_change();
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::dispatch_seekable_ranges_change() const
{
    if (on_seekable_ranges_change)
        on_seekable_ranges_change();
}

bool RemotePlaybackManager::source_has_enabled_track(ReadonlySpan<Media::Track> audio_tracks, ReadonlySpan<Media::Track> video_tracks) const
{
    for (auto const& track : audio_tracks) {
        if (m_enabled_audio_tracks.contains(track))
            return true;
    }
    for (auto const& [handle, sink] : m_video_sinks) {
        if (video_tracks.contains_slow(sink.track))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// The ranges are calculated here from the state of each source, so that enabling or disabling tracks and reaching the
// end of a source buffer's stream are reflected at once.
Vector<Media::CombinedScanState> RemotePlaybackManager::enabled_source_scan_states() const
{
    Vector<Media::CombinedScanState> enabled_sources;
    for (auto const& [stream_id, source] : m_media_stream_sources) {
        if (source_has_enabled_track(source.audio_tracks, source.video_tracks))
            enabled_sources.append(scan_state_for_enabled_tracks(source.scan_state, source.audio_tracks, source.video_tracks));
    }
    for (auto const& [source_buffer_id, source_buffer] : m_source_buffers) {
        if (source_has_enabled_track(source_buffer->audio_tracks(), source_buffer->video_tracks()))
            enabled_sources.append(scan_state_for_enabled_tracks(source_buffer->scan_state(), source_buffer->audio_tracks(), source_buffer->video_tracks()));
    }
    return enabled_sources;
}

Media::BufferedRanges RemotePlaybackManager::buffered_time_ranges() const
{
    return Media::PlaybackManager::buffered_time_ranges_of_sources(enabled_source_scan_states(), m_timeline);
}

Optional<Media::TimeRanges::Range> RemotePlaybackManager::seekable_time_ranges() const
{
    auto buffered = Media::DemuxerScanState::buffered_ranges_of_sources(enabled_source_scan_states());
    return Media::PlaybackManager::seekable_time_range(buffered.time_ranges, m_timeline);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::set_live_seekable_range(Optional<Media::TimeRanges::Range> range)
{
    m_timeline.live_seekable_range = range;
    if (can_send())
        m_client->async_set_live_seekable_range(m_session_id, range);
    dispatch_seekable_ranges_change();
}

Media::CombinedScanState RemotePlaybackManager::scan_state_for_enabled_tracks(Media::DemuxerScanState const& state, ReadonlySpan<Media::Track> audio_tracks, ReadonlySpan<Media::Track> video_tracks) const
{
    return state.combined_scan_state([&](u64 identifier) {
        for (auto const& track : audio_tracks) {
            if (track.identifier() == identifier)
                return m_enabled_audio_tracks.contains(track);
        }
        for (auto const& track : video_tracks) {
            if (track.identifier() == identifier)
                return any_of(m_video_sinks, [&](auto const& entry) { return entry.value.track == track; });
        }
        return false;
    });
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::register_source_buffer(Badge<RemoteSourceBuffer>, RemoteSourceBuffer& source_buffer)
{
    m_source_buffers.set(source_buffer.id(), &source_buffer);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::unregister_source_buffer(Badge<RemoteSourceBuffer>, RemoteSourceBuffer& source_buffer)
{
    m_source_buffers.remove(source_buffer.id());
}

RemoteSourceBuffer* RemotePlaybackManager::find_source_buffer(u64 source_buffer_id)
{
    return m_source_buffers.get(source_buffer_id).value_or(nullptr);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::handle_connection_lost()
{
    auto was_settled = playback_state_is_settled();
    m_client = nullptr;
    dispatch_playback_state_settled_change_if_changed(was_settled);
    for (auto& [id, source_buffer] : m_source_buffers)
        source_buffer->connection_lost({});
    // The pending media sources can't be added anymore, and the sources already added can't play anymore.
    auto pending_media_stream_sources = move(m_pending_media_stream_sources);
    for (auto& [id, promise] : pending_media_stream_sources)
        promise->reject(media_server_gone_error());
    dispatch_error(media_server_gone_error());
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::dispatch_error(Media::DecoderError&& error)
{
    if (m_is_in_error_state)
        return;
    m_is_in_error_state = true;
    if (on_error)
        on_error(move(error));
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::clock_changed(Badge<Client>, Media::MediaTimeReader time_reader)
{
    m_time_reader = move(time_reader);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::media_source_added(Badge<Client>, Optional<u64> stream_id, Vector<Media::Track> audio_tracks, Vector<Media::Track> video_tracks, Optional<Media::Track> preferred_audio_track, Optional<Media::Track> preferred_video_track, Optional<AK::UnixDateTime> start_time_realtime, AK::Duration earliest_possible_position, Media::DemuxerScanState scan_state)
{
    m_audio_tracks.extend(audio_tracks);
    m_video_tracks.extend(video_tracks);
    if (!m_preferred_audio_track.has_value())
        m_preferred_audio_track = preferred_audio_track;
    if (!m_preferred_video_track.has_value())
        m_preferred_video_track = preferred_video_track;
    m_start_time_realtime = start_time_realtime;
    m_timeline.earliest_possible_position = earliest_possible_position;

    // Sources the server added on its own, such as a source buffer's track buffers, have no promise here.
    if (!stream_id.has_value())
        return;
    m_media_stream_sources.set(stream_id.value(), { audio_tracks, video_tracks, move(scan_state) });
    if (auto promise = m_pending_media_stream_sources.take(stream_id.value()); promise.has_value())
        promise.value()->resolve(AddedTracks { move(audio_tracks), move(video_tracks) });
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::media_stream_source_failed(Badge<Client>, u64 stream_id, Media::DecoderError error)
{
    if (auto promise = m_pending_media_stream_sources.take(stream_id); promise.has_value())
        promise.value()->reject(move(error));
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::duration_changed(Badge<Client>, AK::Duration duration)
{
    // A demuxed duration reported before the server saw the owner's must not replace it.
    if (m_duration_is_set_by_owner)
        return;
    m_timeline.duration = duration;
    if (on_duration_change)
        on_duration_change(duration);
    dispatch_seekable_ranges_change();
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::seek_decided(Badge<Client>, u64 seek_request_id, Media::SeekDecision decision)
{
    if (seek_request_id != m_request_id_of_latest_seek)
        return;
    // The server never left the state it was in for a skipped seek.
    if (decision == Media::SeekDecision::Skip)
        m_seek_is_beginning = false;
    if (on_seek_decided)
        on_seek_decided(decision);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::state_changed(Badge<Client>, u64 applied_seek_request_id, Media::PlaybackState state, bool is_playing, Media::AvailableData available_data, bool server_playback_state_is_settled, AK::Duration current_time)
{
    if (applied_seek_request_id != m_latest_seek_request_id) {
        dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "RemotePlaybackManager({}): Dropping {} reported after seek {}, latest is {}", m_session_id, state, applied_seek_request_id, m_latest_seek_request_id);
        return;
    }
    dbgln_if(PLAYBACK_MANAGER_DEBUG, "RemotePlaybackManager({}): Server reports {} playing={} available={} settled={} time={} (mirror was {})", m_session_id, state, is_playing, to_underlying(available_data), server_playback_state_is_settled, current_time, this->state());
    if (state == Media::PlaybackState::Seeking)
        m_seek_timestamp = current_time;
    auto was_settled = playback_state_is_settled();
    m_latest_reported_seek_request_id = applied_seek_request_id;
    m_server_playback_state_is_settled = server_playback_state_is_settled;
    m_is_playing = is_playing;
    m_available_data = available_data;
    dispatch_playback_state_settled_change_if_changed(was_settled);
    auto previous_state = this->state();
    m_seek_is_beginning = false;
    m_state = state;
    if (this->state() != previous_state)
        dispatch_state_change();
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::media_stream_scan_state_changed(Badge<Client>, u64 stream_id, Media::DemuxerScanState scan_state)
{
    auto source = m_media_stream_sources.get(stream_id);
    if (!source.has_value())
        return;
    source.value().scan_state = move(scan_state);
    dispatch_buffered_ranges_change();
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::error(Badge<Client>, Media::DecoderError error)
{
    dispatch_error(move(error));
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::video_resized(Badge<Client>, Media::VideoSinkHandle handle, Gfx::Size<u32> size)
{
    auto sink = m_video_sinks.get(handle);
    if (sink.has_value() && sink->on_resize)
        sink->on_resize(size);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::source_buffer_duration_received(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, double duration)
{
    if (auto* source_buffer = find_source_buffer(source_buffer_id))
        source_buffer->duration_received({}, duration);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::source_buffer_first_initialization_segment_received(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, Vector<Media::Track> const& audio_tracks, Vector<Media::Track> const& video_tracks, Vector<Media::Track> const& text_tracks)
{
    if (auto* source_buffer = find_source_buffer(source_buffer_id))
        source_buffer->first_initialization_segment_received({}, audio_tracks, video_tracks, text_tracks);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::source_buffer_coded_frames_processed(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, AK::Duration group_end_timestamp)
{
    if (auto* source_buffer = find_source_buffer(source_buffer_id))
        source_buffer->coded_frames_processed({}, group_end_timestamp);
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::source_buffer_append_completed(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, u64 append_generation, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState state)
{
    if (auto* source_buffer = find_source_buffer(source_buffer_id))
        source_buffer->append_completed({}, append_generation, move(state));
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::source_buffer_append_failed(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, u64 append_generation, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState state)
{
    if (auto* source_buffer = find_source_buffer(source_buffer_id))
        source_buffer->append_failed({}, append_generation, move(state));
}

void RemotePlaybackManager::source_buffer_removal_completed(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState state)
{
    if (auto* source_buffer = find_source_buffer(source_buffer_id))
        source_buffer->removal_completed({}, move(state));
}

}

namespace MediaClient {

// The renderer's face of a playback session in the media server. It mirrors what the server reports and reads the
// playback clock through shared memory, so nothing a script observes waits on the server.
class RemotePlaybackManager : public Weakable<RemotePlaybackManager> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(RemotePlaybackManager);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(RemotePlaybackManager);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    // The audio plays as part of the group.
    static NonnullOwnPtr<RemotePlaybackManager> create(Audio::PlaybackGroupId audio_group);
    static NonnullOwnPtr<RemotePlaybackManager> create_without_media_server();
    ~RemotePlaybackManager();

    u64 session_id() const { return m_session_id; }
    Client* client() { return m_client.ptr(); }

    AK::Duration duration() const { return m_timeline.duration; }
    void set_duration(AK::Duration);
    AK::Duration current_time() const;

    Optional<AK::UnixDateTime> start_time_realtime() const { return m_start_time_realtime; }
    AK::Duration earliest_possible_position() const { return m_timeline.earliest_possible_position; }

    Vector<Media::Track> const& video_tracks() const { return m_video_tracks; }
    Vector<Media::Track> const& audio_tracks() const { return m_audio_tracks; }
    Optional<Media::Track> preferred_video_track() const { return m_preferred_video_track; }
    Optional<Media::Track> preferred_audio_track() const { return m_preferred_audio_track; }

    Media::VideoSinkHandle reserve_video_sink_handle(Media::Track const&);
    void disable_video_sink_by_handle(Media::VideoSinkHandle);
    void set_video_sink_ticking(Media::VideoSinkHandle, bool);
    void set_video_resize_handler(Media::VideoSinkHandle, Function<void(Gfx::Size<u32>)>);

    void enable_an_audio_track(Media::Track const&);
    void disable_an_audio_track(Media::Track const&);

    struct AddedTracks {
        Vector<Media::Track> audio_tracks;
        Vector<Media::Track> video_tracks;
    };
    using AddMediaSourcePromise = Core::Promise<AddedTracks, Media::DecoderError>;
    NonnullRefPtr<AddMediaSourcePromise> add_media_source(RemoteMediaStream&);

    void start();
    void play();
    void pause();
    void seek(AK::Duration timestamp, Media::SeekMode);

    bool is_playing() const { return m_is_playing; }
    Media::PlaybackState state() const;
    Media::AvailableData available_data() const { return m_available_data; }
    // Whether the playback state can only change through further input, such as more data or a seek.
    bool playback_state_is_settled() const;
    Media::BufferedRanges buffered_time_ranges() const;
    // This is never more than one range, and that range may start and end at the same time.
    Optional<Media::TimeRanges::Range> seekable_time_ranges() const;
    // The range a live stream's player says can be sought to, besides the buffered ranges.
    void set_live_seekable_range(Optional<Media::TimeRanges::Range>);

    void set_volume(double);
    void set_playback_rate(float);
    void set_audio_group(Audio::PlaybackGroupId);

    Function<void()> on_playback_state_change;
    Function<void()> on_playback_state_settled_change;
    Function<void(AK::Duration)> on_duration_change;
    Function<void()> on_buffered_ranges_change;
    // Called for each seek, before any state change the seek causes.
    Function<void(Media::SeekDecision)> on_seek_decided;
    // Called whenever an input of the seekable ranges changes: the duration, the buffered ranges, or the live seekable
    // range.
    Function<void()> on_seekable_ranges_change;
    Function<void(Media::DecoderError&&)> on_error;

    void register_source_buffer(Badge<RemoteSourceBuffer>, RemoteSourceBuffer&);
    void unregister_source_buffer(Badge<RemoteSourceBuffer>, RemoteSourceBuffer&);
    void source_buffer_state_changed(Badge<RemoteSourceBuffer>) { dispatch_buffered_ranges_change(); }

    void connection_lost(Badge<Client>) { handle_connection_lost(); }
    void clock_changed(Badge<Client>, Media::MediaTimeReader);
    void media_source_added(Badge<Client>, Optional<u64> stream_id, Vector<Media::Track> audio_tracks, Vector<Media::Track> video_tracks, Optional<Media::Track> preferred_audio_track, Optional<Media::Track> preferred_video_track, Optional<AK::UnixDateTime> start_time_realtime, AK::Duration earliest_possible_position, Media::DemuxerScanState);
    void media_stream_source_failed(Badge<Client>, u64 stream_id, Media::DecoderError);
    void duration_changed(Badge<Client>, AK::Duration);
    void seek_decided(Badge<Client>, u64 seek_request_id, Media::SeekDecision);
    void state_changed(Badge<Client>, u64 applied_seek_request_id, Media::PlaybackState, bool is_playing, Media::AvailableData, bool server_playback_state_is_settled, AK::Duration current_time);
    void media_stream_scan_state_changed(Badge<Client>, u64 stream_id, Media::DemuxerScanState);
    void error(Badge<Client>, Media::DecoderError);
    void video_resized(Badge<Client>, Media::VideoSinkHandle, Gfx::Size<u32>);
    void source_buffer_duration_received(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, double duration);
    void source_buffer_first_initialization_segment_received(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, Vector<Media::Track> const& audio_tracks, Vector<Media::Track> const& video_tracks, Vector<Media::Track> const& text_tracks);
    void source_buffer_coded_frames_processed(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, AK::Duration group_end_timestamp);
    void source_buffer_append_completed(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, u64 append_generation, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState);
    void source_buffer_append_failed(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, u64 append_generation, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState);
    void source_buffer_removal_completed(Badge<Client>, u64 source_buffer_id, Media::MediaSourceExtensions::PublishedState);

private:
    struct VideoSink {
        explicit VideoSink(Media::Track const& track)
            : track(track)
        {
        }

        Media::Track track;
        Function<void(Gfx::Size<u32>)> on_resize;
    };

    struct MediaStreamSource {
        Vector<Media::Track> audio_tracks;
        Vector<Media::Track> video_tracks;
        Media::DemuxerScanState scan_state;
    };

    RemotePlaybackManager(RefPtr<Client>, u64 session_id);

    bool can_send() const;
    void handle_connection_lost();
    void dispatch_error(Media::DecoderError&&);
    RemoteSourceBuffer* find_source_buffer(u64 source_buffer_id);
    void dispatch_state_change() const;
    void advance_seek_request_id();
    void dispatch_playback_state_settled_change_if_changed(bool was_settled) const;
    void dispatch_buffered_ranges_change() const;
    void dispatch_seekable_ranges_change() const;
    bool source_has_enabled_track(ReadonlySpan<Media::Track> audio_tracks, ReadonlySpan<Media::Track> video_tracks) const;
    Media::CombinedScanState scan_state_for_enabled_tracks(Media::DemuxerScanState const&, ReadonlySpan<Media::Track> audio_tracks, ReadonlySpan<Media::Track> video_tracks) const;
    Vector<Media::CombinedScanState> enabled_source_scan_states() const;

    RefPtr<Client> m_client;
    u64 m_session_id { 0 };

    Optional<Media::MediaTimeReader> m_time_reader;
    Media::MediaTimeline m_timeline;
    bool m_duration_is_set_by_owner { false };
    Optional<AK::UnixDateTime> m_start_time_realtime;
    bool m_is_in_error_state { false };
    Vector<Media::Track> m_audio_tracks;
    Vector<Media::Track> m_video_tracks;
    Optional<Media::Track> m_preferred_audio_track;
    Optional<Media::Track> m_preferred_video_track;

    Media::PlaybackState m_state { Media::PlaybackState::Starting };
    bool m_is_playing { false };
    Media::AvailableData m_available_data { Media::AvailableData::None };

    // A seek reports its target as the current time until the server has chosen where it lands. State reported
    // before the server applied the latest seek request is stale, and is ignored.
    u64 m_latest_seek_request_id { 0 };
    // Track changes also advance the seek request ID, so they don't supersede the decision for the latest seek.
    u64 m_request_id_of_latest_seek { 0 };
    // Set from a seek until the server reports its state after applying the seek, unless the seek is skipped.
    bool m_seek_is_beginning { false };
    u64 m_latest_reported_seek_request_id { 0 };
    bool m_server_playback_state_is_settled { true };
    AK::Duration m_seek_timestamp;

    HashTable<Media::Track> m_enabled_audio_tracks;
    HashMap<Media::VideoSinkHandle, VideoSink> m_video_sinks;
    HashMap<u64, MediaStreamSource> m_media_stream_sources;
    HashMap<u64, RemoteSourceBuffer*> m_source_buffers;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<AddMediaSourcePromise>> m_pending_media_stream_sources;
};

}
