#include <LibMediaCodecs/BitReader.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/CodecString.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/DolbyVision.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/H265.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/NALUnit.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/RBSPBitReader.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/SupplementalEnhancementInformation.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

static constexpr size_t NAL_UNIT_HEADER_SIZE = 2;
static constexpr u8 VIDEO_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 32;
static constexpr u8 SEQUENCE_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 33;
static constexpr u8 PICTURE_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 34;
static constexpr u8 LAST_CODED_SLICE_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 31;
static constexpr u8 FIRST_IRAP_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 16;
static constexpr u8 LAST_IRAP_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 23;
static constexpr u8 FIRST_RASL_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 8;
static constexpr u8 LAST_RASL_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 9;
static constexpr u8 FIRST_BLA_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 16;
static constexpr u8 LAST_BLA_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 18;
static constexpr u8 CRA_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 21;
static constexpr u8 LAST_IDR_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 20;
static constexpr u8 END_OF_SEQUENCE_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 36;
static constexpr u8 END_OF_BITSTREAM_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 37;
static constexpr u8 PREFIX_SUPPLEMENTAL_ENHANCEMENT_INFORMATION_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 39;
// Dolby Vision puts its RPUs in the first of the unspecified NAL unit types.
static constexpr u8 DOLBY_VISION_REFERENCE_PROCESSING_UNIT_NAL_UNIT_TYPE = 62;
static constexpr u8 MAXIMUM_REORDER_FRAME_COUNT = 16;

Optional<H265::Parameters> H265::parse_codec_parameters(GenericLexer& lexer)
{
    if (!lexer.consume_specific('.'))
        return {};

    Parameters parameters {};
    if (lexer.next_is(is_any_of("ABC"sv)))
        parameters.profile_space = lexer.consume() - 'A' + 1;

    auto profile_idc = lexer.consume_while(is_ascii_digit);
    if (profile_idc.is_empty() || profile_idc.length() > 2)
        return {};
    auto maybe_profile_idc = profile_idc.to_number<u8>(TrimWhitespace::No);
    if (!maybe_profile_idc.has_value() || *maybe_profile_idc > 31)
        return {};
    parameters.profile_idc = *maybe_profile_idc;

    if (!lexer.consume_specific('.'))
        return {};

    auto profile_compatibility_flags = lexer.consume_while(is_ascii_hex_digit);
    if (profile_compatibility_flags.is_empty() || profile_compatibility_flags.length() > 8)
        return {};
    auto maybe_profile_compatibility_flags = profile_compatibility_flags.to_number<u32>(TrimWhitespace::No, 16);
    if (!maybe_profile_compatibility_flags.has_value())
        return {};
    parameters.profile_compatibility_flags = *maybe_profile_compatibility_flags;

    if (!lexer.consume_specific('.'))
        return {};

    if (!lexer.next_is(is_any_of("LH"sv)))
        return {};
    parameters.tier_flag = lexer.consume() == 'H';

    auto level_idc = lexer.consume_while(is_ascii_digit);
    if (level_idc.is_empty() || level_idc.length() > 3)
        return {};
    auto maybe_level_idc = level_idc.to_number<u8>(TrimWhitespace::No);
    if (!maybe_level_idc.has_value())
        return {};
    parameters.level_idc = *maybe_level_idc;

    for (size_t index = 0; lexer.consume_specific('.'); index++) {
        if (index == parameters.constraint_indicator_flags.size())
            return {};
        auto digits = lexer.consume_while(is_ascii_hex_digit);
        if (digits.is_empty() || digits.length() > 2)
            return {};
        auto flag = digits.to_number<u8>(TrimWhitespace::No, 16);
        if (!flag.has_value())
            return {};
        parameters.constraint_indicator_flags[index] = *flag;
    }

    if (!lexer.is_eof())
        return {};
    return parameters;
}

// Parameters holds the flags indexed by profile, where general_profile_compatibility_flag[i] is bit i.
static u32 reverse_profile_compatibility_flag_bits(u32 flags)
{
    u32 reversed = 0;
    for (size_t bit = 0; bit < 32; bit++)
        reversed |= ((flags >> bit) & 1) << (31 - bit);
    return reversed;
}

Optional<H265::Parameters> H265::parse_configuration_record(ReadonlyBytes record)
{
    BitReader reader { record };

    auto version = reader.read_bits<u8>(8);
    if (version != 1)
        return {};

    Parameters parameters {};
    parameters.profile_space = reader.read_bits<u8>(2);
    parameters.tier_flag = reader.read_bit();
    parameters.profile_idc = reader.read_bits<u8>(5);
    parameters.profile_compatibility_flags = reverse_profile_compatibility_flag_bits(reader.read_bits<u32>(32));
    for (auto& constraint_indicator_flag : parameters.constraint_indicator_flags)
        constraint_indicator_flag = reader.read_bits<u8>(8);
    parameters.level_idc = reader.read_bits<u8>(8);

    if (reader.has_overrun())
        return {};
    return parameters;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.1.2: nal_unit_header().
Optional<H265::NALUnitHeader> H265::parse_nal_unit_header(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit)
{
    if (nal_unit.size() < NAL_UNIT_HEADER_SIZE)
        return {};
    if ((nal_unit[0] & 0x80) != 0) // forbidden_zero_bit
        return {};
    auto temporal_id_plus1 = nal_unit[1] & 0x07;
    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.2.2: nuh_temporal_id_plus1 shall not be equal to 0.
    if (temporal_id_plus1 == 0)
        return {};

    return NALUnitHeader {
        .nal_unit_type = static_cast<u8>((nal_unit[0] >> 1) & 0x3f),
        .nuh_layer_id = static_cast<u8>(((nal_unit[0] & 0x01) << 5) | (nal_unit[1] >> 3)),
        .temporal_id = static_cast<u8>(temporal_id_plus1 - 1),
    };
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), Table 7-1: nal_unit_type 0 through 31 carry coded slice segments.
bool H265::is_coded_slice(NALUnitHeader const& header)
{
    return header.nal_unit_type <= LAST_CODED_SLICE_NAL_UNIT_TYPE;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.2.2: the even types below the IRAP range are the sub-layer non-reference pictures.
bool H265::is_sub_layer_non_reference(NALUnitHeader const& header)
{
    return header.nal_unit_type < FIRST_IRAP_NAL_UNIT_TYPE && header.nal_unit_type % 2 == 0;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), Table 7-1.
bool H265::is_parameter_set(NALUnitHeader const& header)
{
    return header.nal_unit_type >= VIDEO_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE && header.nal_unit_type <= PICTURE_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 3.73: every VCL NAL unit of an IRAP picture is in the range BLA_W_LP to RSV_IRAP_VCL23.
bool H265::is_random_access_point(NALUnitHeader const& header)
{
    return header.nal_unit_type >= FIRST_IRAP_NAL_UNIT_TYPE && header.nal_unit_type <= LAST_IRAP_NAL_UNIT_TYPE;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 3.126: every VCL NAL unit of a RASL picture is one of these two types.
bool H265::is_random_access_skipped_leading(NALUnitHeader const& header)
{
    return header.nal_unit_type >= FIRST_RASL_NAL_UNIT_TYPE && header.nal_unit_type <= LAST_RASL_NAL_UNIT_TYPE;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 3.126: all RASL pictures are leading pictures of an associated BLA or CRA picture.
bool H265::has_random_access_skipped_leading_pictures(NALUnitHeader const& header)
{
    auto is_broken_link_access = header.nal_unit_type >= FIRST_BLA_NAL_UNIT_TYPE && header.nal_unit_type <= LAST_BLA_NAL_UNIT_TYPE;
    return is_broken_link_access || header.nal_unit_type == CRA_NAL_UNIT_TYPE;
}

static ColorMetadata high_dynamic_range_metadata_of_dolby_vision_nal_unit(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit)
{
    Vector<u8, 1024> rpu;
    Codecs::RBSPBitReader reader { nal_unit.slice(NAL_UNIT_HEADER_SIZE) };
    while (reader.remaining_byte_count() > 0) {
        auto byte = reader.read_bits<u8>(8);
        if (reader.has_overrun())
            break;
        if (rpu.try_append(byte).is_error())
            return {};
    }

    ColorMetadata metadata;
    metadata.maximum_scene_luminance = dolby_vision_maximum_scene_luminance(rpu);
    return metadata;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), Table 7-1: BLA_W_LP through IDR_N_LP.
bool H265::begins_coded_video_sequence(NALUnitHeader const& header)
{
    return header.nuh_layer_id == 0 && header.nal_unit_type >= FIRST_BLA_NAL_UNIT_TYPE && header.nal_unit_type <= LAST_IDR_NAL_UNIT_TYPE;
}

bool H265::ends_coded_video_sequence(NALUnitHeader const& header)
{
    return header.nal_unit_type == END_OF_SEQUENCE_NAL_UNIT_TYPE || header.nal_unit_type == END_OF_BITSTREAM_NAL_UNIT_TYPE;
}

ColorMetadata H265::high_dynamic_range_metadata_of_nal_unit(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit)
{
    auto header = parse_nal_unit_header(nal_unit);
    if (!header.has_value() || header->nuh_layer_id != 0)
        return {};
    if (header->nal_unit_type == PREFIX_SUPPLEMENTAL_ENHANCEMENT_INFORMATION_NAL_UNIT_TYPE)
        return high_dynamic_range_metadata_of_sei_payload(nal_unit.slice(NAL_UNIT_HEADER_SIZE));
    if (header->nal_unit_type == DOLBY_VISION_REFERENCE_PROCESSING_UNIT_NAL_UNIT_TYPE)
        return high_dynamic_range_metadata_of_dolby_vision_nal_unit(nal_unit);
    return {};
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.3: the spec notes that the constraint flag branches do not affect the structure's
// width, so reaching what follows only takes counting bits.
static void skip_profile_tier_level(RBSPBitReader& reader, u8 max_sub_layers_minus1)
{
    static constexpr size_t GENERAL_PROFILE_TIER_LEVEL_BIT_COUNT = 96;
    static constexpr size_t SUB_LAYER_PROFILE_BIT_COUNT = 88;
    static constexpr size_t SUB_LAYER_LEVEL_BIT_COUNT = 8;

    reader.skip_bits(GENERAL_PROFILE_TIER_LEVEL_BIT_COUNT);
    if (max_sub_layers_minus1 == 0)
        return;

    Array<bool, 7> profile_present {};
    Array<bool, 7> level_present {};
    for (u8 index = 0; index < max_sub_layers_minus1; index++) {
        profile_present[index] = reader.read_bit();
        level_present[index] = reader.read_bit();
    }
    reader.skip_bits(2 * static_cast<size_t>(8u - max_sub_layers_minus1)); // reserved_zero_2bits

    for (u8 index = 0; index < max_sub_layers_minus1; index++) {
        if (profile_present[index])
            reader.skip_bits(SUB_LAYER_PROFILE_BIT_COUNT);
        if (level_present[index])
            reader.skip_bits(SUB_LAYER_LEVEL_BIT_COUNT);
    }
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.2.1: video_parameter_set_rbsp(), whose first element is all we track.
Optional<H265::VideoParameterSet> H265::parse_video_parameter_set(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit)
{
    auto header = parse_nal_unit_header(nal_unit);
    if (!header.has_value() || header->nal_unit_type != VIDEO_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE)
        return {};

    RBSPBitReader reader { nal_unit.slice(NAL_UNIT_HEADER_SIZE) };
    auto vps_video_parameter_set_id = reader.read_bits<u8>(4);
    if (reader.has_overrun())
        return {};
    return VideoParameterSet { .vps_video_parameter_set_id = vps_video_parameter_set_id };
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.4: scaling_list_data()
static void skip_scaling_list_data(RBSPBitReader& reader)
{
    for (u32 size_id = 0; size_id < 4; size_id++) {
        for (u32 matrix_id = 0; matrix_id < 6; matrix_id += size_id == 3 ? 3 : 1) {
            auto scaling_list_pred_mode_flag = reader.read_bit();
            if (!scaling_list_pred_mode_flag) {
                reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // scaling_list_pred_matrix_id_delta
                continue;
            }
            auto coefficient_count = min(64u, 1u << (4 + (size_id << 1)));
            if (size_id > 1)
                reader.read_signed_exp_golomb(); // scaling_list_dc_coef_minus8
            for (u32 index = 0; index < coefficient_count; index++)
                reader.read_signed_exp_golomb(); // scaling_list_delta_coef
        }
    }
}

static constexpr u32 MAXIMUM_SHORT_TERM_REFERENCE_PICTURE_SET_COUNT = 64;
static constexpr u32 MAXIMUM_DECODED_PICTURE_BUFFER_SIZE = 16;

struct ShortTermReferencePictureSet {
    Vector<i32, MAXIMUM_DECODED_PICTURE_BUFFER_SIZE> negative_picture_order_count_deltas;
    Vector<i32, MAXIMUM_DECODED_PICTURE_BUFFER_SIZE> positive_picture_order_count_deltas;
};

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.7: st_ref_pic_set(stRpsIdx), as it appears in a sequence parameter set.
// Only the picture order count deltas are kept, since a later set can be predicted from them.
static Optional<ShortTermReferencePictureSet> parse_short_term_reference_picture_set(RBSPBitReader& reader, ReadonlySpan<ShortTermReferencePictureSet> previous_sets)
{
    ShortTermReferencePictureSet result;

    auto inter_ref_pic_set_prediction_flag = !previous_sets.is_empty() && reader.read_bit();
    if (inter_ref_pic_set_prediction_flag) {
        auto delta_rps_sign = reader.read_bit();
        auto abs_delta_rps_minus1 = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
        // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.8: abs_delta_rps_minus1 is in 0 to 2^15 - 1.
        if (reader.has_overrun() || abs_delta_rps_minus1 > 0x7FFF)
            return {};
        // In a sequence parameter set, delta_idx_minus1 is absent and inferred to be 0, so the set predicts from the
        // one before it.
        auto const& reference = previous_sets.last();
        auto delta_rps = (1 - 2 * static_cast<i32>(delta_rps_sign)) * static_cast<i32>(abs_delta_rps_minus1 + 1);

        auto reference_negative_count = reference.negative_picture_order_count_deltas.size();
        auto reference_positive_count = reference.positive_picture_order_count_deltas.size();
        auto reference_delta_count = reference_negative_count + reference_positive_count;
        Vector<bool, MAXIMUM_DECODED_PICTURE_BUFFER_SIZE + 1> use_delta_flags;
        for (size_t j = 0; j <= reference_delta_count; j++) {
            auto used_by_curr_pic_flag = reader.read_bit();
            // When use_delta_flag[ j ] is not present, its value is inferred to be equal to 1.
            auto use_delta_flag = used_by_curr_pic_flag || reader.read_bit();
            use_delta_flags.append(use_delta_flag);
        }

        // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.8: the derivation of DeltaPocS0 and DeltaPocS1 for a predicted set.
        auto& negative = result.negative_picture_order_count_deltas;
        auto& positive = result.positive_picture_order_count_deltas;
        auto append_if_room = [](auto& deltas, i32 delta) {
            if (deltas.size() >= MAXIMUM_DECODED_PICTURE_BUFFER_SIZE)
                return false;
            deltas.append(delta);
            return true;
        };
        for (auto j = static_cast<ssize_t>(reference_positive_count) - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
            auto delta = reference.positive_picture_order_count_deltas[j] + delta_rps;
            if (delta < 0 && use_delta_flags[reference_negative_count + j] && !append_if_room(negative, delta))
                return {};
        }
        if (delta_rps < 0 && use_delta_flags[reference_delta_count] && !append_if_room(negative, delta_rps))
            return {};
        for (size_t j = 0; j < reference_negative_count; j++) {
            auto delta = reference.negative_picture_order_count_deltas[j] + delta_rps;
            if (delta < 0 && use_delta_flags[j] && !append_if_room(negative, delta))
                return {};
        }

        for (auto j = static_cast<ssize_t>(reference_negative_count) - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
            auto delta = reference.negative_picture_order_count_deltas[j] + delta_rps;
            if (delta > 0 && use_delta_flags[j] && !append_if_room(positive, delta))
                return {};
        }
        if (delta_rps > 0 && use_delta_flags[reference_delta_count] && !append_if_room(positive, delta_rps))
            return {};
        for (size_t j = 0; j < reference_positive_count; j++) {
            auto delta = reference.positive_picture_order_count_deltas[j] + delta_rps;
            if (delta > 0 && use_delta_flags[reference_negative_count + j] && !append_if_room(positive, delta))
                return {};
        }
        return result;
    }

    auto num_negative_pics = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    auto num_positive_pics = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    if (reader.has_overrun() || num_negative_pics > MAXIMUM_DECODED_PICTURE_BUFFER_SIZE || num_positive_pics > MAXIMUM_DECODED_PICTURE_BUFFER_SIZE - num_negative_pics)
        return {};
    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.8: the derivation of DeltaPocS0 and DeltaPocS1 for an explicit set.
    i32 picture_order_count = 0;
    for (u32 index = 0; index < num_negative_pics; index++) {
        auto delta_poc_s0_minus1 = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
        reader.skip_bits(1); // used_by_curr_pic_s0_flag
        if (reader.has_overrun() || delta_poc_s0_minus1 > 0x7FFF)
            return {};
        picture_order_count -= static_cast<i32>(delta_poc_s0_minus1 + 1);
        result.negative_picture_order_count_deltas.append(picture_order_count);
    }
    picture_order_count = 0;
    for (u32 index = 0; index < num_positive_pics; index++) {
        auto delta_poc_s1_minus1 = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
        reader.skip_bits(1); // used_by_curr_pic_s1_flag
        if (reader.has_overrun() || delta_poc_s1_minus1 > 0x7FFF)
            return {};
        picture_order_count += static_cast<i32>(delta_poc_s1_minus1 + 1);
        result.positive_picture_order_count_deltas.append(picture_order_count);
    }
    return result;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.2.2.1: seq_parameter_set_rbsp(), from log2_min_luma_coding_block_size_minus3 through the
// colour description in vui_parameters(). Returns the colour description, if the sequence parameter set states one.
static Optional<CodingIndependentCodePoints> parse_sequence_parameter_set_colour_description(RBSPBitReader& reader, u32 log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4)
{
    reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // log2_min_luma_coding_block_size_minus3
    reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // log2_diff_max_min_luma_coding_block_size
    reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // log2_min_luma_transform_block_size_minus2
    reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // log2_diff_max_min_luma_transform_block_size
    reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // max_transform_hierarchy_depth_inter
    reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // max_transform_hierarchy_depth_intra
    if (reader.read_bit()) {           // scaling_list_enabled_flag
        if (reader.read_bit())         // sps_scaling_list_data_present_flag
            skip_scaling_list_data(reader);
    }
    reader.skip_bits(1);                   // amp_enabled_flag
    reader.skip_bits(1);                   // sample_adaptive_offset_enabled_flag
    if (reader.read_bit()) {               // pcm_enabled_flag
        reader.skip_bits(4);               // pcm_sample_bit_depth_luma_minus1
        reader.skip_bits(4);               // pcm_sample_bit_depth_chroma_minus1
        reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // log2_min_pcm_luma_coding_block_size_minus3
        reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // log2_diff_max_min_pcm_luma_coding_block_size
        reader.skip_bits(1);               // pcm_loop_filter_disabled_flag
    }

    auto num_short_term_ref_pic_sets = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    if (reader.has_overrun() || num_short_term_ref_pic_sets > MAXIMUM_SHORT_TERM_REFERENCE_PICTURE_SET_COUNT)
        return {};
    Vector<ShortTermReferencePictureSet> short_term_reference_picture_sets;
    for (u32 index = 0; index < num_short_term_ref_pic_sets; index++) {
        auto set = parse_short_term_reference_picture_set(reader, short_term_reference_picture_sets);
        if (!set.has_value())
            return {};
        short_term_reference_picture_sets.append(set.release_value());
    }

    if (reader.read_bit()) { // long_term_ref_pics_present_flag
        auto num_long_term_ref_pics_sps = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
        // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.3.2.1: num_long_term_ref_pics_sps is in 0 to 32.
        if (reader.has_overrun() || num_long_term_ref_pics_sps > 32)
            return {};
        for (u32 index = 0; index < num_long_term_ref_pics_sps; index++) {
            reader.skip_bits(log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4 + 4); // lt_ref_pic_poc_lsb_sps
            reader.skip_bits(1);                                     // used_by_curr_pic_lt_sps_flag
        }
    }
    reader.skip_bits(1);    // sps_temporal_mvp_enabled_flag
    reader.skip_bits(1);    // strong_intra_smoothing_enabled_flag
    if (!reader.read_bit()) // vui_parameters_present_flag
        return {};

    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), E.2.1: vui_parameters(), through matrix_coeffs.
    static constexpr u8 EXTENDED_SAMPLE_ASPECT_RATIO = 255;
    if (reader.read_bit()) { // aspect_ratio_info_present_flag
        if (reader.read_bits<u8>(8) == EXTENDED_SAMPLE_ASPECT_RATIO) {
            reader.skip_bits(16); // sar_width
            reader.skip_bits(16); // sar_height
        }
    }
    if (reader.read_bit())   // overscan_info_present_flag
        reader.skip_bits(1); // overscan_appropriate_flag
    if (!reader.read_bit())  // video_signal_type_present_flag
        return {};
    reader.skip_bits(3); // video_format
    CodingIndependentCodePoints cicp;
    cicp.set_video_full_range_flag(reader.read_bit() ? VideoFullRangeFlag::Full : VideoFullRangeFlag::Studio);
    if (reader.read_bit()) { // colour_description_present_flag
        cicp.set_color_primaries(static_cast<ColorPrimaries>(reader.read_bits<u8>(8)));
        cicp.set_transfer_characteristics(static_cast<TransferCharacteristics>(reader.read_bits<u8>(8)));
        cicp.set_matrix_coefficients(static_cast<MatrixCoefficients>(reader.read_bits<u8>(8)));
    }
    if (reader.has_overrun())
        return {};
    return cicp;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.2.2.1: seq_parameter_set_rbsp(), through the colour description in vui_parameters().
Optional<H265::SequenceParameterSet> H265::parse_sequence_parameter_set(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit)
{
    auto header = parse_nal_unit_header(nal_unit);
    if (!header.has_value() || header->nal_unit_type != SEQUENCE_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE)
        return {};

    RBSPBitReader reader { nal_unit.slice(NAL_UNIT_HEADER_SIZE) };
    auto sps_video_parameter_set_id = reader.read_bits<u8>(4);
    auto sps_max_sub_layers_minus1 = reader.read_bits<u8>(3);
    reader.skip_bits(1); // sps_temporal_id_nesting_flag
    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.3.2.1: sps_max_sub_layers_minus1 is in the range 0 to 6.
    if (reader.has_overrun() || sps_max_sub_layers_minus1 > 6)
        return {};

    skip_profile_tier_level(reader, sps_max_sub_layers_minus1);

    auto sps_seq_parameter_set_id = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    auto chroma_format_idc = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    if (chroma_format_idc == 3)
        reader.skip_bits(1); // separate_colour_plane_flag
    auto pic_width_in_luma_samples = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    auto pic_height_in_luma_samples = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    if (reader.read_bit()) {               // conformance_window_flag
        reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // conf_win_left_offset
        reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // conf_win_right_offset
        reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // conf_win_top_offset
        reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // conf_win_bottom_offset
    }
    auto bit_depth_luma_minus8 = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // bit_depth_chroma_minus8
    auto log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4 = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();

    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.3.2.1: the counts absent below the highest sub-layer are inferred from it, so the
    // last one coded is the one that bounds the whole stream.
    auto sub_layer_ordering_info_is_present = reader.read_bit();
    u32 sps_max_num_reorder_pics = 0;
    for (u8 index = sub_layer_ordering_info_is_present ? 0 : sps_max_sub_layers_minus1; index <= sps_max_sub_layers_minus1; index++) {
        reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // sps_max_dec_pic_buffering_minus1
        sps_max_num_reorder_pics = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
        reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb(); // sps_max_latency_increase_plus1
    }

    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.3.2.1: sps_seq_parameter_set_id is in 0 to 15, chroma_format_idc in 0 to 3,
    // bit_depth_luma_minus8 in 0 to 8, and log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4 in 0 to 12.
    if (reader.has_overrun() || sps_seq_parameter_set_id > 15 || chroma_format_idc > 3 || bit_depth_luma_minus8 > 8 || log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4 > 12)
        return {};

    // The fields up to here are all a decoder needs to be configured, so a colour description that cannot be read is
    // left unspecified rather than failing the whole set.
    auto cicp = parse_sequence_parameter_set_colour_description(reader, log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4).value_or({});

    return SequenceParameterSet {
        .sps_seq_parameter_set_id = static_cast<u8>(sps_seq_parameter_set_id),
        .sps_video_parameter_set_id = sps_video_parameter_set_id,
        .sps_max_sub_layers_minus1 = sps_max_sub_layers_minus1,
        .sps_max_num_reorder_pics = static_cast<u8>(min(sps_max_num_reorder_pics, static_cast<u32>(MAXIMUM_REORDER_FRAME_COUNT))),
        .chroma_format_idc = static_cast<u8>(chroma_format_idc),
        .bit_depth_luma = static_cast<u8>(bit_depth_luma_minus8 + 8),
        .pic_width_in_luma_samples = pic_width_in_luma_samples,
        .pic_height_in_luma_samples = pic_height_in_luma_samples,
        .cicp = cicp,
    };
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.2.3.1: pic_parameter_set_rbsp(), whose two IDs open the payload.
Optional<H265::PictureParameterSet> H265::parse_picture_parameter_set(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit)
{
    auto header = parse_nal_unit_header(nal_unit);
    if (!header.has_value() || header->nal_unit_type != PICTURE_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE)
        return {};

    RBSPBitReader reader { nal_unit.slice(NAL_UNIT_HEADER_SIZE) };
    auto pps_pic_parameter_set_id = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    auto pps_seq_parameter_set_id = reader.read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.3.3.1: pps_pic_parameter_set_id is in 0 to 63, pps_seq_parameter_set_id in 0 to 15.
    if (reader.has_overrun() || pps_pic_parameter_set_id > 63 || pps_seq_parameter_set_id > 15)
        return {};

    return PictureParameterSet {
        .pps_pic_parameter_set_id = static_cast<u8>(pps_pic_parameter_set_id),
        .pps_seq_parameter_set_id = static_cast<u8>(pps_seq_parameter_set_id),
    };
}

H265::ParameterSetStore::ParameterSetStore()
{
    m_video_indices.fill(ABSENT);
    m_sequence_indices.fill(ABSENT);
    m_picture_indices.fill(ABSENT);
}

H265::ParameterSetStore::StoredVPS const* H265::ParameterSetStore::video_parameter_set(u8 id) const
{
    if (id >= m_video_indices.size() || m_video_indices[id] == ABSENT)
        return nullptr;
    return &m_video[m_video_indices[id]];
}

H265::ParameterSetStore::StoredSPS const* H265::ParameterSetStore::sequence_parameter_set(u8 id) const
{
    if (id >= m_sequence_indices.size() || m_sequence_indices[id] == ABSENT)
        return nullptr;
    return &m_sequence[m_sequence_indices[id]];
}

H265::ParameterSetStore::StoredPPS const* H265::ParameterSetStore::picture_parameter_set(u8 id) const
{
    if (id >= m_picture_indices.size() || m_picture_indices[id] == ABSENT)
        return nullptr;
    return &m_picture[m_picture_indices[id]];
}

ErrorOr<bool> H265::ParameterSetStore::apply_nal_unit(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit)
{
    auto header = parse_nal_unit_header(nal_unit);
    if (!header.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid H.265 NAL unit header");
    // An enhancement layer's sets describe a stream this decoder is not configured for.
    if (header->nuh_layer_id != 0)
        return false;

    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.2.4.1: Replace only the matching ID; retain other definitions.
    // Append new IDs without removing or reordering entries, so indices survive vector growth.
    auto store = [](auto& entries, auto& indices, u8 id, auto const& parameters, ReadonlyBytes nal_unit) -> ErrorOr<bool> {
        using Entry = typename RemoveReference<decltype(entries)>::ValueType;

        if (indices[id] != ABSENT) {
            auto& stored_data = entries[indices[id]];
            if (stored_data.nal_unit.bytes() == nal_unit)
                return false;
            auto bytes = TRY(ByteBuffer::copy(nal_unit));
            stored_data.parameters = parameters;
            stored_data.nal_unit = move(bytes);
            return true;
        }

        auto bytes = TRY(ByteBuffer::copy(nal_unit));
        auto index = static_cast<u16>(entries.size());
        TRY(entries.try_append(Entry { parameters, move(bytes) }));
        indices[id] = index;
        return true;
    };

    switch (header->nal_unit_type) {
    case VIDEO_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE: {
        auto parameters = parse_video_parameter_set(nal_unit);
        if (!parameters.has_value())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid H.265 video parameter set");
        return store(m_video, m_video_indices, parameters->vps_video_parameter_set_id, *parameters, nal_unit);
    }
    case SEQUENCE_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE: {
        auto parameters = parse_sequence_parameter_set(nal_unit);
        if (!parameters.has_value())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid H.265 sequence parameter set");
        return store(m_sequence, m_sequence_indices, parameters->sps_seq_parameter_set_id, *parameters, nal_unit);
    }
    case PICTURE_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE: {
        auto parameters = parse_picture_parameter_set(nal_unit);
        if (!parameters.has_value())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid H.265 picture parameter set");
        return store(m_picture, m_picture_indices, parameters->pps_pic_parameter_set_id, *parameters, nal_unit);
    }
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

// ISO/IEC 14496-15: HEVCDecoderConfigurationRecord, whose parameter sets are grouped into per-type arrays rather
// than the two counted runs an avcC carries.
Optional<H265::ParameterSets> H265::parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(ReadonlyBytes record)
{
    // configurationVersion through numOfArrays.
    static constexpr size_t FIXED_HEADER_SIZE = 23;
    static constexpr size_t ARRAY_HEADER_SIZE = 3;
    static constexpr size_t LENGTH_SIZE_OFFSET = 21;
    static constexpr size_t ARRAY_COUNT_OFFSET = 22;

    if (record.size() < FIXED_HEADER_SIZE)
        return {};
    if (record[0] > 1) // configurationVersion
        return {};

    ParameterSets parameter_sets;
    parameter_sets.nal_unit_length_size = (record[LENGTH_SIZE_OFFSET] & 0x03) + 1;
    // ISO/IEC 14496-15 does not define a three-byte length prefix.
    if (parameter_sets.nal_unit_length_size == 3)
        return {};

    auto array_count = record[ARRAY_COUNT_OFFSET];
    auto remaining_data = record.slice(FIXED_HEADER_SIZE);

    for (u8 array_index = 0; array_index < array_count; array_index++) {
        if (remaining_data.size() < ARRAY_HEADER_SIZE)
            return parameter_sets;
        // The array states a NAL unit type of its own, but each unit's header is what the sets are keyed by.
        auto nal_unit_count = static_cast<u16>((remaining_data[1] << 8) | remaining_data[2]);
        remaining_data = remaining_data.slice(ARRAY_HEADER_SIZE);

        NALUnitIterator iterator { remaining_data, CONFIGURATION_RECORD_NAL_UNIT_LENGTH_SIZE };
        for (u16 index = 0; index < nal_unit_count; index++) {
            auto nal_unit = iterator.next();
            if (!nal_unit.has_value())
                return parameter_sets;

            auto header = parse_nal_unit_header(*nal_unit);
            if (!header.has_value() || header->nuh_layer_id != 0)
                continue;
            switch (header->nal_unit_type) {
            case VIDEO_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE:
                parameter_sets.video.append(*nal_unit);
                break;
            case SEQUENCE_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE:
                parameter_sets.sequence.append(*nal_unit);
                break;
            case PICTURE_PARAMETER_SET_NAL_UNIT_TYPE:
                parameter_sets.picture.append(*nal_unit);
                break;
            default:
                break;
            }
        }
        remaining_data = iterator.remaining_data();
    }

    return parameter_sets;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), A.3.5: the range extensions profiles state the bit depth and chroma format they are
// limited to through the constraint flags that follow the four source flags.
// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.3: where each flag sits among the 48 constraint indicator bits, which open with the
// four source flags.
static constexpr size_t MAX_12BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX = 4;
static constexpr size_t MAX_10BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX = 5;
static constexpr size_t MAX_8BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX = 6;
static constexpr size_t MAX_422CHROMA_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX = 7;
static constexpr size_t MAX_420CHROMA_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX = 8;
static constexpr size_t MAX_MONOCHROME_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX = 9;

static bool constraint_flag(Array<u8, 6> const& flags, size_t index)
{
    return (flags[index / 8] & (0x80 >> (index % 8))) != 0;
}

static void set_constraint_flag(Array<u8, 6>& flags, size_t index)
{
    flags[index / 8] |= 0x80 >> (index % 8);
}

static Optional<H265::Profile> range_extensions_profile(Array<u8, 6> const& constraint_indicator_flags)
{
    auto limited_to_12_bit = constraint_flag(constraint_indicator_flags, MAX_12BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
    auto limited_to_10_bit = constraint_flag(constraint_indicator_flags, MAX_10BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
    auto limited_to_8_bit = constraint_flag(constraint_indicator_flags, MAX_8BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
    auto limited_to_4_2_2 = constraint_flag(constraint_indicator_flags, MAX_422CHROMA_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
    auto limited_to_4_2_0 = constraint_flag(constraint_indicator_flags, MAX_420CHROMA_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
    auto limited_to_monochrome = constraint_flag(constraint_indicator_flags, MAX_MONOCHROME_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);

    if (!limited_to_12_bit)
        return {};
    u8 maximum_bit_depth = 12;
    if (limited_to_8_bit)
        maximum_bit_depth = 8;
    else if (limited_to_10_bit)
        maximum_bit_depth = 10;

    // A profile allowing more than a stream states still covers it, so the intra and still picture profiles resolve
    // to the profile whose bit depth and chroma format they constrain.
    if (limited_to_4_2_0) {
        if (maximum_bit_depth <= 8)
            return H265::Profile::Main;
        if (maximum_bit_depth <= 10)
            return H265::Profile::Main10;
        return H265::Profile::Main12;
    }
    if (limited_to_4_2_2) {
        if (maximum_bit_depth <= 10)
            return H265::Profile::Main422_10;
        return H265::Profile::Main422_12;
    }
    if (limited_to_monochrome)
        return {};
    if (maximum_bit_depth <= 8)
        return H265::Profile::Main444;
    if (maximum_bit_depth <= 10)
        return H265::Profile::Main444_10;
    return H265::Profile::Main444_12;
}

Optional<H265::Profile> H265::Parameters::profile() const
{
    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), A.3: profile_idc identifies a profile only within its own profile space.
    if (profile_space != 0)
        return {};

    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), A.3.2: general_profile_compatibility_flag[j] equal to 1 specifies that the stream
    // conforms to the profile that general_profile_idc equal to j indicates, whatever profile it names. These two
    // are the most constrained profiles a record was captured for, so a claim to either settles the answer.
    static constexpr u32 MAIN_COMPATIBILITY_FLAG = 1u << 1;
    static constexpr u32 MAIN_10_COMPATIBILITY_FLAG = 1u << 2;
    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), A.3.2: Main decoders also decode streams that conform to the Main Still Picture profile.
    static constexpr u32 MAIN_STILL_PICTURE_COMPATIBILITY_FLAG = 1u << 3;
    if ((profile_compatibility_flags & (MAIN_COMPATIBILITY_FLAG | MAIN_STILL_PICTURE_COMPATIBILITY_FLAG)) != 0)
        return Profile::Main;
    if ((profile_compatibility_flags & MAIN_10_COMPATIBILITY_FLAG) != 0)
        return Profile::Main10;

    switch (profile_idc) {
    case 1:
    case 3:
        return Profile::Main;
    case 2:
        return Profile::Main10;
    case 4:
        return range_extensions_profile(constraint_indicator_flags);
    default:
        return {};
    }
}

ReadonlyBytes H265::representative_configuration_record_for_profile(Profile profile)
{
    switch (profile) {
    case Profile::Main:
        return MAIN_CONFIGURATION_RECORD;
    case Profile::Main10:
        return MAIN_10_CONFIGURATION_RECORD;
    case Profile::Main12:
        return MAIN_12_CONFIGURATION_RECORD;
    case Profile::Main422_10:
        return MAIN_4_2_2_10_CONFIGURATION_RECORD;
    case Profile::Main422_12:
        return MAIN_4_2_2_12_CONFIGURATION_RECORD;
    case Profile::Main444:
        return MAIN_4_4_4_CONFIGURATION_RECORD;
    case Profile::Main444_10:
        return MAIN_4_4_4_10_CONFIGURATION_RECORD;
    case Profile::Main444_12:
        return MAIN_4_4_4_12_CONFIGURATION_RECORD;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

H265::Parameters H265::canonical_parameters_for_profile(Profile profile)
{
    Parameters parameters {};
    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.4: "When general_profile_space is equal to 0,
    // general_profile_compatibility_flag[ general_profile_idc ] shall be equal to 1."
    switch (profile) {
    case Profile::Main:
        parameters.profile_idc = 1;
        parameters.profile_compatibility_flags = 1u << 1;
        return parameters;
    case Profile::Main10:
        parameters.profile_idc = 2;
        parameters.profile_compatibility_flags = 1u << 2;
        return parameters;
    default:
        break;
    }

    // Only the flags the profile is read back from are set, so that the result resolves to it and states nothing
    // about the source or bit rate constraints a real stream would carry.
    auto set_flag = [&](size_t index) { set_constraint_flag(parameters.constraint_indicator_flags, index); };
    parameters.profile_idc = 4;
    parameters.profile_compatibility_flags = 1u << 4;
    set_flag(MAX_12BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
    switch (profile) {
    case Profile::Main12:
        set_flag(MAX_422CHROMA_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
        set_flag(MAX_420CHROMA_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
        return parameters;
    case Profile::Main422_10:
        set_flag(MAX_10BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
        set_flag(MAX_422CHROMA_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
        return parameters;
    case Profile::Main422_12:
        set_flag(MAX_422CHROMA_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
        return parameters;
    case Profile::Main444:
        set_flag(MAX_10BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
        set_flag(MAX_8BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
        return parameters;
    case Profile::Main444_10:
        set_flag(MAX_10BIT_CONSTRAINT_FLAG_INDEX);
        return parameters;
    case Profile::Main444_12:
        return parameters;
    default:
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/H265.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/GenericLexer.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Color/ColorMetadata.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Export.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

class H265 {
public:
    // https://mp4ra.org/registered-types/object-types
    static constexpr u8 OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION = 0x23;

    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), Annex A, limited to the profiles a representative record was captured for. The range
    // extensions profiles share one profile_idc and are told apart by the bit depth and chroma format they allow.
    enum class Profile : u8 {
        Main,
        Main10,
        Main12,
        Main422_10,
        Main422_12,
        Main444,
        Main444_10,
        Main444_12,
    };

    struct Parameters {
        Array<u8, 6> constraint_indicator_flags;
        u32 profile_compatibility_flags { 0 };
        u8 profile_space { 0 };
        u8 profile_idc { 0 };
        u8 level_idc { 0 };
        bool tier_flag { false };

        // The most constrained profile the stream states conformance to, which is the one a decoder need only
        // support to decode it. Empty for profiles no record was captured for.
        MEDIACODECS_API Optional<Profile> profile() const;

        bool operator==(Parameters const&) const = default;
    };

    static Optional<Parameters> parse_codec_parameters(GenericLexer&);
    static MEDIACODECS_API Optional<Parameters> parse_configuration_record(ReadonlyBytes);

    // The parameter sets a decoder is configured from. They are views into the configuration record they were read
    // from, so they live only as long as it does. Any of the collections may be empty.
    struct ParameterSets {
        Vector<ReadonlyBytes, 2> video;
        Vector<ReadonlyBytes, 2> sequence;
        Vector<ReadonlyBytes, 2> picture;
        u8 nal_unit_length_size { 4 };
    };

    struct NALUnitHeader {
        u8 nal_unit_type;
        u8 nuh_layer_id;
        u8 temporal_id;
    };

    struct VideoParameterSet {
        u8 vps_video_parameter_set_id;
    };

    struct SequenceParameterSet {
        u8 sps_seq_parameter_set_id;
        u8 sps_video_parameter_set_id;
        u8 sps_max_sub_layers_minus1;
        u8 sps_max_num_reorder_pics;
        u8 chroma_format_idc;
        u8 bit_depth_luma;
        u32 pic_width_in_luma_samples;
        u32 pic_height_in_luma_samples;
        CodingIndependentCodePoints cicp;
    };

    struct PictureParameterSet {
        u8 pps_pic_parameter_set_id;
        u8 pps_seq_parameter_set_id;
    };

    // Latest definitions by ID, independently of which parameter sets are active (H.265, 7.4.2.4.1).
    class MEDIACODECS_API ParameterSetStore {
    public:
        struct StoredVPS {
            VideoParameterSet parameters;
            ByteBuffer nal_unit;
        };
        struct StoredSPS {
            SequenceParameterSet parameters;
            ByteBuffer nal_unit;
        };
        struct StoredPPS {
            PictureParameterSet parameters;
            ByteBuffer nal_unit;
        };

        ParameterSetStore();

        // Returns true for each set that defines something the store did not already hold. A repeated definition,
        // another NAL type, or an enhancement layer's set all return false. A failed update preserves the existing
        // definition.
        ErrorOr<bool> apply_nal_unit(ReadonlyBytes);

        // Views and pointers must be reacquired after updates, which can grow the backing vectors.
        Span<StoredVPS const> video_parameter_sets() const { return m_video; }
        Span<StoredSPS const> sequence_parameter_sets() const { return m_sequence; }
        Span<StoredPPS const> picture_parameter_sets() const { return m_picture; }
        StoredVPS const* video_parameter_set(u8 id) const;
        StoredSPS const* sequence_parameter_set(u8 id) const;
        StoredPPS const* picture_parameter_set(u8 id) const;

    private:
        static constexpr u16 ABSENT = 0xffff;
        // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.4.3.1, 7.4.3.2.1 and 7.4.3.3.1: 16 VPS IDs, 16 SPS IDs and 64 PPS IDs.
        Array<u16, 16> m_video_indices;
        Array<u16, 16> m_sequence_indices;
        Array<u16, 64> m_picture_indices;
        Vector<StoredVPS, 2> m_video;
        Vector<StoredSPS, 2> m_sequence;
        Vector<StoredPPS, 2> m_picture;
    };

    // Unlike H.264's single byte, an H.265 NAL unit header is two, so it cannot be read from the first byte alone.
    static MEDIACODECS_API Optional<NALUnitHeader> parse_nal_unit_header(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit);
    static MEDIACODECS_API bool is_coded_slice(NALUnitHeader const&);
    static MEDIACODECS_API bool is_sub_layer_non_reference(NALUnitHeader const&);
    static MEDIACODECS_API bool is_parameter_set(NALUnitHeader const&);
    static MEDIACODECS_API bool is_random_access_point(NALUnitHeader const&);
    static MEDIACODECS_API bool is_random_access_skipped_leading(NALUnitHeader const&);
    static MEDIACODECS_API bool has_random_access_skipped_leading_pictures(NALUnitHeader const&);
    // IDR and BLA pictures always start a coded video sequence. A CRA picture only starts one at the start of the
    // bitstream or after an end of sequence, which its header cannot tell.
    static MEDIACODECS_API bool begins_coded_video_sequence(NALUnitHeader const&);
    // The picture after an end of sequence or end of bitstream NAL unit starts a coded video sequence, whatever its type.
    static MEDIACODECS_API bool ends_coded_video_sequence(NALUnitHeader const&);

    // The HDR metadata a base layer NAL unit carries, if any. The scene peak applies to the picture the NAL unit is part
    // of, and the rest to its coded video sequence.
    static MEDIACODECS_API ColorMetadata high_dynamic_range_metadata_of_nal_unit(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit);

    // Parse the fields needed for parameter-set tracking and output reordering from a complete NAL unit,
    // including its header. These do not validate the remaining syntax of the parameter set.
    static MEDIACODECS_API Optional<VideoParameterSet> parse_video_parameter_set(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit);
    static MEDIACODECS_API Optional<SequenceParameterSet> parse_sequence_parameter_set(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit);
    static MEDIACODECS_API Optional<PictureParameterSet> parse_picture_parameter_set(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit);

    static MEDIACODECS_API Optional<ParameterSets> parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(ReadonlyBytes configuration_record);

    // A configuration record standing in for streams carrying this profile, so that a platform decoder can be asked
    // what it supports before any stream has arrived. Empty for profiles that no record was captured for. The
    // constraint flags are needed because the range extensions profiles all share one profile_idc.
    static MEDIACODECS_API ReadonlyBytes representative_configuration_record_for_profile(Profile);

    // Parameters that resolve to this profile and nothing more, for keying answers that depend only on it.
    static MEDIACODECS_API Parameters canonical_parameters_for_profile(Profile);
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/HDR10Plus.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibMediaCodecs/BitReader.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/HDR10Plus.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

static constexpr u8 UNITED_STATES_COUNTRY_CODE = 0xB5;
static constexpr u16 SAMSUNG_TERMINAL_PROVIDER_CODE = 0x003C;
static constexpr u16 HDR10_PLUS_TERMINAL_PROVIDER_ORIENTED_CODE = 0x0001;
static constexpr u8 HDR10_PLUS_APPLICATION_IDENTIFIER = 4;
static constexpr u8 LATEST_APPLICATION_VERSION = 1;

// The corners, ellipse and overlap option of each processing window after the first, which covers the whole picture.
static constexpr size_t PROCESSING_WINDOW_BIT_COUNT = 153;
static constexpr size_t TARGETED_SYSTEM_DISPLAY_MAXIMUM_LUMINANCE_BIT_COUNT = 27;
static constexpr size_t ACTUAL_PEAK_LUMINANCE_DIMENSION_BIT_COUNT = 5;
static constexpr size_t ACTUAL_PEAK_LUMINANCE_BIT_COUNT = 4;
static constexpr size_t MAXSCL_BIT_COUNT = 17;
static constexpr u32 MAXIMUM_MAXSCL = 100'000;

Optional<float> hdr10_plus_maximum_scene_luminance(ReadonlyBytes t35_message)
{
    BitReader reader { t35_message };
    if (reader.read_bits<u8>(8) != UNITED_STATES_COUNTRY_CODE)
        return {};
    if (reader.read_bits<u16>(16) != SAMSUNG_TERMINAL_PROVIDER_CODE)
        return {};
    if (reader.read_bits<u16>(16) != HDR10_PLUS_TERMINAL_PROVIDER_ORIENTED_CODE)
        return {};
    if (reader.read_bits<u8>(8) != HDR10_PLUS_APPLICATION_IDENTIFIER)
        return {};
    if (reader.read_bits<u8>(8) > LATEST_APPLICATION_VERSION)
        return {};

    auto window_count = reader.read_bits<u8>(2);
    if (window_count == 0)
        return {};
    reader.skip_bits(PROCESSING_WINDOW_BIT_COUNT * (window_count - 1));

    reader.skip_bits(TARGETED_SYSTEM_DISPLAY_MAXIMUM_LUMINANCE_BIT_COUNT);
    if (reader.read_bit()) {
        auto rows = reader.read_bits<u8>(ACTUAL_PEAK_LUMINANCE_DIMENSION_BIT_COUNT);
        auto columns = reader.read_bits<u8>(ACTUAL_PEAK_LUMINANCE_DIMENSION_BIT_COUNT);
        reader.skip_bits(static_cast<size_t>(rows) * columns * ACTUAL_PEAK_LUMINANCE_BIT_COUNT);
    }

    // The first window's maxscl, in units of 0.00001 of the 10000 cd/m² that the PQ curve peaks at.
    u32 maximum_component = 0;
    for (size_t component = 0; component < 3; component++)
        maximum_component = max(maximum_component, reader.read_bits<u32>(MAXSCL_BIT_COUNT));
    if (reader.has_overrun() || maximum_component == 0 || maximum_component > MAXIMUM_MAXSCL)
        return {};
    constexpr float maxscl_units_per_candela_per_square_metre = 10.0f;
    return static_cast<float>(maximum_component) / maxscl_units_per_candela_per_square_metre;
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/HDR10Plus.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Export.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

// The largest HDR10+ ITU-T T.35 message, from its country code: the six bytes up to its application identifier, then
// the 907 that FFmpeg's AV_HDR_PLUS_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE allows for the rest.
constexpr size_t HDR10_PLUS_MAXIMUM_T35_MESSAGE_SIZE = 6 + 907;

// The brightest colour component in the scene in cd/m², from an HDR10+ (SMPTE ST 2094-40) ITU-T T.35 message that
// begins with its country code. Empty for any other message, or one that gives no peak.
MEDIACODECS_API Optional<float> hdr10_plus_maximum_scene_luminance(ReadonlyBytes t35_message);

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/AV1.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/H264.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/H265.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/NALUnit.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodedFrame.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker::HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker(CodecID codec_id, ReadonlyBytes configuration)
    : m_codec_id(codec_id)
{
    apply_configuration(configuration);
}

void HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker::apply_configuration(ReadonlyBytes configuration)
{
    if (configuration.is_empty())
        return;
    forget_stream();

    switch (m_codec_id) {
    case CodecID::H264:
        if (auto sets = H264::parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(configuration); sets.has_value())
            m_nal_unit_length_size = sets->nal_unit_length_size;
        break;
    case CodecID::H265:
        if (auto sets = H265::parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(configuration); sets.has_value())
            m_nal_unit_length_size = sets->nal_unit_length_size;
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
}

ColorMetadata const& HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker::apply_coded_frame(CodedFrame const& coded_frame)
{
    if (auto configuration = coded_frame.new_codec_configuration(); configuration.has_value())
        apply_configuration(*configuration);
    begin_frame(coded_frame);

    switch (m_codec_id) {
    case CodecID::H264:
    case CodecID::H265: {
        NALUnitIterator iterator { coded_frame.data(), m_nal_unit_length_size };
        for (auto nal_unit = iterator.next(); nal_unit.has_value(); nal_unit = iterator.next())
            apply_nal_unit(*nal_unit);
        break;
    }
    case CodecID::AV1:
        take_bitstream_metadata(AV1::high_dynamic_range_metadata_of_obus(coded_frame.data()));
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
    return m_metadata;
}

void HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker::forget_stream()
{
    m_metadata = {};
    m_next_picture_begins_coded_video_sequence = false;
}

// A message replaces the one before it, so a level it leaves unknown does not fall back to the earlier message's.
void HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker::take_bitstream_metadata(ColorMetadata const& metadata)
{
    if (metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value())
        m_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume = metadata.mastering_display_color_volume;
    if (metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value())
        m_metadata.content_light_level_information = metadata.content_light_level_information;
    if (metadata.maximum_scene_luminance.has_value())
        m_metadata.maximum_scene_luminance = metadata.maximum_scene_luminance;
}

void HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker::begin_frame(CodedFrame const& coded_frame)
{
    m_metadata.maximum_scene_luminance = coded_frame.maximum_scene_luminance();
    m_frame_gave_mastering_display_color_volume = false;
    m_frame_gave_content_light_level_information = false;
}

void HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker::apply_nal_unit(ReadonlyBytes nal_unit)
{
    if (nal_unit.is_empty())
        return;

    ColorMetadata nal_unit_metadata;
    auto begins_coded_video_sequence = false;
    if (m_codec_id == CodecID::H264) {
        nal_unit_metadata = H264::high_dynamic_range_metadata_of_nal_unit(nal_unit);
        begins_coded_video_sequence = H264::begins_coded_video_sequence(nal_unit[0]);
    } else if (m_codec_id == CodecID::H265) {
        auto header = H265::parse_nal_unit_header(nal_unit);
        if (!header.has_value())
            return;
        if (H265::ends_coded_video_sequence(header.value())) {
            m_next_picture_begins_coded_video_sequence = true;
            return;
        }
        nal_unit_metadata = H265::high_dynamic_range_metadata_of_nal_unit(nal_unit);
        begins_coded_video_sequence = H265::begins_coded_video_sequence(header.value());
        if (H265::is_coded_slice(header.value()) && header->nuh_layer_id == 0)
            begins_coded_video_sequence |= exchange(m_next_picture_begins_coded_video_sequence, false);
    } else {
        return;
    }

    m_frame_gave_mastering_display_color_volume |= nal_unit_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume.has_value();
    m_frame_gave_content_light_level_information |= nal_unit_metadata.content_light_level_information.has_value();
    take_bitstream_metadata(nal_unit_metadata);

    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), D.3.28 and D.3.35: the messages only describe the coded video sequence they are part of.
    // They are prefix SEI messages, so any that the sequence's first picture carries came before this slice.
    if (begins_coded_video_sequence) {
        if (!m_frame_gave_mastering_display_color_volume)
            m_metadata.mastering_display_color_volume = {};
        if (!m_frame_gave_content_light_level_information)
            m_metadata.content_light_level_information = {};
    }
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecID.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Color/ColorMetadata.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Export.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Forward.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

// Follows the HDR metadata a video bitstream carries alongside its pictures. The scene peak is each frame's own, while
// the rest carries over to the frames that follow until the bitstream changes it or a new configuration starts over.
class MEDIACODECS_API HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker {
public:
    HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker(CodecID, ReadonlyBytes configuration);

    // Takes the frame's new configuration if it has one, then gives back the metadata of the frame.
    ColorMetadata const& apply_coded_frame(CodedFrame const&);

    // For a decoder that walks the NAL units of H.264 and H.265 frames itself. A new configuration calls for
    // forget_stream(), and each frame for begin_frame() before its NAL units are applied. The frame starts from the
    // scene peak its container gave it, which the bitstream may replace.
    void forget_stream();
    void begin_frame(CodedFrame const&);
    void apply_nal_unit(ReadonlyBytes);

    ColorMetadata const& metadata() const { return m_metadata; }

private:
    void apply_configuration(ReadonlyBytes);
    void take_bitstream_metadata(ColorMetadata const&);

    CodecID m_codec_id;
    u8 m_nal_unit_length_size { 4 };
    ColorMetadata m_metadata;
    // A frame that starts a coded video sequence keeps only the values its own SEI messages gave.
    bool m_frame_gave_mastering_display_color_volume { false };
    bool m_frame_gave_content_light_level_information { false };
    bool m_next_picture_begins_coded_video_sequence { false };
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/MPEG4Audio.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/CharacterTypes.h>
#include <AK/GenericShorthands.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/CodecString.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/MPEG4Audio.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

Optional<MPEG4Audio::Codec> MPEG4Audio::parse_codec_parameters(GenericLexer& lexer)
{
    if (!lexer.consume_specific('.'))
        return {};

    auto object_type_indication = consume_two_digit_hexadecimal(lexer);
    if (!object_type_indication.has_value())
        return {};

    if (*object_type_indication == AAC::MPEG4_AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION) {
        Optional<u32> audio_object_type;
        if (!lexer.is_eof()) {
            if (!lexer.consume_specific('.') || !lexer.next_is(is_ascii_digit))
                return {};
            auto result = lexer.consume_decimal_integer<u32>();
            if (result.is_error())
                return {};
            audio_object_type = result.release_value();
        }
        if (!lexer.is_eof())
            return {};
        return Codec { AAC::Parameters { *object_type_indication, audio_object_type } };
    }

    if (first_is_one_of(*object_type_indication, AAC::MPEG2_MAIN_OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION, AAC::MPEG2_LOW_COMPLEXITY_OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION, AAC::MPEG2_SCALEABLE_SAMPLING_RATE_OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION)) {
        if (!lexer.is_eof())
            return {};
        return Codec { AAC::Parameters { *object_type_indication, {} } };
    }

    if (first_is_one_of(*object_type_indication, MPEG2_BACKWARDS_COMPATIBLE_AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION, MPEG1_AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE_INDICATION)) {
        if (!lexer.is_eof())
            return {};
        return Codec { MP3 {} };
    }

    return {};
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/NALUnit.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

// H.264 and H.265 configuration records both prefix their stored parameter sets with a 16-bit length.
constexpr u8 CONFIGURATION_RECORD_NAL_UNIT_LENGTH_SIZE = 2;

// Walk length-prefixed NAL units without retaining their backing storage or allocating a collection.
class NALUnitIterator {
public:
    NALUnitIterator(ReadonlyBytes data, u8 length_size)
        : m_remaining_data(data)
        , m_length_size(length_size)
        , m_has_error(length_size < 1 || length_size > 4)
    {
    }

    Optional<ReadonlyBytes> next()
    {
        if (m_has_error || m_remaining_data.is_empty())
            return {};
        if (m_remaining_data.size() < m_length_size) {
            m_has_error = true;
            return {};
        }
        u32 length = 0;
        for (u8 index = 0; index < m_length_size; ++index)
            length = (length << 8) | m_remaining_data[index];
        m_remaining_data = m_remaining_data.slice(m_length_size);
        if (length == 0 || length > m_remaining_data.size()) {
            m_has_error = true;
            return {};
        }
        auto nal_unit = m_remaining_data.trim(length);
        m_remaining_data = m_remaining_data.slice(length);
        return nal_unit;
    }

    bool has_error() const { return m_has_error; }

    // Empty once a walk has failed, so that a caller cannot resume from an offset the walk never reached.
    ReadonlyBytes remaining_data() const { return m_has_error ? ReadonlyBytes {} : m_remaining_data; }

private:
    ReadonlyBytes m_remaining_data;
    u8 m_length_size;
    bool m_has_error;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/RBSPBitReader.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Assertions.h>
#include <AK/Concepts.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

// Reads a raw byte sequence payload, the form H.264 and H.265 parameter sets take once the emulation prevention
// bytes padding their 0x000000 through 0x000003 sequences are dropped. Overrun latches as it does in BitReader, so
// a parse checks has_overrun() once at the end rather than testing every field.
class RBSPBitReader {
public:
    explicit RBSPBitReader(ReadonlyBytes data)
        : m_data(data)
    {
    }

    template<Unsigned T = u64>
    T read_bits(size_t count)
    {
        VERIFY(count <= sizeof(T) * 8);

        T result = 0;
        while (count > 0) {
            if (m_byte_index >= m_data.size()) {
                m_has_overrun = true;
                return 0;
            }

            auto bits_left_in_byte = 8 - m_bit_offset;
            auto bits_to_take = min(count, bits_left_in_byte);
            auto byte = m_data[m_byte_index];
            auto chunk = (byte >> (bits_left_in_byte - bits_to_take)) & ((1u << bits_to_take) - 1);
            result = static_cast<T>(result << bits_to_take) | chunk;

            m_bit_offset += bits_to_take;
            count -= bits_to_take;
            if (m_bit_offset == 8)
                advance_to_next_byte(byte);
        }
        return result;
    }

    bool read_bit() { return read_bits<u8>(1) != 0; }

    void skip_bits(size_t count)
    {
        while (count > 0) {
            auto bits_to_skip = min(count, static_cast<size_t>(8));
            read_bits<u8>(bits_to_skip);
            count -= bits_to_skip;
        }
    }

    // ue(v), an Exp-Golomb coded unsigned integer.
    u32 read_unsigned_exp_golomb()
    {
        static constexpr size_t MAXIMUM_LEADING_ZERO_COUNT = 31;
        size_t leading_zero_count = 0;
        while (!read_bit()) {
            if (m_has_overrun)
                return 0;
            leading_zero_count++;
            if (leading_zero_count == MAXIMUM_LEADING_ZERO_COUNT) {
                m_has_overrun = true;
                return 0;
            }
        }
        return static_cast<u32>((1u << leading_zero_count) - 1 + read_bits<u32>(leading_zero_count));
    }

    // se(v), which maps the unsigned code to 0, 1, -1, 2, -2 and so on.
    i32 read_signed_exp_golomb()
    {
        auto code = read_unsigned_exp_golomb();
        auto magnitude = static_cast<i32>((code + 1) / 2);
        return (code % 2) == 0 ? -magnitude : magnitude;
    }

    bool has_overrun() const { return m_has_overrun; }

    // The emulation prevention bytes left to skip count as well, so this is at least the count of RBSP bytes left.
    size_t remaining_byte_count() const { return m_data.size() - m_byte_index; }

private:
    void advance_to_next_byte(u8 consumed_byte)
    {
        static constexpr u8 EMULATION_PREVENTION_BYTE = 0x03;

        m_bit_offset = 0;
        m_byte_index++;
        m_preceding_zero_byte_count = consumed_byte == 0 ? m_preceding_zero_byte_count + 1 : 0;

        if (m_preceding_zero_byte_count < 2 || m_byte_index >= m_data.size())
            return;
        if (m_data[m_byte_index] == EMULATION_PREVENTION_BYTE) {
            m_byte_index++;
            m_preceding_zero_byte_count = 0;
        }
    }

    ReadonlyBytes m_data;
    size_t m_byte_index { 0 };
    u8 m_bit_offset { 0 };
    u8 m_preceding_zero_byte_count { 0 };
    bool m_has_overrun { false };
};

}

/*

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/Checked.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/HDR10Plus.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/RBSPBitReader.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/SupplementalEnhancementInformation.h>

namespace Media::Codecs {

static constexpr u32 USER_DATA_REGISTERED_ITU_T_T35_PAYLOAD_TYPE = 4;
static constexpr u32 MASTERING_DISPLAY_COLOUR_VOLUME_PAYLOAD_TYPE = 137;
static constexpr u32 CONTENT_LIGHT_LEVEL_INFORMATION_PAYLOAD_TYPE = 144;
static constexpr u32 MASTERING_DISPLAY_COLOUR_VOLUME_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 24;
static constexpr u32 CONTENT_LIGHT_LEVEL_INFORMATION_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 4;

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.5: payloadType and payloadSize are a run of 0xFF bytes added to the byte ending it.
static Optional<u32> read_sei_message_value(RBSPBitReader& reader)
{
    Checked<u32> value = 0;
    while (true) {
        auto byte = reader.read_bits<u8>(8);
        if (reader.has_overrun())
            return {};
        value += byte;
        if (value.has_overflow())
            return {};
        if (byte != 0xFF)
            return value.value();
    }
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), D.3.28: values outside these ranges are unknown or unspecified.
static constexpr u16 MINIMUM_CHROMATICITY_CODE = 5;
static constexpr u16 MAXIMUM_CHROMATICITY_X_CODE = 37'000;
static constexpr u16 MAXIMUM_CHROMATICITY_Y_CODE = 42'000;
static constexpr u32 MINIMUM_MAXIMUM_LUMINANCE_CODE = 50'000;
static constexpr u32 MAXIMUM_MAXIMUM_LUMINANCE_CODE = 100'000'000;
static constexpr u32 MAXIMUM_MINIMUM_LUMINANCE_CODE = 50'000;

static Optional<MasteringDisplayColorVolume> read_mastering_display_color_volume(RBSPBitReader& reader)
{
    constexpr float chromaticity_units_per_unit = 50'000.0f;
    constexpr float luminance_units_per_candela_per_square_metre = 10'000.0f;
    auto is_specified = true;
    auto read_chromaticity = [&] {
        auto x = reader.read_bits<u16>(16);
        auto y = reader.read_bits<u16>(16);
        if (x < MINIMUM_CHROMATICITY_CODE || x > MAXIMUM_CHROMATICITY_X_CODE || y < MINIMUM_CHROMATICITY_CODE || y > MAXIMUM_CHROMATICITY_Y_CODE)
            is_specified = false;
        return Chromaticity { static_cast<float>(x) / chromaticity_units_per_unit, static_cast<float>(y) / chromaticity_units_per_unit };
    };

    MasteringDisplayColorVolume volume;
    // The primaries are coded green, blue, then red, the order SMPTE ST 2086 lists them in.
    volume.green = read_chromaticity();
    volume.blue = read_chromaticity();
    volume.red = read_chromaticity();
    volume.white_point = read_chromaticity();
    auto maximum_luminance = reader.read_bits<u32>(32);
    auto minimum_luminance = reader.read_bits<u32>(32);
    if (maximum_luminance < MINIMUM_MAXIMUM_LUMINANCE_CODE || maximum_luminance > MAXIMUM_MAXIMUM_LUMINANCE_CODE)
        is_specified = false;
    // A minimum of zero is out of range too, but Blu-ray releases use it, so it is accepted as FFmpeg accepts it.
    if (minimum_luminance > MAXIMUM_MINIMUM_LUMINANCE_CODE || minimum_luminance >= maximum_luminance)
        is_specified = false;
    if (!is_specified)
        return {};
    volume.maximum_luminance = static_cast<float>(maximum_luminance) / luminance_units_per_candela_per_square_metre;
    volume.minimum_luminance = static_cast<float>(minimum_luminance) / luminance_units_per_candela_per_square_metre;
    return volume;
}

static Optional<float> read_hdr10_plus_maximum_scene_luminance(RBSPBitReader& reader, u32 payload_size)
{
    VERIFY(payload_size <= HDR10_PLUS_MAXIMUM_T35_MESSAGE_SIZE);
    Array<u8, HDR10_PLUS_MAXIMUM_T35_MESSAGE_SIZE> message;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < payload_size; index++)
        message[index] = reader.read_bits<u8>(8);
    return hdr10_plus_maximum_scene_luminance(ReadonlyBytes { message.data(), payload_size });
}

static ContentLightLevelInformation read_content_light_level_information(RBSPBitReader& reader)
{
    ContentLightLevelInformation information;
    information.maximum_content_light_level = reader.read_bits<u16>(16);
    information.maximum_frame_average_light_level = reader.read_bits<u16>(16);
    return information;
}

// ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 7.3.2.4: sei_rbsp().
ColorMetadata high_dynamic_range_metadata_of_sei_payload(ReadonlyBytes escaped_sei_payload)
{
    ColorMetadata metadata;
    RBSPBitReader reader { escaped_sei_payload };

    // The last byte holds the RBSP trailing bits rather than the start of another message.
    while (reader.remaining_byte_count() > 1) {
        auto payload_type = read_sei_message_value(reader);
        auto payload_size = read_sei_message_value(reader);
        if (!payload_type.has_value() || !payload_size.has_value() || payload_size.value() > reader.remaining_byte_count())
            break;

        Optional<MasteringDisplayColorVolume> volume;
        Optional<ContentLightLevelInformation> information;
        Optional<float> maximum_scene_luminance;
        auto unread_payload_size = payload_size.value();
        if (payload_type == USER_DATA_REGISTERED_ITU_T_T35_PAYLOAD_TYPE && unread_payload_size <= HDR10_PLUS_MAXIMUM_T35_MESSAGE_SIZE) {
            maximum_scene_luminance = read_hdr10_plus_maximum_scene_luminance(reader, unread_payload_size);
            unread_payload_size = 0;
        } else if (payload_type == MASTERING_DISPLAY_COLOUR_VOLUME_PAYLOAD_TYPE && unread_payload_size >= MASTERING_DISPLAY_COLOUR_VOLUME_PAYLOAD_SIZE) {
            volume = read_mastering_display_color_volume(reader);
            unread_payload_size -= MASTERING_DISPLAY_COLOUR_VOLUME_PAYLOAD_SIZE;
        } else if (payload_type == CONTENT_LIGHT_LEVEL_INFORMATION_PAYLOAD_TYPE && unread_payload_size >= CONTENT_LIGHT_LEVEL_INFORMATION_PAYLOAD_SIZE) {
            information = read_content_light_level_information(reader);
            unread_payload_size -= CONTENT_LIGHT_LEVEL_INFORMATION_PAYLOAD_SIZE;
        }
        reader.skip_bits(static_cast<size_t>(unread_payload_size) * 8);
        // A message that runs into the RBSP trailing bits is missing some of its own.
        if (reader.has_overrun() || reader.remaining_byte_count() == 0)
            break;

        if (volume.has_value())
            metadata.mastering_display_color_volume = volume;
        if (information.has_value())
            metadata.content_light_level_information = information;
        if (maximum_scene_luminance.has_value())
            metadata.maximum_scene_luminance = maximum_scene_luminance;
    }
    return metadata;
}

}
