FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/Subsampling.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2024, Gregory Bertilson <zaggy1024@gmail.com>
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <LibGfx/Size.h>

namespace Media {

struct Subsampling {
public:
    static constexpr Subsampling yuv420() { return { true, true }; }
    static constexpr Subsampling yuv422() { return { true, false }; }
    static constexpr Subsampling yuv444() { return { false, false }; }

    constexpr Subsampling(bool x, bool y)
        : m_x(x)
        , m_y(y)
    {
    }

    Subsampling() = default;

    bool operator==(Subsampling const&) const = default;

    bool x() const { return m_x; }
    bool y() const { return m_y; }

    static u32 subsampled_size(bool subsampled, u32 size)
    {
        u32 subsampled_as_int = static_cast<u32>(subsampled);
        return (size + subsampled_as_int) >> subsampled_as_int;
    }

    template<Integral T>
    Gfx::Size<T> subsampled_size(Gfx::Size<T> size) const
    {
        return {
            subsampled_size(x(), size.width()),
            subsampled_size(y(), size.height())
        };
    }

private:
    bool m_x = false;
    bool m_y = false;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoder.h
/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Color/ColorMetadata.h>

#include "DecoderError.h"

namespace Media {

enum class DecodeIntent : u8 {
    Reference,
    Output,
};

enum class DecodeCompletion : u8 {
    // A frame or a failure is ready for take_next_output().
    ProducedOutput,
    ProducedNothing,
};

class VideoDecoder {
public:
    virtual ~VideoDecoder() { }

    // Both callbacks are installed before any coded data is received, and run on whichever thread frees the storage
    // or finishes the decode.
    // Called without the decoder's locks held.
    virtual void set_storage_freed_callback(Function<void()>) = 0;
    // Called when a decode finishes while no take_next_output() call is waiting for it, so that a caller blocked
    // elsewhere knows to come back. Decoders whose decodes are complete by the time receive_coded_data() returns
    // never call it. It may be called with the decoder's locks held, so it must not call into the decoder.
    virtual void set_decode_completed_callback(Function<void(DecodeCompletion)>) = 0;
    // Returns whether output is ready to be taken or may still arrive without more coded data. The decode completed
    // callback is called when a decode finishing makes this stop returning true.
    virtual bool has_any_decode_in_progress() const = 0;

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<void> receive_coded_data(CodedFrame const&, DecodeIntent) = 0;
    virtual void signal_end_of_stream() = 0;

    // Callers may pass the optional target parameter to indicate the timestamp past which they need output. This
    // allows reordered codecs to produce a seek-resolving frame without filling the reorder queue first.
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> take_next_output(ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata, Optional<AK::Duration> target = {}) = 0;

    virtual void flush() = 0;
};

}

    any_decode_in_progress_changed(u64 decoder_id, bool any_decode_is_in_progress) =|
    decoder_failed(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation, Media::DecoderError error) =|
    decoder_drained(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation) =|
    // Every slot the decoder can output into is held by the client, so it waits for one to be released. Anything the
    // decoder reports after this means it is no longer waiting.
    decoder_waiting_for_storage(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation) =|
}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoderRegistry.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoderRegistry.h>

namespace Media {

static Vector<VideoDecoderRegistration>& installed_video_decoders()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<Vector<VideoDecoderRegistration>> registrations;
    return *registrations;
}

void install_video_decoders(Vector<ReadonlySpan<VideoDecoderRegistration>> sets)
{
    auto& registrations = installed_video_decoders();
    registrations.clear();
    for (auto set : sets)
        registrations.append(set.data(), set.size());
}

Optional<DecoderCapabilities> video_decoder_capabilities(ParsedCodec const& codec)
{
    for (auto const& registration : installed_video_decoders()) {
        auto capabilities = registration.capabilities(codec);
        if (capabilities.has_value())
            return capabilities;
    }
    return {};
}

VideoDecoderSelection select_video_decoder(ParsedCodec const& codec, VideoDecoderSelection after)
{
    if (track_type_from_codec_id(codec.codec_id()) != TrackType::Video)
        return {};

    auto const& registrations = installed_video_decoders();
    auto registration_count = static_cast<i32>(registrations.size());
    for (auto index = after.registration_index() + 1; index < registration_count; index++) {
        if (registrations[index].capabilities(codec).has_value())
            return VideoDecoderSelection { index };
    }
    return {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<VideoDecoder>> create_video_decoder(VideoDecoderSelection selection, CodecID codec_id, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data)
{
    auto const& registrations = installed_video_decoders();
    VERIFY(selection.has_value());
    VERIFY(selection.registration_index() < static_cast<i32>(registrations.size()));
    return registrations[selection.registration_index()].create(codec_id, codec_initialization_data);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoderServerConnection.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Checked.h>
#include <AK/ConditionVariable.h>
#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <AK/Queue.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodedFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoderServerConnection.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFramePool.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

namespace Media {

class VideoDecoderServerConnection::DecoderSession final : public AtomicRefCounted<DecoderSession> {
public:
    struct Submission {
        u32 generation { 0 };
        u64 ring_offset { 0 };
        u64 size { 0 };
        AK::Duration presentation_timestamp;
        AK::Duration decode_timestamp;
        AK::Duration duration;
        FrameFlags flags { FrameFlags::None };
        Optional<float> maximum_scene_luminance;
        Optional<ByteBuffer> new_codec_configuration;
        DecodeIntent intent { DecodeIntent::Output };
        Optional<AK::Duration> output_target;
    };
    struct EndOfStream {
        u32 generation { 0 };
    };
    struct Flush {
        u32 generation { 0 };
    };
    struct ReplaceRing {
        Core::AnonymousBuffer ring;
    };
    using Command = Variant<Submission, EndOfStream, Flush, ReplaceRing>;

    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<DecoderSession>> create(ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderServerConnection> connection, Core::EventLoop& connection_event_loop, ReadonlySpan<VideoDecoderRegistration> hosted_decoders, u64 decoder_id, u32 generation, CodecID codec_id, ByteBuffer codec_initialization_data)
    {
        auto session = TRY(adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) DecoderSession(move(connection), connection_event_loop, hosted_decoders, decoder_id, generation, codec_id, move(codec_initialization_data))));
        session->m_thread = TRY(Threading::Thread::try_create("Video Decoder"sv, [session]() -> intptr_t {
            session->run();
            return 0;
        }));
        session->m_thread->start();
        return session;
    }

    void enqueue(Command command)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_wait_state->mutex };
        if (auto const* flush = command.get_pointer<Flush>())
            m_newest_requested_generation = flush->generation;
        m_commands.enqueue(move(command));
        m_wait_state->condition.broadcast();
    }

    void exit_and_detach()
    {
        request_exit();
        m_thread->detach();
        m_thread = nullptr;
    }

    // Once this returns, the decoder will not write to any slot again.
    void exit_and_join()
    {
        request_exit();
        (void)m_thread->join();
        m_thread = nullptr;
    }

private:
    void request_exit()
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_wait_state->mutex };
        m_exit_requested = true;
        m_wait_state->condition.broadcast();
    }

    // Shared with the decoder's callbacks, which frames held by the client can outlive the session with.
    struct WaitState : public AtomicRefCounted<WaitState> {
        Mutex mutex;
        ConditionVariable condition { mutex };
        bool storage_was_freed { false };
        bool decode_completed { false };
    };

    DecoderSession(ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderServerConnection> connection, Core::EventLoop& connection_event_loop, ReadonlySpan<VideoDecoderRegistration> hosted_decoders, u64 decoder_id, u32 generation, CodecID codec_id, ByteBuffer codec_initialization_data)
        : m_connection(move(connection))
        , m_connection_event_loop(connection_event_loop)
        , m_hosted_decoders(hosted_decoders)
        , m_decoder_id(decoder_id)
        , m_codec_id(codec_id)
        , m_codec_initialization_data(move(codec_initialization_data))
        , m_newest_requested_generation(generation)
        , m_generation(generation)
    {
    }

    void run()
    {
        create_decoder();
        while (true) {
            Optional<Command> command;
            auto decode_completed = false;
            {
                MutexLocker locker { m_wait_state->mutex };
                while (m_commands.is_empty() && !m_wait_state->decode_completed && !m_exit_requested)
                    m_wait_state->condition.wait();
                if (m_exit_requested)
                    break;
                decode_completed = exchange(m_wait_state->decode_completed, false);
                if (!m_commands.is_empty())
                    command = m_commands.dequeue();
            }
            // Output the decoder finished on its own goes out before the next command, which it does not depend on.
            if (decode_completed && !m_failure.has_value())
                take_outputs();
            if (command.has_value()) {
                command->visit(
                    [&](Submission& submission) { decode_submission(submission); },
                    [&](EndOfStream const& end_of_stream) { drain_to_end_of_stream(end_of_stream.generation); },
                    [&](Flush const& flush) { apply_flush(flush.generation); },
                    [&](ReplaceRing& replace_ring) { m_ring = move(replace_ring.ring); });
            }
            report_whether_any_decode_is_in_progress();
        }
        m_decoder.clear();
    }

    void create_decoder()
    {
        auto decoder_or_error = [&] -> DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<VideoDecoder>> {
            for (auto const& registration : m_hosted_decoders) {
                auto decoder = registration.create(m_codec_id, m_codec_initialization_data);
                if (!decoder.is_error() || decoder.error().category() != DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented)
                    return decoder;
            }
            return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "The video decoder server has no decoder for codec {}", m_codec_id);
        }();
        if (decoder_or_error.is_error()) {
            fail(decoder_or_error.release_error());
            return;
        }
        m_decoder = decoder_or_error.release_value();
        m_decoder->set_storage_freed_callback([wait_state = m_wait_state] {
            MutexLocker locker { wait_state->mutex };
            wait_state->storage_was_freed = true;
            wait_state->condition.broadcast();
        });
        m_decoder->set_decode_completed_callback([wait_state = m_wait_state](DecodeCompletion) {
            MutexLocker locker { wait_state->mutex };
            wait_state->decode_completed = true;
            wait_state->condition.broadcast();
        });
    }

    bool is_superseded_by_flush(u32 generation)
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_wait_state->mutex };
        return generation != m_newest_requested_generation;
    }

    void fail(DecoderError&& error)
    {
        m_failure = move(error);
        report_failure();
    }

    void report_failure()
    {
        VERIFY(m_failure.has_value());
        m_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_decoder_failed(m_decoder_id, m_generation, *m_failure);
        });
    }

    void report_whether_any_decode_is_in_progress()
    {
        auto any_decode_is_in_progress = m_decoder && m_decoder->has_any_decode_in_progress();
        if (any_decode_is_in_progress == m_any_decode_was_reported_in_progress)
            return;
        m_any_decode_was_reported_in_progress = any_decode_is_in_progress;
        m_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_any_decode_in_progress_changed(m_decoder_id, any_decode_is_in_progress);
        });
    }

    void acknowledge_submission()
    {
        report_whether_any_decode_is_in_progress();
        m_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_coded_frame_consumed(m_decoder_id);
        });
    }

    DecoderErrorOr<CodedFrame> coded_frame_for_submission(Submission& submission)
    {
        Checked<u64> end = submission.ring_offset;
        end += submission.size;
        if (!m_ring.is_valid() || end.has_overflow() || end.value() > m_ring.size())
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Invalid, "A coded frame lies outside its ring"sv);

        if (auto luminance = submission.maximum_scene_luminance; luminance.has_value() && (!isfinite(*luminance) || *luminance <= 0))
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Invalid, "A coded frame's scene peak is not a positive luminance"sv);

        auto data = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(FixedArray<u8>::create(m_ring.bytes().slice(submission.ring_offset, submission.size)));
        Optional<FixedArray<u8>> new_codec_configuration;
        if (submission.new_codec_configuration.has_value())
            new_codec_configuration = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(FixedArray<u8>::create(submission.new_codec_configuration->bytes()));
        CodedFrame coded_frame { m_codec_id, submission.presentation_timestamp, submission.decode_timestamp, submission.duration, submission.flags, move(data), move(new_codec_configuration) };
        coded_frame.set_maximum_scene_luminance(submission.maximum_scene_luminance);
        return coded_frame;
    }

    void decode_submission(Submission& submission)
    {
        if (m_failure.has_value() || is_superseded_by_flush(submission.generation)) {
            acknowledge_submission();
            return;
        }

        auto coded_frame_or_error = coded_frame_for_submission(submission);
        if (coded_frame_or_error.is_error()) {
            fail(coded_frame_or_error.release_error());
            acknowledge_submission();
            return;
        }

        auto receive_result = m_decoder->receive_coded_data(coded_frame_or_error.value(), submission.intent);
        if (receive_result.is_error()) {
            fail(receive_result.release_error());
        } else {
            m_output_target = submission.output_target;
            take_outputs();
        }
        acknowledge_submission();
    }

    void drain_to_end_of_stream(u32 generation)
    {
        if (m_failure.has_value() || is_superseded_by_flush(generation))
            return;
        m_decoder->signal_end_of_stream();
        m_output_target = {};
        if (!take_outputs())
            return;
        m_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            connection.async_decoder_drained(m_decoder_id, m_generation);
        });
    }

    void apply_flush(u32 generation)
    {
        m_generation = generation;
        m_output_target = {};
        if (m_failure.has_value()) {
            report_failure();
            return;
        }
        m_decoder->flush();
    }

    // Returns whether the decoder was drained or needs more input, rather than being abandoned or failing.
    bool take_outputs()
    {
        while (true) {
            auto frame_or_error = m_decoder->take_next_output({}, m_output_target);
            if (!frame_or_error.is_error()) {
                send_frame(frame_or_error.release_value());
                continue;
            }

            auto category = frame_or_error.error().category();
            if (category == DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput || category == DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream)
                return true;
            if (category != DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain) {
                fail(frame_or_error.release_error());
                return false;
            }

            // Every slot is held by the client, so wait for it to release one. A flush or exit means the frames
            // waiting for one are not wanted anymore.
            MutexLocker locker { m_wait_state->mutex };
            // The client's consumers may hold the slots indefinitely, so the client is told not to wait for an answer.
            if (!m_wait_state->storage_was_freed && !m_exit_requested && m_newest_requested_generation == m_generation) {
                m_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
                    connection.async_decoder_waiting_for_storage(m_decoder_id, m_generation);
                });
            }
            while (!m_wait_state->storage_was_freed && !m_exit_requested && m_newest_requested_generation == m_generation)
                m_wait_state->condition.wait();
            m_wait_state->storage_was_freed = false;
            if (m_exit_requested || m_newest_requested_generation != m_generation)
                return false;
        }
    }

    void send_frame(NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> frame)
    {
        auto metadata = VideoFrameMetadata::for_frame(*frame);
        auto pixels = frame->storage()->pixels();

        auto should_close_connection = false;
        m_connection.with_target([&](auto& connection) {
            // The frame is held before the client hears of it, so that its release cannot arrive first.
            auto frame_id = connection.hold_frame_until_released(move(frame));
            connection.async_frame_decoded(m_decoder_id, m_generation, frame_id, metadata, move(pixels));
            should_close_connection = connection.should_close_after_decoding_frame();
        });
        if (should_close_connection)
            close_connection();
    }

    void close_connection()
    {
        m_connection_event_loop.deferred_invoke([weak_connection = m_connection] {
            // Shutting down revokes the weak reference, so it happens outside the reference's lock.
            RefPtr<VideoDecoderServerConnection> connection;
            weak_connection.with_target([&](auto& target) { connection = target; });
            if (connection)
                connection->shutdown();
        });
    }

    ThreadSafeWeakRef<VideoDecoderServerConnection> m_connection;
    Core::EventLoop& m_connection_event_loop;
    ReadonlySpan<VideoDecoderRegistration> const m_hosted_decoders;
    u64 const m_decoder_id;
    CodecID const m_codec_id;
    ByteBuffer const m_codec_initialization_data;

    // Only the connection's thread uses this.
    RefPtr<Threading::Thread> m_thread;

    NonnullRefPtr<WaitState> m_wait_state { make_ref_counted<WaitState>() };
    Queue<Command> m_commands;
    bool m_exit_requested { false };
    u32 m_newest_requested_generation { 0 };

    // Only the decoder thread uses these.
    OwnPtr<VideoDecoder> m_decoder;
    Optional<DecoderError> m_failure;
    bool m_any_decode_was_reported_in_progress { false };
    u32 m_generation { 0 };
    // The latest submission's, which output the decoder finishes later is taken with as well.
    Optional<AK::Duration> m_output_target;
    Core::AnonymousBuffer m_ring;
};

VideoDecoderServerConnection::VideoDecoderServerConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport, ReadonlySpan<VideoDecoderRegistration> hosted_decoders)
    : IPC::ConnectionFromClient<VideoDecoderClientEndpoint, VideoDecoderServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport), 1)
    , m_event_loop(Core::EventLoop::current())
    , m_hosted_decoders(hosted_decoders)
{
}

VideoDecoderServerConnection::~VideoDecoderServerConnection()
{
    revoke_weak_refs();
}

void VideoDecoderServerConnection::die()
{
    revoke_weak_refs();
    // The client may still be showing frames in the slots held for it, so nothing may decode into them anymore.
    for (auto& entry : m_sessions)
        entry.value->exit_and_join();
    m_sessions.clear();

    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> held_frames;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_held_frames_mutex };
        held_frames = move(m_held_frames);
    }
    held_frames.clear();

    if (on_death)
        on_death();
}

void VideoDecoderServerConnection::close_after_decoded_frame_count(u32 frame_count)
{
    m_frames_until_close.store(frame_count, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
}

Messages::VideoDecoderServer::DecoderCapabilitiesResponse VideoDecoderServerConnection::decoder_capabilities(ParsedCodec codec)
{
    if (track_type_from_codec_id(codec.codec_id()) != TrackType::Video)
        return Optional<DecoderCapabilities> {};
    for (auto const& registration : m_hosted_decoders) {
        if (auto capabilities = registration.capabilities(codec); capabilities.has_value())
            return capabilities;
    }
    return Optional<DecoderCapabilities> {};
}

void VideoDecoderServerConnection::create_decoder(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation, CodecID codec_id, ByteBuffer codec_initialization_data)
{
    if (m_sessions.contains(decoder_id)) {
        did_misbehave("create_decoder: decoder ID already exists");
        return;
    }
    auto session = DecoderSession::create(make_weak_ref(), m_event_loop, m_hosted_decoders, decoder_id, generation, codec_id, move(codec_initialization_data));
    if (session.is_error()) {
        async_decoder_failed(decoder_id, generation, DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Could not start a video decoder: {}", session.error()));
        return;
    }
    m_sessions.set(decoder_id, session.release_value());
}

void VideoDecoderServerConnection::destroy_decoder(u64 decoder_id)
{
    if (auto session = m_sessions.take(decoder_id); session.has_value())
        (*session)->exit_and_detach();
}

void VideoDecoderServerConnection::replace_coded_data_ring(u64 decoder_id, Core::AnonymousBuffer ring)
{
    if (auto session = m_sessions.get(decoder_id); session.has_value())
        (*session)->enqueue(DecoderSession::ReplaceRing { move(ring) });
}

void VideoDecoderServerConnection::submit_coded_frame(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation, u64 ring_offset, u64 size, AK::Duration presentation_timestamp, AK::Duration decode_timestamp, AK::Duration duration, FrameFlags flags, Optional<float> maximum_scene_luminance, Optional<ByteBuffer> new_codec_configuration, DecodeIntent intent, Optional<AK::Duration> output_target)
{
    auto session = m_sessions.get(decoder_id);
    if (!session.has_value())
        return;
    (*session)->enqueue(DecoderSession::Submission {
        .generation = generation,
        .ring_offset = ring_offset,
        .size = size,
        .presentation_timestamp = presentation_timestamp,
        .decode_timestamp = decode_timestamp,
        .duration = duration,
        .flags = flags,
        .maximum_scene_luminance = maximum_scene_luminance,
        .new_codec_configuration = move(new_codec_configuration),
        .intent = intent,
        .output_target = output_target,
    });
}

void VideoDecoderServerConnection::signal_end_of_stream(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation)
{
    if (auto session = m_sessions.get(decoder_id); session.has_value())
        (*session)->enqueue(DecoderSession::EndOfStream { generation });
}

void VideoDecoderServerConnection::flush(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation)
{
    if (auto session = m_sessions.get(decoder_id); session.has_value())
        (*session)->enqueue(DecoderSession::Flush { generation });
}

void VideoDecoderServerConnection::release_frame(u64 frame_id)
{
    // The frame is dropped outside the lock, since freeing its slot wakes the decoder thread that may be taking it.
    Optional<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> frame;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_held_frames_mutex };
        frame = m_held_frames.take(frame_id);
    }
}

u64 VideoDecoderServerConnection::hold_frame_until_released(NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame> frame)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_held_frames_mutex };
    auto frame_id = m_next_held_frame_id++;
    m_held_frames.set(frame_id, move(frame));
    return frame_id;
}

bool VideoDecoderServerConnection::should_close_after_decoding_frame()
{
    auto frames_until_close = m_frames_until_close.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
    while (true) {
        if (frames_until_close == 0)
            return false;
        if (m_frames_until_close.compare_exchange_strong(frames_until_close, frames_until_close - 1, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed))
            break;
    }
    return frames_until_close == 1;
}

}

// The decoding end of the connection between a VideoDecoderServer and its client, hosting the decoders it is given in
// priority order.
class MEDIACODECS_API VideoDecoderServerConnection final
    : public IPC::ConnectionFromClient<VideoDecoderClientEndpoint, VideoDecoderServerEndpoint>
    , public ThreadSafeWeakable<VideoDecoderServerConnection> {
    C_OBJECT(VideoDecoderServerConnection);

public:
    virtual ~VideoDecoderServerConnection() override;

    Function<void()> on_death;

    // For tests of the client's recovery: the connection closes once its decoders have decoded this many frames, or
    // never if the count is zero.
    void close_after_decoded_frame_count(u32);

private:
    class DecoderSession;

    VideoDecoderServerConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>, ReadonlySpan<VideoDecoderRegistration> hosted_decoders);

    virtual void die() override;

    virtual Messages::VideoDecoderServer::DecoderCapabilitiesResponse decoder_capabilities(ParsedCodec codec) override;
    virtual void create_decoder(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation, CodecID codec_id, ByteBuffer codec_initialization_data) override;
    virtual void destroy_decoder(u64 decoder_id) override;
    virtual void replace_coded_data_ring(u64 decoder_id, Core::AnonymousBuffer ring) override;
    virtual void submit_coded_frame(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation, u64 ring_offset, u64 size, AK::Duration presentation_timestamp, AK::Duration decode_timestamp, AK::Duration duration, FrameFlags flags, Optional<float> maximum_scene_luminance, Optional<ByteBuffer> new_codec_configuration, DecodeIntent intent, Optional<AK::Duration> output_target) override;
    virtual void signal_end_of_stream(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation) override;
    virtual void flush(u64 decoder_id, u32 generation) override;
    virtual void release_frame(u64 frame_id) override;

    // Callable from the decoder threads.
    u64 hold_frame_until_released(NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>);
    bool should_close_after_decoding_frame();

    Core::EventLoop& m_event_loop;
    ReadonlySpan<VideoDecoderRegistration> const m_hosted_decoders;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<DecoderSession>> m_sessions;

    Mutex m_held_frames_mutex;
    HashMap<u64, NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> m_held_frames;
    u64 m_next_held_frame_id { 1 };

    Atomic<u32> m_frames_until_close { 0 };
};

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <LibGfx/Bitmap.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFramePool.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoSurface.h>

#include "VideoFrame.h"

namespace Media {

static u64 next_frame_id()
{
    static Atomic<u64> s_next_id { 1 };
    return s_next_id.fetch_add(1, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed);
}

VideoFrame::VideoFrame(
    AK::Duration timestamp,
    AK::Duration duration,
    Gfx::Size<u32> size,
    u8 bit_depth,
    Subsampling subsampling,
    ColorMetadata color_metadata,
    NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrameStorage> storage)
    : m_id(next_frame_id())
    , m_timestamp(timestamp)
    , m_duration(duration)
    , m_size(size)
    , m_bit_depth(bit_depth)
    , m_subsampling(subsampling)
    , m_color_metadata(move(color_metadata))
    , m_storage(move(storage))
{
    // Only a picture without chroma subsampling can hold RGB, so an identity matrix on any other is a mislabel.
    if (m_color_metadata.cicp.matrix_coefficients() == MatrixCoefficients::Identity && m_subsampling != Subsampling::yuv444())
        m_color_metadata.cicp.set_matrix_coefficients(MatrixCoefficients::Unspecified);
}

VideoFrame::~VideoFrame() = default;

RefPtr<VideoSurface> VideoFrame::surface() const
{
    return m_storage->surface();
}

Core::AnonymousBuffer VideoFrame::pixel_buffer() const
{
    return m_storage->pixel_buffer();
}

Optional<Gfx::YUVData> VideoFrame::yuv_data() const
{
    auto yuv_data = yuv_data_in_buffer(pixel_buffer(), m_size.to_type<int>(), m_bit_depth, m_subsampling, cicp());
    if (yuv_data.is_error())
        return {};
    return yuv_data.release_value();
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap>> VideoFrame::to_bitmap() const
{
    if (auto surface = this->surface())
        return surface->read_back_bitmap(cicp());
    auto yuv_data = this->yuv_data();
    if (!yuv_data.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Video frame has no pixels to read");
    return yuv_data->to_bitmap();
}

}

class VideoSurface;

using VideoFramePixels = Variant<Core::AnonymousBuffer, NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface>>;

class MEDIACODECS_API VideoFrame final : public AtomicRefCounted<VideoFrame> {

public:
    VideoFrame(
        AK::Duration timestamp,
        AK::Duration duration,
        Gfx::Size<u32> size,
        u8 bit_depth,
        Subsampling subsampling,
        ColorMetadata color_metadata,
        NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrameStorage>);
    ~VideoFrame();

    // Tells this frame apart from every other frame in this process, including ones whose storage it shares.
    u64 id() const { return m_id; }

    AK::Duration timestamp() const { return m_timestamp; }
    AK::Duration duration() const { return m_duration; }
    AK::Duration end() const { return m_timestamp + m_duration; }
    bool contains_timestamp(AK::Duration timestamp) { return timestamp >= m_timestamp && timestamp < end(); }
    static AK::Duration conservative_end_of(AK::Duration timestamp, AK::Duration duration) { return timestamp + duration.scaled_by(3, 2); }
    AK::Duration conservative_end() const { return conservative_end_of(m_timestamp, m_duration); }

    Gfx::Size<u32> size() const { return m_size; }
    u32 width() const { return size().width(); }
    u32 height() const { return size().height(); }

    u8 bit_depth() const { return m_bit_depth; }
    Subsampling subsampling() const { return m_subsampling; }
    ColorMetadata const& color_metadata() const { return m_color_metadata; }
    CodingIndependentCodePoints const& cicp() const { return m_color_metadata.cicp; }

    // A view of the planes in the frame's buffer, absent when a surface holds them instead.
    Optional<Gfx::YUVData> yuv_data() const;

    // The surface holding the frame's pixels, null when they are in a buffer instead.
    RefPtr<VideoSurface> surface() const;

    // The buffer holding the frame's pixels, invalid when a surface holds them instead.
    Core::AnonymousBuffer pixel_buffer() const;

    // Converts the pixels to RGBA in memory, wherever they are, if this process can read them.
    ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap>> to_bitmap() const;

    NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrameStorage> const& storage() const { return m_storage; }

private:
    u64 m_id { 0 };
    AK::Duration m_timestamp;
    AK::Duration m_duration;
    Gfx::Size<u32> m_size;
    u8 m_bit_depth;
    Subsampling m_subsampling;
    ColorMetadata m_color_metadata;
    NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrameStorage> m_storage;
};

#include <AK/Checked.h>
#include <LibGfx/YUVData.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Limits.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFrame.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFramePool.h>

#include "VideoFrameMetadata.h"

namespace Media {

ErrorOr<FramePlaneLayout> frame_plane_layout(Gfx::IntSize size, u8 bit_depth, Subsampling subsampling)
{
    constexpr size_t PLANE_ALIGNMENT = 64;

    auto plane_sizes = TRY(Gfx::YUVData::plane_sizes(size, bit_depth, subsampling));
    if (video_frame_exceeds_limits(size.width(), size.height()))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Video frame is larger than the frame size limit");

    auto u_offset = align_up_to(plane_sizes.y, PLANE_ALIGNMENT);
    auto v_offset = align_up_to(u_offset + plane_sizes.u, PLANE_ALIGNMENT);
    Checked<size_t> checked_total_byte_count = v_offset;
    checked_total_byte_count += plane_sizes.v;
    if (checked_total_byte_count.has_overflow())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Video frame plane layout overflows");

    return FramePlaneLayout {
        .y_size = plane_sizes.y,
        .u_offset = u_offset,
        .u_size = plane_sizes.u,
        .v_offset = v_offset,
        .v_size = plane_sizes.v,
        .total_byte_count = checked_total_byte_count.value(),
    };
}

bool VideoFrameMetadata::is_valid() const
{
    if (duration.is_negative())
        return false;
    if (bit_depth != 8 && bit_depth != 10 && bit_depth != 12)
        return false;
    if (size.width() < 1 || size.height() < 1)
        return false;
    if (video_frame_exceeds_limits(size.width(), size.height()))
        return false;
    // No frame is made with an identity matrix on subsampled planes.
    if (color_metadata.cicp.matrix_coefficients() == MatrixCoefficients::Identity && subsampling != Subsampling::yuv444())
        return false;
    return color_metadata.cicp.is_valid_or_unspecified();
}

VideoFrameMetadata VideoFrameMetadata::for_frame(VideoFrame const& frame)
{
    return VideoFrameMetadata {
        .timestamp = frame.timestamp(),
        .duration = frame.duration(),
        .size = frame.size().to_type<int>(),
        .bit_depth = frame.bit_depth(),
        .subsampling = frame.subsampling(),
        .color_metadata = frame.color_metadata(),
    };
}

}

namespace IPC {

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Media::VideoFrameMetadata const& metadata)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(metadata.timestamp));
    TRY(encoder.encode(metadata.duration));
    TRY(encoder.encode(metadata.size));
    TRY(encoder.encode(metadata.bit_depth));
    TRY(encoder.encode(metadata.subsampling.x()));
    TRY(encoder.encode(metadata.subsampling.y()));
    TRY(encoder.encode(metadata.color_metadata));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Media::VideoFrameMetadata> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    Media::VideoFrameMetadata metadata;
    metadata.timestamp = TRY(decoder.decode<AK::Duration>());
    metadata.duration = TRY(decoder.decode<AK::Duration>());
    metadata.size = TRY(decoder.decode<Gfx::IntSize>());
    metadata.bit_depth = TRY(decoder.decode<u8>());
    metadata.subsampling = Media::Subsampling {
        TRY(decoder.decode<bool>()),
        TRY(decoder.decode<bool>()),
    };
    metadata.color_metadata = TRY(decoder.decode<Media::ColorMetadata>());
    if (!metadata.is_valid())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Video frame metadata describes a frame that could not have been decoded");
    return metadata;
}

    AK::Duration duration;
    Gfx::IntSize size;

// How a frame's planes lay out within a pool slot's bytes, aligned for cache- and
// SIMD-friendly plane bases. Both the producer writing a decoded frame into a slot and a
// consumer reading the frame from the slot's buffer derive the same layout.
struct FramePlaneLayout {
    size_t y_size { 0 };
    size_t u_offset { 0 };
    size_t u_size { 0 };
    size_t v_offset { 0 };
    size_t v_size { 0 };
    size_t total_byte_count { 0 };
};

        m_on_release();
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFramePool>> VideoFramePool::create(size_t byte_budget)
{
    return adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) VideoFramePool(byte_budget));
}

VideoFramePool::VideoFramePool(size_t byte_budget)
    : m_byte_budget(byte_budget)
{
}

VideoFramePool::~VideoFramePool() = default;

void VideoFramePool::set_slot_freed_callback(Function<void()> slot_freed_callback)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    VERIFY(m_slots.is_empty());
    m_slot_freed_callback = move(slot_freed_callback);
}

Optional<VideoFramePool::AcquiredSlot> VideoFramePool::try_acquire(size_t byte_count)
{
    VERIFY(byte_count > 0);

    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };

    Optional<u32> reusable_slot_index;
    Optional<u32> free_slot_index;
    for (u32 index = 0; index < m_slots.size(); index++) {
        auto const& slot = m_slots[index];
        if (slot.is_held)
            continue;
        if (!free_slot_index.has_value() || slot.buffer.size() > m_slots[free_slot_index.value()].buffer.size())
            free_slot_index = index;
        if (slot.buffer.is_valid() && slot.buffer.size() == byte_count) {
            reusable_slot_index = index;
            break;
        }
    }

    Slot* chosen_slot = nullptr;
    if (reusable_slot_index.has_value()) {
        chosen_slot = &m_slots[*reusable_slot_index];
    } else {
        // Reallocate the largest free slot to the requested capacity, growing the pool if every slot is held.
        if (!free_slot_index.has_value()) {
            if (m_slots.size() >= MAX_SLOT_COUNT)
                return {};
            if (m_slots.try_append({}).is_error())
                return {};
            free_slot_index = static_cast<u32>(m_slots.size() - 1);
        }
        chosen_slot = &m_slots[*free_slot_index];

        auto allocated_bytes_after = m_allocated_bytes - chosen_slot->buffer.size() + byte_count;
        if (allocated_bytes_after > m_byte_budget) {
            if (held_slot_count_while_locked() >= MIN_SLOT_COUNT) {
                dbgln_if(VIDEO_FRAME_POOL_DEBUG, "VideoFramePool: Refusing to allocate {} bytes over the budget of {}", byte_count, m_byte_budget);
                return {};
            }
            dbgln_if(VIDEO_FRAME_POOL_DEBUG, "VideoFramePool: Exceeding the byte budget ({} > {}) to keep the minimum {} slots live", allocated_bytes_after, m_byte_budget, MIN_SLOT_COUNT);
        }

        auto buffer_result = Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_with_size(byte_count);
        if (buffer_result.is_error())
            return {};
        drop_slot_storage_while_locked(*chosen_slot);
        chosen_slot->buffer = buffer_result.release_value();
        m_allocated_bytes += chosen_slot->buffer.size();
    }

    m_shed_storage_on_release = false;
    chosen_slot->is_held = true;

    free_excess_buffers_while_locked();

    auto slot_index = static_cast<u32>(chosen_slot - m_slots.data());
    auto storage = make_ref_counted<VideoFrameStorage>(chosen_slot->buffer, 0, [pool = NonnullRefPtr { *this }, slot_index] {
        pool->release_slot(slot_index);
    });
    return AcquiredSlot {
        .storage = move(storage),
        .bytes = { chosen_slot->buffer.data<u8>(), byte_count },
    };
}

u32 VideoFramePool::held_slot_count_while_locked() const
{
    u32 held_count = 0;
    for (auto const& slot : m_slots)
        held_count += slot.is_held;
    return held_count;
}

u32 VideoFramePool::allocated_slot_count_while_locked() const
{
    u32 allocated_count = 0;
    for (auto const& slot : m_slots)
        allocated_count += slot.buffer.is_valid();
    return allocated_count;
}

void VideoFramePool::drop_slot_storage_while_locked(Slot& slot)
{
    if (!slot.buffer.is_valid())
        return;
    m_allocated_bytes -= slot.buffer.size();
    slot.buffer = {};
}

void VideoFramePool::free_excess_buffers_while_locked()
{
    while (m_allocated_bytes > m_byte_budget && allocated_slot_count_while_locked() > MIN_SLOT_COUNT) {
        Slot* largest_free_slot = nullptr;
        for (auto& slot : m_slots) {
            if (slot.is_held || !slot.buffer.is_valid())
                continue;
            if (largest_free_slot == nullptr || slot.buffer.size() > largest_free_slot->buffer.size())
                largest_free_slot = &slot;
        }
        if (largest_free_slot == nullptr)
            return;
        drop_slot_storage_while_locked(*largest_free_slot);
    }
}

void VideoFramePool::shed_storage()
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    m_shed_storage_on_release = true;
    for (auto& slot : m_slots) {
        if (!slot.is_held)
            drop_slot_storage_while_locked(slot);
    }
}

void VideoFramePool::release_slot(u32 slot_index)
{
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        auto& slot = m_slots[slot_index];
        VERIFY(slot.is_held);
        slot.is_held = false;
        if (m_shed_storage_on_release)
            drop_slot_storage_while_locked(slot);
    }

    if (m_slot_freed_callback)
        m_slot_freed_callback();
}

size_t VideoFramePool::allocated_byte_count() const
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    return m_allocated_bytes;
}

VideoSurfaceBudget::~VideoSurfaceBudget() = default;

void VideoSurfaceBudget::set_storage_freed_callback(Function<void()> storage_freed_callback)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    VERIFY(m_held_surface_count == 0);
    m_storage_freed_callback = move(storage_freed_callback);
}

RefPtr<VideoFrameStorage> VideoSurfaceBudget::try_hold(NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface> surface, NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurfaceContents> contents)
{
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        if (m_held_surface_count >= MAX_HELD_SURFACE_COUNT)
            return nullptr;
        m_held_surface_count++;
    }
    // The contents go before the decoder hears that the surface is free, so that it finds the surface free to decode
    // into again by the time it looks.
    return make_ref_counted<VideoFrameStorage>(move(surface), 0, [budget = NonnullRefPtr { *this }, contents = RefPtr<VideoSurfaceContents> { move(contents) }]() mutable {
        contents = nullptr;
        budget->release_hold();
    });
}

void VideoSurfaceBudget::release_hold()
{
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        VERIFY(m_held_surface_count > 0);
        m_held_surface_count--;
    }
    if (m_storage_freed_callback)
        m_storage_freed_callback();
}

ErrorOr<Gfx::YUVData> yuv_data_in_buffer(Core::AnonymousBuffer const& buffer, Gfx::IntSize size, u8 bit_depth, Subsampling subsampling, CodingIndependentCodePoints const& cicp)
{
    if (!buffer.is_valid() || buffer.size() == 0)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Invalid video frame buffer");

    auto layout = TRY(frame_plane_layout(size, bit_depth, subsampling));
    if (layout.total_byte_count > buffer.size())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Video frame format does not fit its buffer");

    auto bytes = Bytes { const_cast<u8*>(buffer.data<u8 const>()), buffer.size() };
    return Gfx::YUVData::create(size, bit_depth, subsampling, cicp, bytes.slice(0, layout.y_size), bytes.slice(layout.u_offset, layout.u_size), bytes.slice(layout.v_offset, layout.v_size));
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> create_received_video_frame(VideoFrameMetadata const& metadata, VideoFramePixels pixels, u64 sender_id, Function<void()> on_release)
{
    auto storage = make_ref_counted<VideoFrameStorage>(move(pixels), sender_id, move(on_release));

    if (!metadata.is_valid())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Video frame metadata describes a frame that could not have been decoded");

    if (auto surface = storage->surface()) {
        auto surface_size = surface->size();
        if (metadata.subsampling != surface->subsampling() || metadata.size.width() > surface_size.width() || metadata.size.height() > surface_size.height())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Video frame metadata does not match its surface");
    } else {
        TRY(yuv_data_in_buffer(storage->pixel_buffer(), metadata.size, metadata.bit_depth, metadata.subsampling, metadata.color_metadata.cicp));
    }

    return make_ref_counted<VideoFrame>(metadata.timestamp, metadata.duration, metadata.size.to_type<u32>(), metadata.bit_depth, metadata.subsampling, metadata.color_metadata, move(storage));
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>

namespace Media {

// Holds a frame's pixels until the last frame sharing them is dropped, then runs the release callback once, on
// whichever thread dropped it.
class MEDIACODECS_API VideoFrameStorage final : public AtomicRefCounted<VideoFrameStorage> {
public:
    VideoFrameStorage(VideoFramePixels, u64 sender_id, Function<void()> on_release);
    ~VideoFrameStorage();

    VideoFramePixels const& pixels() const { return m_pixels; }
    // Tells the frames one peer sent apart from every other peer's in this process, and is 0 for frames decoded here.
    u64 sender_id() const { return m_sender_id; }
    // Invalid when a surface holds the pixels instead.
    Core::AnonymousBuffer pixel_buffer() const;
    // Null when a buffer holds the pixels instead.
    RefPtr<VideoSurface> surface() const;

private:
    VideoFramePixels m_pixels;
    u64 m_sender_id { 0 };
    Function<void()> m_on_release;
};

// A pool of shared-memory framebuffers, allocated on demand within a byte budget that the first MIN_SLOT_COUNT
// slots may exceed.
class MEDIACODECS_API VideoFramePool final : public AtomicRefCounted<VideoFramePool> {
public:
    static constexpr u32 MIN_SLOT_COUNT = 4;
    static constexpr u32 MAX_SLOT_COUNT = 8;
    static constexpr size_t DEFAULT_BYTE_BUDGET = 256 * MiB;

    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFramePool>> create(size_t byte_budget = DEFAULT_BYTE_BUDGET);
    ~VideoFramePool();

    // The callback runs on whichever thread frees a slot, without the pool's lock held, and may run concurrently
    // with itself when separate slots are freed at once.
    void set_slot_freed_callback(Function<void()>);

    struct AcquiredSlot {
        NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrameStorage> storage;
        Bytes bytes;
    };
    // Gets a free slot with the requested capacity if it is available, reallocating the buffer if needed.
    Optional<AcquiredSlot> try_acquire(size_t byte_count);

    // Marks each slot's storage for freeing when its hold count drops to zero. This marker is cleared upon the
    // next acquire.
    void shed_storage();

    size_t allocated_byte_count() const;

private:
    struct Slot {
        Core::AnonymousBuffer buffer;
        bool is_held { false };
    };

    explicit VideoFramePool(size_t byte_budget);

    void release_slot(u32 slot_index);
    u32 held_slot_count_while_locked() const;
    u32 allocated_slot_count_while_locked() const;
    void drop_slot_storage_while_locked(Slot&);
    void free_excess_buffers_while_locked();

    mutable Mutex m_mutex;
    Vector<Slot> m_slots;
    Function<void()> m_slot_freed_callback;
    bool m_shed_storage_on_release { false };

    size_t const m_byte_budget { 0 };
    size_t m_allocated_bytes { 0 };
};

class MEDIACODECS_API VideoSurfaceBudget final : public AtomicRefCounted<VideoSurfaceBudget> {
public:
    static constexpr u32 MAX_HELD_SURFACE_COUNT = 8;

    ~VideoSurfaceBudget();

    // The callback runs on whichever thread releases a surface, without the budget's lock held, and may run
    // concurrently with itself.
    void set_storage_freed_callback(Function<void()>);

    // Null once MAX_HELD_SURFACE_COUNT surfaces are held, until one is released.
    RefPtr<VideoFrameStorage> try_hold(NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface>, NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurfaceContents>);

private:
    void release_hold();

    Mutex m_mutex;
    u32 m_held_surface_count { 0 };
    Function<void()> m_storage_freed_callback;
};

// Views the planes laid out within a frame's buffer, failing if they do not fit its capacity.
MEDIACODECS_API ErrorOr<Gfx::YUVData> yuv_data_in_buffer(Core::AnonymousBuffer const&, Gfx::IntSize, u8 bit_depth, Subsampling, CodingIndependentCodePoints const&);

// Refuses a frame the pixels could not hold, releasing them.
MEDIACODECS_API ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> create_received_video_frame(VideoFrameMetadata const&, VideoFramePixels, u64 sender_id, Function<void()> on_release);

}

#include <LibGfx/Bitmap.h>

namespace Media {

VideoSurface::~VideoSurface() = default;

Gfx::IntSize VideoSurface::size() const
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    return { static_cast<int>(m_io_surface.plane_width(0)), static_cast<int>(m_io_surface.plane_height(0)) };
#elif defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    return m_dma_buf.size;
#else
    return {};
#endif
}

Subsampling VideoSurface::subsampling() const
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    if (auto format = Gfx::biplanar_pixel_format(m_io_surface.pixel_format()); format.has_value())
        return format->subsampling;
#endif
    // Every other surface a decoder hands out is NV12 or P010.
    return Subsampling::yuv420();
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap>> VideoSurface::read_back_bitmap([[maybe_unused]] CodingIndependentCodePoints const& cicp) const
{
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    return Gfx::bitmap_from_video_surface(m_io_surface, cicp);
#else
    return Error::from_string_literal("This process cannot read the video surface's pixels back");
#endif
}

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface>> VideoSurface::create(Core::IOSurfaceHandle io_surface)
{
    auto id = io_surface.id();
    return adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) VideoSurface(move(io_surface), id));
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface>> VideoSurface::create_from_mach_port(Core::MachPort const& port)
{
    auto io_surface = TRY(Core::IOSurfaceHandle::from_mach_port(port));
    TRY(Gfx::validate_biplanar_video_surface(io_surface));
    return create(move(io_surface));
}

#endif

#ifdef AK_OS_LINUX

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface>> VideoSurface::create_from_dma_buf(u64 id, Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle dma_buf)
{
    return adopt_nonnull_ref_or_enomem(new (nothrow) VideoSurface(id, move(dma_buf)));
}

#endif

}

namespace IPC {

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode([[maybe_unused]] Encoder& encoder, [[maybe_unused]] NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoSurface> const& surface)
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    TRY(encoder.append_attachment(Attachment::from_mach_port(surface->create_mach_port(), Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MoveSend)));
    return {};
#elif defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    TRY(encoder.encode(surface->id()));
    TRY(encoder.encode(surface->dma_buf()));
    return {};
#else
    return Error::from_string_literal("This platform has no video surfaces to encode");
#endif
}

template<>
ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Media::VideoSurface>> decode([[maybe_unused]] Decoder& decoder)
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    auto attachment = TRY(decoder.attachments().try_dequeue());
    if (attachment.message_right() != Core::MachPort::MessageRight::MoveSend)
        return Error::from_string_literal("VideoSurface attachment is not a moved send right");
    return TRY(Media::VideoSurface::create_from_mach_port(attachment.release_mach_port()));
#elif defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    auto id = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
    auto dma_buf = TRY(decoder.decode<Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle>());
    return TRY(Media::VideoSurface::create_from_dma_buf(id, move(dma_buf)));
#else
    return Error::from_string_literal("This platform has no video surfaces to decode");
#endif
}

}

// What the process that decoded into a surface holds to keep those pixels from being decoded over, for as long as
// the frame slot they were handed out in is held anywhere.
class VideoSurfaceContents : public AtomicRefCounted<VideoSurfaceContents> {
public:
    virtual ~VideoSurfaceContents() = default;

// A frame's pixels in memory that a GPU can sample without a copy. Hardware decoders allocate these and recycle a
// bounded set of them, so each carries the identity its recycling is recognized by.
class MEDIACODECS_API VideoSurface : public AtomicRefCounted<VideoSurface> {
public:
    ~VideoSurface();

    // Tells the surface apart from every other its sender has handed out, including from an earlier decoder process.
    u64 id() const { return m_id; }
    Gfx::IntSize size() const;
    Subsampling subsampling() const;

    // Reads the pixels back into memory, which works only where the platform lets this process map the surface.
    ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap>> read_back_bitmap(CodingIndependentCodePoints const&) const;

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface>> create(Core::IOSurfaceHandle);
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface>> create_from_mach_port(Core::MachPort const&);
    Core::MachPort create_mach_port() const { return m_io_surface.create_mach_port(); }
    Core::IOSurfaceHandle const& io_surface() const { return m_io_surface; }
#endif

#ifdef AK_OS_LINUX
    // The decoder assigns the ID, since the memory behind an image can be exported as any number of file
    // descriptors. The size is the image's, which can exceed the frames decoded into it.
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface>> create_from_dma_buf(u64 id, Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle);

    Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle const& dma_buf() const { return m_dma_buf; }
#endif

private:
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    VideoSurface(Core::IOSurfaceHandle io_surface, u64 id)
        : m_io_surface(move(io_surface))
        , m_id(id)
    {
    }

    Core::IOSurfaceHandle m_io_surface;
#endif

#ifdef AK_OS_LINUX
    VideoSurface(u64 id, Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle dma_buf)
        : m_dma_buf(move(dma_buf))
        , m_id(id)
    {
    }

    Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle m_dma_buf;
#endif

    u64 m_id { 0 };
};

// What a stream has said about its format, tracked across the frames that say it.
struct FormatState;

// Decodes on the platform's media engine, which allocates the surfaces it decodes into and hands them back rather
// than filling ones we provide.
class MEDIACODECS_API VideoToolboxVideoDecoder final : public VideoDecoder {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static Optional<DecoderCapabilities> capabilities(ParsedCodec const&);
    static DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<VideoToolboxVideoDecoder>> try_create(CodecID, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data);

    virtual ~VideoToolboxVideoDecoder() override;

    virtual void set_storage_freed_callback(Function<void()> callback) override { m_surface_budget->set_storage_freed_callback(move(callback)); }
    virtual void set_decode_completed_callback(Function<void(DecodeCompletion)> callback) override { m_decode_completed_callback = move(callback); }
    virtual bool has_any_decode_in_progress() const override;

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<void> receive_coded_data(CodedFrame const&, DecodeIntent) override;
    virtual void signal_end_of_stream() override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> take_next_output(ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata, Optional<AK::Duration> target = {}) override;
    virtual void flush() override;

private:
    struct Session;
    struct DecodedOutput {
        NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurface> surface;
        // Keeps the media engine from decoding over the surface, from the reorder window until the frame it goes out
        // in is released.
        NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurfaceContents> contents;
        AK::Duration timestamp;
        AK::Duration duration;
        Gfx::IntSize size;
        u8 bit_depth { 0 };
        Subsampling subsampling;
        ColorMetadata color_metadata;
    };

    // What a frame in the media engine was submitted with, which its output is given. The media engine hands the
    // submission's ID back with the output.
    struct InFlightFrame {
        u64 submission_id { 0 };
        AK::Duration timestamp;
        AK::Duration duration;
        ColorMetadata high_dynamic_range_metadata;
    };

    VideoToolboxVideoDecoder(CodecID, NonnullOwnPtr<FormatState>);

    DecoderErrorOr<void> ensure_session_for_frame(CodedFrame const&);

    void note_decode_completed(CodingIndependentCodePoints const& cicp, u64 submission_id, i32 status, void* image_buffer);

    void enqueue_decoded_output_while_locked(ColorMetadata const&, void* image_buffer, AK::Duration timestamp, AK::Duration duration);
    void note_decode_failure_while_locked(i32 status);
    void note_frame_left_the_media_engine_while_locked();

    void insert_output_in_presentation_order_while_locked(DecodedOutput&&);
    bool may_pull_frame_from_reorder_queue_while_locked() const;
    Optional<InFlightFrame> take_in_flight_frame_while_locked(u64 submission_id);
    DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> adopt_output_while_locked(ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata, size_t index);

    CodecID const m_codec_id;
    NonnullRefPtr<VideoSurfaceBudget> m_surface_budget { make_ref_counted<VideoSurfaceBudget>() };
    NonnullOwnPtr<FormatState> m_format_state;
    OwnPtr<Session> m_session;
    bool m_reached_end_of_stream { false };
    // ITU-T H.265 (07/2024), 8.1.3: the IRAP picture decoding starts at has NoRaslOutputFlag set, which gives the
    // RASL pictures associated with it PicOutputFlag equal to 0.
    bool m_awaiting_first_submitted_frame { true };
    bool m_discarding_open_gop_leading_pictures { false };

    // The media engine decodes on its own threads, so outputs arrive from outside this decoder's caller.
    mutable Mutex m_output_mutex;
    ConditionVariable m_output_arrived { m_output_mutex };
    bool m_caller_is_waiting_for_output { false };
    Function<void(DecodeCompletion)> m_decode_completed_callback;
    Vector<DecodedOutput> m_outputs;
    Vector<InFlightFrame> m_in_flight_frames;
    u8 m_reorder_frame_count { 0 };
    Optional<DecoderError> m_decode_failure;

    // Only the caller's thread submits, so a read followed by an increment cannot exceed the limit; the media
    // engine's threads only ever retire slots. Relaxed suffices because the modification order of a single
    // location is total, so a retiring frame always observes its own submission.
    Atomic<size_t> m_frames_in_flight { 0 };
    u64 m_next_submission_id { 0 };
};
