#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/BuiltinWrappers.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <AK/OwnPtr.h>
#include <LibGfx/ImportedYCbCrVulkanImage.h>
#include <LibGfx/VulkanContext.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Vulkan/VulkanVideoDevice.h>

namespace Media {

namespace {

constexpr Array required_video_extensions {
    VK_KHR_VIDEO_QUEUE_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_KHR_VIDEO_DECODE_QUEUE_EXTENSION_NAME,
};

constexpr Array required_export_extensions {
    VK_KHR_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_FD_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_EXT_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_DMA_BUF_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_EXT_IMAGE_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXTENSION_NAME,
};

constexpr Array optional_extensions {
    VK_KHR_EXTERNAL_SEMAPHORE_FD_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_KHR_VIDEO_DECODE_H264_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_KHR_VIDEO_DECODE_H265_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_KHR_VIDEO_DECODE_VP9_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_KHR_VIDEO_DECODE_AV1_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_KHR_VIDEO_MAINTENANCE_1_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_KHR_VIDEO_MAINTENANCE_2_EXTENSION_NAME,
};

NeverDestroyed<OwnPtr<VulkanVideoDevice>> s_process_device;

Vector<VkExtensionProperties> device_extensions_of(VkPhysicalDevice physical_device)
{
    u32 count = 0;
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(physical_device, nullptr, &count, nullptr);
    Vector<VkExtensionProperties> extensions;
    extensions.resize(count);
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(physical_device, nullptr, &count, extensions.data());
    return extensions;
}

bool contains_extension(ReadonlySpan<VkExtensionProperties> extensions, StringView name)
{
    return any_of(extensions, [&](auto const& extension) { return StringView { extension.extensionName, strlen(extension.extensionName) } == name; });
}

Vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> queue_families_of(VkPhysicalDevice physical_device)
{
    u32 count = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(physical_device, &count, nullptr);
    Vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> families;
    families.resize(count);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(physical_device, &count, families.data());
    return families;
}

Optional<u32> first_queue_family_with(ReadonlySpan<VkQueueFamilyProperties> families, VkQueueFlags flags)
{
    for (u32 index = 0; index < families.size(); index++) {
        if ((families[index].queueFlags & flags) == flags && families[index].queueCount > 0)
            return index;
    }
    return {};
}

}

Optional<VulkanVideoDevice::DecodeQueueFamily> VulkanVideoDevice::decode_queue_family_of(VkPhysicalDevice physical_device)
{
    u32 count = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties2(physical_device, &count, nullptr);
    Vector<VkQueueFamilyVideoPropertiesKHR> video_properties;
    video_properties.resize(count);
    Vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties2> properties;
    properties.resize(count);
    for (u32 index = 0; index < count; index++) {
        video_properties[index].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUEUE_FAMILY_VIDEO_PROPERTIES_KHR;
        properties[index].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUEUE_FAMILY_PROPERTIES_2;
        properties[index].pNext = &video_properties[index];
    }
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties2(physical_device, &count, properties.data());

    // Only one decode family is created, so it is the one that decodes the most codecs. A family may encode as well.
    constexpr VkVideoCodecOperationFlagsKHR decode_operations = VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_H264_BIT_KHR
        | VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_H265_BIT_KHR | VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_VP9_BIT_KHR | VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_AV1_BIT_KHR;
    Optional<DecodeQueueFamily> chosen_family;
    for (u32 index = 0; index < count; index++) {
        auto const& family = properties[index].queueFamilyProperties;
        if ((family.queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_VIDEO_DECODE_BIT_KHR) == 0 || family.queueCount == 0)
            continue;
        auto codec_operations = video_properties[index].videoCodecOperations & decode_operations;
        if (chosen_family.has_value() && popcount(codec_operations) <= popcount(chosen_family->codec_operations))
            continue;
        chosen_family = DecodeQueueFamily { index, codec_operations };
    }
    return chosen_family;
}

bool VulkanVideoDevice::supports_video_maintenance2(VkPhysicalDevice physical_device)
{
    if (!contains_extension(device_extensions_of(physical_device), VK_KHR_VIDEO_MAINTENANCE_2_EXTENSION_NAME ""sv))
        return false;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVideoMaintenance2FeaturesKHR video_maintenance2 {};
    video_maintenance2.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VIDEO_MAINTENANCE_2_FEATURES_KHR;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 features {};
    features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2;
    features.pNext = &video_maintenance2;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(physical_device, &features);
    return video_maintenance2.videoMaintenance2;
}

ErrorOr<void> VulkanVideoDevice::check_can_decode_video(VkPhysicalDevice physical_device)
{
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties properties;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(physical_device, &properties);
    if (properties.apiVersion < VK_API_VERSION_1_3)
        return Error::from_string_literal("The GPU's Vulkan is older than 1.3");
    auto extensions = device_extensions_of(physical_device);
    auto has_extension = [&](auto name) { return contains_extension(extensions, { name, strlen(name) }); };
    if (!all_of(required_video_extensions, has_extension))
        return Error::from_string_literal("The GPU's Vulkan driver does not expose a video decode queue");
    if (!all_of(required_export_extensions, has_extension))
        return Error::from_string_literal("The GPU's Vulkan driver cannot export images as dma-bufs");

    // FFmpeg submits with synchronization2 and tracks its frames with timeline semaphores, without checking for either.
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features vulkan13 {};
    vulkan13.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features vulkan12 {};
    vulkan12.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES;
    vulkan12.pNext = &vulkan13;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 features {};
    features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2;
    features.pNext = &vulkan12;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(physical_device, &features);
    if (!vulkan12.timelineSemaphore || !vulkan13.synchronization2)
        return Error::from_string_literal("The Vulkan device lacks timeline semaphores or synchronization2");

    // FFmpeg needs a family for compute and one for transfers alongside the decoding one.
    if (!decode_queue_family_of(physical_device).has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("The Vulkan device lacks a decode, compute or transfer queue");
    auto queue_families = queue_families_of(physical_device);
    for (auto flags : { VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT, VK_QUEUE_TRANSFER_BIT }) {
        if (!first_queue_family_with(queue_families, flags).has_value())
            return Error::from_string_literal("The Vulkan device lacks a decode, compute or transfer queue");
    }
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> VulkanVideoDevice::create_for_process(Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity const& identity)
{
    VERIFY(!*s_process_device);
    *s_process_device = TRY(create(identity));
    return {};
}

VulkanVideoDevice* VulkanVideoDevice::the()
{
    return s_process_device->ptr();
}

ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<VulkanVideoDevice>> VulkanVideoDevice::create(Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity const& identity)
{
    auto device = adopt_own(*new VulkanVideoDevice);
    device->m_api_version = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;

    VkApplicationInfo application_info {};
    application_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO;
    application_info.pApplicationName = "Ladybird";
    application_info.apiVersion = device->m_api_version;

    VkInstanceCreateInfo instance_info {};
    instance_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO;
    instance_info.pApplicationInfo = &application_info;
    if (vkCreateInstance(&instance_info, nullptr, &device->m_instance) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Could not create a Vulkan instance");

    u32 physical_device_count = 0;
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(device->m_instance, &physical_device_count, nullptr);
    Vector<VkPhysicalDevice> physical_devices;
    physical_devices.resize(physical_device_count);
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(device->m_instance, &physical_device_count, physical_devices.data());

    for (auto* physical_device : physical_devices) {
        if (Gfx::gpu_device_identity_of(physical_device) == identity) {
            device->m_physical_device = physical_device;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (device->m_physical_device == VK_NULL_HANDLE)
        return Error::from_string_literal("The named GPU is not a Vulkan device here");
    TRY(check_can_decode_video(device->m_physical_device));

    auto available_extensions = device_extensions_of(device->m_physical_device);
    for (auto const* name : required_video_extensions)
        device->m_enabled_extensions.append(name);
    for (auto const* name : required_export_extensions)
        device->m_enabled_extensions.append(name);

    VkPhysicalDeviceVideoMaintenance1FeaturesKHR supported_video_maintenance1 {};
    supported_video_maintenance1.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VIDEO_MAINTENANCE_1_FEATURES_KHR;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features supported_vulkan13 {};
    supported_vulkan13.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES;
    supported_vulkan13.pNext = &supported_video_maintenance1;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features supported_vulkan12 {};
    supported_vulkan12.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES;
    supported_vulkan12.pNext = &supported_vulkan13;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features supported_vulkan11 {};
    supported_vulkan11.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_1_FEATURES;
    supported_vulkan11.pNext = &supported_vulkan12;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 supported_features {};
    supported_features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2;
    supported_features.pNext = &supported_vulkan11;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(device->m_physical_device, &supported_features);

    device->m_vulkan13_features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES;
    device->m_vulkan13_features.synchronization2 = VK_TRUE;
    device->m_vulkan12_features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES;
    device->m_vulkan12_features.timelineSemaphore = VK_TRUE;
    device->m_vulkan12_features.pNext = &device->m_vulkan13_features;
    device->m_vulkan11_features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_1_FEATURES;
    device->m_vulkan11_features.samplerYcbcrConversion = supported_vulkan11.samplerYcbcrConversion;
    device->m_vulkan11_features.pNext = &device->m_vulkan12_features;
    device->m_features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2;
    device->m_features.pNext = &device->m_vulkan11_features;
    void** feature_chain_end = &device->m_vulkan13_features.pNext;

    // FFmpeg also trusts the extension's name alone, so an extension whose feature is missing stays disabled.
    for (auto const* name : optional_extensions) {
        StringView name_view { name, strlen(name) };
        if (!contains_extension(available_extensions, name_view))
            continue;
        if (name_view == VK_KHR_VIDEO_MAINTENANCE_1_EXTENSION_NAME ""sv) {
            if (!supported_video_maintenance1.videoMaintenance1)
                continue;
            device->m_video_maintenance1_features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VIDEO_MAINTENANCE_1_FEATURES_KHR;
            device->m_video_maintenance1_features.videoMaintenance1 = VK_TRUE;
            *feature_chain_end = &device->m_video_maintenance1_features;
            feature_chain_end = &device->m_video_maintenance1_features.pNext;
        } else if (name_view == VK_KHR_VIDEO_MAINTENANCE_2_EXTENSION_NAME ""sv) {
            if (!supports_video_maintenance2(device->m_physical_device))
                continue;
            device->m_video_maintenance2_features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VIDEO_MAINTENANCE_2_FEATURES_KHR;
            device->m_video_maintenance2_features.videoMaintenance2 = VK_TRUE;
            *feature_chain_end = &device->m_video_maintenance2_features;
            feature_chain_end = &device->m_video_maintenance2_features.pNext;
        }
        device->m_enabled_extensions.append(name);
    }

    auto queue_families = queue_families_of(device->m_physical_device);
    auto decode_family = decode_queue_family_of(device->m_physical_device);
    auto compute_family = first_queue_family_with(queue_families, VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT);
    auto transfer_family = first_queue_family_with(queue_families, VK_QUEUE_TRANSFER_BIT);
    VERIFY(decode_family.has_value() && compute_family.has_value() && transfer_family.has_value());
    device->m_decode_codec_operations = decode_family->codec_operations;
    device->m_compute_queue_family = *compute_family;

    Vector<VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo> queue_infos;
    float const queue_priority = 1.0f;
    for (auto family : { decode_family->index, *compute_family, *transfer_family }) {
        if (any_of(device->m_queue_families, [&](auto const& existing) { return existing.index == family; }))
            continue;
        device->m_queue_families.append({ family, queue_families[family].queueFlags });
        VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo queue_info {};
        queue_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO;
        queue_info.queueFamilyIndex = family;
        queue_info.queueCount = 1;
        queue_info.pQueuePriorities = &queue_priority;
        queue_infos.append(queue_info);
    }

    VkDeviceCreateInfo device_info {};
    device_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO;
    device_info.pNext = &device->m_features;
    device_info.queueCreateInfoCount = queue_infos.size();
    device_info.pQueueCreateInfos = queue_infos.data();
    device_info.enabledExtensionCount = device->m_enabled_extensions.size();
    device_info.ppEnabledExtensionNames = device->m_enabled_extensions.data();
    if (vkCreateDevice(device->m_physical_device, &device_info, nullptr, &device->m_logical_device) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Could not create a Vulkan device for decoding video");

    device->m_get_physical_device_video_capabilities = reinterpret_cast<PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR>(vkGetInstanceProcAddr(device->m_instance, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR"));
    if (device->m_get_physical_device_video_capabilities == nullptr)
        return Error::from_string_literal("vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR is unavailable");
    device->m_get_memory_fd = reinterpret_cast<PFN_vkGetMemoryFdKHR>(vkGetDeviceProcAddr(device->m_logical_device, "vkGetMemoryFdKHR"));
    if (device->m_get_memory_fd == nullptr)
        return Error::from_string_literal("vkGetMemoryFdKHR is unavailable");
    device->m_get_image_drm_format_modifier_properties = reinterpret_cast<PFN_vkGetImageDrmFormatModifierPropertiesEXT>(vkGetDeviceProcAddr(device->m_logical_device, "vkGetImageDrmFormatModifierPropertiesEXT"));
    if (device->m_get_image_drm_format_modifier_properties == nullptr)
        return Error::from_string_literal("vkGetImageDrmFormatModifierPropertiesEXT is unavailable");

    return device;
}

VulkanVideoDevice::~VulkanVideoDevice()
{
    if (m_logical_device != VK_NULL_HANDLE)
        vkDestroyDevice(m_logical_device, nullptr);
    if (m_instance != VK_NULL_HANDLE)
        vkDestroyInstance(m_instance, nullptr);
}

bool VulkanVideoDevice::has_enabled_extension(StringView name) const
{
    return any_of(m_enabled_extensions, [&](auto enabled) { return StringView { enabled, strlen(enabled) } == name; });
}

Mutex& VulkanVideoDevice::queue_mutex(u32 family_index)
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_queue_families.size(); i++) {
        if (m_queue_families[i].index == family_index)
            return m_queue_mutexes[i];
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

void VulkanVideoDevice::lock_queue(u32 family_index)
{
    queue_mutex(family_index).lock();
}

void VulkanVideoDevice::unlock_queue(u32 family_index)
{
    queue_mutex(family_index).unlock();
}

ErrorOr<void> VulkanVideoDevice::video_capabilities(VkVideoProfileInfoKHR const& profile, VkVideoCapabilitiesKHR& capabilities) const
{
    if (m_get_physical_device_video_capabilities(m_physical_device, &profile, &capabilities) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return Error::from_string_literal("The Vulkan device cannot decode this video profile");
    return {};
}

static Vector<VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesEXT> drm_format_modifier_properties_of(VkPhysicalDevice physical_device, VkFormat format)
{
    VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesListEXT modifier_list {};
    modifier_list.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_PROPERTIES_LIST_EXT;
    VkFormatProperties2 format_properties {};
    format_properties.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FORMAT_PROPERTIES_2;
    format_properties.pNext = &modifier_list;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties2(physical_device, format, &format_properties);

    Vector<VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesEXT> modifier_properties;
    modifier_properties.resize(modifier_list.drmFormatModifierCount);
    modifier_list.pDrmFormatModifierProperties = modifier_properties.data();
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties2(physical_device, format, &format_properties);
    return modifier_properties;
}

struct DmaBufImageFormat {
    VkExtent3D maximum_extent {};
    VkExternalMemoryFeatureFlags memory_features { 0 };
};

static Optional<DmaBufImageFormat> dma_buf_image_format_of(VkPhysicalDevice physical_device, VkFormat format, u64 modifier, VkImageUsageFlags usage, VkImageCreateFlags flags, void const* video_profile_list, ReadonlySpan<u32> concurrent_queue_families)
{
    VkPhysicalDeviceImageDrmFormatModifierInfoEXT modifier_info {};
    modifier_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_IMAGE_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_INFO_EXT;
    modifier_info.pNext = video_profile_list;
    modifier_info.drmFormatModifier = modifier;
    if (concurrent_queue_families.size() > 1) {
        modifier_info.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_CONCURRENT;
        modifier_info.queueFamilyIndexCount = concurrent_queue_families.size();
        modifier_info.pQueueFamilyIndices = concurrent_queue_families.data();
    }

    VkPhysicalDeviceExternalImageFormatInfo external_info {};
    external_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTERNAL_IMAGE_FORMAT_INFO;
    external_info.pNext = &modifier_info;
    external_info.handleType = VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_DMA_BUF_BIT_EXT;

    VkPhysicalDeviceImageFormatInfo2 image_info {};
    image_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_IMAGE_FORMAT_INFO_2;
    image_info.pNext = &external_info;
    image_info.format = format;
    image_info.type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    image_info.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXT;
    image_info.usage = usage;
    image_info.flags = flags;

    VkExternalImageFormatProperties external_properties {};
    external_properties.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_EXTERNAL_IMAGE_FORMAT_PROPERTIES;
    VkImageFormatProperties2 image_properties {};
    image_properties.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_FORMAT_PROPERTIES_2;
    image_properties.pNext = &external_properties;
    if (vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties2(physical_device, &image_info, &image_properties) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return {};
    return DmaBufImageFormat { image_properties.imageFormatProperties.maxExtent, external_properties.externalMemoryProperties.externalMemoryFeatures };
}

Vector<u64> VulkanVideoDevice::exportable_drm_format_modifiers(VkFormat format, VkImageUsageFlags usage, VkImageCreateFlags flags, void const* video_profile_list, Optional<Gfx::IntSize> size) const
{
    auto modifier_properties = drm_format_modifier_properties_of(m_physical_device, format);

    Vector<u32> queue_family_indices;
    for (auto const& family : m_queue_families)
        queue_family_indices.append(family.index);

    // An image offered several modifiers can only be as large as all of them allow.
    auto fits = [&](DmaBufImageFormat const& image_format) {
        if (!size.has_value())
            return true;
        return static_cast<u32>(size->width()) <= image_format.maximum_extent.width && static_cast<u32>(size->height()) <= image_format.maximum_extent.height;
    };

    Vector<u64> modifiers;
    for (auto const& properties : modifier_properties) {
        // The Compositor runs on the same device and driver, so it sees the same features under each modifier.
        auto required_features = Gfx::ImportedYCbCrVulkanImage::REQUIRED_FORMAT_FEATURES;
        if ((properties.drmFormatModifierTilingFeatures & required_features) != required_features)
            continue;
        if (properties.drmFormatModifierPlaneCount > Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle::MAXIMUM_PLANE_COUNT)
            continue;

        auto exported = dma_buf_image_format_of(m_physical_device, format, properties.drmFormatModifier, usage, flags, video_profile_list, queue_family_indices);
        if (!exported.has_value() || (exported->memory_features & VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_FEATURE_EXPORTABLE_BIT) == 0 || !fits(*exported))
            continue;

        // The Compositor imports the image under usage of its own, which the memory features may differ under.
        auto imported = dma_buf_image_format_of(m_physical_device, format, properties.drmFormatModifier, Gfx::ImportedYCbCrVulkanImage::USAGE, 0, nullptr, {});
        if (!imported.has_value() || (imported->memory_features & VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_FEATURE_IMPORTABLE_BIT) == 0 || !fits(*imported))
            continue;

        modifiers.append(properties.drmFormatModifier);
    }
    return modifiers;
}

ErrorOr<Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle> VulkanVideoDevice::export_image_as_dma_buf(VkImage image, VkDeviceMemory memory, VkFormat format, Gfx::IntSize size, u32 drm_format) const
{
    // The driver picks one of the modifiers that the image was offered when it was created.
    VkImageDrmFormatModifierPropertiesEXT image_modifier {};
    image_modifier.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_PROPERTIES_EXT;
    if (m_get_image_drm_format_modifier_properties(m_logical_device, image, &image_modifier) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Could not find the DRM format modifier of an image");

    Optional<u32> plane_count;
    for (auto const& properties : drm_format_modifier_properties_of(m_physical_device, format)) {
        if (properties.drmFormatModifier == image_modifier.drmFormatModifier)
            plane_count = properties.drmFormatModifierPlaneCount;
    }
    if (!plane_count.has_value() || *plane_count < 1 || *plane_count > Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle::MAXIMUM_PLANE_COUNT)
        return Error::from_string_literal("An image's DRM format modifier lays it out in an unusable number of planes");

    VkMemoryGetFdInfoKHR fd_info {};
    fd_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_GET_FD_INFO_KHR;
    fd_info.memory = memory;
    fd_info.handleType = VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_DMA_BUF_BIT_EXT;
    int fd = -1;
    if (m_get_memory_fd(m_logical_device, &fd_info, &fd) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Could not export an image's memory as a dma-buf");

    Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle dma_buf;
    dma_buf.size = size;
    dma_buf.drm_format = drm_format;
    dma_buf.modifier = image_modifier.drmFormatModifier;
    dma_buf.objects.append(IPC::File::adopt_fd(fd));

    static constexpr Array memory_plane_aspects {
        VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_MEMORY_PLANE_0_BIT_EXT,
        VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_MEMORY_PLANE_1_BIT_EXT,
        VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_MEMORY_PLANE_2_BIT_EXT,
        VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_MEMORY_PLANE_3_BIT_EXT,
    };
    for (u32 plane_index = 0; plane_index < *plane_count; plane_index++) {
        VkImageSubresource subresource {};
        subresource.aspectMask = memory_plane_aspects[plane_index];
        VkSubresourceLayout layout {};
        vkGetImageSubresourceLayout(m_logical_device, image, &subresource, &layout);
        dma_buf.planes.append({ 0, static_cast<u32>(layout.offset), static_cast<u32>(layout.rowPitch) });
    }
    return dma_buf;
}

}

// A Vulkan device for decoding video into images that export as dma-bufs. One serves every decoder in a process, and
// outlives every frame decoded on it.
class MEDIACODECS_API VulkanVideoDevice {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(VulkanVideoDevice);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(VulkanVideoDevice);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    struct QueueFamily {
        u32 index { 0 };
        VkQueueFlags flags { 0 };
    };

    struct DecodeQueueFamily {
        u32 index { 0 };
        VkVideoCodecOperationFlagsKHR codec_operations { 0 };
    };

    // Decoding happens on the GPU that will display the frames, so it is named by the process that displays them. The
    // device is created before the process starts any other threads, and is never destroyed.
    static ErrorOr<void> create_for_process(Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity const&);
    static VulkanVideoDevice* the();

    // Whether a device has what decoding through FFmpeg needs, which the system probe checks without creating one.
    static ErrorOr<void> check_can_decode_video(VkPhysicalDevice);
    // Whether the device takes decoding parameters with each frame, through VK_KHR_video_maintenance2.
    static bool supports_video_maintenance2(VkPhysicalDevice);
    // The family a device created on this GPU decodes on, and the codecs it decodes.
    static Optional<DecodeQueueFamily> decode_queue_family_of(VkPhysicalDevice);

    ~VulkanVideoDevice();

    VkInstance instance() const { return m_instance; }
    VkPhysicalDevice physical_device() const { return m_physical_device; }
    VkDevice logical_device() const { return m_logical_device; }
    u32 api_version() const { return m_api_version; }
    ReadonlySpan<QueueFamily> queue_families() const { return m_queue_families; }
    u32 compute_queue_family() const { return m_compute_queue_family; }
    ReadonlySpan<char const*> enabled_extensions() const { return m_enabled_extensions; }
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 const& enabled_features() const { return m_features; }
    bool has_enabled_extension(StringView) const;
    bool has_sampler_ycbcr_conversion() const { return m_vulkan11_features.samplerYcbcrConversion; }
    bool decodes_codec_operation(VkVideoCodecOperationFlagBitsKHR operation) const { return (m_decode_codec_operations & operation) != 0; }

    // A queue takes one submission at a time, and every FFmpeg in the process submits to this device's queues. Each
    // family has one queue.
    void lock_queue(u32 family_index);
    void unlock_queue(u32 family_index);

    // Fills in the capabilities, and whatever codec-specific capabilities are chained to them, for a video profile.
    ErrorOr<void> video_capabilities(VkVideoProfileInfoKHR const&, VkVideoCapabilitiesKHR&) const;

    // The DRM format modifiers that images of the format, and of the size if it is known, can be created and exported
    // under, and that the Compositor can import them under.
    Vector<u64> exportable_drm_format_modifiers(VkFormat, VkImageUsageFlags, VkImageCreateFlags, void const* video_profile_list, Optional<Gfx::IntSize>) const;

    // Exports an image created under a DRM format modifier, whose planes share one allocation, as a dma-buf.
    ErrorOr<Gfx::LinuxDmaBufHandle> export_image_as_dma_buf(VkImage, VkDeviceMemory, VkFormat, Gfx::IntSize, u32 drm_format) const;

private:
    VulkanVideoDevice() = default;

    static ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<VulkanVideoDevice>> create(Gfx::GpuDeviceIdentity const&);

    Mutex& queue_mutex(u32 family_index);

    u32 m_api_version { 0 };
    VkInstance m_instance { VK_NULL_HANDLE };
    VkPhysicalDevice m_physical_device { VK_NULL_HANDLE };
    VkDevice m_logical_device { VK_NULL_HANDLE };
    Vector<QueueFamily> m_queue_families;
    u32 m_compute_queue_family { 0 };
    VkVideoCodecOperationFlagsKHR m_decode_codec_operations { 0 };
    // One for each of the decode, compute and transfer families, which may coincide.
    Array<Mutex, 3> m_queue_mutexes;
    Vector<char const*> m_enabled_extensions;

    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features m_vulkan11_features {};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features m_vulkan12_features {};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features m_vulkan13_features {};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVideoMaintenance1FeaturesKHR m_video_maintenance1_features {};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVideoMaintenance2FeaturesKHR m_video_maintenance2_features {};

    PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR m_get_physical_device_video_capabilities { nullptr };
    PFN_vkGetMemoryFdKHR m_get_memory_fd { nullptr };
    PFN_vkGetImageDrmFormatModifierPropertiesEXT m_get_image_drm_format_modifier_properties { nullptr };
};

/*

#include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/WindowsMediaFoundation/WindowsMediaFoundation.h>

namespace Media::WindowsMediaFoundation {

// Media Foundation counts time in units of 100 nanoseconds.
static constexpr i64 NANOSECONDS_PER_SAMPLE_TIME_UNIT = 100;

i64 sample_time_from_duration(AK::Duration duration)
{
    return duration.to_nanoseconds() / NANOSECONDS_PER_SAMPLE_TIME_UNIT;
}

AK::Duration duration_from_sample_time(i64 sample_time)
{
    return AK::Duration::from_time_units(sample_time, NANOSECONDS_PER_SAMPLE_TIME_UNIT, 1'000'000'000);
}

static bool media_foundation_is_started()
{
    static bool const started = [] {
        // Decoder threads never enter an apartment, so they rely on the process-wide one staying alive.
        CO_MTA_USAGE_COOKIE cookie;
        if (FAILED(CoIncrementMTAUsage(&cookie)))
            return false;
        return SUCCEEDED(MFStartup(MF_VERSION, MFSTARTUP_NOSOCKET));
    }();
    return started;
}

DecoderErrorOr<ComPtr<IMFTransform>> create_decoder_transform(CodecID codec_id, IMFMediaType& input_type)
{
    if (!media_foundation_is_started())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation could not be started"sv);

    MFT_REGISTER_TYPE_INFO input_type_info {};
    if (FAILED(input_type.GetGUID(MF_MT_MAJOR_TYPE, &input_type_info.guidMajorType)) || FAILED(input_type.GetGUID(MF_MT_SUBTYPE, &input_type_info.guidSubtype)))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Invalid, "Media Foundation input type has no format"sv);
    auto category = input_type_info.guidMajorType == MFMediaType_Audio ? MFT_CATEGORY_AUDIO_DECODER : MFT_CATEGORY_VIDEO_DECODER;

    IMFActivate** activates = nullptr;
    UINT32 activate_count = 0;
    auto flags = MFT_ENUM_FLAG_SYNCMFT | MFT_ENUM_FLAG_LOCALMFT | MFT_ENUM_FLAG_SORTANDFILTER;
    if (FAILED(MFTEnumEx(category, flags, &input_type_info, nullptr, &activates, &activate_count)))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation could not enumerate its decoders"sv);
    ScopeGuard release_activates = [&] {
        for (UINT32 i = 0; i < activate_count; i++)
            activates[i]->Release();
        CoTaskMemFree(static_cast<void*>(activates));
    };

    for (UINT32 i = 0; i < activate_count; i++) {
        ComPtr<IMFTransform> transform;
        if (FAILED(activates[i]->ActivateObject(IID_PPV_ARGS(&transform))))
            continue;
        if (FAILED(transform->SetInputType(0, &input_type, 0))) {
            activates[i]->ShutdownObject();
            continue;
        }
        return transform;
    }

    return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation has no decoder for codec {}", codec_id);
}

DecoderErrorOr<ComPtr<IMFMediaType>> set_first_acceptable_output_type(IMFTransform& transform, Function<bool(GUID const& subtype)> const& subtype_is_acceptable)
{
    for (DWORD type_index = 0;; type_index++) {
        ComPtr<IMFMediaType> available_type;
        auto result = transform.GetOutputAvailableType(0, type_index, &available_type);
        if (result == MF_E_NO_MORE_TYPES)
            break;
        if (FAILED(result))
            return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::Unknown, "Media Foundation decoder could not list its output types: {:#x}", static_cast<u32>(result));

        GUID subtype = GUID_NULL;
        if (FAILED(available_type->GetGUID(MF_MT_SUBTYPE, &subtype)) || !subtype_is_acceptable(subtype))
            continue;
        if (FAILED(transform.SetOutputType(0, available_type.Get(), 0)))
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Unknown, "Media Foundation decoder refused the output format it offered"sv);
        return available_type;
    }
    return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation decoder offers no output format we can read"sv);
}

DecoderErrorOr<ComPtr<IMFSample>> create_input_sample(ReadonlyBytes data, AK::Duration timestamp, AK::Duration duration)
{
    ComPtr<IMFMediaBuffer> buffer;
    if (FAILED(MFCreateMemoryBuffer(static_cast<DWORD>(data.size()), &buffer)))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to allocate a Media Foundation buffer"sv);
    BYTE* buffer_data = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(buffer->Lock(&buffer_data, nullptr, nullptr)))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to lock a Media Foundation buffer"sv);
    data.copy_to({ buffer_data, data.size() });
    buffer->Unlock();
    buffer->SetCurrentLength(static_cast<DWORD>(data.size()));

    ComPtr<IMFSample> sample;
    if (FAILED(MFCreateSample(&sample)) || FAILED(sample->AddBuffer(buffer.Get())))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to allocate a Media Foundation sample"sv);
    sample->SetSampleTime(sample_time_from_duration(timestamp));
    sample->SetSampleDuration(sample_time_from_duration(duration));
    return sample;
}

DecoderErrorOr<OutputStreamInfo> output_stream_info(IMFTransform& transform)
{
    MFT_OUTPUT_STREAM_INFO stream_info {};
    if (FAILED(transform.GetOutputStreamInfo(0, &stream_info)))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Unknown, "Media Foundation decoder did not describe its output stream"sv);
    return OutputStreamInfo {
        .transform_provides_samples = (stream_info.dwFlags & (MFT_OUTPUT_STREAM_PROVIDES_SAMPLES | MFT_OUTPUT_STREAM_CAN_PROVIDE_SAMPLES)) != 0,
        .sample_byte_count = stream_info.cbSize,
        .sample_alignment = stream_info.cbAlignment,
    };
}

DecoderErrorOr<ProcessedOutput> process_output(IMFTransform& transform, Optional<OutputStreamInfo> const& stream_info)
{
    while (true) {
        ComPtr<IMFSample> allocated_sample;
        if (stream_info.has_value() && !stream_info->transform_provides_samples) {
            ComPtr<IMFMediaBuffer> buffer;
            auto buffer_result = stream_info->sample_alignment > 1
                ? MFCreateAlignedMemoryBuffer(stream_info->sample_byte_count, stream_info->sample_alignment - 1, &buffer)
                : MFCreateMemoryBuffer(stream_info->sample_byte_count, &buffer);
            if (FAILED(buffer_result) || FAILED(MFCreateSample(&allocated_sample)) || FAILED(allocated_sample->AddBuffer(buffer.Get())))
                return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to allocate a Media Foundation output sample"sv);
        }

        MFT_OUTPUT_DATA_BUFFER output_buffer {};
        output_buffer.dwStreamID = 0;
        output_buffer.pSample = allocated_sample.Get();
        DWORD status = 0;
        auto result = transform.ProcessOutput(0, 1, &output_buffer, &status);
        if (output_buffer.pEvents != nullptr)
            output_buffer.pEvents->Release();

        if (result == MF_E_TRANSFORM_NEED_MORE_INPUT)
            return NeedsMoreInput {};
        if (result == MF_E_TRANSFORM_STREAM_CHANGE || result == MF_E_TRANSFORM_TYPE_NOT_SET)
            return OutputTypeNeeded {};
        if (FAILED(result))
            return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "Media Foundation decoder failed to produce output with result {:#x}", static_cast<u32>(result));

        ComPtr<IMFSample> sample;
        if (allocated_sample)
            sample = move(allocated_sample);
        else
            sample.Attach(output_buffer.pSample);
        if (sample)
            return sample;
    }
}

}

// What the transform's output stream currently produces, which can change between any two frames.
struct OutputFormat {
    GUID subtype { GUID_NULL };
    u8 bit_depth { 8 };
    // The buffers are padded out to the decoder's block size, and the aperture is the part that is displayed.
    Gfx::Size<u32> frame_size;
    Gfx::Point<u32> aperture_offset;
    Gfx::Size<u32> aperture_size;
    i32 default_stride { 0 };
};

struct WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::DecodedOutput {
    // None marks the end of the stream, after the last frame.
    ComPtr<IMFSample> sample;
    OutputFormat format;
    AK::Duration timestamp;
    AK::Duration duration;
    u64 generation { 0 };
    ColorMetadata high_dynamic_range_metadata;
};

struct WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::Transform {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    ComPtr<IMFTransform> transform;
    OutputFormat output_format;
    // Absent until the transform has accepted an output type.
    Optional<OutputStreamInfo> output_stream_info;
};

class WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData final : public AtomicRefCounted<ThreadData> {
public:
    void set_decode_completed_callback(Function<void(DecodeCompletion)>);
    bool has_any_decode_in_progress() const;

    void enqueue(DecodedOutput);
    void complete_outputs_until_exit();
    // Waits for output still being completed only while draining, when nothing else could wake the caller.
    DecoderErrorOr<DecodedOutput> take_completed_output(bool draining);
    void return_to_front(DecodedOutput);
    void record_failure(DecoderError);
    void discard_outputs();
    void exit();

private:
    Vector<DecodedOutput> take_all_outputs_while_locked();

    mutable Mutex m_mutex;
    ConditionVariable m_condition { m_mutex };
    // Media Foundation hands frames back in presentation order, once nothing decoded later could precede them.
    Queue<DecodedOutput> m_awaiting_completion;
    bool m_output_is_completing { false };
    Vector<DecodedOutput> m_completed;
    Optional<DecoderError> m_decode_failure;
    bool m_completed_end_of_stream { false };
    bool m_caller_is_waiting_for_output { false };
    bool m_should_exit { false };
    u64 m_generation { 0 };
    Function<void(DecodeCompletion)> m_decode_completed_callback;
};

namespace {

Optional<GUID> input_subtype_for_codec(CodecID codec_id)
{
    switch (codec_id) {
    case CodecID::H264:
        return MFVideoFormat_H264;
    case CodecID::H265:
        return MFVideoFormat_HEVC;
    default:
        return {};
    }
}

ComPtr<IMFMediaType> create_input_type(GUID const& subtype, Optional<Gfx::Size<u32>> coded_size)
{
    ComPtr<IMFMediaType> type;
    if (FAILED(MFCreateMediaType(&type)))
        return nullptr;
    if (FAILED(type->SetGUID(MF_MT_MAJOR_TYPE, MFMediaType_Video)))
        return nullptr;
    if (FAILED(type->SetGUID(MF_MT_SUBTYPE, subtype)))
        return nullptr;
    if (FAILED(type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_INTERLACE_MODE, MFVideoInterlace_MixedInterlaceOrProgressive)))
        return nullptr;
    if (coded_size.has_value() && FAILED(MFSetAttributeSize(type.Get(), MF_MT_FRAME_SIZE, coded_size->width(), coded_size->height())))
        return nullptr;
    return type;
}

// The HEVC decoder refuses to produce any output format, or to take input, until it is told the picture size.
Optional<Gfx::Size<u32>> coded_size_from_configuration(CodecID codec_id, ReadonlyBytes configuration)
{
    if (codec_id != CodecID::H265)
        return {};
    auto sets = Codecs::H265::parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(configuration);
    if (!sets.has_value())
        return {};
    for (auto nal_unit : sets->sequence) {
        auto sequence_set = Codecs::H265::parse_sequence_parameter_set(nal_unit);
        if (sequence_set.has_value())
            return Gfx::Size<u32> { sequence_set->pic_width_in_luma_samples, sequence_set->pic_height_in_luma_samples };
    }
    return {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<ComPtr<IMFTransform>> create_transform(CodecID codec_id, Optional<Gfx::Size<u32>> coded_size = {})
{
    auto subtype = input_subtype_for_codec(codec_id);
    if (!subtype.has_value())
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Media Foundation has no decoder for codec {}", codec_id);

    auto input_type = create_input_type(*subtype, coded_size);
    if (!input_type)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to create a Media Foundation media type"sv);
    return create_decoder_transform(codec_id, *input_type.Get());
}

bool profile_is_decodable(ParsedCodec const& codec)
{
    switch (codec.codec_id()) {
    case CodecID::H264: {
        auto parameters = codec.h264_parameters();
        if (!parameters.has_value())
            return true;
        auto profile = parameters->profile();
        if (!profile.has_value())
            return false;
        // The decoder Windows ships handles 8-bit 4:2:0 only.
        using Profile = Codecs::H264::Profile;
        return first_is_one_of(*profile, Profile::Baseline, Profile::Main, Profile::High);
    }
    case CodecID::H265: {
        auto parameters = codec.h265_parameters();
        if (!parameters.has_value())
            return true;
        auto profile = parameters->profile();
        if (!profile.has_value())
            return false;
        using Profile = Codecs::H265::Profile;
        return first_is_one_of(*profile, Profile::Main, Profile::Main10);
    }
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

bool output_subtype_is_usable(GUID const& subtype)
{
    return subtype == MFVideoFormat_NV12 || subtype == MFVideoFormat_P010;
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> wait_until_decoded(IMFSample&)
{
    // FIXME: Software decoding produces output synchronously from ProcessOutput. Hardware will require waiting for
    //        a signal that the output buffer is ready to consume.
    return {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> append_annex_b_nal_unit(ByteBuffer& buffer, ReadonlyBytes nal_unit)
{
    static constexpr Array<u8, 4> START_CODE { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
    DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(buffer.try_append(START_CODE.span()));
    DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(buffer.try_append(nal_unit));
    return {};
}

}

Optional<DecoderCapabilities> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::capabilities(ParsedCodec const& codec)
{
    if (!input_subtype_for_codec(codec.codec_id()).has_value())
        return {};
    if (!profile_is_decodable(codec))
        return {};

    // Activating a transform to answer this costs enough that the answer is worth keeping.
    static NeverDestroyed<Mutex> support_mutex;
    static NeverDestroyed<HashMap<u32, bool>> support_by_codec;

    MutexLocker locker { *support_mutex };
    auto is_supported = support_by_codec->ensure(to_underlying(codec.codec_id()), [&] {
        return !create_transform(codec.codec_id()).is_error();
    });
    if (!is_supported)
        return {};
    return DecoderCapabilities { .smooth = true, .power_efficient = false };
}

DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder>> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::try_create(CodecID codec_id, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data)
{
    auto transform = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(adopt_nonnull_own_or_enomem(new (nothrow) Transform));
    transform->transform = TRY(create_transform(codec_id, coded_size_from_configuration(codec_id, codec_initialization_data)));
    auto thread_data = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(try_make_ref_counted<ThreadData>());

    auto frame_pool_result = VideoFramePool::create();
    if (frame_pool_result.is_error())
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to create a video frame pool: {}", frame_pool_result.release_error());

    auto decoder = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(adopt_nonnull_own_or_enomem(new (nothrow) WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder(codec_id, codec_initialization_data, move(transform), thread_data, frame_pool_result.release_value())));
    TRY(decoder->apply_codec_configuration(codec_initialization_data));
    // Some decoders refuse every output format until they have seen input, so this is retried when they ask.
    (void)decoder->negotiate_output_format();

    auto thread = DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(Threading::Thread::try_create("MFDecode"sv, [thread_data] -> intptr_t {
        thread_data->complete_outputs_until_exit();
        return 0;
    }));
    thread->start();
    thread->detach();
    return decoder;
}

WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder(CodecID codec_id, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data, NonnullOwnPtr<Transform> transform, NonnullRefPtr<ThreadData> thread_data, NonnullRefPtr<VideoFramePool> frame_pool)
    : m_codec_id(codec_id)
    , m_transform(move(transform))
    , m_thread_data(move(thread_data))
    , m_frame_pool(move(frame_pool))
    , m_high_dynamic_range_metadata_tracker(codec_id, codec_initialization_data)
{
}

WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::~WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder()
{
    m_thread_data->exit();

    if (m_transform->output_stream_info.has_value())
        m_transform->transform->ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_NOTIFY_END_STREAMING, 0);
    m_frame_pool->shed_storage();
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::apply_codec_configuration(ReadonlyBytes configuration)
{
    if (configuration.is_empty())
        return {};

    m_annex_b_parameter_sets.clear();
    auto append_all = [&](auto const& nal_units) -> DecoderErrorOr<void> {
        for (auto nal_unit : nal_units)
            TRY(append_annex_b_nal_unit(m_annex_b_parameter_sets, nal_unit));
        return {};
    };

    switch (m_codec_id) {
    case CodecID::H264: {
        auto sets = Codecs::H264::parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(configuration);
        if (!sets.has_value())
            return DecoderError::corrupted("Invalid H.264 configuration record"sv);
        m_nal_unit_length_size = sets->nal_unit_length_size;
        TRY(append_all(sets->sequence));
        TRY(append_all(sets->picture));
        return {};
    }
    case CodecID::H265: {
        auto sets = Codecs::H265::parse_parameter_sets_from_configuration_record(configuration);
        if (!sets.has_value())
            return DecoderError::corrupted("Invalid H.265 configuration record"sv);
        m_nal_unit_length_size = sets->nal_unit_length_size;
        TRY(append_all(sets->video));
        TRY(append_all(sets->sequence));
        TRY(append_all(sets->picture));
        return {};
    }
    default:
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }
}

DecoderErrorOr<ByteBuffer> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::annex_b_access_unit_for(CodedFrame const& coded_frame)
{
    ByteBuffer access_unit;
    if (coded_frame.is_keyframe())
        DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(access_unit.try_append(m_annex_b_parameter_sets));
    DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(access_unit.try_ensure_capacity(access_unit.size() + coded_frame.data().size()));

    Codecs::NALUnitIterator iterator { coded_frame.data(), m_nal_unit_length_size };
    for (auto nal_unit = iterator.next(); nal_unit.has_value(); nal_unit = iterator.next())
        TRY(append_annex_b_nal_unit(access_unit, *nal_unit));
    if (iterator.has_error())
        return DecoderError::corrupted("Invalid NAL unit length"sv);
    return access_unit;
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::receive_coded_data(CodedFrame const& coded_frame, DecodeIntent intent)
{
    if (m_draining)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "Media Foundation decoder has been drained"sv);

    if (auto configuration = coded_frame.new_codec_configuration(); configuration.has_value())
        TRY(apply_codec_configuration(*configuration));

    auto access_unit = TRY(annex_b_access_unit_for(coded_frame));
    auto const& high_dynamic_range_metadata = m_high_dynamic_range_metadata_tracker.apply_coded_frame(coded_frame);

    auto sample = TRY(create_input_sample(access_unit, coded_frame.presentation_timestamp(), coded_frame.duration()));
    auto sample_time = sample_time_from_duration(coded_frame.presentation_timestamp());
    if (coded_frame.is_keyframe())
        sample->SetUINT32(MFSampleExtension_CleanPoint, TRUE);
    if (m_next_input_is_discontinuous)
        sample->SetUINT32(MFSampleExtension_Discontinuity, TRUE);

    auto submitted_frame = SubmittedFrame { sample_time, coded_frame.presentation_timestamp(), coded_frame.duration(), intent, high_dynamic_range_metadata };
    auto insertion_index = m_submitted_frames.size();
    while (insertion_index > 0 && m_submitted_frames[insertion_index - 1].sample_time > sample_time)
        insertion_index--;
    DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(m_submitted_frames.try_insert(insertion_index, submitted_frame));

    auto& transform = *m_transform->transform.Get();
    auto result = transform.ProcessInput(0, sample.Get(), 0);
    if (result == MF_E_NOTACCEPTING) {
        // The transform takes no more input until the output it is holding has been taken.
        TRY(collect_available_outputs());
        result = transform.ProcessInput(0, sample.Get(), 0);
    }
    if (FAILED(result)) {
        // Collecting output may have retired frames ahead of this one.
        if (auto index = index_of_submitted_frame(sample_time); index.has_value())
            m_submitted_frames.remove(*index);
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "Media Foundation decoder rejected a frame with result {:#x}", static_cast<u32>(result));
    }
    m_next_input_is_discontinuous = false;

    // Frames start completing as soon as the transform hands them out.
    return collect_available_outputs();
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::signal_end_of_stream()
{
    auto& transform = *m_transform->transform.Get();
    transform.ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_NOTIFY_END_OF_STREAM, 0);
    transform.ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_COMMAND_DRAIN, 0);
    m_draining = true;

    if (auto collected = collect_available_outputs(); collected.is_error())
        m_thread_data->record_failure(collected.release_error());
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::negotiate_output_format()
{
    auto& transform = *m_transform->transform.Get();
    auto output_type = TRY(set_first_acceptable_output_type(transform, output_subtype_is_usable));
    GUID subtype = GUID_NULL;
    output_type->GetGUID(MF_MT_SUBTYPE, &subtype);

    OutputFormat format;
    format.subtype = subtype;
    format.bit_depth = subtype == MFVideoFormat_P010 ? 10 : 8;

    UINT32 width = 0;
    UINT32 height = 0;
    if (SUCCEEDED(MFGetAttributeSize(output_type.Get(), MF_MT_FRAME_SIZE, &width, &height)))
        format.frame_size = { width, height };
    format.aperture_size = format.frame_size;

    MFVideoArea aperture {};
    if (SUCCEEDED(output_type->GetBlob(MF_MT_MINIMUM_DISPLAY_APERTURE, reinterpret_cast<UINT8*>(&aperture), sizeof(aperture), nullptr))) {
        auto offset_x = max(aperture.OffsetX.value, 0);
        auto offset_y = max(aperture.OffsetY.value, 0);
        auto aperture_width = min<u32>(aperture.Area.cx, format.frame_size.width() - min<u32>(offset_x, format.frame_size.width()));
        auto aperture_height = min<u32>(aperture.Area.cy, format.frame_size.height() - min<u32>(offset_y, format.frame_size.height()));
        format.aperture_offset = { static_cast<u32>(offset_x), static_cast<u32>(offset_y) };
        format.aperture_size = { aperture_width, aperture_height };
    }

    UINT32 default_stride = 0;
    if (SUCCEEDED(output_type->GetUINT32(MF_MT_DEFAULT_STRIDE, &default_stride)))
        format.default_stride = static_cast<i32>(default_stride);

    auto stream_info = TRY(output_stream_info(transform));
    m_transform->output_format = format;

    // The HEVC decoder crashes if told that streaming begins before it has an output format.
    auto was_streaming = m_transform->output_stream_info.has_value();
    m_transform->output_stream_info = stream_info;
    if (!was_streaming) {
        if (FAILED(transform.ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_NOTIFY_BEGIN_STREAMING, 0)) || FAILED(transform.ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_NOTIFY_START_OF_STREAM, 0)))
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Unknown, "Media Foundation decoder refused to start streaming"sv);
    }
    return {};
}

DecoderErrorOr<void> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::collect_available_outputs()
{
    while (true) {
        auto output = TRY(process_output(*m_transform->transform.Get(), m_transform->output_stream_info));
        if (output.has<NeedsMoreInput>()) {
            // A draining transform that wants input has handed out everything it had.
            if (m_draining && !m_drained) {
                m_drained = true;
                m_thread_data->enqueue({});
            }
            return {};
        }
        if (output.has<OutputTypeNeeded>()) {
            TRY(negotiate_output_format());
            continue;
        }

        auto sample = move(output.get<ComPtr<IMFSample>>());
        LONGLONG sample_time = 0;
        LONGLONG sample_duration = 0;
        sample->GetSampleTime(&sample_time);
        sample->GetSampleDuration(&sample_duration);

        auto submitted_frame_index = index_of_submitted_frame(sample_time);
        auto submitted_frame = SubmittedFrame {
            .sample_time = sample_time,
            .timestamp = duration_from_sample_time(sample_time),
            .duration = duration_from_sample_time(sample_duration),
        };
        if (submitted_frame_index.has_value())
            submitted_frame = m_submitted_frames[*submitted_frame_index];
        retire_submitted_frames_through(submitted_frame_index);
        if (submitted_frame.intent == DecodeIntent::Reference)
            continue;

        DecodedOutput decoded_output;
        decoded_output.sample = move(sample);
        decoded_output.format = m_transform->output_format;
        decoded_output.timestamp = submitted_frame.timestamp;
        decoded_output.duration = submitted_frame.duration;
        decoded_output.high_dynamic_range_metadata = submitted_frame.high_dynamic_range_metadata;
        m_thread_data->enqueue(move(decoded_output));
    }
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::set_decode_completed_callback(Function<void(DecodeCompletion)> callback)
{
    m_thread_data->set_decode_completed_callback(move(callback));
}

bool WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::has_any_decode_in_progress() const
{
    return m_thread_data->has_any_decode_in_progress();
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::set_decode_completed_callback(Function<void(DecodeCompletion)> callback)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    m_decode_completed_callback = move(callback);
}

bool WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::has_any_decode_in_progress() const
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    if (!m_awaiting_completion.is_empty() || m_output_is_completing)
        return true;
    return !m_completed.is_empty() || m_decode_failure.has_value();
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::enqueue(DecodedOutput output)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    output.generation = m_generation;
    m_awaiting_completion.enqueue(move(output));
    m_condition.broadcast();
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::complete_outputs_until_exit()
{
    while (true) {
        DecodedOutput output;
        {
            MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
            while (m_awaiting_completion.is_empty() && !m_should_exit)
                m_condition.wait();
            if (m_should_exit)
                return;
            output = m_awaiting_completion.dequeue();
            m_output_is_completing = true;
        }

        DecoderErrorOr<void> decoded = {};
        if (output.sample)
            decoded = wait_until_decoded(*output.sample.Get());

        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        if (m_should_exit)
            return;
        m_output_is_completing = false;
        auto completion = DecodeCompletion::ProducedNothing;
        if (output.generation == m_generation) {
            if (!output.sample)
                m_completed_end_of_stream = true;
            else if (decoded.is_error())
                m_decode_failure = decoded.release_error();
            else
                m_completed.append(move(output));
            completion = DecodeCompletion::ProducedOutput;
        }
        auto caller_needs_waking = completion == DecodeCompletion::ProducedOutput || m_awaiting_completion.is_empty();
        if (caller_needs_waking && !m_caller_is_waiting_for_output && m_decode_completed_callback)
            m_decode_completed_callback(completion);
        m_condition.broadcast();
    }
}

DecoderErrorOr<WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::DecodedOutput> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::take_completed_output(bool draining)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    while (m_completed.is_empty()) {
        if (m_decode_failure.has_value())
            return m_decode_failure.release_value();
        if (m_completed_end_of_stream)
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::EndOfStream, "Media Foundation decoder has been drained"sv);
        if (!draining)
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NeedsMoreInput, "Media Foundation decoder has no finished frame to hand out"sv);

        m_caller_is_waiting_for_output = true;
        m_condition.wait();
        m_caller_is_waiting_for_output = false;
    }
    return m_completed.take_first();
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::return_to_front(DecodedOutput output)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    m_completed.prepend(move(output));
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::record_failure(DecoderError error)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    if (!m_decode_failure.has_value())
        m_decode_failure = move(error);
}

Vector<WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::DecodedOutput> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::take_all_outputs_while_locked()
{
    auto outputs = move(m_completed);
    while (!m_awaiting_completion.is_empty())
        outputs.append(m_awaiting_completion.dequeue());
    return outputs;
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::discard_outputs()
{
    // The stale samples are released after the lock, which the completion thread waits on.
    Vector<DecodedOutput> stale_outputs;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        m_generation++;
        stale_outputs = take_all_outputs_while_locked();
        m_decode_failure.clear();
        m_completed_end_of_stream = false;
    }
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::ThreadData::exit()
{
    Vector<DecodedOutput> stale_outputs;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        m_should_exit = true;
        stale_outputs = take_all_outputs_while_locked();
        m_condition.broadcast();
    }
}

Optional<size_t> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::index_of_submitted_frame(i64 sample_time) const
{
    for (size_t index = 0; index < m_submitted_frames.size(); index++) {
        if (m_submitted_frames[index].sample_time == sample_time)
            return index;
    }
    return {};
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::retire_submitted_frames_through(Optional<size_t> index)
{
    // Frames come out in presentation order, so any earlier one still waiting was dropped by the decoder.
    if (index.has_value())
        m_submitted_frames.remove(0, *index + 1);
}

DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::take_next_output(ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata, [[maybe_unused]] Optional<AK::Duration> target)
{
    TRY(collect_available_outputs());

    auto output = TRY(m_thread_data->take_completed_output(m_draining));

    // Only this thread takes outputs or flushes, so a frame that cannot go out yet can go back to the front.
    auto frame = copy_output_into_frame_pool(output, container_color_metadata);
    if (frame.is_error())
        m_thread_data->return_to_front(move(output));
    return frame;
}

DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::copy_output_into_frame_pool(DecodedOutput const& output, ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata)
{
    auto const& format = output.format;
    auto subsampling = Subsampling::yuv420();
    auto size = format.aperture_size.to_type<int>();

    auto layout_result = frame_plane_layout(size, format.bit_depth, subsampling);
    if (layout_result.is_error())
        return DecoderError::format(DecoderErrorCategory::Invalid, "Failed to compute video frame plane layout: {}", layout_result.release_error());
    auto layout = layout_result.release_value();

    auto acquired_slot = m_frame_pool->try_acquire(layout.total_byte_count);
    if (!acquired_slot.has_value())
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::TryAgain, "Every video frame slot is held elsewhere"sv);

    ComPtr<IMFMediaBuffer> buffer;
    if (FAILED(output.sample->ConvertToContiguousBuffer(&buffer)))
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to read a Media Foundation output sample"sv);

    BYTE* scanline_zero = nullptr;
    LONG pitch = 0;
    DWORD buffer_length = 0;
    ComPtr<IMF2DBuffer> buffer_2d;
    bool locked_2d = SUCCEEDED(buffer.As(&buffer_2d)) && SUCCEEDED(buffer_2d->Lock2D(&scanline_zero, &pitch));
    if (!locked_2d) {
        if (FAILED(buffer->Lock(&scanline_zero, nullptr, &buffer_length)))
            return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Memory, "Failed to lock a Media Foundation output buffer"sv);
        auto component_size = format.bit_depth > 8 ? 2 : 1;
        pitch = format.default_stride != 0 ? format.default_stride : static_cast<LONG>(format.frame_size.width() * component_size);
    }
    ScopeGuard unlock_buffer = [&] {
        if (locked_2d)
            buffer_2d->Unlock2D();
        else
            buffer->Unlock();
    };

    if (pitch <= 0)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::NotImplemented, "Bottom-up Media Foundation output is not supported"sv);

    // Each line holds one luma sample, or one interleaved pair of chroma samples, for every column.
    size_t const component_size = format.bit_depth > 8 ? 2 : 1;
    size_t const source_pitch = pitch;
    size_t const chroma_plane_offset = source_pitch * format.frame_size.height();
    auto const chroma_size = subsampling.subsampled_size(format.aperture_size);
    auto const chroma_offset = Gfx::Point<u32> { format.aperture_offset.x() / 2, format.aperture_offset.y() / 2 };
    size_t const required_length = chroma_plane_offset + source_pitch * (chroma_offset.y() + chroma_size.height());
    if (!locked_2d && buffer_length < required_length)
        return DecoderError::with_description(DecoderErrorCategory::Corrupted, "Media Foundation output buffer is too small for its format"sv);

    auto bytes = acquired_slot->bytes;
    auto y_plane = bytes.slice(0, layout.y_size);
    auto u_plane = bytes.slice(layout.u_offset, layout.u_size);
    auto v_plane = bytes.slice(layout.v_offset, layout.v_size);

    // P010 keeps its 10 bits in the high end of each 16-bit sample, while our frames keep them in the low end.
    auto const sample_shift = format.bit_depth > 8 ? 16 - format.bit_depth : 0;
    auto copy_sample = [&](u8 const* source, u8* destination) {
        if (component_size == 1) {
            *destination = *source;
            return;
        }
        u16 value;
        memcpy(&value, source, sizeof(value));
        value >>= sample_shift;
        memcpy(destination, &value, sizeof(value));
    };

    auto const luma_line_size = format.aperture_size.width() * component_size;
    for (u32 row = 0; row < format.aperture_size.height(); row++) {
        auto const* source = scanline_zero + source_pitch * (format.aperture_offset.y() + row) + format.aperture_offset.x() * component_size;
        auto* destination = y_plane.offset_pointer(row * luma_line_size);
        if (sample_shift == 0) {
            memcpy(destination, source, luma_line_size);
            continue;
        }
        for (u32 column = 0; column < format.aperture_size.width(); column++)
            copy_sample(source + column * component_size, destination + column * component_size);
    }

    auto const chroma_line_size = chroma_size.width() * component_size;
    for (u32 row = 0; row < chroma_size.height(); row++) {
        auto const* source = scanline_zero + chroma_plane_offset + source_pitch * (chroma_offset.y() + row) + chroma_offset.x() * 2 * component_size;
        auto* u_destination = u_plane.offset_pointer(row * chroma_line_size);
        auto* v_destination = v_plane.offset_pointer(row * chroma_line_size);
        for (u32 column = 0; column < chroma_size.width(); column++) {
            copy_sample(source + (column * 2) * component_size, u_destination + column * component_size);
            copy_sample(source + (column * 2 + 1) * component_size, v_destination + column * component_size);
        }
    }

    auto color_metadata = container_color_metadata;
    color_metadata.adopt_specified_values(output.high_dynamic_range_metadata);
    return DECODER_TRY_ALLOC(try_make_ref_counted<VideoFrame>(output.timestamp, output.duration, format.aperture_size, format.bit_depth, subsampling, move(color_metadata), acquired_slot->storage));
}

void WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder::flush()
{
    m_transform->transform->ProcessMessage(MFT_MESSAGE_COMMAND_FLUSH, 0);
    m_submitted_frames.clear();
    m_high_dynamic_range_metadata_tracker.forget_stream();
    m_draining = false;
    m_drained = false;
    m_next_input_is_discontinuous = true;
    m_thread_data->discard_outputs();
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecID.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/CodecParameters.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Codecs/HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/DecoderCapabilities.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/Export.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoDecoder.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/VideoFramePool.h>

namespace Media::WindowsMediaFoundation {

// Decodes the codecs we cannot ship decoders for through the ones Windows provides as Media Foundation transforms. A
// transform can hand out a frame before it has finished decoding, so a thread of the decoder's own waits for each one
// to finish and hands it out.
class MEDIACODECS_API WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder final : public VideoDecoder {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static Optional<DecoderCapabilities> capabilities(ParsedCodec const&);
    static DecoderErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder>> try_create(CodecID, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data);

    virtual ~WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder() override;

    virtual void set_storage_freed_callback(Function<void()> callback) override { m_frame_pool->set_slot_freed_callback(move(callback)); }
    virtual void set_decode_completed_callback(Function<void(DecodeCompletion)>) override;
    virtual bool has_any_decode_in_progress() const override;

    virtual DecoderErrorOr<void> receive_coded_data(CodedFrame const&, DecodeIntent) override;
    virtual void signal_end_of_stream() override;
    virtual DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> take_next_output(ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata, Optional<AK::Duration> target = {}) override;
    virtual void flush() override;

private:
    // These hold everything that names a Media Foundation type, so that the Windows headers stay out of this one.
    struct Transform;
    struct DecodedOutput;
    // Shared with the completion thread, which can outlive the decoder while it finishes waiting on a frame.
    class ThreadData;

    struct SubmittedFrame {
        i64 sample_time { 0 };
        AK::Duration timestamp;
        AK::Duration duration;
        DecodeIntent intent { DecodeIntent::Output };
        ColorMetadata high_dynamic_range_metadata {};
    };

    WindowsMediaFoundationVideoDecoder(CodecID, ReadonlyBytes codec_initialization_data, NonnullOwnPtr<Transform>, NonnullRefPtr<ThreadData>, NonnullRefPtr<VideoFramePool>);

    DecoderErrorOr<void> apply_codec_configuration(ReadonlyBytes);
    DecoderErrorOr<ByteBuffer> annex_b_access_unit_for(CodedFrame const&);

    DecoderErrorOr<void> collect_available_outputs();
    DecoderErrorOr<void> negotiate_output_format();
    Optional<size_t> index_of_submitted_frame(i64 sample_time) const;
    void retire_submitted_frames_through(Optional<size_t> index);

    DecoderErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<VideoFrame>> copy_output_into_frame_pool(DecodedOutput const&, ColorMetadata const& container_color_metadata);

    CodecID const m_codec_id;
    NonnullOwnPtr<Transform> m_transform;
    NonnullRefPtr<ThreadData> m_thread_data;
    NonnullRefPtr<VideoFramePool> m_frame_pool;

    u8 m_nal_unit_length_size { 4 };
    // The transform never sees the configuration record, so its parameter sets are sent ahead of each keyframe.
    ByteBuffer m_annex_b_parameter_sets;
    Codecs::HighDynamicRangeMetadataTracker m_high_dynamic_range_metadata_tracker;

    // Ordered by sample time, which is how the transform hands frames back.
    Vector<SubmittedFrame> m_submitted_frames;
    bool m_draining { false };
    bool m_drained { false };
    // Input only resumes after a drain through a flush, and the transform expects the first sample after either to be
    // marked as following a gap.
    bool m_next_input_is_discontinuous { false };
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibPlatformFeatures/Build.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Assertions.h>
#include <AK/Platform.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/Feature.h>

namespace PlatformFeatures {

// What a build of Ladybird can do, which decides the features that exist in it at all. CMake picks the code only some
// builds can compile, and everything else asks this_build.
struct Build {
    // The Compositor paints through Vulkan, on the GPU the system probe describes.
    bool paints_through_vulkan { false };
    // Vulkan images are shared between processes as dma-bufs.
    bool shares_vulkan_images { false };
    // H.264 and HEVC can be decoded through an FFmpeg the system has, rather than the bundled one.
    bool has_system_ffmpeg { false };

    // Video decoded through Vulkan reaches the Compositor as shared images.
    constexpr bool decodes_video_through_vulkan() const { return shares_vulkan_images; }

    constexpr bool includes(Feature feature) const
    {
        switch (feature) {
        case Feature::GpuPainting:
            return true;
        case Feature::YCbCrImport:
            return shares_vulkan_images;
        case Feature::VulkanVideo:
        case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpeg:
        case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegDirectExport:
        case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegVP9:
        case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1:
        case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1KeepSequenceHeaderEnableRefMVsFlag:
            return decodes_video_through_vulkan();
        case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpeg:
        case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegDirectExport:
        case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH264:
        case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH265:
            return decodes_video_through_vulkan() && has_system_ffmpeg;
        }
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }

    // A build with every feature, so that tests can decide them all on any platform.
    static constexpr Build with_every_feature()
    {
        return { .paints_through_vulkan = true, .shares_vulkan_images = true, .has_system_ffmpeg = true };
    }
};

namespace Detail {

#ifdef USE_VULKAN
constexpr bool paints_through_vulkan = true;
#else
constexpr bool paints_through_vulkan = false;
#endif

#ifdef USE_VULKAN_DMABUF_IMAGES
constexpr bool shares_vulkan_images = true;
#else
constexpr bool shares_vulkan_images = false;
#endif

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX) && !defined(AK_OS_ANDROID)
constexpr bool has_system_ffmpeg = true;
#else
constexpr bool has_system_ffmpeg = false;
#endif

}

constexpr Build this_build {
    .paints_through_vulkan = Detail::paints_through_vulkan,
    .shares_vulkan_images = Detail::shares_vulkan_images,
    .has_system_ffmpeg = Detail::has_system_ffmpeg,
};

}

#include <LibPlatformFeatures/Feature.h>

namespace PlatformFeatures {

StringView feature_id(Feature feature)
{
    switch (feature) {
    case Feature::GpuPainting:
        return "gpu_painting"sv;
    case Feature::YCbCrImport:
        return "ycbcr_import"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideo:
        return "vulkan_video"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpeg:
        return "vulkan_video.bundled_ffmpeg"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegDirectExport:
        return "vulkan_video.bundled_ffmpeg.direct_export"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegVP9:
        return "vulkan_video.bundled_ffmpeg.vp9"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1:
        return "vulkan_video.bundled_ffmpeg.av1"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1KeepSequenceHeaderEnableRefMVsFlag:
        return "vulkan_video.bundled_ffmpeg.av1.keep_sequence_header_enable_ref_mvs_flag"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpeg:
        return "vulkan_video.system_ffmpeg"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegDirectExport:
        return "vulkan_video.system_ffmpeg.direct_export"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH264:
        return "vulkan_video.system_ffmpeg.h264"sv;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH265:
        return "vulkan_video.system_ffmpeg.h265"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

Optional<Feature> feature_from_id(StringView id)
{
    for (auto feature : all_features) {
        if (feature_id(feature) == id)
            return feature;
    }
    return {};
}

FeatureProcess process_of(Feature feature)
{
    switch (feature) {
    case Feature::GpuPainting:
    case Feature::YCbCrImport:
        return FeatureProcess::Compositor;
    case Feature::VulkanVideo:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpeg:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegDirectExport:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegVP9:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1KeepSequenceHeaderEnableRefMVsFlag:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpeg:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegDirectExport:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH264:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH265:
        return FeatureProcess::VideoDecoderServer;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

Optional<Feature> dependency_of(Feature feature)
{
    switch (feature) {
    case Feature::GpuPainting:
        return {};
    case Feature::YCbCrImport:
        return Feature::GpuPainting;
    case Feature::VulkanVideo:
        return Feature::YCbCrImport;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpeg:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpeg:
        return Feature::VulkanVideo;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegDirectExport:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegVP9:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1:
        return Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpeg;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1KeepSequenceHeaderEnableRefMVsFlag:
        return Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1;
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegDirectExport:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH264:
    case Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH265:
        return Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpeg;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

StringView process_name(FeatureProcess process)
{
    switch (process) {
    case FeatureProcess::Compositor:
        return "Compositor"sv;
    case FeatureProcess::VideoDecoderServer:
        return "VideoDecoderServer"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

#pragma once

namespace PlatformFeatures {

// The process that uses a feature, and the only one told whether it is enabled.
enum class FeatureProcess : u8 {
    Compositor,
    VideoDecoderServer,
};

// A feature is only enabled while the feature it depends on is, so each one is declared after its dependency.
enum class Feature : u8 {
    GpuPainting,
    YCbCrImport,
    VulkanVideo,
    VulkanVideoBundledFFmpeg,
    VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegDirectExport,
    VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegVP9,
    VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1,
    VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1KeepSequenceHeaderEnableRefMVsFlag,
    VulkanVideoSystemFFmpeg,
    VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegDirectExport,
    VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH264,
    VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH265,
};

constexpr Array all_features {
    Feature::GpuPainting,
    Feature::YCbCrImport,
    Feature::VulkanVideo,
    Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpeg,
    Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegDirectExport,
    Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegVP9,
    Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1,
    Feature::VulkanVideoBundledFFmpegAV1KeepSequenceHeaderEnableRefMVsFlag,
    Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpeg,
    Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegDirectExport,
    Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH264,
    Feature::VulkanVideoSystemFFmpegH265,
};

StringView feature_id(Feature);
Optional<Feature> feature_from_id(StringView);
FeatureProcess process_of(Feature);
Optional<Feature> dependency_of(Feature);

StringView process_name(FeatureProcess);

}

FILE: Libraries/LibPlatformFeatures/ProcessFeatures.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <AK/StringBuilder.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/ProcessFeatures.h>

namespace PlatformFeatures {

static NeverDestroyed<Optional<ProcessFeatures>> s_current_process_features;

ErrorOr<ProcessFeatures> ProcessFeatures::from_string(FeatureProcess process, StringView string)
{
    ProcessFeatures features { process };
    for (auto id : string.split_view(',')) {
        auto feature = feature_from_id(id);
        if (!feature.has_value())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Unknown platform feature");
        if (process_of(*feature) != process)
            return Error::from_string_literal("A platform feature was given to a process that does not use it");
        features.set_enabled(*feature);
    }
    return features;
}

ByteString ProcessFeatures::to_byte_string() const
{
    StringBuilder builder;
    for (auto feature : all_features) {
        if (!m_enabled.contains(feature))
            continue;
        if (!builder.is_empty())
            builder.append(',');
        builder.append(feature_id(feature));
    }
    return builder.to_byte_string();
}

bool ProcessFeatures::is_enabled(Feature feature) const
{
    VERIFY(process_of(feature) == m_process);
    return m_enabled.contains(feature);
}

void ProcessFeatures::set_enabled(Feature feature)
{
    VERIFY(process_of(feature) == m_process);
    m_enabled.set(feature);
}

void ProcessFeatures::initialize_for_current_process(ProcessFeatures features)
{
    VERIFY(!s_current_process_features->has_value());
    *s_current_process_features = move(features);
}

ProcessFeatures const& ProcessFeatures::the()
{
    return s_current_process_features->value();
}

}

#pragma once
