namespace PlatformFeatures {

// The features one process may use, decided by the Browser before launching it and fixed for the process's lifetime.
class ProcessFeatures {
public:
    explicit ProcessFeatures(FeatureProcess process)
        : m_process(process)
    {
    }

    // The text form names the enabled features, comma-separated, so that it can be passed as an argument.
    static ErrorOr<ProcessFeatures> from_string(FeatureProcess, StringView);
    ByteString to_byte_string() const;

    bool is_enabled(Feature) const;
    void set_enabled(Feature);

    static void initialize_for_current_process(ProcessFeatures);
    static ProcessFeatures const& the();

private:
    FeatureProcess m_process;
    HashTable<Feature> m_enabled;
};

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/JsonValue.h>
#include <LibPlatformFeatures/SystemFacts.h>

namespace PlatformFeatures {

// Drivers name themselves however they like, so their strings are bounded before they reach reports. Vulkan's are at
// most 255 bytes, each of which may have become a three-byte replacement character.
static constexpr size_t maximum_string_length = 1024;

static JsonObject video_decode_to_json(VideoDecodeFacts const& facts)
{
    JsonObject object;
    object.set("supported"sv, facts.supported);
    object.set("dpb_and_output_coincide"sv, facts.dpb_and_output_coincide);
    object.set("dpb_and_output_distinct"sv, facts.dpb_and_output_distinct);
    object.set("dpb_supports_drm_format_modifiers"sv, facts.dpb_supports_drm_format_modifiers);
    return object;
}

static JsonObject ffmpeg_to_json(FFmpegFacts const& facts)
{
    JsonObject object;
    object.set("avcodec_version"sv, facts.avcodec_version);
    object.set("avutil_version"sv, facts.avutil_version);
    object.set("has_vulkan_decoder_for_its_version"sv, facts.has_vulkan_decoder_for_its_version);
    return object;
}

Optional<StringView> OpenSSLFacts::openssl_version_from_curl_ssl_version(StringView ssl_version)
{
    // MultiSSL builds list every backend and parenthesize the inactive ones, in no particular order.
    for (auto backend : ssl_version.split_view(' ')) {
        if (backend.starts_with("OpenSSL/"sv))
            return backend.substring_view("OpenSSL/"sv.length());
    }
    return {};
}

static JsonObject openssl_to_json(OpenSSLFacts const& facts)
{
    JsonObject object;
    object.set("linked_version"sv, facts.linked_version);
    if (facts.curl_version.has_value())
        object.set("curl_version"sv, *facts.curl_version);
    return object;
}

JsonObject SystemFacts::to_json() const
{
    JsonObject object;
    if (gpu.has_value()) {
        JsonObject gpu_object;
        gpu_object.set("vendor_id"sv, gpu->vendor_id);
        gpu_object.set("device_id"sv, gpu->device_id);
        gpu_object.set("device_name"sv, gpu->device_name);
        gpu_object.set("driver_id"sv, gpu->driver_id);
        gpu_object.set("driver_name"sv, gpu->driver_name);
        gpu_object.set("driver_info"sv, gpu->driver_info);
        gpu_object.set("driver_version"sv, gpu->driver_version);
        gpu_object.set("api_version"sv, gpu->api_version);
        gpu_object.set("device_identity"sv, gpu->device_identity);
        gpu_object.set("supports_ycbcr_sampling"sv, gpu->supports_ycbcr_sampling);
        if (gpu->cannot_decode_video_because.has_value())
            gpu_object.set("cannot_decode_video_because"sv, *gpu->cannot_decode_video_because);
        gpu_object.set("supports_video_maintenance2"sv, gpu->supports_video_maintenance2);
        gpu_object.set("h264"sv, video_decode_to_json(gpu->h264));
        gpu_object.set("h265"sv, video_decode_to_json(gpu->h265));
        gpu_object.set("vp9"sv, video_decode_to_json(gpu->vp9));
        gpu_object.set("av1"sv, video_decode_to_json(gpu->av1));
        object.set("gpu"sv, move(gpu_object));
    }
    if (bundled_ffmpeg.has_value())
        object.set("bundled_ffmpeg"sv, ffmpeg_to_json(*bundled_ffmpeg));
    if (system_ffmpeg.has_value())
        object.set("system_ffmpeg"sv, ffmpeg_to_json(*system_ffmpeg));
    if (openssl.has_value())
        object.set("openssl"sv, openssl_to_json(*openssl));
    return object;
}

static ErrorOr<bool> read_bool(JsonObject const& object, StringView key)
{
    auto value = object.get_bool(key);
    if (!value.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("System facts are missing a boolean");
    return *value;
}

static ErrorOr<u32> read_u32(JsonObject const& object, StringView key)
{
    auto value = object.get_u32(key);
    if (!value.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("System facts are missing a number");
    return *value;
}

static ErrorOr<String> read_string(JsonObject const& object, StringView key)
{
    auto value = object.get_string(key);
    if (!value.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("System facts are missing a string");
    if (value->bytes().size() > maximum_string_length)
        return Error::from_string_literal("A string in the system facts is too long");
    return *value;
}

static ErrorOr<JsonObject const*> read_object(JsonObject const& object, StringView key)
{
    auto value = object.get_object(key);
    if (!value.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("System facts are missing an object");
    return &value.value();
}

static ErrorOr<VideoDecodeFacts> video_decode_from_json(JsonObject const& object)
{
    VideoDecodeFacts facts;
    facts.supported = TRY(read_bool(object, "supported"sv));
    facts.dpb_and_output_coincide = TRY(read_bool(object, "dpb_and_output_coincide"sv));
    facts.dpb_and_output_distinct = TRY(read_bool(object, "dpb_and_output_distinct"sv));
    facts.dpb_supports_drm_format_modifiers = TRY(read_bool(object, "dpb_supports_drm_format_modifiers"sv));
    return facts;
}

static ErrorOr<FFmpegFacts> ffmpeg_from_json(JsonObject const& object)
{
    FFmpegFacts facts;
    facts.avcodec_version = TRY(read_u32(object, "avcodec_version"sv));
    facts.avutil_version = TRY(read_u32(object, "avutil_version"sv));
    facts.has_vulkan_decoder_for_its_version = TRY(read_bool(object, "has_vulkan_decoder_for_its_version"sv));
    return facts;
}

static ErrorOr<OpenSSLFacts> openssl_from_json(JsonObject const& object)
{
    OpenSSLFacts facts;
    facts.linked_version = TRY(read_string(object, "linked_version"sv));
    if (object.has("curl_version"sv))
        facts.curl_version = TRY(read_string(object, "curl_version"sv));
    return facts;
}

ErrorOr<SystemFacts> SystemFacts::from_json(StringView json)
{
    auto value = TRY(JsonValue::from_string(json));
    if (!value.is_object())
        return Error::from_string_literal("System facts are not an object");
    return from_json(value.as_object());
}

ErrorOr<SystemFacts> SystemFacts::from_json(JsonObject const& object)
{
    SystemFacts facts;
    if (object.has("gpu"sv)) {
        auto const& gpu_object = *TRY(read_object(object, "gpu"sv));
        GpuFacts gpu;
        gpu.vendor_id = TRY(read_u32(gpu_object, "vendor_id"sv));
        gpu.device_id = TRY(read_u32(gpu_object, "device_id"sv));
        gpu.device_name = TRY(read_string(gpu_object, "device_name"sv));
        gpu.driver_id = TRY(read_u32(gpu_object, "driver_id"sv));
        gpu.driver_name = TRY(read_string(gpu_object, "driver_name"sv));
        gpu.driver_info = TRY(read_string(gpu_object, "driver_info"sv));
        gpu.driver_version = TRY(read_u32(gpu_object, "driver_version"sv));
        gpu.api_version = TRY(read_u32(gpu_object, "api_version"sv));
        gpu.device_identity = TRY(read_string(gpu_object, "device_identity"sv));
        gpu.supports_ycbcr_sampling = TRY(read_bool(gpu_object, "supports_ycbcr_sampling"sv));
        if (gpu_object.has("cannot_decode_video_because"sv))
            gpu.cannot_decode_video_because = TRY(read_string(gpu_object, "cannot_decode_video_because"sv));
        gpu.supports_video_maintenance2 = TRY(read_bool(gpu_object, "supports_video_maintenance2"sv));
        gpu.h264 = TRY(video_decode_from_json(*TRY(read_object(gpu_object, "h264"sv))));
        gpu.h265 = TRY(video_decode_from_json(*TRY(read_object(gpu_object, "h265"sv))));
        gpu.vp9 = TRY(video_decode_from_json(*TRY(read_object(gpu_object, "vp9"sv))));
        gpu.av1 = TRY(video_decode_from_json(*TRY(read_object(gpu_object, "av1"sv))));
        facts.gpu = move(gpu);
    }
    if (object.has("bundled_ffmpeg"sv))
        facts.bundled_ffmpeg = TRY(ffmpeg_from_json(*TRY(read_object(object, "bundled_ffmpeg"sv))));
    if (object.has("system_ffmpeg"sv))
        facts.system_ffmpeg = TRY(ffmpeg_from_json(*TRY(read_object(object, "system_ffmpeg"sv))));
    if (object.has("openssl"sv))
        facts.openssl = TRY(openssl_from_json(*TRY(read_object(object, "openssl"sv))));
    return facts;
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibPlatformFeatures/SystemFacts.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/JsonObject.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/String.h>

namespace PlatformFeatures {

// What the GPU can do when decoding one codec through Vulkan, for its most common 8-bit 4:2:0 profile.
struct VideoDecodeFacts {
    bool supported { false };
    // VK_VIDEO_DECODE_CAPABILITY_DPB_AND_OUTPUT_COINCIDE_BIT_KHR and _DISTINCT_BIT_KHR.
    bool dpb_and_output_coincide { false };
    bool dpb_and_output_distinct { false };
    // Whether any format for images used only as references can be tiled under a DRM format modifier.
    bool dpb_supports_drm_format_modifiers { false };

    bool operator==(VideoDecodeFacts const&) const = default;
};

// The GPU that presents, as Vulkan describes it.
struct GpuFacts {
    u32 vendor_id { 0 };
    u32 device_id { 0 };
    String device_name;
    // VkDriverId, which tells apart drivers for the same vendor's hardware.
    u32 driver_id { 0 };
    String driver_name;
    String driver_info;
    // Encoded by each driver in its own way, so it is only compared alongside the driver ID.
    u32 driver_version { 0 };
    u32 api_version { 0 };
    String device_identity;

    bool supports_ycbcr_sampling { false };
    // Set when the device lacks something decoding through FFmpeg needs.
    Optional<String> cannot_decode_video_because;
    bool supports_video_maintenance2 { false };
    VideoDecodeFacts h264;
    VideoDecodeFacts h265;
    VideoDecodeFacts vp9;
    VideoDecodeFacts av1;

    bool operator==(GpuFacts const&) const = default;
};

struct FFmpegFacts {
    // The libraries' versions are packed like FFmpeg's AV_VERSION_INT.
    static constexpr u32 version(u32 major, u32 minor, u32 micro) { return major << 16 | minor << 8 | micro; }

    u32 avcodec_version { 0 };
    u32 avutil_version { 0 };
    // Whether this build has a Vulkan decoder compiled against headers that match the library's version.
    bool has_vulkan_decoder_for_its_version { false };

    bool operator==(FFmpegFacts const&) const = default;
};

// The OpenSSL that Ladybird links, and the one that curl uses. RequestServer configures curl's SSL_CTX through its own
// OpenSSL, which is only sound when the two are the same library: a system curl can load another one, for instance once
// the system has moved on to a newer OpenSSL than the one Ladybird was built against.
struct OpenSSLFacts {
    // As major.minor.patch, which is how curl names the OpenSSL it uses.
    String linked_version;
    // Empty when curl uses another TLS library.
    Optional<String> curl_version;

    bool operator==(OpenSSLFacts const&) const = default;

    bool curl_uses_another_openssl() const { return curl_version.has_value() && *curl_version != linked_version; }

    // Picks the OpenSSL version out of curl_version_info()'s ssl_version, which names the TLS library curl uses first, as
    // in "OpenSSL/3.5.1" or "OpenSSL/3.5.1 (GnuTLS/3.8.9)". Empty when that library is not OpenSSL.
    static Optional<StringView> openssl_version_from_curl_ssl_version(StringView);
};

// Everything the blocklist decides from, collected by the system probe.
struct SystemFacts {
    Optional<GpuFacts> gpu;
    Optional<FFmpegFacts> bundled_ffmpeg;
    Optional<FFmpegFacts> system_ffmpeg;
    Optional<OpenSSLFacts> openssl;
    // Set instead of the facts when the probe crashed, hung or reported something unreadable. Never serialized.
    Optional<String> probe_failure;

    bool operator==(SystemFacts const&) const = default;

    JsonObject to_json() const;
    static ErrorOr<SystemFacts> from_json(StringView);
    static ErrorOr<SystemFacts> from_json(JsonObject const&);
};

}

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

//! Abstract syntax tree for ECMA-262 regular expressions.
//!
//! The AST is designed to faithfully represent any syntactically valid
//! ECMAScript regex pattern, preserving all information needed for
//! compilation, optimization, and error reporting.
//!
//! The tree lives in a zone (see `ak::Zone`): its lists are slices of the zone and its names are strings of the zone,
//! so the tree has the lifetime `'z` of the zone and is plain data that is copied by value.
//!
//! Spec:
//! - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-patterns>
//! - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-pattern-semantics>

/// A complete parsed regex pattern with its flags.
///
/// Spec model: the `Pattern` grammar goal and the RegExp Record built from it.
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-patterns>
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-regexp-records>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Pattern<'z> {
    pub disjunction: Disjunction<'z>,
    pub flags: Flags,
    /// Total number of capture groups (not counting group 0).
    pub capture_count: u32,
    /// Named capture groups, in order of appearance.
    pub named_groups: &'z [NamedGroup<'z>],
}

/// A named capture group declaration.
///
/// Spec model: a named `GroupSpecifier` that later participates in named
/// backreference resolution.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-patterns>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct NamedGroup<'z> {
    pub name: &'z str,
    pub index: u32,
}

/// Regex flags parsed from the trailing `/flags` portion.
///
/// Spec model: the boolean fields in the RegExp Record that affect parsing and
/// matcher semantics.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-regexp-records>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct Flags {
    pub global: bool,
    pub ignore_case: bool,
    pub multiline: bool,
    pub dot_all: bool,
    pub unicode: bool,
    pub unicode_sets: bool,
    pub sticky: bool,
    pub has_indices: bool,
}

/// A disjunction is a list of alternatives separated by `|`.
///
/// `/a|b|c/` → `Disjunction { alternatives: [a, b, c] }`
///
/// Spec model: `Disjunction`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compilesubpattern>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Disjunction<'z> {
    pub alternatives: &'z [Alternative<'z>],
}

/// An alternative is a sequence of terms matched left-to-right.
///
/// `/abc/` → `Alternative { terms: [a, b, c] }`
///
/// Spec model: `Alternative`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compilesubpattern>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Alternative<'z> {
    pub terms: &'z [Term<'z>],
}

/// A single term in an alternative: an atom optionally followed by a quantifier.
///
/// Spec model: `Term`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compilesubpattern>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Term<'z> {
    pub atom: Atom<'z>,
    pub quantifier: Option<Quantifier>,
}

/// A quantifier specifies repetition of the preceding atom.
///
/// Spec model: the quantifier record produced by `CompileQuantifier`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compilequantifier>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Quantifier {
    pub min: u32,
    pub max: Option<u32>,
    pub greedy: bool,
}

impl Quantifier {
    pub fn zero_or_more(greedy: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            min: 0,
            max: None,
            greedy,
        }
    }

    pub fn one_or_more(greedy: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            min: 1,
            max: None,
            greedy,
        }
    }

    pub fn zero_or_one(greedy: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            min: 0,
            max: Some(1),
            greedy,
        }
    }
}

/// An atom is the fundamental matching unit.
///
/// Spec model: `Atom` and `AtomEscape`, plus assertion-like terms that are
/// represented as dedicated AST variants for easier downstream handling.
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileatom>
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileassertion>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Atom<'z> {
    /// A literal character (as a u32 code point, to support WTF-16 lone surrogates).
    /// `/a/` → `Literal(0x61)`
    Literal(u32),

    /// `.` — matches any character (except newline, unless `dot_all`).
    Dot,

    /// A character class like `[a-z]` or `[^0-9]`.
    CharacterClass(CharacterClass<'z>),

    /// A built-in character class escape: `\d`, `\D`, `\w`, `\W`, `\s`, `\S`.
    BuiltinCharacterClass(BuiltinCharacterClass),

    /// A Unicode property escape: `\p{Letter}`, `\P{Script=Greek}`.
    UnicodeProperty(UnicodeProperty<'z>),

    /// A capturing group: `(expr)` or `(?<name>expr)`.
    Group(Group<'z>),

    /// A non-capturing group: `(?:expr)`.
    NonCapturingGroup(NonCapturingGroup<'z>),

    /// A lookaround assertion: `(?=expr)`, `(?!expr)`, `(?<=expr)`, `(?<!expr)`.
    Lookaround(Lookaround<'z>),

    /// A backreference: `\1`, `\k<name>`.
    Backreference(Backreference<'z>),

    /// An assertion that matches a position, not a character.
    Assertion(AssertionKind),

    /// A modifier group that changes flags for its contents: `(?i:expr)`.
    ModifierGroup(ModifierGroup<'z>),
}

/// A character class: `[abc]`, `[a-z]`, `[^0-9]`.
///
/// Spec model: `CharacterClass`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compilecharacterclass>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct CharacterClass<'z> {
    pub negated: bool,
    pub body: CharacterClassBody<'z>,
}

/// The body of a character class, which differs between `/u`|`/v` mode and
/// legacy mode.
///
/// Spec model: the split between legacy `ClassContents` and `/v`
/// `ClassSetExpression`.
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-patterns>
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compilecharacterclass>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CharacterClassBody<'z> {
    /// Legacy or `/u` mode: a flat list of ranges/chars.
    Ranges(&'z [CharacterClassRange<'z>]),

    /// `/v` (unicode sets) mode: supports set operations.
    UnicodeSet(ClassSetExpression<'z>),
}

/// A single element in a `[...]` character class (legacy and `/u` mode).
///
/// Spec model: the pieces consumed by `CompileToCharSet`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compiletocharset>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CharacterClassRange<'z> {
    /// A single character (as u32 code point, to support WTF-16 lone surrogates).
    Single(u32),

    /// A character range (as u32 code points).
    Range(u32, u32),

    /// A character class escape inside `[...]`: `[\d]`, `[\w]`.
    BuiltinClass(BuiltinCharacterClass),

    /// A Unicode property escape inside `[...]`: `[\p{Letter}]`.
    UnicodeProperty(UnicodeProperty<'z>),
}

/// Set operations for `/v` (unicode sets) mode character classes.
///
/// Spec model: `ClassSetExpression`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compilecharacterclass>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ClassSetExpression<'z> {
    /// A union of class set operands (the default when just listing items).
    Union(&'z [ClassSetOperand<'z>]),

    /// Intersection: `[a-z&&[aeiou]]`.
    Intersection(&'z [ClassSetOperand<'z>]),

    /// Subtraction: `[a-z--[aeiou]]`.
    Subtraction(&'z [ClassSetOperand<'z>]),
}

/// An operand in a unicode sets class expression.
///
/// Spec model: `ClassSetOperand` and `ClassStringDisjunction`.
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-patterns>
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileclasssetstring>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ClassSetOperand<'z> {
    /// A single character.
    Char(u32),

    /// A range: `a-z`.
    Range(u32, u32),

    /// A nested character class: `[a-z]` inside another class.
    NestedClass(CharacterClass<'z>),

    /// A builtin class escape: `\d`, `\w`, etc.
    BuiltinClass(BuiltinCharacterClass),

    /// A Unicode property: `\p{Letter}`.
    UnicodeProperty(UnicodeProperty<'z>),

    /// A string literal in a class (v-flag): `\q{abc}`.
    StringLiteral(&'z [char]),
}

/// Built-in character class escapes.
///
/// Spec model: `CharacterClassEscape`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compiletocharset>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum BuiltinCharacterClass {
    /// `\d` — digits `[0-9]`.
    Digit,
    /// `\D` — non-digits `[^0-9]`.
    NonDigit,
    /// `\w` — word chars `[a-zA-Z0-9_]`.
    Word,
    /// `\W` — non-word chars `[^a-zA-Z0-9_]`.
    NonWord,
    /// `\s` — whitespace.
    Whitespace,
    /// `\S` — non-whitespace.
    NonWhitespace,
}

impl BuiltinCharacterClass {
    /// Return the complementary (negated) class.
    pub fn negated(self) -> Self {
        match self {
            Self::Digit => Self::NonDigit,
            Self::NonDigit => Self::Digit,
            Self::Word => Self::NonWord,
            Self::NonWord => Self::Word,
            Self::Whitespace => Self::NonWhitespace,
            Self::NonWhitespace => Self::Whitespace,
        }
    }
}

/// A Unicode property escape: `\p{...}` or `\P{...}`.
///
/// Spec model: `UnicodePropertyValueExpression` and the property matching
/// abstract operations used to validate it.
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compiletocharset>
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-runtime-semantics-unicodematchproperty-p>
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-runtime-semantics-unicodematchpropertyvalue-p-v>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct UnicodeProperty<'z> {
    /// Whether this is `\P{...}` (negated) or `\p{...}`.
    pub negated: bool,
    /// The property name, e.g. `"Letter"`, `"Script"`.
    pub name: &'z str,
    /// The property value, if present, e.g. `"Greek"` in `\p{Script=Greek}`.
    pub value: Option<&'z str>,
}

/// A capturing group: `(expr)` or `(?<name>expr)`.
///
/// Spec model: a capturing `Atom` with an optional `GroupSpecifier`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileatom>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Group<'z> {
    /// 1-based capture index.
    pub index: u32,
    /// Optional group name for `(?<name>...)`.
    pub name: Option<&'z str>,
    pub body: Disjunction<'z>,
}

/// A non-capturing group: `(?:expr)`.
///
/// Spec model: the `(?: Disjunction )` branch of `Atom`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileatom>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct NonCapturingGroup<'z> {
    pub body: Disjunction<'z>,
}

/// A lookaround assertion.
///
/// Spec model: lookahead and lookbehind forms handled by
/// `Runtime Semantics: CompileAssertion`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileassertion>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Lookaround<'z> {
    pub kind: LookaroundKind,
    pub body: Disjunction<'z>,
}

/// Spec model: the four lookaround assertion forms.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileassertion>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum LookaroundKind {
    /// `(?=...)` — positive lookahead.
    LookaheadPositive,
    /// `(?!...)` — negative lookahead.
    LookaheadNegative,
    /// `(?<=...)` — positive lookbehind.
    LookbehindPositive,
    /// `(?<!...)` — negative lookbehind.
    LookbehindNegative,
}

/// A backreference to a capture group.
///
/// Spec model: decimal and named backreference atoms.
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileatom>
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-backreference-matcher>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Backreference<'z> {
    /// `\1`, `\2`, etc. — numeric backreference.
    Index(u32),
    /// `\k<name>` — named backreference.
    Named(&'z str),
}

/// A zero-width assertion.
///
/// Spec model: the zero-width assertion terms compiled by
/// `Runtime Semantics: CompileAssertion`.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileassertion>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AssertionKind {
    /// `^` — start of input (or line in multiline mode).
    StartOfInput,
    /// `$` — end of input (or line in multiline mode).
    EndOfInput,
    /// `\b` — word boundary.
    WordBoundary,
    /// `\B` — non-word boundary.
    NonWordBoundary,
}

/// A modifier group: `(?imsu-imsu:expr)`.
///
/// Spec model: modifier-scoped `Atom` forms that call `UpdateModifiers`.
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-compileatom>
/// - <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-updatemodifiers>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ModifierGroup<'z> {
    pub add_flags: ModifierFlags,
    pub remove_flags: ModifierFlags,
    pub body: Disjunction<'z>,
}

/// Flags that can be toggled in a modifier group.
///
/// Spec model: the subset of flags accepted by `UpdateModifiers` inside
/// a modifier group.
/// <https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-updatemodifiers>
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct ModifierFlags {
    pub ignore_case: bool,
    pub multiline: bool,
    pub dot_all: bool,
}

/*
