#include <unistd.h>

namespace Sandbox {

using namespace Detail;

static int s_file_broker_socket = -1;

int Detail::file_broker_socket()
{
    return s_file_broker_socket;
}

bool file_broker_is_active()
{
    return s_file_broker_socket >= 0;
}

static bool is_same_or_beneath(StringView path, StringView ancestor)
{
    if (path == ancestor || ancestor == "/"sv)
        return true;
    return path.length() > ancestor.length() && path.starts_with(ancestor) && path[ancestor.length()] == '/';
}

bool file_broker_allows(ReadonlySpan<ResolvedPathRule> rules, StringView canonical_path, FileBrokerAccess access)
{
    for (auto const& rule : rules) {
        StringView rule_path = rule.resolved_path;

        if (access == FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry) {
            if (rule.is_directory && rule.access == PathRule::Access::ReadWrite && canonical_path != rule_path && is_same_or_beneath(canonical_path, rule_path))
                return true;
            continue;
        }

        auto covered = rule.is_directory ? is_same_or_beneath(canonical_path, rule_path) : canonical_path == rule_path;
        if (covered) {
            if (access != FileBrokerAccess::Write || rule.access == PathRule::Access::ReadWrite)
                return true;
        }

        if (access == FileBrokerAccess::Metadata && (is_same_or_beneath(rule_path, canonical_path) || is_same_or_beneath(rule.requested_path, canonical_path)))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

namespace {

enum class WalkMode {
    FollowLast,
    StayOnLast,
    StopBeforeLast,
};

// Walks a path one component at a time without ever following a symbolic link inside the kernel. The helper can change
// the files in a directory it may write to, so a path checked first and opened afterwards could lead somewhere else by
// the time it is opened. Here, the descriptor that is checked is the one that gets used.
class PathWalker {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(PathWalker);

public:
    explicit PathWalker(pid_t helper_pid)
        : m_helper_pid(helper_pid)
    {
    }

    ~PathWalker()
    {
        for (auto fd : m_directories)
            close(fd);
    }

    int walk(StringView absolute_path, WalkMode mode)
    {
        // A trailing slash asks for what the link leads to, even from a system call that otherwise stays on the link.
        if (mode == WalkMode::StayOnLast && absolute_path.ends_with('/'))
            mode = WalkMode::FollowLast;

        auto root = open("/", O_PATH | O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC);
        if (root < 0)
            return errno;
        m_directories.append(root);
        if (fstat(root, &m_stat) < 0)
            return errno;

        Vector<ByteString> pending;
        push_components(pending, absolute_path);

        size_t followed_links = 0;
        while (!pending.is_empty()) {
            auto name = pending.take_last();
            if (name == ".."sv) {
                if (!m_names.is_empty()) {
                    close(m_directories.take_last());
                    m_names.take_last();
                    if (auto error = refresh_stat(); error != 0)
                        return error;
                }
                continue;
            }

            auto is_last = pending.is_empty();
            if (is_last && mode == WalkMode::StopBeforeLast) {
                m_last_name = name;
                return 0;
            }

            // The broker is a process of its own, so what the helper calls /proc/self has to be spelled out.
            if (is_directly_in_proc() && name == "self"sv) {
                name = ByteString::number(m_helper_pid);
                m_ended_on_proc_self = is_last;
            } else if (is_directly_in_proc() && name == "thread-self"sv) {
                return fail_at(name, ENOENT);
            }

            auto fd = openat(m_directories.last(), name.characters(), O_PATH | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC);
            if (fd < 0)
                return fail_at(name, errno);

            struct stat statbuf;
            if (fstat(fd, &statbuf) < 0) {
                auto error = errno;
                close(fd);
                return fail_at(name, error);
            }

            if (S_ISLNK(statbuf.st_mode) && !(is_last && mode == WalkMode::StayOnLast)) {
                char target[PATH_MAX];
                auto length = readlinkat(fd, "", target, sizeof(target));
                auto error = errno;
                close(fd);
                if (length < 0)
                    return fail_at(name, error);
                if (static_cast<size_t>(length) == sizeof(target))
                    return fail_at(name, ENAMETOOLONG);
                if (++followed_links > 40)
                    return fail_at(name, ELOOP);

                StringView target_view { target, static_cast<size_t>(length) };
                if (target_view.starts_with('/')) {
                    while (!m_names.is_empty()) {
                        close(m_directories.take_last());
                        m_names.take_last();
                    }
                    if (auto error = refresh_stat(); error != 0)
                        return error;
                }
                push_components(pending, target_view);
                continue;
            }

            m_directories.append(fd);
            m_names.append(move(name));
            m_stat = statbuf;
        }

        // There was nothing before the last component to stop at, as in a request for the root directory itself.
        if (mode == WalkMode::StopBeforeLast)
            return EEXIST;

        // A trailing slash only ever names a directory.
        if (absolute_path.ends_with('/') && !S_ISDIR(m_stat.st_mode)) {
            m_failed_path = canonical_path();
            return ENOTDIR;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    ByteString canonical_path() const
    {
        if (m_names.is_empty())
            return "/"sv;
        StringBuilder builder;
        for (auto const& name : m_names) {
            builder.append('/');
            builder.append(name);
        }
        return builder.to_byte_string();
    }

    ByteString canonical_path_with_last_name() const { return join(canonical_path(), m_last_name); }
    ByteString const& failed_path() const { return m_failed_path; }
    ByteString const& last_name() const { return m_last_name; }
    bool ended_on_proc_self() const { return m_ended_on_proc_self; }
    int fd() const { return m_directories.last(); }
    struct stat const& stat_result() const { return m_stat; }

private:
    static ByteString join(StringView directory, StringView name)
    {
        if (directory == "/"sv)
            return ByteString::formatted("/{}", name);
        return ByteString::formatted("{}/{}", directory, name);
    }

    static void push_components(Vector<ByteString>& pending, StringView path)
    {
        auto parts = path.split_view('/');
        for (auto const& part : parts.in_reverse()) {
            if (part != "."sv)
                pending.append(part);
        }
    }

    bool is_directly_in_proc() const { return m_names.size() == 1 && m_names.first() == "proc"sv; }

    // Leaving a directory by any way other than a new component has to report the directory that we ended up in.
    int refresh_stat()
    {
        return fstat(m_directories.last(), &m_stat) < 0 ? errno : 0;
    }

    int fail_at(StringView name, int error)
    {
        m_failed_path = join(canonical_path(), name);
        return error;
    }

    pid_t m_helper_pid { 0 };
    Vector<int> m_directories;
    Vector<ByteString> m_names;
    ByteString m_last_name;
    ByteString m_failed_path;
    bool m_ended_on_proc_self { false };
    struct stat m_stat {};
};

class FileBrokerServer {
public:
    FileBrokerServer(Vector<ResolvedPathRule> rules, pid_t helper_pid, ByteString current_directory, ByteString helper_name)
        : m_rules(move(rules))
        , m_helper_pid(helper_pid)
        , m_current_directory(move(current_directory))
        , m_helper_name(move(helper_name))
        , m_logs_refusals(sandbox_debugging_is_enabled())
    {
    }

    void serve(int socket);

private:
    struct Result {
        int error { 0 };
        int fd { -1 };
    };

    bool allows(StringView path, FileBrokerAccess access) const
    {
        if (file_broker_allows(m_rules, path, access))
            return true;
        log_refusal(path, access);
        return false;
    }

    static constexpr size_t max_logged_refusals = 4096;

    // Each path is logged once for each kind of access, since libraries tend to ask for the same files again and again.
    void log_refusal(StringView path, FileBrokerAccess access) const
    {
        if (!m_logs_refusals)
            return;
        if (m_logged_too_many_refusals)
            return;
        auto key = ByteString::formatted("{}:{}", to_underlying(access), path);
        if (m_logged_refusals.contains(key))
            return;
        if (m_logged_refusals.size() == max_logged_refusals) {
            m_logged_too_many_refusals = true;
            warnln("Sandbox refusal in {}: too many refusals, further refusals are not logged", m_helper_name);
            return;
        }
        m_logged_refusals.set(key);
        auto access_name = [&] {
            switch (access) {
            case FileBrokerAccess::Metadata:
                return "metadata"sv;
            case FileBrokerAccess::Read:
                return "read"sv;
            case FileBrokerAccess::Write:
                return "write"sv;
            case FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry:
                return "entry change"sv;
            }
            VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        }();
        warnln("Sandbox refusal in {}: {} access to {}", m_helper_name, access_name, path);
    }

    // A path outside of what the helper can see has to look the same whether or not it exists. Hiding that a path is
    // missing changes nothing for the helper, so only hiding one that exists is logged.
    int failure_for(PathWalker const& walker, int error) const
    {
        if (file_broker_allows(m_rules, walker.failed_path(), FileBrokerAccess::Metadata))
            return error;
        if (error != ENOENT)
            log_refusal(walker.failed_path(), FileBrokerAccess::Metadata);
        return EACCES;
    }

    ErrorOr<ByteString> absolute_path(StringView path, int directory_fd) const;

    Result open_file(StringView path, int flags, u32 mode);
    Result reopen(PathWalker const&, int flags);
    int access_file(StringView path, int mode, u32 at_flags);
    int stat_file(StringView path, bool follow, struct stat& result);
    int read_link(StringView path, char* buffer, u32& length);
    int make_directory(StringView path, u32 mode);
    int remove(StringView path, bool directory);
    int rename_file(StringView old_path, StringView new_path);
    int bind_socket(int fd, char const* address, u32 length);

    void handle(FileBrokerRequest const&, int directory_fds[2], int reply_fd);

    Vector<ResolvedPathRule> m_rules;
    pid_t m_helper_pid { 0 };
    ByteString m_current_directory;
    ByteString m_helper_name;
    bool m_logs_refusals { false };
    mutable HashTable<ByteString> m_logged_refusals;
    mutable bool m_logged_too_many_refusals { false };
};

}

// Relative paths start from the directory that the helper named with a descriptor, or else from its working directory.
ErrorOr<ByteString> FileBrokerServer::absolute_path(StringView path, int directory_fd) const
{
    if (path.is_empty())
        return Error::from_errno(ENOENT);
    if (path.starts_with('/'))
        return ByteString { path };
    if (directory_fd < 0) {
        if (m_current_directory.is_empty())
            return Error::from_errno(ENOENT);
        return ByteString::formatted("{}/{}", m_current_directory, path);
    }

    char link[32];
    (void)snprintf(link, sizeof(link), "/proc/self/fd/%d", directory_fd);
    char directory[PATH_MAX];
    auto length = readlink(link, directory, sizeof(directory));
    if (length < 0)
        return Error::from_errno(errno);
    if (static_cast<size_t>(length) == sizeof(directory))
        return Error::from_errno(ENAMETOOLONG);
    // A socket or a pipe has a name too, but no file system path to start from.
    if (length == 0 || directory[0] != '/')
        return Error::from_errno(ENOTDIR);
    return ByteString::formatted("{}/{}", StringView { directory, static_cast<size_t>(length) }, path);
}

// Goes through the descriptor of the file that was checked, so the open cannot land on any other file.
FileBrokerServer::Result FileBrokerServer::reopen(PathWalker const& walker, int flags)
{
    char link[32];
    (void)snprintf(link, sizeof(link), "/proc/self/fd/%d", walker.fd());
    auto fd = open(link, (flags & ~(O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW)) | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0)
        return { errno, -1 };
    return { 0, fd };
}

FileBrokerServer::Result FileBrokerServer::open_file(StringView path, int flags, u32 mode)
{
    // A nameless temporary file needs a directory that the rules say nothing about, and callers can do without one.
    if ((flags & O_TMPFILE) == O_TMPFILE)
        return { EOPNOTSUPP, -1 };

    auto access_mode = flags & O_ACCMODE;
    // O_CREAT writes nothing to a file that already exists, and the path that makes a new one has its own check.
    auto wants_write = access_mode != O_RDONLY || (flags & O_TRUNC) != 0;
    auto needed = wants_write ? FileBrokerAccess::Write : FileBrokerAccess::Read;

    auto creates_exclusively = (flags & (O_CREAT | O_EXCL)) == (O_CREAT | O_EXCL);
    auto stay_on_last = (flags & O_NOFOLLOW) != 0 || creates_exclusively;
    {
        PathWalker walker { m_helper_pid };
        auto error = walker.walk(path, stay_on_last ? WalkMode::StayOnLast : WalkMode::FollowLast);
        if (error == 0) {
            if ((flags & O_PATH) != 0 ? !allows(walker.canonical_path(), FileBrokerAccess::Metadata) : !allows(walker.canonical_path(), needed))
                return { EACCES, -1 };
            if (creates_exclusively)
                return { EEXIST, -1 };
            if (S_ISLNK(walker.stat_result().st_mode) && (flags & O_PATH) == 0)
                return { ELOOP, -1 };
            return reopen(walker, flags);
        }
        if (error != ENOENT || (flags & O_CREAT) == 0)
            return { failure_for(walker, error), -1 };
    }

    if (path.ends_with('/'))
        return { EISDIR, -1 };

    PathWalker walker { m_helper_pid };
    if (auto error = walker.walk(path, WalkMode::StopBeforeLast); error != 0)
        return { failure_for(walker, error), -1 };
    if (!allows(walker.canonical_path_with_last_name(), FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry))
        return { EACCES, -1 };

    auto fd = openat(walker.fd(), walker.last_name().characters(), flags | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, mode);
    if (fd < 0)
        return { errno, -1 };
    return { 0, fd };
}

int FileBrokerServer::access_file(StringView path, int mode, u32 at_flags)
{
    PathWalker walker { m_helper_pid };
    if (auto error = walker.walk(path, (at_flags & AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) ? WalkMode::StayOnLast : WalkMode::FollowLast); error != 0)
        return failure_for(walker, error);

    auto needed = FileBrokerAccess::Metadata;
    if (mode & W_OK)
        needed = FileBrokerAccess::Write;
    else if (mode & (R_OK | X_OK))
        needed = FileBrokerAccess::Read;
    if (!allows(walker.canonical_path(), needed))
        return EACCES;

    char link[32];
    (void)snprintf(link, sizeof(link), "/proc/self/fd/%d", walker.fd());
    return access(link, mode) < 0 ? errno : 0;
}

int FileBrokerServer::stat_file(StringView path, bool follow, struct stat& result)
{
    PathWalker walker { m_helper_pid };
    if (auto error = walker.walk(path, follow ? WalkMode::FollowLast : WalkMode::StayOnLast); error != 0)
        return failure_for(walker, error);
    if (!allows(walker.canonical_path(), FileBrokerAccess::Metadata))
        return EACCES;
    result = walker.stat_result();
    return 0;
}

int FileBrokerServer::read_link(StringView path, char* buffer, u32& length)
{
    PathWalker walker { m_helper_pid };
    if (auto error = walker.walk(path, WalkMode::StayOnLast); error != 0)
        return failure_for(walker, error);
    if (!allows(walker.canonical_path(), FileBrokerAccess::Metadata))
        return EACCES;

    // The walk replaced this link with the helper's own directory, but the link is what the helper asked about.
    if (walker.ended_on_proc_self()) {
        auto helper_pid = ByteString::number(m_helper_pid);
        memcpy(buffer, helper_pid.characters(), helper_pid.length());
        length = static_cast<u32>(helper_pid.length());
        return 0;
    }

    if (!S_ISLNK(walker.stat_result().st_mode))
        return EINVAL;

    auto result = readlinkat(walker.fd(), "", buffer, PATH_MAX);
    if (result < 0)
        return errno;
    length = static_cast<u32>(result);
    return 0;
}

int FileBrokerServer::make_directory(StringView path, u32 mode)
{
    PathWalker walker { m_helper_pid };
    if (auto error = walker.walk(path, WalkMode::StopBeforeLast); error != 0)
        return failure_for(walker, error);

    // The kernel reports a directory that exists before it asks whether a new one could be made there, and libpulse
    // depends on that for a runtime directory that it may only read.
    auto target = walker.canonical_path_with_last_name();
    if (!file_broker_allows(m_rules, target, FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry)) {
        struct stat statbuf;
        if (file_broker_allows(m_rules, target, FileBrokerAccess::Metadata) && fstatat(walker.fd(), walker.last_name().characters(), &statbuf, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) == 0)
            return EEXIST;
        log_refusal(target, FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry);
        return EACCES;
    }
    return mkdirat(walker.fd(), walker.last_name().characters(), mode) < 0 ? errno : 0;
}

int FileBrokerServer::remove(StringView path, bool directory)
{
    PathWalker walker { m_helper_pid };
    if (auto error = walker.walk(path, WalkMode::StopBeforeLast); error != 0)
        return failure_for(walker, error);
    if (!allows(walker.canonical_path_with_last_name(), FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry))
        return EACCES;
    return unlinkat(walker.fd(), walker.last_name().characters(), directory ? AT_REMOVEDIR : 0) < 0 ? errno : 0;
}

int FileBrokerServer::rename_file(StringView old_path, StringView new_path)
{
    PathWalker old_walker { m_helper_pid };
    if (auto error = old_walker.walk(old_path, WalkMode::StopBeforeLast); error != 0)
        return failure_for(old_walker, error);
    PathWalker new_walker { m_helper_pid };
    if (auto error = new_walker.walk(new_path, WalkMode::StopBeforeLast); error != 0)
        return failure_for(new_walker, error);

    if (!allows(old_walker.canonical_path_with_last_name(), FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry) || !allows(new_walker.canonical_path_with_last_name(), FileBrokerAccess::ChangeEntry))
        return EACCES;
    return renameat(old_walker.fd(), old_walker.last_name().characters(), new_walker.fd(), new_walker.last_name().characters()) < 0 ? errno : 0;
}

// Binding a UNIX socket to a path creates a file that no path rule covers, so only the families that the network policies
// exist for get through. The kernel refuses an address whose family differs from the socket's own, and the address was
// copied out of the helper before this check, so the helper can't change it afterwards.
int FileBrokerServer::bind_socket(int fd, char const* address, u32 length)
{
    sockaddr_storage storage;
    if (fd < 0 || length < sizeof(sa_family_t) || length > sizeof(storage))
        return EINVAL;
    memcpy(&storage, address, length);
    if (storage.ss_family != AF_INET && storage.ss_family != AF_INET6 && storage.ss_family != AF_NETLINK) {
        if (m_logs_refusals)
            warnln("Sandbox refusal in {}: binding a socket of address family {}", m_helper_name, storage.ss_family);
        return EACCES;
    }
    return bind(fd, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr const*>(&storage), length) < 0 ? errno : 0;
}

static void send_response(int reply_fd, FileBrokerResponse const& response, int fd)
{
    iovec io {
        .iov_base = const_cast<FileBrokerResponse*>(&response),
        .iov_len = sizeof(response),
    };

    union {
        cmsghdr header;
        char space[CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int))];
    } control {};

    msghdr message {
        .msg_name = nullptr,
        .msg_namelen = 0,
        .msg_iov = &io,
        .msg_iovlen = 1,
        .msg_control = nullptr,
        .msg_controllen = 0,
        .msg_flags = 0,
    };

    if (fd >= 0) {
        message.msg_control = &control;
        message.msg_controllen = sizeof(control);
        auto* header = CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&message);
        header->cmsg_level = SOL_SOCKET;
        header->cmsg_type = SCM_RIGHTS;
        header->cmsg_len = CMSG_LEN(sizeof(int));
        memcpy(CMSG_DATA(header), &fd, sizeof(fd));
    }

    // Never wait on a socket that the helper chose. If its buffer is full, the helper did that to itself.
    ssize_t sent = 0;
    do {
        sent = sendmsg(reply_fd, &message, MSG_NOSIGNAL | MSG_DONTWAIT);
    } while (sent < 0 && errno == EINTR);
}

void FileBrokerServer::handle(FileBrokerRequest const& request, int directory_fds[2], int reply_fd)
{
    FileBrokerResponse response;
    memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
    response.magic = file_broker_magic;

    int result_fd = -1;
    ScopeGuard send_and_close = [&] {
        send_response(reply_fd, response, result_fd);
        if (result_fd >= 0)
            close(result_fd);
    };

    if (static_cast<FileBrokerOperation>(request.operation) == FileBrokerOperation::BindSocket) {
        response.error = bind_socket(directory_fds[0], request.path, request.path_length);
        return;
    }

    StringView raw_path { request.path, request.path_length };
    StringView raw_second_path { request.second_path, request.second_path_length };
    if (raw_path.contains('\0') || raw_second_path.contains('\0')) {
        response.error = EINVAL;
        return;
    }

    auto path_or_error = absolute_path(raw_path, directory_fds[0]);
    if (path_or_error.is_error()) {
        response.error = path_or_error.error().code();
        return;
    }
    auto path = path_or_error.release_value();

    switch (static_cast<FileBrokerOperation>(request.operation)) {
    case FileBrokerOperation::Open: {
        auto result = open_file(path, request.flags, request.mode);
        response.error = result.error;
        result_fd = result.fd;
        return;
    }
    case FileBrokerOperation::Access:
        response.error = access_file(path, request.flags, request.mode);
        return;
    case FileBrokerOperation::Stat:
        response.error = stat_file(path, true, response.stat_result);
        return;
    case FileBrokerOperation::SymlinkStat:
        response.error = stat_file(path, false, response.stat_result);
        return;
    case FileBrokerOperation::ReadLink:
        response.error = read_link(path, response.link, response.link_length);
        return;
    case FileBrokerOperation::MakeDirectory:
        response.error = make_directory(path, request.mode);
        return;
    case FileBrokerOperation::RemoveFile:
        response.error = remove(path, false);
        return;
    case FileBrokerOperation::RemoveDirectory:
        response.error = remove(path, true);
        return;
    case FileBrokerOperation::BindSocket:
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    case FileBrokerOperation::Rename: {
        auto second_or_error = absolute_path(raw_second_path, directory_fds[1]);
        if (second_or_error.is_error()) {
            response.error = second_or_error.error().code();
            return;
        }
        response.error = rename_file(path, second_or_error.value());
        return;
    }
    }
    response.error = EINVAL;
}

void FileBrokerServer::serve(int socket)
{
    static FileBrokerRequest request;

    for (;;) {
        iovec io {
            .iov_base = &request,
            .iov_len = sizeof(request),
        };

        // Room for more than a well-behaved helper sends, so that anything extra can be counted and closed.
        union {
            cmsghdr header;
            char space[CMSG_SPACE(4 * sizeof(int))];
        } control {};

        msghdr message {
            .msg_name = nullptr,
            .msg_namelen = 0,
            .msg_iov = &io,
            .msg_iovlen = 1,
            .msg_control = &control,
            .msg_controllen = sizeof(control),
            .msg_flags = 0,
        };

        ssize_t received = 0;
        do {
            received = recvmsg(socket, &message, MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC);
        } while (received < 0 && errno == EINTR);
        if (received < 0)
            return;

        int fds[8];
        size_t fd_count = 0;
        for (auto* header = CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&message); header; header = CMSG_NXTHDR(&message, header)) {
            if (header->cmsg_level != SOL_SOCKET || header->cmsg_type != SCM_RIGHTS || header->cmsg_len < CMSG_LEN(0))
                continue;
            auto count = (header->cmsg_len - CMSG_LEN(0)) / sizeof(int);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count && fd_count < 8; ++i)
                memcpy(&fds[fd_count++], CMSG_DATA(header) + i * sizeof(int), sizeof(int));
        }
        ScopeGuard close_fds = [&] {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < fd_count; ++i)
                close(fds[i]);
        };

        if (received == 0 && fd_count == 0)
            return;

        size_t expected_fd_count = 1;
        int directory_fds[2] = { -1, -1 };
        if (static_cast<size_t>(received) != sizeof(request)
            || request.magic != file_broker_magic
            || (message.msg_flags & (MSG_TRUNC | MSG_CTRUNC)) != 0
            || request.path_length >= sizeof(request.path)
            || request.second_path_length >= sizeof(request.second_path)
            || (request.directory_fd_mask & ~3u) != 0) {
            continue;
        }

        if (request.directory_fd_mask & 1)
            ++expected_fd_count;
        if (request.directory_fd_mask & 2)
            ++expected_fd_count;
        if (fd_count != expected_fd_count)
            continue;

        size_t next_fd = 1;
        if (request.directory_fd_mask & 1)
            directory_fds[0] = fds[next_fd++];
        if (request.directory_fd_mask & 2)
            directory_fds[1] = fds[next_fd++];

        handle(request, directory_fds, fds[0]);
    }
}

static void close_all_descriptors_except(int keep)
{
    auto* directory = opendir("/proc/self/fd");
    if (!directory)
        _exit(1);

    Vector<int> to_close;
    while (auto* entry = readdir(directory)) {
        auto fd = atoi(entry->d_name);
        if (entry->d_name[0] != '.' && fd > STDERR_FILENO && fd != keep && fd != dirfd(directory))
            to_close.append(fd);
    }
    closedir(directory);

    for (auto fd : to_close)
        close(fd);
}

static ErrorOr<void> confine_broker()
{
    SeccompPolicy policy;
    policy.allow_filesystem_metadata_queries();
    policy.allow_filesystem_writes();
    policy.allow_file_descriptor_operations();
    policy.allow_ipc();
    policy.allow_binding_sockets();
    policy.allow_memory_without_executable_mappings();
    policy.allow_signals();
    policy.allow_clocks();
    policy.allow_exit();
    return policy.install();
}

ErrorOr<void> start_file_broker(ReadonlySpan<PathRule> rules)
{
    Vector<ResolvedPathRule> resolved_rules;
    for (auto const& rule : rules) {
        char resolved_path[PATH_MAX];
        if (realpath(rule.path.characters(), resolved_path) == nullptr)
            return Error::from_syscall("realpath"sv, errno);
        TRY(resolved_rules.try_append({ rule.path, resolved_path, rule.access, rule.is_directory }));
    }

    // A working directory that was deleted only costs the helper its relative paths, so it must not cost it the sandbox.
    char current_directory[PATH_MAX];
    if (!getcwd(current_directory, sizeof(current_directory)))
        current_directory[0] = '\0';

    int fds[2];
    if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_SEQPACKET | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0, fds) < 0)
        return Error::from_syscall("socketpair"sv, errno);

    auto helper_pid = getpid();
    auto child = fork();
    if (child < 0) {
        auto error = errno;
        close(fds[0]);
        close(fds[1]);
        return Error::from_syscall("fork"sv, error);
    }

    if (child == 0) {
        close(fds[0]);

        // Everything else the helper has open is more than a broker for its files should ever hold.
        close_all_descriptors_except(fds[1]);

        char helper_name[16] = {};
        (void)prctl(PR_GET_NAME, helper_name, 0ul, 0ul, 0ul);
        (void)prctl(PR_SET_NAME, "FileBroker", 0ul, 0ul, 0ul);
        if (prctl(PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, SIGKILL, 0ul, 0ul, 0ul) < 0 || getppid() != helper_pid)
            _exit(1);

        FileBrokerServer server { move(resolved_rules), helper_pid, current_directory, ByteString { helper_name, strnlen(helper_name, sizeof(helper_name)) } };
        if (confine_broker().is_error())
            _exit(1);

        char const ready = 1;
        if (send(fds[1], &ready, 1, MSG_NOSIGNAL) != 1)
            _exit(1);

        server.serve(fds[1]);
        _exit(0);
    }

    close(fds[1]);

    // The helper stays honest about whether it is confined: without this, a broker that failed to start would look like
    // one that refuses every path.
    char ready = 0;
    ssize_t received = 0;
    do {
        received = recv(fds[0], &ready, 1, 0);
    } while (received < 0 && errno == EINTR);
    if (received != 1 || ready != 1) {
        close(fds[0]);
        return Error::from_string_literal("The file broker could not start");
    }

    s_file_broker_socket = fds[0];

    // Landlock confines the helper from here on, while it still sets up drivers and libraries. So must the broker.
    TRY(Detail::install_file_system_filter());
    return {};
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Sandbox.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

namespace Sandbox {

namespace Detail {

static constexpr u32 file_broker_magic = 0x4c424652u;

enum class FileBrokerOperation : u32 {
    Open,
    Access,
    Stat,
    SymlinkStat,
    ReadLink,
    MakeDirectory,
    RemoveFile,
    RemoveDirectory,
    Rename,
    // The address travels in the first path field, and the socket as the first descriptor.
    BindSocket,
};

struct FileBrokerRequest {
    u32 magic;
    u32 operation;
    i32 flags;
    u32 mode;
    u32 path_length;
    u32 second_path_length;
    // Bit 0 says a descriptor for resolving the first path was attached, bit 1 the same for the second path.
    u32 directory_fd_mask;
    char path[PATH_MAX];
    char second_path[PATH_MAX];
};

struct FileBrokerResponse {
    u32 magic;
    i32 error;
    u32 link_length;
    struct stat stat_result;
    char link[PATH_MAX];
};

// The socket that the SIGSYS handler sends its requests to.
int file_broker_socket();

// Sends every system call that takes a path to the broker or refuses it, and allows everything else, so that the helper
// is confined from the moment the broker runs. The helper's own policy stacks on top of this when it installs it.
[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> install_file_system_filter();

}

// A path rule after its symbolic links were followed. The two paths are the same if there were none.
struct ResolvedPathRule {
    ByteString requested_path;
    ByteString resolved_path;
    PathRule::Access access { PathRule::Access::ReadOnly };
    bool is_directory { false };
};

enum class FileBrokerAccess {
    // Knowing that the path exists, which every directory above an allowed path needs for its path to be resolved.
    Metadata,
    Read,
    Write,
    // Making, removing or renaming the entry itself, which only a writable directory above it allows.
    ChangeEntry,
};

// Decides on canonical paths, which contain no symbolic links.
[[nodiscard]] bool file_broker_allows(ReadonlySpan<ResolvedPathRule>, StringView canonical_path, FileBrokerAccess);

// Seccomp can't read the paths that a process passes to the kernel, so it can't tell which files a process opens. On a
// kernel without Landlock, the seccomp policy instead traps every system call that takes a
// path, and a process forked from the helper does the work if the path is one the helper may use. The helper must have
// only one thread, and must not have installed its seccomp policy yet. The broker exits when the helper does.
[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> start_file_broker(ReadonlySpan<PathRule>);

// Tells the seccomp policy to trap system calls that take a path, in place of allowing them.
[[nodiscard]] bool file_broker_is_active();

}

FILE: Libraries/LibSandbox/GpuDriverPaths.cpp
/*

#include <AK/JsonArray.h>
#include <AK/JsonObject.h>
#include <AK/JsonValue.h>
#include <AK/LexicalPath.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <LibCore/Directory.h>
#include <LibCore/Environment.h>
#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibCore/StandardPaths.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibSandbox/Sandbox.h>

namespace Sandbox {

// A driver or layer manifest names the library that the loader opens. A bare name is found by the dynamic loader in
// the library directories, which are already allowed. A path, which may be relative to the manifest, can be anywhere.
static ErrorOr<void> add_manifest_library_paths(Vector<PathRule>& paths, StringView manifest_path)
{
    auto file = Core::File::open(manifest_path, Core::File::OpenMode::Read);
    if (file.is_error())
        return {};
    auto contents = TRY(file.value()->read_until_eof());
    auto manifest = JsonValue::from_string(contents);
    if (manifest.is_error() || !manifest.value().is_object())
        return {};

    auto add_library_path = [&](JsonObject const& entry) -> ErrorOr<void> {
        auto library_path = entry.get_string("library_path"sv);
        if (!library_path.has_value() || !library_path->contains('/'))
            return {};
        auto path = LexicalPath::absolute_path(LexicalPath::dirname(manifest_path), *library_path);
        return add_path_if_exists(paths, path, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly);
    };

    auto const& object = manifest.value().as_object();
    for (auto key : { "ICD"sv, "layer"sv }) {
        if (auto entry = object.get_object(key); entry.has_value())
            TRY(add_library_path(*entry));
    }
    if (auto layers = object.get_array("layers"sv); layers.has_value()) {
        for (auto const& layer : layers->values()) {
            if (layer.is_object())
                TRY(add_library_path(layer.as_object()));
        }
    }
    return {};
}

// Allows a manifest, or every manifest in a directory, along with the libraries that they point to.
static ErrorOr<void> add_manifest_paths(Vector<PathRule>& paths, StringView manifest_file_or_directory)
{
    auto metadata = Core::System::stat(manifest_file_or_directory);
    if (metadata.is_error())
        return {};
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, manifest_file_or_directory, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    if (!S_ISDIR(metadata.value().st_mode))
        return add_manifest_library_paths(paths, manifest_file_or_directory);

    auto flags = static_cast<Core::DirIterator::Flags>(Core::DirIterator::SkipDots | Core::DirIterator::NoStat);
    return Core::Directory::for_each_entry(manifest_file_or_directory, flags, [&](Core::DirectoryEntry const& entry, Core::Directory const&) -> ErrorOr<IterationDecision> {
        if (entry.name.ends_with(".json"sv))
            TRY(add_manifest_library_paths(paths, LexicalPath::join(manifest_file_or_directory, entry.name).string()));
        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    });
}

// The Vulkan loader and glvnd find their drivers and layers through manifests, which they read while the GPU backend
// starts, after Landlock is in place. So we allow the directories that they search by default, and whatever the
// environment points them at instead.
static ErrorOr<void> add_loader_manifest_paths(Vector<PathRule>& paths)
{
    auto home = Core::Environment::get("HOME"sv).value_or(""sv);
    auto environment_or = [](StringView name, ByteString fallback) {
        auto value = Core::Environment::get(name);
        return value.has_value() && !value->is_empty() ? value->to_byte_string() : move(fallback);
    };

    // The Vulkan loader looks for a vulkan directory in each of these, in this order.
    Vector<ByteString> vulkan_search_roots;
    vulkan_search_roots.append(environment_or("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"sv, ByteString::formatted("{}/.config", home)));
    auto config_directories = environment_or("XDG_CONFIG_DIRS"sv, "/etc/xdg"sv);
    for (auto directory : config_directories.split_view(':'))
        vulkan_search_roots.append(directory);
    vulkan_search_roots.append("/etc"sv);
    vulkan_search_roots.append("/usr/local/etc"sv);
    vulkan_search_roots.append(environment_or("XDG_DATA_HOME"sv, ByteString::formatted("{}/.local/share", home)));
    auto data_directories = environment_or("XDG_DATA_DIRS"sv, "/usr/local/share:/usr/share"sv);
    for (auto directory : data_directories.split_view(':'))
        vulkan_search_roots.append(directory);

    for (auto const& root : vulkan_search_roots) {
        if (root.is_empty() || !root.starts_with('/'))
            continue;
        for (auto subdirectory : { "icd.d"sv, "implicit_layer.d"sv, "explicit_layer.d"sv })
            TRY(add_manifest_paths(paths, ByteString::formatted("{}/vulkan/{}", root, subdirectory)));
    }
    for (auto directory : { "/etc/glvnd/egl_vendor.d"sv, "/usr/share/glvnd/egl_vendor.d"sv })
        TRY(add_manifest_paths(paths, directory));

    static constexpr Array manifest_variables {
        "VK_DRIVER_FILES"sv,
        "VK_ICD_FILENAMES"sv,
        "VK_ADD_DRIVER_FILES"sv,
        "VK_LAYER_PATH"sv,
        "VK_ADD_LAYER_PATH"sv,
        "VK_IMPLICIT_LAYER_PATH"sv,
        "VK_ADD_IMPLICIT_LAYER_PATH"sv,
        "__EGL_VENDOR_LIBRARY_FILENAMES"sv,
        "__EGL_VENDOR_LIBRARY_DIRS"sv,
    };
    for (auto variable : manifest_variables) {
        auto value = Core::Environment::get(variable);
        if (!value.has_value())
            continue;
        for (auto entry : value->split_view(':'))
            TRY(add_manifest_paths(paths, entry));
    }
    return {};
}

// A shader cache only makes the driver faster. If we cannot create or open its directory, for example because another
// user owns it, we leave it out and the driver runs without its disk cache.
static ErrorOr<void> add_shader_cache_path(Vector<PathRule>& paths, ByteString const& path)
{
    if (!path.starts_with('/')) {
        dbgln("Leaving out the shader cache at {}: Not an absolute path", path);
        return {};
    }
    if (auto result = Core::Directory::create(path, Core::Directory::CreateDirectories::Yes); result.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Leaving out the shader cache at {}: {}", path, result.error());
        return {};
    }
    if (auto result = add_path_if_exists(paths, path, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite); result.is_error())
        dbgln("Leaving out the shader cache at {}: {}", path, result.error());
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> add_gpu_driver_paths(Vector<PathRule>& paths)
{
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/lib"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/lib64"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/usr/lib"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/usr/local/lib"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    // The driver loads more libraries after Landlock is in place, and they must come from where the libraries that we
    // already use came from. Otherwise the dynamic loader skips to another copy, such as the system's instead of our own.
    TRY(add_loaded_library_directories(paths));
    // cpptrace opens loaded ELF objects when symbolizing in-process stack traces, and drivers read it too.
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, TRY(Core::System::current_executable_path()), PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/etc/glvnd"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/usr/share/glvnd"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/usr/share/drirc.d"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/usr/share/libdrm"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/usr/share/vulkan"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/dev/dri"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/dev/udmabuf"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/sys"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/etc/ld.so.cache"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/etc/egl"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/usr/share/egl"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_loader_manifest_paths(paths));

    // NB: GPU drivers read these while they set up and while they run. They used to do the setup before Landlock was in
    //     place, and in threads that it never confined.
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/proc/self"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/proc/meminfo"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/proc/stat"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/proc/filesystems"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/proc/sys/dev"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/proc/driver/nvidia"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/etc/nvidia"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/usr/share/nvidia"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));

    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/dev/nvidiactl"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/dev/nvidia-modeset"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/dev/nvidia-uvm"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/dev/nvidia-uvm-tools"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
    TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, "/dev/nvidia-caps"sv, PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));

    // NB: Add all of the primary nvidia device files (e.g. /dev/nvidia0, /dev/nvidia1, etc).
    auto flags = static_cast<Core::DirIterator::Flags>(Core::DirIterator::SkipDots | Core::DirIterator::NoStat);
    TRY(Core::Directory::for_each_entry("/dev"sv, flags, [&](Core::DirectoryEntry const& entry, Core::Directory const&) -> ErrorOr<IterationDecision> {
        if (entry.name.starts_with("nvidia"sv)) {
            auto suffix = entry.name.substring_view(6);
            if (!suffix.is_empty() && all_of(suffix, is_ascii_digit))
                TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, TRY(String::formatted("/dev/{}", entry.name)), PathRule::Access::ReadWrite));
        }

        return IterationDecision::Continue;
    }));

    auto mesa_shader_cache_path = Core::Environment::get("MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DIR"sv)
                                      .map([](auto path) { return path.to_byte_string(); })
                                      .value_or_lazy_evaluated([] { return ByteString::formatted("{}/mesa_shader_cache", Core::StandardPaths::cache_directory()); });
    TRY(add_shader_cache_path(paths, mesa_shader_cache_path));

    // The NVIDIA driver keeps its own shader cache.
    if (!Core::System::access("/dev/nvidiactl"sv, F_OK).is_error()) {
        auto nvidia_shader_cache_path = Core::Environment::get("__GL_SHADER_DISK_CACHE_PATH"sv)
                                            .map([](auto path) { return path.to_byte_string(); })
                                            .value_or_lazy_evaluated([] { return ByteString::formatted("{}/nvidia", Core::StandardPaths::cache_directory()); });
        TRY(add_shader_cache_path(paths, nvidia_shader_cache_path));
    }

    return {};
}

}

namespace Sandbox {

ErrorOr<void> install_no_new_privileges()
{
#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    if (prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1, 0, 0, 0) < 0)
        return Error::from_syscall("prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS)"sv, errno);
#endif
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> configure_runtime()
{
#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX) && defined(__GLIBC__) && defined(M_ARENA_MAX) && !defined(HAS_ADDRESS_SANITIZER)
    // NB: This only limits memory use. Other allocators, such as hardened_malloc, do not know this option and return 0,
    //     so we ignore a failure.
    (void)mallopt(M_ARENA_MAX, 4);
#endif
#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX) && defined(HAS_ADDRESS_SANITIZER)
    // The sanitizers symbolize a report through an llvm-symbolizer process they start the first time they need one, but
    // the seccomp filter kills the fork and Landlock refuses the exec once the sandbox is in place, so a report would be
    // lost with its stack. Symbolize one address now so that process is already running when a report needs it.
    char symbolized_pc[64];
    __sanitizer_symbolize_pc(__builtin_return_address(0), "%p %F", symbolized_pc, sizeof(symbolized_pc));
#endif
    return {};
}

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
ErrorOr<void> add_path_if_exists(Vector<PathRule>& paths, StringView path, PathRule::Access access)
{
    auto path_bytes = path.to_byte_string();

    struct stat statbuf;
    if (stat(path_bytes.characters(), &statbuf) < 0) {
        if (errno == ENOENT)
            return {};
        return Error::from_syscall("stat"sv, errno);
    }

    bool is_directory = S_ISDIR(statbuf.st_mode);

    for (auto const& existing_path : paths) {
        if (existing_path.access == access && existing_path.path == path_bytes)
            return {};
    }

    TRY(paths.try_append({ move(path_bytes), access, is_directory }));
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> add_loaded_library_directories(Vector<PathRule>& paths, Optional<StringView> root)
{
    Vector<ByteString> directories;
    dl_iterate_phdr([](dl_phdr_info* info, size_t, void* data) {
        auto& directories = *static_cast<Vector<ByteString>*>(data);
        StringView name { info->dlpi_name, strlen(info->dlpi_name) };
        if (name.starts_with('/')) {
            auto directory = LexicalPath::dirname(name);
            if (!directories.contains_slow(directory))
                directories.append(move(directory));
        }
        return 0;
    },
        &directories);

    for (auto const& directory : directories) {
        if (!root.has_value() || LexicalPath { directory }.is_child_of(LexicalPath { root->to_byte_string() }))
            TRY(add_path_if_exists(paths, directory, PathRule::Access::ReadOnly));
    }
    return {};
}
#endif

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
ErrorOr<void> add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(Vector<SeatbeltPath>& paths, StringView path, SeatbeltPath::Access access)
{
    auto path_bytes = path.to_byte_string();

    struct stat statbuf;
    if (stat(path_bytes.characters(), &statbuf) < 0) {
        if (errno == ENOENT)
            return {};
        return Error::from_syscall("stat"sv, errno);
    }

    char resolved_path[PATH_MAX];
    if (realpath(path_bytes.characters(), resolved_path) == nullptr)
        return Error::from_syscall("realpath"sv, errno);
    path_bytes = resolved_path;

    auto is_directory = S_ISDIR(statbuf.st_mode);

    for (auto const& existing_path : paths) {
        if (existing_path.access == access && existing_path.path == path_bytes)
            return {};
    }

    TRY(paths.try_append({ move(path_bytes), access, is_directory }));
    return {};
}

Optional<ByteString> application_bundle_for_executable(StringView executable_path)
{
    LexicalPath path { executable_path };
    auto const& parts = path.parts_view();
    if (parts.size() < 4)
        return {};
    auto bundle_name = parts[parts.size() - 4];
    if (parts[parts.size() - 2] != "MacOS"sv || parts[parts.size() - 3] != "Contents"sv || !bundle_name.ends_with(".app"sv) || bundle_name == ".app"sv)
        return {};
    return LexicalPath::dirname(LexicalPath::dirname(LexicalPath::dirname(path.string())));
}

static void append_sandbox_string_literal(StringBuilder& builder, StringView string)
{
    builder.append('"');
    for (auto ch : string.bytes()) {
        if (ch == '"' || ch == '\\')
            builder.append('\\');
        builder.append(static_cast<char>(ch));
    }
    builder.append('"');
}

// /etc, /tmp and /var are symbolic links into /private. Seatbelt checks some operations, such as file-test-existence,
// against the path before it follows those links, so a rule for a path in /private also has to name the short form.
static Optional<StringView> path_alias_outside_private(StringView path)
{
    for (auto prefix : { "/private/etc"sv, "/private/tmp"sv, "/private/var"sv }) {
        if (path == prefix || path.starts_with(ByteString::formatted("{}/", prefix)))
            return path.substring_view("/private"sv.length());
    }
    return {};
}

static void append_sandbox_path_filter(StringBuilder& builder, StringView filter, StringView path)
{
    builder.appendff("({} ", filter);
    append_sandbox_string_literal(builder, path);
    builder.append(')');

    if (auto alias = path_alias_outside_private(path); alias.has_value()) {
        builder.appendff(" ({} ", filter);
        append_sandbox_string_literal(builder, *alias);
        builder.append(')');
    }
}

static void append_sandbox_path_filter(StringBuilder& builder, SeatbeltPath const& path)
{
    append_sandbox_path_filter(builder, path.is_directory ? "subpath"sv : "literal"sv, path.path);
}

static bool seatbelt_path_allows_access(SeatbeltPath::Access path_access, SeatbeltPath::Access requested_access)
{
    if (requested_access == SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly)
        return true;
    return path_access == requested_access;
}

static ErrorOr<void> append_allowed_paths(StringBuilder& builder, StringView operation, ReadonlySpan<SeatbeltPath> paths, SeatbeltPath::Access access)
{
    bool emitted_header = false;
    for (auto const& path : paths) {
        if (!seatbelt_path_allows_access(path.access, access))
            continue;

        if (!emitted_header) {
            builder.append("(allow "sv);
            builder.append(operation);
            emitted_header = true;
        }
        builder.append(' ');
        append_sandbox_path_filter(builder, path);
    }

    if (emitted_header)
        builder.append(")\n"sv);

    return {};
}

// Resolving a path, as realpath() does, needs the metadata of every directory above it.
static ErrorOr<void> append_allowed_ancestor_directories(StringBuilder& builder, ReadonlySpan<SeatbeltPath> paths)
{
    Vector<ByteString> ancestors;
    for (auto const& path : paths) {
        for (auto ancestor = LexicalPath::dirname(path.path); ancestor != "/"sv && !ancestor.is_empty(); ancestor = LexicalPath::dirname(ancestor)) {
            if (!ancestors.contains_slow(ancestor))
                TRY(ancestors.try_append(ancestor));
        }
    }

    if (ancestors.is_empty())
        return {};

    builder.append("(allow file-read-metadata file-test-existence"sv);
    for (auto const& ancestor : ancestors) {
        builder.append(' ');
        append_sandbox_path_filter(builder, "literal"sv, ancestor);
    }
    builder.append(")\n"sv);

    return {};
}

static ErrorOr<void> append_allowed_path_extensions(StringBuilder& builder, ReadonlySpan<SeatbeltPath> paths, SeatbeltPath::Access access)
{
    auto extension_class = access == SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadWrite ? "com.apple.app-sandbox.read-write"sv : "com.apple.app-sandbox.read"sv;

    bool emitted_header = false;
    for (auto const& path : paths) {
        if (!seatbelt_path_allows_access(path.access, access))
            continue;

        if (!emitted_header) {
            builder.append("(allow file-issue-extension"sv);
            emitted_header = true;
        }
        builder.append(" (require-all (extension-class "sv);
        append_sandbox_string_literal(builder, extension_class);
        builder.append(") (require-any "sv);
        append_sandbox_path_filter(builder, path);
        builder.append("))"sv);
    }

    if (emitted_header)
        builder.append(")\n"sv);

    return {};
}

static ErrorOr<void> append_allowed_executables(StringBuilder& builder, ReadonlySpan<ByteString> executable_paths)
{
    if (executable_paths.is_empty())
        return {};

    builder.append("(allow syscall-unix (syscall-number SYS_posix_spawn SYS_wait4))\n"sv);
    builder.append("(allow process-fork)\n(allow process-exec"sv);
    for (auto const& path : executable_paths) {
        builder.append(" (literal "sv);
        append_sandbox_string_literal(builder, path);
        builder.append(')');
    }
    builder.append(")\n"sv);

    // NB: Child processes inherit the sandbox, and dyld needs F_GETPATH to find the shared library cache during startup.
    builder.append("(allow system-fcntl (fcntl-command F_GETPATH))\n"sv);

    return {};
}

static ErrorOr<void> append_allowed_iokit_user_client_classes(StringBuilder& builder, ReadonlySpan<StringView> iokit_user_client_classes)
{
    for (auto const& user_client_class : iokit_user_client_classes) {
        builder.append("(allow iokit-open-user-client (iokit-user-client-class "sv);
        append_sandbox_string_literal(builder, user_client_class);
        builder.append("))\n"sv);
    }

    return {};
}

static ErrorOr<void> append_allowed_mach_services(StringBuilder& builder, SeatbeltProfile const& options)
{
    // The frameworks behind these services read properties of the GPU, media and audio devices, and of the platform.
    // Keep the properties that identify the machine out of reach.
    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::GPU) || has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::VideoDecoding) || has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::Audio)) {
        builder.append(R"~~~(
(allow iokit-get-properties)
(deny iokit-get-properties
    (iokit-property
        "IOMACAddress"
        "IOPlatformSerialNumber"
        "IOPlatformUUID"
        "mlb-serial-number"
        "serial-number"))
)~~~"sv);
    }

    if (!options.mach_server_name.is_empty()) {
        builder.append("(allow mach-lookup (global-name "sv);
        append_sandbox_string_literal(builder, options.mach_server_name);
        builder.append("))\n"sv);
    }

    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::Fonts)) {
        builder.append(R"~~~(
(allow mach-lookup
    (global-name "com.apple.fonts")
    (global-name "com.apple.FontObjectsServer"))
)~~~"sv);
    }

    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::Audio)) {
        builder.append(R"~~~(
(allow mach-lookup
    (global-name "com.apple.audio.audiohald")
    (global-name "com.apple.audio.AudioSession")
    (xpc-service-name "com.apple.audio.SandboxHelper"))
(allow device-microphone)
)~~~"sv);
    }

    // Audio output units and audio decoders alike go through the component registrar.
    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::Audio) || has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::AudioDecoding)) {
        builder.append(R"~~~(
(allow mach-lookup
    (global-name "com.apple.audio.AudioComponentRegistrar"))
)~~~"sv);
    }

    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::VideoDecoding)) {
        builder.append(R"~~~(
(allow mach-lookup
    (xpc-service-name "com.apple.coremedia.videodecoder"))
)~~~"sv);
    }

    // Two frameworks ask for the path behind a descriptor they hold: ANGLE for its own descriptors while it sets up an
    // EGL display, and AudioToolbox's code-signing workaround checks while it creates its first AudioConverter — which
    // crash with SIGBUS rather than fail when the command is denied. F_GETPATH also reveals the path of a descriptor
    // that was handed over without one, so the Audio service alone doesn't grant it: The renderer plays WebAudio, but
    // it also receives files from the Browser. MediaServer decodes, and receives nothing but sockets.
    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::GPU) || has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::AudioDecoding)) {
        builder.append(R"~~~(
(allow system-fcntl
    (fcntl-command F_GETPATH))
)~~~"sv);
    }

    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::JIT))
        builder.append("(allow dynamic-code-generation)\n"sv);

    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::IOSurface)) {
        builder.append(R"~~~(
(allow iokit-open-user-client
    (iokit-user-client-class "IOSurfaceRootUserClient"))
)~~~"sv);
    }

    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::GPU)) {
        builder.append(R"~~~(
(allow mach-lookup
    (global-name "com.apple.CARenderServer")
    (xpc-service-name "com.apple.MTLCompilerService"))

; Metal loads the driver bundles for some GPUs from here.
(allow file-read* file-test-existence
    (subpath "/Library/GPUBundles"))

)~~~"sv);
    }

    // CoreGraphics and CoreVideo reach the window server for anything about displays. Without it,
    // CGGetActiveDisplayList() reports no displays and CVDisplayLinkCreateWithCGDisplay() fails with
    // kCVReturnInvalidDisplay. The GPU processes of Chromium and WebKit allow the same service.
    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::Display)) {
        builder.append(R"~~~(
(allow mach-lookup
    (global-name "com.apple.windowserver.active"))
)~~~"sv);
    }

    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> apply_macos_sandbox(SeatbeltProfile const& options)
{
    StringBuilder profile;
    TRY(profile.try_append(R"~~~(
(version 1)

; Seatbelt otherwise adds syscalls that it thinks go with the allowed operations, such as fork() with process-fork.
(disable-syscall-inference)

(deny default

    (literal "/private/var/db")

    (literal "/private/etc/localtime")

    (subpath "/var/db/timezone")

    (subpath "/usr/share"))

    (subpath "/System")
    (subpath "/usr/lib"))

    if (__builtin_available(macOS 27.0, *))
        TRY(profile.try_append("(allow syscall-unix (syscall-number SYS_pipe2))\n"sv));

    if (options.network_access == NetworkAccess::Allowed) {
        TRY(profile.try_append(R"~~~(
; Connect to hosts on the network and to the system's network daemons, but not to local sockets of other processes.
(allow network-outbound
    (remote ip)
    (control-name "com.apple.netsrc")
    (literal "/private/var/run/mDNSResponder"))

; SecTrust evaluates TLS certificates through the per-user trust daemon.
(allow mach-lookup
    (global-name "com.apple.trustd.agent"))

; Sharing a port with another socket would let a helper receive traffic that is meant for another process.
(deny socket-option-set
    (require-all
        (socket-option-level SOL_SOCKET)
        (socket-option-name SO_REUSEADDR SO_REUSEPORT)))

(allow sysctl-read
    (sysctl-name-prefix "net.routetable."))
(allow system-socket
    (require-all
        (socket-domain AF_SYSTEM)
        (socket-protocol 2)))
(allow system-necp-client-action)
(allow file-test-existence
    (literal "/private/var/run/mDNSResponder")
    (literal "/var/run/mDNSResponder"))
(allow syscall-unix
    (syscall-number
        SYS___channel_open
        SYS_necp_client_action
        SYS_necp_open))
)~~~"sv));
    }

    if (options.network_access == NetworkAccess::Datagrams) {
        TRY(profile.try_append(R"~~~(
; Exchange datagrams with peers from UDP sockets that the helper binds itself, at the addresses of the local interfaces
; that getifaddrs() lists. The mDNS responder shares its port with the system's.
(allow network-outbound
    (remote udp))
(allow network-bind
    (local udp))
(allow network-inbound
    (local udp))
(allow syscall-unix
    (syscall-number SYS_bind))
(allow system-info
    (info-type "net.link.addr"))
(allow sysctl-read
    (sysctl-name-prefix "net.routetable."))
)~~~"sv));
    }

    TRY(append_allowed_paths(profile, "file-read* file-test-existence"sv, options.paths, SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(append_allowed_ancestor_directories(profile, options.paths));
    TRY(append_allowed_paths(profile, "file-map-executable"sv, options.paths, SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadAndExecute));
    TRY(append_allowed_paths(profile, "file-write*"sv, options.paths, SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadWrite));

        Vector<SeatbeltPath> log_paths;
        TRY(add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(log_paths, log->path(), SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadWrite));
        // Only append to this process's already-open log, without granting access to the statistics directory.
        TRY(append_allowed_paths(profile, "file-write-data"sv, log_paths, SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadWrite));
    }
    TRY(append_allowed_paths(profile, "file-lock"sv, options.paths, SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadWrite));
    TRY(append_allowed_path_extensions(profile, options.paths, SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadOnly));
    TRY(append_allowed_path_extensions(profile, options.paths, SeatbeltPath::Access::ReadWrite));
    TRY(append_allowed_executables(profile, options.executable_paths));
    TRY(append_allowed_iokit_user_client_classes(profile, options.iokit_user_client_classes));
    TRY(append_allowed_mach_services(profile, options));

    auto profile_string = profile.to_byte_string();

    // IOSurface loads Launch Services preferences on first use. Do this before sandboxing, since a denied read
    // makes Launch Services log errors whose formatting produces CoreFoundation warnings about URLs without schemes.
    if (has_flag(options.system_services, SystemService::IOSurface))
        Core::IOSurfaceHandle::initialize();

    char* errorbuf = nullptr;
#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
    auto result = sandbox_init_with_parameters(profile_string.characters(), 0, nullptr, &errorbuf);
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop
    if (result < 0) {
        if (errorbuf) {
#    pragma clang diagnostic push
#    pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
            sandbox_free_error(errorbuf);
#    pragma clang diagnostic pop
        }
        return Error::from_string_literal("sandbox_init_with_parameters failed");
    }
    return {};
}
#endif

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
static ErrorOr<size_t> count_threads()
{
    auto* directory = opendir("/proc/self/task");
    if (!directory)
        return Error::from_syscall("opendir(/proc/self/task)"sv, errno);

    size_t thread_count = 0;
    while (auto* entry = readdir(directory)) {
        if (entry->d_name[0] != '.')
            ++thread_count;
    }
    closedir(directory);
    return thread_count;
}

static bool s_signals_stay_within_the_process_tree = false;

bool sandbox_debugging_is_enabled()
{
    auto const* value = getenv("LADYBIRD_SANDBOX_DEBUG");
    return value && *value && StringView { value, strlen(value) } != "0"sv;
}

bool signals_stay_within_the_process_tree()
{
    return s_signals_stay_within_the_process_tree;
}

static ErrorOr<void> restrict_filesystem_with_landlock(ReadonlySpan<PathRule> paths, long landlock_abi)
{
    // Before ABI 3, Landlock does not handle truncation, so a helper can truncate any file that it can open.
    static bool s_warned_about_truncation = false;
    if (landlock_abi < 3 && !s_warned_about_truncation) {
        s_warned_about_truncation = true;
        warnln("Landlock ABI {} does not restrict file truncation. Linux 6.2 or later is needed for that.", landlock_abi);
    }

    landlock_ruleset_attr ruleset_attributes {};
    ruleset_attributes.handled_access_fs = LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_EXECUTE
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_WRITE_FILE
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_FILE
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_DIR
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REMOVE_DIR
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REMOVE_FILE
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_CHAR
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_DIR
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_REG
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_SOCK
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_FIFO
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_BLOCK
        | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_SYM;

#    ifdef LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REFER
    if (landlock_abi >= 2)
        ruleset_attributes.handled_access_fs |= LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REFER;
#    endif
#    ifdef LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_TRUNCATE
    if (landlock_abi >= 3)
        ruleset_attributes.handled_access_fs |= LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_TRUNCATE;
#    endif
#    if defined(LANDLOCK_ACCESS_NET_BIND_TCP) && defined(LANDLOCK_ACCESS_NET_CONNECT_TCP)
    auto ruleset_attributes_size = offsetof(landlock_ruleset_attr, handled_access_net);
#    else
    auto ruleset_attributes_size = sizeof(ruleset_attributes);
#    endif
#    ifdef LANDLOCK_SCOPE_ABSTRACT_UNIX_SOCKET
    if (landlock_abi >= 6) {
        ruleset_attributes.scoped = LANDLOCK_SCOPE_ABSTRACT_UNIX_SOCKET;
#        ifdef LANDLOCK_SCOPE_SIGNAL
        ruleset_attributes.scoped |= LANDLOCK_SCOPE_SIGNAL;
#        endif
        ruleset_attributes_size = offsetof(landlock_ruleset_attr, scoped) + sizeof(ruleset_attributes.scoped);
    }
#    endif
    auto ruleset_fd = syscall(__NR_landlock_create_ruleset, &ruleset_attributes, ruleset_attributes_size, 0);
    if (ruleset_fd < 0)
        return Error::from_syscall("landlock_create_ruleset"sv, errno);

    ArmedScopeGuard close_ruleset_fd = [&] {
        close(static_cast<int>(ruleset_fd));
    };

    for (auto const& landlock_path : paths) {
        auto path_fd = open(landlock_path.path.characters(), O_PATH | O_CLOEXEC);
        if (path_fd < 0)
            return Error::from_syscall("open(O_PATH)"sv, errno);

        ArmedScopeGuard close_path_fd = [&] {
            close(path_fd);
        };

        landlock_path_beneath_attr path_beneath {};
        switch (landlock_path.access) {
        case PathRule::Access::ReadOnly: {
            path_beneath.allowed_access = LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_FILE;

            if (landlock_path.is_directory)
                path_beneath.allowed_access |= LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_DIR;
            break;
        }
        case PathRule::Access::ReadAndExecute: {
            path_beneath.allowed_access = LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_FILE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_EXECUTE;

            if (landlock_path.is_directory)
                path_beneath.allowed_access |= LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_DIR;
            break;
        }
        case PathRule::Access::ReadWrite: {
            path_beneath.allowed_access = LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_FILE | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_WRITE_FILE;

#    ifdef LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_TRUNCATE
            if (landlock_abi >= 3)
                path_beneath.allowed_access |= LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_TRUNCATE;
#    endif

            if (landlock_path.is_directory) {
                path_beneath.allowed_access |= LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_READ_DIR
                    | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REMOVE_DIR
                    | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REMOVE_FILE
                    | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_DIR
                    | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_REG
                    | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_SOCK
                    | LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_MAKE_FIFO;

#    ifdef LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REFER
                if (landlock_abi >= 2)
                    path_beneath.allowed_access |= LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REFER;
#    endif
            }
            break;
        }
        }
        path_beneath.parent_fd = path_fd;
        if (syscall(__NR_landlock_add_rule, ruleset_fd, LANDLOCK_RULE_PATH_BENEATH, &path_beneath, 0) < 0)
            return Error::from_syscall("landlock_add_rule"sv, errno);
    }

    if (syscall(__NR_landlock_restrict_self, ruleset_fd, 0) < 0)
        return Error::from_syscall("landlock_restrict_self"sv, errno);
#    if defined(LANDLOCK_SCOPE_ABSTRACT_UNIX_SOCKET) && defined(LANDLOCK_SCOPE_SIGNAL)
    s_signals_stay_within_the_process_tree = landlock_abi >= 6;
#    endif

    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> restrict_filesystem(ReadonlySpan<PathRule> paths)
{
    // Landlock confines only the calling thread and the threads that it starts later, and forking the broker is only
    // safe with one thread. A thread that already runs would keep full access to the file system.
    if (TRY(count_threads()) != 1)
        return Error::from_string_literal("The file system must be restricted before the process starts a second thread");

    // Any failure means we can't have Landlock here: a kernel without it says ENOSYS or EOPNOTSUPP, and a container's
    // own seccomp filter can say anything.
    auto landlock_abi = syscall(__NR_landlock_create_ruleset, nullptr, 0, LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION);
    if (landlock_abi > 0 && !sandbox_debugging_is_enabled())
        return restrict_filesystem_with_landlock(paths, landlock_abi);

    return start_file_broker(paths);
}
#endif

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/EnumBits.h>
#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Platform.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>

namespace Sandbox {

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
struct PathRule {
    enum class Access {
        ReadOnly,
        ReadAndExecute,
        ReadWrite,
    };

    ByteString path;
    Access access { Access::ReadOnly };
    bool is_directory { false };
};
#endif

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
struct SeatbeltPath {
    enum class Access {
        ReadOnly,
        ReadAndExecute,
        ReadWrite,
    };

    ByteString path;
    Access access { Access::ReadOnly };
    bool is_directory { false };
};

enum class NetworkAccess {
    Denied,
    Allowed,
    // Only UDP datagrams, sent to any host and received on sockets the helper binds itself, as ICE and mDNS need.
    Datagrams,
};

// System services that a helper may use, in addition to its own Browser endpoint.
enum class SystemService : u8 {
    None = 0,
    Fonts = 1 << 0,
    Audio = 1 << 1,
    VideoDecoding = 1 << 2,
    GPU = 1 << 3,
    IOSurface = 1 << 4,
    // Mapping MAP_JIT memory, for the code that JIT compilers generate.
    JIT = 1 << 5,
    // Enumerating displays and following their refresh, which CoreGraphics and CoreVideo do through the window server.
    Display = 1 << 6,
    // Decoding audio with the platform's codecs, in addition to playing it.
    AudioDecoding = 1 << 7,
};
AK_ENUM_BITWISE_OPERATORS(SystemService);

struct SeatbeltProfile {
    ReadonlySpan<SeatbeltPath> paths {};
    NetworkAccess network_access { NetworkAccess::Denied };
    ReadonlySpan<ByteString> executable_paths {};
    ReadonlySpan<StringView> iokit_user_client_classes {};

    // The bootstrap name of the Browser endpoint that the helper connects to after installing the sandbox.
    StringView mach_server_name {};
    SystemService system_services { SystemService::None };
};
#endif

[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> install_no_new_privileges();
[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> configure_runtime();

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> add_path_if_exists(Vector<PathRule>& paths, StringView path, PathRule::Access);
[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> add_loaded_library_directories(Vector<PathRule>& paths, Optional<StringView> root = {});
[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> restrict_filesystem(ReadonlySpan<PathRule> = {});
// Whether restrict_filesystem() also kept this process from signalling any process outside its own tree.
[[nodiscard]] bool signals_stay_within_the_process_tree();
// Whether LADYBIRD_SANDBOX_DEBUG asks the sandbox to log what it refuses. The file broker then confines the file system
// even where Landlock exists, because Landlock refuses a path without telling the process, and the broker can log it.
[[nodiscard]] bool sandbox_debugging_is_enabled();
[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> add_gpu_driver_paths(Vector<PathRule>& paths);
#endif

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> add_seatbelt_path_if_exists(Vector<SeatbeltPath>& paths, StringView path, SeatbeltPath::Access);
[[nodiscard]] ErrorOr<void> apply_macos_sandbox(SeatbeltProfile const&);

// Returns the .app bundle that contains the executable, if the executable is in the bundle's Contents/MacOS directory.
[[nodiscard]] Optional<ByteString> application_bundle_for_executable(StringView executable_path);
#endif

}

namespace Sandbox {

namespace {

#if defined(__x86_64__)
static constexpr u32 audit_architecture = AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64;
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
static constexpr u32 audit_architecture = AUDIT_ARCH_AARCH64;
#elif defined(__riscv) && __riscv_xlen == 64
static constexpr u32 audit_architecture = AUDIT_ARCH_RISCV64;
#else
#    error "Add 64-bit seccomp audit architecture for this Linux architecture"
#endif

static constexpr u16 emulate_fstatat_trap = 1;
static constexpr u16 broker_socket_trap = 2;
static constexpr u16 broker_connect_trap = 3;
static constexpr u16 file_broker_trap = 4;
static constexpr u16 signal_mask_trap = 5;
// A refusal for a system call that the file system filter sends to the broker. The policy can't refuse it with an errno,
// because the kernel takes the filter's trap over that, so it traps too, with the errno added to this.
static constexpr u16 refused_path_syscall_trap = 0x1000;
// A refusal that is logged before the errno added to this goes back, when sandbox debugging is on.
static constexpr u16 logged_refusal_trap = 0x2000;

static constexpr u32 thread_clone_required_flags = CLONE_VM | CLONE_FS | CLONE_FILES | CLONE_SIGHAND | CLONE_THREAD;
static constexpr u32 thread_clone_allowed_flags = thread_clone_required_flags
    | CLONE_SYSVSEM
    | CLONE_SETTLS
    | CLONE_PARENT_SETTID
    | CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID
    | CLONE_DETACHED
    | CLONE_CHILD_SETTID;
static constexpr u32 fork_clone_flags = CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID | CLONE_CHILD_SETTID | SIGCHLD;

// A refusal gives the system call an errno. With sandbox debugging on, it traps first, so the refusal can be logged.
static sock_filter refusal_action(int error)
{
    if (sandbox_debugging_is_enabled())
        return BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_TRAP | (logged_refusal_trap + error));
    return BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO | (static_cast<u32>(error) & SECCOMP_RET_DATA));
}

static constexpr unsigned read_only_open_flags = [] {
    unsigned flags = O_CLOEXEC | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOCTTY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK;
#ifdef O_LARGEFILE
    flags |= O_LARGEFILE;
#endif
    return flags;
}();

#define SECCOMP_LOAD_SYSCALL_NR BPF_STMT(BPF_LD | BPF_W | BPF_ABS, static_cast<unsigned int>(offsetof(seccomp_data, nr)))
#define SECCOMP_LOAD_ARCHITECTURE BPF_STMT(BPF_LD | BPF_W | BPF_ABS, static_cast<unsigned int>(offsetof(seccomp_data, arch)))
#define SECCOMP_LOAD_ARGUMENT(index) BPF_STMT(BPF_LD | BPF_W | BPF_ABS, static_cast<unsigned int>(offsetof(seccomp_data, args[(index)])))
#define SECCOMP_ALLOW BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW)
#define SECCOMP_TRAP BPF_STMT(BPF_RET | BPF_K, SECCOMP_RET_TRAP)
#define SECCOMP_ERRNO(error) refusal_action(error)
#define SECCOMP_ALLOW_NOTHING BPF_STMT(BPF_ALU | BPF_ADD | BPF_K, 0)
#define SECCOMP_APPEND_ALLOW_SYSCALL(policy, name)                               \
    do {                                                                         \
        (policy).append(BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, __NR_##name, 0, 1)); \
        (policy).append(SECCOMP_ALLOW);                                          \
    } while (0)
#define SECCOMP_APPEND_ALLOW_SYSCALL_IF_DEFINED(policy, name) \
    IF_DEFINED_##name(SECCOMP_APPEND_ALLOW_SYSCALL(policy, name), (policy).append(SECCOMP_ALLOW_NOTHING))

// A system call that takes a path is allowed when Landlock decides which paths work. Without Landlock, the file system
// filter beneath every policy sends it to the broker or refuses it, which wins over the allow here.
#define SECCOMP_APPEND_PATH_SYSCALL_IF_DEFINED(policy, name) \
    IF_DEFINED_##name(do {                                                                        \
        (policy).append(BPF_JUMP(BPF_JMP | BPF_JEQ | BPF_K, __NR_##name, 0, 1));                  \
        (policy).append((policy).path_syscall_action()); } while (0), (policy).append(SECCOMP_ALLOW_NOTHING))

#    define IF_DEFINED_wait4(if_defined, if_not_defined) if_not_defined
#endif
#ifndef __NR_waitid
#    undef IF_DEFINED_waitid
#    define IF_DEFINED_waitid(if_defined, if_not_defined) if_not_defined
#endif

static size_t safe_string_length(char const* string)
{
    size_t length = 0;
    while (string[length] != '\0')
        ++length;
    return length;
}

// Builds one line of a log message, so that it reaches stderr in one write and lines from two threads never mix.
static void write_bytes_to_stderr(char const* data, size_t length)
{
    while (length > 0) {
        auto written = write(STDERR_FILENO, data, length);
        if (written <= 0)
            return;
        data += written;
        length -= static_cast<size_t>(written);
    }
}

static void write_string_to_stderr(char const* string)
{
    write_bytes_to_stderr(string, safe_string_length(string));
}

class LogLine {
public:
    void append(char const* string) { append_bytes(string, safe_string_length(string)); }

    void append_unsigned(u64 value)
    {
        char buffer[20];
        size_t index = sizeof(buffer);
        do {
            buffer[--index] = static_cast<char>('0' + (value % 10));
            value /= 10;
        } while (value > 0);
        append_bytes(buffer + index, sizeof(buffer) - index);
    }

    void append_hex(u64 value)
    {
        constexpr char const* digits = "0123456789abcdef";
        char buffer[16];
        size_t index = sizeof(buffer);
        do {
            buffer[--index] = digits[value & 0xf];
            value >>= 4;
        } while (value > 0);
        append("0x");
        append_bytes(buffer + index, sizeof(buffer) - index);
    }

    // The line as a C string. The byte that append_bytes() keeps free for the newline holds the terminator.
    char const* text()
    {
        m_data[m_length] = '\0';
        return m_data;
    }

    void write_to_stderr()
    {
        append("\n");
        write_bytes_to_stderr(m_data, m_length);
    }

private:
    void append_bytes(char const* bytes, size_t length)
    {
        // The last byte is kept for the newline.
        auto room = sizeof(m_data) - 1 - m_length;
        if (length > room)
            length = room;
        __builtin_memcpy(m_data + m_length, bytes, length);
        m_length += length;
    }

    char m_data[512];
    size_t m_length { 0 };
};
