//! Accesses of memories without guard pages, atomics, and GC objects: their addresses and checks, and the tests of
//! references against heap types.

use super::{ADDRESS, CodeGenerator, FP, SCRATCH, gpr};
use crate::asm::aarch64::{AtomicRmw, AtomicSize, Cond, Extend, MemOperand, Shift};
use crate::asm::{Gpr, Label, Width};
use crate::convention::{self, Register};
use crate::ir::{AtomicOp, CHECKED_ATOMIC, CHECKED_MEMORY64, HeapTest, Op, REF_TEST_CAST, REF_TEST_NULLABLE, Value};
use crate::regalloc::{CONSTANT_INPUT, NO_REGISTER};
use libwasm_module::abi::{
    ExecutionContext, FunctionHeader, InstanceData, MemoryData, OBJECT_DATA_OFFSET, OBJECT_LENGTH_OFFSET,
    RTT_KIND_ARRAY, RTT_KIND_STRUCT, Rtt, TRAP_ARRAY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, TRAP_CAST_FAILURE, TRAP_MEMORY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS,
    TRAP_NULL_REFERENCE, TRAP_UNALIGNED_ATOMIC,
};
use std::mem::offset_of;

/// An operand of a 32-bit comparison: a register, or an immediate.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) enum Operand32 {
    Register(Gpr),
    Immediate(u32),
}

fn field(offset: usize) -> i32 {
    offset as i32
}

impl CodeGenerator<'_> {
    pub(super) fn lower_gc(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let input = |index: usize| gpr(record.inputs[index]);
        match node.op {
            Op::CheckedAddress => self.checked_address(value),
            Op::AtomicRmw => {
                let size = AtomicSize::from_log2(u32::from(node.flags));
                let (address, operand) = (input(0), input(1));
                let old = if record.output == NO_REGISTER {
                    SCRATCH
                } else {
                    gpr(record.output)
                };
                // The acquire-release forms make every atomic access sequentially consistent with the others.
                let (op, source) = match AtomicOp::from_index(node.args[2]) {
                    AtomicOp::Add => (AtomicRmw::Add, operand),
                    AtomicOp::Sub => {
                        self.asm.neg(Width::W64, SCRATCH, operand);
                        (AtomicRmw::Add, SCRATCH)
                    }
                    AtomicOp::And => {
                        self.asm.mvn(Width::W64, SCRATCH, operand);
                        (AtomicRmw::Clear, SCRATCH)
                    }
                    AtomicOp::Or => (AtomicRmw::Set, operand),
                    AtomicOp::Xor => (AtomicRmw::Xor, operand),
                    AtomicOp::Exchange => (AtomicRmw::Swap, operand),
                };
                self.asm.atomic_rmw(op, size, source, old, address);
            }
            Op::AtomicCompareExchange => {
                let size = AtomicSize::from_log2(u32::from(node.flags));
                // NB: Only the low bytes of the expected value are compared, which is the value wrapped at the access
                //     width. The old value comes back zero-extended in its place.
                self.asm.mov(Width::W64, SCRATCH, input(1));
                self.asm.compare_and_swap(size, SCRATCH, input(2), input(0));
                self.asm.mov(Width::W64, gpr(record.output), SCRATCH);
            }
            Op::AtomicFence => self.asm.dmb_ish(),
            Op::Rtt => {
                let (instance, output) = (input(0), gpr(record.output));
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W64,
                    SCRATCH,
                    MemOperand::Offset(instance, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, type_identities))),
                );
                let operand = self.operand(SCRATCH, 4 * i64::from(node.args[1]), 2);
                self.asm.ldr(Width::W32, SCRATCH, operand);
                self.rtts(output, instance);
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W64,
                    output,
                    MemOperand::Register {
                        base: output,
                        index: SCRATCH,
                        extend: Extend::Uxtx,
                        shifted: true,
                    },
                );
            }
            Op::I31New => {
                // NB: Shifting the 32-bit value left drops its bit 31: ((value & 0x7fffffff) << 1) | 1.
                let output = gpr(record.output);
                self.asm.lsl_imm(Width::W32, output, input(0), 1);
                self.asm.orr_imm(Width::W32, output, output, 1);
            }
            Op::I31Get => {
                let output = gpr(record.output);
                if node.flags != 0 {
                    self.asm.asr_imm(Width::W32, output, input(0), 1);
                } else {
                    self.asm.lsr_imm(Width::W32, output, input(0), 1);
                }
            }
            Op::ElementAddress => {
                let (array, index, output) = (input(0), input(1), gpr(record.output));
                let null = self.trap_label(TRAP_NULL_REFERENCE);
                self.asm.cbz(Width::W64, array, null);
                // NB: The index is zero-extended, so a 64-bit comparison checks it as an unsigned i32.
                let operand = self.operand(array, i64::from(field(OBJECT_LENGTH_OFFSET)), 3);
                self.asm.ldr(Width::W64, SCRATCH, operand);
                self.asm.cmp(Width::W64, index, SCRATCH);
                let out_of_bounds = self.trap_label(TRAP_ARRAY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Hs, out_of_bounds);
                let operand = self.operand(array, i64::from(field(OBJECT_DATA_OFFSET)), 3);
                self.asm.ldr(Width::W64, output, operand);
                // Elements take 1 << flags bytes each.
                self.asm
                    .add_extended(Width::W64, output, output, index, Extend::Uxtx, node.flags);
            }
            Op::RefTest => self.ref_test(value),
            _ => unreachable!("{} is no GC or atomic operation", node.op.name()),
        }
    }

    /// `output` = the runtime types of the store, from `instance`.
    fn rtts(&mut self, output: Gpr, instance: Gpr) {
        self.asm.ldr(
            Width::W64,
            output,
            MemOperand::Offset(instance, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
        );
        self.asm.ldr(
            Width::W64,
            output,
            MemOperand::Offset(output, field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, rtts))),
        );
    }

    /// The address of a checked access: the memory's base + index + offset, after checking that index + offset +
    /// size is at most the memory's size, and for atomics that index + offset is aligned.
    fn checked_address(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let size = 1u64 << (node.flags & 7);
        let memory64 = node.flags & CHECKED_MEMORY64 != 0;
        let (memory, index, output) = (gpr(record.inputs[0]), gpr(record.inputs[1]), gpr(record.output));
        let out_of_bounds = self.trap_label(TRAP_MEMORY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        // The end of the access, which may wrap around for a memory64; i32 indices are zero-extended already.
        let end = SCRATCH;
        if record.inputs[2] == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            let offset = self.immediate(value, 2);
            match offset.checked_add(size) {
                Some(total) if total < (1 << 12) => {
                    self.asm.adds_imm(Width::W64, end, index, total as u32, false);
                }
                Some(total) => {
                    self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, ADDRESS, total);
                    self.asm.adds(Width::W64, end, index, ADDRESS, Shift::Lsl, 0);
                }
                None => {
                    // The offset alone is within the size of 2^64: every index wraps around.
                    self.asm.b(out_of_bounds);
                    return;
                }
            }
            if memory64 {
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Hs, out_of_bounds);
            }
        } else {
            self.asm
                .adds(Width::W64, end, index, gpr(record.inputs[2]), Shift::Lsl, 0);
            if memory64 {
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Hs, out_of_bounds);
            }
            self.asm.adds_imm(Width::W64, end, end, size as u32, false);
            if memory64 {
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Hs, out_of_bounds);
            }
        }
        self.asm.ldr(
            Width::W64,
            ADDRESS,
            MemOperand::Offset(memory, field(offset_of!(MemoryData, size))),
        );
        self.asm.cmp(Width::W64, end, ADDRESS);
        self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Hi, out_of_bounds);
        if node.flags & CHECKED_ATOMIC != 0 && size > 1 {
            // NB: The end and the address differ by the size, a multiple of the alignment.
            let unaligned = self.trap_label(TRAP_UNALIGNED_ATOMIC);
            self.asm.tst_imm(Width::W64, end, size - 1);
            self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Ne, unaligned);
        }
        self.asm.ldr(
            Width::W64,
            output,
            MemOperand::Offset(memory, field(offset_of!(MemoryData, base))),
        );
        self.asm.add(Width::W64, output, output, end, Shift::Lsl, 0);
        self.asm.sub_imm(Width::W64, output, output, size as u32, false);
    }

    /// Compares the u32 in `register` with `operand`.
    fn compare32(&mut self, register: Gpr, operand: Operand32) {
        match operand {
            Operand32::Register(other) => self.asm.cmp(Width::W32, register, other),
            Operand32::Immediate(immediate) => self.compare_immediate(Width::W32, register, u64::from(immediate)),
        }
    }

    /// Branches to `failed` unless the type whose Rtt is in `rtt` is the expected type, of `identity` at `depth`, or
    /// a subtype of it: a type's display lists the identities of its supertypes by depth, and its own last. Clobbers
    /// `rtt` and ADDRESS.
    pub(super) fn check_subtype(&mut self, rtt: Gpr, depth: Operand32, identity: Operand32, failed: Label) {
        self.asm.ldr(
            Width::W32,
            ADDRESS,
            MemOperand::Offset(rtt, field(offset_of!(Rtt, depth))),
        );
        self.compare32(ADDRESS, depth);
        self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Lo, failed);
        self.asm.ldr(
            Width::W64,
            rtt,
            MemOperand::Offset(rtt, field(offset_of!(Rtt, display))),
        );
        let entry = match depth {
            Operand32::Register(depth) => MemOperand::Register {
                base: rtt,
                index: depth,
                extend: Extend::Uxtx,
                shifted: true,
            },
            Operand32::Immediate(depth) => self.operand(rtt, 4 * i64::from(depth), 2),
        };
        self.asm.ldr(Width::W32, ADDRESS, entry);
        self.compare32(ADDRESS, identity);
        self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Ne, failed);
    }

    /// `RefTest`: whether a reference matches a heap type, as 0 or 1, or for a cast a trap where it does not.
    fn ref_test(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let reference = gpr(record.inputs[0]);
        let identity: Register = record.inputs[1];
        let depth = node.args[2];
        let cast = node.flags & REF_TEST_CAST != 0;
        let matched = self.asm.new_label();
        let failed = if cast {
            self.trap_label(TRAP_CAST_FAILURE)
        } else {
            self.asm.new_label()
        };
        let null_matches = node.flags & REF_TEST_NULLABLE != 0;
        self.asm
            .cbz(Width::W64, reference, if null_matches { matched } else { failed });
        let identity = if identity == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            Operand32::Immediate(self.immediate(value, 1) as u32)
        } else {
            Operand32::Register(gpr(identity))
        };
        let subtype_check = |generator: &mut Self, rtt: Gpr| {
            generator.check_subtype(rtt, Operand32::Immediate(depth), identity, failed);
        };
        match HeapTest::from_flags(node.flags) {
            HeapTest::NonNull => {}
            HeapTest::Nothing => self.asm.b(failed),
            HeapTest::I31 => {
                self.asm.tbz(reference, 0, failed);
            }
            HeapTest::Eq => {
                // An i31 (bit 0), or a GC object (bits 1:0 clear) rather than a host value (0b10).
                self.asm.tbnz(reference, 0, matched);
                self.asm.tbnz(reference, 1, failed);
            }
            kind @ (HeapTest::Struct | HeapTest::Array) => {
                let rtt = gpr(record.temps[0]);
                self.asm.tst_imm(Width::W64, reference, 3);
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Ne, failed);
                self.asm.ldr(Width::W64, rtt, MemOperand::Offset(reference, 0));
                let expected = if kind == HeapTest::Struct {
                    RTT_KIND_STRUCT
                } else {
                    RTT_KIND_ARRAY
                };
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W32,
                    ADDRESS,
                    MemOperand::Offset(rtt, field(offset_of!(Rtt, kind))),
                );
                self.compare_immediate(Width::W32, ADDRESS, u64::from(expected));
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Ne, failed);
            }
            HeapTest::ConcreteObject => {
                let rtt = gpr(record.temps[0]);
                self.asm.tst_imm(Width::W64, reference, 3);
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Ne, failed);
                self.asm.ldr(Width::W64, rtt, MemOperand::Offset(reference, 0));
                subtype_check(self, rtt);
            }
            HeapTest::ConcreteFunction => {
                let [rtt, rtts] = [gpr(record.temps[0]), gpr(record.temps[1])];
                let type_identity = MemOperand::Offset(reference, field(offset_of!(FunctionHeader, type_identity)));
                self.asm.ldr(Width::W32, ADDRESS, type_identity);
                self.compare32(ADDRESS, identity);
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Eq, matched);
                self.asm.ldr(Width::W32, rtt, type_identity);
                self.asm
                    .ldr(Width::W64, rtts, MemOperand::Offset(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
                self.rtts(rtts, rtts);
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W64,
                    rtt,
                    MemOperand::Register {
                        base: rtts,
                        index: rtt,
                        extend: Extend::Uxtx,
                        shifted: true,
                    },
                );
                subtype_check(self, rtt);
            }
        }
        self.asm.bind(matched);
        if cast {
            return;
        }
        let output = gpr(record.output);
        let done = self.asm.new_label();
        self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W32, output, 1);
        self.asm.b(done);
        self.asm.bind(failed);
        self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W32, output, 0);
        self.asm.bind(done);
    }
}

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

//! Loads and stores of memory 0, globals and instance data.
//!
//! Memory 0 is a memory32 with guard pages: an access is at base + zero-extended index + offset, with no bounds
//! check, and faults in the guard region where it is out of bounds. i32 values are always zero-extended in
//! registers, so the index register serves as is.

use super::{ADDRESS, CodeGenerator, SCRATCH, fits_offset, fpr, fpr_access, gpr, gpr_access};
use crate::asm::aarch64::{AtomicSize, Extend, MemOp, MemOperand, XZR};
use crate::asm::{Gpr, Width};
use crate::convention::{self, Register};
use crate::ir::{LOAD_ATOMIC, LoadKind, Op, Type, Value};
use crate::regalloc::CONSTANT_INPUT;

/// The memory operation of a load of kind `kind` into a general purpose register.
fn load_op(kind: LoadKind) -> MemOp {
    match kind {
        LoadKind::I32 | LoadKind::I64U32 => MemOp::LdrW,
        LoadKind::I64 => MemOp::LdrX,
        LoadKind::F32 => MemOp::LdrS,
        LoadKind::F64 => MemOp::LdrD,
        LoadKind::I32S8 => MemOp::LdrsbW,
        LoadKind::I64S8 => MemOp::LdrsbX,
        LoadKind::I32U8 | LoadKind::I64U8 => MemOp::Ldrb,
        LoadKind::I32S16 => MemOp::LdrshW,
        LoadKind::I64S16 => MemOp::LdrshX,
        LoadKind::I32U16 | LoadKind::I64U16 => MemOp::Ldrh,
        LoadKind::I64S32 => MemOp::Ldrsw,
    }
}

impl CodeGenerator<'_> {
    /// The operand of an access of `1 << size_log2` bytes of memory 0 with base `base`, index input `index` and
    /// offset `offset`.
    pub(super) fn memory_operand(
        &mut self,
        value: Value,
        base: Register,
        index: Register,
        offset: u32,
        size_log2: u32,
    ) -> MemOperand {
        let base = gpr(base);
        if index == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            let constant = (self.immediate(value, 1) & 0xffff_ffff) + u64::from(offset);
            if fits_offset(constant as i64, size_log2) {
                return MemOperand::Offset(base, constant as i32);
            }
            self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, ADDRESS, constant);
            return MemOperand::Register {
                base,
                index: ADDRESS,
                extend: Extend::Uxtx,
                shifted: false,
            };
        }
        if offset == 0 {
            return MemOperand::Register {
                base,
                index: gpr(index),
                extend: Extend::Uxtx,
                shifted: false,
            };
        }
        // NB: The index and offset, both below 2^32, add up without overflowing 64 bits.
        self.asm.add_any(ADDRESS, gpr(index), i64::from(offset), ADDRESS);
        MemOperand::Register {
            base,
            index: ADDRESS,
            extend: Extend::Uxtx,
            shifted: false,
        }
    }

    /// The address of an access in a register: `base` itself if `operand` is `[base]`, else x17.
    pub(super) fn address_register(&mut self, operand: MemOperand) -> Gpr {
        match operand {
            MemOperand::Offset(base, 0) => base,
            MemOperand::Offset(base, offset) => {
                self.asm.add_any(ADDRESS, base, i64::from(offset), ADDRESS);
                ADDRESS
            }
            MemOperand::Register { base, index, .. } => {
                self.asm.add_extended(Width::W64, ADDRESS, base, index, Extend::Uxtx, 0);
                ADDRESS
            }
            _ => unreachable!("no address of {operand:?}"),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn lower_memory(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let [a, b, c] = record.inputs;
        let output = record.output;
        match node.op {
            Op::Load => {
                let kind = LoadKind::from_flags(node.flags & !LOAD_ATOMIC);
                let size_log2 = kind.size().trailing_zeros();
                let operand = self.memory_operand(value, a, b, node.args[2], size_log2);
                if node.flags & LOAD_ATOMIC != 0 {
                    // Acquire loads, with the stores' exchanges, make atomic accesses sequentially consistent.
                    let address = self.address_register(operand);
                    self.asm
                        .load_acquire(AtomicSize::from_log2(size_log2), gpr(output), address);
                    return;
                }
                let op = load_op(kind);
                let register = if kind.size() >= 4 && matches!(kind, LoadKind::F32 | LoadKind::F64) {
                    fpr(output).0
                } else {
                    gpr(output).0
                };
                self.asm.load_store(op, register, operand);
            }
            Op::VectorLoad => {
                let operand_of = |generator: &mut Self, size_log2: u32| {
                    generator.memory_operand(value, a, b, node.args[2], size_log2)
                };
                self.vector_load(value, operand_of);
            }
            Op::Store => {
                let size = crate::ir::store_size(node.flags);
                let size_log2 = size.trailing_zeros();
                let operand = self.memory_operand(value, a, b, node.args[2], size_log2);
                let stored = func.inputs(value)[2];
                self.store(stored, c, size_log2, operand);
            }
            Op::GlobalGet => {
                let size_log2 = if node.ty == Type::V128 {
                    4
                } else if node.ty.is_64() {
                    3
                } else {
                    2
                };
                let operand = MemOperand::Offset(gpr(a), 0);
                if node.ty.uses_xmm() {
                    self.asm.load_store(fpr_access(size_log2, true), fpr(output).0, operand);
                } else {
                    self.asm.load_store(gpr_access(size_log2, true), gpr(output).0, operand);
                }
            }
            Op::GlobalSet => {
                let stored = node.args[1];
                let size_log2 = match func.node(stored).ty {
                    Type::V128 => 4,
                    ty if ty.is_64() => 3,
                    _ => 2,
                };
                self.store(stored, b, size_log2, MemOperand::Offset(gpr(a), 0));
            }
            Op::FrameLoad => {
                let size_log2 = if node.ty == Type::V128 {
                    4
                } else if node.ty.is_64() {
                    3
                } else {
                    2
                };
                // NB: The slot of a v128 local holds the address of its storage, 8 bytes; other slots the value, whose
                //     size decides which offsets the load takes.
                let slot_size_log2 = if node.flags == 1 { 3 } else { size_log2 };
                let mut operand = self.operand(gpr(a), i64::from(node.args[1] as i32), slot_size_log2);
                if node.flags == 1 {
                    self.asm.ldr(Width::W64, ADDRESS, operand);
                    operand = MemOperand::Offset(ADDRESS, 0);
                }
                if node.ty.uses_xmm() {
                    self.asm.load_store(fpr_access(size_log2, true), fpr(output).0, operand);
                } else {
                    self.asm.load_store(gpr_access(size_log2, true), gpr(output).0, operand);
                }
            }
            Op::InstanceField | Op::LoadPointer => {
                let size_log2 = if node.op == Op::LoadPointer && node.flags == 4 {
                    2
                } else {
                    3
                };
                let operand = self.operand(gpr(a), i64::from(node.args[1]), size_log2);
                self.asm.load_store(gpr_access(size_log2, true), gpr(output).0, operand);
            }
            _ => unreachable!("{} is no memory op", node.op.name()),
        }
    }

    /// Stores `1 << size_log2` bytes of `stored`, which is in `register` or a constant immediate, at `operand`.
    pub(super) fn store(&mut self, stored: Value, register: Register, size_log2: u32, operand: MemOperand) {
        if register == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            let node = self.func.node(stored);
            if node.op == Op::Const128 {
                let bits = self.constant_bits(stored);
                self.load_vector_constant(bits, super::SCRATCH_FPR, true);
                self.asm.load_store(fpr_access(4, false), super::SCRATCH_FPR.0, operand);
                return;
            }
            let bits = node.constant().expect("immediates are constants");
            let source = if bits == 0 {
                XZR
            } else {
                self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, bits);
                SCRATCH
            };
            self.asm.load_store(gpr_access(size_log2, false), source.0, operand);
            return;
        }
        if convention::is_fpr(register) {
            self.asm
                .load_store(fpr_access(size_log2.max(2), false), fpr(register).0, operand);
            return;
        }
        self.asm
            .load_store(gpr_access(size_log2, false), gpr(register).0, operand);
    }
}

/*

//! AArch64 code generation: the blocks in linear order, each node lowered with the registers the allocator gave it
//! (`numeric`, `memory`, `calls`, `tables`, `gc`, `vector`), then the out-of-line code: stubs for edges that need
//! moves, trap stubs and the subtype checks of indirect calls. The code is position independent: it reaches the
//! runtime through absolute addresses, has its jump tables inline, and builds its constants with moves, so it needs
//! no literal pool.
//!
//! x16 and x17 are the scratch registers, v30 and v31 the vector ones; the allocator never gives them out. x17 only
//! ever holds an address being formed (`operand()`), so a lowering may keep a value in x16 across an access.
//! Frame slots are addressed from sp, which is fp minus the frame size everywhere but in tail calls, so that their
//! offsets are positive and fit the scaled immediate forms.

mod calls;
mod gc;
mod memory;
mod numeric;
mod tables;
mod vector;

pub(crate) use vector::{is_vector_shift, vector_temps};

use crate::RuntimeInfo;
use crate::asm::aarch64::{Assembler, Cond, Extend, FloatSize, MemOp, MemOperand, PairOperand, Shift, X16, X17, XZR};
use crate::asm::{Fpr, Gpr, Label, Width};
use crate::convention::{self, Register};
use crate::ir::{BlockId, FloatCondition, Func, IntCondition, NONE, Op, Type, Value};
use crate::regalloc::{Allocation, Location, Move, NO_REGISTER, NO_SLOT};
use libwasm_module::abi::{ExecutionContext, InstanceData};
use std::mem::offset_of;

pub(crate) fn gpr(register: Register) -> Gpr {
    debug_assert!(
        !convention::is_fpr(register),
        "r{register} is no general purpose register"
    );
    Gpr(register)
}

pub(crate) fn fpr(register: Register) -> Fpr {
    debug_assert!(convention::is_fpr(register), "r{register} is no vector register");
    Fpr(convention::vector_register(register))
}

pub(crate) fn width(ty: Type) -> Width {
    if ty.is_64() { Width::W64 } else { Width::W32 }
}

pub(crate) fn float_size(ty: Type) -> FloatSize {
    if ty == Type::F64 {
        FloatSize::Double
    } else {
        FloatSize::Single
    }
}

pub(crate) const SCRATCH: Gpr = X16;
/// Only for forming addresses (see the module documentation).
pub(crate) const ADDRESS: Gpr = X17;
pub(crate) const SCRATCH_FPR: Fpr = Fpr(31);
pub(crate) const SCRATCH_FPR2: Fpr = Fpr(30);
pub(crate) const FP: Gpr = Gpr(29);
pub(crate) const LR: Gpr = Gpr(30);
pub(crate) const SP: Gpr = Gpr(31);

pub(crate) fn condition(condition: IntCondition) -> Cond {
    match condition {
        IntCondition::Eq => Cond::Eq,
        IntCondition::Ne => Cond::Ne,
        IntCondition::LtS => Cond::Lt,
        IntCondition::LtU => Cond::Lo,
        IntCondition::GtS => Cond::Gt,
        IntCondition::GtU => Cond::Hi,
        IntCondition::LeS => Cond::Le,
        IntCondition::LeU => Cond::Ls,
        IntCondition::GeS => Cond::Ge,
        IntCondition::GeU => Cond::Hs,
    }
}

/// The condition after `fcmp a, b` that holds where a float comparison does; all are false for unordered operands
/// but `Ne`.
pub(crate) fn float_condition(condition: FloatCondition) -> Cond {
    match condition {
        FloatCondition::Eq => Cond::Eq,
        FloatCondition::Ne => Cond::Ne,
        FloatCondition::Lt => Cond::Mi,
        FloatCondition::Le => Cond::Ls,
        FloatCondition::Gt => Cond::Gt,
        FloatCondition::Ge => Cond::Ge,
    }
}

/// Whether `offset` fits the immediate of a load or store of `1 << size_log2` bytes.
pub fn fits_offset(offset: i64, size_log2: u32) -> bool {
    let size = 1i64 << size_log2;
    (offset >= 0 && offset % size == 0 && offset / size < 4096) || (-256..256).contains(&offset)
}

/// The memory operation of a load (`load`) or store of `1 << size_log2` bytes to or from a general purpose register,
/// zero-extended.
pub(crate) fn gpr_access(size_log2: u32, load: bool) -> MemOp {
    match (size_log2, load) {
        (0, true) => MemOp::Ldrb,
        (0, false) => MemOp::Strb,
        (1, true) => MemOp::Ldrh,
        (1, false) => MemOp::Strh,
        (2, true) => MemOp::LdrW,
        (2, false) => MemOp::StrW,
        (_, true) => MemOp::LdrX,
        (_, false) => MemOp::StrX,
    }
}

/// The memory operation of a load or store of `1 << size_log2` bytes to or from a vector register.
pub(crate) fn fpr_access(size_log2: u32, load: bool) -> MemOp {
    match (size_log2, load) {
        (2, true) => MemOp::LdrS,
        (2, false) => MemOp::StrS,
        (3, true) => MemOp::LdrD,
        (3, false) => MemOp::StrD,
        (_, true) => MemOp::LdrQ,
        (_, false) => MemOp::StrQ,
    }
}

/// What code generation produced.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Generated {
    pub code: Vec<u8>,
    pub frame_size: u32,
    /// The offsets of the return addresses of calls that check for an exception once they return.
    pub exception_sites: Vec<u32>,
}

/// Out-of-line code for an edge that needs moves: its label, the edge's slot and its target.
struct EdgeStub {
    label: Label,
    slot: u32,
    target: BlockId,
}

pub struct CodeGenerator<'a> {
    func: &'a Func,
    allocation: &'a Allocation,
    runtime: &'a RuntimeInfo,
    asm: Assembler<'a>,
    block_labels: Vec<Label>,
    trap_labels: Vec<Option<Label>>,
    /// The trap with the code in x0, for the runtime's functions that return one.
    dynamic_trap: Option<Label>,
    subtype_checks: Vec<tables::SubtypeCheck>,
    edge_stubs: Vec<EdgeStub>,
    frame_size: u32,
    /// The block whose code is being generated.
    block: BlockId,
    exception_sites: Vec<u32>,
}

impl<'a> CodeGenerator<'a> {
    pub fn new(
        func: &'a Func,
        allocation: &'a Allocation,
        runtime: &'a RuntimeInfo,
        memory: &'a mut crate::CodeMemory,
    ) -> Self {
        let size = convention::FRAME_HEADER_SIZE as u32 + 8 * allocation.slot_count + allocation.outgoing_size;
        Self {
            func,
            allocation,
            runtime,
            asm: Assembler::new(&mut memory.code, &memory.work),
            block_labels: Vec::new(),
            trap_labels: vec![None; 32],
            dynamic_trap: None,
            subtype_checks: Vec::new(),
            edge_stubs: Vec::new(),
            frame_size: size.next_multiple_of(16),
            block: 0,
            exception_sites: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn generate(mut self) -> Result<Generated, crate::CompileFailure> {
        let func = self.func;
        for _ in 0..func.blocks.len() {
            let label = self.asm.new_label();
            self.block_labels.push(label);
        }
        self.prologue();
        for block in 0..func.blocks.len() as BlockId {
            self.block = block;
            let label = self.block_labels[block as usize];
            self.asm.bind(label);
            // Phis in registers that have a slot too are stored there where they are defined.
            for phi in func.phis(block) {
                let record = self.allocation.node(phi);
                let slot = self.allocation.slots[phi as usize];
                if record.output != NO_REGISTER && slot != NO_SLOT {
                    self.store_to_slot(record.output, slot, func.node(phi).ty == Type::V128);
                }
            }
            let data = func.blocks[block as usize];
            for value in data.start..data.end {
                let op = func.node(value).op;
                if op.is_entry_value() {
                    continue;
                }
                for item in self.allocation.node_moves(value) {
                    self.emit_move(item);
                }
                self.lower(value);
                let record = self.allocation.node(value);
                let slot = self.allocation.slots[value as usize];
                if record.output != NO_REGISTER && slot != NO_SLOT {
                    self.store_to_slot(record.output, slot, func.node(value).ty == Type::V128);
                }
            }
        }
        self.out_of_line();
        let code = self
            .asm
            .finish()
            .map_err(|_| crate::CompileFailure::CodeGeneration)?
            .to_vec();
        Ok(Generated {
            code,
            frame_size: self.frame_size,
            exception_sites: self.exception_sites,
        })
    }

    // Frames.

    fn prologue(&mut self) {
        let func = self.func;
        let instance = gpr(convention::INSTANCE_REGISTER);
        self.asm.stp(FP, LR, PairOperand::PreIndex(SP, -16));
        self.asm.add_imm(Width::W64, FP, SP, 16, false);
        // NB: The header goes below sp first, since nothing may be stored below sp. The instance goes in it before the
        //     stack check, which traps through the frame.
        let header = (convention::FRAME_HEADER_SIZE - 16) as u32;
        self.asm.sub_imm(Width::W64, SP, SP, header, false);
        self.asm
            .str(Width::W64, instance, MemOperand::Offset(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
        self.asm.ldr(
            Width::W64,
            SCRATCH,
            MemOperand::Offset(instance, offset_of!(InstanceData, context) as i32),
        );
        self.asm.ldr(
            Width::W64,
            SCRATCH,
            MemOperand::Offset(SCRATCH, offset_of!(ExecutionContext, stack_limit) as i32),
        );
        self.asm.add_any(ADDRESS, FP, -i64::from(self.frame_size), ADDRESS);
        self.asm.cmp(Width::W64, ADDRESS, SCRATCH);
        let overflow = self.trap_label(libwasm_module::abi::TRAP_STACK_EXHAUSTED);
        self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Lo, overflow);
        self.asm.mov_sp(SP, ADDRESS);
        // Values arriving in registers that have slots.
        let data = func.blocks[0];
        for value in data.start..data.end {
            let node = func.node(value);
            if !matches!(node.op, Op::Param | Op::MemoryBase) {
                continue;
            }
            let record = self.allocation.node(value);
            let slot = self.allocation.slots[value as usize];
            if record.output != NO_REGISTER && slot != NO_SLOT {
                self.store_to_slot(record.output, slot, node.ty == Type::V128);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Has the runtime unwind the exception in `exception` from this frame, and continues where it says: at a call
    /// that checks for exceptions, or in the entry trampoline.
    fn throw(&mut self, exception: Gpr) {
        let context = SCRATCH;
        self.asm
            .ldr(Width::W64, context, MemOperand::Offset(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
        self.asm.ldr(
            Width::W64,
            context,
            MemOperand::Offset(context, offset_of!(InstanceData, context) as i32),
        );
        let arguments = offset_of!(ExecutionContext, arguments) as i32;
        self.asm
            .str(Width::W64, exception, MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments));
        self.asm.str(Width::W64, FP, MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments + 8));
        self.asm.mov(Width::W64, Gpr(0), context);
        self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, ADDRESS, self.runtime.throw);
        self.asm.blr(ADDRESS);
        crate::stubs::resume(&mut self.asm, Gpr(0));
    }

    fn epilogue(&mut self) {
        self.asm.sub_imm(Width::W64, SP, FP, 16, false);
        self.asm.ldp(FP, LR, PairOperand::PostIndex(SP, 16));
        self.asm.ret();
    }

    /// Sets sp back to the bottom of the frame, after a call.
    fn reset_sp(&mut self) {
        self.asm.add_any(SP, FP, -i64::from(self.frame_size), ADDRESS);
    }

    fn trap_label(&mut self, code: u32) -> Label {
        if let Some(label) = self.trap_labels[code as usize] {
            return label;
        }
        let label = self.asm.new_label();
        self.trap_labels[code as usize] = Some(label);
        label
    }

    fn dynamic_trap_label(&mut self) -> Label {
        *self.dynamic_trap.get_or_insert_with(|| self.asm.new_label())
    }

    fn out_of_line(&mut self) {
        self.subtype_checks();
        let stubs = std::mem::take(&mut self.edge_stubs);
        for stub in &stubs {
            self.asm.bind(stub.label);
            for item in self.allocation.edge(stub.slot) {
                self.emit_move(item);
            }
            let target = self.block_labels[stub.target as usize];
            self.asm.b(target);
        }
        for code in 0..self.trap_labels.len() {
            if let Some(label) = self.trap_labels[code] {
                self.asm.bind(label);
                self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W32, Gpr(0), code as u64);
                self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, self.runtime.trap_exit);
                self.asm.br(SCRATCH);
            }
        }
        if let Some(label) = self.dynamic_trap {
            // NB: The code is in x0 already.
            self.asm.bind(label);
            self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, self.runtime.trap_exit);
            self.asm.br(SCRATCH);
        }
    }

    // Addresses.

    /// An operand for an access of `1 << size_log2` bytes at `base` + `offset`, through `ADDRESS` where the offset does
    /// not fit.
    pub(crate) fn operand(&mut self, base: Gpr, offset: i64, size_log2: u32) -> MemOperand {
        if fits_offset(offset, size_log2) {
            return MemOperand::Offset(base, offset as i32);
        }
        self.asm.add_any(ADDRESS, base, offset, ADDRESS);
        MemOperand::Offset(ADDRESS, 0)
    }

    /// The sp offset of the frame slot at fp offset `slot`.
    fn frame_offset(&self, slot: i32) -> i64 {
        i64::from(self.frame_size) + i64::from(slot)
    }

    fn location_operand(&mut self, location: Location, size_log2: u32) -> MemOperand {
        let offset = match location {
            Location::Slot(slot) => self.frame_offset(slot),
            Location::Outgoing(index) => 8 * i64::from(index),
            _ => unreachable!("{location:?} is no frame location"),
        };
        self.operand(SP, offset, size_log2)
    }

    // Moves.

    /// Loads (if `load`) or stores the register `register` at `operand`: 8 bytes, or 16 for a vector.
    fn transfer(&mut self, register: Register, operand: MemOperand, vector: bool, load: bool) {
        let op = if vector {
            fpr_access(4, load)
        } else if convention::is_fpr(register) {
            fpr_access(3, load)
        } else {
            gpr_access(3, load)
        };
        let encoding = if convention::is_fpr(register) {
            fpr(register).0
        } else {
            gpr(register).0
        };
        self.asm.load_store(op, encoding, operand);
    }

    fn store_to_slot(&mut self, register: Register, slot: i32, vector: bool) {
        let operand = self.location_operand(Location::Slot(slot), if vector { 4 } else { 3 });
        self.transfer(register, operand, vector, false);
    }

    /// The bits of a constant of any type.
    fn constant_bits(&self, value: Value) -> u128 {
        let node = self.func.node(value);
        match node.op {
            Op::Const128 => self.func.constants[node.args[0] as usize],
            _ => u128::from(node.constant().expect("only constants have bits")),
        }
    }

    /// Puts the constant `bits` into the vector register `register`: its low 64 bits, or all 128 if `vector`.
    pub(crate) fn load_vector_constant(&mut self, bits: u128, register: Fpr, vector: bool) {
        let (low, high) = (bits as u64, (bits >> 64) as u64);
        if low == 0 {
            self.asm.fmov_from_gpr(register, XZR);
        } else {
            self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, low);
            self.asm.fmov_from_gpr(register, SCRATCH);
        }
        if vector && high != 0 {
            let source = if high == low {
                SCRATCH
            } else {
                self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, high);
                SCRATCH
            };
            self.asm.insert_lane_from_gpr(register, 3, 1, source);
        }
    }

    /// Materializes the constant `value` into `register`.
    fn materialize(&mut self, value: Value, register: Register) {
        let ty = self.func.node(value).ty;
        let bits = self.constant_bits(value);
        if convention::is_fpr(register) {
            self.load_vector_constant(bits, fpr(register), ty == Type::V128);
        } else {
            let bits = if ty.is_64() {
                bits as u64
            } else {
                bits as u64 & 0xffff_ffff
            };
            self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, gpr(register), bits);
        }
    }

    /// Stores the constant `value` at `operand` (which does not use x16), as 8 bytes, or 16 for a vector.
    fn store_constant(&mut self, value: Value, location: Location) {
        let node = self.func.node(value);
        if node.op == Op::Const128 {
            let bits = self.constant_bits(value);
            for (half, bits) in [(0, bits as u64), (1, (bits >> 64) as u64)] {
                let source = if bits == 0 {
                    XZR
                } else {
                    self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, bits);
                    SCRATCH
                };
                let operand = self.half_operand(location, half);
                self.asm.str(Width::W64, source, operand);
            }
            return;
        }
        let bits = node.constant().expect("only constants are stored as constants");
        let bits = if node.ty.is_64() { bits } else { bits & 0xffff_ffff };
        let source = if bits == 0 {
            XZR
        } else {
            self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, bits);
            SCRATCH
        };
        let operand = self.location_operand(location, 3);
        self.asm.str(Width::W64, source, operand);
    }

    /// The operand of the 8-byte half `half` of the frame location `location`.
    fn half_operand(&mut self, location: Location, half: i32) -> MemOperand {
        let location = match location {
            Location::Slot(slot) => Location::Slot(slot + 8 * half),
            Location::Outgoing(index) => Location::Outgoing(index + half as u32),
            _ => unreachable!("{location:?} is no frame location"),
        };
        self.location_operand(location, 3)
    }

    /// Copies a vector register.
    pub(crate) fn move_vector(&mut self, to: Fpr, from: Fpr) {
        if to != from {
            self.asm.mov_vector(to, from);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn emit_move(&mut self, item: &Move) {
        match (item.from, item.to) {
            (Location::Register(from), Location::Register(to)) => {
                if from == to {
                    return;
                }
                match (convention::is_fpr(from), convention::is_fpr(to)) {
                    (true, true) => self.move_vector(fpr(to), fpr(from)),
                    (false, false) => self.asm.mov(Width::W64, gpr(to), gpr(from)),
                    (true, false) => self.asm.fmov_to_gpr(gpr(to), fpr(from)),
                    (false, true) => self.asm.fmov_from_gpr(fpr(to), gpr(from)),
                }
            }
            (Location::Constant(value), Location::Register(to)) => self.materialize(value, to),
            (Location::Register(from), to @ (Location::Slot(_) | Location::Outgoing(_))) => {
                let operand = self.location_operand(to, if item.vector { 4 } else { 3 });
                self.transfer(from, operand, item.vector, false);
            }
            (from @ (Location::Slot(_) | Location::Outgoing(_)), Location::Register(to)) => {
                let operand = self.location_operand(from, if item.vector { 4 } else { 3 });
                self.transfer(to, operand, item.vector, true);
            }
            (Location::Constant(value), to @ (Location::Slot(_) | Location::Outgoing(_))) => {
                self.store_constant(value, to);
            }
            (from @ Location::Slot(_), to @ (Location::Slot(_) | Location::Outgoing(_))) => {
                let size_log2 = if item.vector { 4 } else { 3 };
                let operand = self.location_operand(from, size_log2);
                let register = if item.vector { SCRATCH_FPR.0 } else { SCRATCH.0 };
                let (load, store) = if item.vector {
                    (fpr_access(4, true), fpr_access(4, false))
                } else {
                    (gpr_access(3, true), gpr_access(3, false))
                };
                self.asm.load_store(load, register, operand);
                let operand = self.location_operand(to, size_log2);
                self.asm.load_store(store, register, operand);
            }
            (from, Location::ResultArea(index)) => {
                // The value goes through a vector register, or x16; the area's address takes x17.
                let (register, op) = match from {
                    Location::Register(register) if convention::is_fpr(register) => (
                        fpr(register).0,
                        if item.vector {
                            fpr_access(4, false)
                        } else {
                            fpr_access(3, false)
                        },
                    ),
                    Location::Register(register) => (gpr(register).0, gpr_access(3, false)),
                    Location::Slot(slot) => {
                        let size_log2 = if item.vector { 4 } else { 3 };
                        let operand = self.location_operand(Location::Slot(slot), size_log2);
                        self.asm.load_store(fpr_access(size_log2, true), SCRATCH_FPR.0, operand);
                        (SCRATCH_FPR.0, fpr_access(size_log2, false))
                    }
                    Location::Constant(value) => {
                        let bits = self.constant_bits(value);
                        self.load_vector_constant(bits, SCRATCH_FPR, item.vector);
                        let size_log2 = if item.vector { 4 } else { 3 };
                        (SCRATCH_FPR.0, fpr_access(size_log2, false))
                    }
                    _ => unreachable!("results do not come from {from:?}"),
                };
                let pointer = convention::home_slot_offset(convention::result_area_pointer(&self.func.params));
                let operand = self.location_operand(Location::Slot(pointer), 3);
                self.asm.ldr(Width::W64, ADDRESS, operand);
                let operand = MemOperand::Offset(ADDRESS, 8 * index as i32);
                let operand = if fits_offset(8 * i64::from(index), op.size_log2()) {
                    operand
                } else {
                    self.asm.add_any(ADDRESS, ADDRESS, 8 * i64::from(index), ADDRESS);
                    MemOperand::Offset(ADDRESS, 0)
                };
                self.asm.load_store(op, register, operand);
            }
            (from, to) => unreachable!("no move from {from:?} to {to:?}"),
        }
    }

    // Control.

    /// The label an edge jumps to: its target's, or a stub's that moves values into place first.
    fn edge_label(&mut self, slot: u32, target: BlockId) -> Label {
        if self.allocation.edge(slot).is_empty() {
            return self.block_labels[target as usize];
        }
        let label = self.asm.new_label();
        self.edge_stubs.push(EdgeStub { label, slot, target });
        label
    }

    /// Ends the block on its edge `index` without a condition.
    fn jump(&mut self, index: usize) {
        let block = self.block;
        let slot = self.func.blocks[block as usize].successors_start + index as u32;
        let target = self.func.successors(block)[index];
        for item in self.allocation.edge(slot) {
            self.emit_move(item);
        }
        if target != block + 1 {
            let label = self.block_labels[target as usize];
            self.asm.b(label);
        }
    }

    /// Ends the block with a two-way branch on `cond`, which holds for the first successor; inverted where the taken
    /// successor comes next and needs no moves, or is a loop header the edge needs moves into, so that those moves are
    /// inline rather than in a stub that branches again.
    fn branch_on(&mut self, cond: Cond) {
        let block = self.block;
        let data = self.func.blocks[block as usize];
        let successors = self.func.successors(block);
        let (taken, fallthrough) = (successors[0], successors[1]);
        if taken == block + 1 && self.allocation.edge(data.successors_start).is_empty() {
            let label = self.edge_label(data.successors_start + 1, fallthrough);
            self.asm.b_cond(cond.invert(), label);
            return;
        }
        if self.func.is_loop_header(taken) && !self.allocation.edge(data.successors_start).is_empty() {
            let label = self.edge_label(data.successors_start + 1, fallthrough);
            self.asm.b_cond(cond.invert(), label);
            self.jump(0);
            return;
        }
        let taken_label = self.edge_label(data.successors_start, taken);
        self.asm.b_cond(cond, taken_label);
        for item in self.allocation.edge(data.successors_start + 1) {
            self.emit_move(item);
        }
        if fallthrough != block + 1 {
            let label = self.block_labels[fallthrough as usize];
            self.asm.b(label);
        }
    }

    fn lower_terminator(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        match node.op {
            Op::Jump => self.jump(0),
            Op::Branch => {
                self.asm.cmp_imm(Width::W32, gpr(record.inputs[0]), 0, false);
                self.branch_on(Cond::Ne);
            }
            Op::BranchCompare => {
                let ty = func.node(node.args[0]).ty;
                self.compare(value, ty, record.inputs[0], record.inputs[1], 1);
                self.branch_on(condition(IntCondition::from_flags(node.flags)));
            }
            Op::BranchFloatCompare => {
                let ty = func.node(node.args[0]).ty;
                self.asm
                    .float_compare(float_size(ty), fpr(record.inputs[0]), fpr(record.inputs[1]));
                self.branch_on(float_condition(FloatCondition::from_flags(node.flags)));
            }
            Op::BrTable => self.branch_table(value),
            Op::Return => self.epilogue(),
            Op::TailCall => self.lower_tail_call(value),
            Op::Trap => {
                let label = self.trap_label(node.args[0]);
                self.asm.b(label);
            }
            Op::Throw => self.throw(gpr(record.inputs[0])),
            _ => unreachable!("{} is no terminator", node.op.name()),
        }
    }

    fn branch_table(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let block = self.block;
        let data = func.blocks[block as usize];
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let index = gpr(record.inputs[0]);
        let successors = func.successors(block);
        let mut labels = Vec::with_capacity(successors.len());
        for (position, &successor) in successors.iter().enumerate() {
            let label = self.edge_label(data.successors_start + position as u32, successor);
            labels.push(label);
        }
        let targets = func.table_targets(value);
        let (cases, default) = targets.split_at(targets.len() - 1);
        let default = labels[default[0] as usize];
        self.compare_immediate(Width::W32, index, cases.len() as u64);
        self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Hs, default);
        // The table is a branch per case, right after the indirect branch into it.
        let table = self.asm.new_label();
        self.asm.reserve_room(4 * (cases.len() + 4));
        self.asm.adr(SCRATCH, table);
        self.asm
            .add_extended(Width::W64, SCRATCH, SCRATCH, index, Extend::Uxtw, 2);
        self.asm.br(SCRATCH);
        self.asm.bind(table);
        for case in cases {
            self.asm.b(labels[*case as usize]);
        }
    }

    /// `cmp register, #immediate`, through x16 where the immediate does not fit.
    fn compare_immediate(&mut self, width: Width, register: Gpr, immediate: u64) {
        let immediate = if width == Width::W32 {
            immediate & 0xffff_ffff
        } else {
            immediate
        };
        let negated = match width {
            Width::W32 => (immediate as u32).wrapping_neg() as u64,
            Width::W64 => immediate.wrapping_neg(),
        };
        if immediate < 4096 {
            self.asm.cmp_imm(width, register, immediate as u32, false);
        } else if immediate & 0xfff == 0 && immediate < (1 << 24) {
            self.asm.cmp_imm(width, register, (immediate >> 12) as u32, true);
        } else if negated < 4096 {
            self.asm.cmn_imm(width, register, negated as u32, false);
        } else {
            self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, immediate);
            self.asm.cmp(width, register, SCRATCH);
        }
    }

    /// `cmp a, b` of type `ty`, where `b` is input `index` of `value`: an immediate if it is a constant.
    fn compare(&mut self, value: Value, ty: Type, a: Register, b: Register, index: usize) {
        if b == crate::regalloc::CONSTANT_INPUT {
            let bits = self.immediate(value, index);
            self.compare_immediate(width(ty), gpr(a), bits);
        } else {
            self.asm.cmp(width(ty), gpr(a), gpr(b));
        }
    }

    fn lower(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let node = self.func.node(value);
        match node.op {
            op if op.is_terminator() => self.lower_terminator(value),
            Op::Load
            | Op::Store
            | Op::GlobalGet
            | Op::GlobalSet
            | Op::InstanceField
            | Op::LoadPointer
            | Op::FrameLoad
            | Op::VectorLoad => self.lower_memory(value),
            Op::Call | Op::CallResult => self.lower_call(value),
            Op::Offset
            | Op::ReadField
            | Op::WriteField
            | Op::TableElement
            | Op::TableStore
            | Op::CalleeInstance
            | Op::CheckNull
            | Op::CheckInterrupt
            | Op::CheckFunction
            | Op::Helper => self.lower_runtime(value),
            Op::CheckedAddress
            | Op::AtomicRmw
            | Op::AtomicCompareExchange
            | Op::AtomicFence
            | Op::Rtt
            | Op::I31New
            | Op::I31Get
            | Op::ElementAddress
            | Op::RefTest => self.lower_gc(value),
            Op::VectorUnary
            | Op::VectorBinary
            | Op::VectorTernary
            | Op::ExtractLane
            | Op::ReplaceLane
            | Op::Shuffle => self.lower_vector(value),
            _ => self.lower_numeric(value),
        }
    }

    /// The constant of input `index` of `value`, which code generation uses as an immediate.
    fn immediate(&self, value: Value, index: usize) -> u64 {
        let input = self.func.inputs(value)[index];
        self.func.node(input).constant().expect("immediates are constants")
    }

    /// The register of an input that may be a constant: its own, or x16 with the constant in it.
    fn input_or_scratch(&mut self, value: Value, index: usize, register: Register, ty: Type) -> Gpr {
        if register != crate::regalloc::CONSTANT_INPUT {
            return gpr(register);
        }
        let bits = self.immediate(value, index);
        let bits = if ty.is_64() { bits } else { bits & 0xffff_ffff };
        if bits == 0 {
            return XZR;
        }
        self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, bits);
        SCRATCH
    }
}

/// Generates the code of `func`.
pub fn generate(
    func: &Func,
    allocation: &Allocation,
    runtime: &RuntimeInfo,
    _stack_limit: u64,
    memory: &mut crate::CodeMemory,
) -> Result<Generated, crate::CompileFailure> {
    let _ = (NONE, Shift::Lsl);
    CodeGenerator::new(func, allocation, runtime, memory).generate()
}

/*

//! Integer and float arithmetic, comparisons, selects and conversions.

use super::{ADDRESS, CodeGenerator, SCRATCH, SCRATCH_FPR, condition, float_condition, float_size, fpr, gpr, width};
use crate::asm::Width;
use crate::asm::aarch64::{
    Cond, FloatBinary, FloatSize, FloatUnary, Shift, VectorArrangement, encode_logical_immediate,
};
use crate::convention::Register;
use crate::ir::{FLAG_CANNOT_TRAP, FloatCondition, IntCondition, Op, Type, Value};
use crate::regalloc::CONSTANT_INPUT;
use libwasm_module::abi::{TRAP_INTEGER_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, TRAP_INTEGER_OVERFLOW, TRAP_INVALID_CONVERSION};

/// The bits of a width.
fn mask(width: Width) -> u64 {
    match width {
        Width::W32 => 0xffff_ffff,
        Width::W64 => u64::MAX,
    }
}

fn float_bits(ty: Type, value: f64) -> u64 {
    if ty == Type::F64 {
        value.to_bits()
    } else {
        u64::from((value as f32).to_bits())
    }
}

impl CodeGenerator<'_> {
    pub(super) fn lower_numeric(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let [a, b, c] = record.inputs;
        let output = record.output;
        let ty = node.ty;
        match node.op {
            Op::Add | Op::Sub => self.add_sub(value, node.op == Op::Sub, ty, output, a, b),
            Op::And | Op::Or | Op::Xor => self.logic(value, node.op, ty, output, a, b),
            Op::Mul => {
                let rhs = self.input_or_scratch(value, 1, b, ty);
                self.asm.mul(width(ty), gpr(output), gpr(a), rhs);
            }
            Op::Shl | Op::ShrS | Op::ShrU => {
                let (dst, source) = (gpr(output), gpr(a));
                if b == CONSTANT_INPUT {
                    let amount = (self.immediate(value, 1) as u32 & (if ty == Type::I64 { 63 } else { 31 })) as u8;
                    match node.op {
                        Op::Shl => self.asm.lsl_imm(width(ty), dst, source, amount),
                        Op::ShrS => self.asm.asr_imm(width(ty), dst, source, amount),
                        _ => self.asm.lsr_imm(width(ty), dst, source, amount),
                    }
                } else {
                    // NB: The register forms take the amount modulo the width, as WebAssembly does.
                    match node.op {
                        Op::Shl => self.asm.lsl(width(ty), dst, source, gpr(b)),
                        Op::ShrS => self.asm.asr(width(ty), dst, source, gpr(b)),
                        _ => self.asm.lsr(width(ty), dst, source, gpr(b)),
                    }
                }
            }
            Op::Rotl | Op::Rotr => {
                let (dst, source) = (gpr(output), gpr(a));
                let bits = if ty == Type::I64 { 64 } else { 32 };
                if b == CONSTANT_INPUT {
                    let amount = self.immediate(value, 1) as u32 % bits;
                    let right = if node.op == Op::Rotr {
                        amount
                    } else {
                        (bits - amount) % bits
                    };
                    self.asm.ror_imm(width(ty), dst, source, right as u8);
                } else if node.op == Op::Rotr {
                    self.asm.ror(width(ty), dst, source, gpr(b));
                } else {
                    // A left rotation is a right rotation by the negated amount, modulo the width.
                    self.asm.neg(width(ty), SCRATCH, gpr(b));
                    self.asm.ror(width(ty), dst, source, SCRATCH);
                }
            }
            Op::DivS | Op::DivU | Op::RemS | Op::RemU => self.divide(value, ty, output, a, b),
            Op::Clz => self.asm.clz(width(ty), gpr(output), gpr(a)),
            Op::Ctz => {
                self.asm.rbit(width(ty), SCRATCH, gpr(a));
                self.asm.clz(width(ty), gpr(output), SCRATCH);
            }
            Op::Popcnt => {
                self.asm.fmov_from_gpr(SCRATCH_FPR, gpr(a));
                self.asm.vector_count_bits(SCRATCH_FPR, SCRATCH_FPR);
                self.asm
                    .vector_add_across(VectorArrangement::B8, SCRATCH_FPR, SCRATCH_FPR);
                self.asm.fmov_to_gpr(gpr(output), SCRATCH_FPR);
            }
            Op::Eqz => {
                let input_type = func.node(node.args[0]).ty;
                self.asm.cmp_imm(width(input_type), gpr(a), 0, false);
                self.asm.cset(Width::W32, gpr(output), Cond::Eq);
            }
            Op::Compare => {
                let input_type = func.node(node.args[0]).ty;
                self.compare(value, input_type, a, b, 1);
                self.asm
                    .cset(Width::W32, gpr(output), condition(IntCondition::from_flags(node.flags)));
            }
            Op::Extend8S => self.asm.sxtb(width(ty), gpr(output), gpr(a)),
            Op::Extend16S => self.asm.sxth(width(ty), gpr(output), gpr(a)),
            Op::Extend32S | Op::ExtendI32S => self.asm.sxtw(gpr(output), gpr(a)),
            Op::ExtendI32U | Op::Wrap => self.asm.mov(Width::W32, gpr(output), gpr(a)),
            Op::Select => {
                if ty == Type::V128 {
                    let skip = self.asm.new_label();
                    self.move_vector(fpr(output), fpr(c));
                    self.asm.cbz(Width::W32, gpr(a), skip);
                    self.move_vector(fpr(output), fpr(b));
                    self.asm.bind(skip);
                } else if ty.is_float() {
                    self.asm.cmp_imm(Width::W32, gpr(a), 0, false);
                    self.asm
                        .float_select(FloatSize::Double, fpr(output), fpr(b), fpr(c), Cond::Ne);
                } else {
                    self.asm.cmp_imm(Width::W32, gpr(a), 0, false);
                    self.asm.csel(Width::W64, gpr(output), gpr(b), gpr(c), Cond::Ne);
                }
            }
            Op::FAdd | Op::FSub | Op::FMul | Op::FDiv | Op::FMin | Op::FMax => {
                let op = match node.op {
                    Op::FAdd => FloatBinary::Add,
                    Op::FSub => FloatBinary::Sub,
                    Op::FMul => FloatBinary::Mul,
                    Op::FDiv => FloatBinary::Div,
                    // NB: fmin and fmax propagate NaNs and order -0 below +0, as WebAssembly's min and max do.
                    Op::FMin => FloatBinary::Min,
                    _ => FloatBinary::Max,
                };
                self.asm.float_binary(op, float_size(ty), fpr(output), fpr(a), fpr(b));
            }
            Op::FCopysign => {
                let w = width(ty);
                let sign = if ty == Type::F64 { 1u64 << 63 } else { 1 << 31 };
                let size = float_size(ty);
                self.asm.float_to_gpr(size, SCRATCH, fpr(a));
                self.asm.float_to_gpr(size, ADDRESS, fpr(b));
                self.asm.and_imm(w, SCRATCH, SCRATCH, !sign & mask(w));
                self.asm.and_imm(w, ADDRESS, ADDRESS, sign);
                self.asm.orr(w, SCRATCH, SCRATCH, ADDRESS, Shift::Lsl, 0);
                self.asm.gpr_to_float(size, fpr(output), SCRATCH);
            }
            Op::FAbs | Op::FNeg | Op::FSqrt | Op::FCeil | Op::FFloor | Op::FTrunc | Op::FNearest => {
                let op = match node.op {
                    Op::FAbs => FloatUnary::Abs,
                    Op::FNeg => FloatUnary::Neg,
                    Op::FSqrt => FloatUnary::Sqrt,
                    Op::FCeil => FloatUnary::RoundUp,
                    Op::FFloor => FloatUnary::RoundDown,
                    Op::FTrunc => FloatUnary::RoundTowardZero,
                    _ => FloatUnary::RoundNearest,
                };
                self.asm.float_unary(op, float_size(ty), fpr(output), fpr(a));
            }
            Op::FloatCompare => {
                let input_type = func.node(node.args[0]).ty;
                self.asm.float_compare(float_size(input_type), fpr(a), fpr(b));
                let cond = float_condition(FloatCondition::from_flags(node.flags));
                self.asm.cset(Width::W32, gpr(output), cond);
            }
            Op::TruncS | Op::TruncU => self.truncate(value, ty, output, a),
            Op::TruncSatS | Op::TruncSatU => {
                // NB: The conversions saturate, and give 0 for NaN, as the saturating truncations want.
                let input = func.node(node.args[0]).ty;
                self.asm.convert_to_integer(
                    node.op == Op::TruncSatS,
                    width(ty),
                    float_size(input),
                    gpr(output),
                    fpr(a),
                );
            }
            Op::ConvertS | Op::ConvertU => {
                let input = func.node(node.args[0]).ty;
                self.asm.convert_to_float(
                    node.op == Op::ConvertS,
                    width(input),
                    float_size(ty),
                    fpr(output),
                    gpr(a),
                );
            }
            Op::Demote => self.asm.float_convert(FloatSize::Double, fpr(output), fpr(a)),
            Op::Promote => self.asm.float_convert(FloatSize::Single, fpr(output), fpr(a)),
            Op::Reinterpret => {
                if ty.is_float() {
                    self.asm.gpr_to_float(float_size(ty), fpr(output), gpr(a));
                } else {
                    let input = func.node(node.args[0]).ty;
                    self.asm.float_to_gpr(float_size(input), gpr(output), fpr(a));
                }
            }
            _ => unreachable!("{} is no numeric op", node.op.name()),
        }
    }

    fn add_sub(&mut self, value: Value, subtract: bool, ty: Type, output: Register, a: Register, b: Register) {
        let w = width(ty);
        let (dst, lhs) = (gpr(output), gpr(a));
        if b == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            let bits = self.immediate(value, 1);
            let bits = if ty.is_64() { bits } else { bits & 0xffff_ffff };
            let negated = match w {
                Width::W32 => u64::from((bits as u32).wrapping_neg()),
                Width::W64 => bits.wrapping_neg(),
            };
            // The immediate forms take 12 bits, optionally shifted by 12, and subtracting adds the negation.
            let (add, magnitude) = if bits < (1 << 24) {
                (!subtract, bits)
            } else if negated < (1 << 24) {
                (subtract, negated)
            } else {
                self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, bits);
                if subtract {
                    self.asm.sub(w, dst, lhs, SCRATCH, Shift::Lsl, 0);
                } else {
                    self.asm.add(w, dst, lhs, SCRATCH, Shift::Lsl, 0);
                }
                return;
            };
            let (high, low) = ((magnitude >> 12) as u32, (magnitude & 0xfff) as u32);
            let mut source = lhs;
            if high != 0 {
                if add {
                    self.asm.add_imm(w, dst, source, high, true);
                } else {
                    self.asm.sub_imm(w, dst, source, high, true);
                }
                source = dst;
            }
            if low != 0 || source != dst {
                if add {
                    self.asm.add_imm(w, dst, source, low, false);
                } else {
                    self.asm.sub_imm(w, dst, source, low, false);
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if subtract {
            self.asm.sub(w, dst, lhs, gpr(b), Shift::Lsl, 0);
        } else {
            self.asm.add(w, dst, lhs, gpr(b), Shift::Lsl, 0);
        }
    }

    fn logic(&mut self, value: Value, op: Op, ty: Type, output: Register, a: Register, b: Register) {
        let w = width(ty);
        let (dst, lhs) = (gpr(output), gpr(a));
        if b == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            let bits = self.immediate(value, 1) & mask(w);
            if encode_logical_immediate(bits, w).is_some() {
                match op {
                    Op::And => self.asm.and_imm(w, dst, lhs, bits),
                    Op::Or => self.asm.orr_imm(w, dst, lhs, bits),
                    _ => self.asm.eor_imm(w, dst, lhs, bits),
                }
                return;
            }
        }
        let rhs = self.input_or_scratch(value, 1, b, ty);
        match op {
            Op::And => self.asm.and(w, dst, lhs, rhs, Shift::Lsl, 0),
            Op::Or => self.asm.orr(w, dst, lhs, rhs, Shift::Lsl, 0),
            _ => self.asm.eor(w, dst, lhs, rhs, Shift::Lsl, 0),
        }
    }

    /// Division and remainder. The hardware gives 0 for a zero divisor and INT_MIN for INT_MIN / -1, so both are
    /// checked; the remainder of INT_MIN and -1 comes out 0 as it should.
    fn divide(&mut self, value: Value, ty: Type, output: Register, a: Register, b: Register) {
        let node = *self.func.node(value);
        let w = width(ty);
        let (dst, dividend, divisor) = (gpr(output), gpr(a), gpr(b));
        let checked = node.flags & FLAG_CANNOT_TRAP == 0;
        if checked {
            let zero = self.trap_label(TRAP_INTEGER_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO);
            self.asm.cbz(w, divisor, zero);
        }
        let signed = matches!(node.op, Op::DivS | Op::RemS);
        if node.op == Op::DivS && checked {
            let divide = self.asm.new_label();
            let overflow = self.trap_label(TRAP_INTEGER_OVERFLOW);
            self.asm.cmn_imm(w, divisor, 1, false);
            self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Ne, divide);
            // INT_MIN - 1 is the only subtraction of 1 that overflows.
            self.asm.cmp_imm(w, dividend, 1, false);
            self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Vs, overflow);
            self.asm.bind(divide);
        }
        let quotient = if matches!(node.op, Op::DivS | Op::DivU) {
            dst
        } else {
            SCRATCH
        };
        if signed {
            self.asm.sdiv(w, quotient, dividend, divisor);
        } else {
            self.asm.udiv(w, quotient, dividend, divisor);
        }
        if quotient == SCRATCH {
            self.asm.msub(w, dst, SCRATCH, divisor, dividend);
        }
    }

    /// Compares `source` with the float constant `bound` of type `input`, with v31 holding the bound.
    fn compare_with_constant(&mut self, input: Type, source: Register, bound: f64) {
        let bits = float_bits(input, bound);
        self.load_vector_constant(u128::from(bits), SCRATCH_FPR, false);
        self.asm.float_compare(float_size(input), fpr(source), SCRATCH_FPR);
    }

    /// The trapping truncations of floats to integers: NaN is invalid, and values out of range overflow.
    fn truncate(&mut self, value: Value, ty: Type, output: Register, source: Register) {
        let node = *self.func.node(value);
        let input = self.func.node(node.args[0]).ty;
        let invalid = self.trap_label(TRAP_INVALID_CONVERSION);
        let overflow = self.trap_label(TRAP_INTEGER_OVERFLOW);
        self.asm.float_compare(float_size(input), fpr(source), fpr(source));
        self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Vs, invalid);
        let signed = node.op == Op::TruncS;
        let bits = if ty == Type::I64 { 64 } else { 32 };
        let limit = 2f64.powi(if signed { bits - 1 } else { bits });
        // The lower bound: values at or below it overflow (or below it, where it is exact).
        let (lower, below_only) = match (signed, bits, input) {
            (true, 32, Type::F64) => (-limit - 1.0, false),
            (true, _, _) => (-limit, true),
            (false, _, _) => (-1.0, false),
        };
        self.compare_with_constant(input, source, lower);
        self.asm.b_cond(if below_only { Cond::Lo } else { Cond::Ls }, overflow);
        self.compare_with_constant(input, source, limit);
        self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Hs, overflow);
        self.asm
            .convert_to_integer(signed, width(ty), float_size(input), gpr(output), fpr(source));
    }
}
