//! Runtime data: fields of memories, tables and segments, table elements, the checks of indirect calls, and calls of
//! the runtime's functions.

use super::gc::Operand32;
use super::{ADDRESS, CodeGenerator, FP, SCRATCH, gpr};
use crate::asm::aarch64::{Cond, Extend, MemOperand, XZR};
use crate::asm::{Gpr, Label, Width};
use crate::convention;
use crate::ir::{Helper, Op, Value};
use crate::regalloc::CONSTANT_INPUT;
use libwasm_module::abi::{
    ExecutionContext, FunctionHeader, InstanceData, Rtt, TRAP_INDIRECT_CALL_TYPE_MISMATCH, TableData,
};
use std::mem::offset_of;

/// The out-of-line part of a `CheckFunction`: whether a function whose type is not the expected one has a subtype of
/// it, which only GC modules can declare.
pub(super) struct SubtypeCheck {
    label: Label,
    back: Label,
    reference: Gpr,
    identity: Gpr,
    temps: [Gpr; 2],
}

fn field_width(bytes: u8) -> Width {
    if bytes == 4 { Width::W32 } else { Width::W64 }
}

fn field(offset: usize) -> i32 {
    offset as i32
}

impl CodeGenerator<'_> {
    pub(super) fn lower_runtime(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let input = |index: usize| gpr(record.inputs[index]);
        match node.op {
            Op::Offset => {
                self.asm
                    .add_any(gpr(record.output), input(0), i64::from(node.args[1] as i32), ADDRESS);
            }
            Op::ReadField => {
                let width = field_width(node.flags);
                let operand = self.operand(
                    input(0),
                    i64::from(node.args[1] as i32),
                    if width == Width::W32 { 2 } else { 3 },
                );
                self.asm.ldr(width, gpr(record.output), operand);
            }
            Op::WriteField => {
                let width = field_width(node.flags);
                let source = if record.inputs[1] == CONSTANT_INPUT {
                    let bits = self.immediate(value, 1);
                    if bits == 0 {
                        XZR
                    } else {
                        self.asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, bits);
                        SCRATCH
                    }
                } else {
                    input(1)
                };
                let operand = self.operand(
                    input(0),
                    i64::from(node.args[2] as i32),
                    if width == Width::W32 { 2 } else { 3 },
                );
                self.asm.str(width, source, operand);
            }
            Op::TableElement | Op::TableStore => {
                let (table, index) = (input(0), input(1));
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W64,
                    SCRATCH,
                    MemOperand::Offset(table, field(offset_of!(TableData, size))),
                );
                self.asm.cmp(Width::W64, index, SCRATCH);
                let out_of_bounds = self.trap_label(u32::from(node.flags));
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Hs, out_of_bounds);
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W64,
                    SCRATCH,
                    MemOperand::Offset(table, field(offset_of!(TableData, elements))),
                );
                let element = MemOperand::Register {
                    base: SCRATCH,
                    index,
                    extend: Extend::Uxtx,
                    shifted: true,
                };
                if node.op == Op::TableElement {
                    self.asm.ldr(Width::W64, gpr(record.output), element);
                } else {
                    self.asm.str(Width::W64, input(2), element);
                }
            }
            Op::CalleeInstance => {
                let (header, caller, output) = (input(0), input(1), gpr(record.output));
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W64,
                    SCRATCH,
                    MemOperand::Offset(header, field(offset_of!(FunctionHeader, instance))),
                );
                self.asm.cmp_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, 0, false);
                self.asm.csel(Width::W64, output, SCRATCH, caller, Cond::Ne);
            }
            Op::CheckNull => {
                let null = self.trap_label(u32::from(node.flags));
                self.asm.cbz(Width::W64, input(0), null);
            }
            Op::CheckInterrupt => {
                let interrupted = self.trap_label(libwasm_module::abi::TRAP_STACK_EXHAUSTED);
                self.asm
                    .ldr(Width::W64, SCRATCH, MemOperand::Offset(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W64,
                    SCRATCH,
                    MemOperand::Offset(SCRATCH, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
                );
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W64,
                    SCRATCH,
                    MemOperand::Offset(SCRATCH, field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, stack_limit))),
                );
                self.asm.cmp(Width::W64, FP, SCRATCH);
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Lo, interrupted);
            }
            Op::CheckFunction => {
                let (reference, identity) = (input(0), input(1));
                let null = self.trap_label(u32::from(node.flags));
                self.asm.cbz(Width::W64, reference, null);
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W32,
                    SCRATCH,
                    MemOperand::Offset(reference, field(offset_of!(FunctionHeader, type_identity))),
                );
                self.asm.cmp(Width::W32, SCRATCH, identity);
                let label = self.asm.new_label();
                let back = self.asm.new_label();
                self.asm.b_cond(Cond::Ne, label);
                self.asm.bind(back);
                self.subtype_checks.push(SubtypeCheck {
                    label,
                    back,
                    reference,
                    identity,
                    temps: [gpr(record.temps[0]), gpr(record.temps[1])],
                });
            }
            Op::Helper => {
                let helper = Helper::from_index(node.args[2]);
                let context = Gpr(convention::HELPER_REGISTERS[0]);
                self.asm.ldr(
                    Width::W64,
                    context,
                    MemOperand::Offset(context, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
                );
                let arguments = offset_of!(ExecutionContext, arguments) as i32;
                for index in 1..func.inputs(value).len() {
                    self.asm.str(
                        Width::W64,
                        Gpr(convention::HELPER_REGISTERS[index]),
                        MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments + 8 * (index as i32 - 1)),
                    );
                }
                self.asm.mov_imm(
                    Width::W64,
                    SCRATCH,
                    crate::runtime::helper_address(helper, self.runtime),
                );
                self.asm.blr(SCRATCH);
                let result = Gpr(convention::GPR_RESULTS[0]);
                if helper.may_trap() {
                    let trap = self.dynamic_trap_label();
                    self.asm.cbnz(Width::W64, result, trap);
                } else if helper.traps_on_zero() {
                    let trap = self.trap_label(libwasm_module::abi::TRAP_RUNTIME);
                    self.asm.cbz(Width::W64, result, trap);
                } else if let Some(value) = helper.trap_value() {
                    let trap = self.trap_label(libwasm_module::abi::TRAP_RUNTIME);
                    self.asm.cmp_imm(Width::W64, result, value as u32, false);
                    self.asm.b_cond(crate::asm::aarch64::Cond::Eq, trap);
                }
            }
            _ => unreachable!("{} is no runtime operation", node.op.name()),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn subtype_checks(&mut self) {
        let checks = std::mem::take(&mut self.subtype_checks);
        if checks.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let mismatch = self.trap_label(TRAP_INDIRECT_CALL_TYPE_MISMATCH);
        for check in checks {
            let [rtts, actual] = check.temps;
            self.asm.bind(check.label);
            self.asm
                .ldr(Width::W64, rtts, MemOperand::Offset(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
            self.asm.ldr(
                Width::W64,
                rtts,
                MemOperand::Offset(rtts, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
            );
            self.asm.ldr(
                Width::W64,
                rtts,
                MemOperand::Offset(rtts, field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, rtts))),
            );
            self.asm.ldr(
                Width::W32,
                SCRATCH,
                MemOperand::Offset(check.reference, field(offset_of!(FunctionHeader, type_identity))),
            );
            let indexed = |index: Gpr, shift: bool| MemOperand::Register {
                base: rtts,
                index,
                extend: Extend::Uxtx,
                shifted: shift,
            };
            self.asm.ldr(Width::W64, actual, indexed(SCRATCH, true));
            // The expected type's Rtt, by the identity, which is zero-extended in its register.
            let target = rtts;
            self.asm.ldr(Width::W64, target, indexed(check.identity, true));
            self.asm.ldr(
                Width::W32,
                SCRATCH,
                MemOperand::Offset(target, field(offset_of!(Rtt, depth))),
            );
            self.check_subtype(
                actual,
                Operand32::Register(SCRATCH),
                Operand32::Register(check.identity),
                mismatch,
            );
            self.asm.b(check.back);
        }
    }
}

//! Vectors: v128 loads, lanes and SIMD arithmetic, as Advanced SIMD instructions.
//!
//! The allocator gives a vector node an output register apart from its inputs, so a lowering may write its output
//! before it has read all inputs; v30 and v31 are the scratch registers. Inputs may share a register (`i32x4.add x
//! x`), and are never written. Where the interpreter's instruction sequence decides bits the spec leaves open (NaN
//! payloads of min and max, relaxed instructions), the lowering is the same sequence, with each of its operations
//! expanded as the interpreter's AArch64 code expands it, so that both tiers agree bit for bit.

use super::{CodeGenerator, SCRATCH, SCRATCH_FPR, SCRATCH_FPR2, fpr, fpr_access, gpr};
use crate::asm::aarch64::{MemOperand, VectorArrangement};
use crate::asm::{Fpr, Gpr, Width};
use crate::convention::Register;
use crate::ir::{Func, Op, Type, Value};
use crate::regalloc::CONSTANT_INPUT;
use libwasm_module::opcode::simd::*;

/// The extra vector registers the lowering of a vector node takes: none, the scratch registers suffice.
pub(crate) fn vector_temps(_func: &Func, _value: Value) -> usize {
    0
}

/// Whether a binary SIMD operation is a shift by an i32, whose count may be a constant.
pub(crate) fn is_vector_shift(sub_opcode: u32) -> bool {
    matches!(
        sub_opcode,
        I8X16_SHL
            | I8X16_SHR_S
            | I8X16_SHR_U
            | I16X8_SHL
            | I16X8_SHR_S
            | I16X8_SHR_U
            | I32X4_SHL
            | I32X4_SHR_S
            | I32X4_SHR_U
            | I64X2_SHL
            | I64X2_SHR_S
            | I64X2_SHR_U
    )
}

const V31: Fpr = SCRATCH_FPR;
const V30: Fpr = SCRATCH_FPR2;

// The opcodes of the "three same" instructions, with their U bit.
const ADD: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b10000);
const SUB: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b10000);
const CMEQ: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b10001);
const CMGT: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b00110);
const CMHI: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b00110);
const CMGE: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b00111);
const CMHS: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b00111);
const SQADD: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b00001);
const UQADD: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b00001);
const SQSUB: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b00101);
const UQSUB: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b00101);
const URHADD: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b00010);
const MUL: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b10011);
const SMAX: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b01100);
const UMAX: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b01100);
const SMIN: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b01101);
const UMIN: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b01101);
const SSHL: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b01000);
const USHL: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b01000);
const ADDP: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b10111);
const SQRDMULH: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b10110);

/// The bitwise "three same" instructions: U, size and the opcode 00011.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum Logic {
    And,
    Bic,
    Orr,
    Eor,
    Bsl,
}

impl Logic {
    const fn fields(self) -> (bool, u32) {
        match self {
            Logic::And => (false, 0),
            Logic::Bic => (false, 1),
            Logic::Orr => (false, 2),
            Logic::Eor => (true, 0),
            Logic::Bsl => (true, 1),
        }
    }
}

// The float "three same" instructions: U, the high bit of the size field, and the opcode.
const FADD: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 0, 0b11010);
const FSUB: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 1, 0b11010);
const FMUL: (bool, u32, u32) = (true, 0, 0b11011);
const FDIV: (bool, u32, u32) = (true, 0, 0b11111);
const FCMEQ: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 0, 0b11100);
const FCMGE: (bool, u32, u32) = (true, 0, 0b11100);
const FCMGT: (bool, u32, u32) = (true, 1, 0b11100);

// The "two-register miscellaneous" instructions: U, the opcode, and for float ones the high bit of the size field.
const ABS: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b01011);
const NEG: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b01011);
const CNT: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b00101);
const NOT: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b00101);
const CMEQ_ZERO: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b01001);
const SADDLP: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b00010);
const UADDLP: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b00010);
const XTN: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b10010);
const SQXTN: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b10100);
const UQXTN: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b10100);
const SQXTUN: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b10010);
const REV64: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b00000);
const FCVTN: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 0, 0b10110);
const FCVTL: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 0, 0b10111);
const FABS: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 1, 0b01111);
const FNEG: (bool, u32, u32) = (true, 1, 0b01111);
const FSQRT: (bool, u32, u32) = (true, 1, 0b11111);
const FRINTN: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 0, 0b11000);
const FRINTM: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 0, 0b11001);
const FRINTP: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 1, 0b11000);
const FRINTZ: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 1, 0b11001);
const SCVTF: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 0, 0b11101);
const UCVTF: (bool, u32, u32) = (true, 0, 0b11101);
const FCVTZS: (bool, u32, u32) = (false, 1, 0b11011);
const FCVTZU: (bool, u32, u32) = (true, 1, 0b11011);

// The "three different" instructions: U and the opcode.
const SMULL: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b1100);
const UMULL: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b1100);
const UMLAL: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b1000);

// The shifts by an immediate: U and the opcode.
const SHL: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b01010);
const SSHR: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b00000);
const USHR: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b00000);
const USRA: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b00010);
const SSHLL: (bool, u32) = (false, 0b10100);
const USHLL: (bool, u32) = (true, 0b10100);

// The permutes.
const UZP1: u32 = 0b001;
const UZP2: u32 = 0b101;

// The copies: imm4.
const DUP_ELEMENT: u32 = 0b0000;
const DUP_GENERAL: u32 = 0b0001;
const INS_GENERAL: u32 = 0b0011;
const SMOV: u32 = 0b0101;
const UMOV: u32 = 0b0111;

/// The imm5 field of a copy of lane `index` of lanes of `1 << size` bytes.
const fn lane_imm5(size: u32, index: u32) -> u32 {
    ((index << 1) | 1) << size
}

/// The size field of a float operation: the high bit, and the precision.
const fn float_size_field(high: u32, double: bool) -> u32 {
    (high << 1) | double as u32
}

impl CodeGenerator<'_> {
    // Instructions.

    fn three(&mut self, (u, opcode): (bool, u32), size: u32, d: Fpr, n: Fpr, m: Fpr) {
        self.asm.vector_three_same(true, (u, opcode), size, d, n, m);
    }

    fn bitwise(&mut self, op: Logic, d: Fpr, n: Fpr, m: Fpr) {
        let (u, size) = op.fields();
        self.asm.vector_three_same(true, (u, 0b00011), size, d, n, m);
    }

    fn float_three(&mut self, (u, high, opcode): (bool, u32, u32), double: bool, d: Fpr, n: Fpr, m: Fpr) {
        self.asm
            .vector_three_same(true, (u, opcode), float_size_field(high, double), d, n, m);
    }

    fn misc(&mut self, (u, opcode): (bool, u32), size: u32, d: Fpr, n: Fpr) {
        self.asm.vector_two_misc(true, u, size, opcode, d, n);
    }

    fn float_misc(&mut self, (u, high, opcode): (bool, u32, u32), double: bool, d: Fpr, n: Fpr) {
        self.asm
            .vector_two_misc(true, u, float_size_field(high, double), opcode, d, n);
    }

    /// A shift left by `shift` of lanes of `1 << size` bytes.
    fn shift_left(&mut self, (u, opcode): (bool, u32), size: u32, shift: u32, d: Fpr, n: Fpr) {
        let bits = 8 << size;
        self.asm.vector_shift_immediate(true, u, bits + shift, opcode, d, n);
    }

    /// A shift right by `shift` (1 to the lane width) of lanes of `1 << size` bytes.
    fn shift_right(&mut self, (u, opcode): (bool, u32), size: u32, shift: u32, d: Fpr, n: Fpr) {
        let bits = 8 << size;
        self.asm.vector_shift_immediate(true, u, 2 * bits - shift, opcode, d, n);
    }

    /// `sshll`/`ushll #0` (`high`: `sshll2`/`ushll2`): the low or high half's lanes of `1 << size` bytes, extended.
    fn extend(&mut self, signed: bool, high: bool, size: u32, d: Fpr, n: Fpr) {
        let (u, opcode) = if signed { SSHLL } else { USHLL };
        self.asm.vector_shift_immediate(high, u, 8 << size, opcode, d, n);
    }

    /// A long multiply (`smull`, `umull`, `umlal` and their high forms) of lanes of `1 << size` bytes.
    fn long(&mut self, (u, opcode): (bool, u32), high: bool, size: u32, d: Fpr, n: Fpr, m: Fpr) {
        self.asm.vector_three_different(high, (u, opcode), size, d, n, m);
    }

    /// A narrowing (`xtn`, `sqxtn`, `uqxtn`, `sqxtun`, or with `high` their second forms) to lanes of `1 << size`
    /// bytes.
    fn narrow(&mut self, (u, opcode): (bool, u32), high: bool, size: u32, d: Fpr, n: Fpr) {
        self.asm.vector_two_misc(high, u, size, opcode, d, n);
    }

    fn not(&mut self, d: Fpr, n: Fpr) {
        self.misc(NOT, 0, d, n);
    }

    /// Fills `d` with the constant `bits`.
    fn vector_constant(&mut self, d: Fpr, bits: u128) {
        self.load_vector_constant(bits, d, true);
    }

    /// Fills every lane of `1 << size` bytes of `d` with the general purpose register `n`.
    fn dup_general(&mut self, size: u32, d: Fpr, n: Gpr) {
        self.asm
            .vector_copy(true, false, lane_imm5(size, 0), DUP_GENERAL, d.0, n.0);
    }

    // Lowerings.

    /// A `VectorLoad`, whose operand `operand_of` makes for an access of `1 << size_log2` bytes.
    pub(super) fn vector_load(&mut self, value: Value, operand_of: impl Fn(&mut Self, u32) -> MemOperand) {
        let node = *self.func.node(value);
        let dst = fpr(self.allocation.node(value).output);
        let sub_opcode = u32::from(node.flags);
        let load = |generator: &mut Self, size_log2: u32| {
            let operand = operand_of(generator, size_log2);
            generator.asm.load_store(fpr_access(size_log2, true), dst.0, operand);
        };
        match sub_opcode {
            V128_LOAD => load(self, 4),
            V128_LOAD8X8_S | V128_LOAD8X8_U | V128_LOAD16X4_S | V128_LOAD16X4_U | V128_LOAD32X2_S | V128_LOAD32X2_U => {
                load(self, 3);
                let (size, signed) = match sub_opcode {
                    V128_LOAD8X8_S => (0, true),
                    V128_LOAD8X8_U => (0, false),
                    V128_LOAD16X4_S => (1, true),
                    V128_LOAD16X4_U => (1, false),
                    V128_LOAD32X2_S => (2, true),
                    _ => (2, false),
                };
                self.extend(signed, false, size, dst, dst);
            }
            V128_LOAD8_SPLAT | V128_LOAD16_SPLAT | V128_LOAD32_SPLAT | V128_LOAD64_SPLAT => {
                let size = match sub_opcode {
                    V128_LOAD8_SPLAT => 0,
                    V128_LOAD16_SPLAT => 1,
                    V128_LOAD32_SPLAT => 2,
                    _ => 3,
                };
                let operand = operand_of(self, size);
                let address = self.address_register(operand);
                self.asm.load_replicate(size, dst, address);
            }
            // NB: Loads of 32 or 64 bits clear the rest of the register.
            V128_LOAD32_ZERO => load(self, 2),
            _ => load(self, 3),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn lower_vector(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let [a, b, c] = record.inputs;
        let output = record.output;
        match node.op {
            Op::VectorUnary => self.vector_unary(node.args[1], node.ty, output, a),
            Op::VectorBinary => self.vector_binary(value, node.args[2], output, a, b),
            Op::VectorTernary => {
                let sub_opcode = if u32::from(node.flags) == V128_BITSELECT {
                    V128_BITSELECT
                } else {
                    0x100 | u32::from(node.flags)
                };
                self.vector_ternary(sub_opcode, fpr(output), [fpr(a), fpr(b), fpr(c)]);
            }
            Op::ExtractLane => self.extract_lane(node.args[1], node.args[2], output, fpr(a)),
            Op::ReplaceLane => {
                let sub_opcode = node.args[2] & 0xffff;
                let lane = node.args[2] >> 16;
                let dst = fpr(output);
                self.move_vector(dst, fpr(a));
                let size = match sub_opcode {
                    I8X16_REPLACE_LANE => 0,
                    I16X8_REPLACE_LANE => 1,
                    I32X4_REPLACE_LANE | F32X4_REPLACE_LANE => 2,
                    _ => 3,
                };
                if matches!(sub_opcode, F32X4_REPLACE_LANE | F64X2_REPLACE_LANE) {
                    // `ins vd.<T>[lane], vn.<T>[0]`
                    self.asm
                        .vector_copy(true, true, lane_imm5(size, lane), 0, dst.0, fpr(b).0);
                } else {
                    self.asm
                        .vector_copy(true, false, lane_imm5(size, lane), INS_GENERAL, dst.0, gpr(b).0);
                }
            }
            Op::Shuffle => {
                let lanes = func.constants[node.args[2] as usize];
                let dst = fpr(output);
                if node.args[0] == node.args[1] {
                    // NB: The builder makes the lanes of a shuffle of one vector 0 to 15, but its operands may have
                    //     become the same value since. A table of one register gives zero for lanes of 16 and up.
                    self.vector_constant(dst, lanes & u128::from_le_bytes([15; 16]));
                    self.asm.vector_table(dst, fpr(a), 1, dst);
                } else {
                    // The table of two registers has to be in consecutive ones.
                    self.move_vector(V30, fpr(a));
                    self.move_vector(V31, fpr(b));
                    self.vector_constant(dst, lanes);
                    self.asm.vector_table(dst, V30, 2, dst);
                }
            }
            _ => unreachable!("{} is no vector op", node.op.name()),
        }
    }

    fn vector_unary(&mut self, sub_opcode: u32, ty: Type, output: Register, a: Register) {
        if ty == Type::I32 {
            self.vector_test(sub_opcode, gpr(output), fpr(a));
            return;
        }
        let dst = fpr(output);
        match sub_opcode {
            I8X16_SPLAT => self.dup_general(0, dst, gpr(a)),
            I16X8_SPLAT => self.dup_general(1, dst, gpr(a)),
            I32X4_SPLAT => self.dup_general(2, dst, gpr(a)),
            I64X2_SPLAT => self.dup_general(3, dst, gpr(a)),
            F32X4_SPLAT => self
                .asm
                .vector_copy(true, false, lane_imm5(2, 0), DUP_ELEMENT, dst.0, fpr(a).0),
            F64X2_SPLAT => self
                .asm
                .vector_copy(true, false, lane_imm5(3, 0), DUP_ELEMENT, dst.0, fpr(a).0),
            _ => self.vector_lanewise_unary(sub_opcode, dst, fpr(a)),
        }
    }

    /// The unary operations from a vector to a vector.
    fn vector_lanewise_unary(&mut self, sub_opcode: u32, dst: Fpr, a: Fpr) {
        match sub_opcode {
            V128_NOT => self.not(dst, a),
            I8X16_ABS => self.misc(ABS, 0, dst, a),
            I16X8_ABS => self.misc(ABS, 1, dst, a),
            I32X4_ABS => self.misc(ABS, 2, dst, a),
            I64X2_ABS => self.misc(ABS, 3, dst, a),
            I8X16_NEG => self.misc(NEG, 0, dst, a),
            I16X8_NEG => self.misc(NEG, 1, dst, a),
            I32X4_NEG => self.misc(NEG, 2, dst, a),
            I64X2_NEG => self.misc(NEG, 3, dst, a),
            I8X16_POPCNT => self.misc(CNT, 0, dst, a),
            // NB: These only change the sign bit, as the interpreter's masks do.
            F32X4_ABS => self.float_misc(FABS, false, dst, a),
            F32X4_NEG => self.float_misc(FNEG, false, dst, a),
            F64X2_ABS => self.float_misc(FABS, true, dst, a),
            F64X2_NEG => self.float_misc(FNEG, true, dst, a),
            F32X4_SQRT => self.float_misc(FSQRT, false, dst, a),
            F64X2_SQRT => self.float_misc(FSQRT, true, dst, a),
            F32X4_NEAREST => self.float_misc(FRINTN, false, dst, a),
            F32X4_FLOOR => self.float_misc(FRINTM, false, dst, a),
            F32X4_CEIL => self.float_misc(FRINTP, false, dst, a),
            F32X4_TRUNC => self.float_misc(FRINTZ, false, dst, a),
            F64X2_NEAREST => self.float_misc(FRINTN, true, dst, a),
            F64X2_FLOOR => self.float_misc(FRINTM, true, dst, a),
            F64X2_CEIL => self.float_misc(FRINTP, true, dst, a),
            F64X2_TRUNC => self.float_misc(FRINTZ, true, dst, a),
            I16X8_EXTEND_LOW_I8X16_S => self.extend(true, false, 0, dst, a),
            I16X8_EXTEND_HIGH_I8X16_S => self.extend(true, true, 0, dst, a),
            I16X8_EXTEND_LOW_I8X16_U => self.extend(false, false, 0, dst, a),
            I16X8_EXTEND_HIGH_I8X16_U => self.extend(false, true, 0, dst, a),
            I32X4_EXTEND_LOW_I16X8_S => self.extend(true, false, 1, dst, a),
            I32X4_EXTEND_HIGH_I16X8_S => self.extend(true, true, 1, dst, a),
            I32X4_EXTEND_LOW_I16X8_U => self.extend(false, false, 1, dst, a),
            I32X4_EXTEND_HIGH_I16X8_U => self.extend(false, true, 1, dst, a),
            I64X2_EXTEND_LOW_I32X4_S => self.extend(true, false, 2, dst, a),
            I64X2_EXTEND_HIGH_I32X4_S => self.extend(true, true, 2, dst, a),
            I64X2_EXTEND_LOW_I32X4_U => self.extend(false, false, 2, dst, a),
            I64X2_EXTEND_HIGH_I32X4_U => self.extend(false, true, 2, dst, a),
            I16X8_EXTADD_PAIRWISE_I8X16_S => self.misc(SADDLP, 0, dst, a),
            I16X8_EXTADD_PAIRWISE_I8X16_U => self.misc(UADDLP, 0, dst, a),
            I32X4_EXTADD_PAIRWISE_I16X8_S => self.misc(SADDLP, 1, dst, a),
            I32X4_EXTADD_PAIRWISE_I16X8_U => self.misc(UADDLP, 1, dst, a),
            // NB: The conversions from integers round once, as the spec wants, so any exact sequence agrees.
            F32X4_CONVERT_I32X4_S => self.float_misc(SCVTF, false, dst, a),
            F32X4_CONVERT_I32X4_U => self.float_misc(UCVTF, false, dst, a),
            F64X2_CONVERT_LOW_I32X4_S => {
                self.extend(true, false, 2, dst, a);
                self.float_misc(SCVTF, true, dst, dst);
            }
            F64X2_CONVERT_LOW_I32X4_U => {
                self.extend(false, false, 2, dst, a);
                self.float_misc(UCVTF, true, dst, dst);
            }
            // NB: The truncations saturate and give 0 for NaN, as the saturating ones want.
            I32X4_TRUNC_SAT_F32X4_S => self.float_misc(FCVTZS, false, dst, a),
            I32X4_TRUNC_SAT_F32X4_U => self.float_misc(FCVTZU, false, dst, a),
            I32X4_TRUNC_SAT_F64X2_S_ZERO => {
                self.float_misc(FCVTZS, true, dst, a);
                self.narrow(SQXTN, false, 2, dst, dst);
            }
            I32X4_TRUNC_SAT_F64X2_U_ZERO => {
                self.float_misc(FCVTZU, true, dst, a);
                self.narrow(UQXTN, false, 2, dst, dst);
            }
            // The interpreter's demotion and promotion are these instructions.
            F32X4_DEMOTE_F64X2_ZERO => self.asm.vector_two_misc(false, FCVTN.0, 1, FCVTN.2, dst, a),
            F64X2_PROMOTE_LOW_F32X4 => self.asm.vector_two_misc(false, FCVTL.0, 1, FCVTL.2, dst, a),
            _ => unreachable!("SIMD sub-opcode {sub_opcode:#x} is no unary vector operation"),
        }
    }

    /// The reductions of a vector to an i32.
    fn vector_test(&mut self, sub_opcode: u32, dst: Gpr, a: Fpr) {
        match sub_opcode {
            V128_ANY_TRUE => {
                // umaxv s31, a.4s
                self.asm.vector_across(true, true, 2, 0b01010, V31, a);
                self.asm.fmov_to_gpr(dst, V31);
                self.asm.cmp_imm(Width::W64, dst, 0, false);
                self.asm.cset(Width::W32, dst, crate::asm::aarch64::Cond::Ne);
            }
            I8X16_ALL_TRUE | I16X8_ALL_TRUE | I32X4_ALL_TRUE | I64X2_ALL_TRUE => {
                // All lanes are nonzero where no lane equals zero.
                let size = match sub_opcode {
                    I8X16_ALL_TRUE => 0,
                    I16X8_ALL_TRUE => 1,
                    I32X4_ALL_TRUE => 2,
                    _ => 3,
                };
                self.misc(CMEQ_ZERO, size, V31, a);
                self.asm.vector_across(true, true, 2, 0b01010, V31, V31);
                self.asm.fmov_to_gpr(dst, V31);
                self.asm.cmp_imm(Width::W64, dst, 0, false);
                self.asm.cset(Width::W32, dst, crate::asm::aarch64::Cond::Eq);
            }
            I8X16_BITMASK | I16X8_BITMASK => {
                // The sign bits gathered: each shift-and-accumulate doubles the bits a lane holds, until the low
                // byte of each 64-bit half holds those of its half.
                let (size, half_bits) = if sub_opcode == I8X16_BITMASK { (0u32, 8) } else { (1, 4) };
                let bits = 8u32 << size;
                self.shift_right(USHR, size, bits - 1, V31, a);
                // Each doubling of the lane width moves the upper half's bits next to the lower half's.
                let mut gathered = 1u32;
                for wider in size + 1..4 {
                    self.shift_right(USRA, wider, (8 << (wider - 1)) - gathered, V31, V31);
                    gathered *= 2;
                }
                self.asm
                    .vector_copy(false, false, lane_imm5(0, 0), UMOV, SCRATCH.0, V31.0);
                self.asm
                    .vector_copy(false, false, lane_imm5(0, 8), UMOV, super::ADDRESS.0, V31.0);
                self.asm.orr(
                    Width::W32,
                    dst,
                    SCRATCH,
                    super::ADDRESS,
                    crate::asm::aarch64::Shift::Lsl,
                    half_bits,
                );
            }
            I32X4_BITMASK => {
                self.shift_right(USHR, 2, 31, V31, a);
                self.shift_right(USRA, 3, 31, V31, V31);
                self.asm
                    .vector_copy(false, false, lane_imm5(2, 0), UMOV, SCRATCH.0, V31.0);
                self.asm
                    .vector_copy(false, false, lane_imm5(2, 2), UMOV, super::ADDRESS.0, V31.0);
                self.asm.orr(
                    Width::W32,
                    dst,
                    SCRATCH,
                    super::ADDRESS,
                    crate::asm::aarch64::Shift::Lsl,
                    2,
                );
            }
            I64X2_BITMASK => {
                self.shift_right(USHR, 3, 63, V31, a);
                self.asm
                    .vector_copy(true, false, lane_imm5(3, 0), UMOV, SCRATCH.0, V31.0);
                self.asm
                    .vector_copy(true, false, lane_imm5(3, 1), UMOV, super::ADDRESS.0, V31.0);
                self.asm.orr(
                    Width::W32,
                    dst,
                    SCRATCH,
                    super::ADDRESS,
                    crate::asm::aarch64::Shift::Lsl,
                    1,
                );
            }
            _ => unreachable!("SIMD sub-opcode {sub_opcode:#x} is no reduction to an i32"),
        }
    }

    /// The interpreter's `v128_min_f*(x, y)`: `y > x ? x : y`, lane by lane.
    fn interpreter_min(&mut self, double: bool, d: Fpr, x: Fpr, y: Fpr) {
        self.float_three(FCMGT, double, d, y, x);
        self.bitwise(Logic::Bsl, d, x, y);
    }

    /// The interpreter's `v128_max_f*(x, y)`: `x > y ? x : y`, lane by lane.
    fn interpreter_max(&mut self, double: bool, d: Fpr, x: Fpr, y: Fpr) {
        self.float_three(FCMGT, double, d, x, y);
        self.bitwise(Logic::Bsl, d, x, y);
    }

    /// The interpreter's `v128_unord_f*(x, y)`, into `d`, through v30.
    fn interpreter_unordered(&mut self, double: bool, d: Fpr, x: Fpr, y: Fpr) {
        self.float_three(FCMEQ, double, V30, x, x);
        self.float_three(FCMEQ, double, d, y, y);
        self.bitwise(Logic::And, d, V30, d);
        self.not(d, d);
    }

    fn vector_binary(&mut self, value: Value, sub_opcode: u32, output: Register, a: Register, b: Register) {
        let dst = fpr(output);
        if is_vector_shift(sub_opcode) {
            let count = (b == CONSTANT_INPUT).then(|| self.immediate(value, 1) as u32);
            self.vector_shift(sub_opcode, dst, fpr(a), b, count);
            return;
        }
        let (a, b) = (fpr(a), fpr(b));
        let integer = |op: (bool, u32), size: u32| (op, size, false);
        let swapped = |op: (bool, u32), size: u32| (op, size, true);
        let simple = match sub_opcode {
            I8X16_EQ => Some(integer(CMEQ, 0)),
            I16X8_EQ => Some(integer(CMEQ, 1)),
            I32X4_EQ => Some(integer(CMEQ, 2)),
            I64X2_EQ => Some(integer(CMEQ, 3)),
            I8X16_GT_S => Some(integer(CMGT, 0)),
            I16X8_GT_S => Some(integer(CMGT, 1)),
            I32X4_GT_S => Some(integer(CMGT, 2)),
            I64X2_GT_S => Some(integer(CMGT, 3)),
            I8X16_LT_S => Some(swapped(CMGT, 0)),
            I16X8_LT_S => Some(swapped(CMGT, 1)),
            I32X4_LT_S => Some(swapped(CMGT, 2)),
            I64X2_LT_S => Some(swapped(CMGT, 3)),
            I8X16_GE_S => Some(integer(CMGE, 0)),
            I16X8_GE_S => Some(integer(CMGE, 1)),
            I32X4_GE_S => Some(integer(CMGE, 2)),
            I64X2_GE_S => Some(integer(CMGE, 3)),
            I8X16_LE_S => Some(swapped(CMGE, 0)),
            I16X8_LE_S => Some(swapped(CMGE, 1)),
            I32X4_LE_S => Some(swapped(CMGE, 2)),
            I64X2_LE_S => Some(swapped(CMGE, 3)),
            I8X16_GT_U => Some(integer(CMHI, 0)),
            I16X8_GT_U => Some(integer(CMHI, 1)),
            I32X4_GT_U => Some(integer(CMHI, 2)),
            I8X16_LT_U => Some(swapped(CMHI, 0)),
            I16X8_LT_U => Some(swapped(CMHI, 1)),
            I32X4_LT_U => Some(swapped(CMHI, 2)),
            I8X16_GE_U => Some(integer(CMHS, 0)),
            I16X8_GE_U => Some(integer(CMHS, 1)),
            I32X4_GE_U => Some(integer(CMHS, 2)),
            I8X16_LE_U => Some(swapped(CMHS, 0)),
            I16X8_LE_U => Some(swapped(CMHS, 1)),
            I32X4_LE_U => Some(swapped(CMHS, 2)),
            I8X16_ADD => Some(integer(ADD, 0)),
            I16X8_ADD => Some(integer(ADD, 1)),
            I32X4_ADD => Some(integer(ADD, 2)),
            I64X2_ADD => Some(integer(ADD, 3)),
            I8X16_SUB => Some(integer(SUB, 0)),
            I16X8_SUB => Some(integer(SUB, 1)),
            I32X4_SUB => Some(integer(SUB, 2)),
            I64X2_SUB => Some(integer(SUB, 3)),
            I8X16_ADD_SAT_S => Some(integer(SQADD, 0)),
            I8X16_ADD_SAT_U => Some(integer(UQADD, 0)),
            I8X16_SUB_SAT_S => Some(integer(SQSUB, 0)),
            I8X16_SUB_SAT_U => Some(integer(UQSUB, 0)),
            I16X8_ADD_SAT_S => Some(integer(SQADD, 1)),
            I16X8_ADD_SAT_U => Some(integer(UQADD, 1)),
            I16X8_SUB_SAT_S => Some(integer(SQSUB, 1)),
            I16X8_SUB_SAT_U => Some(integer(UQSUB, 1)),
            I8X16_AVGR_U => Some(integer(URHADD, 0)),
            I16X8_AVGR_U => Some(integer(URHADD, 1)),
            I16X8_MUL => Some(integer(MUL, 1)),
            I32X4_MUL => Some(integer(MUL, 2)),
            I8X16_MIN_S => Some(integer(SMIN, 0)),
            I8X16_MIN_U => Some(integer(UMIN, 0)),
            I8X16_MAX_S => Some(integer(SMAX, 0)),
            I8X16_MAX_U => Some(integer(UMAX, 0)),
            I16X8_MIN_S => Some(integer(SMIN, 1)),
            I16X8_MIN_U => Some(integer(UMIN, 1)),
            I16X8_MAX_S => Some(integer(SMAX, 1)),
            I16X8_MAX_U => Some(integer(UMAX, 1)),
            I32X4_MIN_S => Some(integer(SMIN, 2)),
            I32X4_MIN_U => Some(integer(UMIN, 2)),
            I32X4_MAX_S => Some(integer(SMAX, 2)),
            I32X4_MAX_U => Some(integer(UMAX, 2)),
            // NB: The rounding doubling multiply saturates the one product that overflows, -1 * -1.
            I16X8_Q15MULR_SAT_S => Some(integer(SQRDMULH, 1)),
            _ => None,
        };
        if let Some((op, size, swap)) = simple {
            let (lhs, rhs) = if swap { (b, a) } else { (a, b) };
            self.three(op, size, dst, lhs, rhs);
            return;
        }
        match sub_opcode {
            V128_AND => self.bitwise(Logic::And, dst, a, b),
            V128_OR => self.bitwise(Logic::Orr, dst, a, b),
            V128_XOR => self.bitwise(Logic::Eor, dst, a, b),
            V128_ANDNOT => self.bitwise(Logic::Bic, dst, a, b),
            I8X16_NE | I16X8_NE | I32X4_NE | I64X2_NE => {
                let size = match sub_opcode {
                    I8X16_NE => 0,
                    I16X8_NE => 1,
                    I32X4_NE => 2,
                    _ => 3,
                };
                self.three(CMEQ, size, dst, a, b);
                self.not(dst, dst);
            }
            F32X4_EQ | F64X2_EQ => self.float_three(FCMEQ, sub_opcode == F64X2_EQ, dst, a, b),
            F32X4_NE | F64X2_NE => {
                self.float_three(FCMEQ, sub_opcode == F64X2_NE, dst, a, b);
                self.not(dst, dst);
            }
            F32X4_LT | F64X2_LT => self.float_three(FCMGT, sub_opcode == F64X2_LT, dst, b, a),
            F32X4_LE | F64X2_LE => self.float_three(FCMGE, sub_opcode == F64X2_LE, dst, b, a),
            F32X4_GT | F64X2_GT => self.float_three(FCMGT, sub_opcode == F64X2_GT, dst, a, b),
            F32X4_GE | F64X2_GE => self.float_three(FCMGE, sub_opcode == F64X2_GE, dst, a, b),
            F32X4_ADD | F64X2_ADD => self.float_three(FADD, sub_opcode == F64X2_ADD, dst, a, b),
            F32X4_SUB | F64X2_SUB => self.float_three(FSUB, sub_opcode == F64X2_SUB, dst, a, b),
            F32X4_MUL | F64X2_MUL => self.float_three(FMUL, sub_opcode == F64X2_MUL, dst, a, b),
            F32X4_DIV | F64X2_DIV => self.float_three(FDIV, sub_opcode == F64X2_DIV, dst, a, b),
            // pmin is b < a ? b : a, the interpreter's min of b and a.
            F32X4_PMIN | F64X2_PMIN => self.interpreter_min(sub_opcode == F64X2_PMIN, dst, b, a),
            F32X4_PMAX | F64X2_PMAX => self.interpreter_max(sub_opcode == F64X2_PMAX, dst, b, a),
            F32X4_MIN | F64X2_MIN => {
                // Both orders, so that a NaN or -0 in either operand makes it into the result, and NaN lanes
                // canonical.
                let double = sub_opcode == F64X2_MIN;
                self.interpreter_min(double, V31, a, b);
                self.interpreter_min(double, dst, b, a);
                self.bitwise(Logic::Orr, dst, dst, V31);
                self.interpreter_unordered(double, V31, dst, dst);
                self.bitwise(Logic::Orr, dst, dst, V31);
                self.nan_payload_shift(double, V31);
                self.bitwise(Logic::Bic, dst, dst, V31);
            }
            F32X4_MAX | F64X2_MAX => {
                // Both orders, so that a NaN in either operand makes it into the result, +0 beats -0, and NaN
                // lanes are canonical.
                let double = sub_opcode == F64X2_MAX;
                self.interpreter_max(double, V31, a, b);
                self.interpreter_max(double, dst, b, a);
                self.bitwise(Logic::Eor, V31, V31, dst);
                self.bitwise(Logic::Orr, dst, dst, V31);
                self.float_three(FSUB, double, dst, dst, V31);
                self.interpreter_unordered(double, V31, V31, dst);
                self.nan_payload_shift(double, V31);
                self.bitwise(Logic::Bic, dst, dst, V31);
            }
            I8X16_SWIZZLE => {
                // NB: tbl picks zero for indices of 16 and up.
                self.asm.vector_table(dst, a, 1, b);
            }
            I8X16_NARROW_I16X8_S | I8X16_NARROW_I16X8_U | I16X8_NARROW_I32X4_S | I16X8_NARROW_I32X4_U => {
                let op = if matches!(sub_opcode, I8X16_NARROW_I16X8_S | I16X8_NARROW_I32X4_S) {
                    SQXTN
                } else {
                    SQXTUN
                };
                let size = if matches!(sub_opcode, I8X16_NARROW_I16X8_S | I8X16_NARROW_I16X8_U) {
                    0
                } else {
                    1
                };
                self.narrow(op, false, size, dst, a);
                self.narrow(op, true, size, dst, b);
            }
            I32X4_DOT_I16X8_S => {
                self.long(SMULL, false, 1, V31, a, b);
                self.long(SMULL, true, 1, V30, a, b);
                self.three(ADDP, 2, dst, V31, V30);
            }
            I64X2_MUL => {
                // The cross products of the halves added, shifted up, plus the low halves' full product.
                self.misc(REV64, 2, V31, b);
                self.three(MUL, 2, V31, V31, a);
                self.misc(UADDLP, 2, dst, V31);
                self.shift_left(SHL, 3, 32, dst, dst);
                self.narrow(XTN, false, 2, V31, a);
                self.narrow(XTN, false, 2, V30, b);
                self.long(UMLAL, false, 2, dst, V31, V30);
            }
            I16X8_EXTMUL_LOW_I8X16_S => self.long(SMULL, false, 0, dst, a, b),
            I16X8_EXTMUL_HIGH_I8X16_S => self.long(SMULL, true, 0, dst, a, b),
            I16X8_EXTMUL_LOW_I8X16_U => self.long(UMULL, false, 0, dst, a, b),
            I16X8_EXTMUL_HIGH_I8X16_U => self.long(UMULL, true, 0, dst, a, b),
            I32X4_EXTMUL_LOW_I16X8_S => self.long(SMULL, false, 1, dst, a, b),
            I32X4_EXTMUL_HIGH_I16X8_S => self.long(SMULL, true, 1, dst, a, b),
            I32X4_EXTMUL_LOW_I16X8_U => self.long(UMULL, false, 1, dst, a, b),
            I32X4_EXTMUL_HIGH_I16X8_U => self.long(UMULL, true, 1, dst, a, b),
            I64X2_EXTMUL_LOW_I32X4_S => self.long(SMULL, false, 2, dst, a, b),
            I64X2_EXTMUL_HIGH_I32X4_S => self.long(SMULL, true, 2, dst, a, b),
            I64X2_EXTMUL_LOW_I32X4_U => self.long(UMULL, false, 2, dst, a, b),
            I64X2_EXTMUL_HIGH_I32X4_U => self.long(UMULL, true, 2, dst, a, b),
            I16X8_RELAXED_DOT_I8X16_I7X16_S => self.multiply_add_unsigned_signed(dst, b, a),
            _ => unreachable!("SIMD sub-opcode {sub_opcode:#x} is no binary vector operation"),
        }
    }

    /// The bits a NaN lane of an all-ones mask in `d` keeps of a value, shifted into place: the interpreter shifts
    /// the mask right by 10 for floats and 13 for doubles, so that the sign, the exponent and the quiet bit remain.
    fn nan_payload_shift(&mut self, double: bool, d: Fpr) {
        if double {
            self.shift_right(USHR, 3, 13, d, d);
        } else {
            self.shift_right(USHR, 2, 10, d, d);
        }
    }

    /// The interpreter's `v128_madd_u8_s8(u, s)`: the unsigned bytes of `u` times the signed bytes of `s`, adjacent
    /// products added into 16-bit lanes with signed saturation.
    fn multiply_add_unsigned_signed(&mut self, dst: Fpr, u: Fpr, s: Fpr) {
        self.extend(false, false, 0, V31, u);
        self.extend(true, false, 0, V30, s);
        self.three(MUL, 1, V31, V31, V30);
        self.extend(false, true, 0, dst, u);
        self.extend(true, true, 0, V30, s);
        self.three(MUL, 1, dst, dst, V30);
        self.asm.vector_permute(VectorArrangement::H8, UZP1, V30, V31, dst);
        self.asm.vector_permute(VectorArrangement::H8, UZP2, dst, V31, dst);
        self.three(SQADD, 1, dst, V30, dst);
    }

    /// A shift of the vector in `a` by the i32 in `count_register`, or by `count` where it is a constant.
    fn vector_shift(&mut self, sub_opcode: u32, dst: Fpr, a: Fpr, count_register: Register, count: Option<u32>) {
        let size = match sub_opcode {
            I8X16_SHL | I8X16_SHR_S | I8X16_SHR_U => 0,
            I16X8_SHL | I16X8_SHR_S | I16X8_SHR_U => 1,
            I32X4_SHL | I32X4_SHR_S | I32X4_SHR_U => 2,
            _ => 3,
        };
        let bits = 8u32 << size;
        let left = matches!(sub_opcode, I8X16_SHL | I16X8_SHL | I32X4_SHL | I64X2_SHL);
        let signed = matches!(sub_opcode, I8X16_SHR_S | I16X8_SHR_S | I32X4_SHR_S | I64X2_SHR_S);
        if let Some(count) = count {
            let count = count & (bits - 1);
            if count == 0 {
                self.move_vector(dst, a);
            } else if left {
                self.shift_left(SHL, size, count, dst, a);
            } else {
                self.shift_right(if signed { SSHR } else { USHR }, size, count, dst, a);
            }
            return;
        }
        // The count masked, negated for right shifts (sshl and ushl shift right by negative counts), in every lane.
        self.asm
            .and_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, gpr(count_register), u64::from(bits - 1));
        if !left {
            self.asm.neg(Width::W64, SCRATCH, SCRATCH);
        }
        self.dup_general(size, V31, SCRATCH);
        self.three(if signed { SSHL } else { USHL }, size, dst, a, V31);
    }

    fn vector_ternary(&mut self, sub_opcode: u32, dst: Fpr, [a, b, c]: [Fpr; 3]) {
        match sub_opcode {
            V128_BITSELECT => {
                // (a & c) | (b & !c)
                self.move_vector(dst, c);
                self.bitwise(Logic::Bsl, dst, a, b);
            }
            // The multiply-adds round twice, as the interpreter's do.
            F32X4_RELAXED_MADD | F64X2_RELAXED_MADD => {
                let double = sub_opcode == F64X2_RELAXED_MADD;
                self.float_three(FMUL, double, dst, a, b);
                self.float_three(FADD, double, dst, dst, c);
            }
            F32X4_RELAXED_NMADD | F64X2_RELAXED_NMADD => {
                let double = sub_opcode == F64X2_RELAXED_NMADD;
                self.float_three(FMUL, double, dst, a, b);
                self.float_three(FSUB, double, dst, c, dst);
            }
            I32X4_RELAXED_DOT_I8X16_I7X16_ADD_S => {
                // Pairs as the 16-bit dot product makes them, then added in pairs again, and to c.
                self.multiply_add_unsigned_signed(dst, b, a);
                self.misc(SADDLP, 1, dst, dst);
                self.three(ADD, 2, dst, dst, c);
            }
            _ => unreachable!("SIMD sub-opcode {sub_opcode:#x} is no ternary vector operation"),
        }
    }

    fn extract_lane(&mut self, sub_opcode: u32, lane: u32, output: Register, vector: Fpr) {
        // `smov`, `umov` (Q for a 64-bit lane), or for floats `dup sd/dd, vn.<T>[lane]` (scalar), which clears the
        // rest of the register.
        let (size, copy) = match sub_opcode {
            I8X16_EXTRACT_LANE_S => (0, Some((false, SMOV))),
            I8X16_EXTRACT_LANE_U => (0, Some((false, UMOV))),
            I16X8_EXTRACT_LANE_S => (1, Some((false, SMOV))),
            I16X8_EXTRACT_LANE_U => (1, Some((false, UMOV))),
            I32X4_EXTRACT_LANE => (2, Some((false, UMOV))),
            I64X2_EXTRACT_LANE => (3, Some((true, UMOV))),
            F32X4_EXTRACT_LANE => (2, None),
            _ => (3, None),
        };
        if let Some((q, imm4)) = copy {
            self.asm
                .vector_copy(q, false, lane_imm5(size, lane), imm4, gpr(output).0, vector.0);
        } else {
            let destination = fpr(output);
            self.asm.emit(
                0x5e00_0400 | (lane_imm5(size, lane) << 16) | (u32::from(vector.0) << 5) | u32::from(destination.0),
            );
        }
    }
}

//! Calls between compiled functions (see `convention`). The allocator moved the arguments into place, so a call
//! only passes the result area, if any, calls through the callee's `FunctionHeader`, and puts rsp back where the
//! frame wants it, which also undoes whatever a callee's tail calls did to it.

use super::{CodeGenerator, FP, SCRATCH, SP, fpr, gpr, precision, width};
use crate::asm::{Address, Gpr, Width};
use crate::convention::{self, Place};
use crate::ir::{FLAG_CHECKS_EXCEPTION, Func, Op, Type, Value};
use libwasm_module::abi::FunctionHeader;
use std::mem::offset_of;

/// The slots of a call's arguments.
fn argument_slots(func: &Func, call: Value) -> u32 {
    func.inputs(call)[3..]
        .iter()
        .map(|argument| func.node(*argument).ty.slots())
        .sum()
}
use crate::regalloc::call_result_types;

impl CodeGenerator<'_> {
    pub(super) fn lower_call(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        match node.op {
            Op::Call => {
                let argument_slots = argument_slots(func, value);
                let results = call_result_types(func, value);
                if convention::has_result_area(&results) {
                    let pointer = 8 * argument_slots as i32;
                    let area = 8 * (argument_slots + 1).next_multiple_of(2) as i32;
                    self.asm.lea(Width::W64, SCRATCH, &Address::new(SP, area));
                    self.asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(SP, pointer), SCRATCH);
                }
                let callee = gpr(convention::CALLEE_REGISTER);
                self.asm
                    .call_m(&Address::new(callee, offset_of!(FunctionHeader, native_entry) as i32));
                if node.flags & FLAG_CHECKS_EXCEPTION != 0 {
                    self.exception_sites.push(self.asm.offset() as u32);
                }
                self.asm
                    .lea(Width::W64, SP, &Address::new(FP, -(self.frame_size as i32)));
            }
            Op::CallResult => {
                let call = node.args[0];
                let index = node.args[1] as usize;
                let results = call_result_types(func, call);
                let mut places = Vec::with_capacity(results.len());
                convention::result_places(&results, &mut places);
                if let Place::Memory(slot) = places[index] {
                    let output = self.allocation.node(value).output;
                    let area = 8 * (argument_slots(func, call) + 1).next_multiple_of(2) as i32;
                    let address = Address::new(SP, area + 8 * slot as i32);
                    if node.ty == Type::V128 {
                        self.load_vector(fpr(output).0, &address);
                    } else if node.ty.is_float() {
                        self.asm.vmovs_rm(precision(node.ty), fpr(output), &address);
                    } else {
                        self.asm.mov_rm(width(node.ty), gpr(output), &address);
                    }
                }
            }
            _ => unreachable!("{} is no call", node.op.name()),
        }
    }

    /// A tail call: the allocator put the arguments where a call passes them, which this copies the stack arguments
    /// from into the incoming area (see `convention`).
    pub(super) fn lower_tail_call(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let parameters = func.inputs(value)[3..]
            .iter()
            .map(|argument| func.node(*argument).ty)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let has_result_area = convention::has_result_area(&func.results);
        let callee_slots = convention::slots(&parameters);
        // NB: The callee returns the function's results, so both have a result area or neither has. Moving the bottom
        //     of the frame by the difference of their incoming areas, down or up, keeps the area's top in place.
        let needed = convention::incoming_area_slots(&parameters, &func.results);
        let available = convention::incoming_area_slots(&func.params, &func.results);
        let slide = 8 * (needed as i32 - available as i32);
        // NB: The callee's operands are in their registers, which leaves rax and rbx free.
        let (return_address, saved_fp) = (Gpr(convention::RAX), Gpr(convention::RBX));
        if slide != 0 {
            self.asm.mov_rm(
                Width::W64,
                return_address,
                &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_RETURN_ADDRESS),
            );
            self.asm
                .mov_rm(Width::W64, saved_fp, &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_SAVED_FP));
        }
        let mut copied = Vec::new();
        let mut places = Vec::new();
        convention::parameter_places(&parameters, &mut places);
        for (index, place) in places.iter().enumerate() {
            if let Place::Memory(slot) = *place {
                copied.extend(slot..slot + parameters[index].slots());
            }
        }
        if has_result_area {
            // The function's caller gets the callee's results.
            let pointer = convention::home_slot_offset(convention::result_area_pointer(&func.params));
            self.asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, &Address::new(FP, pointer));
            self.asm
                .mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(SP, 8 * callee_slots as i32), SCRATCH);
            copied.push(callee_slots);
        }
        // The incoming area is above the outgoing one, so copying down from the top never overwrites a source.
        for &slot in copied.iter().rev() {
            self.asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, &Address::new(SP, 8 * slot as i32));
            self.asm
                .mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(FP, 8 * slot as i32 - slide), SCRATCH);
        }
        if slide != 0 {
            self.asm.mov_mr(
                Width::W64,
                &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_RETURN_ADDRESS - slide),
                return_address,
            );
            self.asm.mov_mr(
                Width::W64,
                &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_SAVED_FP - slide),
                saved_fp,
            );
        }
        self.asm
            .lea(Width::W64, SP, &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_SAVED_FP - slide));
        self.asm.pop(FP);
        let callee = gpr(convention::CALLEE_REGISTER);
        self.asm
            .jmp_m(&Address::new(callee, offset_of!(FunctionHeader, native_entry) as i32));
    }
}

/*

//! Accesses of memories without guard pages, atomics, and GC objects: their addresses and checks, and the tests of
//! references against heap types.

use super::{CodeGenerator, FP, SCRATCH, gpr};
use crate::asm::x86_64::{AluOp, Cond};
use crate::asm::{Address, Gpr, Label, Scale, Width};
use crate::convention::{self, Register};
use crate::ir::{AtomicOp, CHECKED_ATOMIC, CHECKED_MEMORY64, HeapTest, Op, REF_TEST_CAST, REF_TEST_NULLABLE, Value};
use crate::regalloc::CONSTANT_INPUT;
use libwasm_module::abi::{
    ExecutionContext, FunctionHeader, InstanceData, MemoryData, OBJECT_DATA_OFFSET, OBJECT_LENGTH_OFFSET,
    RTT_KIND_ARRAY, RTT_KIND_STRUCT, Rtt, TRAP_ARRAY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, TRAP_CAST_FAILURE, TRAP_MEMORY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS,
    TRAP_NULL_REFERENCE, TRAP_UNALIGNED_ATOMIC,
};
use std::mem::offset_of;

/// An operand of a 32-bit comparison: a register, or an immediate.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) enum Operand32 {
    Register(Gpr),
    Immediate(i32),
}

fn field(offset: usize) -> i32 {
    offset as i32
}

/// The width of the instructions for an access of `size` bytes whose value is zero-extended to 32 or 64 bits.
fn access_width(size: u32) -> Width {
    if size == 8 { Width::W64 } else { Width::W32 }
}

impl CodeGenerator<'_> {
    pub(super) fn lower_gc(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let input = |index: usize| gpr(record.inputs[index]);
        match node.op {
            Op::CheckedAddress => self.checked_address(value),
            Op::AtomicRmw => {
                let size = 1u32 << node.flags;
                let (address, operand) = (Address::new(input(0), 0), input(1));
                let old = Gpr(convention::RAX);
                match AtomicOp::from_index(node.args[2]) {
                    op @ (AtomicOp::Add | AtomicOp::Sub) => {
                        self.asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, old, operand);
                        if op == AtomicOp::Sub {
                            self.asm.neg(Width::W64, old);
                        }
                        self.asm.lock_xadd(size, &address, old);
                    }
                    AtomicOp::Exchange => {
                        self.asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, old, operand);
                        self.asm.xchg_mr(size, &address, old);
                    }
                    op => {
                        // A compare-exchange loop, until no other thread changed the location in between.
                        let updated = gpr(record.temps[1]);
                        let alu = match op {
                            AtomicOp::And => AluOp::And,
                            AtomicOp::Or => AluOp::Or,
                            _ => AluOp::Xor,
                        };
                        self.load_zero_extended(size, old, &address);
                        let again = self.asm.new_label();
                        self.asm.bind(again);
                        self.asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, updated, old);
                        self.asm.alu_rr(alu, Width::W64, updated, operand);
                        self.asm.lock_cmpxchg(size, &address, updated);
                        self.asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, again);
                    }
                }
                self.zero_extend(size, old);
            }
            Op::AtomicCompareExchange => {
                let size = 1u32 << node.flags;
                // NB: Only the low `size` bytes of rax are compared, which is the expected value wrapped at the
                //     access width.
                self.asm.lock_cmpxchg(size, &Address::new(input(0), 0), input(2));
                self.zero_extend(size, Gpr(convention::RAX));
            }
            Op::AtomicFence => self.asm.mfence(),
            Op::Rtt => {
                let (instance, output) = (input(0), gpr(record.output));
                self.asm.mov_rm(
                    Width::W64,
                    SCRATCH,
                    &Address::new(instance, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, type_identities))),
                );
                self.asm
                    .mov_rm(Width::W32, SCRATCH, &Address::new(SCRATCH, 4 * node.args[1] as i32));
                self.rtts(output, instance);
                self.asm
                    .mov_rm(Width::W64, output, &Address::indexed(output, SCRATCH, Scale::Eight, 0));
            }
            Op::I31New => {
                // NB: Shifting the 32-bit value left drops its bit 31: ((value & 0x7fffffff) << 1) | 1.
                self.asm.lea(
                    Width::W32,
                    gpr(record.output),
                    &Address::indexed(input(0), input(0), Scale::One, 1),
                );
            }
            Op::I31Get => {
                let output = gpr(record.output);
                self.asm.mov_rr(Width::W32, output, input(0));
                if node.flags != 0 {
                    self.asm.sar_ri(Width::W32, output, 1);
                } else {
                    self.asm.shr_ri(Width::W32, output, 1);
                }
            }
            Op::ElementAddress => {
                let (array, index, output) = (input(0), input(1), gpr(record.output));
                let null = self.trap_label(TRAP_NULL_REFERENCE);
                self.asm.test_rr(Width::W64, array, array);
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::Equal, null);
                // NB: The index is zero-extended, so a 64-bit comparison checks it as an unsigned i32.
                self.asm.alu_rm(
                    AluOp::Cmp,
                    Width::W64,
                    index,
                    &Address::new(array, field(OBJECT_LENGTH_OFFSET)),
                );
                let out_of_bounds = self.trap_label(TRAP_ARRAY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::AboveOrEqual, out_of_bounds);
                self.asm
                    .mov_rm(Width::W64, output, &Address::new(array, field(OBJECT_DATA_OFFSET)));
                // Elements take 1 << flags bytes each. A scale goes up to 8, so a v128 adds the index twice.
                let scale = match node.flags {
                    0 => Scale::One,
                    1 => Scale::Two,
                    2 => Scale::Four,
                    _ => Scale::Eight,
                };
                self.asm
                    .lea(Width::W64, output, &Address::indexed(output, index, scale, 0));
                if node.flags == 4 {
                    self.asm
                        .lea(Width::W64, output, &Address::indexed(output, index, Scale::Eight, 0));
                }
            }
            Op::RefTest => self.ref_test(value),
            _ => unreachable!("{} is no GC or atomic operation", node.op.name()),
        }
    }

    /// `output` = the runtime types of the store, from `instance`.
    fn rtts(&mut self, output: Gpr, instance: Gpr) {
        self.asm.mov_rm(
            Width::W64,
            output,
            &Address::new(instance, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
        );
        self.asm.mov_rm(
            Width::W64,
            output,
            &Address::new(output, field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, rtts))),
        );
    }

    fn load_zero_extended(&mut self, size: u32, dst: Gpr, address: &Address) {
        match size {
            1 => self.asm.movzx8_rm(dst, address),
            2 => self.asm.movzx16_rm(dst, address),
            _ => self.asm.mov_rm(access_width(size), dst, address),
        }
    }

    fn zero_extend(&mut self, size: u32, register: Gpr) {
        match size {
            1 => self.asm.movzx8_rr(register, register),
            2 => self.asm.movzx16_rr(register, register),
            4 => self.asm.mov_rr(Width::W32, register, register),
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    /// The address of a checked access: the memory's base + index + offset, after checking that index + offset +
    /// size is at most the memory's size, and for atomics that index + offset is aligned.
    fn checked_address(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let size = 1u64 << (node.flags & 7);
        let memory64 = node.flags & CHECKED_MEMORY64 != 0;
        let (memory, index, output) = (gpr(record.inputs[0]), gpr(record.inputs[1]), gpr(record.output));
        let out_of_bounds = self.trap_label(TRAP_MEMORY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        // The end of the access, which may wrap around for a memory64; i32 indices are zero-extended already.
        let end = SCRATCH;
        self.asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, end, index);
        if record.inputs[2] == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            let offset = self.immediate(value, 2);
            self.asm.add_ri(Width::W64, end, (offset + size) as i32);
            if memory64 {
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::Below, out_of_bounds);
            }
        } else {
            self.asm.add_rr(Width::W64, end, gpr(record.inputs[2]));
            if memory64 {
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::Below, out_of_bounds);
            }
            self.asm.add_ri(Width::W64, end, size as i32);
            if memory64 {
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::Below, out_of_bounds);
            }
        }
        self.asm.alu_rm(
            AluOp::Cmp,
            Width::W64,
            end,
            &Address::new(memory, field(offset_of!(MemoryData, size))),
        );
        self.asm.jcc(Cond::Above, out_of_bounds);
        if node.flags & CHECKED_ATOMIC != 0 && size > 1 {
            // NB: The end and the address differ by the size, a multiple of the alignment.
            let unaligned = self.trap_label(TRAP_UNALIGNED_ATOMIC);
            self.asm.test_ri(Width::W32, end, size as i32 - 1);
            self.asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, unaligned);
        }
        self.asm.mov_rm(
            Width::W64,
            output,
            &Address::new(memory, field(offset_of!(MemoryData, base))),
        );
        self.asm.lea(
            Width::W64,
            output,
            &Address::indexed(output, end, Scale::One, -(size as i32)),
        );
    }

    /// `cmp dword [address], operand`.
    fn compare32(&mut self, address: &Address, operand: Operand32) {
        match operand {
            Operand32::Register(register) => self.asm.cmp_mr(Width::W32, address, register),
            Operand32::Immediate(immediate) => self.asm.cmp_mi(Width::W32, address, immediate),
        }
    }

    /// Jumps to `failed` unless the type whose Rtt is in `rtt` is the expected type, of `identity` at `depth`, or a
    /// subtype of it: a type's display lists the identities of its supertypes by depth, and its own last. Clobbers
    /// `rtt`.
    pub(super) fn check_subtype(&mut self, rtt: Gpr, depth: Operand32, identity: Operand32, failed: Label) {
        self.compare32(&Address::new(rtt, field(offset_of!(Rtt, depth))), depth);
        self.asm.jcc(Cond::Below, failed);
        self.asm
            .mov_rm(Width::W64, rtt, &Address::new(rtt, field(offset_of!(Rtt, display))));
        let entry = match depth {
            Operand32::Register(depth) => Address::indexed(rtt, depth, Scale::Four, 0),
            Operand32::Immediate(depth) => Address::new(rtt, 4 * depth),
        };
        self.compare32(&entry, identity);
        self.asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, failed);
    }

    /// `RefTest`: whether a reference matches a heap type, as 0 or 1, or for a cast a trap where it does not.
    fn ref_test(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let reference = gpr(record.inputs[0]);
        let identity: Register = record.inputs[1];
        let depth = node.args[2] as i32;
        let cast = node.flags & REF_TEST_CAST != 0;
        let matched = self.asm.new_label();
        let failed = if cast {
            self.trap_label(TRAP_CAST_FAILURE)
        } else {
            self.asm.new_label()
        };
        self.asm.test_rr(Width::W64, reference, reference);
        let null_matches = node.flags & REF_TEST_NULLABLE != 0;
        self.asm.jcc(Cond::Equal, if null_matches { matched } else { failed });
        let identity = if identity == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            Operand32::Immediate(self.immediate(value, 1) as i32)
        } else {
            Operand32::Register(gpr(identity))
        };
        let subtype_check = |generator: &mut Self, rtt: Gpr| {
            generator.check_subtype(rtt, Operand32::Immediate(depth), identity, failed);
        };
        match HeapTest::from_flags(node.flags) {
            HeapTest::NonNull => {}
            HeapTest::Nothing => self.asm.jmp(failed),
            HeapTest::I31 => {
                self.asm.test_ri(Width::W32, reference, 1);
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::Equal, failed);
            }
            HeapTest::Eq => {
                // An i31 (bit 0), or a GC object (bits 1:0 clear) rather than a host value (0b10).
                self.asm.test_ri(Width::W32, reference, 1);
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, matched);
                self.asm.test_ri(Width::W32, reference, 2);
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, failed);
            }
            kind @ (HeapTest::Struct | HeapTest::Array) => {
                let rtt = gpr(record.temps[0]);
                self.asm.test_ri(Width::W32, reference, 3);
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, failed);
                self.asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, rtt, &Address::new(reference, 0));
                let expected = if kind == HeapTest::Struct {
                    RTT_KIND_STRUCT
                } else {
                    RTT_KIND_ARRAY
                };
                self.asm.cmp_mi(
                    Width::W32,
                    &Address::new(rtt, field(offset_of!(Rtt, kind))),
                    expected as i32,
                );
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, failed);
            }
            HeapTest::ConcreteObject => {
                let rtt = gpr(record.temps[0]);
                self.asm.test_ri(Width::W32, reference, 3);
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, failed);
                self.asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, rtt, &Address::new(reference, 0));
                subtype_check(self, rtt);
            }
            HeapTest::ConcreteFunction => {
                let [rtt, rtts] = [gpr(record.temps[0]), gpr(record.temps[1])];
                let type_identity = Address::new(reference, field(offset_of!(FunctionHeader, type_identity)));
                self.compare32(&type_identity, identity);
                self.asm.jcc(Cond::Equal, matched);
                self.asm.mov_rm(Width::W32, rtt, &type_identity);
                self.asm
                    .mov_rm(Width::W64, rtts, &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
                self.rtts(rtts, rtts);
                self.asm
                    .mov_rm(Width::W64, rtt, &Address::indexed(rtts, rtt, Scale::Eight, 0));
                subtype_check(self, rtt);
            }
        }
        self.asm.bind(matched);
        if cast {
            return;
        }
        let output = gpr(record.output);
        let done = self.asm.new_label();
        self.asm.mov_ri32(output, 1);
        self.asm.jmp(done);
        self.asm.bind(failed);
        self.asm.mov_ri32(output, 0);
        self.asm.bind(done);
    }
}

/*

//! Loads and stores of memory 0, globals and instance data.
//!
//! Memory 0 is a memory32 with guard pages: an access is at base + zero-extended index + offset, with no bounds
//! check, and faults in the guard region where it is out of bounds. i32 values are always zero-extended in
//! registers, so the index register serves as is.

use super::{CodeGenerator, SCRATCH, fpr, gpr, precision, width};
use crate::asm::{Address, Scale, Width};
use crate::convention::{self, Register};
use crate::ir::{LoadKind, Op, Type, Value};
use crate::regalloc::CONSTANT_INPUT;

impl CodeGenerator<'_> {
    /// The address of an access of memory 0 with base `base`, index input `index` and offset `offset`.
    fn memory_address(&mut self, value: Value, base: Register, index: Register, offset: u32) -> Address {
        let base = gpr(base);
        if index == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            let constant = self.immediate(value, 1) & 0xffff_ffff;
            return Address::new(base, (constant + u64::from(offset)) as i32);
        }
        if let Ok(offset) = i32::try_from(offset) {
            return Address::indexed(base, gpr(index), Scale::One, offset);
        }
        // NB: Offsets of 2^31 and up do not fit a displacement; the index and offset, both below 2^32, add up
        //     without overflowing 64 bits.
        self.asm.mov_ri(SCRATCH, u64::from(offset));
        self.asm.add_rr(Width::W64, SCRATCH, gpr(index));
        Address::indexed(base, SCRATCH, Scale::One, 0)
    }

    pub(super) fn lower_memory(&mut self, value: Value) {
        let func = self.func;
        let node = *func.node(value);
        let record = *self.allocation.node(value);
        let [a, b, c] = record.inputs;
        let output = record.output;
        match node.op {
            Op::Load => {
                let address = self.memory_address(value, a, b, node.args[2]);
                let dst = output;
                match LoadKind::from_flags(node.flags) {
                    LoadKind::I32 | LoadKind::I64U32 => self.asm.mov_rm(Width::W32, gpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::I64 => self.asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, gpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::F32 => self
                        .asm
                        .vmovs_rm(crate::asm::x86_64::Precision::Single, fpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::F64 => self
                        .asm
                        .vmovs_rm(crate::asm::x86_64::Precision::Double, fpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::I32S8 => self.asm.movsx8_rm(Width::W32, gpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::I64S8 => self.asm.movsx8_rm(Width::W64, gpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::I32U8 | LoadKind::I64U8 => self.asm.movzx8_rm(gpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::I32S16 => self.asm.movsx16_rm(Width::W32, gpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::I64S16 => self.asm.movsx16_rm(Width::W64, gpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::I32U16 | LoadKind::I64U16 => self.asm.movzx16_rm(gpr(dst), &address),
                    LoadKind::I64S32 => self.asm.movsxd_rm(gpr(dst), &address),
                }
            }
            Op::VectorLoad => {
                let address = self.memory_address(value, a, b, node.args[2]);
                self.vector_load(value, &address);
            }
            Op::Store => {
                let address = self.memory_address(value, a, b, node.args[2]);
                let stored = func.inputs(value)[2];
                self.store(stored, c, crate::ir::store_size(node.flags), &address);
            }
            Op::GlobalGet => {
                let address = Address::new(gpr(a), 0);
                if node.ty == Type::V128 {
                    self.load_vector(fpr(output).0, &address);
                } else if node.ty.is_float() {
                    self.asm.vmovs_rm(precision(node.ty), fpr(output), &address);
                } else {
                    self.asm.mov_rm(width(node.ty), gpr(output), &address);
                }
            }
            Op::GlobalSet => {
                let address = Address::new(gpr(a), 0);
                let stored = node.args[1];
                let size = match func.node(stored).ty {
                    Type::V128 => 16,
                    ty if ty.is_64() => 8,
                    _ => 4,
                };
                self.store(stored, b, size, &address);
            }
            Op::FrameLoad => {
                let mut address = Address::new(gpr(a), node.args[1] as i32);
                if node.flags == 1 {
                    self.asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, &address);
                    address = Address::new(SCRATCH, 0);
                }
                if node.ty == Type::V128 {
                    self.load_vector(fpr(output).0, &address);
                } else if node.ty.is_float() {
                    self.asm.vmovs_rm(precision(node.ty), fpr(output), &address);
                } else {
                    self.asm.mov_rm(width(node.ty), gpr(output), &address);
                }
            }
            Op::InstanceField | Op::LoadPointer => {
                let address = Address::new(gpr(a), node.args[1] as i32);
                // NB: A 32-bit load zero-extends, as an i32 must be in its register.
                let load_width = if node.op == Op::LoadPointer && node.flags == 4 {
                    Width::W32
                } else {
                    Width::W64
                };
                self.asm.mov_rm(load_width, gpr(output), &address);
            }
            _ => unreachable!("{} is no memory op", node.op.name()),
        }
    }

    /// Stores `size` bytes of `stored`, which is in `register` or a constant immediate, at `address`.
    fn store(&mut self, stored: Value, register: Register, size: u32, address: &Address) {
        let ty = self.func.node(stored).ty;
        if register == CONSTANT_INPUT {
            let bits = self.func.node(stored).constant().expect("immediates are constants");
            match size {
                1 => self.asm.mov8_mi(address, bits as u8),
                2 => self.asm.mov16_mi(address, bits as u16),
                4 => self.asm.mov_mi(Width::W32, address, bits as u32 as i32),
                _ => self.asm.mov_mi(Width::W64, address, bits as i64 as i32),
            }
            return;
        }
        if size == 16 {
            self.store_vector(register, address);
            return;
        }
        if convention::is_fpr(register) {
            let p = if size == 8 || ty == Type::F64 {
                crate::asm::x86_64::Precision::Double
            } else {
                crate::asm::x86_64::Precision::Single
            };
            self.asm.vmovs_mr(p, address, fpr(register));
            return;
        }
        let register = gpr(register);
        match size {
            1 => self.asm.mov8_mr(address, register),
            2 => self.asm.mov16_mr(address, register),
            4 => self.asm.mov_mr(Width::W32, address, register),
            _ => self.asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, address, register),
        }
    }
}

/*
