//! The register allocation verifier. It simulates what every register holds through each block, from the state the
//! allocator says the block starts with, and checks that every input is where the allocation says, and that every
//! edge's moves turn the state at the end of its source into the state its target starts with (with phis replaced
//! by their inputs). A value's slot is written where it is defined (a phi's where its block starts, or by the moves
//! of its edges), and values that share a slot must have intervals that do not overlap, so that a slot that the
//! block has not written holds the one of its values that is live there.

use super::{Allocation, CONSTANT_INPUT, Location, NO_REGISTER, REGISTER_COUNT, SLOT_INPUT, call_result_types};
use crate::convention::{self, Place};
use crate::ir::{BlockId, Func, NONE, Op, Shape, Value};
use crate::regalloc::liveness::{Liveness, block_start_position, edge_position, node_position, predecessor_index};
use std::collections::HashMap;

struct Simulation<'a> {
    liveness: &'a Liveness,
    registers: [u32; REGISTER_COUNT],
    /// What the block wrote to slots so far.
    slots: HashMap<i32, Value>,
    /// The values of each slot.
    owners: HashMap<i32, Vec<Value>>,
    /// The position the simulation is at.
    position: u32,
    errors: Vec<String>,
}

impl Simulation<'_> {
    fn error(&mut self, message: String) {
        if self.errors.len() < 20 {
            self.errors.push(message);
        }
    }

    /// The value `location` holds, as far as the simulation knows.
    fn read(&self, location: Location) -> Option<Value> {
        match location {
            Location::Register(register) => Some(self.registers[register as usize]).filter(|value| *value != NONE),
            Location::Slot(slot) => self.slots.get(&slot).copied().or_else(|| self.owner_at(slot)),
            Location::Constant(value) => Some(value),
            Location::Outgoing(_) | Location::ResultArea(_) => None,
        }
    }

    /// The value of `slot` that is live at the current position, which a slot that the block did not write holds.
    fn owner_at(&self, slot: i32) -> Option<Value> {
        let owners = self.owners.get(&slot)?;
        if let [owner] = owners.as_slice() {
            return Some(*owner);
        }
        owners.iter().copied().find(|owner| {
            self.liveness.definition[*owner as usize] < self.position
                && self.liveness.end[*owner as usize] >= self.position
        })
    }

    fn apply(&mut self, moves: &[super::Move]) {
        for item in moves {
            let value = self.read(item.from).unwrap_or(NONE);
            match item.to {
                Location::Register(register) => self.registers[register as usize] = value,
                Location::Slot(slot) => {
                    self.slots.insert(slot, value);
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }

    fn check_holds(&mut self, location: Location, value: Value, what: &str) {
        let ok = match location {
            Location::Register(register) => self.registers[register as usize] == value,
            Location::Slot(slot) => self.read(Location::Slot(slot)) == Some(value),
            Location::Constant(constant) => constant == value,
            _ => true,
        };
        if !ok {
            self.error(format!("{what}: v{value} is not in {location:?}"));
        }
    }
}

pub fn verify(func: &Func, allocation: &Allocation) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut liveness = Liveness::default();
    liveness.compute(func);
    let mut simulation = Simulation {
        liveness: &liveness,
        registers: [NONE; REGISTER_COUNT],
        slots: HashMap::new(),
        owners: HashMap::new(),
        position: 0,
        errors: Vec::new(),
    };
    for (value, &slot) in allocation.slots.iter().enumerate() {
        if slot != super::NO_SLOT {
            simulation.owners.entry(slot).or_default().push(value as Value);
        }
    }
    // The values of a slot follow each other: none is defined while another one is live.
    let mut overlaps = Vec::new();
    for (slot, owners) in &mut simulation.owners {
        owners.sort_by_key(|owner| liveness.definition[*owner as usize]);
        for pair in owners.windows(2) {
            if liveness.end[pair[0] as usize] > liveness.definition[pair[1] as usize] {
                overlaps.push(format!(
                    "v{} and v{} share [fp{slot:+}] while both are live",
                    pair[0], pair[1]
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    for overlap in overlaps {
        simulation.error(overlap);
    }
    let mut places = Vec::new();
    for block in 0..func.blocks.len() as BlockId {
        simulation.registers = allocation.block_states[block as usize];
        simulation.slots.clear();
        simulation.position = block_start_position(func, block);
        for phi in func.phis(block) {
            let slot = allocation.slots[phi as usize];
            if slot != super::NO_SLOT {
                simulation.slots.insert(slot, phi);
            }
        }
        let data = func.blocks[block as usize];
        for value in data.start..data.end {
            let node = *func.node(value);
            if node.op.is_entry_value() {
                continue;
            }
            let record = *allocation.node(value);
            simulation.position = node_position(value);
            simulation.apply(allocation.node_moves(value));
            let inputs = func.inputs(value);
            match node.op {
                Op::Helper => {
                    for (index, &input) in inputs.iter().enumerate() {
                        let register = convention::HELPER_REGISTERS[index];
                        simulation.check_holds(Location::Register(register), input, &format!("helper v{value}"));
                    }
                    for register in 0..REGISTER_COUNT {
                        if convention::HOST_CLOBBERS & (1 << register) != 0 {
                            simulation.registers[register] = NONE;
                        }
                    }
                }
                Op::Call | Op::TailCall => {
                    let arguments = &inputs[3..];
                    let types = arguments
                        .iter()
                        .map(|argument| func.node(*argument).ty)
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    convention::parameter_places(&types, &mut places);
                    for (index, &argument) in arguments.iter().enumerate() {
                        if let Place::Register(register) = places[index] {
                            simulation.check_holds(Location::Register(register), argument, &format!("call v{value}"));
                        }
                    }
                    for (input, register) in [
                        (inputs[0], convention::CALLEE_REGISTER),
                        (inputs[1], convention::INSTANCE_REGISTER),
                        (inputs[2], convention::MEMORY_BASE_REGISTER),
                    ] {
                        simulation.check_holds(Location::Register(register), input, &format!("call v{value}"));
                    }
                    simulation.registers = [NONE; REGISTER_COUNT];
                    let _ = call_result_types(func, value);
                }
                Op::Return => {
                    convention::result_places(&func.results, &mut places);
                    for (index, &result) in inputs.iter().enumerate() {
                        if let Place::Register(register) = places[index] {
                            simulation.check_holds(Location::Register(register), result, &format!("return v{value}"));
                        }
                    }
                }
                _ => {
                    let count = match node.op.shape() {
                        Shape::Fixed(count) => count as usize,
                        Shape::Variadic => inputs.len().min(3),
                    };
                    for (index, &input) in inputs.iter().enumerate().take(count) {
                        let register = record.inputs[index];
                        if register == SLOT_INPUT {
                            let slot = allocation.slots[input as usize];
                            simulation.check_holds(Location::Slot(slot), input, &format!("v{value} input {index}"));
                            continue;
                        }
                        if register == CONSTANT_INPUT {
                            if !func.node(input).op.is_constant() {
                                simulation.error(format!("v{value} takes v{input} as an immediate"));
                            }
                            continue;
                        }
                        if func.node(input).op.is_constant() {
                            // Materialized into the register by the moves before the node.
                            continue;
                        }
                        simulation.check_holds(Location::Register(register), input, &format!("v{value} input {index}"));
                    }
                    for temp in record.temps {
                        if temp != NO_REGISTER {
                            simulation.registers[temp as usize] = NONE;
                        }
                    }
                    #[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
                    if matches!(node.op, Op::DivS | Op::DivU | Op::RemS | Op::RemU) {
                        simulation.registers[convention::RAX as usize] = NONE;
                        simulation.registers[convention::RDX as usize] = NONE;
                    }
                }
            }
            if record.output != NO_REGISTER {
                simulation.registers[record.output as usize] = value;
            }
            let slot = allocation.slots[value as usize];
            if slot != super::NO_SLOT {
                simulation.slots.insert(slot, value);
            }
        }
        // The edges.
        simulation.position = edge_position(func, block);
        let end_registers = simulation.registers;
        let end_slots = simulation.slots.clone();
        let successors_start = data.successors_start;
        for (index, &successor) in func.successors(block).iter().enumerate() {
            simulation.registers = end_registers;
            simulation.slots = end_slots.clone();
            simulation.apply(allocation.edge(successors_start + index as u32));
            let predecessor = predecessor_index(func, successor, block);
            let target = allocation.block_states[successor as usize];
            for (register, &value) in target.iter().enumerate() {
                if value == NONE {
                    continue;
                }
                let expected = if func.node(value).op == Op::Phi && func.phis(successor).any(|phi| phi == value) {
                    func.inputs(value)[predecessor]
                } else {
                    value
                };
                let held = simulation.registers[register];
                if held != expected {
                    simulation.error(format!(
                        "edge b{block} -> b{successor}: r{register} holds v{held}, not v{expected}"
                    ));
                }
            }
            for phi in func.phis(successor) {
                if allocation.node(phi).output != NO_REGISTER {
                    continue;
                }
                let input = func.inputs(phi)[predecessor];
                let slot = allocation.slots[phi as usize];
                if simulation.read(Location::Slot(slot)) != Some(input) {
                    simulation.error(format!(
                        "edge b{block} -> b{successor}: the slot of phi v{phi} lacks v{input}"
                    ));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if simulation.errors.is_empty() {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(simulation.errors.join("\n"))
    }
}

/// The allocation as text, for `dump-ir` and failures.
pub fn dump(func: &Func, allocation: &Allocation) -> String {
    use std::fmt::Write;
    let name = |location: &Location| match location {
        Location::Register(register) if convention::is_fpr(*register) => {
            format!("xmm{}", register - convention::FPR_BASE)
        }
        Location::Register(register) => format!("r{register}"),
        Location::Slot(slot) => format!("[fp{slot:+}]"),
        Location::Outgoing(index) => format!("out{index}"),
        Location::ResultArea(index) => format!("result{index}"),
        Location::Constant(value) => format!("#v{value}"),
    };
    let register = |register: u8| match register {
        NO_REGISTER => "-".to_string(),
        CONSTANT_INPUT => "#".to_string(),
        SLOT_INPUT => "[slot]".to_string(),
        _ => name(&Location::Register(register)),
    };
    let moves = |moves: &[super::Move]| {
        moves
            .iter()
            .map(|item| format!("{} -> {}", name(&item.from), name(&item.to)))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(", ")
    };
    let mut out = String::new();
    for block in 0..func.blocks.len() as BlockId {
        writeln!(out, "b{block}:").unwrap();
        for phi in func.phis(block) {
            let record = allocation.node(phi);
            writeln!(
                out,
                "  v{phi} phi -> {} slot {}",
                register(record.output),
                allocation.slots[phi as usize]
            )
            .unwrap();
        }
        let data = func.blocks[block as usize];
        for value in data.start..data.end {
            let node = func.node(value);
            if node.op.is_entry_value() {
                continue;
            }
            let record = allocation.node(value);
            if record.moves_count > 0 {
                writeln!(out, "  moves {}", moves(allocation.node_moves(value))).unwrap();
            }
            let inputs = record.inputs.iter().map(|input| register(*input)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
            write!(out, "  v{value} {} ({})", node.op.name(), inputs.join(", ")).unwrap();
            if record.output != NO_REGISTER {
                write!(out, " -> {}", register(record.output)).unwrap();
            }
            if allocation.slots[value as usize] != super::NO_SLOT {
                write!(out, " spill [fp{:+}]", allocation.slots[value as usize]).unwrap();
            }
            out.push('\n');
        }
        for (index, &successor) in func.successors(block).iter().enumerate() {
            let edge = allocation.edge(data.successors_start + index as u32);
            if !edge.is_empty() {
                writeln!(out, "  edge -> b{successor}: {}", moves(edge)).unwrap();
            }
        }
    }
    writeln!(
        out,
        "slots: {}, outgoing: {}",
        allocation.slot_count, allocation.outgoing_size
    )
    .unwrap();
    out
}

/*

//! The functions of the runtime compiled code calls for bulk memory, table and array operations (`Op::Helper`). They
//! take their operands in the context's `arguments` like the runtime's own helpers, need nothing but the data the
//! operands point at, and return 0, or the TRAP_* code to trap with. Growing, allocating, and waiting on and
//! notifying shared memory locations call the runtime's own helpers.

use crate::RuntimeInfo;
use crate::ir::Helper;
use libjs_runtime_macros::jit_abi;
use libwasm_module::abi::{
    ExecutionContext, MemoryData, OBJECT_DATA_OFFSET, OBJECT_LENGTH_OFFSET, Rtt, STORAGE_32, STORAGE_I8, STORAGE_I16,
    STORAGE_V128, Segment, TRAP_ARRAY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, TRAP_MEMORY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, TRAP_NULL_REFERENCE,
    TRAP_TABLE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, TableData,
};

/// Makes instruction fetches see code just written at `start`, `length` bytes. On AArch64 the data cache lines are
/// cleaned to where instruction fetches see them and the instruction cache lines invalidated; x86-64 keeps its caches
/// coherent.
pub fn flush_instruction_cache(start: usize, length: usize) {
    #[cfg(all(target_arch = "aarch64", target_os = "macos"))]
    {
        unsafe extern "C" {
            fn sys_icache_invalidate(start: *mut core::ffi::c_void, length: usize);
        }
        // SAFETY: The range is code the caller just wrote.
        unsafe { sys_icache_invalidate(start as *mut core::ffi::c_void, length) };
    }
    #[cfg(all(target_arch = "aarch64", not(target_os = "macos")))]
    // SAFETY: Cache maintenance by address changes no data.
    unsafe {
        let cache_type: u64;
        core::arch::asm!("mrs {}, ctr_el0", out(reg) cache_type, options(nomem, nostack));
        let data_line = 4usize << ((cache_type >> 16) & 15);
        let instruction_line = 4usize << (cache_type & 15);
        let end = start + length;
        let mut line = start & !(data_line - 1);
        while line < end {
            core::arch::asm!("dc cvau, {}", in(reg) line, options(nostack));
            line += data_line;
        }
        core::arch::asm!("dsb ish", options(nostack));
        let mut line = start & !(instruction_line - 1);
        while line < end {
            core::arch::asm!("ic ivau, {}", in(reg) line, options(nostack));
            line += instruction_line;
        }
        core::arch::asm!("dsb ish", "isb", options(nostack));
    }
    #[cfg(not(target_arch = "aarch64"))]
    let _ = (start, length);
}

/// A helper, with the calling convention compiled code calls it with.
#[cfg(not(all(target_arch = "x86_64", windows)))]
type HelperFunction = unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut ExecutionContext) -> u64;
#[cfg(all(target_arch = "x86_64", windows))]
type HelperFunction = unsafe extern "sysv64" fn(*mut ExecutionContext) -> u64;

/// The address of the function `helper` calls.
pub fn helper_address(helper: Helper, runtime: &RuntimeInfo) -> u64 {
    let function: HelperFunction = match helper {
        Helper::MemoryGrow => return runtime.memory_grow,
        Helper::TableGrow => return runtime.table_grow,
        Helper::AllocateException => return runtime.allocate_exception,
        Helper::MemoryFill => memory_fill,
        Helper::MemoryCopy => memory_copy,
        Helper::MemoryInit => memory_init,
        Helper::TableFill => table_fill,
        Helper::TableCopy => table_copy,
        Helper::TableInit => table_init,
        Helper::AtomicWait => return runtime.wait,
        Helper::AtomicNotify => return runtime.notify,
        Helper::Allocate => return runtime.allocate,
        Helper::ArrayFill => array_fill,
        Helper::ArrayCopy => array_copy,
        Helper::ArrayInitData => array_init_data,
        Helper::ArrayInitElem => array_init_elem,
        Helper::SegmentRange => segment_range,
    };
    function as usize as u64
}

/// Whether `count` items from `start` are within `size`. The operands of memory64 and table64 operations are
/// 64-bit, so the end can wrap around.
fn in_range(start: u64, count: u64, size: u64) -> bool {
    start.checked_add(count).is_some_and(|end| end <= size)
}

unsafe fn arguments<'a>(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> &'a [u64; 6] {
    unsafe { &(*context).arguments }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn memory_fill(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[memory, destination, value, count, ..] = arguments(context);
        let memory = &*(memory as *const MemoryData);
        if !in_range(destination, count, memory.size()) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_MEMORY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        if count == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        std::ptr::write_bytes(memory.base.add(destination as usize), value as u8, count as usize);
        0
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn memory_copy(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[destination_memory, source_memory, destination, source, count, _] = arguments(context);
        let destination_memory = &*(destination_memory as *const MemoryData);
        let source_memory = &*(source_memory as *const MemoryData);
        if !in_range(destination, count, destination_memory.size()) || !in_range(source, count, source_memory.size()) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_MEMORY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        if count == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        std::ptr::copy(
            source_memory.base.add(source as usize),
            destination_memory.base.add(destination as usize),
            count as usize,
        );
        0
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn memory_init(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[memory, segment, destination, source, count, _] = arguments(context);
        let memory = &*(memory as *const MemoryData);
        let segment = &*(segment as *const Segment);
        if !in_range(source, count, segment.length) || !in_range(destination, count, memory.size()) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_MEMORY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        if count == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        std::ptr::copy(
            segment.contents.add(source as usize),
            memory.base.add(destination as usize),
            count as usize,
        );
        0
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn table_fill(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[table, destination, value, count, ..] = arguments(context);
        let table = &*(table as *const TableData);
        if !in_range(destination, count, table.size) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_TABLE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        for index in destination..destination + count {
            *table.elements.add(index as usize) = value;
        }
        0
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn table_copy(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[destination_table, source_table, destination, source, count, _] = arguments(context);
        let destination_table = &*(destination_table as *const TableData);
        let source_table = &*(source_table as *const TableData);
        if !in_range(destination, count, destination_table.size) || !in_range(source, count, source_table.size) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_TABLE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        if count == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        std::ptr::copy(
            source_table.elements.add(source as usize),
            destination_table.elements.add(destination as usize),
            count as usize,
        );
        0
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn table_init(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[table, segment, destination, source, count, _] = arguments(context);
        let table = &*(table as *const TableData);
        let segment = &*(segment as *const Segment);
        if !in_range(source, count, segment.length) || !in_range(destination, count, table.size) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_TABLE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        if count == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        std::ptr::copy(
            segment.contents.cast::<u64>().add(source as usize),
            table.elements.add(destination as usize),
            count as usize,
        );
        0
    }
}

// GC arrays. An array is a cell with its data's address at OBJECT_DATA_OFFSET, its length at OBJECT_LENGTH_OFFSET, and
// its Rtt first; elements take their natural size (see abi.rs).

/// An array's data, length, and element storage kind.
unsafe fn array_parts(array: u64) -> (*mut u8, u64, u8) {
    unsafe {
        let cell = array as *const u8;
        let data = cell.add(OBJECT_DATA_OFFSET).cast::<*mut u8>().read();
        let length = cell.add(OBJECT_LENGTH_OFFSET).cast::<u64>().read();
        let rtt = cell.cast::<*const Rtt>().read();
        (data, length, *(*rtt).field_kinds)
    }
}

/// The bytes an element of storage `kind` takes, in an array and in a data segment alike.
fn element_size(kind: u8) -> usize {
    match kind {
        STORAGE_I8 => 1,
        STORAGE_I16 => 2,
        STORAGE_32 => 4,
        STORAGE_V128 => 16,
        _ => 8,
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn array_fill(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[array, start, low, high, count, _] = arguments(context);
        if array == 0 {
            return u64::from(TRAP_NULL_REFERENCE);
        }
        let (data, length, kind) = array_parts(array);
        if !in_range(start, count, length) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_ARRAY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        let size = element_size(kind);
        for index in start..start + count {
            let element = data.add(index as usize * size);
            match kind {
                STORAGE_I8 => element.write(low as u8),
                STORAGE_I16 => element.cast::<u16>().write(low as u16),
                STORAGE_32 => element.cast::<u32>().write(low as u32),
                STORAGE_V128 => {
                    element.cast::<u64>().write(low);
                    element.cast::<u64>().add(1).write(high);
                }
                _ => element.cast::<u64>().write(low),
            }
        }
        0
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn array_copy(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[destination, destination_start, source, source_start, count, _] = arguments(context);
        if source == 0 || destination == 0 {
            return u64::from(TRAP_NULL_REFERENCE);
        }
        let (source_data, source_length, _) = array_parts(source);
        let (destination_data, destination_length, kind) = array_parts(destination);
        if !in_range(source_start, count, source_length) || !in_range(destination_start, count, destination_length) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_ARRAY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        if count == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        let size = element_size(kind);
        std::ptr::copy(
            source_data.add(source_start as usize * size),
            destination_data.add(destination_start as usize * size),
            count as usize * size,
        );
        0
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn array_init_data(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[array, segment, destination, source, count, _] = arguments(context);
        if array == 0 {
            return u64::from(TRAP_NULL_REFERENCE);
        }
        let (data, length, kind) = array_parts(array);
        if !in_range(destination, count, length) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_ARRAY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        let segment = &*(segment as *const Segment);
        let size = element_size(kind);
        // NB: The count is below 2^32 and the size at most 16, so their product does not wrap.
        if !in_range(source, count * size as u64, segment.length) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_MEMORY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        // Elements are stored as data segments hold them.
        std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
            segment.contents.add(source as usize),
            data.add(destination as usize * size),
            count as usize * size,
        );
        0
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn array_init_elem(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[array, segment, destination, source, count, _] = arguments(context);
        if array == 0 {
            return u64::from(TRAP_NULL_REFERENCE);
        }
        let (data, length, _) = array_parts(array);
        if !in_range(destination, count, length) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_ARRAY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        let segment = &*(segment as *const Segment);
        if !in_range(source, count, segment.length) {
            return u64::from(TRAP_TABLE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
        }
        if count == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        std::ptr::copy(
            segment.contents.cast::<u64>().add(source as usize),
            data.cast::<u64>().add(destination as usize),
            count as usize,
        );
        0
    }
}

#[jit_abi]
unsafe extern "C" fn segment_range(context: *mut ExecutionContext) -> u64 {
    unsafe {
        let &[segment, start, count, unit, trap, _] = arguments(context);
        let segment = &*(segment as *const Segment);
        // NB: The count is below 2^32 and the unit at most 16, so their product does not wrap.
        if in_range(start, count * unit, segment.length) {
            0
        } else {
            trap
        }
    }
}

//! Code around compiled functions on AArch64, which the runtime makes once per process (see `stubs.rs` for what each
//! stub does). The trap exit takes the TRAP_* code in w0.

use crate::RuntimeInfo;
use crate::asm::aarch64::{Assembler, Cond, Extend, MemOp, MemOperand, PairOperand, Shift, X16, X17, XZR};
use crate::asm::{Fpr, Gpr, Width};
use crate::codegen::aarch64::{fits_offset, fpr};
use crate::convention::{self, Place, Register};
use crate::ir::Type;
use libwasm_module::abi::{ExecutionContext, FRAME_CONTEXT, InstanceData, TRAP_RUNTIME, TRAP_STACK_EXHAUSTED};
use std::mem::offset_of;

const FP: Gpr = Gpr(29);
const LR: Gpr = Gpr(30);
const SP: Gpr = Gpr(31);
const SCRATCH: Gpr = X16;
const SCRATCH_FPR: Fpr = Fpr(31);

fn x(index: u8) -> Gpr {
    Gpr(index)
}

fn field(offset: usize) -> i32 {
    offset as i32
}

/// An operand for an access of `1 << size_log2` bytes at `base` + `offset`, through x17 where the offset does not fit.
fn operand(asm: &mut Assembler, base: Gpr, offset: i32, size_log2: u32) -> MemOperand {
    if fits_offset(i64::from(offset), size_log2) {
        return MemOperand::Offset(base, offset);
    }
    asm.add_any(X17, base, i64::from(offset), X17);
    MemOperand::Offset(X17, 0)
}

/// Loads (if `load`) or stores the value of type `ty` in the register `register` (as the allocator numbers it) at
/// `base` + `offset`.
fn transfer(asm: &mut Assembler, ty: Type, register: Register, base: Gpr, offset: i32, load: bool) {
    if ty == Type::V128 || convention::is_fpr(register) {
        transfer_fpr(asm, ty, fpr(register), base, offset, load);
        return;
    }
    // NB: i32 values are zero-extended in registers.
    let op = match (ty == Type::I32, load) {
        (true, true) => MemOp::LdrW,
        (false, true) => MemOp::LdrX,
        (_, false) => MemOp::StrX,
    };
    let size_log2 = if op == MemOp::LdrW { 2 } else { 3 };
    let operand = operand(asm, base, offset, size_log2);
    asm.load_store(op, register, operand);
}

fn transfer_fpr(asm: &mut Assembler, ty: Type, register: Fpr, base: Gpr, offset: i32, load: bool) {
    let (op, size_log2) = match (ty == Type::V128, load) {
        (true, true) => (MemOp::LdrQ, 4),
        (true, false) => (MemOp::StrQ, 4),
        (false, true) => (MemOp::LdrD, 3),
        (false, false) => (MemOp::StrD, 3),
    };
    let operand = operand(asm, base, offset, size_log2);
    asm.load_store(op, register.0, operand);
}

/// Copies a value of type `ty` between memory locations, through the scratch vector register.
fn copy(asm: &mut Assembler, ty: Type, from: (Gpr, i32), to: (Gpr, i32)) {
    let ty = if ty == Type::V128 { Type::V128 } else { Type::F64 };
    transfer_fpr(asm, ty, SCRATCH_FPR, from.0, from.1, true);
    transfer_fpr(asm, ty, SCRATCH_FPR, to.0, to.1, false);
}

/// Jumps to the trap exit with the code `code`.
fn trap(asm: &mut Assembler, code: u32, runtime: &RuntimeInfo) {
    asm.mov_imm(Width::W32, x(0), u64::from(code));
    asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, runtime.trap_exit);
    asm.br(SCRATCH);
}

/// Pushes a frame record and makes fp the caller's sp, as compiled functions do, then allocates `frame_size` bytes
/// below fp, the header included, and stores the instance in x13 in the header.
fn enter(asm: &mut Assembler, frame_size: i32) {
    asm.stp(FP, LR, PairOperand::PreIndex(SP, -16));
    asm.add_imm(Width::W64, FP, SP, 16, false);
    asm.add_any(SP, SP, -i64::from(frame_size - 16), X17);
    asm.str(
        Width::W64,
        x(convention::INSTANCE_REGISTER),
        MemOperand::Offset(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE),
    );
}

fn leave(asm: &mut Assembler) {
    asm.sub_imm(Width::W64, SP, FP, 16, false);
    asm.ldp(FP, LR, PairOperand::PostIndex(SP, 16));
    asm.ret();
}

/// The host stub for functions with these parameter and result types.
pub fn host_stub(params: &[Type], results: &[Type], runtime: &RuntimeInfo) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut memory = crate::CodeMemory::new();
    let mut asm = Assembler::new(&mut memory.code, &memory.work);
    let parameter_slots = convention::slots(params) as i32;
    let result_slots = convention::slots(results) as i32;
    let buffer_slots = parameter_slots.max(result_slots);
    // Below the frame header: a zero word, which makes the frame the runtime unwinds an exception from look like an
    // entry frame, and the operand stack image at sp.
    let zero = -convention::FRAME_HEADER_SIZE - 8;
    let frame_size = (convention::FRAME_HEADER_SIZE as u32 + 8 + 8 * buffer_slots as u32).next_multiple_of(16) as i32;
    let context = x(9);
    let instance = x(convention::INSTANCE_REGISTER);

    // The stack check comes first, against the frame's bottom, with the header already in place for the trap.
    asm.stp(FP, LR, PairOperand::PreIndex(SP, -16));
    asm.add_imm(Width::W64, FP, SP, 16, false);
    asm.sub_imm(Width::W64, SP, SP, (convention::FRAME_HEADER_SIZE - 16) as u32, false);
    asm.str(Width::W64, instance, MemOperand::Offset(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        context,
        MemOperand::Offset(instance, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
    );
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        SCRATCH,
        MemOperand::Offset(context, field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, stack_limit))),
    );
    asm.add_any(X17, FP, -i64::from(frame_size), X17);
    asm.cmp(Width::W64, X17, SCRATCH);
    let exhausted = asm.new_label();
    asm.b_cond(Cond::Lo, exhausted);
    asm.mov_sp(SP, X17);

    // The operand stack grows down, so the first argument is in the highest slots.
    let top = 8 * (buffer_slots - parameter_slots);
    let mut places = Vec::new();
    convention::parameter_places(params, &mut places);
    for (index, place) in places.iter().enumerate() {
        let home = convention::home_slot(params, index) as i32;
        let slot = parameter_slots - home - params[index].slots() as i32;
        let offset = top + 8 * slot;
        match *place {
            Place::Register(register) => transfer(&mut asm, params[index], register, SP, offset, false),
            Place::Memory(home) => copy(&mut asm, params[index], (FP, 8 * home as i32), (SP, offset)),
        }
    }

    let arguments = field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, arguments));
    asm.str(
        Width::W64,
        x(convention::CALLEE_REGISTER),
        MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments),
    );
    asm.add_any(SCRATCH, SP, i64::from(top), X17);
    asm.str(Width::W64, SCRATCH, MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments + 8));
    asm.str(Width::W64, XZR, MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments + 16));
    asm.str(Width::W64, XZR, MemOperand::Offset(FP, zero));
    asm.sub_imm(
        Width::W64,
        SCRATCH,
        FP,
        (convention::FRAME_INSTANCE - zero) as u32,
        false,
    );
    asm.str(Width::W64, SCRATCH, MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments + 24));
    asm.mov(Width::W64, x(0), context);
    asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, runtime.call_host);
    asm.blr(SCRATCH);

    // 0 is a trap, which the runtime keeps; 1 would resume at a handler, which the zero word rules out.
    let failed = asm.new_label();
    asm.cmp_imm(Width::W64, x(0), 1, false);
    asm.b_cond(Cond::Ls, failed);
    let return_top = x(9);
    asm.mov(Width::W64, return_top, x(0));
    let area = x(10);
    if convention::has_result_area(results) {
        let operand = operand(&mut asm, FP, 8 * parameter_slots, 3);
        asm.ldr(Width::W64, area, operand);
    }
    convention::result_places(results, &mut places);
    for (index, place) in places.iter().enumerate() {
        let home = convention::home_slot(results, index) as i32;
        let slot = result_slots - home - results[index].slots() as i32;
        let offset = 8 * slot;
        match *place {
            Place::Register(register) => transfer(&mut asm, results[index], register, return_top, offset, true),
            Place::Memory(home) => copy(&mut asm, results[index], (return_top, offset), (area, 8 * home as i32)),
        }
    }
    leave(&mut asm);

    for (label, code) in [(failed, TRAP_RUNTIME), (exhausted, TRAP_STACK_EXHAUSTED)] {
        asm.bind(label);
        trap(&mut asm, code, runtime);
    }
    asm.finish().expect("stubs have no unbound labels").to_vec()
}

/// What the entry trampoline calls compiled code with, and what it returns.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct NativeCall {
    /// The code to call: the callee's `native_entry`, or the entry of an OSR compile.
    pub entry: u64,
    pub header: u64,
    pub instance: u64,
    pub memory_base: u64,
    /// The integer argument registers, in `convention::GPR_ARGUMENTS` order.
    pub gprs: [u64; 8],
    /// The vector argument registers, low half first.
    pub xmms: [[u64; 2]; 8],
    /// The home slots of the call, and a result area if it needs one: copied to the outgoing area before the
    /// call, and back after it.
    pub image: u64,
    pub image_slots: u64,
    /// The slot of the result area pointer in the image, or u64::MAX, and the slot the result area starts at
    /// (`convention::result_area_slot()`); the image lays them out as the outgoing area does.
    pub result_pointer_slot: u64,
    pub result_area_slot: u64,
    /// x0 and x1 after the call.
    pub result_gprs: [u64; 2],
    /// v0 and v1 after the call.
    pub result_xmms: [[u64; 2]; 2],
    /// Where the trampoline keeps its stack pointer during the call.
    pub saved_sp: u64,
}

/// The size of the area the runtime adapter saves the argument registers in: the eight integer ones, then the eight
/// vector ones, 16 bytes each. The runtime function stores the results' registers in the same places: x0 and x1, v0
/// and v1.
pub const ADAPTER_SAVE_AREA: usize = 8 * 8 + 8 * 16;

/// The trap exit: stores the code in w0 as the context's first argument, and the context in the frame that trapped
/// (fp), and continues at the interpreter's TrapFromNative handler at `handler`.
pub fn trap_exit(handler: u64) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut memory = crate::CodeMemory::new();
    let mut asm = Assembler::new(&mut memory.code, &memory.work);
    let context = SCRATCH;
    asm.ldr(Width::W64, context, MemOperand::Offset(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        context,
        MemOperand::Offset(context, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
    );
    asm.str(Width::W64, context, MemOperand::Offset(FP, FRAME_CONTEXT as i32));
    asm.mov(Width::W32, x(0), x(0));
    asm.str(
        Width::W64,
        x(0),
        MemOperand::Offset(context, field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, arguments))),
    );
    asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, X17, handler);
    asm.br(X17);
    asm.finish().expect("stubs have no unbound labels").to_vec()
}

/// Continues where the `resume` of the context in `context` says, as the runtime set it after unwinding an
/// exception: loads sp and fp and jumps.
pub fn resume(asm: &mut Assembler, context: Gpr) {
    let resume = field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, resume));
    asm.ldr(Width::W64, X17, MemOperand::Offset(context, resume));
    asm.mov_sp(SP, X17);
    asm.ldr(Width::W64, FP, MemOperand::Offset(context, resume + 8));
    asm.ldr(Width::W64, X17, MemOperand::Offset(context, resume + 16));
    asm.br(X17);
}

/// Copies `count` 8-byte words from `from` up to `to` through `temp`, clobbering all four.
fn copy_words(asm: &mut Assembler, from: Gpr, to: Gpr, count: Gpr, temp: Gpr) {
    let done = asm.new_label();
    let again = asm.new_label();
    asm.cbz(Width::W64, count, done);
    asm.bind(again);
    asm.ldr(Width::W64, temp, MemOperand::PostIndex(from, 8));
    asm.str(Width::W64, temp, MemOperand::PostIndex(to, 8));
    asm.subs_imm(Width::W64, count, count, 1, false);
    asm.b_cond(Cond::Ne, again);
    asm.bind(done);
}

/// The entry trampoline, `extern "C" fn(*mut NativeCall)`, and the offset of the address its call of compiled code
/// returns to, where an exception the compiled code does not handle continues (see `RuntimeInfo::throw`). It keeps
/// the record in x19, which compiled code never uses, and saves nothing else: compiled code uses only the registers
/// the host ABI does not preserve (see `convention`).
pub fn entry_trampoline() -> (Vec<u8>, usize) {
    let mut memory = crate::CodeMemory::new();
    let mut asm = Assembler::new(&mut memory.code, &memory.work);
    let record = Gpr(19);
    let call_field = |offset: usize| field(offset);
    asm.stp(FP, LR, PairOperand::PreIndex(SP, -32));
    asm.mov_sp(FP, SP);
    asm.stp(record, Gpr(20), PairOperand::Offset(SP, 16));
    asm.mov(Width::W64, record, x(0));
    // The image goes at the bottom of the stack, 16-byte aligned.
    let (count, size) = (x(9), x(10));
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        count,
        MemOperand::Offset(record, call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, image_slots))),
    );
    asm.lsl_imm(Width::W64, size, count, 3);
    asm.add_imm(Width::W64, size, size, 15, false);
    asm.and_imm(Width::W64, size, size, !15u64);
    asm.sub_extended(Width::W64, SP, SP, size, Extend::Uxtx, 0);
    asm.mov_sp(x(11), SP);
    asm.str(
        Width::W64,
        x(11),
        MemOperand::Offset(record, call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, saved_sp))),
    );
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        x(12),
        MemOperand::Offset(record, call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, image))),
    );
    copy_words(&mut asm, x(12), x(11), count, x(13));
    // The result area pointer points at the result area on the stack.
    let no_area = asm.new_label();
    let (pointer, area) = (x(10), x(15));
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        pointer,
        MemOperand::Offset(record, call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, result_pointer_slot))),
    );
    asm.cmn_imm(Width::W64, pointer, 1, false);
    asm.b_cond(Cond::Eq, no_area);
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        area,
        MemOperand::Offset(record, call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, result_area_slot))),
    );
    asm.mov_sp(x(11), SP);
    asm.add(Width::W64, x(12), x(11), area, Shift::Lsl, 3);
    asm.add(Width::W64, x(13), x(11), pointer, Shift::Lsl, 3);
    asm.str(Width::W64, x(12), MemOperand::Offset(x(13), 0));
    asm.bind(no_area);
    for index in 0..8u8 {
        let offset = call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, xmms) + 16 * index as usize);
        transfer_fpr(
            &mut asm,
            Type::V128,
            fpr(convention::FPR_ARGUMENTS[index as usize]),
            record,
            offset,
            true,
        );
    }
    for (index, register) in convention::GPR_ARGUMENTS.iter().enumerate() {
        let offset = call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, gprs) + 8 * index);
        asm.ldr(Width::W64, x(*register), MemOperand::Offset(record, offset));
    }
    for (register, offset) in [
        (convention::CALLEE_REGISTER, offset_of!(NativeCall, header)),
        (convention::INSTANCE_REGISTER, offset_of!(NativeCall, instance)),
        (convention::MEMORY_BASE_REGISTER, offset_of!(NativeCall, memory_base)),
    ] {
        asm.ldr(Width::W64, x(register), MemOperand::Offset(record, field(offset)));
    }
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        SCRATCH,
        MemOperand::Offset(record, call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, entry))),
    );
    asm.blr(SCRATCH);
    let return_offset = asm.offset();
    // NB: Tail calls may have moved sp; the record has it.
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        x(11),
        MemOperand::Offset(record, call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, saved_sp))),
    );
    asm.mov_sp(SP, x(11));
    let results = call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, result_gprs));
    asm.str(Width::W64, x(0), MemOperand::Offset(record, results));
    asm.str(Width::W64, x(1), MemOperand::Offset(record, results + 8));
    for index in 0..2u8 {
        let offset = call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, result_xmms) + 16 * index as usize);
        transfer_fpr(
            &mut asm,
            Type::V128,
            fpr(convention::FPR_RESULTS[index as usize]),
            record,
            offset,
            false,
        );
    }
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        x(9),
        MemOperand::Offset(record, call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, image_slots))),
    );
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        x(12),
        MemOperand::Offset(record, call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, image))),
    );
    asm.mov_sp(x(11), SP);
    copy_words(&mut asm, x(11), x(12), x(9), x(13));
    asm.mov_sp(SP, FP);
    asm.ldp(record, Gpr(20), PairOperand::Offset(SP, 16));
    asm.ldp(FP, LR, PairOperand::PostIndex(SP, 32));
    asm.ret();
    (
        asm.finish().expect("stubs have no unbound labels").to_vec(),
        return_offset,
    )
}

/// What the runtime function of the adapter returns when the call threw an exception, which the runtime unwound: the
/// adapter continues where the context's `resume` says.
pub const ADAPTER_RESUME: u64 = u64::MAX;

/// The runtime adapter. `function` is the runtime's `extern "C" fn(*mut ExecutionContext) -> u64`, which it calls
/// with the callee's header, the save area and fp as the context's first three arguments. A nonzero result is a
/// trap code, or `ADAPTER_RESUME`.
pub fn runtime_adapter(function: u64, runtime: &RuntimeInfo) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut memory = crate::CodeMemory::new();
    let mut asm = Assembler::new(&mut memory.code, &memory.work);
    let instance = x(convention::INSTANCE_REGISTER);
    // Below the frame header, the save area at sp.
    let frame_size = (convention::FRAME_HEADER_SIZE as usize + ADAPTER_SAVE_AREA).next_multiple_of(16) as i32;
    enter(&mut asm, frame_size);
    for (index, register) in convention::GPR_ARGUMENTS.iter().enumerate() {
        asm.str(Width::W64, x(*register), MemOperand::Offset(SP, 8 * index as i32));
    }
    let vectors = 8 * convention::GPR_ARGUMENTS.len() as i32;
    for (index, register) in convention::FPR_ARGUMENTS.iter().enumerate() {
        transfer_fpr(
            &mut asm,
            Type::V128,
            fpr(*register),
            SP,
            vectors + 16 * index as i32,
            false,
        );
    }
    let context = SCRATCH;
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        context,
        MemOperand::Offset(instance, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
    );
    let arguments = field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, arguments));
    asm.str(
        Width::W64,
        x(convention::CALLEE_REGISTER),
        MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments),
    );
    asm.mov_sp(X17, SP);
    asm.str(Width::W64, X17, MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments + 8));
    asm.str(Width::W64, FP, MemOperand::Offset(context, arguments + 16));
    asm.mov(Width::W64, x(0), context);
    asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, function);
    asm.blr(SCRATCH);
    let trap = asm.new_label();
    asm.cbnz(Width::W64, x(0), trap);
    for (index, register) in convention::GPR_RESULTS.iter().enumerate() {
        asm.ldr(Width::W64, x(*register), MemOperand::Offset(SP, 8 * index as i32));
    }
    for (index, register) in convention::FPR_RESULTS.iter().enumerate() {
        transfer_fpr(
            &mut asm,
            Type::V128,
            fpr(*register),
            SP,
            vectors + 16 * index as i32,
            true,
        );
    }
    leave(&mut asm);
    asm.bind(trap);
    let unwound = asm.new_label();
    asm.cmn_imm(Width::W64, x(0), 1, false);
    asm.b_cond(Cond::Eq, unwound);
    // NB: The code is in x0 already.
    asm.mov_imm(Width::W64, SCRATCH, runtime.trap_exit);
    asm.br(SCRATCH);
    asm.bind(unwound);
    let context = SCRATCH;
    asm.ldr(Width::W64, context, MemOperand::Offset(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
    asm.ldr(
        Width::W64,
        context,
        MemOperand::Offset(context, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
    );
    resume(&mut asm, context);
    asm.finish().expect("stubs have no unbound labels").to_vec()
}

//! Code around compiled functions, which the runtime makes once per process:
//!
//! - The trap exit, which compiled code jumps to with a TRAP_* code in edi. It leaves the code through the
//!   interpreter's TrapFromNative handler, which returns from the interpreter's innermost entry with the trap.
//! - The entry trampoline, through which the runtime calls compiled code: a function of a `NativeCall`, with the System
//!   V calling convention on every x86-64 target, whose registers and home slot image it loads.
//! - The runtime adapter, the native entry of functions that run in the runtime (interpreted and host functions):
//!   it saves the argument registers and calls a function of the runtime with them, the callee's header and the
//!   frame, which puts the results where they go or returns a trap code.
//!
//! A host stub, of a signature, calls a host function through `wasm_runtime_call_host` directly, for the tests that
//! run compiled code without the runtime.

use crate::RuntimeInfo;
use crate::asm::x86_64::{Assembler, Cond, Precision, VexMap, VexOpcode, VexOperand, VexPrefix};
use crate::asm::{Address, Fpr, Gpr, Width};
use crate::convention::{self, Place, Register};
use crate::ir::Type;
use libwasm_module::abi::{ExecutionContext, FRAME_CONTEXT, InstanceData, TRAP_RUNTIME, TRAP_STACK_EXHAUSTED};
use std::mem::offset_of;

const VMOVUPS_LOAD: VexOpcode = VexOpcode::new(VexPrefix::None, VexMap::Map0F, 0x10);
const VMOVUPS_STORE: VexOpcode = VexOpcode::new(VexPrefix::None, VexMap::Map0F, 0x11);

const FP: Gpr = Gpr(convention::RBP);
const SP: Gpr = Gpr(convention::RSP);
const SCRATCH: Gpr = Gpr(convention::SCRATCH_GPR);
const SCRATCH_FPR: Register = convention::SCRATCH_FPR;

/// Loads (if `load`) or stores the value of type `ty` in `register` at `address`.
fn transfer(asm: &mut Assembler, ty: Type, register: Register, address: Address, load: bool) {
    if ty == Type::V128 {
        let opcode = if load { VMOVUPS_LOAD } else { VMOVUPS_STORE };
        asm.vex(
            opcode,
            register - convention::FPR_BASE,
            0,
            VexOperand::Memory(address),
            None,
        );
    } else if convention::is_fpr(register) {
        let register = Fpr(register - convention::FPR_BASE);
        if load {
            asm.vmovs_rm(Precision::Double, register, &address);
        } else {
            asm.vmovs_mr(Precision::Double, &address, register);
        }
    } else if load {
        // NB: i32 values are zero-extended in registers.
        let width = if ty == Type::I32 { Width::W32 } else { Width::W64 };
        asm.mov_rm(width, Gpr(register), &address);
    } else {
        asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &address, Gpr(register));
    }
}

/// Copies a value of type `ty` between memory locations.
fn copy(asm: &mut Assembler, ty: Type, from: Address, to: Address) {
    let register = if ty == Type::V128 || ty.is_float() {
        SCRATCH_FPR
    } else {
        SCRATCH.0
    };
    let ty = if ty.is_float() { Type::F64 } else { ty };
    transfer(asm, ty, register, from, true);
    transfer(asm, ty, register, to, false);
}

/// The host stub for functions with these parameter and result types.
pub fn host_stub(params: &[Type], results: &[Type], runtime: &RuntimeInfo) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut memory = crate::CodeMemory::new();
    let mut asm = Assembler::for_host(&mut memory.code, &memory.work);
    let parameter_slots = convention::slots(params) as i32;
    let result_slots = convention::slots(results) as i32;
    let buffer_slots = parameter_slots.max(result_slots);
    // Below the frame header: a zero word, which makes the frame the runtime unwinds an exception from look like an
    // entry frame, and the operand stack image at rsp.
    let zero = -convention::FRAME_HEADER_SIZE - 8;
    let frame_size = (convention::FRAME_HEADER_SIZE as u32 + 8 + 8 * buffer_slots as u32).next_multiple_of(16) as i32;
    let context = Gpr(convention::RAX);
    let instance = Gpr(convention::INSTANCE_REGISTER);

    asm.push(FP);
    asm.lea(Width::W64, FP, &Address::new(SP, 16));
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE), instance);
    asm.mov_rm(
        Width::W64,
        context,
        &Address::new(instance, offset_of!(InstanceData, context) as i32),
    );
    asm.lea(Width::W64, SCRATCH, &Address::new(SP, -(frame_size - 16)));
    asm.alu_rm(
        crate::asm::x86_64::AluOp::Cmp,
        Width::W64,
        SCRATCH,
        &Address::new(context, offset_of!(ExecutionContext, stack_limit) as i32),
    );
    let exhausted = asm.new_label();
    asm.jcc(Cond::Below, exhausted);
    asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, SP, SCRATCH);

    // The operand stack grows down, so the first argument is in the highest slots.
    let top = 8 * (buffer_slots - parameter_slots);
    let mut places = Vec::new();
    convention::parameter_places(params, &mut places);
    for (index, place) in places.iter().enumerate() {
        let home = convention::home_slot(params, index) as i32;
        let slot = parameter_slots - home - params[index].slots() as i32;
        let address = Address::new(SP, top + 8 * slot);
        match *place {
            Place::Register(register) => transfer(&mut asm, params[index], register, address, false),
            Place::Memory(home) => copy(&mut asm, params[index], Address::new(FP, 8 * home as i32), address),
        }
    }

    let arguments = offset_of!(ExecutionContext, arguments) as i32;
    asm.mov_mr(
        Width::W64,
        &Address::new(context, arguments),
        Gpr(convention::CALLEE_REGISTER),
    );
    asm.lea(Width::W64, SCRATCH, &Address::new(SP, top));
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(context, arguments + 8), SCRATCH);
    asm.mov_mi(Width::W64, &Address::new(context, arguments + 16), 0);
    asm.mov_mi(Width::W64, &Address::new(FP, zero), 0);
    asm.lea(
        Width::W64,
        SCRATCH,
        &Address::new(FP, zero - convention::FRAME_INSTANCE),
    );
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(context, arguments + 24), SCRATCH);
    asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, Gpr(convention::RDI), context);
    asm.mov_ri(SCRATCH, runtime.call_host);
    asm.call_r(SCRATCH);

    // 0 is a trap, which the runtime keeps; 1 would resume at a handler, which the zero word rules out.
    let failed = asm.new_label();
    asm.cmp_ri(Width::W64, Gpr(convention::RAX), 1);
    asm.jcc(Cond::BelowOrEqual, failed);
    let return_top = Gpr(convention::RAX);
    let area = Gpr(convention::R11);
    if convention::has_result_area(results) {
        asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, area, &Address::new(FP, 8 * parameter_slots));
    }
    convention::result_places(results, &mut places);
    // NB: Backwards, so that rax, which the first integer result goes to, is written last.
    for (index, place) in places.iter().enumerate().rev() {
        let home = convention::home_slot(results, index) as i32;
        let slot = result_slots - home - results[index].slots() as i32;
        let address = Address::new(return_top, 8 * slot);
        match *place {
            Place::Register(register) => transfer(&mut asm, results[index], register, address, true),
            Place::Memory(home) => {
                let to = Address::new(area, 8 * home as i32);
                let register = if results[index] == Type::V128 || results[index].is_float() {
                    SCRATCH_FPR
                } else {
                    convention::RCX
                };
                let ty = if results[index].is_float() {
                    Type::F64
                } else {
                    results[index]
                };
                transfer(&mut asm, ty, register, address, true);
                transfer(&mut asm, ty, register, to, false);
            }
        }
    }
    asm.lea(Width::W64, SP, &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_SAVED_FP));
    asm.pop(FP);
    asm.ret();

    for (label, code) in [(failed, TRAP_RUNTIME), (exhausted, TRAP_STACK_EXHAUSTED)] {
        asm.bind(label);
        asm.mov_ri32(Gpr(convention::RDI), code);
        asm.mov_ri(SCRATCH, runtime.trap_exit);
        asm.jmp_r(SCRATCH);
    }
    asm.finish().expect("stubs have no unbound labels").to_vec()
}

/// What the entry trampoline calls compiled code with, and what it returns.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct NativeCall {
    /// The code to call: the callee's `native_entry`, or the entry of an OSR compile.
    pub entry: u64,
    pub header: u64,
    pub instance: u64,
    pub memory_base: u64,
    /// The integer argument registers, in `convention::GPR_ARGUMENTS` order.
    pub gprs: [u64; 6],
    /// The vector argument registers, low half first.
    pub xmms: [[u64; 2]; 8],
    /// The home slots of the call, and a result area if it needs one: copied to the outgoing area before the
    /// call, and back after it.
    pub image: u64,
    pub image_slots: u64,
    /// The slot of the result area pointer in the image, or u64::MAX, and the slot the result area starts at
    /// (`convention::result_area_slot()`); the image lays them out as the outgoing area does.
    pub result_pointer_slot: u64,
    pub result_area_slot: u64,
    /// rax and rdx after the call.
    pub result_gprs: [u64; 2],
    /// xmm0 and xmm1 after the call.
    pub result_xmms: [[u64; 2]; 2],
    /// Where the trampoline keeps its stack pointer during the call.
    pub saved_sp: u64,
}

/// The size of the area the runtime adapter saves the argument registers in: the six integer ones, then the eight
/// vector ones, 16 bytes each. The runtime function stores the results' registers in the same places: rax and rdx
/// where rdi and rsi were, xmm0 and xmm1 where they were.
pub const ADAPTER_SAVE_AREA: usize = 6 * 8 + 8 * 16;

fn gpr(register: Register) -> Gpr {
    Gpr(register)
}

fn field(offset: usize) -> i32 {
    offset as i32
}

/// The trap exit: stores the code in edi as the context's first argument, and the context in the frame that
/// trapped, and continues at the interpreter's TrapFromNative handler at `handler`.
pub fn trap_exit(handler: u64) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut memory = crate::CodeMemory::new();
    let mut asm = Assembler::for_host(&mut memory.code, &memory.work);
    let context = gpr(convention::RAX);
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, context, &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
    asm.mov_rm(
        Width::W64,
        context,
        &Address::new(context, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
    );
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(FP, FRAME_CONTEXT as i32), context);
    asm.mov_mr(
        Width::W64,
        &Address::new(context, field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, arguments))),
        gpr(convention::RDI),
    );
    asm.mov_ri(SCRATCH, handler);
    asm.jmp_r(SCRATCH);
    asm.finish().expect("stubs have no unbound labels").to_vec()
}

/// Continues where the `resume` of the context in `context` says, as the runtime set it after unwinding an
/// exception: loads rsp and rbp and jumps.
pub fn resume(asm: &mut Assembler, context: Gpr) {
    let resume = field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, resume));
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, SP, &Address::new(context, resume));
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, FP, &Address::new(context, resume + 8));
    asm.jmp_m(&Address::new(context, resume + 16));
}

/// Copies `count` 8-byte words from `from` up to `to` through `temp`, clobbering all four.
fn copy_words(asm: &mut Assembler, from: Gpr, to: Gpr, count: Gpr, temp: Gpr) {
    let done = asm.new_label();
    let again = asm.new_label();
    asm.test_rr(Width::W64, count, count);
    asm.jcc(Cond::Equal, done);
    asm.bind(again);
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, temp, &Address::new(from, 0));
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(to, 0), temp);
    asm.add_ri(Width::W64, from, 8);
    asm.add_ri(Width::W64, to, 8);
    asm.sub_ri(Width::W64, count, 1);
    asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, again);
    asm.bind(done);
}

/// The entry trampoline, a System V `fn(*mut NativeCall)`, and the offset of the address its call of compiled code
/// returns to, where an exception the compiled code does not handle continues (see `RuntimeInfo::throw`).
pub fn entry_trampoline() -> (Vec<u8>, usize) {
    let mut memory = crate::CodeMemory::new();
    let mut asm = Assembler::for_host(&mut memory.code, &memory.work);
    let record = gpr(convention::R11);
    let (rax, rcx, rdx, rsi, rdi) = (
        gpr(convention::RAX),
        gpr(convention::RCX),
        gpr(convention::RDX),
        gpr(convention::RSI),
        gpr(convention::RDI),
    );
    let call_field = |offset: usize| Address::new(record, field(offset));
    let saved_registers = [
        convention::RBX,
        convention::R12,
        convention::R13,
        convention::R14,
        convention::R15,
    ];
    // NB: The frame is set up like that of compiled code, so that a stack walk that starts in compiled code before its
    //     frame is set up, and takes this frame for its frame, stays on track.
    asm.push(FP);
    asm.lea(Width::W64, FP, &Address::new(SP, 16));
    for register in saved_registers {
        asm.push(gpr(register));
    }
    let lowest_saved_register = convention::FRAME_SAVED_FP - 8 * saved_registers.len() as i32;
    let record_slot = lowest_saved_register - 8;
    // NB: Six pushes after the return address leave rsp 16-byte aligned. The record is the sixth.
    asm.push(rdi);
    asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, record, rdi);
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, rcx, &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, image_slots)));
    asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, rax, rcx);
    asm.shl_ri(Width::W64, rax, 3);
    asm.add_ri(Width::W64, rax, 15);
    asm.and_ri(Width::W64, rax, -16);
    if crate::asm::x86_64::PROBES_STACK {
        // NB: The image's pages are touched before anything goes in them (see `Assembler::probe_stack()`).
        let (top, bottom) = (rdx, rsi);
        asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, top, SP);
        asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, bottom, SP);
        asm.sub_rr(Width::W64, bottom, rax);
        asm.probe_stack(top, bottom, None);
        asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, SP, bottom);
    } else {
        asm.sub_rr(Width::W64, SP, rax);
    }
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, saved_sp)), SP);
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, rsi, &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, image)));
    asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, rdi, SP);
    copy_words(&mut asm, rsi, rdi, rcx, rdx);
    // The result area pointer points at the result area on the stack.
    let no_area = asm.new_label();
    asm.mov_rm(
        Width::W64,
        rax,
        &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, result_pointer_slot)),
    );
    asm.cmp_ri(Width::W64, rax, -1);
    asm.jcc(Cond::Equal, no_area);
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, rcx, &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, result_area_slot)));
    asm.lea(Width::W64, rsi, &Address::indexed(SP, rcx, crate::asm::Scale::Eight, 0));
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::indexed(SP, rax, crate::asm::Scale::Eight, 0), rsi);
    asm.bind(no_area);
    for index in 0..8u8 {
        let address = Address::new(record, field(offset_of!(NativeCall, xmms) + 16 * index as usize));
        asm.vex(VMOVUPS_LOAD, index, 0, VexOperand::Memory(address), None);
    }
    for (index, register) in convention::GPR_ARGUMENTS.iter().enumerate() {
        let address = Address::new(record, field(offset_of!(NativeCall, gprs) + 8 * index));
        asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, gpr(*register), &address);
    }
    for (register, offset) in [
        (convention::CALLEE_REGISTER, offset_of!(NativeCall, header)),
        (convention::INSTANCE_REGISTER, offset_of!(NativeCall, instance)),
        (convention::MEMORY_BASE_REGISTER, offset_of!(NativeCall, memory_base)),
    ] {
        asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, gpr(register), &Address::new(record, field(offset)));
    }
    asm.call_m(&call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, entry)));
    let return_offset = asm.offset();
    // NB: Tail calls may have moved rsp; the record has it.
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, record, &Address::new(FP, record_slot));
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, SP, &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, saved_sp)));
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, result_gprs)), rax);
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, result_gprs) + 8), rdx);
    for index in 0..2u8 {
        let address = Address::new(record, field(offset_of!(NativeCall, result_xmms) + 16 * index as usize));
        asm.vex(VMOVUPS_STORE, index, 0, VexOperand::Memory(address), None);
    }
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, rcx, &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, image_slots)));
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, rdi, &call_field(offset_of!(NativeCall, image)));
    asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, rsi, SP);
    copy_words(&mut asm, rsi, rdi, rcx, rdx);
    asm.lea(Width::W64, SP, &Address::new(FP, lowest_saved_register));
    for register in saved_registers.into_iter().rev() {
        asm.pop(gpr(register));
    }
    asm.pop(FP);
    asm.ret();
    (
        asm.finish().expect("stubs have no unbound labels").to_vec(),
        return_offset,
    )
}

/// What the runtime function of the adapter returns when the call threw an exception, which the runtime unwound: the
/// adapter continues where the context's `resume` says.
pub const ADAPTER_RESUME: u64 = u64::MAX;

/// The runtime adapter. `function` is the runtime's System V `fn(*mut ExecutionContext) -> u64`, which it calls with
/// the callee's header, the save area and fp as the context's first three arguments. A nonzero result is a trap code,
/// or `ADAPTER_RESUME`.
pub fn runtime_adapter(function: u64, runtime: &RuntimeInfo) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut memory = crate::CodeMemory::new();
    let mut asm = Assembler::for_host(&mut memory.code, &memory.work);
    let instance = gpr(convention::INSTANCE_REGISTER);
    // Below the frame header, the save area at rsp.
    let frame_size = (convention::FRAME_HEADER_SIZE as usize + ADAPTER_SAVE_AREA).next_multiple_of(16) as i32;
    asm.push(FP);
    asm.lea(Width::W64, FP, &Address::new(SP, 16));
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE), instance);
    asm.sub_ri(Width::W64, SP, frame_size - 16);
    for (index, register) in convention::GPR_ARGUMENTS.iter().enumerate() {
        asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(SP, 8 * index as i32), gpr(*register));
    }
    for index in 0..8u8 {
        let address = Address::new(SP, 48 + 16 * i32::from(index));
        asm.vex(VMOVUPS_STORE, index, 0, VexOperand::Memory(address), None);
    }
    let context = gpr(convention::RAX);
    asm.mov_rm(
        Width::W64,
        context,
        &Address::new(instance, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
    );
    let arguments = field(offset_of!(ExecutionContext, arguments));
    asm.mov_mr(
        Width::W64,
        &Address::new(context, arguments),
        gpr(convention::CALLEE_REGISTER),
    );
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(context, arguments + 8), SP);
    asm.mov_mr(Width::W64, &Address::new(context, arguments + 16), FP);
    asm.mov_rr(Width::W64, gpr(convention::RDI), context);
    asm.mov_ri(SCRATCH, function);
    asm.call_r(SCRATCH);
    let trap = asm.new_label();
    asm.test_rr(Width::W64, gpr(convention::RAX), gpr(convention::RAX));
    asm.jcc(Cond::NotEqual, trap);
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, gpr(convention::RAX), &Address::new(SP, 0));
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, gpr(convention::RDX), &Address::new(SP, 8));
    for index in 0..2u8 {
        let address = Address::new(SP, 48 + 16 * i32::from(index));
        asm.vex(VMOVUPS_LOAD, index, 0, VexOperand::Memory(address), None);
    }
    asm.lea(Width::W64, SP, &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_SAVED_FP));
    asm.pop(FP);
    asm.ret();
    asm.bind(trap);
    let unwound = asm.new_label();
    asm.cmp_ri(Width::W64, gpr(convention::RAX), -1);
    asm.jcc(Cond::Equal, unwound);
    asm.mov_rr(Width::W32, gpr(convention::RDI), gpr(convention::RAX));
    asm.mov_ri(SCRATCH, runtime.trap_exit);
    asm.jmp_r(SCRATCH);
    asm.bind(unwound);
    let context = gpr(convention::RAX);
    asm.mov_rm(Width::W64, context, &Address::new(FP, convention::FRAME_INSTANCE));
    asm.mov_rm(
        Width::W64,
        context,
        &Address::new(context, field(offset_of!(InstanceData, context))),
    );
    resume(&mut asm, context);
    asm.finish().expect("stubs have no unbound labels").to_vec()
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWasm/JIT/src/table.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! A hash table for the compiler's per-compile maps, which emptying makes no work.
//!
//! OPTIMIZATION: Every compile starts with empty maps, and most functions are small, while a few are huge. A
//! general hash map's `clear()` touches its whole capacity, so after one huge function every small one would pay
//! for it. Here every slot carries the number of the compile that wrote it, and a slot of an older compile is empty:
//! emptying the table is one increment. Keys are never removed; callers that need removal store a value that means
//! none. Open addressing with linear probing, at most half full.

/// A key: hashes to 64 bits without a hasher object.
pub trait TableKey: Copy + Eq + Default {
    fn hash(&self) -> u64;
}

impl TableKey for u64 {
    #[inline]
    fn hash(&self) -> u64 {
        self.wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15)
    }
}

impl TableKey for [u32; 4] {
    #[inline]
    fn hash(&self) -> u64 {
        let low = u64::from(self[0]) | (u64::from(self[1]) << 32);
        let high = u64::from(self[2]) | (u64::from(self[3]) << 32);
        (low.wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15) ^ high).wrapping_mul(0xc2b2_ae3d_27d4_eb4f)
    }
}

impl TableKey for [u32; 6] {
    #[inline]
    fn hash(&self) -> u64 {
        let words = [
            u64::from(self[0]) | (u64::from(self[1]) << 32),
            u64::from(self[2]) | (u64::from(self[3]) << 32),
            u64::from(self[4]) | (u64::from(self[5]) << 32),
        ];
        let mut hash = 0u64;
        for word in words {
            hash = (hash.rotate_left(26) ^ word).wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15);
        }
        hash
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
struct Slot<K: TableKey> {
    key: K,
    value: u32,
    stamp: u32,
}

pub struct Table<K: TableKey> {
    slots: Vec<Slot<K>>,
    stamp: u32,
    len: usize,
    shift: u32,
}

impl<K: TableKey> Default for Table<K> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            slots: Vec::new(),
            stamp: 1,
            len: 0,
            shift: 64,
        }
    }
}

const MINIMUM_CAPACITY: usize = 64;

impl<K: TableKey> Table<K> {
    /// Empties the table.
    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.len = 0;
        self.stamp = self.stamp.wrapping_add(1);
        if self.stamp == 0 {
            // NB: Once in 2^32 compiles, the stamps start over, and the old ones must not look current.
            for slot in &mut self.slots {
                slot.stamp = 0;
            }
            self.stamp = 1;
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    fn index(&self, key: &K) -> usize {
        (key.hash() >> self.shift) as usize
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn get(&self, key: K) -> Option<u32> {
        if self.slots.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let mask = self.slots.len() - 1;
        let mut index = self.index(&key);
        loop {
            let slot = &self.slots[index];
            if slot.stamp != self.stamp {
                return None;
            }
            if slot.key == key {
                return Some(slot.value);
            }
            index = (index + 1) & mask;
        }
    }

    /// Sets the value of `key`, and returns its previous one.
    #[inline]
    pub fn insert(&mut self, key: K, value: u32) -> Option<u32> {
        if (self.len + 1) * 2 > self.slots.len() {
            self.grow();
        }
        let mask = self.slots.len() - 1;
        let mut index = self.index(&key);
        loop {
            let stamp = self.stamp;
            let slot = &mut self.slots[index];
            if slot.stamp != stamp {
                *slot = Slot { key, value, stamp };
                self.len += 1;
                return None;
            }
            if slot.key == key {
                let previous = slot.value;
                slot.value = value;
                return Some(previous);
            }
            index = (index + 1) & mask;
        }
    }

    fn grow(&mut self) {
        let capacity = (self.slots.len() * 2).max(MINIMUM_CAPACITY);
        let old = std::mem::replace(&mut self.slots, vec![Slot::default(); capacity]);
        let old_stamp = self.stamp;
        self.shift = 64 - capacity.trailing_zeros();
        self.stamp = 1;
        self.len = 0;
        for slot in old {
            if slot.stamp == old_stamp {
                self.insert(slot.key, slot.value);
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn inserts_finds_and_empties() {
        let mut table = Table::<u64>::default();
        for key in 0..1000u64 {
            assert_eq!(table.insert(key * 7, key as u32), None);
        }
        for key in 0..1000u64 {
            assert_eq!(table.get(key * 7), Some(key as u32));
        }
        assert_eq!(table.insert(14, 99), Some(2));
        assert_eq!(table.get(15), None);
        table.clear();
        assert_eq!(table.get(14), None);
        assert_eq!(table.insert(14, 5), None);
        assert_eq!(table.get(14), Some(5));
    }
}

//! `memory.atomic.wait` in compiled code traps in an agent that cannot block. A process of its own, since the JIT's
//! options are the process's.

#![cfg(any(target_arch = "x86_64", all(target_arch = "aarch64", not(windows))))]

use libwasm_engine::runtime::{ExternValue, Store, Trap, Value};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[test]
fn wait_traps_compiled_in_an_agent_that_cannot_block() {
    // SAFETY: Nothing else runs yet.
    unsafe { std::env::set_var("LIBWASM_JIT", "forced") };
    let path = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../Engine/tests/fixtures/shared_waits.wasm");
    let module = Arc::new(libwasm_engine::compile(&std::fs::read(path).unwrap()).unwrap());
    for can_block in [true, false] {
        let mut store = Store::new();
        store.can_block = can_block;
        let instance = store.instantiate(module.clone(), &[]).unwrap();
        let Some(ExternValue::Function(wait)) = store.instance(instance).export("wait") else {
            panic!("no wait export");
        };
        // The location holds 0, so a wait for 1 returns at once where the agent can block.
        let result = store.invoke(wait, &[Value::I32(0), Value::I32(1), Value::I64(0)]);
        if can_block {
            assert_eq!(result, Ok(vec![Value::I32(1)]));
        } else {
            assert!(matches!(result, Err(Trap::Host(_))), "{result:?}");
        }
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWasm/JIT/tests/decode.rs
/*

//! The decoder reads every body of the spec testsuite's valid modules to its end, with balanced nesting.

use libwasm_jit::decode::{Decoder, nesting_change};
use std::path::PathBuf;

/// The spec testsuite's modules, if the build directory has them.
pub fn spec_modules() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let root = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../..");
    let directory = std::env::var_os("LIBWASM_SPEC_MODULES")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| root.join("Build/release/Libraries/LibWasm/Tests/Fixtures/SpecTests"));
    directory.is_dir().then_some(directory)
}

#[test]
fn decoded_lengths_match_every_spec_body() {
    let Some(directory) = spec_modules() else {
        eprintln!("no spec testsuite modules; skipped");
        return;
    };
    let mut bodies = 0;
    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(directory).unwrap() {
        let path = entry.unwrap().path();
        if path.extension().is_none_or(|extension| extension != "wasm") {
            continue;
        }
        let Ok(module) = libwasm_engine::compile(&std::fs::read(&path).unwrap()) else {
            continue;
        };
        for body in &module.code {
            let mut decoder = Decoder::new(&module.bytes, body.code.start as usize, body.code.end as usize);
            let mut depth = 1;
            while depth > 0 {
                assert!(!decoder.is_at_end(), "{}: the body ends early", path.display());
                depth += nesting_change(&decoder.decode());
            }
            assert_eq!(decoder.position(), body.code.end as usize, "{}", path.display());
            bodies += 1;
        }
    }
    assert!(bodies > 1000, "only {bodies} bodies");
}
