// One of the lists of animations an element holds, which a loop over it reads entry by entry as it goes, so the loop
// may change the list.
class ElementAnimationList {
public:
    ElementAnimationList(RustFFI::ElementAnimations const* animations, RustFFI::ElementAnimationListKind kind, RustFFI::AnimationOwnerSlot slot)
        : m_animations(animations)
        , m_kind(kind)
        , m_slot(slot)
    {
    }

    size_t size() const { return m_animations ? RustFFI::animations_element_animations_count(m_animations, m_kind, m_slot) : 0; }
    bool is_empty() const { return size() == 0; }
    AnimationRef at(size_t index) const { return AnimationRef { *RustFFI::animations_element_animations_get(m_animations, m_kind, m_slot, index) }; }

    struct End { };
    class Iterator {
    public:
        Iterator(ElementAnimationList const& list)
            : m_list(list)
        {
        }
        AnimationRef operator*() const { return m_list.at(m_index); }
        Iterator& operator++()
        {
            ++m_index;
            return *this;
        }
        bool operator!=(End) const { return m_index < m_list.size(); }

    private:
        ElementAnimationList const& m_list;
        size_t m_index { 0 };
    };
    Iterator begin() const { return Iterator { *this }; }
    End end() const { return {}; }

private:
    RustFFI::ElementAnimations const* m_animations;
    RustFFI::ElementAnimationListKind m_kind;
    RustFFI::AnimationOwnerSlot m_slot;
};

// https://drafts.csswg.org/web-animations-1/#animatable
class WEB_API Animatable {
public:
    virtual ~Animatable();

    ElementAnimationList associated_animations_in_composite_order();
    ElementAnimationList associated_animations_unordered() const;
    void invalidate_associated_animation_composite_order();
    bool has_associated_animations() const;
    // The element's lists of its animations, where it holds any.
    RustFFI::ElementAnimations const* element_animations_if_created() const { return m_animations; }
    // The element's lists of its animations, created where it holds none yet, which also follow what the element
    // published of the effects that target it to the style engine.
    RustFFI::ElementAnimations& ensure_animations();
    // Forgets what the element published to the style engine of the effects that target it, as its identity there
    // changes.
    void forget_published_effect_descriptions();
    // The bytes of the element's lists of its animations and transitions, with the records of the animations associated
    // with it and of their effects, and of the keyframe sets those run that `first_counted` answers are counted first.
    size_t animation_record_memory_size(bool (*first_counted)(void*, RustFFI::KeyframeSet const*), void* context) const;

    void associate_with_animation(AnimationRef const&);
    // Disassociates the animation from the element, which `effect`, the animation's associated effect, targeted.
    void disassociate_with_animation(AnimationRef const&, Optional<EffectRef> const& effect);
    void on_document_changed(DOM::Document& old_document, DOM::Document& new_document);
    void cancel_css_animations_and_transitions();
    // Cancels the CSS animations and transitions one of the element's pseudo-elements owns.
    void cancel_css_animations_and_transitions_of(CSS::PseudoElement);
    // Plays or pauses the CSS animations the element and its pseudo-elements own as their animation-play-state last
    // computed.
    void play_or_pause_css_animations_as_their_play_state_asks();

    // The list of the element, or of one of its known pseudo-elements, of the CSS animations and transitions it owns.
    static Optional<RustFFI::AnimationOwnerSlot> owner_slot(Optional<CSS::PseudoElement>);

    bool has_css_animations_or_transitions() const;
    bool has_css_defined_animations(Optional<CSS::PseudoElement>) const;

    // Whether the installed style gives any longhand a matching transition-property entry, answered without listing them.
    bool has_matching_transition_property_entry(Optional<CSS::PseudoElement>) const;
    bool has_existing_transitions(Optional<CSS::PseudoElement>) const;

protected:
    void visit_edges(JS::Cell::Visitor&);
    // Lets go of the animations as the GC finalizes the element, so that an animation that only the lists held is no
    // longer alive to the host before anything else runs.
    void finalize_animations();

private:
    // The lists, created as the element first holds an animation, which the element owns.
    RustFFI::ElementAnimations* m_animations { nullptr };
};

    undefined pause();

AnimationUpdateContext::ElementData::ElementData() = default;

AnimationUpdateContext::ElementData::ElementData(CSS::InstalledStyle style_before_update, RefPtr<CSS::ComputedStyleWorkingSet> target_style)
    : style_before_update(move(style_before_update))
    , target_style(move(target_style))
{
}

AnimationUpdateContext::ElementData& AnimationUpdateContext::ElementData::operator=(ElementData&&) = default;

void AnimationUpdateContext::ElementData::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    for (auto const& effect : effects)
        effect.visit_edges(visitor);
}

void AnimationUpdateContext::add_effect(DOM::AbstractElement abstract_element, EffectRef const& effect)
{
    auto& style_computer = abstract_element.element().document().style_computer();
    auto& element_data = elements.ensure(abstract_element, [&abstract_element, &style_computer] {
        auto const& style = abstract_element.installed_style();
        if (!style)
            return ElementData {};
        auto computed_properties = style_computer.reconstruct_computed_properties_for_animation(style);
        return ElementData { style, move(computed_properties) };
    });

    if (!element_data.target_style)
        return;
    element_data.effects.append(effect);
}

AnimationUpdateContext::AnimationUpdateContext() = default;

void web_animation_effect_set_keyframe_set(RustFFI::AnimationEffectCell const*, RustFFI::KeyframeSet const*);
DOM::Element* web_animation_element_of_wrapper(JSObject*);
JSObject* web_animation_wrap_element(void* realm, DOM::Element*);
DOM::Document* web_animation_document_of_wrapper(JSObject* document_wrapper);
}

void EffectRef::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor) const
{
    if (auto* effect = static_cast<GC::Cell*>(RustFFI::animations_effect_object_cell(&record()))) {
        visitor.visit(effect);
        return;
    }
    visitor.visit(target());
}

void web_animation_effect_visit_host_cells(RustFFI::AnimationEffectCell const* record, void* visitor)
{
    auto& cell_visitor = *static_cast<GC::Cell::Visitor*>(visitor);
    EffectRef effect { *record };
    if (auto animation = effect.associated_animation(); animation.has_value())
        animation->visit_edges(cell_visitor);
    cell_visitor.visit(effect.target());
}

// Sets the target element, and where `update`, notes what the keyframes read of it and invalidates the style the effect
// produces.
void web_animation_effect_set_target(RustFFI::AnimationEffectCell const* record, DOM::Element* target, bool update)
{
    EffectRef effect { *record };
    // NB: The record associates the associated animation with the new target rather than the old.
    RustFFI::animations_effect_set_target_element(record, target, web_animation_perform_host_effect);
    if (!update)
        return;

    if (target)
        CSS::record_attr_names_read_by_keyframes(*target, effect.keyframe_set());
    effect.invalidate();
    // FIXME: We don't remove the animated style from the old target element as part of normal animated style update and
    //        it will remain "stuck" until its style is fully invalidated for some other reason.
}

// Sets the keyframes the effect runs, invalidating the style it produces where they change.
void web_animation_effect_set_keyframe_set(RustFFI::AnimationEffectCell const* record, RustFFI::KeyframeSet const* keyframe_set_pointer)
{
    EffectRef effect { *record };
    auto keyframe_set = KeyframeSetHandle::adopt(keyframe_set_pointer);
    if (effect.keyframe_set() == keyframe_set)
        return;

    RustFFI::animations_effect_set_keyframe_set(record, keyframe_set.ptr());
    if (auto* target = effect.target())
        CSS::record_attr_names_read_by_keyframes(*target, effect.keyframe_set());
    effect.invalidate();
}

DOM::Element* web_animation_element_of_wrapper(JSObject* wrapper)
{
    return Bindings::impl_from<DOM::Element>(JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(wrapper));
}

static JSObject* wrap_in_realm(void* realm, GC::Ref<Bindings::Wrappable> object)
{
    auto& js_realm = *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm);
    auto wrapper = Bindings::wrap(Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(js_realm), js_realm, object);
    return JS::HostABI::object_to_abi(wrapper.ptr());
}

JSObject* web_animation_wrap_element(void* realm, DOM::Element* element)
{
    return wrap_in_realm(realm, *element);
}

DOM::Document* web_animation_document_of_wrapper(JSObject* document_wrapper)
{
    return Bindings::impl_from<DOM::Document>(JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(document_wrapper));
}

AnimationUpdateContext::~AnimationUpdateContext()
{
    publish();
}

void AnimationUpdateContext::publish()
{
    // Each element's effects, sampled over the style it holds.
    struct Sample {
        DOM::AbstractElement element;
        ElementData const& data;
        Vector<EffectRef> effects;

        void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
        {
            element.visit_edges(visitor);
            for (auto const& effect : effects)
                effect.visit_edges(visitor);
        }
    };
    GC::RootVector<Sample> samples;
    for (auto& it : elements) {
        if (!it.value.target_style)
            continue;
        auto& element = it.key;
        GC::Ref<DOM::Element> target = element.element();
        // Disconnected elements no longer have a style-engine row to publish refreshed
        // animation style into.
        if (target->style_node_id() == 0)
            continue;
        // NB: The engine assigns no record to a pseudo-element that is not rendered, so the style a read of it holds
        //     has no record for its animations to compose over, and it reads as it computes to without them.
        if (auto pseudo_element = element.pseudo_element(); pseudo_element.has_value() && !CSS::is_element_reference_pseudo_element(*pseudo_element)) {
            auto& document = target->document();
            Layout::ForcedReadScope read_scope { document };
            Layout::BegunRead const& read = read_scope;
            if (!CSS::StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_assigns_pseudo_element_record(document.style_computer().style_engine().host(), &read, target->style_node_id().value(), CSS::pseudo_element_to_ffi(pseudo_element)))
                continue;
        }
        // Provisionally started transitions are not associated with the element yet, so they are
        // never among the collected effects, but their values are already part of the published
        // style. Collect them first, in composite order below every associated effect, or this
        // update would rebuild the style without them.
        Vector<EffectRef> effects_to_collect;
        RustFFI::FfiOwningElement owner {
            .element = target.ptr(),
            .pseudo_element = element.pseudo_element().has_value() ? to_underlying(*element.pseudo_element()) : u8 { 0 },
            .has_pseudo_element = element.pseudo_element().has_value(),
        };
        for (size_t index = 0;; ++index) {
            auto const* effect = RustFFI::animations_document_animations_proposed_transition_effect(&target->document().document_animations(), owner, index);
            if (!effect)
                break;
            effects_to_collect.append(EffectRef { *effect });
        }
        for (auto const& animation : target->associated_animations_in_composite_order()) {
            auto effect = animation.effect();
            if (!effect.has_value() || animation.play_state() == RustFFI::AnimationPlayState::Idle)
                continue;
            if (effect->target() != target.ptr() || effect->pseudo_element_type() != element.pseudo_element())
                continue;
            effects_to_collect.append(*effect);
        }
        // A dirty effect may have just become irrelevant. Include it once so rebuilding the
        // animated overlay removes its terminal contribution.
        for (auto& dirty_effect : it.value.effects) {
            if (!effects_to_collect.contains_slow(dirty_effect))
                effects_to_collect.append(dirty_effect);
        }
        samples.append({ element, it.value, move(effects_to_collect) });
    }

    // An element whose overlay the update publishes, and whether the record it installed may become its transition
    // baseline.
    struct Publication {
        Sample& sample;
        bool may_record_baseline { false };
    };
    Vector<Publication> publications;
    GC::RootVector<CSS::StyleComputer::SampledAnimationOverlay> overlays;
    Vector<CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiAnimationOverlayPublication> published;

    // The render owner samples every element of a document in one call, and publishes what it sampled in another,
    // before any of their styles is installed.
    for (size_t first = 0; first < samples.size();) {
        auto& document = samples[first].element.document();
        auto& style_computer = document.style_computer();
        Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document };
        GC::RootVector<CSS::StyleComputer::AnimationRefreshRequest> requests;
        size_t end = first;
        for (; end < samples.size() && &samples[end].element.document() == &document; ++end) {
            auto& sample = samples[end];
            if (sample.element.installed_style() != sample.data.style_before_update)
                continue;
            // NB: An element left with no effects, as where its style just removed its last animation, has nothing to
            //     sample, and what it animated of its custom properties ends here.
            if (sample.effects.is_empty())
                style_computer.stop_publishing_animated_custom_properties(sample.element);
            else
                requests.append({ sample.element, sample.effects.span(), *sample.data.target_style });
        }
        // A timeline script observed ahead of its current time in this task is sampled at that time, as an update of the
        // effects needing it is, or the style installed here and the one that update sampled would keep disagreeing about
        // an effect that ended between the two times.
        auto refresh = [&] { style_computer.refresh_animations_into_each(read, requests); };
        using Refresh = decltype(refresh);
        RustFFI::animations_document_animations_at_times_observed_ahead(&document.document_animations(), &refresh, [](void* context) { (*static_cast<Refresh*>(context))(); });

        publications.clear_with_capacity();
        overlays.clear_with_capacity();
        for (auto& sample : samples.span().slice(first, end - first)) {
            auto const& style = *sample.data.target_style;
            if (sample.element.installed_style() != sample.data.style_before_update
                || !sample.element.installed_style().animation_overlay_changed(style.animated_overlay()))
                continue;
            bool const may_record_baseline = style.animated_overlay() && !CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::rust_animated_overlay_is_empty(style.animated_overlay())
                && document.is_in_style_stabilization_epoch();
            publications.append({ sample, may_record_baseline });
            overlays.append({ sample.element, style });
        }
        published.resize(overlays.size());
        style_computer.publish_sampled_animation_overlays(read, overlays, published);
        // NB: Each publication hands over a reference to the style it published, which a later one can retire.
        Vector<CSS::InstalledStyle> published_styles;
        published_styles.ensure_capacity(published.size());
        for (auto const& publication : published)
            published_styles.unchecked_append(CSS::InstalledStyle::adopt(publication.record));
        first = end;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < publications.size(); ++i) {
            auto const& [sample, may_record_baseline] = publications[i];
            auto const& animated_property_invalidation = published[i].invalidation;
            auto& element = sample.element;
            auto const& data = sample.data;
            GC::Ref<DOM::Element> target = element.element();
            // An earlier entry already republished this style with the current animation values.
            bool const republished = element.installed_style() != data.style_before_update;
            if (!republished && may_record_baseline && (document.style_stabilization_has_style_reactions() || animated_property_invalidation.requires_base_style_recomputation))
                style_computer.record_transition_stabilization_baseline(element, data.style_before_update);
            if (republished)
                continue;
            auto invalidation = CSS::decode_style_invalidation(animated_property_invalidation.invalidation);
            target->refresh_computed_style(read, element.pseudo_element(), move(published_styles[i]));
            if (auto* svg_element = as_if<SVG::SVGElement>(*target); svg_element && !element.pseudo_element().has_value())
                svg_element->note_svg_paint_resource_description_may_have_changed();

            // Box-type, overflow, and text-alignment adjustments consume the unadjusted base values,
            // which an animation-only overlay update deliberately does not reconstruct. Publish an
            // exact feedback action so the ordinary reaction path re-cascades that base before the
            // frame becomes observable.
            if (animated_property_invalidation.requires_base_style_recomputation && !data.base_is_current)
                target->document().style_computer().style_engine().record_derived_element_style_input_change(target->style_node_id(), CSS::StyleEngine::PublishedStyle | CSS::StyleEngine::RecomputeStyle);

            // NB: Publishing the composition had the style engine restyle the element's pseudo-elements and the
            //     children that compute from what the composition moved, in its next pass.

            // NB: refresh_computed_style() already publishes the new record to the layout node, unless the node shows a
            //     style the arena derived from the old one. Only that, inherited values and image resources require
            //     the additional C++ style side effects.
            auto apply_layout_node_style_side_effects = [&](Layout::NodeWithStyle& layout_node, CSS::StyleRecordID style_record) {
                if (animated_property_invalidation.requires_layout_node_style_application || layout_node.has_layout_derived_style())
                    layout_node.apply_style(style_record);
                else if (animated_property_invalidation.requires_style_resource_update)
                    layout_node.attach_style_resources();
            };
            if (!element.pseudo_element().has_value()) {
                if (auto* layout_node = target->unsafe_layout_node(read))
                    apply_layout_node_style_side_effects(*layout_node, target->style_record_identity());
            } else if (auto pseudo_element_node = target->pseudo_element_unsafe_layout_node(read, element.pseudo_element().value())) {
                apply_layout_node_style_side_effects(*pseudo_element_node, target->style_record_identity(element.pseudo_element()));
            }

            if (invalidation.needs_relayout())
                target->set_needs_layout_update(DOM::SetNeedsLayoutReason::KeyframeEffect);
            if (invalidation.needs_layout_tree_rebuild()) {
                auto rebuild_root = element.pseudo_element().has_value()
                    ? CSS::LayoutTreeRebuildRoot::Parent
                    : invalidation.layout_tree_rebuild_root();
                target->set_needs_layout_tree_rebuild(read, DOM::SetNeedsLayoutTreeUpdateReason::KeyframeEffect, rebuild_root);
            }
            if (invalidation.accumulated_visual_contexts() != CSS::AccumulatedVisualContextInvalidation::None) {
                auto scope = invalidation.accumulated_visual_contexts() == CSS::AccumulatedVisualContextInvalidation::Rebuild
                    ? DOM::Document::AccumulatedVisualContextUpdateScope::Structure
                    : DOM::Document::AccumulatedVisualContextUpdateScope::Values;
                // NB: Element-reference pseudo elements (e.g. ::placeholder) are not synthetic, so schedule their
                //     layout node directly instead of going through the owning element.
                if (element.pseudo_element().has_value()) {
                    if (auto pseudo_element_node = target->pseudo_element_unsafe_layout_node(read, element.pseudo_element().value()))
                        element.document().schedule_accumulated_visual_context_update(*pseudo_element_node, scope);
                } else {
                    element.document().schedule_accumulated_visual_context_update(read, target, scope);
                }
            }

            auto* repaint_layout_node = element.pseudo_element().has_value()
                ? target->pseudo_element_unsafe_layout_node(read, *element.pseudo_element())
                : target->unsafe_layout_node(read);
            if (repaint_layout_node && Painting::has_committed_box(*repaint_layout_node))
                Painting::repaint_after_style_change(*repaint_layout_node, invalidation);
        }
    }
    elements.clear();
}

}

namespace Web::Animations {

// This object lives for the duration of an animation update, and is used to store per-element data about animated CSS properties.
struct AnimationUpdateContext {
    struct ElementData {
        ElementData();
        ElementData(CSS::InstalledStyle, RefPtr<CSS::ComputedStyleWorkingSet>);
        ElementData(ElementData&&);
        ElementData& operator=(ElementData&&);
        ~ElementData();

        // NB: The effects keep their AnimationEffects alive while the update holds them.
        void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor&);

        CSS::InstalledStyle style_before_update;
        RefPtr<CSS::ComputedStyleWorkingSet> target_style;
        Vector<EffectRef> effects;
        // Whether the record the update samples over was computed by this style update, so that the base
        // adjustments the sampled values feed into were made over the values the element holds now.
        bool base_is_current { false };
    };

    AnimationUpdateContext();
    // Publishes what is left unpublished.
    ~AnimationUpdateContext();

    // Samples each element's effects over the style it holds and publishes what they compose, which the destructor
    // otherwise does.
    void publish();

    // Notes that the update samples `effect` over the style `abstract_element` holds.
    void add_effect(DOM::AbstractElement, EffectRef const& effect);

    // NOTE: This is lazily populated by KeyframeEffects as their respective animations are applied to an element.
    GC::RootHashMap<DOM::AbstractElement, ElementData> elements;
};

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/BinarySearch.h>
#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>
#include <LibWeb/Animations/RustFFI.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/PropertyID.h>

namespace Web::Animations {

// https://www.w3.org/TR/web-animations-1/#target-property
// The properties the keyframes of a set animate, borrowed from the set for as long as what lent it holds it.
class TargetProperties {
public:
    TargetProperties() = default;
    explicit TargetProperties(RustFFI::FfiKeyframeSetFacts const& facts)
        : m_properties(facts.target_properties, facts.target_property_count)
    {
    }

    bool contains(CSS::PropertyID property_id) const
    {
        return binary_search(m_properties, static_cast<u16>(property_id)) != nullptr;
    }

private:
    ReadonlySpan<u16> m_properties;
};

// A borrowed view of an immutable keyframe set, valid for as long as what lent it holds the set.
class KeyframeSetView {
public:
    KeyframeSetView() = default;
    explicit KeyframeSetView(RustFFI::KeyframeSet const* set)
        : m_set(set)
    {
    }

    RustFFI::KeyframeSet const* ptr() const { return m_set; }
    explicit operator bool() const { return m_set; }
    bool operator==(KeyframeSetView const& other) const { return m_set == other.m_set; }

    RustFFI::FfiKeyframeSetFacts facts() const { return RustFFI::animations_keyframe_set_facts(m_set); }
    TargetProperties target_properties() const { return m_set ? TargetProperties { facts() } : TargetProperties {}; }

protected:
    RustFFI::KeyframeSet const* m_set { nullptr };
};

// A reference to an immutable keyframe set, which Rust owns and shares between everything that runs it.
class KeyframeSetHandle : public KeyframeSetView {
public:
    KeyframeSetHandle() = default;

    // Takes over the one reference a keyframe set builder handed out.
    static KeyframeSetHandle adopt(RustFFI::KeyframeSet const* set)
    {
        KeyframeSetHandle handle;
        handle.m_set = set;
        return handle;
    }

    // Takes a reference of its own to a set something else holds one to.
    static KeyframeSetHandle retained(RustFFI::KeyframeSet const* set)
    {
        if (set)
            RustFFI::animations_keyframe_set_retain(set);
        return adopt(set);
    }

    KeyframeSetHandle(KeyframeSetHandle const& other)
        : KeyframeSetHandle(retained(other.m_set))
    {
    }

    KeyframeSetHandle(KeyframeSetHandle&& other)
        : KeyframeSetView(exchange(other.m_set, nullptr))
    {
    }

    KeyframeSetHandle& operator=(KeyframeSetHandle const& other)
    {
        if (this != &other)
            *this = retained(other.m_set);
        return *this;
    }

    KeyframeSetHandle& operator=(KeyframeSetHandle&& other)
    {
        if (this != &other) {
            release();
            m_set = exchange(other.m_set, nullptr);
        }
        return *this;
    }

    ~KeyframeSetHandle() { release(); }

private:
    void release()
    {
        if (auto const* set = exchange(m_set, nullptr))
            RustFFI::animations_keyframe_set_release(set);
    }
};

}

#include <LibGC/Heap.h>
#include <LibWeb/Animations/NamedTimelines.h>

namespace Web::Animations {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(NamedTimelines);

GC::Ref<NamedTimelines> NamedTimelines::create(DOM::Document& document)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<NamedTimelines>(document);
}

NamedTimelines::NamedTimelines(DOM::Document& document)
    : m_document(document)
{
}

void NamedTimelines::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_document);
    for (auto& declaring_element : m_declaring_elements)
        visitor.visit(declaring_element.element);
    visitor.visit(m_declaring_element_indices);
    for (auto& [key, timeline] : m_timelines)
        visitor.visit(key.element);
}

NamedTimelines::Declaration const* NamedTimelines::DeclaringElement::declaration_named(Utf16FlyString const& name) const
{
    // NB: Of the declarations that share a name, the last one is the one the element defines.
    for (size_t i = declarations.size(); i-- > 0;) {
        if (declarations[i].name == name)
            return &declarations[i];
    }
    return nullptr;
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scoping-1/#flat-tree
// NB: Visits |node| and its flat tree descendants in flat tree order: a shadow host's shadow tree takes the place of
//     its children, and a slot's assigned nodes take the place of its children when it has any.
template<typename Callback>
static void for_each_flat_tree_inclusive_descendant(DOM::Node& node, Callback const& callback)
{
    callback(node);
    auto visit_children_of = [&](DOM::Node& parent) {
        for (auto* child = parent.first_child(); child; child = child->next_sibling())
            for_each_flat_tree_inclusive_descendant(*child, callback);
    };
    if (auto* element = as_if<DOM::Element>(node); element && element->shadow_root()) {
        visit_children_of(*element->shadow_root());
        return;
    }
    if (auto* slot = as_if<HTML::HTMLSlotElement>(node); slot && !slot->assigned_nodes_internal().is_empty()) {
        for (auto const& slottable : slot->assigned_nodes_internal())
            slottable.visit([&](auto const& assigned) { for_each_flat_tree_inclusive_descendant(static_cast<DOM::Node&>(*assigned), callback); });
        return;
    }
    visit_children_of(node);
}

void NamedTimelines::refresh_declarations()
{
    // NB: An element that comes to declare timelines changes its style, which moves the declarations generation. A change
    //     to the tree can only take declarations away, which matters where any were collected.
    auto dom_tree_version = m_document->dom_tree_version();
    auto declarations_generation = m_document->timeline_declarations_generation();
    bool const tree_changed = m_collected_dom_tree_version != dom_tree_version && !m_declaring_elements.is_empty();
    if (m_collected_declarations_generation.has_value() && m_collected_declarations_generation == declarations_generation && !tree_changed)
        return;
    m_collected_dom_tree_version = dom_tree_version;
    m_collected_declarations_generation = declarations_generation;
    m_tracked_animations_need_update = true;

    m_declaring_elements.clear();
    m_declaring_element_indices.clear();

    // NB: The declarations are collected in flat tree order, which the lookup of the last defined timeline uses.
    for_each_flat_tree_inclusive_descendant(*m_document, [&](DOM::Node& node) {
        auto* element = as_if<DOM::Element>(node);
        if (!element)
            return;
        auto const* values_pointer = element->style_group<CSS::ComputedValues::AnimationValues>();
        if (!values_pointer || !CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::rust_animation_values_declare_timelines(values_pointer))
            return;
        auto const& values = *values_pointer;

        DeclaringElement declaring_element { .element = *element, .declarations = {}, .scopes_all_names = false, .scoped_names = {} };
        CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::rust_animation_values_timeline_declarations(&values, &declaring_element, [](void* context, CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::FfiTimelineDeclaration const* declaration) {
            // NB: The style engine hands over a reference to a calculated inset, which may be null.
            auto retain = [](void const* value) {
                return value ? CSS::RustStyleValueHandle::retained(static_cast<CSS::StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData const*>(value)) : CSS::RustStyleValueHandle {};
            };
            auto const& inset = declaration->view_inset;
            static_cast<DeclaringElement*>(context)->declarations.append({
                .name = CSS::css_string_from_rust(declaration->name),
                .is_view = declaration->is_view,
                .axis = declaration->axis,
                .view_inset_start = { inset.start_is_auto, inset.start_px, inset.start_percentage, retain(inset.start_calculated) },
                .view_inset_end = { inset.end_is_auto, inset.end_px, inset.end_percentage, retain(inset.end_calculated) },
            });
        });
        auto scope = CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::rust_animation_values_timeline_scope(&values, &declaring_element, [](void* context, CSS::StyleValueFFI::CssString const* name) {
            static_cast<DeclaringElement*>(context)->scoped_names.append(CSS::css_string_from_rust(name));
        });
        declaring_element.scopes_all_names = scope == CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::FfiTimelineScope::All;

        m_declaring_element_indices.set(*element, m_declaring_elements.size());
        m_declaring_elements.append(move(declaring_element));
    });

    // NB: A timeline whose element no longer declares it is dropped. The animations that follow it look their
    //     timeline up again.
    m_timelines.remove_all_matching([&](TimelineKey const& key, auto const&) {
        auto const* declaring_element = this->declaring_element(*key.element);
        return !declaring_element || !declaring_element->declaration_named(key.name);
    });
}

NamedTimelines::DeclaringElement const* NamedTimelines::declaring_element(DOM::Element const& element) const
{
    auto index = m_declaring_element_indices.get(element);
    if (!index.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    return &m_declaring_elements[*index];
}

TimelineView NamedTimelines::timeline_for(DOM::Element& element, Declaration const& declaration)
{
    auto edge = [](ViewTimelineInsetEdge const& edge) -> RustFFI::FfiViewTimelineInsetEdge {
        return { .is_auto = edge.is_auto, .px = edge.px, .percentage = edge.percentage, .calculated = edge.calculated.data() };
    };
    RustFFI::FfiViewTimelineInset inset { .start = edge(declaration.view_inset_start), .end = edge(declaration.view_inset_end) };

    TimelineKey key { element, declaration.name };
    if (auto existing = m_timelines.get(key); existing.has_value() && existing->is_view_timeline() == declaration.is_view) {
        // An element may only define one timeline per name, which keeps its identity while its axis and inset change.
        // NB: The animations the timeline updates as they change stay alive through it, which can run script.
        GC::RootVector<AnimationRef> updated_animations;
        RustFFI::FfiTimelineAnimationsHost host { .context = &updated_animations, .keep_alive = keep_animation_alive_in, .perform = web_animation_perform_host_effect };
        RustFFI::animations_scroll_timeline_set_axis_and_inset(&existing->record(), declaration.axis, declaration.is_view ? &inset : nullptr, &host);
        return *existing;
    }

    RustFFI::FfiTimelineDescription description {
        .kind = declaration.is_view ? RustFFI::FfiTimelineKind::View : RustFFI::FfiTimelineKind::Scroll,
        .origin_time = 0,
        .source = declaration.is_view
            ? RustFFI::FfiScrollTimelineSource { .element = nullptr, .is_anonymous = true, .scroller = to_underlying(CSS::Scroller::Nearest), .target = &element, .pseudo_element = 0, .has_pseudo_element = false }
            : RustFFI::FfiScrollTimelineSource { .element = &element, .is_anonymous = false, .scroller = 0, .target = nullptr, .pseudo_element = 0, .has_pseudo_element = false },
        .axis = declaration.axis,
        .inset = inset,
    };
    TimelineView timeline { *RustFFI::animations_document_create_timeline(m_document.ptr(), &description) };
    m_timelines.set(key, timeline);
    return timeline;
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/scroll-animations-1/#target-timeline
Optional<TimelineView> NamedTimelines::target_timeline(DOM::AbstractElement const& element, Utf16FlyString const& name)
{
    refresh_declarations();

    // Whether |descendant| is a flat tree descendant of |ancestor| that a timeline name it defines is in scope for:
    // no element between them limits the scope of |name| to its own descendants.
    // INTEROP: The spec looks at all flat tree descendants, but like Chrome, a timeline inside an element that scopes
    //          its name, including the element itself, is only found by lookups within that element.
    auto is_in_scope_of = [&](DOM::Element const& descendant, DOM::Element const& ancestor) {
        for (auto const* element = &descendant; element; element = element->flat_tree_parent_element()) {
            if (element == &ancestor)
                return element != &descendant;
            if (auto const* declaring_element = this->declaring_element(*element); declaring_element && declaring_element->scopes(name))
                return false;
        }
        return false;
    };

    // The target timeline for a given element element referencing a timeline name name is:
    for (Optional<DOM::AbstractElement> current = element; current.has_value();) {
        auto& current_element = current->element();
        auto const* declaring_element = current->pseudo_element().has_value() ? nullptr : this->declaring_element(current_element);

        // If element defines a timeline matching name,
        if (declaring_element) {
            if (auto const* declaration = declaring_element->declaration_named(name)) {
                // That timeline.
                return timeline_for(current_element, *declaration);
            }
        }

        // Otherwise, if name is scoped by element, or if element is the document element,
        if ((declaring_element && declaring_element->scopes(name)) || (!current->pseudo_element().has_value() && &current_element == m_document->document_element())) {
            // The last defined timeline matching name among element's flat tree descendants in flat tree order, or,
            // if no such timeline exists, an inactive timeline.
            for (size_t i = m_declaring_elements.size(); i-- > 0;) {
                auto const& candidate = m_declaring_elements[i];
                auto const* declaration = candidate.declaration_named(name);
                if (declaration && is_in_scope_of(candidate.element, current_element))
                    return timeline_for(candidate.element, *declaration);
            }
            return {};
        }

        // Otherwise, the target timeline for element's flat tree parent referencing name.
        auto* parent = current->flat_tree_parent_element();
        if (!parent)
            break;
        current = DOM::AbstractElement { *parent };
    }
    return {};
}

namespace {

// What looking up the named timelines of the CSS animations of the document again asks of the host.
struct NamedTimelinesHostContext {
    GC::Ref<NamedTimelines> named_timelines;
    // NB: The animations stay alive while their timelines are looked up, which can run script.
    GC::RootVector<AnimationRef> animations;
};

RustFFI::TimelineCell const* target_timeline_of_owner(void* context, RustFFI::FfiOwningElement owner, size_t name)
{
    DOM::AbstractElement target { *static_cast<DOM::Element*>(owner.element), owner.has_pseudo_element ? static_cast<CSS::PseudoElement>(owner.pseudo_element) : Optional<CSS::PseudoElement> {} };
    auto timeline = static_cast<NamedTimelinesHostContext*>(context)->named_timelines->target_timeline(target, Utf16FlyString::from_raw(name));
    return timeline.has_value() ? &timeline->record() : nullptr;
}

void keep_alive(void* context, RustFFI::AnimationCell const* animation)
{
    keep_animation_alive_in(&static_cast<NamedTimelinesHostContext*>(context)->animations, animation);
}

}

bool NamedTimelines::update_tracked_animations()
{
    refresh_declarations();
    if (!m_tracked_animations_need_update)
        return false;
    m_tracked_animations_need_update = false;
    NamedTimelinesHostContext context { *this, {} };
    RustFFI::FfiNamedTimelinesHost host {
        .context = &context,
        .target_timeline = target_timeline_of_owner,
        .keep_alive = keep_alive,
        .in_execution_context = in_execution_context_of_animation,
        .perform = web_animation_perform_host_effect,
    };
    return m_document->update_named_timelines_of_animations(host);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Utf16FlyString.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibGC/Cell.h>
#include <LibGC/CellAllocator.h>
#include <LibGC/Ptr.h>

namespace Web::Animations {

// The scroll progress timelines and view progress timelines that elements of a document declare by name with the
// 'scroll-timeline' and 'view-timeline' properties, and the animations that look them up by name.
// https://drafts.csswg.org/scroll-animations-1/#timeline-scoping
class NamedTimelines final : public GC::Cell {
    GC_CELL(NamedTimelines, GC::Cell);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(NamedTimelines);

public:
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<NamedTimelines> create(DOM::Document&);

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/scroll-animations-1/#target-timeline
    Optional<TimelineView> target_timeline(DOM::AbstractElement const&, Utf16FlyString const& name);

    // Looks the timelines of the tracked animations up again, where the declarations of the document have changed.
    // Returns whether any animation changed its timeline.
    bool update_tracked_animations();

private:
    explicit NamedTimelines(DOM::Document&);

    virtual void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor&) override;

    // One side of the view progress visibility range: auto takes the scroll container's scroll padding, otherwise a
    // length plus a percentage of the scrollport.
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/scroll-animations-1/#view-timeline-inset
    struct ViewTimelineInsetEdge {
        bool is_auto { true };
        double px { 0 };
        double percentage { 0 };
        // NB: An inset only a calculation can describe, such as min(50%, 10px), resolves against the scrollport size.
        CSS::RustStyleValueHandle calculated {};
    };
    struct Declaration {
        Utf16FlyString name;
        bool is_view { false };
        // NB: The host's ScrollAxis, which numbers the axes as CSS::Axis does.
        u8 axis { 0 };
        ViewTimelineInsetEdge view_inset_start;
        ViewTimelineInsetEdge view_inset_end;
    };
    struct DeclaringElement {
        GC::Ref<DOM::Element> element;
        Vector<Declaration> declarations;
        bool scopes_all_names { false };
        Vector<Utf16FlyString> scoped_names;

        Declaration const* declaration_named(Utf16FlyString const&) const;
        bool scopes(Utf16FlyString const& name) const { return scopes_all_names || scoped_names.contains_slow(name); }
    };

    // Collects the declarations of the document again, when its tree or the timeline declarations of its elements
    // have changed since they were last collected.
    void refresh_declarations();

    DeclaringElement const* declaring_element(DOM::Element const&) const;
    TimelineView timeline_for(DOM::Element&, Declaration const&);

    GC::Ref<DOM::Document> m_document;

    // The elements that declare timelines or scope timeline names, in tree order.
    Vector<DeclaringElement> m_declaring_elements;
    HashMap<GC::Ref<DOM::Element const>, size_t> m_declaring_element_indices;
    Optional<u64> m_collected_dom_tree_version;
    Optional<u64> m_collected_declarations_generation;

    struct TimelineKey {
        GC::Ref<DOM::Element> element;
        Utf16FlyString name;

        bool operator==(TimelineKey const&) const = default;
    };
    struct TimelineKeyTraits : public DefaultTraits<TimelineKey> {
        static unsigned hash(TimelineKey const& key) { return pair_int_hash(ptr_hash(key.element.ptr()), key.name.hash()); }
    };
    // NB: The document keeps the timelines alive.
    HashMap<TimelineKey, TimelineView, TimelineKeyTraits> m_timelines;

    // NB: The document holds the tracked animations, as its animations following named timelines.
    bool m_tracked_animations_need_update { false };
};

}

void visit_host_cell(void* visitor, void* cell, RustFFI::HostCellKind kind)
{
    auto& cell_visitor = *static_cast<GC::Cell::Visitor*>(visitor);
    switch (kind) {
    case RustFFI::HostCellKind::Cell:
        cell_visitor.visit(static_cast<GC::Cell*>(cell));
        return;
    case RustFFI::HostCellKind::Element:
        cell_visitor.visit(static_cast<DOM::Element*>(cell));
        return;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

void keep_animation_alive_in(void* root_vector, RustFFI::AnimationCell const* animation)
{
    static_cast<GC::RootVector<AnimationRef>*>(root_vector)->append(AnimationRef { *animation });
}

void in_execution_context_of_animation(void*, RustFFI::AnimationCell const* animation, void (*run)(void*), void* run_context)
{
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { HTML::relevant_realm(relevant_global_object_of(AnimationRef { *animation })) };
    run(run_context);
}

Optional<CSS::PseudoElement> EffectRef::pseudo_element_type() const
{
    auto pseudo_element = RustFFI::animations_effect_target(&record()).pseudo_element;
    if (!pseudo_element.serialization)
        return {};
    return static_cast<CSS::PseudoElement>(pseudo_element.kind);
}

void EffectRef::invalidate() const
{
    RustFFI::animations_effect_forget_what_the_host_concluded(&record());
    if (auto* target = this->target())
        target->document().set_needs_animated_style_update(*this);
}

// What the animation records ask of the host.
extern "C" void web_animation_set_needs_animated_style_update(void const* effect, DOM::Element* target);
extern "C" RustFFI::FfiTargetFacts web_animation_target_facts(DOM::Element* target, u32 wanted);

void web_animation_set_needs_animated_style_update(void const* effect, DOM::Element* target)
{
    target->document().set_needs_animated_style_update(EffectRef { *static_cast<RustFFI::AnimationEffectCell const*>(effect) });
}

// Whether nothing shows the target's style, as a display: none ancestor leaves the target without a box.
// NB: SVG resources keep their style under display: none, where boxes elsewhere in the document can reference them.
static bool target_is_unseen_in_display_none_subtree(DOM::Element const& target)
{
    if (target.has_layout_box() || !target.has_inclusive_ancestor_with_display_none_ignoring_animations())
        return false;
    bool has_referenceable_svg_element = false;
    target.for_each_in_inclusive_subtree_of_type<SVG::SVGElement>([&](SVG::SVGElement const& element) {
        if (!element.is_referenceable_in_display_none_subtree())
            return TraversalDecision::Continue;
        has_referenceable_svg_element = true;
        return TraversalDecision::Break;
    });
    return !has_referenceable_svg_element;
}

// Whether a listener on `target`, the nodes its events bubble to or its window hears an event `hears` names.
template<typename Hears>
static bool event_is_heard_at(DOM::Element& target, Hears const& hears)
{
    for (auto* node = static_cast<DOM::Node*>(&target); node;) {
        if (hears(*node))
            return true;
        if (auto assigned_slot = DOM::assigned_slot_for_node(*node))
            node = assigned_slot.ptr();
        else
            node = node->parent_or_shadow_host();
    }
    auto window = target.document().window();
    return window && hears(*window);
}

static bool target_fact_holds(DOM::Element& target, u32 fact)
{
    switch (fact) {
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_LAYOUT_IS_UP_TO_DATE:
        return target.document().layout_is_up_to_date();
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_IS_CONNECTED:
        return target.is_connected();
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_HAS_LAYOUT_BOX:
        return target.has_layout_box();
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_IS_SVG:
        return target.namespace_uri() == Namespace::SVG;
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_INSIDE_BOXLESS_CONTAINER:
        for (auto navigable = target.document().navigable(); navigable;) {
            auto container = navigable->container();
            if (!container)
                break;
            if (container->document().layout_is_up_to_date() && !container->has_layout_box())
                return true;
            navigable = container->document().navigable();
        }
        return false;
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_UNSEEN_IN_DISPLAY_NONE_SUBTREE:
        return target_is_unseen_in_display_none_subtree(target);
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_HIDDEN_WITHOUT_VISIBLE_DESCENDANT: {
        Layout::ForcedReadScope read { target.document() };
        auto const* layout_node = target.unsafe_layout_node(read);
        if (!layout_node || layout_node->visibility() != CSS::Visibility::Hidden)
            return false;
        bool has_visible_descendant = false;
        layout_node->for_each_in_inclusive_subtree_of_type<Layout::NodeWithStyle>([&](auto const& descendant) {
            if (descendant.visibility() != CSS::Visibility::Visible)
                return TraversalDecision::Continue;
            has_visible_descendant = true;
            return TraversalDecision::Break;
        });
        return !has_visible_descendant;
    }
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_HEARS_CSS_ANIMATION_EVENTS:
        return event_is_heard_at(target, [](DOM::EventTarget const& event_target) {
            return event_target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::animationcancel)
                || event_target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::animationiteration)
                || event_target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::animationstart)
                || event_target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::webkitAnimationIteration)
                || event_target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::webkitAnimationStart);
        });
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_HEARS_CSS_ANIMATION_ITERATION_EVENTS:
        return event_is_heard_at(target, [](DOM::EventTarget const& event_target) {
            return event_target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::animationiteration)
                || event_target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::webkitAnimationIteration);
        });
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_HEARS_TIME_EVENTS:
        return target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::beginEvent)
            || target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::endEvent)
            || target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::repeatEvent);
    case RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_HEARS_REPEAT_EVENT:
        return target.has_event_listener(HTML::EventNames::repeatEvent);
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

RustFFI::FfiTargetFacts web_animation_target_facts(DOM::Element* target, u32 wanted)
{
    RustFFI::FfiTargetFacts answer {};
    for (u32 fact = 1; fact <= wanted; fact <<= 1) {
        if (!(wanted & fact))
            continue;
        if (fact == RustFFI::TARGET_FACT_SKIP_KEY) {
            Layout::ForcedReadScope read { target->document() };
            answer.key = {
                .target_style_generation = target->animation_style_generation(),
                .target_subtree_style_generation = target->animation_subtree_style_generation(),
                .layout_node = bit_cast<FlatPtr>(target->unsafe_layout_node(read)),
                .target_is_connected = target->is_connected(),
            };
        } else if (target_fact_holds(*target, fact)) {
            answer.facts |= fact;
        }
    }
    return answer;
}

static bool is_in_display_none_subtree_ignoring_animations(DOM::AbstractElement abstract_element)
{
    if (abstract_element.pseudo_element().has_value() && abstract_element.element().installed_style(abstract_element.pseudo_element()).display_is_none_ignoring_animations())
        return true;
    return abstract_element.element().has_inclusive_ancestor_with_display_none_ignoring_animations();
}

void EffectRef::update_computed_properties(AnimationUpdateContext& context) const
{
    auto* target = this->target();
    if (!target || !target->is_connected())
        return;

    // An effect that animates `display` can be the very thing holding its `display: none` target visible, and
    // the update being skipped is the one that applies or removes that override, so it must always run.
    // NB: A descendant's retained style can still describe a display-none subtree while ancestor visibility
    //     reactions are propagating, so inspect the current target and ancestor styles before skipping its update.
    // NB: Only a pseudo-element can skip it. What an element animates reaches the SVG paint servers below it, which
    //     keep their style under display: none.
    DOM::AbstractElement abstract_element { *target, pseudo_element_type() };
    if (abstract_element.pseudo_element().has_value()
        && !target_properties().contains(CSS::PropertyID::Display)
        && is_in_display_none_subtree_ignoring_animations(abstract_element))
        return;

    target->update_animated_properties({}, pseudo_element_type(), *this, context);
}

extern "C" {

// Declared in Bindings/Rust/src/animations/animation.rs.
void* web_animation_object_realm(RustFFI::AnimationCell const*);
void web_animation_perform_object_effect(JSVM*, RustFFI::FfiHostEffect const*);

// What Bindings/Rust/src/animations asks of the host.
enum class StyleUpdateScope : u8 {
    Element,
    Document,
};
void web_animation_update_style_of_element(DOM::Element*, bool has_pseudo_element, u8 pseudo_element, StyleUpdateScope);
void* web_animation_realm_of_element(DOM::Element*);
void* web_animation_realm_of_document(DOM::Document*);
double web_animation_current_high_resolution_time(void* realm);
void web_animation_append_pending_playback_event(DOM::Document*, RustFFI::AnimationCell const*, RustFFI::PlaybackEventType, RustFFI::OptionalTimeValue current_time, RustFFI::OptionalTimeValue timeline_time, RustFFI::OptionalNumber scheduled_event_time, double time_stamp);
void web_animation_event_set_time_stamp(DOM::Event*, double time_stamp);
}

// NB: Script observes a CSS animation or transition with the style of its owning element computed, and the play state
//     of an animation with the style of the document of its owning element computed.
void web_animation_update_style_of_element(DOM::Element* element, bool has_pseudo_element, u8 pseudo_element, StyleUpdateScope scope)
{
    if (scope == StyleUpdateScope::Document) {
        element->document().update_style();
        return;
    }
    DOM::AbstractElement owning_element { *element, has_pseudo_element ? static_cast<CSS::PseudoElement>(pseudo_element) : Optional<CSS::PseudoElement> {} };
    element->document().update_style_for_element(owning_element, DOM::Document::StyleUpdateMode::OnlyIfNeeded);
}

void* web_animation_realm_of_element(DOM::Element* element)
{
    return &HTML::relevant_realm(element->document());
}

void* web_animation_realm_of_document(DOM::Document* document)
{
    return &HTML::relevant_realm(*document);
}

double web_animation_current_high_resolution_time(void* realm)
{
    return HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm)->global_object());
}

void web_animation_append_pending_playback_event(DOM::Document* document, RustFFI::AnimationCell const* animation, RustFFI::PlaybackEventType type, RustFFI::OptionalTimeValue current_time, RustFFI::OptionalTimeValue timeline_time, RustFFI::OptionalNumber scheduled_event_time, double time_stamp)
{
    document->append_pending_animation_event(AnimationRef { *animation }, {
                                                                              .kind = RustFFI::PendingAnimationEventKind::Playback,
                                                                              .css_event_type = {},
                                                                              .playback_event_type = type,
                                                                              .time_event_type = {},
                                                                              .detail = 0,
                                                                              .elapsed_time = 0,
                                                                              .current_time = current_time,
                                                                              .timeline_time = timeline_time,
                                                                              .scheduled_event_time = scheduled_event_time,
                                                                              .time_stamp = time_stamp,
                                                                          });
}

void web_animation_event_set_time_stamp(DOM::Event* event, double time_stamp)
{
    event->set_time_stamp(time_stamp);
}

void AnimationRef::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor) const
{
    RustFFI::animations_animation_visit_host_cells(&record(), &visitor, visit_host_cell);
}

i32 compare_elements_in_tree_order_for_composite_order(void* first, void* second)
{
    auto& first_element = *static_cast<DOM::Element*>(first);
    auto& second_element = *static_cast<DOM::Element*>(second);
    return first_element.document().compare_elements_in_tree_order_for_composite_order(first_element, second_element);
}

JS::Object& relevant_global_object_of(AnimationRef const& animation)
{
    if (auto* realm = static_cast<JS::Realm*>(web_animation_object_realm(&animation.record())))
        return realm->global_object();
    auto* element = static_cast<DOM::Element*>(RustFFI::animations_animation_owning_element(&animation.record()).element);
    if (!element)
        element = static_cast<DOM::Element*>(RustFFI::animations_smil_animation_element(&animation.record()));
    VERIFY(element);
    return element->document().relevant_settings_object().global_object();
}

// Whether an invalidation changes the animation as the last rendering update planned it for the render clock, rather
// than move it on in time, as a rendering update does.
enum class ChangesPlan : bool {
    No,
    Yes,
};

// Invalidates the style the associated effect of the animation produces.
static void invalidate_effect(AnimationRef const& animation, ChangesPlan changes_plan)
{
    auto effect = animation.effect();
    if (!effect.has_value())
        return;
    // The render clock's lanes tick the document's animations as the last rendering update planned them.
    if (auto* target = effect->target(); changes_plan == ChangesPlan::Yes && target && target->document().layout_node_arena_if_created())
        Layout::RustFFI::document_host_note_animation_change(target->document().layout_node_arena_if_created()->host());
    effect->invalidate();
}

void web_animation_perform_host_effect(RustFFI::FfiHostEffect const* host_effect)
{
    auto const& effect = *host_effect;
    AnimationRef animation { *effect.animation };
    auto effect_target = [&] -> DOM::Element* {
        auto associated_effect = animation.effect();
        return associated_effect.has_value() ? associated_effect->target() : nullptr;
    };
    using Kind = RustFFI::FfiHostEffectKind;
    switch (effect.kind) {
    case Kind::ReplaceReadyPromise:
    case Kind::ResolveReadyPromise:
    case Kind::RejectReadyPromise:
    case Kind::ReplaceFinishedPromise:
    case Kind::ResolveFinishedPromise:
    case Kind::RejectFinishedPromise:
    case Kind::QueuePlaybackEvent:
        web_animation_perform_object_effect(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), host_effect);
        return;
    case Kind::QueueFinishNotificationTask: {
        // NB: The task runs whether or not the animation has an object, as the finish notification steps note that the
        //     animation finished.
        auto& global = relevant_global_object_of(animation);
        auto& document = HTML::relevant_window(global).associated_document();
        auto task = HTML::Task::create(HTML::Task::Source::DOMManipulation, &document, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(animation, global), [](AnimationRef const& animation, JS::Object& global) {
            HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext context { HTML::relevant_realm(global) };
            RustFFI::animations_animation_run_finish_notification_steps(&animation.record(), web_animation_perform_host_effect);
        }));
        RustFFI::animations_animation_set_finish_notification_task(&animation.record(), task->id().value());
        (void)HTML::main_thread_event_loop().task_queue().add(move(task));
        return;
    }
    case Kind::CancelFinishNotificationTask:
        HTML::main_thread_event_loop().task_queue().remove_tasks_matching([id = HTML::TaskID { effect.task }](auto const& task) {
            return task.id() == id;
        });
        return;
    case Kind::InvalidateEffect:
        invalidate_effect(animation, effect.changes_plan ? ChangesPlan::Yes : ChangesPlan::No);
        return;
    case Kind::InvalidateUnlessThrottled: {
        auto keyframe_effect = animation.effect();
        if (!keyframe_effect.has_value())
            return;
        if (keyframe_effect->can_skip_per_frame_style_update()) {
            if (auto* target = keyframe_effect->target())
                target->document().note_throttled_animation_style_update();
        } else if (effect.invalidate) {
            invalidate_effect(animation, ChangesPlan::No);
        }
        return;
    }
    case Kind::AssociateWithTarget:
        static_cast<DOM::Element*>(effect.element)->associate_with_animation(animation);
        return;
    case Kind::DisassociateFromTarget:
        static_cast<DOM::Element*>(effect.element)->disassociate_with_animation(animation, EffectRef { *effect.effect });
        return;
    case Kind::RecomputeEffectStyle: {
        AnimationUpdateContext context;
        EffectRef { *effect.effect }.update_computed_properties(context);
        return;
    }
    case Kind::RequestRepaint:
        if (auto* target = effect_target())
            target->set_needs_repaint(InvalidateDisplayList::No);
        return;
    case Kind::ScheduleWakeup:
        if (auto* target = effect_target())
            target->document().schedule_compositor_animation_wakeup(effect.delay);
        return;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

RustFFI::DocumentAnimations* web_animation_document_animations(DOM::Document* document)
{
    return &document->document_animations();
}

RustFFI::FfiDocumentClock web_animation_document_clock(DOM::Document* document)
{
    auto& settings = document->relevant_settings_object();
    auto& global = settings.global_object();
    return {
        .now = HighResolutionTime::relative_high_resolution_time(HighResolutionTime::unsafe_shared_current_time(), global),
        .task_generation = settings.responsible_event_loop().task_generation(),
        .timeline_start_time = document->last_animation_frame_timestamp().value_or_lazy_evaluated([&] {
            return HighResolutionTime::relative_high_resolution_time(document->load_timing_info().navigation_start_time, global);
        }),
    };
}

// The target an anonymous scroll timeline finds its scroller from.
static DOM::AbstractElement anonymous_target(RustFFI::FfiScrollTimelineSource const& source)
{
    Optional<CSS::PseudoElement> pseudo_element;
    if (source.has_pseudo_element)
        pseudo_element = static_cast<CSS::PseudoElement>(source.pseudo_element);
    return DOM::AbstractElement { *static_cast<DOM::Element*>(source.target), pseudo_element };
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/scroll-animations-1/#dom-scrolltimeline-source
static GC::Ptr<DOM::Element const> scroll_timeline_source(RustFFI::FfiScrollTimelineSource const& source)
{
    if (!source.is_anonymous)
        return static_cast<DOM::Element const*>(source.element);
    auto target = anonymous_target(source);
    switch (static_cast<CSS::Scroller>(source.scroller)) {
    case CSS::Scroller::Root:
        return target.document().document_element();
    case CSS::Scroller::Nearest: {
        GC::Ptr<DOM::Element const> ancestor = target.flat_tree_parent_element();

        // Whether a box is a scroll container depends on its used overflow, which is visible for a body whose
        // overflow is propagated to the viewport. The document element stands for the viewport.
        Layout::ForcedReadScope read { target.document() };
        while (ancestor && !ancestor->is_document_element()) {
            auto const* layout_node = ancestor->unsafe_layout_node(read);
            if (layout_node && layout_node->is_scroll_container())
                break;
            ancestor = ancestor->flat_tree_parent_element();
        }

        return ancestor;
    }
    case CSS::Scroller::Self:
        return target.element();
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

void web_animation_find_scroll_timeline_boxes(RustFFI::FfiScrollTimelineSource const* source, bool is_view, void* context, void (*measure)(void*, RustFFI::FfiScrollTimelineBoxes const*))
{
    // NB: The record measures the boxes the timeline follows where the render state of the document whose viewport or
    //     element the source propagates to lays them out.
    RustFFI::FfiScrollTimelineBoxes boxes {
        .host = nullptr,
        .read = nullptr,
        .scroller = Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId_INVALID,
        .has_scroll_node = false,
        .scroll_node = {},
        .scroller_style_node = 0,
        .subject = Compositing::RustFFI::NodeSlotId_INVALID,
        .subject_style_node = 0,
    };

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/scroll-animations-1/#scroll-notation
    // References to the root element propagate to the document viewport (which functions as its scroll container).
    auto const element = scroll_timeline_source(*source);
    Variant<GC::Ptr<DOM::Element const>, GC::Ptr<DOM::Document>> propagated_source = element;
    if (element && element.ptr() == element->document().document_element())
        propagated_source = element->owner_document();
    if (propagated_source.visit([](auto const& source) { return source == nullptr; }))
        return measure(context, &boxes);

    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { propagated_source.visit([](auto const& source) -> DOM::Document const& { return source->document(); }) };
    auto const* layout_node = propagated_source.visit([&read](auto const& source) -> Layout::NodeWithStyle const* { return source->unsafe_layout_node(read); });
    if (!layout_node)
        return measure(context, &boxes);

    boxes.host = layout_node->document_host();
    boxes.read = read;
    boxes.scroller = Layout::Node::slot_id(layout_node);
    if (auto scroll_node = Painting::async_scroll_node_stable_id(*layout_node); scroll_node.has_value()) {
        boxes.has_scroll_node = true;
        boxes.scroll_node = { .node_id = scroll_node->node_id.value(), .kind = to_underlying(scroll_node->kind), .pseudo_element_type = scroll_node->pseudo_element_type };
    }
    boxes.scroller_style_node = propagated_source.visit(
        [](GC::Ptr<DOM::Element const> const& element) { return element->style_node_id().value(); },
        [](GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> const&) -> u32 { return 0; });
    // NB: A view timeline follows the box of its subject besides its scroller's.
    if (is_view) {
        auto subject = anonymous_target(*source);
        boxes.subject = Layout::Node::slot_id(subject.unsafe_layout_node(read));
        // NB: A clock tick finds the subject by its style node, which a pseudo-element does not name.
        if (!subject.pseudo_element().has_value())
            boxes.subject_style_node = subject.element().style_node_id().value();
    }
    measure(context, &boxes);
}

DOM::Element* web_animation_scroll_timeline_source(RustFFI::FfiScrollTimelineSource const* source, bool is_view)
{
    if (is_view) {
        // The values of subject, source, and currentTime are all computed when any of them is requested or updated.
        auto subject = anonymous_target(*source);
        subject.document().update_layout(DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::ViewTimelineSource);

        // If the source or subject of a ViewTimeline is an element whose principal box does not exist, [...] then the
        // ViewTimeline is inactive.
        // INTEROP: Its source is then null, as WebKit and Blink have it.
        for (GC::Ptr<DOM::Element const> element = &subject.element(); element; element = element->flat_tree_parent_element()) {
            if (!element->has_style() || element->installed_style().display_is_none())
                return nullptr;
        }
    } else if (source->is_anonymous && static_cast<CSS::Scroller>(source->scroller) == CSS::Scroller::Nearest) {
        // The nearest scroll container is the nearest one by used overflow, which layout decides.
        anonymous_target(*source).document().update_layout(DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::ScrollTimelineSource);
    }
    return const_cast<DOM::Element*>(scroll_timeline_source(*source).ptr());
}

DOM::Element* web_animation_document_scrolling_element(DOM::Document* document)
{
    return const_cast<DOM::Element*>(document->scrolling_element().ptr());
}

// NB: Absolutizes a style value that script gave, as the document's values are.
CSS::StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData const* web_animation_absolutize_style_value(DOM::Document* document, CSS::StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData const* value)
{
    auto style_value = CSS::StyleValue::adopt_rust_style_value_data(CSS::StyleValueFFI::rust_style_value_retain(value));
    auto computed = style_value->absolutized(CSS::ComputationContext { .length_resolution_context = CSS::Length::ResolutionContext::for_document(*document) });
    return CSS::StyleValueFFI::rust_style_value_retain(computed->rust_style_value_data());
}

// NB: What committing the computed styles of an animation answers its bindings.
enum class CommitStylesResult : u8 {
    Committed,
    TargetCannotHaveInlineStyle,
    TargetIsNotBeingRendered,
};

extern "C" WEB_API CommitStylesResult web_animation_commit_styles(RustFFI::AnimationCell const* animation_cell);

// https://drafts.csswg.org/web-animations-1/#commit-computed-styles
extern "C" WEB_API CommitStylesResult web_animation_commit_styles(RustFFI::AnimationCell const* animation_cell)
{
    AnimationRef animation { *animation_cell };

    // 1. Let targets be the set of all effect targets for animation effects associated with animation.
    auto effect = animation.effect();
    if (!effect.has_value() || !effect->target())
        return CommitStylesResult::Committed;
    GC::Ref<DOM::Element> target = *effect->target();

    // 2. For each target in targets:
    //    1. If target is not an element capable of having a style attribute (for example, it is a pseudo-element or is
    //       an element in a document format for which style attributes are not defined) throw a
    //       "NoModificationAllowedError" DOMException and abort these steps.
    auto const& namespace_uri = target->namespace_uri();
    if (effect->pseudo_element_type().has_value() || (namespace_uri != Namespace::HTML && namespace_uri != Namespace::SVG && namespace_uri != Namespace::MathML))
        return CommitStylesResult::TargetCannotHaveInlineStyle;

    OrderedHashMap<CSS::PropertyNameAndID, NonnullRefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const>> declarations;
    {
        // 2. If, after applying any pending style changes, target is not being rendered, throw an "InvalidStateError"
        //    DOMException and abort these steps.
        auto& document = target->document();
        Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document };
        document.update_layout(DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::AnimationCommitStyles);
        if (!target->is_connected() || !target->has_style())
            return CommitStylesResult::TargetIsNotBeingRendered;
        auto computed_style = target->computed_style();
        if (!target->unsafe_layout_node(read) && (!computed_style->display().is_contents() || computed_style->in_display_none_subtree()))
            return CommitStylesResult::TargetIsNotBeingRendered;

        // 4. Let targeted properties be the set of physical longhand properties that are a target property for at
        //    least one animation effect associated with animation whose effect target is target.
        HashTable<CSS::PropertyNameAndID> targeted_properties;
        auto add_longhand = [&](CSS::PropertyID property) {
            auto physical_property = CSS::map_logical_alias_to_physical_property(property, { computed_style->writing_mode(), computed_style->direction() });
            targeted_properties.set(CSS::PropertyNameAndID::from_id(physical_property));
        };
        RustFFI::FfiKeyframeSetFacts facts {};
        if (auto keyframe_set = effect->keyframe_set())
            facts = keyframe_set.facts();
        for (auto raw_property : ReadonlySpan<u16> { facts.target_properties, facts.target_property_count }) {
            auto property = static_cast<CSS::PropertyID>(raw_property);
            if (CSS::property_is_shorthand(property)) {
                for (auto longhand : CSS::expanded_longhands_for_shorthand(property))
                    add_longhand(longhand);
            } else {
                add_longhand(property);
            }
        }
        for (auto name : ReadonlySpan<FlatPtr> { reinterpret_cast<FlatPtr const*>(facts.target_custom_properties), facts.target_custom_property_count })
            targeted_properties.set(CSS::PropertyNameAndID::from_name(Utf16FlyString::from_raw(name)).release_value());

        // 5. For each property, property, in targeted properties:
        //    1. Let partialEffectStack be a copy of the effect stack for property on target.
        //    2. If animation's replace state is removed, add all animation effects associated with animation whose
        //       effect target is target and that include property as a target property to partialEffectStack.
        //    3. Remove from partialEffectStack any animation effects whose associated animation has a higher composite
        //       order than animation.
        Vector<EffectRef> effects;
        for (auto other_animation : target->associated_animations_in_composite_order()) {
            auto other_effect = other_animation.effect();
            if (other_effect.has_value() && !other_effect->pseudo_element_type().has_value()
                && RustFFI::animations_animation_composite_order(&other_animation.record(), animation_cell, compare_elements_in_tree_order_for_composite_order) < 0)
                effects.append(other_effect.release_value());
        }
        effects.append(*effect);

        // 4. Let effect value be the result of calculating the result of partialEffectStack for property using
        //    target's computed style (see §5.4.3 Calculating the result of an effect stack) and setting the
        //    endpoint-inclusive active interval flag to true when calculating the animation effect phase
        //    (see §4.6.6 Animation effect phases and states).
        DOM::AbstractElement element { target, {} };
        // NB: A timeline script observed ahead of its current time in this task is sampled at that time, as the style
        //     update above was, so the committed values are those of the time script read.
        RefPtr<CSS::ComputedStyleWorkingSet> committed_style;
        auto commit = [&] { committed_style = document.style_computer().compute_style_for_animation_commit(read, element, effects.span()); };
        using Commit = decltype(commit);
        RustFFI::animations_document_animations_at_times_observed_ahead(&document.document_animations(), &commit, [](void* context) { (*static_cast<Commit*>(context))(); });
        auto style = committed_style.release_nonnull();
        auto custom_properties = element.custom_property_data();
        if (custom_properties && element.custom_property_data_is_animation_overlay())
            custom_properties = custom_properties->parent();
        for (auto const& property : targeted_properties) {
            if (property.is_custom_property()) {
                RefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const> value;
                if (auto animated_value = style->animated_custom_properties().get(property.name()); animated_value.has_value())
                    value = **animated_value;
                else if (custom_properties) {
                    if (auto base_value = custom_properties->get(property.name()); base_value.has_value())
                        value = base_value->value;
                }
                if (!value) {
                    if (auto registration = document.get_registered_custom_property(property.name()); registration.has_value() && registration->initial_value)
                        value = CSS::compute_registered_custom_property_initial_value(document, *registration);
                }
                if (value)
                    declarations.set(property, value.release_nonnull());
            } else {
                declarations.set(property, CSS::unscaled_by_zoom(property.id(), style->property(property.id()), computed_style->effective_zoom()));
            }
        }
    }

    // 3. Let inline style be the result of getting the CSS declaration block corresponding to target's style
    //    attribute. If target does not have a style attribute, let inline style be a new empty CSS declaration block
    //    with the owner node set to target.
    auto inline_style = target->style();
    // 5.5. Set a CSS declaration of property for effect value in inline style.
    // 6. Update style attribute for inline style.
    inline_style->set_computed_properties(declarations);
    return CommitStylesResult::Committed;
}

// NB: What the reflection of the keyframes of a CSS animation or transition asks of the style of its target.
extern "C" WEB_API bool web_animation_compute_css_keyframe_values(DOM::Element* target, bool has_pseudo_element, u8 pseudo_element, CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::FfiReflectedKeyframeProperty const* properties, size_t property_count, size_t keyframe_count, CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::FfiStyleSheetResourceContext const* resource_context, void* context, CSS::StyleComputer::CSSKeyframeValueCallback emit);
extern "C" WEB_API double web_animation_effective_zoom_of_target(DOM::Element* target, bool has_pseudo_element, u8 pseudo_element);

extern "C" WEB_API bool web_animation_compute_css_keyframe_values(DOM::Element* target, bool has_pseudo_element, u8 pseudo_element, CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::FfiReflectedKeyframeProperty const* properties, size_t property_count, size_t keyframe_count, CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::FfiStyleSheetResourceContext const* resource_context, void* context, CSS::StyleComputer::CSSKeyframeValueCallback emit)
{
    DOM::AbstractElement abstract_target { *target, has_pseudo_element ? static_cast<CSS::PseudoElement>(pseudo_element) : Optional<CSS::PseudoElement> {} };
    if (!abstract_target.installed_style())
        return false;
    target->document().style_computer().compute_css_keyframe_values(abstract_target, { properties, property_count }, keyframe_count, *resource_context, context, emit);
    return true;
}

extern "C" WEB_API double web_animation_effective_zoom_of_target(DOM::Element* target, bool has_pseudo_element, u8 pseudo_element)
{
    DOM::AbstractElement abstract_target { *target, has_pseudo_element ? static_cast<CSS::PseudoElement>(pseudo_element) : Optional<CSS::PseudoElement> {} };
    if (auto style = abstract_target.computed_style())
        return style->effective_zoom();
    return 1;
}

{
    HTML::note_rendering_trace_event(StringView { reinterpret_cast<char const*>(event), length });
}
