/// A CSS color that a context was given: the color in sRGB, which the attribute that was set to it serializes, and the
/// color converted to the color space of the context, which the context paints with.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct CanvasColor {
    pub(crate) srgb: Color,
    pub(crate) in_color_space: Color,
}

impl CanvasColor {
    /// A color that is the same in every color space of a context.
    pub(crate) const fn invariant(color: Color) -> Self {
        Self {
            srgb: color,
            in_color_space: color,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn alpha(self) -> u8 {
        self.in_color_space.alpha()
    }
}

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-fillstyle
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) enum FillOrStrokeStyle {
    Color(CanvasColor),
    Gradient(Ref<CanvasGradient>),
    Pattern(Ref<CanvasPattern>),
}

impl FillOrStrokeStyle {
    /// Whether a draw with the style can change a pixel.
    pub(crate) fn is_visible(self) -> bool {
        match self {
            Self::Color(color) => color.alpha() > 0,
            Self::Gradient(gradient) => gradient.is_visible(),
            Self::Pattern(_) => true,
        }
    }

    /// Whether the style is a pattern that is marked as not origin-clean.
    pub(crate) fn is_not_origin_clean(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Pattern(pattern) if pattern.is_not_origin_clean())
    }
}

// SAFETY: Visits the gradient or the pattern, the cells that a style holds.
unsafe impl Trace for FillOrStrokeStyle {
    fn trace(&self, visitor: &mut Visitor) {
        match self {
            Self::Color(_) => {}
            Self::Gradient(gradient) => gradient.trace(visitor),
            Self::Pattern(pattern) => pattern.trace(visitor),
        }
    }
}

/// The letter spacing or the word spacing of a context, a CSS <length> as the context was given it.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct Spacing {
    pub(crate) length: StyleValue,
    pub(crate) serialized: Utf16String,
}

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#drawing-state
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct DrawingState {
    pub(crate) transform: AffineTransform,
    pub(crate) fill_style: FillOrStrokeStyle,
    pub(crate) stroke_style: FillOrStrokeStyle,
    pub(crate) shadow_offset_x: f32,
    pub(crate) shadow_offset_y: f32,
    pub(crate) shadow_blur: f32,
    pub(crate) shadow_color: CanvasColor,
    /// The serialized filter graph of the current filter, which the states share.
    pub(crate) filter: Option<Rc<[u8]>>,
    /// The value of the filter attribute, unless it is "none".
    pub(crate) filter_string: Option<Utf16String>,
    pub(crate) line_width: f32,
    pub(crate) line_cap: CanvasLineCap,
    pub(crate) line_join: CanvasLineJoin,
    pub(crate) miter_limit: f32,
    pub(crate) dash_list: Vec<f64>,
    pub(crate) line_dash_offset: f32,
    pub(crate) image_smoothing_enabled: bool,
    pub(crate) image_smoothing_quality: ImageSmoothingQuality,
    pub(crate) global_alpha: f32,
    pub(crate) current_compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator,
    /// The font, which is resolved the first time the context needs one.
    pub(crate) font: Option<ResolvedFont>,
    pub(crate) text_align: CanvasTextAlign,
    pub(crate) text_baseline: CanvasTextBaseline,
    pub(crate) direction: CanvasDirection,
    /// The language, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-language
    pub(crate) language: Utf16String,
    /// The letter spacing, unless it is 0px.
    pub(crate) letter_spacing: Option<Spacing>,
    /// The word spacing, unless it is 0px.
    pub(crate) word_spacing: Option<Spacing>,
    pub(crate) font_kerning: CanvasFontKerning,
    pub(crate) font_stretch: CanvasFontStretch,
    pub(crate) font_variant_caps: CanvasFontVariantCaps,
    pub(crate) text_rendering: CanvasTextRendering,
}

impl Default for DrawingState {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            transform: AffineTransform::identity(),
            fill_style: FillOrStrokeStyle::Color(CanvasColor::invariant(Color::from_rgb(0, 0, 0))),
            stroke_style: FillOrStrokeStyle::Color(CanvasColor::invariant(Color::from_rgb(0, 0, 0))),
            shadow_offset_x: 0.0,
            shadow_offset_y: 0.0,
            shadow_blur: 0.0,
            shadow_color: CanvasColor::invariant(Color::TRANSPARENT),
            filter: None,
            filter_string: None,
            line_width: 1.0,
            line_cap: CanvasLineCap::Butt,
            line_join: CanvasLineJoin::Miter,
            miter_limit: 10.0,
            dash_list: Vec::new(),
            line_dash_offset: 0.0,
            image_smoothing_enabled: true,
            image_smoothing_quality: ImageSmoothingQuality::Low,
            global_alpha: 1.0,
            current_compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SourceOver,
            font: None,
            text_align: CanvasTextAlign::Start,
            text_baseline: CanvasTextBaseline::Alphabetic,
            direction: CanvasDirection::Inherit,
            language: Utf16String::from_ascii(b"inherit"),
            letter_spacing: None,
            word_spacing: None,
            font_kerning: CanvasFontKerning::Auto,
            font_stretch: CanvasFontStretch::Normal,
            font_variant_caps: CanvasFontVariantCaps::Normal,
            text_rendering: CanvasTextRendering::Auto,
        }
    }
}

// SAFETY: Visits the fill and the stroke style, the cells that a drawing state holds.
unsafe impl Trace for DrawingState {
    fn trace(&self, visitor: &mut Visitor) {
        self.fill_style.trace(visitor);
        self.stroke_style.trace(visitor);
    }
}

impl DrawingState {
    pub(crate) fn cap_style(&self) -> CapStyle {
        match self.line_cap {
            CanvasLineCap::Butt => CapStyle::Butt,
            CanvasLineCap::Round => CapStyle::Round,
            CanvasLineCap::Square => CapStyle::Square,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn join_style(&self) -> JoinStyle {
        match self.line_join {
            CanvasLineJoin::Round => JoinStyle::Round,
            CanvasLineJoin::Bevel => JoinStyle::Bevel,
            CanvasLineJoin::Miter => JoinStyle::Miter,
        }
    }

    /// The dash list in floats, as a stroke records it.
    #[allow(
        clippy::cast_possible_truncation,
        reason = "a stroke records its dashes in floats, as the C++ did"
    )]
    pub(crate) fn dash_array(&self) -> Vec<f32> {
        self.dash_list.iter().map(|&dash| dash as f32).collect()
    }
}

/// The names of the compositing and blending operators that globalCompositeOperation takes, in the order that the
/// getter of the C++ looked the operator up in.
const COMPOSITE_OPERATIONS: [(&str, CompositingAndBlendingOperator); 30] = [
    ("normal", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal),
    ("multiply", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Multiply),
    ("screen", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Screen),
    ("overlay", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Overlay),
    ("darken", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Darken),
    ("lighten", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Lighten),
    ("color-dodge", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::ColorDodge),
    ("color-burn", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::ColorBurn),
    ("hard-light", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::HardLight),
    ("soft-light", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SoftLight),
    ("difference", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Difference),
    ("exclusion", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Exclusion),
    ("hue", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Hue),
    ("saturation", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Saturation),
    ("color", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Color),
    ("luminosity", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Luminosity),
    ("clear", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Clear),
    ("copy", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Copy),
    ("source-over", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SourceOver),
    ("destination-over", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::DestinationOver),
    ("source-in", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SourceIn),
    ("destination-in", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::DestinationIn),
    ("source-out", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SourceOut),
    ("destination-out", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::DestinationOut),
    ("source-atop", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SourceATop),
    ("destination-atop", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::DestinationATop),
    ("xor", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Xor),
    ("lighter", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Lighter),
    ("plus-darker", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::PlusDarker),
    ("plus-lighter", CompositingAndBlendingOperator::PlusLighter),
];

/// The name of a compositing and blending operator, which every operator that a context can have has.
pub(crate) fn composite_operation_name(operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator) -> &'static str {
    COMPOSITE_OPERATIONS
        .iter()
        .find(|(_, candidate)| *candidate == operator)
        .map(|(name, _)| *name)
        .expect("a context has an operator that globalCompositeOperation names")
}

/// The compositing and blending operator that a string names exactly, if it names one.
pub(crate) fn composite_operation_named(name: &Utf16String) -> Option<CompositingAndBlendingOperator> {
    let units = name.to_utf16();
    COMPOSITE_OPERATIONS
        .iter()
        .find(|(candidate, _)| candidate.encode_utf16().eq(units.iter().copied()))
        .map(|(_, operator)| *operator)
}

/// A color as the attributes of a context serialize it, with HTML-compatible serialization requested.
/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#serialisation-of-a-color
/// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-4/#HTML-compatible-serialization-of-srgb
pub(crate) fn serialize_color(color: Color) -> Utf16String {
    // NB: Our colors are always sRGB with 8-bit components, and HTML-compatible serialization is always requested
    //     here, so only the alpha decides which serialization is used.
    // If the following conditions are all true:
    // 1. The color space is sRGB
    // 2. The alpha is 1
    // 3. The RGB component values are internally represented as integers between 0 and 255 inclusive (i.e. 8-bit
    //    unsigned integer)
    // 4. HTML-compatible serialization is requested
    // Then corresponding sRGB values are serialized in 6-digit hex color notation as follows:
    // A seven-character string consisting of the character "#", followed immediately by the two-digit hexadecimal
    // representations of the red component, the green component, and the blue component, in that order, using ASCII
    // lower hex digits. No spaces are permitted.
    if color.alpha() == 255 {
        let serialized = format!("#{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}", color.red(), color.green(), color.blue());
        return Utf16String::from_ascii(serialized.as_bytes());
    }
    // Otherwise, for sRGB the CSS serialization of sRGB values is used and for other color spaces, the relevant
    // serialization of the <color> value.
    let serialized = if color.alpha() == 0 {
        format!("rgba({}, {}, {}, 0)", color.red(), color.green(), color.blue())
    } else {
        format!(
            "rgba({}, {}, {}, 0.{})",
            color.red(),
            color.green(),
            color.blue(),
            alpha_digits(color.alpha())
        )
    };
    Utf16String::from_ascii(serialized.as_bytes())
}

/// The shortest fractional digits of an 8-bit alpha that read back as it, as format_to_8bit_compatible() of
/// LibGfx/Color.cpp writes them: 127 is "498", and 128 is "5".
fn alpha_digits(value: u8) -> String {
    let value = u32::from(value);
    let three_digits = (value * 1000 + 127) / 255;
    let rounded_to_two_digits = (three_digits + 5) / 10 * 10;
    if (rounded_to_two_digits * 255 / 100 + 5) / 10 != value {
        return format!("{three_digits:03}");
    }
    let rounded_to_one_digit = (three_digits + 50) / 100 * 100;
    if (rounded_to_one_digit * 255 / 100 + 5) / 10 != value {
        return format!("{:02}", rounded_to_two_digits / 10);
    }
    format!("{}", rounded_to_one_digit / 100)
}

//! The C ABI that Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/Canvas/Canvas2DContextBase.cpp declares, and calls with the cell of a context

/// Mirrors `Web::HTML::ContextCreationArguments`.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct ContextCreationArguments {
    canvas: *mut c_void,
    canvas_host: *mut c_void,
    canvas_is_offscreen: bool,
    width: i32,
    height: i32,
    alpha: bool,
    desynchronized: bool,
    /// The underlying value of a Web::Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace.
    color_space: u8,
    /// The underlying value of a Web::Bindings::CanvasColorType.
    color_type: u8,
    will_read_frequently: bool,
}

fn with_context<R>(context: &InterfaceCell, function: impl FnOnce(&ContextState) -> R) -> R {
    if let Some(context) = context.object_if::<RenderingContext2D<OnScreen>>() {
        return function(&context);
    }
    function(&context.object::<RenderingContext2D<Offscreen>>())
}

/// # Safety
///
/// The pointers of the arguments are what [`ContextCreationArguments`] describes.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_canvas_2d_context_create(
    vm: &libjs_rust::api::Vm,
    arguments: &ContextCreationArguments,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let canvas = Canvas {
        cell: NonNull::new(arguments.canvas).expect("C++ passes the canvas"),
        host: NonNull::new(arguments.canvas_host).expect("C++ passes the canvas"),
        is_offscreen: arguments.canvas_is_offscreen,
    };
    let parameters = ContextParameters {
        canvas,
        context_attributes: CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings {
            alpha: arguments.alpha,
            desynchronized: arguments.desynchronized,
            color_space: PredefinedColorSpace::from_u8(arguments.color_space).expect("C++ passes a color space"),
            color_type: CanvasColorType::from_u8(arguments.color_type).expect("C++ passes a color type"),
            will_read_frequently: arguments.will_read_frequently,
        },
        size: IntSize {
            width: arguments.width,
            height: arguments.height,
        },
    };
    if arguments.canvas_is_offscreen {
        cell_into_abi(allocate(vm, |defer_gc| {
            RenderingContext2D::<Offscreen>::new(defer_gc, ContextState::new(defer_gc, parameters))
        }))
    } else {
        cell_into_abi(allocate(vm, |defer_gc| {
            RenderingContext2D::<OnScreen>::new(defer_gc, ContextState::new(defer_gc, parameters))
        }))
    }
}

/// A Gfx::DecodedImageFrame allocated with new that the caller takes over, or null. Unpremultiplied pixels come back
/// as RGBA8888, and premultiplied pixels as BGRA8888, in the color space.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_canvas_2d_context_read_pixels(
    context: &InterfaceCell,
    rect: IntRect,
    alpha_type: AlphaType,
    color_space: ColorSpace,
) -> *mut c_void {
    with_context(context, |context| context.read_pixels(rect, alpha_type, color_space))
        .map_or(core::ptr::null_mut(), |frame| frame.hand_over_copy())
}

/// Draws the ImageBitmap at the point as drawImage() does, and returns whether that threw nothing.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_canvas_2d_context_draw_image_bitmap(
    context: &InterfaceCell,
    image_bitmap: &InterfaceCell,
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
) -> bool {
    let image_bitmap = image_bitmap.object::<ImageBitmap>();
    let image = CanvasImageSource::ImageBitmap(image_bitmap);
    // An ImageBitmap has a size of its own, so no default object size applies to it.
    let (width, height) = image.size(IntSize::default());
    #[allow(
        clippy::cast_precision_loss,
        reason = "a size of an image becomes a float, as the C++ had it"
    )]
    let (width, height) = (width as f32, height as f32);
    with_context(context, |context| {
        context
            .draw_image_internal(image, 0.0, 0.0, width, height, x, y, width, height)
            .is_ok()
    })
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    /// Sets the Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> to a copy of the frame, which is lent for the call.
    fn web_canvas_2d_set_video_frame_copy(out_frame: *mut c_void, frame: *const c_void);
}

/// Sets the Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> to a copy of the frame of the video at its current playback position, and
/// returns whether the video has one.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `video` must be a live wrapper of an HTMLVideoElement, and `out_frame` an Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame>.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_canvas_2d_read_back_video_frame(video: *mut c_void, out_frame: *mut c_void) -> bool {
    let video = NonNull::new(video.cast::<libjs_rust::api::Object>()).expect("C++ passes the video");
    // SAFETY: The caller passes a live wrapper of an HTMLVideoElement.
    let video = unsafe { CppInterface::from_wrapper(libjs_rust::api::Gc::from_non_null(video)) };
    // NB: The colors of a video can be outside the gamut of sRGB, so the frame is read back in the widest color space of
    //     a canvas.
    let Some(frame) = read_back_current_video_frame(video, ColorSpace::DisplayP3) else {
        return false;
    };
    // SAFETY: The handle keeps the frame alive for the call, and the caller passes the optional.
    unsafe { web_canvas_2d_set_video_frame_copy(out_frame, frame.as_raw()) };
    true
}

//! The transport of a 2D canvas in the product: the stream of its Web::Compositor::CompositorHost, and the
//! CompositorConnection of LibWeb, through the C ABI that Libraries/LibWeb/Compositor/Canvas2DStreamFFI.cpp gives it.

use core::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use std::rc::Rc;

use libcompositing_rust::display_list::canvas_2d_recorder::{

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_canvas_2d_connection_post_stream_batch_fonts_and_image_frames(
        connection: *mut c_void,
        fonts: *const *const c_void,
        font_count: usize,
        image_frames: *const *const c_void,
        image_frame_count: usize,
    ) -> bool;
    fn web_canvas_2d_video_frame_hold_ref(hold: *mut c_void);
    fn web_canvas_2d_video_frame_hold_unref(hold: *mut c_void);
    fn web_canvas_2d_video_frame_hold_note_sent_to_compositor(hold: *mut c_void);

struct ReservedCanvasIds {
    connection_serial: u64,
    ids: Range<u64>,
}

thread_local! {
    static RESERVED_CANVAS_IDS: RefCell<Option<ReservedCanvasIds>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
}

// SAFETY (of every call below): The connection is live, and the fonts and image frames are lent for the call, in which
// C++ takes references of its own.
impl CompositorConnection {
    fn reserve_context_id(self, size: IntSize) -> Option<CanvasId> {
        // NB: The Compositor refuses the same sizes, so a context it is asked to create always exists afterwards.
        if !is_valid_canvas_2d_size(size) {
            return None;
        }
        let connection_serial = self.serial();
        let reserved_id = RESERVED_CANVAS_IDS.with_borrow_mut(|reserved| {
            reserved
                .as_mut()
                .filter(|reserved| reserved.connection_serial == connection_serial)
                .and_then(|reserved| reserved.ids.next())
        });
        if let Some(canvas_id) = reserved_id {
            return Some(CanvasId(canvas_id));
        }
        // OPTIMIZATION: Creating a context is asynchronous, under an ID from a range reserved up front. A synchronous
        //               reply would wait for the Compositor to replay every canvas command queued before it.
        let response = self.send_sync(ReserveCanvasIds)?;
        let first_canvas_id = response.first_canvas_id.0;
        let mut ids = first_canvas_id..first_canvas_id.checked_add(response.count)?;
        let canvas_id = ids.next();
        RESERVED_CANVAS_IDS.set(Some(ReservedCanvasIds { connection_serial, ids }));
        canvas_id.map(CanvasId)
    }

    pub(crate) fn post_stream_batch_fonts_and_image_frames(
        self,
        fonts: &[&FontHandle],
        image_frames: &[&ImageFrameHandle],
    ) -> bool {
        let fonts: Vec<*const c_void> = fonts.iter().map(|font| font.as_raw()).collect();
        let image_frames: Vec<*const c_void> = image_frames.iter().map(|frame| frame.as_raw()).collect();
        unsafe {
            web_canvas_2d_connection_post_stream_batch_fonts_and_image_frames(
                self.as_ptr(),
                fonts.as_ptr(),
                fonts.len(),
                image_frames.as_ptr(),
                image_frames.len(),
            )
        }
    }

    fn read_back_pixels(
        self,
        canvas_id: CanvasId,
        rect: IntRect,
        alpha_type: AlphaType,
        color_space: ColorSpace,
    ) -> Option<ImageFrameHandle> {
        let size = usize::try_from(rect.width)
            .ok()?
            .checked_mul(usize::try_from(rect.height).ok()?)?
            .checked_mul(4)?;
        let pixels = SharedBuffer::create(size)?;
        let response = self.send_sync(ReadBackCanvas2dPixels {
            canvas_id,
            rect,
            alpha_type,
            color_space: color_space.into(),
            pixels: pixels.for_message(),
        })?;
        let IntSize { width, height } = response.size;
        if width <= 0 || height <= 0 {
            return None;
        }
        pixels.into_image_frame(width, height, alpha_type, color_space)
    }
}

pub(crate) struct VideoFrameHold(NonNull<c_void>);

// SAFETY (of every call below): The value owns a reference to the hold.
impl VideoFrameHold {
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `hold` must be a VideoFrameHold, one reference to which the value takes over.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn adopt(hold: NonNull<c_void>) -> Self {
        Self(hold)
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_same_hold_as(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.0 == other.0
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_sent_to_compositor(&self) {
        unsafe { web_canvas_2d_video_frame_hold_note_sent_to_compositor(self.0.as_ptr()) };
    }
}

impl Clone for VideoFrameHold {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        unsafe { web_canvas_2d_video_frame_hold_ref(self.0.as_ptr()) };
        Self(self.0)
    }
}

impl Drop for VideoFrameHold {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        unsafe { web_canvas_2d_video_frame_hold_unref(self.0.as_ptr()) };
    }
}

#[repr(C)]
pub(crate) struct TransportAbi {
    pub(crate) stream: *mut c_void,
    pub(crate) connection: *mut c_void,
}

impl Default for TransportAbi {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            stream: core::ptr::null_mut(),
            connection: core::ptr::null_mut(),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) struct CompositorTransport {
    stream: Rc<RefCell<Canvas2DStream>>,
    connection: CompositorConnection,
    connection_serial: u64,
    canvas_id: Cell<Option<CanvasId>>,
}

impl CompositorTransport {
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// The transport must be one that LibWeb has just handed over.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn adopt(transport: TransportAbi) -> Self {
        let stream = NonNull::new(transport.stream).expect("LibWeb passes the stream of the host");
        let connection = NonNull::new(transport.connection).expect("LibWeb passes the connection");
        // SAFETY: The value owns a reference to the connection, which it gives up when dropped.
        let connection = unsafe { CompositorConnection::lent(connection) };
        Self {
            // SAFETY: The host keeps the stream while it hands it out.
            stream: unsafe { shared_stream(stream) },
            connection,
            connection_serial: connection.serial(),
            canvas_id: Cell::new(None),
        }
    }

    fn recording_canvas_id(&self) -> CanvasId {
        self.canvas_id
            .get()
            .expect("a canvas records once its context is created")
    }
}

impl Drop for CompositorTransport {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: The value owns a reference to the connection.
        unsafe { self.connection.release() };
    }
}

impl Transport for CompositorTransport {
    type Font = FontHandle;
    type ImageFrame = ImageFrameHandle;
    type VideoFrameHold = VideoFrameHold;

    fn create_context(&self, size: IntSize, alpha: bool, will_read_frequently: bool, color_space: ColorSpace) -> bool {
        assert!(self.canvas_id.get().is_none(), "a transport creates one context");
        let Some(canvas_id) = self.connection.reserve_context_id(size) else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(poster) = self.connection.poster_while_compositor_is_reachable() else {
            return false;
        };
        let message = CreateCanvas2dContext {
            canvas_id,
            size,
            alpha,
            will_read_frequently,
            color_space: color_space.into(),
        };
        if !self.connection.post_or_lose_compositor(&poster, message) {
            return false;
        }
        self.canvas_id.set(Some(canvas_id));
        true
    }

    fn canvas_id(&self) -> Option<CanvasId> {
        self.canvas_id.get()
    }

    fn destroy_context(&self) {
        let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.take() else {
            return;
        };
        if let Some(poster) = self.connection.poster_while_compositor_is_reachable() {
            self.connection
                .post_or_lose_compositor(&poster, DestroyCanvas2dContext { canvas_id });
        }
    }

    fn append_command(&self, record: &[u8]) {
        let canvas_id = self.recording_canvas_id();
        self.stream
            .borrow_mut()
            .append_command(self.connection_serial, canvas_id, record);
    }

    fn add_font(&self, font: &FontHandle) -> FontResourceId {
        self.stream.borrow_mut().add_font(font)
    }

    fn add_image_frame(&self, frame: &ImageFrameHandle) -> ImageFrameResourceId {
        self.stream.borrow_mut().add_image_frame(frame)
    }

    fn retain_video_frame_hold(&self, hold: &VideoFrameHold) {
        self.stream.borrow_mut().retain_video_frame_hold(hold);
    }

    fn record_present(&self) {
        let canvas_id = self.recording_canvas_id();
        self.stream
            .borrow_mut()
            .record_present(self.connection_serial, canvas_id);
    }

    fn pending_command_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.stream.borrow().pending_command_count()
    }

    fn flush(&self) {
        flush(&self.stream, self.connection);
    }

    fn read_back_pixels(
        &self,
        rect: IntRect,
        alpha_type: AlphaType,
        color_space: ColorSpace,
    ) -> Option<ImageFrameHandle> {
        let canvas_id = self.canvas_id.get()?;
        self.connection
            .read_back_pixels(canvas_id, rect, alpha_type, color_space)
    }
}

//! The operations of the CanvasPath mixin on the current default path of a 2D context, whose steps are in
//! html/canvas_path.rs.

use libgfx_rust::path::Path;

use super::context::{CanvasKind, RenderingContext2D};
use super::float;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::html::canvas_path::{
    self, UnrestrictedDoubleOrDOMPointInitOrUnrestrictedDoubleOrDOMPointInitSequence, round_rect_radii,
};

impl<K: CanvasKind> RenderingContext2D<K> {
    fn build_path<R>(&self, function: impl FnOnce(&mut Path) -> R) -> R {
        function(&mut self.path_mut())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-closepath
    pub(crate) fn close_path(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.build_path(canvas_path::close_path);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-moveto
    pub(crate) fn move_to(&self, _: &mut CallContext, x: f64, y: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.build_path(|path| canvas_path::move_to(path, float(x), float(y)));
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-lineto
    pub(crate) fn line_to(&self, _: &mut CallContext, x: f64, y: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.build_path(|path| canvas_path::line_to(path, float(x), float(y)));
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-quadraticcurveto
    pub(crate) fn quadratic_curve_to(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        cpx: f64,
        cpy: f64,
        x: f64,
        y: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.build_path(|path| canvas_path::quadratic_curve_to(path, float(cpx), float(cpy), float(x), float(y)));
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-beziercurveto
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the arguments of bezierCurveTo()")]
    pub(crate) fn bezier_curve_to(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        cp1x: f64,
        cp1y: f64,
        cp2x: f64,
        cp2y: f64,
        x: f64,
        y: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.build_path(|path| canvas_path::bezier_curve_to(path, cp1x, cp1y, cp2x, cp2y, x, y));
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-arcto
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the arguments of arcTo()")]
    pub(crate) fn arc_to(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        x1: f64,
        y1: f64,
        x2: f64,
        y2: f64,
        radius: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.build_path(|path| canvas_path::arc_to(path, x1, y1, x2, y2, radius))?;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-rect
    pub(crate) fn rect(&self, _: &mut CallContext, x: f64, y: f64, w: f64, h: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.build_path(|path| canvas_path::rect(path, x, y, w, h));
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-roundrect
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the arguments of roundRect()")]
    pub(crate) fn round_rect(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        x: f64,
        y: f64,
        w: f64,
        h: f64,
        radii: UnrestrictedDoubleOrDOMPointInitOrUnrestrictedDoubleOrDOMPointInitSequence,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let radii = round_rect_radii(radii);
        self.build_path(|path| canvas_path::round_rect(path, x, y, w, h, &radii))?;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-arc
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the arguments of arc()")]
    pub(crate) fn arc(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        x: f64,
        y: f64,
        radius: f64,
        start_angle: f64,
        end_angle: f64,
        counterclockwise: bool,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.build_path(|path| {
            canvas_path::arc(
                path,
                float(x),
                float(y),
                float(radius),
                start_angle,
                end_angle,
                counterclockwise,
            )
        })?;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-ellipse
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the arguments of ellipse()")]
    pub(crate) fn ellipse(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        x: f64,
        y: f64,
        radius_x: f64,
        radius_y: f64,
        rotation: f64,
        start_angle: f64,
        end_angle: f64,
        counterclockwise: bool,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.build_path(|path| {
            canvas_path::ellipse(
                path,
                float(x),
                float(y),
                float(radius_x),
                float(radius_y),
                float(rotation),
                start_angle,
                end_angle,
                counterclockwise,
            )
        })?;
        Ok(())
    }

use core::cell::RefCell;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::rc::Rc;

use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::{CanvasId, FontResourceId, ImageFrameResourceId};
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::Compositing_Canvas2DCommandStreamSegment;
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::compositor_web_content_server::messages::UpdateCanvas2dStream;
use libgfx_rust::font::FontHandle;
use libgfx_rust::image_frame::ImageFrameHandle;

use super::host::VideoFrameHold;
use crate::compositor_connection::CompositorConnection;

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct Canvas2DStream {
    pending: Batch,
}

struct PendingSegment {
    connection_serial: u64,
    segment: Compositing_Canvas2DCommandStreamSegment,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Batch {
    segments: Vec<PendingSegment>,
    command_count: usize,
    fonts: HashMap<u64, FontHandle>,
    image_frames: HashMap<u64, ImageFrameHandle>,
    video_frame_holds: Vec<VideoFrameHold>,
}

impl Batch {
    fn put_back_ahead(&mut self, mut earlier: Batch) {
        let later = std::mem::take(self);
        earlier.segments.extend(later.segments);
        earlier.command_count += later.command_count;
        earlier.fonts.extend(later.fonts);
        earlier.image_frames.extend(later.image_frames);
        earlier.video_frame_holds.extend(later.video_frame_holds);
        *self = earlier;
    }
}

impl Canvas2DStream {
    pub(crate) fn append_command(&mut self, connection_serial: u64, canvas_id: CanvasId, record: &[u8]) {
        // A presented segment must keep its position in the stream, so recording after a present marker starts a new
        // segment for the same canvas.
        let segments = &mut self.pending.segments;
        match segments.last_mut() {
            Some(pending)
                if pending.connection_serial == connection_serial
                    && pending.segment.canvas_id == canvas_id
                    && !pending.segment.present =>
            {
                pending.segment.tape.extend_from_slice(record);
            }
            _ => segments.push(PendingSegment {
                connection_serial,
                segment: Compositing_Canvas2DCommandStreamSegment {
                    canvas_id,
                    tape: record.to_vec(),
                    present: false,
                },
            }),
        }
        self.pending.command_count += 1;
    }

    /// Marks the canvas as presentable at this point of the stream.
    pub(crate) fn record_present(&mut self, connection_serial: u64, canvas_id: CanvasId) {
        let segments = &mut self.pending.segments;
        match segments.last_mut() {
            Some(pending)
                if pending.connection_serial == connection_serial && pending.segment.canvas_id == canvas_id =>
            {
                pending.segment.present = true;
            }
            _ => segments.push(PendingSegment {
                connection_serial,
                segment: Compositing_Canvas2DCommandStreamSegment {
                    canvas_id,
                    tape: Vec::new(),
                    present: true,
                },
            }),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_font(&mut self, font: &FontHandle) -> FontResourceId {
        let id = font.id().0;
        self.pending.fonts.entry(id).or_insert_with(|| font.clone());
        FontResourceId(id)
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_image_frame(&mut self, frame: &ImageFrameHandle) -> ImageFrameResourceId {
        let id = frame.id();
        self.pending.image_frames.entry(id).or_insert_with(|| frame.clone());
        ImageFrameResourceId(id)
    }

    pub(crate) fn retain_video_frame_hold(&mut self, hold: &VideoFrameHold) {
        let holds = &mut self.pending.video_frame_holds;
        if holds.last().is_some_and(|last| last.is_same_hold_as(hold)) {
            return;
        }
        holds.push(hold.clone());
    }

    /// The number of records that the stream holds for every canvas.
    pub(crate) fn pending_command_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.pending.command_count
    }
}

/// Posts what `stream` holds to the Compositor through `connection`. While the Compositor cannot be reached through
/// it, the records stay in the stream for a flush through a connection that can reach one.
pub(crate) fn flush(stream: &RefCell<Canvas2DStream>, connection: CompositorConnection) {
    let mut batch = std::mem::take(&mut stream.borrow_mut().pending);
    if batch.segments.is_empty() {
        stream.borrow_mut().pending.put_back_ahead(batch);
        return;
    }
    let Some(poster) = connection.poster_while_compositor_is_reachable() else {
        stream.borrow_mut().pending.put_back_ahead(batch);
        return;
    };
    // NB: The canvases that a connection made are named by the IDs that its Compositor handed out, which the next
    //     Compositor hands out again. So the records of canvases of an older connection are dropped, and those of a
    //     newer one wait for it.
    let connection_serial = connection.serial();
    if batch
        .segments
        .iter()
        .any(|pending| pending.connection_serial > connection_serial)
    {
        stream.borrow_mut().pending.put_back_ahead(batch);
        return;
    }
    batch
        .segments
        .retain(|pending| pending.connection_serial == connection_serial);
    if batch.segments.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let fonts: Vec<&FontHandle> = batch.fonts.values().collect();
    let image_frames: Vec<&ImageFrameHandle> = batch.image_frames.values().collect();
    if !connection.post_stream_batch_fonts_and_image_frames(&fonts, &image_frames) {
        stream.borrow_mut().pending.put_back_ahead(batch);
        return;
    }
    let message = UpdateCanvas2dStream {
        segments: std::mem::take(&mut batch.segments)
            .into_iter()
            .map(|pending| pending.segment)
            .collect(),
    };
    if !connection.post_or_lose_compositor(&poster, message) {
        return;
    }
    for hold in &batch.video_frame_holds {
        hold.note_sent_to_compositor();
    }
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `stream` must be a stream that web_canvas_2d_stream_create() made, which C++ does not destroy during `'a`.
unsafe fn stream_from_raw<'a>(stream: *mut c_void) -> &'a RefCell<Canvas2DStream> {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { &*stream.cast::<RefCell<Canvas2DStream>>() }
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `stream` must be a stream that web_canvas_2d_stream_create() made and C++ has not destroyed yet.
pub(crate) unsafe fn shared_stream(stream: NonNull<c_void>) -> Rc<RefCell<Canvas2DStream>> {
    let stream = stream.as_ptr().cast::<RefCell<Canvas2DStream>>().cast_const();
    // SAFETY: The stream is an Rc, of which C++ holds a reference, guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe {
        Rc::increment_strong_count(stream);
        Rc::from_raw(stream)
    }
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_canvas_2d_stream_create() -> *mut c_void {
    Rc::into_raw(Rc::new(RefCell::new(Canvas2DStream::default())))
        .cast_mut()
        .cast()
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `stream` must be a stream that web_canvas_2d_stream_create() made, which the caller does not use afterwards.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_canvas_2d_stream_destroy(stream: *mut c_void) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    drop(unsafe { Rc::from_raw(stream.cast::<RefCell<Canvas2DStream>>().cast_const()) });
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `stream` must be a stream that web_canvas_2d_stream_create() made, and `connection` a live
/// Web::Compositor::CompositorConnection.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_canvas_2d_stream_flush(stream: *mut c_void, connection: *mut c_void) {
    let connection = NonNull::new(connection).expect("C++ passes a connection");
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    unsafe { flush(stream_from_raw(stream), CompositorConnection::lent(connection)) };
}

/// # Safety
///
/// `stream` must be a stream that web_canvas_2d_stream_create() made.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_canvas_2d_stream_discard(stream: *mut c_void) {
    // SAFETY: Guaranteed by the caller.
    let discarded = std::mem::take(&mut unsafe { stream_from_raw(stream) }.borrow_mut().pending);
    drop(discarded);
}

//! The text of a 2D context: shaping it across the fonts of the cascade of the font of the context, laying it out
//! as the text preparation algorithm does, and its outlines.

use libgfx_rust::font::{
    EmojiPresentation, FontCascadeListHandle, FontHandle, code_point_ends_emoji_zwj_element,
    code_point_extends_emoji_sequence, emoji_presentation_for_code_point,
};
use libgfx_rust::path::{GlyphRun, Path};
use libgfx_rust::text_layout::{GlyphBuffer, TextType, shape_text as shape_text_in_font};
use libgfx_rust::{AffineTransform, FloatPoint};

use super::context::multiply_transforms;
use super::drawing_state::DrawingState;
use crate::html::canvas_rendering_context2d::{CanvasTextAlign, CanvasTextBaseline};

/// A run of the text that one font of the cascade shapes.
pub(crate) struct ShapedRun {
    pub(crate) font: FontHandle,
    pub(crate) glyphs: GlyphBuffer,
    pub(crate) width: f32,
}

/// The code point at the index of the code units and how many code units it takes, as AK::Utf16View iterates them: a
/// surrogate that is not part of a pair is a code point of its own.
fn code_point_at(text: &[u16], index: usize) -> (u32, usize) {
    let code_unit = text[index];
    if (0xD800..0xDC00).contains(&code_unit)
        && let Some(&next_code_unit) = text.get(index + 1)
        && (0xDC00..0xE000).contains(&next_code_unit)
    {
        let code_point = 0x10000 + ((u32::from(code_unit) - 0xD800) << 10) + (u32::from(next_code_unit) - 0xDC00);
        return (code_point, 2);
    }
    (u32::from(code_unit), 1)
}

/// The text shaped from the baseline start, with a run for each part of it that one font of the cascade draws, as
/// Gfx::shape_text() shapes it across a Gfx::FontCascadeList.
pub(crate) fn shape_text(
    cascade: &FontCascadeListHandle,
    text: &[u16],
    baseline_start: FloatPoint,
    letter_spacing: f32,
    word_spacing: f32,
) -> Vec<ShapedRun> {
    const ZERO_WIDTH_JOINER: u32 = 0x200d;
    // The presentation the code point at `index` has: Its default one, or the one a variation selector after it asks
    // for.
    let presentation_at = |index: usize, code_point: u32, length: usize| -> EmojiPresentation {
        let next = (index + length < text.len()).then(|| code_point_at(text, index + length));
        let code_point_after_next = next.and_then(|(_, next_length)| {
            let index_after_next = index + length + next_length;
            (index_after_next < text.len()).then(|| code_point_at(text, index_after_next).0)
        });
        emoji_presentation_for_code_point(
            code_point,
            next.map(|(next_code_point, _)| next_code_point),
            code_point_after_next,
        )
    };

    let mut runs = Vec::new();
    if text.is_empty() {
        return runs;
    }

    let mut last_position = baseline_start;
    let mut add_run = |text: &[u16], font: &FontHandle| {
        let shaped = shape_text_in_font(font, text, TextType::Common, 0.0, letter_spacing, word_spacing);
        let width = shaped.width();
        let mut glyphs = shaped.into_glyphs();
        if last_position.x != 0.0 || last_position.y != 0.0 {
            glyphs.update_positions(|_, x, y| {
                *x += last_position.x;
                *y += last_position.y;
            });
        }
        last_position.x += width;
        runs.push(ShapedRun {
            font: font.clone(),
            glyphs,
            width,
        });
    };

    let (first_code_point, first_length) = code_point_at(text, 0);
    let mut last_font = cascade.font_for_code_point(
        first_code_point,
        presentation_at(0, first_code_point, first_length),
        None,
    );
    let mut run_start = 0;
    let mut previous_code_point = first_code_point;
    let mut joiner_joins_emoji = false;
    let mut index = first_length;
    while index < text.len() {
        let (code_point, length) = code_point_at(text, index);
        // NB: A variation selector and a joiner go with the character they follow. And the font that draws that
        //     character draws the rest of its sequence too, as far as it has the glyphs: What extends the sequence,
        //     and what a joiner joins to it. A joiner after a character that's no emoji joins nothing, and neither
        //     does one before a character with a variation selector that asks for its text presentation: Those are no
        //     part of an emoji sequence.
        if code_point == ZERO_WIDTH_JOINER {
            // NB: A pictograph that defaults to text presentation ends an emoji ZWJ element too, when the joiner
            //     joins it to another pictograph.
            let joined_code_point = (index + length < text.len()).then(|| code_point_at(text, index + length).0);
            joiner_joins_emoji = code_point_ends_emoji_zwj_element(previous_code_point)
                || emoji_presentation_for_code_point(previous_code_point, Some(code_point), joined_code_point).is_emoji;
        }
        let presentation = presentation_at(index, code_point, length);
        let is_joined = previous_code_point == ZERO_WIDTH_JOINER
            && joiner_joins_emoji
            && (presentation.is_emoji || !presentation.forced);
        let stays_in_run = matches!(code_point, 0xfe0e | 0xfe0f | ZERO_WIDTH_JOINER)
            || ((code_point_extends_emoji_sequence(code_point) || is_joined) && last_font.contains_glyph(code_point));
        if !stays_in_run {
            let font = cascade.font_for_code_point(code_point, presentation, Some(&last_font));
            if font.as_raw() != last_font.as_raw() {
                add_run(&text[run_start..index], &last_font);
                last_font = font;
                run_start = index;
            }
        }
        previous_code_point = code_point;
        index += length;
    }
    if run_start < text.len() {
        add_run(&text[run_start..], &last_font);
    }
    runs
}

/// The outlines of the glyphs of the runs, as one path.
pub(crate) fn path_of_runs(runs: &[ShapedRun]) -> Path {
    let glyph_runs: Vec<GlyphRun> = runs
        .iter()
        .map(|run| GlyphRun {
            font: run.font.clone(),
            glyphs: run.glyphs.clone(),
        })
        .collect();
    Path::from_glyph_runs(&glyph_runs)
}

/// How far the top of the font's em square is above the alphabetic baseline, and its bottom below it. The em square is
/// as tall as the font size, and it's divided at the baseline in the same proportion as the font's ascent and descent.
pub(crate) fn em_square_ascent_and_descent(font: &FontHandle) -> (f32, f32) {
    let facts = font.facts();
    let font_height = facts.ascent + facts.descent;
    let ascent = if font_height > 0.0 {
        facts.pixel_size * facts.ascent / font_height
    } else {
        facts.pixel_size / 2.0
    };
    (ascent, facts.pixel_size - ascent)
}

/// The distance from the alphabetic baseline down to the baseline that textBaseline names, in the metrics of the
/// first font of the cascade, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-textbaseline
pub(crate) fn baseline_offset(text_baseline: CanvasTextBaseline, first_font: &FontHandle) -> f32 {
    let ascent = first_font.facts().ascent;
    let descent = first_font.facts().descent;
    let (em_ascent, em_descent) = em_square_ascent_and_descent(first_font);
    match text_baseline {
        // "The top of the em square"
        CanvasTextBaseline::Top => em_ascent,
        CanvasTextBaseline::Hanging => ascent * 0.8,
        // "The middle of the em square"
        CanvasTextBaseline::Middle => (em_ascent - em_descent) / 2.0,
        CanvasTextBaseline::Alphabetic => 0.0,
        CanvasTextBaseline::Ideographic => -descent,
        // "The bottom of the em square"
        CanvasTextBaseline::Bottom => -em_descent,
    }
}

fn translation(x: f32, y: f32) -> AffineTransform {
    AffineTransform::new(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, x, y)
}

/// How far the left edge of an inline box of the width is to the right of the anchor point, which textAlign and
/// the direction of the text determine, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-textalign
pub(crate) fn horizontal_alignment_offset(text_align: CanvasTextAlign, is_rtl: bool, text_width: f32) -> f32 {
    // The direction affects how "start" and "end" are interpreted:
    // - "ltr": start=left, end=right
    // - "rtl": start=right, end=left
    match text_align {
        // Center alignment is the same regardless of direction.
        CanvasTextAlign::Center => -text_width / 2.0,
        // In RTL, "start" means right-aligned. In LTR, it means left-aligned, which needs no translation.
        CanvasTextAlign::Start if is_rtl => -text_width,
        // In LTR, "end" means right-aligned. In RTL, it means left-aligned, which needs no translation.
        CanvasTextAlign::End if !is_rtl => -text_width,
        // Explicit "left" and "right" alignments ignore direction.
        CanvasTextAlign::Right => -text_width,
        CanvasTextAlign::Start | CanvasTextAlign::End | CanvasTextAlign::Left => 0.0,
    }
}

/// Where text of the width goes relative to the point that it is drawn at, and how much it is condensed to fit in the
/// maximum width. The text starts at x, around which it is condensed.
#[allow(
    clippy::cast_possible_truncation,
    reason = "the transform is in floats, as the C++ had it"
)]
pub(crate) fn text_transform(
    state: &DrawingState,
    is_rtl: bool,
    first_font: &FontHandle,
    x: f32,
    mut text_width: f32,
    max_width: Option<f64>,
) -> AffineTransform {
    let mut transform = AffineTransform::identity();

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#text-preparation-algorithm:
    // 9. If maxWidth was provided and the hypothetical width of the inline box in the hypothetical line box is greater
    //    than maxWidth CSS pixels, then change font to have a more condensed font (if one is available or if a
    //    reasonably readable one can be synthesized by applying a horizontal scale factor to the font) or a smaller
    //    font, and return to the previous step.
    if let Some(max_width) = max_width
        && text_width > max_width as f32
    {
        let horizontal_scale = max_width as f32 / text_width;
        transform = AffineTransform::new(horizontal_scale, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, x - horizontal_scale * x, 0.0);
        text_width *= horizontal_scale;
    }

    // Apply text align
    let alignment_offset = horizontal_alignment_offset(state.text_align, is_rtl, text_width);
    if alignment_offset != 0.0 {
        transform = multiply_transforms(translation(alignment_offset, 0.0), transform);
    }

    // Apply text baseline
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-textbaseline
    let baseline_y_offset = baseline_offset(state.text_baseline, first_font);
    if baseline_y_offset != 0.0 {
        transform = multiply_transforms(translation(0.0, baseline_y_offset), transform);
    }

    transform
}

/// https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace
fn is_ascii_whitespace(code_unit: u16) -> bool {
    matches!(code_unit, 0x09 | 0x0A | 0x0C | 0x0D | 0x20)
}

/// The text with every ASCII whitespace replaced by a U+0020 SPACE, step 2 of the text preparation algorithm.
pub(crate) fn replace_ascii_whitespace(text: &[u16]) -> Vec<u16> {
    text.iter()
        .map(|&code_unit| {
            if is_ascii_whitespace(code_unit) {
                0x20
            } else {
                code_unit
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

//! ClipboardEvent, https://w3c.github.io/clipboard-apis/#clipboardevent

use core::ffi::c_void;

/// The dictionary ClipboardEventInit of Clipboard/ClipboardEvent.idl.

    pub(crate) clipboard_data: Option<Ref<DataTransfer>>,

// https://w3c.github.io/clipboard-apis/#clipboardevent
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ClipboardEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    clipboard_data: Option<Ref<DataTransfer>>,
}

impl Wrappable for ClipboardEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl ClipboardEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: &EventInit,
        clipboard_data: Option<Ref<DataTransfer>>,
    ) -> Ref<ClipboardEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.bubbles,
            event_init.cancelable,
            event_init.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| ClipboardEvent { event, clipboard_data });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init_dict: ClipboardEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<ClipboardEvent>> {
        Ok(Self::create(
            cx.vm(),
            cx.realm(),
            &r#type,
            &event_init_dict.parent,
            event_init_dict.clipboard_data,
        ))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    pub(crate) fn clipboard_data(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<DataTransfer>>> {
        Ok(self.clipboard_data)
    }
}

pub(crate) const WEB_CUSTOM_FORMAT_PREFIX: &str = "web ";

/// The enumeration PresentationStyle of Clipboard/ClipboardItem.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default, Eq, PartialEq)]

    #[default]
    Unspecified,
    Inline,
    Attachment,
}

impl PresentationStyle {
    pub(crate) fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Unspecified => "unspecified",
            Self::Inline => "inline",
            Self::Attachment => "attachment",
        }
    }
}

/// The dictionary ClipboardItemOptions of Clipboard/ClipboardItem.idl.

    pub(crate) presentation_style: PresentationStyle,

#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]

    Blob(AnyBlob),

// https://w3c.github.io/clipboard-apis/#representation

#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]

    pub(crate) mime_type: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) is_custom: bool,
    pub(crate) data: WebIdlPromise,

impl Representation {
    fn type_string(&self) -> Utf16String {
        if self.is_custom {
            return Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("web {}", String::from_utf16_lossy(&self.mime_type.to_utf16())));
        }
        self.mime_type.clone()
    }
}

// https://w3c.github.io/clipboard-apis/#clipboard-item-interface

#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
struct GetTypeInParallel {
    item: Ref<ClipboardItem>,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    promise: WebIdlPromise,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    mime_type: MimeType,
    is_custom: bool,

fn not_found_error(r#type: &Utf16String) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom(
        "NotFoundError",
        Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
            "No data found for MIME type: {}",
            String::from_utf16_lossy(&r#type.to_utf16())
        )),
    )
}

fn without_web_custom_format_prefix(r#type: &Utf16String) -> (Vec<char>, bool) {
    let code_points = string_to_code_points(r#type);
    let prefix: Vec<char> = WEB_CUSTOM_FORMAT_PREFIX.chars().collect();
    match code_points.strip_prefix(prefix.as_slice()) {
        Some(rest) => (rest.to_vec(), true),
        None => (code_points, false),
    }
}

fn resolve_with_blob(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>, promise: WebIdlPromise, blob: Ref<Blob>) {
    let wrapper = wrap(&CallContext::new(vm, realm), blob);
    resolve_promise(vm, promise, Value::from_object(wrapper));
}

impl ClipboardItem {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm) -> Ref<ClipboardItem> {
        let item = allocate(vm, |_| ClipboardItem {
            this: Cell::new(None),
            representations: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            presentation_style: Cell::new(PresentationStyle::Unspecified),
            types: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            clipboard_change_count_at_read: Cell::new(None),
            originating_system_clipboard_item: RefCell::new(None),
            unsanitized_mime_types: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            representations_with_resolvers: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
        });
        item.this.set(Some(item));
        item
    }

    fn this(&self) -> Ref<Self> {
        self.this
            .get()
            .expect("a ClipboardItem knows itself once it is created")
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/clipboard-apis/#dom-clipboarditem-clipboarditem
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        items: MarkedVec<'_, (Utf16String, WebIdlPromise)>,
        options: ClipboardItemOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<ClipboardItem>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. If items is empty, then throw a TypeError.
        if items.is_empty() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("Items cannot be empty"));
        }

        // 2. If options is empty, then set options["presentationStyle"] = "unspecified".
        // NOTE: This step is handled by presentationStyle's default value in ClipboardItemOptions.

        // 3. Set this's clipboard item to a new clipboard item.
        let clipboard_item = Self::create(vm);

        // 4. Set this's clipboard item's presentation style to options["presentationStyle"].
        clipboard_item.presentation_style.set(options.presentation_style);

        // 5. Let types be a list of DOMString.
        let mut types = Vec::new();

        // 6. For each (key, value) in items:
        for (key, value) in items.values().iter() {
            // 2. Let isCustom be false.
            // 3. If key starts with `"web "` prefix, then:
            //     1. Remove `"web "` prefix and assign the remaining string to key.
            //     2. Set isCustom to true.
            let (key_without_prefix, is_custom) = without_web_custom_format_prefix(key);

            // 5. Let mimeType be the result of parsing a MIME type given key.
            // 6. If mimeType is failure, then throw a TypeError.
            let Some(mime_type) = MimeType::parse(&key_without_prefix) else {
                return Err(Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                    "Invalid MIME type: {}",
                    String::from_utf16_lossy(&key.to_utf16())
                ))));
            };

            let mime_type_serialized = Utf16String::from_utf8(&mime_type.serialize());

            // 7. If this's clipboard item's list of representations contains a representation whose MIME type
            //    is mimeType and whose [representation/isCustom] is isCustom, then throw a TypeError.
            let exists = clipboard_item
                .representations
                .borrow()
                .iter()
                .any(|item| item.mime_type == mime_type_serialized && item.is_custom == is_custom);
            if exists {
                return Err(Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                    "Duplicate MIME type: {}",
                    String::from_utf16_lossy(&key.to_utf16())
                ))));
            }

            // 11. Let mimeTypeString be the result of serializing a MIME type with mimeType.
            // 12. If isCustom is true, prefix mimeTypeString with `"web "`.
            let mime_type_string = if is_custom {
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("web {}", mime_type.serialize()))
            } else {
                mime_type_serialized.clone()
            };

            // 13. Add mimeTypeString to types.
            types.push(mime_type_string);

            // 1. Let representation be a new representation.
            // 4. Set representation’s isCustom flag to isCustom.
            // 8. Set representation’s MIME type to mimeType.
            // 9. Set representation’s data to value.
            // 10. Append representation to this's clipboard item's list of representations.
            clipboard_item.representations.borrow_mut(vm).push(Representation {
                mime_type: mime_type_serialized,
                is_custom,
                data: *value,
            });
        }

        // 7. Set this's types array to the result of running create a frozen array from types.
        *clipboard_item.types.borrow_mut() = types;

        Ok(clipboard_item)
    }

    pub(crate) fn presentation_style(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<PresentationStyle> {
        Ok(self.presentation_style.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn types(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Vec<Utf16String>> {
        Ok(self.types.borrow().clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn representations<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, Representation> {
        let representations = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        representations.extend_from_slice(&self.representations.borrow());
        representations
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_representations(&self) -> bool {
        !self.representations.borrow().is_empty()
    }

    pub(crate) fn append_representation(&self, vm: &Vm, representation: Representation) {
        self.types.borrow_mut().push(representation.mime_type.clone());
        self.representations.borrow_mut(vm).push(representation);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_clipboard_change_count_at_read(&self, count: usize) {
        self.clipboard_change_count_at_read.set(Some(count));
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_originating_system_clipboard_item(&self, item: Option<SystemClipboardItem>) {
        *self.originating_system_clipboard_item.borrow_mut() = item;
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_unsanitized_mime_types(&self, types: Vec<Utf16String>) {
        *self.unsanitized_mime_types.borrow_mut() = types;
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/clipboard-apis/#dom-clipboarditem-gettype
    pub(crate) fn get_type(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, r#type: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = cx.realm();

        // 2. Let isCustom be false.
        // 3. If type starts with `"web "` prefix, then:
        //     1. Remove `"web "` prefix and assign the remaining string to type.
        //     2. Set isCustom to true.
        let (type_without_prefix, is_custom) = without_web_custom_format_prefix(&r#type);

        // 4. Let mimeType be the result of parsing a MIME type given type.
        // 5. If mimeType is failure, then throw a TypeError.
        let Some(mime_type) = MimeType::parse(&type_without_prefix) else {
            return Err(Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                "Invalid MIME type: {}",
                String::from_utf16_lossy(&r#type.to_utf16())
            ))));
        };

        let mime_type_serialized = Utf16String::from_utf8(&mime_type.serialize());

        // 6. Let itemTypeList be this’s clipboard item’s list of representations.
        let item_type_list = self.representations(vm);

        // 7.  Let p be a new promise in realm.
        let promise = create_promise(vm, realm);

        // 8. For each representation in itemTypeList:
        for (index, representation) in item_type_list.values().iter().enumerate() {
            // 1. If representation’s MIME type is mimeType and representation’s isCustom is isCustom, then:
            if representation.mime_type == mime_type_serialized && representation.is_custom == is_custom {
                // FIXME: 1. If this’s clipboard change count at read is not null, and the current clipboard change count is not
                //           equal to this’s clipboard change count at read, then reject p with an "InvalidStateError" DOMException
                //           in realm, and return p.

                // 2. If this’s clipboard change count at read is not null, then:
                if self.clipboard_change_count_at_read.get().is_some() {
                    // 1. Let key be mimeType’s essence. If isCustom is true, prefix key with `"web "`.
                    let essence = mime_type.essence();
                    let mut key = format!("{}/{}", essence.type_, essence.subtype);
                    if is_custom {
                        key = format!("web {key}");
                    }
                    let key = Utf16String::from_utf8(&key);

                    // 2. If this’s representations with resolvers[key] exists, then return this’s representations with resolvers[key].
                    let resolver = self
                        .representations_with_resolvers
                        .borrow()
                        .iter()
                        .find(|(existing_key, _)| *existing_key == key)
                        .map(|(_, resolver)| *resolver);
                    if let Some(resolver) = resolver {
                        return Ok(resolver);
                    }

                    // 3. Set this’s representations with resolvers[key] to p.
                    self.representations_with_resolvers.borrow_mut(vm).push((key, promise));

                    // 4. Run the following steps in parallel:
                    deferred_invoke(
                        vm,
                        GetTypeInParallel {
                            item: self.this(),
                            realm,
                            promise,
                            mime_type: mime_type.clone(),
                            is_custom,
                        },
                        get_type_in_parallel,
                    );
                }

                // 3. Let representationDataPromise be the representation’s data.
                let representation_data_promise = representation.data;

                // 4. React to representationDataPromise:
                react_to_promise(
                    vm,
                    representation_data_promise,
                    (promise, self.this(), index),
                    // 1. If representationDataPromise was fulfilled with value v, then:
                    Some(|cx, (promise, item, index), value| {
                        let vm = cx.vm();

                        // 1. If v is a DOMString, then follow the below steps:
                        if value.is_string() {
                            // 1. Let dataAsBytes be the result of UTF-8 encoding v.
                            let data_as_bytes =
                                String::from_utf16_lossy(&value.as_string().utf16_string().to_utf16()).into_bytes();

                            // 2. Let blobData be a Blob created using dataAsBytes with its type set to mimeType, serialized.
                            let mime_type_serialized = item.representations.borrow()[index].mime_type.clone();
                            let blob_data = allocate(vm, |_| Blob::new(data_as_bytes, mime_type_serialized));

                            // 3. Resolve p with blobData.
                            resolve_with_blob(vm, promise_realm(promise), promise, blob_data);
                        }
                        // 2. If v is a Blob, then follow the below steps:
                        if clipboard_item_data_blob(value).is_some() {
                            // 1. Resolve p with v.
                            resolve_promise(vm, promise, value);
                        }

                        Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
                    }),
                    // 2. If representationDataPromise was rejected, then:
                    Some(|cx, (promise, item, index), _| {
                        // 1. Reject p with "NotFoundError" DOMException in realm.
                        let r#type = item.representations.borrow()[index].type_string();
                        reject_promise_with_exception(cx.vm(), promise, not_found_error(&r#type));

                        Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
                    }),
                );

                // 5. Return p.
                return Ok(promise);
            }
        }

        // 9. Reject p with "NotFoundError" DOMException in realm.
        reject_promise_with_exception(vm, promise, not_found_error(&r#type));

        // 10. Return p.
        Ok(promise)
    }

    pub(crate) fn supports(_: &mut CallContext, r#type: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        Ok(Self::supports_type(&r#type))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/clipboard-apis/#dom-clipboarditem-supports
    pub(crate) fn supports_type(r#type: &Utf16String) -> bool {
        // 1. If type is in mandatory data types or optional data types, then return true.
        // 2. If not, then return false.
        // TODO: Implement optional data types, like web custom formats and image/svg+xml.
        let r#type = r#type.to_utf16();
        ["text/plain", "text/html", "image/png"]
            .iter()
            .any(|supported| r#type.iter().copied().eq(supported.encode_utf16()))
    }
}

// https://w3c.github.io/clipboard-apis/#dom-clipboarditem-gettype
fn get_type_in_parallel(vm: &Vm, steps: GetTypeInParallel) {
    let GetTypeInParallel {
        item,
        realm,
        promise,
        mime_type,
        is_custom,
    } = steps;

    // 1. Let clipboardItem be this’s originating system clipboard item.
    let clipboard_item = item.originating_system_clipboard_item.borrow();

    // 2. If clipboardItem is null, then queue a global task on the clipboard task source, given realm’s
    //    global object, to reject p with an "InvalidStateError" DOMException in realm, then abort these
    //    steps.
    let Some(clipboard_item) = clipboard_item.as_ref() else {
        queue_a_global_task(
            vm,
            realm.global_object(),
            TaskSource::Clipboard,
            promise,
            |vm, promise| {
                with_temporary_execution_context(promise_realm(promise), || {
                    reject_promise_with_exception(
                        vm,
                        promise,
                        Exception::Dom(
                            "InvalidStateError",
                            Utf16String::from_utf8(
                                "This clipboard item is missing an originating system clipboard entry",
                            ),
                        ),
                    );
                });
            },
        );
        return;
    };

    let mut os_format_name = String::new();

    // 3. If isCustom is true, then:
    if is_custom {
        // FIXME: 1. Let mapName be the os specific custom map name.
        // FIXME: 2. Let mapRepresentation be the system clipboard representation in clipboardItem’s list of system
        //           clipboard representations whose name is mapName. If there is no such system clipboard
        //           representation, then queue a global task on the clipboard task source, given realm’s global
        //           object, to reject p with a "NotFoundError" DOMException in realm, then abort these steps.
        // FIXME: 3. Let webCustomFormatMapString be the JSON string deserialized from mapRepresentation’s data.
        // FIXME: 4. Let osFormatName be the value in webCustomFormatMapString whose key matches mimeType
        //           serialized.
        // FIXME: 5. If osFormatName is not found, then queue a global task on the clipboard task source, given
        //           realm’s global object, to reject p with a "NotFoundError" DOMException in realm, then abort
        //           these steps.
    }
    // 4. Else, let osFormatName be the result of running os specific well-known format given mimeType.
    else {
        os_format_name = os_specific_well_known_format(&mime_type);
    }

    // 5. Let clipboardRepresentation be the system clipboard representation in clipboardItem’s list of
    //    system clipboard representations whose name is osFormatName. If there is no such system clipboard
    //    representation, then queue a global task on the clipboard task source, given realm’s global object,
    //    to reject p with a "NotFoundError" DOMException in realm, then abort these steps.
    let clipboard_representation = clipboard_item
        .system_clipboard_representations
        .iter()
        .find(|item| item.name == os_format_name);

    let Some(clipboard_representation) = clipboard_representation else {
        let message = Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("No data found for MIME type: {os_format_name}"));
        queue_a_global_task(
            vm,
            realm.global_object(),
            TaskSource::Clipboard,
            (promise, message),
            |vm, (promise, message)| {
                with_temporary_execution_context(promise_realm(promise), || {
                    reject_promise_with_exception(vm, promise, Exception::Dom("NotFoundError", message));
                });
            },
        );
        return;
    };

    // 6. Let rawData be clipboardRepresentation’s data.
    let raw_data = &clipboard_representation.data;

    // 7. Let cleanData be a copy of rawData.
    let clean_data = raw_data.clone();

    // FIXME: 8. If mimeType’s essence is in this’s unsanitized MIME types and mimeType’s essence is in the
    //           optional unsanitized data types list, then do nothing.
    // FIXME: 9. Else, if mimeType’s essence is not "image/png", the user agent MAY sanitize cleanData.

    // 10. Let blob be a Blob whose type is mimeType serialized and whose underlying byte sequence is cleanData.
    let blob = allocate(vm, |_| {
        Blob::new(clean_data, Utf16String::from_utf8(&mime_type.serialize()))
    });

    // 11. Queue a global task on the clipboard task source, given realm’s global object, to resolve p with blob.
    queue_a_global_task(
        vm,
        realm.global_object(),
        TaskSource::Clipboard,
        (realm, promise, blob),
        |vm, (realm, promise, blob)| {
            with_temporary_execution_context(realm, || {
                resolve_with_blob(vm, realm, promise, blob);
            });
        },
    );
}
