//! AnimationEvent, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations-2/#interface-animationevent

use core::cell::RefCell;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Visitor, Vm};
use libweb_rust::AnimationRecordRef;

use super::css_animation::CSSAnimation;
use crate::animations::animation::{Animation, AnyAnimation, animation_object};
use crate::bindings::event_target::CppEvent;
use crate::bindings::interface::Inherits;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::event::EventInit;

/// The animation an event names, as its record. The event visits what keeps the record's object, or the elements the
/// record names, alive.
/// NB: The event lets go of the record as it is finalized rather than as it is swept, after the elements the record
///     names may be gone, so that the record never outlives them alive.
pub(crate) struct EventAnimation(RefCell<Option<AnimationRecordRef>>);

impl EventAnimation {
    /// The animation of a record of it.
    pub(crate) fn of_record(animation: AnimationRecordRef) -> Self {
        Self(RefCell::new(Some(animation)))
    }

    /// The animation of an object of it.
    pub(crate) fn of_object(animation: &Animation) -> Self {
        Self::of_record(animation.record().clone())
    }

    /// The object of the animation, which a CSS animation or transition gets as script first asks for it.
    pub(crate) fn wrap(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> AnyAnimation {
        let animation = self.0.borrow();
        animation_object(
            cx.vm(),
            animation.as_ref().expect("an event that is alive holds its animation"),
        )
    }

    /// Lets go of the record, as the event is finalized.
    pub(crate) fn release(&self) {
        self.0.borrow_mut().take();
    }
}

// SAFETY: Visits the cells of the host that keep the record's object, or the elements the record names, alive.
unsafe impl Trace for EventAnimation {
    fn trace(&self, visitor: &mut Visitor) {
        if let Some(animation) = self.0.borrow().as_ref() {
            animation.for_each_host_cell(|cell, _| {
                // SAFETY: The record names live cells of the host, which the event keeps alive.
                visitor.visit(unsafe { Gc::from_non_null(cell) });
            });
        }
    }
}

/// The dictionary AnimationEventInit of CSS/AnimationEvent.idl.
pub(crate) struct AnimationEventInit {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) animation: Option<Ref<CSSAnimation>>,
    pub(crate) animation_name: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) elapsed_time: f64,
    pub(crate) pseudo_element: Utf16String,
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations-2/#interface-animationevent
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct AnimationEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    animation_name: Utf16String,
    elapsed_time: f64,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pseudo_element: Utf16String,
    animation: Option<EventAnimation>,
}

impl Wrappable for AnimationEvent {
    const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(object: Ref<Self>) {
        if let Some(animation) = &object.animation {
            animation.release();
        }
    }
}

impl AnimationEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: AnimationEventInit,
    ) -> Ref<AnimationEvent> {
        let animation = event_init
            .animation
            .as_ref()
            .map(|animation| EventAnimation::of_object(animation.parent()));
        Self::create_for_animation(vm, realm, event_name, event_init, animation)
    }

    /// A new event that names `animation` in place of the animation of `event_init`.
    pub(crate) fn create_for_animation(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: AnimationEventInit,
        animation: Option<EventAnimation>,
    ) -> Ref<AnimationEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.parent.bubbles,
            event_init.parent.cancelable,
            event_init.parent.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| AnimationEvent {
            event,
            animation_name: event_init.animation_name,
            elapsed_time: event_init.elapsed_time,
            pseudo_element: event_init.pseudo_element,
            animation,
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        animation_event_init_dict: AnimationEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AnimationEvent>> {
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &r#type, animation_event_init_dict))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    pub(crate) fn animation_name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.animation_name.clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn elapsed_time(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.elapsed_time)
    }

    pub(crate) fn pseudo_element(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.pseudo_element.clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn animation(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<AnyAnimation>> {
        Ok(self.animation.as_ref().map(|animation| animation.wrap(cx)))
    }
}

    animation: Animation,

    }

    }

        self.animation.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(object: Ref<Self>) {
        object.animation.finalize_animation();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for CSSAnimation {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl CSSAnimation {

    pub(crate) fn animation_name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.animation.record().css_animation_name())
    }
}

//! CSSConditionRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-3/#the-cssconditionrule-interface

use std::rc::Rc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::Trace;
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;

use super::css_grouping_rule::CSSGroupingRule;
use super::css_rule::{AnyCSSRule, CSSRule};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Wrappable};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSConditionRule {
    grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSConditionRule {}

impl Inherits<CSSGroupingRule> for CSSConditionRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }
}

impl CSSConditionRule {
    pub(crate) fn new(native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Self {
        Self {
            grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule::new(native_rule),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn grouping_rule(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        self.grouping_rule.rule()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-3/#dom-cssconditionrule-conditiontext
    pub(crate) fn condition_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(match self.rule().object() {
            AnyCSSRule::CSSContainerRule(object) => object.serialized_condition_text(),
            AnyCSSRule::CSSMediaRule(object) => object.serialized_condition_text(),
            AnyCSSRule::CSSSupportsRule(object) => object.serialized_condition_text(),
            _ => unreachable!("only these rules are condition rules"),
        })
    }
}

//! CSSContainerRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-5/#the-csscontainerrule-interface

use super::css_condition_rule::CSSConditionRule;
use super::css_grouping_rule::CSSGroupingRule;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_rule::{CSSRule, RuleText, serialize_block_of_rules};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use std::rc::Rc;

/// The dictionary CSSContainerCondition of CSS/CSSContainerRule.idl.
pub(crate) struct CSSContainerCondition {
    pub(crate) name: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) query: Utf16String,
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSContainerRule {
    condition_rule: CSSConditionRule,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSContainerRule);

impl Inherits<CSSConditionRule> for CSSContainerRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSConditionRule {
        &self.condition_rule
    }
}

impl CSSContainerRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            condition_rule: CSSConditionRule::new(native_rule),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        self.condition_rule.rule()
    }

    pub(crate) fn grouping_rule(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        self.condition_rule.grouping_rule()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-5/#the-csscontainerrule-interface
    pub(crate) fn serialized_condition_text(&self) -> Utf16String {
        // The conditionText attribute (defined on the CSSConditionRule parent rule), on getting, must return a value as
        // follows:

        // 1. Let conditions be the result of getting the conditions attribute.
        let conditions = self.rule().native_rule().container_conditions();

        // 2. Let first be true.
        let mut first = true;

        // 2. Let result be the empty string.
        let mut result = RuleText::default();

        // 3. For each condition in conditions:
        for condition in &conditions {
            // 1. If first is false, append ", " to result.
            if !first {
                result.push_str(", ");
            }

            // 2. Set first to false.
            first = false;

            // 3. If condition's name is not empty:
            if !condition.name.is_empty() {
                // 1. Append condition's name to result.
                result.push(&condition.name);

                // 2. If condition's query is not empty, append a single space to result.
                if !condition.query.is_empty() {
                    result.push_str(" ");
                }
            }

            // 4. Append condition's query to result.
            result.push(&condition.query);
        }

        // 5. Return result.
        result.finish()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-1/#serialize-a-css-rule
    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        // AD-HOC: The spec does not define @container serialization, so this is based on CSSMediaRule::serialized().
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@container ");
        text.push(&self.serialized_condition_text());
        serialize_block_of_rules(text, vm, self.grouping_rule().child_rules(vm))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-5/#dom-csscontainerrule-containername
    pub(crate) fn container_name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The containerName attribute, on getting, must return a value as follows:

        // 1. Let conditions be the result of getting the conditions attribute.
        let mut conditions = self.rule().native_rule().container_conditions();

        // 2. If the length of conditions is 1:
        if conditions.len() == 1 {
            // 1. Return the only condition's name.
            return Ok(conditions.swap_remove(0).name);
        }

        // 3. Return "".
        Ok(Utf16String::from_utf16(&[]))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-5/#dom-csscontainerrule-containerquery
    pub(crate) fn container_query(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The containerQuery attribute, on getting, must return a value as follows:

        // 1. Let conditions be the result of getting the conditions attribute.
        let mut conditions = self.rule().native_rule().container_conditions();

        // 2. If the length of conditions is 1:
        if conditions.len() == 1 {
            // 1. Return the only condition's query.
            return Ok(conditions.swap_remove(0).query);
        }

        // 3. Return "".
        Ok(Utf16String::from_utf16(&[]))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-5/#dom-csscontainerrule-conditions
    pub(crate) fn conditions(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Vec<CSSContainerCondition>> {
        // The conditions attribute, on getting, must return a value as follows:

        // 1. Let result be an empty list.
        // 2. For each <container-condition> condition specified in the rule:
        // 1. Let dict be a new CSSContainerCondition with name set to the serialized <container-name> of condition if
        //    specified, or "" otherwise, and query set to the <container-query> specified in condition without any
        //    logical simplifications, so that the returned query will evaluate to the same result as the specified
        //    query in any conformant implementation of this specification (including implementations that implement
        //    future extensions allowed by the <general-enclosed> extensibility mechanism in this specification). In
        //    other words, token stream simplifications are allowed (such as reducing whitespace to a single space or
        //    omitting it in cases where it is known to be optional), but logical simplifications (such as removal of
        //    unneeded parentheses, or simplification based on evaluating results) are not allowed.
        // 2. Append dict to result.
        // 3. Return result.
        Ok(self
            .rule()
            .native_rule()
            .container_conditions()
            .into_iter()
            .map(|condition| CSSContainerCondition {
                name: condition.name,
                query: condition.query,
            })
            .collect())
    }
}

        self.set_descriptor("pad", &value);
        Ok(())

    pub(crate) fn speak_as(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.rule.native_rule().counter_style_descriptor("speak-as"))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-counter-styles-3/#dom-csscounterstylerule-speakas
    pub(crate) fn set_speak_as(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.set_descriptor("speak-as", &value);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-counter-styles-3/#dom-csscounterstylerule-fallback
    pub(crate) fn fallback(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.rule.native_rule().counter_style_descriptor("fallback"))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-counter-styles-3/#dom-csscounterstylerule-fallback
    pub(crate) fn set_fallback(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.set_descriptor("fallback", &value);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, _: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        let native_rule = self.rule.native_rule();
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@counter-style ");
        text.push(&serialize_identifier(&native_rule.counter_style_name()));
        text.push_str(" {");
        for name in [
            "system",
            "negative",
            "prefix",
            "suffix",
            "range",
            "pad",
            "fallback",
            "symbols",
            "additive-symbols",
            "speak-as",
        ] {
            let value = native_rule.counter_style_descriptor(name);
            if !value.is_empty() {
                text.push_str(" ");
                text.push_str(name);
                text.push_str(": ");
                text.push(&value);
                text.push_str(";");
            }
        }
        text.push_str(" }");
        text.finish()
    }
}

//! What the interfaces of the descriptors of an at-rule share: each is a CSSStyleDeclaration with an attribute for each
//! descriptor.

/// An interface of the descriptors of an at-rule, with the entry point through which LibWeb creates its objects, and
/// the getter and the setter of each descriptor.
macro_rules! descriptors_interface {
    ($interface:ident, $create:ident, $(($getter:ident, $setter:ident, $name:literal)),+ $(,)?) => {
        #[derive(libjs_rust::api::Trace)]
        #[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
        pub(crate) struct $interface {
            declaration: $crate::css::css_style_declaration::CSSStyleDeclaration,
        }

        impl $crate::bindings::interface::Wrappable for $interface {
            fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<core::ptr::NonNull<core::ffi::c_void>> {
                self.declaration.as_cpp_parent()
            }
        }

        impl $crate::bindings::interface::Inherits<$crate::css::css_style_declaration::CSSStyleDeclaration>
            for $interface
        {
            fn parent(&self) -> &$crate::css::css_style_declaration::CSSStyleDeclaration {
                &self.declaration
            }
        }

        impl $interface {
            $(
                pub(crate) fn $getter(
                    &self,
                    _: &mut $crate::bindings::CallContext,
                ) -> $crate::bindings::WebIdlResult<ak::Utf16String> {
                    Ok(self.declaration.get($name))
                }

                pub(crate) fn $setter(
                    &self,
                    _: &mut $crate::bindings::CallContext,
                    value: ak::Utf16String,
                ) -> $crate::bindings::WebIdlResult<()> {
                    self.declaration.set($name, value)
                }
            )+
        }

        /// A new object that owns the descriptors, which LibWeb created.
        ///
        /// # Safety
        ///
        /// `vm` must be the live VM, and `descriptors` the live cell of a Web::CSS::CSSDescriptors.
        #[unsafe(no_mangle)]
        pub unsafe extern "C" fn $create(vm: *mut core::ffi::c_void, descriptors: *mut core::ffi::c_void) {
            assert!(!vm.is_null(), "C++ passes the VM");
            // SAFETY: The caller passes the live VM and a live cell.
            let (vm, descriptors) = unsafe {
                (&*vm.cast::<libjs_rust::api::Vm>(), $crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell::from_raw(descriptors))
            };
            let object = $crate::bindings::interface::allocate(vm, |_| $interface {
                declaration: $crate::css::css_style_declaration::CSSStyleDeclaration::new(descriptors),
            });
            object.declaration.set_owner(object);
        }
    };
}

pub(crate) use descriptors_interface;

//! CSSFontFaceRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#om-fontface

use super::css_font_face_descriptors::CSSFontFaceDescriptors;
use super::css_rule::CSSRule;
use super::css_rule::RuleText;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use std::rc::Rc;

/// AtRuleID::FontFace.
const FONT_FACE_AT_RULE: u8 = 0;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSFontFaceRule {
    rule: CSSRule,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSFontFaceRule);

impl Inherits<CSSRule> for CSSFontFaceRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }
}

impl CSSFontFaceRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            rule: CSSRule::new(native_rule),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfacerule-style
    pub(crate) fn style(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSFontFaceDescriptors>> {
        Ok(self.rule.declarations_object(cx))
    }

    fn descriptor(&self, name: &str) -> Option<Utf16String> {
        self.rule.native_rule().descriptor_text(FONT_FACE_AT_RULE, name)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#ref-for-cssfontfacerule
    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, _: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        // The result of concatenating the following:

        // 1. The string "@font-face {".
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@font-face {");

        // 2. If the font-family descriptor is present:
        if let Some(font_family) = self.descriptor("font-family") {
            // 1. A single SPACE (U+0020), followed by the string "font-family:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020).
            text.push_str(" font-family: ");

            // 2. The result of performing serialize a string on the rule’s font family name.
            text.push(&font_family);

            // 3. The string ";", i.e., SEMICOLON (U+003B).
            text.push_str(";");
        }

        // 3. If the rule’s associated source list is not empty, follow these substeps:
        if let Some(sources) = self.descriptor("src") {
            // 1. A single SPACE (U+0020), followed by the string "src:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020).
            text.push_str(" src: ");

            // 2. The result of invoking serialize a comma-separated list on performing serialize a URL or serialize a
            //    LOCAL for each source on the source list.
            text.push(&sources);

            // 3. The string ";", i.e., SEMICOLON (U+003B).
            text.push_str(";");
        }

        // 4. If rule’s associated unicode-range descriptor is present, a single SPACE (U+0020), followed by the string
        //    "unicode-range:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020), followed by the result of performing serialize a
        //    <'unicode-range'>, followed by the string ";", i.e., SEMICOLON (U+003B).
        self.append_descriptor(&mut text, "unicode-range", "unicode-range");

        // FIXME: 5. If rule’s associated font-variant descriptor is present, a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //        followed by the string "font-variant:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //        followed by the result of performing serialize a <'font-variant'>,
        //        followed by the string ";", i.e., SEMICOLON (U+003B).

        // 6. If rule’s associated font-feature-settings descriptor is present, a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //    followed by the string "font-feature-settings:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //    followed by the result of performing serialize a <'font-feature-settings'>,
        //    followed by the string ";", i.e., SEMICOLON (U+003B).
        self.append_descriptor(&mut text, "font-feature-settings", "font-feature-settings");

        // 7. If rule’s associated font-stretch descriptor is present, a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //    followed by the string "font-stretch:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //    followed by the result of performing serialize a <'font-stretch'>,
        //    followed by the string ";", i.e., SEMICOLON (U+003B).
        // NB: font-stretch is now an alias for font-width, so we use that instead.
        self.append_descriptor(&mut text, "font-stretch", "font-width");

        // 8. If rule’s associated font-weight descriptor is present, a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //     followed by the string "font-weight:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //     followed by the result of performing serialize a <'font-weight'>,
        //     followed by the string ";", i.e., SEMICOLON (U+003B).
        self.append_descriptor(&mut text, "font-weight", "font-weight");

        // 9. If rule’s associated font-style descriptor is present, a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //     followed by the string "font-style:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020),
        //     followed by the result of performing serialize a <'font-style'>,
        //     followed by the string ";", i.e., SEMICOLON (U+003B).
        self.append_descriptor(&mut text, "font-style", "font-style");

        // 10. A single SPACE (U+0020), followed by the string "}", i.e., RIGHT CURLY BRACKET (U+007D).
        text.push_str(" }");
        text.finish()
    }

    fn append_descriptor(&self, text: &mut RuleText, label: &str, descriptor: &str) {
        if let Some(value) = self.descriptor(descriptor) {
            text.push_str(" ");
            text.push_str(label);
            text.push_str(": ");
            text.push(&value);
            text.push_str(";");
        }
    }
}

//! CSSFontFeatureValuesMap, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#cssfontfeaturevaluesmap

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Array, Gc, Map, MarkedVec, Object, Trace, Value, Vm};
use libweb_rust::FontFeatureValuesRuleKind;

use super::css_font_feature_values_rule::CSSFontFeatureValuesRule;
use crate::bindings::conversions::ToJs;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::maplike::context_of_map;
use crate::bindings::maplike::{Maplike, WritableMaplike};
use crate::bindings::setlike::WorldEntries;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
// NB: VibratePattern is the only typedef of (unsigned long or sequence<unsigned long>), so the bindings name the union
//     after it.
use crate::notifications_api::notification::VibratePattern;

fn create_map_value(cx: &CallContext, values: &[u32]) -> Value {
    let list = MarkedVec::with_capacity(cx.vm(), values.len());
    for value in values {
        list.push(Value::from_f64(f64::from(*value)));
    }
    Value::from_object(Array::create_from(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &list.values()).upcast::<Object>())
}

fn set_map_entry(cx: &CallContext, map: Gc<Map>, name: &Utf16String, values: &[u32]) {
    let key = name.clone().to_js(cx).expect("a string converts to a JS value");
    map.map_set(cx.vm(), key, create_map_value(cx, values));
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#cssfontfeaturevaluesmap
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSFontFeatureValuesMap {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    kind: FontFeatureValuesRuleKind,
    parent_rule: Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesRule>,
    map_entries: WorldEntries<Map>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSFontFeatureValuesMap {}

impl CSSFontFeatureValuesMap {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        kind: FontFeatureValuesRuleKind,
        parent_rule: Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesRule>,
    ) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            kind,
            parent_rule,
            map_entries: WorldEntries::default(),
        })
    }

    fn max_value_count(&self) -> usize {
        match self.kind {
            FontFeatureValuesRuleKind::CharacterVariant => 2,
            FontFeatureValuesRuleKind::Styleset => usize::MAX,
            _ => 1,
        }
    }

    fn entries(&self) -> Vec<(Utf16String, Vec<u32>)> {
        self.parent_rule
            .rule()
            .native_rule()
            .font_feature_values_entries(self.kind)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#cssfontfeaturevaluesmap
    pub(crate) fn set(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        feature_value_name: Utf16String,
        values: VibratePattern,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The CSSFontFeatureValuesMap interface uses the default map class methods but the set method has different
        // behavior. It takes a sequence of unsigned integers and associates it with a given featureValueName. The
        // method behaves the same as the default map class method except that

        // A single unsigned long value is treated as a sequence of a single value.
        let values = match values {
            VibratePattern::UnsignedLong(value) => vec![value],
            VibratePattern::Sequence(values) => values,
        };

        // The method throws an exception if an invalid number of values is passed in.
        if values.is_empty() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("CSSFontFeatureValuesMap.set requires at least one value."),
            ));
        }

        // If the associated feature value block only allows a limited number of values, the set method throws an
        // InvalidAccessError exception when the input sequence to set contains more than the limited number of values.
        // See the description of multi-valued feature value definitions for details on the maximum number of values
        // allowed for a given type of feature value block.
        if values.len() > self.max_value_count() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                    "CSSFontFeatureValuesMap.set only allows a maximum of {} values for the associated feature",
                    self.max_value_count()
                )),
            ));
        }

        self.parent_rule
            .rule()
            .native_rule()
            .set_font_feature_value(self.kind, &feature_value_name, values.clone());
        self.parent_rule.clear_caches();
        self.map_entries.for_each_live(cx.vm(), |map| {
            set_map_entry(&context_of_map(cx, map), map, &feature_value_name, &values);
        });
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Maplike for CSSFontFeatureValuesMap {
    fn map_entries(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> Gc<Map> {
        self.map_entries.get_or_create(cx, || {
            let map = Map::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm());
            for (name, values) in self.entries() {
                set_map_entry(cx, map, &name, &values);
            }
            map
        })
    }

    /// NB: Each get() converts the sequence of the entry to a new JS array.
    fn map_value(&self, cx: &CallContext, key: &Utf16String) -> Option<Value> {
        self.entries()
            .into_iter()
            .find(|(name, _)| name == key)
            .map(|(_, values)| create_map_value(cx, &values))
    }
}

impl WritableMaplike for CSSFontFeatureValuesMap {
    fn map_set(&self, _: &CallContext, _: Utf16String, _: Value) {
        unreachable!("the interface declares its own set operation");
    }

    fn map_remove(&self, cx: &CallContext, key: &Utf16String) -> bool {
        let removed = self
            .parent_rule
            .rule()
            .native_rule()
            .remove_font_feature_value(self.kind, key);
        if removed {
            self.parent_rule.clear_caches();
            self.map_entries.for_each_live(cx.vm(), |map| {
                let key = key.clone().to_js(cx).expect("a string converts to a JS value");
                map.map_remove(cx.vm(), key);
            });
        }
        removed
    }

    fn map_clear(&self, cx: &CallContext) {
        self.parent_rule
            .rule()
            .native_rule()
            .clear_font_feature_values(self.kind);
        self.parent_rule.clear_caches();
        self.map_entries.for_each_live(cx.vm(), |map| {
            map.map_clear(cx.vm());
        });
    }
}

//! CSSFontFeatureValuesRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#cssfontfeaturevaluesrule

use super::css_font_feature_values_map::CSSFontFeatureValuesMap;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_rule::{AnyCSSRule, CSSRule, RuleText};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use libjs_rust::api::GcRefCell;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::FontFeatureValuesRuleKind;
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use libweb_rust::cssom::{FONT_FEATURE_VALUES_KINDS, serialize_identifier, serialize_string_value};
use std::rc::Rc;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_font_feature_values_rule_clear_caches(rule: *mut c_void);
}

/// https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace
fn is_ascii_whitespace(unit: u16) -> bool {
    matches!(unit, 0x09 | 0x0a | 0x0c | 0x0d | 0x20)
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSFontFeatureValuesRule {
    rule: CSSRule,
    /// The CSSFontFeatureValuesMaps of the rule, by the kind of its feature values.
    maps: GcRefCell<[Option<Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesMap>>; 7]>,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSFontFeatureValuesRule);

impl Inherits<CSSRule> for CSSFontFeatureValuesRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }
}

impl CSSFontFeatureValuesRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            rule: CSSRule::new(native_rule),
            maps: GcRefCell::new(Default::default()),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }

    /// Drops what the fonts of the document cached from the values of the rule.
    pub(crate) fn clear_caches(&self) {
        // SAFETY: The cell is that of this object, which is live.
        unsafe { web_css_font_feature_values_rule_clear_caches(self.rule.object().cell()) };
    }

    fn map(&self, cx: &CallContext, kind: FontFeatureValuesRuleKind) -> Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesMap> {
        let index = kind as usize;
        if let Some(map) = self.maps.borrow()[index] {
            return map;
        }
        let AnyCSSRule::CSSFontFeatureValuesRule(rule) = self.rule.object() else {
            unreachable!("this rule is a CSSFontFeatureValuesRule");
        };
        let map = CSSFontFeatureValuesMap::create(cx.vm(), kind, rule);
        self.maps.borrow_mut(cx.vm())[index] = Some(map);
        map
    }

    fn serialized_font_family(&self) -> Utf16String {
        let mut text = RuleText::default();
        for (index, family) in self
            .rule
            .native_rule()
            .font_feature_values_families()
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
        {
            if index != 0 {
                text.push_str(", ");
            }
            let units = family.to_utf16();
            if units.iter().any(|unit| is_ascii_whitespace(*unit)) {
                text.push(&serialize_string_value(family));
            } else {
                text.push(&serialize_identifier(family));
            }
        }
        text.finish()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfeaturevaluesrule-fontfamily
    pub(crate) fn font_family(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.serialized_font_family())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfeaturevaluesrule-fontfamily
    pub(crate) fn set_font_family(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let units = value.to_utf16();
        let families = units
            .split(|unit| *unit == u16::from(b','))
            .filter(|family| !family.is_empty())
            .map(|family| {
                let start = family
                    .iter()
                    .position(|unit| !is_ascii_whitespace(*unit))
                    .unwrap_or(family.len());
                let end = family
                    .iter()
                    .rposition(|unit| !is_ascii_whitespace(*unit))
                    .map_or(start, |end| end + 1);
                Utf16String::from_utf16(&family[start..end])
            })
            .collect();
        self.rule.native_rule().set_font_feature_values_families(families);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfeaturevaluesrule-annotation
    pub(crate) fn annotation(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesMap>> {
        Ok(self.map(cx, FontFeatureValuesRuleKind::Annotation))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfeaturevaluesrule-ornaments
    pub(crate) fn ornaments(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesMap>> {
        Ok(self.map(cx, FontFeatureValuesRuleKind::Ornaments))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfeaturevaluesrule-stylistic
    pub(crate) fn stylistic(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesMap>> {
        Ok(self.map(cx, FontFeatureValuesRuleKind::Stylistic))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfeaturevaluesrule-swash
    pub(crate) fn swash(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesMap>> {
        Ok(self.map(cx, FontFeatureValuesRuleKind::Swash))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfeaturevaluesrule-charactervariant
    pub(crate) fn character_variant(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesMap>> {
        Ok(self.map(cx, FontFeatureValuesRuleKind::CharacterVariant))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfeaturevaluesrule-styleset
    pub(crate) fn styleset(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesMap>> {
        Ok(self.map(cx, FontFeatureValuesRuleKind::Styleset))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#dom-cssfontfeaturevaluesrule-historicalforms
    pub(crate) fn historical_forms(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesMap>> {
        Ok(self.map(cx, FontFeatureValuesRuleKind::HistoricalForms))
    }

    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, _: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@font-feature-values ");
        text.push(&self.serialized_font_family());
        text.push_str(" {");
        for (kind, at_rule_name) in FONT_FEATURE_VALUES_KINDS {
            let entries = self.rule.native_rule().font_feature_values_entries(kind);
            if entries.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            text.push_str("  @");
            text.push_str(at_rule_name);
            text.push_str(" {");
            for (name, values) in entries {
                text.push_str(" ");
                text.push(&serialize_identifier(&name));
                text.push_str(":");
                for value in values {
                    text.push_str(&format!(" {value}"));
                }
                text.push_str(";");
            }
            text.push_str(" }");
        }
        text.push_str(" }");
        text.finish()
    }
}

//! CSSFunctionRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-mixins-1/#cssfunctionrule

use super::css_grouping_rule::CSSGroupingRule;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_rule::{CSSRule, RuleText, serialized_rules};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use std::rc::Rc;

/// The dictionary FunctionParameter of CSS/CSSFunctionRule.idl.
pub(crate) struct FunctionParameter {
    pub(crate) name: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) r#type: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) default_value: Option<Utf16String>,
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSFunctionRule {
    grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSFunctionRule);

impl Inherits<CSSGroupingRule> for CSSFunctionRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }
}

impl CSSFunctionRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule::new(native_rule),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        self.grouping_rule.rule()
    }

    pub(crate) fn grouping_rule(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-mixins-1/#dom-cssfunctionrule-name
    pub(crate) fn name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.rule().native_rule().function_name())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-mixins-1/#dom-cssfunctionrule-getparameters
    pub(crate) fn get_parameters(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Vec<FunctionParameter>> {
        Ok(self
            .rule()
            .native_rule()
            .function_parameters()
            .into_iter()
            .map(|parameter| FunctionParameter {
                name: parameter.name,
                r#type: parameter.parameter_type,
                default_value: parameter.default_value,
            })
            .collect())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-mixins-1/#dom-cssfunctionrule-returntype
    pub(crate) fn return_type(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.rule().native_rule().function_return_type())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-mixins-1/#serialize-a-cssfunctionrule
    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        // NB: The native rule serializes steps 1 to 5, which read only what it holds.
        let mut text = RuleText::default();
        text.push(&self.rule().native_rule().function_prelude_text());

        // 6. A single SPACE (U+0020), followed by a LEFT CURLY BRACKET (U+007B).
        text.push_str(" {");

        // 7. The result of performing serialize a CSS rule on each rule in cssRules, filtering out empty strings, each
        //    preceded by a single SPACE (U+0020).
        for rule in serialized_rules(vm, self.grouping_rule.child_rules(vm)) {
            text.push_str(" ");
            text.push(&rule);
        }

        // 8. A single SPACE (U+0020), followed by a single RIGHT CURLY BRACKET (U+007D).
        text.push_str(" }");
        text.finish()
    }
}

//! CSSGroupingRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-cssgroupingrule-interface

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::rc::Rc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::{NativeRule, RuleInsertionResult, RuleRemovalResult};

use super::css_rule::CSSRule;
use super::css_rule_list::CSSRuleList;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_grouping_rule_parse_rule(
        rule: *mut c_void,
        text: usize,
        declarations_failed: *mut bool,
    ) -> *const c_void;
    fn web_css_grouping_rule_inserted(rule: *mut c_void, inserted: *const c_void);
    fn web_css_grouping_rule_removed(rule: *mut c_void, removed: *const c_void);
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSGroupingRule {
    rule: CSSRule,
    /// The list of the child rules, which the first read makes, as most style rules nest none.
    rules: GcRefCell<Option<Ref<CSSRuleList>>>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSGroupingRule {}

impl Inherits<CSSRule> for CSSGroupingRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }
}

pub(crate) fn insertion_error(result: RuleInsertionResult) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    match result {
        RuleInsertionResult::Success => Ok(()),
        RuleInsertionResult::IndexSizeError => Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(
            "CSS rule index out of bounds.",
        ))),
        RuleInsertionResult::HierarchyRequestError => Err(Exception::Dom(
            "HierarchyRequestError",
            Utf16String::from_utf8("Cannot insert rule at specified index."),
        )),
        RuleInsertionResult::InvalidStateError => Err(Exception::Dom(
            "InvalidStateError",
            Utf16String::from_utf8("Cannot insert @namespace rule into a stylesheet with non-namespace/import rules"),
        )),
    }
}

/// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#remove-a-css-rule
pub(crate) fn validate_rule_removal(result: RuleRemovalResult) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    match result {
        RuleRemovalResult::Success => Ok(()),
        RuleRemovalResult::IndexSizeError => Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(
            "CSS rule index out of bounds.",
        ))),
        RuleRemovalResult::InvalidStateError => Err(Exception::Dom(
            "InvalidStateError",
            Utf16String::from_utf8("Cannot remove @namespace rule from a stylesheet with non-namespace/import rules."),
        )),
    }
}

impl CSSGroupingRule {
    pub(crate) fn new(native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Self {
        Self {
            rule: CSSRule::new(native_rule),
            rules: GcRefCell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }

    pub(crate) fn existing_css_rules(&self) -> Option<Ref<CSSRuleList>> {
        *self.rules.borrow()
    }

    pub(crate) fn child_rules(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Ref<CSSRuleList> {
        if let Some(rules) = self.existing_css_rules() {
            return rules;
        }
        let native_rules = self
            .rule
            .native_rule()
            .cssom_children()
            .expect("a grouping rule has child rules");
        let rules = CSSRuleList::create_for_rule(vm, native_rules, self.rule.object());
        *self.rules.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(rules);
        rules
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssgroupingrule-cssrules
    pub(crate) fn css_rules(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSRuleList>> {
        Ok(self.child_rules(cx.vm()))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssgroupingrule-insertrule
    pub(crate) fn insert_rule(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, rule: Utf16String, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // The insertRule(rule, index) method must return the result of invoking insert a CSS rule rule into the child
        // CSS rules at index, with the nested flag set.
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rules = self.child_rules(vm);

        // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#insert-a-css-rule
        // 1. Set length to the number of items in list.
        let length = rules.native_length();

        // 2. If index is greater than length, then throw an IndexSizeError exception.
        if index as usize > length {
            return Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(
                "CSS rule index out of bounds.",
            )));
        }

        // 3. Set new rule to the results of performing parse a CSS rule on argument rule.
        // 4. If new rule is a syntax error, and nested is set, perform the following substeps:
        let object = self.rule.object();
        let mut declarations_failed = false;
        // SAFETY: The cell is that of this object, the text is handed over, and the out pointer is valid.
        let new_rule =
            unsafe { web_css_grouping_rule_parse_rule(object.cell(), rule.into_raw(), &raw mut declarations_failed) };

        // 5. If new rule is a syntax error, throw a SyntaxError exception.
        if new_rule.is_null() {
            let message = if declarations_failed {
                "Unable to parse CSS declarations block."
            } else {
                "Unable to parse CSS rule."
            };
            return Err(Exception::syntax_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(message)));
        }
        // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over a reference to the rule.
        let new_rule = unsafe { Rc::from_raw(new_rule.cast::<NativeRule>()) };

        insertion_error(
            rules
                .native_rules()
                .cssom_insert_rule(index as usize, Rc::clone(&new_rule), true),
        )?;

        // SAFETY: The cell is that of this object, and the rule is live.
        unsafe { web_css_grouping_rule_inserted(object.cell(), Rc::as_ptr(&new_rule).cast()) };
        Ok(index)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssgroupingrule-deleterule
    pub(crate) fn delete_rule(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The deleteRule(index) method must remove a CSS rule from the child CSS rules at index.
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rules = self.child_rules(vm);
        let index = index as usize;
        validate_rule_removal(rules.native_rules().cssom_validate_removal(index))?;
        let removed_rule = rules.native_rules().cssom_rule_at(index);
        rules.remove_a_css_rule_without_validation(vm, index);

        // SAFETY: The cell is that of this object, and the rule is live.
        unsafe { web_css_grouping_rule_removed(self.rule.object().cell(), Rc::as_ptr(&removed_rule).cast()) };
        Ok(())
    }
}

//! CSSImageValue, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssimagevalue

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::RetainedStyleValue;

use super::css_style_value::{AnyCSSStyleValue, CSSStyleValue, PerformTypeCheck};
use super::typed_om::{self, TypedOmValueType};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{Exception, WebIdlResult};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSImageValue {
    style_value: CSSStyleValue,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSImageValue {}

impl Inherits<CSSStyleValue> for CSSImageValue {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        &self.style_value
    }
}

impl CSSImageValue {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, source_value: RetainedStyleValue) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            style_value: CSSStyleValue::with_source(source_value),
        });
        object
            .style_value
            .set_object(vm, AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSImageValue(object));
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn style_value(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        &self.style_value
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
    pub(crate) fn create_an_internal_representation(
        &self,
        property_id: u16,
        property_name: &Utf16String,
        perform_type_check: PerformTypeCheck,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        // If value is a CSSStyleValue subclass,
        //     If value does not match the grammar of a list-valued property iteration of property, throw a TypeError.
        // NB: https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssstylevalue-match-a-grammar doesn't list CSSImageValue,
        //     but we should match <image>.
        if perform_type_check == PerformTypeCheck::Yes
            && !typed_om::property_accepts_type(property_id, TypedOmValueType::Image)
        {
            return Err(Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                "Property '{}' does not accept <image>",
                typed_om::to_rust_string(property_name)
            ))));
        }

        //     FIXME: If any component of property’s CSS grammar has a limited numeric range, and the corresponding part
        //            of value is a CSSUnitValue that is outside of that range, replace that value with the result of
        //            wrapping it in a fresh CSSMathSum whose values internal slot contains only that part of value.

        //     Return the value.
        Ok(self
            .style_value
            .source_value()
            .expect("a CSSImageValue has a source value")
            .clone())
    }
}

//! CSSImportRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-cssimportrule-interface

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::null_mut;
use std::rc::Rc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;

use super::css_rule::{AnyCSSRule, CSSRule, RuleText, impl_rule_wrappable, selector_list_text};
use super::css_style_sheet::CSSStyleSheet;
use super::media_list::MediaList;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate, cell_from_abi};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_import_create(rule: *const c_void, document: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_import_set_rule(import: *mut c_void, rule: *mut c_void);
    fn web_css_import_set_parent_style_sheet(import: *mut c_void, sheet: *mut c_void);
    fn web_css_import_href(import: *mut c_void) -> usize;
    fn web_css_import_url_text(import: *mut c_void) -> usize;
    fn web_css_import_media(import: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_import_style_sheet(import: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSImportRule {
    rule: CSSRule,
    /// The cell that holds the Web::CSS::StyleSheetImport, which loads the sheet.
    import: CppCell,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSImportRule);

impl Inherits<CSSRule> for CSSImportRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }
}

impl CSSImportRule {
    /// The object of a rule that C++ does not load yet.
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>, document: Option<&CppCell>) -> Ref<Self> {
        let document = document.map_or(null_mut(), CppCell::as_ptr);
        // SAFETY: The rule is live, and the cell is that of a live Document, or null.
        let import = unsafe { web_css_import_create(Rc::as_ptr(&native_rule).cast(), document) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns a live cell.
        let import = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(import) };
        Self::create_for_import(vm, native_rule, import)
    }

    /// The object of a rule that the import loads.
    pub(crate) fn create_for_import(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>, import: CppCell) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            rule: CSSRule::new(native_rule),
            import,
        })
    }

    /// Tells the import of the object that the object is its rule.
    pub(crate) fn finish(object: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm) -> AnyCSSRule {
        let any = AnyCSSRule::CSSImportRule(object);
        any.set_object(vm, any);
        // SAFETY: Both cells are live.
        unsafe { web_css_import_set_rule(object.import.as_ptr(), any.cell()) };
        any
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }

    pub(crate) fn import_cell(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.import.as_ptr()
    }

    pub(crate) fn parent_style_sheet_changed(&self, sheet: Option<&CppCell>) {
        let sheet = sheet.map_or(null_mut(), CppCell::as_ptr);
        // SAFETY: The cells are live, or the sheet is null.
        unsafe { web_css_import_set_parent_style_sheet(self.import.as_ptr(), sheet) };
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssimportrule-href
    pub(crate) fn href(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let href = unsafe { web_css_import_href(self.import.as_ptr()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over the string.
        Ok(unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(href) })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssimportrule-media
    pub(crate) fn media(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<MediaList>> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let media = unsafe { web_css_import_media(self.import.as_ptr()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live cell of a MediaList.
        Ok(unsafe { cell_from_abi(media) })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssimportrule-stylesheet
    pub(crate) fn style_sheet(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<CSSStyleSheet>>> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let sheet = unsafe { web_css_import_style_sheet(self.import.as_ptr()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live cell of a CSSStyleSheet, or null.
        Ok((!sheet.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { cell_from_abi(sheet) }))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssimportrule-layername
    pub(crate) fn layer_name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        // The layerName attribute must return the layer name declared in the at-rule itself, or an empty string if the
        // layer is anonymous, or null if the at-rule does not declare a layer.
        Ok(self.rule.native_rule().import_layer())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssimportrule-supportstext
    pub(crate) fn supports_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        // The supportsText attribute must return the <supports-condition> declared in the at-rule itself, or null if
        // the at-rule does not declare a supports condition.
        Ok(self.rule.native_rule().import_supports_text())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-rule
    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, _: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        let native_rule = self.rule.native_rule();

        // The result of concatenating the following:

        // 1. The string "@import" followed by a single SPACE (U+0020).
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@import ");

        // 2. The result of performing serialize a URL on the rule’s location.
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let url = unsafe { web_css_import_url_text(self.import.as_ptr()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over the string.
        text.push(&unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(url) });

        // AD-HOC: Serialize the rule's layer if it exists.
        if let Some(layer) = native_rule.import_layer() {
            if layer.is_empty() {
                text.push_str(" layer");
            } else {
                text.push_str(" layer(");
                text.push(&layer);
                text.push_str(")");
            }
        }

        // AD-HOC: Serialize the rule's import scope if it exists.
        if let Some((start, end)) = native_rule.scope_selector_lists() {
            text.push_str(" scope");
            if !start.is_null() || !end.is_null() {
                text.push_str("(");
                if !start.is_null() {
                    let start_text = selector_list_text(start, None);
                    if end.is_null() {
                        text.push(&start_text);
                    } else {
                        text.push_str("(");
                        text.push(&start_text);
                        text.push_str(")");
                    }
                }
                if !end.is_null() {
                    if !start.is_null() {
                        text.push_str(" ");
                    }
                    text.push_str("to (");
                    text.push(&selector_list_text(end, None));
                    text.push_str(")");
                }
                text.push_str(")");
            }
        }

        // AD-HOC: Serialize the rule's supports condition if it exists.
        //         This isn't currently specified, but major browsers include this in their serialization of import
        //         rules
        if let Some(supports) = native_rule.import_supports_text() {
            text.push_str(" supports(");
            text.push(&supports);
            text.push_str(")");
        }

        // 3. If the rule’s associated media list is not empty, a single SPACE (U+0020) followed by the result of
        //    performing serialize a media query list on the media list.
        let media = native_rule.media_list();
        if media.length() != 0 {
            text.push_str(" ");
            text.push(&media.media_text());
        }

        // 4. The string ";", i.e., SEMICOLON (U+003B).
        text.push_str(";");
        text.finish()
    }
}

//! CSSKeyframeRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#interface-csskeyframerule

use super::css_rule::CSSRule;
use super::css_rule::RuleText;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_style_properties::CSSStyleProperties;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use libweb_rust::typed_om::serialize_a_number;
use std::rc::Rc;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSKeyframeRule {
    rule: CSSRule,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSKeyframeRule);

impl Inherits<CSSRule> for CSSKeyframeRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }
}

impl CSSKeyframeRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            rule: CSSRule::new(native_rule),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }

    fn serialized_key_text(&self) -> Utf16String {
        let mut text = String::new();
        for (index, key) in self.rule.native_rule().keyframe_keys().iter().enumerate() {
            if index != 0 {
                text.push_str(", ");
            }
            serialize_a_number(&mut text, *key);
            text.push('%');
        }
        Utf16String::from_utf8(&text)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#dom-csskeyframerule-keytext
    pub(crate) fn key_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.serialized_key_text())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#dom-csskeyframerule-keytext
    pub(crate) fn set_key_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext, _: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // FIXME: Parse the value as a keyframe selector and replace the keys of the rule with it.
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#dom-csskeyframerule-style
    pub(crate) fn style(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSStyleProperties>> {
        Ok(self.rule.declarations_object(cx))
    }

    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        let mut text = RuleText::default();
        text.push(&self.serialized_key_text());
        text.push_str(" { ");
        text.push(&self.rule.serialized_declarations(vm));
        text.push_str(" }");
        text.finish()
    }
}

//! CSSKeyframesRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#interface-csskeyframesrule

use super::css_keyframe_rule::CSSKeyframeRule;
use super::css_rule::CSSRule;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_rule::{AnyCSSRule, RuleText};
use super::css_rule_list::CSSRuleList;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use libjs_rust::api::GcRefCell;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use libweb_rust::cssom::{is_valid_animation_name, serialize_identifier, serialize_string_value};
use std::rc::Rc;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_keyframes_rule_changed(rule: *mut c_void);
    fn web_css_keyframes_rule_will_rename(rule: *mut c_void);
    fn web_css_keyframes_rule_renamed(rule: *mut c_void);
    fn web_css_parse_keyframe_rule(text: usize) -> *const c_void;
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSKeyframesRule {
    rule: CSSRule,
    rules: GcRefCell<Option<Ref<CSSRuleList>>>,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSKeyframesRule);

impl Inherits<CSSRule> for CSSKeyframesRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }
}

impl CSSKeyframesRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            rule: CSSRule::new(native_rule),
            rules: GcRefCell::new(None),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }

    pub(crate) fn existing_css_rules(&self) -> Option<Ref<CSSRuleList>> {
        *self.rules.borrow()
    }

    pub(crate) fn child_rules(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Ref<CSSRuleList> {
        if let Some(rules) = self.existing_css_rules() {
            return rules;
        }
        let native_rules = self
            .rule
            .native_rule()
            .cssom_children()
            .expect("a @keyframes rule has keyframes");
        let rules = CSSRuleList::create_for_rule(vm, native_rules, self.rule.object());
        *self.rules.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(rules);
        rules
    }

    fn native_length(&self) -> usize {
        self.rule
            .native_rule()
            .cssom_children()
            .expect("a @keyframes rule has keyframes")
            .cssom_length()
    }

    fn keyframe(&self, vm: &Vm, index: usize) -> Option<Ref<CSSKeyframeRule>> {
        if index >= self.native_length() {
            return None;
        }
        match self.child_rules(vm).rule_at(vm, index) {
            AnyCSSRule::CSSKeyframeRule(keyframe) => Some(keyframe),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    fn keyframes_changed(&self) {
        if self.rule.parent_sheet().is_some() {
            // SAFETY: The cell is that of this object, which is live.
            unsafe { web_css_keyframes_rule_changed(self.rule.object().cell()) };
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#dom-csskeyframesrule-name
    pub(crate) fn name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.rule.native_rule().keyframes_name())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#dom-csskeyframesrule-name
    pub(crate) fn set_name(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let native_rule = self.rule.native_rule();
        if native_rule.keyframes_name() == value {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let cell = self.rule.object().cell();
        // SAFETY: The cell is that of this object, which is live.
        unsafe { web_css_keyframes_rule_will_rename(cell) };
        native_rule.set_keyframes_name(&value);
        // SAFETY: The cell is that of this object, which is live.
        unsafe { web_css_keyframes_rule_renamed(cell) };
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#dom-csskeyframesrule-cssrules
    pub(crate) fn css_rules(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSRuleList>> {
        Ok(self.child_rules(cx.vm()))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#dom-csskeyframesrule-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(u32::try_from(self.native_length()).expect("a rule has fewer than 2^32 keyframes"))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#interface-csskeyframesrule
    pub(crate) fn item(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSKeyframeRule>> {
        Ok(self
            .keyframe(cx.vm(), index as usize)
            .expect("the bindings check the index"))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations/#interface-csskeyframesrule-appendrule
    pub(crate) fn append_rule(&self, _: &mut CallContext, rule: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The appendRule method appends the passed CSSKeyframeRule at the end of the keyframes rule.
        // SAFETY: The string is handed over.
        let parsed_rule = unsafe { web_css_parse_keyframe_rule(rule.into_raw()) };
        if parsed_rule.is_null() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over a reference to the rule.
        let parsed_rule = unsafe { Rc::from_raw(parsed_rule.cast::<NativeRule>()) };
        let children = self
            .rule
            .native_rule()
            .cssom_children()
            .expect("a @keyframes rule has keyframes");
        children.cssom_append_rule(parsed_rule);
        self.keyframes_changed();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations-1/#interface-csskeyframesrule-deleterule
    pub(crate) fn delete_rule(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, select: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The deleteRule method deletes the last declared CSSKeyframeRule matching the specified keyframe selector. If
        // no matching rule exists, the method does nothing.
        let native_rule = self.rule.native_rule();
        let Some(index) = native_rule.find_keyframe(&select) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        if let Some(rules) = self.existing_css_rules() {
            rules.remove_a_css_rule_without_validation(cx.vm(), index);
        } else {
            native_rule
                .cssom_children()
                .expect("a @keyframes rule has keyframes")
                .cssom_remove(index);
        }
        self.keyframes_changed();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations-1/#interface-csskeyframesrule-findrule
    pub(crate) fn find_rule(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        select: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<CSSKeyframeRule>>> {
        // The findRule returns the last declared CSSKeyframeRule matching the specified keyframe selector. If no
        // matching rule exists, the method does nothing.
        let index = self.rule.native_rule().find_keyframe(&select);
        Ok(index.and_then(|index| self.keyframe(cx.vm(), index)))
    }

    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@keyframes ");

        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations-1/#keyframes
        // When serialized, the value is serialized as an <ident> unless it’s a disallowed keyword, in which case
        // it’s serialized as a <string>.
        let name = self.rule.native_rule().keyframes_name();
        if is_valid_animation_name(&name) {
            text.push(&serialize_identifier(&name));
        } else {
            text.push(&serialize_string_value(&name));
        }

        text.push_str(" { ");
        let rules = self.child_rules(vm);
        for index in 0..rules.native_length() {
            text.push(&rules.rule_at(vm, index).serialized(vm));
            text.push_str(" ");
        }
        text.push_str("}");
        text.finish()
    }
}

//! CSSKeywordValue, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#csskeywordvalue

use core::cell::RefCell;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{RetainedStyleValue, serialize_an_identifier};

use super::css_style_value::{AnyCSSStyleValue, CSSStyleValue, PerformTypeCheck};
use super::typed_om;
use crate::bindings::conversions::UsvString;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

/// The union (DOMString or CSSKeywordValue) of CSS/CSSKeywordValue.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum CSSKeywordish {
    DOMString(#[gc(untraced)] Utf16String),
    CSSKeywordValue(Ref<CSSKeywordValue>),
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSKeywordValue {
    style_value: CSSStyleValue,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    value: RefCell<Utf16String>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSKeywordValue {}

impl Inherits<CSSStyleValue> for CSSKeywordValue {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        &self.style_value
    }
}

impl CSSKeywordValue {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, value: Utf16String) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            style_value: CSSStyleValue::empty(),
            value: RefCell::new(value),
        });
        object
            .style_value
            .set_object(vm, AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSKeywordValue(object));
        object
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csskeywordvalue-csskeywordvalue
    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext, value: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. If value is an empty string, throw a TypeError.
        let value = value.into_utf16_string();
        if value.is_empty() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "Cannot create a CSSKeywordValue with an empty string as the value",
            ));
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, return a new CSSKeywordValue with its value internal slot set to value.
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), value))
    }

    pub(crate) fn style_value(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        &self.style_value
    }

    pub(crate) fn raw_value(&self) -> Utf16String {
        self.value.borrow().clone()
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csskeywordvalue-value
    pub(crate) fn value(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.raw_value())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csskeywordvalue-value
    pub(crate) fn set_value(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If value is an empty string, throw a TypeError.
        let value = value.into_utf16_string();
        if value.is_empty() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "Cannot set CSSKeywordValue.value to an empty string",
            ));
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, set this’s value internal slot, to value.
        *self.value.borrow_mut() = value;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#keywordvalue-serialization
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self) -> Utf16String {
        // To serialize a CSSKeywordValue this:
        // 1. Return this’s value internal slot.
        // AD-HOC: Serialize it as an identifier. Spec issue: https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/12545
        serialize_an_identifier(&self.value.borrow())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
    pub(crate) fn create_an_internal_representation(
        &self,
        property_id: u16,
        property_name: &Utf16String,
        perform_type_check: PerformTypeCheck,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        // If value is a CSSStyleValue subclass,
        //     If value does not match the grammar of a list-valued property iteration of property, throw a TypeError.
        // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssstylevalue-match-a-grammar
        // A CSSKeywordValue matches an <ident> specified in a grammar if its value internal slot matches the
        // identifier.
        // If case-folding rules are in effect normally for that <ident> (such as Auto matching the keyword auto
        // specified in the grammar for width), they apply to this comparison as well.
        //
        //     If any component of property’s CSS grammar has a limited numeric range, and the corresponding part of
        //     value is a CSSUnitValue that is outside of that range, replace that value with the result of wrapping it
        //     in a fresh CSSMathSum whose values internal slot contains only that part of value.
        // NB: Non-applicable.
        //
        //     Return the value.
        let value = self.value.borrow();
        typed_om::keyword_style_value_for_property(property_id, &value, perform_type_check).ok_or_else(|| {
            Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                "Property '{}' does not accept the keyword '{}'",
                typed_om::to_rust_string(property_name),
                typed_om::to_rust_string(&value)
            )))
        })
    }
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#rectify-a-keywordish-value
pub(crate) fn rectify_a_keywordish_value(vm: &Vm, keywordish: &CSSKeywordish) -> Ref<CSSKeywordValue> {
    // To rectify a keywordish value val, perform the following steps:
    match keywordish {
        // 1. If val is a CSSKeywordValue, return val.
        CSSKeywordish::CSSKeywordValue(value) => *value,
        // 2. If val is a DOMString, return a new CSSKeywordValue with its value internal slot set to val.
        CSSKeywordish::DOMString(value) => CSSKeywordValue::create(vm, value.clone()),
    }
}

//! CSSLayerBlockRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade-5/#the-csslayerblockrule-interface

use super::css_grouping_rule::CSSGroupingRule;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_rule::{AnyCSSRule, CSSRule, RuleText};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use std::rc::Rc;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSLayerBlockRule {
    grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSLayerBlockRule);

impl Inherits<CSSGroupingRule> for CSSLayerBlockRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }
}

impl CSSLayerBlockRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule::new(native_rule),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        self.grouping_rule.rule()
    }

    pub(crate) fn grouping_rule(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }

    fn layer_name(&self) -> Utf16String {
        self.rule().native_rule().layer_names().swap_remove(0)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade-5/#dom-csslayerblockrule-name
    pub(crate) fn name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.layer_name())
    }

    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        // AD-HOC: No spec yet, so this is based on the @media serialization algorithm.
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@layer");
        let name = self.layer_name();
        if !name.is_empty() {
            text.push_str(" ");
            text.push(&name);
        }
        text.push_str(" {\n");

        // AD-HOC: All modern browsers omit the ending newline if there are no CSS rules, so let's do the same.
        let rules = self.grouping_rule.child_rules(vm);
        if rules.native_length() == 0 {
            text.push_str("}");
            return text.finish();
        }
        for index in 0..rules.native_length() {
            if index != 0 {
                text.push_str("\n");
            }
            text.push_str("  ");
            text.push(&AnyCSSRule::serialized(rules.rule_at(vm, index), vm));
        }
        text.push_str("\n}");
        text.finish()
    }
}
