impl From<AnyCSSNumericValue> for AnyCSSStyleValue {
    fn from(value: AnyCSSNumericValue) -> Self {
        match value {
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSNumericValue(object) => Self::CSSNumericValue(object),
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathClamp(object) => Self::CSSMathClamp(object),
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathInvert(object) => Self::CSSMathInvert(object),
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMax(object) => Self::CSSMathMax(object),
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMin(object) => Self::CSSMathMin(object),
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathNegate(object) => Self::CSSMathNegate(object),
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathProduct(object) => Self::CSSMathProduct(object),
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathSum(object) => Self::CSSMathSum(object),
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathValue(object) => Self::CSSMathValue(object),
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(object) => Self::CSSUnitValue(object),
        }
    }
}

impl Deref for AnyCSSNumericValue {
    type Target = CSSNumericValue;

    fn deref(&self) -> &CSSNumericValue {
        match self {
            Self::CSSNumericValue(object) => object,
            Self::CSSMathClamp(object) => object.math_value().parent(),
            Self::CSSMathInvert(object) => object.math_value().parent(),
            Self::CSSMathMax(object) => object.math_value().parent(),
            Self::CSSMathMin(object) => object.math_value().parent(),
            Self::CSSMathNegate(object) => object.math_value().parent(),
            Self::CSSMathProduct(object) => object.math_value().parent(),
            Self::CSSMathSum(object) => object.math_value().parent(),
            Self::CSSMathValue(object) => <CSSMathValue as Inherits<CSSNumericValue>>::parent(object),
            Self::CSSUnitValue(object) => <CSSUnitValue as Inherits<CSSNumericValue>>::parent(object),
        }
    }
}

impl ToJs for AnyCSSNumericValue {
    fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {
        Ok(Value::from_object(match self {
            Self::CSSNumericValue(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSMathClamp(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSMathInvert(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSMathMax(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSMathMin(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSMathNegate(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSMathProduct(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSMathSum(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSMathValue(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSUnitValue(object) => wrap(cx, object),
        }))
    }
}

/// The arguments of the serialization of a CSSNumericValue,
/// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssnumericvalue
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub(crate) struct SerializationParams {
    pub(crate) minimum: Option<f64>,
    pub(crate) maximum: Option<f64>,
    pub(crate) nested: bool,
    pub(crate) parenless: bool,
}

impl AnyCSSNumericValue {
    /// The object as the unit value that it is, if it is one.
    pub(crate) fn as_unit_value(&self) -> Option<Ref<CSSUnitValue>> {
        match self {
            Self::CSSUnitValue(object) => Some(*object),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn numeric_value_style_value(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        self.deref().parent()
    }

    /// Tells the part of the object that all CSSStyleValues have which object it is the part of.
    pub(crate) fn finish(self, vm: &Vm) -> Self {
        self.numeric_value_style_value().set_object(vm, self.into());
        self
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#equal-numeric-value
    pub(crate) fn is_equal_numeric_value(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        // 1. If value1 and value2 are not members of the same interface, return false.
        // NB: The steps of each interface return false for an object of another.
        match (self, other) {
            (Self::CSSUnitValue(first), Self::CSSUnitValue(second)) => first.is_equal_unit_value(second),
            (Self::CSSMathSum(first), Self::CSSMathSum(second)) => {
                first.numeric_array().is_equal_numeric_values(&second.numeric_array())
            }
            (Self::CSSMathProduct(first), Self::CSSMathProduct(second)) => {
                first.numeric_array().is_equal_numeric_values(&second.numeric_array())
            }
            (Self::CSSMathMin(first), Self::CSSMathMin(second)) => {
                first.numeric_array().is_equal_numeric_values(&second.numeric_array())
            }
            (Self::CSSMathMax(first), Self::CSSMathMax(second)) => {
                first.numeric_array().is_equal_numeric_values(&second.numeric_array())
            }
            // 4. Assert: value1 and value2 are both CSSMathNegates or CSSMathInverts.
            // 5. Return whether value1’s value and value2’s value are equal numeric values.
            (Self::CSSMathNegate(first), Self::CSSMathNegate(second)) => {
                first.inner_value().is_equal_numeric_value(&second.inner_value())
            }
            (Self::CSSMathInvert(first), Self::CSSMathInvert(second)) => {
                first.inner_value().is_equal_numeric_value(&second.inner_value())
            }
            (Self::CSSMathClamp(first), Self::CSSMathClamp(second)) => first.is_equal_clamp(second),
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-a-sum-value
    pub(crate) fn create_a_sum_value(&self) -> Option<SumValue> {
        match self {
            Self::CSSNumericValue(_) | Self::CSSMathValue(_) => {
                unreachable!("no object is only of an abstract interface")
            }
            Self::CSSMathClamp(object) => object.create_a_sum_value(),
            Self::CSSMathInvert(object) => object.create_a_sum_value(),
            Self::CSSMathMax(object) => object.create_a_sum_value(),
            Self::CSSMathMin(object) => object.create_a_sum_value(),
            Self::CSSMathNegate(object) => object.create_a_sum_value(),
            Self::CSSMathProduct(object) => object.create_a_sum_value(),
            Self::CSSMathSum(object) => object.create_a_sum_value(),
            Self::CSSUnitValue(object) => Some(object.create_a_sum_value()),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_calculation_node(&self) -> WebIdlResult<Arc<CalcNode>> {
        match self {
            Self::CSSNumericValue(_) | Self::CSSMathValue(_) => {
                unreachable!("no object is only of an abstract interface")
            }
            Self::CSSMathClamp(object) => object.create_calculation_node(),
            Self::CSSMathInvert(object) => object.create_calculation_node(),
            Self::CSSMathMax(object) => object.create_calculation_node(),
            Self::CSSMathMin(object) => object.create_calculation_node(),
            Self::CSSMathNegate(object) => object.create_calculation_node(),
            Self::CSSMathProduct(object) => object.create_calculation_node(),
            Self::CSSMathSum(object) => object.create_calculation_node(),
            Self::CSSUnitValue(object) => object.create_calculation_node(),
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssnumericvalue
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self, s: &mut String, params: SerializationParams) {
        // To serialize a CSSNumericValue this, given an optional minimum, a numeric value, and optional maximum, a
        // numeric value:
        // 1. If this is a CSSUnitValue, serialize a CSSUnitValue from this, passing minimum and maximum. Return the
        //    result.
        // 2. Otherwise, serialize a CSSMathValue from this, and return the result.
        let (nested, parenless) = (params.nested, params.parenless);
        match self {
            Self::CSSNumericValue(_) | Self::CSSMathValue(_) => {
                unreachable!("no object is only of an abstract interface")
            }
            Self::CSSUnitValue(object) => object.serialize_unit_value(s, params.minimum, params.maximum),
            Self::CSSMathClamp(object) => object.serialize_math_value(s),
            Self::CSSMathInvert(object) => object.serialize_math_value(s, nested, parenless),
            Self::CSSMathMax(object) => object.serialize_math_value(s),
            Self::CSSMathMin(object) => object.serialize_math_value(s),
            Self::CSSMathNegate(object) => object.serialize_math_value(s, nested, parenless),
            Self::CSSMathProduct(object) => object.serialize_math_value(s, nested, parenless),
            Self::CSSMathSum(object) => object.serialize_math_value(s, nested, parenless),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn to_string_with(self, params: SerializationParams) -> String {
        let mut s = String::new();
        self.serialize(&mut s, params);
        s
    }

    pub(crate) fn to_css_string(self) -> Utf16String {
        Utf16String::from_utf8(&self.to_string_with(SerializationParams::default()))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
    pub(crate) fn math_value_internal_representation(
        &self,
        property_id: u16,
        perform_type_check: PerformTypeCheck,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        // If value is a CSSStyleValue subclass,
        //     If value does not match the grammar of a list-valued property iteration of property, throw a TypeError.
        //
        //     If any component of property’s CSS grammar has a limited numeric range, and the corresponding part of
        //     value is a CSSUnitValue that is outside of that range, replace that value with the result of wrapping it
        //     in a fresh CSSMathSum whose values internal slot contains only that part of value.
        //
        //     Return the value.
        let node = self.create_calculation_node()?;
        typed_om::calculated_style_value(property_id, node, self.numeric_type(), perform_type_check)
            .ok_or_else(|| Exception::type_error("Property does not accept values of this type."))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssmath-negate-a-cssnumericvalue
    pub(crate) fn negate(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Self {
        // 1. If this is a CSSMathNegate object, return this’s value internal slot.
        if let Self::CSSMathNegate(negate) = self {
            return negate.inner_value();
        }

        // 2. If this is a CSSUnitValue object, return a new CSSUnitValue with the same unit internal slot as this, and
        //    a value internal slot set to the negation of this’s.
        if let Self::CSSUnitValue(unit_value) = self {
            return Self::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(vm, -unit_value.raw_value(), unit_value.raw_unit()));
        }

        // 3. Otherwise, return a new CSSMathNegate object whose value internal slot is set to this.
        Self::CSSMathNegate(CSSMathNegate::create(vm, *self))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssmath-invert-a-cssnumericvalue
    pub(crate) fn invert(&self, vm: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        // 1. If this is a CSSMathInvert object, return this’s value internal slot.
        if let Self::CSSMathInvert(invert) = self {
            return Ok(invert.inner_value());
        }

        // 2. If this is a CSSUnitValue object with unit internal slot set to "number":
        if let Self::CSSUnitValue(unit_value) = self
            && unit_value.raw_unit() == "number"
        {
            // 1. If this’s value internal slot is set to 0 or -0, throw a RangeError.
            if unit_value.raw_value() == 0.0 {
                return Err(Exception::range_error("Zero has no multiplicative inverse"));
            }

            // 2. Else return a new CSSUnitValue with the unit internal slot set to "number", and a value internal slot
            //    set to 1 divided by this’s {CSSUnitValue/value}} internal slot.
            return Ok(Self::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(
                vm,
                1.0 / unit_value.raw_value(),
                "number",
            )));
        }

        // 3. Otherwise, return a new CSSMathInvert object whose value internal slot is set to this.
        Ok(Self::CSSMathInvert(CSSMathInvert::create(vm, *self)))
    }

    /// The values of this object if it is of the interface that an operation makes, or this object, as the first steps
    /// of add(), mul(), min() and max() prepend them to values.
    fn with_rectified_values<'vm>(
        &self,
        vm: &'vm Vm,
        own_values: Option<&[Self]>,
        initial_values: &MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>,
    ) -> MarkedVec<'vm, Self> {
        // 1. Replace each item of values with the result of rectifying a numberish value for the item.
        // 2. If this is a CSSMathSum object, prepend the items in this’s values internal slot to values.
        //    Otherwise, prepend this to values.
        // NB: We reorder the steps a little to avoid the awkward prepending.
        let values = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        match own_values {
            Some(own_values) => values.extend_from_slice(own_values),
            None => values.push(*self),
        }
        for value in initial_values.values().iter() {
            values.push(rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, value, None));
        }
        values
    }

    pub(crate) fn add(&self, vm: &Vm, initial_values: &MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        let own_values = match self {
            Self::CSSMathSum(math_sum) => Some(math_sum.numeric_array()),
            _ => None,
        };
        let own_values = own_values.as_ref().map(|array| array.values());
        let values = self.with_rectified_values(vm, own_values, initial_values);

        // 3. If all of the items in values are CSSUnitValues and have the same unit, return a new CSSUnitValue whose
        //    unit internal slot is set to that unit, and value internal slot is set to the sum of the value internal
        //    slots of the items in values. This addition must be done "left to right" - if values is « 1, 2, 3, 4 »,
        //    the result must be (((1 + 2) + 3) + 4). (This detail is necessary to ensure interoperability in the
        //    presence of floating-point arithmetic.)
        if let Some(result) = apply_math_operation_on_css_unit_values(vm, &values, |a, b| a + b) {
            return Ok(result);
        }

        // 4. Let type be the result of adding the types of every item in values. If type is failure, throw a TypeError.
        // 5. Return a new CSSMathSum object whose values internal slot is set to values.
        Ok(Self::CSSMathSum(CSSMathSum::add_all_types_into_math_sum(vm, &values)?))
    }

    fn mul(&self, vm: &Vm, initial_values: &MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        let own_values = match self {
            Self::CSSMathProduct(math_product) => Some(math_product.numeric_array()),
            _ => None,
        };
        let own_values = own_values.as_ref().map(|array| array.values());
        let values = self.with_rectified_values(vm, own_values, initial_values);

        // 3. If all of the items in values are CSSUnitValues with unit internal slot set to "number", return a new
        //    CSSUnitValue whose unit internal slot is set to "number", and value internal slot is set to the product of
        //    the value internal slots of the items in values.
        //
        //    This multiplication must be done "left to right" - if values is « 1, 2, 3, 4 », the result must be
        //    (((1 × 2) × 3) × 4). (This detail is necessary to ensure interoperability in the presence of
        //    floating-point arithmetic.)
        //
        // 4. If all of the items in values are CSSUnitValues with unit internal slot set to "number" except one which
        //    is set to unit, return a new CSSUnitValue whose unit internal slot is set to unit, and value internal slot
        //    is set to the product of the value internal slots of the items in values.
        //
        //    This multiplication must be done "left to right" - if values is « 1, 2, 3, 4 », the result must be
        //    (((1 × 2) × 3) × 4).
        if let Some(unit_values) = css_unit_values_of(vm, &values) {
            let unit_values = unit_values.values();
            let mut other_units = unit_values.iter().filter(|value| value.raw_unit() != "number");
            let first_other_unit = other_units.next();
            if other_units.next().is_none() {
                let product = unit_values
                    .iter()
                    .fold(1.0, |product, value| product * value.raw_value());
                let unit = first_other_unit.map_or("number", |value| value.raw_unit());
                return Ok(Self::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(vm, product, unit)));
            }
        }

        // 5. Let type be the result of multiplying the types of every item in values. If type is failure, throw a
        //    TypeError.
        // 6. Return a new CSSMathProduct object whose values internal slot is set to values.
        Ok(Self::CSSMathProduct(
            CSSMathProduct::multiply_all_types_into_math_product(vm, &values)?,
        ))
    }
}

/// The CSSUnitValues of the values, if that is all they are.
fn css_unit_values_of<'vm>(
    vm: &'vm Vm,
    values: &MarkedVec<'_, AnyCSSNumericValue>,
) -> Option<MarkedVec<'vm, Ref<CSSUnitValue>>> {
    let unit_values = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, values.len());
    for value in values.values().iter() {
        unit_values.push(value.as_unit_value()?);
    }
    Some(unit_values)
}

/// Whether all of the values are CSSUnitValues with the same unit, in which case the operation runs over them from left
/// to right, and the new CSSUnitValue that results.
fn apply_math_operation_on_css_unit_values(
    vm: &Vm,
    values: &MarkedVec<'_, AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    operation: impl Fn(f64, f64) -> f64,
) -> Option<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
    let unit_values = css_unit_values_of(vm, values)?;
    let unit_values = unit_values.values();
    let (first, rest) = unit_values.split_first().expect("an operation has at least one value");
    if rest.iter().any(|value| value.raw_unit() != first.raw_unit()) {
        return None;
    }
    let result = rest
        .iter()
        .fold(first.raw_value(), |result, value| operation(result, value.raw_value()));
    Some(AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(
        vm,
        result,
        first.raw_unit(),
    )))
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#rectify-a-numberish-value
pub(crate) fn rectify_a_numberish_value(vm: &Vm, numberish: &CSSNumberish, unit: Option<&str>) -> AnyCSSNumericValue {
    match numberish {
        CSSNumberish::CSSNumericValue(value) => *value,
        CSSNumberish::Double(value) => {
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(vm, *value, unit.unwrap_or("number")))
        }
    }
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssnumericvalue
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSNumericValue {
    style_value: CSSStyleValue,
    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssnumericvalue-type
    #[gc(untraced)]
    numeric_type: NumericType,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSNumericValue {}

impl Inherits<CSSStyleValue> for CSSNumericValue {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        &self.style_value
    }
}

fn to_om_numeric_base_type(base_type: usize) -> CSSNumericBaseType {
    match base_type {
        BASE_TYPE_LENGTH => CSSNumericBaseType::Length,
        BASE_TYPE_ANGLE => CSSNumericBaseType::Angle,
        BASE_TYPE_TIME => CSSNumericBaseType::Time,
        BASE_TYPE_FREQUENCY => CSSNumericBaseType::Frequency,
        BASE_TYPE_RESOLUTION => CSSNumericBaseType::Resolution,
        BASE_TYPE_FLEX => CSSNumericBaseType::Flex,
        BASE_TYPE_PERCENT => CSSNumericBaseType::Percent,
        _ => unreachable!("a numeric type has seven base types"),
    }
}

impl CSSNumericValue {
    pub(crate) fn new(numeric_type: NumericType) -> Self {
        Self {
            style_value: CSSStyleValue::empty(),
            numeric_type,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn numeric_type(&self) -> NumericType {
        self.numeric_type
    }

    /// The object that this is the CSSNumericValue part of.
    fn this(&self) -> AnyCSSNumericValue {
        self.style_value.object().as_numeric().expect("the object is numeric")
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-add
    pub(crate) fn add(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        values: MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        self.this().add(cx.vm(), &values)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-sub
    pub(crate) fn sub(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        initial_values: MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        // 1. Replace each item of values with the result of rectifying a numberish value for the item, then negating
        //    the value.
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let values = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        for value in initial_values.values().iter() {
            values.push(CSSNumberish::CSSNumericValue(
                rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, value, None).negate(vm),
            ));
        }

        // 2. Return the result of calling the add() internal algorithm with this and values.
        self.this().add(vm, &values)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-mul
    pub(crate) fn mul(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        values: MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        self.this().mul(cx.vm(), &values)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-div
    pub(crate) fn div(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        initial_values: MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        // 1. Replace each item of values with the result of rectifying a numberish value for the item, then inverting
        //    the value.
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let values = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        for value in initial_values.values().iter() {
            values.push(CSSNumberish::CSSNumericValue(
                rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, value, None).invert(vm)?,
            ));
        }

        // 2. Return the result of calling the mul() internal algorithm with this and values.
        self.this().mul(vm, &values)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-min
    pub(crate) fn min(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        initial_values: MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let this = self.this();
        let own_values = match this {
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMin(math_min) => Some(math_min.numeric_array()),
            _ => None,
        };
        let own_values = own_values.as_ref().map(|array| array.values());
        let values = this.with_rectified_values(vm, own_values, &initial_values);

        // 3. If all of the items in values are CSSUnitValues and have the same unit, return a new CSSUnitValue whose
        //    unit internal slot is set to that unit, and value internal slot is set to the minimum of the value
        //    internal slots of the items in values.
        if let Some(result) = apply_math_operation_on_css_unit_values(vm, &values, |a, b| if b < a { b } else { a }) {
            return Ok(result);
        }

        // 4. Let type be the result of adding the types of every item in values. If type is failure, throw a TypeError.
        // 5. Return a new CSSMathMin object whose values internal slot is set to values.
        Ok(AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMin(CSSMathMin::add_all_types_into_math_min(
            vm, &values,
        )?))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-max
    pub(crate) fn max(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        initial_values: MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let this = self.this();
        let own_values = match this {
            AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMax(math_max) => Some(math_max.numeric_array()),
            _ => None,
        };
        let own_values = own_values.as_ref().map(|array| array.values());
        let values = this.with_rectified_values(vm, own_values, &initial_values);

        // 3. If all of the items in values are CSSUnitValues and have the same unit, return a new CSSUnitValue whose
        //    unit internal slot is set to that unit, and value internal slot is set to the maximum of the value
        //    internal slots of the items in values.
        if let Some(result) = apply_math_operation_on_css_unit_values(vm, &values, |a, b| if a < b { b } else { a }) {
            return Ok(result);
        }

        // 4. Let type be the result of adding the types of every item in values. If type is failure, throw a TypeError.
        // 5. Return a new CSSMathMax object whose values internal slot is set to values.
        Ok(AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMax(CSSMathMax::add_all_types_into_math_max(
            vm, &values,
        )?))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-equals
    pub(crate) fn equals_for_bindings(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        values: MarkedVec<'_, CSSNumberish>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The equals(...values) method, when called on a CSSNumericValue this, must perform the following steps:

        // 1. Replace each item of values with the result of rectifying a numberish value for the item.
        // 2. For each item in values, if the item is not an equal numeric value to this, return false.
        let this = self.this();
        for value in values.values().iter() {
            let rectified_value = rectify_a_numberish_value(cx.vm(), value, None);
            if !this.is_equal_numeric_value(&rectified_value) {
                return Ok(false);
            }
        }

        // 3. Return true.
        Ok(true)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-to
    pub(crate) fn to(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, unit: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSUnitValue>> {
        let unit = typed_om::to_rust_string(&unit.into_utf16_string());
        self.this().to_unit(cx.vm(), &unit)
    }

    pub(crate) fn type_for_bindings(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CSSNumericType> {
        let mut result = CSSNumericType::default();
        for (base_type, power) in self.numeric_type.exponents.iter().enumerate() {
            let Some(power) = power.filter(|power| *power != 0) else {
                continue;
            };
            let entry = match base_type {
                BASE_TYPE_LENGTH => &mut result.length,
                BASE_TYPE_ANGLE => &mut result.angle,
                BASE_TYPE_TIME => &mut result.time,
                BASE_TYPE_FREQUENCY => &mut result.frequency,
                BASE_TYPE_RESOLUTION => &mut result.resolution,
                BASE_TYPE_FLEX => &mut result.flex,
                BASE_TYPE_PERCENT => &mut result.percent,
                _ => unreachable!("a numeric type has seven base types"),
            };
            *entry = Some(power);
        }
        result.percent_hint = self
            .numeric_type
            .percent_hint
            .map(|percent_hint| to_om_numeric_base_type(usize::from(percent_hint)));
        Ok(result)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-parse
    pub(crate) fn parse(cx: &mut CallContext, css_text: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        // The parse(cssText) method, when called, must perform the following steps:
        let value = parse_a_numeric_value(&css_text.into_utf16_string()).ok_or_else(|| {
            Exception::syntax_error(Utf16String::from_utf8("Input is not a numeric component value."))
        })?;
        typed_om::reify_a_numeric_value(cx.vm(), &value)
            .ok_or_else(|| Exception::syntax_error(Utf16String::from_utf8("Unable to reify this math function.")))
    }
}

impl AnyCSSNumericValue {
    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssnumericvalue-to
    pub(crate) fn to_unit(self, vm: &Vm, unit: &str) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSUnitValue>> {
        // The to(unit) method converts an existing CSSNumericValue this into another one with the specified unit, if
        // possible. When called, it must perform the following steps:

        // 1. Let type be the result of creating a type from unit. If type is failure, throw a SyntaxError.
        if create_a_type_from_unit(unit).is_none() {
            return Err(Exception::syntax_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                "Unrecognized unit '{unit}'"
            ))));
        }

        // 2. Let sum be the result of creating a sum value from this. If sum is failure, throw a TypeError.
        let Some(sum) = self.create_a_sum_value() else {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(&format!(
                "Unable to create a sum from input '{}'",
                self.to_string_with(SerializationParams::default())
            )));
        };

        // 3. If sum has more than one item, throw a TypeError.
        //    Otherwise, let item be the result of creating a CSSUnitValue from the sole item in sum, then converting it
        //    to unit. If item is failure, throw a TypeError.
        if sum.len() > 1 {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("Sum contains more than one item"));
        }
        let Some(item) = CSSUnitValue::create_from_sum_value_item(vm, &sum[0]) else {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(&format!(
                "Unable to create CSSUnitValue from input '{}'",
                self.to_string_with(SerializationParams::default())
            )));
        };
        let Some(converted_item) = item.converted_to_unit(vm, unit) else {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("Unable to convert input to requested unit"));
        };

        // 4. Return item.
        Ok(converted_item)
    }
}

//! CSSPageRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-csspagerule-interface

use super::css_grouping_rule::CSSGroupingRule;
use super::css_page_descriptors::CSSPageDescriptors;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_rule::{CSSRule, RuleText, serialized_rules};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use std::rc::Rc;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSPageRule {
    grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSPageRule);

impl Inherits<CSSGroupingRule> for CSSPageRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }
}

impl CSSPageRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule::new(native_rule),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        self.grouping_rule.rule()
    }

    pub(crate) fn grouping_rule(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-csspagerule-selectortext
    pub(crate) fn selector_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.rule().native_rule().page_selector_text())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-csspagerule-selectortext
    pub(crate) fn set_selector_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // On setting the selectorText attribute these steps must be run:
        // 1. Run the parse a list of CSS page selectors algorithm on the given value.
        // 2. If the algorithm returns a non-null value replace the associated selector list with the returned value.
        // 3. Otherwise, if the algorithm returns a null value, do nothing.
        self.rule().native_rule().set_page_selector_text(&value);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-csspagerule-style
    pub(crate) fn style(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSPageDescriptors>> {
        Ok(self.rule().declarations_object(cx))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#ref-for-csspagerule
    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        // AD-HOC: There's no spec for this yet, but Chrome puts declarations before margin rules.
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@page ");
        let selector = self.rule().native_rule().page_selector_text();
        if !selector.is_empty() {
            text.push(&selector);
            text.push_str(" ");
        }
        text.push_str("{ ");
        if !self.rule().native_rule().has_no_declarations() {
            text.push(&self.rule().serialized_declarations(vm));
            text.push_str(" ");
        }
        for rule in serialized_rules(vm, self.grouping_rule.child_rules(vm)) {
            text.push(&rule);
            text.push_str(" ");
        }
        text.push_str("}");
        text.finish()
    }
}

//! CSSPerspective, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssperspective

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{BASE_TYPE_LENGTH, RetainedStyleValue, TransformFunction, transformation_style_value};

use super::css_keyword_value::{CSSKeywordValue, CSSKeywordish, rectify_a_keywordish_value};
use super::css_numeric_value::{AnyCSSNumericValue, SerializationParams};
use super::css_style_value::AnyCSSStyleValue;
use super::css_transform_component::{
    AnyCSSTransformComponent, CSSTransformComponent, Is2D, argument_style_value, create_dom_matrix,
};
use super::typed_om;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix::DOMMatrix;
use crate::geometry::matrix::Matrix4;

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#typedefdef-cssperspectivevalue
// NB: CSSKeywordish is flattened here, because our bindings generator flattens nested variants.
#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum CSSPerspectiveValue {
    CSSNumericValue(AnyCSSNumericValue),
    DOMString(#[gc(untraced)] Utf16String),
    CSSKeywordValue(Ref<CSSKeywordValue>),
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum CSSPerspectiveValueInternal {
    CSSNumericValue(AnyCSSNumericValue),
    CSSKeywordValue(Ref<CSSKeywordValue>),
}

fn to_internal(vm: &Vm, value: CSSPerspectiveValue) -> WebIdlResult<CSSPerspectiveValueInternal> {
    // Steps 1 and 2 of The CSSPerspective(length) constructor:
    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssperspective-cssperspective
    let keywordish = match value {
        // 1. If length is a CSSNumericValue:
        CSSPerspectiveValue::CSSNumericValue(numeric_value) => {
            // 1. If length does not match <length>, throw a TypeError.
            if !numeric_value.numeric_type().matches_dimension(BASE_TYPE_LENGTH, None) {
                return Err(Exception::type_error(
                    "CSSPerspective length component doesn't match <length>",
                ));
            }
            return Ok(CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSNumericValue(numeric_value));
        }
        // 2. Otherwise (that is, if length is not a CSSNumericValue):
        CSSPerspectiveValue::DOMString(value) => CSSKeywordish::DOMString(value),
        CSSPerspectiveValue::CSSKeywordValue(value) => CSSKeywordish::CSSKeywordValue(value),
    };

    // 1. Rectify a keywordish value from length, then set length to the result’s value.
    let rectified_length = rectify_a_keywordish_value(vm, &keywordish);

    // 2. If length does not represent a value that is an ASCII case-insensitive match for the keyword none,
    //    throw a TypeError.
    if !typed_om::to_rust_string(&rectified_length.raw_value()).eq_ignore_ascii_case("none") {
        return Err(Exception::type_error(
            "CSSPerspective length component is a keyword other than `none`",
        ));
    }

    Ok(CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSKeywordValue(rectified_length))
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSPerspective {
    transform_component: CSSTransformComponent,
    length: GcRefCell<CSSPerspectiveValueInternal>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSPerspective {}

impl Inherits<CSSTransformComponent> for CSSPerspective {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSTransformComponent {
        &self.transform_component
    }
}

impl CSSPerspective {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, length: CSSPerspectiveValueInternal) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            transform_component: CSSTransformComponent::new(Is2D::No),
            length: GcRefCell::new(length),
        });
        AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSPerspective(object).finish(vm);
        object
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssperspective-cssperspective
    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext, length: CSSPerspectiveValue) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // The CSSPerspective(length) constructor must, when invoked, perform the following steps:
        // NB: Steps 1 and 2 are implemented in to_internal().
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let internal_length = to_internal(vm, length)?;

        // 3. Return a new CSSPerspective object with its length internal slot set to length, and its is2D internal slot
        //    set to false.
        Ok(Self::create(vm, internal_length))
    }

    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CSSPerspectiveValue> {
        Ok(match *self.length.borrow() {
            CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSNumericValue(value) => CSSPerspectiveValue::CSSNumericValue(value),
            CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSKeywordValue(value) => CSSPerspectiveValue::CSSKeywordValue(value),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_length(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: CSSPerspectiveValue) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // AD-HOC: Not specced. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        //         WPT expects this to throw for invalid values, so just reuse the constructor code.
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let length = to_internal(vm, value)?;
        *self.length.borrow_mut(vm) = length;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssperspective
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self) -> Utf16String {
        // 1. Let s initially be "perspective(".
        let mut s = String::from("perspective(");

        // 2. Serialize this’s length internal slot, with a minimum of 0px, and append it to s.
        match *self.length.borrow() {
            CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSNumericValue(numeric_value) => numeric_value.serialize(
                &mut s,
                SerializationParams {
                    minimum: Some(0.0),
                    ..SerializationParams::default()
                },
            ),
            CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSKeywordValue(keyword_value) => {
                s.push_str(&typed_om::to_rust_string(&keyword_value.serialize()));
            }
        }

        // 3. Append ")" to s, and return s.
        s.push(')');
        Utf16String::from_utf8(&s)
    }

    pub(crate) fn to_matrix(&self, vm: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        // 1. Let matrix be a new DOMMatrix object, initialized to this’s equivalent 4x4 transform matrix, as defined in
        //    CSS Transforms 1 § 12. Mathematical Description of Transform Functions, and with its is2D internal slot
        //    set to the same value as this’s is2D internal slot.
        //    NOTE: Recall that the is2D flag affects what transform, and thus what equivalent matrix, a
        //          CSSTransformComponent represents.
        //    As the entries of such a matrix are defined relative to the px unit, if any <length>s in this involved in
        //    generating the matrix are not compatible units with px (such as relative lengths or percentages), throw a
        //    TypeError.
        let mut matrix = Matrix4::identity();

        match *self.length.borrow() {
            CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSNumericValue(numeric_value) => {
                // NB: to_unit() throws a TypeError if the conversion can't be done.
                let distance = numeric_value.to_unit(vm, "px")?.raw_value();
                // NB: Matrix4 is row by row, so the element m34 is in the fourth row and the third column.
                //     Unlike f64::max(), this keeps a distance that is NaN.
                matrix.elements[3][2] = -1.0 / if distance < 1.0 { 1.0 } else { distance };
            }
            CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSKeywordValue(_) => {
                // NB: This is `none`, so do nothing.
            }
        }

        Ok(create_dom_matrix(vm, matrix, self.transform_component.raw_is_2d()))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssperspective-is2d
    pub(crate) fn set_is_2d(&self) {
        // The is2D attribute of a CSSPerspective object must, on setting, do nothing.
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_style_value(&self, vm: &Vm, property_id: u16) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        let length = match *self.length.borrow() {
            CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSNumericValue(value) => argument_style_value(vm, property_id, value)?,
            CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSKeywordValue(value) => {
                argument_style_value(vm, property_id, AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSKeywordValue(value))?
            }
        };
        Ok(transformation_style_value(
            property_id,
            TransformFunction::Perspective,
            vec![length],
        ))
    }
}

//! CSSPositionTryRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#the-csspositiontryrule-interface

use super::css_position_try_descriptors::CSSPositionTryDescriptors;
use super::css_rule::CSSRule;
use super::css_rule::RuleText;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use libweb_rust::cssom::serialize_identifier;
use std::rc::Rc;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSPositionTryRule {
    rule: CSSRule,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSPositionTryRule);

impl Inherits<CSSRule> for CSSPositionTryRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }
}

impl CSSPositionTryRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            rule: CSSRule::new(native_rule),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        &self.rule
    }

    fn serialized_name(&self) -> Utf16String {
        // Its name attribute represents the name declared in the rule's prelude.
        // INTEROP: Other browsers return the name serialized as an identifier.
        serialize_identifier(&self.rule.native_rule().at_rule_name())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#dom-csspositiontryrule-name
    pub(crate) fn name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.serialized_name())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#dom-csspositiontryrule-style
    pub(crate) fn style(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSPositionTryDescriptors>> {
        // On getting, it must return a CSSPositionTryDescriptors object for the @position-try at-rule, with the
        // following properties:
        //   computed flag: Unset
        //   readonly flag: Unset
        //   declarations: The declared descriptors in the rule, in specified order.
        //   parent CSS rule: The context object
        //   owner node: Null
        Ok(self.rule.declarations_object(cx))
    }

    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        // AD-HOC: There is no spec for serializing CSSPositionTryRule. This matches other browsers.
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@position-try ");
        text.push(&self.serialized_name());
        text.push_str(" { ");
        if !self.rule.native_rule().has_no_declarations() {
            text.push(&self.rule.serialized_declarations(vm));
            text.push_str(" ");
        }
        text.push_str("}");
        text.finish()
    }
}

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-properties-values-api/#the-css-property-rule-interface
    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, _: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        let native_rule = self.rule.native_rule();

        // To serialize a CSSPropertyRule, return the concatenation of the following:

        // 1. The string "@property" followed by a single SPACE (U+0020).
        // 2. The result of performing serialize an identifier on the rule’s name, followed by a single SPACE (U+0020).
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@property ");
        text.push(&serialize_identifier(&native_rule.property_name()));
        text.push_str(" ");

        // 3. The string "{ ", i.e., a single LEFT CURLY BRACKET (U+007B), followed by a SPACE (U+0020).
        text.push_str("{ ");

        // 4. The string "syntax:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020).
        // 5. The result of performing serialize a string on the rule’s syntax, followed by a single SEMICOLON (U+003B),
        //    followed by a SPACE (U+0020).
        text.push_str("syntax: ");
        text.push(&serialize_string_value(&native_rule.property_syntax()));
        text.push_str("; ");

        // 6. The string "inherits:", followed by a single SPACE (U+0020).
        // 7. For the rule’s inherits attribute, one of the following depending on the attribute’s value:
        //      true:  The string "true" followed by a single SEMICOLON (U+003B), followed by a SPACE (U+0020).
        //      false: The string "false" followed by a single SEMICOLON (U+003B), followed by a SPACE (U+0020).
        text.push_str(if native_rule.property_inherits() {
            "inherits: true; "
        } else {
            "inherits: false; "
        });

        // 8. If the rule’s initial-value is present, follow these substeps:
        if let Some(initial_value) = native_rule.property_initial_value() {
            // 1. The string "initial-value:".
            // 2. The result of performing serialize a CSS value in the rule’s initial-value followed by a single
            //    SEMICOLON (U+003B), followed by a SPACE (U+0020).
            text.push_str("initial-value: ");
            text.push(&initial_value);
            text.push_str("; ");
        }

        // 9. A single RIGHT CURLY BRACKET (U+007D).
        text.push_str("}");
        text.finish()
    }
}

//! CSSRotate, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssrotate

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{RetainedStyleValue, TransformFunction, transformation_style_value};

use super::css_numeric_value::{AnyCSSNumericValue, CSSNumberish, SerializationParams, rectify_a_numberish_value};
use super::css_transform_component::{
    AnyCSSTransformComponent, CSSTransformComponent, Is2D, argument_style_value, create_dom_matrix, matches_angle,
    matches_number,
};
use super::css_unit_value::CSSUnitValue;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix::DOMMatrix;
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix_read_only::DOMMatrixReadOnly;
use crate::geometry::matrix::Matrix4;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSRotate {
    transform_component: CSSTransformComponent,
    x: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    y: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    z: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    angle: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSRotate {}

impl Inherits<CSSTransformComponent> for CSSRotate {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSTransformComponent {
        &self.transform_component
    }
}

impl CSSRotate {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        is_2d: Is2D,
        x: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        y: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        z: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        angle: AnyCSSNumericValue,
    ) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            transform_component: CSSTransformComponent::new(is_2d),
            x: GcRefCell::new(x),
            y: GcRefCell::new(y),
            z: GcRefCell::new(z),
            angle: GcRefCell::new(angle),
        });
        AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSRotate(object).finish(vm);
        object
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssrotate-cssrotate
    pub(crate) fn construct_from_angle(cx: &mut CallContext, angle: AnyCSSNumericValue) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // The CSSRotate(angle) constructor must, when invoked, perform the following steps:

        // 1. If angle doesn’t match <angle>, throw a TypeError.
        if !matches_angle(&angle) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSRotate angle component doesn't match <angle>"));
        }

        // 2. Return a new CSSRotate with its angle internal slot set to angle, its x and y internal slots set to new
        //    unit values of (0, "number"), its z internal slot set to a new unit value of (1, "number"), and its is2D
        //    internal slot set to true.
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let unit_value = |value| AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(vm, value, "number"));
        Ok(Self::create(
            vm,
            Is2D::Yes,
            unit_value(0.0),
            unit_value(0.0),
            unit_value(1.0),
            angle,
        ))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssrotate-cssrotate-x-y-z-anglec
    pub(crate) fn construct_from_axis(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        x: CSSNumberish,
        y: CSSNumberish,
        z: CSSNumberish,
        angle: AnyCSSNumericValue,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // The CSSRotate(x, y, z, angle) constructor must, when invoked, perform the following steps:

        // 1. If angle doesn’t match <angle>, throw a TypeError.
        if !matches_angle(&angle) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSRotate angle component doesn't match <angle>"));
        }

        // 2. Let x, y, and z be replaced by the result of rectifying a numberish value.
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rectified_x = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &x, None);
        let rectified_y = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &y, None);
        let rectified_z = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &z, None);

        // 3. If x, y, or z don’t match <number>, throw a TypeError.
        if !matches_number(&rectified_x) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSRotate x component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        if !matches_number(&rectified_y) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSRotate y component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        if !matches_number(&rectified_z) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSRotate z component doesn't match <number>"));
        }

        // 4. Return a new CSSRotate with its angle internal slot set to angle, its x, y, z internal slots set to x, y,
        //    and z, and its is2D internal slot set to false.
        Ok(Self::create(vm, Is2D::No, rectified_x, rectified_y, rectified_z, angle))
    }

    pub(crate) fn x(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CSSNumberish> {
        Ok(CSSNumberish::CSSNumericValue(*self.x.borrow()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn y(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CSSNumberish> {
        Ok(CSSNumberish::CSSNumericValue(*self.y.borrow()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn z(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CSSNumberish> {
        Ok(CSSNumberish::CSSNumericValue(*self.z.borrow()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn angle(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        Ok(*self.angle.borrow())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssrotate-x
    pub(crate) fn set_x(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: CSSNumberish) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The x, y, and z attributes must, on setting to a new value val, rectify a numberish value from val and set
        // the corresponding internal slot to the result of that.
        // AD-HOC: WPT expects this to throw for invalid values. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rectified_x = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &value, None);
        if !matches_number(&rectified_x) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSRotate x component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        *self.x.borrow_mut(vm) = rectified_x;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssrotate-y
    pub(crate) fn set_y(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: CSSNumberish) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The x, y, and z attributes must, on setting to a new value val, rectify a numberish value from val and set
        // the corresponding internal slot to the result of that.
        // AD-HOC: WPT expects this to throw for invalid values. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rectified_y = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &value, None);
        if !matches_number(&rectified_y) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSRotate y component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        *self.y.borrow_mut(vm) = rectified_y;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssrotate-z
    pub(crate) fn set_z(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: CSSNumberish) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The x, y, and z attributes must, on setting to a new value val, rectify a numberish value from val and set
        // the corresponding internal slot to the result of that.
        // AD-HOC: WPT expects this to throw for invalid values. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rectified_z = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &value, None);
        if !matches_number(&rectified_z) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSRotate z component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        *self.z.borrow_mut(vm) = rectified_z;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_angle(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: AnyCSSNumericValue) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // AD-HOC: Not specced. WPT expects this to throw for invalid values.
        //         https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        if !matches_angle(&value) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSRotate angle component doesn't match <angle>"));
        }
        *self.angle.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = value;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssrotate
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self) -> Utf16String {
        let params = SerializationParams::default();

        // 1. Let s initially be the empty string.
        let mut s = String::new();

        // 2. If this’s is2D internal slot is false:
        if !self.transform_component.raw_is_2d() {
            // 1. Append "rotate3d(" to s.
            s.push_str("rotate3d(");

            // 2. Serialize this’s x internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.x.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 3. Append ", " to s.
            s.push_str(", ");

            // 4. Serialize this’s y internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.y.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 5. Append ", " to s.
            s.push_str(", ");

            // 6. Serialize this’s z internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.z.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 7. Append "," to s.
            s.push_str(", ");

            // 8. Serialize this’s angle internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.angle.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 9. Append ")" to s, and return s.
            s.push(')');
        }
        // 2. Otherwise:
        else {
            // 1. Append "rotate(" to s.
            s.push_str("rotate(");

            // 2. Serialize this’s angle internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.angle.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 3. Append ")" to s, and return s.
            s.push(')');
        }
        Utf16String::from_utf8(&s)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstransformcomponent-tomatrix
    pub(crate) fn to_matrix(&self, vm: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        // 1. Let matrix be a new DOMMatrix object, initialized to this’s equivalent 4x4 transform matrix, as defined in
        //    CSS Transforms 1 § 12. Mathematical Description of Transform Functions, and with its is2D internal slot
        //    set to the same value as this’s is2D internal slot.
        //    NOTE: Recall that the is2D flag affects what transform, and thus what equivalent matrix, a
        //          CSSTransformComponent represents.
        //    As the entries of such a matrix are defined relative to the px unit, if any <length>s in this involved in
        //    generating the matrix are not compatible units with px (such as relative lengths or percentages), throw a
        //    TypeError.
        // 2. Return matrix.

        let is_2d = self.transform_component.raw_is_2d();
        let matrix = create_dom_matrix(vm, Matrix4::identity(), is_2d);
        let read_only_matrix = <DOMMatrix as Inherits<DOMMatrixReadOnly>>::parent(&matrix);

        // NB: to_unit() throws a TypeError if the conversion can't be done.
        let angle = self.angle.borrow().to_unit(vm, "deg")?.raw_value();

        if is_2d {
            read_only_matrix.rotate_axis_angle_self_steps(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, angle);
            return Ok(matrix);
        }

        let x = self.x.borrow().to_unit(vm, "number")?.raw_value();
        let y = self.y.borrow().to_unit(vm, "number")?.raw_value();
        let z = self.z.borrow().to_unit(vm, "number")?.raw_value();

        read_only_matrix.rotate_axis_angle_self_steps(x, y, z, angle);
        Ok(matrix)
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_style_value(&self, vm: &Vm, property_id: u16) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        if self.transform_component.raw_is_2d() {
            let angle = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.angle.borrow())?;
            return Ok(transformation_style_value(
                property_id,
                TransformFunction::Rotate,
                vec![angle],
            ));
        }

        let x = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.x.borrow())?;
        let y = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.y.borrow())?;
        let z = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.z.borrow())?;
        let angle = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.angle.borrow())?;
        Ok(transformation_style_value(
            property_id,
            TransformFunction::Rotate3d,
            vec![x, y, z, angle],
        ))
    }
}

//! CSSRuleList, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-cssrulelist-interface

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::null_mut;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::rc::Rc;

use libjs_rust::api::{DeferGc, GcRefCell, MarkedVec, Trace, Visitor, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRuleList;

use super::css_rule::AnyCSSRule;
use super::exports::rule_from_abi;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::interface::{InterfaceCell, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_style_sheet_import_rule(sheet: *mut c_void, identity: u64) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_style_sheet_disconnect_font_faces(sheet: *mut c_void, rule: *const c_void);
    fn web_css_style_sheet_rules_changed(sheet: *mut c_void);
}

/// The objects of the rules of a list that have one, by the identity of the rule.
#[derive(Default)]
struct RuleObjects(HashMap<u64, AnyCSSRule>);

// SAFETY: Forwards to every object.
unsafe impl Trace for RuleObjects {
    fn trace(&self, visitor: &mut Visitor) {
        for object in self.0.values() {
            object.trace(visitor);
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSRuleList {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    rules: Rc<NativeRuleList>,
    objects: GcRefCell<RuleObjects>,
    owner_rule: GcRefCell<Option<AnyCSSRule>>,
    /// The cell of the CSSStyleSheet.
    parent_style_sheet: GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,
    /// The cell of the Document that the @import rules of the list load for.
    document: GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSRuleList {
    const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
    const OWNS_EXTERNAL_MEMORY: bool = true;

    fn external_memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        self.rules.cssom_external_memory_size()
    }
}

impl CSSRuleList {
    pub(crate) fn new(_: &DeferGc<'_>, rules: Rc<NativeRuleList>, document: Option<CppCell>) -> Self {
        Self {
            rules,
            objects: GcRefCell::new(RuleObjects::default()),
            owner_rule: GcRefCell::new(None),
            parent_style_sheet: GcRefCell::new(None),
            document: GcRefCell::new(document),
        }
    }

    /// The list of the child rules of `owner`.
    pub(crate) fn create_for_rule(vm: &Vm, rules: Rc<NativeRuleList>, owner: AnyCSSRule) -> Ref<Self> {
        let list = allocate(vm, |defer_gc| Self::new(defer_gc, rules, None));
        *list.owner_rule.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(owner);
        *list.parent_style_sheet.borrow_mut(vm) = owner.parent_sheet();
        list
    }

    pub(crate) fn native_rules(&self) -> &Rc<NativeRuleList> {
        &self.rules
    }

    pub(crate) fn native_length(&self) -> usize {
        self.rules.cssom_length()
    }

    pub(crate) fn existing_object(&self, identity: u64) -> Option<AnyCSSRule> {
        self.objects.borrow().0.get(&identity).copied()
    }

    /// The object of the rule at the index, which the first call creates.
    pub(crate) fn rule_at(&self, vm: &Vm, index: usize) -> AnyCSSRule {
        let identity = self.rules.cssom_identity_at(index);
        if let Some(object) = self.existing_object(identity) {
            return object;
        }

        let sheet = self.parent_style_sheet.borrow().clone();
        // SAFETY: The cell is that of a live CSSStyleSheet.
        let import = sheet.as_ref().map_or(null_mut(), |sheet| unsafe {
            web_css_style_sheet_import_rule(sheet.as_ptr(), identity)
        });
        let object = if import.is_null() {
            AnyCSSRule::create(vm, self.rules.cssom_rule_at(index), self.document.borrow().as_ref())
        } else {
            // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live cell of the CSSImportRule of the rule.
            unsafe { rule_from_abi(InterfaceCell::from_raw(import)) }
        };
        self.objects.borrow_mut(vm).0.insert(identity, object);
        let owner = *self.owner_rule.borrow();
        if owner.is_some() {
            object.set_parent_rule(vm, owner);
        } else {
            object.set_parent_style_sheet(vm, sheet);
        }
        object
    }

    fn rule_objects<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, AnyCSSRule> {
        let objects = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        for object in self.objects.borrow().0.values() {
            objects.push(*object);
        }
        objects
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_parent_style_sheet(&self, vm: &Vm, sheet: Option<CppCell>) {
        *self.parent_style_sheet.borrow_mut(vm) = sheet.clone();
        for object in self.rule_objects(vm).values().iter() {
            object.set_parent_style_sheet(vm, sheet.clone());
        }
    }

    /// Replaces the rules of the list with those of the other list, whose objects are new.
    pub(crate) fn set_rules(&self, vm: &Vm, rules: &NativeRuleList, document: Option<CppCell>) {
        for object in self.rule_objects(vm).values().iter() {
            object.set_parent_style_sheet(vm, None);
        }
        self.rules.cssom_replace(rules);
        self.objects.borrow_mut(vm).0.clear();
        *self.document.borrow_mut(vm) = document;
    }

    /// What a change of the rules of a sheet means for the sheet: only the list of the sheet itself has no owner rule.
    fn notify_change(&self) {
        if self.owner_rule.borrow().is_some() {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(sheet) = self.parent_style_sheet.borrow().as_ref() {
            // SAFETY: The cell is that of a live CSSStyleSheet.
            unsafe { web_css_style_sheet_rules_changed(sheet.as_ptr()) };
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#remove-a-css-rule
    pub(crate) fn remove_a_css_rule_without_validation(&self, vm: &Vm, index: usize) {
        assert!(index < self.native_length(), "the caller validated the index");

        let old_rule = self.rules.cssom_rule_at(index);
        let identity = old_rule.cssom_identity();
        let old_object = self.existing_object(identity);

        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#font-face-css-connection
        // If a @font-face rule is removed from the document, its corresponding FontFace object is no longer
        // CSS-connected. The connection is not restorable by any means (but adding the @font-face back to the
        // stylesheet will create a brand new FontFace object which is CSS-connected).
        if let Some(sheet) = self.parent_style_sheet.borrow().as_ref() {
            // SAFETY: The cell is that of a live CSSStyleSheet, and the rule is live.
            unsafe { web_css_style_sheet_disconnect_font_faces(sheet.as_ptr(), Rc::as_ptr(&old_rule).cast()) };
        }

        // 5. Remove rule old rule from list at the zero-indexed position index.
        self.rules.cssom_remove(index);
        self.objects.borrow_mut(vm).0.remove(&identity);

        // 6. Set old rule’s parent CSS rule and parent CSS style sheet to null.
        // NB: We set the parent stylesheet to null within set_parent_rule.
        if let Some(old_object) = old_object {
            old_object.set_parent_rule(vm, None);
        }

        self.notify_change();
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssrulelist-item
    pub(crate) fn item(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Option<AnyCSSRule>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let index = index as usize;
        if index >= self.native_length() {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        Ok(Some(self.rule_at(vm, index)))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssrulelist-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(u32::try_from(self.native_length()).expect("a list has fewer than 2^32 rules"))
    }
}

//! CSSRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-cssrule-interface

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ops::Deref;
use core::ptr::{NonNull, null_mut};
use std::rc::Rc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, Object, ThrowCompletionOr, Trace, Value, Vm};
use libweb_rust::{NativeRule, NativeRuleList, NativeRuleType, TextSink};

use super::css_condition_rule::CSSConditionRule;
use super::css_container_rule::CSSContainerRule;
use super::css_counter_style_rule::CSSCounterStyleRule;
use super::css_font_face_rule::CSSFontFaceRule;
use super::css_font_feature_values_rule::CSSFontFeatureValuesRule;

use super::css_function_rule::CSSFunctionRule;
use super::css_grouping_rule::CSSGroupingRule;
use super::css_import_rule::CSSImportRule;
use super::css_keyframe_rule::CSSKeyframeRule;

use super::css_media_rule::CSSMediaRule;
use super::css_namespace_rule::CSSNamespaceRule;
