unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_wrap_object(realm: *mut c_void, cell: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_rule_create_declarations(rule: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_declarations_serialized(declarations: *mut c_void) -> usize;
    fn web_css_declaration_owner(declaration: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_style_sheet_native_rules(sheet: *mut c_void) -> *const c_void;
    fn web_css_selector_list_text(selectors: *const c_void, sheet: *mut c_void) -> usize;
}

/// The wrapper of the object of an interface implemented in C++ in the world of the call.
pub(crate) fn wrap_cpp_cell(cx: &CallContext, cell: &CppCell) -> CppInterface {
    // SAFETY: The realm is live, and the cell is that of an object of an interface implemented in C++.
    let wrapper = unsafe { web_css_wrap_object(cx.realm().as_ptr().cast(), cell.as_ptr()) };
    let wrapper = NonNull::new(wrapper.cast::<Object>()).expect("LibWeb returns the wrapper of the object");
    // SAFETY: LibWeb returns a live wrapper of the object.
    unsafe { CppInterface::from_wrapper(Gc::from_non_null(wrapper)) }
}

/// The text of the selector list that the pointer points to, which names the namespaces of the sheet.
pub(crate) fn selector_list_text(selectors: *const c_void, sheet: Option<&CppCell>) -> Utf16String {
    let sheet = sheet.map_or(null_mut(), CppCell::as_ptr);
    // SAFETY: The caller passes a live list, and the sheet is the live cell of a CSSStyleSheet, or null.
    let text = unsafe { web_css_selector_list_text(selectors, sheet) };
    // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over the string.
    unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(text) }
}

/// The native rules of the sheet, whose cell is that of a CSSStyleSheet.
pub(crate) fn native_rules_of_sheet(sheet: &CppCell) -> Rc<NativeRuleList> {
    // SAFETY: The cell is that of a live CSSStyleSheet.
    let rules = unsafe { web_css_style_sheet_native_rules(sheet.as_ptr()) };
    // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live list of the sheet.
    unsafe { NativeRuleList::retained_from_raw(rules.cast()) }
}

/// What an interface that inherits from CSSRule says about the memory of its objects outside the heap, which is that
/// of the native rule.
macro_rules! impl_rule_wrappable {
    ($type:ty) => {
        impl crate::bindings::interface::Wrappable for $type {
            // NB: The native rules and their lists share state with the whole document's style without synchronization.
            const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
            const OWNS_EXTERNAL_MEMORY: bool = true;

            fn external_memory_size(&self) -> usize {
                self.rule().native_rule().cssom_external_memory_size()
            }
        }
    };
}
pub(crate) use impl_rule_wrappable;

/// A rule's part of every rule, which the attributes of CSSRule run on.
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSRule {
    /// The rule of the sheet that the object represents.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>,
    /// The object that this is the part of, which the steps that differ between the interfaces run on.
    object: GcRefCell<Option<AnyCSSRule>>,
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#concept-css-rule-parent-css-rule
    parent_rule: GcRefCell<Option<AnyCSSRule>>,
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#concept-css-rule-parent-css-style-sheet, the cell of a CSSStyleSheet.
    parent_style_sheet: GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,
    /// The cell of the CSSStyleDeclaration of the declarations of the rule, once it is asked for.
    declarations: GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSRule {
    const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
}

impl CSSRule {
    pub(crate) fn new(native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Self {
        Self {
            native_rule,
            object: GcRefCell::new(None),
            parent_rule: GcRefCell::new(None),
            parent_style_sheet: GcRefCell::new(None),
            declarations: GcRefCell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn native_rule(&self) -> &Rc<NativeRule> {
        &self.native_rule
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_object(&self, vm: &Vm, object: AnyCSSRule) {
        *self.object.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(object);
    }

    pub(crate) fn object(&self) -> AnyCSSRule {
        self.object.borrow().expect("an object knows what it is")
    }

    pub(crate) fn parent_rule_object(&self) -> Option<AnyCSSRule> {
        *self.parent_rule.borrow()
    }

    pub(crate) fn parent_sheet(&self) -> Option<CppCell> {
        self.parent_style_sheet.borrow().clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn store_parent_rule(&self, vm: &Vm, parent_rule: Option<AnyCSSRule>) {
        *self.parent_rule.borrow_mut(vm) = parent_rule;
    }

    pub(crate) fn store_parent_style_sheet(&self, vm: &Vm, parent_style_sheet: Option<CppCell>) {
        *self.parent_style_sheet.borrow_mut(vm) = parent_style_sheet;
    }

    /// The CSSStyleDeclaration of the declarations of the rule, which the first call creates.
    pub(crate) fn declarations(&self, vm: &Vm) -> CppCell {
        if let Some(declarations) = self.declarations.borrow().as_ref() {
            return declarations.clone();
        }
        // SAFETY: The cell is that of this object, which is live.
        let declarations = unsafe { web_css_rule_create_declarations(self.object().cell()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns a live cell.
        let declarations = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(declarations) };
        *self.declarations.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(declarations.clone());
        declarations
    }

    /// The text of the declarations of the rule, which is what the CSSStyleDeclaration of the rule serializes to.
    pub(crate) fn serialized_declarations(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        let declarations = self.declarations(vm);
        // SAFETY: The cell is that of a live CSSStyleDeclaration.
        let text = unsafe { web_css_declarations_serialized(declarations.as_ptr()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over the string.
        unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(text) }
    }

    /// The object of an interface implemented in Rust that owns the CSSStyleDeclaration of the rule, which the `style`
    /// attribute of the rule returns.
    pub(crate) fn declarations_object<T: Interface>(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> Ref<T> {
        let declarations = self.declarations(cx.vm());
        // SAFETY: The cell is that of a live CSSStyleDeclaration, whose owner is an object of the interface of the rule.
        unsafe { cell_from_abi(web_css_declaration_owner(declarations.as_ptr())) }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssrule-csstext
    pub(crate) fn css_text(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The cssText attribute must return a serialization of the CSS rule.
        Ok(self.object().serialized(cx.vm()))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssrule-csstext
    pub(crate) fn set_css_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext, _: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // On setting the cssText attribute must do nothing.
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssrule-parentrule
    pub(crate) fn parent_rule(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<AnyCSSRule>> {
        Ok(self.parent_rule_object())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssrule-parentstylesheet
    pub(crate) fn parent_style_sheet(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<CSSStyleSheet>>> {
        let sheet = self.parent_style_sheet.borrow();
        // SAFETY: The cell is that of a live CSSStyleSheet.
        Ok(sheet.as_ref().map(|sheet| unsafe { cell_from_abi(sheet.as_ptr()) }))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssrule-type
    pub(crate) fn type_for_bindings(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u16> {
        // NB: Types that aren't defined in the spec must return 0.
        //     To do this, we arbitrarily make non-spec ones start at 100.
        let rule_type = self.native_rule.cssom_type() as u16;
        Ok(if rule_type >= 100 { 0 } else { rule_type })
    }
}

/// The object of a CSSRule, of an interface that inherits from it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
#[expect(clippy::enum_variant_names, reason = "the variants are named after the interfaces")]
#[expect(
    dead_code,
    reason = "the bindings match the variants of interfaces that only others inherit from"
)]
pub(crate) enum AnyCSSRule {
    CSSRule(Ref<CSSRule>),
    CSSConditionRule(Ref<CSSConditionRule>),
    CSSContainerRule(Ref<CSSContainerRule>),
    CSSCounterStyleRule(Ref<CSSCounterStyleRule>),
    CSSFontFaceRule(Ref<CSSFontFaceRule>),
    CSSFontFeatureValuesRule(Ref<CSSFontFeatureValuesRule>),
    CSSFunctionDeclarations(Ref<CSSFunctionDeclarations>),
    CSSFunctionRule(Ref<CSSFunctionRule>),
    CSSGroupingRule(Ref<CSSGroupingRule>),
    CSSImportRule(Ref<CSSImportRule>),
    CSSKeyframeRule(Ref<CSSKeyframeRule>),
    CSSKeyframesRule(Ref<CSSKeyframesRule>),
    CSSLayerBlockRule(Ref<CSSLayerBlockRule>),
    CSSLayerStatementRule(Ref<CSSLayerStatementRule>),
    CSSMarginRule(Ref<CSSMarginRule>),
    CSSMediaRule(Ref<CSSMediaRule>),
    CSSNamespaceRule(Ref<CSSNamespaceRule>),
    CSSNestedDeclarations(Ref<CSSNestedDeclarations>),
    CSSPageRule(Ref<CSSPageRule>),
    CSSPositionTryRule(Ref<CSSPositionTryRule>),
    CSSPropertyRule(Ref<CSSPropertyRule>),
    CSSScopeRule(Ref<CSSScopeRule>),
    CSSStyleRule(Ref<CSSStyleRule>),
    CSSSupportsRule(Ref<CSSSupportsRule>),
}

/// Runs the expression on the object of every interface that has objects of its own.
macro_rules! for_each_rule {
    ($any:expr, $object:ident => $expression:expr) => {
        match $any {
            AnyCSSRule::CSSContainerRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSCounterStyleRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSFontFaceRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSFontFeatureValuesRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSFunctionDeclarations($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSFunctionRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSImportRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSKeyframeRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSKeyframesRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSLayerBlockRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSLayerStatementRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSMarginRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSMediaRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSNamespaceRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSNestedDeclarations($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSPageRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSPositionTryRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSPropertyRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSScopeRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSStyleRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSSupportsRule($object) => $expression,
            AnyCSSRule::CSSRule(_) | AnyCSSRule::CSSGroupingRule(_) | AnyCSSRule::CSSConditionRule(_) => {
                unreachable!("nothing creates an object of an interface that only others inherit from")
            }
        }
    };
}

impl Deref for AnyCSSRule {
    type Target = CSSRule;

    fn deref(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        for_each_rule!(self, object => object.rule())
    }
}

impl ToJs for AnyCSSRule {
    fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {
        Ok(Value::from_object(for_each_rule!(self, object => wrap(cx, object))))
    }
}

impl AnyCSSRule {
    /// The object for a rule of a sheet, which `document` loads what it imports for.
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, rule: Rc<NativeRule>, document: Option<&CppCell>) -> Self {
        let object = match rule.cssom_type() {
            NativeRuleType::Style => Self::CSSStyleRule(CSSStyleRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Import => Self::CSSImportRule(CSSImportRule::create(vm, rule, document)),
            NativeRuleType::Media => Self::CSSMediaRule(CSSMediaRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::FontFace => Self::CSSFontFaceRule(CSSFontFaceRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Page => Self::CSSPageRule(CSSPageRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Keyframes => Self::CSSKeyframesRule(CSSKeyframesRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Keyframe => Self::CSSKeyframeRule(CSSKeyframeRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Margin => Self::CSSMarginRule(CSSMarginRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Namespace => Self::CSSNamespaceRule(CSSNamespaceRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::CounterStyle => Self::CSSCounterStyleRule(CSSCounterStyleRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Supports => Self::CSSSupportsRule(CSSSupportsRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::FontFeatureValues => {
                Self::CSSFontFeatureValuesRule(CSSFontFeatureValuesRule::create(vm, rule))
            }
            NativeRuleType::LayerBlock => Self::CSSLayerBlockRule(CSSLayerBlockRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::LayerStatement => Self::CSSLayerStatementRule(CSSLayerStatementRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::NestedDeclarations => Self::CSSNestedDeclarations(CSSNestedDeclarations::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Property => Self::CSSPropertyRule(CSSPropertyRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Function => Self::CSSFunctionRule(CSSFunctionRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::FunctionDeclarations => {
                Self::CSSFunctionDeclarations(CSSFunctionDeclarations::create(vm, rule))
            }
            NativeRuleType::Container => Self::CSSContainerRule(CSSContainerRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::Scope => Self::CSSScopeRule(CSSScopeRule::create(vm, rule)),
            NativeRuleType::PositionTry => Self::CSSPositionTryRule(CSSPositionTryRule::create(vm, rule)),
        };
        if let Self::CSSImportRule(import) = object {
            return CSSImportRule::finish(import, vm);
        }
        object.set_object(vm, object);
        object
    }

    /// The cell of the object, which C++ names through the handles of the rules.
    pub(crate) fn cell(self) -> *mut c_void {
        for_each_rule!(self, object => cell_into_abi(object))
    }

    /// The object as a rule with child rules that it manages itself, if it is one.
    pub(crate) fn grouping_rule(&self) -> Option<&CSSGroupingRule> {
        match self {
            Self::CSSContainerRule(object) => Some(object.grouping_rule()),
            Self::CSSFunctionRule(object) => Some(object.grouping_rule()),
            Self::CSSLayerBlockRule(object) => Some(object.grouping_rule()),
            Self::CSSMediaRule(object) => Some(object.grouping_rule()),
            Self::CSSPageRule(object) => Some(object.grouping_rule()),
            Self::CSSScopeRule(object) => Some(object.grouping_rule()),
            Self::CSSStyleRule(object) => Some(object.grouping_rule()),
            Self::CSSSupportsRule(object) => Some(object.grouping_rule()),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    /// The list of child rules of the object, if it has made one.
    pub(crate) fn existing_child_rules(&self) -> Option<Ref<CSSRuleList>> {
        if let Self::CSSKeyframesRule(object) = self {
            return object.existing_css_rules();
        }
        self.grouping_rule().and_then(CSSGroupingRule::existing_css_rules)
    }

    /// The list of child rules of the object, which the first call makes.
    pub(crate) fn child_rules(self, vm: &Vm) -> Option<Ref<CSSRuleList>> {
        if let Self::CSSKeyframesRule(object) = self {
            return Some(object.child_rules(vm));
        }
        self.grouping_rule().map(|rule| rule.child_rules(vm))
    }

    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-rule
    pub(crate) fn serialized(self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        for_each_rule!(self, object => object.serialized(vm))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_parent_rule(self, vm: &Vm, parent_rule: Option<Self>) {
        self.store_parent_rule(vm, parent_rule);
        self.set_parent_style_sheet(vm, parent_rule.and_then(|parent_rule| parent_rule.parent_sheet()));
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_parent_style_sheet(self, vm: &Vm, sheet: Option<CppCell>) {
        self.store_parent_style_sheet(vm, sheet.clone());
        if let Self::CSSImportRule(object) = self {
            object.parent_style_sheet_changed(sheet.as_ref());
        }
        if let Some(rules) = self.existing_child_rules() {
            rules.set_parent_style_sheet(vm, sheet);
        }
    }
}

/// The text of each of the rules of the list, without the empty ones.
pub(crate) fn serialized_rules(vm: &Vm, rules: Ref<CSSRuleList>) -> Vec<Utf16String> {
    (0..rules.native_length())
        .map(|index| rules.rule_at(vm, index).serialized(vm))
        .filter(|text| !text.is_empty())
        .collect()
}

/// A string that grows by what the rules serialize to.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct RuleText(TextSink);

impl RuleText {
    pub(crate) fn new(text: &str) -> Self {
        let mut result = Self::default();
        result.push_str(text);
        result
    }

    pub(crate) fn push_str(&mut self, text: &str) {
        text.encode_utf16().for_each(|unit| self.0.push_code_unit(unit));
    }

    pub(crate) fn push(&mut self, text: &Utf16String) {
        self.0.push_string(text);
    }

    pub(crate) fn push_units(&mut self, units: &[u16]) {
        units.iter().for_each(|&unit| self.0.push_code_unit(unit));
    }

    pub(crate) fn finish(self) -> Utf16String {
        self.0.into_utf16_string()
    }
}

/// `@<at-rule> {`, each rule on a line of its own indented by two spaces, and `}`, as @media, @scope and @container
/// serialize, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-rule
pub(crate) fn serialize_block_of_rules(mut text: RuleText, vm: &Vm, rules: Ref<CSSRuleList>) -> Utf16String {
    // 3. A single SPACE (U+0020), followed by the string "{", i.e., LEFT CURLY BRACKET (U+007B), followed by a newline.
    text.push_str(" {\n");

    // 4. The result of performing serialize a CSS rule on each rule in the rule’s cssRules list,
    //    filtering out empty strings, indenting each item with two spaces, all joined with newline.
    for rule in serialized_rules(vm, rules) {
        text.push_str("  ");
        text.push(&rule);
        text.push_str("\n");
    }

    // 5. A newline, followed by the string "}", i.e., RIGHT CURLY BRACKET (U+007D)
    // AD-HOC: All modern browsers omit the ending newline if there are no CSS rules, so let's do the same.
    //         If there are rules, the required newline is appended in the loop above.
    text.push_str("}");
    text.finish()
}

//! CSSScale, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssscale

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{RetainedStyleValue, TransformFunction, transformation_style_value};

use super::css_numeric_value::{AnyCSSNumericValue, CSSNumberish, SerializationParams, rectify_a_numberish_value};
use super::css_transform_component::{
    AnyCSSTransformComponent, CSSTransformComponent, Is2D, argument_style_value, create_dom_matrix, matches_number,
};
use super::css_unit_value::CSSUnitValue;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix::DOMMatrix;
use crate::geometry::matrix::Matrix4;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSScale {
    transform_component: CSSTransformComponent,
    x: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    y: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    z: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSScale {}

impl Inherits<CSSTransformComponent> for CSSScale {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSTransformComponent {
        &self.transform_component
    }
}

impl CSSScale {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        is_2d: Is2D,
        x: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        y: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        z: AnyCSSNumericValue,
    ) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            transform_component: CSSTransformComponent::new(is_2d),
            x: GcRefCell::new(x),
            y: GcRefCell::new(y),
            z: GcRefCell::new(z),
        });
        AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSScale(object).finish(vm);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        x: CSSNumberish,
        y: CSSNumberish,
        z: Option<CSSNumberish>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // The CSSScale(x, y, z) constructor must, when invoked, perform the following steps:

        // 1. Let x, y, and z (if passed) be replaced by the result of rectifying a numberish value.
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rectified_x = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &x, None);
        let rectified_y = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &y, None);
        let rectified_z = z.map(|z| rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &z, None));

        // 2. If x, y, or z (if passed) don’t match <number>, throw a TypeError.
        if !matches_number(&rectified_x) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSScale x component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        if !matches_number(&rectified_y) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSScale y component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        if rectified_z.as_ref().is_some_and(|z| !matches_number(z)) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSScale z component doesn't match <number>"));
        }

        // 3. Let this be a new CSSScale object, with its x and y internal slots set to x and y.
        // 4. If z was passed, set this’s z internal slot to z, and set this’s is2D internal slot to false.
        // 5. If z was not passed, set this’s z internal slot to a new unit value of (1, "number"), and set this’s is2D
        //    internal slot to true.
        let (is_2d, rectified_z) = match rectified_z {
            Some(z) => (Is2D::No, z),
            None => (
                Is2D::Yes,
                AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(vm, 1.0, "number")),
            ),
        };
        let this = Self::create(vm, is_2d, rectified_x, rectified_y, rectified_z);

        // 6. Return this.
        Ok(this)
    }

    pub(crate) fn x(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CSSNumberish> {
        Ok(CSSNumberish::CSSNumericValue(*self.x.borrow()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn y(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CSSNumberish> {
        Ok(CSSNumberish::CSSNumericValue(*self.y.borrow()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn z(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CSSNumberish> {
        Ok(CSSNumberish::CSSNumericValue(*self.z.borrow()))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssscale-x
    pub(crate) fn set_x(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: CSSNumberish) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The x, y, and z attributes must, on setting to a new value val, rectify a numberish value from val and set
        // the corresponding internal slot to the result of that.
        // AD-HOC: WPT expects this to throw for invalid values. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rectified_x = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &value, None);
        if !matches_number(&rectified_x) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSScale x component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        *self.x.borrow_mut(vm) = rectified_x;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssscale-y
    pub(crate) fn set_y(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: CSSNumberish) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The x, y, and z attributes must, on setting to a new value val, rectify a numberish value from val and set
        // the corresponding internal slot to the result of that.
        // AD-HOC: WPT expects this to throw for invalid values. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rectified_y = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &value, None);
        if !matches_number(&rectified_y) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSScale y component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        *self.y.borrow_mut(vm) = rectified_y;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssscale-z
    pub(crate) fn set_z(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: CSSNumberish) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The x, y, and z attributes must, on setting to a new value val, rectify a numberish value from val and set
        // the corresponding internal slot to the result of that.
        // AD-HOC: WPT expects this to throw for invalid values. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let rectified_z = rectify_a_numberish_value(vm, &value, None);
        if !matches_number(&rectified_z) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSScale z component doesn't match <number>"));
        }
        *self.z.borrow_mut(vm) = rectified_z;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssscale
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self) -> Utf16String {
        let params = SerializationParams::default();

        // 1. Let s initially be the empty string.
        let mut s = String::new();

        // 2. If this’s is2D internal slot is false:
        if !self.transform_component.raw_is_2d() {
            // 1. Append "scale3d(" to s.
            s.push_str("scale3d(");

            // 2. Serialize this’s x internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.x.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 3. Append ", " to s.
            s.push_str(", ");

            // 4. Serialize this’s y internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.y.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 5. Append ", " to s.
            s.push_str(", ");

            // 6. Serialize this’s z internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.z.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 7. Append ")" to s, and return s.
            s.push(')');
        }
        // 3. Otherwise:
        else {
            // 1. Append "scale(" to s.
            s.push_str("scale(");

            // 2. Serialize this’s x internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.x.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 3. If this’s x and y internal slots are equal numeric values, append ")" to s and return s.
            // AD-HOC: Don't do this - neither Chrome nor Safari show this behavior.
            //         Upstream issue: https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1161

            // 4. Otherwise, append ", " to s.
            s.push_str(", ");

            // 5. Serialize this’s y internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.y.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 6. Append ")" to s, and return s.
            s.push(')');
        }
        Utf16String::from_utf8(&s)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstransformcomponent-tomatrix
    pub(crate) fn to_matrix(&self, vm: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        // 1. Let matrix be a new DOMMatrix object, initialized to this’s equivalent 4x4 transform matrix, as defined in
        //    CSS Transforms 1 § 12. Mathematical Description of Transform Functions, and with its is2D internal slot
        //    set to the same value as this’s is2D internal slot.
        //    NOTE: Recall that the is2D flag affects what transform, and thus what equivalent matrix, a
        //          CSSTransformComponent represents.
        //    As the entries of such a matrix are defined relative to the px unit, if any <length>s in this involved in
        //    generating the matrix are not compatible units with px (such as relative lengths or percentages), throw a
        //    TypeError.
        // 2. Return matrix.

        // NB: to_unit() throws a TypeError if the conversion can't be done.
        let is_2d = self.transform_component.raw_is_2d();
        let x = self.x.borrow().to_unit(vm, "number")?.raw_value();
        let y = self.y.borrow().to_unit(vm, "number")?.raw_value();

        let mut z = 1.0;
        if !is_2d {
            z = self.z.borrow().to_unit(vm, "number")?.raw_value();
        }

        Ok(create_dom_matrix(vm, Matrix4::scale(x, y, z), is_2d))
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_style_value(&self, vm: &Vm, property_id: u16) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        let x = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.x.borrow())?;
        let y = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.y.borrow())?;
        if self.transform_component.raw_is_2d() {
            return Ok(transformation_style_value(
                property_id,
                TransformFunction::Scale,
                vec![x, y],
            ));
        }

        let z = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.z.borrow())?;
        Ok(transformation_style_value(
            property_id,
            TransformFunction::Scale3d,
            vec![x, y, z],
        ))
    }
}

//! CSSScopeRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade-6/#the-cssscoperule-interface

use super::css_grouping_rule::CSSGroupingRule;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_rule::{CSSRule, RuleText, selector_list_text, serialize_block_of_rules};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use std::rc::Rc;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSScopeRule {
    grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSScopeRule);

impl Inherits<CSSGroupingRule> for CSSScopeRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }
}

impl CSSScopeRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule::new(native_rule),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        self.grouping_rule.rule()
    }

    pub(crate) fn grouping_rule(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }

    fn scope_text(&self, selectors: *const core::ffi::c_void) -> Option<Utf16String> {
        (!selectors.is_null()).then(|| selector_list_text(selectors, None))
    }

    fn start_text(&self) -> Option<Utf16String> {
        let (start, _) = self
            .rule()
            .native_rule()
            .scope_selector_lists()
            .expect("a @scope rule has a scope");
        self.scope_text(start)
    }

    fn end_text(&self) -> Option<Utf16String> {
        let (_, end) = self
            .rule()
            .native_rule()
            .scope_selector_lists()
            .expect("a @scope rule has a scope");
        self.scope_text(end)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade-6/#dom-cssscoperule-start
    pub(crate) fn start(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        Ok(self.start_text())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade-6/#dom-cssscoperule-end
    pub(crate) fn end(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        Ok(self.end_text())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-rule
    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        // AD-HOC: There is no spec for this yet.
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@scope");
        if let Some(start) = self.start_text() {
            text.push_str(" (");
            text.push(&start);
            text.push_str(")");
        }
        if let Some(end) = self.end_text() {
            text.push_str(" to (");
            text.push(&end);
            text.push_str(")");
        }
        serialize_block_of_rules(text, vm, self.grouping_rule.child_rules(vm))
    }
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSSkewX {

    }

        Ok(*self.ax.borrow())
    }

        //         WPT expects this to throw for invalid values.
        if !matches_angle(&ax) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSSkewX ax component doesn't match <angle>"));
        }
        *self.ax.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = ax;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssskewx
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self) -> Utf16String {
        // 1. Let s initially be "skewX(".
        let mut s = String::from("skewX(");

        // 2. Serialize this’s ax internal slot, and append it to s.
        self.ax.borrow().serialize(&mut s, SerializationParams::default());

        // 3. Append ")" to s, and return s.
        s.push(')');
        Utf16String::from_utf8(&s)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstransformcomponent-tomatrix
    pub(crate) fn to_matrix(&self, vm: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        // 1. Let matrix be a new DOMMatrix object, initialized to this’s equivalent 4x4 transform matrix, as defined in
        //    CSS Transforms 1 § 12. Mathematical Description of Transform Functions, and with its is2D internal slot
        //    set to the same value as this’s is2D internal slot.
        //    NOTE: Recall that the is2D flag affects what transform, and thus what equivalent matrix, a
        //          CSSTransformComponent represents.
        //    As the entries of such a matrix are defined relative to the px unit, if any <length>s in this involved in
        //    generating the matrix are not compatible units with px (such as relative lengths or percentages), throw a
        //    TypeError.
        let ax_rad = self.ax.borrow().to_unit(vm, "rad")?.raw_value();

        // NB: Matrix4 is row by row, so the element m21 is in the first row.
        let mut matrix = Matrix4::identity();
        matrix.elements[0][1] = f64::from(math::tan(ax_rad as f32));

        Ok(create_dom_matrix(vm, matrix, self.transform_component.raw_is_2d()))
    }

    }

        Ok(transformation_style_value(
            property_id,
            TransformFunction::SkewX,
            vec![ax],
        ))
    }
}

//! CSSSkew, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssskew

use ak::{Utf16String, math};
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{RetainedStyleValue, TransformFunction, transformation_style_value};

use super::css_numeric_value::{AnyCSSNumericValue, SerializationParams};
use super::css_transform_component::{
    AnyCSSTransformComponent, CSSTransformComponent, Is2D, argument_style_value, create_dom_matrix, matches_angle,
};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix::DOMMatrix;
use crate::geometry::matrix::Matrix4;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSSkew {
    transform_component: CSSTransformComponent,
    ax: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    ay: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSSkew {}

impl Inherits<CSSTransformComponent> for CSSSkew {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSTransformComponent {
        &self.transform_component
    }
}

impl CSSSkew {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, ax: AnyCSSNumericValue, ay: AnyCSSNumericValue) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            transform_component: CSSTransformComponent::new(Is2D::Yes),
            ax: GcRefCell::new(ax),
            ay: GcRefCell::new(ay),
        });
        AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSSkew(object).finish(vm);
        object
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssskew-cssskew
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        ax: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        ay: AnyCSSNumericValue,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // The CSSSkew(ax, ay) constructor must, when invoked, perform the following steps:

        // 1. If ax or ay do not match <angle>, throw a TypeError.
        if !matches_angle(&ax) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSSkew ax component doesn't match <angle>"));
        }
        if !matches_angle(&ay) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSSkew ay component doesn't match <angle>"));
        }

        // 2. Return a new CSSSkew object with its ax and ay internal slots set to ax and ay, and its is2D internal slot
        //    set to true.
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), ax, ay))
    }

    pub(crate) fn ax(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        Ok(*self.ax.borrow())
    }

    pub(crate) fn ay(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        Ok(*self.ay.borrow())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_ax(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, ax: AnyCSSNumericValue) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // AD-HOC: Not specced. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        //         WPT expects this to throw for invalid values.
        if !matches_angle(&ax) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSSkew ax component doesn't match <angle>"));
        }
        *self.ax.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = ax;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_ay(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, ay: AnyCSSNumericValue) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // AD-HOC: Not specced. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        //         WPT expects this to throw for invalid values.
        if !matches_angle(&ay) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSSkew ay component doesn't match <angle>"));
        }
        *self.ay.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = ay;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssskew
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self) -> Utf16String {
        let params = SerializationParams::default();

        // 1. Let s initially be "skew(".
        let mut s = String::from("skew(");

        // 2. Serialize this’s ax internal slot, and append it to s.
        self.ax.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

        // 3. If this’s ay internal slot is a CSSUnitValue with a value of 0, then append ")" to s and return s.
        let ay = *self.ay.borrow();
        if ay.as_unit_value().is_some_and(|ay| ay.raw_value() == 0.0) {
            s.push(')');
            return Utf16String::from_utf8(&s);
        }

        // 4. Otherwise, append ", " to s.
        s.push_str(", ");

        // 5. Serialize this’s ay internal slot, and append it to s.
        ay.serialize(&mut s, params);

        // 6. Append ")" to s, and return s.
        s.push(')');
        Utf16String::from_utf8(&s)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstransformcomponent-tomatrix
    pub(crate) fn to_matrix(&self, vm: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        // 1. Let matrix be a new DOMMatrix object, initialized to this’s equivalent 4x4 transform matrix, as defined in
        //    CSS Transforms 1 § 12. Mathematical Description of Transform Functions, and with its is2D internal slot
        //    set to the same value as this’s is2D internal slot.
        //    NOTE: Recall that the is2D flag affects what transform, and thus what equivalent matrix, a
        //          CSSTransformComponent represents.
        //    As the entries of such a matrix are defined relative to the px unit, if any <length>s in this involved in
        //    generating the matrix are not compatible units with px (such as relative lengths or percentages), throw a
        //    TypeError.
        let ax_rad = self.ax.borrow().to_unit(vm, "rad")?.raw_value();
        let ay_rad = self.ay.borrow().to_unit(vm, "rad")?.raw_value();

        // NB: Matrix4 is row by row, so the element m21 is in the first row and m12 in the second.
        let mut matrix = Matrix4::identity();
        matrix.elements[0][1] = f64::from(math::tan(ax_rad as f32));
        matrix.elements[1][0] = f64::from(math::tan(ay_rad as f32));

        Ok(create_dom_matrix(vm, matrix, self.transform_component.raw_is_2d()))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssskew-is2d
    pub(crate) fn set_is_2d(&self) {
        // The is2D attribute of a CSSSkew, CSSSkewX, or CSSSkewY object must, on setting, do nothing.
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_style_value(&self, vm: &Vm, property_id: u16) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        let ax = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.ax.borrow())?;
        let ay = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.ay.borrow())?;
        Ok(transformation_style_value(
            property_id,
            TransformFunction::Skew,
            vec![ax, ay],
        ))
    }
}

/// What every interface that inherits from CSSStyleDeclaration has: the Web::CSS::CSSStyleDeclaration that holds the

/// What a step that LibWeb runs says: `Ok` if it succeeded, and the message of the exception otherwise.
fn result_of_step(succeeded: bool, error_message: usize) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    if succeeded {
        return Ok(());
    }
    // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over the message of the exception.
    let message = unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(error_message) };
    Err(Exception::Dom("NoModificationAllowedError", message))
}

impl CSSStyleDeclaration {
    pub(crate) fn new(declaration: CppCell) -> Self {
        Self { declaration }
    }

    /// The C++ object that the wrappers of the object hold as their wrappable, which the wrapper caches of LibWeb's C++
    /// bindings look for.
    pub(crate) fn as_cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        NonNull::new(self.declaration.as_ptr())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_owner<T: Interface>(&self, owner: Ref<T>) {
        // SAFETY: The cells are live, and the owner keeps the declaration alive.
        unsafe { web_css_declaration_set_owner(self.declaration.as_ptr(), T::INTERFACE_NAME, cell_into_abi(owner)) };
    }

    /// The value of the property or descriptor, whose name is one the bindings know.
    pub(crate) fn get(&self, name: &'static str) -> Utf16String {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, the name is lent for the call, and LibWeb hands over the string.
        unsafe {
            Utf16String::from_raw_owned(web_css_declaration_get_by_name(
                self.declaration.as_ptr(),
                name.as_ptr(),
                name.len(),
            ))
        }
    }

    /// Sets the property or descriptor, whose name is one the bindings know.
    pub(crate) fn set(&self, name: &'static str, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut error_message = 0;
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, the name is lent for the call, and the value is handed over.
        let succeeded = unsafe {
            web_css_declaration_set_by_name(
                self.declaration.as_ptr(),
                name.as_ptr(),
                name.len(),
                value.into_raw(),
                &raw mut error_message,
            )
        };
        result_of_step(succeeded, error_message)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-csstext
    pub(crate) fn css_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and LibWeb hands over the string.
        Ok(unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(web_css_declaration_css_text(self.declaration.as_ptr())) })
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_css_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut error_message = 0;
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and the value is handed over.
        let succeeded = unsafe {
            web_css_declaration_set_css_text(self.declaration.as_ptr(), value.into_raw(), &raw mut error_message)
        };
        result_of_step(succeeded, error_message)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let length = unsafe { web_css_declaration_length(self.declaration.as_ptr()) };
        Ok(u32::try_from(length).expect("a declaration block has fewer than 2^32 declarations"))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-item
    pub(crate) fn item(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and LibWeb hands over the string.
        Ok(unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(web_css_declaration_item(self.declaration.as_ptr(), index as usize)) })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-getpropertyvalue
    pub(crate) fn get_property_value(&self, _: &mut CallContext, property: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, the name is handed over, and LibWeb hands over the string.
        Ok(unsafe {
            Utf16String::from_raw_owned(web_css_declaration_get_property_value(
                self.declaration.as_ptr(),
                property.into_raw(),
            ))
        })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-getpropertypriority
    pub(crate) fn get_property_priority(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        property: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, the name is handed over, and LibWeb hands over the string.
        Ok(unsafe {
            Utf16String::from_raw_owned(web_css_declaration_get_property_priority(
                self.declaration.as_ptr(),
                property.into_raw(),
            ))
        })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-setproperty
    pub(crate) fn set_property(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        property: Utf16String,
        value: Utf16String,
        priority: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut error_message = 0;
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and the strings are handed over.
        let succeeded = unsafe {
            web_css_declaration_set_property(
                self.declaration.as_ptr(),
                property.into_raw(),
                value.into_raw(),
                priority.into_raw(),
                &raw mut error_message,
            )
        };
        result_of_step(succeeded, error_message)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-removeproperty
    pub(crate) fn remove_property(&self, _: &mut CallContext, property: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        let mut removed_value = 0;
        let mut error_message = 0;
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and the name is handed over.
        let succeeded = unsafe {
            web_css_declaration_remove_property(
                self.declaration.as_ptr(),
                property.into_raw(),
                &raw mut removed_value,
                &raw mut error_message,
            )
        };
        result_of_step(succeeded, error_message)?;
        // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over the value.
        Ok(unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(removed_value) })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-parentrule
    pub(crate) fn parent_rule(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<AnyCSSRule>> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let rule = unsafe { web_css_declaration_parent_rule(self.declaration.as_ptr()) };
        if rule.is_null() {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live cell of a rule.
        Ok(Some(unsafe { rule_from_abi(InterfaceCell::from_raw(rule)) }))
    }

//! CSSStyleProperties, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyleproperties

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{
    Attribute, Gc, NativeFunction, Object, PropertyAttributes, PropertyKey, Realm, ThrowCompletionOr, Trace, Value, Vm,
};
use libweb_rust::css_property_names;

use super::css_style_declaration::CSSStyleDeclaration;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::{CppCell, LentCppCell, cpp_class};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Wrappable, allocate};

/// What an accessor of a CSS property captures. NB: The name is static, so the collector has nothing to see in it.
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSPropertyAccessor {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    property_name: &'static str,
}

impl CSSPropertyAccessor {
    /// The accessor's security check identifier, which differs from the attribute's only where that cannot matter.
    pub(crate) fn property_name(&self) -> &'static str {
        self.property_name
    }
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSStyleProperties {
    declaration: CSSStyleDeclaration,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSStyleProperties {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.declaration.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl Inherits<CSSStyleDeclaration> for CSSStyleProperties {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSStyleDeclaration {
        &self.declaration
    }
}

/// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#css-property-to-idl-attribute
fn css_property_to_idl_attribute(property: &str, lowercase_first: bool) -> String {
    // 1. Let output be the empty string.
    let mut output = String::new();

    // 2. Let uppercase next be unset.
    let mut uppercase_next = false;

    // 3. If the lowercase first flag is set, remove the first character from property.
    let property = if lowercase_first { &property[1..] } else { property };

    // 4. For each character c in property:
    for c in property.chars() {
        // 1. If c is "-", set uppercase next.
        if c == '-' {
            uppercase_next = true;
        }
        // 2. Otherwise, if uppercase next is set, unset uppercase next and append c converted to ASCII uppercase to
        //    output.
        else if uppercase_next {
            uppercase_next = false;
            output.push(c.to_ascii_uppercase());
        }
        // 3. Otherwise, append c to output.
        else {
            output.push(c);
        }
    }

    // 5. Return output.
    output
}

impl CSSStyleProperties {
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyleproperties-cssfloat
    pub(crate) fn css_float(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The cssFloat attribute, on getting, must return the result of invoking getPropertyValue() with float as
        // argument.
        Ok(self.declaration.get("float"))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_css_float(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // On setting, the attribute must invoke setProperty() with float as first argument, as second argument the
        // given value, and no third argument. Any exceptions thrown must be re-thrown.
        self.declaration.set("float", value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn property_value(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        property: &CSSPropertyAccessor,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.declaration.get(property.property_name))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_property_value(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        property: &CSSPropertyAccessor,
        value: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.declaration.set(property.property_name, value)
    }

    /// Defines the accessors of the CSS properties on the interface prototype object.
    pub(crate) fn define_property_accessors<Getter, Setter>(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        prototype: Gc<Object>,
        getter: Getter,
        setter: Setter,
    ) where
        Getter: Fn(&Vm, &CSSPropertyAccessor) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> + Copy + 'static,
        Setter: Fn(&Vm, &CSSPropertyAccessor) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> + Copy + 'static,
    {
        let attributes = PropertyAttributes::new(Attribute::CONFIGURABLE | Attribute::ENUMERABLE);
        let define = |attribute: &str, property_name: &'static str| {
            let key = PropertyKey::from_utf8(attribute);
            let capture = || CSSPropertyAccessor { property_name };
            let get = NativeFunction::create(vm, capture(), getter, 0, &key, Some(realm), Some("get"), None);
            let set = NativeFunction::create(vm, capture(), setter, 1, &key, Some(realm), Some("set"), None);
            prototype.define_direct_accessor(vm, &key, Some(get.upcast()), Some(set.upcast()), attributes);
        };
        for property in css_property_names() {
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyleproperties-camel_cased_attribute
            define(&css_property_to_idl_attribute(property, false), property);
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyleproperties-webkit_cased_attribute
            if property.starts_with("-webkit-") {
                define(&css_property_to_idl_attribute(property, true), property);
            }
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyleproperties-dashed_attribute
            if property.contains('-') {
                define(property, property);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// A new object that owns the declaration block, which LibWeb created.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_css_style_properties_create(vm: &Vm, declaration: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::CSSStyleProperties>) {
    let declaration = CppCell::from_lent(declaration);
    let object = allocate(vm, |_| CSSStyleProperties {
        declaration: CSSStyleDeclaration::new(declaration),
    });
    object.declaration.set_owner(object);
}

//! CSSStyleRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-cssstylerule-interface

use super::css_grouping_rule::CSSGroupingRule;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_rule::{CSSRule, RuleText, native_rules_of_sheet, selector_list_text};
use super::css_style_properties::CSSStyleProperties;
use super::style_property_map::StylePropertyMap;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use libjs_rust::api::GcRefCell;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use std::rc::Rc;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_style_rule_selector_changed(rule: *mut c_void);
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSStyleRule {
    grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule,
    /// The StylePropertyMap of the rule, once it is asked for.
    style_map: GcRefCell<Option<Ref<StylePropertyMap>>>,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSStyleRule);

impl Inherits<CSSGroupingRule> for CSSStyleRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }
}

impl CSSStyleRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            grouping_rule: CSSGroupingRule::new(native_rule),
            style_map: GcRefCell::new(None),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        self.grouping_rule.rule()
    }

    pub(crate) fn grouping_rule(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        &self.grouping_rule
    }

    fn serialized_selector_text(&self) -> Utf16String {
        // The selectorText attribute, on getting, must return the result of serializing the associated group of
        // selectors.
        selector_list_text(
            self.rule().native_rule().style_selector_list(),
            self.rule().parent_sheet().as_ref(),
        )
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-1/#dom-cssstylerule-selectortext
    pub(crate) fn selector_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.serialized_selector_text())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-1/#dom-cssstylerule-selectortext
    pub(crate) fn set_selector_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.replace_selectors(&value);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-1/#dom-cssstylerule-selectortext
    pub(crate) fn replace_selectors(&self, value: &Utf16String) {
        // 1. Run the parse a group of selectors algorithm on the given value.
        let sheet = self.rule().parent_sheet();
        let sheet_rules = sheet.as_ref().map(native_rules_of_sheet);

        // 2. If the algorithm returns a non-null value replace the associated group of selectors with the returned
        //    value.
        let native_rule = self.rule().native_rule();
        if native_rule.cssom_set_selector_text(value, sheet_rules.as_deref()) && sheet.is_some() {
            // SAFETY: The cell is that of this object, which is live.
            unsafe { web_css_style_rule_selector_changed(self.rule().object().cell()) };
        }

        // 3. Otherwise, if the algorithm returns a null value, do nothing.
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-1/#dom-cssstylerule-style
    pub(crate) fn style(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSStyleProperties>> {
        Ok(self.rule().declarations_object(cx))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssstylerule-stylemap
    pub(crate) fn style_map(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<StylePropertyMap>> {
        if let Some(style_map) = *self.style_map.borrow() {
            return Ok(style_map);
        }
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let style_map = StylePropertyMap::create(vm, self.rule().declarations(vm));
        *self.style_map.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(style_map);
        Ok(style_map)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-1/#serialize-a-css-rule
    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        // 1. Let s initially be the result of performing serialize a group of selectors on the rule’s associated
        //    selectors, followed by the string " {", i.e., a single SPACE (U+0020), followed by LEFT CURLY BRACKET
        //    (U+007B).
        let mut s = RuleText::default();
        s.push(&self.serialized_selector_text());
        s.push_str(" {");

        // 2. Let decls be the result of performing serialize a CSS declaration block on the rule’s associated
        //    declarations, or null if there are no such declarations.
        let decls = (!self.rule().native_rule().has_no_declarations()).then(|| self.rule().serialized_declarations(vm));

        // 3. Let rules be the result of performing serialize a CSS rule on each rule in the rule’s cssRules list,
        //    or null if there are no such rules.
        let child_rules = self.grouping_rule.child_rules(vm);
        let has_rules = child_rules.native_length() != 0;
        let mut rules = (0..child_rules.native_length())
            .map(|index| child_rules.rule_at(vm, index).serialized(vm))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();

        // 4. If decls and rules are both null, append " }" to s (i.e. a single SPACE (U+0020) followed by RIGHT CURLY
        //    BRACKET (U+007D)) and return s.
        if decls.is_none() && !has_rules {
            s.push_str(" }");
            return s.finish();
        }

        // 5. If rules is null:
        if !has_rules {
            // 1. Append a single SPACE (U+0020) to s
            s.push_str(" ");
            // 2. Append decls to s
            s.push(&decls.expect("step 4 returned if there are no declarations"));
            // 3. Append " }" to s (i.e. a single SPACE (U+0020) followed by RIGHT CURLY BRACKET (U+007D)).
            s.push_str(" }");
            // 4. Return s.
            return s.finish();
        }

        // 6. Otherwise:
        // 1. If decls is not null, prepend it to rules.
        if let Some(decls) = decls {
            rules.insert(0, decls);
        }

        // 2. For each rule in rules:
        for rule in &rules {
            // * If rule is the empty string, do nothing.
            if rule.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }

            // * Otherwise:
            // 1. Append a newline followed by two spaces to s.
            // 2. Append rule to s.
            s.push_str("\n  ");
            s.push(rule);
        }

        // 3. Append a newline followed by RIGHT CURLY BRACKET (U+007D) to s.
        s.push_str("\n}");

        // 4. Return s.
        s.finish()
    }
}

//! CSSStyleSheet, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-cssstylesheet-interface

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::null_mut;
use std::rc::Rc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::{NativeRule, NativeRuleList, NativeRuleType, NativeStyleSheetFlag};

use super::css_grouping_rule::{insertion_error, validate_rule_removal};
use super::css_rule::{AnyCSSRule, RuleText};
use super::css_rule_list::CSSRuleList;
use super::exports::rule_from_abi;
use super::media_list::MediaList;
use super::style_sheet::StyleSheet;
use crate::bindings::conversions::UsvString;

use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, InterfaceCell, Ref, Wrappable, allocate, cell_from_abi};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_realm_document(realm: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_style_sheet_construct(
        document: *mut c_void,
        has_base_url: bool,
        base_url: usize,
        media_list: *mut c_void,
        media_text: usize,
        disabled: bool,
    ) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_native_rules(state: *mut c_void) -> *const c_void;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_owner_rule(state: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_rule_list(state: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_parse_rule(state: *mut c_void, rule: usize) -> *const c_void;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_rule_inserted(state: *mut c_void, rule: *const c_void);
    fn web_css_sheet_state_remove_rule(state: *mut c_void, index: u32);
    fn web_css_sheet_state_replace(state: *mut c_void, text: usize) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_replace_rules(state: *mut c_void, text: usize);
}

/// The union (MediaList or DOMString) of CSSStyleSheetInit.
pub(crate) enum MediaListOrDOMString {
    MediaList(Ref<MediaList>),
    DOMString(Utf16String),
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dictdef-cssstylesheetinit
pub(crate) struct CSSStyleSheetInit {
    pub(crate) base_url: Option<Utf16String>,
    pub(crate) media: MediaListOrDOMString,
    pub(crate) disabled: bool,
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSStyleSheet {
    style_sheet: StyleSheet,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSStyleSheet {
    const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
    const OWNS_EXTERNAL_MEMORY: bool = true;

    fn external_memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        self.style_sheet.state_external_memory_size()
    }
}

impl Inherits<StyleSheet> for CSSStyleSheet {
    fn parent(&self) -> &StyleSheet {
        &self.style_sheet
    }
}

impl CSSStyleSheet {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, state: CppCell) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            style_sheet: StyleSheet::new(state),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn state_cell(&self) -> &CppCell {
        self.style_sheet.state_cell()
    }

    fn state(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.style_sheet.state()
    }

    fn native_rules(&self) -> Rc<NativeRuleList> {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let rules = unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_native_rules(self.state()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live list of the sheet.
        unsafe { NativeRuleList::retained_from_raw(rules.cast()) }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-cssstylesheet
    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext, options: CSSStyleSheetInit) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // SAFETY: The realm is live.
        let document = unsafe { web_css_realm_document(cx.realm().as_ptr().cast()) };
        let has_base_url = options.base_url.is_some();
        let base_url = options
            .base_url
            .unwrap_or_else(|| Utf16String::from_ascii(b""))
            .into_raw();
        let (media_list, media_text) = match options.media {
            MediaListOrDOMString::MediaList(list) => (list.as_ptr().cast(), Utf16String::from_ascii(b"").into_raw()),
            MediaListOrDOMString::DOMString(text) => (null_mut(), text.into_raw()),
        };
        // SAFETY: The document and the list are live, and the strings are handed over.
        let sheet = unsafe {
            web_css_style_sheet_construct(
                document,
                has_base_url,
                base_url,
                media_list,
                media_text,
                options.disabled,
            )
        };
        if sheet.is_null() {
            return Err(not_allowed_error("Constructed style sheets must have a valid base URL"));
        }
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live cell of a CSSStyleSheet.
        Ok(unsafe { cell_from_abi(sheet) })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-ownerrule
    pub(crate) fn owner_rule(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<AnyCSSRule>> {
        // The ownerRule attribute must return the owner CSS rule.
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let rule = unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_owner_rule(self.state()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live cell of a CSSImportRule, or null.
        Ok((!rule.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { rule_from_abi(InterfaceCell::from_raw(rule)) }))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-cssrules
    pub(crate) fn css_rules(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSRuleList>> {
        // 1. If the origin-clean flag is unset, throw a SecurityError exception.
        if !self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::OriginClean) {
            return Err(security_error("Can't access the rules of cross-origin stylesheets."));
        }

        // 2. Return a read-only, live CSSRuleList object representing the CSS rules.
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and LibWeb returns the live cell of a CSSRuleList.
        Ok(unsafe { cell_from_abi(web_css_sheet_state_rule_list(self.state())) })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-rules
    pub(crate) fn rules(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSRuleList>> {
        // The rules attribute must follow the same steps as cssRules, and return the same object cssRules would return.
        self.css_rules(cx)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-insertrule
    pub(crate) fn insert_rule(&self, _: &mut CallContext, rule: Utf16String, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // 1. If the origin-clean flag is unset, throw a SecurityError exception.
        if !self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::OriginClean) {
            return Err(security_error("Can't call insert_rule() on cross-origin stylesheets."));
        }

        // 2. If the disallow modification flag is set, throw a NotAllowedError DOMException.
        if self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::DisallowModification) {
            return Err(not_allowed_error(
                "Can't call insert_rule() on non-modifiable stylesheets.",
            ));
        }

        // 3. Let parsed rule be the return value of invoking parse a rule with rule.
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and the text is handed over.
        let parsed_rule = unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_parse_rule(self.state(), rule.into_raw()) };

        // 4. If parsed rule is a syntax error, throw a SyntaxError DOMException.
        if parsed_rule.is_null() {
            return Err(Exception::syntax_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(
                "Unable to parse CSS rule.",
            )));
        }
        // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over a reference to the rule.
        let parsed_rule = unsafe { Rc::from_raw(parsed_rule.cast::<NativeRule>()) };

        // 5. If parsed rule is an @import rule, and the constructed flag is set, throw a SyntaxError DOMException.
        if self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::Constructed)
            && parsed_rule.cssom_type() == NativeRuleType::Import
        {
            return Err(Exception::syntax_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(
                "Can't insert @import rules into a constructed stylesheet.",
            )));
        }

        // 6. Return the result of invoking insert a CSS rule rule in the CSS rules at index.
        insertion_error(
            self.native_rules()
                .cssom_insert_rule(index as usize, Rc::clone(&parsed_rule), false),
        )?;

        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and so is the rule.
        unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_rule_inserted(self.state(), Rc::as_ptr(&parsed_rule).cast()) };
        Ok(index)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-deleterule
    pub(crate) fn delete_rule(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If the origin-clean flag is unset, throw a SecurityError exception.
        if !self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::OriginClean) {
            return Err(security_error("Can't call delete_rule() on cross-origin stylesheets."));
        }

        // 2. If the disallow modification flag is set, throw a NotAllowedError DOMException.
        if self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::DisallowModification) {
            return Err(not_allowed_error(
                "Can't call delete_rule() on non-modifiable stylesheets.",
            ));
        }

        // 3. Remove a CSS rule in the CSS rules at index.
        validate_rule_removal(self.native_rules().cssom_validate_removal(index as usize))?;
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and the index is valid.
        unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_remove_rule(self.state(), index) };
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-replace
    pub(crate) fn replace(&self, _: &mut CallContext, text: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        // 1. Let promise be a promise.
        // 2. If the constructed flag is not set, or the disallow modification flag is set, reject promise with a
        //    NotAllowedError DOMException and return promise.
        // NB: The bindings reject a new promise with what this returns, as a sheet that is not constructed may have no
        //     owner node to find a realm through.
        if !self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::Constructed) {
            return Err(not_allowed_error("Can't call replace() on non-constructed stylesheets"));
        }
        if self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::DisallowModification) {
            return Err(not_allowed_error("Can't call replace() on non-modifiable stylesheets"));
        }

        let text = text.into_utf16_string().into_raw();
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, the text is handed over, and LibWeb returns a live promise.
        Ok(unsafe { promise_from_abi(web_css_sheet_state_replace(self.state(), text)) })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-replacesync
    pub(crate) fn replace_sync(&self, _: &mut CallContext, text: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#synchronously-replace-the-rules-of-a-cssstylesheet
        // 1. If the constructed flag is not set, or the disallow modification flag is set, throw a NotAllowedError
        //    DOMException.
        if !self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::Constructed) {
            return Err(not_allowed_error(
                "Can't call replaceSync() on non-constructed stylesheets",
            ));
        }
        if self.style_sheet.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::DisallowModification) {
            return Err(not_allowed_error(
                "Can't call replaceSync() on non-modifiable stylesheets",
            ));
        }

        let text = text.into_utf16_string().into_raw();
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and the text is handed over.
        unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_replace_rules(self.state(), text) };
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-addrule
    pub(crate) fn add_rule(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        selector: Utf16String,
        style: Utf16String,
        index: Option<u32>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        // 1. Let rule be an empty string.
        // 2. Append selector to rule.
        let mut rule = RuleText::default();
        rule.push(&selector);

        // 3. Append " { " to rule.
        rule.push_str(" { ");

        // 4. If block is not empty, append block, followed by a space, to rule.
        if !style.is_empty() {
            rule.push(&style);
            rule.push_str(" ");
        }

        // 5. Append "}" to rule
        rule.push_str("}");

        // 6. Let index be optionalIndex if provided, or the number of CSS rules in the stylesheet otherwise.
        let index = index.unwrap_or_else(|| {
            u32::try_from(self.native_rules().cssom_length()).expect("a sheet has fewer than 2^32 rules")
        });

        // 7. Call insertRule(), with rule and index as arguments.
        self.insert_rule(cx, rule.finish(), index)?;

        // 8. Return -1.
        Ok(-1)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstylesheet-removerule
    pub(crate) fn remove_rule(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, index: Option<u32>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The removeRule(index) method must run the same steps as deleteRule().
        self.delete_rule(cx, index.unwrap_or(0))
    }
}

fn security_error(message: &str) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("SecurityError", Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
}

fn not_allowed_error(message: &str) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("NotAllowedError", Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
}

//! CSSStyleValue, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssstylevalue

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, MarkedVec, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::RetainedStyleValue;

use super::css_image_value::CSSImageValue;
use super::css_keyword_value::CSSKeywordValue;
use super::css_math_clamp::CSSMathClamp;
use super::css_math_invert::CSSMathInvert;
use super::css_math_max::CSSMathMax;
use super::css_math_min::CSSMathMin;
use super::css_math_negate::CSSMathNegate;
use super::css_math_product::CSSMathProduct;
use super::css_math_sum::CSSMathSum;
use super::css_math_value::CSSMathValue;
use super::css_numeric_value::{AnyCSSNumericValue, CSSNumericValue};
use super::css_transform_value::CSSTransformValue;
use super::css_unit_value::CSSUnitValue;
