/// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum PerformTypeCheck {
    No,
    Yes,
}

/// An object of CSSStyleValue or of an interface that inherits from it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
#[expect(clippy::enum_variant_names, reason = "the variants are named after the interfaces")]
pub(crate) enum AnyCSSStyleValue {
    CSSStyleValue(Ref<CSSStyleValue>),
    CSSImageValue(Ref<CSSImageValue>),
    CSSKeywordValue(Ref<CSSKeywordValue>),
    CSSMathClamp(Ref<CSSMathClamp>),
    CSSMathInvert(Ref<CSSMathInvert>),
    CSSMathMax(Ref<CSSMathMax>),
    CSSMathMin(Ref<CSSMathMin>),
    CSSMathNegate(Ref<CSSMathNegate>),
    CSSMathProduct(Ref<CSSMathProduct>),
    CSSMathSum(Ref<CSSMathSum>),
    CSSMathValue(Ref<CSSMathValue>),
    CSSNumericValue(Ref<CSSNumericValue>),
    CSSTransformValue(Ref<CSSTransformValue>),
    CSSUnitValue(Ref<CSSUnitValue>),
    CSSUnparsedValue(Ref<CSSUnparsedValue>),
}

impl AnyCSSStyleValue {
    /// The object as a CSSNumericValue, if it is one.
    pub(crate) fn as_numeric(self) -> Option<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        Some(match self {
            Self::CSSMathClamp(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathClamp(object),
            Self::CSSMathInvert(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathInvert(object),
            Self::CSSMathMax(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMax(object),
            Self::CSSMathMin(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMin(object),
            Self::CSSMathNegate(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathNegate(object),
            Self::CSSMathProduct(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathProduct(object),
            Self::CSSMathSum(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathSum(object),
            Self::CSSMathValue(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathValue(object),
            Self::CSSNumericValue(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSNumericValue(object),
            Self::CSSUnitValue(object) => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(object),
            _ => return None,
        })
    }

    /// The part of the object that all CSSStyleValues have.
    pub(crate) fn style_value(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        fn part_of_math_value(value: &CSSMathValue) -> &CSSStyleValue {
            <CSSMathValue as Inherits<CSSNumericValue>>::parent(value).parent()
        }

        match self {
            Self::CSSStyleValue(object) => object,
            Self::CSSImageValue(object) => object.style_value(),
            Self::CSSKeywordValue(object) => object.style_value(),
            Self::CSSMathClamp(object) => part_of_math_value(object.math_value()),
            Self::CSSMathInvert(object) => part_of_math_value(object.math_value()),
            Self::CSSMathMax(object) => part_of_math_value(object.math_value()),
            Self::CSSMathMin(object) => part_of_math_value(object.math_value()),
            Self::CSSMathNegate(object) => part_of_math_value(object.math_value()),
            Self::CSSMathProduct(object) => part_of_math_value(object.math_value()),
            Self::CSSMathSum(object) => part_of_math_value(object.math_value()),
            Self::CSSMathValue(object) => part_of_math_value(object),
            Self::CSSNumericValue(object) => object.parent(),
            Self::CSSTransformValue(object) => object.style_value(),
            Self::CSSUnitValue(object) => <CSSUnitValue as Inherits<CSSNumericValue>>::parent(object).parent(),
            Self::CSSUnparsedValue(object) => object.style_value(),
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#stylevalue-serialization
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self, vm: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        match self {
            Self::CSSStyleValue(object) => Ok(object.serialize_source_value()),
            // AD-HOC: The spec doesn't say how to serialize this, as it's intentionally a black box.
            //         We just rely on CSSStyleValue serializing its held StyleValue.
            Self::CSSImageValue(object) => Ok(object.style_value().serialize_source_value()),
            Self::CSSKeywordValue(object) => Ok(object.serialize()),
            Self::CSSTransformValue(object) => object.serialize(vm),
            Self::CSSUnparsedValue(object) => Ok(object.serialize()),
            _ => Ok(self.as_numeric().expect("the object is numeric").to_css_string()),
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
    pub(crate) fn create_an_internal_representation(
        &self,
        vm: &Vm,
        property_id: u16,
        property_name: &Utf16String,
        perform_type_check: PerformTypeCheck,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        match self {
            Self::CSSStyleValue(object) => object.create_an_internal_representation(),
            Self::CSSImageValue(object) => {
                object.create_an_internal_representation(property_id, property_name, perform_type_check)
            }
            Self::CSSKeywordValue(object) => {
                object.create_an_internal_representation(property_id, property_name, perform_type_check)
            }
            Self::CSSTransformValue(object) => {
                object.create_an_internal_representation(vm, property_id, perform_type_check)
            }
            Self::CSSUnparsedValue(object) => object.create_an_internal_representation(),
            Self::CSSUnitValue(object) => object.create_an_internal_representation(property_id, perform_type_check),
            _ => self
                .as_numeric()
                .expect("the object is numeric")
                .math_value_internal_representation(property_id, perform_type_check),
        }
    }
}

impl ToJs for AnyCSSStyleValue {
    fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {
        Ok(match self {
            Self::CSSStyleValue(object) => Value::from_object(wrap(cx, object)),
            Self::CSSImageValue(object) => Value::from_object(wrap(cx, object)),
            Self::CSSKeywordValue(object) => Value::from_object(wrap(cx, object)),
            Self::CSSTransformValue(object) => Value::from_object(wrap(cx, object)),
            Self::CSSUnparsedValue(object) => Value::from_object(wrap(cx, object)),
            _ => return self.as_numeric().expect("the object is numeric").to_js(cx),
        })
    }
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssstylevalue
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSStyleValue {
    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssstylevalue-associatedproperty-slot
    #[gc(untraced)]
    associated_property: Option<Utf16String>,
    /// The value this object was reified from.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    source_value: Option<RetainedStyleValue>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    serialization_mode: u8,
    /// The object that this is the CSSStyleValue part of, by which the steps of CSSStyleValue reach the steps of the
    /// interface of the object.
    object: GcRefCell<Option<AnyCSSStyleValue>>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSStyleValue {}

impl CSSStyleValue {
    /// The part of an object of an interface that inherits from CSSStyleValue and has no source value.
    pub(crate) fn empty() -> Self {
        Self::with_source_value(None, None, 0)
    }

    /// The part of an object of an interface that inherits from CSSStyleValue and has a source value.
    pub(crate) fn with_source(source_value: RetainedStyleValue) -> Self {
        Self::with_source_value(None, Some(source_value), 0)
    }

    fn with_source_value(
        associated_property: Option<Utf16String>,
        source_value: Option<RetainedStyleValue>,
        serialization_mode: u8,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            associated_property,
            source_value,
            serialization_mode,
            object: GcRefCell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        associated_property: Utf16String,
        source_value: RetainedStyleValue,
        serialization_mode: u8,
    ) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| {
            Self::with_source_value(Some(associated_property), Some(source_value), serialization_mode)
        });
        object.set_object(vm, AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSStyleValue(object));
        object
    }

    /// Tells the part which object it belongs to, which an object does as soon as it exists.
    pub(crate) fn set_object(&self, vm: &Vm, object: AnyCSSStyleValue) {
        *self.object.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(object);
    }

    pub(crate) fn object(&self) -> AnyCSSStyleValue {
        self.object.borrow().expect("an object exists from when it is created")
    }

    pub(crate) fn associated_property(&self) -> Option<&Utf16String> {
        self.associated_property.as_ref()
    }

    pub(crate) fn source_value(&self) -> Option<&RetainedStyleValue> {
        self.source_value.as_ref()
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#stylevalue-serialization
    fn serialize_source_value(&self) -> Utf16String {
        // FIXME: if the value was constructed from a USVString
        // NB: Basically, if this was constructed with "parse a CSSStyleValue", regardless of what CSSStyleValue type it
        //     is now.
        //     the serialization is the USVString from which the value was constructed.
        // otherwise, if the value was constructed using an IDL constructor
        //     the serialization is specified in the sections below.
        // NB: This is handled by the interfaces that inherit from this one.
        // FIXME: otherwise, if the value was extracted from the CSSOM
        // NB: For CSSStyleValue itself, we use the source value we were created from.
        self.source_value
            .as_ref()
            .map(|source_value| source_value.serialize(self.serialization_mode))
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
    fn create_an_internal_representation(&self) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        // If value is a direct CSSStyleValue,
        //     Return value’s associated value.
        self.source_value
            .clone()
            .ok_or_else(|| Exception::type_error("Missing create_an_internal_representation() overload"))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#stylevalue-serialization
    pub(crate) fn to_string(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        self.object().serialize(cx.vm())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssstylevalue-parse
    pub(crate) fn parse(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        property: UsvString,
        css_text: UsvString,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSStyleValue> {
        // The parse(property, cssText) method, when invoked, must parse a CSSStyleValue with property property, cssText
        // cssText, and parseMultiple set to false, and return the result.
        let values = typed_om::parse_a_css_style_value(cx, property, css_text)?;
        Ok(values.get(0).expect("parsing results in at least one value"))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssstylevalue-parseall
    pub(crate) fn parse_all<'vm>(
        cx: &mut CallContext<'vm>,
        property: UsvString,
        css_text: UsvString,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<MarkedVec<'vm, AnyCSSStyleValue>> {
        // The parseAll(property, cssText) method, when invoked, must parse a CSSStyleValue with property property,
        // cssText cssText, and parseMultiple set to true, and return the result.
        typed_om::parse_a_css_style_value(cx, property, css_text)
    }
}

//! CSSSupportsRule, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-3/#the-csssupportsrule-interface

use super::css_condition_rule::CSSConditionRule;
use super::css_grouping_rule::CSSGroupingRule;
use super::css_rule::impl_rule_wrappable;
use super::css_rule::{AnyCSSRule, CSSRule, RuleText};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeRule;
use std::rc::Rc;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSSupportsRule {
    condition_rule: CSSConditionRule,
}

impl_rule_wrappable!(CSSSupportsRule);

impl Inherits<CSSConditionRule> for CSSSupportsRule {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSConditionRule {
        &self.condition_rule
    }
}

impl CSSSupportsRule {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, native_rule: Rc<NativeRule>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            condition_rule: CSSConditionRule::new(native_rule),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn rule(&self) -> &CSSRule {
        self.condition_rule.rule()
    }

    pub(crate) fn grouping_rule(&self) -> &CSSGroupingRule {
        self.condition_rule.grouping_rule()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-conditional-5/#dom-csssupportsrule-matches
    pub(crate) fn matches(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        Ok(self.rule().native_rule().supports_condition_matches())
    }

    pub(crate) fn serialized_condition_text(&self) -> Utf16String {
        self.rule().native_rule().supports_condition_text()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-rule
    pub(crate) fn serialized(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Utf16String {
        // Note: The spec doesn't cover this yet, so I'm roughly following the spec for the @media rule.
        // It should be pretty close!
        let mut text = RuleText::new("@supports ");
        text.push(&self.serialized_condition_text());
        text.push_str(" {\n");
        let rules = self.grouping_rule().child_rules(vm);
        for index in 0..rules.native_length() {
            if index != 0 {
                text.push_str("\n");
            }
            text.push_str("  ");
            text.push(&AnyCSSRule::serialized(rules.rule_at(vm, index), vm));
        }
        text.push_str("\n}");
        text.finish()
    }
}

    Yes,

/// An object of CSSTransformComponent or of an interface that inherits from it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum AnyCSSTransformComponent {
    CSSTransformComponent(Ref<CSSTransformComponent>),
    CSSMatrixComponent(Ref<CSSMatrixComponent>),
    CSSPerspective(Ref<CSSPerspective>),
    CSSRotate(Ref<CSSRotate>),
    CSSScale(Ref<CSSScale>),
    CSSSkew(Ref<CSSSkew>),
    CSSSkewX(Ref<CSSSkewX>),
    CSSSkewY(Ref<CSSSkewY>),
    CSSTranslate(Ref<CSSTranslate>),
}

impl Deref for AnyCSSTransformComponent {
    type Target = CSSTransformComponent;

    fn deref(&self) -> &CSSTransformComponent {
        match self {
            Self::CSSTransformComponent(object) => object,
            Self::CSSMatrixComponent(object) => <CSSMatrixComponent as Inherits<CSSTransformComponent>>::parent(object),
            Self::CSSPerspective(object) => <CSSPerspective as Inherits<CSSTransformComponent>>::parent(object),
            Self::CSSRotate(object) => <CSSRotate as Inherits<CSSTransformComponent>>::parent(object),
            Self::CSSScale(object) => <CSSScale as Inherits<CSSTransformComponent>>::parent(object),
            Self::CSSSkew(object) => <CSSSkew as Inherits<CSSTransformComponent>>::parent(object),
            Self::CSSSkewX(object) => <CSSSkewX as Inherits<CSSTransformComponent>>::parent(object),
            Self::CSSSkewY(object) => <CSSSkewY as Inherits<CSSTransformComponent>>::parent(object),
            Self::CSSTranslate(object) => <CSSTranslate as Inherits<CSSTransformComponent>>::parent(object),
        }
    }
}

impl ToJs for AnyCSSTransformComponent {
    fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {
        Ok(Value::from_object(match self {
            Self::CSSTransformComponent(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSMatrixComponent(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSPerspective(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSRotate(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSScale(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSSkew(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSSkewX(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSSkewY(object) => wrap(cx, object),
            Self::CSSTranslate(object) => wrap(cx, object),
        }))
    }
}

impl AnyCSSTransformComponent {
    /// Tells the part of the object that all CSSTransformComponents have which object it is the part of.
    pub(crate) fn finish(self, vm: &Vm) -> Self {
        self.set_object(vm, self);
        self
    }

    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        match self {
            Self::CSSTransformComponent(_) => unreachable!("no object is only of an abstract interface"),
            Self::CSSMatrixComponent(object) => object.serialize(),
            Self::CSSPerspective(object) => Ok(object.serialize()),
            Self::CSSRotate(object) => Ok(object.serialize()),
            Self::CSSScale(object) => Ok(object.serialize()),
            Self::CSSSkew(object) => Ok(object.serialize()),
            Self::CSSSkewX(object) => Ok(object.serialize()),
            Self::CSSSkewY(object) => Ok(object.serialize()),
            Self::CSSTranslate(object) => Ok(object.serialize()),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn to_matrix(self, vm: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        match self {
            Self::CSSTransformComponent(_) => unreachable!("no object is only of an abstract interface"),
            Self::CSSMatrixComponent(object) => Ok(object.to_matrix(vm)),
            Self::CSSPerspective(object) => object.to_matrix(vm),
            Self::CSSRotate(object) => object.to_matrix(vm),
            Self::CSSScale(object) => object.to_matrix(vm),
            Self::CSSSkew(object) => object.to_matrix(vm),
            Self::CSSSkewX(object) => object.to_matrix(vm),
            Self::CSSSkewY(object) => object.to_matrix(vm),
            Self::CSSTranslate(object) => object.to_matrix(vm),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_style_value(&self, vm: &Vm, property_id: u16) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        match self {
            Self::CSSTransformComponent(_) => unreachable!("no object is only of an abstract interface"),
            Self::CSSMatrixComponent(object) => Ok(object.create_style_value(property_id)),
            Self::CSSPerspective(object) => object.create_style_value(vm, property_id),
            Self::CSSRotate(object) => object.create_style_value(vm, property_id),
            Self::CSSScale(object) => object.create_style_value(vm, property_id),
            Self::CSSSkew(object) => object.create_style_value(vm, property_id),
            Self::CSSSkewX(object) => object.create_style_value(vm, property_id),
            Self::CSSSkewY(object) => object.create_style_value(vm, property_id),
            Self::CSSTranslate(object) => object.create_style_value(vm, property_id),
        }
    }

    fn set_is_2d_steps(&self, value: bool) {
        match self {
            Self::CSSPerspective(object) => object.set_is_2d(),
            Self::CSSSkew(object) => object.set_is_2d(),
            Self::CSSSkewX(object) => object.set_is_2d(),
            Self::CSSSkewY(object) => object.set_is_2d(),
            _ => self.is_2d.set(value),
        }
    }
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#csstransformcomponent
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSTransformComponent {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    is_2d: Cell<bool>,
    /// The object that this is the CSSTransformComponent part of, by which the steps of CSSTransformComponent reach the
    /// steps of the interface of the object.
    object: GcRefCell<Option<AnyCSSTransformComponent>>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSTransformComponent {}

impl CSSTransformComponent {
    pub(crate) fn new(is_2d: Is2D) -> Self {
        Self {
            is_2d: Cell::new(is_2d == Is2D::Yes),
            object: GcRefCell::new(None),
        }
    }

    /// Tells the part which object it belongs to, which an object does as soon as it exists.
    pub(crate) fn set_object(&self, vm: &Vm, object: AnyCSSTransformComponent) {
        *self.object.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(object);
    }

    pub(crate) fn object(&self) -> AnyCSSTransformComponent {
        self.object.borrow().expect("an object exists from when it is created")
    }

    pub(crate) fn raw_is_2d(&self) -> bool {
        self.is_2d.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn to_string(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        self.object().serialize()
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_2d(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        Ok(self.is_2d.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_is_2d(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: bool) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.object().set_is_2d_steps(value);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn to_matrix(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        self.object().to_matrix(cx.vm())
    }
}

/// A new DOMMatrix with the elements of the matrix, whose is 2D is the value.
pub(crate) fn create_dom_matrix(vm: &Vm, matrix: Matrix4, is_2d: bool) -> Ref<DOMMatrix> {
    allocate(vm, |_| DOMMatrix::from_read_only(DOMMatrixReadOnly::new(matrix, is_2d)))
}

    argument: impl Into<AnyCSSStyleValue>,
) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#reify-a-transform-function
pub(crate) fn reify_a_transform_function(vm: &Vm, value: &RetainedStyleValue) -> Option<AnyCSSTransformComponent> {
    let (transform_function, values) = transformation_parts(value);

    // NB: An argument that does not reify to a numeric value gives up, like a function that is not reifiable.
    let reify_numeric_argument = |index: usize| typed_om::reify_a_numeric_value(vm, &values[index]);
    let reify_unit_value =
        |value: f64, unit: &str| AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(vm, value, unit));
    let reify_0 = || reify_unit_value(0.0, "number");
    let reify_1 = || reify_unit_value(1.0, "number");
    let reify_0px = || reify_unit_value(0.0, "px");
    let reify_0deg = || reify_unit_value(0.0, "deg");

    let translate = |is_2d, x, y, z| AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSTranslate(CSSTranslate::create(vm, is_2d, x, y, z));
    let scale = |is_2d, x, y, z| AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSScale(CSSScale::create(vm, is_2d, x, y, z));
    let rotate =
        |is_2d, x, y, z, angle| AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSRotate(CSSRotate::create(vm, is_2d, x, y, z, angle));

    // To reify a <transform-function> func, perform the appropriate set of steps below, based on func:
    Some(match transform_function {
        // -> matrix()
        // -> matrix3d()
        //    1. Return a new CSSMatrixComponent object, whose matrix internal slot is set to a 4x4 matrix representing
        //       the same information as func, and whose is2D internal slot is true if func is matrix(), and false
        //       otherwise.
        TransformFunction::Matrix | TransformFunction::Matrix3d => {
            let transform_as_matrix = transform_matrix(value)?;

            // NB: The matrix is row by row, as Matrix4 stores it.
            let mut matrix = Matrix4::identity();
            for (index, element) in transform_as_matrix.into_iter().enumerate() {
                matrix.elements[index / 4][index % 4] = f64::from(element);
            }

            let is_2d = if transform_function == TransformFunction::Matrix {
                Is2D::Yes
            } else {
                Is2D::No
            };
            let dom_matrix = create_dom_matrix(vm, matrix, matrix.is_2d_affine());
            AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSMatrixComponent(CSSMatrixComponent::create(vm, is_2d, dom_matrix))
        }

        // -> translate()
        // -> translateX()
        // -> translateY()
        // -> translate3d()
        // -> translateZ()
        //    1. Return a new CSSTranslate object, whose x, y, and z internal slots are set to the reification of the
        //       specified x/y/z offsets, or the reification of 0px if not specified in func, and whose is2D internal
        //       slot is true if func is translate(), translateX(), or translateY(), and false otherwise.
        TransformFunction::Translate => {
            // NB: Default y to 0px if it's not specified.
            let y = if values.len() > 1 {
                reify_numeric_argument(1)?
            } else {
                reify_0px()
            };
            translate(Is2D::Yes, reify_numeric_argument(0)?, y, reify_0px())
        }
        TransformFunction::TranslateX => translate(Is2D::Yes, reify_numeric_argument(0)?, reify_0px(), reify_0px()),
        TransformFunction::TranslateY => translate(Is2D::Yes, reify_0px(), reify_numeric_argument(0)?, reify_0px()),
        TransformFunction::Translate3d => translate(
            Is2D::No,
            reify_numeric_argument(0)?,
            reify_numeric_argument(1)?,
            reify_numeric_argument(2)?,
        ),
        TransformFunction::TranslateZ => translate(Is2D::No, reify_0px(), reify_0px(), reify_numeric_argument(0)?),

        // -> scale()
        // -> scaleX()
        // -> scaleY()
        // -> scale3d()
        // -> scaleZ()
        //    1. Return a new CSSScale object, whose x, y, and z internal slots are set to the specified x/y/z scales,
        //       or to 1 if not specified in func and whose is2D internal slot is true if func is scale(), scaleX(), or
        //       scaleY(), and false otherwise.
        TransformFunction::Scale => {
            // NB: Default y to a copy of x if it's not specified.
            let y = if values.len() > 1 {
                reify_numeric_argument(1)?
            } else {
                reify_numeric_argument(0)?
            };
            scale(Is2D::Yes, reify_numeric_argument(0)?, y, reify_1())
        }
        TransformFunction::ScaleX => scale(Is2D::Yes, reify_numeric_argument(0)?, reify_1(), reify_1()),
        TransformFunction::ScaleY => scale(Is2D::Yes, reify_1(), reify_numeric_argument(0)?, reify_1()),
        TransformFunction::Scale3d => scale(
            Is2D::No,
            reify_numeric_argument(0)?,
            reify_numeric_argument(1)?,
            reify_numeric_argument(2)?,
        ),
        TransformFunction::ScaleZ => scale(Is2D::No, reify_1(), reify_1(), reify_numeric_argument(0)?),

        // -> rotate()
        // -> rotate3d()
        // -> rotateX()
        // -> rotateY()
        // -> rotateZ()
        //    1. Return a new CSSRotate object, whose angle internal slot is set to the reification of the specified
        //       angle, and whose x, y, and z internal slots are set to the specified rotation axis coordinates, or the
        //       implicit axis coordinates if not specified in func and whose is2D internal slot is true if func is
        //       rotate(), and false otherwise.
        TransformFunction::Rotate => rotate(Is2D::Yes, reify_0(), reify_0(), reify_1(), reify_numeric_argument(0)?),
        TransformFunction::Rotate3d => rotate(
            Is2D::No,
            reify_numeric_argument(0)?,
            reify_numeric_argument(1)?,
            reify_numeric_argument(2)?,
            reify_numeric_argument(3)?,
        ),
        TransformFunction::RotateX => rotate(Is2D::No, reify_1(), reify_0(), reify_0(), reify_numeric_argument(0)?),
        TransformFunction::RotateY => rotate(Is2D::No, reify_0(), reify_1(), reify_0(), reify_numeric_argument(0)?),
        TransformFunction::RotateZ => rotate(Is2D::No, reify_0(), reify_0(), reify_1(), reify_numeric_argument(0)?),

        // -> skew()
        //    1. Return a new CSSSkew object, whose ax and ay internal slots are set to the reification of the specified
        //       x and y angles, or the reification of 0deg if not specified in func, and whose is2D internal slot is
        //       true.
        TransformFunction::Skew => {
            // NB: Default y to 0deg if it's not specified.
            let y = if values.len() > 1 {
                reify_numeric_argument(1)?
            } else {
                reify_0deg()
            };
            AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSSkew(CSSSkew::create(vm, reify_numeric_argument(0)?, y))
        }

        // -> skewX()
        //    1. Return a new CSSSkewX object, whose ax internal slot is set to the reification of the specified x
        //       angle, or the reification of 0deg if not specified in func, and whose is2D internal slot is true.
        TransformFunction::SkewX => {
            AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSSkewX(CSSSkewX::create(vm, reify_numeric_argument(0)?))
        }

        // -> skewY()
        //    1. Return a new CSSSkewY object, whose ay internal slot is set to the reification of the specified y
        //       angle, or the reification of 0deg if not specified in func, and whose is2D internal slot is true.
        TransformFunction::SkewY => {
            AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSSkewY(CSSSkewY::create(vm, reify_numeric_argument(0)?))
        }

        // -> perspective()
        //    1. Return a new CSSPerspective object, whose length internal slot is set to the reification of the
        //       specified length (see reify a numeric value if it is a length, and reify an identifier if it is the
        //       keyword none) and whose is2D internal slot is false.
        TransformFunction::Perspective => {
            let length = match reification_of(&values[0]) {
                Reification::Keyword(keyword) => {
                    CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSKeywordValue(CSSKeywordValue::create(vm, keyword))
                }
                _ => CSSPerspectiveValueInternal::CSSNumericValue(reify_numeric_argument(0)?),
            };
            AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSPerspective(CSSPerspective::create(vm, length))
        }
    })
}

//! CSSTransformValue, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#csstransformvalue

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, MarkedVec, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::RetainedStyleValue;

use super::css_style_value::{AnyCSSStyleValue, CSSStyleValue, PerformTypeCheck};
use super::css_transform_component::{AnyCSSTransformComponent, create_dom_matrix};
use super::typed_om;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix::DOMMatrix;
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix_read_only::DOMMatrixReadOnly;
use crate::geometry::matrix::Matrix4;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSTransformValue {
    style_value: CSSStyleValue,
    transforms: GcRefCell<Vec<AnyCSSTransformComponent>>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSTransformValue {}

impl Inherits<CSSStyleValue> for CSSTransformValue {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        &self.style_value
    }
}

impl CSSTransformValue {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, transforms: &MarkedVec<'_, AnyCSSTransformComponent>) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            style_value: CSSStyleValue::empty(),
            transforms: GcRefCell::new(transforms.to_vec()),
        });
        object
            .style_value
            .set_object(vm, AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSTransformValue(object));
        object
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstransformvalue-csstransformvalue
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        transforms: MarkedVec<'_, AnyCSSTransformComponent>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // The CSSTransformValue(transforms) constructor must, when called, perform the following steps:

        // 1. If transforms is empty, throw a TypeError.
        if transforms.is_empty() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "CSSTransformValue's transforms list cannot be empty.",
            ));
        }

        // 2. Return a new CSSTransformValue whose values to iterate over is transforms.
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), &transforms))
    }

    pub(crate) fn style_value(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        &self.style_value
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstransformvalue-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // The length attribute indicates how many transform components are contained within the CSSTransformValue.
        Ok(u32::try_from(self.transforms.borrow().len()).expect("the list has fewer items than an index can name"))
    }

    pub(crate) fn item(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSTransformComponent> {
        Ok(self.transforms.borrow()[index as usize])
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#ref-for-dfn-set-the-value-of-an-existing-indexed-property%E2%91%A0
    pub(crate) fn set_value_of_existing_indexed_property(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        index: u32,
        value: AnyCSSTransformComponent,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // To set the value of an existing indexed property of a CSSTransformValue this, an index n, and a value new
        // value, let values be this’s [[values]] internal slot, and set values[n] to new value.
        self.transforms.borrow_mut(cx.vm())[index as usize] = value;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#ref-for-dfn-set-the-value-of-a-new-indexed-property①
    pub(crate) fn set_value_of_new_indexed_property(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        index: u32,
        value: AnyCSSTransformComponent,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // To set the value of a new indexed property of a CSSTransformValue this, an index n, and a value new value,
        // let values be this’s [[values]] internal slot. If n is not equal to the size of values, throw a RangeError.
        // Otherwise, append new value to values.
        if index as usize != self.transforms.borrow().len() {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("Index out of range"));
        }

        self.transforms.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).push(value);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstransformvalue-is2d
    pub(crate) fn is_2d(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The is2D attribute of a CSSTransformValue this must, on getting, return true if, for each func in this’s
        // values to iterate over, the func’s is2D attribute would return true; otherwise, the attribute returns false.
        Ok(self.transforms.borrow().iter().all(|transform| transform.raw_is_2d()))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstransformvalue-tomatrix
    pub(crate) fn to_matrix(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        // The toMatrix() method of a CSSTransformValue this must, when called, perform the following steps:
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Let matrix be a new DOMMatrix, initialized to the identity matrix, with its is2D internal slot set to
        //    true.
        // NB: The elements and the slot stay in locals until the matrix is returned.
        let mut matrix = Matrix4::identity();
        let mut is_2d = true;

        // 2. For each func in this’s values to iterate over:
        for function in self.transforms.borrow().iter() {
            // 1. Let funcMatrix be the DOMMatrix returned by calling toMatrix() on func.
            // AD-HOC: This can throw exceptions.
            let function_matrix = function.to_matrix(vm)?;
            let function_matrix = <DOMMatrix as Inherits<DOMMatrixReadOnly>>::parent(&function_matrix);

            // 2. Set matrix to the result of multiplying matrix and the matrix represented by funcMatrix.
            matrix = matrix.multiplied(function_matrix.matrix());
            if !function_matrix.is_2d() {
                is_2d = false;
            }
        }

        // 3. Return matrix.
        Ok(create_dom_matrix(vm, matrix, is_2d))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-csstransformvalue
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self, _: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // 1. Return the result of serializing each item in this’s values to iterate over, then concatenating them
        //    separated by " ".
        let mut s = String::new();
        for (index, transform) in self.transforms.borrow().iter().enumerate() {
            if index != 0 {
                s.push(' ');
            }
            s.push_str(&typed_om::to_rust_string(&transform.serialize()?));
        }
        Ok(Utf16String::from_utf8(&s))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
    pub(crate) fn create_an_internal_representation(
        &self,
        vm: &Vm,
        property_id: u16,
        perform_type_check: PerformTypeCheck,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        // NB: This can become <transform-function> or <transform-list>, and we don't know which is wanted without
        //     performing the type checking.
        //     We can worry about that if and when we ever do have a CSSTransformValue that isn't top-level.
        assert!(perform_type_check == PerformTypeCheck::Yes);

        // If value is a CSSStyleValue subclass,
        //     If value does not match the grammar of a list-valued property iteration of property, throw a TypeError.
        //
        //     If any component of property’s CSS grammar has a limited numeric range, and the corresponding part of
        //     value is a CSSUnitValue that is outside of that range, replace that value with the result of wrapping it
        //     in a fresh CSSMathSum whose values internal slot contains only that part of value.
        //
        //     Return the value.

        // NB: We match <transform-function> if we have 1 transform. We match <transform-list> always.
        let transforms = self.transforms.borrow();
        if transforms.len() == 1 && typed_om::property_accepts_transform_function(property_id) {
            return transforms[0].create_style_value(vm, property_id);
        }

        if typed_om::property_accepts_transform_list(property_id) {
            let values = transforms
                .iter()
                .map(|transform| transform.create_style_value(vm, property_id))
                .collect::<WebIdlResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
            return Ok(typed_om::style_value_list(values));
        }

        Err(Exception::type_error("Property does not accept values of this type."))
    }
}

//! CSSTransition, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transitions-2/#the-CSSTransition-interface

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Visitor, Vm};

use crate::animations::animation::Animation;
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transitions-2/#the-CSSTransition-interface
pub(crate) struct CSSTransition {
    animation: Animation,
}

// SAFETY: The animation visits what it reaches.
unsafe impl Trace for CSSTransition {
    fn trace(&self, visitor: &mut Visitor) {
        self.animation.trace(visitor);
    }
}

impl Inherits<Animation> for CSSTransition {
    fn parent(&self) -> &Animation {
        &self.animation
    }
}

impl Wrappable for CSSTransition {
    const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.animation.relevant_realm()
    }

    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.animation.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(object: Ref<Self>) {
        object.animation.finalize_animation();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for CSSTransition {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl CSSTransition {
    /// The object of a CSS transition, whose state `animation` holds.
    pub(crate) fn allocate(vm: &Vm, animation: Animation) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self { animation })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transitions-2/#dom-csstransition-transitionproperty
    pub(crate) fn transition_property(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.animation.record().css_transition_property())
    }
}

//! CSSTranslate, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#csstranslate

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{BASE_TYPE_LENGTH, RetainedStyleValue, TransformFunction, transformation_style_value};

use super::css_numeric_value::{AnyCSSNumericValue, SerializationParams};
use super::css_transform_component::{
    AnyCSSTransformComponent, CSSTransformComponent, Is2D, argument_style_value, create_dom_matrix,
};
use super::css_unit_value::CSSUnitValue;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix::DOMMatrix;
use crate::geometry::matrix::Matrix4;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSTranslate {
    transform_component: CSSTransformComponent,
    x: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    y: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    z: GcRefCell<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSTranslate {}

impl Inherits<CSSTransformComponent> for CSSTranslate {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSTransformComponent {
        &self.transform_component
    }
}

fn matches_length_percentage(value: &AnyCSSNumericValue) -> bool {
    value
        .numeric_type()
        .matches_dimension_percentage(BASE_TYPE_LENGTH, None)
}

fn matches_length(value: &AnyCSSNumericValue) -> bool {
    value.numeric_type().matches_dimension(BASE_TYPE_LENGTH, None)
}

impl CSSTranslate {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        is_2d: Is2D,
        x: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        y: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        z: AnyCSSNumericValue,
    ) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            transform_component: CSSTransformComponent::new(is_2d),
            x: GcRefCell::new(x),
            y: GcRefCell::new(y),
            z: GcRefCell::new(z),
        });
        AnyCSSTransformComponent::CSSTranslate(object).finish(vm);
        object
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstranslate-csstranslate
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        x: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        y: AnyCSSNumericValue,
        z: Option<AnyCSSNumericValue>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // The CSSTranslate(x, y, z) constructor must, when invoked, perform the following steps:

        // 1. If x or y don’t match <length-percentage>, throw a TypeError.
        if !matches_length_percentage(&x) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "CSSTranslate x component doesn't match <length-percentage>",
            ));
        }

        if !matches_length_percentage(&y) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "CSSTranslate y component doesn't match <length-percentage>",
            ));
        }

        // 2. If z was passed, but doesn’t match <length>, throw a TypeError.
        if z.as_ref().is_some_and(|z| !matches_length(z)) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSTranslate z component doesn't match <length>"));
        }

        // 3. Let this be a new CSSTranslate object, with its x and y internal slots set to x and y.
        // 4. If z was passed, set this’s z internal slot to z, and set this’s is2D internal slot to false.
        // 5. If z was not passed, set this’s z internal slot to a new unit value of (0, "px"), and set this’s is2D
        //    internal slot to true.
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let (is_2d, z) = match z {
            Some(z) => (Is2D::No, z),
            None => (
                Is2D::Yes,
                AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(vm, 0.0, "px")),
            ),
        };
        let this = Self::create(vm, is_2d, x, y, z);

        // 6. Return this.
        Ok(this)
    }

    pub(crate) fn x(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        Ok(*self.x.borrow())
    }

    pub(crate) fn y(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        Ok(*self.y.borrow())
    }

    pub(crate) fn z(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
        Ok(*self.z.borrow())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_x(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, x: AnyCSSNumericValue) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // AD-HOC: Not specced. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        //         WPT expects this to throw for invalid values.
        if !matches_length_percentage(&x) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "CSSTranslate x component doesn't match <length-percentage>",
            ));
        }
        *self.x.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = x;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_y(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, y: AnyCSSNumericValue) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // AD-HOC: Not specced. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        //         WPT expects this to throw for invalid values.
        if !matches_length_percentage(&y) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "CSSTranslate y component doesn't match <length-percentage>",
            ));
        }
        *self.y.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = y;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_z(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, z: AnyCSSNumericValue) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // AD-HOC: Not specced. https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1153
        //         WPT expects this to throw for invalid values.
        if !matches_length(&z) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("CSSTranslate z component doesn't match <length>"));
        }
        *self.z.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = z;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-csstranslate
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self) -> Utf16String {
        let params = SerializationParams::default();

        // 1. Let s initially be the empty string.
        let mut s = String::new();

        // 2. If this’s is2D internal slot is false:
        if !self.transform_component.raw_is_2d() {
            // 1. Append "translate3d(" to s.
            s.push_str("translate3d(");

            // 2. Serialize this’s x internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.x.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 3. Append ", " to s.
            s.push_str(", ");

            // 4. Serialize this’s y internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.y.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 5. Append ", " to s.
            s.push_str(", ");

            // 6. Serialize this’s z internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.z.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 7. Append ")" to s, and return s.
            s.push(')');
        }
        // 3. Otherwise:
        else {
            // 1. Append "translate(" to s.
            s.push_str("translate(");

            // 2. Serialize this’s x internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.x.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 3. Append ", " to s.
            s.push_str(", ");

            // 4. Serialize this’s y internal slot, and append it to s.
            self.y.borrow().serialize(&mut s, params);

            // 5. Append ")" to s, and return s.
            s.push(')');
        }
        Utf16String::from_utf8(&s)
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-csstransformcomponent-tomatrix
    pub(crate) fn to_matrix(&self, vm: &Vm) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        // 1. Let matrix be a new DOMMatrix object, initialized to this’s equivalent 4x4 transform matrix, as defined in
        //    CSS Transforms 1 § 12. Mathematical Description of Transform Functions, and with its is2D internal slot
        //    set to the same value as this’s is2D internal slot.
        //    NOTE: Recall that the is2D flag affects what transform, and thus what equivalent matrix, a
        //          CSSTransformComponent represents.
        //    As the entries of such a matrix are defined relative to the px unit, if any <length>s in this involved in
        //    generating the matrix are not compatible units with px (such as relative lengths or percentages), throw a
        //    TypeError.
        let is_2d = self.transform_component.raw_is_2d();
        let x = self.x.borrow().to_unit(vm, "px")?.raw_value();
        let y = self.y.borrow().to_unit(vm, "px")?.raw_value();

        let mut z = 0.0;
        if !is_2d {
            z = self.z.borrow().to_unit(vm, "px")?.raw_value();
        }

        Ok(create_dom_matrix(vm, Matrix4::translation(x, y, z), is_2d))
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_style_value(&self, vm: &Vm, property_id: u16) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        let x = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.x.borrow())?;
        let y = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.y.borrow())?;
        if self.transform_component.raw_is_2d() {
            return Ok(transformation_style_value(
                property_id,
                TransformFunction::Translate,
                vec![x, y],
            ));
        }

        let z = argument_style_value(vm, property_id, *self.z.borrow())?;
        Ok(transformation_style_value(
            property_id,
            TransformFunction::Translate3d,
            vec![x, y, z],
        ))
    }
}

//! CSSUnitValue, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssunitvalue

use core::cell::Cell;
use std::sync::Arc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{
    CalcNode, NumericValue, RetainedStyleValue, SumValue, SumValueItem, UnitMap, conversion_ratio,
    create_a_type_from_unit, in_canonical_unit, serialize_a_number,
};

use super::css_numeric_value::{AnyCSSNumericValue, CSSNumericValue};
use super::css_style_value::PerformTypeCheck;
use super::typed_om;
use crate::bindings::conversions::UsvString;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSUnitValue {
    numeric_value: CSSNumericValue,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    value: Cell<f64>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    unit: String,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSUnitValue {}

impl Inherits<CSSNumericValue> for CSSUnitValue {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSNumericValue {
        &self.numeric_value
    }
}

impl CSSUnitValue {
    /// A new CSSUnitValue with a unit that is known to be one.
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, value: f64, unit: &str) -> Ref<Self> {
        // The type of a CSSUnitValue is the result of creating a type from its unit internal slot.
        // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#type-of-a-cssunitvalue
        let numeric_type = create_a_type_from_unit(unit).expect("the unit of a CSSUnitValue is a unit");
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            numeric_value: CSSNumericValue::new(numeric_type),
            value: Cell::new(value),
            // AD-HOC: WPT expects the unit to be lowercase but this doesn't seem to be specified anywhere.
            unit: unit.to_ascii_lowercase(),
        });
        AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(object).finish(vm);
        object
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-a-cssunitvalue-from-a-sum-value-item
    pub(crate) fn create_from_sum_value_item(vm: &Vm, item: &SumValueItem) -> Option<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. If item has more than one entry in its unit map, return failure.
        if item.unit_map.len() > 1 {
            return None;
        }

        // 2. If item has no entries in its unit map, return a new CSSUnitValue whose unit internal slot is set to
        //    "number", and whose value internal slot is set to item’s value.
        let Some((unit, power)) = item.unit_map.iter().next() else {
            return Some(Self::create(vm, item.value, "number"));
        };

        // 3. Otherwise, item has a single entry in its unit map. If that entry’s value is anything other than 1, return
        //    failure.
        if *power != 1 {
            return None;
        }

        // 4. Otherwise, return a new CSSUnitValue whose unit internal slot is set to that entry’s key, and whose value
        //    internal slot is set to item’s value.
        Some(Self::create(vm, item.value, unit))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssunitvalue-cssunitvalue
    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext, value: f64, unit: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. If creating a type from unit returns failure, throw a TypeError and abort this algorithm.
        let unit = typed_om::to_rust_string(&unit.into_utf16_string());
        if create_a_type_from_unit(&unit).is_none() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "Cannot create CSSUnitValue with unrecognized unit",
            ));
        }

        // 2. Return a new CSSUnitValue with its value internal slot set to value and its unit set to unit.
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), value, &unit))
    }

    pub(crate) fn raw_value(&self) -> f64 {
        self.value.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn raw_unit(&self) -> &str {
        &self.unit
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssunitvalue-value
    pub(crate) fn value(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.value.get())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssunitvalue-value
    pub(crate) fn set_value(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // AD-HOC: No definition: https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1146
        self.value.set(value);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssunitvalue-unit
    pub(crate) fn unit(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(Utf16String::from_utf8(&self.unit))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssunitvalue
    pub(crate) fn serialize_unit_value(&self, s: &mut String, minimum: Option<f64>, maximum: Option<f64>) {
        // To serialize a CSSUnitValue this, with optional arguments minimum, a numeric value, and maximum, a numeric
        // value:

        // 1. Let value and unit be this‘s value and unit internal slots.
        let value = self.value.get();

        // 4. If minimum was passed and this is less than minimum, or if maximum was passed and this is greater than
        //    maximum, or either minimum and/or maximum were passed and the relative size of this and minimum/maximum
        //    can’t be determined with the available information at this time, prepend "calc(" to s, then append ")" to
        //    s.
        // NB: This step is done first to avoid prepending to the string.
        // FIXME: "or either minimum and/or maximum were passed and the relative size of this and minimum/maximum can't
        //        be determined with the available information at this time"
        let needs_calc_wrapper =
            minimum.is_some_and(|minimum| value < minimum) || maximum.is_some_and(|maximum| value > maximum);
        if needs_calc_wrapper {
            s.push_str("calc(");
        }

        // 2. Set s to the result of serializing a <number> from value, per CSSOM §6.7.2 Serializing CSS Values.
        serialize_a_number(s, value);

        // 3. If unit is:
        match self.unit.as_str() {
            // -> "number"
            // Do nothing.
            "number" => {}
            // -> "percent"
            // Append "%" to s.
            "percent" => s.push('%'),
            // -> anything else
            // Append unit to s.
            unit => s.push_str(unit),
        }

        if needs_calc_wrapper {
            s.push(')');
        }

        // 5. Return s.
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#convert-a-cssunitvalue
    pub(crate) fn converted_to_unit(&self, vm: &Vm, unit: &str) -> Option<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. Let old unit be the value of this’s unit internal slot, and old value be the value of this’s value
        //    internal slot.
        // 2. If old unit and unit are not compatible units, return failure.
        let ratio = conversion_ratio(&self.unit, unit)?;

        // 3. Return a new CSSUnitValue whose unit internal slot is set to unit, and whose value internal slot is set to
        //    old value multiplied by the conversation ratio between old unit and unit.
        Some(Self::create(vm, self.value.get() * ratio, unit))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#equal-numeric-value
    pub(crate) fn is_equal_unit_value(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        // 2. If value1 and value2 are both CSSUnitValues, return true if they have equal unit and value internal slots,
        //    or false otherwise.
        self.unit == other.unit && self.value.get() == other.value.get()
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-a-sum-value
    pub(crate) fn create_a_sum_value(&self) -> SumValue {
        // 1. Let unit be the value of this’s unit internal slot, and value be the value of this’s value internal slot.
        // 2. If unit is a member of a set of compatible units, and is not the set’s canonical unit, multiply value by
        //    the conversion ratio between unit and the canonical unit, and change unit to the canonical unit.
        let (value, unit) = in_canonical_unit(self.value.get(), &self.unit);

        // 3. If unit is "number", return «(value, «[ ]»)».
        if unit == "number" {
            return vec![SumValueItem {
                value,
                unit_map: UnitMap::new(),
            }];
        }

        // 4. Otherwise, return «(value, «[unit → 1]»)».
        vec![SumValueItem {
            value,
            unit_map: UnitMap::from([(unit, 1)]),
        }]
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_calculation_node(&self) -> WebIdlResult<Arc<CalcNode>> {
        NumericValue::from_unit(self.value.get(), &self.unit)
            .map(NumericValue::calculation_node)
            .ok_or_else(|| Exception::type_error("Unable to create calculation node."))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
    pub(crate) fn create_an_internal_representation(
        &self,
        property_id: u16,
        perform_type_check: PerformTypeCheck,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        // If value is a CSSStyleValue subclass,
        //     If value does not match the grammar of a list-valued property iteration of property, throw a TypeError.
        //
        //     If any component of property’s CSS grammar has a limited numeric range, and the corresponding part of
        //     value is a CSSUnitValue that is outside of that range, replace that value with the result of wrapping it
        //     in a fresh CSSMathSum whose values internal slot contains only that part of value.
        //
        //     Return the value.
        let Some(value) = NumericValue::from_unit(self.value.get(), &self.unit) else {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("Unrecognized unit."));
        };
        if perform_type_check == PerformTypeCheck::No {
            return Ok(value.style_value());
        }
        typed_om::numeric_style_value_for_property(property_id, value, self.numeric_value.numeric_type())
            .ok_or_else(|| Exception::type_error("Property does not accept values of this type."))
    }
}

//! CSSUnparsedValue, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssunparsedvalue

use std::collections::HashSet;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, MarkedVec, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{RetainedStyleValue, unresolved_style_value};

use super::css_rule::RuleText;
use super::css_style_value::{AnyCSSStyleValue, CSSStyleValue};
use super::css_variable_reference_value::CSSVariableReferenceValue;
use crate::bindings::conversions::UsvString;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

/// The union (USVString or CSSVariableReferenceValue) of CSS/CSSUnparsedValue.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum CSSUnparsedSegment {
    USVString(#[gc(untraced)] UsvString),
    CSSVariableReferenceValue(Ref<CSSVariableReferenceValue>),
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSUnparsedValue {
    style_value: CSSStyleValue,
    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssunparsedvalue-tokens-slot
    tokens: GcRefCell<Vec<CSSUnparsedSegment>>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSUnparsedValue {}

impl Inherits<CSSStyleValue> for CSSUnparsedValue {
    fn parent(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        &self.style_value
    }
}

impl CSSUnparsedValue {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, members: &MarkedVec<'_, CSSUnparsedSegment>) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            style_value: CSSStyleValue::empty(),
            tokens: GcRefCell::new(members.to_vec()),
        });
        object
            .style_value
            .set_object(vm, AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSUnparsedValue(object));
        object
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssunparsedvalue-cssunparsedvalue
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        members: MarkedVec<'_, CSSUnparsedSegment>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // AD-HOC: There is no spec for this, see https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1146
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), &members))
    }

    pub(crate) fn style_value(&self) -> &CSSStyleValue {
        &self.style_value
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssunparsedvalue-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // The length attribute returns the size of the [[tokens]] internal slot.
        Ok(u32::try_from(self.tokens.borrow().len()).expect("the value has fewer tokens than an index can name"))
    }

    pub(crate) fn item(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<CSSUnparsedSegment> {
        Ok(self.tokens.borrow()[index as usize].clone())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#ref-for-dfn-set-the-value-of-an-existing-indexed-property
    pub(crate) fn set_value_of_existing_indexed_property(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        n: u32,
        new_value: CSSUnparsedSegment,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // To set the value of an existing indexed property of a CSSUnparsedValue this, an index n, and a value new
        // value, let tokens be this’s [[tokens]] internal slot, and set tokens[n] to new value.
        self.tokens.borrow_mut(cx.vm())[n as usize] = new_value;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#ref-for-dfn-set-the-value-of-a-new-indexed-property
    pub(crate) fn set_value_of_new_indexed_property(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        n: u32,
        new_value: CSSUnparsedSegment,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // To set the value of a new indexed property of a CSSUnparsedValue this, an index n, and a value new value, let
        // tokens be this’s [[tokens]] internal slot. If n is not equal to the size of tokens, throw a RangeError.
        // Otherwise, append new value to tokens.
        let mut tokens = self.tokens.borrow_mut(cx.vm());
        if n as usize != tokens.len() {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("Index out of range"));
        }
        tokens.push(new_value);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn contains_unparsed_value(&self, needle: &Self, visited: &mut HashSet<*const Self>) -> bool {
        // NB: A value can contain itself without containing the needle, so each value is only scanned once.
        if !visited.insert(core::ptr::from_ref(self)) {
            return false;
        }
        self.tokens.borrow().iter().any(|segment| {
            let CSSUnparsedSegment::CSSVariableReferenceValue(variable_reference) = segment else {
                return false;
            };
            let Some(fallback) = variable_reference.raw_fallback() else {
                return false;
            };
            let fallback: &Self = &fallback;
            core::ptr::eq(fallback, needle) || fallback.contains_unparsed_value(needle, visited)
        })
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssunparsedvalue
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self) -> Utf16String {
        // AD-HOC: It's possible for one of the tokens to contain this in its fallback slot, or a similar situation with
        //         more levels of nesting. To avoid crashing, do a scan for that first and return the empty string.
        // Spec issue: https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1158
        if self.contains_unparsed_value(self, &mut HashSet::new()) {
            return Utf16String::default();
        }

        // To serialize a CSSUnparsedValue this:
        // 1. Let s initially be the empty string.
        let mut s = RuleText::default();

        // 2. For each item in this’s [[tokens]] internal slot:
        for item in self.tokens.borrow().iter() {
            // FIXME: In order to match the expected test behaviour, this should insert comments, with the same rules as
            //        serialize_a_series_of_component_values(). See https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1148
            match item {
                // 1. If item is a USVString, append it to s.
                CSSUnparsedSegment::USVString(string) => s.push_units(&string.to_utf16()),
                // 2. Otherwise, item is a CSSVariableReferenceValue. Serialize it, then append the result to s.
                CSSUnparsedSegment::CSSVariableReferenceValue(variable) => variable.serialize(&mut s),
            }
        }

        // 3. Return s.
        s.finish()
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
    pub(crate) fn create_an_internal_representation(&self) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
        // If value is a CSSStyleValue subclass,
        //     If value does not match the grammar of a list-valued property iteration of property, throw a TypeError.
        //
        //     If any component of property’s CSS grammar has a limited numeric range, and the corresponding part of
        //     value is a CSSUnitValue that is outside of that range, replace that value with the result of wrapping it
        //     in a fresh CSSMathSum whose values internal slot contains only that part of value.
        //
        //     Return the value.

        // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssstylevalue-match-a-grammar
        // A CSSUnparsedValue matches any grammar.

        // NB: CSSUnparsedValue stores a list of strings, each of which may contain any number of tokens. So the
        //     simplest way to convert it to ComponentValues is to serialize and then parse it.
        unresolved_style_value(&self.serialize())
            .ok_or_else(|| Exception::type_error("Invalid arbitrary substitution function syntax"))
    }
}

//! CSSVariableReferenceValue, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#cssvariablereferencevalue

use core::cell::RefCell;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{GcRefCell, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::is_a_custom_property_name_string;

use super::css_rule::RuleText;
use super::css_unparsed_value::CSSUnparsedValue;
use super::typed_om;
use crate::bindings::conversions::UsvString;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CSSVariableReferenceValue {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    variable: RefCell<Utf16String>,
    fallback: GcRefCell<Option<Ref<CSSUnparsedValue>>>,
}

impl Wrappable for CSSVariableReferenceValue {}

fn not_a_custom_property_name(variable: &Utf16String) -> Exception {
    Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
        "'{}' is not a valid CSS custom property name",
        typed_om::to_rust_string(variable)
    )))
}

impl CSSVariableReferenceValue {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, variable: Utf16String, fallback: Option<Ref<CSSUnparsedValue>>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            variable: RefCell::new(variable),
            fallback: GcRefCell::new(fallback),
        })
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssvariablereferencevalue-cssvariablereferencevalue
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        variable: UsvString,
        fallback: Option<Ref<CSSUnparsedValue>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // The CSSVariableReferenceValue(variable, fallback) constructor must, when called, perform the following steps:
        // 1. If variable is not a custom property name string, throw a TypeError.
        let variable = variable.into_utf16_string();
        if !is_a_custom_property_name_string(&variable) {
            return Err(not_a_custom_property_name(&variable));
        }

        // 2. Return a new CSSVariableReferenceValue with its variable internal slot set to variable and its fallback
        //    internal slot set to fallback.
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), variable, fallback))
    }

    pub(crate) fn raw_fallback(&self) -> Option<Ref<CSSUnparsedValue>> {
        *self.fallback.borrow()
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssvariablereferencevalue-variable
    pub(crate) fn variable(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The getter for the variable attribute of a CSSVariableReferenceValue this must return its variable internal
        // slot.
        Ok(self.variable.borrow().clone())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssvariablereferencevalue-variable
    pub(crate) fn set_variable(&self, _: &mut CallContext, variable: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The variable attribute of a CSSVariableReferenceValue this must, on setting a variable variable, perform the
        // following steps:
        // 1. If variable is not a custom property name string, throw a TypeError.
        let variable = variable.into_utf16_string();
        if !is_a_custom_property_name_string(&variable) {
            return Err(not_a_custom_property_name(&variable));
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, set this’s variable internal slot to variable.
        *self.variable.borrow_mut() = variable;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-cssvariablereferencevalue-fallback
    pub(crate) fn fallback(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<CSSUnparsedValue>>> {
        // AD-HOC: No spec algorithm, see https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1146#issuecomment-3188550133
        Ok(self.raw_fallback())
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#serialize-a-cssvariablereferencevalue
    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self, s: &mut RuleText) {
        // To serialize a CSSVariableReferenceValue this:
        // 1. Let s initially be "var(".
        s.push_str("var(");

        // 2. Append this’s variable internal slot to s.
        s.push(&self.variable.borrow());

        // 3. If this’s fallback internal slot is not null, append ", " to s, then serialize the fallback internal slot
        //    and append it to s.
        if let Some(fallback) = self.raw_fallback() {
            // AD-HOC: Tested behaviour requires we append "," without the space.
            //         https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1148
            s.push_str(",");
            s.push(&fallback.serialize());
        }

        // 4. Append ")" to s and return s.
        s.push_str(")");
    }
}
