//! The CSS namespace, https://www.w3.org/TR/cssom-1/#namespacedef-css

use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{self, RegisteredSyntax, RetainedStyleValue};

use super::css_rule::RuleText;
use super::css_unit_value::CSSUnitValue;
use super::highlight_registry::HighlightRegistry;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, cell_from_abi};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_realm_document(realm: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_namespace_highlight_registry(document: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_namespace_is_registered(document: *mut c_void, name: usize) -> bool;
    fn web_css_namespace_parse_initial_value_descriptor(document: *mut c_void, value: usize) -> *const c_void;
    fn web_css_namespace_parse_with_a_syntax(
        document: *mut c_void,
        value: usize,
        syntax: *const c_void,
    ) -> *const c_void;
    fn web_css_namespace_register(
        document: *mut c_void,
        name: usize,
        syntax: *const c_void,
        inherits: bool,
        initial_value: *const c_void,
    );
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-properties-values-api-1/#dictdef-propertydefinition
pub(crate) struct PropertyDefinition {
    pub(crate) name: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) syntax: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) inherits: bool,
    pub(crate) initial_value: Option<Utf16String>,
}

fn syntax_error(message: &str) -> Exception {
    Exception::syntax_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
}

fn optional_style_value(pointer: *const c_void) -> Option<RetainedStyleValue> {
    // SAFETY: C++ hands over a strong reference to a style value.
    (!pointer.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { RetainedStyleValue::from_raw(pointer) })
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/cssom-1/#namespacedef-css
#[allow(clippy::upper_case_acronyms)]
pub(crate) struct CSS;

impl CSS {
    fn document(cx: &CallContext) -> *mut c_void {
        // SAFETY: The realm is live.
        unsafe { web_css_realm_document(cx.realm().as_ptr().cast()) }
    }

    // https://www.w3.org/TR/cssom-1/#dom-css-escape
    pub(crate) fn escape(_: &mut CallContext, ident: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The escape(ident) operation must return the result of invoking serialize an identifier of ident.
        Ok(typed_om::serialize_an_identifier(&ident))
    }

    // https://www.w3.org/TR/css-conditional-3/#dom-css-supports
    pub(crate) fn supports_property(
        _: &mut CallContext,
        property: Utf16String,
        value: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // 1. If property is an ASCII case-insensitive match for any defined CSS property that the UA supports, or is a
        //    custom property name string, and value successfully parses according to that property’s grammar, return
        //    true.
        // 2. Otherwise, return false.
        let Some((_, property_id)) = typed_om::property_from_name(&property) else {
            return Ok(false);
        };
        Ok(typed_om::parse_value_for_property(property_id, &value).is_some())
    }

    // https://www.w3.org/TR/css-conditional-3/#dom-css-supports
    pub(crate) fn supports_condition(_: &mut CallContext, condition_text: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // 1. If conditionText, parsed and evaluated as a <supports-condition>, would return true, return true.
        if typed_om::supports_condition_matches(&condition_text) {
            return Ok(true);
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, If conditionText, wrapped in parentheses and then parsed and evaluated as a
        //    <supports-condition>, would return true, return true.
        let mut wrapped_condition_text = RuleText::new("(");
        wrapped_condition_text.push(&condition_text);
        wrapped_condition_text.push_str(")");
        if typed_om::supports_condition_matches(&wrapped_condition_text.finish()) {
            return Ok(true);
        }

        // 3. Otherwise, return false.
        Ok(false)
    }

    // https://www.w3.org/TR/css-properties-values-api-1/#the-registerproperty-function
    pub(crate) fn register_property(cx: &mut CallContext, definition: PropertyDefinition) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Let property set be the value of the current global object’s associated Document’s
        //    [[registeredPropertySet]] slot.
        let document = Self::document(cx);

        // 2. If name is not a custom property name string, throw a SyntaxError and exit this algorithm.
        if !typed_om::is_a_custom_property_name_string(&definition.name) {
            return Err(syntax_error("Invalid property name"));
        }

        // If property set already contains an entry with name as its property name (compared codepoint-wise),
        // throw an InvalidModificationError and exit this algorithm.
        // SAFETY: The document is live, and this hands over a reference to the string.
        if unsafe { web_css_namespace_is_registered(document, definition.name.clone().into_raw()) } {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidModificationError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Property already registered"),
            ));
        }

        // 3. Attempt to consume a syntax definition from syntax. If it returns failure, throw a SyntaxError.
        //    Otherwise, let syntax definition be the returned syntax definition.
        let Some(syntax_definition) = RegisteredSyntax::parse(&definition.syntax) else {
            return Err(syntax_error("Invalid syntax definition"));
        };

        // 4. If syntax definition is the universal syntax definition, and initialValue is not present,
        let parsed_initial_value = match (syntax_definition.is_universal(), definition.initial_value) {
            // let parsed initial value be empty.
            // This must be treated identically to the "default" initial value of custom properties, as defined in
            // [css-variables].
            (true, None) => None,
            // Otherwise, if syntax definition is the universal syntax definition,
            // parse initialValue as a <declaration-value>
            (true, Some(initial_value)) => {
                // AD-HOC: Parse this as the equivalent descriptor value in order to disallow arbitrary substitution
                //         functions.
                // SAFETY: The document is live, and this hands over a reference to the string.
                let parsed = optional_style_value(unsafe {
                    web_css_namespace_parse_initial_value_descriptor(document, initial_value.into_raw())
                });

                // If this fails, throw a SyntaxError and exit this algorithm.
                // Otherwise, let parsed initial value be the parsed result.
                Some(parsed.ok_or_else(|| syntax_error("Invalid initial value"))?)
            }
            // Otherwise, if initialValue is not present, throw a SyntaxError and exit this algorithm.
            (false, None) => {
                return Err(syntax_error("Initial value must be provided for non-universal syntax"));
            }
            // Otherwise, parse initialValue according to syntax definition.
            (false, Some(initial_value)) => {
                // NB: We don't need to worry about explicitly rejecting arbitrary substitution functions here since all
                //     supported syntaxes implicitly reject them
                // SAFETY: The document and the syntax are live, and this hands over a reference to the string.
                let parsed = optional_style_value(unsafe {
                    web_css_namespace_parse_with_a_syntax(
                        document,
                        initial_value.into_raw(),
                        syntax_definition.as_ptr(),
                    )
                });

                // If this fails, throw a SyntaxError and exit this algorithm.
                // Otherwise, let parsed initial value be the parsed result.
                let parsed = parsed
                    .filter(|value| !value.is_guaranteed_invalid())
                    .ok_or_else(|| syntax_error("Invalid initial value"))?;

                // If parsed initial value is not computationally independent, throw a SyntaxError and exit this
                // algorithm.
                if !parsed.is_computationally_independent() {
                    return Err(syntax_error("Initial value must be computationally independent"));
                }
                Some(parsed)
            }
        };

        // 5. Set inherit flag to the value of inherits.
        // 6. Let registered property be a struct with a property name of name, a syntax of syntax definition,
        //    an initial value of parsed initial value, and an inherit flag of inherit flag.
        //    Append registered property to property set.
        // SAFETY: The document is live, and this hands over references to the string, the syntax and the value.
        unsafe {
            web_css_namespace_register(
                document,
                definition.name.into_raw(),
                syntax_definition.into_raw(),
                definition.inherits,
                parsed_initial_value.map_or(core::ptr::null(), RetainedStyleValue::into_raw),
            );
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#dom-css-highlights
    pub(crate) fn highlights(cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<HighlightRegistry>> {
        // The highlight registry is accessed via the highlights attribute of the CSS namespace, and represents all the
        // custom highlights registered for the current global object’s associated Document.
        // SAFETY: The document is live, and it returns its live registry.
        Ok(unsafe { cell_from_abi::<HighlightRegistry>(web_css_namespace_highlight_registry(Self::document(cx))) })
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#numeric-factory
    fn numeric_factory(cx: &CallContext, value: f64, unit: &str) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CSSUnitValue>> {
        // All of the above methods must, when called with a double value, return a new CSSUnitValue whose value
        // internal slot is set to value and whose unit internal slot is set to the name of the method as defined here.
        Ok(CSSUnitValue::create(cx.vm(), value, unit))
    }
}

// NB: The numeric factories of the units in CSS/Units.json.
include!(concat!(env!("OUT_DIR"), "/css_numeric_factories.rs"));

/// Calls back with the name and the ranges of each registered custom highlight, from the bottom of the stacking order
/// to the top. The callback adopts the name, and the ranges stay alive until it returns.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `vm` must be the live VM, `registry` a live HighlightRegistry, and `callback` a function that takes `context`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_highlight_registry_for_each_highlight_in_stacking_order(
    vm: &Vm,
    registry: &InterfaceCell,
    context: *mut c_void,
    callback: unsafe extern "C" fn(context: *mut c_void, name: usize, ranges: *const *mut c_void, range_count: usize),
) {
    let registry = registry.object::<HighlightRegistry>();
    for entry in registry.highlights_in_stacking_order(vm).values().iter() {
        let ranges = entry.highlight.ranges(vm);
        let range_cells: Vec<*mut c_void> = ranges.values().iter().map(CppCell::as_ptr).collect();
        // SAFETY: The caller passes a callback that takes the context, and the marked list keeps the ranges alive.
        unsafe {
            callback(
                context,
                entry.name.clone().into_raw(),
                range_cells.as_ptr(),
                range_cells.len(),
            );
        }
    }
}

/// The object of the rule whose cell C++ holds, which C++ names by any of the interfaces it is an object of.
pub(crate) fn rule_from_abi(cell: &InterfaceCell) -> AnyCSSRule {
    macro_rules! decode {
        ($($interface:ident),+ $(,)?) => {
            $(
                if let Some(object) = cell.object_if::<$interface>() {
                    return AnyCSSRule::$interface(object);
                }
            )+
        };
    }
    decode!(
        CSSStyleRule,
        CSSNestedDeclarations,
        CSSMediaRule,
        CSSSupportsRule,
        CSSContainerRule,
        CSSScopeRule,
        CSSLayerBlockRule,
        CSSLayerStatementRule,
        CSSImportRule,
        CSSFontFaceRule,
        CSSKeyframesRule,
        CSSKeyframeRule,
        CSSPageRule,
        CSSMarginRule,
        CSSNamespaceRule,
        CSSPropertyRule,
        CSSCounterStyleRule,
        CSSFontFeatureValuesRule,
        CSSFunctionRule,
        CSSFunctionDeclarations,
        CSSPositionTryRule,
    );
    unreachable!("nothing creates an object of an interface that only others inherit from")
}

}

/// A new CSSRuleList of the native rules, whose @import rules `document` loads, if it is not null.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `vm` must be the live VM, `rules` a live list, and `document` the live cell of a Document, or null.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_css_rule_list_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    rules: *const NativeRuleList,
    document: Option<&LentCppCell<cpp_class::Document>>,
) -> *mut c_void {

}

/// A new CSSImportRule for the import that `import` holds, in the sheet `sheet`, if it is not null.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `vm` must be the live VM, `rule` a live rule, `import` the live cell of a StyleSheetImportCell, and `sheet` that of
/// a CSSStyleSheet, or null.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_css_import_rule_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    rule: *const NativeRule,
    import: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::StyleSheetImportCell>,
    sheet: Option<&LentCppCell<cpp_class::CSSStyleSheet>>,
) -> *mut c_void {
    // SAFETY: The caller passes a live rule.
    let (rule, import, sheet) = unsafe {
        (
            NativeRule::retained_from_raw(rule),
            CppCell::from_lent(import),
            sheet.map(CppCell::from_lent),
        )
    };
    let object = CSSImportRule::finish(CSSImportRule::create_for_import(vm, rule, import), vm);
    object.store_parent_style_sheet(vm, sheet);
    object.cell()
}

/// The cell of the StyleSheetImportCell of the rule.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_css_import_rule_import(rule: &InterfaceCell) -> *mut c_void {
    let rule: Ref<CSSImportRule> = rule.object();
    rule.import_cell()
}

pub extern "C" fn web_visual_viewport_map_point_from_layout_viewport(
    viewport: &InterfaceCell,
    position: FfiCssPixelPoint,
) -> FfiCssPixelPoint {
    viewport
        .object::<VisualViewport>()
        .map_point_from_layout_viewport(position.into())
        .into()
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_visual_viewport_map_rect_from_layout_viewport(
    viewport: &InterfaceCell,
    rect: FfiCssPixelRect,
) -> FfiCssPixelRect {
    let viewport = viewport.object::<VisualViewport>();
    let mapped = viewport.map_rect_from_layout_viewport(CssPixelRect::new(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height));
    FfiCssPixelRect {
        x: mapped.x,
        y: mapped.y,
        width: mapped.width,
        height: mapped.height,
    }
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_visual_viewport_reset(viewport: &InterfaceCell) {
    viewport.object::<VisualViewport>().reset();
}

//! FontFaceSetLoadEvent, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#fontfacesetloadevent

use core::ffi::c_void;

/// The dictionary FontFaceSetLoadEventInit of CSS/FontFaceSetLoadEvent.idl.
pub(crate) struct FontFaceSetLoadEventInit<'vm> {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) fontfaces: MarkedVec<'vm, CppInterface>,
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#fontfacesetloadevent
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct FontFaceSetLoadEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    fontfaces: Vec<CppFontFaceState>,
}

impl Wrappable for FontFaceSetLoadEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl FontFaceSetLoadEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: EventInit,
        fontfaces: &MarkedVec<'_, CppFontFaceState>,
    ) -> Ref<FontFaceSetLoadEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.bubbles,
            event_init.cancelable,
            event_init.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| FontFaceSetLoadEvent {
            event,
            fontfaces: fontfaces.to_vec(),
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#dom-fontfacesetloadevent-fontfacesetloadevent
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init_dict: FontFaceSetLoadEventInit<'_>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<FontFaceSetLoadEvent>> {
        let fontfaces = MarkedVec::with_capacity(cx.vm(), event_init_dict.fontfaces.len());
        for font_face in event_init_dict.fontfaces.values().iter() {
            fontfaces.push(CppFontFaceState::of_wrapper(font_face.wrapper()));
        }
        Ok(Self::create(
            cx.vm(),
            cx.realm(),
            &r#type,
            event_init_dict.parent,
            &fontfaces,
        ))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#dom-fontfacesetloadevent-fontfaces
    pub(crate) fn fontfaces<'vm>(&self, cx: &mut CallContext<'vm>) -> WebIdlResult<MarkedVec<'vm, CppInterface>> {
        let fontfaces = MarkedVec::with_capacity(cx.vm(), self.fontfaces.len());
        for font_face in &self.fontfaces {
            fontfaces.push(font_face.interface(cx));
        }
        Ok(fontfaces)
    }
}

/// The enumeration FontFaceSetLoadStatus of CSS/FontFaceSet.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum FontFaceSetLoadStatus {
    Loading,
    Loaded,
}

/// The reference-counted state of a font face, which LibWeb implements in C++. The FontFace object that script sees is
/// only made from it when something wraps it.
pub(crate) struct CppFontFaceState(NonNull<c_void>);

impl Clone for CppFontFaceState {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: This holds a reference, so the state is live.
        unsafe { Self::from_raw(self.as_ptr()) }
    }
}

impl Drop for CppFontFaceState {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: This holds a reference.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_unref(self.as_ptr()) };
    }
}

// SAFETY: The state visits every cell it can reach.
unsafe impl Trace for CppFontFaceState {
    fn trace(&self, visitor: &mut Visitor) {
        // SAFETY: This holds a reference, and the visitor is live.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_visit_edges(self.as_ptr(), visitor.as_raw().cast()) };
    }
}

impl CppFontFaceState {
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `font_face` must be a live FontFaceState, which this takes a reference to.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn from_raw(font_face: *mut c_void) -> Self {
        let font_face = NonNull::new(font_face).expect("C++ passes a font face");
        // SAFETY: The caller passes a live state.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_ref(font_face.as_ptr()) };
        Self(font_face)
    }

    pub(crate) fn of_wrapper(wrapper: Gc<Object>) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: The caller passes a wrapper of a FontFace, whose state is live.
        unsafe { Self::from_raw(web_css_font_face_of_wrapper(wrapper.as_ptr().cast())) }
    }

    fn as_ptr(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.0.as_ptr()
    }

    fn is(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.as_ptr() == other.as_ptr()
    }

    pub(crate) fn interface(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> CppInterface {
        // SAFETY: This holds a reference, and LibWeb returns a live FontFace.
        let font_face = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(web_css_font_face_cssom_font_face(self.as_ptr())) };
        wrap_cpp_cell(cx, &font_face)
    }

    fn wrapper(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> Value {
        Value::from_object(self.interface(cx).wrapper())
    }

    fn is_css_connected(&self) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The FontFace is live.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_is_css_connected(self.as_ptr()) }
    }

    fn css_rule_identity(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        let mut identity = 0;
        // SAFETY: The FontFace is live, and the identity outlives the call.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_css_rule_identity(self.as_ptr(), &raw mut identity) }.then_some(identity)
    }

    fn is_loading(&self) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The FontFace is live.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_is_loading(self.as_ptr()) }
    }

    fn is_loaded(&self) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The FontFace is live.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_is_loaded(self.as_ptr()) }
    }

    fn family_name(&self) -> Utf16String {
        // SAFETY: The FontFace is live, and LibWeb hands over the string.
        unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(web_css_font_face_family_name(self.as_ptr())) }
    }

    fn unicode_ranges_include_any_of(&self, text: &Utf16String) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The FontFace is live, and this hands over a reference to the string.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_unicode_ranges_include_any_of(self.as_ptr(), text.clone().into_raw()) }
    }

    /// Calls load() on the FontFace, and returns its [[FontStatusPromise]].
    fn load(&self) -> WebIdlPromise {
        // SAFETY: The FontFace is live, and LibWeb returns a live promise.
        unsafe { promise_from_abi(web_css_font_face_load(self.as_ptr())) }
    }
}

fn contains(font_faces: &[CppFontFaceState], font_face: &CppFontFaceState) -> bool {
    font_faces.iter().any(|entry| entry.is(font_face))
}

fn take_font_faces<'vm>(vm: &'vm Vm, list: &GcRefCell<Vec<CppFontFaceState>>) -> MarkedVec<'vm, CppFontFaceState> {
    let font_faces = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, list.borrow().len());
    font_faces.extend_from_slice(&list.borrow());
    list.borrow_mut(vm).clear();
    font_faces
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#fontfaceset
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct FontFaceSet {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    environment: CppCell,
    this: Cell<Option<Ref<FontFaceSet>>>,

    /// The set entries of this setlike object, in insertion order.
    font_faces: GcRefCell<Vec<CppFontFaceState>>,
    set_entries: WorldEntries<Set>,

    ready_promise: Cell<Option<WebIdlPromise>>,      // [[ReadyPromise]]
    loading_fonts: GcRefCell<Vec<CppFontFaceState>>, // [[LoadingFonts]]
    loaded_fonts: GcRefCell<Vec<CppFontFaceState>>,  // [[LoadedFonts]]
    failed_fonts: GcRefCell<Vec<CppFontFaceState>>,  // [[FailedFonts]]

    #[gc(untraced)]
    status: Cell<FontFaceSetLoadStatus>,
    is_pending_on_the_environment: Cell<bool>,
    ready_promise_is_resolved: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Wrappable for FontFaceSet {
    const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        Some(self.realm)
    }

    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for FontFaceSet {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl FontFaceSet {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>, environment: CppCell) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| FontFaceSet {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            realm,
            environment,
            this: Cell::new(None),
            font_faces: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            set_entries: WorldEntries::default(),
            ready_promise: Cell::new(None),
            loading_fonts: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            loaded_fonts: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            failed_fonts: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            status: Cell::new(FontFaceSetLoadStatus::Loaded),
            is_pending_on_the_environment: Cell::new(true),
            ready_promise_is_resolved: Cell::new(false),
        });
        object.this.set(Some(object));
        object.event_target.set_owner(object);
        object
            .ready_promise
            .set(Some(with_temporary_execution_context(realm, || {
                create_promise(vm, realm)
            })));
        object
    }

    fn this(&self) -> Ref<Self> {
        self.this.get().expect("a FontFaceSet knows itself once it is created")
    }

    fn as_abi(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        cell_into_abi(self.this())
    }

    fn ready_promise(&self) -> WebIdlPromise {
        self.ready_promise.get().expect("a FontFaceSet has a [[ReadyPromise]]")
    }

    pub(crate) fn relevant_settings_object(&self) -> &CppCell {
        &self.environment
    }

    pub(crate) fn size(&self) -> usize {
        self.font_faces.borrow().len()
    }

    fn did_change_loading_fonts(&self) {
        // SAFETY: The set is live.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_set_record_loading_fonts(self.as_abi(), self.loading_fonts.borrow().len()) };
    }

    fn entries<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, CppFontFaceState> {
        let entries = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, self.font_faces.borrow().len());
        entries.extend_from_slice(&self.font_faces.borrow());
        entries
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#dom-fontfaceset-add
    pub(crate) fn add(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, font: CppInterface) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<FontFaceSet>> {
        let font = CppFontFaceState::of_wrapper(font.wrapper());

        // 1. If font is already in the FontFaceSet’s set entries, skip to the last step of this algorithm immediately.
        if contains(&self.font_faces.borrow(), &font) {
            return Ok(self.this());
        }

        // 2. If font is CSS-connected, throw an InvalidModificationError exception and exit this algorithm immediately.
        if font.is_css_connected() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidModificationError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot add a CSS-connected FontFace to a FontFaceSet"),
            ));
        }

        // NB: This method implements steps 3 and 4.
        self.add_css_connected_font(cx.vm(), font);

        // 5. Return the FontFaceSet.
        Ok(self.this())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#dom-fontfaceset-add
    pub(crate) fn add_css_connected_font(&self, vm: &Vm, font: CppFontFaceState) {
        // 3. Add the font argument to the FontFaceSet’s set entries.
        if contains(&self.font_faces.borrow(), &font) {
            return;
        }

        self.font_faces.borrow_mut(vm).push(font.clone());
        let cx = CallContext::new(vm, self.realm);
        self.set_entries.for_each_live(vm, |set| {
            set.set_add(vm, font.wrapper(&context_of_set(&cx, set)));
        });
        // SAFETY: The FontFace and the set are live.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_did_join_set(font.as_ptr(), self.as_abi()) };

        // 4. If font’s status attribute is "loading"
        if font.is_loading() {
            self.font_started_loading(vm, font);
        }
    }

    /// Removes the font face of a CSS @font-face rule from the set entries.
    pub(crate) fn remove_css_connected_font(&self, vm: &Vm, font: &CppFontFaceState) {
        self.remove_font_face(vm, font, AllowCSSConnected::Yes);
    }

    /// What every FontFaceSet does when a font in it starts to load, or when a font that is loading joins it.
    pub(crate) fn font_started_loading(&self, vm: &Vm, font: CppFontFaceState) {
        // 1. If the FontFaceSet’s [[LoadingFonts]] list is empty, switch the FontFaceSet to loading.
        if self.loading_fonts.borrow().is_empty() {
            self.switch_to_loading(vm);
        }

        // 2. Append font to the FontFaceSet’s [[LoadingFonts]] list.
        self.loading_fonts.borrow_mut(vm).push(font);
        self.did_change_loading_fonts();
    }

    /// What every FontFaceSet does when a font in it loaded, or failed to.
    pub(crate) fn font_finished_loading(&self, vm: &Vm, font: CppFontFaceState, succeeded: bool) {
        // 1. Add font face to the FontFaceSet’s [[LoadedFonts]] list, or to its [[FailedFonts]] list.
        let list = if succeeded {
            &self.loaded_fonts
        } else {
            &self.failed_fonts
        };
        list.borrow_mut(vm).push(font.clone());

        // 2. Remove font face from the FontFaceSet’s [[LoadingFonts]] list. If font was the last item in that list
        //    (and so the list is now empty), switch the FontFaceSet to loaded.
        self.loading_fonts.borrow_mut(vm).retain(|entry| !entry.is(&font));
        self.did_change_loading_fonts();
        if self.loading_fonts.borrow().is_empty() {
            self.switch_to_loaded(vm);
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#document-font-face-set
    // The FontFaceSet entries for a document's font source must be initially populated with all the CSS-connected
    // FontFace objects from all of the CSS @font-face rules in the document or shadow root CSS style sheets, in
    // document order. As @font-face rules are added or removed, the corresponding objects must be added or removed and
    // maintain this ordering. Any manually-added FontFace objects must be ordered after the CSS-connected ones.
    pub(crate) fn synchronize_css_connected_font_order(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        unsafe extern "C" fn append_identity(context: *mut c_void, identity: u64, layer_rank: usize) {
            // SAFETY: The context is the list below, which outlives the call.
            unsafe { &mut *context.cast::<Vec<(u64, usize)>>() }.push((identity, layer_rank));
        }

        let font_faces = self.entries(vm);
        let font_faces = font_faces.values();
        if font_faces.len() < 2 {
            return;
        }
        let mut connected_font_faces = HashMap::new();
        for (index, font_face) in font_faces.iter().enumerate() {
            if let Some(identity) = font_face.css_rule_identity() {
                connected_font_faces.insert(identity, index);
            }
        }

        // Every sheet added or removed asks again. Without a face from a rule the walk over their rules finds nothing.
        let mut rule_identities: Vec<(u64, usize)> = Vec::new();
        if !connected_font_faces.is_empty() {
            // SAFETY: The set is live, and the list outlives the call.
            let has_window = unsafe {
                web_css_font_face_set_for_each_font_face_rule(
                    self.as_abi(),
                    (&raw mut rule_identities).cast(),
                    append_identity,
                )
            };
            if !has_window {
                return;
            }
        }

        let ordered_font_faces = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, font_faces.len());
        let mut seen = HashSet::new();
        let mut layer_ranks = HashMap::new();
        for (identity, rank) in rule_identities {
            if let Some(index) = connected_font_faces.get(&identity)
                && seen.insert(font_faces[*index].as_ptr())
            {
                let face = &font_faces[*index];
                if rank != usize::MAX {
                    layer_ranks.insert(face.as_ptr(), rank);
                }
                ordered_font_faces.push(face.clone());
            }
        }
        for font_face in font_faces.iter() {
            if font_face.is_css_connected() && seen.insert(font_face.as_ptr()) {
                ordered_font_faces.push(font_face.clone());
            }
        }
        for font_face in font_faces.iter() {
            if !font_face.is_css_connected() {
                ordered_font_faces.push(font_face.clone());
            }
        }

        let order_changed = ordered_font_faces.len() != font_faces.len()
            || ordered_font_faces
                .values()
                .iter()
                .zip(font_faces.iter())
                .any(|(ordered, entry)| !ordered.is(entry));
        if order_changed {
            *self.font_faces.borrow_mut(vm) = ordered_font_faces.to_vec();
            let cx = CallContext::new(vm, self.realm);
            self.set_entries.for_each_live(vm, |set| {
                set.set_clear(vm);
                let cx = context_of_set(&cx, set);
                for font_face in ordered_font_faces.values().iter() {
                    set.set_add(vm, font_face.wrapper(&cx));
                }
            });
        }
        let mut cells: Vec<*mut c_void> = ordered_font_faces
            .values()
            .iter()
            .map(CppFontFaceState::as_ptr)
            .collect();
        // Layer precedence affects rendering. FontFaceSet iteration keeps its document order.
        if !layer_ranks.is_empty() {
            cells.sort_by_key(|cell| layer_ranks.get(cell).copied().unwrap_or(usize::MAX));
        }
        // SAFETY: The set and the FontFaces are live, and the list outlives the call.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_set_synchronize_font_computer(self.as_abi(), cells.as_ptr(), cells.len()) };
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#dom-fontfaceset-delete
    pub(crate) fn delete(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, font: CppInterface) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        let font = CppFontFaceState::of_wrapper(font.wrapper());
        Ok(self.remove_font_face(cx.vm(), &font, AllowCSSConnected::No))
    }

    fn remove_font_face(&self, vm: &Vm, font: &CppFontFaceState, allow_css_connected: AllowCSSConnected) -> bool {
        // 1. If font is CSS-connected, return false and exit this algorithm immediately.
        if allow_css_connected == AllowCSSConnected::No && font.is_css_connected() {
            return false;
        }

        // 2. Let deleted be the result of removing font from the FontFaceSet’s set entries.
        if !contains(&self.font_faces.borrow(), font) {
            return false;
        }
        self.font_faces.borrow_mut(vm).retain(|entry| !entry.is(font));
        self.did_remove_from_set_entries(vm, font);

        // 3. If font is present in the FontFaceSet’s [[LoadedFonts]], or [[FailedFonts]] lists, remove it.
        self.loaded_fonts.borrow_mut(vm).retain(|entry| !entry.is(font));
        self.failed_fonts.borrow_mut(vm).retain(|entry| !entry.is(font));

        // 4. If font is present in the FontFaceSet’s [[LoadingFonts]] list, remove it.
        //    If font was the last item in that list (and so the list is now empty), switch the FontFaceSet to loaded.
        let was_in_loading_fonts = contains(&self.loading_fonts.borrow(), font);
        self.loading_fonts.borrow_mut(vm).retain(|entry| !entry.is(font));
        self.did_change_loading_fonts();
        if was_in_loading_fonts && self.loading_fonts.borrow().is_empty() {
            self.switch_to_loaded(vm);
        }

        true
    }

    fn did_remove_from_set_entries(&self, vm: &Vm, font: &CppFontFaceState) {
        let cx = CallContext::new(vm, self.realm);
        self.set_entries.for_each_live(vm, |set| {
            set.set_remove(vm, font.wrapper(&context_of_set(&cx, set)));
        });
        // SAFETY: The FontFace and the set are live.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_did_leave_set(font.as_ptr(), self.as_abi()) };
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#dom-fontfaceset-clear
    pub(crate) fn clear(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Remove all non-CSS-connected items from the FontFaceSet's set entries,
        //    its [[LoadedFonts]] list, and its [[FailedFonts]] list.
        for font_face in self
            .entries(vm)
            .values()
            .iter()
            .filter(|font_face| !font_face.is_css_connected())
        {
            self.did_remove_from_set_entries(vm, font_face);
        }
        self.font_faces
            .borrow_mut(vm)
            .retain(CppFontFaceState::is_css_connected);
        self.loaded_fonts
            .borrow_mut(vm)
            .retain(CppFontFaceState::is_css_connected);
        self.failed_fonts
            .borrow_mut(vm)
            .retain(CppFontFaceState::is_css_connected);

        // 2. If the FontFaceSet's [[LoadingFonts]] list is non-empty, remove all items from it,
        //    then switch the FontFaceSet to loaded.
        if !self.loading_fonts.borrow().is_empty() {
            self.loading_fonts.borrow_mut(vm).clear();
            self.did_change_loading_fonts();
            self.switch_to_loaded(vm);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#find-the-matching-font-faces
    fn find_matching_font_faces<'vm>(
        &self,
        vm: &'vm Vm,
        font: &Utf16String,
        text: &Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<MarkedVec<'vm, CppFontFaceState>> {
        // 1. Parse font using the CSS value syntax of the font property. If a syntax error occurs, return a syntax
        //    error.
        // If the parsed value is a CSS-wide keyword, return a syntax error.
        // NB: This case is already caught by font_family_names().

        // FIXME: Absolutize all relative lengths against the initial values of the corresponding properties. (For
        //        example, a relative font weight like bolder is evaluated against the initial value normal.)

        // FIXME: 2. If text was not explicitly provided, let it be a string containing a single space character
        //           (U+0020 SPACE).

        // 3. Let font family list be the list of font families parsed from font, and font style be the other font
        //    style attributes parsed from font.
        // NB: The generic font family keywords are skipped.
        let Some(font_family_list) = font_family_names(font) else {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "SyntaxError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Unable to parse font"),
            ));
        };

        // 5. Let matched font faces initially be an empty list.
        let matched_font_faces = MarkedVec::new(vm);

        // 6. For each family in font family list, use the font matching rules to select the font faces from available
        //    font faces that match the font style, and add them to matched font faces. The use of the unicodeRange
        //    attribute means that this may be more than just a single font face.
        let font_faces = self.entries(vm);
        let font_faces = font_faces.values();
        let family_names: Vec<_> = font_faces.iter().map(CppFontFaceState::family_name).collect();
        for font_family_name in &font_family_list {
            // FIXME: The matching below is super basic. We currently just match font family names by their string value.
            for (font_face, family_name) in font_faces.iter().zip(&family_names) {
                if family_name == font_family_name && !contains(&matched_font_faces.values(), font_face) {
                    matched_font_faces.push(font_face.clone());
                }
            }
        }

        // FIXME: 7. If matched font faces is empty, set the found faces flag to false. Otherwise, set it to true.

        // 8. For each font face in matched font faces, if its defined unicode-range does not include the codepoint of
        //    at least one character in text, remove it from the list.
        let remaining_font_faces = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, matched_font_faces.len());
        for font_face in matched_font_faces.values().iter() {
            if font_face.unicode_ranges_include_any_of(text) {
                remaining_font_faces.push(font_face.clone());
            }
        }

        // 9. Return matched font faces and the found faces flag.
        Ok(remaining_font_faces)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#dom-fontfaceset-load
    pub(crate) fn load(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        font: Utf16String,
        text: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = self.realm;

        // 1. Let font face set be the FontFaceSet object this method was called on. Let promise be a newly-created
        //    promise object.
        let promise = create_promise(vm, realm);

        // 3. Find the matching font faces from font face set using the font and text arguments passed to the function,
        //    and let font face list be the return value (ignoring the found faces flag). If a syntax error was
        //    returned, reject promise with a SyntaxError exception and terminate these steps.
        let font_face_list = match self.find_matching_font_faces(vm, &font, &text) {
            Ok(font_face_list) => font_face_list,
            Err(exception) => {
                reject_promise_with_exception(vm, promise, exception);
                return Ok(promise);
            }
        };

        // 4. Queue a task to run the following steps synchronously:
        // AD-HOC: Firefox and Chromium both match faces and start loading them in the current task. The web relies on
        //         this behavior, e.g. Instagram's story viewer. See the following spec issue for more details:
        //         https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/14804
        {
            // 1. For all of the font faces in the font face list, call their load() method.
            let wrappers = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, font_face_list.len());
            let promises = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, font_face_list.len());
            let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
            for font_face in font_face_list.values().iter() {
                wrappers.push(font_face.wrapper(&cx));
                promises.push(font_face.load());
            }
            let font_face_list = Array::create_from(vm, realm, &wrappers.to_vec());

            // 2. Resolve promise with the result of waiting for all of the [[FontStatusPromise]]s of each font face in
            //    the font face list, in order.
            react_to_promise(
                vm,
                get_promise_for_wait_for_all(vm, realm, &promises.values()),
                (promise, font_face_list),
                Some(|cx, (promise, font_face_list), _| {
                    resolve_promise(cx.vm(), promise, Value::from_object(font_face_list.upcast::<Object>()));
                    Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
                }),
                Some(|cx, (promise, _), reason| {
                    reject_promise(cx.vm(), promise, reason);
                    Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
                }),
            );
        }

        // 2. Return promise. Complete the rest of these steps asynchronously.
        Ok(promise)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#dom-fontfaceset-check
    pub(crate) fn check(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, font: Utf16String, text: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // 1. Let font face set be the FontFaceSet object this method was called on.
        // 2. Find the matching font faces from font face set using the font and text arguments passed to the function,
        //    and including system fonts, and let font face list be the returned list of font faces, and found faces be
        //    the returned found faces flag. If a syntax error was returned, throw a SyntaxError exception and terminate
        //    these steps.
        let font_face_list = self.find_matching_font_faces(cx.vm(), &font, &text)?;

        // 3. If font face list is empty, or all fonts in the font face list either have a status attribute of "loaded"
        //    or are system fonts, return true. Otherwise, return false.
        // FIXME: We should check if the font face is a system font here.
        Ok(font_face_list.values().iter().all(CppFontFaceState::is_loaded))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#font-face-set-ready
    pub(crate) fn ready(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        // Pending style or layout changes can start a deferred font load. Flush them before returning an already
        // fulfilled promise so switching the FontFaceSet to loading can replace it with a new pending promise.
        if self.ready_promise_is_resolved.get() {
            // SAFETY: The set is live.
            unsafe { web_css_font_face_set_update_layout(self.as_abi(), false) };
        }

        Ok(self.ready_promise())
    }

    pub(crate) fn status(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<FontFaceSetLoadStatus> {
        Ok(self.status.get())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#fire-a-font-load-event
    fn fire_a_font_load_event(&self, vm: &Vm, name: &str, font_faces: &MarkedVec<'_, CppFontFaceState>) {
        // To fire a font load event named e at a FontFaceSet target with optional font faces means to fire a simple
        // event named e using the FontFaceSetLoadEvent interface that also meets these conditions:
        // 1. The fontfaces attribute is initialized to the result of filtering font faces to only contain FontFace
        //    objects contained in target.
        let fontfaces = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, font_faces.len());
        for font_face in font_faces.values().iter() {
            if contains(&self.font_faces.borrow(), font_face) {
                fontfaces.push(font_face.clone());
            }
        }
        let event_init = EventInit {
            bubbles: false,
            cancelable: false,
            composed: false,
        };
        let event = FontFaceSetLoadEvent::create(vm, self.realm, &Utf16String::from_utf8(name), event_init, &fontfaces);
        self.event_target.dispatch_event(event.event());
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#ref-for-fontfaceset-pending-on-the-environment%E2%91%A1
    pub(crate) fn set_is_pending_on_the_environment(&self, vm: &Vm, is_pending_on_the_environment: bool) {
        if is_pending_on_the_environment == self.is_pending_on_the_environment.get() {
            return;
        }
        self.is_pending_on_the_environment.set(is_pending_on_the_environment);

        // Whenever a FontFaceSet goes from pending on the environment to not pending on the environment, the user agent
        // must run the following steps:
        if !is_pending_on_the_environment {
            // 1. If the FontFaceSet is stuck on the environment and its [[LoadingFonts]] list is empty, switch the
            //    FontFaceSet to loaded.
            // FIXME: We also need to mark empty FontFaceSets as loaded, so that the [[ReadyPromise]] gets resolved.
            //        Spec issue: https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/13538#issuecomment-3933951987
            // AD-HOC: Also switch when nothing has ever entered the LoadingFonts list: an empty set, or a set whose
            //         entries all have deferred unicode-ranges that no rendered codepoint matched. Without this the
            //         ready promise stays pending forever.
            if self.loading_fonts.borrow().is_empty() {
                self.switch_to_loaded(vm);
            }

            // 2. If the FontFaceSet is stuck on the environment, unmark it as such.
            // NB: The AD-HOC condition above covers being stuck, so nothing records it.
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#switch-the-fontfaceset-to-loading
    fn switch_to_loading(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        // 1. Let font face set be the given FontFaceSet.
        // 2. Set the status attribute of font face set to "loading".
        self.status.set(FontFaceSetLoadStatus::Loading);

        // 3. If font face set’s [[ReadyPromise]] slot currently holds a fulfilled promise, replace it with a fresh
        //    pending promise.
        // AD-HOC: A promise that was resolved with a set whose "then" lookup may run script is fulfilled later, so
        //         we check whether the promise was resolved instead.
        if self.ready_promise_is_resolved.replace(false) {
            let realm = self.realm;
            self.ready_promise.set(Some(with_temporary_execution_context(realm, || {
                create_promise(vm, realm)
            })));
        }

        // 4. Queue a task to fire a font load event named loading at font face set.
        queue_a_task(vm, TaskSource::FontLoading, self.this(), |vm, this| {
            with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(this.realm, || {
                this.fire_a_font_load_event(vm, "loading", &MarkedVec::new(vm));
            });
        });
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#switch-the-fontfaceset-to-loaded
    fn switch_to_loaded(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        // 1. Let font face set be the given FontFaceSet.
        // 2. If font face set is pending on the environment, mark it as stuck on the environment, and exit this
        //    algorithm.
        if self.is_pending_on_the_environment.get() {
            return;
        }

        // NB: Pending style or layout changes can depend on a recently loaded font or start another deferred font load.
        // SAFETY: The set is live.
        unsafe { web_css_font_face_set_update_layout(self.as_abi(), true) };
        if !self.loading_fonts.borrow().is_empty() {
            return;
        }

        // 3. Set font face set’s status attribute to "loaded".
        let was_loading = self.status.get() == FontFaceSetLoadStatus::Loading;
        self.status.set(FontFaceSetLoadStatus::Loaded);

        // 4. Fulfill font face set’s [[ReadyPromise]] attribute’s value with font face set.
        let realm = self.realm;
        self.ready_promise_is_resolved.set(true);
        with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(realm, || {
            let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
            let value = self.this().to_js(&cx).expect("wrapping a FontFaceSet can't throw");
            resolve_promise(vm, self.ready_promise(), value);
        });

        // AD-HOC: A set that never switched to loading only fulfills its ready promise. Firing loadingdone for it would
        //         report a load that never happened.
        if !was_loading {
            return;
        }

        // 5. Queue a task to perform the following steps synchronously:
        queue_a_task(vm, TaskSource::FontLoading, self.this(), |vm, this| {
            with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(this.realm, || {
                // 1. Let loaded fonts be the (possibly empty) contents of font face set’s [[LoadedFonts]] slot.
                // 2. Let failed fonts be the (possibly empty) contents of font face set’s [[FailedFonts]] slot.
                // 3. Reset the [[LoadedFonts]] and [[FailedFonts]] slots to empty lists.
                let loaded_fonts = take_font_faces(vm, &this.loaded_fonts);
                let failed_fonts = take_font_faces(vm, &this.failed_fonts);

                // 4. Fire a font load event named loadingdone at font face set with loaded fonts.
                this.fire_a_font_load_event(vm, "loadingdone", &loaded_fonts);

                // 5. If font face set’s failed fonts is non-empty, fire a font load event named loadingerror at font face
                //    set with failed fonts.
                if !failed_fonts.is_empty() {
                    this.fire_a_font_load_event(vm, "loadingerror", &failed_fonts);
                }
            });
        });
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Eq, PartialEq)]
enum AllowCSSConnected {
    No,
    Yes,
}

impl Setlike for FontFaceSet {
    fn set_entries(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> Gc<Set> {
        self.set_entries.get_or_create(cx, || {
            let set = Set::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm());
            for font_face in self.entries(cx.vm()).values().iter() {
                set.set_add(cx.vm(), font_face.wrapper(cx));
            }
            set
        })
    }

    fn set_entries_size(&self) -> usize {
        self.font_faces.borrow().len()
    }

    fn set_entries_contain(&self, value: Value) -> bool {
        contains(
            &self.font_faces.borrow(),
            &CppFontFaceState::of_wrapper(value.as_object()),
        )
    }
}

//! HighlightRegistry, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#highlightregistry

use core::cell::Cell;
use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, Map, MarkedVec, Trace, Value, Vm};

use super::css_rule::wrap_cpp_cell;
use super::highlight::Highlight;
use crate::bindings::conversions::{CppInterface, ToJs};
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate, implementation_of, wrap};
use crate::bindings::maplike::context_of_map;
use crate::bindings::maplike::{Maplike, WritableMaplike};
use crate::bindings::setlike::WorldEntries;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_highlight_registry_point_is_in_viewport(document: *mut c_void, x: f32, y: f32) -> bool;
    fn web_css_highlight_registry_shadow_root_at_point(document: *mut c_void, x: f32, y: f32) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_highlight_registry_range_is_hit(range: *mut c_void, x: f32, y: f32) -> bool;
    fn web_css_shadow_root_of_wrapper(wrapper: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_highlight_registry_invalidate_custom_highlights(document: *mut c_void);
}

/// The dictionary HighlightsFromPointOptions of CSS/HighlightRegistry.idl.
pub(crate) struct HighlightsFromPointOptions<'vm> {
    pub(crate) shadow_roots: MarkedVec<'vm, CppInterface>,
}

/// The dictionary HighlightHitResult of CSS/HighlightRegistry.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct HighlightHitResult {
    pub(crate) highlight: Option<Ref<Highlight>>,
    pub(crate) ranges: Option<Vec<CppInterface>>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct RegisteredHighlight {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pub(crate) name: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) highlight: Ref<Highlight>,
    /// When the name was last set, which orders custom highlights of the same priority.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    registration_sequence: u64,
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#highlightregistry
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct HighlightRegistry {
    document: CppCell,
    this: Cell<Option<Ref<HighlightRegistry>>>,
    /// The map entries of this maplike object, in insertion order.
    highlights: GcRefCell<Vec<RegisteredHighlight>>,
    map_entries: WorldEntries<Map>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    next_registration_sequence: Cell<u64>,
}

impl Wrappable for HighlightRegistry {}

fn set_map_entry(cx: &CallContext, map: Gc<Map>, name: &Utf16String, highlight: Ref<Highlight>) {
    let key = name.clone().to_js(cx).expect("a string converts to a JS value");
    map.map_set(cx.vm(), key, Value::from_object(wrap(cx, highlight)));
}

impl HighlightRegistry {
    fn registered_highlights<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, RegisteredHighlight> {
        let highlights = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        highlights.extend_from_slice(&self.highlights.borrow());
        highlights
    }

    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, document: CppCell) -> Ref<Self> {
        let registry = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            document,
            this: Cell::new(None),
            highlights: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            map_entries: WorldEntries::default(),
            next_registration_sequence: Cell::new(0),
        });
        registry.this.set(Some(registry));
        registry
    }

    fn this(&self) -> Ref<Self> {
        self.this
            .get()
            .expect("a HighlightRegistry knows itself once it is created")
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_highlights(&self) -> bool {
        !self.highlights.borrow().is_empty()
    }

    /// Whether a registered custom highlight has a range.
    pub(crate) fn has_ranges(&self) -> bool {
        self.highlights
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .any(|entry| entry.highlight.has_ranges())
    }

    /// Whether a registered custom highlight has the range whose cell C++ passes.
    pub(crate) fn contains_range(&self, range: *mut c_void) -> bool {
        self.highlights
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .any(|entry| entry.highlight.contains_range(range))
    }

    /// The registered custom highlights, from the bottom of the stacking order to the top.
    pub(crate) fn highlights_in_stacking_order<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, RegisteredHighlight> {
        let highlights = self.registered_highlights(vm);
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#priorities
        // A higher priority results in being above in the stacking order. [...] When two or more custom highlights
        // have the same numerical priority, the one most recently registered has the higher effective priority.
        highlights
            .values_mut()
            .sort_by_key(|entry| (entry.highlight.current_priority(), entry.registration_sequence));
        highlights
    }

    /// Tells the document that what the custom highlights paint changed.
    pub(crate) fn invalidate_custom_highlights(&self) {
        // SAFETY: The document is live.
        unsafe { web_css_highlight_registry_invalidate_custom_highlights(self.document.as_ptr()) };
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#dom-highlightregistry-highlightsfrompoint
    pub(crate) fn highlights_from_point<'vm>(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext<'vm>,
        x: f32,
        y: f32,
        options: HighlightsFromPointOptions<'_>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<MarkedVec<'vm, HighlightHitResult>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let results = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        let document = self.document.as_ptr();

        // 1. If any of the following are true, return the empty sequence:
        //    * x is negative
        //    * y is negative
        //    * x is greater than the viewport width excluding the size of a rendered scroll bar (if any)
        //    * y is greater than the viewport height excluding the size of a rendered scroll bar (if any)
        // SAFETY: The document is live.
        if !unsafe { web_css_highlight_registry_point_is_in_viewport(document, x, y) } {
            return Ok(results);
        }

        //    * The topmost box in the viewport in paint order that would be a target for hit testing at coordinates x,y
        //      when applying the transforms that apply to the descendants of the viewport, has an element associated to
        //      it that's in a shadow tree whose shadow root is not contained by options.shadowRoots.
        // SAFETY: The document is live.
        let shadow_root = unsafe { web_css_highlight_registry_shadow_root_at_point(document, x, y) };
        if !shadow_root.is_null() {
            let is_contained = options.shadow_roots.to_vec().iter().any(|allowed_shadow_root| {
                // SAFETY: The bindings checked that the wrapper is that of a ShadowRoot.
                unsafe { web_css_shadow_root_of_wrapper(allowed_shadow_root.wrapper().as_ptr().cast()) == shadow_root }
            });
            if !is_contained {
                return Ok(results);
            }
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, let results be an empty sequence.
        // NB: The results stay in insertion order in a MarkedVec, as they hold new wrappers, with the sort keys next to
        //     them.
        let unsorted_results = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        let mut sort_keys: Vec<(i32, u64)> = Vec::new();

        // 3. For each Highlight highlight in this HighlightRegistry:
        for entry in self.registered_highlights(vm).values().iter() {
            let highlight = entry.highlight;

            // 1. Let result be a new HighlightHitResult with highlight set to highlight.
            let ranges = MarkedVec::new(vm);

            // 2. For each AbstractRange abstractRange in highlight:
            for abstract_range in highlight.ranges(vm).values().iter() {
                // 1. If abstractRange is an invalid StaticRange, then continue.
                // 2. Let range be a new Range whose start node and end node are set to abstractRange’s start node and
                //    end node respectively, and start offset and end offset are set to abstractRange’s start offset
                //    and end offset respectively.
                // 3. If the coordinates x,y fall inside at least one of the DOMRects returned by calling
                //    getClientRects() on range, then append abstractRange to result.ranges.
                // SAFETY: The range is live.
                if unsafe { web_css_highlight_registry_range_is_hit(abstract_range.as_ptr(), x, y) } {
                    ranges.push(wrap_cpp_cell(cx, abstract_range));
                }
            }

            // 3. If result.ranges is not empty, append result to results.
            if !ranges.is_empty() {
                sort_keys.push((highlight.current_priority(), entry.registration_sequence));
                unsorted_results.push(HighlightHitResult {
                    highlight: Some(highlight),
                    ranges: Some(ranges.to_vec()),
                });
            }
        }

        // 4. Sort results by descending order of priority of its HighlightHitResults' highlight attributes.
        // NB: When two or more custom highlights have the same numerical priority, the one most recently registered has
        //     the higher effective priority.
        let mut order: Vec<usize> = (0..sort_keys.len()).collect();
        order.sort_by_key(|index| {
            let (priority, registration_sequence) = sort_keys[*index];
            (core::cmp::Reverse(priority), core::cmp::Reverse(registration_sequence))
        });

        // 5. Return results.
        for index in order {
            results.push(unsorted_results.get(index).expect("the index is in the results"));
        }
        Ok(results)
    }
}

impl Maplike for HighlightRegistry {
    fn map_entries(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> Gc<Map> {
        self.map_entries.get_or_create(cx, || {
            let map = Map::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm());
            for entry in self.registered_highlights(cx.vm()).values().iter() {
                set_map_entry(cx, map, &entry.name, entry.highlight);
            }
            map
        })
    }
}

impl WritableMaplike for HighlightRegistry {
    fn map_set(&self, cx: &CallContext, key: Utf16String, value: Value) {
        let highlight = implementation_of::<Highlight>(value.as_object());
        // NB: Setting a name again registers it again, though the maplike entry keeps its place in iteration order.
        let registration_sequence = self.next_registration_sequence.get() + 1;
        self.next_registration_sequence.set(registration_sequence);
        let previous = {
            let mut highlights = self.highlights.borrow_mut(cx.vm());
            match highlights.iter_mut().find(|entry| entry.name == key) {
                Some(entry) => {
                    entry.registration_sequence = registration_sequence;
                    Some(core::mem::replace(&mut entry.highlight, highlight))
                }
                None => {
                    highlights.push(RegisteredHighlight {
                        name: key.clone(),
                        highlight,
                        registration_sequence,
                    });
                    None
                }
            }
        };
        if let Some(previous) = previous {
            previous.did_unregister(self.this());
        }
        highlight.did_register(cx.vm(), self.this());
        self.map_entries.for_each_live(cx.vm(), |map| {
            set_map_entry(&context_of_map(cx, map), map, &key, highlight);
        });
        self.invalidate_custom_highlights();
    }

    fn map_remove(&self, cx: &CallContext, key: &Utf16String) -> bool {
        let position = self.highlights.borrow().iter().position(|entry| entry.name == *key);
        let Some(position) = position else {
            return false;
        };
        let removed = self.highlights.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).remove(position);
        removed.highlight.did_unregister(self.this());
        self.map_entries.for_each_live(cx.vm(), |map| {
            let key = key.clone().to_js(cx).expect("a string converts to a JS value");
            map.map_remove(cx.vm(), key);
        });
        self.invalidate_custom_highlights();
        true
    }

    fn map_clear(&self, cx: &CallContext) {
        let removed = self.registered_highlights(cx.vm());
        self.highlights.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).clear();
        for entry in removed.values().iter() {
            entry.highlight.did_unregister(self.this());
        }
        self.map_entries.for_each_live(cx.vm(), |map| {
            map.map_clear(cx.vm());
        });
        if !removed.is_empty() {
            self.invalidate_custom_highlights();
        }
    }
}

//! Highlight, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#highlight

use core::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::collections::HashSet;

use libjs_rust::api::{EmbedderCell, Gc, GcRefCell, GcWeak, MarkedVec, Set, Trace, Value, Vm};

use super::css_rule::wrap_cpp_cell;
use super::highlight_registry::HighlightRegistry;
use crate::bindings::conversions::CppInterface;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, Wrapped, allocate};
use crate::bindings::setlike::context_of_set;
use crate::bindings::setlike::{Setlike, WorldEntries, WritableSetlike};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_abstract_range_of_wrapper(wrapper: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
}

/// The enumeration HighlightType of CSS/Highlight.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum HighlightType {
    Highlight,
    SpellingError,
    GrammarError,
}

/// The AbstractRange that a JS value of the value type of the setlike declaration wraps.
fn range_of_value(value: Value) -> CppCell {
    // SAFETY: The bindings checked that the value is a wrapper of an AbstractRange.
    unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(web_css_abstract_range_of_wrapper(value.as_object().as_ptr().cast())) }
}

fn range_wrapper(cx: &CallContext, range: &CppCell) -> Value {
    Value::from_object(wrap_cpp_cell(cx, range).wrapper())
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#highlight
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct Highlight {
    /// The set entries of this setlike object, in insertion order.
    ranges: GcRefCell<Vec<CppCell>>,
    /// The addresses of the ranges, to find one without a walk over all of them.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    range_addresses: RefCell<HashSet<usize>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    priority: Cell<i32>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    highlight_type: Cell<HighlightType>,
    set_entries: WorldEntries<Set>,
    /// The registries that the highlight is registered in, once for each name that it is registered under.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    registries: RefCell<Vec<GcWeak<EmbedderCell<Wrapped<HighlightRegistry>>>>>,
}

impl Wrappable for Highlight {}

impl Highlight {
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#dom-highlight-highlight
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        initial_ranges: MarkedVec<'_, CppInterface>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. Let highlight be the new Highlight object.
        // 2. Set highlight’s priority to 0.
        // 3. Set highlight’s type to highlight.
        let highlight = allocate(cx.vm(), |_| Self {
            ranges: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            range_addresses: RefCell::new(HashSet::new()),
            priority: Cell::new(0),
            highlight_type: Cell::new(HighlightType::Highlight),
            set_entries: WorldEntries::default(),
            registries: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
        });

        // 4. For each range of initialRanges, let rangeArg be the result of converting range to an ECMAScript value,
        //    then run the steps for a built-in setlike add function, with highlight as the this value, and rangeArg as
        //    the argument.
        // NB: highlight has no wrapper yet, so there are no set entries in any world to update.
        for range in initial_ranges.values().iter() {
            highlight.add_range(cx, range_of_value(Value::from_object(range.wrapper())));
        }

        // 5. Return highlight.
        Ok(highlight)
    }

    pub(crate) fn priority(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        Ok(self.priority.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_priority(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, priority: i32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if self.priority.replace(priority) != priority {
            self.invalidate_registries(cx.vm());
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn r#type(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<HighlightType> {
        Ok(self.highlight_type.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_type(&self, _: &mut CallContext, highlight_type: HighlightType) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.highlight_type.set(highlight_type);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// The priority that sorts the results of highlightsFromPoint().
    pub(crate) fn current_priority(&self) -> i32 {
        self.priority.get()
    }

    /// The ranges of the highlight, in insertion order.
    pub(crate) fn ranges<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, CppCell> {
        let ranges = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        ranges.extend_from_slice(&self.ranges.borrow());
        ranges
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_ranges(&self) -> bool {
        !self.ranges.borrow().is_empty()
    }

    /// Whether the highlight has the range whose cell C++ passes.
    pub(crate) fn contains_range(&self, range: *mut c_void) -> bool {
        self.range_addresses.borrow().contains(&(range as usize))
    }

    pub(crate) fn did_register(&self, vm: &Vm, registry: Ref<HighlightRegistry>) {
        let mut registries = self.registries.borrow_mut();
        registries.retain(|registered| registered.get().is_some());
        registries.push(GcWeak::new(vm.heap(), registry));
    }

    pub(crate) fn did_unregister(&self, registry: Ref<HighlightRegistry>) {
        let mut registries = self.registries.borrow_mut();
        if let Some(position) = registries
            .iter()
            .position(|registered| registered.get().is_some_and(|live| live.as_ptr() == registry.as_ptr()))
        {
            registries.remove(position);
        }
    }

    /// Tells each registry that the highlight is registered in that what the highlight paints changed.
    fn invalidate_registries(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        let live = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        for registered in self.registries.borrow().iter() {
            if let Some(registry) = registered.get() {
                live.push(registry);
            }
        }
        for registry in live.values().iter() {
            registry.invalidate_custom_highlights();
        }
    }

    fn add_range(&self, cx: &CallContext, range: CppCell) -> bool {
        if !self.range_addresses.borrow_mut().insert(range.as_ptr() as usize) {
            return false;
        }
        self.ranges.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).push(range);
        true
    }
}

impl Setlike for Highlight {
    fn set_entries(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> Gc<Set> {
        self.set_entries.get_or_create(cx, || {
            let set = Set::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm());
            for range in self.ranges(cx.vm()).values().iter() {
                set.set_add(cx.vm(), range_wrapper(cx, range));
            }
            set
        })
    }

    fn set_entries_size(&self) -> usize {
        self.ranges.borrow().len()
    }

    fn set_entries_contain(&self, value: Value) -> bool {
        self.range_addresses
            .borrow()
            .contains(&(range_of_value(value).as_ptr() as usize))
    }
}

impl WritableSetlike for Highlight {
    fn set_add(&self, cx: &CallContext, value: Value) {
        let range = range_of_value(value);
        if !self.add_range(cx, range.clone()) {
            return;
        }
        self.set_entries.for_each_live(cx.vm(), |set| {
            set.set_add(cx.vm(), range_wrapper(&context_of_set(cx, set), &range));
        });
        self.invalidate_registries(cx.vm());
    }

    fn set_remove(&self, cx: &CallContext, value: Value) -> bool {
        let range = range_of_value(value);
        if !self.range_addresses.borrow_mut().remove(&(range.as_ptr() as usize)) {
            return false;
        }
        self.ranges
            .borrow_mut(cx.vm())
            .retain(|existing| existing.as_ptr() != range.as_ptr());
        self.set_entries.for_each_live(cx.vm(), |set| {
            set.set_remove(cx.vm(), range_wrapper(&context_of_set(cx, set), &range));
        });
        self.invalidate_registries(cx.vm());
        true
    }

    fn set_clear(&self, cx: &CallContext) {
        let had_ranges = self.has_ranges();
        self.range_addresses.borrow_mut().clear();
        self.ranges.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).clear();
        self.set_entries.for_each_live(cx.vm(), |set| {
            set.set_clear(cx.vm());
        });
        if had_ranges {
            self.invalidate_registries(cx.vm());
        }
    }
}

//! MediaList, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-medialist-interface

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::null_mut;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{DeferGc, GcRefCell, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::{MediaListDeleteResult, NativeMediaList};

use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::interface::Wrappable;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_media_list_changed(style_sheet: *mut c_void, rule: *mut c_void);
}

/// A media list belongs to a sheet, to an `@media` or `@import` rule inside one, or to both, when the sheet of an
/// `@import` rule arrives after its list was asked for. Both are gates on whether rules apply, so both have to say when
/// the gate moves.
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct MediaList {
    /// The collection of media queries, which the sheet or the rule reads as well.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    media: NativeMediaList,
    /// The cell of the CSSStyleSheet.
    associated_style_sheet: GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,
    /// The cell of the CSSRule.
    associated_rule: GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,
}

impl Wrappable for MediaList {}

fn cell_pointer(cell: &GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>) -> *mut c_void {
    cell.borrow().as_ref().map_or(null_mut(), CppCell::as_ptr)
}

impl MediaList {
    pub(crate) fn new(_: &DeferGc<'_>, media: NativeMediaList) -> Self {
        Self {
            media,
            associated_style_sheet: GcRefCell::new(None),
            associated_rule: GcRefCell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn share_media(&self) -> NativeMediaList {
        self.media.share()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_associated_style_sheet(&self, vm: &Vm, sheet: CppCell) {
        *self.associated_style_sheet.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(sheet);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_associated_rule(&self, vm: &Vm, rule: CppCell) {
        *self.associated_rule.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(rule);
    }

    fn media_changed(&self) {
        let style_sheet = cell_pointer(&self.associated_style_sheet);
        let rule = cell_pointer(&self.associated_rule);
        // SAFETY: The cells are a CSSStyleSheet and a CSSRule, or null, and the list keeps them alive.
        unsafe { web_css_media_list_changed(style_sheet, rule) };
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-medialist-mediatext
    pub(crate) fn media_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.media.media_text())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-medialist-mediatext
    pub(crate) fn set_media_text(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.media.set_media_text(value.as_units());
        self.media_changed();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-medialist-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(u32::try_from(self.media.length()).expect("a list has fewer than 2^32 media queries"))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-medialist-item
    pub(crate) fn item(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        Ok(self.media.item(index as usize))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-medialist-appendmedium
    pub(crate) fn append_medium(&self, _: &mut CallContext, medium: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if self.media.append_medium(medium.as_units()) {
            self.media_changed();
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-medialist-deletemedium
    pub(crate) fn delete_medium(&self, _: &mut CallContext, medium: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        match self.media.delete_medium(medium.as_units()) {
            MediaListDeleteResult::Invalid => Ok(()),
            MediaListDeleteResult::NotFound => Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotFoundError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Media query not found in list"),
            )),
            MediaListDeleteResult::Removed => {
                self.media_changed();
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

//! MediaQueryListEvent, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#mediaquerylistevent

/// The dictionary MediaQueryListEventInit of CSS/MediaQueryListEvent.idl.

    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) matches: bool,

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#mediaquerylistevent

#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]

        &self.event
    }

        Ok(self.media.clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn matches(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {

    }

/*
