//! MediaQueryList, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#the-mediaquerylist-interface

use core::cell::Cell;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::NativeMediaList;

use crate::bindings::callback::CallbackInterface;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::css::media_query_list_event::{MediaQueryListEvent, MediaQueryListEventInit};
use crate::dom::event::EventInit;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_media_query_list_evaluate(document: *mut c_void, media: *const c_void) -> bool;
    fn web_css_media_query_list_update_container_layout(document: *mut c_void) -> bool;
}

const CHANGE: &str = "change";

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#the-mediaquerylist-interface
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct MediaQueryList {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,

    // A MediaQueryList object has an associated media query list and an associated document set on creation.
    document: CppCell,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    media: NativeMediaList,

    has_changed_state: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Wrappable for MediaQueryList {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        Some(self.realm)
    }

    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for MediaQueryList {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl MediaQueryList {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>, document: CppCell, media: NativeMediaList) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| MediaQueryList {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            realm,
            document,
            media,
            has_changed_state: Cell::new(false),
        });
        object.event_target.set_owner(object);
        object.evaluate();
        object
    }

    fn evaluate(&self) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The document is live, and the media query list is lent for the call.
        unsafe { web_css_media_query_list_evaluate(self.document.as_ptr(), (&raw const self.media).cast()) }
    }

    fn current_matches(&self) -> bool {
        let did_match = self.media.matches();

        // NB: If our document is inside a frame, we need to update layout since that may cause our frame (and thus
        //     viewport) to resize.
        // SAFETY: The document is live.
        if unsafe { web_css_media_query_list_update_container_layout(self.document.as_ptr()) } {
            self.evaluate();
        }

        let now_matches = self.media.matches();
        if did_match != now_matches {
            self.has_changed_state.set(true);
        }
        now_matches
    }

    /// Whether the list has to outlive its last script reference, to receive change events.
    pub(crate) fn has_change_listener(&self) -> bool {
        self.event_target.has_event_listener(CHANGE)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#evaluate-media-queries-and-report-changes
    pub(crate) fn evaluate_and_report_change(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        let did_match = self.current_matches();
        let now_matches = self.evaluate();
        let did_change_internally = self.has_changed_state.replace(false);

        // 1. If target’s matches state has changed since the last time these steps were run, fire an event at target
        //    using the MediaQueryListEvent constructor, with its type attribute initialized to change, its isTrusted
        //    attribute initialized to true, its media attribute initialized to target’s media, and its matches
        //    attribute initialized to target’s matches state.
        if did_change_internally || did_match != now_matches {
            let event_init = MediaQueryListEventInit {
                parent: EventInit {
                    bubbles: false,
                    cancelable: false,
                    composed: false,
                },
                matches: now_matches,
                media: self.media.media_text(),
            };
            let event =
                MediaQueryListEvent::create(vm, self.realm, &Utf16String::from_ascii(CHANGE.as_bytes()), event_init);
            self.event_target.dispatch_event(event.event());
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-mediaquerylist-media
    pub(crate) fn media(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.media.media_text())
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-mediaquerylist-matches
    pub(crate) fn matches(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        Ok(self.current_matches())
    }

    // https://www.w3.org/TR/cssom-view/#dom-mediaquerylist-addlistener
    pub(crate) fn add_listener(&self, _: &mut CallContext, callback: Option<CallbackInterface>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If listener is null, terminate these steps.
        let Some(callback) = callback else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        // 2. Append an event listener to the associated list of event listeners with type set to change, callback set
        //    to listener, and capture set to false, unless there already is an event listener in that list with the
        //    same type, callback, and capture.
        //    (NOTE: capture is set to false by default)
        self.event_target.add_event_listener_without_options(CHANGE, &callback);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://www.w3.org/TR/cssom-view/#dom-mediaquerylist-removelistener
    pub(crate) fn remove_listener(&self, _: &mut CallContext, callback: Option<CallbackInterface>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Remove an event listener from the associated list of event listeners, whose type is change, callback is
        //    listener, and capture is false.
        // NB: While the spec doesn't technically use remove_event_listener and instead manipulates the list directly,
        //     every major engine uses remove_event_listener. This means if an event listener removes another event
        //     listener that comes after it, the removed event listener will not be invoked.
        if let Some(callback) = callback {
            self.event_target
                .remove_event_listener_without_options(CHANGE, &callback);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

//! Screen, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#screen

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::css::screen_orientation::ScreenOrientation;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_screen_area(window: *mut c_void, available: bool, width: *mut i32, height: *mut i32);
    fn web_css_screen_is_extended(window: *mut c_void) -> bool;
}

/// Which area of the screen an attribute reports.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum ScreenArea {
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#web-exposed-screen-area
    WebExposed,
    /// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#web-exposed-available-screen-area
    WebExposedAvailable,
}

// The colorDepth and pixelDepth attributes should return the number of bits allocated to colors for a pixel in the
// output device, excluding the alpha channel.
const COLOR_DEPTH: u32 = 24;

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#screen
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct Screen {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    window: CppCell,
    orientation: GcRefCell<Option<Ref<ScreenOrientation>>>,
}

impl Wrappable for Screen {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        Some(self.realm)
    }

    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for Screen {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl Screen {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>, window: CppCell) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Screen {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            realm,
            window,
            orientation: GcRefCell::new(None),
        });
        object.event_target.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    fn area(&self, area: ScreenArea) -> (i32, i32) {
        let (mut width, mut height) = (0, 0);
        // SAFETY: The window is live, and the sizes are lent for the call.
        unsafe {
            web_css_screen_area(
                self.window.as_ptr(),
                matches!(area, ScreenArea::WebExposedAvailable),
                &raw mut width,
                &raw mut height,
            );
        }
        (width, height)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#dom-screen-availwidth
    pub(crate) fn avail_width(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        // The availWidth attribute must return the width of the Web-exposed available screen area.
        Ok(self.area(ScreenArea::WebExposedAvailable).0)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#dom-screen-availheight
    pub(crate) fn avail_height(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        // The availHeight attribute must return the height of the Web-exposed available screen area.
        Ok(self.area(ScreenArea::WebExposedAvailable).1)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#dom-screen-width
    pub(crate) fn width(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        // The width attribute must return the width of the Web-exposed screen area.
        Ok(self.area(ScreenArea::WebExposed).0)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#dom-screen-height
    pub(crate) fn height(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        // The height attribute must return the height of the Web-exposed screen area.
        Ok(self.area(ScreenArea::WebExposed).1)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#dom-screen-colordepth
    pub(crate) fn color_depth(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(COLOR_DEPTH)
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#dom-screen-pixeldepth
    pub(crate) fn pixel_depth(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(COLOR_DEPTH)
    }

    pub(crate) fn orientation(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<ScreenOrientation>> {
        if let Some(orientation) = *self.orientation.borrow() {
            return Ok(orientation);
        }
        let orientation = ScreenOrientation::create(cx.vm(), self.realm);
        *self.orientation.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = Some(orientation);
        Ok(orientation)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/window-management/#dom-screen-isextended
    pub(crate) fn is_extended(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // SAFETY: The window is live.
        Ok(unsafe { web_css_screen_is_extended(self.window.as_ptr()) })
    }
}

//! StylePropertyMapReadOnly, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#stylepropertymapreadonly

use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{
    Array, DeferGc, EmbedderCell, EmbedderClass, EmbedderValue, Gc, MarkedVec, Object, Trace, Value, Vm,
};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::RetainedStyleValue;

use super::css_style_value::{AnyCSSStyleValue, CSSStyleValue};
use super::typed_om::{append_style_value, reify, to_rust_string};
use crate::bindings::conversions::{ToJs, UsvString};
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate, implementation_if, implementation_of};
use crate::bindings::iterable::{IterationKind, PairIterable};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::css::style_property_map::StylePropertyMap;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_style_map_property(name: usize, id: *mut u16, canonical_name: *mut usize) -> bool;
    fn web_css_style_map_iterations(
        is_computed: bool,
        source: *mut c_void,
        name: usize,
        values: *mut c_void,
        append: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const c_void),
    ) -> u8;
    fn web_css_style_map_has(is_computed: bool, source: *mut c_void, name: usize) -> bool;
    fn web_css_style_map_property_names(
        is_computed: bool,
        source: *mut c_void,
        names: *mut c_void,
        append: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, usize),
    );
    fn web_css_style_map_property_count(is_computed: bool, source: *mut c_void) -> usize;
}

/// The numeric value of SerializationMode::Normal of C++.
pub(super) const SERIALIZATION_MODE_NORMAL: u8 = 0;
/// The numeric value of SerializationMode::ResolvedValue of C++.
const SERIALIZATION_MODE_RESOLVED_VALUE: u8 = 1;

/// What web_css_style_map_iterations() found.
const ITERATIONS_ABSENT: u8 = 0;
const ITERATIONS_SHORTHAND: u8 = 2;

/// A valid CSS property, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#valid-css-property
pub(crate) struct Property {
    pub(crate) id: u16,
    pub(crate) name: Utf16String,
}

impl Property {
    /// The steps that every method of a style map starts with:
    /// 1. If property is not a custom property name string, set property to property ASCII lowercased.
    /// 2. If property is not a valid CSS property, throw a TypeError.
    pub(crate) fn from_name(name: &Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        let (mut id, mut canonical_name) = (0, 0);
        // SAFETY: This hands over a reference to the string, and the results are lent for the call.
        let is_valid =
            unsafe { web_css_style_map_property(name.clone().into_raw(), &raw mut id, &raw mut canonical_name) };
        if !is_valid {
            return Err(Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                "'{}' is not a valid CSS property",
                to_rust_string(name)
            ))));
        }
        Ok(Self {
            id,
            // SAFETY: C++ hands over a reference to a string.
            name: unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(canonical_name) },
        })
    }
}

/// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymapreadonly-declarations-slot
/// NB: We just directly refer to our source, at least for now.
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
enum Declarations {
    /// The Element whose computed style this reflects.
    ComputedStyle(CppCell),
    /// The CSSStyleDeclaration that this reflects.
    Declared(CppCell),
}

/// The value pairs of a style map when an iteration started.
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ValuePairs {
    pairs: Vec<(Value, Value)>,
}

static VALUE_PAIRS_CLASS: EmbedderClass<ValuePairs> = EmbedderClass::new("StylePropertyMapReadOnly value pairs");

impl EmbedderValue for ValuePairs {
    const CLASS: &'static EmbedderClass<Self> = &VALUE_PAIRS_CLASS;
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#stylepropertymapreadonly
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct StylePropertyMapReadOnly {
    declarations: Declarations,
}

impl Wrappable for StylePropertyMapReadOnly {}

impl Inherits<StylePropertyMapReadOnly> for StylePropertyMapReadOnly {
    fn parent(&self) -> &StylePropertyMapReadOnly {
        self
    }
}

impl PairIterable for StylePropertyMapReadOnly {
    type Key = Value;
    type Value = Value;
    type Target = Gc<EmbedderCell<ValuePairs>>;

    /// INTEROP: Snapshot the entry list when iteration starts, matching Chrome and Safari.
    fn iteration_target(cx: &CallContext, wrapper: Gc<Object>, kind: IterationKind) -> Self::Target {
        let pairs = if let Some(map) = implementation_if::<StylePropertyMap>(wrapper) {
            map.parent().value_pairs(cx, kind)
        } else {
            implementation_of::<Self>(wrapper).value_pairs(cx, kind)
        };
        VALUE_PAIRS_CLASS.allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| ValuePairs {
            pairs: pairs.to_pairs(defer_gc),
        })
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#stylepropertymapreadonly
    fn value_pairs_to_iterate_over(target: &Self::Target) -> impl core::ops::Deref<Target = [(Value, Value)]> + '_ {
        target.pairs.as_slice()
    }
}

/// The keys and values of value pairs, one after the other, which stay alive while more of them are created.
struct MarkedValuePairs<'vm>(MarkedVec<'vm, Value>);

impl MarkedValuePairs<'_> {
    fn to_pairs(&self, _: &DeferGc<'_>) -> Vec<(Value, Value)> {
        let values = self.0.to_vec();
        let (pairs, _) = values.as_chunks::<2>();
        pairs.iter().map(|&[key, value]| (key, value)).collect()
    }
}

impl StylePropertyMapReadOnly {
    pub(crate) fn new_declared(declaration: CppCell) -> Self {
        Self {
            declarations: Declarations::Declared(declaration),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_computed_style(vm: &Vm, element: CppCell) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            declarations: Declarations::ComputedStyle(element),
        })
    }

    /// The CSSStyleDeclaration of a map that reflects one.
    pub(crate) fn declaration(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        match &self.declarations {
            Declarations::Declared(declaration) => declaration.as_ptr(),
            Declarations::ComputedStyle(_) => {
                unreachable!("writable StylePropertyMaps are backed by a CSSStyleDeclaration")
            }
        }
    }

    fn source(&self) -> (bool, *mut c_void) {
        match &self.declarations {
            Declarations::ComputedStyle(element) => (true, element.as_ptr()),
            Declarations::Declared(declaration) => (false, declaration.as_ptr()),
        }
    }

    /// INTEROP: Computed border-image values represent all four sides or both axes, even when their serialization
    ///          collapses to a single numeric value or keyword.
    fn reify_property_value(
        vm: &Vm,
        value: &RetainedStyleValue,
        property: &Property,
        is_computed: bool,
    ) -> AnyCSSStyleValue {
        let name = to_rust_string(&property.name);
        let is_border_image_value = matches!(
            name.as_str(),
            "border-image-width" | "border-image-outset" | "border-image-slice" | "border-image-repeat"
        );
        if is_computed && is_border_image_value {
            return AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSStyleValue(CSSStyleValue::create(
                vm,
                property.name.clone(),
                value.clone(),
                SERIALIZATION_MODE_NORMAL,
            ));
        }
        reify(vm, value, &property.name)
    }

    /// The reified iterations of props[property], up to the limit. There are none if props[property] does not exist.
    fn reified_iterations<'vm>(
        &self,
        vm: &'vm Vm,
        property: &Property,
        limit: usize,
    ) -> MarkedVec<'vm, AnyCSSStyleValue> {
        let (is_computed, source) = self.source();
        let mut iterations: Vec<RetainedStyleValue> = Vec::new();
        // SAFETY: The source is live, this hands over a reference to the string, and the values are lent for the call.
        let kind = unsafe {
            web_css_style_map_iterations(
                is_computed,
                source,
                property.name.clone().into_raw(),
                (&raw mut iterations).cast(),
                append_style_value,
            )
        };

        let results = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        if kind == ITERATIONS_ABSENT {
            return results;
        }
        if kind == ITERATIONS_SHORTHAND {
            results.push(AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSStyleValue(CSSStyleValue::create(
                vm,
                property.name.clone(),
                iterations.remove(0),
                SERIALIZATION_MODE_RESOLVED_VALUE,
            )));
            return results;
        }
        for value in iterations.iter().take(limit) {
            results.push(Self::reify_property_value(vm, value, property, is_computed));
        }
        results
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymapreadonly-get
    pub(crate) fn get(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, property: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<Option<AnyCSSStyleValue>> {
        // The get(property) method, when called on a StylePropertyMapReadOnly this, must perform the following steps:

        // 1. If property is not a custom property name string, set property to property ASCII lowercased.
        // 2. If property is not a valid CSS property, throw a TypeError.
        let property = Property::from_name(&property.into_utf16_string())?;

        // 3. Let props be the value of this’s [[declarations]] internal slot.
        // 4. If props[property] exists, subdivide into iterations props[property], then reify the first item of the
        //    result and return it.
        // 5. Otherwise, return undefined.
        Ok(self.reified_iterations(cx.vm(), &property, 1).get(0))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymapreadonly-getall
    pub(crate) fn get_all<'vm>(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext<'vm>,
        property: UsvString,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<MarkedVec<'vm, AnyCSSStyleValue>> {
        // The getAll(property) method, when called on a StylePropertyMap this, must perform the following steps:

        // 1. If property is not a custom property name string, set property to property ASCII lowercased.
        // 2. If property is not a valid CSS property, throw a TypeError.
        let property = Property::from_name(&property.into_utf16_string())?;

        // 3. Let props be the value of this’s [[declarations]] internal slot.
        // 4. If props[property] exists, subdivide into iterations props[property], then reify each item of the result,
        //    and return the list.
        // 5. Otherwise, return an empty list.
        Ok(self.reified_iterations(cx.vm(), &property, usize::MAX))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymapreadonly-has
    pub(crate) fn has(&self, _: &mut CallContext, property: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The has(property) method, when called on a StylePropertyMapReadOnly this, must perform the following steps:

        // 1. If property is not a custom property name string, set property to property ASCII lowercased.
        // 2. If property is not a valid CSS property, throw a TypeError.
        let property = Property::from_name(&property.into_utf16_string())?;

        // 3. Let props be the value of this’s [[declarations]] internal slot.
        // 4. If props[property] exists, return true. Otherwise, return false.
        let (is_computed, source) = self.source();
        // SAFETY: The source is live, and this hands over a reference to the string.
        Ok(unsafe { web_css_style_map_has(is_computed, source, property.name.into_raw()) })
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymapreadonly-size
    pub(crate) fn size(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // The size attribute, on getting from a StylePropertyMapReadOnly this, must perform the following steps:

        // 1. Return the size of the value of this’s [[declarations]] internal slot.
        let (is_computed, source) = self.source();
        // SAFETY: The source is live.
        let size = unsafe { web_css_style_map_property_count(is_computed, source) };
        Ok(u32::try_from(size).expect("a map has fewer than 2^32 properties"))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymapreadonly-declarations-slot
    fn property_names(&self) -> Vec<Utf16String> {
        unsafe extern "C" fn append_name(names: *mut c_void, name: usize) {
            // SAFETY: The context is the vector below, and C++ hands over a reference to a string.
            unsafe { (*names.cast::<Vec<Utf16String>>()).push(Utf16String::from_raw_owned(name)) };
        }

        let (is_computed, source) = self.source();
        let mut names: Vec<Utf16String> = Vec::new();
        // SAFETY: The source is live, and the names are lent for the call.
        unsafe { web_css_style_map_property_names(is_computed, source, (&raw mut names).cast(), append_name) };

        // INTEROP: Inline and declared maps preserve declaration order.
        if is_computed {
            // Unless otherwise stated, the initial ordering of the [[declarations]] internal slot is based on the key
            // of each entry:
            // 1. Standardized properties (not custom properties or vendor-prefixed properties), ASCII lowercased and
            //    then sorted in increasing code-point order.
            // 2. Vendor-prefixed/experimental properties (those whose name starts with a single dash), ASCII lowercased
            //    and then sorted in increasing code-point order.
            // 3. Custom properties, sorted in increasing code-point order. (These are never lower-cased; they are
            //    preserved exactly as written.)
            names.sort_by_cached_key(|name| {
                let name = name.to_utf16();
                let category = match name.as_ref() {
                    [0x2d, 0x2d, ..] => 2,
                    [0x2d, ..] => 1,
                    _ => 0,
                };
                let code_points: Vec<u32> = char::decode_utf16(name.iter().copied())
                    .map(|unit| unit.map_or_else(|error| u32::from(error.unpaired_surrogate()), u32::from))
                    .collect();
                (category, code_points)
            });
        }
        names
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#stylepropertymapreadonly
    fn value_pairs<'vm>(&self, cx: &CallContext<'vm>, kind: IterationKind) -> MarkedValuePairs<'vm> {
        // The value pairs to iterate over for a StylePropertyMapReadOnly object this are obtained as follows:
        // 1. Let declarations be this’s [[declarations]] slot.
        // 2. Let value pairs be an empty list.
        let value_pairs = MarkedVec::new(cx.vm());

        // 3. For each prop → value in declarations:
        for name in self.property_names() {
            let key = name.clone().to_js(cx).expect("a string converts to a JS value");
            value_pairs.push(key);

            // NB: An iteration over the keys does not read the values.
            if matches!(kind, IterationKind::Key) {
                value_pairs.push(Value::UNDEFINED);
                continue;
            }

            // 1. Let iterations be the result of dividing into iterations value.
            // 2. Reify each item of iterations, and let objects be the result.
            let Ok(property) = Property::from_name(&name) else {
                unreachable!("the name of a declaration is a valid CSS property");
            };
            let objects = self.reified_iterations(cx.vm(), &property, usize::MAX);

            // 3. Append prop/objects to value pairs.
            let wrappers = MarkedVec::with_capacity(cx.vm(), objects.len());
            for object in objects.values().iter() {
                wrappers.push(object.to_js(cx).expect("an object converts to a JS value"));
            }
            let array = Array::create_from(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &wrappers.to_vec());
            value_pairs.push(Value::from_object(array.upcast::<Object>()));
        }

        // 4. Return value pairs.
        MarkedValuePairs(value_pairs)
    }
}

//! StylePropertyMap, https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#stylepropertymap

use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{MarkedVec, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::typed_om::{RetainedStyleValue, property_is_shorthand};

use super::css_style_value::AnyCSSStyleValue;
use super::style_property_map_read_only::{Property, SERIALIZATION_MODE_NORMAL, StylePropertyMapReadOnly};
use super::typed_om::{comma_separated_style_value_list, parse_values, to_rust_string};
use crate::bindings::conversions::UsvString;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::css::css_style_value::PerformTypeCheck;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_style_map_parse(declaration: *mut c_void, property_id: u16, css_text: usize) -> *const c_void;
    fn web_css_style_map_declared_value(declaration: *mut c_void, name: usize) -> *const c_void;
    fn web_css_style_map_set_value(
        declaration: *mut c_void,
        name: usize,
        value: *const c_void,
        message: *mut usize,
    ) -> u8;
    fn web_css_style_map_remove(declaration: *mut c_void, name: usize, message: *mut usize) -> u8;
    fn web_css_style_map_clear(declaration: *mut c_void, message: *mut usize) -> u8;
}

/// What a change to a declaration reported, as the ChangeResult of C++.
const CHANGE_RESULT_SUCCESS: u8 = 0;
const CHANGE_RESULT_TYPE_ERROR: u8 = 1;

/// Runs a change to a declaration, which writes a message if it fails.
fn change_declaration(change: impl FnOnce(*mut usize) -> u8) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    let mut message = 0;
    let result = change(&raw mut message);
    if result == CHANGE_RESULT_SUCCESS {
        return Ok(());
    }
    // SAFETY: C++ hands over a reference to a string when a change fails.
    let message = unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(message) };
    if result == CHANGE_RESULT_TYPE_ERROR {
        return Err(Exception::TypeError(message));
    }
    Err(Exception::Dom("NoModificationAllowedError", message))
}

/// The union (CSSStyleValue or USVString) of CSS/StylePropertyMap.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum CSSStyleValueOrUSVString {
    CSSStyleValue(AnyCSSStyleValue),
    USVString(#[gc(untraced)] UsvString),
}

fn any_have_non_matching_associated_property(property: &Utf16String, values: &[CSSStyleValueOrUSVString]) -> bool {
    values.iter().any(|value| {
        let CSSStyleValueOrUSVString::CSSStyleValue(value) = value else {
            return false;
        };
        value
            .style_value()
            .associated_property()
            .is_some_and(|associated_property| associated_property != property)
    })
}

/// The value of the text according to the grammar of the property, parsed for the declaration if one is given.
fn parse(declaration: *mut c_void, property_id: u16, css_text: Utf16String) -> Option<RetainedStyleValue> {
    // SAFETY: The declaration is live or null, and this hands over a reference to the string.
    let value = unsafe { web_css_style_map_parse(declaration, property_id, css_text.into_raw()) };
    // SAFETY: C++ hands over a strong reference, if it parsed the value.
    (!value.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { RetainedStyleValue::from_raw(value) })
}

fn is_custom_property(property: &Property) -> bool {
    libweb_rust::typed_om::is_a_custom_property_name_string(&property.name)
}

fn is_list_valued(property: &Property) -> bool {
    super::typed_om::property_is_list_valued(property.id)
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
fn create_an_internal_representation(
    vm: &Vm,
    property: &Property,
    value: &CSSStyleValueOrUSVString,
) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
    let property_name = to_rust_string(&property.name);

    // To create an internal representation, given a string property and a string or CSSStyleValue value:
    let internal_representation = match value {
        CSSStyleValueOrUSVString::CSSStyleValue(css_style_value) => {
            let internal_representation = css_style_value.create_an_internal_representation(
                vm,
                property.id,
                &property.name,
                PerformTypeCheck::Yes,
            )?;
            // INTEROP: Custom properties, including registered ones, only accept CSSUnparsedValue objects and
            //          CSS-wide keywords.
            if is_custom_property(property)
                && !matches!(css_style_value, AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSUnparsedValue(_))
                && !internal_representation.is_css_wide_keyword()
            {
                return Err(Exception::type_error(
                    "Custom properties only accept unparsed values and CSS-wide keywords",
                ));
            }
            internal_representation
        }
        CSSStyleValueOrUSVString::USVString(css_text) => {
            // If value is a USVString,
            //     Parse a CSSStyleValue with property property, cssText value, and parseMultiple set to false, and
            //     return the result.
            let values = parse_values(vm, property.name.clone(), css_text.clone().into_utf16_string())?;
            let result = values.get(0).expect("a parsed value has an iteration");
            // AD-HOC: Result is a CSSStyleValue but we want an internal representation, so... convert it again I guess?
            result.create_an_internal_representation(vm, property.id, &property.name, PerformTypeCheck::Yes)?
        }
    };

    if let CSSStyleValueOrUSVString::CSSStyleValue(css_style_value) = value
        && let Some(numeric_value) = css_style_value.as_numeric()
        && !is_custom_property(property)
    {
        // INTEROP: Shape image thresholds accept typed numbers but not typed percentages.
        if property_name == "shape-image-threshold" && !numeric_value.numeric_type().matches_number(None) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("Shape image thresholds require a number"));
        }

        // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
        // If value does not match the grammar of a list-valued property iteration of property, throw a TypeError.
        // NB: A property's component types do not establish that a numeric value alone matches its whole grammar.
        let serialized_value = internal_representation.serialize(SERIALIZATION_MODE_NORMAL);
        if parse(core::ptr::null_mut(), property.id, serialized_value).is_none() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "Numeric value does not match the property's grammar",
            ));
        }
    }

    // NB: Step easing keywords are custom identifiers outside the property parser. Store the parsed iteration so
    //     multi-value set() and append() use the easing representation expected by style computation.
    if internal_representation.is_custom_ident()
        && matches!(
            property_name.as_str(),
            "animation-timing-function" | "transition-timing-function"
        )
    {
        let serialized_value = internal_representation.serialize(SERIALIZATION_MODE_NORMAL);
        if let Some(items) = parse(core::ptr::null_mut(), property.id, serialized_value)
            .and_then(|parsed_value| parsed_value.value_list_items())
            && let [item] = items.as_slice()
        {
            return Ok(item.clone());
        }
    }

    // AD-HOC: Our parser represents a text-indent that is just a length-percentage as a text-indent value, and style
    //         computation expects that.
    if property_name == "text-indent" && internal_representation.is_length_percentage() {
        return Ok(internal_representation.into_text_indent());
    }

    Ok(internal_representation)
}

fn normalize_overflow_clip_margin_internal_representation(
    declaration: *mut c_void,
    property: &Property,
    value: RetainedStyleValue,
) -> WebIdlResult<RetainedStyleValue> {
    let property_name = to_rust_string(&property.name);
    if !matches!(
        property_name.as_str(),
        "overflow-clip-margin" | "overflow-clip-margin-block" | "overflow-clip-margin-inline"
    ) {
        return Ok(value);
    }

    if value.is_shorthand()
        || value.is_unresolved()
        || value.is_pending_substitution()
        || value.is_guaranteed_invalid()
        || value.is_css_wide_keyword()
    {
        return Ok(value);
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#create-an-internal-representation
    // If value is a CSSStyleValue subclass, if value does not match the grammar of a list-valued property
    // iteration of property, throw a TypeError.
    let serialized_value = value.serialize(SERIALIZATION_MODE_NORMAL);
    parse(declaration, property.id, serialized_value.clone()).ok_or_else(|| {
        Exception::type_error(&format!(
            "Property '{property_name}' does not accept the value '{}'",
            to_rust_string(&serialized_value)
        ))
    })
}

/// AD-HOC: To match the behavior of our parser we should store values of list-valued longhands as lists even if there
///         is only one value, except in some rare circumstances.
fn should_wrap_value_in_list(property: &Property, value: &RetainedStyleValue) -> bool {
    if property_is_shorthand(property.id) {
        return false;
    }

    if !is_list_valued(property) {
        return false;
    }

    // Values which are not yet fully resolved should not be wrapped in lists.
    !(value.is_unresolved()
        || value.is_pending_substitution()
        || value.is_guaranteed_invalid()
        || value.is_css_wide_keyword())
}

/// AD-HOC: A single keyword or identifier should be stored the way our parser stores it for the property. That is
///         either the keyword on its own, as for `box-shadow: none`, or a list with the identifier as its only item, as
///         for `container-name: foo`. So we parse it as a value of the property.
fn parsed_identifier_value(
    declaration: *mut c_void,
    property: &Property,
    value: &RetainedStyleValue,
) -> Option<RetainedStyleValue> {
    if is_custom_property(property) {
        return None;
    }
    if !value.is_custom_ident() && !(value.is_keyword() && !value.is_css_wide_keyword()) {
        return None;
    }
    parse(declaration, property.id, value.serialize(SERIALIZATION_MODE_NORMAL))
}

/// AD-HOC: Our parser represents the track sizes of grid-auto-columns and grid-auto-rows as a single track size list,
///         and style computation expects that.
fn grid_track_size_list(property: &Property, values: &[RetainedStyleValue]) -> Option<RetainedStyleValue> {
    let property_name = to_rust_string(&property.name);
    if !matches!(property_name.as_str(), "grid-auto-columns" | "grid-auto-rows") {
        return None;
    }
    let is_not_a_track_size = |value: &RetainedStyleValue| {
        value.is_grid_track_size_list()
            || value.is_unresolved()
            || value.is_pending_substitution()
            || value.is_guaranteed_invalid()
            || value.is_css_wide_keyword()
    };
    if values.iter().any(is_not_a_track_size) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(RetainedStyleValue::grid_track_size_list(values.to_vec()))
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#stylepropertymap
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct StylePropertyMap {
    read_only: StylePropertyMapReadOnly,
}

impl Wrappable for StylePropertyMap {}

impl Inherits<StylePropertyMapReadOnly> for StylePropertyMap {
    fn parent(&self) -> &StylePropertyMapReadOnly {
        &self.read_only
    }
}

impl StylePropertyMap {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, declaration: CppCell) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            read_only: StylePropertyMapReadOnly::new_declared(declaration),
        })
    }

    fn set_property_style_value(&self, property: &Property, value: RetainedStyleValue) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        change_declaration(|message| {
            // SAFETY: The declaration is live, and this hands over references to the string and the value.
            unsafe {
                web_css_style_map_set_value(
                    self.read_only.declaration(),
                    property.name.clone().into_raw(),
                    value.into_raw(),
                    message,
                )
            }
        })
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymap-set
    pub(crate) fn set(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        property: UsvString,
        values: MarkedVec<'_, CSSStyleValueOrUSVString>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The set(property, ...values) method, when called on a StylePropertyMap this, must perform the following
        // steps:

        // 1. If property is not a custom property name string, set property to property ASCII lowercased.
        // 2. If property is not a valid CSS property, throw a TypeError.
        let property_name = property.into_utf16_string();
        let property = Property::from_name(&property_name)?;
        let name = to_rust_string(&property_name);
        let values = values.values();

        // 3. If property is a single-valued property and values has more than one item, throw a TypeError.
        // NB: Custom properties should all be single-valued.
        if (is_custom_property(&property) || !is_list_valued(&property)) && values.len() > 1 {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(&format!(
                "Property '{name}' only accepts a single value"
            )));
        }

        // FIXME: The spec doesn't say how to handle empty `values`, but other browsers throw a TypeError so let's do
        //        that too - see https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1176
        if values.is_empty() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(&format!(
                "Property '{name}' requires at least one value"
            )));
        }

        // 4. If any of the items in values have a non-null [[associatedProperty]] internal slot, and that slot’s value
        //    is anything other than property, throw a TypeError.
        if any_have_non_matching_associated_property(&property.name, &values) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "One of the passed CSSStyleValues has a different associated property",
            ));
        }

        // 5. If the size of values is two or more, and one or more of the items are a CSSUnparsedValue or
        //    CSSVariableReferenceValue object, throw a TypeError.
        // NOTE: Having 2+ values implies that you’re setting multiple items of a list-valued property, but the presence
        //       of a var() function in the string-based OM disables all syntax parsing, including splitting into
        //       individual iterations (because there might be more commas inside of the var() value, so you can’t tell
        //       how many items are actually going to show up). This step’s restriction preserves the same semantics in
        //       the Typed OM.
        // FIXME: This is done as part of step 9, because we need to detect if a string value would be an
        //        CSSUnparsedValue or CSSVariableReferenceValue. Spec issue:
        //        https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1157

        // 6. Let props be the value of this’s [[declarations]] internal slot.
        let props = self.read_only.declaration();

        // 8. Let values to set be an empty list.
        let mut values_to_set = Vec::with_capacity(values.len());

        // 9. For each value in values, create an internal representation for property and value, and append the result
        //    to values to set.
        for value in values.iter() {
            // AD-HOC: Step 5 is done here, see above.
            let internal_representation = create_an_internal_representation(cx.vm(), &property, value)?;
            let internal_representation =
                normalize_overflow_clip_margin_internal_representation(props, &property, internal_representation)?;

            if values.len() >= 2 && internal_representation.is_unresolved() {
                return Err(Exception::type_error(
                    "Cannot provide multiple values if one is an CSSUnparsedValue or CSSVariableReferenceValue",
                ));
            }

            values_to_set.push(internal_representation);
        }

        // 7. If props[property] exists, remove it.
        // NB: Removal and replacement happen together in set_property_style_value(), after validation, so observers
        //     receive a single style-attribute update.

        // 10. Set props[property] to values to set.
        // NOTE: The property is deleted then added back so that it gets put at the end of the ordered map, which gives
        //       the expected behavior in the face of shorthand properties.
        if let [value] = values_to_set.as_slice()
            && let Some(parsed_value) = parsed_identifier_value(props, &property, value)
        {
            return self.set_property_style_value(&property, parsed_value);
        }
        if let Some(track_size_list) = grid_track_size_list(&property, &values_to_set) {
            return self.set_property_style_value(&property, track_size_list);
        }
        if let [value] = values_to_set.as_slice()
            && !should_wrap_value_in_list(&property, value)
        {
            return self.set_property_style_value(&property, value.clone());
        }
        self.set_property_style_value(&property, comma_separated_style_value_list(values_to_set))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymap-append
    pub(crate) fn append(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        property: UsvString,
        values: MarkedVec<'_, CSSStyleValueOrUSVString>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The append(property, ...values) method, when called on a StylePropertyMap this, must perform the following
        // steps:

        // 1. If property is not a custom property name string, set property to property ASCII lowercased.
        // 2. If property is not a valid CSS property, throw a TypeError.
        let property_name = property.into_utf16_string();
        let property = Property::from_name(&property_name)?;
        let name = to_rust_string(&property_name);
        let values = values.values();

        // 3. If property is not a list-valued property, throw a TypeError.
        if !is_list_valued(&property) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(&format!(
                "'{name}' is not a list-valued property"
            )));
        }

        // 4. If any of the items in values have a non-null [[associatedProperty]] internal slot, and that slot’s value
        //    is anything other than property, throw a TypeError.
        if any_have_non_matching_associated_property(&property.name, &values) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "One of the passed CSSStyleValues has a different associated property",
            ));
        }

        // 5. If any of the items in values are a CSSUnparsedValue or CSSVariableReferenceValue object, throw a
        //    TypeError.
        // NOTE: When a property is set via string-based APIs, the presence of var() in a property prevents the entire
        //       thing from being interpreted. In other words, everything besides the var() is a plain component value,
        //       not a meaningful type. This step’s restriction preserves the same semantics in the Typed OM.
        // FIXME: This is done as part of step 10, because we need to detect if a string value would be an
        //        CSSUnparsedValue or CSSVariableReferenceValue. Spec issue:
        //        https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1157

        // 6. Let props be the value of this’s [[declarations]] internal slot.
        let props = self.read_only.declaration();

        // 7. If props[property] does not exist, set props[property] to an empty list.
        // SAFETY: The declaration is live, and this hands over a reference to the string.
        let existing_value = unsafe { web_css_style_map_declared_value(props, property.name.clone().into_raw()) };
        // SAFETY: C++ hands over a strong reference, if the property has a value.
        let existing_value =
            (!existing_value.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { RetainedStyleValue::from_raw(existing_value) });

        // 8. If props[property] contains a var() reference, throw a TypeError.
        if existing_value.as_ref().is_some_and(RetainedStyleValue::is_unresolved) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(&format!(
                "Existing value for '{name}' contains var() references."
            )));
        }

        // NB: Appending no values must not replace the declaration or update the style attribute.
        if values.is_empty() {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 9. Let temp values be an empty list.
        // NB: StyleValues are immutable, so we always create a new one. We add directly to it instead of using "temp
        //     values".
        let mut value_list = Vec::new();
        if let Some(existing_value) = existing_value {
            match existing_value.value_list_items() {
                Some(items) => value_list = items,
                None => value_list.push(existing_value),
            }
        }

        // 10. For each value in values, create an internal representation with property and value, and append the
        //     returned value to temp values.
        for value in values.iter() {
            // AD-HOC: Step 5 is done here, see above.
            let internal_representation = create_an_internal_representation(cx.vm(), &property, value)?;

            if internal_representation.is_unresolved() {
                return Err(Exception::type_error(
                    "Cannot append a CSSUnparsedValue or CSSVariableReferenceValue",
                ));
            }

            value_list.push(internal_representation);
        }

        // 11. Append the entries of temp values to props[property].
        // NB: StyleValues are immutable, so we create a new one instead.
        self.set_property_style_value(&property, comma_separated_style_value_list(value_list))
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymap-delete
    pub(crate) fn delete(&self, _: &mut CallContext, property: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The delete(property) method, when called on a StylePropertyMap this, must perform the following steps:

        // 1. If property is not a custom property name string, set property to property ASCII lowercased.
        // 2. If property is not a valid CSS property, throw a TypeError.
        let property = Property::from_name(&property.into_utf16_string())?;

        // 3. If this’s [[declarations]] internal slot contains property, remove it.
        change_declaration(|message| {
            // SAFETY: The declaration is live, and this hands over a reference to the string.
            unsafe { web_css_style_map_remove(self.read_only.declaration(), property.name.into_raw(), message) }
        })
    }

    // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#dom-stylepropertymap-clear
    pub(crate) fn clear(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The clear() method, when called on a StylePropertyMap this, must perform the following steps:

        // 1. Remove all of the declarations in this’s [[declarations]] internal slot.
        change_declaration(|message| {
            // SAFETY: The declaration is live.
            unsafe { web_css_style_map_clear(self.read_only.declaration(), message) }
        })
    }
}

//! StyleSheetList, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-stylesheetlist-interface

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_style_sheet_list_length(scope: *mut c_void) -> u32;
    fn web_css_style_sheet_list_item(scope: *mut c_void, index: u32) -> *mut c_void;
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct StyleSheetList {
    /// The Web::CSS::StyleScope whose sheets the list represents, which belongs to the node.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    scope: *mut c_void,
    /// The cell of the Document or ShadowRoot.
    node: CppCell,
}

impl Wrappable for StyleSheetList {}

impl StyleSheetList {
    pub(crate) fn new(scope: *mut c_void, node: CppCell) -> Self {
        Self { scope, node }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheetlist-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // SAFETY: The node keeps its scope alive.
        Ok(unsafe { web_css_style_sheet_list_length(self.scope) })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheetlist-item
    pub(crate) fn item(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<CSSStyleSheet>>> {
        // SAFETY: The node keeps its scope alive.
        let sheet = unsafe { web_css_style_sheet_list_item(self.scope, index) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live cell of a CSSStyleSheet, or null.
        Ok((!sheet.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { cell_from_abi(sheet) }))
    }

//! StyleSheet, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-stylesheet-interface

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::Trace;
use libweb_rust::NativeStyleSheetFlag;

use super::css_rule::wrap_cpp_cell;
use super::css_style_sheet::CSSStyleSheet;
use super::media_list::MediaList;
use crate::bindings::conversions::{CppInterface, UsvString};
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, cell_from_abi};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_sheet_state_external_memory_size(state: *mut c_void) -> usize;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_flag(state: *mut c_void, flag: u8) -> bool;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_set_disabled(state: *mut c_void, disabled: bool);
    fn web_css_sheet_state_location(state: *mut c_void, location: *mut usize) -> bool;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_title(state: *mut c_void) -> usize;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_owner_node(state: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_parent_style_sheet(state: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_css_sheet_state_media(state: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct StyleSheet {
    /// The cell that holds the Web::CSS::StyleSheetState, which attaches the sheet to its documents and loads it.
    state: CppCell,
}

impl Wrappable for StyleSheet {}

impl StyleSheet {
    pub(crate) fn new(state: CppCell) -> Self {
        Self { state }
    }

    pub(crate) fn state(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.state.as_ptr()
    }

    pub(crate) fn state_cell(&self) -> &CppCell {
        &self.state
    }

    pub(crate) fn state_external_memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_external_memory_size(self.state()) }
    }

    pub(crate) fn flag(&self, flag: NativeStyleSheetFlag) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_flag(self.state(), flag as u8) }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheet-type
    pub(crate) fn r#type(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The type attribute must return the type.
        Ok(Utf16String::from_ascii(b"text/css"))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheet-href
    pub(crate) fn href(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<UsvString>> {
        // The href attribute must return the location.
        let mut location = 0;
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and the out pointer is valid.
        if !unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_location(self.state(), &raw mut location) } {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        // SAFETY: LibWeb hands over the string.
        let location = unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(location) };
        Ok(Some(UsvString::from_utf16_replacing_lone_surrogates(
            &location.to_utf16(),
        )))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheet-ownernode
    pub(crate) fn owner_node(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<CppInterface>> {
        // The ownerNode attribute must return the owner node.
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let Some(node) = NonNull::new(unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_owner_node(self.state()) }) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns a live cell.
        let node = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(node.as_ptr()) };
        Ok(Some(wrap_cpp_cell(cx, &node)))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheet-parentstylesheet
    pub(crate) fn parent_style_sheet(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<CSSStyleSheet>>> {
        // The parentStyleSheet attribute must return the parent CSS style sheet.
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        let sheet = unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_parent_style_sheet(self.state()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live cell of a CSSStyleSheet, or null.
        Ok((!sheet.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { cell_from_abi(sheet) }))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheet-title
    pub(crate) fn title(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        // The title attribute must return the title or null if title is the empty string.
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and LibWeb hands over the string.
        let title = unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(web_css_sheet_state_title(self.state())) };
        Ok((!title.is_empty()).then_some(title))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheet-media
    pub(crate) fn media(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<MediaList>> {
        // The media attribute must return the media.
        // SAFETY: The cell is live, and LibWeb returns the live cell of a MediaList.
        Ok(unsafe { cell_from_abi(web_css_sheet_state_media(self.state())) })
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheet-disabled
    pub(crate) fn disabled(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The disabled attribute, on getting, must return true if the disabled flag is set, or false otherwise.
        Ok(self.flag(NativeStyleSheetFlag::Disabled))
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-stylesheet-disabled
    pub(crate) fn set_disabled(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: bool) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // On setting, the disabled attribute must set the disabled flag if the new value is true, or unset the disabled
        // flag otherwise.
        // SAFETY: The cell is live.
        unsafe { web_css_sheet_state_set_disabled(self.state(), value) };
        Ok(())
    }
}

//! TransitionEvent, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transitions-2/#interface-transitionevent-idl

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use super::animation_event::EventAnimation;
use super::css_transition::CSSTransition;
use crate::animations::animation::AnyAnimation;
use crate::bindings::event_target::CppEvent;
use crate::bindings::interface::Inherits;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::event::EventInit;

/// The dictionary TransitionEventInit of CSS/TransitionEvent.idl.
pub(crate) struct TransitionEventInit {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) animation: Option<Ref<CSSTransition>>,
    pub(crate) elapsed_time: f64,
    pub(crate) property_name: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) pseudo_element: Utf16String,
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transitions-2/#interface-transitionevent-idl
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct TransitionEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    property_name: Utf16String,
    elapsed_time: f64,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pseudo_element: Utf16String,
    animation: Option<EventAnimation>,
}

impl Wrappable for TransitionEvent {
    const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(object: Ref<Self>) {
        if let Some(animation) = &object.animation {
            animation.release();
        }
    }
}

impl TransitionEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: TransitionEventInit,
    ) -> Ref<TransitionEvent> {
        let animation = event_init
            .animation
            .as_ref()
            .map(|animation| EventAnimation::of_object(animation.parent()));
        Self::create_for_animation(vm, realm, event_name, event_init, animation)
    }

    /// A new event that names `animation` in place of the animation of `event_init`.
    pub(crate) fn create_for_animation(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: TransitionEventInit,
        animation: Option<EventAnimation>,
    ) -> Ref<TransitionEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.parent.bubbles,
            event_init.parent.cancelable,
            event_init.parent.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| TransitionEvent {
            event,
            property_name: event_init.property_name,
            elapsed_time: event_init.elapsed_time,
            pseudo_element: event_init.pseudo_element,
            animation,
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        transition_event_init_dict: TransitionEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<TransitionEvent>> {
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &r#type, transition_event_init_dict))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    pub(crate) fn property_name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.property_name.clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn elapsed_time(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.elapsed_time)
    }

    pub(crate) fn pseudo_element(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.pseudo_element.clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn animation(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<AnyAnimation>> {
        Ok(self.animation.as_ref().map(|animation| animation.wrap(cx)))
    }
}

//! What the interfaces of the CSS Typed OM share: reification, and how values reach the property tables and the parser.
//! https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/

use core::ffi::c_void;

};

use super::css_transform_component::{AnyCSSTransformComponent, reify_a_transform_function};
use super::css_transform_value::CSSTransformValue;

/// The string as a Rust string, for what is ASCII or only goes into a message.
pub(crate) fn to_rust_string(string: &Utf16String) -> String {
    String::from_utf16_lossy(&string.to_utf16())
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_style_map_property_is_list_valued(property_id: u16) -> bool;
}

pub(crate) fn property_is_list_valued(property_id: u16) -> bool {
    // SAFETY: The call has no preconditions.
    unsafe { web_css_style_map_property_is_list_valued(property_id) }
}

/// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#subdivide-into-iterations
fn subdivide_into_iterations(value: RetainedStyleValue, property_id: u16) -> Vec<RetainedStyleValue> {
    // 1. If property is a single-valued property, return a list containing whole value.
    // 2. Otherwise, divide whole value into individual iterations, as appropriate for property, and return a list
    //    containing the iterations in order.
    if property_is_list_valued(property_id)
        && let Some(iterations) = value.value_list_items()
    {
        return iterations;
    }
    vec![value]
}

pub(crate) fn property_accepts_transform_function(property_id: u16) -> bool {
    property_accepts_type(property_id, TypedOmValueType::TransformFunction)
}

pub(crate) fn property_accepts_transform_list(property_id: u16) -> bool {
    property_accepts_type(property_id, TypedOmValueType::TransformList)
}

/// The value of the property for a CSSUnitValue, which is wrapped in a calculation if the property does not accept it
/// on its own, if the property takes values of its type.
pub(crate) fn numeric_style_value_for_property(
    property_id: u16,
    value: NumericValue,
    numeric_type: NumericType,
) -> Option<RetainedStyleValue> {
    let calculation = Arc::new(CalcNode::Sum(vec![value.calculation_node()]));
    typed_om::numeric_style_value(property_id, value.style_value(), calculation, numeric_type)
}

/// The calculated value of the property for a CSSMathValue, if the property takes values of its type.
pub(crate) fn calculated_style_value(
    property_id: u16,
    calculation: Arc<CalcNode>,
    numeric_type: NumericType,
    perform_type_check: PerformTypeCheck,
) -> Option<RetainedStyleValue> {
    typed_om::calculated_style_value(
        property_id,
        calculation,
        numeric_type,
        perform_type_check == PerformTypeCheck::Yes,
    )
}

/// The value of the property for a CSSKeywordValue, if the keyword matches the grammar of the property.
pub(crate) fn keyword_style_value_for_property(
    property_id: u16,
    value: &Utf16String,
    perform_type_check: PerformTypeCheck,
) -> Option<RetainedStyleValue> {
    typed_om::keyword_style_value(
        property_id,
        value,
        perform_type_check == PerformTypeCheck::Yes,
        property_is_list_valued(property_id),
    )
}

pub(crate) fn style_value_list(values: Vec<RetainedStyleValue>) -> RetainedStyleValue {
    typed_om::style_value_list(values, false)
}

pub(crate) fn comma_separated_style_value_list(values: Vec<RetainedStyleValue>) -> RetainedStyleValue {
    typed_om::style_value_list(values, true)
}

pub(crate) unsafe extern "C" fn append_style_value(values: *mut c_void, value: *const c_void) {
    // SAFETY: The context is the Vec of parse_a_css_style_value(), and C++ hands over a strong reference.
    unsafe { (*values.cast::<Vec<RetainedStyleValue>>()).push(RetainedStyleValue::from_raw(value)) };
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#parse-a-cssstylevalue
pub(crate) fn parse_values(
    vm: &Vm,
    property: Utf16String,
    css_text: Utf16String,
) -> WebIdlResult<MarkedVec<'_, AnyCSSStyleValue>> {
    // 1. If property is not a custom property name string, set property to property ASCII lowercased.
    // 2. If property is not a valid CSS property, throw a TypeError.
    let Some((name, property_id)) = typed_om::property_from_name(&property) else {
        return Err(Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
            "'{}' is not a valid CSS property",
            to_rust_string(&property)
        ))));
    };

    // 3. Attempt to parse cssText according to property’s grammar.
    //    If this fails, throw a TypeError.
    //    Otherwise, let whole value be the parsed result.
    let Some(whole_value) = typed_om::parse_value_for_property(property_id, &css_text) else {
        return Err(Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
            "Failed to parse '{}' as a value for '{}' property",
            to_rust_string(&css_text),
            to_rust_string(&property)
        ))));
    };

    // 4. Subdivide into iterations whole value, according to property, and let values be the result.
    let values = subdivide_into_iterations(whole_value, property_id);

    // 5. For each value in values, replace it with the result of reifying value for property.
    let reified_values = MarkedVec::new(vm);
    for value in &values {
        reified_values.push(reify(vm, value, &name));
    }

    // 6. If parseMultiple is false, return values[0]. Otherwise, return values.
    // FIXME: We need to somehow store the source css_text on the returned CSSStyleValue.
    //        https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1156
    Ok(reified_values)
}

pub(crate) fn parse_a_css_style_value<'vm>(
    cx: &mut CallContext<'vm>,
    property: UsvString,
    css_text: UsvString,
) -> WebIdlResult<MarkedVec<'vm, AnyCSSStyleValue>> {
    parse_values(cx.vm(), property.into_utf16_string(), css_text.into_utf16_string())
}

fn unit_value(vm: &Vm, value: f64, unit: &str) -> AnyCSSStyleValue {
    AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(vm, value, unit)).into()
}

fn default_reification(vm: &Vm, value: &RetainedStyleValue, property: &Utf16String) -> AnyCSSStyleValue {
    // 1. Return a new CSSStyleValue object representing value whose [[associatedProperty]] internal slot is set to
    //    property.
    AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSStyleValue(CSSStyleValue::create(vm, property.clone(), value.clone(), 0))
}

/// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#reify-stylevalue
pub(crate) fn reify(vm: &Vm, value: &RetainedStyleValue, property: &Utf16String) -> AnyCSSStyleValue {
    match reification_of(value) {
        Reification::Default => default_reification(vm, value, property),
        // AD-HOC: There's no spec description of how to reify as a CSSImageValue.
        Reification::Image => AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSImageValue(CSSImageValue::create(vm, value.clone())),
        // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#reify-ident
        Reification::Keyword(keyword) => AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSKeywordValue(CSSKeywordValue::create(vm, keyword)),
        // https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#reify-a-numeric-value
        // NB: Steps 1 and 2 don't apply here.
        // 3. Return a new CSSUnitValue with its value internal slot set to the numeric value of num, and its unit
        //    internal slot set to "number" if num is a <number>, "percent" if num is a <percentage>, and num’s unit if
        //    num is a <dimension>.
        //    If the value being reified is a computed value, the unit used must be the appropriate canonical unit for
        //    the value’s type, with the numeric value scaled accordingly.
        // FIXME: Reify computed value correctly. That sounds like it should work by computing the value properly before
        //        we reach this point.
        Reification::Unit { value, unit } => unit_value(vm, value, &unit),
        // NB: Step 1 doesn't apply here.
        // 2. If num is the unitless value 0 and num is a <dimension>, return a new CSSUnitValue with its value internal
        //    slot set to 0, and its unit internal slot set to "px".
        Reification::Number { value, is_integer } => {
            // NB: Determine whether the associated property expects 0 to be a <length>.
            // FIXME: Do this for registered custom properties.
            if value == 0.0 && typed_om::zero_is_a_length(property, is_integer) {
                return unit_value(vm, 0.0, "px");
            }
            unit_value(vm, value, "number")
        }
        Reification::Value(inner_value) => reify(vm, &inner_value, property),
        // NB: This spec algorithm is incomplete and assumes we do not already have a calculation tree.
        Reification::Calculated => reify_a_math_expression(vm, value)
            .map(AnyCSSStyleValue::from)
            // Some math functions are not reifiable yet. If we contain one, we have to fall back to CSSStyleValue.
            // https://github.com/w3c/css-houdini-drafts/issues/1090
            .unwrap_or_else(|| default_reification(vm, value, property)),
        Reification::Unresolved(segments) => {
            AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSUnparsedValue(reify_a_list_of_component_values(vm, &segments))
        }
        Reification::List(values) => {
            // NB: <transform-list> is a StyleValueList that contains TransformStyleValues. If that's what we are,
            //     follow the steps for reifying that.
            if !values.is_empty()
                && values.iter().all(RetainedStyleValue::is_transformation)
                && let Some(transform_list) = reify_a_transform_list(vm, &values)
            {
                return AnyCSSStyleValue::CSSTransformValue(transform_list);
            }

            // NB: A list with a single item, such as `text-decoration-line: underline`, is that item on its own. Reify
            //     the item, so that a single keyword reifies as a CSSKeywordValue.
            if let [item] = values.as_slice() {
                return reify(vm, item, property);
            }

            // NB: Otherwise, there isn't an equivalent CSSStyleValue for StyleValueList, so just use the default.
            default_reification(vm, value, property)
        }
    }
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#reify-a-transform-list
fn reify_a_transform_list(vm: &Vm, values: &[RetainedStyleValue]) -> Option<Ref<CSSTransformValue>> {
    let transform_components: MarkedVec<'_, AnyCSSTransformComponent> = MarkedVec::new(vm);
    for transform in values {
        // NB: Not all transform functions are reifiable, in which case we give up reifying as a transform list.
        transform_components.push(reify_a_transform_function(vm, transform)?);
    }
    Some(CSSTransformValue::create(vm, &transform_components))
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#reify-a-list-of-component-values
fn reify_a_list_of_component_values(vm: &Vm, segments: &[ReifiedUnresolvedSegment]) -> Ref<CSSUnparsedValue> {
    let members = MarkedVec::new(vm);
    for segment in segments {
        members.push(match segment {
            ReifiedUnresolvedSegment::Text(text) => {
                CSSUnparsedSegment::USVString(UsvString::from_utf16_replacing_lone_surrogates(text))
            }
            ReifiedUnresolvedSegment::Variable { name, fallback } => {
                let fallback = fallback
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|fallback| reify_a_list_of_component_values(vm, fallback));
                CSSUnparsedSegment::CSSVariableReferenceValue(CSSVariableReferenceValue::create(
                    vm,
                    Utf16String::from_utf16(name),
                    fallback,
                ))
            }
        });
    }
    CSSUnparsedValue::create(vm, &members)
}

fn unit_name_of(node: &CalcReificationNode) -> &'static str {
    match node.numeric_kind {
        0 => "number",
        1 => DimensionType::Angle.unit_name(node.unit),
        2 => DimensionType::Flex.unit_name(node.unit),
        3 => DimensionType::Frequency.unit_name(node.unit),
        4 => DimensionType::Length.unit_name(node.unit),
        5 => "percent",
        6 => DimensionType::Resolution.unit_name(node.unit),
        7 => DimensionType::Time.unit_name(node.unit),
        kind => unreachable!("invalid numeric kind {kind}"),
    }
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#reify-a-math-expression
pub(crate) fn reify_a_math_expression(vm: &Vm, calculated: &RetainedStyleValue) -> Option<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
    let (nodes, child_indices) = calculation_nodes(calculated)?;
    let reified_nodes: MarkedVec<'_, AnyCSSNumericValue> = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, nodes.len());
    for node in &nodes {
        let numeric_type = node.numeric_type.to_calc();
        let children = &child_indices[node.child_start..node.child_start + node.child_count];
        let child = |index: usize| {
            reified_nodes
                .get(children[index])
                .expect("a child comes before its parent")
        };

        // NB: The reified objects get the types that their constructors would give them, computed from their reified
        //     children. The internal calculation's type may differ, for example by carrying a percent hint from the
        //     property that it belongs to.
        let combined_type_of_children = |combine: fn(&NumericType, &NumericType) -> Option<NumericType>| {
            let mut result: Option<NumericType> = None;
            for index in 0..children.len() {
                let child_type = child(index).numeric_type();
                match result {
                    Some(numeric_type_so_far) => match combine(&numeric_type_so_far, &child_type) {
                        Some(combined) => result = Some(combined),
                        None => return numeric_type,
                    },
                    None => result = Some(child_type),
                }
            }
            result.unwrap_or(numeric_type)
        };
        let added_types_of_children = || combined_type_of_children(NumericType::added_to);
        let multiplied_types_of_children = || combined_type_of_children(NumericType::multiplied_by);
        let reify_children = || {
            let values = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, children.len());
            for index in 0..children.len() {
                values.push(child(index));
            }
            CSSNumericArray::create(vm, &values)
        };

        reified_nodes.push(match node.kind {
            0 => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSUnitValue(CSSUnitValue::create(vm, node.value, unit_name_of(node))),
            2 => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathSum(CSSMathSum::create(vm, added_types_of_children(), reify_children())),
            3 => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathProduct(CSSMathProduct::create(
                vm,
                multiplied_types_of_children(),
                reify_children(),
            )),
            4 => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathNegate(CSSMathNegate::create(vm, child(0))),
            5 => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathInvert(CSSMathInvert::create(vm, child(0))),
            6 => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMin(CSSMathMin::create(vm, added_types_of_children(), reify_children())),
            7 => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathMax(CSSMathMax::create(vm, added_types_of_children(), reify_children())),
            8 => AnyCSSNumericValue::CSSMathClamp(CSSMathClamp::create(
                vm,
                added_types_of_children(),
                child(0),
                child(1),
                child(2),
            )),
            kind => unreachable!("invalid reification node kind {kind}"),
        });
    }
    reified_nodes.pop()
}

// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-typed-om-1/#reify-a-numeric-value
pub(crate) fn reify_a_numeric_value(vm: &Vm, numeric_value: &RetainedStyleValue) -> Option<AnyCSSNumericValue> {
    reify(vm, numeric_value, &Utf16String::default()).as_numeric()
}
