//! VisualViewport, https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#visualviewport

use core::cell::Cell;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use libcompositing_rust::css_pixels::{CssPixelPoint, CssPixelRect, CssPixels, FfiCssPixelRect};
use libgfx_rust::geometry::{FloatPoint, FloatRect};
use libgfx_rust::matrix::AffineTransform;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_css_visual_viewport_document_is_fully_active(document: *mut c_void) -> bool;
    fn web_css_visual_viewport_document_viewport_rect(document: *mut c_void) -> FfiCssPixelRect;
    fn web_css_visual_viewport_append_pending_scroll_event(
        document: *mut c_void,
        event_target: *mut c_void,
        r#type: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    );
    fn web_css_visual_viewport_did_change_offset_or_scale(document: *mut c_void);
}

const SCROLL: &str = "scroll";
const SCROLLEND: &str = "scrollend";

const MIN_ALLOWED_SCALE: f64 = 1.0;
const MAX_ALLOWED_SCALE: f64 = 5.0;

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#visualviewport
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct VisualViewport {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    document: CppCell,

    #[gc(untraced)]
    offset: Cell<CssPixelPoint>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    scale: Cell<f64>,
    scale_is_new_to_compositor: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Wrappable for VisualViewport {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        Some(self.realm)
    }

    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for VisualViewport {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl VisualViewport {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>, document: CppCell) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| VisualViewport {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            realm,
            document,
            offset: Cell::new(CssPixelPoint::default()),
            scale: Cell::new(1.0),
            scale_is_new_to_compositor: Cell::new(false),
        });
        object.event_target.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn event_target(&self) -> &CppEventTarget {
        &self.event_target
    }

    pub(crate) fn offset(&self) -> CssPixelPoint {
        self.offset.get()
    }

    fn document_is_fully_active(&self) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The document is live.
        unsafe { web_css_visual_viewport_document_is_fully_active(self.document.as_ptr()) }
    }

    fn viewport_rect(&self) -> CssPixelRect {
        // SAFETY: The document is live.
        let rect = unsafe { web_css_visual_viewport_document_viewport_rect(self.document.as_ptr()) };
        CssPixelRect::new(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height)
    }

    fn append_pending_scroll_event(&self, event_type: &str) {
        // SAFETY: The document and the EventTarget are live, and the type is lent for the call.
        unsafe {
            web_css_visual_viewport_append_pending_scroll_event(
                self.document.as_ptr(),
                self.event_target.as_ptr(),
                ak::Span::new(event_type.as_bytes()),
            );
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-visualviewport-offsetleft
    pub(crate) fn offset_left_value(&self) -> f64 {
        // 1. If the visual viewport’s associated document is not fully active, return 0.
        if !self.document_is_fully_active() {
            return 0.0;
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, return the offset of the left edge of the visual viewport from the left edge of the layout
        //    viewport.
        self.offset.get().x.to_double()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-visualviewport-offsettop
    pub(crate) fn offset_top_value(&self) -> f64 {
        // 1. If the visual viewport’s associated document is not fully active, return 0.
        if !self.document_is_fully_active() {
            return 0.0;
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, return the offset of the top edge of the visual viewport from the top edge of the layout
        //    viewport.
        self.offset.get().y.to_double()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-visualviewport-pageleft
    pub(crate) fn page_left_value(&self) -> f64 {
        // 1. If the visual viewport’s associated document is not fully active, return 0.
        if !self.document_is_fully_active() {
            return 0.0;
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, return the offset of the left edge of the visual viewport from the
        //    left edge of the initial containing block of the layout viewport’s document.
        self.viewport_rect().x.to_double() + self.offset_left_value()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-visualviewport-pagetop
    pub(crate) fn page_top_value(&self) -> f64 {
        // 1. If the visual viewport’s associated document is not fully active, return 0.
        if !self.document_is_fully_active() {
            return 0.0;
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, return the offset of the top edge of the visual viewport from the
        //    top edge of the initial containing block of the layout viewport’s document.
        self.viewport_rect().y.to_double() + self.offset_top_value()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-visualviewport-width
    pub(crate) fn width_value(&self) -> f64 {
        // 1. If the visual viewport’s associated document is not fully active, return 0.
        if !self.document_is_fully_active() {
            return 0.0;
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, return the width of the visual viewport
        //    FIXME: excluding the width of any rendered vertical classic scrollbar that is fixed to the visual viewport.
        self.viewport_rect().width.to_double() / self.scale.get()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-visualviewport-height
    pub(crate) fn height_value(&self) -> f64 {
        // 1. If the visual viewport’s associated document is not fully active, return 0.
        if !self.document_is_fully_active() {
            return 0.0;
        }

        // 2. Otherwise, return the height of the visual viewport
        //    FIXME: excluding the height of any rendered vertical classic scrollbar that is fixed to the visual viewport.
        self.viewport_rect().height.to_double() / self.scale.get()
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-visualviewport-scale
    pub(crate) fn scale_value(&self) -> f64 {
        self.scale.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn offset_left(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.offset_left_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn offset_top(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.offset_top_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn page_left(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.page_left_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn page_top(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.page_top_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn width(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.width_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn height(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.height_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn scale(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.scale_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn scroll_by(&self, delta: CssPixelPoint) {
        if delta.x == CssPixels::default() && delta.y == CssPixels::default() {
            return;
        }
        let offset = self.offset.get();
        self.offset
            .set(CssPixelPoint::new(offset.x + delta.x, offset.y + delta.y));
        self.did_scroll();
        self.did_change_offset_or_scale();
    }

    // The compositor zooms and pans the visual viewport too, and hears of every change made to it here.
    fn did_change_offset_or_scale(&self) {
        // SAFETY: The document is live.
        unsafe { web_css_visual_viewport_did_change_offset_or_scale(self.document.as_ptr()) }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#scrolling-events
    fn did_scroll(&self) {
        // Whenever a visual viewport gets scrolled (whether in response to user interaction or by an API), the user
        // agent must run these steps:

        // 1. Let vv be the VisualViewport object that was scrolled.
        // 2. Let doc be vv's associated document.
        // 3. If (vv, "scroll") is already in doc's pending scroll events, abort these steps.
        // 4. Append (vv, "scroll") to doc's pending scroll events.
        self.append_pending_scroll_event(SCROLL);
    }

    fn transform(&self) -> AffineTransform {
        let offset = self.offset.get();
        let scale = self.scale.get();
        AffineTransform::identity()
            .translated(
                (-offset.x.to_double() * scale) as f32,
                (-offset.y.to_double() * scale) as f32,
            )
            .scaled(scale as f32, scale as f32)
    }

    pub(crate) fn zoom(&self, position: CssPixelPoint, scale_delta: f64) {
        let scale = self.scale.get();
        let new_scale = (scale * (1.0 + scale_delta)).clamp(MIN_ALLOWED_SCALE, MAX_ALLOWED_SCALE);
        let applied_delta = new_scale / scale;

        // For pinch zoom we want focal_point to stay put on screen:
        // scale_new * (focal_point - offset_new) = scale_old * (focal_point - offset_old)
        let old_offset = self.offset.get();
        let new_offset_along = |offset: CssPixels, position: CssPixels, viewport_length: CssPixels| {
            let new_offset = offset.to_double() * scale * applied_delta + position.to_double() * (applied_delta - 1.0);
            let max_offset = (viewport_length.to_double() * (new_scale - 1.0)).max(0.0);
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for(new_offset.clamp(0.0, max_offset) / new_scale)
        };
        let viewport_rect = self.viewport_rect();
        let new_offset = CssPixelPoint::new(
            new_offset_along(old_offset.x, position.x, viewport_rect.width),
            new_offset_along(old_offset.y, position.y, viewport_rect.height),
        );

        self.scale.set(new_scale);
        self.scale_is_new_to_compositor.set(true);
        self.offset.set(new_offset);
        if new_offset != old_offset {
            self.did_scroll();
        }
        self.did_change_offset_or_scale();
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_scale_zoomed_by_compositor(&self, scale: f64) {
        if scale == self.scale.get() {
            return;
        }
        self.scale.set(scale);
        self.did_change_offset_or_scale();
    }

    /// The scale, if this thread changed it since the compositor last heard of it.
    pub(crate) fn take_scale_for_compositor(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        self.scale_is_new_to_compositor.replace(false).then(|| self.scale.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn map_to_layout_viewport(&self, position: CssPixelPoint) -> CssPixelPoint {
        let inverse = self.transform().inverse().unwrap_or_default();
        let mapped = inverse.map_point(FloatPoint {
            x: position.x.to_int() as f32,
            y: position.y.to_int() as f32,
        });
        CssPixelPoint::new(
            CssPixels::from_integer(mapped.x.round_ties_even() as i64),
            CssPixels::from_integer(mapped.y.round_ties_even() as i64),
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn map_point_from_layout_viewport(&self, position: CssPixelPoint) -> CssPixelPoint {
        let mapped = self.transform().map_point(FloatPoint {
            x: position.x.to_float(),
            y: position.y.to_float(),
        });
        CssPixelPoint::new(
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.x),
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.y),
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn map_rect_from_layout_viewport(&self, rect: CssPixelRect) -> CssPixelRect {
        let mapped = self.transform().map_rect(FloatRect {
            x: rect.x.to_float(),
            y: rect.y.to_float(),
            width: rect.width.to_float(),
            height: rect.height.to_float(),
        });
        CssPixelRect::new(
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.x),
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.y),
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.width),
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(mapped.height),
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn reset(&self) {
        self.scale.set(1.0);
        self.scale_is_new_to_compositor.set(true);
        let old_offset = self.offset.replace(CssPixelPoint::default());
        if old_offset != CssPixelPoint::default() {
            self.did_scroll();
            // Resetting performs an instant scroll, so its scrollend event is queued immediately.
            self.append_pending_scroll_event(SCROLLEND);
        }
        self.did_change_offset_or_scale();
    }
}

use core::ffi::c_void;

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::interface::{InterfaceCell, Ref, Wrappable, allocate, cell_into_abi};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::abort_signal::AbortSignal;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct AbortController {
    signal: Ref<AbortSignal>,
}

impl Wrappable for AbortController {}

impl AbortController {
    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-abortcontroller-abortcontroller
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm) -> Ref<Self> {
        // 1. Let signal be a new AbortSignal object.
        let signal = AbortSignal::create(vm);

        // 2. Set this’s signal to signal.
        allocate(vm, |_| Self { signal })
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm()))
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-abortcontroller-signal
    pub(crate) fn get_signal(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AbortSignal>> {
        // The signal getter steps are to return this’s signal.
        Ok(self.signal)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-abortcontroller-abort
    pub(crate) fn abort(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, reason: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The abort(reason) method steps are to signal abort on this with reason if it is given.
        self.signal_abort(cx, reason);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller-signal-abort
    fn signal_abort(&self, cx: &CallContext, reason: Option<Value>) {
        // To signal abort on an AbortController controller with an optional reason, signal abort on controller’s signal with reason if it is given.
        self.signal.signal_abort(cx.vm(), reason, cx.realm());
    }
}

/// Creates an AbortController.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_controller_create(vm: &Vm) -> *mut c_void {
    cell_into_abi(AbortController::create(vm))
}

/// Returns the controller’s signal.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_controller_signal(controller: &InterfaceCell) -> *mut c_void {
    cell_into_abi(controller.object::<AbortController>().signal)
}

/// Aborts the controller with the reason in the realm.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_controller_abort(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    controller: &InterfaceCell,
    reason: Value,
) {
    let controller = controller.object::<AbortController>();
    controller.signal_abort(&CallContext::new(vm, realm), Some(reason));
}

use core::cell::Cell;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, MarkedVec, NativeFunction, Realm, Throw, Trace, Value, Vm, call};

use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::{CppCell, LentCppCell, cpp_class};
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEvent, CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::global_object::window_or_worker_global_scope_from_global_object;
use crate::bindings::interface::{InterfaceCell, Ref, Wrappable, allocate, cell_into_abi};
use crate::bindings::promise::{TaskSource, exception_value, queue_a_global_task};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_dom_run_abort_algorithm(algorithm: *mut c_void);
}

/// An abort algorithm of LibWeb's C++ code, a GC::Function<void()>.
#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CppAbortAlgorithm(CppCell);

impl CppAbortAlgorithm {
    fn from_lent(algorithm: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::AbortAlgorithm>) -> Self {
        Self(CppCell::from_lent(algorithm))
    }

    fn run(&self) {
        // SAFETY: The algorithm is a live GC::Function<void()>.
        unsafe { web_dom_run_abort_algorithm(self.0.as_ptr()) };
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum AbortAlgorithm {
    Cpp(CppAbortAlgorithm),
    Rust(Gc<NativeFunction>),
}

impl AbortAlgorithm {
    fn run(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        match self {
            Self::Cpp(algorithm) => algorithm.run(),
            Self::Rust(algorithm) => {
                // NB: The algorithm cannot fail, but it can run into the abort of the script that it calls.
                let result = call(vm, Value::from_object(*algorithm), Value::UNDEFINED, &[]);
                assert!(result.is_ok() || vm.interrupt_requested());
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct AbortSignal {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,
    abort_reason: Cell<Value>,
    // NB: The identifiers increase, so the list stays sorted by them.
    abort_algorithms: GcRefCell<Vec<(u64, AbortAlgorithm)>>,
    next_abort_algorithm_id: Cell<u64>,
    // AD-HOC: Source and dependent signals are strongly traced.
    source_signals: GcRefCell<Vec<Ref<AbortSignal>>>,
    dependent_signals: GcRefCell<Vec<Ref<AbortSignal>>>,
    dependent: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Wrappable for AbortSignal {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }

    const OWNS_EXTERNAL_MEMORY: bool = true;

    fn external_memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        self.abort_algorithms
            .borrow()
            .capacity()
            .saturating_mul(size_of::<(u64, AbortAlgorithm)>())
            .saturating_add(
                self.source_signals
                    .borrow()
                    .capacity()
                    .saturating_mul(size_of::<Ref<Self>>()),
            )
            .saturating_add(
                self.dependent_signals
                    .borrow()
                    .capacity()
                    .saturating_mul(size_of::<Ref<Self>>()),
            )
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for AbortSignal {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl AbortSignal {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm) -> Ref<Self> {
        let signal = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            abort_reason: Cell::new(Value::UNDEFINED),
            abort_algorithms: GcRefCell::default(),
            next_abort_algorithm_id: Cell::new(0),
            source_signals: GcRefCell::default(),
            dependent_signals: GcRefCell::default(),
            dependent: Cell::new(false),
        });
        signal.event_target.set_owner(signal);
        signal
    }

    pub(crate) fn aborted(&self) -> bool {
        !self.abort_reason.get().is_undefined()
    }

    pub(crate) fn reason(&self) -> Value {
        self.abort_reason.get()
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortsignal-add
    pub(crate) fn add_abort_algorithm(&self, vm: &Vm, abort_algorithm: AbortAlgorithm) -> Option<u64> {
        // 1. If signal is aborted, then return.
        if self.aborted() {
            return None;
        }

        // 2. Append algorithm to signal’s abort algorithms.
        let id = self.next_abort_algorithm_id.get().wrapping_add(1);
        self.next_abort_algorithm_id.set(id);
        self.abort_algorithms.borrow_mut(vm).push((id, abort_algorithm));
        Some(id)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortsignal-remove
    pub(crate) fn remove_abort_algorithm(&self, vm: &Vm, id: u64) {
        // To remove an algorithm algorithm from an AbortSignal signal, remove algorithm from signal’s abort algorithms.
        let mut algorithms = self.abort_algorithms.borrow_mut(vm);
        if let Ok(index) = algorithms.binary_search_by_key(&id, |(algorithm_id, _)| *algorithm_id) {
            algorithms.remove(index);
        }
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortsignal-signal-abort
    pub(crate) fn signal_abort(&self, vm: &Vm, reason: Option<Value>, realm: Gc<Realm>) {
        // 1. If signal is aborted, then return.
        if self.aborted() {
            return;
        }

        // 2. Set signal’s abort reason to reason if it is given; otherwise to a new "AbortError" DOMException.
        let reason = match reason {
            Some(reason) if !reason.is_undefined() => reason,
            _ => exception_value(
                vm,
                realm,
                Exception::Dom("AbortError", Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Aborted without reason")),
            ),
        };
        self.abort_reason.set(reason);

        // 3. Let dependentSignalsToAbort be a new list.
        let dependent_signals_to_abort = MarkedVec::new(vm);

        // 4. For each dependentSignal of signal’s dependent signals:
        for dependent_signal in self.dependent_signals.borrow().iter() {
            // 1. If dependentSignal is not aborted:
            if !dependent_signal.aborted() {
                // 1. Set dependentSignal’s abort reason to signal’s abort reason.
                dependent_signal.abort_reason.set(self.abort_reason.get());

                // 2. Append dependentSignal to dependentSignalsToAbort.
                dependent_signals_to_abort.push(*dependent_signal);
            }
        }

        // 5. Run the abort steps for signal.
        self.run_the_abort_steps(vm, realm);

        // 6. For each dependentSignal of dependentSignalsToAbort, run the abort steps for dependentSignal.
        for dependent_signal in dependent_signals_to_abort.values().iter() {
            dependent_signal.run_the_abort_steps(vm, realm);
        }
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#run-the-abort-steps
    fn run_the_abort_steps(&self, vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) {
        // 1. For each algorithm of signal’s abort algorithms: run algorithm.
        // NB: An algorithm can remove algorithms, including itself, so this looks up the next one after each runs.
        let mut previous = None;
        loop {
            let next = {
                let algorithms = self.abort_algorithms.borrow();
                let index = algorithms.partition_point(|(id, _)| previous.is_some_and(|previous| *id <= previous));
                algorithms.get(index).cloned()
            };
            let Some((id, algorithm)) = next else {
                break;
            };
            algorithm.run(vm);
            previous = Some(id);
        }

        // 2. Empty signal’s abort algorithms.
        self.abort_algorithms.borrow_mut(vm).clear();

        // 3. Fire an event named abort at signal.
        self.event_target
            .dispatch_event(&CppEvent::create(realm, "abort", false, false, false));
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-abortsignal-throwifaborted
    pub(crate) fn throw_if_aborted(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The throwIfAborted() method steps are to throw this’s abort reason, if this is aborted.
        if self.aborted() {
            return Err(Exception::from(Throw::new(self.abort_reason.get())));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-abortsignal-abort
    pub(crate) fn abort(cx: &mut CallContext, maybe_reason: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. Let signal be a new AbortSignal object.
        let signal = Self::create(cx.vm());

        // 2. Set signal’s abort reason to reason if it is given; otherwise to a new "AbortError" DOMException.
        let mut reason = maybe_reason.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED);
        if reason.is_undefined() {
            reason = exception_value(
                cx.vm(),
                cx.realm(),
                Exception::Dom("AbortError", Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Aborted without reason")),
            );
        }
        signal.abort_reason.set(reason);

        // 3. Return signal.
        Ok(signal)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-abortsignal-timeout
    pub(crate) fn timeout(cx: &mut CallContext, milliseconds: u64) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. Let signal be a new AbortSignal object.
        let signal = Self::create(cx.vm());

        // 2. Let global be signal’s relevant global object.
        let realm = cx.realm();
        let global = realm.global_object();

        // 3. Run steps after a timeout given global, "AbortSignal-timeout", milliseconds, and the following step:
        let global_scope = window_or_worker_global_scope_from_global_object(global)
            .expect("AbortSignal.timeout() is only exposed on a Window or WorkerGlobalScope");
        global_scope.run_steps_after_a_timeout(cx.vm(), milliseconds, (realm, signal), |vm, (realm, signal)| {
            // 1. Queue a global task on the timer task source given global to signal abort given signal and a new "TimeoutError" DOMException.
            queue_a_global_task(
                vm,
                realm.global_object(),
                TaskSource::TimerTask,
                (realm, signal),
                |vm, (realm, signal)| {
                    let reason = exception_value(
                        vm,
                        realm,
                        Exception::Dom("TimeoutError", Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Signal timed out")),
                    );
                    signal.signal_abort(vm, Some(reason), realm);
                },
            );
        });

        // 4. Return signal.
        Ok(signal)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-abortsignal-any
    pub(crate) fn any(cx: &mut CallContext, signals: MarkedVec<'_, Ref<Self>>) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // The static any(signals) method steps are to return the result of creating a dependent abort signal from signals using AbortSignal and the current realm.
        Ok(Self::create_dependent_abort_signal(cx.vm(), &signals.values()))
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-abortsignal-aborted
    pub(crate) fn get_aborted(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The aborted getter steps are to return true if this is aborted; otherwise false.
        Ok(self.aborted())
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-abortsignal-reason
    pub(crate) fn get_reason(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The reason getter steps are to return this’s abort reason.
        Ok(self.reason())
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-dependent-abort-signal
    pub(crate) fn create_dependent_abort_signal(vm: &Vm, signals: &[Ref<Self>]) -> Ref<Self> {
        // 1. Let resultSignal be a new object implementing signalInterface using realm.
        let result_signal = Self::create(vm);

        // 2. For each signal of signals: if signal is aborted, then set resultSignal’s abort reason to signal’s abort reason and return resultSignal.
        for signal in signals {
            if signal.aborted() {
                result_signal.abort_reason.set(signal.reason());
                return result_signal;
            }
        }

        // 3. Set resultSignal’s dependent to true.
        result_signal.dependent.set(true);

        // 4. For each signal of signals:
        for signal in signals {
            // 1. If signal’s dependent is false:
            if !signal.dependent.get() {
                // 1. Append signal to resultSignal’s source signals.
                result_signal.source_signals.borrow_mut(vm).push(*signal);

                // 2. Append resultSignal to signal’s dependent signals.
                signal.dependent_signals.borrow_mut(vm).push(result_signal);
            }
            // 2. Otherwise, for each sourceSignal of signal’s source signals:
            else {
                for source_signal in signal.source_signals.borrow().iter() {
                    // 1. Assert: sourceSignal is not aborted and not dependent.
                    assert!(!source_signal.aborted());
                    assert!(!source_signal.dependent.get());

                    // 2. Append sourceSignal to resultSignal’s source signals.
                    result_signal.source_signals.borrow_mut(vm).push(*source_signal);

                    // 3. Append resultSignal to sourceSignal’s dependent signals.
                    source_signal.dependent_signals.borrow_mut(vm).push(result_signal);
                }
            }
        }

        // 5. Return resultSignal.
        result_signal
    }
}

/// Creates an AbortSignal.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_signal_create(vm: &Vm) -> *mut c_void {
    cell_into_abi(AbortSignal::create(vm))
}

/// Returns whether the signal is aborted.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_signal_aborted(signal: &InterfaceCell) -> bool {
    signal.object::<AbortSignal>().aborted()
}

/// Returns the signal’s abort reason.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_signal_reason(signal: &InterfaceCell) -> u64 {
    signal.object::<AbortSignal>().reason().to_raw()
}

/// Adds a C++ abort algorithm and returns its identifier if the signal accepts it.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_signal_add_abort_algorithm(
    vm: &Vm,
    signal: &InterfaceCell,
    algorithm: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::AbortAlgorithm>,
    id: &mut u64,
) -> bool {
    let signal = signal.object::<AbortSignal>();
    let algorithm = AbortAlgorithm::Cpp(CppAbortAlgorithm::from_lent(algorithm));
    let Some(algorithm_id) = signal.add_abort_algorithm(vm, algorithm) else {
        return false;
    };
    *id = algorithm_id;
    true
}

/// Removes the abort algorithm with the identifier.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_signal_remove_abort_algorithm(vm: &Vm, signal: &InterfaceCell, id: u64) {
    signal.object::<AbortSignal>().remove_abort_algorithm(vm, id);
}

/// Signals abort with the reason in the realm.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_signal_signal_abort(vm: &Vm, signal: &InterfaceCell, reason: Value, realm: Gc<Realm>) {
    let signal = signal.object::<AbortSignal>();
    signal.signal_abort(vm, Some(reason), realm);
}

/// Creates a dependent AbortSignal from the signals.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_abort_signal_create_dependent_abort_signal(
    vm: &Vm,
    signals: ak::Span<'_, &InterfaceCell>,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let list = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, signals.as_slice().len());
    for signal in signals.as_slice() {
        list.push(signal.object::<AbortSignal>());
    }
    cell_into_abi(AbortSignal::create_dependent_abort_signal(vm, &list.values()))
}

//! CustomEvent, https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-customevent

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, Realm, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::event_target::CppEvent;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::lent_string::LentUtf16FlyString;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::event::EventInit;

/// The dictionary CustomEventInit of DOM/CustomEvent.idl.
pub(crate) struct CustomEventInit {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) detail: Value,
}

// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#customevent
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CustomEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-customevent-initcustomevent-type-bubbles-cancelable-detail-detail
    detail: GcRefCell<Value>,
}

impl Wrappable for CustomEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl CustomEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: CustomEventInit,
    ) -> Ref<CustomEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.parent.bubbles,
            event_init.parent.cancelable,
            event_init.parent.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| CustomEvent {
            event,
            detail: GcRefCell::new(event_init.detail),
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init_dict: CustomEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CustomEvent>> {
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &r#type, event_init_dict))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-customevent-detail
    pub(crate) fn detail(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        Ok(*self.detail.borrow())
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-customevent-initcustomevent
    pub(crate) fn init_custom_event(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        bubbles: bool,
        cancelable: bool,
        detail: Value,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If this’s dispatch flag is set, then return.
        if self.event.dispatched() {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 2. Initialize this with type, bubbles, and cancelable.
        self.event.initialize_event(&r#type, bubbles, cancelable);

        // 3. Set this’s detail attribute to detail.
        *self.detail.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = detail;
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// The Event of a new trusted CustomEvent in the realm, for the implementation to fire.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_custom_event_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    r#type: LentUtf16FlyString<'_>,
    detail: Value,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let event_init = CustomEventInit {
        parent: EventInit {
            bubbles: false,
            cancelable: false,
            composed: false,
        },
        detail,
    };
    let r#type: Utf16String = r#type.to_utf16_fly_string().into();
    let event = CustomEvent::create(vm, realm, &r#type, event_init);
    event.event().as_ptr()
}

/// The Event of a new CustomEvent in the realm whose type is the empty string, for createEvent().
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_custom_event_create_for_create_event(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) -> *mut c_void {
    let event_init = CustomEventInit {
        parent: EventInit {
            bubbles: false,
            cancelable: false,
            composed: false,
        },
        detail: Value::NULL,
    };
    CustomEvent::create(vm, realm, &Utf16String::from_utf8(""), event_init)
        .event()
        .as_ptr()
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
#[repr(C)]
pub(crate) struct DocumentUnloadTimingInfo {
    pub(crate) unload_event_start_time: f64,
    pub(crate) unload_event_end_time: f64,
}

impl CppDocument {
    pub(crate) fn from_lent(document: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::Document>) -> Self {
        Self(CppCell::from_lent(document))
    }

    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `document` must be a live Document.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn from_raw(document: *mut c_void) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: The caller passes a live Document.
        Self(unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(document) })
    }

    pub(crate) fn as_ptr(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.0.as_ptr()
    }

    pub(crate) fn downgrade(&self, vm: &Vm) -> WeakCppDocument {
        WeakCppDocument(WeakCppCell::new(vm, &self.0))
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#fully-active
    pub(crate) fn is_fully_active(&self) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The Document is live.
        unsafe { web_bindings_document_is_fully_active(self.0.as_ptr()) }
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#allowed-to-use
    pub(crate) fn is_allowed_to_use_feature(&self, feature: PolicyControlledFeature) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The Document is live.
        unsafe { web_bindings_document_is_allowed_to_use_feature(self.0.as_ptr(), feature as u8) }
    }

    /// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin
    pub(crate) fn origin(&self) -> Origin {
        unsafe extern "C" fn on_origin(origin: *mut c_void, ffi_origin: *const FfiOrigin) {
            // SAFETY: origin is the origin below, and LibWeb lends the origin for the call.
            unsafe { *origin.cast::<Option<Origin>>() = Some((*ffi_origin).to_origin()) };
        }

        let mut origin = None;
        // SAFETY: The Document is live, and the origin outlives the call.
        unsafe { web_bindings_document_origin(self.0.as_ptr(), (&raw mut origin).cast(), on_origin) };
        origin.expect("LibWeb lends the origin")
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#visibility-state
    pub(crate) fn visibility_state(&self) -> VisibilityState {
        // SAFETY: The Document is live.
        match unsafe { web_bindings_document_visibility_state(self.0.as_ptr()) } {
            0 => VisibilityState::Visible,
            1 => VisibilityState::Hidden,
            _ => unreachable!("LibWeb returns a VisibilityState"),
        }
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#fully-active-descendant-of-a-top-level-traversable-with-user-attention
    pub(crate) fn is_fully_active_descendant_of_a_top_level_traversable_with_user_attention(&self) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The Document is live.
        unsafe {
            web_bindings_document_is_fully_active_descendant_of_a_top_level_traversable_with_user_attention(
                self.0.as_ptr(),
            )
        }
    }

    /// Calls the steps with the VM, the cell and whether the Document is visible whenever its visibility state
    /// changes, for as long as the returned DocumentObserver lives.
    pub(crate) fn observe_visibility_state(
        &self,
        cell: *mut c_void,
        steps: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *mut c_void, bool),
    ) -> CppCell {
        // SAFETY: The Document and the cell are live, and LibWeb returns a live DocumentObserver.
        unsafe {
            CppCell::from_raw(web_bindings_document_observe_visibility_state(
                self.0.as_ptr(),
                cell,
                steps,
            ))
        }
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#has-focus-steps
    pub(crate) fn has_focus(&self) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The Document is live.
        unsafe { web_bindings_document_has_focus(self.0.as_ptr()) }
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-lifecycle.html#destroy-a-document
    pub(crate) fn has_been_destroyed(&self) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: The Document is live.
        unsafe { web_bindings_document_has_been_destroyed(self.0.as_ptr()) }
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#node-navigable
    pub(crate) fn navigable(&self) -> Option<CppNavigable> {
        // SAFETY: The Document is live, and LibWeb returns null or its live node navigable.
        let navigable = unsafe { web_bindings_document_navigable(self.0.as_ptr()) };
        // SAFETY: The navigable is live.
        (!navigable.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { CppNavigable::from_raw(navigable) })
    }

    /// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url
    pub(crate) fn url(&self) -> Url {
        // SAFETY: The Document is live, and LibWeb lends its URL, which this copies before the Document can change it.
        unsafe { web_bindings_document_url(self.0.as_ptr()).to_url() }
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#load-timing-info
    pub(crate) fn load_timing_info(&self) -> DocumentLoadTimingInfo {
        let mut load_timing_info = DocumentLoadTimingInfo::default();
        // SAFETY: The Document is live, and LibWeb writes its load timing info.
        unsafe { web_bindings_document_load_timing_info(self.0.as_ptr(), &raw mut load_timing_info) };
        load_timing_info
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#previous-document-unload-timing
    pub(crate) fn previous_document_unload_timing(&self) -> DocumentUnloadTimingInfo {
        let mut unload_timing = DocumentUnloadTimingInfo::default();
        // SAFETY: The Document is live, and LibWeb writes its previous document unload timing.
        unsafe { web_bindings_document_previous_document_unload_timing(self.0.as_ptr(), &raw mut unload_timing) };
        unload_timing
    }

    /// https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dfn-document-navigation-timing-entry
    pub(crate) fn navigation_timing_entry(&self) -> Option<Ref<PerformanceNavigationTiming>> {
        // SAFETY: The Document is live.
        let entry = unsafe { web_bindings_document_navigation_timing_entry(self.0.as_ptr()) };
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns null or the cell of the Document's PerformanceNavigationTiming.
        (!entry.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { cell_from_abi(entry) })
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_navigation_timing_entry(&self, entry: Ref<PerformanceNavigationTiming>) {
        // SAFETY: The Document and the entry are live.
        unsafe { web_bindings_document_set_navigation_timing_entry(self.0.as_ptr(), cell_into_abi(entry)) };
    }
}

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#is-a-registrable-domain-suffix-of-or-is-equal-to
pub(crate) fn is_a_registrable_domain_suffix_of_or_is_equal_to(
    host_suffix_string: &Utf16String,
    original_host: &Host,
) -> bool {
    let original_host = FfiUrlHost::new(original_host.kind, &original_host.serialization);
    // SAFETY: The host suffix string and the host are lent for the call.
    unsafe {
        web_bindings_is_a_registrable_domain_suffix_of_or_is_equal_to(
            host_suffix_string.raw_identity(),
            &raw const original_host,
        )
    }
}

/// https://drafts.csswg.org/web-animations-1/#dom-document-timeline
pub(crate) fn timeline(this: &CppInterface, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DocumentTimeline>> {
    // The DocumentTimeline object representing the default document timeline.
    // SAFETY: The wrapper is live, and LibWeb returns the document it wraps.
    let document = NonNull::new(unsafe { web_animation_document_of_wrapper(this.wrapper().as_ptr().cast()) })
        .expect("a wrapper of a Document wraps a document");
    let record = TimelineRecordRef::default_of_document(document);
    let AnyAnimationTimeline::DocumentTimeline(timeline) = timeline_object_of_record(cx.vm(), &record) else {
        unreachable!("the default document timeline is a document timeline");
    };
    Ok(timeline)
}

/// https://drafts.csswg.org/web-animations-1/#dom-documentorshadowroot-getanimations
pub(crate) fn get_animations<'vm>(
    this: &CppInterface,
    cx: &mut CallContext<'vm>,
) -> WebIdlResult<MarkedVec<'vm, AnyAnimation>> {
    document_or_shadow_root::get_animations(this, cx)
}

//! https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-domtokenlist

use core::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::{Utf16FlyString, Utf16String};
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Utf16StringBuilder, Utf16View, Vm, utf16_string_external_memory_size};
use libwebcommon_rust::infra::character_types::is_ascii_whitespace;

use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::{LentCppCell, cpp_class};
use crate::bindings::interface::{InterfaceCell, Wrappable, allocate, cell_into_abi};
use crate::bindings::lent_string::LentUtf16FlyString;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, MustNotThrow, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::element::CppElement;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct DOMTokenList {
    associated_element: CppElement,
    associated_attribute: Utf16FlyString,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    token_set: RefCell<Vec<Utf16String>>,
    is_running_update_steps: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Wrappable for DOMTokenList {
    const OWNS_EXTERNAL_MEMORY: bool = true;

    fn external_memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        let token_set = self.token_set.borrow();
        token_set
            .iter()
            .fold(token_set.capacity() * size_of::<Utf16String>(), |size, token| {
                size.saturating_add(utf16_string_external_memory_size(token))
            })
    }
}

impl DOMTokenList {
    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#ref-for-domtokenlist%E2%91%A0%E2%91%A2
    fn new(associated_element: CppElement, associated_attribute: Utf16FlyString) -> Self {
        let list = Self {
            associated_element,
            associated_attribute,
            token_set: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            is_running_update_steps: Cell::new(false),
        };

        // When a DOMTokenList object set is created:
        // 1. Let element be set’s element.
        // 2. Let attributeName be set’s attribute name.
        // 3. Let value be the result of getting an attribute value given element and attributeName.
        let value = list
            .associated_element
            .get_attribute_ns(None, &list.associated_attribute);

        // 4. Run the attribute change steps for element, attributeName, value, value, and null.
        list.associated_attribute_changed(value);
        list
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#ref-for-domtokenlist%E2%91%A0%E2%91%A1
    fn associated_attribute_changed(&self, value: Option<Utf16String>) {
        // 1. If localName is set’s attribute name, namespace is null, and value is null, then empty token set.
        // 2. Otherwise, if localName is set’s attribute name and namespace is null, then set set’s token set to value,
        //    parsed.
        // AD-HOC: The caller is responsible for checking the name and namespace.
        // OPTIMIZATION: The update steps just wrote this value from the token set, so there is nothing new to parse.
        if self.is_running_update_steps.get() {
            return;
        }
        let mut token_set = self.token_set.borrow_mut();
        *token_set = Vec::new();
        let Some(value) = value else {
            return;
        };
        *token_set = parse_ordered_set(Utf16View::of_string(&value));
    }

    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(u32::try_from(self.token_set.borrow().len()).expect("a token list has fewer than 2^32 tokens"))
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domtokenlist-item
    pub(crate) fn item(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        let token_set = self.token_set.borrow();
        let index = index as usize;

        // 1. If index is equal to or greater than this’s token set’s size, then return null.
        if index >= token_set.len() {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        // 2. Return this’s token set[index].
        Ok(Some(token_set[index].clone()))
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domtokenlist-contains
    pub(crate) fn contains(&self, _: &mut CallContext, token: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        Ok(self.token_set.borrow().contains(&token))
    }

    pub(crate) fn add(&self, _: &mut CallContext, tokens: Vec<Utf16String>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.add_tokens(&tokens)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domtokenlist-add
    fn add_tokens(&self, tokens: &[Utf16String]) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. For each token of tokens:
        for token in tokens {
            // a. If token is the empty string, then throw a "SyntaxError" DOMException.
            // b. If token contains any ASCII whitespace, then throw an "InvalidCharacterError" DOMException.
            validate_token(token)?;
        }

        // 2. For each token of tokens: append token to this’s token set.
        for token in tokens {
            append_to_ordered_set(&mut self.token_set.borrow_mut(), Utf16View::of_string(token));
        }

        // 3. Run the update steps.
        self.run_update_steps();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn remove(&self, _: &mut CallContext, tokens: Vec<Utf16String>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.remove_tokens(&tokens)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domtokenlist-remove
    fn remove_tokens(&self, tokens: &[Utf16String]) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. For each token of tokens:
        for token in tokens {
            // a. If token is the empty string, then throw a "SyntaxError" DOMException.
            // b. If token contains any ASCII whitespace, then throw an "InvalidCharacterError" DOMException.
            validate_token(token)?;
        }

        // 2. For each token of tokens: remove token from this’s token set.
        for token in tokens {
            remove_from_ordered_set(&mut self.token_set.borrow_mut(), Utf16View::of_string(token));
        }

        // 3. Run the update steps.
        self.run_update_steps();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn toggle(&self, _: &mut CallContext, token: Utf16String, force: Option<bool>) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        self.toggle_token(token, force)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domtokenlist-toggle
    fn toggle_token(&self, token: Utf16String, force: Option<bool>) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // 1. If token is the empty string, then throw a "SyntaxError" DOMException.
        // 2. If token contains any ASCII whitespace, then throw an "InvalidCharacterError" DOMException.
        validate_token(&token)?;

        // 3. If this’s token set[token] exists:
        if self.token_set.borrow().contains(&token) {
            // a. If force is either not given or is false, then remove token from this’s token set, run the update steps and return false.
            if force != Some(true) {
                remove_from_ordered_set(&mut self.token_set.borrow_mut(), Utf16View::of_string(&token));
                self.run_update_steps();
                return Ok(false);
            }

            // b. Return true.
            return Ok(true);
        }

        // 4. Otherwise, if force not given or is true, append token to this’s token set, run the update steps, and return true.
        if force != Some(false) {
            append_to_ordered_set(&mut self.token_set.borrow_mut(), Utf16View::of_string(&token));
            self.run_update_steps();
            return Ok(true);
        }

        // 5. Return false.
        Ok(false)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domtokenlist-replace
    pub(crate) fn replace(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        token: Utf16String,
        new_token: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // 1. If either token or newToken is the empty string, then throw a "SyntaxError" DOMException.
        validate_token_not_empty(&token)?;
        validate_token_not_empty(&new_token)?;

        // 2. If either token or newToken contains any ASCII whitespace, then throw an "InvalidCharacterError" DOMException.
        validate_token_not_whitespace(&token)?;
        validate_token_not_whitespace(&new_token)?;

        // 3. If this’s token set does not contain token, then return false.
        if !self.token_set.borrow().contains(&token) {
            return Ok(false);
        }

        // 4. Replace token in this’s token set with newToken.
        replace_in_ordered_set(
            &mut self.token_set.borrow_mut(),
            Utf16View::of_string(&token),
            Utf16View::of_string(&new_token),
        );

        // 5. Run the update steps.
        self.run_update_steps();

        // 6. Return true.
        Ok(true)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domtokenlist-supports
    pub(crate) fn supports(&self, _: &mut CallContext, token: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // 1. Let result be the return value of validation steps called with token.
        // 2. Return result.
        self.run_validation_steps(Utf16View::of_string(&token))
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-domtokenlist-validation
    fn run_validation_steps(&self, token: Utf16View<'_>) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        let name = self.associated_element.local_name();
        let name = Utf16View::of_fly_string(&name);
        let attribute = Utf16View::of_fly_string(&self.associated_attribute);
        let supported_tokens: Option<&[&[u8]]> = match (name, attribute) {
            // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/links.html#linkTypes
            (name, attribute) if name == "link" && attribute == "rel" => Some(&[
                b"modulepreload",
                b"preload",
                b"preconnect",
                b"dns-prefetch",
                b"stylesheet",
                b"icon",
                b"alternate",
                b"prefetch",
                b"prerender",
                b"next",
                b"manifest",
                b"apple-touch-icon",
                b"apple-touch-icon-precomposed",
                b"canonical",
            ]),
            (name, attribute) if attribute == "rel" && (name == "a" || name == "area" || name == "form") => {
                Some(&[b"noreferrer", b"noopener", b"opener"])
            }

            // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#blocking-attribute
            (name, attribute) if attribute == "blocking" && (name == "link" || name == "script" || name == "style") => {
                Some(&[b"render"])
            }

            // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#attr-iframe-sandbox
            (name, attribute) if name == "iframe" && attribute == "sandbox" => Some(&[
                b"allow-downloads",
                b"allow-forms",
                b"allow-modals",
                b"allow-orientation-lock",
                b"allow-pointer-lock",
                b"allow-popups",
                b"allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox",
                b"allow-presentation",
                b"allow-same-origin",
                b"allow-scripts",
                b"allow-top-navigation",
                b"allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation",
                b"allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols",
            ]),
            _ => None,
        };

        // 1. If set’s element and attribute name does not define supported tokens, then throw a TypeError.
        let Some(supported_tokens) = supported_tokens else {
            let mut message = Utf16StringBuilder::new();
            message.append_ascii("Attribute ");
            message.append(attribute);
            message.append_ascii(" does not define any supported tokens");
            return Err(Exception::TypeError(message.to_utf16_string()));
        };

        // 2. Let lowercaseToken be token, in ASCII lowercase.
        // 3. If lowercaseToken is present in the supported tokens of set’s element and attribute name, then return true.
        if supported_tokens
            .iter()
            .any(|supported| token.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(Utf16View::Ascii(supported)))
        {
            return Ok(true);
        }

        // 4. Return false.
        Ok(false)
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domtokenlist-value
    pub(crate) fn value(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self
            .associated_element
            .get_attribute_ns(None, &self.associated_attribute)
            .unwrap_or_default())
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#ref-for-concept-element-attributes-set-value%E2%91%A2
    pub(crate) fn set_value(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.associated_element
            .set_attribute_value(&self.associated_attribute, value);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-dtl-update
    fn run_update_steps(&self) {
        // 1. If get an attribute by namespace and local name given null, set’s attribute name, and set’s element returns null and set’s token set is empty, then return.
        let attribute = self
            .associated_element
            .get_attribute_ns(None, &self.associated_attribute);
        if attribute.is_none() && self.token_set.borrow().is_empty() {
            return;
        }

        // 2. Set an attribute value given set’s element, set’s attribute name, and the result of running the ordered set
        //    serializer for set’s token set.
        let serialized = serialize_ordered_set(&self.token_set.borrow());
        let was_running_update_steps = self.is_running_update_steps.replace(true);
        self.associated_element
            .set_attribute_value(&self.associated_attribute, serialized);
        self.is_running_update_steps.set(was_running_update_steps);
    }
}

fn validate_token(token: &Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    validate_token_not_empty(token)?;
    validate_token_not_whitespace(token)
}

fn validate_token_not_empty(token: &Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    if token.is_empty() {
        return Err(Exception::syntax_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(
            "Non-empty DOM tokens are not allowed",
        )));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_token_not_whitespace(token: &Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    if Utf16View::of_string(token)
        .code_units()
        .any(|unit| is_ascii_whitespace(u32::from(unit)))
    {
        return Err(Exception::Dom(
            "InvalidCharacterError",
            Utf16String::from_utf8("DOM tokens containing ASCII whitespace are not allowed"),
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

// https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append
fn append_to_ordered_set(set: &mut Vec<Utf16String>, item: Utf16View<'_>) {
    if !set.iter().any(|value| Utf16View::of_string(value) == item) {
        set.push(item.to_utf16_string());
    }
}

// https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove
fn remove_from_ordered_set(set: &mut Vec<Utf16String>, item: Utf16View<'_>) {
    if let Some(index) = set.iter().position(|value| Utf16View::of_string(value) == item) {
        set.remove(index);
    }
}

// https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-replace
fn replace_in_ordered_set(set: &mut Vec<Utf16String>, item: Utf16View<'_>, replacement: Utf16View<'_>) {
    let item_index = set
        .iter()
        .position(|value| Utf16View::of_string(value) == item)
        .expect("the set contains the item");

    let Some(replacement_index) = set.iter().position(|value| Utf16View::of_string(value) == replacement) else {
        set[item_index] = replacement.to_utf16_string();
        return;
    };

    if item_index == replacement_index {
        return;
    }

    if replacement_index < item_index {
        set.remove(item_index);
        return;
    }

    set[item_index] = set.remove(replacement_index);
}

// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-ordered-set-parser
fn parse_ordered_set(input: Utf16View<'_>) -> Vec<Utf16String> {
    // 1. Let inputTokens be the result of splitting input on ASCII whitespace.
    // 2. Let tokens be a new ordered set.
    let mut tokens = Vec::new();

    // 3. For each token of inputTokens: append token to tokens.
    let mut token_start = None;
    for (index, unit) in input.code_units().enumerate() {
        if is_ascii_whitespace(u32::from(unit)) {
            if let Some(start) = token_start.take() {
                append_to_ordered_set(&mut tokens, input.substring_view(start, index - start));
            }
            continue;
        }

        if token_start.is_none() {
            token_start = Some(index);
        }
    }
    if let Some(start) = token_start {
        append_to_ordered_set(
            &mut tokens,
            input.substring_view(start, input.length_in_code_units() - start),
        );
    }

    // 4. Return tokens.
    tokens
}

// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-ordered-set-serializer
fn serialize_ordered_set(token_set: &[Utf16String]) -> Utf16String {
    // The ordered set serializer takes a set and returns the concatenation of set using U+0020 SPACE.
    let mut builder = Utf16StringBuilder::new();
    for token in token_set {
        if !builder.is_empty() {
            builder.append_ascii(" ");
        }
        builder.append(Utf16View::of_string(token));
    }
    builder.to_utf16_string()
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_dom_token_list_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    element: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::Element>,
    attribute: LentUtf16FlyString<'_>,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let (element, attribute) = (CppElement::from_lent(element), attribute.to_utf16_fly_string());
    cell_into_abi(allocate(vm, |_| DOMTokenList::new(element, attribute)))
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_dom_token_list_attribute_changed(list: &InterfaceCell, value: Option<Utf16String>) {
    let list = list.object::<DOMTokenList>();
    list.associated_attribute_changed(value);
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_dom_token_list_add(list: &InterfaceCell, token: Utf16String) {
    let list = list.object::<DOMTokenList>();
    list.add_tokens(&[token]).must();
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_dom_token_list_remove(list: &InterfaceCell, token: Utf16String) {
    let list = list.object::<DOMTokenList>();
    list.remove_tokens(&[token]).must();
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_dom_token_list_toggle(list: &InterfaceCell, token: Utf16String, force: bool) {
    let list = list.object::<DOMTokenList>();
    list.toggle_token(token, Some(force)).must();
}

//! The members of Element that are implemented in Rust, https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element

use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::{Utf16FlyString, Utf16String};
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, MarkedVec, Object, Trace};

use crate::animations::animatable::{self, GetAnimationsOptions, UnrestrictedDoubleOrKeyframeAnimationOptions};
use crate::animations::animation::AnyAnimation;
use crate::bindings::conversions::CppInterface;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::{CppCell, LentCppCell, cpp_class};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_dom_is_valid_attribute_local_name(name: usize) -> bool;
    fn web_dom_element_local_name(element: *mut c_void) -> usize;
    fn web_dom_element_get_attribute_ns(element: *mut c_void, namespace: usize, name: usize) -> usize;
    fn web_dom_element_set_attribute_value(element: *mut c_void, name: usize, value: usize);
    fn web_dom_element_remove_attribute(element: *mut c_void, name: usize);
    fn web_dom_element_for_each_attribute(
        element: *mut c_void,
        callback: *mut c_void,
        on_attribute: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, usize, usize),
    );
    fn web_dom_element_attribute(
        element: *mut c_void,
        name: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
        value: *mut c_void,
        on_value: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, usize),
    );
}

unsafe extern "C" fn on_value(value: *mut c_void, raw_value: usize) {
    // SAFETY: value is the result slot of the caller, and LibWeb hands over a reference to the string.
    unsafe { *value.cast::<Option<Utf16String>>() = Some(Utf16String::from_raw_owned(raw_value)) };
}

unsafe extern "C" fn on_attribute(callback: *mut c_void, name: usize, value: usize) {
    // SAFETY: callback is the callback of the caller, and LibWeb lends the name and the value for the call.
    let (callback, name, value) = unsafe {
        (
            &mut *callback.cast::<&mut dyn FnMut(&Utf16FlyString, &Utf16String)>(),
            Utf16FlyString::from_raw_borrowed(name),
            Utf16String::from_raw_borrowed(value),
        )
    };
    callback(&name, &value);
}

/// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element
#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CppElement(CppCell);

impl CppElement {
    pub(crate) fn from_lent(element: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::Element>) -> Self {
        Self(CppCell::from_lent(element))
    }

    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `element` must be a live Element.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn from_raw(element: *mut c_void) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: The caller passes a live Element.
        Self(unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(element) })
    }

    pub(crate) fn local_name(&self) -> Utf16FlyString {
        // SAFETY: The element is live and owns the returned local name.
        unsafe { Utf16FlyString::from_raw_borrowed(web_dom_element_local_name(self.0.as_ptr())) }
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_attribute_ns(
        &self,
        namespace: Option<&Utf16FlyString>,
        name: &Utf16FlyString,
    ) -> Option<Utf16String> {
        let namespace = namespace.map_or(0, |namespace| namespace.raw_identity());
        // SAFETY: The element is live and the names are lent for the call.
        let value = unsafe { web_dom_element_get_attribute_ns(self.0.as_ptr(), namespace, name.raw_identity()) };
        // SAFETY: A nonzero result transfers a reference to the value.
        (value != 0).then(|| unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(value) })
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_attribute_value(&self, name: &Utf16FlyString, value: Utf16String) {
        // SAFETY: The element is live, the name is lent for the call, and the value reference is transferred.
        unsafe { web_dom_element_set_attribute_value(self.0.as_ptr(), name.raw_identity(), value.into_raw()) };
    }

    /// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-remove-by-name
    pub(crate) fn remove_attribute(&self, name: &Utf16FlyString) {
        // SAFETY: The element is live and the name is lent for the call.
        unsafe { web_dom_element_remove_attribute(self.0.as_ptr(), name.raw_identity()) };
    }

    /// Calls `callback` with the qualified name and the value of each attribute in the element's attribute list, in
    /// order.
    pub(crate) fn for_each_attribute(&self, mut callback: impl FnMut(&Utf16FlyString, &Utf16String)) {
        let mut callback: &mut dyn FnMut(&Utf16FlyString, &Utf16String) = &mut callback;
        // SAFETY: The element is live, and the callback outlives the call.
        unsafe { web_dom_element_for_each_attribute(self.0.as_ptr(), (&raw mut callback).cast(), on_attribute) };
    }

    /// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-get-value
    pub(crate) fn attribute(&self, name: &str) -> Option<Utf16String> {
        let mut value = None;
        // SAFETY: The element is live, the name is lent for the call, and the value outlives it.
        unsafe {
            web_dom_element_attribute(
                self.0.as_ptr(),
                ak::Span::new(name.as_bytes()),
                (&raw mut value).cast(),
                on_value,
            );
        }
        value
    }
}

// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-attribute-local-name
pub(crate) fn is_valid_attribute_local_name(name: &Utf16String) -> bool {
    // SAFETY: The name is live for the call.
    unsafe { web_dom_is_valid_attribute_local_name(name.raw_identity()) }
}

//! The C ABI through which LibWeb's C++ reads the URLSearchParams objects that it receives from script, which
//! Libraries/LibWeb/DOMURL/URLSearchParams.h declares.

use core::ffi::c_void;

use super::url_search_params::URLSearchParams;
use crate::bindings::interface::{InterfaceCell, Ref};

/// Calls `on_complete` with the serialization of the list of the URLSearchParams whose cell C++ lends, an ASCII
/// string that it borrows for the call, https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `cell` must be the live cell of a URLSearchParams.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_url_search_params_serialize(
    cell: &InterfaceCell,
    ctx: *mut c_void,
    on_complete: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const u8, usize),
) {
    let object: Ref<URLSearchParams> = cell.object();
    let serialization = object.serialize();
    // SAFETY: on_complete is a valid function pointer; ctx is caller-provided.
    unsafe { on_complete(ctx, serialization.as_ptr(), serialization.len()) };
}

//! The URL Standard, https://url.spec.whatwg.org/, and the Origin interface of the HTML Standard,
//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#the-origin-interface

use ak::Utf16StringUnits;
use liburl_rust::url::UrlInput;

#[cfg(not(test))]
pub(crate) mod exports;
#[cfg(not(test))]
pub(crate) mod origin;
#[cfg(not(test))]
pub(crate) mod url;
#[cfg(not(test))]
pub(crate) mod url_search_params;

pub(crate) fn url_input(units: Utf16StringUnits<'_>) -> UrlInput<'_> {
    match units {
        Utf16StringUnits::Ascii(bytes) => UrlInput::Utf8(core::str::from_utf8(bytes).expect("ASCII is UTF-8")),
        Utf16StringUnits::Latin1(bytes) => UrlInput::Latin1(bytes),
        Utf16StringUnits::Utf16(code_units) => UrlInput::Utf16(code_units),
    }
}

//! Origin, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#the-origin-interface

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Value, is_host_instance_of};
use liburl_rust::origin::{OpaqueOriginKind, Origin as OriginValue};
use liburl_rust::{BasicParseOptions, FfiOrigin, basic_parse};

use super::url::URL;
use super::url_input;
use crate::bindings::conversions::to_dom_string;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Interface, Ref, Wrappable, allocate, implementation_of};
use crate::bindings::services::web_bindings_extract_an_origin;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::html::message_event::MessageEvent;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct Origin {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#concept-origin-origin
    // Origin objects have an associated origin, which holds an origin.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    origin: OriginValue,
}

impl Wrappable for Origin {}

impl Origin {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#dom-origin-constructor
    pub(crate) fn construct(_: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        // The new Origin() constructor steps are to set this's origin to a unique opaque origin.
        Ok(Self {
            origin: OriginValue::new_opaque(OpaqueOriginKind::Standard),
        })
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#dom-origin-from
    pub(crate) fn from(cx: &mut CallContext, value: Value) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. If value is a platform object:
        //     1. Let origin be the result of executing value's extract an origin operation.
        //     2. If origin is not null, then return a new Origin object whose origin is origin.
        if let Some(origin) = extract_an_origin(value) {
            return Ok(allocate(cx.vm(), |_| Self { origin }));
        }

        // 2. If value is a string:
        if value.is_string() {
            // 1. Let parsedURL be the result of basic URL parsing value.
            let string = to_dom_string(cx.vm(), value)?;
            let parsed_url = basic_parse(url_input(string.as_units()), BasicParseOptions::new());

            // 2. If parsedURL is not failure, then return a new Origin object whose origin is set to parsedURL's
            //    origin.
            if let Some(parsed_url) = parsed_url {
                let origin = parsed_url.origin();
                return Ok(allocate(cx.vm(), |_| Self { origin }));
            }
        }

        // 3. Throw a TypeError.
        Err(Exception::TypeError(Utf16String::from_utf8(
            "Value is not a valid Origin",
        )))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#dom-origin-opaque
    pub(crate) fn opaque(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The opaque getter steps are to return true if this's origin is an opaque origin; otherwise false.
        Ok(self.origin.is_opaque())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#dom-origin-issameorigin
    pub(crate) fn is_same_origin(&self, _: &mut CallContext, other: Ref<Self>) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The isSameOrigin(other) method steps are to return true if this's origin is same origin with other's
        // origin; otherwise false.
        Ok(self.origin.is_same_origin(&other.origin))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#dom-origin-issamesite
    pub(crate) fn is_same_site(&self, _: &mut CallContext, other: Ref<Self>) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The isSameSite(other) method steps are to return true if this's origin is same site with other's origin;
        // otherwise false.
        Ok(self.origin.is_same_site(&other.origin))
    }
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#extract-an-origin
fn extract_an_origin(value: Value) -> Option<OriginValue> {
    if !value.is_object() {
        return None;
    }
    let object = value.as_object();

    // Objects implementing the Origin interface's extract an origin steps are to return this's origin.
    if is_host_instance_of(&object, Origin::wrapper_class()) {
        return Some(implementation_of::<Origin>(object).origin.clone());
    }
    if is_host_instance_of(&object, URL::wrapper_class()) {
        return Some(implementation_of::<URL>(object).extract_an_origin());
    }
    if is_host_instance_of(&object, MessageEvent::wrapper_class()) {
        return implementation_of::<MessageEvent>(object).extract_an_origin();
    }

    unsafe extern "C" fn on_origin(ctx: *mut core::ffi::c_void, ffi_origin: *const FfiOrigin) {
        // SAFETY: ctx is the result below, and LibWeb lends the origin for the call.
        unsafe { *ctx.cast::<Option<OriginValue>>() = Some((*ffi_origin).to_origin()) };
    }

    let mut origin = None;
    // SAFETY: The object is live, and the result outlives the call.
    unsafe { web_bindings_extract_an_origin(object.as_ptr().cast(), (&raw mut origin).cast(), on_origin) };
    origin
}

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
