//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#canvasshadowstyles

use ak::Utf16String;

use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::canvas_2d::context::{CanvasKind, RenderingContext2D};
use crate::canvas_2d::drawing_state::serialize_color;
use crate::canvas_2d::float;

impl<K: CanvasKind> RenderingContext2D<K> {
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsetx
    pub(crate) fn shadow_offset_x(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(f64::from(self.drawing_state().shadow_offset_x))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_shadow_offset_x(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, offset_x: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let offset_x = float(offset_x);
        if offset_x.is_finite() {
            self.drawing_state_mut(cx.vm()).shadow_offset_x = offset_x;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsety
    pub(crate) fn shadow_offset_y(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(f64::from(self.drawing_state().shadow_offset_y))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_shadow_offset_y(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, offset_y: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let offset_y = float(offset_y);
        if offset_y.is_finite() {
            self.drawing_state_mut(cx.vm()).shadow_offset_y = offset_y;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-shadowblur
    pub(crate) fn shadow_blur(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(f64::from(self.drawing_state().shadow_blur))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_shadow_blur(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, blur_radius: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // On setting, the attribute must be set to the new value, except if the value is negative, infinite or NaN,
        // in which case the new value must be ignored.
        let blur_radius = float(blur_radius);
        if blur_radius < 0.0 || !blur_radius.is_finite() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.drawing_state_mut(cx.vm()).shadow_blur = blur_radius;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-shadowcolor
    pub(crate) fn shadow_color(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(serialize_color(self.drawing_state().shadow_color.srgb))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_shadow_color(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, color: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Let context be this's canvas attribute's value, if that is an element; otherwise null.

        // 2. Let parsedValue be the result of parsing the given value with context if non-null.
        // 3. If parsedValue is failure, then return.
        let Some(parsed_value) = self.parse_a_css_color_value(&color) else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        // 4. Set this's shadow color to parsedValue.
        self.drawing_state_mut(cx.vm()).shadow_color = parsed_value;
        Ok(())
    }
}

/*

//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#canvasstate

use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::canvas_2d::context::{CanvasKind, CanvasRecorder, RenderingContext2D};

impl<K: CanvasKind> RenderingContext2D<K> {
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-save
    pub(crate) fn save(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The save() method steps are to push a copy of the current drawing state onto the drawing state stack.
        self.push_drawing_state(cx.vm());

        self.record_if_ready(CanvasRecorder::save);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-restore
    pub(crate) fn restore(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The restore() method steps are to pop the top entry in the drawing state stack, and reset the drawing state
        // it describes. If there is no saved state, then the method must do nothing.
        if !self.pop_drawing_state(cx.vm()) {
            return Ok(());
        }
        // NB: The current default path is not part of the drawing state.
        self.keep_path_in_place();

        self.record_if_ready(CanvasRecorder::restore);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-reset
    pub(crate) fn reset(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The reset() method steps are to reset the rendering context to its default state.
        self.reset_to_default_state();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-iscontextlost
    pub(crate) fn is_context_lost(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The isContextLost() method steps are to return this's context lost.
        Ok(self.context_is_lost())
    }
}

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-font
    pub(crate) fn font(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // On getting, the font attribute must return the serialized form of the current font of the context (with no
        // 'line-height' component).
        // NB: When the context has no font yet, that is the font it starts with.
        Ok(self.drawing_state().font.as_ref().map_or_else(
            || Utf16String::from_ascii(b"10px sans-serif"),
            |font| font.serialized.clone(),
        ))
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-font
    pub(crate) fn set_font(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, font: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The font IDL attribute, on setting, must be parsed as a CSS <'font'> value (but without supporting
        // property-independent style sheet syntax like 'inherit'), and the resulting font must be assigned to the
        // context, with the 'line-height' component forced to 'normal', with the 'font-size' component converted to
        // CSS pixels, and with system fonts being computed to explicit values.
        // If the new value is syntactically incorrect (including using property-independent style sheet syntax like
        // 'inherit' or 'initial'), then it must be ignored, without assigning a new font value.
        // NB: LibWeb's C++ parses the value and resolves it against the canvas.
        self.assign_font(cx.vm(), &font);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-textalign
    pub(crate) fn text_align(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CanvasTextAlign> {

    }

//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#canvastext

use libjs_rust::api::Vm;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::DisplayListGlyph;
use libgfx_rust::path::Path;
use libgfx_rust::text_layout::glyph_run_ink_bounding_box;
use libgfx_rust::{CompositingAndBlendingOperator, FloatPoint};

use super::text_metrics::{TextMeasurements, TextMetrics};
use crate::bindings::interface::Ref;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::canvas_2d::context::{CanvasKind, ContextState, RenderingContext2D, paint_of};
use crate::canvas_2d::float;
use crate::canvas_2d::text::{
    baseline_offset, em_square_ascent_and_descent, horizontal_alignment_offset, path_of_runs, replace_ascii_whitespace,
    shape_text, text_transform,
};
use crate::html::canvas_rendering_context2d::CanvasTextBaseline;

impl ContextState {
    /// The outlines of the glyphs of the text, drawn at the point.
    fn text_path(&self, vm: &Vm, text: &[u16], x: f32, y: f32, max_width: Option<f64>) -> Path {
        let font = self.current_font(vm);
        let letter_spacing = self.resolved_letter_spacing();
        let word_spacing = self.resolved_word_spacing();
        let runs = shape_text(&font.cascade, text, FloatPoint { x, y }, letter_spacing, word_spacing);
        let path = path_of_runs(&runs);
        let text_width: f32 = runs.iter().map(|run| run.width).sum();
        let is_rtl = self.direction_is_rtl();
        let transform = text_transform(
            &self.drawing_state(),
            is_rtl,
            &font.cascade.first(),
            x,
            text_width,
            max_width,
        );
        path.copy_transformed(transform.values)
    }
}

/// Whether the arguments of fillText() or strokeText() let it draw.
/// INTEROP: A maxWidth of zero or less draws nothing at all, rather than a draw of no text, which an operator such as
///          copy would composite over the whole canvas.
fn arguments_let_text_draw(x: f32, y: f32, max_width: Option<f64>) -> bool {
    x.is_finite() && y.is_finite() && max_width.is_none_or(|max_width| max_width.is_finite() && max_width > 0.0)
}

impl<K: CanvasKind> RenderingContext2D<K> {
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-filltext
    pub(crate) fn fill_text(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        text: Utf16String,
        x: f64,
        y: f64,
        max_width: Option<f64>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let (x, y) = (float(x), float(y));
        if !arguments_let_text_draw(x, y, max_width) {
            return Ok(());
        }
        if !self.recorder_is_ready() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        {
            let state = self.drawing_state();
            if !state.fill_style.is_visible()
                && state.current_compositing_and_blending_operator == CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SourceOver
            {
                return Ok(());
            }
        }

        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#text-preparation-algorithm
        // 2. Replace all ASCII whitespace in text with U+0020 SPACE characters.
        let text = replace_ascii_whitespace(&text.to_utf16());

        let font = self.current_font(cx.vm());
        let letter_spacing = self.resolved_letter_spacing();
        let word_spacing = self.resolved_word_spacing();
        let runs = shape_text(
            &font.cascade,
            &text,
            FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
            letter_spacing,
            word_spacing,
        );

        // NB: The glyphs are not filled as outlines, since the glyphs of a color font can have none. All runs are a
        //     single draw, so that the fallback fonts of the text share one shadow and one composite.
        let mut glyphs = Vec::new();
        let mut glyph_runs = Vec::with_capacity(runs.len());
        let mut text_width = 0.0;
        for run in &runs {
            text_width += run.width;
            if run.font.is_invisible() {
                continue;
            }
            let first_glyph = glyphs.len();
            glyphs.extend(
                run.glyphs
                    .placed()
                    .filter(|placed| placed.glyph.should_paint())
                    .map(DisplayListGlyph::from),
            );
            if glyphs.len() > first_glyph {
                glyph_runs.push((&run.font, glyphs.len() - first_glyph));
            }
        }
        let first_font = font.cascade.first();
        let state = self.drawing_state();
        let transform = text_transform(&state, self.direction_is_rtl(), &first_font, x, text_width, max_width);
        let translation = transform.map_point(FloatPoint { x, y });
        let horizontal_scale = transform.a();
        self.record(|recorder| {
            let paint = paint_of(recorder, &state.fill_style, self.context_attributes.color_space);
            recorder.draw_glyph_runs(
                &glyph_runs,
                &glyphs,
                translation,
                horizontal_scale,
                &paint,
                &ContextState::compositing(&state),
            );
        });
        drop(state);
        self.did_draw();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-stroketext
    pub(crate) fn stroke_text(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        text: Utf16String,
        x: f64,
        y: f64,
        max_width: Option<f64>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let (x, y) = (float(x), float(y));
        if !arguments_let_text_draw(x, y, max_width) {
            return Ok(());
        }
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#text-preparation-algorithm
        // 2. Replace all ASCII whitespace in text with U+0020 SPACE characters.
        let text = replace_ascii_whitespace(&text.to_utf16());
        self.stroke_internal(&self.text_path(cx.vm(), &text, x, y, max_width));
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-measuretext
    pub(crate) fn measure_text(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, text: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<TextMetrics>> {
        // The measureText(text) method steps are to run the text preparation algorithm, passing it text and the object
        // implementing the CanvasText interface, and then using the returned inline box return a new TextMetrics
        // object with members behaving as described in the following list:

        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#text-preparation-algorithm
        // 1. If maxWidth was provided but is less than or equal to zero or equal to NaN, then return an empty array.
        // 2. Replace all ASCII whitespace in text with U+0020 SPACE characters.
        let replaced_text = replace_ascii_whitespace(&text.to_utf16());

        // 3. Let font be the current font of target, as given by that object's font attribute.
        let font = self.current_font(cx.vm());
        let letter_spacing = self.resolved_letter_spacing();
        let word_spacing = self.resolved_word_spacing();
        let runs = shape_text(
            &font.cascade,
            &replaced_text,
            FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
            letter_spacing,
            word_spacing,
        );

        // FIXME: 4. Let language be the target's language.
        // FIXME: 5. If language is "inherit": ...
        // FIXME: 6. If language is the empty string, then set language to explicitly unknown.
        // 7. Apply the appropriate step from the following list to determine the value of direction: ...
        let is_rtl = self.direction_is_rtl();

        // 8. Form a hypothetical infinitely-wide CSS line box containing a single inline box containing the text text,
        //    with the CSS content language set to language, and with its CSS properties set as follows: ...
        // FIXME: Actually use a LineBox here instead of, you know, using the default font and measuring its size
        //        (which is not the spec at all).
        let mut width = 0.0_f32;
        for run in &runs {
            width += run.width;
        }

        // 9. If maxWidth was provided and the hypothetical width of the inline box in the hypothetical line box is
        //    greater than maxWidth CSS pixels, then change font to have a more condensed font (if one is available or
        //    if a reasonably readable one can be synthesized by applying a horizontal scale factor to the font) or a
        //    smaller font, and return to the previous step.
        // 10. The anchor point is a point on the inline box, and the physical alignment is one of the values left,
        //     right, and center. These variables are determined by the textAlign and textBaseline values.
        // NB: The horizontal position of the anchor point places the inline box below, and its vertical position is
        //     the baseline offset below.
        let alignment_offset = horizontal_alignment_offset(self.drawing_state().text_align, is_rtl, width);
        // 11. Let result be an array constructed by iterating over each glyph in the inline box from left to right (if
        //     any), adding to the array, for each glyph, the shape of the glyph as it is in the inline box, positioned
        //     on a coordinate space using CSS pixels with its origin at the anchor point.
        // 12. Return result, physical alignment, and the inline box.
        // NB: The inline box is as wide as the text, with the anchor point at the origin.
        let (box_left, box_right) = (alignment_offset, alignment_offset + width);

        // FIXME: Use the font that was used to create the glyphs of the runs.
        let first_font = font.cascade.first();
        let ascent = first_font.facts().ascent;
        let descent = first_font.facts().descent;
        let hanging_baseline = ascent * 0.8;
        let text_baseline: CanvasTextBaseline = self.drawing_state().text_baseline;
        let baseline_offset = baseline_offset(text_baseline, &first_font);
        let (em_ascent, em_descent) = em_square_ascent_and_descent(&first_font);

        // NB: The bounding rectangle of the given text is that of the ink of its glyphs, which is relative to the
        //     alphabetic baseline at the start of the inline box. Text without ink has that of the inline box.
        let ink_bounds = runs
            .iter()
            .filter(|run| !run.font.is_invisible())
            .map(|run| glyph_run_ink_bounding_box(&run.font, &run.glyphs, 1.0))
            .filter(|[_, _, width, height]| *width > 0.0 && *height > 0.0)
            .map(|[x, y, width, height]| (x, x + width, y, y + height))
            .reduce(|a, b| (a.0.min(b.0), a.1.max(b.1), a.2.min(b.2), a.3.max(b.3)));
        let (text_left, text_right, text_top, text_bottom) = match ink_bounds {
            Some((left, right, top, bottom)) => (alignment_offset + left, alignment_offset + right, top, bottom),
            None => (box_left, box_right, -ascent, descent),
        };

        let measurements = TextMeasurements {
            // width attribute: The width of that inline box, in CSS pixels. (The text's advance width.)
            width: f64::from(width),
            // actualBoundingBoxLeft attribute: The distance parallel to the baseline from the alignment point given by
            // the textAlign attribute to the left side of the bounding rectangle of the given text, in CSS pixels;
            // positive numbers indicating a distance going left from the given alignment point.
            actual_bounding_box_left: f64::from(-text_left),
            // actualBoundingBoxRight attribute: The distance parallel to the baseline from the alignment point given
            // by the textAlign attribute to the right side of the bounding rectangle of the given text, in CSS pixels;
            // positive numbers indicating a distance going right from the given alignment point.
            actual_bounding_box_right: f64::from(text_right),
            // fontBoundingBoxAscent attribute: The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline
            // attribute to the ascent metric of the first available font, in CSS pixels; positive numbers indicating
            // a distance going up from the given baseline.
            font_bounding_box_ascent: f64::from(ascent - baseline_offset),
            // fontBoundingBoxDescent attribute: The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline
            // attribute to the descent metric of the first available font, in CSS pixels; positive numbers indicating
            // a distance going down from the given baseline.
            font_bounding_box_descent: f64::from(descent + baseline_offset),
            // actualBoundingBoxAscent attribute: The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline
            // attribute to the top of the bounding rectangle of the given text, in CSS pixels; positive numbers
            // indicating a distance going up from the given baseline.
            actual_bounding_box_ascent: f64::from(-text_top - baseline_offset),
            // actualBoundingBoxDescent attribute: The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline
            // attribute to the bottom of the bounding rectangle of the given text, in CSS pixels; positive numbers
            // indicating a distance going down from the given baseline.
            actual_bounding_box_descent: f64::from(text_bottom + baseline_offset),
            // emHeightAscent attribute: The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline attribute
            // to the highest top of the em squares in the inline box, in CSS pixels; positive numbers indicating that
            // the given baseline is below the top of that em square (so this value will usually be positive). Zero if
            // the given baseline is the top of that em square; half the font size if the given baseline is the middle
            // of that em square.
            em_height_ascent: f64::from(em_ascent - baseline_offset),
            // emHeightDescent attribute: The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline attribute
            // to the lowest bottom of the em squares in the inline box, in CSS pixels; positive numbers indicating
            // that the given baseline is above the bottom of that em square. (Zero if the given baseline is the bottom
            // of that em square.)
            em_height_descent: f64::from(em_descent + baseline_offset),
            // hangingBaseline attribute: The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline attribute
            // to the hanging baseline of the inline box, in CSS pixels; positive numbers indicating that the given
            // baseline is below the hanging baseline. (Zero if the given baseline is the hanging baseline.)
            hanging_baseline: f64::from(hanging_baseline - baseline_offset),
            // alphabeticBaseline attribute: The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline
            // attribute to the alphabetic baseline of the inline box, in CSS pixels; positive numbers indicating that
            // the given baseline is below the alphabetic baseline. (Zero if the given baseline is the alphabetic
            // baseline.)
            alphabetic_baseline: f64::from(-baseline_offset),
            // ideographicBaseline attribute: The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline
            // attribute to the ideographic-under baseline of the inline box, in CSS pixels; positive numbers
            // indicating that the given baseline is below the ideographic-under baseline. (Zero if the given baseline
            // is the ideographic-under baseline.)
            ideographic_baseline: f64::from(-descent - baseline_offset),
        };

        Ok(TextMetrics::create(cx.vm(), measurements))
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/html/canvas_transform.rs
/*

//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#canvastransform
//!
//! The current default path is kept in the coordinates of the current transformation matrix, so an operation that
//! changes the matrix transforms the path by the inverse of the change.

use libgfx_rust::AffineTransform;
use libjs_rust::api::Vm;

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::canvas_2d::context::{CanvasKind, RenderingContext2D, multiply_transforms, rotated, scaled, translated};
use crate::canvas_2d::float;
use crate::geometry::dictionaries::{DOMMatrix2DInit, validate_and_fixup_2d};
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix::DOMMatrix;
use crate::geometry::dom_matrix_read_only::DOMMatrixReadOnly;

fn all_finite(values: &[f64]) -> bool {
    values.iter().all(|value| value.is_finite())
}

impl<K: CanvasKind> RenderingContext2D<K> {
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-scale
    pub(crate) fn scale(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, x: f64, y: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let (x, y) = (float(x), float(y));
        if !x.is_finite() || !y.is_finite() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        {
            let mut state = self.drawing_state_mut(cx.vm());
            state.transform = scaled(state.transform, x, y);
        }
        self.flush_transform();
        // NB: A zero factor leaves the matrix without an inverse, and then there is no 1 / x or 1 / y.
        self.keep_path_in_place_after_multiplication(|| {
            Some(scaled(
                AffineTransform::identity(),
                float(1.0 / f64::from(x)),
                float(1.0 / f64::from(y)),
            ))
        });
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-translate
    pub(crate) fn translate(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, x: f64, y: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let (x, y) = (float(x), float(y));
        if !x.is_finite() || !y.is_finite() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        {
            let mut state = self.drawing_state_mut(cx.vm());
            state.transform = translated(state.transform, x, y);
        }
        self.flush_transform();
        self.keep_path_in_place_after_multiplication(|| Some(translated(AffineTransform::identity(), -x, -y)));
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-rotate
    pub(crate) fn rotate(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, radians: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let radians = float(radians);
        if !radians.is_finite() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        {
            let mut state = self.drawing_state_mut(cx.vm());
            state.transform = rotated(state.transform, radians);
        }
        self.flush_transform();
        self.keep_path_in_place_after_multiplication(|| Some(rotated(AffineTransform::identity(), -radians)));
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-transform
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the arguments of transform()")]
    pub(crate) fn transform(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        a: f64,
        b: f64,
        c: f64,
        d: f64,
        e: f64,
        f: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.multiply_transform(cx.vm(), a, b, c, d, e, f);
        Ok(())
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the arguments of transform()")]
    fn multiply_transform(&self, vm: &Vm, a: f64, b: f64, c: f64, d: f64, e: f64, f: f64) {
        // 1. If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN, then return.
        if !all_finite(&[a, b, c, d, e, f]) {
            return;
        }

        // 2. Replace the current transformation matrix with the result of multiplying the current transformation
        //    matrix with the matrix described by:
        //    a c e
        //    b d f
        //    0 0 1
        let transform = AffineTransform::new(float(a), float(b), float(c), float(d), float(e), float(f));
        {
            let mut state = self.drawing_state_mut(vm);
            state.transform = multiply_transforms(state.transform, transform);
        }

        self.keep_path_in_place_after_multiplication(|| transform.inverse());
        self.flush_transform();
    }

    /// Moves the current default path into the coordinates of the current transformation matrix, after a
    /// multiplication of the matrix with another whose inverse is given, so that the points of the path stay where
    /// they were on the output bitmap when they were added.
    ///
    /// NB: A path cannot be kept in the coordinates of a matrix that is not invertible. When a multiplication leaves
    ///     the matrix without an inverse, the path stays in the coordinates of the last matrix that was invertible,
    ///     and every later multiplication leaves the matrix without one too. keep_path_in_place() moves the path from
    ///     there when the matrix is replaced with an invertible one again.
    fn keep_path_in_place_after_multiplication(
        &self,
        inverse_of_multiplication: impl FnOnce() -> Option<AffineTransform>,
    ) {
        let transform = self.drawing_state().transform;
        if transform.inverse().is_none() {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(inverse) = inverse_of_multiplication() {
            self.transform_path(inverse);
        }
        self.set_path_transform(transform);
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-gettransform
    pub(crate) fn get_transform(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMMatrix>> {
        // The getTransform() method, when invoked, must return a newly created DOMMatrix representing a copy of the
        // current transformation matrix matrix of the context.
        let transform = self.drawing_state().transform;
        let elements = transform.values.map(f64::from);
        let matrix = DOMMatrix::from_read_only(DOMMatrixReadOnly::create_2d_matrix(elements));
        Ok(allocate(cx.vm(), |_| matrix))
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-settransform
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the arguments of setTransform()")]
    pub(crate) fn set_transform(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        a: f64,
        b: f64,
        c: f64,
        d: f64,
        e: f64,
        f: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN, then return.
        if !all_finite(&[a, b, c, d, e, f]) {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 2. Reset the current transformation matrix to the matrix described by:
        //    a c e
        //    b d f
        //    0 0 1
        self.set_current_transform(
            cx.vm(),
            AffineTransform::new(float(a), float(b), float(c), float(d), float(e), float(f)),
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-settransform-matrix
    pub(crate) fn set_transform_to_matrix(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, transform: DOMMatrix2DInit) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Let matrix be the result of creating a DOMMatrix from the 2D dictionary transform.
        let matrix = validate_and_fixup_2d(&transform)?;

        // 2. If one or more of matrix's m11 element, m12 element, m21 element, m22 element, m41 element, or m42
        //    element are infinite or NaN, then return.
        if !matrix.is_finite() {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 3. Reset the current transformation matrix to matrix.
        self.set_current_transform(cx.vm(), matrix.to_affine_transform());
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-resettransform
    pub(crate) fn reset_transform(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The resetTransform() method, when invoked, must reset the current transformation matrix to the identity
        // matrix.
        self.set_current_transform(cx.vm(), AffineTransform::identity());
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Replaces the current transformation matrix, which leaves the current default path where it is on the output
    /// bitmap.
    fn set_current_transform(&self, vm: &Vm, transform: AffineTransform) {
        self.drawing_state_mut(vm).transform = transform;
        self.keep_path_in_place();
        self.flush_transform();
    }

    /// Moves the current default path into the coordinates of the current transformation matrix, after a change of
    /// the matrix that is not a multiplication with another, so that the points of the path stay where they were on
    /// the output bitmap when they were added.
    pub(crate) fn keep_path_in_place(&self) {
        let transform = self.drawing_state().transform;
        // NB: A path cannot be kept in the coordinates of a matrix that is not invertible, so it stays in those of the
        //     last matrix that was, as it does for a multiplication.
        let Some(inverse) = transform.inverse() else {
            return;
        };
        let path_transform = self.path_transform();
        self.set_path_transform(transform);
        if transform.values == path_transform.values {
            return;
        }
        self.transform_path(multiply_transforms(inverse, path_transform));
    }
}

/*

//! The color stops of a CanvasGradient, kept in the order of their positions. Stops at the same position stay in
//! the order they were added in, as the spec says.

use libgfx_rust::Color;

use super::predefined_color_space::PredefinedColorSpace;

/// The number of predefined color spaces.
const COLOR_SPACE_COUNT: usize = 4;

/// The color stops, as the parallel arrays of colors and positions that a paint lends the recorder. A gradient can
/// paint in a context of any color space, so the colors of its stops are kept in each of them.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct ColorStopList {
    colors: [Vec<Color>; COLOR_SPACE_COUNT],
    positions: Vec<f32>,
}

impl ColorStopList {
    /// The colors of the stops in the color space.
    pub(crate) fn colors(&self, color_space: PredefinedColorSpace) -> &[Color] {
        &self.colors[color_space as usize]
    }

    pub(crate) fn positions(&self) -> &[f32] {
        &self.positions
    }

    /// Places the stop after every stop at a position that is not greater than its own. Its color is given in each
    /// color space, in the order of PredefinedColorSpace.
    pub(crate) fn add(&mut self, position: f32, colors: [Color; COLOR_SPACE_COUNT]) {
        let index = self.positions.partition_point(|&other| other <= position);
        self.positions.insert(index, position);
        for (list, color) in self.colors.iter_mut().zip(colors) {
            list.insert(index, color);
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{ColorStopList, PredefinedColorSpace};
    use libgfx_rust::Color;

    #[test]
    fn stops_are_sorted_by_position() {
        let mut stops = ColorStopList::default();
        stops.add(0.5, [Color(1); 4]);
        stops.add(0.0, [Color(2); 4]);
        stops.add(1.0, [Color(3); 4]);
        stops.add(0.25, [Color(4); 4]);
        assert_eq!(stops.positions(), [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0]);
        assert_eq!(
            stops.colors(PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb),
            [Color(2), Color(4), Color(1), Color(3)]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn stops_at_one_position_stay_in_the_order_they_were_added() {
        let mut stops = ColorStopList::default();
        for color in 0..20 {
            stops.add(0.5, [Color(color); 4]);
        }
        assert_eq!(
            stops.colors(PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb),
            (0..20).map(Color).collect::<Vec<_>>()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn stops_at_several_positions_stay_in_the_order_they_were_added() {
        let mut stops = ColorStopList::default();
        let positions = [0.5, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 0.5, 0.1, 0.5, 0.3, 0.5, 0.1, 0.7, 0.5];
        for (color, position) in (0..).zip(positions) {
            stops.add(position, [Color(color); 4]);
        }
        assert_eq!(
            stops.positions(),
            [0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            stops.colors(PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb),
            [1, 5, 9, 7, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 11, 10, 3].map(Color)
        );
    }
}

//! CommandEvent, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#commandevent

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use crate::bindings::conversions::CppInterface;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::{CppCell, LentCppCell, cpp_class};
use crate::bindings::event_target::CppEvent;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::lent_string::{LentUtf16FlyString, LentUtf16String};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::css::css_rule::wrap_cpp_cell;
use crate::dom::event::EventInit;

/// The dictionary CommandEventInit of HTML/CommandEvent.idl.
pub(crate) struct CommandEventInit {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) source: Option<CppInterface>,
    pub(crate) command: Utf16String,
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#commandevent
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CommandEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    source: Option<CppCell>,
    command: Utf16String,
}

impl Wrappable for CommandEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl CommandEvent {
    fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: &EventInit,
        source: Option<CppCell>,
        command: Utf16String,
    ) -> Ref<CommandEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.bubbles,
            event_init.cancelable,
            event_init.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| CommandEvent { event, source, command });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init_dict: CommandEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<CommandEvent>> {
        let source = event_init_dict.source.map(CppInterface::cell);
        Ok(Self::create(
            cx.vm(),
            cx.realm(),
            &r#type,
            &event_init_dict.parent,
            source,
            event_init_dict.command,
        ))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#dom-commandevent-source
    pub(crate) fn source(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<CppInterface>> {
        // The source getter steps are to return the result of retargeting source against this's currentTarget.
        Ok(self.source.as_ref().map(|source| {
            let source = self.event.retarget_against_current_target(source);
            wrap_cpp_cell(cx, &source)
        }))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#dom-commandevent-command
    pub(crate) fn command(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.command.clone())
    }
}

/// The Event of a new trusted CommandEvent in the realm, for the implementation to fire.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "C++ passes each member of the dictionary")]
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_command_event_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    r#type: LentUtf16FlyString<'_>,
    bubbles: bool,
    cancelable: bool,
    composed: bool,
    source: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::Element>,
    command: LentUtf16String<'_>,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let event_init = EventInit {
        bubbles,
        cancelable,
        composed,
    };
    let r#type: Utf16String = r#type.to_utf16_fly_string().into();
    let source = CppCell::from_lent(source);
    let event = CommandEvent::create(vm, realm, &r#type, &event_init, Some(source), command.to_utf16_string());
    event.event().as_ptr()
}

//! DataTransferItemList, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#the-datatransferitemlist-interface

use ak::{Utf16FlyString, Utf16String};
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Utf16StringBuilder, Utf16View, Vm};

use super::data_transfer::{DataTransfer, READ_WRITE};
use super::data_transfer_item::DataTransferItem;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::file_api::file::File;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct DataTransferItemList {
    data_transfer: Ref<DataTransfer>,
}

impl Wrappable for DataTransferItemList {}

impl DataTransferItemList {
    pub(super) fn create(vm: &Vm, data_transfer: Ref<DataTransfer>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self { data_transfer })
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransferitemlist-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // The length attribute must return zero if the object is in the disabled mode; otherwise it must return the number
        // of items in the drag data store item list.
        let length = self.data_transfer.store().map_or(0, |store| store.len());
        Ok(u32::try_from(length).expect("a transfer has fewer than 2^32 items"))
    }

    pub(crate) fn item(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DataTransferItem>> {
        // The generated indexed property getter checks the index against length.
        Ok(self.data_transfer.item(index as usize))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransferitemlist-add
    pub(crate) fn add_string(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        data: Utf16String,
        type_string: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<DataTransferItem>>> {
        // 1. If the DataTransferItemList object is not in the read/write mode, return null.
        let Some(store) = self.data_transfer.store().filter(|store| store.mode() == READ_WRITE) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };

        // 2. Jump to the appropriate set of steps from the following list:
        //    -> If the first argument to the method is a string

        // If there is already an item in the drag data store item list whose kind is text and whose type string is equal
        // to the value of the method's second argument, converted to ASCII lowercase, then throw a "NotSupportedError"
        // DOMException.
        let format = Utf16View::of_string(&type_string);
        if (0..store.len()).any(|index| {
            let (is_file, item_type, _) = store.item(index);
            !is_file && Utf16View::of_fly_string(&item_type).equals_ignoring_ascii_case(format)
        }) {
            let mut message = Utf16StringBuilder::new();
            message.append_ascii("There is already a DataTransferItem with type ");
            message.append(format);
            return Err(Exception::Dom("NotSupportedError", message.to_utf16_string()));
        }

        // Otherwise, add an item to the drag data store item list whose kind is text, whose type string is equal to the
        // value of the method's second argument, converted to ASCII lowercase, and whose data is the string given by the
        // method's first argument.
        let lowercase_type = Utf16FlyString::from_utf16_string(&type_string.to_ascii_lowercase());
        store.add_text(&lowercase_type, &data);

        // 3. Determine the value of the indexed property corresponding to the newly added item, and return that value (a
        //    newly created DataTransferItem object).
        Ok(Some(DataTransfer::did_add_item(&self.data_transfer, cx.vm())))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransferitemlist-add
    pub(crate) fn add_file(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        file: Ref<File>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<DataTransferItem>>> {
        // 1. If the DataTransferItemList object is not in the read/write mode, return null.
        let Some(store) = self.data_transfer.store().filter(|store| store.mode() == READ_WRITE) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };

        // 2. Jump to the appropriate set of steps from the following list:
        //     -> If the first argument to the method is a File

        // Add an item to the drag data store item list whose kind is File, whose type string is the type of the File,
        // converted to ASCII lowercase, and whose data is the same as the File's data.
        store.add_file(file);

        // 3. Determine the value of the indexed property corresponding to the newly added item, and return that value (a
        //    newly created DataTransferItem object).
        Ok(Some(DataTransfer::did_add_item(&self.data_transfer, cx.vm())))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransferitemlist-remove
    pub(crate) fn remove(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If the DataTransferItemList object is not in the read/write mode, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        let Some(store) = self.data_transfer.store().filter(|store| store.mode() == READ_WRITE) else {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"DataTransferItemList is not in read/write mode"),
            ));
        };

        // 2. If the drag data store does not contain an indexth item, then return.
        let index = index as usize;
        if index >= store.len() {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 3. Remove the indexth item from the drag data store.
        self.data_transfer.remove_item(cx.vm(), index);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransferitemlist-clear
    pub(crate) fn clear(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The clear() method, if the DataTransferItemList object is in the read/write mode, must remove all the items from
        // the drag data store. Otherwise, it must do nothing.
        let Some(store) = self.data_transfer.store().filter(|store| store.mode() == READ_WRITE) else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        for index in (0..store.len()).rev() {
            self.data_transfer.remove_item(cx.vm(), index);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

//! DataTransferItem, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#the-datatransferitem-interface

use core::cell::{self, Cell};

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{PrimitiveString, Trace, Value, Vm};

use super::data_transfer::{DataTransfer, DragDataStore, PROTECTED};
use crate::bindings::callback::CallbackFunction;
use crate::bindings::conversions::CppInterface;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::promise::{TaskSource, queue_a_task};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::file_api::file::File;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct DataTransferItem {
    data_transfer: Ref<DataTransfer>,
    index: Cell<Option<usize>>,
}

impl Wrappable for DataTransferItem {}

impl DataTransferItem {
    pub(super) fn create(vm: &Vm, data_transfer: Ref<DataTransfer>, index: usize) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            data_transfer,
            index: Cell::new(Some(index)),
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn set_index(&self, index: Option<usize>) {
        self.index.set(index);
    }

    fn store_and_index(&self) -> Option<(cell::Ref<'_, DragDataStore>, usize)> {
        let index = self.index.get()?;
        Some((self.data_transfer.store()?, index))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransferitem-kind
    pub(crate) fn kind(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The kind attribute must return the empty string if the DataTransferItem object is in the disabled mode; otherwise
        // it must return the string given in the cell from the second column of the following table from the row whose cell
        // in the first column contains the drag data item kind of the item represented by the DataTransferItem object:
        //
        //     Kind | String
        //     ---------------
        //     Text | "string"
        //     File | "file"
        let Some((store, index)) = self.store_and_index() else {
            return Ok(Utf16String::default());
        };
        let (is_file, _, _) = store.item(index);
        Ok(Utf16String::from_ascii(if is_file { b"file" } else { b"string" }))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransferitem-type
    pub(crate) fn r#type(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The type attribute must return the empty string if the DataTransferItem object is in the disabled mode; otherwise
        // it must return the drag data item type string of the item represented by the DataTransferItem object.
        let Some((store, index)) = self.store_and_index() else {
            return Ok(Utf16String::default());
        };
        let (_, type_string, _) = store.item(index);
        Ok(Utf16String::from(type_string))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransferitem-getasstring
    pub(crate) fn get_as_string(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, callback: Option<CallbackFunction>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If the callback is null, return.
        let Some(callback) = callback else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        // 2. If the DataTransferItem object is not in the read/write mode or the read-only mode, return. The callback is
        //    never invoked.
        let Some((store, index)) = self.store_and_index().filter(|(store, _)| store.mode() != PROTECTED) else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        // 3. If the drag data item kind is not text, then return. The callback is never invoked.
        let (is_file, _, data) = store.item(index);
        if is_file {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 4. Otherwise, queue a task to invoke callback, passing the actual data of the item represented by the
        //    DataTransferItem object as the argument.
        queue_a_task(
            cx.vm(),
            TaskSource::Unspecified,
            (callback, data),
            |vm, (callback, data)| {
                let data = Value::from_string(PrimitiveString::create(vm, data));
                // AD-HOC: The spec gives no exception behavior, which WebIDL requires for this callback.
                //         Report exceptions.
                callback.invoke_and_report(&[data]);
            },
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransferitem-getasfile
    pub(crate) fn get_as_file(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<File>>> {
        // 1. If the DataTransferItem object is not in the read/write mode or the read-only mode, then return null.
        let Some((store, index)) = self.store_and_index().filter(|(store, _)| store.mode() != PROTECTED) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };

        // 2. If the drag data item kind is not File, then return null.
        let (is_file, _, _) = store.item(index);
        if !is_file {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        // 3. Return a new File object representing the actual data of the item represented by the DataTransferItem object.
        Ok(Some(store.create_file(index)))
    }

    // https://wicg.github.io/entries-api/#dom-datatransferitem-webkitgetasentry
    pub(crate) fn webkit_get_as_entry(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<CppInterface>> {
        // 1. Let store be this's DataTransfer object’s drag data store.

        // 2. If store’s drag data store mode is not read/write mode or read-only mode, return null and abort these steps
        let Some((store, index)) = self.store_and_index().filter(|(store, _)| store.mode() != PROTECTED) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };

        // 3. Let item be the item in store’s drag data store item list that this represents.
        let (is_file, _, _) = store.item(index);

        // 4. If item’s kind is not File, then return null and abort these steps.
        if !is_file {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        // 5. Return a new FileSystemEntry object representing the entry.
        Ok(Some(store.create_file_entry(index, cx.realm())))
    }
}

//! DataTransfer, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#the-datatransfer-interface

use core::cell::{self, Cell, RefCell};
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::{Utf16FlyString, Utf16String};
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, Must, Object, Realm, Trace, Utf16View, Value, Vm};

use super::data_transfer_item::DataTransferItem;
use super::data_transfer_item_list::DataTransferItemList;
use crate::bindings::conversions::{CppInterface, ToJs, frozen_array_to_js, sequence_to_js};
use crate::bindings::interface::{InterfaceCell, Ref, Wrappable, allocate, cell_from_abi, cell_into_abi};
use crate::bindings::lent_string::LentUtf16FlyString;
use crate::bindings::setlike::WorldEntries;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::file_api::file::File;
use crate::file_api::file_list::FileList;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_data_transfer_create_writable_store() -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_data_transfer_store_unref(store: *mut c_void);
    fn web_data_transfer_store_mode(store: *mut c_void) -> u8;
    fn web_data_transfer_store_size(store: *mut c_void) -> usize;
    fn web_data_transfer_store_item(store: *mut c_void, index: usize) -> DragDataStoreItemView;
    fn web_data_transfer_store_add_text(store: *mut c_void, type_: usize, data: usize);
    fn web_data_transfer_store_remove_item(store: *mut c_void, index: usize);
    fn web_data_transfer_store_add_file(store: *mut c_void, file: *mut c_void);
    fn web_data_transfer_create_file(store: *mut c_void, index: usize) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_data_transfer_create_file_entry(store: *mut c_void, index: usize, realm: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
}

pub(super) const READ_WRITE: u8 = 0;
pub(super) const PROTECTED: u8 = 2;

// The store is shared with the native drag, drop and clipboard handlers. This holds one reference to it.
pub(super) struct DragDataStore(NonNull<c_void>);

impl Drop for DragDataStore {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: This owns a reference to the store.
        unsafe { web_data_transfer_store_unref(self.0.as_ptr()) };
    }
}

#[repr(C)]
struct DragDataStoreItemView {
    type_string: usize,
    data: usize,
    is_file: bool,
}

impl DragDataStore {
    pub(super) fn mode(&self) -> u8 {
        // SAFETY: This holds the store alive.
        unsafe { web_data_transfer_store_mode(self.0.as_ptr()) }
    }

    pub(super) fn len(&self) -> usize {
        // SAFETY: This holds the store alive.
        unsafe { web_data_transfer_store_size(self.0.as_ptr()) }
    }

    pub(super) fn item(&self, index: usize) -> (bool, Utf16FlyString, Utf16String) {
        // SAFETY: All callers pass an index within the live store. The strings are lent by that item.
        unsafe {
            let item = web_data_transfer_store_item(self.0.as_ptr(), index);
            (
                item.is_file,
                Utf16FlyString::from_raw_borrowed(item.type_string),
                Utf16String::from_raw_borrowed(item.data),
            )
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn add_text(&self, type_string: &Utf16FlyString, data: &Utf16String) {
        // SAFETY: This holds the store alive and the strings are lent for the call.
        unsafe { web_data_transfer_store_add_text(self.0.as_ptr(), type_string.raw_identity(), data.raw_identity()) };
    }

    pub(super) fn add_file(&self, file: Ref<File>) {
        // SAFETY: This holds the store alive and the file is live.
        unsafe { web_data_transfer_store_add_file(self.0.as_ptr(), cell_into_abi(file)) };
    }

    pub(super) fn create_file(&self, index: usize) -> Ref<File> {
        // SAFETY: This holds the store alive, and the index refers to a file item. LibWeb returns the new File cell.
        unsafe { cell_from_abi(web_data_transfer_create_file(self.0.as_ptr(), index)) }
    }

    pub(super) fn create_file_entry(&self, index: usize, realm: Gc<Realm>) -> CppInterface {
        // SAFETY: The store and realm are live, and the index refers to a file item.
        let wrapper = unsafe { web_data_transfer_create_file_entry(self.0.as_ptr(), index, realm.as_ptr().cast()) };
        let wrapper = NonNull::new(wrapper.cast()).expect("LibWeb wraps the file entry");
        // SAFETY: LibWeb returns a live FileSystemEntry wrapper.
        unsafe { CppInterface::from_wrapper(Gc::from_non_null(wrapper)) }
    }

    fn remove_item(&self, index: usize) {
        // SAFETY: The transfer's item list and the store have matching indices.
        unsafe { web_data_transfer_store_remove_item(self.0.as_ptr(), index) };
    }
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct DataTransfer {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    store: RefCell<Option<DragDataStore>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    drop_effect: RefCell<Utf16FlyString>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    effect_allowed: RefCell<Utf16FlyString>,
    items: Cell<Option<Ref<DataTransferItemList>>>,
    item_list: GcRefCell<Vec<Ref<DataTransferItem>>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    types: RefCell<Vec<Utf16String>>,
    types_arrays: WorldEntries<Object>,
}

impl Wrappable for DataTransfer {}

impl DataTransfer {
    fn create(vm: &Vm, store: DragDataStore) -> Ref<Self> {
        let count = store.len();
        let transfer = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            store: RefCell::new(Some(store)),
            drop_effect: RefCell::new(Utf16FlyString::from_utf8("none")),
            effect_allowed: RefCell::new(Utf16FlyString::from_utf8("none")),
            items: Cell::default(),
            item_list: GcRefCell::new(Vec::with_capacity(count)),
            types: RefCell::default(),
            types_arrays: WorldEntries::default(),
        });

        for index in 0..count {
            Self::append_item(&transfer, vm, index);
        }
        transfer.update_types();
        transfer
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransfer
    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. Set the drag data store's item list to be an empty list.
        // 2. Set the drag data store's mode to read/write mode.
        // SAFETY: LibWeb transfers one reference to a new, empty read/write store.
        let store = unsafe { web_data_transfer_create_writable_store() };
        let store = DragDataStore(NonNull::new(store).expect("LibWeb creates a drag data store"));

        // 3. Set the dropEffect and effectAllowed to "none".
        // NB: create() sets both to "none".
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), store))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransfer-dropeffect
    pub(crate) fn drop_effect(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(Utf16String::from(&*self.drop_effect.borrow()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_drop_effect(&self, _: &mut CallContext, effect: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.set_drop_effect_value(Utf16FlyString::from_utf16_string(&effect));
        Ok(())
    }

    fn set_drop_effect_value(&self, effect: Utf16FlyString) {
        // On setting, if the new value is one of "none", "copy", "link", or "move", then the attribute's current value
        // must be set to the new value. Other values must be ignored.
        let value = Utf16String::from(&effect);
        if ["none", "copy", "link", "move"].iter().any(|valid| value == *valid) {
            *self.drop_effect.borrow_mut() = effect;
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransfer-effectallowed
    pub(crate) fn effect_allowed(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(Utf16String::from(&*self.effect_allowed.borrow()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_effect_allowed(&self, _: &mut CallContext, effect: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // On setting, if the drag data store's mode is the read/write mode and the new value is one of "none", "copy",
        // "copyLink", "copyMove", "link", "linkMove", "move", "all", or "uninitialized", then the attribute's current
        // value must be set to the new value. Otherwise, it must be left unchanged.
        if self
            .store
            .borrow()
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|store| store.mode() == READ_WRITE)
        {
            self.set_effect_allowed_internal(Utf16FlyString::from_utf16_string(&effect));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn set_effect_allowed_internal(&self, effect: Utf16FlyString) {
        // AD-HOC: We need to be able to set the effectAllowed attribute internally regardless of the state of the drag
        //         data store.
        let value = Utf16String::from(&effect);
        if [
            "none",
            "copy",
            "copyLink",
            "copyMove",
            "link",
            "linkMove",
            "move",
            "all",
            "uninitialized",
        ]
        .iter()
        .any(|valid| value == *valid)
        {
            *self.effect_allowed.borrow_mut() = effect;
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransfer-items
    pub(crate) fn items(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DataTransferItemList>> {
        // The items attribute must return a DataTransferItemList object associated with the DataTransfer object.
        Ok(this.items.get().unwrap_or_else(|| {
            let items = DataTransferItemList::create(cx.vm(), *this);
            this.items.set(Some(items));
            items
        }))
    }

    pub(super) fn store(&self) -> Option<cell::Ref<'_, DragDataStore>> {
        cell::Ref::filter_map(self.store.borrow(), Option::as_ref).ok()
    }

    pub(super) fn item(&self, index: usize) -> Ref<DataTransferItem> {
        self.item_list.borrow()[index]
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransfer-types
    pub(crate) fn types(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The types attribute must return this DataTransfer object's types array.
        let array = self.types_arrays.get_or_create(cx, || {
            let types = self.types.borrow().clone();
            let array = sequence_to_js(cx, types, |r#type| r#type.to_js(cx));
            frozen_array_to_js(cx, array).must().as_object()
        });
        Ok(Value::from_object(array))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransfer-getdata
    pub(crate) fn get_data(&self, _: &mut CallContext, format: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // 1. If the DataTransfer object is no longer associated with a drag data store, then return the empty string.
        let store = self.store.borrow();
        let Some(store) = store.as_ref() else {
            return Ok(Utf16String::default());
        };

        // 2. If the drag data store's mode is the protected mode, then return the empty string.
        if store.mode() == PROTECTED {
            return Ok(Utf16String::default());
        }

        // 3. Let format be the first argument, converted to ASCII lowercase.
        // 4. Let convert-to-URL be false.
        // 5. If format equals "text", change it to "text/plain".
        // 6. If format equals "url", change it to "text/uri-list" and set convert-to-URL to true.
        let format = normalize_format(&format);

        // 7. If there is no item in the drag data store item list whose kind is text and whose type string is equal to
        //    format, return the empty string.
        let index = (0..store.len()).find(|&index| {
            let (is_file, type_string, _) = store.item(index);
            !is_file && Utf16View::of_fly_string(&type_string).equals_ignoring_ascii_case(format)
        });
        let Some(index) = index else {
            return Ok(Utf16String::default());
        };

        // 8. Let result be the data of the item in the drag data store item list whose kind is Plain Unicode string and
        //    whose type string is equal to format.
        let (_, _, result) = store.item(index);

        // FIXME: 9. If convert-to-URL is true, then parse result as appropriate for text/uri-list data, and then set
        //           result to the first URL from the list, if any, or the empty string otherwise.

        // 10. Return result.
        Ok(result)
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransfer-setdata
    pub(crate) fn set_data(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        format: Utf16String,
        data: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If the DataTransfer object is no longer associated with a drag data store, return. Nothing happens.
        let store = this.store.borrow();
        let Some(store) = store.as_ref() else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        // 2. If the drag data store's mode is not the read/write mode, return. Nothing happens.
        if store.mode() != READ_WRITE {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 3. Let format be the first argument, converted to ASCII lowercase.
        let format = format.to_ascii_lowercase();

        // 4. If format equals "text", change it to "text/plain". If format equals "url", change it to "text/uri-list".
        let format = normalize_format(&format).to_utf16_fly_string();

        // 5. Remove the item in the drag data store item list whose kind is text and whose type string is equal to
        //    format, if there is one.
        let previous_item = (0..store.len()).find(|&index| {
            let (is_file, type_string, _) = store.item(index);
            !is_file && type_string == format
        });
        if let Some(index) = previous_item {
            this.remove_item(cx.vm(), index);
        }

        // 6. Add an item to the drag data store item list whose kind is text, whose type string is equal to format, and
        //    whose data is the string given by the method's second argument.
        store.add_text(&format, &data);
        Self::did_add_item(this, cx.vm());
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransfer-cleardata
    pub(crate) fn clear_data(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, format: Option<Utf16String>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If the DataTransfer object is no longer associated with a drag data store, return. Nothing happens.
        let store = self.store.borrow();
        let Some(store) = store.as_ref() else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        // 2. If the drag data store's mode is not the read/write mode, return. Nothing happens.
        if store.mode() != READ_WRITE {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 3. If the method was called with no arguments, remove each item in the drag data store item list whose kind is
        //    Plain Unicode string, and return.
        let Some(format) = format else {
            self.remove_text_items(cx.vm(), store, |_| true);
            return Ok(());
        };

        // 4. Set format to format, converted to ASCII lowercase.
        // 5. If format equals "text", change it to "text/plain". If format equals "url", change it to "text/uri-list".
        let format = normalize_format(&format);

        // 6. Remove the item in the drag data store item list whose kind is text and whose type string is equal to
        //    format, if there is one.
        self.remove_text_items(cx.vm(), store, |type_string| {
            Utf16View::of_fly_string(type_string).equals_ignoring_ascii_case(format)
        });
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#dom-datatransfer-files
    pub(crate) fn files(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<FileList>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Start with an empty list L.
        let files = allocate(vm, |defer_gc| FileList::new(defer_gc, &[]));

        // 2. If the DataTransfer object is no longer associated with a drag data store, the FileList is empty. Return
        //    the empty list L.
        let store = self.store.borrow();
        let Some(store) = store.as_ref() else {
            return Ok(files);
        };

        // 3. If the drag data store's mode is the protected mode, return the empty list L.
        if store.mode() == PROTECTED {
            return Ok(files);
        }

        // 4. For each item in the drag data store item list whose kind is File, add the item's data (the file, in
        //    particular its name and contents, as well as its type) to the list L.
        for index in 0..store.len() {
            let (is_file, _, _) = store.item(index);
            if is_file {
                files.add_file(vm, store.create_file(index));
            }
        }

        // 5. The files found by these steps are those in the list L.
        Ok(files)
    }

    fn append_item(this: &Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm, index: usize) -> Ref<DataTransferItem> {
        let item = DataTransferItem::create(vm, *this, index);
        this.item_list.borrow_mut(vm).push(item);
        item
    }

    pub(super) fn did_add_item(this: &Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm) -> Ref<DataTransferItem> {
        let index = this.item_list.borrow().len();
        let item = Self::append_item(this, vm, index);
        this.update_types();
        item
    }

    pub(super) fn remove_item(&self, vm: &Vm, index: usize) {
        let mut items = self.item_list.borrow_mut(vm);
        let store = self.store().expect("removing an item requires a drag data store");
        store.remove_item(index);
        items.remove(index).set_index(None);
        for (index, item) in items.iter().enumerate().skip(index) {
            item.set_index(Some(index));
        }
        drop(items);
        self.update_types();
    }

    fn remove_text_items(&self, vm: &Vm, store: &DragDataStore, matches: impl Fn(&Utf16FlyString) -> bool) {
        for index in (0..store.len()).rev() {
            let (is_file, type_string, _) = store.item(index);
            if !is_file && matches(&type_string) {
                self.remove_item(vm, index);
            }
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#concept-datatransfer-types
    fn update_types(&self) {
        // 1. Let L be an empty sequence.
        let mut types = Vec::new();

        // 2. If the DataTransfer object is still associated with a drag data store:
        if let Some(store) = self.store.borrow().as_ref() {
            let mut contains_file = false;

            // 1. For each item in the DataTransfer object's drag data store item list whose kind is text, add an entry
            //    to L consisting of the item's type string.
            for index in 0..store.len() {
                let (is_file, type_string, _) = store.item(index);
                if is_file {
                    contains_file = true;
                } else {
                    types.push(Utf16String::from(type_string));
                }
            }

            // 2. If there are any items in the DataTransfer object's drag data store item list whose kind is File, then
            //    add an entry to L consisting of the string "Files". (This value can be distinguished from the other
            //    values because it is not lowercase.)
            if contains_file {
                types.push(Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Files"));
            }
        }

        // 3. Set the DataTransfer object's types array to the result of creating a frozen array from L.
        *self.types.borrow_mut() = types;
        self.types_arrays.clear();
    }
}

fn normalize_format(format: &Utf16String) -> Utf16View<'_> {
    let format = Utf16View::of_string(format);
    if format.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(Utf16View::Ascii(b"text")) {
        Utf16View::Ascii(b"text/plain")
    } else if format.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(Utf16View::Ascii(b"url")) {
        Utf16View::Ascii(b"text/uri-list")
    } else {
        format
    }
}

/// # Safety
///
/// The caller transfers one ownership reference to a live drag data store.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_data_transfer_create(vm: &Vm, store: NonNull<c_void>) -> *mut c_void {
    cell_into_abi(DataTransfer::create(vm, DragDataStore(store)))
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_data_transfer_disassociate(transfer: &InterfaceCell) {
    let transfer = transfer.object::<DataTransfer>();
    transfer.store.borrow_mut().take();
    transfer.update_types();
}

//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/common-dom-interfaces.html#domstringlist

use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::{Span, Utf16String};
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate, cell_into_abi};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct DOMStringList {
    strings: Vec<Utf16String>,
}

impl Wrappable for DOMStringList {}

impl DOMStringList {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, strings: Vec<Utf16String>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self { strings })
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/common-dom-interfaces.html#dom-domstringlist-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // The length getter steps are to return this's associated list's size.
        Ok(u32::try_from(self.strings.len()).expect("a DOMStringList has fewer than 2^32 strings"))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/common-dom-interfaces.html#dom-domstringlist-item
    pub(crate) fn item(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        // The item(index) method steps are to return the indexth item in this's associated list, or null if index
        // plus one is greater than this's associated list's size.
        Ok(self.strings.get(index as usize).cloned())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/common-dom-interfaces.html#dom-domstringlist-contains
    pub(crate) fn contains(&self, _: &mut CallContext, string: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The contains(string) method steps are to return true if this's associated list contains string, and
        // false otherwise.
        Ok(self.strings.contains(&string))
    }
}

/// # Safety
///
/// The caller passes the live VM and transfers ownership of each string in the span.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_dom_string_list_create(vm: &Vm, strings: Span<'_, usize>) -> *mut c_void {
    let strings = strings
        .as_slice()
        .iter()
        // SAFETY: The caller transfers one reference for each string.
        .map(|&string| unsafe { Utf16String::from_raw_owned(string) })
        .collect();
    cell_into_abi(DOMStringList::create(vm, strings))
}
