//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#domstringmap

use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::{Utf16FlyString, Utf16String};
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Utf16StringBuilder, Utf16View, Vm};

use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::{LentCppCell, cpp_class};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Wrappable, allocate, cell_into_abi};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::element::{CppElement, is_valid_attribute_local_name};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct DOMStringMap {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#concept-domstringmap-element
    associated_element: CppElement,
}

impl Wrappable for DOMStringMap {}

impl DOMStringMap {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#concept-domstringmap-pairs
    pub(crate) fn supported_property_names(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> Vec<Utf16String> {
        // The supported property names on a DOMStringMap object at any instant are the names of each pair returned from
        // getting the DOMStringMap's name-value pairs at that instant, in the order returned.
        //
        // 1. Let list be an empty list of name-value pairs.
        let mut names = Vec::new();

        self.associated_element.for_each_attribute(|name, _| {
            if let Some(property_name) = property_name_from_data_attribute_name(Utf16View::of_fly_string(name)) {
                names.push(property_name);
            }
        });

        // 4. Return list.
        names
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#dom-domstringmap-nameditem
    pub(crate) fn determine_value_of_named_property(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        name: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // To determine the value of a named property name for a DOMStringMap, return the value component of the
        // name-value pair whose name component is name in the list returned from getting the DOMStringMap's name-value
        // pairs.
        let mut value = None;
        self.associated_element
            .for_each_attribute(|attribute_name, attribute_value| {
                if value.is_some() {
                    return;
                }
                if data_attribute_name_matches_property_name(
                    Utf16View::of_fly_string(attribute_name),
                    Utf16View::of_string(&name),
                ) {
                    value = Some(attribute_value.clone());
                }
            });

        Ok(value.expect("a DOMStringMap determines the value of a supported property name"))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_value_of_new_named_property(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        name: Utf16String,
        value: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.set_value_of_named_property(&name, value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_value_of_existing_named_property(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        name: Utf16String,
        value: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.set_value_of_named_property(&name, value)
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#dom-domstringmap-setitem
    fn set_value_of_named_property(&self, name: &Utf16String, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut builder = Utf16StringBuilder::new();

        // 3. Insert the string data- at the front of name.
        // NB: This is done out of order because the builder cannot prepend.
        builder.append_ascii("data-");

        let name = Utf16View::of_string(name);

        for character_index in 0..name.length_in_code_units() {
            // 1. If name contains a U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS character (-) followed by an ASCII lower alpha, then throw a
            //    "SyntaxError" DOMException.
            let current_character = name.code_unit_at(character_index);

            if current_character == u16::from(b'-') && character_index + 1 < name.length_in_code_units() {
                let next_character = name.code_unit_at(character_index + 1);
                if is_ascii_lower_alpha(next_character) {
                    return Err(Exception::syntax_error(Utf16String::from_utf8(
                        "Name cannot contain a '-' followed by a lowercase character.",
                    )));
                }
            }

            // 2. For each ASCII upper alpha in name, insert a U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS character (-) before the character
            //    and replace the character with the same character converted to ASCII lowercase.
            if is_ascii_upper_alpha(current_character) {
                builder.append_ascii("-");
                builder.append_code_unit(to_ascii_lowercase(current_character));
                continue;
            }

            builder.append_code_unit(current_character);
        }

        // 4. If name is not a valid attribute local name, then throw an "InvalidCharacterError" DOMException.
        let data_name = builder.to_utf16_string();
        if !is_valid_attribute_local_name(&data_name) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidCharacterError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Name is not a valid attribute local name."),
            ));
        }

        // 5. Set an attribute value for the DOMStringMap's associated element using name and value.
        let data_name = Utf16FlyString::from_utf16_string(&data_name);
        self.associated_element.set_attribute_value(&data_name, value);

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#dom-domstringmap-removeitem
    pub(crate) fn delete_existing_named_property(&self, _: &mut CallContext, name: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut builder = Utf16StringBuilder::new();

        // 2. Insert the string data- at the front of name.
        // NB: This is done out of order because the builder cannot prepend.
        builder.append_ascii("data-");

        for character in Utf16View::of_string(&name).code_units() {
            // 1. For each ASCII upper alpha in name, insert a U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS character (-) before the character
            //    and replace the character with the same character converted to ASCII lowercase.
            if is_ascii_upper_alpha(character) {
                builder.append_ascii("-");
                builder.append_code_unit(to_ascii_lowercase(character));
                continue;
            }

            builder.append_code_unit(character);
        }

        // 3. Remove an attribute by name given name and the DOMStringMap's associated element.
        let data_name = Utf16FlyString::from_utf16_string(&builder.to_utf16_string());
        self.associated_element.remove_attribute(&data_name);

        Ok(())
    }
}

fn is_ascii_upper_alpha(code_unit: u16) -> bool {
    u8::try_from(code_unit).is_ok_and(|character| character.is_ascii_uppercase())
}

fn is_ascii_lower_alpha(code_unit: u16) -> bool {
    u8::try_from(code_unit).is_ok_and(|character| character.is_ascii_lowercase())
}

fn to_ascii_uppercase(code_unit: u16) -> u16 {
    u8::try_from(code_unit).map_or(code_unit, |character| u16::from(character.to_ascii_uppercase()))
}

fn to_ascii_lowercase(code_unit: u16) -> u16 {
    u8::try_from(code_unit).map_or(code_unit, |character| u16::from(character.to_ascii_lowercase()))
}

fn is_data_attribute_name(name: Utf16View<'_>) -> bool {
    // This implements the attribute-name predicate from getting the DOMStringMap's name-value pairs:
    //
    // 2. For each content attribute on the DOMStringMap's associated element whose first five characters are the
    //    string "data-" and whose remaining characters (if any) do not include any ASCII upper alphas, ...
    if !name.starts_with(Utf16View::Ascii(b"data-")) {
        return false;
    }

    let name_after_starting_data = name.substring_view(5, name.length_in_code_units() - 5);
    !name_after_starting_data.code_units().any(is_ascii_upper_alpha)
}

fn property_name_from_data_attribute_name(name: Utf16View<'_>) -> Option<Utf16String> {
    if !is_data_attribute_name(name) {
        return None;
    }

    let name_after_starting_data = name.substring_view(5, name.length_in_code_units() - 5);

    // 2. For each content attribute on the DOMStringMap's associated element whose first five characters are the
    //    string "data-" and whose remaining characters (if any) do not include any ASCII upper alphas, in the order
    //    that those attributes are listed in the element's attribute list, add a name-value pair to list whose name is
    //    the attribute's name with the first five characters removed and whose value is the attribute's value.
    //
    // 3. For each name in list, for each U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS character (-) in the name that is followed by an ASCII
    //    lower alpha, remove the U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS character (-) and replace the character that followed it by the
    //    same character converted to ASCII uppercase.
    let length = name_after_starting_data.length_in_code_units();
    let mut builder = Utf16StringBuilder::new();
    let mut character_index = 0;
    while character_index < length {
        let current_character = name_after_starting_data.code_unit_at(character_index);

        if character_index + 1 < length && current_character == u16::from(b'-') {
            let next_character = name_after_starting_data.code_unit_at(character_index + 1);

            if is_ascii_lower_alpha(next_character) {
                builder.append_code_unit(to_ascii_uppercase(next_character));

                // Skip the next character.
                character_index += 2;

                continue;
            }
        }

        builder.append_code_unit(current_character);
        character_index += 1;
    }

    Some(builder.to_utf16_string())
}

fn data_attribute_name_matches_property_name(attribute_name: Utf16View<'_>, property_name: Utf16View<'_>) -> bool {
    if !is_data_attribute_name(attribute_name) {
        return false;
    }

    // This performs the name transformation from getting the DOMStringMap's name-value pairs, but compares each UTF-16
    // code unit directly instead of constructing the transformed name.
    let name_after_starting_data = attribute_name.substring_view(5, attribute_name.length_in_code_units() - 5);
    let length = name_after_starting_data.length_in_code_units();
    let mut property_name_index = 0;

    let mut character_index = 0;
    while character_index < length {
        let mut current_character = name_after_starting_data.code_unit_at(character_index);

        if character_index + 1 < length && current_character == u16::from(b'-') {
            let next_character = name_after_starting_data.code_unit_at(character_index + 1);

            if is_ascii_lower_alpha(next_character) {
                current_character = to_ascii_uppercase(next_character);
                character_index += 1;
            }
        }

        if property_name_index >= property_name.length_in_code_units() {
            return false;
        }
        if property_name.code_unit_at(property_name_index) != current_character {
            return false;
        }
        property_name_index += 1;
        character_index += 1;
    }

    property_name_index == property_name.length_in_code_units()
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_dom_string_map_create(vm: &Vm, element: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::Element>) -> *mut c_void {
    let associated_element = CppElement::from_lent(element);
    cell_into_abi(allocate(vm, |_| DOMStringMap { associated_element }))
}

//! ErrorEvent, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#errorevent

use core::ffi::c_void;

/// The dictionary ErrorEventInit of HTML/ErrorEvent.idl.
pub(crate) struct ErrorEventInit {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) message: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) filename: UsvString,
    pub(crate) lineno: u32,
    pub(crate) colno: u32,

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#errorevent
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ErrorEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    message: Utf16String,
    filename: UsvString,
    lineno: u32,
    colno: u32,
    error: Value,
}

impl Wrappable for ErrorEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl ErrorEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: ErrorEventInit,
    ) -> Ref<ErrorEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.parent.bubbles,
            event_init.parent.cancelable,
            event_init.parent.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| ErrorEvent {
            event,
            message: event_init.message,
            filename: event_init.filename,
            lineno: event_init.lineno,
            colno: event_init.colno,
            error: event_init.error.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED),
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init_dict: ErrorEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<ErrorEvent>> {
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &r#type, event_init_dict))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#dom-errorevent-message
    pub(crate) fn message(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.message.clone())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#dom-errorevent-filename
    pub(crate) fn filename(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<UsvString> {
        Ok(self.filename.clone())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#dom-errorevent-lineno
    pub(crate) fn lineno(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(self.lineno)
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#dom-errorevent-colno
    pub(crate) fn colno(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(self.colno)
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#dom-errorevent-error
    pub(crate) fn error(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        Ok(self.error)
    }
}

/// The Event of a new trusted ErrorEvent in the realm, for the implementation to fire.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "C++ passes each member of the dictionary")]
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_error_event_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    r#type: LentUtf16FlyString<'_>,
    bubbles: bool,
    cancelable: bool,
    composed: bool,
    message: LentUtf16String<'_>,
    filename: LentUtf16String<'_>,
    lineno: u32,
    colno: u32,
    error: Value,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let event_init = ErrorEventInit {
        parent: EventInit {
            bubbles,
            cancelable,
            composed,
        },
        message: message.to_utf16_string(),
        filename: UsvString::from_utf16_string(&filename.to_utf16_string()),
        lineno,
        colno,
        error: Some(error),
    };
    let r#type: Utf16String = r#type.to_utf16_fly_string().into();
    let event = ErrorEvent::create(vm, realm, &r#type, event_init);
    event.event().as_ptr()
}

/// Stores the attributes of the ErrorEvent, whose strings the caller adopts.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_error_event_attributes(
    event: &InterfaceCell,
    message: &mut usize,
    filename: &mut usize,
    lineno: &mut u32,
    colno: &mut u32,
    error: &mut u64,
) {
    let event = event.implementation::<ErrorEvent>();
    *message = event.message.clone().into_raw();
    *filename = event.filename.clone().into_utf16_string().into_raw();
    *lineno = event.lineno;
    *colno = event.colno;
    *error = event.error.to_raw();
}

use crate::html::message_event::{MessageEvent, MessageEventInit};
use crate::platform::timer::CppTimer;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_html_event_source_create_request(
        settings: *mut c_void,
        url: *const RustUrl,
        use_credentials: bool,
    ) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_html_event_source_fetch(realm: *mut c_void, request: *mut c_void, event_source: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_html_event_source_incrementally_read_body(
        realm: *mut c_void,
        response: *mut c_void,
        event_source: *mut c_void,
    );
}

/// The dictionary EventSourceInit of HTML/EventSource.idl.
pub(crate) struct EventSourceInit {
    pub(crate) with_credentials: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u16)]
enum ReadyState {
    Connecting = 0,
    Open = 1,
    Closed = 2,
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#eventsource
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct EventSource {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#concept-eventsource-url
    #[gc(untraced)]
    url: OnceCell<Url>,

    /// The origin of the event stream's final URL.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    final_url_origin: RefCell<Option<Origin>>,

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#concept-event-stream-request
    #[gc(untraced)]
    request: OnceCell<CppRequest>,

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#concept-event-stream-reconnection-time
    #[gc(untraced)]
    reconnection_time: Cell<Duration>,

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#concept-event-stream-last-event-id
    #[gc(untraced)]
    last_event_id: RefCell<String>,

    #[gc(untraced)]
    event_type: RefCell<String>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    data: RefCell<String>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    last_event_id_buffer: RefCell<String>,

    with_credentials: Cell<bool>,

    #[gc(untraced)]
    ready_state: Cell<ReadyState>,

    /// The bytes of the body that follow its last line break, and whether none of the body has been interpreted yet.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pending_data: RefCell<Vec<u8>>,
    is_start_of_stream: Cell<bool>,
    /// Whether the last byte of the body that has been interpreted is a CR, which a LF that follows it pairs with.
    last_was_cr: Cell<bool>,

    /// When the delay of step 2 of reestablishing the connection ends.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    end_of_delay: Cell<Option<Instant>>,

    fetch_controller: GcRefCell<Option<CppFetchController>>,
    reconnection_timer: GcRefCell<Option<CppTimer>>,
}

impl Wrappable for EventSource {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        Some(self.realm)
    }

    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for EventSource {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

/// The event sources of the thread's agent: references that do not keep them alive, which a collected event source
/// leaves empty. The empty ones are pruned once the list has grown to twice what was live after the last pruning.
struct EventSources {
    event_sources: Vec<GcWeak<EmbedderCell<Wrapped<EventSource>>>>,
    live_after_pruning: usize,
}

impl EventSources {
    const EVENT_SOURCES_BEFORE_FIRST_PRUNING: usize = 128;

    fn add(&mut self, vm: &Vm, event_source: Ref<EventSource>) {
        if self.event_sources.len() >= (2 * self.live_after_pruning).max(Self::EVENT_SOURCES_BEFORE_FIRST_PRUNING) {
            self.event_sources.retain(|event_source| event_source.get().is_some());
            self.live_after_pruning = self.event_sources.len();
        }
        self.event_sources.push(GcWeak::new(vm.heap(), event_source));
    }
}

thread_local! {
    static EVENT_SOURCES: RefCell<EventSources> = const {
        RefCell::new(EventSources {
            event_sources: Vec::new(),
            live_after_pruning: 0,
        })
    };
}

/// Forgets the event sources of the thread's agent, whose references into its heap have to go before the heap does.
pub(crate) fn forget_event_sources_of_agent() {
    EVENT_SOURCES.with_borrow_mut(|event_sources| {
        event_sources.event_sources.clear();
        event_sources.live_after_pruning = 0;
    });
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#event-stream-interpretation
fn for_each_line(string: &str, last_was_cr: &mut bool, mut callback: impl FnMut(&str)) {
    let mut substart = 0;
    for (i, ch) in string.char_indices() {
        if ch == '\n' {
            if !*last_was_cr {
                callback(&string[substart..i]);
            }
            substart = i + 1;
            *last_was_cr = false;
        } else if ch == '\r' {
            callback(&string[substart..i]);
            substart = i + 1;
            *last_was_cr = true;
        } else {
            *last_was_cr = false;
        }
    }
    if substart < string.len() {
        callback(&string[substart..]);
    }
}

impl EventSource {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#dom-eventsource
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        url: UsvString,
        event_source_init_dict: EventSourceInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = cx.realm();

        // 1. Let ev be a new EventSource object.
        let ev = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            realm,
            url: OnceCell::new(),
            final_url_origin: RefCell::new(None),
            request: OnceCell::new(),
            reconnection_time: Cell::new(Duration::from_secs(3)),
            last_event_id: RefCell::new(String::new()),
            event_type: RefCell::new(String::new()),
            data: RefCell::new(String::new()),
            last_event_id_buffer: RefCell::new(String::new()),
            with_credentials: Cell::new(false),
            ready_state: Cell::new(ReadyState::Connecting),
            pending_data: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            is_start_of_stream: Cell::new(true),
            last_was_cr: Cell::new(false),
            end_of_delay: Cell::new(None),
            fetch_controller: GcRefCell::new(None),
            reconnection_timer: GcRefCell::new(None),
        });
        ev.event_target.set_owner(ev);

        // 2. Let settings be ev's relevant settings object.
        let settings = relevant_settings_object(realm.global_object());

        // 3. Let urlRecord be the result of encoding-parsing a URL given url, relative to settings.
        let url_record = settings.encoding_parse_url(url.as_utf16_string());

        // 4. If urlRecord is failure, then throw a "SyntaxError" DOMException.
        let Some(url_record) = url_record else {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "SyntaxError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                    "Invalid URL '{}'",
                    String::from_utf16_lossy(url.as_utf16_string().to_utf16().as_ref())
                )),
            ));
        };

        // 5. Set ev's url to urlRecord.
        let url_record = ev.url.get_or_init(|| url_record);

        // 6. Let corsAttributeState be Anonymous.
        let mut use_credentials = false;

        // 7. If the value of eventSourceInitDict's withCredentials member is true, then set corsAttributeState to Use Credentials
        //    and set ev's withCredentials attribute to true.
        if event_source_init_dict.with_credentials {
            use_credentials = true;
            ev.with_credentials.set(true);
        }

        // Steps 8-12.
        let rust_url = RustUrl::from_url(url_record);
        // SAFETY: The settings object is live, the URL is lent for the call, and LibWeb hands over a reference to the
        //         request.
        let request = unsafe {
            CppRequest::adopt(web_html_event_source_create_request(
                settings.as_ptr(),
                &raw const rust_url,
                use_credentials,
            ))
        };

        // 13. Set ev's request to request.
        let request = ev.request.get_or_init(|| request);

        // 14. Let processEventSourceEndOfBody given response res be the following step: if res is not a network error, then
        //     reestablish the connection.
        // NB: See process_event_source_end_of_body().

        // 15. Fetch request, with processResponseEndOfBody set to processEventSourceEndOfBody and processResponse set to the
        //     following steps given response res:
        // NB: See process_response().
        Self::fetch(ev, request);
        EVENT_SOURCES.with_borrow_mut(|event_sources| event_sources.add(vm, ev));
        ev.update_pending_activity();

        // 16. Return ev.
        Ok(ev)
    }

    fn fetch(this: Ref<Self>, request: &CppRequest) {
        // SAFETY: The realm, the request and this are live, and LibWeb returns a live fetch controller.
        let fetch_controller = unsafe {
            CppFetchController::from_raw(web_html_event_source_fetch(
                this.realm.as_ptr().cast(),
                request.as_ptr(),
                cell_into_abi(this),
            ))
        };
        this.fetch_controller.replace(Some(fetch_controller));
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#dom-eventsource
    pub(crate) fn process_event_source_end_of_body(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm, response: CppResponseView) {
        if !response.is_network_error() {
            Self::reestablish_the_connection(this, vm);
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#dom-eventsource
    pub(crate) fn process_response(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm, response: CppResponseView) {
        let content_type_is_text_event_stream = || {
            response.extract_mime_type().is_some_and(|content_type| {
                let essence = content_type.essence();
                essence.type_ == "text" && essence.subtype == "event-stream"
            })
        };

        // 1. If res is an aborted network error, then fail the connection.
        if response.is_network_error() && response.aborted() {
            Self::fail_the_connection(this, vm);
        }
        // 2. Otherwise, if res is a network error, then reestablish the connection, unless the user agent knows that
        //    to be futile, in which case the user agent may fail the connection.
        else if response.is_network_error() {
            Self::reestablish_the_connection(this, vm);
        }
        // 3. Otherwise, if res's status is not 200, or if res's `Content-Type` is not `text/event-stream`, then fail
        //    the connection.
        else if response.status() != 200 || !content_type_is_text_event_stream() {
            Self::fail_the_connection(this, vm);
        }
        // 4. Otherwise, announce the connection and interpret res's body line by line.
        else {
            Self::announce_the_connection(this, vm);

            let final_url = response
                .url(false)
                .expect("A response that is not a network error has a URL");
            let final_url = basic_parse(url_input(final_url.as_units()), BasicParseOptions::new())
                .expect("The URL of a response parses");
            this.final_url_origin.replace(Some(final_url.origin()));

            this.pending_data.borrow_mut().clear();
            this.is_start_of_stream.set(true);
            this.last_was_cr.set(false);

            // When a stream is parsed, a data buffer, an event type buffer, and a last event ID buffer must be associated with
            // it. They must be initialized to the empty string.
            // AD-HOC: The last event ID buffer starts as the last event ID string, which other engines keep across streams.
            this.data.borrow_mut().clear();
            this.event_type.borrow_mut().clear();
            *this.last_event_id_buffer.borrow_mut() = this.last_event_id.borrow().clone();

            // SAFETY: The realm, the response and this are live.
            unsafe {
                web_html_event_source_incrementally_read_body(
                    this.realm.as_ptr().cast(),
                    response.as_ptr(),
                    cell_into_abi(this),
                );
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn process_body_chunk(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm, body: &[u8]) {
        let mut pending_data = this.pending_data.borrow_mut();
        // The bytes kept from earlier chunks hold no line break.
        let kept_length = pending_data.len();
        pending_data.extend_from_slice(body);

        let Some(last_line_break) = body.iter().rposition(|byte| *byte == b'\r' || *byte == b'\n') else {
            return;
        };

        let end_index = kept_length + last_line_break + 1;
        let response: Vec<u8> = pending_data.drain(..end_index).collect();
        drop(pending_data);

        Self::interpret_response(this, vm, &response, this.is_start_of_stream.get());
        this.is_start_of_stream.set(false);
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#dom-eventsource-url
    pub(crate) fn url(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<UsvString> {
        let url = self.url.get().expect("The constructor sets the URL");
        Ok(UsvString::from_utf8(url.serialize(ExcludeFragment::No)))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#dom-eventsource-withcredentials
    pub(crate) fn with_credentials(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        Ok(self.with_credentials.get())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#dom-eventsource-readystate
    pub(crate) fn ready_state(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u16> {
        Ok(self.ready_state.get() as u16)
    }

    fn set_ready_state(&self, ready_state: ReadyState) {
        self.ready_state.set(ready_state);
        self.update_pending_activity();
    }

    fn update_pending_activity(&self) {
        self.event_target
            .set_has_pending_activity(self.realm, self.ready_state.get() != ReadyState::Closed);
    }

    fn abort_the_fetch(&self) {
        if let Some(fetch_controller) = self.fetch_controller.borrow().as_ref() {
            fetch_controller.abort(self.realm);
        }
        if let Some(reconnection_timer) = self.reconnection_timer.borrow().as_ref() {
            reconnection_timer.stop();
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#dom-eventsource-close
    pub(crate) fn close(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The close() method must abort any instances of the fetch algorithm started for this EventSource object, and must
        // set the readyState attribute to CLOSED.
        self.abort_the_fetch();
        self.set_ready_state(ReadyState::Closed);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#concept-eventsource-forcibly-close
    fn forcibly_close(&self) {
        // If a user agent is to forcibly close an EventSource object (this happens when a Document object goes away
        // permanently), the user agent must abort any instances of the fetch algorithm started for this EventSource
        // object, and must set the readyState attribute to CLOSED.
        self.abort_the_fetch();
        self.set_ready_state(ReadyState::Closed);
    }

    /// Forcibly closes the event sources whose relevant realm is the realm.
    pub(crate) fn forcibly_close_all(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) {
        let event_sources = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        EVENT_SOURCES.with_borrow(|all_event_sources| {
            for event_source in all_event_sources.event_sources.iter().filter_map(GcWeak::get) {
                if event_source.realm == realm {
                    event_sources.push(event_source);
                }
            }
        });
        for event_source in event_sources.values().iter() {
            event_source.forcibly_close();
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#announce-the-connection
    fn announce_the_connection(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm) {
        // When a user agent is to announce the connection, the user agent must queue a task which, if the readyState attribute
        // is set to a value other than CLOSED, sets the readyState attribute to OPEN and fires an event named open at the
        // EventSource object.
        queue_a_task(vm, TaskSource::RemoteEvent, this, |_, this| {
            if this.ready_state.get() != ReadyState::Closed {
                this.set_ready_state(ReadyState::Open);
                this.event_target.dispatch_event(&this.create_associated_event("open"));
            }
        });
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#reestablish-the-connection
    fn reestablish_the_connection(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm) {
        // OPTIMIZATION: readyState never leaves CLOSED, so both tasks below would return without doing anything.
        if this.ready_state.get() == ReadyState::Closed {
            return;
        }

        this.end_of_delay
            .set(Some(Instant::now() + this.reconnection_time.get()));

        // 1. Queue a task to run the following steps:
        queue_a_task(vm, TaskSource::RemoteEvent, this, |vm, this| {
            // 1. If the readyState attribute is set to CLOSED, abort the task.
            if this.ready_state.get() == ReadyState::Closed {
                return;
            }

            // 2. Set the readyState attribute to CONNECTING.
            this.set_ready_state(ReadyState::Connecting);

            // 3. Fire an event named error at the EventSource object.
            this.event_target.dispatch_event(&this.create_associated_event("error"));

            // NB: Step 4 waits for this task to finish, and an error event handler can spin a nested event loop. So the
            //     timer for the rest of the delay of step 2 starts only once this task has finished.
            if this.ready_state.get() != ReadyState::Closed {
                Self::start_the_reconnection_timer(this, vm);
            }
        });
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#reestablish-the-connection
    fn start_the_reconnection_timer(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm) {
        let end_of_delay = this
            .end_of_delay
            .get()
            .expect("Reestablishing the connection sets the end of the delay");
        let remaining_delay = end_of_delay.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());

        // 2. Wait a delay equal to the reconnection time of the event source.
        let timer = CppTimer::create_single_shot(
            vm,
            u64::try_from(remaining_delay.as_millis()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX),
            this,
            |vm, this| {
                // 3. Optionally, wait some more. In particular, if the previous attempt failed, then user agents might introduce
                //    an exponential backoff delay to avoid overloading a potentially already overloaded server. Alternatively, if
                //    the operating system has reported that there is no network connectivity, user agents might wait for the
                //    operating system to announce that the network connection has returned before retrying.

                // 4. Wait until the aforementioned task has run, if it has not yet run.
                // NB: The timer starts only once that task has run. See step 1.

                // 5. Queue a task to run the following steps:
                queue_a_task(vm, TaskSource::RemoteEvent, this, |_, this| {
                    // 1. If the EventSource object's readyState attribute is not set to CONNECTING, then return.
                    if this.ready_state.get() != ReadyState::Connecting {
                        return;
                    }

                    // 2. Let request be the EventSource object's request.
                    let request = this.request.get().expect("The constructor sets the request");

                    // 3. If the EventSource object's last event ID string is not the empty string, then:
                    let last_event_id = this.last_event_id.borrow();
                    if !last_event_id.is_empty() {
                        // 1. Let lastEventIDValue be the EventSource object's last event ID string, encoded as UTF-8.
                        let last_event_id_value = last_event_id.as_bytes();
                        // 2. Set (`Last-Event-ID`, lastEventIDValue) in request's header list.
                        request.set_header(b"Last-Event-ID", last_event_id_value);
                    }
                    // AD-HOC: Delete the header an earlier reconnection set, as other engines do.
                    else {
                        request.delete_header(b"Last-Event-ID");
                    }
                    drop(last_event_id);

                    // 4. Fetch request and process the response obtained in this fashion, if any, as described earlier in this
                    //    section.
                    Self::fetch(this, request);
                });
            },
        );
        this.reconnection_timer.replace(Some(timer));
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#fail-the-connection
    fn fail_the_connection(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm) {
        // When a user agent is to fail the connection, the user agent must queue a task which, if the readyState attribute
        // is set to a value other than CLOSED, sets the readyState attribute to CLOSED and fires an event named error at the
        // EventSource object. Once the user agent has failed the connection, it does not attempt to reconnect.
        queue_a_task(vm, TaskSource::RemoteEvent, this, |_, this| {
            if this.ready_state.get() != ReadyState::Closed {
                this.set_ready_state(ReadyState::Closed);
                this.event_target.dispatch_event(&this.create_associated_event("error"));
            }
        });
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#event-stream-interpretation
    fn interpret_response(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm, response: &[u8], is_start_of_stream: bool) {
        // Streams must be decoded using the UTF-8 decode algorithm.
        let response = if is_start_of_stream {
            response.strip_prefix(b"\xEF\xBB\xBF").unwrap_or(response)
        } else {
            response
        };
        let response_string = String::from_utf8_lossy(response);

        // Lines must be processed, in the order they are received, as follows:
        let mut last_was_cr = this.last_was_cr.get();
        for_each_line(&response_string, &mut last_was_cr, |line| {
            // -> If the line is empty (a blank line)
            if line.is_empty() {
                // Dispatch the event, as defined below.
                Self::dispatch_the_event(this, vm);
            }
            // -> If the line starts with a U+003A COLON character (:)
            else if line.starts_with(':') {
                // Ignore the line.
            }
            // -> If the line contains a U+003A COLON character (:)
            else if let Some((field, value)) = line.split_once(':') {
                // Collect the characters on the line before the first U+003A COLON character (:), and let field be that string.
                // Collect the characters on the line after the first U+003A COLON character (:), and let value be that string.
                // If value starts with a U+0020 SPACE character, remove it from value.
                let value = value.strip_prefix(' ').unwrap_or(value);

                // Process the field using the steps described below, using field as the field name and value as the field value.
                this.process_field(field, value);
            }
            // -> Otherwise, the string is not empty but does not contain a U+003A COLON character (:)
            else {
                // Process the field using the steps described below, using the whole line as the field name, and the empty
                // string as the field value.
                this.process_field(line, "");
            }
        });
        this.last_was_cr.set(last_was_cr);
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#processField
    fn process_field(&self, field: &str, value: &str) {
        match field {
            // -> If the field name is "event"
            "event" => {
                // Set the event type buffer to the field value.
                *self.event_type.borrow_mut() = value.to_owned();
            }
            // -> If the field name is "data"
            "data" => {
                // Append the field value to the data buffer, then append a single U+000A LINE FEED (LF) character to the data buffer.
                let mut data = self.data.borrow_mut();
                data.push_str(value);
                data.push('\n');
            }
            // -> If the field name is "id"
            "id" => {
                // If the field value does not contain U+0000 NULL, then set the last event ID buffer to the field value.
                // Otherwise, ignore the field.
                if !value.contains('\0') {
                    *self.last_event_id_buffer.borrow_mut() = value.to_owned();
                }
            }
            // -> If the field name is "retry"
            "retry" => {
                // If the field value consists of only ASCII digits, then interpret the field value as an integer in base ten,
                // and set the event stream's reconnection time to that integer. Otherwise, ignore the field.
                if value.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit())
                    && let Ok(retry) = value.parse::<i64>()
                {
                    self.reconnection_time.set(Duration::from_millis(retry.unsigned_abs()));
                }
            }
            // -> Otherwise
            _ => {
                // The field is ignored.
            }
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#dispatchMessage
    fn dispatch_the_event(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm) {
        // 1. Set the last event ID string of the event source to the value of the last event ID buffer. The buffer does not
        //    get reset, so the last event ID string of the event source remains set to this value until the next time it is
        //    set by the server.
        *this.last_event_id.borrow_mut() = this.last_event_id_buffer.borrow().clone();
        let last_event_id = this.last_event_id.borrow();

        // 2. If the data buffer is an empty string, set the data buffer and the event type buffer to the empty string and return.
        let mut data = this.data.borrow_mut();
        let mut event_type = this.event_type.borrow_mut();
        let mut data_buffer = data.as_str();

        if data_buffer.is_empty() {
            event_type.clear();
            data.clear();
            return;
        }

        // 3. If the data buffer's last character is a U+000A LINE FEED (LF) character, then remove the last character from the data buffer.
        if let Some(stripped) = data_buffer.strip_suffix('\n') {
            data_buffer = stripped;
        }

        // 4. Let event be the result of creating an event using MessageEvent, in the relevant realm of the EventSource object.
        // 5. Initialize event's type attribute to "message", its data attribute to data, its origin to the origin of the event
        //    stream's final URL (i.e., the URL after redirects), and its lastEventId attribute to the last event ID string of
        //    the event source.
        // 6. If the event type buffer has a value other than the empty string, change the type of the newly created event to equal
        //    the value of the event type buffer.
        let r#type = if event_type.is_empty() {
            "message"
        } else {
            event_type.as_str()
        };
        let origin = this.final_url_origin.borrow();
        let origin = origin
            .as_ref()
            .expect("Interpreting the event stream follows its response");
        let mut event_init = MessageEventInit::new(vm);
        event_init.data = Value::from_string(PrimitiveString::create(vm, Utf16String::from_utf8(data_buffer)));
        event_init.last_event_id = Utf16String::from_utf8(&last_event_id);
        let event = MessageEvent::create(
            vm,
            this.realm,
            &Utf16String::from_utf8(r#type),
            event_init,
            Some(origin.clone()),
        );

        // 7. Set the data buffer and the event type buffer to the empty string.
        event_type.clear();
        data.clear();

        // 8. Queue a task which, if the readyState attribute is set to a value other than CLOSED, dispatches the newly created
        //    event at the EventSource object.
        queue_a_task(vm, TaskSource::RemoteEvent, (this, event), |_, (this, event)| {
            if this.ready_state.get() != ReadyState::Closed {
                this.event_target.dispatch_event(event.event());
            }
        });
    }

    fn create_associated_event(&self, event_name: &str) -> CppEvent {
        CppEvent::create(self.realm, event_name, false, false, false)
    }
}

//! handles, which Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/ImageData.cpp, Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/ImageBitmap.cpp and

/// # Safety
///
/// `objects` must point to `count` live objects.
unsafe fn objects_from_abi(vm: &Vm, objects: *const *mut c_void, count: usize) -> MarkedVec<'_, Gc<Object>> {
    let list = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, count);
    // SAFETY: The caller passes `count` live objects.
    for &object in unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(objects, count) } {
        list.push(unsafe { Gc::from_non_null(NonNull::new(object.cast::<Object>()).expect("C++ passes objects")) });
    }
    list
}

/// Creates an ImageData of the size, with transparent black pixels and the sRGB color space, in the realm, and stores
/// its cell, or throws what initializing an ImageData throws.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_image_data_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    out_image_data: &mut *mut c_void,
) -> RawNativeFunctionResult {
    let mut cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
    let result = ImageData::create(&mut cx, width, height, None, None).map(|image_data| {
        *out_image_data = cell_into_abi(image_data);
        Value::UNDEFINED
    });
    RawNativeFunctionResult::from_completion(result.map_err(|exception| exception.throw(&cx)))
}

/// postMessage(message, transfer) on the port, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#dom-messageport-postmessage
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `vm` must be the live VM, `realm` a live realm, and `port` a live cell of a MessagePort. The message must be live,
/// and the transfer list `count` live objects.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_message_port_post_message(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    port: &InterfaceCell,
    message: Value,
    transfer: *const *mut c_void,
    count: usize,
) -> RawNativeFunctionResult {
    let mut cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
    let port = port.object::<MessagePort>();
    // SAFETY: The caller passes `count` live objects.
    let transfer_list = unsafe { objects_from_abi(vm, transfer, count) };
    let result = MessagePort::post_message(&port, &mut cx, message, transfer_list);
    RawNativeFunctionResult::from_completion(
        result
            .map(|()| Value::UNDEFINED)
            .map_err(|exception| exception.throw(&cx)),
    )
}

/// The transfer steps of the MessagePort of a new channel to a worker, which C++ runs outside
/// StructuredSerializeWithTransfer, into a data holder that holds no type, whose carrier it hands over. The data holder
/// goes through the browser process, and the token in `out_parked_end_token` is for settling what became of it.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_message_port_transfer_steps(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    port: &InterfaceCell,
    may_leave_process: bool,
    out_data_holder: &mut *mut c_void,
    out_parked_end_token: &mut u64,
) -> RawNativeFunctionResult {
    let port = port.object::<MessagePort>();
    let mut cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
    let data_holder = TransferDataHolder::new();
    let result = MessagePort::transfer_steps(&port, &mut cx, &mut TransferDataWriter::new(&data_holder, realm, None));
    if result.is_ok() {
        let mut payload = data_holder.finish();
        *out_parked_end_token = payload.park_channel_end(may_leave_process);
        *out_data_holder = payload.into_cpp();
    }
    RawNativeFunctionResult::from_completion(
        result
            .map(|()| Value::UNDEFINED)
            .map_err(|exception| exception.throw(&cx)),
    )
}

/// Tells that nobody in this process is going to claim the channel end of the token, unless somebody did.

    give_up_on_parked_end(token);
}

/// How the port reaches the port it is entangled with, as an ASCII string that lives forever, for tests.

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]

}

/// The transfer-receiving steps of a MessagePort that C++ runs outside StructuredDeserializeWithTransfer, which return
/// the wrapper of the new MessagePort.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `vm` must be the live VM, `realm` a live realm, and `data_holder` an HTML::TransferDataEncoder that C++ hands over.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_message_port_transfer_receiving_steps(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    data_holder: *mut c_void,
) -> RawNativeFunctionResult {
    // SAFETY: The caller hands over the data holder.
    let mut payload = unsafe { TransferPayload::from_cpp(data_holder) };
    let mut cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
    let mut data_holder = TransferDataReader::new(&mut payload, realm);
    let result = MessagePort::transfer_receiving_steps(&mut cx, &mut data_holder);
    RawNativeFunctionResult::from_completion(
        result
            .map(|port| Value::from_object(wrap(&cx, port)))
            .map_err(|exception| exception.throw(&cx)),
    )
}

/// Steps 6 to 9 of BroadcastChannel's postMessage(), for a message that another process posted, whose channel name
/// C++ hands over.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `vm` must be the live VM, the origins and the bytes lent, `channel_name` an owned AK::Utf16String, and
/// `shared_store_lifeline` a descriptor that is open for the call, or negative.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_broadcast_channel_deliver_message_locally(
    vm: &Vm,
    storage_key_origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    channel_name: Utf16String,
    source_origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    serialized_message: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    shared_store_lifeline: c_int,
) {
    // SAFETY: The caller lends the origins.
    let (storage_key, source_origin) = unsafe {
        (
            StorageKey {
                origin: (*storage_key_origin).to_origin(),
            },
            (*source_origin).to_origin(),
        )
    };
    let message = BROADCAST_CHANNEL_MESSAGE_CLASS.allocate(vm, |defer_gc| BroadcastChannelMessage {
        storage_key,
        channel_name,
        source_origin,
        // SAFETY: The caller keeps the descriptor open for the call.
        serialized: unsafe {
            MessageRecord::received(defer_gc, serialized_message.as_slice(), &[], &[], shared_store_lifeline)
        },
    });
    BroadcastChannel::deliver_message_locally(vm, message, None);
}

/// A new Storage object of the type, 0 for "local" and 1 for "session", for the Window of the realm, whose map is a new
/// storage proxy map over the bottle for the realm's settings object: steps 2 to 4 of the localStorage and
/// sessionStorage getters. Null when obtaining the bottle map fails.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_html_create_storage(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>, storage_type: u8) -> *mut c_void {
    let storage_type = StorageType::from_abi(storage_type);
    let environment = relevant_settings_object(realm.global_object());
    let map = match storage_type {
        StorageType::Local => obtain_a_local_storage_bottle_map(&environment, StorageEndpointType::LocalStorage),
        StorageType::Session => obtain_a_session_storage_bottle_map(&environment, StorageEndpointType::SessionStorage),
    };
    map.map_or(core::ptr::null_mut(), |map| {
        cell_into_abi(Storage::create(vm, realm, storage_type, map))
    })
}

/// Loads the map of the Storage object now rather than on first access, so changes other processes make start
/// arriving.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_html_storage_connect(storage: &InterfaceCell) {
    storage.implementation::<Storage>().map().connect();
}

/// Calls `on_item` with each key of the map of the Storage object and its value, raw AK::Utf16Strings that Rust lends
/// for the call.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `storage` must be the live cell of a Storage object.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_html_storage_for_each_item(
    storage: &InterfaceCell,
    ctx: *mut c_void,
    on_item: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, usize, usize),
) {
    let map = storage.implementation::<Storage>().map();
    for key in map.keys() {
        if let Some(value) = map.get(&key) {
            // SAFETY: The strings outlive the call.
            unsafe { on_item(ctx, key.raw_identity(), value.raw_identity()) };
        }
    }
}

/// The Event of a new StorageEvent in the realm whose type is the empty string and whose attributes are their
/// defaults, for createEvent().
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_html_create_storage_event(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) -> *mut c_void {
    let event_init = StorageEventInit {
        parent: EventInit {
            bubbles: false,
            cancelable: false,
            composed: false,
        },
        key: None,
        old_value: None,
        new_value: None,
        url: UsvString::from_utf8(""),
        storage_area: None,
    };
    StorageEvent::create(vm, realm, &Utf16String::from_utf8(""), event_init)
        .event()
        .as_ptr()
}

/// The Event of a new trusted MessageEvent in the realm, for C++ to fire. Its origin is the origin if there is one,
/// and the empty string otherwise.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// The VM, the realm, the data and each port must be live, and so must the source if it is not null. The type, the
/// port array and the origin are lent for the call.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "C++ passes each member of the dictionary")]
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_html_create_message_event(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    r#type: LentUtf16FlyString<'_>,
    data: Value,
    ports: *const *mut c_void,
    count: usize,
    source: Option<&InterfaceCell>,
    origin: *const FfiOrigin,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let mut event_init = MessageEventInit::new(vm);
    event_init.data = data;
    // SAFETY: The caller lends the ports for the call.
    for &port in unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(ports, count) } {
        // SAFETY: Each port is a live MessagePort.
        event_init.ports.push(unsafe { cell_from_abi::<MessagePort>(port) });
    }
    if let Some(source) = source {
        event_init.source = Some(MessageEventSource::MessagePort(source.object::<MessagePort>()));
    }
    // SAFETY: An origin that is not null is lent for the call.
    let origin = (!origin.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { (*origin).to_origin() });
    let r#type: Utf16String = r#type.to_utf16_fly_string().into();
    let event = MessageEvent::create(vm, realm, &r#type, event_init, origin);
    event.event().as_ptr()
}

/// The Event of a new MessageEvent in the realm whose type is the empty string, for createEvent().
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_html_create_message_event_for_create_event(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) -> *mut c_void {
    MessageEvent::create_for_create_event(vm, realm).event().as_ptr()
}

/// # Safety
///
/// The VM, the realm, the target and the transferred objects must be live, and the target must be a Window if remote
/// is false and a RemoteNavigable otherwise. The target origin string is handed over, and the transfer list is lent.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_window_post_message(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    target: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::Cell>,
    remote: bool,
    message: Value,
    target_origin: Utf16String,
    transfer: *const *mut c_void,
    count: usize,
) -> RawNativeFunctionResult {
    let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
    // SAFETY: The caller lends the live target, message and transferred objects, and hands over the string.
    let (target, transfer) = unsafe { (CppCell::from_lent(target), objects_from_abi(vm, transfer, count)) };
    let result = window_post_message_steps(&cx, target, remote, message, &target_origin, &transfer.values());
    RawNativeFunctionResult::from_completion(result.map(|()| Value::UNDEFINED).map_err(|error| error.throw(&cx)))
}

/// # Safety
///
/// The VM, the Window and the source, if any, must be live, and the record and the origins are lent for the call.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_window_queue_posted_message(
    vm: &Vm,
    target_window: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::Window>,
    record: *mut c_void,
    target_origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    source: *mut c_void,
) {
    // SAFETY: The caller passes the live VM, and lends the Window, the source, the record and the origins.
    unsafe {
        let posted_message = PostedMessage {
            target_window: CppCell::from_lent(target_window),
            serialize_with_transfer_result: TransferRecord::from_cpp(vm, SerializedTransferRecord::from_raw(record)),
            target_origin: target_origin.as_ref().map(|origin| origin.to_origin()),
            origin: (*origin).to_origin(),
            source: NonNull::new(source).map(|source| CppCell::from_raw(source.as_ptr())),
        };
        queue_posted_message(vm, posted_message);
    }
}

/// # Safety
///
/// The VM and the realm must be live, and `transfer` must point to `count` live objects.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_structured_clone(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    value: Value,
    transfer: *const *mut c_void,
    count: usize,
) -> RawNativeFunctionResult {
    let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
    // SAFETY: The caller passes a live value and `count` live objects.
    let transfer = unsafe { objects_from_abi(vm, transfer, count) };
    let result = structured_clone(&cx, value, &transfer.values());
    RawNativeFunctionResult::from_completion(result.map_err(|exception| exception.throw(&cx)))
}

/// Creates the ImageBitmapRenderingContext of the HTMLCanvasElement whose cell is `canvas` and whose
/// Web::HTML::CanvasHost is `canvas_host`, and returns its cell.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `canvas` must be the live cell of the canvas, and `canvas_host` the same object as a Web::HTML::CanvasHost.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_image_bitmap_rendering_context_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    canvas: *mut c_void,
    canvas_host: *mut c_void,
    alpha: bool,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let canvas = Canvas {
        cell: NonNull::new(canvas).expect("C++ passes the canvas"),
        host: NonNull::new(canvas_host).expect("C++ passes the canvas"),
        is_offscreen: false,
    };
    cell_into_abi(allocate(vm, |defer_gc| {
        ImageBitmapRenderingContext::new(defer_gc, canvas, alpha)
    }))
}

/// The dictionary FormDataEventInit of HTML/FormDataEvent.idl.
pub(crate) struct FormDataEventInit {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) form_data: Ref<FormData>,

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#formdataevent
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct FormDataEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    form_data: Ref<FormData>,
}

impl Wrappable for FormDataEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl FormDataEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: FormDataEventInit,
    ) -> Ref<FormDataEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.parent.bubbles,
            event_init.parent.cancelable,
            event_init.parent.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| FormDataEvent {
            event,
            form_data: event_init.form_data,
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init_dict: FormDataEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<FormDataEvent>> {
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &r#type, event_init_dict))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#dom-formdataevent-formdata
    pub(crate) fn form_data(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<FormData>> {
        Ok(self.form_data)
    }
}

/// The Event of a new trusted FormDataEvent in the realm, for the implementation to fire.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_form_data_event_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    r#type: LentUtf16FlyString<'_>,
    bubbles: bool,
    cancelable: bool,
    composed: bool,
    form_data: &InterfaceCell,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let event_init = FormDataEventInit {
        parent: EventInit {
            bubbles,
            cancelable,
            composed,
        },
        form_data: form_data.object::<FormData>(),
    };
    let r#type: Utf16String = r#type.to_utf16_fly_string().into();
    let event = FormDataEvent::create(vm, realm, &r#type, event_init);
    event.event().as_ptr()
}

/// The Event of a new trusted HashChangeEvent in the realm, for the implementation to fire.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_hash_change_event_create(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    r#type: LentUtf16FlyString<'_>,
    old_url: LentUtf16String<'_>,
    new_url: LentUtf16String<'_>,
) -> *mut c_void {
    let event_init = HashChangeEventInit {
        parent: EventInit {
            bubbles: false,
            cancelable: false,
            composed: false,

        new_url: UsvString::from_utf16_string(&new_url.to_utf16_string()),

        .as_ptr()
}

use core::ffi::c_void;

use libjs_rust::api::{MarkedVec, Vm};

use crate::bindings::conversions::CppInterface;
use crate::dom::element::CppElement;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_html_form_element_submittable_elements(
        form: *mut c_void,
        elements: *mut c_void,
        on_element: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *mut c_void),
    );
}

unsafe extern "C" fn on_element(elements: *mut c_void, element: *mut c_void) {
    // SAFETY: elements is the list of the caller, and LibWeb passes a live Element.
    unsafe { (*elements.cast::<MarkedVec<'_, CppElement>>()).push(CppElement::from_raw(element)) };
}

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#the-form-element
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct CppHTMLFormElement(CppInterface);

impl CppHTMLFormElement {
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `form` must be the wrapper of an HTMLFormElement.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn from_interface(form: CppInterface) -> Self {
        Self(form)
    }

    pub(crate) fn interface(self) -> CppInterface {
        self.0
    }

    /// The submittable elements whose form owner is the form, in tree order.
    pub(crate) fn submittable_elements<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, CppElement> {
        let elements = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        // SAFETY: The form is live, and the list outlives the call.
        unsafe {
            web_html_form_element_submittable_elements(
                self.0.wrapper().as_ptr().cast(),
                (&raw const elements).cast_mut().cast(),
                on_element,
            );
        }
        elements
    }
}

/*

//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface

use core::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libgfx_rust::image_frame::ImageFrameHandle;
use libjs_rust::api::{DeferGc, ForeignCellSlot, Gc, Realm, Trace};

use crate::bindings::conversions::CppInterface;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::canvas_2d::canvas::Canvas;
use crate::html::image_bitmap::ImageBitmap;

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode
enum BitmapMode {
    /// The output bitmap is a default transparent bitmap, of the size of the canvas.
    Blank,
    /// The output bitmap refers to bitmap data that was acquired via transferFromImageBitmap() — none, for an
    /// ImageBitmap that was created without any.
    Valid(Option<ImageFrameHandle>),
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ImageBitmapRenderingContext {
    canvas_cell: ForeignCellSlot,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    canvas: Canvas,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    bitmap_mode: RefCell<BitmapMode>,
    /// The origin-clean flag of the output bitmap,
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#concept-canvas-origin-clean
    #[gc(untraced)]
    origin_clean: Cell<bool>,
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha
    #[gc(untraced)]
    alpha: bool,
}

impl Wrappable for ImageBitmapRenderingContext {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.canvas.relevant_realm()
    }

    const OWNS_EXTERNAL_MEMORY: bool = true;

    fn external_memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        // NB: LibGC asks while it sweeps, when nothing borrows the bitmap mode mutably.
        match self.bitmap_mode.try_borrow().as_deref() {
            Ok(BitmapMode::Valid(Some(frame))) => frame.size_in_bytes(),
            _ => 0,
        }
    }
}

impl ImageBitmapRenderingContext {
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#imagebitmaprenderingcontext-creation-algorithm
    pub(crate) fn new(_: &DeferGc<'_>, canvas: Canvas, alpha: bool) -> Self {
        // 1. Let settings be the result of converting options to the dictionary type ImageBitmapRenderingContextSettings.
        //    (This can throw an exception.)
        // NB: HTMLCanvasElement::get_context() converts the options, and passes alpha.

        // 2. Let context be a new ImageBitmapRenderingContext object.
        // 3. Initialize context's canvas attribute to point to target.
        let canvas_cell = ForeignCellSlot::empty();
        // SAFETY: The canvas is a live cell of the heap that the runtime allocates from.
        unsafe { canvas_cell.set(Some(canvas.cell)) };

        // 4. Set context's output bitmap to the same bitmap as target's bitmap (so that they are shared).
        // 5. Run the steps to set an ImageBitmapRenderingContext's output bitmap with context.
        // 6. Initialize context's alpha flag to true.
        // 7. Process each of the members of settings as follows:
        //    alpha: If false, then set context's alpha flag to false.
        // 8. Return context.
        Self {
            canvas_cell,
            canvas,
            bitmap_mode: RefCell::new(BitmapMode::Blank),
            origin_clean: Cell::new(true),
            alpha,
        }
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-canvas
    pub(crate) fn canvas(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CppInterface> {
        // The canvas attribute must return the value it was initialized to when the object was created.
        Ok(self.canvas.wrapper(cx.realm()))
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap
    pub(crate) fn transfer_from_image_bitmap(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        bitmap: Option<Ref<ImageBitmap>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Let bitmapContext be the ImageBitmapRenderingContext object on which the transferFromImageBitmap() method
        //    was called.
        // 2. If bitmap is null, then run the steps to set an ImageBitmapRenderingContext's output bitmap, with
        //    bitmapContext as the context argument and no bitmap argument, then return.
        let Some(bitmap) = bitmap else {
            self.set_output_bitmap(None);
            return Ok(());
        };

        // 3. If the value of bitmap's [[Detached]] internal slot is set to true, then throw an "InvalidStateError"
        //    DOMException.
        if bitmap.is_detached() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("The ImageBitmap is detached"),
            ));
        }

        // 4. Run the steps to set an ImageBitmapRenderingContext's output bitmap, with the context argument equal to
        //    bitmapContext, and the bitmap argument referring to bitmap's underlying bitmap data.
        self.set_output_bitmap(Some((bitmap.frame(), bitmap.origin_clean())));

        // 5. Set the value of bitmap's [[Detached]] internal slot to true.
        // 6. Unset bitmap's bitmap data.
        bitmap.close_bitmap();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext's-output-bitmap
    fn set_output_bitmap(&self, bitmap: Option<(Option<ImageFrameHandle>, bool)>) {
        match bitmap {
            // 1. If a bitmap argument was not provided:
            None => {
                // 1. Set context's bitmap mode to blank.
                // 2. Let canvas be the canvas element to which context is bound.
                // 3. Set context's output bitmap to be transparent black with a natural width equal to the numeric
                //    value of canvas's width attribute and a natural height equal to the numeric value of canvas's
                //    height attribute, those values being interpreted in CSS pixels.
                // NB: The canvas makes that bitmap when something reads it, at the size its attributes have then.
                self.bitmap_mode.replace(BitmapMode::Blank);

                // 4. Set the output bitmap's origin-clean flag to true.
                self.origin_clean.set(true);
            }
            // 2. If a bitmap argument was provided:
            Some((frame, origin_clean)) => {
                // 1. Set context's bitmap mode to valid.
                // 2. Set context's output bitmap to refer to the same underlying bitmap data as bitmap, without making
                //    a copy.
                //    The origin-clean flag of bitmap is included in the bitmap data to be referenced by context's
                //    output bitmap.
                self.bitmap_mode.replace(BitmapMode::Valid(frame));
                self.origin_clean.set(origin_clean);
            }
        }
        self.canvas.did_change_content();
    }

    /// The frame of the output bitmap, which stays valid until the output bitmap changes; null in blank mode, and for
    /// an output bitmap without bitmap data.
    pub(crate) fn raw_frame(&self) -> *const c_void {
        match &*self.bitmap_mode.borrow() {
            BitmapMode::Valid(Some(frame)) => frame.as_raw(),
            _ => core::ptr::null(),
        }
    }

    /// Whether the bitmap mode is blank.
    pub(crate) fn is_blank(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(*self.bitmap_mode.borrow(), BitmapMode::Blank)
    }

    pub(crate) fn origin_clean(&self) -> bool {
        self.origin_clean.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn alpha(&self) -> bool {
        self.alpha
    }
}
