//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#imagebitmap

use core::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::borrow::Cow;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libgfx_rust::image_frame::ImageFrameHandle;
use libjs_rust::api::{RawNativeFunctionResult, Trace, Vm};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::structured_data::{
    Serializable, SerializationReader, SerializationWriter, TransferDataReader, TransferDataWriter, Transferable,
};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

/// The Gfx::ColorSpace of a frame as Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/ImageBitmap.cpp hands it over and reads it, with the bytes
/// of an ICC profile that borrow from the frame or from the caller.
#[repr(C)]
struct FrameColorSpace {
    kind: u8,
    color_primaries: u8,
    transfer_characteristics: u8,
    icc_profile: *const u8,
    icc_profile_size: usize,
}

impl FrameColorSpace {
    const SRGB: Self = Self {
        kind: COLOR_SPACE_KIND_SRGB,
        color_primaries: 0,
        transfer_characteristics: 0,
        icc_profile: core::ptr::null(),
        icc_profile_size: 0,
    };
}

/// The bitmap data that Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/ImageBitmap.cpp creates a frame from, with bytes that borrow from the
/// caller.
#[repr(C)]
struct FramePixels {
    width: i32,
    height: i32,
    pitch: u64,
    format: i32,
    alpha_type: i32,
    data: *const u8,
    data_size: usize,
    color_space: FrameColorSpace,
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    // Defined in Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/ImageBitmap.cpp, which encodes and decodes the pixels of a transferred
    // frame. A frame that it hands over is a Gfx::DecodedImageFrame allocated with new, or null for none.
    fn web_image_bitmap_frame_color_space(frame: *const c_void, color_space: &mut FrameColorSpace);
    fn web_image_bitmap_create_frame(
        realm: *mut c_void,
        pixels: &FramePixels,
        out_frame: &mut *mut c_void,
    ) -> RawNativeFunctionResult;
    fn web_image_bitmap_copy_to_shared_pixels(
        image_bitmap_pixels: *mut c_void,
        frame: *const c_void,
        buffer_index: &mut u32,
        offset: &mut u64,
    ) -> bool;
    fn web_image_bitmap_create_frame_from_shared_pixels(
        realm: *mut c_void,
        data_holder: *mut c_void,
        buffer_index: u32,
        offset: u64,
        pixels: &FramePixels,
        out_frame: &mut *mut c_void,
    ) -> RawNativeFunctionResult;
}

/// The bitmap data of an ImageBitmap: an image frame, which has the bitmap and keeps its id, so that each drawing of
/// the ImageBitmap names the same image.
struct BitmapData {
    frame: ImageFrameHandle,
}

impl BitmapData {
    fn new(frame: ImageFrameHandle) -> Self {
        Self { frame }
    }

    /// The bitmap data that C++ hands over, if any.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `frame` must be a Gfx::DecodedImageFrame that C++ allocated with new for this, or null.
    unsafe fn from_handed_over_frame(frame: *mut c_void) -> Option<Self> {
        // SAFETY: The caller hands over a frame that C++ allocated with new, which nothing uses after this.
        (!frame.is_null()).then(|| Self::new(unsafe { ImageFrameHandle::adopt(frame) }))
    }
}

const BITMAP_KIND_NONE: u8 = 0;
const BITMAP_KIND_SRGB: u8 = 1;
const BITMAP_KIND_WITH_COLOR_SPACE: u8 = 2;

const COLOR_SPACE_KIND_SRGB: u8 = 0;
const COLOR_SPACE_KIND_CICP: u8 = 1;
const COLOR_SPACE_KIND_ICC_PROFILE: u8 = 2;

const BITMAP_FORMATS: [(i32, &[u8]); 4] = [(1, b"BGRx8888"), (2, b"BGRA8888"), (3, b"RGBx8888"), (4, b"RGBA8888")];

const ALPHA_TYPES: [(i32, &[u8]); 2] = [(0, b"premultiplied"), (1, b"unpremultiplied")];

fn data_clone_error(message: &[u8]) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("DataCloneError", Utf16String::from_ascii(message))
}

/// Writes a value of Gfx as a record holds one: by its identifier in a storage record, and by its underlying value in
/// one for IPC.
fn serialize_enumeration(serialized: &mut SerializationWriter, values: &[(i32, &[u8])], value: i32, for_storage: bool) {
    if !for_storage {
        serialized.write_i32(value);
        return;
    }
    let (_, identifier) = values
        .iter()
        .find(|(underlying_value, _)| *underlying_value == value)
        .expect("a bitmap has a format and an alpha type that a record holds");
    serialized.write_utf16_string(&Utf16String::from_ascii(identifier));
}

/// Reads what serialize_enumeration() writes, which throws a "DataCloneError" DOMException with the message of an
/// invalid underlying value or of an unknown identifier for one that it does not know.
fn deserialize_enumeration(
    serialized: &mut SerializationReader,
    values: &[(i32, &[u8])],
    invalid_message: &[u8],
    unknown_message: &[u8],
) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
    if !serialized.is_for_storage() {
        let value = serialized.read_i32()?;
        if !values.iter().any(|(underlying_value, _)| *underlying_value == value) {
            return Err(data_clone_error(invalid_message));
        }
        return Ok(value);
    }
    let identifier = serialized.read_utf16_string()?;
    values
        .iter()
        .find(|(_, value_identifier)| identifier == Utf16String::from_ascii(value_identifier))
        .map(|(value, _)| *value)
        .ok_or_else(|| data_clone_error(unknown_message))
}

/// The color space of the frame, with bytes that borrow from it.
fn frame_color_space(frame: &ImageFrameHandle) -> FrameColorSpace {
    let mut color_space = FrameColorSpace::SRGB;
    // SAFETY: The handle keeps the frame live.
    unsafe { web_image_bitmap_frame_color_space(frame.as_raw(), &mut color_space) };
    color_space
}

/// The pixels of the frame in rows `minimum_pitch()` bytes apart, so that what is written does not depend on how far
/// apart the memory of this machine places them. They borrow from the frame unless its rows are farther apart.
fn tightly_packed_frame_bytes(frame: &ImageFrameHandle) -> Cow<'_, [u8]> {
    // SAFETY: The handle keeps the pixels mapped, and nothing writes to the pixels of a frame.
    let bytes = unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(frame.pixels().as_ptr(), frame.size_in_bytes()) };
    let row_size = frame.minimum_pitch();
    if frame.pitch() == row_size {
        return Cow::Borrowed(bytes);
    }
    let rows = bytes.chunks_exact(frame.pitch());
    let mut tightly_packed_bytes = Vec::with_capacity(rows.len() * row_size);
    for row in rows {
        tightly_packed_bytes.extend_from_slice(&row[..row_size]);
    }
    Cow::Owned(tightly_packed_bytes)
}

/// Writes a copy of the bitmap data of the frame, or that there is none.
fn serialize_bitmap_data(serialized: &mut SerializationWriter, frame: Option<&ImageFrameHandle>, for_storage: bool) {
    let Some(frame) = frame else {
        serialized.write_u8(BITMAP_KIND_NONE);
        return;
    };
    let color_space = frame_color_space(frame);

    let has_color_space = color_space.kind != COLOR_SPACE_KIND_SRGB;
    serialized.write_u8(if has_color_space {
        BITMAP_KIND_WITH_COLOR_SPACE
    } else {
        BITMAP_KIND_SRGB
    });
    serialized.write_i32(frame.width());
    serialized.write_i32(frame.height());
    serialized.write_u64(frame.minimum_pitch() as u64);
    serialize_enumeration(serialized, &BITMAP_FORMATS, frame.bitmap_format_value(), for_storage);
    serialize_enumeration(serialized, &ALPHA_TYPES, frame.alpha_type_value(), for_storage);
    serialized.write_bytes(&tightly_packed_frame_bytes(frame));
    if !has_color_space {
        return;
    }
    serialized.write_u8(color_space.kind);
    if color_space.kind == COLOR_SPACE_KIND_CICP {
        serialized.write_u8(color_space.color_primaries);
        serialized.write_u8(color_space.transfer_characteristics);
    } else {
        // SAFETY: The bytes borrow from the frame, which lives for the call.
        serialized
            .write_bytes(unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(color_space.icc_profile, color_space.icc_profile_size) });
    }
}

fn write_transferred_color_space(data_holder: &mut TransferDataWriter, color_space: &FrameColorSpace) {
    data_holder.write(&color_space.kind);
    if color_space.kind == COLOR_SPACE_KIND_CICP {
        data_holder.write(&color_space.color_primaries);
        data_holder.write(&color_space.transfer_characteristics);
    } else if color_space.kind == COLOR_SPACE_KIND_ICC_PROFILE {
        // SAFETY: The bytes borrow from the frame, which lives for the call.
        data_holder.write(unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(color_space.icc_profile, color_space.icc_profile_size) });
    }
}

/// Writes the bitmap data of the frame, or that there is none, to the data holder of a transfer: its pixels go to the
/// shared memory of the transfer if there is room for them there, and inline otherwise.
fn write_transferred_bitmap_data(data_holder: &mut TransferDataWriter, frame: Option<&ImageFrameHandle>) {
    let (mut buffer_index, mut offset) = (0, 0);
    // SAFETY: The pixels are lent for the steps, and the handle keeps the frame live.
    let in_shared_pixels = frame.is_some_and(|frame| unsafe {
        web_image_bitmap_copy_to_shared_pixels(
            data_holder.image_bitmap_pixels_as_raw(),
            frame.as_raw(),
            &mut buffer_index,
            &mut offset,
        )
    });
    data_holder.write_bool(in_shared_pixels);
    let Some(frame) = frame else {
        data_holder.write(&BITMAP_KIND_NONE);
        return;
    };
    let color_space = frame_color_space(frame);
    if in_shared_pixels {
        data_holder.write(&buffer_index);
        data_holder.write(&offset);
        data_holder.write(&frame.width());
        data_holder.write(&frame.height());
        data_holder.write(&frame.bitmap_format_value());
        data_holder.write(&frame.alpha_type_value());
        write_transferred_color_space(data_holder, &color_space);
        return;
    }
    let has_color_space = color_space.kind != COLOR_SPACE_KIND_SRGB;
    data_holder.write(&if has_color_space {
        BITMAP_KIND_WITH_COLOR_SPACE
    } else {
        BITMAP_KIND_SRGB
    });
    data_holder.write(&frame.width());
    data_holder.write(&frame.height());
    data_holder.write(&(frame.minimum_pitch() as u64));
    data_holder.write(&frame.bitmap_format_value());
    data_holder.write(&frame.alpha_type_value());
    data_holder.write(&*tightly_packed_frame_bytes(frame));
    if has_color_space {
        write_transferred_color_space(data_holder, &color_space);
    }
}

/// Reads what write_transferred_color_space() writes into the pixels.
fn read_transferred_color_space(
    data_holder: &mut TransferDataReader,
    color_space: &mut FrameColorSpace,
) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    color_space.kind = data_holder.read()?;
    match color_space.kind {
        COLOR_SPACE_KIND_SRGB => {}
        COLOR_SPACE_KIND_CICP => {
            color_space.color_primaries = data_holder.read()?;
            color_space.transfer_characteristics = data_holder.read()?;
        }
        COLOR_SPACE_KIND_ICC_PROFILE => {
            let icc_profile = data_holder.read_bytes()?;
            color_space.icc_profile = icc_profile.as_ptr();
            color_space.icc_profile_size = icc_profile.len();
        }
        _ => return Err(data_clone_error(b"Invalid ImageBitmap color space")),
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Reads what write_transferred_bitmap_data() writes, and creates the bitmap data in the realm of the data holder.
fn read_transferred_bitmap_data(data_holder: &mut TransferDataReader) -> WebIdlResult<Option<BitmapData>> {
    let realm = data_holder.realm();
    let in_shared_pixels = data_holder.read_bool()?;
    let mut pixels = FramePixels {
        width: 0,
        height: 0,
        pitch: 0,
        format: 0,
        alpha_type: 0,
        data: core::ptr::null(),
        data_size: 0,
        color_space: FrameColorSpace::SRGB,
    };
    let mut frame = core::ptr::null_mut();
    if in_shared_pixels {
        let buffer_index = data_holder.read::<u32>()?;
        let offset = data_holder.read::<u64>()?;
        pixels.width = data_holder.read()?;
        pixels.height = data_holder.read()?;
        pixels.format = data_holder.read()?;
        pixels.alpha_type = data_holder.read()?;
        read_transferred_color_space(data_holder, &mut pixels.color_space)?;
        // SAFETY: The realm is live, the data holder is lent for the steps, and the call borrows the bytes.
        unsafe {
            web_image_bitmap_create_frame_from_shared_pixels(
                realm.as_ptr().cast(),
                data_holder.shared_pixels_as_raw()?,
                buffer_index,
                offset,
                &pixels,
                &mut frame,
            )
        }
        .into_completion()?;
    } else {
        let kind = data_holder.read::<u8>()?;
        if kind == BITMAP_KIND_NONE {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        if kind != BITMAP_KIND_SRGB && kind != BITMAP_KIND_WITH_COLOR_SPACE {
            return Err(data_clone_error(b"Invalid ImageBitmap bitmap data"));
        }
        pixels.width = data_holder.read()?;
        pixels.height = data_holder.read()?;
        pixels.pitch = data_holder.read()?;
        pixels.format = data_holder.read()?;
        pixels.alpha_type = data_holder.read()?;
        let data = data_holder.read_bytes()?;
        pixels.data = data.as_ptr();
        pixels.data_size = data.len();
        if kind == BITMAP_KIND_WITH_COLOR_SPACE {
            read_transferred_color_space(data_holder, &mut pixels.color_space)?;
        }
        // SAFETY: The realm is live, and the call borrows the bytes.
        unsafe { web_image_bitmap_create_frame(realm.as_ptr().cast(), &pixels, &mut frame) }.into_completion()?;
    }
    // SAFETY: C++ hands over the frame it created.
    Ok(unsafe { BitmapData::from_handed_over_frame(frame) })
}

/// Reads what serialize_bitmap_data() writes, and creates the bitmap data in the realm of the call context.
fn deserialize_bitmap_data(cx: &CallContext, serialized: &mut SerializationReader) -> WebIdlResult<Option<BitmapData>> {
    let kind = serialized.read_u8()?;
    if kind == BITMAP_KIND_NONE {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    if kind != BITMAP_KIND_SRGB && kind != BITMAP_KIND_WITH_COLOR_SPACE {
        return Err(data_clone_error(b"Invalid ImageBitmap bitmap data"));
    }
    let width = serialized.read_i32()?;
    let height = serialized.read_i32()?;
    let pitch = serialized.read_u64()?;
    let format = deserialize_enumeration(
        serialized,
        &BITMAP_FORMATS,
        b"Invalid structured serialize bitmap format",
        b"Unknown structured serialize bitmap format",
    )?;
    let alpha_type = deserialize_enumeration(
        serialized,
        &ALPHA_TYPES,
        b"Invalid structured serialize alpha type",
        b"Unknown structured serialize alpha type",
    )?;
    let data = serialized.read_borrowed_bytes()?;

    let (mut color_space_kind, mut color_primaries, mut transfer_characteristics) = (COLOR_SPACE_KIND_SRGB, 0, 0);
    let mut icc_profile: &[u8] = &[];
    if kind == BITMAP_KIND_WITH_COLOR_SPACE {
        color_space_kind = serialized.read_u8()?;
        match color_space_kind {
            COLOR_SPACE_KIND_SRGB => {}
            COLOR_SPACE_KIND_CICP => {
                color_primaries = serialized.read_u8()?;
                transfer_characteristics = serialized.read_u8()?;
            }
            COLOR_SPACE_KIND_ICC_PROFILE => icc_profile = serialized.read_borrowed_bytes()?,
            _ => return Err(data_clone_error(b"Invalid ImageBitmap color space")),
        }
    }

    let pixels = FramePixels {
        width,
        height,
        pitch,
        format,
        alpha_type,
        data: data.as_ptr(),
        data_size: data.len(),
        color_space: FrameColorSpace {
            kind: color_space_kind,
            color_primaries,
            transfer_characteristics,
            icc_profile: icc_profile.as_ptr(),
            icc_profile_size: icc_profile.len(),
        },
    };
    let mut frame = core::ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: The realm is live, and the call borrows the bytes.
    unsafe { web_image_bitmap_create_frame(cx.realm().as_ptr().cast(), &pixels, &mut frame) }.into_completion()?;
    // SAFETY: C++ hands over the frame it created.
    Ok(unsafe { BitmapData::from_handed_over_frame(frame) })
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ImageBitmap {
    /// The bitmap data, which close() and the transfer steps unset.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    bitmap: RefCell<Option<BitmapData>>,
    /// The size of the bitmap data the ImageBitmap was created with, in CSS pixels.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    width: u32,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    height: u32,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    detached: Cell<bool>,
    /// An ImageBitmap object's bitmap has an origin-clean flag, which indicates whether the bitmap is tainted by
    /// content from a different origin. The flag is initially set to true and may be changed to false by the steps of
    /// createImageBitmap().
    #[gc(untraced)]
    origin_clean: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Wrappable for ImageBitmap {
    const OWNS_EXTERNAL_MEMORY: bool = true;

    fn external_memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        // NB: LibGC asks while it sweeps, when nothing borrows the bitmap data mutably.
        self.bitmap
            .try_borrow()
            .ok()
            .and_then(|bitmap| bitmap.as_ref().map(|bitmap| bitmap.frame.size_in_bytes()))
            .unwrap_or(0)
    }
}

impl ImageBitmap {
    fn new(bitmap: Option<BitmapData>) -> Self {
        let (width, height) = bitmap.as_ref().map_or((0, 0), |bitmap| {
            (
                u32::try_from(bitmap.frame.width()).expect("a bitmap has a width"),
                u32::try_from(bitmap.frame.height()).expect("a bitmap has a height"),
            )
        });
        Self {
            bitmap: RefCell::new(bitmap),
            width,
            height,
            detached: Cell::new(false),
            origin_clean: Cell::new(true),
        }
    }

    /// A new ImageBitmap whose bitmap data is the frame, or that has none.
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, frame: Option<ImageFrameHandle>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self::new(frame.map(BitmapData::new)))
    }

    /// The frame of the bitmap data, unless the ImageBitmap has none, as when it is closed or transferred.
    pub(crate) fn frame(&self) -> Option<ImageFrameHandle> {
        self.bitmap.borrow().as_ref().map(|bitmap| bitmap.frame.clone())
    }

    /// The raw frame of the bitmap data, which stays valid until the bitmap data is unset.
    pub(crate) fn raw_frame(&self) -> *const c_void {
        self.bitmap
            .borrow()
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(core::ptr::null(), |bitmap| bitmap.frame.as_raw())
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_detached(&self) -> bool {
        self.detached.get()
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#concept-canvas-origin-clean
    pub(crate) fn origin_clean(&self) -> bool {
        self.origin_clean.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_origin_clean(&self, origin_clean: bool) {
        self.origin_clean.set(origin_clean);
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagebitmap-width
    pub(crate) fn width(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(self.width_of_bitmap())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagebitmap-height
    pub(crate) fn height(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(self.height_of_bitmap())
    }

    pub(crate) fn width_of_bitmap(&self) -> u32 {
        // 1. If this's [[Detached]] internal slot's value is true, then return 0.
        if self.detached.get() {
            return 0;
        }
        // 2. Return this's width, in CSS pixels.
        self.width
    }

    pub(crate) fn height_of_bitmap(&self) -> u32 {
        // 1. If this's [[Detached]] internal slot's value is true, then return 0.
        if self.detached.get() {
            return 0;
        }
        // 2. Return this's height, in CSS pixels.
        self.height
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagebitmap-close
    pub(crate) fn close(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.close_bitmap();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn close_bitmap(&self) {
        // 1. Set this's [[Detached]] internal slot value to true.
        self.detached.set(true);

        // 2. Unset this's bitmap data.
        self.bitmap.replace(None);
    }
}

impl Serializable for ImageBitmap {
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#the-imagebitmap-interface:serialization-steps
    fn serialization_steps(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        serialized: &mut SerializationWriter,
        for_storage: bool,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If value's origin-clean flag is not set, then throw a "DataCloneError" DOMException.
        if !self.origin_clean.get() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "DataCloneError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot serialize an ImageBitmap that is not origin-clean"),
            ));
        }

        // 2. Set serialized.[[BitmapData]] to a copy of value's bitmap data.
        serialize_bitmap_data(serialized, self.frame().as_ref(), for_storage);

        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#the-imagebitmap-interface:deserialization-steps
    fn deserialization_steps(cx: &mut CallContext, serialized: &mut SerializationReader) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        // 1. Set value's bitmap data to serialized.[[BitmapData]].
        Ok(Self::new(deserialize_bitmap_data(cx, serialized)?))
    }
}

impl Transferable for ImageBitmap {
    fn detached(&self) -> &Cell<bool> {
        &self.detached
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#the-imagebitmap-interface:transfer-steps
    fn transfer_steps(this: &Ref<Self>, _: &mut CallContext, data_holder: &mut TransferDataWriter) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If value's origin-clean flag is not set, then throw a "DataCloneError" DOMException.
        if !this.origin_clean.get() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "DataCloneError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot transfer an ImageBitmap that is not origin-clean"),
            ));
        }

        // 2. Set dataHolder.[[BitmapData]] to value's bitmap data.
        write_transferred_bitmap_data(data_holder, this.frame().as_ref());

        // 3. Unset value's bitmap data.
        this.bitmap.replace(None);

        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#the-imagebitmap-interface:transfer-receiving-steps
    fn transfer_receiving_steps(cx: &mut CallContext, data_holder: &mut TransferDataReader) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. Set value's bitmap data to dataHolder.[[BitmapData]].
        let bitmap_data = read_transferred_bitmap_data(data_holder)?;
        Ok(allocate(cx.vm(), |_| Self::new(bitmap_data)))
    }
}

/*

//! https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#imagedata

use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{
    ArrayBuffer, ArrayBufferOrder, ArrayBufferShared, Gc, Trace, TypedArrayBase, TypedArrayKind, Value,
    create_typed_array_on_buffer, is_typed_array_out_of_bounds, make_typed_array_with_buffer_witness_record,
    typed_array_byte_length,
};

use super::predefined_color_space::PredefinedColorSpace;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::structured_data::{Serializable, SerializationReader, SerializationWriter};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#imagedatasettings
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct ImageDataSettings {
    pub(crate) color_space: Option<PredefinedColorSpace>,
}

/// The size of a pixel of an ImageData, whose pixels are RGBA8888.
const BYTES_PER_PIXEL: u32 = 4;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ImageData {
    /// The Uint8ClampedArray of the data attribute, in whose buffer the pixels are, RGBA8888 and unpremultiplied, row
    /// by row. Script can detach the buffer, and shrink one that is resizable, at any time.
    data: Gc<TypedArrayBase>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    width: u32,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    height: u32,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    color_space: PredefinedColorSpace,
}

impl Wrappable for ImageData {}

/// Whether the typed array has room for the pixels of an ImageData of the size, so that they can be read and written
/// in it.
fn can_hold_pixels(data: &TypedArrayBase, width: u32, height: u32) -> bool {
    let data_record = make_typed_array_with_buffer_witness_record(data, ArrayBufferOrder::SeqCst);
    if is_typed_array_out_of_bounds(&data_record) {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(expected_byte_length) = (width as usize)
        .checked_mul(height as usize)
        .and_then(|pixels| pixels.checked_mul(BYTES_PER_PIXEL as usize))
    else {
        return false;
    };
    typed_array_byte_length(&data_record) as usize >= expected_byte_length
}

impl ImageData {
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagedata
    pub(crate) fn construct_with_size(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        sw: u32,
        sh: u32,
        settings: ImageDataSettings,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        // 1. If one or both of sw and sh are zero, then throw an "IndexSizeError" DOMException.
        if sw == 0 || sh == 0 {
            return Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_ascii(
                b"The source width and height must be greater than zero.",
            )));
        }

        // 2. Initialize this given sw, sh, and settings set to settings.
        // 3. Initialize the image data of this to transparent black.
        Self::initialize(cx, sh, sw, Some(&settings), None, None)
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagedata-with-data
    pub(crate) fn construct_with_data(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        data: Gc<TypedArrayBase>,
        sw: u32,
        sh: Option<u32>,
        settings: ImageDataSettings,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        let data_record = make_typed_array_with_buffer_witness_record(&data, ArrayBufferOrder::SeqCst);
        if is_typed_array_out_of_bounds(&data_record) {
            return Err(invalid_state_error(b"Source data must not be out-of-bounds."));
        }

        // 1. Let length be the number of bytes in data.
        let length = typed_array_byte_length(&data_record);

        // 2. If length is not a nonzero integral multiple of four, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if length == 0 || !length.is_multiple_of(BYTES_PER_PIXEL as usize) {
            return Err(invalid_state_error(
                b"Source data must have a non-zero length that is a multiple of four.",
            ));
        }

        // 3. Let length be length divided by four.
        let length = length / BYTES_PER_PIXEL as usize;

        // 4. If length is not an integral multiple of sw, then throw an "IndexSizeError" DOMException.
        // NOTE: At this step, the length is guaranteed to be greater than zero (otherwise the second step above would
        //       have aborted the steps), so if sw is zero, this step will throw the exception and return.
        if sw == 0 || !length.is_multiple_of(sw as usize) {
            return Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_ascii(
                b"Source width must be a multiple of source data's length.",
            )));
        }

        // 5. Let height be length divided by sw.
        let height = length / sw as usize;

        // 6. If sh was given and its value is not equal to height, then throw an "IndexSizeError" DOMException.
        if sh.is_some_and(|sh| sh as usize != height) {
            return Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_ascii(
                b"Source height must be equal to the calculated height of the data.",
            )));
        }

        // 7. Initialize this given sw, sh, settings set to settings, and source set to data.
        // FIXME: This seems to be a spec issue, sh is an optional but height always have a value.
        let Ok(height) = u32::try_from(height) else {
            return Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_ascii(
                b"The specified image size could not be created",
            )));
        };
        Self::initialize(cx, height, sw, Some(&settings), Some(data), None)
    }

    /// A new ImageData of the size, with transparent black pixels, as the 2D contexts create them: steps 2 to 4 of
    /// createImageData() and steps 3 to 4 of getImageData().
    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
        settings: Option<&ImageDataSettings>,
        default_color_space: Option<PredefinedColorSpace>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let image_data = Self::initialize(cx, height, width, settings, None, default_color_space)?;
        Ok(allocate(cx.vm(), |_| image_data))
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#initialize-an-imagedata-object
    fn initialize(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        rows: u32,
        pixels_per_row: u32,
        settings: Option<&ImageDataSettings>,
        source: Option<Gc<TypedArrayBase>>,
        default_color_space: Option<PredefinedColorSpace>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        let data = match source {
            // 1. If source was given, then initialize the data attribute of imageData to source.
            Some(source) => source,
            None => {
                let Some(size) = rows
                    .checked_mul(pixels_per_row)
                    .and_then(|pixels| pixels.checked_mul(BYTES_PER_PIXEL))
                else {
                    return Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_ascii(
                        b"The specified image size could not be created",
                    )));
                };

                // 2. Otherwise (source was not given), initialize the data attribute of imageData to a new
                //    Uint8ClampedArray object. The Uint8ClampedArray object must use a new Canvas Pixel ArrayBuffer for
                //    its storage, and must have a zero start offset and a length equal to the length of its storage,
                //    in bytes. The Canvas Pixel ArrayBuffer must have the correct size to store rows × pixelsPerRow
                //    pixels.
                // 3. If the Canvas Pixel ArrayBuffer cannot be allocated, then rethrow the RangeError thrown by
                //    JavaScript, and return.
                let buffer = ArrayBuffer::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), size as usize, ArrayBufferShared::No)?;
                create_typed_array_on_buffer(
                    cx.vm(),
                    cx.realm(),
                    TypedArrayKind::Uint8ClampedArray,
                    size as usize,
                    buffer,
                )
            }
        };

        // AD-HOC: Validate that the data has room for the pixels.
        if !can_hold_pixels(&data, pixels_per_row, rows) {
            return Err(invalid_state_error(
                b"Source data must not be detached or out-of-bounds.",
            ));
        }

        // 4. Initialize the width attribute of imageData to pixelsPerRow.
        // 5. Initialize the height attribute of imageData to rows.
        // 6. If settings was given and settings["colorSpace"] exists, then initialize the colorSpace attribute of
        //    imageData to settings["colorSpace"].
        // 7. Otherwise, if defaultColorSpace was given, then initialize the colorSpace attribute of imageData to
        //    defaultColorSpace.
        // 8. Otherwise, initialize the colorSpace attribute of imageData to "srgb".
        let color_space = settings
            .and_then(|settings| settings.color_space)
            .or(default_color_space)
            .unwrap_or(PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb);

        Ok(Self {
            data,
            width: pixels_per_row,
            height: rows,
            color_space,
        })
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagedata-width
    pub(crate) fn width(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(self.width)
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagedata-height
    pub(crate) fn height(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(self.height)
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagedata-data
    pub(crate) fn data(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Gc<TypedArrayBase>> {
        Ok(self.data)
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagedata-colorspace
    pub(crate) fn color_space(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<PredefinedColorSpace> {
        Ok(self.color_space)
    }

    pub(crate) fn predefined_color_space(&self) -> PredefinedColorSpace {
        self.color_space
    }

    pub(crate) fn size(&self) -> (u32, u32) {
        (self.width, self.height)
    }

    /// Whether the buffer of the data attribute is detached.
    pub(crate) fn is_detached(&self) -> bool {
        self.data.viewed_array_buffer().is_detached()
    }

    /// The first byte of the pixels, which are width × height × 4 bytes, unless the buffer of the data attribute is
    /// detached or the data no longer has room for them. The pointer is valid until script runs: script can detach
    /// or shrink the buffer, and write to it, so the pixels are read and written through the pointer, never as a
    /// slice.
    pub(crate) fn pixels(&self) -> Option<NonNull<u8>> {
        if !can_hold_pixels(&self.data, self.width, self.height) {
            return None;
        }
        let buffer = self.data.viewed_array_buffer();
        let byte_offset = self.data.byte_offset();
        NonNull::new(buffer.with_data_block(|data_block| data_block.data_at(byte_offset)))
    }
}

fn invalid_state_error(message: &[u8]) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("InvalidStateError", Utf16String::from_ascii(message))
}

/// The identifier by which a storage record holds a color space.
fn color_space_storage_identifier(color_space: PredefinedColorSpace) -> &'static [u8] {
    match color_space {
        PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb => b"srgb",
        PredefinedColorSpace::SrgbLinear => b"srgb-linear",
        PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3 => b"display-p3",
        PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3Linear => b"display-p3-linear",
    }
}

/// Writes the color space as a record holds one: by its identifier in a storage record, and by its underlying value in
/// one for IPC.
fn serialize_color_space(serialized: &mut SerializationWriter, color_space: PredefinedColorSpace, for_storage: bool) {
    if for_storage {
        serialized.write_utf16_string(&Utf16String::from_ascii(color_space_storage_identifier(color_space)));
    } else {
        serialized.write_u8(color_space as u8);
    }
}

/// Reads what serialize_color_space() writes.
fn deserialize_color_space(serialized: &mut SerializationReader) -> WebIdlResult<PredefinedColorSpace> {
    let color_space = if serialized.is_for_storage() {
        let identifier = serialized.read_utf16_string()?;
        [
            PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb,
            PredefinedColorSpace::SrgbLinear,
            PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3,
            PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3Linear,
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .find(|&color_space| identifier == Utf16String::from_ascii(color_space_storage_identifier(color_space)))
    } else {
        PredefinedColorSpace::from_u8(serialized.read_u8()?)
    };
    color_space.ok_or_else(|| {
        Exception::Dom(
            "DataCloneError",
            Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Unknown structured serialize color space"),
        )
    })
}

impl Serializable for ImageData {
    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#the-imagedata-interface:serialization-steps
    fn serialization_steps(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        serialized: &mut SerializationWriter,
        for_storage: bool,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Set serialized.[[Data]] to the sub-serialization of the value of value's data attribute.
        serialized.write_value(Value::from_object(self.data))?;

        // 2. Set serialized.[[Width]] to the value of value's width attribute.
        serialized.write_u32(self.width);

        // 3. Set serialized.[[Height]] to the value of value's height attribute.
        serialized.write_u32(self.height);

        // 4. Set serialized.[[ColorSpace]] to the value of value's colorSpace attribute.
        serialize_color_space(serialized, self.color_space, for_storage);

        // FIXME: 5. Set serialized.[[PixelFormat]] to the value of value's pixelFormat attribute.

        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#the-imagedata-interface:deserialization-steps
    fn deserialization_steps(_: &mut CallContext, serialized: &mut SerializationReader) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        // 1. Initialize value's data attribute to the sub-deserialization of serialized.[[Data]].
        let data_value = serialized.read_value()?;
        let data = data_value
            .is_object()
            .then(|| data_value.as_object().downcast::<TypedArrayBase>())
            .flatten()
            .filter(|data| data.kind() == TypedArrayKind::Uint8ClampedArray)
            .ok_or_else(|| {
                Exception::Dom(
                    "DataCloneError",
                    Utf16String::from_ascii(b"ImageData data must be a Uint8ClampedArray"),
                )
            })?;

        // 2. Initialize value's width attribute to serialized.[[Width]].
        let width = serialized.read_u32()?;

        // 3. Initialize value's height attribute to serialized.[[Height]].
        let height = serialized.read_u32()?;

        // 4. Initialize value's colorSpace attribute to serialized.[[ColorSpace]].
        let color_space = deserialize_color_space(serialized)?;

        // FIXME: 5. Initialize value's pixelFormat attribute to serialized.[[PixelFormat]].

        // AD-HOC: Validate that the data has room for the pixels.
        if !can_hold_pixels(&data, width, height) {
            return Err(invalid_state_error(
                b"Image data must not be detached or out-of-bounds.",
            ));
        }

        Ok(Self {
            data,
            width,
            height,
            color_space,
        })
    }
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]

    code: u16,
    message: Utf16String,
}

impl Wrappable for MediaError {}

impl MediaError {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#dom-mediaerror-code
    pub(crate) fn code(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u16> {

    }
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]

    error.implementation::<MediaError>().message.clone().into_raw()

//! MessageChannel, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#message-channels

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::html::message_port::MessagePort;

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#messagechannel
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct MessageChannel {
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    // Each MessageChannel object has an associated port 1 and an associated port 2, both MessagePort objects.
    port1: Ref<MessagePort>,
    port2: Ref<MessagePort>,
}

impl Wrappable for MessageChannel {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        Some(self.realm)
    }
}

impl MessageChannel {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#dom-messagechannel
    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Self> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = cx.realm();

        // 1. Set this's port 1 to a new MessagePort in this's relevant realm.
        let port1 = MessagePort::create(vm, realm);

        // 2. Set this's port 2 to a new MessagePort in this's relevant realm.
        let port2 = MessagePort::create(vm, realm);

        // 3. Entangle this's port 1 and this's port 2.
        MessagePort::entangle(vm, port1, port2);

        Ok(Self { realm, port1, port2 })
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#dom-messagechannel-port1
    pub(crate) fn port1(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<MessagePort>> {
        // The port1 getter steps are to return this's port 1.
        Ok(self.port1)
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#dom-messagechannel-port2
    pub(crate) fn port2(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<MessagePort>> {
        // The port2 getter steps are to return this's port 2.
        Ok(self.port2)
    }
}

/// The union MessageEventSource of HTML/MessageEvent.idl, whose members the bindings convert.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum MessageEventSource {
    WindowProxy(CppInterface),
    MessagePort(Ref<MessagePort>),
}

/// The dictionary MessageEventInit of HTML/MessageEvent.idl, whose members the bindings convert.
pub(crate) struct MessageEventInit<'vm> {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) data: Value,
    pub(crate) origin: UsvString,
    pub(crate) last_event_id: Utf16String,
    pub(crate) source: Option<MessageEventSource>,
    pub(crate) ports: MarkedVec<'vm, Ref<MessagePort>>,
}

impl<'vm> MessageEventInit<'vm> {
    /// The dictionary with the default value of each member.
    pub(crate) fn new(vm: &'vm Vm) -> Self {
        Self {
            parent: EventInit {
                bubbles: false,
                cancelable: false,
                composed: false,
            },
            data: Value::NULL,
            origin: UsvString::from_utf8(""),
            last_event_id: Utf16String::from_utf8(""),
            source: None,
            ports: MarkedVec::new(vm),
        }
    }
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/comms.html#concept-messageevent-origin
// Each MessageEvent has an origin (an origin, a string, or null), initially null.
enum MessageEventOrigin {
    Origin(Origin),
    String(UsvString),
    Null,
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
struct MessageEventState {
    data: Value,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    origin: MessageEventOrigin,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    last_event_id: Utf16String,
    source: Option<MessageEventSource>,
    ports: Vec<Ref<MessagePort>>,
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/comms.html#messageevent
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct MessageEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    state: GcRefCell<MessageEventState>,
    ports_arrays: WorldEntries<Object>,
}

impl Wrappable for MessageEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl MessageEvent {
    /// A new MessageEvent in the realm, whose origin is the origin if there is one, and the origin member of the
    /// dictionary otherwise.
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: MessageEventInit<'_>,
        origin: Option<Origin>,
    ) -> Ref<MessageEvent> {
        let origin = match origin {
            Some(origin) => MessageEventOrigin::Origin(origin),
            None => MessageEventOrigin::String(event_init.origin),
        };
        Self::create_with_origin(
            vm,
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.parent,
            event_init.data,
            origin,
            event_init.last_event_id,
            event_init.source,
            &event_init.ports,
        )
    }

    /// A new MessageEvent in the realm whose type is the empty string, for createEvent().
    pub(crate) fn create_for_create_event(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) -> Ref<MessageEvent> {
        let event_init = MessageEventInit::new(vm);
        Self::create_with_origin(
            vm,
            realm,
            &Utf16String::from_utf8(""),
            event_init.parent,
            event_init.data,
            MessageEventOrigin::Null,
            event_init.last_event_id,
            event_init.source,
            &event_init.ports,
        )
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the event has these attributes")]
    fn create_with_origin(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: EventInit,
        data: Value,
        origin: MessageEventOrigin,
        last_event_id: Utf16String,
        source: Option<MessageEventSource>,
        ports: &MarkedVec<'_, Ref<MessagePort>>,
    ) -> Ref<MessageEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.bubbles,
            event_init.cancelable,
            event_init.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| MessageEvent {
            event,
            state: GcRefCell::new(MessageEventState {
                data,
                origin,
                last_event_id,
                source,
                ports: ports.to_vec(),
            }),
            ports_arrays: WorldEntries::default(),
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init_dict: MessageEventInit<'_>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<MessageEvent>> {
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &r#type, event_init_dict, None))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    /// The data attribute, for the implementation.
    pub(crate) fn data_value(&self) -> Value {
        self.state.borrow().data
    }

    pub(crate) fn data(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        Ok(self.data_value())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/comms.html#dom-messageevent-origin
    pub(crate) fn origin(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<UsvString> {
        Ok(match &self.state.borrow().origin {
            // 1. If this's origin is an origin, then return the serialization of this's origin.
            MessageEventOrigin::Origin(origin) => UsvString::from_utf8(&origin.serialize()),
            // 2. If this's origin is null, then return the empty string.
            MessageEventOrigin::Null => UsvString::from_utf8(""),
            // 3. Return this's origin.
            MessageEventOrigin::String(origin) => origin.clone(),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn last_event_id(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.state.borrow().last_event_id.clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn source(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<MessageEventSource>> {
        Ok(self.state.borrow().source)
    }

    pub(crate) fn ports(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        let ports = self.ports_arrays.get_or_create(cx, || {
            let ports = MarkedVec::new(cx.vm());
            for port in &self.state.borrow().ports {
                ports.push(*port);
            }
            let array = rooted_sequence_to_js(cx, ports, |port| Ok(Value::from_object(wrap(cx, *port))));
            frozen_array_to_js(cx, array).must().as_object()
        });
        Ok(Value::from_object(ports))
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/comms.html#dom-messageevent-initmessageevent
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the operation has these arguments")]
    pub(crate) fn init_message_event(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        bubbles: bool,
        cancelable: bool,
        data: Value,
        origin: UsvString,
        last_event_id: Utf16String,
        source: Option<MessageEventSource>,
        ports: MarkedVec<'_, Ref<MessagePort>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The initMessageEvent(type, bubbles, cancelable, data, origin, lastEventId, source, ports) method must
        // initialize the event in a manner analogous to the similarly-named initEvent() method.

        // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-initevent
        // 1. If this’s dispatch flag is set, then return.
        if self.event.dispatched() {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 2. Initialize this with type, bubbles, and cancelable.
        self.event.initialize_event(&r#type, bubbles, cancelable);

        *self.state.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = MessageEventState {
            data,
            origin: MessageEventOrigin::String(origin),
            last_event_id,
            source,
            ports: ports.to_vec(),
        };

        self.ports_arrays.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/comms.html#the-messageevent-interface:extract-an-origin
    pub(crate) fn extract_an_origin(&self) -> Option<Origin> {
        // Objects implementing the MessageEvent interface's extract an origin steps are to return this's origin if it
        // is an origin; otherwise null.
        match &self.state.borrow().origin {
            MessageEventOrigin::Origin(origin) => Some(origin.clone()),
            MessageEventOrigin::String(_) | MessageEventOrigin::Null => None,
        }
    }
}

/// The dictionary StructuredSerializeOptions of HTML/MessagePort.idl, whose members the bindings convert.
pub(crate) struct StructuredSerializeOptions<'vm> {
