//! WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#windoworworkerglobalscope

use core::ffi::c_void;

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Object, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, cell_from_abi};
use crate::bindings::promise::{pending_steps, run_pending_steps};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::html::structured_serialize::transfer_record::TransferRecord;
use crate::html::structured_serialize::{structured_deserialize_with_transfer, structured_serialize_with_transfer};
use crate::trusted_types::trusted_type_policy_factory::TrustedTypePolicyFactory;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_html_window_or_worker_global_scope_run_steps_after_a_timeout(
        global_object: *mut c_void,
        milliseconds: u64,
        cell: *mut c_void,
        steps: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *mut c_void),
    );
    fn web_html_window_or_worker_global_scope_trusted_types(global_object: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/structured-data.html#dom-structuredclone
pub(crate) fn structured_clone(cx: &CallContext, value: Value, transfer: &[Gc<Object>]) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
    // 1. Let serialized be ? StructuredSerializeWithTransfer(value, options["transfer"]).
    let serialized = structured_serialize_with_transfer(cx, value, transfer)?;

    // 2. Let deserializeRecord be ? StructuredDeserializeWithTransfer(serialized, this's relevant realm).
    let deserialize_record = structured_deserialize_with_transfer(cx, serialized);
    TransferRecord::discard(serialized);

    // 3. Return deserializeRecord.[[Deserialized]].
    Ok(deserialize_record?.deserialized)
}

// https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#dom-windoworworkerglobalscope-trustedtypes
pub(crate) fn trusted_types(global_object: Gc<Object>) -> Ref<TrustedTypePolicyFactory> {
    // SAFETY: The global object is a live Window or WorkerGlobalScope, whose live factory LibWeb returns.
    unsafe {
        cell_from_abi(web_html_window_or_worker_global_scope_trusted_types(
            global_object.as_ptr().cast(),
        ))
    }
}

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#windoworworkerglobalscope
#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct CppWindowOrWorkerGlobalScope(pub(crate) Gc<Object>);

impl CppWindowOrWorkerGlobalScope {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/timers-and-user-prompts.html#run-steps-after-a-timeout
    pub(crate) fn run_steps_after_a_timeout<C: Trace + Clone + 'static>(
        &self,
        vm: &Vm,
        milliseconds: u64,
        captures: C,
        steps: fn(&Vm, C),
    ) {
        let cell = pending_steps(vm, captures, steps);
        // SAFETY: The global object is a live Window or WorkerGlobalScope, and LibWeb keeps the steps alive until the
        // timeout completes.
        unsafe {
            web_html_window_or_worker_global_scope_run_steps_after_a_timeout(
                self.0.as_ptr().cast(),
                milliseconds,
                cell,
                run_pending_steps,
            );
        }
    }
}

type ReceiveOrigin = unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const FfiOrigin);

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_window_post_message_incumbent_settings() -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_window_post_message_settings_origin(settings: *mut c_void, context: *mut c_void, receive: ReceiveOrigin);
    fn web_window_post_message_source(settings: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_window_post_message_source_object(source: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_window_post_message_parse_target_origin(target: usize, context: *mut c_void, receive: ReceiveOrigin);
    fn web_window_post_message_realm(window: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_window_post_message_document_origin(window: *mut c_void, context: *mut c_void, receive: ReceiveOrigin);
    fn web_window_post_message_send_remote(
        target: *mut c_void,
        settings: *mut c_void,
        record: *mut c_void,
        target_origin: *const FfiOrigin,
        source_origin: *const FfiOrigin,
        source: *mut c_void,
    );
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct PostedMessage {
    pub(crate) target_window: CppCell,
    pub(crate) serialize_with_transfer_result: TransferRecordRef,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pub(crate) target_origin: Option<Origin>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pub(crate) origin: Origin,
    pub(crate) source: Option<CppCell>,
}

static POSTED_MESSAGE_CLASS: EmbedderClass<PostedMessage> = EmbedderClass::new("WindowPostedMessage");

impl EmbedderValue for PostedMessage {
    const CLASS: &'static EmbedderClass<Self> = &POSTED_MESSAGE_CLASS;
}

unsafe extern "C" fn receive_origin(context: *mut c_void, origin: *const FfiOrigin) {
    // SAFETY: Each caller lends its result slot, and C++ lends a valid origin for the call.
    unsafe { *context.cast::<Option<Origin>>() = Some((*origin).to_origin()) };
}

fn origin_of(cell: &CppCell, query: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *mut c_void, ReceiveOrigin)) -> Origin {
    let mut origin = None;
    // SAFETY: The cell is live, and the callback writes to the result slot while it is lent.
    unsafe { query(cell.as_ptr(), (&raw mut origin).cast(), receive_origin) };
    origin.expect("C++ lends the origin")
}

fn realm_of(window: &CppCell) -> Gc<Realm> {
    // SAFETY: The window is live, and C++ returns its live principal realm.
    unsafe {
        Gc::from_non_null(
            NonNull::new(web_window_post_message_realm(window.as_ptr()).cast()).expect("a Window has a realm"),
        )
    }
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#window-post-message-steps
pub(crate) fn window_post_message_steps(
    cx: &CallContext,
    target_window: CppCell,
    remote: bool,
    message: Value,
    target_origin: &Utf16String,
    transfer: &[Gc<Object>],
) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    // 1. Let targetRealm be targetWindow's realm.
    // NB: Taken from targetWindow when the queued task delivers the message.

    // 2. Let incumbentSettings be the incumbent settings object.
    // SAFETY: C++ returns the live incumbent settings object.
    let incumbent_settings = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(web_window_post_message_incumbent_settings()) };

    // 3. Let targetOrigin be options["targetOrigin"].
    let target_origin_units = target_origin.to_utf16();
    let target_origin = if target_origin_units.as_ref() == [u16::from(b'/')] {
        // 4. If targetOrigin is a single U+002F SOLIDUS character (/), then set targetOrigin to incumbentSettings's origin.
        Some(origin_of(&incumbent_settings, web_window_post_message_settings_origin))
    }
    // 5. Otherwise, if targetOrigin is not a single U+002A ASTERISK character (*):
    else if target_origin_units.as_ref() != [u16::from(b'*')] {
        // 1. Let parsedURL be the result of running the URL parser on targetOrigin.
        let mut parsed_url_origin = None;
        // SAFETY: The string and the result slot are lent for the call.
        unsafe {
            web_window_post_message_parse_target_origin(
                target_origin.raw_identity(),
                (&raw mut parsed_url_origin).cast(),
                receive_origin,
            );
        }

        // 2. If parsedURL is failure, then throw a "SyntaxError" DOMException.
        let Some(parsed_url_origin) = parsed_url_origin else {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "SyntaxError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                    "Invalid URL for targetOrigin: '{}'",
                    String::from_utf16_lossy(&target_origin_units)
                )),
            ));
        };

        // 3. Set targetOrigin to parsedURL's origin.
        Some(parsed_url_origin)
    } else {
        None
    };

    // 6. Let transfer be options["transfer"].
    // 7. Let serializeWithTransferResult be StructuredSerializeWithTransfer(message, transfer). Rethrow any exceptions.
    let serialize_with_transfer_result = structured_serialize_with_transfer(cx, message, transfer)?;

    // NB: The task queued by step 8 reads incumbentSettings in its steps 2 and 3. Snapshot those values here.
    // 8.2. Let origin be incumbentSettings's origin.
    let origin = origin_of(&incumbent_settings, web_window_post_message_settings_origin);

    // 8.3. Let source be the WindowProxy object corresponding to incumbentSettings's global object (a Window object).
    // SAFETY: The settings object is live, and C++ returns its live WindowProxy.
    let source = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(web_window_post_message_source(incumbent_settings.as_ptr())) };

    // 8. Queue a global task on the posted message task source given targetWindow to run the following steps:
    if remote {
        // NB: targetWindow lives in the process hosting this navigable's document, so the task is a request to the UI
        //     process, which forwards it there. That process represents the source's navigable, which names the source.
        //     A source whose [[Window]] has no navigable is null there.
        let serialize_with_transfer_result = TransferRecord::into_cpp(serialize_with_transfer_result, cx.vm());
        FfiOrigin::with_origin(&origin, |origin| {
            let send = |target_origin| {
                // SAFETY: Every cell and origin is live, and the call takes over the record's contents.
                unsafe {
                    web_window_post_message_send_remote(
                        target_window.as_ptr(),
                        incumbent_settings.as_ptr(),
                        serialize_with_transfer_result.record().as_raw(),
                        target_origin,
                        origin,
                        source.as_ptr(),
                    );
                }
            };
            match &target_origin {
                Some(target_origin) => FfiOrigin::with_origin(target_origin, |target_origin| send(target_origin)),
                None => send(core::ptr::null()),
            }
        });
        return Ok(());
    }
    queue_posted_message(
        cx.vm(),
        PostedMessage {
            target_window,
            serialize_with_transfer_result,
            target_origin,
            origin,
            source: Some(source),
        },
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn queue_posted_message(vm: &Vm, posted_message: PostedMessage) {
    let posted_message = POSTED_MESSAGE_CLASS.allocate(vm, |_| posted_message);
    queue_a_global_task(
        vm,
        realm_of(&posted_message.target_window).global_object(),
        TaskSource::PostedMessage,
        posted_message,
        posted_message_task_steps,
    );
}

fn posted_message_task_steps(vm: &Vm, posted_message: Gc<EmbedderCell<PostedMessage>>) {
    let serialize_with_transfer_result = posted_message.serialize_with_transfer_result;

    // 1. Let targetRealm be targetWindow's realm.
    let target_realm = realm_of(&posted_message.target_window);

    // 1. If the targetOrigin argument is not a single literal U+002A ASTERISK character (*) and targetWindow's
    //    associated Document's origin is not same origin with targetOrigin, then return.
    // NB: Due to step 4 and 5 above, the only time it's not '*' is if target_origin contains an Origin.
    if let Some(target_origin) = &posted_message.target_origin
        && !origin_of(&posted_message.target_window, web_window_post_message_document_origin)
            .is_same_origin(target_origin)
    {
        TransferRecord::discard(serialize_with_transfer_result);
        return;
    }

    // 2. Let origin be incumbentSettings's origin.
    // 3. Let source be the WindowProxy object corresponding to incumbentSettings's global object (a Window object).
    // NB: Both were snapshotted before the task was queued.
    let origin = &posted_message.origin;
    let source = posted_message.source.as_ref().map(|source| {
        // SAFETY: The source is a live WindowProxy, and C++ returns its live object.
        let object = unsafe { web_window_post_message_source_object(source.as_ptr()) };
        let object = NonNull::new(object.cast()).expect("a WindowProxy has an object");
        // SAFETY: The object is live.
        let object = unsafe { Gc::<Object>::from_non_null(object) };
        MessageEventSource::WindowProxy(window_proxy_from_object(object).expect("the source is a WindowProxy"))
    });

    // 4. Let deserializeRecord be StructuredDeserializeWithTransfer(serializeWithTransferResult, targetRealm).
    // NB: The execution context must not stay on the stack while the event is dispatched, so that a microtask
    //     checkpoint can be performed after each listener.
    let cx = CallContext::new(vm, target_realm);
    let deserialize_record = with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(target_realm, || {
        structured_deserialize_with_transfer(&cx, serialize_with_transfer_result)
    });
    TransferRecord::discard(serialize_with_transfer_result);

    // SAFETY: The target is a live Window, which is an EventTarget.
    let target_window = unsafe { CppEventTarget::from_raw(posted_message.target_window.as_ptr()) };

    //    If this throws an exception, catch it, fire an event named messageerror at targetWindow, using MessageEvent,
    //    with its origin initialized to origin and the source attribute initialized to source, and then return.
    let Ok(deserialize_record) = deserialize_record else {
        let mut event_init = MessageEventInit::new(vm);
        event_init.source = source;
        let event = MessageEvent::create(
            vm,
            target_realm,
            &Utf16String::from_utf8("messageerror"),
            event_init,
            Some(origin.clone()),
        );
        target_window.dispatch_event(event.event());
        return;
    };

    // 5. Let messageClone be deserializeRecord.[[Deserialized]].
    let message_clone = deserialize_record.deserialized;

    // 6. Let newPorts be a new frozen array consisting of all MessagePort objects in deserializeRecord.[[TransferredValues]],
    //    if any, maintaining their relative order.
    // FIXME: Use a FrozenArray
    let new_ports = MarkedVec::new(vm);
    for &value in deserialize_record.transferred_values.values().iter() {
        if is_host_instance_of(&value, MessagePort::wrapper_class()) {
            new_ports.push(implementation_of::<MessagePort>(value));
        }
    }

    // 7. Fire an event named message at targetWindow, using MessageEvent, with its origin initialized to origin,
    //    the source attribute initialized to source, the data attribute initialized to messageClone, and the ports
    //    attribute initialized to newPorts.
    let mut event_init = MessageEventInit::new(vm);
    event_init.data = message_clone;
    event_init.source = source;
    event_init.ports = new_ports;
    let event = MessageEvent::create(
        vm,
        target_realm,
        &Utf16String::from_utf8("message"),
        event_init,
        Some(origin.clone()),
    );
    target_window.dispatch_event(event.event());
}

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/system-state.html#pdf-viewer-plugin-names
pub(crate) const PDF_VIEWER_PLUGIN_NAMES: [&str; 5] = [
    "PDF Viewer",
    "Chrome PDF Viewer",
    "Chromium PDF Viewer",
    "Microsoft Edge PDF Viewer",
    "WebKit built-in PDF",
];

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/system-state.html#pdf-viewer-mime-types
pub(crate) const PDF_VIEWER_MIME_TYPES: [&str; 2] = ["application/pdf", "text/pdf"];

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/system-state.html#pdf-viewer-plugin-objects
pub(crate) fn with_pdf_viewer_plugin_objects<R>(
    vm: &Vm,
    window: &CppWindow,
    steps: impl FnOnce(&[Ref<Plugin>]) -> R,
) -> R {
    // Each Window object has a PDF viewer plugin objects list. If the user agent's PDF viewer supported is false, then
    // it is the empty list.
    if !window.pdf_viewer_supported() {
        return steps(&[]);
    }

    // Otherwise, it is a list containing five Plugin objects, whose names are, respectively:
    // 0. "PDF Viewer"
    // 1. "Chrome PDF Viewer"
    // 2. "Chromium PDF Viewer"
    // 3. "Microsoft Edge PDF Viewer"
    // 4. "WebKit built-in PDF"
    // The values of the above list form the PDF viewer plugin names list.
    let data = realm_data(vm, window.realm());
    if data.pdf_viewer_plugin_objects.borrow().is_empty() {
        let mut plugins = data.pdf_viewer_plugin_objects.borrow_mut(vm);
        for name in PDF_VIEWER_PLUGIN_NAMES {
            plugins.push(Plugin::create(vm, window.clone(), Utf16String::from_utf8(name)));
        }
    }
    steps(&data.pdf_viewer_plugin_objects.borrow())
}

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/system-state.html#pdf-viewer-mime-type-objects
pub(crate) fn with_pdf_viewer_mime_type_objects<R>(
    vm: &Vm,
    window: &CppWindow,
    steps: impl FnOnce(&[Ref<MimeType>]) -> R,
) -> R {
    // Each Window object has a PDF viewer mime type objects list. If the user agent's PDF viewer supported is false,
    // then it is the empty list.
    if !window.pdf_viewer_supported() {
        return steps(&[]);
    }

    // Otherwise, it is a list containing two MimeType objects, whose types are, respectively:
    // 0. "application/pdf"
    // 1. "text/pdf"
    // The values of the above list form the PDF viewer mime types list.
    let data = realm_data(vm, window.realm());
    if data.pdf_viewer_mime_type_objects.borrow().is_empty() {
        let mut mime_types = data.pdf_viewer_mime_type_objects.borrow_mut(vm);
        for r#type in PDF_VIEWER_MIME_TYPES {
            mime_types.push(MimeType::create(vm, window.clone(), Utf16String::from_utf8(r#type)));
        }
    }
    steps(&data.pdf_viewer_mime_type_objects.borrow())
}

    fn web_indexed_db_json_string(value: usize) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_indexed_db_json_binary(bytes: ak::Span<'_, u8>) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_indexed_db_json_null() -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_indexed_db_json_array() -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_indexed_db_json_array_append(array: *mut c_void, value: *mut c_void);
}

/// A WebIDL::DOMException of LibWeb.
#[derive(Clone, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct DomException(CppCell);

impl DomException {
    pub(crate) fn create(name: &str, message: &str) -> Self {
        Self::create_with_utf16_message(name, &Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
    }

    fn create_with_utf16_message(name: &str, message: &Utf16String) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: The name and the message are lent for the call, and LibWeb returns a live DOMException.
        Self(unsafe {
            CppCell::from_raw(web_indexed_db_create_dom_exception(
                ak::Span::new(name.as_bytes()),
                message.raw_identity(),
            ))
        })
    }

    /// The operations of requests only throw DOMExceptions.
    pub(crate) fn from_exception(exception: Exception) -> Self {
        match exception {
            Exception::Dom(name, message) => Self::create_with_utf16_message(name, &message),
            Exception::Thrown(throw) => {
                // SAFETY: The value is live while the call reads it.
                let exception = unsafe { web_indexed_db_dom_exception_from_value(throw.value().to_raw()) };
                assert!(!exception.is_null(), "the operation of a request threw a DOMException");
                // SAFETY: LibWeb returns a live DOMException.
                Self(unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(exception) })
            }
            Exception::TypeError(_) | Exception::RangeError(_) => {
                unreachable!("the operation of a request threw a DOMException")
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn wrapper(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> CppInterface {
        // SAFETY: The realm and the DOMException are live, and LibWeb returns a live wrapper.
        let wrapper = unsafe { web_indexed_db_wrap_dom_exception(cx.realm().as_ptr().cast(), self.0.as_ptr()) };
        let wrapper = NonNull::new(wrapper.cast::<Object>()).expect("LibWeb returns a wrapper");
        // SAFETY: The wrapper is a live wrapper of a DOMException.
        unsafe { CppInterface::from_wrapper(Gc::from_non_null(wrapper)) }
    }
}

unsafe extern "C" fn run_function(vm: *mut c_void, cell: *mut c_void) {
    // SAFETY: LibWeb passes the VM and the cell of the function, which it kept alive.
    let (vm, function) = unsafe {
        (
            &*vm.cast::<Vm>(),
            Function::from_cell(Gc::from_non_null(NonNull::new_unchecked(
                cell.cast::<EmbedderCell<FunctionCell>>(),
            ))),
        )
    };
    call_function(vm, function);
}

/// Queues the task with no document and no event loop, as the C++ did.
pub(crate) fn queue_a_task_on_the_database_access_task_source(_: &Vm, steps: Function) {
    // SAFETY: The function is live, and the task keeps it alive until it runs.
    unsafe { web_indexed_db_queue_a_database_task(steps.cell_as_ptr(), run_function) };
}

/// Runs the function from a deferred invocation, as the C++ ran steps "in parallel".
pub(crate) fn run_in_parallel(_: &Vm, steps: Function) {
    // SAFETY: The function is live, and the deferred invocation keeps it alive until it runs.
    unsafe { web_indexed_db_run_in_parallel(steps.cell_as_ptr(), run_function) };
}

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#main-thread-event-loop
pub(crate) fn current_event_loop() -> CppCell {
    // SAFETY: LibWeb returns the live event loop.
    unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(web_indexed_db_current_event_loop()) }
}

/// Checks the database's pending connection wait after the collection that runs a finalizer, if the database is still
/// alive then. Must not allocate a cell.
pub(crate) fn enqueue_post_gc_task(database: crate::indexed_db::internal::database::DatabaseRef) {
    // SAFETY: The database is live while LibGC finalizes the connection.
    unsafe { web_indexed_db_enqueue_check_pending_connection_wait(database.as_ptr().cast()) };
}

    database.check_pending_connection_wait(vm);
}

pub(crate) fn devtools_client_is_active(realm: Gc<Realm>) -> bool {
    // SAFETY: The realm is live.
    unsafe { web_indexed_db_devtools_client_is_active(realm.as_ptr().cast()) }
}

/// A JsonValue of the key, which the caller takes over.
pub(crate) fn json_value_of_key(key: &Key) -> *mut c_void {
    // SAFETY: Each call hands over a new JsonValue, which the array takes over when it is appended.
    unsafe {
        match key.value() {
            _ if key.is_invalid() => web_indexed_db_json_null(),
            KeyValue::Double(value) => web_indexed_db_json_number(*value),
            KeyValue::String(value) => web_indexed_db_json_string(value.raw_identity()),
            KeyValue::Bytes(value) => web_indexed_db_json_binary(ak::Span::new(value)),
            KeyValue::Keys(subkeys) => {
                let array = web_indexed_db_json_array();
                for subkey in subkeys {
                    web_indexed_db_json_array_append(array, json_value_of_key(subkey));
                }
                array
            }
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn notify_devtools_of_committed_changes(realm: Gc<Realm>, changes: &TransactionChanges) {
    // SAFETY: LibWeb returns new changes, which the notification takes over.
    let cpp_changes = unsafe { web_indexed_db_create_transaction_changes() };
    let append = |kind: u8, change: &TransactionChange| {
        let key = change
            .key
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(core::ptr::null_mut(), |key| json_value_of_key(key));
        // SAFETY: The changes are live, the names are lent for the call, and the call takes over the key.
        unsafe {
            web_indexed_db_append_transaction_change(
                cpp_changes,
                kind,
                change.database_name.raw_identity(),
                change.object_store_name.raw_identity(),
                key,
            );
        }
    };
    for change in &changes.added {
        append(0, change);
    }
    for change in &changes.changed {
        append(1, change);
    }
    for change in &changes.deleted {
        append(2, change);
    }
    // SAFETY: The realm is live, and the call takes over the changes.
    unsafe { web_indexed_db_notify_devtools(realm.as_ptr().cast(), cpp_changes) };
}

//! The C ABI of IndexedDB for LibWeb's C++ code: Libraries/LibWeb/IndexedDB/IDBFactory.cpp and Inspection.cpp.

use core::ffi::c_void;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Vm};
use liburl_rust::FfiOrigin;

use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::{CppCell, LentCppCell, cpp_class};
use crate::bindings::interface::cell_into_abi;
use crate::bindings::lent_string::LentUtf16String;
use crate::indexed_db::cpp::json_value_of_key;
use crate::indexed_db::idb_factory::IDBFactory;
use crate::indexed_db::idb_key_range::IDBKeyRange;

    KeyPath, cleanup_indexed_database_transactions, clear_an_object_store, close_a_database_connection,
    delete_records_from_an_object_store,
};
use crate::indexed_db::internal::database::Database;

/// # Safety
///
/// The origin must be one that LibWeb lends.
unsafe fn storage_key_from_abi(origin: *const FfiOrigin) -> StorageKey {
    // SAFETY: The caller lends a live origin.
    StorageKey {
        origin: unsafe { (*origin).to_origin() },
    }
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_indexed_db_create_factory(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) -> *mut c_void {
    cell_into_abi(IDBFactory::create(vm, realm))
}

/// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#cleanup-indexed-database-transactions
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_indexed_db_cleanup_indexed_database_transactions(
    vm: &Vm,
    event_loop: &LentCppCell<cpp_class::EventLoop>,
) -> bool {
    let event_loop = CppCell::from_lent(event_loop);
    cleanup_indexed_database_transactions(vm, &event_loop)
}

/// Runs close a database connection with every connection of the realm's global object whose close pending flag is
/// unset.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn web_rust_indexed_db_close_all_connections(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) {
    Database::for_each_database(vm, |database| {
        for connection in database.associated_connections(vm).values().iter() {
            if connection.close_pending() {
                continue;
            }
            if connection.realm() == realm {
                close_a_database_connection(vm, *connection, None, false);
            }
        }
    });
}

/// A key path as the inspection callbacks receive it: none, a string, or a list of strings.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct KeyPathAbi {
    kind: u8,
    strings: *const usize,
    count: usize,
}

fn with_key_path_abi<R>(key_path: Option<&KeyPath>, function: impl FnOnce(&KeyPathAbi) -> R) -> R {
    match key_path {
        None => function(&KeyPathAbi {
            kind: 0,
            strings: core::ptr::null(),
            count: 0,
        }),
        Some(KeyPath::String(string)) => {
            let raw = [string.raw_identity()];
            function(&KeyPathAbi {
                kind: 1,
                strings: raw.as_ptr(),
                count: 1,
            })
        }
        Some(KeyPath::Sequence(strings)) => {
            let raw: Vec<usize> = strings.iter().map(Utf16String::raw_identity).collect();
            function(&KeyPathAbi {
                kind: 2,
                strings: raw.as_ptr(),
                count: raw.len(),
            })
        }
    }
}

/// Calls `on_database` with each database of the storage key: its name, its version, and the names of its object
/// stores, which the call borrows.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// The VM must be live, the origin lent, and `on_database` must not keep what it borrows.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_indexed_db_inspect_databases(
    vm: &Vm,
    origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    ctx: *mut c_void,
    on_database: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, usize, u64, *const usize, usize),
) {
    // SAFETY: The caller lends the origin.
    let storage_key = unsafe { storage_key_from_abi(origin) };
    for database in Database::for_key(vm, &storage_key).values().iter() {
        let names: Vec<Utf16String> = database
            .object_stores(vm)
            .values()
            .iter()
            .map(|object_store| object_store.name())
            .collect();
        let raw_names: Vec<usize> = names.iter().map(Utf16String::raw_identity).collect();
        let name = database.name();
        // SAFETY: The strings are lent for the call.
        unsafe {
            on_database(
                ctx,
                name.raw_identity(),
                database.version(),
                raw_names.as_ptr(),
                raw_names.len(),
            );
        }
    }
}

/// Calls `on_object_store` with each object store of the database of the storage key with the name, and then
/// `on_index` with each of its indexes. Returns whether the database exists.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// The VM must be live, the origin and the name lent, and the callbacks must not keep what they borrow.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_indexed_db_inspect_object_stores(
    vm: &Vm,
    origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    database_name: LentUtf16String<'_>,
    ctx: *mut c_void,
    on_object_store: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, usize, *const KeyPathAbi, bool),
    on_index: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, usize, *const KeyPathAbi, bool, bool),
) -> bool {
    // SAFETY: The caller lends the origin.
    let (storage_key, database_name) = unsafe { (storage_key_from_abi(origin), database_name.to_utf16_string()) };
    let Some(database) = Database::for_key_and_name(vm, &storage_key, &database_name) else {
        return false;
    };
    for object_store in database.object_stores(vm).values().iter() {
        let name = object_store.name();
        with_key_path_abi(object_store.key_path(), |key_path| {
            // SAFETY: What the callback receives is lent for the call.
            unsafe { on_object_store(ctx, name.raw_identity(), key_path, object_store.uses_a_key_generator()) };
        });
        for index in object_store.indexes(vm).values().iter() {
            let index_name = index.name();
            with_key_path_abi(Some(index.key_path()), |key_path| {
                // SAFETY: What the callback receives is lent for the call.
                unsafe {
                    on_index(
                        ctx,
                        index_name.raw_identity(),
                        key_path,
                        index.unique(),
                        index.multi_entry(),
                    );
                }
            });
        }
    }
    true
}

/// Calls `on_record` with each record of the object store with the name in the database of the storage key with the
/// name: its key, a JsonValue that the callback takes over, and the bytes of its value, which the call borrows.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// The VM must be live, the origin and the names lent, and the callback must not keep the bytes.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_indexed_db_inspect_records(
    vm: &Vm,
    origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    database_name: LentUtf16String<'_>,
    object_store_name: LentUtf16String<'_>,
    ctx: *mut c_void,
    on_record: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *mut c_void, ak::Span<'_, u8>),
) {
    // SAFETY: The caller lends the origin.
    let (storage_key, database_name, object_store_name) = unsafe {
        (
            storage_key_from_abi(origin),
            database_name.to_utf16_string(),
            object_store_name.to_utf16_string(),
        )
    };
    let Some(database) = Database::for_key_and_name(vm, &storage_key, &database_name) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(object_store) = database.object_store_with_name(&object_store_name) else {
        return;
    };
    for record in object_store.records().iter() {
        // SAFETY: The callback takes over the key and borrows the bytes for the call.
        unsafe { on_record(ctx, json_value_of_key(&record.key), ak::Span::new(&record.value)) };
    }
}

/// The outcome of an inspection operation.
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum InspectionStatus {
    Done = 0,
    NoDatabase = 1,
    NoObjectStore = 2,
    NoRecord = 3,
    Blocked = 4,
}

/// Deletes the database of the storage key with the name, unless a connection to it is open.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// The VM must be live, and the origin and the name lent.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_indexed_db_delete_database_for_inspection(
    vm: &Vm,
    origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    database_name: LentUtf16String<'_>,
) -> InspectionStatus {
    // SAFETY: The caller lends the origin.
    let (storage_key, database_name) = unsafe { (storage_key_from_abi(origin), database_name.to_utf16_string()) };
    if let Some(database) = Database::for_key_and_name(vm, &storage_key, &database_name)
        && !database.associated_connections(vm).is_empty()
    {
        return InspectionStatus::Blocked;
    }

    Database::delete_for_key_and_name(vm, &storage_key, &database_name);
    InspectionStatus::Done
}

/// Clears the object store with the name of the database of the storage key with the name.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// The VM must be live, and the origin and the names lent.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_indexed_db_clear_object_store_for_inspection(
    vm: &Vm,
    origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    database_name: LentUtf16String<'_>,
    object_store_name: LentUtf16String<'_>,
) -> InspectionStatus {
    // SAFETY: The caller lends the origin.
    let (storage_key, database_name, object_store_name) = unsafe {
        (
            storage_key_from_abi(origin),
            database_name.to_utf16_string(),
            object_store_name.to_utf16_string(),
        )
    };
    let Some(database) = Database::for_key_and_name(vm, &storage_key, &database_name) else {
        return InspectionStatus::NoDatabase;
    };
    let Some(object_store) = database.object_store_with_name(&object_store_name) else {
        return InspectionStatus::NoObjectStore;
    };

    clear_an_object_store(vm, object_store);
    InspectionStatus::Done
}

/// Deletes the first record of the object store with the name of the database of the storage key with the name whose
/// key `matches` accepts. `matches` takes over the key it is given.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// The VM must be live, and the origin and the names lent.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_indexed_db_delete_record_for_inspection(
    vm: &Vm,
    origin: *const FfiOrigin,
    database_name: LentUtf16String<'_>,
    object_store_name: LentUtf16String<'_>,
    ctx: *mut c_void,
    matches: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *mut c_void) -> bool,
) -> InspectionStatus {
    // SAFETY: The caller lends the origin.
    let (storage_key, database_name, object_store_name) = unsafe {
        (
            storage_key_from_abi(origin),
            database_name.to_utf16_string(),
            object_store_name.to_utf16_string(),
        )
    };
    let Some(database) = Database::for_key_and_name(vm, &storage_key, &database_name) else {
        return InspectionStatus::NoDatabase;
    };
    let Some(object_store) = database.object_store_with_name(&object_store_name) else {
        return InspectionStatus::NoObjectStore;
    };

    let key = object_store
        .records()
        .iter()
        .map(|record| record.key.clone())
        // SAFETY: The callback takes over the key.
        .find(|key| unsafe { matches(ctx, json_value_of_key(key)) });
    let Some(key) = key else {
        return InspectionStatus::NoRecord;
    };

    let range = IDBKeyRange::create(vm, Some(key.clone()), Some(key), false, false);
    delete_records_from_an_object_store(vm, object_store, &range);
    InspectionStatus::Done
}

//! IDBCursorWithValue, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#idbcursorwithvalue

#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBCursorWithValue {
    cursor: IDBCursor,
}

    fn parent(&self) -> &IDBCursor {
        &self.cursor
    }
}

    pub(crate) fn new(cursor: IDBCursor) -> Self {
        Self { cursor }

        // The value getter steps are to return this’s current value.
        Ok(self.cursor.current_value().unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED))
    }
}

//! IDBCursor, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#cursor-interface

/// The enumeration IDBCursorDirection of IndexedDB/IDBCursor.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum IDBCursorDirection {
    Next,
    Nextunique,
    Prev,
    Prevunique,
}

/// The union (IDBObjectStore or IDBIndex) of IndexedDB/IDBCursor.idl.
pub(crate) enum IDBObjectStoreOrIDBIndex {
    IDBObjectStore(Ref<IDBObjectStore>),
    IDBIndex(Ref<IDBIndex>),
}

/// The source handle of a cursor: the index handle or the object store handle that opened it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum CursorSourceHandle {
    ObjectStore(Ref<IDBObjectStore>),
    Index(Ref<IDBIndex>),
}

impl From<CursorSourceHandle> for IDBRequestSource {
    fn from(source_handle: CursorSourceHandle) -> Self {
        match source_handle {
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(object_store) => IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(object_store),
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(index) => IDBRequestSource::Index(index),
        }
    }
}

// NB: The key and primaryKey getters return the same object instance every time they are inspected, until the
//     cursor's key or effective key changes. These cache the converted values along with the keys they came from.
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
struct CachedKeyValue {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    key: Option<Rc<Key>>,
    value: Value,
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#cursor-interface
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBCursor {
    // A cursor has a key and a value which represent the key and the value of the last iterated record.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    key: RefCell<Option<Rc<Key>>>,
    value: Cell<Option<Value>>,

    // A cursor has a position within its range.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    position: RefCell<Option<Rc<Key>>>,

    // When iterating indexes the cursor also has an object store position
    #[gc(untraced)]
    object_store_position: RefCell<Option<Rc<Key>>>,

    // A cursor has a direction that determines whether it moves in monotonically increasing or decreasing order of the record keys when iterated, and if it skips duplicated values when iterating indexes.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    direction: IDBCursorDirection,

    // A cursor has a got value flag.
    got_value: Cell<bool>,

    // A cursor has a source handle, which is the index handle or the object store handle that opened the cursor.
    source_handle: CursorSourceHandle,

    // A cursor has a range of records in either an index or an object store.
    range: Ref<IDBKeyRange>,

    // A cursor has a request, which is the request used to open the cursor.
    request: Cell<Option<Ref<IDBRequest>>>,

    // A cursor also has a key only flag, that indicates whether the cursor’s value is exposed via the API.
    key_only: bool,

    cached_key_value: GcRefCell<CachedKeyValue>,
    cached_primary_key_value: GcRefCell<CachedKeyValue>,

    // NB: The cursor as the interface it was created as, for the members of IDBCursor to return and pass on.
    this: Cell<Option<AnyIDBCursor>>,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBCursor {}

impl IDBCursor {
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the C++ created a cursor with these")]
    fn new(
        source_handle: CursorSourceHandle,
        position: Option<Rc<Key>>,
        direction: IDBCursorDirection,
        got_value: bool,
        key: Option<Rc<Key>>,
        value: Option<Value>,
        range: Ref<IDBKeyRange>,
        key_only: bool,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            value: Cell::new(value),
            position: RefCell::new(position),
            object_store_position: RefCell::new(None),
            direction,
            got_value: Cell::new(got_value),
            key: RefCell::new(key),
            source_handle,
            range,
            request: Cell::new(None),
            key_only,
            cached_key_value: GcRefCell::new(CachedKeyValue {
                key: None,
                value: Value::UNDEFINED,
            }),
            cached_primary_key_value: GcRefCell::new(CachedKeyValue {
                key: None,
                value: Value::UNDEFINED,
            }),
            this: Cell::new(None),
        }
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the C++ created a cursor with these")]
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        source_handle: CursorSourceHandle,
        position: Option<Rc<Key>>,
        direction: IDBCursorDirection,
        got_value: bool,
        key: Option<Rc<Key>>,
        value: Option<Value>,
        range: Ref<IDBKeyRange>,
        key_only: bool,
    ) -> AnyIDBCursor {
        let cursor = Self::new(
            source_handle,
            position,
            direction,
            got_value,
            key,
            value,
            range,
            key_only,
        );

        // A cursor that has its key only flag set to false implements the IDBCursorWithValue interface as well.
        let cursor = if key_only {
            AnyIDBCursor::IDBCursor(allocate(vm, |_| cursor))
        } else {
            AnyIDBCursor::IDBCursorWithValue(allocate(vm, |_| IDBCursorWithValue::new(cursor)))
        };
        cursor.this.set(Some(cursor));
        cursor
    }

    fn this(&self) -> AnyIDBCursor {
        self.this.get().expect("a cursor knows itself once it is created")
    }

    pub(crate) fn realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        match self.source_handle {
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(object_store) => object_store.realm(),
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(index) => index.realm(),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn direction_value(&self) -> IDBCursorDirection {
        self.direction
    }

    pub(crate) fn range(&self) -> Ref<IDBKeyRange> {
        self.range
    }

    pub(crate) fn position(&self) -> Option<Rc<Key>> {
        self.position.borrow().clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_key(&self) -> Option<Rc<Key>> {
        self.key.borrow().clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn object_store_position(&self) -> Option<Rc<Key>> {
        self.object_store_position.borrow().clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn key_only(&self) -> bool {
        self.key_only
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_value(&self) -> Option<Value> {
        self.value.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_request(&self, request: Option<Ref<IDBRequest>>) {
        self.request.set(request);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_position(&self, position: Option<Rc<Key>>) {
        *self.position.borrow_mut() = position;
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_got_value(&self, got_value: bool) {
        self.got_value.set(got_value);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_key(&self, key: Option<Rc<Key>>) {
        *self.key.borrow_mut() = key;
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_value(&self, value: Option<Value>) {
        self.value.set(value);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_object_store_position(&self, object_store_position: Option<Rc<Key>>) {
        *self.object_store_position.borrow_mut() = object_store_position;
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbcursor-source
    pub(crate) fn source(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<IDBObjectStoreOrIDBIndex> {
        // The source getter steps are to return this’s source handle.
        Ok(match self.source_handle {
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(object_store) => IDBObjectStoreOrIDBIndex::IDBObjectStore(object_store),
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(index) => IDBObjectStoreOrIDBIndex::IDBIndex(index),
        })
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbcursor-direction
    pub(crate) fn direction(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<IDBCursorDirection> {
        // The direction getter steps are to return this’s direction.
        Ok(self.direction)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbcursor-request
    pub(crate) fn request(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        // The request getter steps are to return this’s request.
        Ok(self.request.get().expect("a cursor has a request once it is returned"))
    }

    pub(crate) fn key(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The key getter steps are to return the result of converting a key to a
        // value with the cursor's current key.
        // NOTE: If key returns an object (e.g. a Date or Array), it returns the same object instance every time it is
        //       inspected, until the cursor's key is changed. This means that if the object is modified, those
        //       modifications will be seen by anyone inspecting the value of the cursor. However modifying such an object
        //       does not modify the contents of the database.
        let Some(key) = self.current_key() else {
            return Ok(Value::UNDEFINED);
        };

        let is_cached = self
            .cached_key_value
            .borrow()
            .key
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|cached| Rc::ptr_eq(cached, &key));
        if !is_cached {
            let value = convert_a_key_to_a_value(cx, &key);
            *self.cached_key_value.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = CachedKeyValue { key: Some(key), value };
        }
        Ok(self.cached_key_value.borrow().value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn primary_key(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The primaryKey getter steps are to return the result of converting a key
        // to a value with the cursor's current effective key.
        // NOTE: If primaryKey returns an object (e.g. a Date or Array), it returns the same object instance every time
        //       is inspected, until the cursor's effective key is changed. This means that if the object is modified,
        //       those modifications will be seen by anyone inspecting the value of the cursor. However modifying such an
        //       object does not modify the contents of the database.
        // AD-HOC: The effective key of a cursor whose key is undefined is undefined too, as in other engines.
        let Some(effective_key) = self.current_key().and_then(|_| self.effective_key()) else {
            return Ok(Value::UNDEFINED);
        };
        let is_cached = self
            .cached_primary_key_value
            .borrow()
            .key
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|cached| Rc::ptr_eq(cached, &effective_key));
        if !is_cached {
            let value = convert_a_key_to_a_value(cx, &effective_key);
            *self.cached_primary_key_value.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = CachedKeyValue {
                key: Some(effective_key),
                value,
            };
        }
        Ok(self.cached_primary_key_value.borrow().value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_source_or_object_store_deleted(&self) -> bool {
        match self.source_handle {
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(object_store) => object_store.store().is_deleted(),
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(index) => index.index().is_deleted() || index.index().object_store().is_deleted(),
        }
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#cursor-transaction
    pub(crate) fn transaction_object(&self) -> Ref<IDBTransaction> {
        // A cursor has a transaction, which is the transaction from the cursor’s source handle.
        match self.source_handle {
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(object_store) => object_store.transaction_object(),
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(index) => index.transaction_object(),
        }
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#cursor-source
    pub(crate) fn internal_source(&self) -> RecordSource {
        // A cursor has a source, which is an index or an object store from the cursor’s source handle.
        match self.source_handle {
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(object_store) => RecordSource::ObjectStore(object_store.store()),
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(index) => RecordSource::Index(index.index()),
        }
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbcursor-continue
    pub(crate) fn r#continue(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, key: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = self.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this's transaction.
        let transaction = self.transaction_object();

        // 2. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while continuing cursor",
            ));
        }

        // 3. If this’s source or effective object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if self.is_source_or_object_store_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Source or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If this's got value flag is false, indicating that the cursor is being iterated or has iterated past its end, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !self.got_value.get() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Cursor is active or EOL while continuing"));
        }

        // 5. If key is given, then:
        let mut key_value: Option<Rc<Key>> = None;
        if let Some(key) = key {
            // 1. Let r be the result of converting a value to a key with key. Rethrow any exceptions.
            let r = convert_a_value_to_a_key(&realm_cx, key, None)?;

            // 2. If r is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
            if r.is_invalid() {
                return Err(Exception::Dom("DataError", r.value_as_string().clone()));
            }

            // 3. Let key be r.
            let position = self.position().expect("a cursor that got a value has a position");
            key_value = Some(r.clone());

            // 4. If key is less than or equal to this's position and this's direction is "next" or "nextunique", then throw a "DataError" DOMException.
            let is_less_than_or_equal_to = Key::less_than(&r, &position) || Key::equals(&r, &position);
            if is_less_than_or_equal_to
                && (self.direction == IDBCursorDirection::Next || self.direction == IDBCursorDirection::Nextunique)
            {
                return Err(data_error("Key is less than or equal to cursor's position"));
            }

            // 5. If key is greater than or equal to this's position and this's direction is "prev" or "prevunique", then throw a "DataError" DOMException.
            let is_greater_than_or_equal_to = Key::greater_than(&r, &position) || Key::equals(&r, &position);
            if is_greater_than_or_equal_to
                && (self.direction == IDBCursorDirection::Prev || self.direction == IDBCursorDirection::Prevunique)
            {
                return Err(data_error("Key is greater than or equal to cursor's position"));
            }
        }

        // 6. Set this's got value flag to false.
        self.got_value.set(false);

        // 7. Let request be this's request.
        let request = self.request.get().expect("a cursor has a request");

        // 8. Set request’s processed flag to false.
        request.set_processed(false);

        // 9. Set request’s done flag to false.
        request.set_done(false);

        // 10. Let operation be an algorithm to run iterate a cursor with the current Realm record, this, and key (if given).
        let operation = create_operation(
            vm,
            (self.this(), realm, NoCells(key_value)),
            |vm, &(this, realm, ref key_value)| {
                let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
                let result = iterate_a_cursor(&cx, this, key_value.0.clone(), None, 1)?;
                Ok(idb_cursor_result(&cx, result))
            },
        );

        // 11. Run asynchronously execute a request with this’s source handle, operation, and request.
        asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            self.source_handle.into(),
            operation,
            Some(AnyIDBRequest::IDBRequest(request)),
        );

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#cursor-effective-key
    pub(crate) fn effective_key(&self) -> Option<Rc<Key>> {
        match self.source_handle {
            // If the source of a cursor is an object store, the effective key of the cursor is the cursor’s position
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(_) => self.position(),
            // If the source of a cursor is an index, the effective key is the cursor’s object store position.
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(_) => self.object_store_position(),
        }
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbcursor-advance
    pub(crate) fn advance(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, count: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = self.realm();

        // 1. If count is 0 (zero), throw a TypeError.
        if count == 0 {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("Count must not be zero (0)"));
        }

        // 2. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = self.transaction_object();

        // 3. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while advancing cursor",
            ));
        }

        // 4. If this’s source or effective object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if self.is_source_or_object_store_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Source or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 5. If this’s got value flag is false, indicating that the cursor is being iterated or has iterated past its end, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !self.got_value.get() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Cursor is active or EOL while advancing"));
        }

        // 6. Set this’s got value flag to false.
        self.got_value.set(false);

        // 7. Let request be this’s request.
        let request = self.request.get().expect("a cursor has a request");

        // 8. Set request’s processed flag to false.
        request.set_processed(false);

        // 9. Set request’s done flag to false.
        request.set_done(false);

        // 10. Let operation be an algorithm to run iterate a cursor with the current Realm record, this, and count.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (self.this(), realm, count), |vm, &(this, realm, count)| {
            let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
            let result = iterate_a_cursor(&cx, this, None, None, u64::from(count))?;
            Ok(idb_cursor_result(&cx, result))
        });

        // 11. Run asynchronously execute a request with this’s source handle, operation, and request.
        asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            self.source_handle.into(),
            operation,
            Some(AnyIDBRequest::IDBRequest(request)),
        );

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbcursor-continueprimarykey
    pub(crate) fn continue_primary_key(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        key_param: Value,
        primary_key_param: Value,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = self.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = self.transaction_object();

        // 2. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while continuing cursor",
            ));
        }

        // 3. If this’s source or effective object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if self.is_source_or_object_store_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Source or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If this’s source is not an index throw an "InvalidAccessError" DOMException.
        if !matches!(self.source_handle, CursorSourceHandle::Index(_)) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Cursor source is not an index"),
            ));
        }

        // 5. If this’s direction is not "next" or "prev", throw an "InvalidAccessError" DOMException.
        if self.direction != IDBCursorDirection::Next && self.direction != IDBCursorDirection::Prev {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Cursor direction is not next or prev"),
            ));
        }

        // 6. If this’s got value flag is false, indicating that the cursor is being iterated or has iterated past its end, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !self.got_value.get() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Cursor is active or EOL while continuing"));
        }

        // 7. Let r be the result of converting a value to a key with key. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let mut r = convert_a_value_to_a_key(&realm_cx, key_param, None)?;

        // 8. If r is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if r.is_invalid() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom("DataError", r.value_as_string().clone()));
        }

        // 9. Let key be r.
        let key = r;

        // 10. Let r be the result of converting a value to a key with primaryKey. Rethrow any exceptions.
        r = convert_a_value_to_a_key(&realm_cx, primary_key_param, None)?;

        // 11. If r is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if r.is_invalid() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom("DataError", r.value_as_string().clone()));
        }

        // 12. Let primaryKey be r.
        let primary_key = r;

        let position = self.position().expect("a cursor that got a value has a position");
        let object_store_position = self
            .object_store_position()
            .expect("a cursor of an index that got a value has an object store position");

        // 13. If key is less than this’s position and this’s direction is "next", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if Key::less_than(&key, &position) && self.direction == IDBCursorDirection::Next {
            return Err(data_error("Key is less than cursor's position"));
        }

        // 14. If key is greater than this’s position and this’s direction is "prev", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if Key::greater_than(&key, &position) && self.direction == IDBCursorDirection::Prev {
            return Err(data_error("Key is greater than cursor's position"));
        }

        // 15. If key is equal to this’s position and primaryKey is less than or equal to this’s object store position and this’s direction is "next", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if Key::equals(&key, &position)
            && (Key::less_than(&primary_key, &object_store_position)
                || Key::equals(&primary_key, &object_store_position))
            && self.direction == IDBCursorDirection::Next
        {
            return Err(data_error("Key is equal to cursor's position"));
        }

        // 16. If key is equal to this’s position and primaryKey is greater than or equal to this’s object store position and this’s direction is "prev", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if Key::equals(&key, &position)
            && (Key::greater_than(&primary_key, &object_store_position)
                || Key::equals(&primary_key, &object_store_position))
            && self.direction == IDBCursorDirection::Prev
        {
            return Err(data_error("Key is equal to cursor's position"));
        }

        // 17. Set this’s got value flag to false.
        self.got_value.set(false);

        // 18. Let request be this’s request.
        let request = self.request.get().expect("a cursor has a request");

        // 19. Set request’s processed flag to false.
        request.set_processed(false);

        // 20. Set request’s done flag to false.
        request.set_done(false);

        // 21. Let operation be an algorithm to run iterate a cursor with the current Realm record, this, key, and primaryKey.
        let operation = create_operation(
            vm,
            (self.this(), realm, NoCells((key, primary_key))),
            |vm, &(this, realm, ref keys)| {
                let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
                let result = iterate_a_cursor(&cx, this, Some(keys.0.0.clone()), Some(keys.0.1.clone()), 1)?;
                Ok(idb_cursor_result(&cx, result))
            },
        );

        // 22. Run asynchronously execute a request with this’s source handle, operation, and request.
        asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            self.source_handle.into(),
            operation,
            Some(AnyIDBRequest::IDBRequest(request)),
        );

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#cursor-effective-object-store
    pub(crate) fn effective_object_store(&self) -> ObjectStoreRef {
        match self.source_handle {
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(store) => {
                // If the source of a cursor is an object store, the effective object store of the cursor is that object store.
                store.store()
            }
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(index) => {
                // If the source of a cursor is an index, the effective object store of the cursor is that index’s referenced object store.
                index.object_store_handle().store()
            }
        }
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbcursor-update
    pub(crate) fn update(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: Value) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = self.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = self.transaction_object();

        // 2. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while updating cursor",
            ));
        }

        // 3. If transaction is a read-only transaction, throw a "ReadOnlyError" DOMException.
        if transaction.is_readonly() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "ReadOnlyError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Transaction is read-only while updating cursor"),
            ));
        }

        // 4. If this’s source or effective object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if self.is_source_or_object_store_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Source or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 5. If this’s got value flag is false, indicating that the cursor is being iterated or has iterated past its end, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !self.got_value.get() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Cursor is active or EOL while updating"));
        }

        // 6. If this’s key only flag is true, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if self.key_only {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Cursor is key-only while updating"));
        }

        // 7. Let targetRealm be a user-agent defined Realm.
        // NOTE: this is 'realm' above

        // 8. Let clone be a clone of value in targetRealm during transaction. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let clone = clone_in_realm(&realm_cx, value, transaction)?;

        // 9. If this’s effective object store uses in-line keys, then:
        let effective_object_store = self.effective_object_store();
        if effective_object_store.uses_inline_keys() {
            // 1. Let kpk be the result of extracting a key from a value using a key path with clone and the key path of this’s effective object store. Rethrow any exceptions.
            let kpk = extract_a_key_from_a_value_using_a_key_path(
                &realm_cx,
                clone,
                effective_object_store.key_path().expect("the store uses in-line keys"),
                false,
            )?;

            // 2. If kpk is failure, invalid, or not equal to this’s effective key, throw a "DataError" DOMException.
            let Ok(kpk_value) = kpk else {
                return Err(data_error("Key path is invalid"));
            };

            if kpk_value.is_invalid() {
                return Err(data_error("Key path is invalid"));
            }

            if !Key::equals(
                &kpk_value,
                &self
                    .effective_key()
                    .expect("a cursor with a value has an effective key"),
            ) {
                return Err(data_error("Key path is not equal to effective key"));
            }
        }

        // 10. Let operation be an algorithm to run store a record into an object store with this’s effective object store, clone, this’s effective key, and false.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (self.this(), realm, clone), |vm, &(this, realm, clone)| {
            with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(realm, || {
                let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
                let optional_key = store_a_record_into_an_object_store(
                    &cx,
                    this.effective_object_store(),
                    clone,
                    Some(
                        this.effective_key()
                            .expect("a cursor with a value has an effective key"),
                    ),
                    false,
                )?;

                let Some(optional_key) = optional_key.filter(|key| !key.is_invalid()) else {
                    return Ok(Value::UNDEFINED);
                };

                Ok(convert_a_key_to_a_value(&cx, &optional_key))
            })
        });

        // 11. Return the result (an IDBRequest) of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        Ok(request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::Cursor(self.this()),
            operation,
            None,
        )))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbcursor-delete
    pub(crate) fn delete(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = self.transaction_object();

        // 2. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while deleting cursor",
            ));
        }

        // 3. If transaction is a read-only transaction, throw a "ReadOnlyError" DOMException.
        if transaction.is_readonly() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "ReadOnlyError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Transaction is read-only while deleting cursor"),
            ));
        }

        // 4. If this’s source or effective object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if self.is_source_or_object_store_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Source or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 5. If this’s got value flag is false, indicating that the cursor is being iterated or has iterated past its end, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !self.got_value.get() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Cursor is active or EOL while deleting"));
        }

        // 6. If this’s key only flag is true, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if self.key_only {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Cursor is key-only while deleting"));
        }

        // 7. Let operation be an algorithm to run delete records from an object store with this’s effective object store and this’s effective key.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, self.this(), |vm, &this| {
            let effective_key = this
                .effective_key()
                .expect("a cursor with a value has an effective key");
            let range = IDBKeyRange::create(vm, Some(effective_key.clone()), Some(effective_key), false, false);
            Ok(delete_records_from_an_object_store(
                vm,
                this.effective_object_store(),
                &range,
            ))
        });

        // 8. Return the result (an IDBRequest) of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        Ok(request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::Cursor(self.this()),
            operation,
            None,
        )))
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum AnyIDBCursor {
    IDBCursor(Ref<IDBCursor>),
    IDBCursorWithValue(Ref<IDBCursorWithValue>),
}

impl Deref for AnyIDBCursor {
    type Target = IDBCursor;

    fn deref(&self) -> &IDBCursor {
        match self {
            Self::IDBCursor(cursor) => cursor,
            Self::IDBCursorWithValue(cursor) => {
                let cursor: &IDBCursorWithValue = cursor;
                cursor.parent()
            }
        }
    }
}

impl ToJs for AnyIDBCursor {
    fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {
        match self {
            Self::IDBCursor(cursor) => cursor.to_js(cx),
            Self::IDBCursorWithValue(cursor) => cursor.to_js(cx),
        }
    }
}
