// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#IDBDatabase-interface
// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#database-connection
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBDatabase {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,

    pending_transaction_waits: GcRefCell<Vec<PendingTransactionWait>>,

    version: Cell<u64>,
    name: Utf16String,

    // Each connection has a close pending flag which is initially false.
    close_pending: Cell<bool>,

    // When a connection is initially created it is in an opened state.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    state: Cell<ConnectionState>,

    // A connection has an object store set, which is initialized to the set of object stores in the associated database when the connection is created.
    // The contents of the set will remain constant except when an upgrade transaction is live.
    object_store_set: GcRefCell<Vec<ObjectStoreRef>>,

    // NOTE: There is an associated database in the spec, but there is no mention where it is assigned, nor where its from
    //       So we stash the one we have when opening a connection.
    associated_database: DatabaseRef,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,

    // NOTE: We need to keep track of what transactions were created by this connection
    // NB: Only the ones that have yet to finish, which is all that closing the connection and scheduling transactions
    //     look at. Keeping the finished ones would keep every transaction of a long-lived connection alive.
    transactions: GcRefCell<Vec<Ref<IDBTransaction>>>,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBDatabase {
    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(object: Ref<Self>) {
        object.associated_database.dissociate(object);
        enqueue_post_gc_task(object.associated_database);
    }

    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for IDBDatabase {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl IDBDatabase {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>, db: DatabaseRef) -> Ref<IDBDatabase> {
        let object_stores = db.object_stores(vm);
        let connection = allocate(vm, |_| IDBDatabase {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            pending_transaction_waits: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            version: Cell::new(0),
            name: db.name(),
            close_pending: Cell::new(false),
            state: Cell::new(ConnectionState::Open),
            object_store_set: GcRefCell::new(object_stores.to_vec()),
            associated_database: db,
            realm,
            transactions: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
        });
        connection.event_target.set_owner(connection);
        db.associate(vm, connection);
        connection
    }

    pub(crate) fn event_target(&self) -> &CppEventTarget {
        &self.event_target
    }

    pub(crate) fn realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        self.realm
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_version(&self, version: u64) {
        self.version.set(version);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_close_pending(&self, close_pending: bool) {
        self.close_pending.set(close_pending);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_state(&self, state: ConnectionState) {
        self.state.set(state);
    }

    pub(crate) fn close_pending(&self) -> bool {
        self.close_pending.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn state(&self) -> ConnectionState {
        self.state.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn associated_database(&self) -> DatabaseRef {
        self.associated_database
    }

    pub(crate) fn object_store_set<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, ObjectStoreRef> {
        let object_store_set = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        object_store_set.extend_from_slice(&self.object_store_set.borrow());
        object_store_set
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_to_object_store_set(&self, vm: &Vm, object_store: ObjectStoreRef) {
        self.object_store_set.borrow_mut(vm).push(object_store);
    }

    pub(crate) fn remove_from_object_store_set(&self, vm: &Vm, object_store: ObjectStoreRef) {
        let mut object_store_set = self.object_store_set.borrow_mut(vm);
        if let Some(position) = object_store_set.iter().position(|entry| *entry == object_store) {
            object_store_set.remove(position);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn transactions<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, Ref<IDBTransaction>> {
        let transactions = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        transactions.extend_from_slice(&self.transactions.borrow());
        transactions
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_transaction(&self, vm: &Vm, transaction: Ref<IDBTransaction>) {
        self.transactions.borrow_mut(vm).push(transaction);
    }

    pub(crate) fn remove_finished_transaction(&self, vm: &Vm, transaction: Ref<IDBTransaction>) {
        assert!(transaction.is_finished());
        let mut transactions = self.transactions.borrow_mut(vm);
        let position = transactions
            .iter()
            .position(|entry| *entry == transaction)
            .expect("a transaction finishes once, on the connection that created it");
        // NB: Keep the order, which block_on_conflicting_transactions() relies on to find earlier transactions.
        transactions.remove(position);
    }

    pub(crate) fn name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.name.clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn version(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u64> {
        Ok(self.version.get())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbdatabase-close
    pub(crate) fn close(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Run close a database connection with this connection.
        close_a_database_connection(cx.vm(), *this, None, false);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbdatabase-createobjectstore
    pub(crate) fn create_object_store(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        name: Utf16String,
        options: IDBObjectStoreParameters,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBObjectStore>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Let database be this's associated database.
        let database = this.associated_database;

        // 2. Let transaction be database’s upgrade transaction if it is not null, or throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException otherwise.
        let Some(transaction) = database.upgrade_transaction() else {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Upgrade transaction is null"));
        };

        // 3. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while creating object store",
            ));
        }

        // 4. Let keyPath be options’s keyPath member if it is not undefined or null, or null otherwise.
        let key_path = options.key_path.map(|key_path| match key_path {
            DOMStringOrDOMStringSequence::DOMString(value) => KeyPath::String(value),
            DOMStringOrDOMStringSequence::Sequence(values) => KeyPath::Sequence(values),
        });

        // 5. If keyPath is not null and is not a valid key path, throw a "SyntaxError" DOMException.
        if let Some(key_path) = &key_path
            && !is_valid_key_path(key_path)
        {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "SyntaxError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Invalid key path"),
            ));
        }

        // 6. If an object store named name already exists in database throw a "ConstraintError" DOMException.
        if database.object_store_with_name(&name).is_some() {
            return Err(constraint_error("Object store already exists"));
        }

        // 7. Let autoIncrement be options’s autoIncrement member.
        let auto_increment = options.auto_increment;

        let is_empty_key_path_or_sequence = match &key_path {
            Some(KeyPath::String(value)) => value.is_empty(),
            Some(KeyPath::Sequence(_)) => true,
            None => false,
        };

        // 8. If autoIncrement is true and keyPath is an empty string or any sequence (empty or otherwise), throw an "InvalidAccessError" DOMException.
        if auto_increment && is_empty_key_path_or_sequence {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Auto increment is true and key path is empty or sequence"),
            ));
        }

        // 9. Let store be a new object store in database.
        //    Set the created object store's name to name.
        //    If autoIncrement is true, then the created object store uses a key generator.
        //    If keyPath is not null, set the created object store's key path to keyPath.
        let object_store = ObjectStore::create(vm, database, name, auto_increment, key_path);

        // AD-HOC: Add newly created object store to this's object store set.
        this.add_to_object_store_set(vm, object_store);

        // AD-HOC: Set up a mutation log for this store and log its creation for potential revert on abort.
        transaction.set_up_mutation_log_for_new_store(vm, object_store);

        // 10. Return a new object store handle associated with store and transaction.
        transaction.add_to_scope(vm, object_store);
        Ok(IDBTransaction::get_or_create_object_store_handle(
            transaction,
            vm,
            object_store,
        ))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbdatabase-objectstorenames
    pub(crate) fn object_store_names(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMStringList>> {
        // 1. Let names be a list of the names of the object stores in this's object store set.
        let names = self
            .object_store_set
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .map(|object_store| object_store.name())
            .collect();

        // 2. Return the result (a DOMStringList) of creating a sorted name list with names.
        Ok(create_a_sorted_name_list(cx.vm(), names))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbdatabase-deleteobjectstore
    pub(crate) fn delete_object_store(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, name: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Let database be this's associated database.
        let database = self.associated_database;

        // 2. Let transaction be database’s upgrade transaction if it is not null, or throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException otherwise.
        let Some(transaction) = database.upgrade_transaction() else {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Upgrade transaction is null"));
        };

        // 3. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while deleting object store",
            ));
        }

        // 4. Let store be the object store named name in database, or throw a "NotFoundError" DOMException if none.
        let Some(store) = database.object_store_with_name(&name) else {
            return Err(not_found_error("Object store not found while trying to delete"));
        };

        // 5. Remove store from this's object store set.
        self.remove_from_object_store_set(vm, store);

        // NB: Upgrade transactions' scope is always the entire database. Since we removed this store from the database,
        //     it no longer belongs in the scope.
        transaction.remove_from_scope(vm, store);

        // 6. If there is an object store handle associated with store and transaction, remove all entries from its index set.
        if let Some(handle) = transaction.object_store_handle_for(store) {
            handle.index_set_clear(vm);
        }

        // AD-HOC: Mark the store and its indexes as deleted so that stale handles throw InvalidStateError.
        store.set_deleted(true);
        for index in store.indexes(vm).values().iter() {
            index.set_deleted(true);
        }

        // AD-HOC: Log the deletion for potential revert on abort.
        store
            .mutation_log()
            .expect("an upgrade transaction logs the mutations of its stores")
            .note_object_store_deleted(vm);

        // 7. Destroy store.
        Database::remove_object_store(database, vm, store);

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbdatabase-transaction
    pub(crate) fn transaction(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        store_names: DOMStringOrDOMStringSequence,
        mode: IDBTransactionMode,
        options: IDBTransactionOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBTransaction>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. If a live upgrade transaction is associated with the connection, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        let database = this.associated_database;
        if database.upgrade_transaction().is_some() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Upgrade transaction is live"));
        }

        // 2. If this's close pending flag is true, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if this.close_pending() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Close pending"));
        }

        // 3. Let scope be the set of unique strings in storeNames if it is a sequence, or a set containing one string equal to storeNames otherwise.
        let mut scope: Vec<Utf16String> = Vec::new();
        match store_names {
            DOMStringOrDOMStringSequence::Sequence(store_names) => {
                for store_name in store_names {
                    if !scope.contains(&store_name) {
                        scope.push(store_name);
                    }
                }
            }
            DOMStringOrDOMStringSequence::DOMString(store_name) => {
                scope.push(store_name);
            }
        }

        // 4. If any string in scope is not the name of an object store in the connected database, throw a "NotFoundError" DOMException.
        for store_name in &scope {
            if database.object_store_with_name(store_name).is_none() {
                return Err(not_found_error(
                    "Provided object store names does not exist in database",
                ));
            }
        }

        // 5. If scope is empty, throw an "InvalidAccessError" DOMException.
        if scope.is_empty() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Scope is empty"),
            ));
        }

        // 6. If mode is not "readonly" or "readwrite", throw a TypeError.
        if mode != IDBTransactionMode::Readonly && mode != IDBTransactionMode::Readwrite {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("Invalid transaction mode"));
        }

        // 7. Let transaction be a newly created transaction with this connection, mode, options’ durability member, and the set of object stores named in scope.
        let scope_stores = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        for store_name in &scope {
            let store = database
                .object_store_with_name(store_name)
                .expect("every name in scope is an object store");
            scope_stores.push(store);
        }

        let transaction = IDBTransaction::create(vm, *this, mode, options.durability, &scope_stores.values());

        // 8. Set transaction’s cleanup event loop to the current event loop.
        transaction.set_cleanup_event_loop(vm, Some(current_event_loop()));

        Self::block_on_conflicting_transactions(*this, vm, transaction);

        // 9. Return an IDBTransaction object representing transaction.
        Ok(transaction)
    }

    pub(crate) fn wait_for_transactions_to_finish(
        &self,
        vm: &Vm,
        transactions: &[Ref<IDBTransaction>],
        on_complete: Function,
    ) {
        let all_finished = transactions.iter().all(|entry| entry.is_finished());

        if all_finished {
            queue_a_database_task(vm, on_complete);
            return;
        }

        self.pending_transaction_waits
            .borrow_mut(vm)
            .push(PendingTransactionWait {
                transactions: transactions.to_vec(),
                callback: on_complete,
            });
    }

    pub(crate) fn check_pending_transaction_waits(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        let mut i = 0;
        loop {
            let callback = {
                let mut waits = self.pending_transaction_waits.borrow_mut(vm);
                if i >= waits.len() {
                    break;
                }
                let all_finished = waits[i]
                    .transactions
                    .iter()
                    .all(|transaction| transaction.is_finished());
                if !all_finished {
                    i += 1;
                    continue;
                }
                waits.remove(i).callback
            };
            call_function(vm, callback);
        }
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#transaction-scheduling
    pub(crate) fn block_on_conflicting_transactions(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm, transaction: Ref<IDBTransaction>) {
        // The following constraints define when a transaction can be started:

        // - A read-only transactions tx can start when there are no read/write transactions which:
        // - A read/write transaction tx can start when there are no transactions which:

        let blocking = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        let transaction_scope = transaction.scope(vm);
        for other in this.transactions(vm).values().iter() {
            let other = *other;

            // - Were created before tx; and
            if other == transaction {
                break;
            }

            // NB: According to the above conditions, we only block on transactions if one is read/write.
            if transaction.is_readonly() && other.is_readonly() {
                continue;
            }

            // - have overlapping scopes with tx; and
            let other_scope = other.scope(vm);
            let have_overlapping_scopes = transaction_scope
                .values()
                .iter()
                .any(|store| other_scope.values().contains(store));
            if !have_overlapping_scopes {
                continue;
            }

            // - are not finished.
            if other.is_finished() {
                continue;
            }

            blocking.push(other);
        }

        if blocking.is_empty() {
            if !transaction.is_readonly() {
                transaction.set_up_mutation_logs(vm);
            }
            return;
        }

        transaction.request_list().block_execution();
        this.wait_for_transactions_to_finish(
            vm,
            &blocking.values(),
            create_function(vm, transaction, |vm, &transaction, ()| {
                // NB: The transaction may have been aborted while it was blocked, and must not be committed after.
                if transaction.is_finished() {
                    return;
                }
                assert!(transaction.state() != TransactionState::Active);
                if transaction.request_list().is_empty() {
                    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#transaction-commit
                    // The implementation must attempt to commit an inactive transaction when all requests placed
                    // against the transaction have completed and their returned results handled, no new requests have
                    // been placed against the transaction, and the transaction has not been aborted

                    // If we were blocked, that means that the JS task has had its chance to make requests. If the request
                    // list is empty, then the cleanup in the microtask checkpoint already ran, but skipped auto-committing.
                    // We have to do it here instead.

                    // FIXME: Update if this becomes explicit:
                    //        https://github.com/w3c/IndexedDB/issues/489#issuecomment-3994928473
                    // NB: A transaction that commit() was called on while it was blocked is already committing.
                    if transaction.state() != TransactionState::Committing {
                        commit_a_transaction(vm, transaction);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if !transaction.is_readonly() {
                    transaction.set_up_mutation_logs(vm);
                }
                transaction.request_list().unblock_execution(vm);
            }),
        );
    }
}

//! IDBFactory, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#factory-interface

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Array, Gc, Must, Object, PrimitiveString, PropertyKey, Realm, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::environment_settings_object::relevant_settings_object;

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};

/// The dictionary IDBDatabaseInfo of IndexedDB/IDBFactory.idl.
pub(crate) struct IDBDatabaseInfo {
    pub(crate) name: Option<Utf16String>,
    pub(crate) version: Option<u64>,
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#idbfactory
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBFactory {
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBFactory {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        Some(self.realm)
    }
}

impl IDBFactory {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) -> Ref<IDBFactory> {
        allocate(vm, |_| IDBFactory { realm })
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbfactory-open
    pub(crate) fn open(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        name: Utf16String,
        version: Option<u64>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBOpenDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = self.realm;

        // 1. If version is 0 (zero), throw a TypeError.
        if version == Some(0) {
            return Err(Exception::type_error("The version provided must not be 0"));
        }

        // 2. Let environment be this's relevant settings object.
        // 3. Let storageKey be the result of running obtain a storage key given environment.
        //    If failure is returned, then throw a "SecurityError" DOMException and abort these steps.
        let Some(storage_key) = obtain_a_storage_key(&relevant_settings_object(realm.global_object())) else {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "SecurityError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Failed to obtain a storage key"),
            ));
        };

        // 4. Let request be a new open request.
        let request = IDBOpenDBRequest::create(vm, realm);

        // 5. Run these steps in parallel:
        // NB: We could defer these steps, but it wouldn't be observable anyway, since open_a_database_connection() will
        //     put this work into a queue and then process it later in the event loop regardless.

        // 1. Let result be the result of opening a database connection, with storageKey, name, version if given and undefined otherwise, and request.
        open_a_database_connection(
            vm,
            realm,
            storage_key,
            name,
            version,
            AnyIDBRequest::IDBOpenDBRequest(request),
            create_function_with(vm, (realm, request), |vm, &(realm, request), result: OpenResult| {
                // 2. Set request’s processed flag to true.
                let request = AnyIDBRequest::IDBOpenDBRequest(request);
                request.set_processed(true);

                // 3. Queue a database task to run these steps:
                queue_a_database_task(
                    vm,
                    create_function(vm, (realm, request, result), |vm, &(realm, request, ref result), ()| {
                        match result {
                            // 1. If result is an error, then:
                            Err(error) => {
                                // 1. Set request’s result to undefined.
                                request.set_result(Value::UNDEFINED);

                                // 2. Set request’s error to result.
                                request.set_error(vm, Some(error.clone()));

                                // 3. Set request’s done flag to true.
                                request.set_done(true);

                                // 4. Fire an event named error at request with its bubbles and cancelable attributes initialized to true.
                                request.event_target().dispatch_event(&CppEvent::create(
                                    request.realm(),
                                    "error",
                                    true,
                                    true,
                                    false,
                                ));
                            }
                            // 2. Otherwise:
                            Ok(connection) => {
                                // 1. Set request’s result to result.
                                set_idb_request_result(vm, realm, request, *connection);

                                // 2. Set request’s done flag to true.
                                request.set_done(true);

                                // 3. Fire an event named success at request.
                                request.event_target().dispatch_event(&CppEvent::create(
                                    request.realm(),
                                    "success",
                                    false,
                                    false,
                                    false,
                                ));
                            }
                        }
                    }),
                );
            }),
        );

        // 6. Return a new IDBOpenDBRequest object for request.
        Ok(request)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbfactory-cmp
    pub(crate) fn cmp(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, first: Value, second: Value) -> WebIdlResult<i16> {
        let cx = CallContext::new(cx.vm(), self.realm);

        // 1. Let a be the result of converting a value to a key with first. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let a = convert_a_value_to_a_key(&cx, first, None)?;

        // 2. If a is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if a.is_invalid() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "DataError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Failed to convert a value to a key"),
            ));
        }

        // 3. Let b be the result of converting a value to a key with second. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let b = convert_a_value_to_a_key(&cx, second, None)?;

        // 4. If b is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if b.is_invalid() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "DataError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Failed to convert a value to a key"),
            ));
        }

        // 5. Return the results of comparing two keys with a and b.
        Ok(i16::from(Key::compare_two_keys(&a, &b)))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbfactory-deletedatabase
    pub(crate) fn delete_database(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        name: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBOpenDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = self.realm;

        // 1. Let environment be this's relevant settings object.
        // 2. Let storageKey be the result of running obtain a storage key given environment.
        //    If failure is returned, then throw a "SecurityError" DOMException and abort these steps.
        let Some(storage_key) = obtain_a_storage_key(&relevant_settings_object(realm.global_object())) else {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "SecurityError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Failed to obtain a storage key"),
            ));
        };

        // 3. Let request be a new open request.
        let request = IDBOpenDBRequest::create(vm, realm);

        // 4. Run these steps in parallel:
        // NB: We could defer these steps, but it wouldn't be observable anyway, since delete_a_database() will
        //     put this work into a queue and then process it later in the event loop regardless.

        // 1. Let result be the result of deleting a database, with storageKey, name, and request.
        delete_a_database(
            vm,
            realm,
            storage_key,
            name,
            AnyIDBRequest::IDBOpenDBRequest(request),
            create_function_with(vm, (realm, request), |vm, &(realm, request), result: DeleteResult| {
                // 2. Set request’s processed flag to true.
                let request = AnyIDBRequest::IDBOpenDBRequest(request);
                request.set_processed(true);

                // 3. Queue a database task to run these steps:
                queue_a_database_task(
                    vm,
                    create_function(vm, (realm, request, result), |vm, &(realm, request, ref result), ()| {
                        match result {
                            // 1. If result is an error, set request’s error to result, set request’s done flag to true, and fire an event
                            //    named error at request with its bubbles and cancelable attributes initialized to true.
                            Err(error) => {
                                request.set_error(vm, Some(error.clone()));
                                request.set_done(true);
                                request.event_target().dispatch_event(&CppEvent::create(
                                    request.realm(),
                                    "error",
                                    true,
                                    true,
                                    false,
                                ));
                            }
                            // 2. Otherwise, set request’s result to undefined, set request’s done flag to true, and fire a version change
                            //    event named success at request with result and null.
                            Ok(value) => {
                                request.set_result(Value::UNDEFINED);
                                request.set_done(true);
                                fire_a_version_change_event(vm, realm, "success", request.event_target(), *value, None);
                            }
                        }
                    }),
                );
            }),
        );

        // 5. Return a new IDBOpenDBRequest object for request.
        Ok(request)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbfactory-databases
    pub(crate) fn databases(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = self.realm;
        let promise = create_promise(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let environment be this's relevant settings object.
        // 2. Let storageKey be the result of running obtain a storage key given environment.
        //    If failure is returned, then return a promise rejected with a "SecurityError" DOMException
        let Some(storage_key) = obtain_a_storage_key(&relevant_settings_object(realm.global_object())) else {
            let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
            let error = Exception::Dom(
                "SecurityError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Failed to obtain a storage key"),
            )
            .throw(&cx);
            reject_promise(vm, promise, error.value());
            return Ok(promise);
        };

        // 3. Let p be a new promise.
        // NB: p is the promise created above.

        // 4. Run these steps in parallel:
        run_in_parallel(
            vm,
            create_function(
                vm,
                (realm, NoCells(storage_key), promise),
                |vm, &(realm, ref storage_key, promise), ()| {
                    crate::bindings::interface::with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(realm, || {
                        // 1. Let databases be the set of databases in storageKey.
                        //    If this cannot be determined for any reason, then queue a database task to reject p with an appropriate error (e.g. an "UnknownError" DOMException) and terminate these steps.
                        let databases = Database::for_key(vm, &storage_key.0);

                        // 2. Let result be a new list.
                        // 3. For each db of databases:
                        //     1. If db's version is 0, then continue.
                        //     2. Let info be a new IDBDatabaseInfo dictionary.
                        //     3. Set info's name dictionary member to db's name.
                        //     4. Set info's version dictionary member to db's version.
                        //     5. Append info to result.
                        // 4. Queue a database task to resolve p with result.
                        // AD-HOC: p is resolved directly in a deferred invocation, not in a database task.
                        resolve_database_info_list_promise(vm, realm, promise, &databases.values());
                    });
                },
            ),
        );

        // 5. Return p.
        Ok(promise)
    }
}

// NB: The generated conversion of IDBDatabaseInfo is only built with the bindings, so the dictionaries are built here.
fn resolve_database_info_list_promise(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>, promise: WebIdlPromise, databases: &[DatabaseRef]) {
    let result = Array::create(vm, realm, 0, None).must();

    let mut result_index: u64 = 0;
    for db in databases {
        // INTEROP: A database's version is not reported until its upgrade transaction commits, so that databases()
        //          does not pick up changes that have not been committed.
        let mut version = db.version();
        if let Some(upgrade_transaction) = db.upgrade_transaction() {
            version = upgrade_transaction.original_version();
        }

        if version == 0 {
            continue;
        }

        let info = Object::create(vm, realm, Some(realm.intrinsics().object_prototype(vm)));
        info.create_data_property(
            vm,
            &PropertyKey::from_utf8("name"),
            Value::from_string(PrimitiveString::create(vm, db.name())),
            None,
            None,
        )
        .must();
        #[allow(
            clippy::cast_precision_loss,
            reason = "the C++ converted the version to a double as well"
        )]
        info.create_data_property(
            vm,
            &PropertyKey::from_utf8("version"),
            Value::from_f64(version as f64),
            None,
            None,
        )
        .must();
        result
            .create_data_property_or_throw(vm, &PropertyKey::from_number(result_index), Value::from_object(info))
            .must();
        result_index += 1;
    }

    resolve_promise(vm, promise, Value::from_object(result));
}

//! IDBIndex, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#index-interface

use core::cell::RefCell;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, Object, Realm, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::indexed_db::idb_cursor::{CursorSourceHandle, IDBCursor, IDBCursorDirection};
use crate::indexed_db::idb_object_store::{
    IDBGetAllOptions, IDBObjectStore, constraint_error, idb_cursor_result, invalid_state_error, request_of,
    transaction_inactive_error,
};
use crate::indexed_db::idb_request::{IDBRequest, IDBRequestSource};
use crate::indexed_db::idb_transaction::IDBTransaction;
use crate::indexed_db::internal::algorithms::{
    KeyPath, RecordKind, RecordSource, asynchronously_execute_a_request, convert_a_key_path_to_a_value,
    convert_a_value_to_a_key_range, count_the_records_in_a_range, create_a_request_to_retrieve_multiple_items,
    create_a_request_to_retrieve_multiple_items_with_options, iterate_a_cursor,
    retrieve_a_referenced_value_from_an_index, retrieve_a_value_from_an_index,
};
use crate::indexed_db::internal::function::create_operation;

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#index-interface
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBIndex {
    // An index handle has an associated index and an associated object store handle.
    index: IndexRef,
    object_store_handle: Ref<IDBObjectStore>,

    // An index handle has a name, which is initialized to the name of the associated index when the index handle is created.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    name: RefCell<Utf16String>,

    // NB: The keyPath getter returns the same Array every time it is inspected in the same realm.
    key_path_arrays: GcRefCell<Vec<(Gc<Object>, Gc<Object>)>>,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBIndex {}

impl IDBIndex {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, index: IndexRef, object_store: Ref<IDBObjectStore>) -> Ref<IDBIndex> {
        let handle = allocate(vm, |_| IDBIndex {
            index,
            object_store_handle: object_store,
            name: RefCell::new(index.name()),
            key_path_arrays: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
        });
        object_store.transaction_object().register_index_handle(vm, handle);
        handle
    }

    pub(crate) fn realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        self.object_store_handle.realm()
    }

    // The transaction of an index handle is the transaction of its associated object store handle.
    pub(crate) fn transaction_object(&self) -> Ref<IDBTransaction> {
        self.object_store_handle.transaction_object()
    }

    pub(crate) fn index(&self) -> IndexRef {
        self.index
    }

    pub(crate) fn object_store_handle(&self) -> Ref<IDBObjectStore> {
        self.object_store_handle
    }

    pub(crate) fn update_name(&self) {
        *self.name.borrow_mut() = self.index.name();
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-name
    pub(crate) fn name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The name getter steps are to return this’s name.
        Ok(self.name.borrow().clone())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-name
    pub(crate) fn set_name(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Let name be the given value.
        let name = &value;

        // 2. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = self.transaction_object();

        // 3. Let index be this’s index.
        let index = self.index;

        // 4. If transaction is not an upgrade transaction, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_upgrade_transaction() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Transaction is not an upgrade transaction"));
        }

        // 5. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while updating index name",
            ));
        }

        // 6. If index or index’s object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if index.is_deleted() || index.object_store().is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Index or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 7. If index’s name is equal to name, terminate these steps.
        if index.name() == *name {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 8. If an index named name already exists in index’s object store, throw a "ConstraintError" DOMException.
        if index.object_store().index_set_get(name).is_some() {
            return Err(constraint_error("An index with the given name already exists"));
        }

        // AD-HOC: Log the rename for potential revert on abort.
        self.object_store_handle
            .store()
            .mutation_log()
            .expect("an upgrade transaction logs the mutations of its stores")
            .note_index_renamed(vm, index, index.name());

        // 9. Set index’s name to name.
        Index::set_name(index, vm, name.clone());

        // NOTE: Update the key in the map so it still matches the name
        self.object_store_handle
            .rename_index_set_entry(vm, &self.name.borrow(), name.clone());

        // 10. Set this’s name to name.
        *self.name.borrow_mut() = name.clone();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-objectstore
    pub(crate) fn object_store(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBObjectStore>> {
        // The objectStore getter steps are to return this’s object store handle.
        Ok(self.object_store_handle)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-keypath
    pub(crate) fn key_path(&self) -> &KeyPath {
        self.index.key_path()
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-keypath
    pub(crate) fn key_path_value(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The keyPath getter steps are to return this’s index’s key path. The key path is converted as a DOMString (if a
        // string) or a sequence<DOMString> (if a list of strings), per [WEBIDL].
        // NOTE: The returned value is not the same instance that was used when the index was created. However, if this
        //       attribute returns an object (specifically an Array), it returns the same object instance every time it is
        //       inspected. Changing the properties of the object has no effect on the index.
        let global_object = cx.realm().global_object();
        if let Some((_, array)) = self
            .key_path_arrays
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .find(|(global, _)| *global == global_object)
        {
            return Ok(Value::from_object(*array));
        }

        let value = convert_a_key_path_to_a_value(cx, self.key_path());
        if value.is_object() {
            self.key_path_arrays
                .borrow_mut(cx.vm())
                .push((global_object, value.as_object()));
        }
        Ok(value)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-multientry
    pub(crate) fn multi_entry(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The multiEntry getter steps are to return this’s index’s multiEntry flag.
        Ok(self.index.multi_entry())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-unique
    pub(crate) fn unique(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The unique getter steps are to return this’s index’s unique flag.
        Ok(self.index.unique())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-opencursor
    pub(crate) fn open_cursor(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        query: Option<Value>,
        direction: IDBCursorDirection,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction_object();

        // 2. Let index be this’s index.
        let index = this.index;

        // 3. If index or index’s object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if index.is_deleted() || index.object_store().is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Index or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while opening cursor",
            ));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let range = convert_a_value_to_a_key_range(&realm_cx, query, false)?;

        // 6. Let cursor be a new cursor with its source handle set to this, undefined position, direction set to direction, got value flag set to false, undefined key and value, range set to range, and key only flag set to false.
        let cursor = IDBCursor::create(
            vm,
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(*this),
            None,
            direction,
            false,
            None,
            None,
            range,
            false,
        );

        // 7. Let operation be an algorithm to run iterate a cursor with the current Realm record and cursor.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (realm, cursor), |vm, &(realm, cursor)| {
            let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
            let result = iterate_a_cursor(&cx, cursor, None, None, 1)?;
            Ok(idb_cursor_result(&cx, result))
        });

        // 8. Let request be the result of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        let request = request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::Index(*this),
            operation,
            None,
        ));

        // 9. Set cursor’s request to request.
        cursor.set_request(Some(request));

        // 10. Return request.
        Ok(request)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-get
    pub(crate) fn get(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, query: Value) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction_object();

        // 2. Let index be this’s index.
        let index = this.index;

        // 3. If index or index’s object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if index.is_deleted() || index.object_store().is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Index or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error("Transaction is not active while getting"));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query and true. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let range = convert_a_value_to_a_key_range(&realm_cx, Some(query), true)?;

        // 6. Let operation be an algorithm to run retrieve a referenced value from an index with the current Realm record, index, and range.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (realm, index, range), |vm, &(realm, index, range)| {
            retrieve_a_referenced_value_from_an_index(&CallContext::new(vm, realm), index, &range)
        });

        // 7. Return the result (an IDBRequest) of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        Ok(request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::Index(*this),
            operation,
            None,
        )))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-getkey
    pub(crate) fn get_key(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, query: Value) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction_object();

        // 2. Let index be this’s index.
        let index = this.index;

        // 3. If index or index’s object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if index.is_deleted() || index.object_store().is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Index or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while getting key",
            ));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query and true. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let range = convert_a_value_to_a_key_range(&realm_cx, Some(query), true)?;

        // 6. Let operation be an algorithm to run retrieve a value from an index with index and range.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (realm, index, range), |vm, &(realm, index, range)| {
            Ok(retrieve_a_value_from_an_index(
                &CallContext::new(vm, realm),
                index,
                &range,
            ))
        });

        // 7. Return the result (an IDBRequest) of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        Ok(request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::Index(*this),
            operation,
            None,
        )))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-getall
    pub(crate) fn get_all(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        query_or_options: Option<Value>,
        count: Option<u32>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        // 1. Return the result of creating a request to retrieve multiple items with the current Realm record, this,
        //    "value", queryOrOptions, and count if given. Rethrow any exceptions.
        create_a_request_to_retrieve_multiple_items(
            &CallContext::new(cx.vm(), this.realm()),
            IDBRequestSource::Index(*this),
            RecordKind::Value,
            query_or_options.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED),
            count,
        )
        .map(request_of)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-getallkeys
    pub(crate) fn get_all_keys(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        query_or_options: Option<Value>,
        count: Option<u32>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        // 1. Return the result of creating a request to retrieve multiple items with the current Realm record, this, "key",
        //    queryOrOptions, and count if given. Rethrow any exceptions.
        create_a_request_to_retrieve_multiple_items(
            &CallContext::new(cx.vm(), this.realm()),
            IDBRequestSource::Index(*this),
            RecordKind::Key,
            query_or_options.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED),
            count,
        )
        .map(request_of)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-count
    pub(crate) fn count(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, query: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction_object();

        // 2. Let index be this’s index.
        let index = this.index;

        // 3. If index or index’s object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if index.is_deleted() || index.object_store().is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Index or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error("Transaction is not active while counting"));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let range = convert_a_value_to_a_key_range(&realm_cx, query, false)?;

        // 6. Let operation be an algorithm to run count the records in a range with index and range.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (index, range), |_, &(index, range)| {
            Ok(count_the_records_in_a_range(RecordSource::Index(index), &range))
        });

        // 7. Return the result (an IDBRequest) of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        Ok(request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::Index(*this),
            operation,
            None,
        )))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-openkeycursor
    pub(crate) fn open_key_cursor(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        query: Option<Value>,
        direction: IDBCursorDirection,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction_object();

        // 2. Let index be this’s index.
        let index = this.index;

        // 3. If index or index’s object store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if index.is_deleted() || index.object_store().is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Index or its object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while opening key cursor",
            ));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let range = convert_a_value_to_a_key_range(&realm_cx, query, false)?;

        // 6. Let cursor be a new cursor with its source handle set to this, undefined position, direction set to direction, got value flag set to false, undefined key and value, range set to range, and key only flag set to true.
        let cursor = IDBCursor::create(
            vm,
            CursorSourceHandle::Index(*this),
            None,
            direction,
            false,
            None,
            None,
            range,
            true,
        );

        // 7. Let operation be an algorithm to run iterate a cursor with the current Realm record and cursor.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (realm, cursor), |vm, &(realm, cursor)| {
            let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
            let result = iterate_a_cursor(&cx, cursor, None, None, 1)?;
            Ok(idb_cursor_result(&cx, result))
        });

        // 8. Let request be the result of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        let request = request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::Index(*this),
            operation,
            None,
        ));

        // 9. Set cursor’s request to request.
        cursor.set_request(Some(request));

        // 10. Return request.
        Ok(request)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbindex-getallrecords
    pub(crate) fn get_all_records(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        options: IDBGetAllOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        // 1. Return the result of creating a request to retrieve multiple items with the current Realm record, this,
        //    "record", and options. Rethrow any exceptions.
        create_a_request_to_retrieve_multiple_items_with_options(
            &CallContext::new(cx.vm(), this.realm()),
            IDBRequestSource::Index(*this),
            RecordKind::Record,
            &options,
        )
        .map(request_of)
    }
}

//! IDBKeyRange, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#keyrange

use std::rc::Rc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Value, Vm, is_host_instance_of};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Interface, Ref, Wrappable, allocate, implementation_of};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::indexed_db::internal::algorithms::{convert_a_key_to_a_value, convert_a_value_to_a_key};
use crate::indexed_db::internal::key::Key;

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#keyrange
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBKeyRange {
    // A key range has an associated lower bound (null or a key).
    #[gc(untraced)]
    lower_bound: Option<Rc<Key>>,

    // A key range has an associated upper bound (null or a key).
    #[gc(untraced)]
    upper_bound: Option<Rc<Key>>,

    // A key range has an associated lower open flag. Unless otherwise stated it is false.
    lower_open: bool,

    // A key range has an associated upper open flag. Unless otherwise stated it is false.
    upper_open: bool,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBKeyRange {}

impl IDBKeyRange {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        lower_bound: Option<Rc<Key>>,
        upper_bound: Option<Rc<Key>>,
        lower_open: bool,
        upper_open: bool,
    ) -> Ref<IDBKeyRange> {
        allocate(vm, |_| IDBKeyRange {
            lower_bound,
            upper_bound,
            lower_open,
            upper_open,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_lower_open(&self) -> bool {
        self.lower_open
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_upper_open(&self) -> bool {
        self.upper_open
    }

    pub(crate) fn lower_key(&self) -> Option<&Rc<Key>> {
        self.lower_bound.as_ref()
    }

    pub(crate) fn upper_key(&self) -> Option<&Rc<Key>> {
        self.upper_bound.as_ref()
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#in
    pub(crate) fn is_in_range(&self, key: &Key) -> bool {
        // A key is in a key range range if both of the following conditions are fulfilled:

        // The range’s lower bound is null, or it is less than key, or it is both equal to key and the range’s lower open flag is false.
        let lower_bound_in_range = match self.lower_key() {
            None => true,
            Some(lower_key) => Key::less_than(lower_key, key) || (Key::equals(key, lower_key) && !self.is_lower_open()),
        };

        // The range’s upper bound is null, or it is greater than key, or it is both equal to key and the range’s upper open flag is false.
        let upper_bound_in_range = match self.upper_key() {
            None => true,
            Some(upper_key) => {
                Key::greater_than(upper_key, key) || (Key::equals(key, upper_key) && !self.is_upper_open())
            }
        };

        lower_bound_in_range && upper_bound_in_range
    }

    pub(crate) fn key_range_lower(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The lower getter steps are to return the result of converting a key to a
        // value with this's lower bound if it is not null, or undefined otherwise.
        if let Some(lower_key) = self.lower_key() {
            return Ok(convert_a_key_to_a_value(cx, lower_key));
        }

        Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
    }

    pub(crate) fn key_range_upper(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The upper getter steps are to return the result of converting a key to a
        // value with this's upper bound if it is not null, or undefined otherwise.
        if let Some(upper_key) = self.upper_key() {
            return Ok(convert_a_key_to_a_value(cx, upper_key));
        }

        Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbkeyrange-loweropen
    pub(crate) fn lower_open(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The lowerOpen getter steps are to return this’s lower open flag.
        Ok(self.lower_open)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbkeyrange-upperopen
    pub(crate) fn upper_open(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The upperOpen getter steps are to return this’s upper open flag.
        Ok(self.upper_open)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbkeyrange-only
    pub(crate) fn only(cx: &mut CallContext, value: Value) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBKeyRange>> {
        // 1. Let key be the result of converting a value to a key with value. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let key = convert_a_value_to_a_key(cx, value, None)?;

        // 2. If key is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if key.is_invalid() {
            return Err(data_error("Value is invalid"));
        }

        // 3. Create and return a new key range containing only key.
        Ok(IDBKeyRange::create(cx.vm(), Some(key.clone()), Some(key), false, false))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbkeyrange-lowerbound
    pub(crate) fn lower_bound(cx: &mut CallContext, lower: Value, open: bool) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBKeyRange>> {
        // 1. Let lowerKey be the result of converting a value to a key with lower. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let key = convert_a_value_to_a_key(cx, lower, None)?;

        // 2. If lowerKey is invalid, throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if key.is_invalid() {
            return Err(data_error("Value is invalid"));
        }

        // 3. Create and return a new key range with lower bound set to lowerKey, lower open flag set to open, upper bound set to null, and upper open flag set to true.
        Ok(IDBKeyRange::create(cx.vm(), Some(key), None, open, true))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbkeyrange-upperbound
    pub(crate) fn upper_bound(cx: &mut CallContext, upper: Value, open: bool) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBKeyRange>> {
        // 1. Let upperKey be the result of converting a value to a key with upper. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let key = convert_a_value_to_a_key(cx, upper, None)?;

        // 2. If upperKey is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if key.is_invalid() {
            return Err(data_error("Value is invalid"));
        }

        // 3. Create and return a new key range with lower bound set to null, lower open flag set to true, upper bound set to upperKey, and upper open flag set to open.
        Ok(IDBKeyRange::create(cx.vm(), None, Some(key), true, open))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbkeyrange-bound
    pub(crate) fn bound(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        lower: Value,
        upper: Value,
        lower_open: bool,
        upper_open: bool,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBKeyRange>> {
        // 1. Let lowerKey be the result of converting a value to a key with lower. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let lower_key = convert_a_value_to_a_key(cx, lower, None)?;

        // 2. If lowerKey is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if lower_key.is_invalid() {
            return Err(data_error("Value is invalid"));
        }

        // 3. Let upperKey be the result of converting a value to a key with upper. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let upper_key = convert_a_value_to_a_key(cx, upper, None)?;

        // 4. If upperKey is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if upper_key.is_invalid() {
            return Err(data_error("Value is invalid"));
        }

        // 5. If lowerKey is greater than upperKey, throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if Key::less_than(&upper_key, &lower_key) {
            return Err(data_error("Lower key is greater than upper key"));
        }

        // 6. Create and return a new key range with lower bound set to lowerKey, lower open flag set to lowerOpen, upper bound set to upperKey and upper open flag set to upperOpen.
        Ok(IDBKeyRange::create(
            cx.vm(),
            Some(lower_key),
            Some(upper_key),
            lower_open,
            upper_open,
        ))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbkeyrange-includes
    pub(crate) fn includes(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, key: Value) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // 1. Let k be the result of converting a value to a key with key. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let converted_key = convert_a_value_to_a_key(cx, key, None)?;

        // 2. If k is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if converted_key.is_invalid() {
            return Err(data_error("Value is invalid"));
        }

        // 3. Return true if k is in this range, and false otherwise.
        Ok(self.is_in_range(&converted_key))
    }
}

fn data_error(message: &str) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("DataError", Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
}

pub(crate) fn key_range_from_value(value: Value) -> Option<Ref<IDBKeyRange>> {
    if !value.is_object() {
        return None;
    }
    let object = value.as_object();
    if !is_host_instance_of(&object, IDBKeyRange::wrapper_class()) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(implementation_of(object))
}

//! IDBObjectStore, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#object-store-interface

use std::rc::Rc;

use core::cell::RefCell;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, Must, Object, Realm, Trace, Value, Vm};
