// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#object-store-interface
// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#object-store-handle-construct
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBObjectStore {
    // An object store handle has an associated object store and an associated transaction.
    store: ObjectStoreRef,
    transaction: Ref<IDBTransaction>,

    // An object store handle has a name, which is initialized to the name of the associated object store when the object store handle is created.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    name: RefCell<Utf16String>,

    // An object store handle has an index set
    indexes: GcRefCell<Vec<(Utf16String, IndexRef)>>,

    // NB: The keyPath getter returns the same Array every time it is inspected in the same realm.
    key_path_arrays: GcRefCell<Vec<(Gc<Object>, Gc<Object>)>>,

    // NB: Each call to index() on the same IDBObjectStore instance with the same name returns the same IDBIndex
    //     instance. These are keyed by index so that they survive renames.
    index_handles: GcRefCell<Vec<(IndexRef, Ref<IDBIndex>)>>,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBObjectStore {}

impl IDBObjectStore {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, store: ObjectStoreRef, transaction: Ref<IDBTransaction>) -> Ref<IDBObjectStore> {
        allocate(vm, |defer| IDBObjectStore {
            store,
            transaction,
            name: RefCell::new(store.name()),
            // An object store handle has an index set, which is initialized to the set of indexes that reference the associated object store when the object store handle is created.
            indexes: GcRefCell::new(store.index_set(defer)),
            key_path_arrays: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            index_handles: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        self.transaction.realm()
    }

    pub(crate) fn store(&self) -> ObjectStoreRef {
        self.store
    }

    pub(crate) fn transaction_object(&self) -> Ref<IDBTransaction> {
        self.transaction
    }

    pub(crate) fn index_set_get(&self, name: &Utf16String) -> Option<IndexRef> {
        self.indexes
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .find(|(index_name, _)| index_name == name)
            .map(|(_, index)| *index)
    }

    pub(crate) fn rename_index_set_entry(&self, vm: &Vm, old_name: &Utf16String, name: Utf16String) {
        let mut indexes = self.indexes.borrow_mut(vm);
        let position = indexes
            .iter()
            .position(|(index_name, _)| index_name == old_name)
            .expect("the index is in the index set of its handle");
        let (_, index) = indexes.remove(position);
        match indexes.iter_mut().find(|(index_name, _)| *index_name == name) {
            Some(entry) => entry.1 = index,
            None => indexes.push((name, index)),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn index_set_clear(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        self.indexes.borrow_mut(vm).clear();
    }

    pub(crate) fn update_name(&self) {
        *self.name.borrow_mut() = self.store.name();
    }

    pub(crate) fn update_index_set(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        self.store.copy_index_set_into(&mut self.indexes.borrow_mut(vm));
    }

    fn index_handle(this: &Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm, index: IndexRef) -> Ref<IDBIndex> {
        if let Some((_, handle)) = this.index_handles.borrow().iter().find(|(entry, _)| *entry == index) {
            return *handle;
        }
        let handle = IDBIndex::create(vm, index, *this);
        this.index_handles.borrow_mut(vm).push((index, handle));
        handle
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-name
    pub(crate) fn name(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        // The name getter steps are to return this’s name.
        Ok(self.name.borrow().clone())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-name
    pub(crate) fn set_name(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Let name be the given value.
        let name = &value;

        // 2. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = self.transaction;

        // 3. Let store be this’s object store.
        let store = self.store;

        // 4. If store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if store.is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 5. If transaction is not an upgrade transaction, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_upgrade_transaction() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Attempted to set name outside of version change"));
        }

        // 6. If transaction’s state is not active, throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while updating object store name",
            ));
        }

        // 7. If store’s name is equal to name, terminate these steps.
        if store.name() == *name {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 8. If an object store named name already exists in store’s database, throw a "ConstraintError" DOMException.
        if store.database().object_store_with_name(name).is_some() {
            return Err(constraint_error("Object store with the given name already exists"));
        }

        // AD-HOC: Log the rename for potential revert on abort.
        store
            .mutation_log()
            .expect("an upgrade transaction logs the mutations of its stores")
            .note_object_store_renamed(vm, store.name());

        // 9. Set store’s name to name.
        store.set_name(name.clone());

        // 10. Set this’s name to name.
        *self.name.borrow_mut() = name.clone();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-keypath
    pub(crate) fn key_path(&self) -> Option<&KeyPath> {
        self.store.key_path()
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-keypath
    pub(crate) fn key_path_value(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // The keyPath getter steps are to return this’s object store’s key path, or null if none. The key path is
        // converted as a DOMString (if a string) or a sequence<DOMString> (if a list of strings), per [WEBIDL].
        let Some(key_path) = self.key_path() else {
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        };

        // NOTE: The returned value is not the same instance that was used when the object store was created. However, if
        //       this attribute returns an object (specifically an Array), it returns the same object instance every time
        //       it is inspected. Changing the properties of the object has no effect on the object store.
        let global_object = cx.realm().global_object();
        if let Some((_, array)) = self
            .key_path_arrays
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .find(|(global, _)| *global == global_object)
        {
            return Ok(Value::from_object(*array));
        }

        let value = convert_a_key_path_to_a_value(cx, key_path);
        if value.is_object() {
            self.key_path_arrays
                .borrow_mut(vm)
                .push((global_object, value.as_object()));
        }
        Ok(value)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-indexnames
    pub(crate) fn index_names(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMStringList>> {
        // 1. Let names be a list of the names of the indexes in this's index set.
        let names = self.indexes.borrow().iter().map(|(name, _)| name.clone()).collect();

        // 2. Return the result (a DOMStringList) of creating a sorted name list with names.
        Ok(create_a_sorted_name_list(cx.vm(), names))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-transaction
    pub(crate) fn transaction(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBTransaction>> {
        // The transaction getter steps are to return this’s transaction.
        Ok(self.transaction)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-autoincrement
    pub(crate) fn auto_increment(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        // The autoIncrement getter steps are to return true if this’s object store has a key generator, and false otherwise.
        Ok(self.store.uses_a_key_generator())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-createindex
    pub(crate) fn create_index(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        name: Utf16String,
        key_path: DOMStringOrDOMStringSequence,
        options: IDBIndexParameters,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBIndex>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let key_path = match key_path {
            DOMStringOrDOMStringSequence::DOMString(value) => KeyPath::String(value),
            DOMStringOrDOMStringSequence::Sequence(values) => KeyPath::Sequence(values),
        };

        // 1. Let transaction be this's transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction;

        // 2. Let store be this's object store.
        let store = this.store;

        // 3. If transaction is not an upgrade transaction, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_upgrade_transaction() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Transaction is not an upgrade transaction"));
        }

        // 4. If store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if store.is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 5. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while creating index",
            ));
        }

        // 6. If an index named name already exists in store, throw a "ConstraintError" DOMException.
        if store.index_set_get(&name).is_some() {
            return Err(constraint_error("An index with the given name already exists"));
        }

        // 7. If keyPath is not a valid key path, throw a "SyntaxError" DOMException.
        if !is_valid_key_path(&key_path) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "SyntaxError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Key path is not valid"),
            ));
        }

        // 8. Let unique be options’s unique member.
        let unique = options.unique;

        // 9. Let multiEntry be options’s multiEntry member.
        let multi_entry = options.multi_entry;

        // 10. If keyPath is a sequence and multiEntry is true, throw an "InvalidAccessError" DOMException.
        if matches!(key_path, KeyPath::Sequence(_)) && multi_entry {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Key path is a sequence and multiEntry is true"),
            ));
        }

        // 11. Let index be a new index in store.
        //     Set index’s name to name, key path to keyPath, unique flag to unique, and multiEntry flag to multiEntry.
        let index = Index::create(vm, store, &name, &key_path, unique, multi_entry);

        // 12. Add index to this's index set.
        {
            let mut indexes = this.indexes.borrow_mut(vm);
            match indexes.iter_mut().find(|(index_name, _)| *index_name == name) {
                Some(entry) => entry.1 = index,
                None => indexes.push((name, index)),
            }
        }

        // AD-HOC: Log the creation for potential revert on abort.
        store
            .mutation_log()
            .expect("an upgrade transaction logs the mutations of its stores")
            .note_index_created(vm, index);

        // AD-HOC: Fill the index with the records of store, as a request after the ones made before.
        queue_the_creation_of_an_index(vm, *this, index);

        // 13. Return a new index handle associated with index and this.
        Ok(Self::index_handle(this, vm, index))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-index
    pub(crate) fn index(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, name: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBIndex>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction;

        // 2. Let store be this’s object store.
        let store = this.store;

        // 3. If store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if store.is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is finished, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if transaction.state() == TransactionState::Finished {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Transaction is finished"));
        }

        // 5. Let index be the index named name in this’s index set if one exists, or throw a "NotFoundError" DOMException otherwise.
        let Some(index) = this.index_set_get(&name) else {
            return Err(not_found_error("Index not found in object store"));
        };

        // 6. Return an index handle associated with index and this.
        // NOTE: Each call to this method on the same IDBObjectStore instance with the same name returns the same IDBIndex
        //       instance.
        Ok(Self::index_handle(this, vm, index))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-deleteindex
    pub(crate) fn delete_index(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, name: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = self.transaction;

        // 2. Let store be this’s object store.
        let store = self.store;

        // 3. If transaction is not an upgrade transaction, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_upgrade_transaction() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Transaction is not an upgrade transaction"));
        }

        // 4. If store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if store.is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 5. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while deleting index",
            ));
        }

        // 6. Let index be the index named name in store if one exists, or throw a "NotFoundError" DOMException otherwise.
        let Some(index) = store.index_set_get(&name) else {
            return Err(not_found_error("Index not found while trying to delete it"));
        };

        // 7. Remove index from this’s index set.
        {
            let mut indexes = self.indexes.borrow_mut(vm);
            if let Some(position) = indexes.iter().position(|(index_name, _)| *index_name == name) {
                indexes.remove(position);
            }
        }

        // AD-HOC: Mark the index as deleted so that stale handles throw InvalidStateError.
        index.set_deleted(true);

        // AD-HOC: Log the deletion for potential revert on abort.
        store
            .mutation_log()
            .expect("an upgrade transaction logs the mutations of its stores")
            .note_index_deleted(vm, index);

        // 8. Destroy index.
        store.index_set_remove(vm, &name);

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#add-or-put
    fn add_or_put(
        handle: Ref<IDBObjectStore>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        value: Value,
        key: Option<Value>,
        no_overwrite: bool,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<AnyIDBRequest> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = handle.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be handle’s transaction.
        let transaction = handle.transaction;

        // 2. Let store be handle’s object store.
        let store = handle.store;

        // 3. If store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if store.is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while running add/put",
            ));
        }

        // 5. If transaction is a read-only transaction, throw a "ReadOnlyError" DOMException.
        if transaction.is_readonly() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "ReadOnlyError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("Transaction is read-only"),
            ));
        }

        let key_was_given = key.is_some_and(|key| !key.is_undefined());

        // 6. If store uses in-line keys and key was given, throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if store.uses_inline_keys() && key_was_given {
            return Err(data_error("Store uses in-line keys and key was given"));
        }

        // 7. If store uses out-of-line keys and has no key generator and key was not given, throw a "DataError" DOMException.
        if store.uses_out_of_line_keys() && !store.uses_a_key_generator() && !key_was_given {
            return Err(data_error(
                "Store uses out-of-line keys and has no key generator and key was not given",
            ));
        }

        let mut key_value: Option<Rc<Key>> = None;
        // 8. If key was given, then:
        if key_was_given {
            // 1. Let r be the result of converting a value to a key with key. Rethrow any exceptions.
            let r = convert_a_value_to_a_key(&realm_cx, key.expect("key was given"), None)?;

            // 2. If r is "invalid value" or "invalid type", throw a "DataError" DOMException.
            if r.is_invalid() {
                return Err(data_error("Key is invalid"));
            }

            // 3. Let key be r.
            key_value = Some(r);
        }

        // 9. Let targetRealm be a user-agent defined Realm.
        let target_cx = &realm_cx;

        // 10. Let clone be a clone of value in targetRealm during transaction. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let clone = clone_in_realm(target_cx, value, transaction)?;

        // 11. If store uses in-line keys, then:
        if store.uses_inline_keys() {
            let store_key_path = store.key_path().expect("the store uses in-line keys");

            // 1. Let kpk be the result of extracting a key from a value using a key path with clone and store’s key path. Rethrow any exceptions.
            let maybe_kpk = extract_a_key_from_a_value_using_a_key_path(&realm_cx, clone, store_key_path, false)?;

            // NOTE: Step 2 and 3 is reversed here, since we check for failure before validity.
            // 3. If kpk is not failure, let key be kpk.
            if let Ok(kpk) = maybe_kpk {
                // 2. If kpk is invalid, throw a "DataError" DOMException.
                if kpk.is_invalid() {
                    return Err(Exception::Dom("DataError", kpk.value_as_string().clone()));
                }
                key_value = Some(kpk);
            }
            // 4. Otherwise (kpk is failure):
            else {
                // 1. If store does not have a key generator, throw a "DataError" DOMException.
                if !store.uses_a_key_generator() {
                    return Err(data_error("Store does not have a key generator"));
                }

                // 2. If check that a key could be injected into a value with clone and store’s key path return false, throw a "DataError" DOMException.
                if !check_that_a_key_could_be_injected_into_a_value(&realm_cx, clone, store_key_path) {
                    return Err(data_error("Key could not be injected into value"));
                }
            }
        }

        // 12. Let operation be an algorithm to run store a record into an object store with store, clone, key, and no-overwrite flag.
        let operation = create_operation(
            vm,
            (realm, store, clone, NoCells(key_value), no_overwrite),
            |vm, &(realm, store, clone, ref key_value, no_overwrite)| {
                with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(realm, || {
                    let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
                    let optional_key =
                        store_a_record_into_an_object_store(&cx, store, clone, key_value.0.clone(), no_overwrite)?;

                    let Some(optional_key) = optional_key.filter(|key| !key.is_invalid()) else {
                        return Ok(Value::UNDEFINED);
                    };

                    Ok(convert_a_key_to_a_value(&cx, &optional_key))
                })
            },
        );

        // 13. Return the result (an IDBRequest) of running asynchronously execute a request with handle and operation.
        Ok(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(handle),
            operation,
            None,
        ))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-add
    pub(crate) fn add(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        value: Value,
        key: Option<Value>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        // The add(value, key) method steps are to return the result of running add or put with this, value, key and the no-overwrite flag true.
        Self::add_or_put(*this, cx, value, key, true).map(request_of)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-put
    pub(crate) fn put(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        value: Value,
        key: Option<Value>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        // The put(value, key) method steps are to return the result of running add or put with this, value, key and the no-overwrite flag false.
        Self::add_or_put(*this, cx, value, key, false).map(request_of)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-count
    pub(crate) fn count(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, query: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this's transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction;

        // 2. Let store be this's object store.
        let store = this.store;

        // 3. If store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if store.is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while doing count",
            ));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let range = convert_a_value_to_a_key_range(&realm_cx, query, false)?;

        // 6. Let operation be an algorithm to run count the records in a range with store and range.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (store, range), |_, &(store, range)| {
            Ok(count_the_records_in_a_range(RecordSource::ObjectStore(store), &range))
        });

        // 7. Return the result (an IDBRequest) of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        Ok(request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(*this),
            operation,
            None,
        )))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-get
    pub(crate) fn get(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, query: Value) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        let transaction = this.transaction;

        // 2. Let store be this's object store.

            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error("Transaction is not active while getting"));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query and true. Rethrow any exceptions.

        // 6. Let operation be an algorithm to run retrieve a value from an object store with the current Realm record, store, and range.

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-opencursor
    pub(crate) fn open_cursor(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        query: Option<Value>,
        direction: IDBCursorDirection,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this's transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction;

        // 2. Let store be this’s object store.
        let store = this.store;

        // 3. If store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if store.is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while opening cursor",
            ));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let range = convert_a_value_to_a_key_range(&realm_cx, query, false)?;

        // 6. Let cursor be a new cursor with its source handle set to this, undefined position, direction set to direction,
        //    got value flag set to false, undefined key and value, range set to range, and key only flag set to false.
        let cursor = IDBCursor::create(
            vm,
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(*this),
            None,
            direction,
            false,
            None,
            None,
            range,
            false,
        );

        // 7. Let operation be an algorithm to run iterate a cursor with the current Realm record and cursor.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (realm, cursor), |vm, &(realm, cursor)| {
            let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
            let result = iterate_a_cursor(&cx, cursor, None, None, 1)?;
            Ok(idb_cursor_result(&cx, result))
        });

        // 8. Let request be the result of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        let request = request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(*this),
            operation,
            None,
        ));

        // 9. Set cursor’s request to request.
        cursor.set_request(Some(request));

        // 10. Return request.
        Ok(request)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-delete

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-getkey
    pub(crate) fn get_key(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, query: Value) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this’s transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction;

        // 2. Let store be this’s object store.
        let store = this.store;

        // 3. If store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if store.is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while getting key",
            ));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query and true. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let range = convert_a_value_to_a_key_range(&realm_cx, Some(query), true)?;

        // 6. Let operation be an algorithm to run retrieve a key from an object store with store and range.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (realm, store, range), |vm, &(realm, store, range)| {
            Ok(retrieve_a_key_from_an_object_store(
                &CallContext::new(vm, realm),
                store,
                &range,
            ))
        });

        // 7. Return the result (an IDBRequest) of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        Ok(request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(*this),
            operation,
            None,
        )))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-getall
    pub(crate) fn get_all(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        query_or_options: Option<Value>,
        count: Option<u32>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        // 1. Return the result of creating a request to retrieve multiple items with the current Realm record, this,
        //    "value", queryOrOptions, and count if given. Rethrow any exceptions.
        create_a_request_to_retrieve_multiple_items(
            &CallContext::new(cx.vm(), this.realm()),
            IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(*this),
            RecordKind::Value,
            query_or_options.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED),
            count,
        )
        .map(request_of)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-openkeycursor
    pub(crate) fn open_key_cursor(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        query: Option<Value>,
        direction: IDBCursorDirection,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.realm();
        let realm_cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);

        // 1. Let transaction be this's transaction.
        let transaction = this.transaction;

        // 2. Let store be this’s object store.
        let store = this.store;

        // 3. If store has been deleted, throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if store.is_deleted() {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Object store has been deleted"));
        }

        // 4. If transaction’s state is not active, then throw a "TransactionInactiveError" DOMException.
        if !transaction.is_active() {
            return Err(transaction_inactive_error(
                "Transaction is not active while opening key cursor",
            ));
        }

        // 5. Let range be the result of converting a value to a key range with query. Rethrow any exceptions.
        let range = convert_a_value_to_a_key_range(&realm_cx, query, false)?;

        // 6. Let cursor be a new cursor with its source handle set to this, undefined position, direction set to direction, got value flag set to false, undefined key and value, range set to range, and key only flag set to true.
        let cursor = IDBCursor::create(
            vm,
            CursorSourceHandle::ObjectStore(*this),
            None,
            direction,
            false,
            None,
            None,
            range,
            true,
        );

        // 7. Let operation be an algorithm to run iterate a cursor with the current Realm record and cursor.
        let operation = create_operation(vm, (realm, cursor), |vm, &(realm, cursor)| {
            let cx = CallContext::new(vm, realm);
            let result = iterate_a_cursor(&cx, cursor, None, None, 1)?;
            Ok(idb_cursor_result(&cx, result))
        });

        // 8. Let request be the result of running asynchronously execute a request with this and operation.
        let request = request_of(asynchronously_execute_a_request(
            vm,
            IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(*this),
            operation,
            None,
        ));

        // 9. Set cursor’s request to request.
        cursor.set_request(Some(request));

        // 10. Return request.
        Ok(request)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-getallkeys
    pub(crate) fn get_all_keys(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        query_or_options: Option<Value>,
        count: Option<u32>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        // 1. Return the result of creating a request to retrieve multiple items with the current Realm record, this, "key",
        //    queryOrOptions, and count if given. Rethrow any exceptions.
        create_a_request_to_retrieve_multiple_items(
            &CallContext::new(cx.vm(), this.realm()),
            IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(*this),
            RecordKind::Key,
            query_or_options.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED),
            count,
        )
        .map(request_of)
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbobjectstore-getallrecords
    pub(crate) fn get_all_records(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        options: IDBGetAllOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBRequest>> {
        // 1. Return the result of creating a request to retrieve multiple items with the current Realm record, this,
        //    "record", and options. Rethrow any exceptions.
        create_a_request_to_retrieve_multiple_items_with_options(
            &CallContext::new(cx.vm(), this.realm()),
            IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(*this),
            RecordKind::Record,
            &options,
        )
        .map(request_of)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn request_of(request: AnyIDBRequest) -> Ref<IDBRequest> {
    match request {
        AnyIDBRequest::IDBRequest(request) => request,
        AnyIDBRequest::IDBOpenDBRequest(_) => unreachable!("a request against a transaction is not an open request"),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn idb_cursor_result(cx: &CallContext, cursor: Option<AnyIDBCursor>) -> Value {
    match cursor {
        None => Value::NULL,
        Some(cursor) => cursor.to_js(cx).must(),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn invalid_state_error(message: &str) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("InvalidStateError", Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
}

pub(crate) fn transaction_inactive_error(message: &str) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("TransactionInactiveError", Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
}

pub(crate) fn constraint_error(message: &str) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("ConstraintError", Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
}

pub(crate) fn not_found_error(message: &str) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("NotFoundError", Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
}

pub(crate) fn data_error(message: &str) -> Exception {
    Exception::Dom("DataError", Utf16String::from_utf8(message))
}

//! IDBOpenDBRequest, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#idbopendbrequest

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::indexed_db::idb_request::{IDBRequest, IDBRequestSource};

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#idbopendbrequest
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBOpenDBRequest {
    request: IDBRequest,
}

impl Inherits<IDBRequest> for IDBOpenDBRequest {
    fn parent(&self) -> &IDBRequest {
        &self.request
    }
}

impl Wrappable for IDBOpenDBRequest {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.request.cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for IDBOpenDBRequest {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#open-requests
        // An open request’s get the parent algorithm returns null.
        None
    }
}

impl IDBOpenDBRequest {
    // NOTE: The source of an open request is always null.
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>) -> Ref<IDBOpenDBRequest> {
        let request = allocate(vm, |_| IDBOpenDBRequest {
            request: IDBRequest::new(realm, IDBRequestSource::Empty),
        });
        request.request.event_target().set_owner(request);
        request
    }
}

//! IDBRecord, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#record-interface

use std::rc::Rc;

/// The bytes of a Web::HTML::StorageSerializationRecord, which records share.
pub(crate) type StorageSerializationRecord = Rc<[u8]>;

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#object-store-record
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct ObjectStoreRecord {
    pub(crate) key: Rc<Key>,
    pub(crate) value: StorageSerializationRecord,
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#index-list-of-records

    pub(crate) key: Rc<Key>,
    pub(crate) value: Rc<Key>,
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#record-snapshot
// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#record-interface
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBRecord {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    key: Rc<Key>,
    value: Value,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    primary_key: Rc<Key>,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBRecord {}

impl IDBRecord {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, key: Rc<Key>, value: Value, primary_key: Rc<Key>) -> Ref<IDBRecord> {
        allocate(vm, |_| IDBRecord {
            key,
            value,
            primary_key,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn key(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The key getter steps are to return the result of converting a key to a
        // value with this's key.
        Ok(convert_a_key_to_a_value(cx, &self.key))
    }

    pub(crate) fn primary_key(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The primaryKey getter steps are to return the result of converting a key
        // to a value with this's primary key.
        Ok(convert_a_key_to_a_value(cx, &self.primary_key))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbrecord-value
    pub(crate) fn value(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // The value getter steps are to return this’s value.
        Ok(self.value)
    }
}

//! IDBRequest, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#request-api

use core::cell::Cell;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ops::Deref;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{EmbedderCell, Gc, GcRefCell, GcWeak, Realm, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::conversions::{CppInterface, ToJs};
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, Wrapped, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::indexed_db::cpp::DomException;
use crate::indexed_db::idb_cursor::AnyIDBCursor;
use crate::indexed_db::idb_index::IDBIndex;
use crate::indexed_db::idb_object_store::IDBObjectStore;
use crate::indexed_db::idb_open_db_request::IDBOpenDBRequest;
use crate::indexed_db::idb_transaction::IDBTransaction;

/// The enumeration IDBRequestReadyState of IndexedDB/IDBRequest.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum IDBRequestReadyState {
    Pending,
    Done,
}

/// The union (IDBObjectStore or IDBIndex or IDBCursor) of IndexedDB/IDBRequest.idl.
#[allow(
    clippy::enum_variant_names,
    reason = "the variants have the names of the interfaces of the union"
)]
pub(crate) enum IDBObjectStoreOrIDBIndexOrIDBCursor {
    IDBObjectStore(Ref<IDBObjectStore>),
    IDBIndex(Ref<IDBIndex>),
    IDBCursor(AnyIDBCursor),
}

/// The source of a request: an object store handle, an index handle, or a cursor, or none for an open request.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum IDBRequestSource {
    Empty,
    ObjectStore(Ref<IDBObjectStore>),
    Index(Ref<IDBIndex>),
    Cursor(AnyIDBCursor),
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#request-api
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBRequest {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,

    // A request has a processed flag which is initially false.
    processed: Cell<bool>,

    // A request has a done flag which is initially false.
    done: Cell<bool>,

    // A request has a result and an error
    result: Cell<Value>,
    error: GcRefCell<Option<DomException>>,

    // A request has a source object.
    source: Cell<IDBRequestSource>,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,

    // A request has a transaction which is initially null.
    transaction: Cell<Option<Ref<IDBTransaction>>>,

    // AD-HOC: Set to true to prevent queued operations and result events from executing.
    aborted: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBRequest {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for IDBRequest {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#request-construct
        // A request’s get the parent algorithm returns the request’s transaction.
        self.transaction
            .get()
            .map(|transaction| transaction.event_target().clone())
    }
}

impl IDBRequest {
    pub(crate) fn new(realm: Gc<Realm>, source: IDBRequestSource) -> Self {
        Self {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            processed: Cell::new(false),
            done: Cell::new(false),
            result: Cell::new(Value::UNDEFINED),
            error: GcRefCell::new(None),
            source: Cell::new(source),
            realm,
            transaction: Cell::new(None),
            aborted: Cell::new(false),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, realm: Gc<Realm>, source: IDBRequestSource) -> Ref<IDBRequest> {
        let request = allocate(vm, |_| IDBRequest::new(realm, source));
        request.event_target.set_owner(request);
        request
    }

    pub(crate) fn event_target(&self) -> &CppEventTarget {
        &self.event_target
    }

    pub(crate) fn done(&self) -> bool {
        self.done.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn processed(&self) -> bool {
        self.processed.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn transaction_object(&self) -> Option<Ref<IDBTransaction>> {
        self.transaction.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        self.realm
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_done(&self, done: bool) {
        self.done.set(done);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_result(&self, result: Value) {
        self.result.set(result);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_error(&self, vm: &Vm, error: Option<DomException>) {
        *self.error.borrow_mut(vm) = error;
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_processed(&self, processed: bool) {
        self.processed.set(processed);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_transaction(&self, transaction: Option<Ref<IDBTransaction>>) {
        self.transaction.set(transaction);
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_error(&self) -> bool {
        self.error.borrow().is_some()
    }

    pub(crate) fn aborted(&self) -> bool {
        self.aborted.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_aborted(&self, aborted: bool) {
        self.aborted.set(aborted);
    }

    /// The error, without the done flag check of the getter.
    pub(crate) fn error_object(&self) -> Option<DomException> {
        self.error.borrow().clone()
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbrequest-result
    pub(crate) fn result(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        // 1. If this's done flag is false, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !self.done() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("The request is not done"),
            ));
        }

        // 2. Return this's result, or undefined if the request resulted in an error.
        if self.has_error() {
            return Ok(Value::UNDEFINED);
        }

        Ok(self.result.get())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbrequest-error
    pub(crate) fn error(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<CppInterface>> {
        // 1. If this's done flag is false, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !self.done.get() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8("The request is not done"),
            ));
        }

        // 2. Return this's error, or null if no error occurred.
        Ok(self.error_object().map(|error| error.wrapper(cx)))
    }

    pub(crate) fn source(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<IDBObjectStoreOrIDBIndexOrIDBCursor>> {
        Ok(match self.source.get() {
            IDBRequestSource::Empty => None,
            IDBRequestSource::ObjectStore(object_store) => {
                Some(IDBObjectStoreOrIDBIndexOrIDBCursor::IDBObjectStore(object_store))
            }
            IDBRequestSource::Index(index) => Some(IDBObjectStoreOrIDBIndexOrIDBCursor::IDBIndex(index)),
            IDBRequestSource::Cursor(cursor) => Some(IDBObjectStoreOrIDBIndexOrIDBCursor::IDBCursor(cursor)),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn transaction(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<IDBTransaction>>> {
        Ok(self.transaction.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn ready_state(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<IDBRequestReadyState> {
        // The readyState getter steps are to return "pending" if this's done flag is false, and "done" otherwise.
        Ok(if self.done() {
            IDBRequestReadyState::Done
        } else {
            IDBRequestReadyState::Pending
        })
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum AnyIDBRequest {
    IDBRequest(Ref<IDBRequest>),
    IDBOpenDBRequest(Ref<IDBOpenDBRequest>),
}

impl Deref for AnyIDBRequest {
    type Target = IDBRequest;

    fn deref(&self) -> &IDBRequest {
        match self {
            Self::IDBRequest(request) => request,
            Self::IDBOpenDBRequest(request) => {
                let request: &IDBOpenDBRequest = request;
                request.parent()
            }
        }
    }
}

impl ToJs for AnyIDBRequest {
    fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> libjs_rust::api::ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {
        match self {
            Self::IDBRequest(request) => request.to_js(cx),
            Self::IDBOpenDBRequest(request) => request.to_js(cx),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) enum WeakIDBRequest {
    IDBRequest(GcWeak<EmbedderCell<Wrapped<IDBRequest>>>),
    IDBOpenDBRequest(GcWeak<EmbedderCell<Wrapped<IDBOpenDBRequest>>>),
}

impl WeakIDBRequest {
    pub(crate) fn new(vm: &Vm, request: AnyIDBRequest) -> Self {
        match request {
            AnyIDBRequest::IDBRequest(request) => Self::IDBRequest(GcWeak::new(vm.heap(), request)),
            AnyIDBRequest::IDBOpenDBRequest(request) => Self::IDBOpenDBRequest(GcWeak::new(vm.heap(), request)),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn get(&self) -> Option<AnyIDBRequest> {
        match self {
            Self::IDBRequest(request) => request.get().map(AnyIDBRequest::IDBRequest),
            Self::IDBOpenDBRequest(request) => request.get().map(AnyIDBRequest::IDBOpenDBRequest),
        }
    }
}

//! IDBTransaction, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#transaction

use core::cell::Cell;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, MarkedVec, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use crate::bindings::conversions::CppInterface;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::html::dom_string_list::DOMStringList;
use crate::indexed_db::cpp::{DomException, devtools_client_is_active, notify_devtools_of_committed_changes};
use crate::indexed_db::idb_database::{IDBDatabase, IDBTransactionDurability};
use crate::indexed_db::idb_index::IDBIndex;
use crate::indexed_db::idb_object_store::{IDBObjectStore, invalid_state_error, not_found_error};
use crate::indexed_db::idb_request::AnyIDBRequest;

use crate::indexed_db::internal::mutation_log::{MutationLog, MutationLogRef, TransactionChanges};
use crate::indexed_db::internal::object_store::ObjectStoreRef;
use crate::indexed_db::internal::request_list::RequestList;

/// The enumeration IDBTransactionMode of IndexedDB/IDBTransaction.idl.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum IDBTransactionMode {
    Readonly,
    Readwrite,
    Versionchange,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum TransactionState {
    Active,
    Inactive,
    Committing,
    Finished,
}

// AD-HOC: Per-store mutation logs for data and schema change reversion.
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
struct StoreMutationLog {
    store: ObjectStoreRef,
    log: MutationLogRef,
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#transaction
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBTransaction {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,

    // AD-HOC: The transaction has a connection
    connection: Ref<IDBDatabase>,

    // A transaction has a mode that determines which types of interactions can be performed upon that transaction.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    mode: IDBTransactionMode,

    // A transaction has a durability hint. This is a hint to the user agent of whether to prioritize performance or durability when committing the transaction.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    durability: IDBTransactionDurability,

    // A transaction has a state
    #[gc(untraced)]
    state: Cell<TransactionState>,

    // A transaction has a error which is set if the transaction is aborted.
    error: GcRefCell<Option<DomException>>,

    // A transaction has an associated upgrade request
    associated_request: Cell<Option<AnyIDBRequest>>,

    // AD-HOC: We need to track abort state separately, since we cannot rely on only the error.
    aborted: Cell<bool>,

    // A transaction has a scope which is a set of object stores that the transaction may interact with.
    scope: GcRefCell<Vec<ObjectStoreRef>>,

    // A transaction has a request list of pending requests which have been made against the transaction.
    request_list: RequestList,

    // A transaction optionally has a cleanup event loop which is an event loop.
    cleanup_event_loop: GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,

    object_store_handles: GcRefCell<Vec<(ObjectStoreRef, Ref<IDBObjectStore>)>>,
    index_handles: GcRefCell<Vec<Ref<IDBIndex>>>,

    store_mutation_logs: GcRefCell<Vec<StoreMutationLog>>,
    original_version: Cell<u64>,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBTransaction {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for IDBTransaction {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#transaction-construct
        // A transaction’s get the parent algorithm returns the transaction’s connection.
        Some(self.connection.event_target().clone())
    }
}

impl IDBTransaction {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        connection: Ref<IDBDatabase>,
        mode: IDBTransactionMode,
        durability: IDBTransactionDurability,
        scope: &[ObjectStoreRef],
    ) -> Ref<IDBTransaction> {
        let transaction = allocate(vm, |defer| IDBTransaction {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            connection,
            mode,
            durability,
            state: Cell::new(TransactionState::Active),
            error: GcRefCell::new(None),
            associated_request: Cell::new(None),
            aborted: Cell::new(false),
            scope: GcRefCell::new(scope.to_vec()),
            request_list: RequestList::new(defer),
            cleanup_event_loop: GcRefCell::new(None),
            object_store_handles: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            index_handles: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            store_mutation_logs: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            original_version: Cell::new(0),
        });
        transaction.event_target.set_owner(transaction);
        connection.add_transaction(vm, transaction);
        transaction
    }

    pub(crate) fn event_target(&self) -> &CppEventTarget {
        &self.event_target
    }

    pub(crate) fn state(&self) -> TransactionState {
        self.state.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn error_object(&self) -> Option<DomException> {
        self.error.borrow().clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn connection_object(&self) -> Ref<IDBDatabase> {
        self.connection
    }

    pub(crate) fn associated_request(&self) -> Option<AnyIDBRequest> {
        self.associated_request.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn aborted(&self) -> bool {
        self.aborted.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        self.connection.realm()
    }

    pub(crate) fn request_list(&self) -> &RequestList {
        &self.request_list
    }

    pub(crate) fn scope<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, ObjectStoreRef> {
        let scope = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        scope.extend_from_slice(&self.scope.borrow());
        scope
    }

    pub(crate) fn cleanup_event_loop(&self) -> Option<*mut c_void> {
        self.cleanup_event_loop.borrow().as_ref().map(CppCell::as_ptr)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_error(&self, vm: &Vm, error: Option<DomException>) {
        *self.error.borrow_mut(vm) = error;
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_associated_request(&self, request: Option<AnyIDBRequest>) {
        self.associated_request.set(request);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_aborted(&self, aborted: bool) {
        self.aborted.set(aborted);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_cleanup_event_loop(&self, vm: &Vm, event_loop: Option<CppCell>) {
        *self.cleanup_event_loop.borrow_mut(vm) = event_loop;
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_state(&self, state: TransactionState) {
        // NB: Finishing also has to remove the transaction from its connection, which set_finished() does.
        assert!(state != TransactionState::Finished);
        self.state.set(state);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_finished(vm: &Vm, transaction: Ref<Self>) {
        transaction.state.set(TransactionState::Finished);
        transaction.connection.remove_finished_transaction(vm, transaction);
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_upgrade_transaction(&self) -> bool {
        self.mode == IDBTransactionMode::Versionchange
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_readonly(&self) -> bool {
        self.mode == IDBTransactionMode::Readonly
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_finished(&self) -> bool {
        self.state.get() == TransactionState::Finished
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_active(&self) -> bool {
        self.state.get() == TransactionState::Active
    }

    pub(crate) fn object_store_named(&self, name: &Utf16String) -> Option<ObjectStoreRef> {
        self.scope.borrow().iter().find(|store| store.name() == *name).copied()
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_to_scope(&self, vm: &Vm, object_store: ObjectStoreRef) {
        self.scope.borrow_mut(vm).push(object_store);
    }

    pub(crate) fn remove_from_scope(&self, vm: &Vm, object_store: ObjectStoreRef) {
        let mut scope = self.scope.borrow_mut(vm);
        if let Some(position) = scope.iter().position(|other| *other == object_store) {
            scope.remove(position);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_scope(&self, vm: &Vm, scope: &[ObjectStoreRef]) {
        *self.scope.borrow_mut(vm) = scope.to_vec();
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_or_create_object_store_handle(
        this: Ref<Self>,
        vm: &Vm,
        store: ObjectStoreRef,
    ) -> Ref<IDBObjectStore> {
        if let Some(handle) = this.object_store_handle_for(store) {
            return handle;
        }

        let handle = IDBObjectStore::create(vm, store, this);
        this.object_store_handles.borrow_mut(vm).push((store, handle));
        handle
    }

    pub(crate) fn object_store_handle_for(&self, store: ObjectStoreRef) -> Option<Ref<IDBObjectStore>> {
        self.object_store_handles
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .find(|(entry, _)| *entry == store)
            .map(|(_, handle)| *handle)
    }

    pub(crate) fn object_store_handles<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, Ref<IDBObjectStore>> {
        let handles = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        for (_, handle) in self.object_store_handles.borrow().iter() {
            handles.push(*handle);
        }
        handles
    }

    pub(crate) fn register_index_handle(&self, vm: &Vm, handle: Ref<IDBIndex>) {
        self.index_handles.borrow_mut(vm).push(handle);
    }

    pub(crate) fn index_handles<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, Ref<IDBIndex>> {
        let handles = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        handles.extend_from_slice(&self.index_handles.borrow());
        handles
    }

    // Mutation log management. Logs are per-store and track both data and schema mutations.
    pub(crate) fn set_up_mutation_logs(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        self.original_version
            .set(self.connection.associated_database().version());

        for store in self.scope(vm).values().iter() {
            let log = MutationLog::create(vm);
            store.set_mutation_log(Some(log));
            self.store_mutation_logs
                .borrow_mut(vm)
                .push(StoreMutationLog { store: *store, log });
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn original_version(&self) -> u64 {
        self.original_version.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_up_mutation_log_for_new_store(&self, vm: &Vm, store: ObjectStoreRef) {
        let log = MutationLog::create(vm);
        store.set_mutation_log(Some(log));
        self.store_mutation_logs
            .borrow_mut(vm)
            .push(StoreMutationLog { store, log });
        log.note_object_store_created(vm);
    }

    pub(crate) fn revert_all_mutations(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        let database = self.connection.associated_database();
        let entries = MarkedVec::new(vm);
        for entry in self.store_mutation_logs.borrow().iter() {
            entries.push((entry.store, entry.log));
        }
        for (store, log) in entries.values().iter().rev() {
            log.revert(vm, *store, database, self.connection);
        }

        database.set_version(self.original_version.get());
        self.connection.set_version(self.original_version.get());
    }

    pub(crate) fn discard_mutation_logs(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        for entry in self.store_mutation_logs.borrow().iter() {
            entry.store.set_mutation_log(None);
        }
        self.store_mutation_logs.borrow_mut(vm).clear();
    }

    pub(crate) fn notify_devtools_of_committed_changes(&self) {
        if !devtools_client_is_active(self.realm()) {
            return;
        }

        let mut changes = TransactionChanges::default();
        let database_name = self.connection.associated_database().name();
        for entry in self.store_mutation_logs.borrow().iter() {
            entry
                .log
                .append_changes(&database_name, &entry.store.name(), &mut changes);
        }
        if changes.is_empty() {
            return;
        }

        notify_devtools_of_committed_changes(self.realm(), &changes);
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbtransaction-objectstorenames
    pub(crate) fn object_store_names(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<DOMStringList>> {
        // 1. Let names be a list of the names of the object stores in this's scope.
        let names = self
            .scope
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .map(|object_store| object_store.name())
            .collect();

        // 2. Return the result (a DOMStringList) of creating a sorted name list with names.
        Ok(create_a_sorted_name_list(cx.vm(), names))
    }

    pub(crate) fn mode(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<IDBTransactionMode> {
        Ok(self.mode)
    }

    pub(crate) fn durability(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<IDBTransactionDurability> {
        Ok(self.durability)
    }

    pub(crate) fn connection(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBDatabase>> {
        Ok(self.connection)
    }

    pub(crate) fn error(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<CppInterface>> {
        Ok(self.error_object().map(|error| error.wrapper(cx)))
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbtransaction-abort
    pub(crate) fn abort(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If this's state is committing or finished, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if this.state.get() == TransactionState::Committing || this.state.get() == TransactionState::Finished {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Transaction is ending"));
        }

        // 2. Run abort a transaction with this and null.
        abort_a_transaction(cx.vm(), *this, None);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbtransaction-commit
    pub(crate) fn commit(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If this's state is not active, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if this.state.get() != TransactionState::Active {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Transaction is not active while committing"));
        }

        // 2. Run commit a transaction with this.
        commit_a_transaction(cx.vm(), *this);

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#dom-idbtransaction-objectstore
    pub(crate) fn object_store(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        name: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBObjectStore>> {
        // 1. If this's state is finished, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if this.state.get() == TransactionState::Finished {
            return Err(invalid_state_error("Transaction is finished"));
        }

        // 2. Let store be the object store named name in this's scope, or throw a "NotFoundError" DOMException if none.
        let Some(store) = this.object_store_named(&name) else {
            return Err(not_found_error("Object store not found in transactions scope"));
        };

        // 3. Return an object store handle associated with store and this.

        // https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#object-store-handle-construct
        // Multiple handles may be associated with the same object store in different transactions,
        // but there must be only one object store handle associated with a particular object store
        // within a transaction.
        Ok(Self::get_or_create_object_store_handle(*this, cx.vm(), store))
    }
}

//! IDBVersionChangeEvent, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#events

use core::ffi::c_void;

/// The dictionary IDBVersionChangeEventInit of IndexedDB/IDBVersionChangeEvent.idl.
pub(crate) struct IDBVersionChangeEventInit {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) new_version: Option<u64>,
    pub(crate) old_version: u64,
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#events
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct IDBVersionChangeEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    old_version: u64,
    new_version: Option<u64>,
}

impl Wrappable for IDBVersionChangeEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl IDBVersionChangeEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: &IDBVersionChangeEventInit,
    ) -> Ref<IDBVersionChangeEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.parent.bubbles,
            event_init.parent.cancelable,
            event_init.parent.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| IDBVersionChangeEvent {
            event,
            old_version: event_init.old_version,
            new_version: event_init.new_version,
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init_dict: IDBVersionChangeEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IDBVersionChangeEvent>> {
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &r#type, &event_init_dict))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    pub(crate) fn old_version(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u64> {
        Ok(self.old_version)
    }

    pub(crate) fn new_version(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<u64>> {
        Ok(self.new_version)
    }
}

/// A key path, https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#key-path-construct: a string or a list of strings.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) enum KeyPath {
    String(Utf16String),
    Sequence(Vec<Utf16String>),
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
struct TaskCounterState {
    remaining_tasks: Cell<usize>,
    after_all: Cell<Option<Function>>,
}

static TASK_COUNTER_STATE_CLASS: EmbedderClass<TaskCounterState> = EmbedderClass::new("IndexedDBTaskCounterState");

impl EmbedderValue for TaskCounterState {
    const CLASS: &'static EmbedderClass<Self> = &TASK_COUNTER_STATE_CLASS;
}

type TaskCounterStateRef = Gc<EmbedderCell<TaskCounterState>>;

impl TaskCounterState {
    fn create(vm: &Vm) -> TaskCounterStateRef {
        TASK_COUNTER_STATE_CLASS.allocate(vm, |_| TaskCounterState {
            remaining_tasks: Cell::new(0),
            after_all: Cell::new(None),
        })
    }

    fn decrement_remaining_tasks(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        assert!(self.remaining_tasks.get() > 0);
        self.remaining_tasks.set(self.remaining_tasks.get() - 1);
        if self.remaining_tasks.get() > 0 {
            return;
        }

        queue_a_database_task(
            vm,
            self.after_all.get().expect("the steps to run after all tasks are set"),
        );
    }
}

fn strictly_split_key_path(key_path: &Utf16String) -> Vec<Utf16String> {
    key_path
        .to_utf16()
        .split(|code_unit| *code_unit == u16::from(b'.'))
        .map(Utf16String::from_utf16)
        .collect()
}

pub(crate) type OpenResult = Result<Ref<IDBDatabase>, DomException>;

fn call_completion<A: 'static>(vm: &Vm, queue: ConnectionQueueRef, completion: FunctionWith<A>, result: A) {
    completion.call(vm, result);
    queue.request_list.on_request_processed(vm);
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#open-a-database-connection
pub(crate) fn open_a_database_connection(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    storage_key: StorageKey,
    name: Utf16String,
    maybe_version: Option<u64>,
    request: AnyIDBRequest,
    on_complete: FunctionWith<OpenResult>,
) {
    // 1. Let queue be the connection queue for storageKey and name.
    let queue = storage(vm).connection_queue_for_key_and_name(vm, &storage_key, &name);

    // 2. Add request to queue.
    // 3. Wait until all previous requests in queue have been processed.
    let steps = create_function(
        vm,
        (
            realm,
            queue,
            NoCells(storage_key),
            name,
            maybe_version,
            request,
            on_complete,
        ),
        |vm, &(realm, queue, ref storage_key, ref name, maybe_version, request, on_complete), ()| {
            // 4. Let db be the database named name in storageKey, or null otherwise.
            let maybe_db = Database::for_key_and_name(vm, &storage_key.0, name);

            // 5. If version is undefined, let version be 1 if db is null, or db’s version otherwise.
            let version = maybe_version.unwrap_or_else(|| maybe_db.map_or(1, |db| db.version()));

            // 6. If db is null, let db be a new database with name name, version 0 (zero), and with no object stores.
            //    If this fails for any reason, return an appropriate error (e.g. a QuotaExceededError, or an "UnknownError" DOMException).
            let db = maybe_db.unwrap_or_else(|| Database::create_for_key_and_name(vm, &storage_key.0, name));

            // 7. If db’s version is greater than version, return a newly created "VersionError" DOMException and abort these steps.
            if db.version() > version {
                call_completion(
                    vm,
                    queue,
                    on_complete,
                    Err(DomException::create(
                        "VersionError",
                        "Database version is greater than the requested version",
                    )),
                );
                return;
            }

            // 8. Let connection be a new connection to db.
            let connection = IDBDatabase::create(vm, realm, db);

            // 9. Set connection’s version to version.
            connection.set_version(version);

            // 10. If db’s version is less than version, then:
            if db.version() < version {
                // 1. Let openConnections be the set of all connections, except connection, associated with db.
                let open_connections = db.associated_connections_except(vm, connection);

                // 2. For each entry of openConnections that does not have its close pending flag set to true,
                //    queue a database task to fire a version change event named versionchange at entry with db’s version and version.
                let mut task_counter_state: Option<TaskCounterStateRef> = None;
                for &entry in open_connections.values().iter() {
                    if !entry.close_pending() {
                        let state = *task_counter_state.get_or_insert_with(|| TaskCounterState::create(vm));

                        state.remaining_tasks.set(state.remaining_tasks.get() + 1);
                        queue_a_database_task(
                            vm,
                            create_function(
                                vm,
                                (realm, entry, db, version, state),
                                |vm, &(realm, entry, db, version, state), ()| {
                                    fire_a_version_change_event(
                                        vm,
                                        realm,
                                        "versionchange",
                                        entry.event_target(),
                                        db.version(),
                                        Some(version),
                                    );
                                    state.decrement_remaining_tasks(vm);
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                }

                // 3. Wait for all of the events to be fired.
                let after_all = create_function(
                    vm,
                    (
                        realm,
                        queue,
                        OpenConnections(open_connections.to_vec()),
                        db,
                        version,
                        connection,
                        request,
                        on_complete,
                    ),
                    |vm, &(realm, queue, ref open_connections, db, version, connection, request, on_complete), ()| {
                        // 4. If any of the connections in openConnections are still not closed,
                        //    queue a database task to fire a version change event named blocked at request with db’s version and version.
                        let any_connection_is_not_closed = open_connections
                            .0
                            .iter()
                            .any(|entry| entry.state() != ConnectionState::Closed);
                        if any_connection_is_not_closed {
                            queue_a_database_task(
                                vm,
                                create_function(
                                    vm,
                                    (realm, request, db, version),
                                    |vm, &(realm, request, db, version), ()| {
                                        fire_a_version_change_event(
                                            vm,
                                            realm,
                                            "blocked",
                                            request.event_target(),
                                            db.version(),
                                            Some(version),
                                        );
                                    },
                                ),
                            );
                        }

                        // 5. Wait until all connections in openConnections are closed.
                        db.wait_for_connections_to_close(
                            vm,
                            &open_connections.0,
                            create_function(
                                vm,
                                (realm, queue, connection, version, request, on_complete),
                                |vm, &(realm, queue, connection, version, request, on_complete), ()| {
                                    // 6. Run upgrade a database using connection, version and request.
                                    upgrade_a_database(
                                        vm,
                                        realm,
                                        connection,
                                        version,
                                        request,
                                        create_function(
                                            vm,
                                            (queue, connection, request, on_complete),
                                            |vm, &(queue, connection, request, on_complete), ()| {
                                                // 7. If connection was closed, return a newly created "AbortError" DOMException and abort these steps.
                                                if connection.state() == ConnectionState::Closed {
                                                    call_completion(
                                                        vm,
                                                        queue,
                                                        on_complete,
                                                        Err(DomException::create(
                                                            "AbortError",
                                                            "Connection was closed",
                                                        )),
                                                    );
                                                    return;
                                                }

                                                // 8. If request's error is set, run the steps to close a database connection with connection,
                                                //    return a newly created "AbortError" DOMException and abort these steps.
                                                if request.has_error() {
                                                    close_a_database_connection(
                                                        vm,
                                                        connection,
                                                        Some(create_function(
                                                            vm,
                                                            (queue, on_complete),
                                                            |vm, &(queue, on_complete), ()| {
                                                                call_completion(
                                                                    vm,
                                                                    queue,
                                                                    on_complete,
                                                                    Err(DomException::create(
                                                                        "AbortError",
                                                                        "Upgrade transaction was aborted",
                                                                    )),
                                                                );
                                                            },
                                                        )),
                                                        false,
                                                    );
                                                    return;
                                                }

                                                // 11. Return connection.
                                                call_completion(vm, queue, on_complete, Ok(connection));
                                            },
                                        ),
                                    );
                                },
                            ),
                        );
                    },
                );

                if let Some(state) = task_counter_state {
                    state.after_all.set(Some(after_all));
                } else {
                    queue_a_database_task(vm, after_all);
                }

                // NOTE: Because of the async nature of this function, we return here and call the on_complete function
                //       with the connection when necessary.
                return;
            }

            // 11. Return connection.
            call_completion(vm, queue, on_complete, Ok(connection));
        },
    );
    queue.request_list.enqueue(vm, request, steps);
}

/// The connections that an algorithm waits on, which it keeps alive while it waits.
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
struct OpenConnections(Vec<Ref<IDBDatabase>>);

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#fire-a-version-change-event
pub(crate) fn fire_a_version_change_event(
    vm: &Vm,
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    event_name: &str,
    target: &CppEventTarget,
    old_version: u64,
    new_version: Option<u64>,
) -> bool {
    let event_init = IDBVersionChangeEventInit {
        // 3. Set event’s bubbles and cancelable attributes to false.
        parent: EventInit {
            bubbles: false,
            cancelable: false,
            composed: false,
        },
        // 4. Set event’s oldVersion attribute to oldVersion.
        old_version,
        // 5. Set event’s newVersion attribute to newVersion.
        new_version,
    };

    // 1. Let event be the result of creating an event using IDBVersionChangeEvent.
    // 2. Set event’s type attribute to e.
    let event = IDBVersionChangeEvent::create(vm, realm, &Utf16String::from_utf8(event_name), &event_init);

    // 6. Let legacyOutputDidListenersThrowFlag be false.
    // 7. Dispatch event at target with legacyOutputDidListenersThrowFlag.
    // 8. Return legacyOutputDidListenersThrowFlag.
    target.dispatch_event_with_legacy_output_did_listeners_throw_flag(event.event())
}

// https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#convert-value-to-key
pub(crate) fn convert_a_value_to_a_key(
    cx: &CallContext,
    input: Value,
