//! ReadableStreamDefaultReader, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-reader-class

use std::collections::VecDeque;

use core::cell::Cell;

use libjs_rust::api::{
    DeferGc, EmbedderCell, EmbedderClass, EmbedderValue, Gc, GcRefCell, MarkedVec, Realm, Trace, TypedArrayBase,
    TypedArrayKind, Value, Vm,
};

use crate::bindings::conversions::BufferSource;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::promise::{
    WebIdlPromise, create_promise, create_rejected_promise_from_exception, exception_value,
};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::streams::cpp::{CppBytesSteps, CppReadRequest, CppValueSteps};
use crate::streams::read_request::ReadRequest;
use crate::streams::readable_byte_stream_controller::ReadableByteStreamController;
use crate::streams::readable_stream::{
    ReadableStream, ReadableStreamReader, ReadableStreamState, is_readable_stream_locked,
};
use crate::streams::readable_stream_default_controller::ReadableStreamDefaultController;
use crate::streams::readable_stream_generic_reader::{
    ReadableStreamGenericReader, readable_stream_reader_generic_initialize, readable_stream_reader_generic_release,
};
use crate::streams::readable_stream_pipe_to::PipeToRef;
use crate::streams::underlying_source::ReadableStreamController;

/// The dictionary ReadableStreamReadResult of Streams/ReadableStreamDefaultReader.idl, which the bindings convert.
/// NB: The read requests resolve their promises with iterator result objects, as LibWeb's C++ does, so nothing
///     creates this.
pub(crate) struct ReadableStreamReadResult {
    pub(crate) done: Option<bool>,
    pub(crate) value: Option<Value>,
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamdefaultreader
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ReadableStreamDefaultReader {
    generic: ReadableStreamGenericReader,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamdefaultreader-readrequests
    read_requests: GcRefCell<VecDeque<ReadRequest>>,
    /// The pipe that reads from the reader's stream, which the reader keeps alive.
    pipe_to: Cell<Option<PipeToRef>>,
}

impl Wrappable for ReadableStreamDefaultReader {}

impl ReadableStreamDefaultReader {
    pub(crate) fn new(_: &DeferGc<'_>) -> Self {
        Self {
            generic: ReadableStreamGenericReader::default(),
            read_requests: GcRefCell::new(VecDeque::new()),
            pipe_to: Cell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_pipe_to(&self, pipe_to: Option<PipeToRef>) {
        self.pipe_to.set(pipe_to);
    }

    pub(crate) fn generic(&self) -> &ReadableStreamGenericReader {
        &self.generic
    }

    pub(crate) fn append_read_request(&self, vm: &Vm, read_request: ReadRequest) {
        self.read_requests.borrow_mut(vm).push_back(read_request);
    }

    /// Takes the reader's [[readRequests]], leaving an empty list.
    pub(crate) fn take_read_requests<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> MarkedVec<'vm, ReadRequest> {
        let read_requests = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, self.read_requests.borrow().len());
        for read_request in self.read_requests.borrow().iter() {
            read_requests.push(read_request.clone());
        }
        self.read_requests.borrow_mut(vm).clear();
        read_requests
    }

    /// Removes the first of the reader's [[readRequests]], which are not empty.
    pub(crate) fn take_first_read_request(&self, vm: &Vm) -> Option<ReadRequest> {
        self.read_requests.borrow_mut(vm).pop_front()
    }

    pub(crate) fn read_requests_len(&self) -> usize {
        self.read_requests.borrow().len()
    }

    pub(crate) fn read_requests_is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.read_requests.borrow().is_empty()
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-reader-constructor
    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext, stream: Ref<ReadableStream>) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let reader = allocate(cx.vm(), Self::new);

        // 1. Perform ? SetUpReadableStreamDefaultReader(this, stream).
        set_up_readable_stream_default_reader(cx, reader, stream)?;
        Ok(reader)
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#generic-reader-closed
    pub(crate) fn closed(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        self.generic.closed()
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-reader-read
    pub(crate) fn read(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        let cx = &this.generic.context(cx.vm());

        // 1. If this.[[stream]] is undefined, return a promise rejected with a TypeError exception.
        if this.generic.stream().is_none() {
            let exception = Exception::type_error("Cannot read from an empty stream");
            return Ok(create_rejected_promise_from_exception(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), exception));
        }

        // 2. Let promise be a new promise.
        let promise = create_promise(cx.vm(), cx.realm());

        // 3. Let readRequest be a new read request with the following items:
        //    chunk steps, given chunk
        //        1. Resolve promise with «[ "value" → chunk, "done" → false ]».
        //    close steps
        //        1. Resolve promise with «[ "value" → undefined, "done" → true ]».
        //    error steps, given e
        //        1. Reject promise with e.
        let read_request = ReadRequest::DefaultReaderRead(promise);

        // 4. Perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultReaderRead(this, readRequest).
        readable_stream_default_reader_read(cx.vm(), *this, read_request);

        // 5. Return promise.
        Ok(promise)
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-reader-release-lock
    pub(crate) fn release_lock(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If this.[[stream]] is undefined, return.
        if this.generic.stream().is_none() {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 2. Perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultReaderRelease(this).
        readable_stream_default_reader_release(cx.vm(), *this);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#generic-reader-cancel
    pub(crate) fn cancel(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, reason: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        let reader = ReadableStreamReader::ReadableStreamDefaultReader(*this);
        Ok(ReadableStreamGenericReader::cancel(cx.vm(), reader, reason))
    }

    /// To read a chunk from a ReadableStreamDefaultReader reader, given a read request readRequest,
    /// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamdefaultreader-read-a-chunk
    pub(crate) fn read_a_chunk(vm: &Vm, reader: Ref<Self>, read_request: CppReadRequest) {
        // To read a chunk from a ReadableStreamDefaultReader reader, given a read request readRequest,
        // perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultReaderRead(reader, readRequest).
        readable_stream_default_reader_read(vm, reader, ReadRequest::Cpp(read_request));
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamdefaultreader-read-all-bytes
    pub(crate) fn read_all_bytes(
        vm: &Vm,
        reader: Ref<Self>,
        success_steps: CppBytesSteps,
        failure_steps: CppValueSteps,
    ) {
        let realm = reader.generic.closed_promise_realm();

        // To read all bytes from a ReadableStreamDefaultReader reader, given successSteps, which is an algorithm
        // accepting a byte sequence, and failureSteps, which is an algorithm accepting a JavaScript value: read-loop
        // given reader, a new byte sequence, successSteps, and failureSteps.

        // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#read-loop
        // 1. Let readRequest be a new read request with the following items:
        //    NOTE: The items are the steps of ReadLoop.
        let read_request = READ_LOOP_CLASS.allocate(vm, |_| ReadLoop {
            realm,
            reader,
            bytes: core::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            success_steps,
            failure_steps,
        });

        // 2. Perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultReaderRead(reader, readRequest).
        readable_stream_default_reader_read(vm, reader, ReadRequest::ReadLoop(read_request));
    }
}

/// The state of a read-loop, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#read-loop, whose read request reads the next chunk with
/// the same state.
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ReadLoop {
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    reader: Ref<ReadableStreamDefaultReader>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    bytes: core::cell::RefCell<Vec<u8>>,
    success_steps: CppBytesSteps,
    failure_steps: CppValueSteps,
}

static READ_LOOP_CLASS: EmbedderClass<ReadLoop> = EmbedderClass::new("ReadLoop");

impl EmbedderValue for ReadLoop {
    const CLASS: &'static EmbedderClass<Self> = &READ_LOOP_CLASS;
}

impl ReadLoop {
    // chunk steps, given chunk
    pub(crate) fn chunk_steps(this: Gc<EmbedderCell<Self>>, vm: &Vm, chunk: Value) {
        // 1. If chunk is not a Uint8Array object, call failureSteps with a TypeError and abort these steps.
        let typed_array = if chunk.is_object() {
            chunk.as_object().downcast::<TypedArrayBase>()
        } else {
            None
        };
        let Some(array) = typed_array.filter(|typed_array| typed_array.kind() == TypedArrayKind::Uint8Array) else {
            let error = exception_value(vm, this.realm, Exception::type_error("Chunk data is not Uint8Array"));
            this.failure_steps.call(error);
            return;
        };

        // 2. Append the bytes represented by chunk to bytes.
        // NB: Since a chunk is whatever the stream enqueued, and enqueue() takes an 'any', this Uint8Array may well be
        //     a view onto an SAB with no conversion having had the chance to reject one. So, use with_bytes() to read
        //     it through — rather than handing over a pointer into memory that another agent can be writing.
        // SAFETY: Appending the bytes to bytes neither runs script nor allocates a cell.
        unsafe { BufferSource::TypedArray(array).with_bytes(|bytes| this.bytes.borrow_mut().extend_from_slice(bytes)) };

        // FIXME: As the spec suggests, implement this non-recursively - instead of directly. It is not too big of a
        //        deal currently as we enqueue the entire blob buffer in one go, meaning that we only recurse a single
        //        time. Once we begin queuing up more than one chunk at a time, we may run into stack overflow problems.
        //
        // 3. Read-loop given reader, bytes, successSteps, and failureSteps.
        readable_stream_default_reader_read(vm, this.reader, ReadRequest::ReadLoop(this));
    }

    // close steps
    pub(crate) fn close_steps(&self) {
        // 1. Call successSteps with bytes.
        let bytes = core::mem::take(&mut *self.bytes.borrow_mut());
        self.success_steps.call(&bytes);
    }

    // error steps, given e
    pub(crate) fn error_steps(&self, error: Value) {
        // 1. Call failureSteps with e.
        self.failure_steps.call(error);
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#abstract-opdef-readablestreamdefaultreadererrorreadrequests
pub(crate) fn readable_stream_default_reader_error_read_requests(
    vm: &Vm,
    reader: Ref<ReadableStreamDefaultReader>,
    error: Value,
) {
    // 1. Let readRequests be reader.[[readRequests]].
    // 2. Set reader.[[readRequests]] to a new empty list.
    let read_requests = reader.take_read_requests(vm);

    // 3. For each readRequest of readRequests,
    for index in 0..read_requests.len() {
        // 1. Perform readRequest’s error steps, given e.
        read_requests
            .get(index)
            .expect("the index is in bounds")
            .error_steps(vm, error);
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readable-stream-default-reader-read
pub(crate) fn readable_stream_default_reader_read(
    vm: &Vm,
    reader: Ref<ReadableStreamDefaultReader>,
    read_request: ReadRequest,
) {
    // 1. Let stream be reader.[[stream]].
    // 2. Assert: stream is not undefined.
    let stream = reader.generic.stream().expect("a reader that reads has a stream");

    // 3. Set stream.[[disturbed]] to true.
    stream.set_disturbed(true);

    match stream.state() {
        // 4. If stream.[[state]] is "closed", perform readRequest’s close steps.
        ReadableStreamState::Closed => read_request.close_steps(vm),
        // 5. Otherwise, if stream.[[state]] is "errored", perform readRequest’s error steps given
        //    stream.[[storedError]].
        ReadableStreamState::Errored => read_request.error_steps(vm, stream.stored_error()),
        // 6. Otherwise,
        ReadableStreamState::Readable => {
            // 1. Assert: stream.[[state]] is "readable".
            // 2. Perform ! stream.[[controller]].[[PullSteps]](readRequest).
            match stream.controller().expect("a stream that is set up has a controller") {
                ReadableStreamController::ReadableStreamDefaultController(controller) => {
                    ReadableStreamDefaultController::pull_steps(controller, vm, read_request);
                }
                ReadableStreamController::ReadableByteStreamController(controller) => {
                    ReadableByteStreamController::pull_steps(controller, &reader.generic.context(vm), read_request);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#abstract-opdef-readablestreamdefaultreaderrelease
pub(crate) fn readable_stream_default_reader_release(vm: &Vm, reader: Ref<ReadableStreamDefaultReader>) {
    let realm = reader.generic.closed_promise_realm();

    // 1. Perform ! ReadableStreamReaderGenericRelease(reader).
    readable_stream_reader_generic_release(vm, ReadableStreamReader::ReadableStreamDefaultReader(reader));

    // 2. Let e be a new TypeError exception.
    let exception = exception_value(vm, realm, Exception::type_error("Reader has been released"));

    // 3. Perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultReaderErrorReadRequests(reader, e).
    readable_stream_default_reader_error_read_requests(vm, reader, exception);
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#set-up-readable-stream-default-reader
pub(crate) fn set_up_readable_stream_default_reader(
    cx: &CallContext,
    reader: Ref<ReadableStreamDefaultReader>,
    stream: Ref<ReadableStream>,
) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    // 1. If ! IsReadableStreamLocked(stream) is true, throw a TypeError exception.
    if is_readable_stream_locked(stream) {
        return Err(Exception::type_error("Cannot create stream reader for a locked stream"));
    }

    // 2. Perform ! ReadableStreamReaderGenericInitialize(reader, stream).
    readable_stream_reader_generic_initialize(cx, ReadableStreamReader::ReadableStreamDefaultReader(reader), stream);

    // 3. Set reader.[[readRequests]] to a new empty list.
    reader.read_requests.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).clear();
    Ok(())
}

//! ReadableStreamGenericReader, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#generic-reader-mixin, and the abstract operations of
//! readers, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#rs-reader-abstract-ops

use core::cell::Cell;

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::interface::Ref;
use crate::bindings::promise::{
    WebIdlPromise, create_promise, create_rejected_promise, create_rejected_promise_from_exception,
    create_resolved_promise, exception_value, mark_promise_as_handled, promise_realm, reject_promise,
};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::streams::readable_byte_stream_controller::ReadableByteStreamController;
use crate::streams::readable_stream::{
    ReadableStream, ReadableStreamReader, ReadableStreamState, readable_stream_cancel,
};
use crate::streams::readable_stream_default_controller::ReadableStreamDefaultController;
use crate::streams::underlying_source::ReadableStreamController;

/// What a ReadableStreamDefaultReader and a ReadableStreamBYOBReader both are,
/// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamgenericreader
#[derive(Default, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ReadableStreamGenericReader {
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamgenericreader-closedpromise
    closed_promise: Cell<Option<WebIdlPromise>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readablestreamgenericreader-stream
    stream: Cell<Option<Ref<ReadableStream>>>,
}

impl ReadableStreamGenericReader {
    pub(crate) fn closed_promise(&self) -> Option<WebIdlPromise> {
        self.closed_promise.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_closed_promise(&self, promise: WebIdlPromise) {
        self.closed_promise.set(Some(promise));
    }

    pub(crate) fn stream(&self) -> Option<Ref<ReadableStream>> {
        self.stream.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_stream(&self, stream: Option<Ref<ReadableStream>>) {
        self.stream.set(stream);
    }

    /// The realm of the reader's [[closedPromise]], which the promises and the exceptions of the reader are created
    /// in, as LibWeb's C++ creates them.
    pub(crate) fn closed_promise_realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        promise_realm(
            self.closed_promise()
                .expect("a reader that is set up has a closed promise"),
        )
    }

    /// The context of the realm of the reader's [[closedPromise]].
    pub(crate) fn context<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> CallContext<'vm> {
        CallContext::new(vm, self.closed_promise_realm())
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#generic-reader-closed
    pub(crate) fn closed(&self) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        // 1. Return this.[[closedPromise]].
        Ok(self
            .closed_promise()
            .expect("a reader that is set up has a closed promise"))
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#generic-reader-cancel
    pub(crate) fn cancel(vm: &Vm, reader: ReadableStreamReader, reason: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlPromise {
        // 1. If this.[[stream]] is undefined, return a promise rejected with a TypeError exception.
        if reader.generic().stream().is_none() {
            let exception = Exception::type_error("No stream present to cancel");
            let realm = reader.generic().closed_promise_realm();
            return create_rejected_promise_from_exception(vm, realm, exception);
        }

        // 2. Return ! ReadableStreamReaderGenericCancel(this, reason).
        readable_stream_reader_generic_cancel(vm, reader, reason.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED))
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readable-stream-reader-generic-cancel
pub(crate) fn readable_stream_reader_generic_cancel(
    vm: &Vm,
    reader: ReadableStreamReader,
    reason: Value,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    // 1. Let stream be reader.[[stream]].
    // 2. Assert: stream is not undefined.
    let stream = reader.generic().stream().expect("a reader that cancels has a stream");

    // 3. Return ! ReadableStreamCancel(stream, reason).
    readable_stream_cancel(&reader.generic().context(vm), stream, reason)
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readable-stream-reader-generic-initialize
pub(crate) fn readable_stream_reader_generic_initialize(
    cx: &CallContext,
    reader: ReadableStreamReader,
    stream: Ref<ReadableStream>,
) {
    let vm = cx.vm();
    let generic = reader.generic();

    // 1. Set reader.[[stream]] to stream.
    generic.set_stream(Some(stream));

    // 2. Set stream.[[reader]] to reader.
    stream.set_reader(Some(reader));

    match stream.state() {
        // 3. If stream.[[state]] is "readable",
        ReadableStreamState::Readable => {
            // 1. Set reader.[[closedPromise]] to a new promise.
            generic.set_closed_promise(create_promise(vm, cx.realm()));
        }
        // 4. Otherwise, if stream.[[state]] is "closed",
        ReadableStreamState::Closed => {
            // 1. Set reader.[[closedPromise]] to a promise resolved with undefined.
            generic.set_closed_promise(create_resolved_promise(vm, cx.realm(), Value::UNDEFINED));
        }
        // 5. Otherwise,
        ReadableStreamState::Errored => {
            // 1. Assert: stream.[[state]] is "errored".
            // 2. Set reader.[[closedPromise]] to a promise rejected with stream.[[storedError]].
            let closed_promise = create_rejected_promise(vm, cx.realm(), stream.stored_error());
            generic.set_closed_promise(closed_promise);

            // 3. Set reader.[[closedPromise]].[[PromiseIsHandled]] to true.
            mark_promise_as_handled(vm, closed_promise);
        }
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readable-stream-reader-generic-release
pub(crate) fn readable_stream_reader_generic_release(vm: &Vm, reader: ReadableStreamReader) {
    let generic = reader.generic();

    // 1. Let stream be reader.[[stream]].
    // 2. Assert: stream is not undefined.
    let stream = generic.stream().expect("a reader that is released has a stream");

    // 3. Assert: stream.[[reader]] is reader.
    assert!(stream.reader() == Some(reader));

    let realm = generic.closed_promise_realm();
    let exception = exception_value(vm, realm, Exception::type_error("Reader has been released"));

    // 4. If stream.[[state]] is "readable", reject reader.[[closedPromise]] with a TypeError exception.
    if stream.state() == ReadableStreamState::Readable {
        reject_promise(
            vm,
            generic
                .closed_promise()
                .expect("a reader of a stream has a closed promise"),
            exception,
        );
    }
    // 5. Otherwise, set reader.[[closedPromise]] to a promise rejected with a TypeError exception.
    else {
        generic.set_closed_promise(create_rejected_promise(vm, realm, exception));
    }

    // 6. Set reader.[[closedPromise]].[[PromiseIsHandled]] to true.
    mark_promise_as_handled(
        vm,
        generic
            .closed_promise()
            .expect("a reader of a stream has a closed promise"),
    );

    // 7. Perform ! stream.[[controller]].[[ReleaseSteps]]().
    match stream.controller().expect("a stream that is set up has a controller") {
        ReadableStreamController::ReadableStreamDefaultController(controller) => {
            ReadableStreamDefaultController::release_steps(controller);
        }
        ReadableStreamController::ReadableByteStreamController(controller) => {
            ReadableByteStreamController::release_steps(vm, controller);
        }
    }

    // 8. Set stream.[[reader]] to undefined.
    stream.set_reader(None);

    // 9. Set reader.[[stream]] to undefined.
    generic.set_stream(None);
}

//! ReadableStreamPipeTo, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readable-stream-pipe-to, whose reading of chunks from its
//! source and writing them to its destination in parallel happens in the state of the pipe.

use std::collections::VecDeque;

use core::cell::Cell;

use libjs_rust::api::{
    EmbedderCell, EmbedderClass, EmbedderValue, Gc, GcRefCell, MarkedVec, NativeFunction, PropertyKey, Trace, Value, Vm,
};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks};
use crate::bindings::promise::{
    ReactionSteps, WebIdlPromise, create_promise, create_resolved_promise, exception_value,
    get_promise_for_wait_for_all, is_promise_fulfilled, mark_promise_as_handled, promise_realm, queue_a_microtask,
    react_to_promise, reject_promise, resolve_promise,
};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, MustNotThrow, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::abort_signal::{AbortAlgorithm, AbortSignal};
use crate::streams::read_request::ReadRequest;
use crate::streams::readable_stream::{
    ReadableStream, ReadableStreamState, acquire_readable_stream_default_reader, is_readable_stream_locked,
    readable_stream_cancel,
};
use crate::streams::readable_stream_default_reader::{
    ReadableStreamDefaultReader, readable_stream_default_reader_read, readable_stream_default_reader_release,
};
use crate::streams::writable_stream::{
    WritableStream, WritableStreamState, acquire_writable_stream_default_writer, is_writable_stream_locked,
    writable_stream_abort, writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight,
};
use crate::streams::writable_stream_default_writer::{
    WritableStreamDefaultWriter, writable_stream_default_writer_close_with_error_propagation,
    writable_stream_default_writer_release, writable_stream_default_writer_write,
};

/// The action that the pipe shuts down with, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#rs-pipeTo-shutdown-with-action
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
enum ShutdownAction {
    /// ! WritableStreamAbort(dest, source.[[storedError]])
    AbortDestination,
    /// ! ReadableStreamCancel(source, dest.[[storedError]])
    CancelSourceWithDestinationError,
    /// ! ReadableStreamCancel(source, destClosed)
    CancelSource(Value),
    /// ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterCloseWithErrorPropagation(writer)
    CloseDestination,
    /// Getting a promise to wait for all of the actions of the abortAlgorithm, given the signal's abort reason.
    AbortAlgorithm(Value),
}

/// What shutting down the pipe does once every chunk that has been read has been written.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
enum ShutdownSteps {
    /// The steps of shutting down with an action, passing along originalError if it was given.
    WithAction {
        action: ShutdownAction,
        original_error: Option<Value>,
    },
    /// The steps of shutting down, passing along error if it was given.
    WithoutAction { error: Option<Value> },
}

/// The state of a pipe, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ref-for-in-parallel
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct PipeTo {
    promise: WebIdlPromise,
    source: Ref<ReadableStream>,
    destination: Ref<WritableStream>,
    reader: Ref<ReadableStreamDefaultReader>,
    writer: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultWriter>,
    signal: GcRefCell<Option<Ref<AbortSignal>>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    signal_algorithm_id: Cell<Option<u64>>,
    last_write_promise: Cell<Option<WebIdlPromise>>,
    unwritten_chunks: GcRefCell<VecDeque<Value>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    prevent_close: bool,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    prevent_abort: bool,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    prevent_cancel: bool,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readable-stream-pipe-to: shuttingDown
    shutting_down: Cell<bool>,
}

static PIPE_TO_CLASS: EmbedderClass<PipeTo> = EmbedderClass::new("ReadableStreamPipeTo");

impl EmbedderValue for PipeTo {
    const CLASS: &'static EmbedderClass<Self> = &PIPE_TO_CLASS;
}

pub(crate) type PipeToRef = Gc<EmbedderCell<PipeTo>>;

impl PipeTo {
    /// The context of the realm of promise.
    fn context<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> CallContext<'vm> {
        CallContext::new(vm, promise_realm(self.promise))
    }

    /// The reaction to the reader's and the writer's closed promises and to the rejection of the writer's ready
    /// promise, which checks whether the pipe has to shut down.
    fn on_shutdown(cx: &CallContext, this: PipeToRef, _: Value) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        Self::check_for_error_and_close_states(this, cx.vm());
        Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
    }

    fn process(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) {
        if Self::check_for_error_and_close_states(this, vm) {
            return;
        }

        let ready_promise = this.writer.ready_promise();

        if let Some(ready_promise) = ready_promise
            && is_promise_fulfilled(ready_promise)
        {
            Self::read_chunk(this, vm);
            return;
        }

        if let Some(ready_promise) = ready_promise {
            react_to_promise(
                vm,
                ready_promise,
                this,
                Some(|cx, this, _| {
                    Self::read_chunk(this, cx.vm());
                    Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
                }),
                Some(Self::on_shutdown),
            );
        }
    }

    // abortAlgorithm
    fn abort_algorithm(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm, signal: &AbortSignal) {
        with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(promise_realm(this.promise), || {
            // 1. Let error be signal’s abort reason.
            let error = signal.reason();

            // 5. Shutdown with an action consisting of getting a promise to wait for all of the actions in actions,
            //    and with error.
            Self::shutdown_with_action(this, vm, ShutdownAction::AbortAlgorithm(error), Some(error));
        });
    }

    /// Performs the action that the pipe shuts down with.
    fn perform_action(this: PipeToRef, cx: &CallContext, action: ShutdownAction) -> WebIdlPromise {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        match action {
            ShutdownAction::AbortDestination => writable_stream_abort(cx, this.destination, this.source.stored_error()),
            ShutdownAction::CancelSourceWithDestinationError => {
                readable_stream_cancel(cx, this.source, this.destination.stored_error())
            }
            ShutdownAction::CancelSource(error) => readable_stream_cancel(cx, this.source, error),
            ShutdownAction::CloseDestination => {
                writable_stream_default_writer_close_with_error_propagation(vm, this.writer)
            }
            ShutdownAction::AbortAlgorithm(error) => {
                // 2. Let actions be an empty ordered set.
                let actions = MarkedVec::new(vm);

                // 3. If preventAbort is false, append the following action to actions:
                if !this.prevent_abort {
                    // 1. If dest.[[state]] is "writable", return ! WritableStreamAbort(dest, error).
                    if this.destination.state() == WritableStreamState::Writable {
                        actions.push(writable_stream_abort(cx, this.destination, error));
                    }
                    // 2. Otherwise, return a promise resolved with undefined.
                    else {
                        actions.push(create_resolved_promise(vm, cx.realm(), Value::UNDEFINED));
                    }
                }

                // 4. If preventCancel is false, append the following action action to actions:
                if !this.prevent_cancel {
                    // 1. If source.[[state]] is "readable", return ! ReadableStreamCancel(source, error).
                    if this.source.state() == ReadableStreamState::Readable {
                        actions.push(readable_stream_cancel(cx, this.source, error));
                    }
                    // 2. Otherwise, return a promise resolved with undefined.
                    else {
                        actions.push(create_resolved_promise(vm, cx.realm(), Value::UNDEFINED));
                    }
                }

                get_promise_for_wait_for_all(vm, cx.realm(), &actions.to_vec())
            }
        }
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#rs-pipeTo-shutdown-with-action
    fn shutdown_with_action(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm, action: ShutdownAction, original_error: Option<Value>) {
        // 1. If shuttingDown is true, abort these substeps.
        if this.shutting_down.get() {
            return;
        }

        // 2. Set shuttingDown to true.
        this.shutting_down.set(true);

        let steps = ShutdownSteps::WithAction { action, original_error };

        // 3. If dest.[[state]] is "writable" and ! WritableStreamCloseQueuedOrInFlight(dest) is false,
        if this.destination.state() == WritableStreamState::Writable
            && !writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight(this.destination)
        {
            // 1. If any chunks have been read but not yet written, write them to dest.
            Self::write_unwritten_chunks(this, vm);

            // 2. Wait until every chunk that has been read has been written (i.e. the corresponding promises have
            //    settled).
            Self::wait_for_pending_writes_to_complete(this, vm, steps);
        } else {
            Self::on_pending_writes_complete(this, vm, steps);
        }
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#rs-pipeTo-shutdown
    fn shutdown(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm, error: Option<Value>) {
        // 1. If shuttingDown is true, abort these substeps.
        if this.shutting_down.get() {
            return;
        }

        // 2. Set shuttingDown to true.
        this.shutting_down.set(true);

        let steps = ShutdownSteps::WithoutAction { error };

        // 3. If dest.[[state]] is "writable" and ! WritableStreamCloseQueuedOrInFlight(dest) is false,
        if this.destination.state() == WritableStreamState::Writable
            && !writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight(this.destination)
        {
            // 1. If any chunks have been read but not yet written, write them to dest.
            Self::write_unwritten_chunks(this, vm);

            // 2. Wait until every chunk that has been read has been written (i.e. the corresponding promises have
            //    settled).
            Self::wait_for_pending_writes_to_complete(this, vm, steps);
        } else {
            Self::on_pending_writes_complete(this, vm, steps);
        }
    }

    /// The steps of shutting down that follow waiting until every chunk that has been read has been written.
    fn on_pending_writes_complete(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm, steps: ShutdownSteps) {
        with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(promise_realm(this.promise), || match steps {
            ShutdownSteps::WithAction { action, original_error } => {
                // 4. Let p be the result of performing action.
                let promise = Self::perform_action(this, &this.context(vm), action);

                react_to_promise(
                    vm,
                    promise,
                    (this, original_error),
                    // 5. Upon fulfillment of p, finalize, passing along originalError if it was given.
                    Some(|cx, (this, original_error), _| {
                        Self::finish(this, cx.vm(), original_error);
                        Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
                    }),
                    // 6. Upon rejection of p with reason newError, finalize with newError.
                    Some(|cx, (this, _), new_error| {
                        Self::finish(this, cx.vm(), Some(new_error));
                        Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
                    }),
                );
            }
            ShutdownSteps::WithoutAction { error } => {
                // 4. Finalize, passing along error if it was given.
                Self::finish(this, vm, error);
            }
        });
    }

    fn read_chunk(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) {
        // Shutdown must stop activity: if shuttingDown becomes true, the user agent must not initiate further reads
        // from reader, and must only perform writes of already-read chunks, as described below. In particular, the
        // user agent must check the below conditions before performing any reads or writes, since they might lead to
        // immediate shutdown.
        if Self::check_for_error_and_close_states(this, vm) {
            return;
        }

        let read_request = ReadRequest::PipeTo(this);
        readable_stream_default_reader_read(vm, this.reader, read_request);
    }

    // chunk steps, given chunk, of the read request of the pipe
    pub(crate) fn read_request_chunk_steps(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm, chunk: Value) {
        this.unwritten_chunks.borrow_mut(vm).push_back(chunk);

        if Self::check_for_error_and_close_states(this, vm) {
            return;
        }

        queue_a_microtask(vm, promise_realm(this.promise), this, |vm, this| {
            with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(promise_realm(this.promise), || {
                Self::write_chunk(this, vm);
                Self::process(this, vm);
            });
        });
    }

    // close steps, of the read request of the pipe
    pub(crate) fn read_request_close_steps(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) {
        if !Self::check_for_error_and_close_states(this, vm) {
            Self::finish(this, vm, None);
        }
    }

    // error steps, of the read request of the pipe
    pub(crate) fn read_request_error_steps(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm, _: Value) {
        Self::check_for_error_and_close_states(this, vm);
    }

    fn write_chunk(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) {
        // Shutdown must stop activity: if shuttingDown becomes true, the user agent must not initiate further reads
        // from reader, and must only perform writes of already-read chunks, as described below. In particular, the
        // user agent must check the below conditions before performing any reads or writes, since they might lead to
        // immediate shutdown.
        if !this.shutting_down.get() && Self::check_for_error_and_close_states(this, vm) {
            return;
        }

        // NB: Shutdown writes every unwritten chunk, which can run before the write that a read queued.
        let Some(chunk) = this.unwritten_chunks.borrow_mut(vm).pop_front() else {
            return;
        };
        let promise = writable_stream_default_writer_write(vm, this.writer, chunk);
        mark_promise_as_handled(vm, promise);

        this.last_write_promise.set(Some(promise));
    }

    fn write_unwritten_chunks(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) {
        while !this.unwritten_chunks.borrow().is_empty() {
            Self::write_chunk(this, vm);
        }
    }

    fn wait_for_pending_writes_to_complete(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm, steps: ShutdownSteps) {
        let Some(last_write_promise) = this.last_write_promise.take() else {
            queue_a_microtask(vm, promise_realm(this.promise), (this, steps), |vm, (this, steps)| {
                Self::on_pending_writes_complete(this, vm, steps);
            });
            return;
        };

        let run_complete_steps: ReactionSteps<(PipeToRef, ShutdownSteps)> = |cx, (this, steps), _| {
            Self::on_pending_writes_complete(this, cx.vm(), steps);
            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        };
        react_to_promise(
            vm,
            last_write_promise,
            (this, steps),
            Some(run_complete_steps),
            Some(run_complete_steps),
        );
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#rs-pipeTo-finalize
    fn finish(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm, error: Option<Value>) {
        // 1. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterRelease(writer).
        writable_stream_default_writer_release(vm, this.writer);

        // 2. If reader implements ReadableStreamBYOBReader, perform ! ReadableStreamBYOBReaderRelease(reader).
        // 3. Otherwise, perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultReaderRelease(reader).
        readable_stream_default_reader_release(vm, this.reader);

        // 4. If signal is not undefined, remove abortAlgorithm from signal.
        let signal = *this.signal.borrow();
        if let Some(signal) = signal {
            signal.remove_abort_algorithm(
                vm,
                this.signal_algorithm_id
                    .get()
                    .expect("an abort algorithm was added to the signal"),
            );
        }

        match error {
            // 5. If error was given, reject promise with error.
            Some(error) => reject_promise(vm, this.promise, error),
            // 6. Otherwise, resolve promise with undefined.
            None => resolve_promise(vm, this.promise, Value::UNDEFINED),
        }

        this.reader.set_pipe_to(None);
    }

    fn check_for_error_and_close_states(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) -> bool {
        // Error and close states must be propagated: the following conditions must be applied in order.
        this.shutting_down.get()
            || Self::check_for_forward_errors(this, vm)
            || Self::check_for_backward_errors(this, vm)
            || Self::check_for_forward_close(this, vm)
            || Self::check_for_backward_close(this, vm)
    }

    fn check_for_forward_errors(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) -> bool {
        // 1. Errors must be propagated forward: if source.[[state]] is or becomes "errored", then
        if this.source.state() == ReadableStreamState::Errored {
            // 1. If preventAbort is false, shutdown with an action of ! WritableStreamAbort(dest,
            //    source.[[storedError]]) and with source.[[storedError]].
            if !this.prevent_abort {
                Self::shutdown_with_action(
                    this,
                    vm,
                    ShutdownAction::AbortDestination,
                    Some(this.source.stored_error()),
                );
            }
            // 2. Otherwise, shutdown with source.[[storedError]].
            else {
                Self::shutdown(this, vm, Some(this.source.stored_error()));
            }
        }

        this.shutting_down.get()
    }

    fn check_for_backward_errors(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) -> bool {
        // 2. Errors must be propagated backward: if dest.[[state]] is or becomes "errored", then
        if this.destination.state() == WritableStreamState::Errored {
            // 1. If preventCancel is false, shutdown with an action of ! ReadableStreamCancel(source,
            //    dest.[[storedError]]) and with dest.[[storedError]].
            if !this.prevent_cancel {
                Self::shutdown_with_action(
                    this,
                    vm,
                    ShutdownAction::CancelSourceWithDestinationError,
                    Some(this.destination.stored_error()),
                );
            }
            // 2. Otherwise, shutdown with dest.[[storedError]].
            else {
                Self::shutdown(this, vm, Some(this.destination.stored_error()));
            }
        }

        this.shutting_down.get()
    }

    fn check_for_forward_close(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) -> bool {
        // 3. Closing must be propagated forward: if source.[[state]] is or becomes "closed", then
        if this.source.state() == ReadableStreamState::Closed {
            // 1. If preventClose is false, shutdown with an action of
            //    ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterCloseWithErrorPropagation(writer).
            if !this.prevent_close {
                Self::shutdown_with_action(this, vm, ShutdownAction::CloseDestination, None);
            }
            // 2. Otherwise, shutdown.
            else {
                Self::shutdown(this, vm, None);
            }
        }

        this.shutting_down.get()
    }

    fn check_for_backward_close(this: PipeToRef, vm: &Vm) -> bool {
        // 4. Closing must be propagated backward: if ! WritableStreamCloseQueuedOrInFlight(dest) is true or
        //    dest.[[state]] is "closed", then
        if writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight(this.destination)
            || this.destination.state() == WritableStreamState::Closed
        {
            // 1. Assert: no chunks have been read or written.

            // 2. Let destClosed be a new TypeError.
            let destination_closed = exception_value(
                vm,
                promise_realm(this.promise),
                Exception::type_error("Destination stream was closed during piping operation"),
            );

            // 3. If preventCancel is false, shutdown with an action of ! ReadableStreamCancel(source, destClosed)
            //    and with destClosed.
            if !this.prevent_cancel {
                Self::shutdown_with_action(
                    this,
                    vm,
                    ShutdownAction::CancelSource(destination_closed),
                    Some(destination_closed),
                );
            }
            // 4. Otherwise, shutdown with destClosed.
            else {
                Self::shutdown(this, vm, Some(destination_closed));
            }
        }

        this.shutting_down.get()
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readable-stream-pipe-to
pub(crate) fn readable_stream_pipe_to(
    cx: &CallContext,
    source: Ref<ReadableStream>,
    destination: Ref<WritableStream>,
    prevent_close: bool,
    prevent_abort: bool,
    prevent_cancel: bool,
    signal: Option<Ref<AbortSignal>>,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    let vm = cx.vm();

    // 1. Assert: source implements ReadableStream.
    // 2. Assert: dest implements WritableStream.
    // 3. Assert: preventClose, preventAbort, and preventCancel are all booleans.

    // 4. If signal was not given, let signal be undefined.
    // 5. Assert: either signal is undefined, or signal implements AbortSignal.

    // 6. Assert: ! IsReadableStreamLocked(source) is false.
    assert!(!is_readable_stream_locked(source));

    // 7. Assert: ! IsWritableStreamLocked(dest) is false.
    assert!(!is_writable_stream_locked(destination));

    // 8. If source.[[controller]] implements ReadableByteStreamController, let reader be either
    //    ! AcquireReadableStreamBYOBReader(source) or ! AcquireReadableStreamDefaultReader(source), at the user
    //    agent’s discretion.
    // 9. Otherwise, let reader be ! AcquireReadableStreamDefaultReader(source).
    let reader = acquire_readable_stream_default_reader(cx, source).must();

    // 10. Let writer be ! AcquireWritableStreamDefaultWriter(dest).
    let writer = acquire_writable_stream_default_writer(cx, destination).must();

    // 11. Set source.[[disturbed]] to true.
    source.set_disturbed(true);

    // 12. Let shuttingDown be false.
    // NOTE: This is internal to the state of the pipe.

    // 13. Let promise be a new promise.
    let promise = create_promise(vm, cx.realm());

    let this = PIPE_TO_CLASS.allocate(vm, |_| PipeTo {
        promise,
        source,
        destination,
        reader,
        writer,
        signal: GcRefCell::new(None),
        signal_algorithm_id: Cell::new(None),
        last_write_promise: Cell::new(None),
        unwritten_chunks: GcRefCell::new(VecDeque::new()),
        prevent_close,
        prevent_abort,
        prevent_cancel,
        shutting_down: Cell::new(false),
    });

    reader.set_pipe_to(Some(this));

    if let Some(reader_closed_promise) = reader.generic().closed_promise() {
        react_to_promise(
            vm,
            reader_closed_promise,
            this,
            Some(PipeTo::on_shutdown),
            Some(PipeTo::on_shutdown),
        );
    }
    if let Some(writer_closed_promise) = writer.closed_promise() {
        react_to_promise(
            vm,
            writer_closed_promise,
            this,
            Some(PipeTo::on_shutdown),
            Some(PipeTo::on_shutdown),
        );
    }

    // 14. If signal is not undefined,
    if let Some(signal) = signal {
        // 1. Let abortAlgorithm be the following steps:

        // 2. If signal is aborted, perform abortAlgorithm and return promise.
        if signal.aborted() {
            PipeTo::abort_algorithm(this, vm, &signal);
            return promise;
        }

        // 3. Add abortAlgorithm to signal.
        let abort_algorithm = NativeFunction::create(
            vm,
            (this, signal),
            |vm: &Vm, (this, signal): &(PipeToRef, Ref<AbortSignal>)| {
                PipeTo::abort_algorithm(*this, vm, signal);
                Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
            },
            0,
            &PropertyKey::from_utf8(""),
            Some(cx.realm()),
            None,
            None,
        );
        let signal_id = signal
            .add_abort_algorithm(vm, AbortAlgorithm::Rust(abort_algorithm))
            .expect("a signal that is not aborted takes algorithms");
        *this.signal.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(signal);
        this.signal_algorithm_id.set(Some(signal_id));
    }

    // 15. In parallel (but not really; see #905), using reader and writer, read all chunks from source and write them
    //     to dest. Due to the locking provided by the reader and writer, the exact manner in which this happens is not
    //     observable to author code, and so there is flexibility in how this is done. The following constraints apply
    //     regardless of the exact algorithm used:
    PipeTo::process(this, vm);

    // 16. Return promise.
    promise
}

//! ReadableStreamTee, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#readable-stream-tee, and the state that the algorithms and read
//! requests of a tee share.

use core::cell::Cell;

use libjs_rust::api::{EmbedderCell, EmbedderClass, EmbedderValue, Gc, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::conversions::{ArrayBufferView, BufferSource, buffer_source_type_of};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks};
use crate::bindings::promise::{
    WebIdlPromise, create_promise, create_resolved_promise, exception_value, promise_realm, queue_a_microtask,
    resolve_promise, upon_rejection,
};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, MustNotThrow, WebIdlResult};
use crate::streams::abstract_operations::{clone_as_uint8_array, structured_clone};
use crate::streams::algorithms::{CancelAlgorithm, PullAlgorithm, StartAlgorithm};
use crate::streams::read_request::{ReadIntoRequest, ReadRequest};
use crate::streams::readable_byte_stream_controller::{
    ReadableByteStreamController, readable_byte_stream_controller_close, readable_byte_stream_controller_enqueue,
    readable_byte_stream_controller_error, readable_byte_stream_controller_get_byob_request,
    readable_byte_stream_controller_respond, readable_byte_stream_controller_respond_with_new_view,
};
use crate::streams::readable_stream::{
    ReadableStream, ReadableStreamReader, acquire_readable_stream_byob_reader, acquire_readable_stream_default_reader,
    create_array_from_list, create_readable_byte_stream, create_readable_stream, readable_stream_cancel,
};
use crate::streams::readable_stream_byob_reader::{
    readable_stream_byob_reader_read, readable_stream_byob_reader_release,
};

    readable_stream_default_controller_enqueue, readable_stream_default_controller_error,

    ReadableStreamDefaultReader, readable_stream_default_reader_read, readable_stream_default_reader_release,
};
