// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct TransformStream {
    /// The realm of the stream, which its promises and the results of its operations are created in.
    realm: Cell<Gc<Realm>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-backpressure
    #[gc(untraced)]
    backpressure: Cell<Option<bool>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-backpressurechangepromise
    backpressure_change_promise: Cell<Option<WebIdlPromise>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-controller
    controller: Cell<Option<Ref<TransformStreamDefaultController>>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-detached
    detached: Cell<bool>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-readable
    readable: Cell<Option<Ref<ReadableStream>>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-writable
    writable: Cell<Option<Ref<WritableStream>>>,
}

impl Wrappable for TransformStream {}

impl TransformStream {
    pub(crate) fn new(realm: Gc<Realm>) -> Self {
        Self {
            realm: Cell::new(realm),
            backpressure: Cell::new(Some(false)),
            backpressure_change_promise: Cell::new(None),
            controller: Cell::new(None),
            detached: Cell::new(false),
            readable: Cell::new(None),
            writable: Cell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        self.realm.get()
    }

    /// The context of the realm of the stream.
    pub(crate) fn context<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> CallContext<'vm> {
        CallContext::new(vm, self.realm())
    }

    /// The stream's [[readable]], which it has once it is initialized.
    pub(crate) fn readable_stream(&self) -> Ref<ReadableStream> {
        self.readable
            .get()
            .expect("a transform stream that is initialized has a readable stream")
    }

    /// The stream's [[writable]], which it has once it is initialized.
    pub(crate) fn writable_stream(&self) -> Ref<WritableStream> {
        self.writable
            .get()
            .expect("a transform stream that is initialized has a writable stream")
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_readable(&self, readable: Option<Ref<ReadableStream>>) {
        self.readable.set(readable);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_writable(&self, writable: Option<Ref<WritableStream>>) {
        self.writable.set(writable);
    }

    pub(crate) fn controller(&self) -> Option<Ref<TransformStreamDefaultController>> {
        self.controller.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_controller(&self, controller: Option<Ref<TransformStreamDefaultController>>) {
        self.controller.set(controller);
    }

    pub(crate) fn backpressure(&self) -> Option<bool> {
        self.backpressure.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_backpressure(&self, backpressure: Option<bool>) {
        self.backpressure.set(backpressure);
    }

    pub(crate) fn backpressure_change_promise(&self) -> Option<WebIdlPromise> {
        self.backpressure_change_promise.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_backpressure_change_promise(&self, promise: Option<WebIdlPromise>) {
        self.backpressure_change_promise.set(promise);
    }

    /// The realm of the stream's [[backpressureChangePromise]].
    pub(crate) fn backpressure_change_promise_realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        promise_realm(
            self.backpressure_change_promise()
                .expect("the stream has a backpressure change promise"),
        )
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ts-constructor
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        transformer: Option<Gc<Object>>,
        writable_strategy: QueuingStrategy,
        readable_strategy: QueuingStrategy,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let this = allocate(cx.vm(), |_| Self::new(cx.realm()));

        // 1. If transformer is missing, set it to null.
        let transformer = transformer.map_or(Value::NULL, Value::from_object);

        // 2. Let transformerDict be transformer, converted to an IDL value of type Transformer.
        let transformer_dict = Transformer::from_js(cx.vm(), transformer)?;

        // 3. If transformerDict["readableType"] exists, throw a RangeError exception.
        if transformer_dict.readable_type.is_some() {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("Invalid use of reserved key 'readableType'"));
        }

        // 4. If transformerDict["writableType"] exists, throw a RangeError exception.
        if transformer_dict.writable_type.is_some() {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("Invalid use of reserved key 'writableType'"));
        }

        // 5. Let readableHighWaterMark be ? ExtractHighWaterMark(readableStrategy, 0).
        let readable_high_water_mark = extract_high_water_mark(&readable_strategy, 0.0)?;

        // 6. Let readableSizeAlgorithm be ! ExtractSizeAlgorithm(readableStrategy).
        let readable_size_algorithm = extract_size_algorithm(&readable_strategy);

        // 7. Let writableHighWaterMark be ? ExtractHighWaterMark(writableStrategy, 1).
        let writable_high_water_mark = extract_high_water_mark(&writable_strategy, 1.0)?;

        // 8. Let writableSizeAlgorithm be ! ExtractSizeAlgorithm(writableStrategy).
        let writable_size_algorithm = extract_size_algorithm(&writable_strategy);

        // 9. Let startPromise be a new promise.
        let start_promise = create_promise(cx.vm(), cx.realm());

        // 10. Perform ! InitializeTransformStream(this, startPromise, writableHighWaterMark, writableSizeAlgorithm,
        //     readableHighWaterMark, readableSizeAlgorithm).
        initialize_transform_stream(
            cx,
            this,
            start_promise,
            writable_high_water_mark,
            writable_size_algorithm,
            readable_high_water_mark,
            readable_size_algorithm,
        );

        // 11. Perform ? SetUpTransformStreamDefaultControllerFromTransformer(this, transformer, transformerDict).
        let start = transformer_dict.start.clone();
        set_up_transform_stream_default_controller_from_transformer(cx, this, transformer, transformer_dict);

        // 12. If transformerDict["start"] exists, then resolve startPromise with the result of invoking
        //     transformerDict["start"] with argument list « this.[[controller]] » and callback this value transformer.
        if let Some(start) = start {
            let controller = this
                .controller()
                .expect("a transform stream that is set up has a controller");
            let result = start.invoke(Some(transformer), &[Value::from_object(wrap(cx, controller))])?;
            resolve_promise(cx.vm(), start_promise, result);
        }
        // 13. Otherwise, resolve startPromise with undefined.
        else {
            resolve_promise(cx.vm(), start_promise, Value::UNDEFINED);
        }

        Ok(this)
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ts-readable
    pub(crate) fn readable(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<ReadableStream>> {
        // 1. Return this.[[readable]].
        Ok(self.readable_stream())
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ts-writable
    pub(crate) fn writable(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<WritableStream>> {
        // 1. Return this.[[writable]].
        Ok(self.writable_stream())
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-set-up
    pub(crate) fn set_up(
        this: Ref<Self>,
        cx: &CallContext,
        transform_algorithm: TransformAlgorithm,
        flush_algorithm: FlushAlgorithm,
        cancel_algorithm: CancelAlgorithm,
    ) {
        // 1. Let writableHighWaterMark be 1.
        let writable_high_water_mark = 1.0;

        // 2. Let writableSizeAlgorithm be an algorithm that returns 1.
        let writable_size_algorithm = SizeAlgorithm::ReturnsOne;

        // 3. Let readableHighWaterMark be 0.
        let readable_high_water_mark = 0.0;

        // 4. Let readableSizeAlgorithm be an algorithm that returns 1.
        let readable_size_algorithm = SizeAlgorithm::ReturnsOne;

        // 5. Let transformAlgorithmWrapper be an algorithm that runs these steps given a value chunk:
        let transform_algorithm_wrapper = transform_algorithm;

        // 6. Let flushAlgorithmWrapper be an algorithm that runs these steps:
        let flush_algorithm_wrapper = flush_algorithm;

        // 7. Let cancelAlgorithmWrapper be an algorithm that runs these steps given a value reason:
        let cancel_algorithm_wrapper = cancel_algorithm;

        // 8. Let startPromise be a promise resolved with undefined.
        let start_promise = create_resolved_promise(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), Value::UNDEFINED);

        // 9. Perform ! InitializeTransformStream(stream, startPromise, writableHighWaterMark, writableSizeAlgorithm,
        //    readableHighWaterMark, readableSizeAlgorithm).
        initialize_transform_stream(
            cx,
            this,
            start_promise,
            writable_high_water_mark,
            writable_size_algorithm,
            readable_high_water_mark,
            readable_size_algorithm,
        );

        // 10. Let controller be a new TransformStreamDefaultController.
        let controller = allocate(cx.vm(), |_| TransformStreamDefaultController::new());

        // 11. Perform ! SetUpTransformStreamDefaultController(stream, controller, transformAlgorithmWrapper,
        //     flushAlgorithmWrapper, cancelAlgorithmWrapper).
        set_up_transform_stream_default_controller(
            this,
            controller,
            transform_algorithm_wrapper,
            flush_algorithm_wrapper,
            cancel_algorithm_wrapper,
        );
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transformstream-enqueue
    pub(crate) fn enqueue(this: Ref<Self>, vm: &Vm, chunk: Value) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // To enqueue the JavaScript value chunk into a TransformStream stream, perform
        // ! TransformStreamDefaultControllerEnqueue(stream.[[controller]], chunk).
        // AD-HOC: This can throw: a chunk looks up "then" on the read result, and script there can cancel the readable
        //         side before the next chunk of the same transform.
        let controller = this
            .controller()
            .expect("a transform stream that is set up has a controller");
        transform_stream_default_controller_enqueue(
            &CallContext::new(vm, this.backpressure_change_promise_realm()),
            controller,
            chunk,
        )
    }
}

impl Transferable for TransformStream {
    fn detached(&self) -> &Cell<bool> {
        &self.detached
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ref-for-transfer-steps②
    fn transfer_steps(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        data_holder: &mut TransferDataWriter,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Let readable be value.[[readable]].
        let readable = this.readable_stream();

        // 2. Let writable be value.[[writable]].
        let writable = this.writable_stream();

        // 3. If ! IsReadableStreamLocked(readable) is true, throw a "DataCloneError" DOMException.
        if is_readable_stream_locked(readable) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "DataCloneError",
                ak::Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot transfer locked ReadableStream"),
            ));
        }

        // 4. If ! IsWritableStreamLocked(writable) is true, throw a "DataCloneError" DOMException.
        if is_writable_stream_locked(writable) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "DataCloneError",
                ak::Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot transfer locked WritableStream"),
            ));
        }

        // 5. Set dataHolder.[[readable]] to ! StructuredSerializeWithTransfer(readable, « readable »).
        data_holder
            .write_transferred_value(cx, Value::from_object(wrap(cx, readable)))
            .must();

        // 6. Set dataHolder.[[writable]] to ! StructuredSerializeWithTransfer(writable, « writable »).
        data_holder
            .write_transferred_value(cx, Value::from_object(wrap(cx, writable)))
            .must();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ref-for-transfer-receiving-steps②
    fn transfer_receiving_steps(cx: &mut CallContext, data_holder: &mut TransferDataReader) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let value = allocate(cx.vm(), |_| Self::new(cx.realm()));

        // 1. Let readableRecord be ! StructuredDeserializeWithTransfer(dataHolder.[[readable]], the current Realm).
        let readable_record = data_holder.read_transferred_value(cx).must();

        // 2. Let writableRecord be ! StructuredDeserializeWithTransfer(dataHolder.[[writable]], the current Realm).
        let writable_record = data_holder.read_transferred_value(cx).must();

        // 3. Set value.[[readable]] to readableRecord.[[Deserialized]].
        assert!(readable_record.is_object());
        value.set_readable(Some(implementation_of::<ReadableStream>(readable_record.as_object())));

        // 4. Set value.[[writable]] to writableRecord.[[Deserialized]].
        assert!(writable_record.is_object());
        value.set_writable(Some(implementation_of::<WritableStream>(writable_record.as_object())));

        // 5. Set value.[[backpressure]], value.[[backpressureChangePromise]], and value.[[controller]] to undefined.
        value.set_backpressure(None);
        value.set_backpressure_change_promise(None);
        value.set_controller(None);

        Ok(value)
    }
}

/// The ReadableStreamDefaultController of the [[readable]] of a TransformStream.
pub(crate) fn readable_default_controller(readable: Ref<ReadableStream>) -> Ref<ReadableStreamDefaultController> {
    let Some(ReadableStreamController::ReadableStreamDefaultController(controller)) = readable.controller() else {
        panic!("the readable stream of a transform stream has a ReadableStreamDefaultController");
    };
    controller
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#initialize-transform-stream
pub(crate) fn initialize_transform_stream(
    cx: &CallContext,
    stream: Ref<TransformStream>,
    start_promise: WebIdlPromise,
    writable_high_water_mark: f64,
    writable_size_algorithm: SizeAlgorithm,
    readable_high_water_mark: f64,
    readable_size_algorithm: SizeAlgorithm,
) {
    // 1. Let startAlgorithm be an algorithm that returns startPromise.
    let start_algorithm = || StartAlgorithm::ReturnsPromise(start_promise);

    // 2. Let writeAlgorithm be the following steps, taking a chunk argument:
    //    1. Return ! TransformStreamDefaultSinkWriteAlgorithm(stream, chunk).
    let write_algorithm = WriteAlgorithm::TransformStream(stream);

    // 3. Let abortAlgorithm be the following steps, taking a reason argument:
    //    1. Return ! TransformStreamDefaultSinkAbortAlgorithm(stream, reason).
    let abort_algorithm = AbortAlgorithm::TransformStream(stream);

    // 4. Let closeAlgorithm be the following steps:
    //    1. Return ! TransformStreamDefaultSinkCloseAlgorithm(stream).
    let close_algorithm = CloseAlgorithm::TransformStream(stream);

    // 5. Set stream.[[writable]] to ! CreateWritableStream(startAlgorithm, writeAlgorithm, closeAlgorithm,
    //    abortAlgorithm, writableHighWaterMark, writableSizeAlgorithm).
    let writable = create_writable_stream(
        cx,
        start_algorithm(),
        write_algorithm,
        close_algorithm,
        abort_algorithm,
        writable_high_water_mark,
        writable_size_algorithm,
    )
    .must();
    stream.set_writable(Some(writable));

    // 6. Let pullAlgorithm be the following steps:
    //    1. Return ! TransformStreamDefaultSourcePullAlgorithm(stream).
    let pull_algorithm = PullAlgorithm::TransformStream(stream);

    // 7. Let cancelAlgorithm be the following steps, taking a reason argument:
    //    1. Return ! TransformStreamDefaultSourceCancelAlgorithm(stream, reason).
    let cancel_algorithm = CancelAlgorithm::TransformStream(stream);

    // 8. Set stream.[[readable]] to ! CreateReadableStream(startAlgorithm, pullAlgorithm, cancelAlgorithm,
    //    readableHighWaterMark, readableSizeAlgorithm).
    let readable = create_readable_stream(
        cx,
        start_algorithm(),
        pull_algorithm,
        cancel_algorithm,
        Some(readable_high_water_mark),
        Some(readable_size_algorithm),
    )
    .must();
    stream.set_readable(Some(readable));

    // 9. Set stream.[[backpressure]] and stream.[[backpressureChangePromise]] to undefined.
    stream.set_backpressure(None);
    stream.set_backpressure_change_promise(None);

    // 10. Perform ! TransformStreamSetBackpressure(stream, true).
    transform_stream_set_backpressure(cx, stream, true);

    // 11. Set stream.[[controller]] to undefined.
    stream.set_controller(None);
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transform-stream-error
pub(crate) fn transform_stream_error(cx: &CallContext, stream: Ref<TransformStream>, error: Value) {
    let readable_controller = readable_default_controller(stream.readable_stream());

    // 1. Perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultControllerError(stream.[[readable]].[[controller]], e).
    readable_stream_default_controller_error(cx, readable_controller, error);

    // 2. Perform ! TransformStreamErrorWritableAndUnblockWrite(stream, e).
    transform_stream_error_writable_and_unblock_write(cx, stream, error);
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transform-stream-error-writable-and-unblock-write
pub(crate) fn transform_stream_error_writable_and_unblock_write(
    cx: &CallContext,
    stream: Ref<TransformStream>,
    error: Value,
) {
    // 1. Perform ! TransformStreamDefaultControllerClearAlgorithms(stream.[[controller]]).
    transform_stream_default_controller_clear_algorithms(
        stream
            .controller()
            .expect("a transform stream that is set up has a controller"),
    );

    // 2. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerErrorIfNeeded(stream.[[writable]].[[controller]], e).
    let writable_controller = stream
        .writable_stream()
        .controller()
        .expect("a writable stream has a controller");
    writable_stream_default_controller_error_if_needed(cx, writable_controller, error);

    // 3. Perform ! TransformStreamUnblockWrite(stream).
    transform_stream_unblock_write(cx, stream);
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transform-stream-set-backpressure
pub(crate) fn transform_stream_set_backpressure(cx: &CallContext, stream: Ref<TransformStream>, backpressure: bool) {
    // 1. Assert: stream.[[backpressure]] is not backpressure.
    assert!(stream.backpressure() != Some(backpressure));

    // 2. If stream.[[backpressureChangePromise]] is not undefined, resolve stream.[[backpressureChangePromise]] with
    //    undefined.
    if let Some(backpressure_change_promise) = stream.backpressure_change_promise() {
        resolve_promise(cx.vm(), backpressure_change_promise, Value::UNDEFINED);
    }

    // 3. Set stream.[[backpressureChangePromise]] to a new promise.
    stream.set_backpressure_change_promise(Some(create_promise(cx.vm(), cx.realm())));

    // 4. Set stream.[[backpressure]] to backpressure.
    stream.set_backpressure(Some(backpressure));
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transform-stream-unblock-write
pub(crate) fn transform_stream_unblock_write(cx: &CallContext, stream: Ref<TransformStream>) {
    // 1. If stream.[[backpressure]] is true, perform ! TransformStreamSetBackpressure(stream, false).
    if stream.backpressure() == Some(true) {
        transform_stream_set_backpressure(
            &CallContext::new(cx.vm(), stream.backpressure_change_promise_realm()),
            stream,
            false,
        );
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transform-stream-default-sink-write-algorithm
pub(crate) fn transform_stream_default_sink_write_algorithm(
    cx: &CallContext,
    stream: Ref<TransformStream>,
    chunk: Value,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    // 1. Assert: stream.[[writable]].[[state]] is "writable".
    assert!(stream.writable_stream().state() == WritableStreamState::Writable);

    // 2. Let controller be stream.[[controller]].
    let controller = stream
        .controller()
        .expect("a transform stream that is set up has a controller");

    // 3. If stream.[[backpressure]] is true,
    if stream.backpressure() == Some(true) {
        // 1. Let backpressureChangePromise be stream.[[backpressureChangePromise]].
        let backpressure_change_promise = stream.backpressure_change_promise();

        // 2. Assert: backpressureChangePromise is not undefined.
        let backpressure_change_promise =
            backpressure_change_promise.expect("a stream with backpressure has a backpressure change promise");

        // 3. Return the result of reacting to backpressureChangePromise with the following fulfillment steps:
        return upon_fulfillment(
            cx.vm(),
            backpressure_change_promise,
            (stream, controller, chunk),
            |cx, (stream, controller, chunk), _| {
                // 1. Let writable be stream.[[writable]].
                let writable = stream.writable_stream();

                // 2. Let state be writable.[[state]].
                let state = writable.state();

                // 3. If state is "erroring", throw writable.[[storedError]].
                if state == WritableStreamState::Erroring {
                    return Err(Exception::Thrown(Throw::new(writable.stored_error())));
                }

                // 4. Assert: state is "writable".
                assert!(state == WritableStreamState::Writable);

                // 5. Return ! TransformStreamDefaultControllerPerformTransform(controller, chunk).
                let promise = transform_stream_default_controller_perform_transform(cx, controller, chunk);
                Ok(Value::from_object(promise.promise()))
            },
        );
    }

    // 4. Return ! TransformStreamDefaultControllerPerformTransform(controller, chunk).
    transform_stream_default_controller_perform_transform(cx, controller, chunk)
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transform-stream-default-sink-abort-algorithm
pub(crate) fn transform_stream_default_sink_abort_algorithm(
    cx: &CallContext,
    stream: Ref<TransformStream>,
    reason: Value,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    let vm = cx.vm();
    let realm = stream.backpressure_change_promise_realm();

    // 1. Let controller be stream.[[controller]].
    let controller = stream
        .controller()
        .expect("a transform stream that is set up has a controller");

    // 2. If controller.[[finishPromise]] is not undefined, return controller.[[finishPromise]].
    if let Some(finish_promise) = controller.finish_promise() {
        return finish_promise;
    }

    // 3. Let readable be stream.[[readable]].
    let readable = stream.readable_stream();

    // 4. Let controller.[[finishPromise]] be a new promise.
    controller.set_finish_promise(Some(create_promise(vm, realm)));

    // 5. Let cancelPromise be the result of performing controller.[[cancelAlgorithm]], passing reason.
    // AD-HOC: terminate() and an error clear the algorithms without setting controller.[[finishPromise]], and script can
    //         get here after that, by aborting the writable side or canceling the readable side. There is nothing left
    //         to run then.
    let cancel_promise = match controller.cancel_algorithm() {
        Some(cancel_algorithm) => cancel_algorithm.run(&stream.context(vm), reason),
        None => create_resolved_promise(vm, realm, Value::UNDEFINED),
    };

    // 6. Perform ! TransformStreamDefaultControllerClearAlgorithms(controller).
    transform_stream_default_controller_clear_algorithms(controller);

    // 7. React to cancelPromise:
    react_to_promise(
        vm,
        cancel_promise,
        (readable, controller, reason),
        // 1. If cancelPromise was fulfilled, then:
        Some(|cx, (readable, controller, reason), _| {
            let vm = cx.vm();
            let finish_promise = controller
                .finish_promise()
                .expect("the controller has a finish promise");

            // 1. If readable.[[state]] is "errored", reject controller.[[finishPromise]] with readable.[[storedError]].
            if readable.state() == ReadableStreamState::Errored {
                reject_promise(vm, finish_promise, readable.stored_error());
            }
            // 2. Otherwise:
            else {
                // 1. Perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultControllerError(readable.[[controller]], reason).
                readable_stream_default_controller_error(
                    &readable.context(vm),
                    readable_default_controller(readable),
                    reason,
                );

                // 2. Resolve controller.[[finishPromise]] with undefined.
                resolve_promise(vm, finish_promise, Value::UNDEFINED);
            }

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
        // 2. If cancelPromise was rejected with reason r, then:
        Some(|cx, (readable, controller, _), reason| {
            let vm = cx.vm();

            // 1. Perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultControllerError(readable.[[controller]], r).
            readable_stream_default_controller_error(
                &readable.context(vm),
                readable_default_controller(readable),
                reason,
            );

            // 2. Reject controller.[[finishPromise]] with r.
            let finish_promise = controller
                .finish_promise()
                .expect("the controller has a finish promise");
            reject_promise(vm, finish_promise, reason);

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
    );

    // 8. Return controller.[[finishPromise]].
    controller
        .finish_promise()
        .expect("the controller has a finish promise")
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transform-stream-default-sink-close-algorithm
pub(crate) fn transform_stream_default_sink_close_algorithm(
    cx: &CallContext,
    stream: Ref<TransformStream>,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    let vm = cx.vm();
    let realm = stream.backpressure_change_promise_realm();

    // 1. Let controller be stream.[[controller]].
    let controller = stream
        .controller()
        .expect("a transform stream that is set up has a controller");

    // 2. If controller.[[finishPromise]] is not undefined, return controller.[[finishPromise]].
    if let Some(finish_promise) = controller.finish_promise() {
        return finish_promise;
    }

    // 3. Let readable be stream.[[readable]].
    let readable = stream.readable_stream();

    // 4. Let controller.[[finishPromise]] be a new promise.
    controller.set_finish_promise(Some(create_promise(vm, realm)));

    // 5. Let flushPromise be the result of performing controller.[[flushAlgorithm]].
    // AD-HOC: As with the abort algorithm, there is nothing left to run once the algorithms are cleared.
    let flush_promise = match controller.flush_algorithm() {
        Some(flush_algorithm) => flush_algorithm.run(&stream.context(vm)),
        None => create_resolved_promise(vm, realm, Value::UNDEFINED),
    };

    // 6. Perform ! TransformStreamDefaultControllerClearAlgorithms(controller).
    transform_stream_default_controller_clear_algorithms(controller);

    // 7. React to flushPromise:
    react_to_promise(
        vm,
        flush_promise,
        (controller, readable),
        // 1. If flushPromise was fulfilled, then:
        Some(|cx, (controller, readable), _| {
            let vm = cx.vm();
            let finish_promise = controller
                .finish_promise()
                .expect("the controller has a finish promise");

            // 1. If readable.[[state]] is "errored", reject controller.[[finishPromise]] with readable.[[storedError]].
            if readable.state() == ReadableStreamState::Errored {
                reject_promise(vm, finish_promise, readable.stored_error());
            }
            // 2. Otherwise:
            else {
                // 1. Perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultControllerClose(readable.[[controller]]).
                readable_stream_default_controller_close(&readable.context(vm), readable_default_controller(readable));

                // 2. Resolve controller.[[finishPromise]] with undefined.
                resolve_promise(vm, finish_promise, Value::UNDEFINED);
            }

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
        // 2. If flushPromise was rejected with reason r, then:
        Some(|cx, (controller, readable), reason| {
            let vm = cx.vm();

            // 1. Perform ! ReadableStreamDefaultControllerError(readable.[[controller]], r).
            readable_stream_default_controller_error(
                &readable.context(vm),
                readable_default_controller(readable),
                reason,
            );

            // 2. Reject controller.[[finishPromise]] with r.
            let finish_promise = controller
                .finish_promise()
                .expect("the controller has a finish promise");
            reject_promise(vm, finish_promise, reason);

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
    );

    // 8. Return controller.[[finishPromise]].
    controller
        .finish_promise()
        .expect("the controller has a finish promise")
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transform-stream-default-source-cancel
pub(crate) fn transform_stream_default_source_cancel_algorithm(
    cx: &CallContext,
    stream: Ref<TransformStream>,
    reason: Value,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    let vm = cx.vm();
    let realm = stream.backpressure_change_promise_realm();

    // 1. Let controller be stream.[[controller]].
    let controller = stream
        .controller()
        .expect("a transform stream that is set up has a controller");

    // 2. If controller.[[finishPromise]] is not undefined, return controller.[[finishPromise]].
    if let Some(finish_promise) = controller.finish_promise() {
        return finish_promise;
    }

    // 3. Let writable be stream.[[writable]].
    let writable = stream.writable_stream();

    // 4. Let controller.[[finishPromise]] be a new promise.
    controller.set_finish_promise(Some(create_promise(vm, realm)));

    // 5. Let cancelPromise be the result of performing controller.[[cancelAlgorithm]], passing reason.
    // AD-HOC: terminate() and an error clear the algorithms without setting controller.[[finishPromise]], and script can
    //         get here after that, by aborting the writable side or canceling the readable side. There is nothing left
    //         to run then.
    let cancel_promise = match controller.cancel_algorithm() {
        Some(cancel_algorithm) => cancel_algorithm.run(&stream.context(vm), reason),
        None => create_resolved_promise(vm, realm, Value::UNDEFINED),
    };

    // 6. Perform ! TransformStreamDefaultControllerClearAlgorithms(controller).
    transform_stream_default_controller_clear_algorithms(controller);

    // 7. React to cancelPromise:
    react_to_promise(
        vm,
        cancel_promise,
        (stream, writable, controller, reason),
        // 1. If cancelPromise was fulfilled, then:
        Some(|cx, (stream, writable, controller, reason), _| {
            let vm = cx.vm();
            let finish_promise = controller
                .finish_promise()
                .expect("the controller has a finish promise");

            // 1. If writable.[[state]] is "errored", reject controller.[[finishPromise]] with writable.[[storedError]].
            if writable.state() == WritableStreamState::Errored {
                reject_promise(vm, finish_promise, writable.stored_error());
            }
            // 2. Otherwise:
            else {
                // 1. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerErrorIfNeeded(writable.[[controller]], reason).
                let writable_controller = writable.controller().expect("a writable stream has a controller");
                writable_stream_default_controller_error_if_needed(&writable.context(vm), writable_controller, reason);

                // 2. Perform ! TransformStreamUnblockWrite(stream).
                transform_stream_unblock_write(cx, stream);

                // 3. Resolve controller.[[finishPromise]] with undefined.
                resolve_promise(vm, finish_promise, Value::UNDEFINED);
            }

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
        // 2. If cancelPromise was rejected with reason r, then:
        Some(|cx, (stream, writable, controller, _), reason| {
            let vm = cx.vm();

            // 1. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerErrorIfNeeded(writable.[[controller]], r).
            let writable_controller = writable.controller().expect("a writable stream has a controller");
            writable_stream_default_controller_error_if_needed(&writable.context(vm), writable_controller, reason);

            // 2. Perform ! TransformStreamUnblockWrite(stream).
            transform_stream_unblock_write(cx, stream);

            // 3. Reject controller.[[finishPromise]] with r.
            let finish_promise = controller
                .finish_promise()
                .expect("the controller has a finish promise");
            reject_promise(vm, finish_promise, reason);

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
    );

    // 8. Return controller.[[finishPromise]].
    controller
        .finish_promise()
        .expect("the controller has a finish promise")
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#transform-stream-default-source-pull
pub(crate) fn transform_stream_default_source_pull_algorithm(
    cx: &CallContext,
    stream: Ref<TransformStream>,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    // 1. Assert: stream.[[backpressure]] is true.
    assert!(stream.backpressure() == Some(true));

    // 2. Assert: stream.[[backpressureChangePromise]] is not undefined.
    assert!(stream.backpressure_change_promise().is_some());

    // 3. Perform ! TransformStreamSetBackpressure(stream, false).
    transform_stream_set_backpressure(
        &CallContext::new(cx.vm(), stream.backpressure_change_promise_realm()),
        stream,
        false,
    );

    // 4. Return stream.[[backpressureChangePromise]].
    stream
        .backpressure_change_promise()
        .expect("the stream has a backpressure change promise")
}

//! WritableStreamDefaultController, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ws-default-controller-class, and its abstract
//! operations, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ws-default-controller-abstract-ops

use core::cell::Cell;

use libjs_rust::api::{DeferGc, GcRefCell, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate, wrap};
use crate::bindings::promise::{WebIdlPromise, create_resolved_promise, exception_value, react_to_promise};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, MustNotThrow, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::abort_signal::AbortSignal;
use crate::streams::algorithms::{AbortAlgorithm, CloseAlgorithm, SizeAlgorithm, StartAlgorithm, WriteAlgorithm};
use crate::streams::queue_with_sizes::QueueWithSizes;
use crate::streams::underlying_sink::UnderlyingSink;
use crate::streams::writable_stream::{
    WritableStream, WritableStreamState, writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight,
    writable_stream_deal_with_rejection, writable_stream_finish_erroring, writable_stream_finish_in_flight_close,
    writable_stream_finish_in_flight_close_with_error, writable_stream_finish_in_flight_write,
    writable_stream_finish_in_flight_write_with_error, writable_stream_mark_close_request_in_flight,
    writable_stream_mark_first_write_request_in_flight, writable_stream_start_erroring,
    writable_stream_update_backpressure,
};

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#close-sentinel
fn create_close_sentinel() -> Value {
    // The close sentinel is a unique value enqueued into [[queue]], in lieu of a chunk, to signal that the stream is
    // closed. It is only used internally, and is never exposed to web developers.
    Value::EMPTY
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#close-sentinel
fn is_close_sentinel(value: Value) -> bool {
    value.is_empty()
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WritableStreamDefaultController {
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-abortalgorithm
    abort_algorithm: GcRefCell<Option<AbortAlgorithm>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-closealgorithm
    close_algorithm: GcRefCell<Option<CloseAlgorithm>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-queue
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-queuetotalsize
    queue: QueueWithSizes,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-abortcontroller
    signal: GcRefCell<Option<Ref<AbortSignal>>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-started
    started: Cell<bool>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-strategyhwm
    #[gc(untraced)]
    strategy_hwm: Cell<f64>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-strategysizealgorithm
    strategy_size_algorithm: GcRefCell<Option<SizeAlgorithm>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-stream
    stream: Cell<Option<Ref<WritableStream>>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultcontroller-writealgorithm
    write_algorithm: GcRefCell<Option<WriteAlgorithm>>,
}

impl Wrappable for WritableStreamDefaultController {}

impl WritableStreamDefaultController {
    pub(crate) fn new(defer_gc: &DeferGc<'_>) -> Self {
        Self {
            abort_algorithm: GcRefCell::new(None),
            close_algorithm: GcRefCell::new(None),
            queue: QueueWithSizes::new(defer_gc),
            signal: GcRefCell::new(None),
            started: Cell::new(false),
            strategy_hwm: Cell::new(0.0),
            strategy_size_algorithm: GcRefCell::new(None),
            stream: Cell::new(None),
            write_algorithm: GcRefCell::new(None),
        }
    }

    /// The controller's [[stream]], which it has once it is set up.
    pub(crate) fn stream(&self) -> Ref<WritableStream> {
        self.stream.get().expect("a controller that is set up has a stream")
    }

    pub(crate) fn started(&self) -> bool {
        self.started.get()
    }

    /// The controller's [[writeAlgorithm]], which it has until its algorithms are cleared.
    fn write_algorithm(&self) -> Option<WriteAlgorithm> {
        self.write_algorithm.borrow().clone()
    }

    /// The controller's [[closeAlgorithm]], which it has until its algorithms are cleared.
    fn close_algorithm(&self) -> Option<CloseAlgorithm> {
        self.close_algorithm.borrow().clone()
    }

    /// The controller's [[abortAlgorithm]], which it has until its algorithms are cleared.
    fn abort_algorithm(&self) -> Option<AbortAlgorithm> {
        self.abort_algorithm.borrow().clone()
    }

    /// The controller's [[strategySizeAlgorithm]], which it has until its algorithms are cleared.
    fn strategy_size_algorithm(&self) -> Option<SizeAlgorithm> {
        self.strategy_size_algorithm.borrow().clone()
    }

    /// The signal of the controller's [[abortController]].
    pub(crate) fn abort_signal(&self) -> Ref<AbortSignal> {
        self.signal.borrow().expect("a controller that is set up has a signal")
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ws-default-controller-signal
    pub(crate) fn signal(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AbortSignal>> {
        Ok(self.abort_signal())
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ws-default-controller-error
    pub(crate) fn error(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, e: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Let state be this.[[stream]].[[state]].
        let state = this.stream().state();

        // 2. If state is not "writable", return.
        if state != WritableStreamState::Writable {
            return Ok(());
        }

        // 3. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerError(this, e).
        writable_stream_default_controller_error(cx, *this, e.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED));
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ws-default-controller-private-abort
    pub(crate) fn abort_steps(this: Ref<Self>, cx: &CallContext, reason: Value) -> WebIdlPromise {
        // 1. Let result be the result of performing this.[[abortAlgorithm]], passing reason.
        let abort_algorithm = this
            .abort_algorithm()
            .expect("a controller that aborts has an abort algorithm");
        let result = abort_algorithm.run(&this.stream().context(cx.vm()), reason);

        // 2. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerClearAlgorithms(this).
        writable_stream_default_controller_clear_algorithms(this);

        // 3. Return result.
        result
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ws-default-controller-private-error
    pub(crate) fn error_steps(vm: &Vm, this: Ref<Self>) {
        // 1. Perform ! ResetQueue(this).
        this.queue.reset_queue(vm);
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#set-up-writable-stream-default-controller
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the abstract operation takes these arguments")]
pub(crate) fn set_up_writable_stream_default_controller(
    cx: &CallContext,
    stream: Ref<WritableStream>,
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
    start_algorithm: StartAlgorithm,
    write_algorithm: WriteAlgorithm,
    close_algorithm: CloseAlgorithm,
    abort_algorithm: AbortAlgorithm,
    high_water_mark: f64,
    size_algorithm: SizeAlgorithm,
) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    let vm = cx.vm();

    // 1. Assert: stream implements WritableStream.

    // 2. Assert: stream.[[controller]] is undefined.
    assert!(stream.controller().is_none());

    // 3. Set controller.[[stream]] to stream.
    controller.stream.set(Some(stream));

    // 4. Set stream.[[controller]] to controller.
    stream.set_controller(Some(controller));

    // 5. Perform ! ResetQueue(controller).
    controller.queue.reset_queue(vm);

    // 6. Set controller.[[abortController]] to a new AbortController.
    let signal = AbortSignal::create(vm);
    *controller.signal.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(signal);

    // 7. Set controller.[[started]] to false.
    controller.started.set(false);

    // 8. Set controller.[[strategySizeAlgorithm]] to sizeAlgorithm.
    *controller.strategy_size_algorithm.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(size_algorithm);

    // 9. Set controller.[[strategyHWM]] to highWaterMark.
    controller.strategy_hwm.set(high_water_mark);

    // 10. Set controller.[[writeAlgorithm]] to writeAlgorithm.
    *controller.write_algorithm.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(write_algorithm);

    // 11. Set controller.[[closeAlgorithm]] to closeAlgorithm.
    *controller.close_algorithm.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(close_algorithm);

    // 12. Set controller.[[abortAlgorithm]] to abortAlgorithm.
    *controller.abort_algorithm.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(abort_algorithm);

    // 13. Let backpressure be ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerGetBackpressure(controller).
    let backpressure = writable_stream_default_controller_get_backpressure(controller);

    // 14. Perform ! WritableStreamUpdateBackpressure(stream, backpressure).
    writable_stream_update_backpressure(cx, stream, backpressure);

    // 15. Let startResult be the result of performing startAlgorithm. (This may throw an exception.)
    let start_result = start_algorithm.run()?;

    // 16. Let startPromise be a promise resolved with startResult.
    let start_promise = create_resolved_promise(vm, cx.realm(), start_result);

    react_to_promise(
        vm,
        start_promise,
        (controller, stream),
        // 17. Upon fulfillment of startPromise,
        Some(|cx, (controller, stream), _| {
            let cx = &stream.context(cx.vm());

            // 1. Assert: stream.[[state]] is "writable" or "erroring".
            assert!(matches!(
                stream.state(),
                WritableStreamState::Writable | WritableStreamState::Erroring
            ));

            // 2. Set controller.[[started]] to true.
            controller.started.set(true);

            // 3. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerAdvanceQueueIfNeeded(controller).
            writable_stream_default_controller_advance_queue_if_needed(cx, controller);

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
        // 18. Upon rejection of startPromise with reason r,
        Some(|cx, (controller, stream), reason| {
            let cx = &stream.context(cx.vm());

            // 1. Assert: stream.[[state]] is "writable" or "erroring".
            assert!(matches!(
                stream.state(),
                WritableStreamState::Writable | WritableStreamState::Erroring
            ));

            // 2. Set controller.[[started]] to true.
            controller.started.set(true);

            // 3. Perform ! WritableStreamDealWithRejection(stream, r).
            writable_stream_deal_with_rejection(cx, stream, reason);

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
    );
    Ok(())
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#set-up-writable-stream-default-controller-from-underlying-sink
pub(crate) fn set_up_writable_stream_default_controller_from_underlying_sink(
    cx: &CallContext,
    stream: Ref<WritableStream>,
    underlying_sink: Value,
    underlying_sink_dict: UnderlyingSink,
    high_water_mark: f64,
    size_algorithm: SizeAlgorithm,
) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
    // 1. Let controller be a new WritableStreamDefaultController.
    let controller = allocate(cx.vm(), WritableStreamDefaultController::new);

    // 2. Let startAlgorithm be an algorithm that returns undefined.
    let mut start_algorithm = StartAlgorithm::ReturnsUndefined;

    // 3. Let writeAlgorithm be an algorithm that returns a promise resolved with undefined.
    let mut write_algorithm = WriteAlgorithm::ReturnsResolvedUndefined;

    // 4. Let closeAlgorithm be an algorithm that returns a promise resolved with undefined.
    let mut close_algorithm = CloseAlgorithm::ReturnsResolvedUndefined;

    // 5. Let abortAlgorithm be an algorithm that returns a promise resolved with undefined.
    let mut abort_algorithm = AbortAlgorithm::ReturnsResolvedUndefined;

    // 6. If underlyingSinkDict["start"] exists, then set startAlgorithm to an algorithm which returns the result of
    //    invoking underlyingSinkDict["start"] with argument list « controller », exception behavior "rethrow", and
    //    callback this value underlyingSink.
    if let Some(start) = underlying_sink_dict.start {
        start_algorithm = StartAlgorithm::Callback {
            start,
            this_value: underlying_sink,
            controller: Value::from_object(wrap(cx, controller)),
        };
    }

    // 7. If underlyingSinkDict["write"] exists, then set writeAlgorithm to an algorithm which takes an argument chunk
    //    and returns the result of invoking underlyingSinkDict["write"] with argument list « chunk, controller » and
    //    callback this value underlyingSink.
    if let Some(write) = underlying_sink_dict.write {
        write_algorithm = WriteAlgorithm::Callback {
            write,
            underlying_sink,
            controller,
        };
    }

    // 8. If underlyingSinkDict["close"] exists, then set closeAlgorithm to an algorithm which returns the result of
    //    invoking underlyingSinkDict["close"] with argument list «» and callback this value underlyingSink.
    if let Some(close) = underlying_sink_dict.close {
        close_algorithm = CloseAlgorithm::Callback { close, underlying_sink };
    }

    // 9. If underlyingSinkDict["abort"] exists, then set abortAlgorithm to an algorithm which takes an argument reason
    //    and returns the result of invoking underlyingSinkDict["abort"] with argument list « reason » and callback this
    //    value underlyingSink.
    if let Some(abort) = underlying_sink_dict.abort {
        abort_algorithm = AbortAlgorithm::Callback { abort, underlying_sink };
    }

    // 10. Perform ? SetUpWritableStreamDefaultController(stream, controller, startAlgorithm, writeAlgorithm,
    //     closeAlgorithm, abortAlgorithm, highWaterMark, sizeAlgorithm).
    set_up_writable_stream_default_controller(
        cx,
        stream,
        controller,
        start_algorithm,
        write_algorithm,
        close_algorithm,
        abort_algorithm,
        high_water_mark,
        size_algorithm,
    )
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-advance-queue-if-needed
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_advance_queue_if_needed(
    cx: &CallContext,
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
) {
    // 1. Let stream be controller.[[stream]].
    let stream = controller.stream();

    // 2. If controller.[[started]] is false, return.
    if !controller.started() {
        return;
    }

    // 3. If stream.[[inFlightWriteRequest]] is not undefined, return.
    if stream.in_flight_write_request().is_some() {
        return;
    }

    // 4. Let state be stream.[[state]].
    let state = stream.state();

    // 5. Assert: state is not "closed" or "errored".
    assert!(state != WritableStreamState::Closed && state != WritableStreamState::Errored);

    // 6. If state is "erroring",
    if state == WritableStreamState::Erroring {
        // 1. Perform ! WritableStreamFinishErroring(stream).
        writable_stream_finish_erroring(cx, stream);

        // 2. Return.
        return;
    }

    // 7. If controller.[[queue]] is empty, return.
    if controller.queue.is_empty() {
        return;
    }

    // 8. Let value be ! PeekQueueValue(controller).
    let value = controller.queue.peek_queue_value();

    // 9. If value is the close sentinel, perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerProcessClose(controller).
    if is_close_sentinel(value) {
        writable_stream_default_controller_process_close(cx, controller);
    }
    // 10. Otherwise, perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerProcessWrite(controller, value).
    else {
        writable_stream_default_controller_process_write(cx, controller, value);
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-clear-algorithms
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_clear_algorithms(controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>) {
    // 1. Set controller.[[writeAlgorithm]] to undefined.
    controller.write_algorithm.replace(None);

    // 2. Set controller.[[closeAlgorithm]] to undefined.
    controller.close_algorithm.replace(None);

    // 3. Set controller.[[abortAlgorithm]] to undefined.
    controller.abort_algorithm.replace(None);

    // 4. Set controller.[[strategySizeAlgorithm]] to undefined.
    controller.strategy_size_algorithm.replace(None);
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-close
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_close(
    cx: &CallContext,
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
) {
    // 1. Perform ! EnqueueValueWithSize(controller, close sentinel, 0).
    controller
        .queue
        .enqueue_value_with_size(cx.vm(), create_close_sentinel(), Value::from_f64(0.0))
        .must();

    // 2. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerAdvanceQueueIfNeeded(controller).
    writable_stream_default_controller_advance_queue_if_needed(cx, controller);
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-error
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_error(
    cx: &CallContext,
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
    error: Value,
) {
    // 1. Let stream be controller.[[stream]].
    let stream = controller.stream();

    // 2. Assert: stream.[[state]] is "writable".
    assert!(stream.state() == WritableStreamState::Writable);

    // 3. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerClearAlgorithms(controller).
    writable_stream_default_controller_clear_algorithms(controller);

    // 4. Perform ! WritableStreamStartErroring(stream, error).
    writable_stream_start_erroring(cx, stream, error);
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-error-if-needed
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_error_if_needed(
    cx: &CallContext,
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
    error: Value,
) {
    // 1. If controller.[[stream]].[[state]] is "writable", perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerError(controller,
    //    error).
    if controller.stream().state() == WritableStreamState::Writable {
        writable_stream_default_controller_error(cx, controller, error);
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-get-backpressure
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_get_backpressure(
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
) -> bool {
    // 1. Let desiredSize be ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerGetDesiredSize(controller).
    let desired_size = writable_stream_default_controller_get_desired_size(controller);

    // 2. Return true if desiredSize ≤ 0, or false otherwise.
    desired_size <= 0.0
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-get-chunk-size
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_get_chunk_size(
    cx: &CallContext,
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
    chunk: Value,
) -> Value {
    // 1. If controller.[[strategySizeAlgorithm]] is undefined, then:
    let Some(strategy_size_algorithm) = controller.strategy_size_algorithm() else {
        // 1. Assert: controller.[[stream]].[[state]] is not "writable".
        // AD-HOC: This does not hold: closing clears the algorithms, and the stream is "writable" until the sink closed.
        //         A write in that time gets here on its way to being rejected.

        // 2. Return 1.
        return Value::from_f64(1.0);
    };

    // 2. Let returnValue be the result of performing controller.[[strategySizeAlgorithm]], passing in chunk, and
    //    interpreting the result as a completion record.
    let return_value = strategy_size_algorithm.run(&controller.stream().context(cx.vm()), chunk);

    match return_value {
        // 3. If returnValue is an abrupt completion,
        Err(throw) => {
            // 1. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerErrorIfNeeded(controller, returnValue.[[Value]]).
            writable_stream_default_controller_error_if_needed(cx, controller, throw.value());

            // 2. Return 1.
            Value::from_f64(1.0)
        }
        // 4. Return returnValue.[[Value]].
        Ok(value) => value,
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-get-desired-size
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_get_desired_size(
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
) -> f64 {
    // 1. Return controller.[[strategyHWM]] − controller.[[queueTotalSize]].
    controller.strategy_hwm.get() - controller.queue.total_size()
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-process-close
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_process_close(
    cx: &CallContext,
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
) {
    // 1. Let stream be controller.[[stream]].
    let stream = controller.stream();

    // 2. Perform ! WritableStreamMarkCloseRequestInFlight(stream).
    writable_stream_mark_close_request_in_flight(stream);

    // 3. Perform ! DequeueValue(controller).
    controller.queue.dequeue_value(cx.vm());

    // 4. Assert: controller.[[queue]] is empty.
    assert!(controller.queue.is_empty());

    // 5. Let sinkClosePromise be the result of performing controller.[[closeAlgorithm]].
    let close_algorithm = controller
        .close_algorithm()
        .expect("a controller that closes has a close algorithm");
    let sink_close_promise = close_algorithm.run(&stream.context(cx.vm()));

    // 6. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerClearAlgorithms(controller).
    writable_stream_default_controller_clear_algorithms(controller);

    react_to_promise(
        cx.vm(),
        sink_close_promise,
        stream,
        // 7. Upon fulfillment of sinkClosePromise,
        Some(|cx, stream, _| {
            // 1. Perform ! WritableStreamFinishInFlightClose(stream).
            writable_stream_finish_in_flight_close(cx, stream);

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
        // 8. Upon rejection of sinkClosePromise with reason reason,
        Some(|cx, stream, reason| {
            // 1. Perform ! WritableStreamFinishInFlightCloseWithError(stream, reason).
            writable_stream_finish_in_flight_close_with_error(cx, stream, reason);

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
    );
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-process-write
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_process_write(
    cx: &CallContext,
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
    chunk: Value,
) {
    // 1. Let stream be controller.[[stream]].
    let stream = controller.stream();

    // 2. Perform ! WritableStreamMarkFirstWriteRequestInFlight(stream).
    writable_stream_mark_first_write_request_in_flight(cx.vm(), stream);

    // 3. Let sinkWritePromise be the result of performing controller.[[writeAlgorithm]], passing in chunk.
    let write_algorithm = controller
        .write_algorithm()
        .expect("a controller that writes has a write algorithm");
    let sink_write_promise = write_algorithm.run(&stream.context(cx.vm()), chunk);

    react_to_promise(
        cx.vm(),
        sink_write_promise,
        (controller, stream),
        // 4. Upon fulfillment of sinkWritePromise,
        Some(|cx, (controller, stream), _| {
            // 1. Perform ! WritableStreamFinishInFlightWrite(stream).
            writable_stream_finish_in_flight_write(cx, stream);

            // 2. Let state be stream.[[state]].
            let state = stream.state();

            // 3. Assert: state is "writable" or "erroring".
            assert!(state == WritableStreamState::Writable || state == WritableStreamState::Erroring);

            // 4. Perform ! DequeueValue(controller).
            controller.queue.dequeue_value(cx.vm());

            // 5. If ! WritableStreamCloseQueuedOrInFlight(stream) is false and state is "writable",
            if !writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight(stream) && state == WritableStreamState::Writable {
                // 1. Let backpressure be ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerGetBackpressure(controller).
                let backpressure = writable_stream_default_controller_get_backpressure(controller);

                // 2. Perform ! WritableStreamUpdateBackpressure(stream, backpressure).
                writable_stream_update_backpressure(cx, stream, backpressure);
            }

            // 6. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerAdvanceQueueIfNeeded(controller).
            writable_stream_default_controller_advance_queue_if_needed(cx, controller);

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
        // 5. Upon rejection of sinkWritePromise with reason,
        Some(|cx, (controller, stream), reason| {
            // 1. If stream.[[state]] is "writable", perform
            //    ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerClearAlgorithms(controller).
            if stream.state() == WritableStreamState::Writable {
                writable_stream_default_controller_clear_algorithms(controller);
            }

            // 2. Perform ! WritableStreamFinishInFlightWriteWithError(stream, reason).
            writable_stream_finish_in_flight_write_with_error(cx, stream, reason);

            Ok(Value::UNDEFINED)
        }),
    );
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-controller-write
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_controller_write(
    cx: &CallContext,
    controller: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultController>,
    chunk: Value,
    chunk_size: Value,
) {
    // 1. Let enqueueResult be EnqueueValueWithSize(controller, chunk, chunkSize).
    let enqueue_result = controller.queue.enqueue_value_with_size(cx.vm(), chunk, chunk_size);

    // 2. If enqueueResult is an abrupt completion,
    if let Err(exception) = enqueue_result {
        let error = exception_value(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), exception);

        // 1. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerErrorIfNeeded(controller, enqueueResult.[[Value]]).
        writable_stream_default_controller_error_if_needed(cx, controller, error);

        // 2. Return.
        return;
    }

    // 3. Let stream be controller.[[stream]].
    let stream = controller.stream();

    // 4. If ! WritableStreamCloseQueuedOrInFlight(stream) is false and stream.[[state]] is "writable",
    if !writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight(stream) && stream.state() == WritableStreamState::Writable {
        // 1. Let backpressure be ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerGetBackpressure(controller).
        let backpressure = writable_stream_default_controller_get_backpressure(controller);

        // 2. Perform ! WritableStreamUpdateBackpressure(stream, backpressure).
        writable_stream_update_backpressure(cx, stream, backpressure);
    }

    // 5. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerAdvanceQueueIfNeeded(controller).
    writable_stream_default_controller_advance_queue_if_needed(cx, controller);
}

//! WritableStreamDefaultWriter, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-class, and the abstract operations of
//! writers, https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#ws-writer-abstract-ops

use core::cell::Cell;

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Promise, PromiseState, Realm, Trace, Value, Vm};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::promise::{
    WebIdlPromise, create_rejected_promise, create_rejected_promise_from_exception, create_resolved_promise,
    exception_value, mark_promise_as_handled, promise_realm, reject_promise,
};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::streams::writable_stream::{
    WritableStream, WritableStreamState, set_up_writable_stream_default_writer, writable_stream_abort,
    writable_stream_add_write_request, writable_stream_close, writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight,
};
use crate::streams::writable_stream_default_controller::{
    writable_stream_default_controller_get_chunk_size, writable_stream_default_controller_get_desired_size,
    writable_stream_default_controller_write,
};

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultwriter
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WritableStreamDefaultWriter {
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultwriter-closedpromise
    closed_promise: Cell<Option<WebIdlPromise>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultwriter-readypromise
    ready_promise: Cell<Option<WebIdlPromise>>,
    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writablestreamdefaultwriter-stream
    stream: Cell<Option<Ref<WritableStream>>>,
}

impl Wrappable for WritableStreamDefaultWriter {}

impl WritableStreamDefaultWriter {
    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            closed_promise: Cell::new(None),
            ready_promise: Cell::new(None),
            stream: Cell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn closed_promise(&self) -> Option<WebIdlPromise> {
        self.closed_promise.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn ready_promise(&self) -> Option<WebIdlPromise> {
        self.ready_promise.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn stream(&self) -> Option<Ref<WritableStream>> {
        self.stream.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_closed_promise(&self, promise: WebIdlPromise) {
        self.closed_promise.set(Some(promise));
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_ready_promise(&self, promise: WebIdlPromise) {
        self.ready_promise.set(Some(promise));
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_stream(&self, stream: Option<Ref<WritableStream>>) {
        self.stream.set(stream);
    }

    /// The realm of the writer's [[closedPromise]], which most promises and exceptions of the writer are created in,
    /// as LibWeb's C++ creates them.
    pub(crate) fn closed_promise_realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        promise_realm(
            self.closed_promise()
                .expect("a writer that is set up has a closed promise"),
        )
    }

    /// The realm of the writer's [[readyPromise]], which the promises of the writer's write() are created in, as
    /// LibWeb's C++ creates them.
    pub(crate) fn ready_promise_realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        promise_realm(
            self.ready_promise()
                .expect("a writer that is set up has a ready promise"),
        )
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-constructor
    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext, stream: Ref<WritableStream>) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let this = allocate(cx.vm(), |_| Self::new());

        // 1. Perform ? SetUpWritableStreamDefaultWriter(this, stream).
        set_up_writable_stream_default_writer(cx, this, stream)?;
        Ok(this)
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-closed
    pub(crate) fn closed(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        // 1. Return this.[[closedPromise]].
        Ok(self
            .closed_promise()
            .expect("a writer that is set up has a closed promise"))
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-desired-size
    pub(crate) fn desired_size(this: &Ref<Self>, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<f64>> {
        // 1. If this.[[stream]] is undefined, throw a TypeError exception.
        if this.stream().is_none() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "Cannot get desired size of writer that has no locked stream",
            ));
        }

        // 2. Return ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterGetDesiredSize(this).
        Ok(writable_stream_default_writer_get_desired_size(*this))
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-ready
    pub(crate) fn ready(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        // 1. Return this.[[readyPromise]].
        Ok(self
            .ready_promise()
            .expect("a writer that is set up has a ready promise"))
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-abort
    pub(crate) fn abort(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, reason: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.closed_promise_realm();

        // 1. If this.[[stream]] is undefined, return a promise rejected with a TypeError exception.
        if this.stream().is_none() {
            let exception = Exception::type_error("Cannot abort a writer that has no locked stream");
            return Ok(create_rejected_promise_from_exception(vm, realm, exception));
        }

        // 2. Return ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterAbort(this, reason).
        Ok(writable_stream_default_writer_abort(
            vm,
            *this,
            reason.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED),
        ))
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-close
    pub(crate) fn close(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.closed_promise_realm();

        // 1. Let stream be this.[[stream]].
        // 2. If stream is undefined, return a promise rejected with a TypeError exception.
        let Some(stream) = this.stream() else {
            let exception = Exception::type_error("Cannot close a writer that has no locked stream");
            return Ok(create_rejected_promise_from_exception(vm, realm, exception));
        };

        // 3. If ! WritableStreamCloseQueuedOrInFlight(stream) is true, return a promise rejected with a TypeError
        //    exception.
        if writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight(stream) {
            let exception = Exception::type_error("Cannot close a stream that is already closed or errored");
            return Ok(create_rejected_promise_from_exception(vm, realm, exception));
        }

        // 4. Return ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterClose(this).
        Ok(writable_stream_default_writer_close(vm, *this))
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-release-lock
    pub(crate) fn release_lock(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. Let stream be this.[[stream]].
        // 2. If stream is undefined, return.
        let Some(stream) = this.stream() else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        // 3. Assert: stream.[[writer]] is not undefined.
        assert!(stream.writer().is_some());

        // 4. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterRelease(this).
        writable_stream_default_writer_release(cx.vm(), *this);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-write
    pub(crate) fn write(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, chunk: Option<Value>) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let realm = this.ready_promise_realm();

        // 1. If this.[[stream]] is undefined, return a promise rejected with a TypeError exception.
        if this.stream().is_none() {
            let exception = Exception::type_error("Cannot write to a writer that has no locked stream");
            return Ok(create_rejected_promise_from_exception(vm, realm, exception));
        }

        // 2. Return ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterWrite(this, chunk).
        Ok(writable_stream_default_writer_write(
            vm,
            *this,
            chunk.unwrap_or(Value::UNDEFINED),
        ))
    }
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-writer-abort
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_writer_abort(
    vm: &Vm,
    writer: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultWriter>,
    reason: Value,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    // 1. Let stream be writer.[[stream]].
    // 2. Assert: stream is not undefined.
    let stream = writer.stream().expect("a writer that aborts its stream has a stream");

    // 3. Return ! WritableStreamAbort(stream, reason).
    writable_stream_abort(&CallContext::new(vm, writer.closed_promise_realm()), stream, reason)
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-writer-close
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_writer_close(vm: &Vm, writer: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultWriter>) -> WebIdlPromise {
    // 1. Let stream be writer.[[stream]].
    // 2. Assert: stream is not undefined.
    let stream = writer.stream().expect("a writer that closes its stream has a stream");

    // 3. Return ! WritableStreamClose(stream).
    writable_stream_close(&CallContext::new(vm, writer.closed_promise_realm()), stream)
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-writer-close-with-error-propagation
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_writer_close_with_error_propagation(
    vm: &Vm,
    writer: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultWriter>,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    let realm = writer.closed_promise_realm();

    // 1. Let stream be writer.[[stream]].
    // 2. Assert: stream is not undefined.
    let stream = writer.stream().expect("a writer that closes its stream has a stream");

    // 3. Let state be stream.[[state]].
    let state = stream.state();

    // 4. If ! WritableStreamCloseQueuedOrInFlight(stream) is true or state is "closed", return a promise resolved with
    //    undefined.
    if writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight(stream) || state == WritableStreamState::Closed {
        return create_resolved_promise(vm, realm, Value::UNDEFINED);
    }

    // 5. If state is "errored", return a promise rejected with stream.[[storedError]].
    if state == WritableStreamState::Errored {
        return create_rejected_promise(vm, realm, stream.stored_error());
    }

    // 6. Assert: state is "writable" or "erroring".
    assert!(state == WritableStreamState::Writable || state == WritableStreamState::Erroring);

    // 7. Return ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterClose(writer).
    writable_stream_default_writer_close(vm, writer)
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-writer-ensure-closed-promise-rejected
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_writer_ensure_closed_promise_rejected(
    vm: &Vm,
    writer: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultWriter>,
    error: Value,
) {
    let realm = writer.closed_promise_realm();
    let closed_promise = writer
        .closed_promise()
        .expect("a writer that is set up has a closed promise");

    // 1. If writer.[[closedPromise]].[[PromiseState]] is "pending", reject writer.[[closedPromise]] with error.
    let state = closed_promise
        .promise()
        .downcast::<Promise>()
        .expect("a writer's promises are Promises")
        .state();
    if state == PromiseState::Pending {
        reject_promise(vm, closed_promise, error);
    }
    // 2. Otherwise, set writer.[[closedPromise]] to a promise rejected with error.
    else {
        writer.set_closed_promise(create_rejected_promise(vm, realm, error));
    }

    // 3. Set writer.[[closedPromise]].[[PromiseIsHandled]] to true.
    mark_promise_as_handled(
        vm,
        writer
            .closed_promise()
            .expect("a writer that is set up has a closed promise"),
    );
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-writer-ensure-ready-promise-rejected
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_writer_ensure_ready_promise_rejected(
    vm: &Vm,
    writer: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultWriter>,
    error: Value,
) {
    let realm = writer.ready_promise_realm();
    let ready_promise = writer
        .ready_promise()
        .expect("a writer that is set up has a ready promise");

    // 1. If writer.[[readyPromise]].[[PromiseState]] is "pending", reject writer.[[readyPromise]] with error.
    let state = ready_promise
        .promise()
        .downcast::<Promise>()
        .expect("a writer's promises are Promises")
        .state();
    if state == PromiseState::Pending {
        reject_promise(vm, ready_promise, error);
    }
    // 2. Otherwise, set writer.[[readyPromise]] to a promise rejected with error.
    else {
        writer.set_ready_promise(create_rejected_promise(vm, realm, error));
    }

    // 3. Set writer.[[readyPromise]].[[PromiseIsHandled]] to true.
    mark_promise_as_handled(
        vm,
        writer
            .ready_promise()
            .expect("a writer that is set up has a ready promise"),
    );
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-writer-get-desired-size
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_writer_get_desired_size(writer: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultWriter>) -> Option<f64> {
    // 1. Let stream be writer.[[stream]].
    let stream = writer
        .stream()
        .expect("a writer whose desired size is gotten has a stream");

    // 2. Let state be stream.[[state]].
    let state = stream.state();

    // 3. If state is "errored" or "erroring", return null.
    if state == WritableStreamState::Errored || state == WritableStreamState::Erroring {
        return None;
    }

    // 4. If state is "closed", return 0.
    if state == WritableStreamState::Closed {
        return Some(0.0);
    }

    // 5. Return ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerGetDesiredSize(stream.[[controller]]).
    Some(writable_stream_default_controller_get_desired_size(
        stream.controller().expect("a stream that is set up has a controller"),
    ))
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-writer-release
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_writer_release(vm: &Vm, writer: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultWriter>) {
    let realm = writer.closed_promise_realm();

    // 1. Let stream be writer.[[stream]].
    // 2. Assert: stream is not undefined.
    let stream = writer.stream().expect("a writer that is released has a stream");

    // 3. Assert: stream.[[writer]] is writer.
    assert!(stream.writer() == Some(writer));

    // 4. Let releasedError be a new TypeError.
    let released_error = exception_value(
        vm,
        realm,
        Exception::type_error("Writer's stream lock has been released"),
    );

    // 5. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterEnsureReadyPromiseRejected(writer, releasedError).
    writable_stream_default_writer_ensure_ready_promise_rejected(vm, writer, released_error);

    // 6. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultWriterEnsureClosedPromiseRejected(writer, releasedError).
    writable_stream_default_writer_ensure_closed_promise_rejected(vm, writer, released_error);

    // 7. Set stream.[[writer]] to undefined.
    stream.set_writer(None);

    // 8. Set writer.[[stream]] to undefined.
    writer.set_stream(None);
}

// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#writable-stream-default-writer-write
pub(crate) fn writable_stream_default_writer_write(
    vm: &Vm,
    writer: Ref<WritableStreamDefaultWriter>,
    chunk: Value,
) -> WebIdlPromise {
    let realm = writer.ready_promise_realm();
    let cx = &CallContext::new(vm, realm);

    // 1. Let stream be writer.[[stream]].
    // 2. Assert: stream is not undefined.
    let stream = writer.stream().expect("a writer that writes has a stream");

    // 3. Let controller be stream.[[controller]].
    let controller = stream.controller().expect("a stream that is set up has a controller");

    // 4. Let chunkSize be ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerGetChunkSize(controller, chunk).
    let chunk_size = writable_stream_default_controller_get_chunk_size(cx, controller, chunk);

    // 5. If stream is not equal to writer.[[stream]], return a promise rejected with a TypeError exception.
    if writer.stream() != Some(stream) {
        let exception = Exception::type_error("Writer's locked stream changed during write");
        return create_rejected_promise_from_exception(vm, realm, exception);
    }

    // 6. Let state be stream.[[state]].
    let state = stream.state();

    // 7. If state is "errored", return a promise rejected with stream.[[storedError]].
    if state == WritableStreamState::Errored {
        return create_rejected_promise(vm, realm, stream.stored_error());
    }

    // 8. If ! WritableStreamCloseQueuedOrInFlight(stream) is true or state is "closed", return a promise rejected with
    //    a TypeError exception indicating that the stream is closing or closed.
    if writable_stream_close_queued_or_in_flight(stream) || state == WritableStreamState::Closed {
        let exception = Exception::type_error("Cannot write to a writer whose stream is closing or already closed");
        return create_rejected_promise_from_exception(vm, realm, exception);
    }

    // 9. If state is "erroring", return a promise rejected with stream.[[storedError]].
    if state == WritableStreamState::Erroring {
        return create_rejected_promise(vm, realm, stream.stored_error());
    }

    // 10. Assert: state is "writable".
    assert!(state == WritableStreamState::Writable);

    // 11. Let promise be ! WritableStreamAddWriteRequest(stream).
    let promise = writable_stream_add_write_request(cx, stream);

    // 12. Perform ! WritableStreamDefaultControllerWrite(controller, chunk, chunkSize).
    writable_stream_default_controller_write(cx, controller, chunk, chunk_size);

    // 13. Return promise.
    promise
}
