impl AudioNode {
    pub(crate) fn new(_defer_gc: &DeferGc<'_>, context: AnyBaseAudioContext, channel_count: u32) -> Self {
        let node_id = context.next_node_id();
        Self {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            context,
            channel_count: Cell::new(channel_count),
            channel_count_mode: Cell::new(ChannelCountMode::Max),
            channel_interpretation: Cell::new(ChannelInterpretation::Speakers),
            output_connections: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            param_connections: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            node_id,
            this: Cell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_this(&self, this: AnyAudioNode) {
        self.this.set(Some(this));
    }

    pub(crate) fn this(&self) -> AnyAudioNode {
        self.this.get().expect("a node knows itself after allocation")
    }

    // A node that is no longer reachable from script or the audio graph retires
    // its renderer node during finalization while the owning context is alive.
    pub(crate) fn finalize_node(&self) {
        self.context
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::RemoveNode(RemoveNode { node_id: self.node_id }));
    }

    pub(crate) fn event_target(&self) -> &CppEventTarget {
        &self.event_target
    }

    pub(crate) fn context_value(&self) -> AnyBaseAudioContext {
        self.context
    }

    pub(crate) fn node_id(&self) -> u64 {
        self.node_id
    }

    pub(crate) fn queue_render_node_creation(&self, node: Box<NodeHandle>) {
        self.context
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::AddNode(AddNode { node }));

        // The channel configuration is settled before the render node is created, and the rendering thread ignores
        // messages for nodes it does not know about yet, so it has to be sent again now.
        self.queue_channel_config_update();
    }

    fn queue_connection_update(&self) {
        let node_connections = self
            .output_connections
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .map(|connection| OutgoingNodeConnection {
                destination: connection.destination_node.node_id(),
                output_index: connection.output as usize,
                input_index: connection.input as usize,
            })
            .collect();
        let param_connections = self
            .param_connections
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .map(|connection| OutgoingParamConnection {
                destination: Arc::clone(connection.destination_param.render_param()),
                output_index: connection.output as usize,
            })
            .collect();
        self.context
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::ReplaceConnections(ReplaceConnections {
                source: self.node_id(),
                node_connections,
                param_connections,
            }));
    }

    fn queue_channel_config_update(&self) {
        self.context
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::SetChannelConfig(SetChannelConfig {
                node_id: self.node_id(),
                channel_count: self.channel_count.get() as usize,
                channel_count_mode: self.channel_count_mode.get(),
                channel_interpretation: self.channel_interpretation.get(),
            }));
    }

    pub(crate) fn initialize_audio_node_options(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        given_options: &AudioNodeOptions,
        default_options: &AudioNodeDefaultOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // Set channel count, fallback to default if not provided
        if let Some(channel_count) = given_options.channel_count {
            self.set_channel_count(cx, channel_count)?;
        } else {
            self.set_channel_count(cx, default_options.channel_count)?;
        }

        // Set channel count mode, fallback to default if not provided
        if let Some(channel_count_mode) = given_options.channel_count_mode {
            self.set_channel_count_mode(cx, channel_count_mode)?;
        } else {
            self.set_channel_count_mode(cx, default_options.channel_count_mode)?;
        }

        // Set channel interpretation, fallback to default if not provided
        if let Some(channel_interpretation) = given_options.channel_interpretation {
            self.set_channel_interpretation(cx, channel_interpretation)?;
        } else {
            self.set_channel_interpretation(cx, default_options.channel_interpretation)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-connect
    pub(crate) fn connect_to_node(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        destination_node: AnyAudioNode,
        output: u32,
        input: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<AnyAudioNode> {
        let output_connection = AudioNodeConnection {
            destination_node,
            output,
            input,
        };

        // There can only be one connection between a given output of one specific node and a given input of another specific node.
        // Multiple connections with the same termini are ignored.
        for existing_connection in self.output_connections.borrow().iter() {
            if *existing_connection == output_connection {
                return Ok(destination_node);
            }
        }

        // If the destination parameter is an AudioNode that has been created using another AudioContext, an InvalidAccessError MUST be thrown.
        if self.context != destination_node.context_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot connect to an AudioNode in a different AudioContext"),
            ));
        }

        // The output parameter is an index describing which output of the AudioNode from which to connect.
        // If this parameter is out-of-bounds, an IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown.
        if output >= self.number_of_outputs_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("Output index {output} exceeds number of outputs")),
            ));
        }

        // The input parameter is an index describing which input of the destination AudioNode to connect to.
        // If this parameter is out-of-bounds, an IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown.
        if input >= destination_node.number_of_inputs_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("Input index '{input}' exceeds number of inputs")),
            ));
        }

        // Connect node's output to destination_node input.
        self.output_connections.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).push(output_connection);

        self.queue_connection_update();

        Ok(destination_node)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-connect-destinationparam-output
    pub(crate) fn connect_to_param(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        destination_param: Ref<AudioParam>,
        output: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let param_connection = AudioParamConnection {
            destination_param,
            output,
        };

        // There can only be one connection between a given output of one specific node and a specific AudioParam. Multiple connections
        //  with the same termini are ignored.
        for existing_connection in self.param_connections.borrow().iter() {
            if *existing_connection == param_connection {
                return Ok(());
            }
        }

        // If destinationParam belongs to an AudioNode that belongs to a BaseAudioContext that is different from the BaseAudioContext
        // that has created the AudioNode on which this method was called, an InvalidAccessError MUST be thrown.
        if self.context != destination_param.context_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot connect to an AudioParam in a different AudioContext"),
            ));
        }

        // The output parameter is an index describing which output of the AudioNode from which to connect.
        // If the parameter is out-of-bounds, an IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown.
        if output >= self.number_of_outputs_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("Output index {output} exceeds number of outputs")),
            ));
        }

        // Connect node's output to destination_param.
        self.param_connections.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).push(param_connection);

        self.queue_connection_update();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-disconnect
    pub(crate) fn disconnect_all(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.output_connections.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).clear();
        self.param_connections.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).clear();

        self.queue_connection_update();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-disconnect-output
    pub(crate) fn disconnect_output(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, output: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The output parameter is an index describing which output of the AudioNode to disconnect.
        // It disconnects all outgoing connections from the given output.
        // If this parameter is out-of-bounds, an IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown.
        if output >= self.number_of_outputs_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("Output index {output} exceeds number of outputs")),
            ));
        }

        self.output_connections
            .borrow_mut(cx.vm())
            .retain(|connection| !(connection.output == output));

        self.param_connections
            .borrow_mut(cx.vm())
            .retain(|connection| !(connection.output == output));

        self.queue_connection_update();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-disconnect-destinationnode
    pub(crate) fn disconnect_node(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, destination_node: AnyAudioNode) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The destinationNode parameter is the AudioNode to disconnect.
        // It disconnects all outgoing connections to the given destinationNode.
        let before = self.output_connections.borrow().len();
        self.output_connections
            .borrow_mut(cx.vm())
            .retain(|connection| !(connection.destination_node == destination_node));

        // If there is no connection to the destinationNode, an InvalidAccessError exception MUST be thrown.
        if self.output_connections.borrow().len() == before {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"No connection to given AudioNode"),
            ));
        }

        self.queue_connection_update();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-disconnect-destinationnode-output
    pub(crate) fn disconnect_node_output(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        destination_node: AnyAudioNode,
        output: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The output parameter is an index describing which output of the AudioNode from which to disconnect.
        // If this parameter is out-of-bounds, an IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown.
        if output >= self.number_of_outputs_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("Output index {output} exceeds number of outputs")),
            ));
        }

        // The destinationNode parameter is the AudioNode to disconnect.
        let before = self.output_connections.borrow().len();
        self.output_connections
            .borrow_mut(cx.vm())
            .retain(|connection| !(connection.destination_node == destination_node && connection.output == output));

        //  If there is no connection to the destinationNode from the given output, an InvalidAccessError exception MUST be thrown.
        if self.output_connections.borrow().len() == before {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("No connection from output {output} to given AudioNode")),
            ));
        }

        self.queue_connection_update();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-disconnect-destinationnode-output-input
    pub(crate) fn disconnect_node_output_input(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        destination_node: AnyAudioNode,
        output: u32,
        input: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The output parameter is an index describing which output of the AudioNode from which to disconnect.
        // If this parameter is out-of-bounds, an IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown.
        if output >= self.number_of_outputs_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("Output index {output} exceeds number of outputs")),
            ));
        }

        // The input parameter is an index describing which input of the destination AudioNode to disconnect.
        // If this parameter is out-of-bounds, an IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown.
        if input >= destination_node.number_of_inputs_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("Input index '{input}' exceeds number of inputs")),
            ));
        }

        // The destinationNode parameter is the AudioNode to disconnect.
        let before = self.output_connections.borrow().len();
        self.output_connections.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).retain(|connection| {
            !(connection.destination_node == destination_node
                && connection.output == output
                && connection.input == input)
        });

        // If there is no connection to the destinationNode from the given output to the given input, an InvalidAccessError exception MUST be thrown.
        if self.output_connections.borrow().len() == before {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!(
                    "No connection from output {output} to input {input} of given AudioNode"
                )),
            ));
        }

        self.queue_connection_update();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-disconnect-destinationparam
    pub(crate) fn disconnect_param(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        destination_param: Ref<AudioParam>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The destinationParam parameter is the AudioParam to disconnect.
        let before = self.param_connections.borrow().len();
        self.param_connections
            .borrow_mut(cx.vm())
            .retain(|connection| !(connection.destination_param == destination_param));

        // If there is no connection to the destinationParam, an InvalidAccessError exception MUST be thrown.
        if self.param_connections.borrow().len() == before {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"No connection to given AudioParam"),
            ));
        }

        self.queue_connection_update();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-disconnect-destinationparam-output
    pub(crate) fn disconnect_param_output(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        destination_param: Ref<AudioParam>,
        output: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The output parameter is an index describing which output of the AudioNode from which to disconnect.
        // If this parameter is out-of-bounds, an IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown.
        if output >= self.number_of_outputs_value() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("Output index {output} exceeds number of outputs")),
            ));
        }

        // The destinationParam parameter is the AudioParam to disconnect.
        let before = self.param_connections.borrow().len();
        self.param_connections
            .borrow_mut(cx.vm())
            .retain(|connection| !(connection.destination_param == destination_param && connection.output == output));

        // If there is no connection to the destinationParam, an InvalidAccessError exception MUST be thrown.
        if self.param_connections.borrow().len() == before {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidAccessError",
                Utf16String::from_utf8(&format!("No connection from output {output} to given AudioParam")),
            ));
        }

        self.queue_connection_update();

        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-context
    pub(crate) fn context(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<AnyBaseAudioContext> {
        // The BaseAudioContext which owns this AudioNode.
        Ok(self.context)
    }

    pub(crate) fn channel_count_value(&self) -> u32 {
        self.channel_count.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn channel_count(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(self.channel_count_value())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-numberofinputs
    pub(crate) fn number_of_inputs(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(self.number_of_inputs_value())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-numberofoutputs
    pub(crate) fn number_of_outputs(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(self.number_of_outputs_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_inputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        self.this().number_of_inputs()
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_outputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        self.this().number_of_outputs()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.this().set_channel_count(cx, value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_mode(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: ChannelCountMode) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.this().set_channel_count_mode(cx, value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_channel_interpretation(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        value: ChannelInterpretation,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.this().set_channel_interpretation(cx, value)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcount
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_impl(&self, value: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // If this value is set to zero or to a value greater than the implementation’s maximum number
        // of channels the implementation MUST throw a NotSupportedError exception.
        if value == 0 || value > BaseAudioContext::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Invalid channel count"),
            ));
        }
        self.channel_count.set(value);
        self.queue_channel_config_update();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcountmode
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_mode_impl(&self, value: ChannelCountMode) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.channel_count_mode.set(value);
        self.queue_channel_config_update();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcountmode
    pub(crate) fn channel_count_mode(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<ChannelCountMode> {
        Ok(self.channel_count_mode.get())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelinterpretation
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_interpretation_impl(&self, value: ChannelInterpretation) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.channel_interpretation.set(value);
        self.queue_channel_config_update();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelinterpretation
    pub(crate) fn channel_interpretation(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<ChannelInterpretation> {
        Ok(self.channel_interpretation.get())
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
#[allow(clippy::enum_variant_names, reason = "the variants have the interfaces’ names")]
pub(crate) enum AnyAudioNode {
    AudioNode(Ref<AudioNode>),
    AudioScheduledSourceNode(Ref<AudioScheduledSourceNode>),
    AnalyserNode(Ref<AnalyserNode>),
    AudioBufferSourceNode(Ref<AudioBufferSourceNode>),
    AudioDestinationNode(Ref<AudioDestinationNode>),
    AudioWorkletNode(Ref<AudioWorkletNode>),
    BiquadFilterNode(Ref<BiquadFilterNode>),
    ChannelMergerNode(Ref<ChannelMergerNode>),
    ChannelSplitterNode(Ref<ChannelSplitterNode>),
    ConstantSourceNode(Ref<ConstantSourceNode>),
    ConvolverNode(Ref<ConvolverNode>),
    DelayNode(Ref<DelayNode>),
    DynamicsCompressorNode(Ref<DynamicsCompressorNode>),
    GainNode(Ref<GainNode>),
    IIRFilterNode(Ref<IIRFilterNode>),
    MediaElementAudioSourceNode(Ref<MediaElementAudioSourceNode>),
    MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode(Ref<MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode>),
    MediaStreamAudioSourceNode(Ref<MediaStreamAudioSourceNode>),
    OscillatorNode(Ref<OscillatorNode>),
    PannerNode(Ref<PannerNode>),
    ScriptProcessorNode(Ref<ScriptProcessorNode>),
    StereoPannerNode(Ref<StereoPannerNode>),
    WaveShaperNode(Ref<WaveShaperNode>),
}

impl Deref for AnyAudioNode {
    type Target = AudioNode;

    fn deref(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        match self {
            Self::AudioNode(node) => node,
            Self::AudioScheduledSourceNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::AnalyserNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::AudioBufferSourceNode(node) => node.parent().parent(),
            Self::AudioDestinationNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::AudioWorkletNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::BiquadFilterNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::ChannelMergerNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::ChannelSplitterNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::ConstantSourceNode(node) => node.parent().parent(),
            Self::ConvolverNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::DelayNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::DynamicsCompressorNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::GainNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::IIRFilterNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::MediaElementAudioSourceNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::MediaStreamAudioSourceNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::OscillatorNode(node) => node.parent().parent(),
            Self::PannerNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::ScriptProcessorNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::StereoPannerNode(node) => node.parent(),
            Self::WaveShaperNode(node) => node.parent(),
        }
    }
}

impl ToJs for AnyAudioNode {
    fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {
        match self {
            Self::AudioNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::AudioScheduledSourceNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::AnalyserNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::AudioBufferSourceNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::AudioDestinationNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::AudioWorkletNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::BiquadFilterNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::ChannelMergerNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::ChannelSplitterNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::ConstantSourceNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::ConvolverNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::DelayNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::DynamicsCompressorNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::GainNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::IIRFilterNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::MediaElementAudioSourceNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::MediaStreamAudioSourceNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::OscillatorNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::PannerNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::ScriptProcessorNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::StereoPannerNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
            Self::WaveShaperNode(node) => node.to_js(cx),
        }
    }
}

impl AnyAudioNode {
    fn number_of_inputs(self) -> u32 {
        match self {
            Self::AudioNode(_) => unreachable!("an abstract audio node has no instances"),
            Self::AudioScheduledSourceNode(_) => unreachable!("an abstract audio node has no instances"),
            Self::AnalyserNode(_) => 1,
            Self::AudioBufferSourceNode(_) => 0,
            Self::AudioDestinationNode(_) => 1,
            Self::AudioWorkletNode(node) => node.number_of_inputs_value(),
            Self::BiquadFilterNode(_) => 1,
            Self::ChannelMergerNode(node) => node.number_of_inputs_value(),
            Self::ChannelSplitterNode(node) => node.number_of_inputs_value(),
            Self::ConstantSourceNode(_) => 0,
            Self::ConvolverNode(_) => 1,
            Self::DelayNode(_) => 1,
            Self::DynamicsCompressorNode(_) => 1,
            Self::GainNode(_) => 1,
            Self::IIRFilterNode(_) => 1,
            Self::MediaElementAudioSourceNode(_) => 0,
            Self::MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode(_) => 1,
            Self::MediaStreamAudioSourceNode(_) => 0,
            Self::OscillatorNode(_) => 0,
            Self::PannerNode(_) => 1,
            Self::ScriptProcessorNode(node) => node.number_of_inputs_value(),
            Self::StereoPannerNode(_) => 1,
            Self::WaveShaperNode(_) => 1,
        }
    }

    fn number_of_outputs(self) -> u32 {
        match self {
            Self::AudioNode(_) => unreachable!("an abstract audio node has no instances"),
            Self::AudioScheduledSourceNode(_) => unreachable!("an abstract audio node has no instances"),
            Self::AnalyserNode(_) => 1,
            Self::AudioBufferSourceNode(_) => 1,
            Self::AudioDestinationNode(_) => 1,
            Self::AudioWorkletNode(node) => node.number_of_outputs_value(),
            Self::BiquadFilterNode(_) => 1,
            Self::ChannelMergerNode(node) => node.number_of_outputs_value(),
            Self::ChannelSplitterNode(node) => node.number_of_outputs_value(),
            Self::ConstantSourceNode(_) => 1,
            Self::ConvolverNode(_) => 1,
            Self::DelayNode(_) => 1,
            Self::DynamicsCompressorNode(_) => 1,
            Self::GainNode(_) => 1,
            Self::IIRFilterNode(_) => 1,
            Self::MediaElementAudioSourceNode(_) => 1,
            Self::MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode(_) => 0,
            Self::MediaStreamAudioSourceNode(_) => 1,
            Self::OscillatorNode(_) => 1,
            Self::PannerNode(_) => 1,
            Self::ScriptProcessorNode(node) => node.number_of_outputs_value(),
            Self::StereoPannerNode(_) => 1,
            Self::WaveShaperNode(_) => 1,
        }
    }

    fn set_channel_count(self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        match self {
            Self::AudioDestinationNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_override(cx, value),
            Self::ChannelMergerNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_override(cx, value),
            Self::ChannelSplitterNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_override(cx, value),
            Self::DynamicsCompressorNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_override(cx, value),
            Self::PannerNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_override(cx, value),
            Self::StereoPannerNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_override(cx, value),
            Self::ScriptProcessorNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_override(cx, value),
            Self::ConvolverNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_override(cx, value),
            _ => self.deref().set_channel_count_impl(value),
        }
    }

    fn set_channel_count_mode(self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: ChannelCountMode) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        match self {
            Self::ChannelMergerNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_mode_override(cx, value),
            Self::ChannelSplitterNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_mode_override(cx, value),
            Self::DynamicsCompressorNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_mode_override(cx, value),
            Self::PannerNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_mode_override(cx, value),
            Self::StereoPannerNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_mode_override(cx, value),
            Self::ScriptProcessorNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_mode_override(cx, value),
            Self::ConvolverNode(node) => node.set_channel_count_mode_override(cx, value),
            _ => self.deref().set_channel_count_mode_impl(value),
        }
    }

    fn set_channel_interpretation(self, cx: &mut CallContext, value: ChannelInterpretation) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        match self {
            Self::ChannelSplitterNode(node) => node.set_channel_interpretation_override(cx, value),
            _ => self.deref().set_channel_interpretation_impl(value),
        }
    }
}

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, Map, Trace, Value, Vm};

use super::audio_param::AudioParam;
use crate::bindings::CallContext;
use crate::bindings::conversions::{ToJs, to_dom_string};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, SecurityCheckType, Wrappable, allocate, this_implementation, wrap};
use crate::bindings::maplike::Maplike;

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#AudioParamMap
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct AudioParamMap {
    entries: GcRefCell<Vec<(Utf16String, Ref<AudioParam>)>>,
}

impl Wrappable for AudioParamMap {}
impl AudioParamMap {
    pub(crate) fn values<'vm>(&self, vm: &'vm Vm) -> libjs_rust::api::MarkedVec<'vm, Ref<AudioParam>> {
        let values = libjs_rust::api::MarkedVec::new(vm);
        for (_, value) in &*self.entries.borrow() {
            values.push(*value);
        }
        values
    }

    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            entries: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_entry(&self, vm: &Vm, key: Utf16String, value: Ref<AudioParam>) {
        let mut entries = self.entries.borrow_mut(vm);
        if let Some(entry) = entries.iter_mut().find(|entry| entry.0 == key) {
            entry.1 = value;
        } else {
            entries.push((key, value));
        }
    }
}

impl Maplike for AudioParamMap {
    // https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#js-map-has
    fn has(vm: &Vm) -> libjs_rust::api::ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {
        // 1. Let O be the this value, implementation-checked against A with identifier "has" and type "method".
        let (_, implementation, _cx) = this_implementation::<Self>(vm, "has", SecurityCheckType::Method)?;

        // 2. Let map be the map entries of the IDL value that represents a reference to O.
        let map = &implementation.entries;

        // 3. Let keyType be the key type specified in the maplike declaration.
        // 4. Let key be keyArg converted to an IDL value of type keyType.
        let key = to_dom_string(vm, vm.argument(0))?;

        // 5. If key is -0, set key to +0.
        // NB: DOMString conversion cannot produce a numeric -0 key.
        // 6. If map[key] exists, then return true; otherwise return false.
        Ok(Value::from_bool(map.borrow().iter().any(|entry| entry.0 == key)))
    }

    fn map_entries(&self, cx: &CallContext) -> Gc<Map> {
        let map_entries = Map::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm());
        for (key, value) in &*self.entries.borrow() {
            let key = key.clone().to_js(cx).expect("a string converts to a JS value");
            let value = Value::from_object(wrap(cx, *value));
            map_entries.map_set(cx.vm(), key, value);
        }
        map_entries
    }

    fn map_value(&self, cx: &CallContext, key: &Utf16String) -> Option<Value> {
        let entries = self.entries.borrow();
        let entry = entries.iter().find(|entry| &entry.0 == key)?;
        Some(Value::from_object(wrap(cx, entry.1)))
    }
}

use std::cell::Cell;
use std::sync::Arc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::audio_param_timeline::{AudioParamTimeline, InsertResult};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::render_node::RenderAudioParam;

use super::audio_node::AnyAudioNode;
use super::base_audio_context::{AnyBaseAudioContext, BaseAudioContext};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

pub(crate) use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::render_node::AutomationRate;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub(crate) enum FixedAutomationRate {
    No,
    Yes,
}

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#AudioParam
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct AudioParam {
    context: AnyBaseAudioContext,

    // An AudioParam is a facet of the AudioNode that exposes it, so holding on to the parameter keeps that node, and
    // with it the node's render node and automation, alive.
    owner: Cell<Option<AnyAudioNode>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    timeline: Arc<AudioParamTimeline>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    render_param: Arc<RenderAudioParam>,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-current-value-slot
    default_value: f32,
    min_value: f32,
    max_value: f32,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    automation_rate: Cell<AutomationRate>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    fixed_automation_rate: FixedAutomationRate,
}

impl Wrappable for AudioParam {}
fn clamp(value: f32, min: f32, max: f32) -> f32 {
    assert!(max >= min);
    if value > max {
        return max;
    }
    if value < min {
        return min;
    }
    value
}

fn max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { b } else { a }
}

impl AudioParam {
    // The owner is the AudioNode this parameter belongs to, or null for AudioListener parameters.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "preserve the C++ parameter initialization")]
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        owner: Option<AnyAudioNode>,
        default_value: f32,
        min_value: f32,
        max_value: f32,
        automation_rate: AutomationRate,
        fixed_automation_rate: FixedAutomationRate,
    ) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| {
            let timeline = Arc::new(AudioParamTimeline::new(default_value));
            let render_param = Arc::new(RenderAudioParam::new(
                Arc::clone(&timeline),
                min_value,
                max_value,
                automation_rate,
                BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
            ));
            Self {
                context,
                owner: Cell::new(owner),
                timeline,
                render_param,
                default_value,
                min_value,
                max_value,
                automation_rate: Cell::new(automation_rate),
                fixed_automation_rate,
            }
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_owner(&self, owner: AnyAudioNode) {
        self.owner.set(Some(owner));
    }

    pub(crate) fn context_value(&self) -> AnyBaseAudioContext {
        self.context
    }

    pub(crate) fn render_param(&self) -> &Arc<RenderAudioParam> {
        &self.render_param
    }

    fn current_time(&self) -> f64 {
        self.context.current_time_value()
    }

    fn context_error(&self, vm: &Vm, name: &'static str, message: &[u8]) -> Exception {
        let realm = self.context.realm();
        Exception::Thrown(Exception::Dom(name, Utf16String::from_ascii(message)).throw(&CallContext::new(vm, realm)))
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-value
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#simple-nominal-range
    pub(crate) fn value(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f32> {
        // Each AudioParam includes minValue and maxValue attributes that together form the simple nominal range
        // for the parameter. In effect, value of the parameter is clamped to the range [minValue, maxValue].
        Ok(clamp(self.timeline.current_value(), self.min_value, self.max_value))
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-value
    pub(crate) fn set_value(this: &Ref<Self>, cx: &mut CallContext, value: f32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // Setting this attribute has the effect of assigning the requested value to the [[current value]] slot, and calling
        // the setValueAtTime() method with the current AudioContext's currentTime and [[current value]].
        this.timeline.set_current_value(value);
        Self::set_value_at_time(this, cx, value, this.current_time())?;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#computedvalue
    pub(crate) fn intrinsic_value_at_time(&self, time: f64) -> f32 {
        self.timeline.value_at_time(time)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-automationrate
    pub(crate) fn automation_rate(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<AutomationRate> {
        Ok(self.automation_rate.get())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-automationrate
    pub(crate) fn set_automation_rate(&self, _: &mut CallContext, automation_rate: AutomationRate) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if automation_rate != self.automation_rate.get() && self.fixed_automation_rate == FixedAutomationRate::Yes {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Automation rate cannot be changed"),
            ));
        }
        self.automation_rate.set(automation_rate);
        self.render_param.set_automation_rate(automation_rate);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-defaultvalue
    pub(crate) fn default_value(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f32> {
        Ok(self.default_value)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-minvalue
    pub(crate) fn min_value(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f32> {
        Ok(self.min_value)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-maxvalue
    pub(crate) fn max_value(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f32> {
        Ok(self.max_value)
    }

    fn map_insert_result(&self, vm: &Vm, result: InsertResult) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        match result {
            InsertResult::Success => Ok(()),
            InsertResult::EventContainedInValueCurve => Err(self.context_error(
                vm,
                "NotSupportedError",
                b"Cannot schedule an automation event during a value curve",
            )),
            InsertResult::ValueCurveOverlapsEvent => Err(self.context_error(
                vm,
                "NotSupportedError",
                b"Cannot schedule a value curve containing an automation event",
            )),
        }
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-setvalueattime
    pub(crate) fn set_value_at_time(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        value: f32,
        mut start_time: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if startTime is negative or is not a finite number.
        if start_time < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("startTime must not be negative"));
        }

        // If startTime is less than currentTime, it is clamped to currentTime.
        start_time = max(start_time, this.current_time());
        this.map_insert_result(cx.vm(), this.timeline.set_value_at_time(value, start_time))?;
        Ok(*this)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-linearramptovalueattime
    pub(crate) fn linear_ramp_to_value_at_time(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        value: f32,
        mut end_time: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if endTime is negative or is not a finite number.
        if end_time < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("endTime must not be negative"));
        }

        // If endTime is less than currentTime, it is clamped to currentTime.
        let current_time = this.current_time();
        end_time = max(end_time, current_time);
        this.map_insert_result(
            cx.vm(),
            this.timeline
                .linear_ramp_to_value_at_time(value, end_time, current_time, this.timeline.current_value()),
        )?;
        Ok(*this)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-exponentialramptovalueattime
    pub(crate) fn exponential_ramp_to_value_at_time(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        value: f32,
        mut end_time: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if value is equal to 0.
        if value == 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("value must not be zero"));
        }

        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if endTime is negative or is not a finite number.
        if end_time < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("endTime must not be negative"));
        }

        // If endTime is less than currentTime, it is clamped to currentTime.
        let current_time = this.current_time();
        end_time = max(end_time, current_time);
        this.map_insert_result(
            cx.vm(),
            this.timeline.exponential_ramp_to_value_at_time(
                value,
                end_time,
                current_time,
                this.timeline.current_value(),
            ),
        )?;
        Ok(*this)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-settargetattime
    pub(crate) fn set_target_at_time(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        target: f32,
        mut start_time: f64,
        time_constant: f32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if startTime is negative or is not a finite number.
        if start_time < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("startTime must not be negative"));
        }

        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if timeConstant is negative or is not a finite number.
        if time_constant < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("timeConstant must not be negative"));
        }

        // If startTime is less than currentTime, it is clamped to currentTime.
        start_time = max(start_time, this.current_time());
        this.map_insert_result(
            cx.vm(),
            this.timeline.set_target_at_time(target, start_time, time_constant),
        )?;
        Ok(*this)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-setvaluecurveattime
    #[allow(
        clippy::redundant_clone,
        reason = "the C++ operation copies its borrowed sequence into the timeline"
    )]
    pub(crate) fn set_value_curve_at_time(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        values: Vec<f32>,
        mut start_time: f64,
        duration: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // An InvalidStateError exception MUST be thrown if values has a length less than 2.
        if values.len() < 2 {
            return Err(this.context_error(
                cx.vm(),
                "InvalidStateError",
                b"values must contain at least two elements",
            ));
        }

        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if startTime is negative or is not a finite number.
        if start_time < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("startTime must not be negative"));
        }

        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if duration is not strictly positive or is not a finite number.
        if duration <= 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("duration must be positive"));
        }

        // If startTime is less than currentTime, it is clamped to currentTime.
        start_time = max(start_time, this.current_time());
        this.map_insert_result(
            cx.vm(),
            this.timeline
                .set_value_curve_at_time(values.clone(), start_time, duration),
        )?;
        Ok(*this)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-cancelscheduledvalues
    pub(crate) fn cancel_scheduled_values(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        mut cancel_time: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if cancelTime is negative.
        if cancel_time < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("cancelTime must not be negative"));
        }

        // If cancelTime is less than currentTime, it is clamped to currentTime.
        cancel_time = max(cancel_time, this.current_time());
        this.timeline.cancel_scheduled_values(cancel_time);
        Ok(*this)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioparam-cancelandholdattime
    pub(crate) fn cancel_and_hold_at_time(
        this: &Ref<Self>,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        mut cancel_time: f64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if cancelTime is negative.
        if cancel_time < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("cancelTime must not be negative"));
        }

        // If cancelTime is less than currentTime, it is clamped to currentTime.
        cancel_time = max(cancel_time, this.current_time());
        this.timeline.cancel_and_hold_at_time(cancel_time);
        Ok(*this)
    }
}

    }

impl AudioProcessingEvent {

        vm: &Vm,
        event: CppEvent,
        playback_time: f64,

        output_buffer: Ref<AudioBuffer>,
    ) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            event,
            playback_time,
            input_buffer,
            output_buffer,
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,

            event_init_dict.parent.bubbles,
            event_init_dict.parent.cancelable,
            event_init_dict.parent.composed,
        );
        Ok(Self::create(
            cx.vm(),
            event,
            event_init_dict.playback_time,
            event_init_dict.input_buffer,
            event_init_dict.output_buffer,
        ))
    }

        &self.event
    }

    }

        Ok(self.input_buffer)
    }

    pub(crate) fn output_buffer(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioBuffer>> {
        Ok(self.output_buffer)
    }
}

use std::cell::Cell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::DeferGc;
use libjs_rust::api::Trace;
use libweb_rust::web_audio::control_message::ControlMessage;
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::node_message::{NodeMessage, StartSource, StopSource};

use super::audio_node::AudioNode;
use super::base_audio_context::{AnyBaseAudioContext, AudioContextState};
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#AudioScheduledSourceNode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct AudioScheduledSourceNode {
    node: AudioNode,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioscheduledsourcenode-source-started-slot
    source_started: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Inherits<AudioNode> for AudioScheduledSourceNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for AudioScheduledSourceNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        node.node.finalize_node();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for AudioScheduledSourceNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl AudioScheduledSourceNode {
    pub(crate) fn new(defer_gc: &DeferGc<'_>, context: AnyBaseAudioContext) -> Self {
        Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            source_started: Cell::new(false),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn source_started(&self) -> bool {
        self.source_started.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_source_started(&self, value: bool) {
        self.source_started.set(value);
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioscheduledsourcenode-start
    pub(crate) fn start(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, when: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If this AudioScheduledSourceNode internal slot [[source started]] is true, an InvalidStateError exception MUST be thrown.
        if self.source_started() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"AudioScheduledSourceNode source has already started"),
            ));
        }

        // 2. Check for any errors that must be thrown due to parameter constraints described below.
        //    If any exception is thrown during this step, abort those steps.
        //    A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if when is negative.
        if when < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("when must not be negative"));
        }

        // 3. Set the internal slot [[source started]] on this AudioScheduledSourceNode to true.
        self.set_source_started(true);

        // 4. Queue a control message to start the AudioScheduledSourceNode, including the parameter values in the message.
        self.node
            .context_value()
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::StartSource(StartSource {
                node_id: self.node.node_id(),
                when,
            })));
        self.node.context_value().add_playing_source(cx.vm(), self.node.this());

        // 5. Send a control message to the associated AudioContext to start running its rendering thread only when all the following conditions are met:
        //    1. The context’s [[control thread state]] is "suspended".
        //    2. The context is allowed to start.
        //    3. [[suspended by user]] flag is false.
        // AD-HOC: Sources in an OfflineAudioContext are scheduled by start() and rendered by startRendering().
        if let AnyBaseAudioContext::AudioContext(context) = self.node.context_value()
            && context.parent().control_state() == AudioContextState::Suspended
            && context.allowed_to_start()
            && !context.suspended_by_user()
            // AD-HOC: As in resume(), only start rendering while the context's document is fully active.
            && context.parent().document_is_fully_active()
        {
            // AD-HOC: Record startup now so another source started in the same task cannot request it again.
            context.parent().set_control_state(AudioContextState::Running);
            context.run_control_message_to_resume(cx.vm(), None);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioscheduledsourcenode-stop
    pub(crate) fn stop(&self, _: &mut CallContext, when: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If this AudioScheduledSourceNode internal slot [[source started]] is not true, an InvalidStateError exception MUST be thrown.
        if !self.source_started.get() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"AudioScheduledSourceNode source has not been started"),
            ));
        }

        // 2. Check for any errors that must be thrown due to parameter constraints described below.
        //    A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if when is negative.
        if when < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("when must not be negative"));
        }

        // 3. Queue a control message to stop the AudioScheduledSourceNode, including the parameter values in the message.
        self.node
            .context_value()
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::StopSource(StopSource {
                node_id: self.node.node_id(),
                when,
            })));
        Ok(())
    }
}

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#AudioWorkletNode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct AudioWorkletNode {
    node: AudioNode,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioworkletnode-audioworkletnode-context-name-options-name
    name: Utf16String,
    number_of_inputs: u32,
    number_of_outputs: u32,
    parameter_map: Ref<AudioParamMap>,
    parameter_names: Vec<Utf16String>, // descriptor order; keys for the `parameters` argument
    port: Ref<MessagePort>,
    scope: CppCell,
    processor: Cell<Option<Ref<AudioWorkletProcessor>>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pipe: RefCell<Option<Arc<AudioWorkletPipe>>>,
}

impl Inherits<AudioNode> for AudioWorkletNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for AudioWorkletNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        if let Some(pipe) = &*node.pipe.borrow() {
            pipe.set_client(None);
            pipe.set_state(WorkletPipeState::ShutDown);
        }
        node.node.finalize_node();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for AudioWorkletNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

pub(crate) struct AudioWorkletNodeOptions {
    pub parent: AudioNodeOptions,
    pub number_of_inputs: u32,
    pub number_of_outputs: u32,
    pub output_channel_count: Option<Vec<u32>>,
    pub parameter_data: Option<Vec<(Utf16String, f64)>>,
    pub processor_options: Option<Gc<Object>>,
}

struct AudioParamDescriptor {
    name: Utf16String,
    default_value: f32,
    min_value: f32,
    max_value: f32,
    automation_rate: AutomationRate,
}

#[derive(Trace)]

unsafe extern "C" {
