struct PumpClient {
    vm: NonNull<Vm>,

    // weak: the slot must not keep the node alive (see keep-alive notes)
    node: GcWeak<EmbedderCell<Wrapped<AudioWorkletNode>>>,
}

impl AudioWorkletPipeClient for PumpClient {
    fn pump(&self) {
        if let Some(node) = self.node.get() {
            // SAFETY: The VM of the control thread outlives its audio nodes.
            node.pump(unsafe { self.vm.as_ref() });
        }
    }
}

impl AudioWorkletNode {
    fn this(&self) -> Ref<Self> {
        let AnyAudioNode::AudioWorkletNode(node) = self.node.this() else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        node
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioworkletnode-audioworkletnode
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        name: Utf16String,
        options: AudioWorkletNodeOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. If nodeName does not exist as a key in the BaseAudioContext's node name to parameter descriptor
        //    map, throw an InvalidStateError exception and abort these steps.
        let worklet = context.audio_worklet_cell(vm);
        let mut descriptors = Vec::<AudioParamDescriptor>::new();
        unsafe extern "C" fn descriptor(
            context: *mut c_void,
            name: usize,
            default_value: f32,
            min_value: f32,
            max_value: f32,
            automation_rate: AutomationRate,
        ) {
            let name = unsafe { ak::Utf16FlyString::from_raw_borrowed(name) }.into();
            unsafe { &mut *context.cast::<Vec<AudioParamDescriptor>>() }.push(AudioParamDescriptor {
                name,
                default_value,
                min_value,
                max_value,
                automation_rate,
            });
        }
        if !unsafe {
            web_audio_worklet_find_definition(
                worklet.as_ptr(),
                name.raw_identity(),
                (&raw mut descriptors).cast(),
                descriptor,
            )
        } {
            let mut message: Vec<u16> = b"No AudioWorkletProcessor named '"
                .iter()
                .copied()
                .map(u16::from)
                .collect();
            message.extend_from_slice(&name.to_utf16());
            message.extend(b"' is registered".iter().copied().map(u16::from));
            return Err(Exception::Dom("InvalidStateError", Utf16String::from_utf16(&message)));
        }

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#configuring-channels-with-audioworkletnodeoptions
        // If both numberOfInputs and numberOfOutputs are zero, throw a NotSupportedError.
        if options.number_of_inputs == 0 && options.number_of_outputs == 0 {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"AudioWorkletNode must have at least one input or output"),
            ));
        }

        // If outputChannelCount exists: throw an IndexSizeError if its length does not equal numberOfOutputs;
        // throw a NotSupportedError if any entry is zero or greater than the supported maximum.
        if let Some(output_channel_count) = &options.output_channel_count {
            if output_channel_count.len() != options.number_of_outputs as usize {
                return Err(Exception::Dom(
                    "IndexSizeError",
                    Utf16String::from_ascii(b"outputChannelCount length must equal numberOfOutputs"),
                ));
            }
            for channel_count in output_channel_count {
                if *channel_count == 0 || *channel_count > BaseAudioContext::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS {
                    return Err(Exception::Dom(
                        "NotSupportedError",
                        Utf16String::from_ascii(b"outputChannelCount entries must be between 1 and 32"),
                    ));
                }
            }
        }
        let scope = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(web_audio_worklet_global_scope(worklet.as_ptr())) };
        let worklet_realm: Gc<Realm> =
            unsafe { Gc::from_non_null(NonNull::new(web_audio_worklet_scope_realm(scope.as_ptr()).cast()).unwrap()) };

        // 2. Let node be this value; initialize node's AudioNode base with context and options.
        let parameter_map = AudioParamMap::create(vm);
        let node_port = MessagePort::create(vm, context.realm());
        let node = allocate(vm, |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            name,
            number_of_inputs: options.number_of_inputs,
            number_of_outputs: options.number_of_outputs,
            parameter_map,
            parameter_names: descriptors.iter().map(|descriptor| descriptor.name.clone()).collect(),
            port: node_port,
            scope: scope.clone(),
            processor: Cell::new(None),
            pipe: RefCell::new(None),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::AudioWorkletNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Max,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;

        // 3. Let map be a new AudioParamMap; for each descriptor in the parameter descriptors, create an
        //    AudioParam and append it to map; apply parameterData overrides.
        for descriptor in &descriptors {
            let param = AudioParam::create(
                vm,
                context,
                Some(AnyAudioNode::AudioWorkletNode(node)),
                descriptor.default_value,
                descriptor.min_value,
                descriptor.max_value,
                descriptor.automation_rate,
                FixedAutomationRate::No,
            );
            if let Some(parameter_data) = &options.parameter_data {
                if let Some(entry) = parameter_data.iter().find(|entry| entry.0 == descriptor.name) {
                    AudioParam::set_value(&param, cx, entry.1 as f32)?;
                }
            }
            parameter_map.set_entry(vm, descriptor.name.clone(), param);
        }

        // 4. Let messageChannel be a new MessageChannel (collapsed): node.port and the processor's port are
        //    entangled; node.port's message queue is enabled immediately. The processor-side port stays
        //    disabled until the processor constructor has returned, so messages posted before (or during)
        //    construction are queued and delivered to listeners the constructor registered — even ones added
        //    with addEventListener() and no explicit start().
        let processor_port = MessagePort::create(vm, worklet_realm);
        MessagePort::entangle(vm, node_port, processor_port);
        MessagePort::enable(node_port, vm);

        // 5. Let serializedProcessorOptions be StructuredSerialize(optionsObject's processorOptions).
        // 6-7. (Deserialization happens into the worklet realm when building the processor's options object.)
        let mut cloned_processor_options = None;
        if let Some(processor_options) = options.processor_options {
            let value = unsafe {
                web_audio_worklet_clone_options(
                    (vm as *const Vm).cast_mut().cast(),
                    worklet_realm.as_ptr().cast(),
                    cx.realm().as_ptr().cast(),
                    processor_options.as_ptr().cast(),
                )
            }
            .into_completion()?;
            assert!(value.is_object());
            cloned_processor_options = Some(value.as_object());
        }
        let options_object = Object::create(vm, worklet_realm, Some(worklet_realm.intrinsics().object_prototype(vm)));
        options_object
            .create_data_property(
                vm,
                &PropertyKey::from_utf8("numberOfInputs"),
                Value::from_f64(f64::from(options.number_of_inputs)),
                None,
                None,
            )
            .expect("a new options object accepts a property");
        options_object
            .create_data_property(
                vm,
                &PropertyKey::from_utf8("numberOfOutputs"),
                Value::from_f64(f64::from(options.number_of_outputs)),
                None,
                None,
            )
            .expect("a new options object accepts a property");
        if let Some(output_channel_count) = &options.output_channel_count {
            let array = Array::create(vm, worklet_realm, output_channel_count.len() as u64, None)
                .expect("an output-channel array is created");
            for (index, channel_count) in output_channel_count.iter().enumerate() {
                array
                    .create_data_property(
                        vm,
                        &PropertyKey::from(index as u32),
                        Value::from_f64(f64::from(*channel_count)),
                        None,
                        None,
                    )
                    .expect("a new array accepts a property");
            }
            options_object
                .create_data_property(
                    vm,
                    &PropertyKey::from_utf8("outputChannelCount"),
                    Value::from_object(array),
                    None,
                    None,
                )
                .expect("a new options object accepts a property");
        }
        if let Some(parameter_data) = &options.parameter_data {
            let data = Object::create(vm, worklet_realm, Some(worklet_realm.intrinsics().object_prototype(vm)));
            for (key, value) in parameter_data {
                data.create_data_property(
                    vm,
                    &PropertyKey::from_utf16_string(key),
                    Value::from_f64(*value),
                    None,
                    None,
                )
                .expect("a new parameter-data object accepts a property");
            }
            options_object
                .create_data_property(
                    vm,
                    &PropertyKey::from_utf8("parameterData"),
                    Value::from_object(data),
                    None,
                    None,
                )
                .expect("a new options object accepts a property");
        }

        // processorOptions is always present; when omitted by the caller, Web Audio specifies an empty object.
        let processor_options = cloned_processor_options.unwrap_or_else(|| {
            Object::create(vm, worklet_realm, Some(worklet_realm.intrinsics().object_prototype(vm)))
        });
        options_object
            .create_data_property(
                vm,
                &PropertyKey::from_utf8("processorOptions"),
                Value::from_object(processor_options),
                None,
                None,
            )
            .expect("a new options object accepts a property");

        // Reserve space for later input layout changes without allocating on the render thread.
        let input_channel_capacity = vec![BaseAudioContext::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS; options.number_of_inputs as usize];
        let output_channel_count_matches_input =
            options.number_of_inputs == 1 && options.number_of_outputs == 1 && options.output_channel_count.is_none();
        let mut output_channel_capacity = Vec::new();
        for index in 0..options.number_of_outputs as usize {
            if let Some(counts) = &options.output_channel_count {
                output_channel_capacity.push(counts[index]);
            } else {
                output_channel_capacity.push(if output_channel_count_matches_input {
                    BaseAudioContext::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS
                } else {
                    1
                });
            }
        }
        let mut param_is_a_rate = Vec::new();
        for descriptor in &descriptors {
            param_is_a_rate.push(descriptor.automation_rate == AutomationRate::ARate);
        }
        let sizing = ring_sizing_for_device_latency(
            100,
            context.sample_rate_value(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
        );
        let pipe = AudioWorkletPipe::new(Config {
            quantum_size: BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
            input_count: options.number_of_inputs as usize,
            output_count: options.number_of_outputs as usize,
            input_channel_capacity,
            output_channel_capacity: output_channel_capacity.clone(),
            output_channel_count_matches_input,
            param_count: descriptors.len(),
            param_is_a_rate,
            ring_capacity: sizing.ring_capacity,
            prime_level: sizing.prime_level,
        });
        unsafe { pipe.prime_outputs_with_silence(sizing.prime_level) };
        *node.pipe.borrow_mut() = Some(Arc::clone(&pipe));
        pipe.set_client(Some(Rc::new(PumpClient {
            vm: NonNull::from(vm),
            node: GcWeak::new(vm.heap(), node),
        })));

        // Create the render mirror. Channel configuration rides in the constructor (the graph drops
        // SetChannelConfig messages that precede AddNode).
        let render_params: Vec<Arc<RenderAudioParam>> = parameter_map
            .values(vm)
            .values()
            .iter()
            .map(|param| Arc::clone(param.render_param()))
            .collect();
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(create_audio_worklet_render_node(
            node.node.node_id(),
            options.number_of_inputs as usize,
            options.number_of_outputs as usize,
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
            &output_channel_capacity,
            node.node.channel_count_value() as usize,
            node.node.channel_count_mode(cx)?,
            node.node.channel_interpretation(cx)?,
            Arc::clone(&pipe),
            render_params,
        ));

        // FIXME: Implement the spec's actively-processing keep-alive (drop this when the processor's
        //        process() return value has been false and inputs are silent). For now a live worklet
        //        node stays registered with the context until the context goes away.
        context.add_playing_source(vm, AnyAudioNode::AudioWorkletNode(node));

        // 8. Queue a control message to invoke the constructor of the corresponding AudioWorkletProcessor.
        // NOTE: The worklet shares the window agent's event loop, so the control message becomes a queued
        //       global task on the worklet global; the node constructor returns before user code runs.
        let task = PROCESSOR_CONSTRUCTION_TASK_CLASS.allocate(vm, |_| ProcessorConstructionTask {
            node,
            scope,
            processor_port,
            options_object,
        });
        queue_a_global_task(
            vm,
            worklet_realm.global_object(),
            TaskSource::DOMManipulation,
            task,
            |vm, task| {
                task.node
                    .invoke_processor_constructor(vm, &task.scope, task.processor_port, task.options_object);
            },
        );
        Ok(node)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#invoking-processor-constructor
    fn invoke_processor_constructor(
        &self,
        vm: &Vm,
        scope: &CppCell,
        processor_port: Ref<MessagePort>,
        options_object: Gc<Object>,
    ) {
        // 1. Let constructionData be the processor construction data transferred from the control thread.
        // 2. Let processorName, nodeReference and serializedPort be constructionData’s name, node, and port respectively.
        // 3. Let serializedOptions be constructionData’s options.
        // 4. Let deserializedPort be the result of StructuredDeserialize(serializedPort, the current Realm).
        // 5. Let deserializedOptions be the result of StructuredDeserialize(serializedOptions, the current Realm).
        // NB: The queued task carries the construction data with the port and options already deserialized.
        let worklet_realm: Gc<Realm> =
            unsafe { Gc::from_non_null(NonNull::new(web_audio_worklet_scope_realm(scope.as_ptr()).cast()).unwrap()) };
        with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(worklet_realm, || {
            // 6. Let processorCtor be the result of looking up processorName on the AudioWorkletGlobalScope’s node name to processor constructor map.
            let processor_ctor: Gc<FunctionObject> = unsafe {
                Gc::from_non_null(
                    NonNull::new(
                        web_audio_worklet_processor_constructor(scope.as_ptr(), self.name.raw_identity()).cast(),
                    )
                    .unwrap(),
                )
            };

            // 7. Store nodeReference and deserializedPort to node reference and transferred port of this AudioWorkletGlobalScope’s pending processor construction data respectively.
            unsafe {
                web_audio_worklet_set_pending_data(
                    scope.as_ptr(),
                    cell_into_abi(self.this()),
                    cell_into_abi(processor_port),
                );
            };

            // 8. Construct a callback function from processorCtor with the argument of deserializedOptions. If any exceptions are thrown in the callback, queue a task to the control thread to fire an event named processorerror at nodeReference using ErrorEvent.
            // AD-HOC: A constructor that returns an object other than an AudioWorkletProcessor fails with a TypeError.
            let constructed =
                construct(vm, processor_ctor, &[Value::from_object(options_object)], None).and_then(|object| {
                    implementation_if_wrapper::<AudioWorkletProcessor>(object).ok_or_else(|| {
                        vm.throw_completion_with_message::<()>(
                            ErrorKind::TypeError,
                            "The processor constructor did not return an AudioWorkletProcessor".to_string(),
                        )
                        .unwrap_err()
                    })
                });
            let processor = match constructed {
                Ok(processor) => Some(processor),
                Err(error) => {
                    self.pipe.borrow().as_ref().unwrap().set_state(WorkletPipeState::Failed);
                    self.fire_processor_error(error.value());
                    None
                }
            };

            // 9. Empty the pending processor construction data slot.
            unsafe { web_audio_worklet_clear_pending_data(scope.as_ptr()) };
            let Some(processor) = processor else {
                return;
            };
            self.processor.set(Some(processor));
            self.node
                .context_value()
                .add_audio_worklet_pipe(Arc::clone(self.pipe.borrow().as_ref().unwrap()));

            // NB: Defer incoming messages until the constructor can register listeners.
            MessagePort::enable(processor_port, vm);
        });
    }

    // Drains one node's input ring, runs its processor's process() per quantum, and pushes the
    // results back. Scheduled (coalesced) by the render thread via the pipe's wakeup callback.
    fn pump(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        let pipe = Arc::clone(self.pipe.borrow().as_ref().expect("a pumped node has a pipe"));

        // Every invocation consumes its scheduled wakeup, including stale callbacks for removed slots.
        pipe.clear_wakeup_flag();
        let Some(processor) = self.processor.get() else {
            return;
        };
        if pipe.state() == WorkletPipeState::ShutDown || !processor.callable_process.get() {
            return;
        }

        let realm: Gc<Realm> = unsafe {
            Gc::from_non_null(NonNull::new(web_audio_worklet_scope_realm(self.scope.as_ptr()).cast()).unwrap())
        };

        // Keep one execution context for the batch so its microtask checkpoint runs after all available quanta.
        with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(realm, || {
            // 4.4.4.2. Let O be the ECMAScript object corresponding to processor.
            let processor_object = wrap(&CallContext::new(vm, realm), processor);
            let config = &pipe.config;
            loop {
                if pipe.output_occupancy() == config.ring_capacity {
                    break;
                }
                let mut processed_one = false;
                let mut pump_error = None;
                let mut output_full = false;

                let _ = unsafe {
                    pipe.try_read_input(|input_slot| {
                        processed_one = true;

                        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#rendering-loop — currentFrame/currentTime
                        // reflect the block being processed.
                        web_audio_worklet_set_current_frame(self.scope.as_ptr(), input_slot.start_frame());

                        // The processor may detach channel arrays, so they cannot be reused without checking their buffers.
                        // FIXME: Reuse arrays that remain attached.
                        let build_channel_array =
                            |channel_count: usize, fill_channel: &dyn Fn(usize, &TypedArrayBase)| {
                                let channels = Array::create(vm, realm, channel_count as u64, None)
                                    .expect("a channel array is created");
                                for channel in 0..channel_count {
                                    let float32_array = create_typed_array(
                                        vm,
                                        realm,
                                        TypedArrayKind::Float32Array,
                                        config.quantum_size,
                                    )
                                    .expect("a channel's Float32Array is created");
                                    fill_channel(channel, &float32_array);
                                    channels
                                        .create_data_property(
                                            vm,
                                            &PropertyKey::from(channel as u32),
                                            Value::from_object(float32_array),
                                            None,
                                            None,
                                        )
                                        .expect("a new array accepts a property");
                                }
                                channels
                            };

                        let inputs = Array::create(vm, realm, config.input_count as u64, None)
                            .expect("the inputs array is created");
                        for input in 0..config.input_count {
                            let channels = build_channel_array(
                                input_slot.actual_channel_count(input) as usize,
                                &|channel, float32_array| {
                                    overwrite_float32_array(float32_array, input_slot.input_channel(input, channel));
                                },
                            );
                            inputs
                                .create_data_property(
                                    vm,
                                    &PropertyKey::from(input as u32),
                                    Value::from_object(channels),
                                    None,
                                    None,
                                )
                                .expect("a new array accepts a property");
                        }

                        let output_channel_count = |output: usize| -> usize {
                            if config.output_channel_count_matches_input {
                                return (input_slot.actual_channel_count(0) as usize).max(1);
                            }
                            config.output_channel_capacity[output] as usize
                        };
                        let outputs = Array::create(vm, realm, config.output_count as u64, None)
                            .expect("the outputs array is created");
                        let output_channel_arrays = MarkedVec::with_capacity(vm, config.output_count);
                        for output in 0..config.output_count {
                            let channels = build_channel_array(output_channel_count(output), &|_, _| {});
                            output_channel_arrays.push(channels);
                            outputs
                                .create_data_property(
                                    vm,
                                    &PropertyKey::from(output as u32),
                                    Value::from_object(channels),
                                    None,
                                    None,
                                )
                                .expect("a new array accepts a property");
                        }

                        let parameters = Object::create(vm, realm, Some(realm.intrinsics().object_prototype(vm)));
                        for param_index in 0..config.param_count {
                            let block = input_slot.param_block(param_index);
                            let float32_array =
                                create_typed_array(vm, realm, TypedArrayKind::Float32Array, block.len())
                                    .expect("a parameter's Float32Array is created");
                            overwrite_float32_array(&float32_array, block);
                            parameters
                                .create_data_property(
                                    vm,
                                    &PropertyKey::from_utf16_string(&self.parameter_names[param_index]),
                                    Value::from_object(float32_array),
                                    None,
                                    None,
                                )
                                .expect("a new parameters object accepts a property");
                        }

                        // 4.4.4.7. Let getResult be Get(O, "process").
                        let process_value = match processor_object.get(vm, &PropertyKey::from_utf8("process")) {
                            Ok(value) if value.is_function() => value,
                            Ok(_) => {
                                let error = vm
                                    .throw_completion_with_message::<()>(
                                        ErrorKind::TypeError,
                                        "AudioWorkletProcessor.process must be a function".to_string(),
                                    )
                                    .unwrap_err();
                                pump_error = Some(error.value());
                                return;
                            }
                            Err(error) => {
                                pump_error = Some(error.value());
                                return;
                            }
                        };

                        // 4.4.4.11. Set [[callable process]] to true.
                        processor.callable_process.set(true);

                        let process_arguments = [
                            Value::from_object(inputs),
                            Value::from_object(outputs),
                            Value::from_object(parameters),
                        ];
                        let result = match call(
                            vm,
                            process_value,
                            Value::from_object(processor_object),
                            &process_arguments,
                        ) {
                            Ok(result) => result,
                            Err(error) => {
                                pump_error = Some(error.value());
                                return;
                            }
                        };

                        if pipe.state() == WorkletPipeState::ShutDown {
                            return;
                        }

                        let processor_active = result.to_boolean();

                        // Push the processed quantum back; read outputs defensively (detached → silence).
                        let pushed = pipe.try_write_output(|output_slot| {
                            output_slot.set_start_frame(input_slot.start_frame());
                            output_slot.set_processor_active(processor_active);
                            for output in 0..config.output_count {
                                let channel_count = output_channel_count(output);
                                output_slot.set_actual_channel_count(output, channel_count as u32);
                                let channels = output_channel_arrays.get(output).unwrap();
                                for channel in 0..channel_count {
                                    let destination = output_slot.output_channel(output, channel);
                                    let channel_value = channels
                                        .get(vm, &PropertyKey::from(channel as u32))
                                        .expect("a channel array's element is a data property");
                                    let float32_array = channel_value
                                        .is_object()
                                        .then(|| channel_value.as_object().downcast::<TypedArrayBase>())
                                        .flatten()
                                        .filter(|array| array.kind() == TypedArrayKind::Float32Array);
                                    let Some(float32_array) = float32_array.filter(|array| {
                                        !array.viewed_array_buffer().is_detached()
                                            && float32_array_length(array) >= config.quantum_size
                                    }) else {
                                        destination.fill(0.);
                                        continue;
                                    };
                                    let bytes = ak::slice_from_raw_parts_mut(
                                        destination.as_mut_ptr().cast::<u8>(),
                                        size_of_val(destination),
                                    );
                                    float32_array
                                        .viewed_array_buffer()
                                        .copy_to(float32_array.byte_offset(), bytes);
                                }
                            }
                        });
                        if !pushed {
                            output_full = true;
                        }
                    })
                };

                // 4.4.4.13.3. If completion is an abrupt completion:
                if let Some(error) = pump_error {
                    // 4.4.4.13.3.1. Set [[callable process]] to false.
                    processor.callable_process.set(false);

                    // 4.4.4.13.3.2. Set processor’s active source flag to false.
                    // 4.4.4.13.3.3. Make a silent output buffer available for reading.
                    // NB: A failed pipe renders silence.
                    pipe.set_state(WorkletPipeState::Failed);

                    // 4.4.4.13.3.4. Queue a task to the control thread to fire an event named processorerror at the associated AudioWorkletNode using ErrorEvent.
                    processor.node_reference.fire_processor_error(error);
                    return;
                }
                if pipe.state() == WorkletPipeState::ShutDown {
                    return;
                }
                if output_full {
                    break;
                }
                if !processed_one {
                    break;
                }
            }
        });
    }

    pub(crate) fn fire_processor_error(&self, error: Value) {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioworkletnode-onprocessorerror
        // "...the processor will queue a task to fire an event named processorerror using ErrorEvent at the
        //  associated AudioWorkletNode."
        unsafe {
            web_audio_worklet_queue_processor_error(
                cell_into_abi(self.this()),
                self.node.event_target().as_ptr(),
                self.node.context_value().global_event_target().as_ptr(),
                error.to_raw(),
            );
        };
    }

    pub(crate) fn parameters(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParamMap>> {
        Ok(self.parameter_map)
    }

    pub(crate) fn port(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<MessagePort>> {
        Ok(self.port)
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_inputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        self.number_of_inputs
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_outputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        self.number_of_outputs
    }
}

use core::cell::Cell;
use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace};

use super::audio_worklet_node::AudioWorkletNode;
use crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate, cell_from_abi};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};
use crate::html::message_port::MessagePort;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_audio_processor_global_scope(realm: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_audio_processor_pending_node_reference(scope: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_audio_processor_pending_transferred_port(scope: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_audio_worklet_clear_pending_data(scope: *mut c_void);
    fn web_audio_processor_scope_realm(scope: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
}

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#AudioWorkletProcessor
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct AudioWorkletProcessor {
    global_scope: CppCell,
    pub(super) node_reference: Ref<AudioWorkletNode>,
    pub(super) callable_process: Cell<bool>,
    port: Ref<MessagePort>,
}

impl Wrappable for AudioWorkletProcessor {
    // Ensures wrappers for this processor are created in the worklet realm, not the page realm.
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        // Pin wrapper creation to the worklet realm.
        let realm = unsafe { web_audio_processor_scope_realm(self.global_scope.as_ptr()) };
        Some(unsafe { Gc::from_non_null(NonNull::new(realm.cast::<Realm>()).unwrap()) })
    }
}

impl AudioWorkletProcessor {
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audioworkletprocessor-audioworkletprocessor
    pub(crate) fn construct(cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let global_scope = unsafe { web_audio_processor_global_scope(cx.realm().as_ptr().cast()) };
        if global_scope.is_null() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "AudioWorkletProcessor can only be constructed in an AudioWorkletGlobalScope",
            ));
        }
        // 1. Let nodeReference be the result of looking up node reference on the pending processor construction data of the current AudioWorkletGlobalScope. Throw a TypeError exception if the slot is empty.
        let node_reference = unsafe { web_audio_processor_pending_node_reference(global_scope) };
        if node_reference.is_null() {
            return Err(Exception::type_error(
                "AudioWorkletProcessor cannot be constructed directly; it is instantiated by AudioWorkletNode",
            ));
        }
        let node_reference = unsafe { cell_from_abi::<AudioWorkletNode>(node_reference) };

        // 2. Let processor be the this value.
        let processor = allocate(cx.vm(), |_| Self {
            global_scope: unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(global_scope) },

            // 3. Set processor’s [[node reference]] to nodeReference.
            node_reference,

            // 4. Set processor’s [[callable process]] to true.
            callable_process: Cell::new(true),

            // 5. Let deserializedPort be the result of looking up transferred port from the pending processor construction data.
            port: {
                let deserialized_port =
                    unsafe { cell_from_abi::<MessagePort>(web_audio_processor_pending_transferred_port(global_scope)) };
                // 6. Set processor’s port to deserializedPort.
                deserialized_port
            },
        });

        // 7. Empty the pending processor construction data slot.
        unsafe { web_audio_worklet_clear_pending_data(global_scope) };
        Ok(processor)
    }

    pub(crate) fn port(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<MessagePort>> {
        Ok(self.port)
    }
}

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#BaseAudioContext
pub(crate) struct BaseAudioContext {
    event_target: CppEventTarget,
    pub(crate) destination: Cell<Option<Ref<AudioDestinationNode>>>,
    pub(crate) pending_promises: GcRefCell<Vec<WebIdlPromise>>,
    next_node_id: Cell<u64>,
    sample_rate: Cell<f32>,
    pub(crate) listener: Cell<Option<Ref<AudioListener>>>,
    global_object: CppCell,
    state: Cell<AudioContextState>,
    control_thread_state: Cell<AudioContextState>,
    rendering_thread_state: Cell<AudioContextState>,
    media_element_event_task_source: MediaElementTaskSource,
    document_observer: GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,
    audio_worklet: GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,
    control_message_queue: Arc<ControlMessageQueue>,
    playing_sources: GcRefCell<Vec<(u64, AnyAudioNode)>>,
    script_processor_nodes: RefCell<Vec<GcWeak<EmbedderCell<Wrapped<ScriptProcessorNode>>>>>,
    audio_worklet_pipes: RefCell<Vec<Arc<AudioWorkletPipe>>>,

    // Kept alive only while they can still produce audio; see visit_edges().
    media_stream_sources: RefCell<Vec<GcWeak<EmbedderCell<Wrapped<MediaStreamAudioSourceNode>>>>>,
    this: Cell<Option<AnyBaseAudioContext>>,
}

// SAFETY: This traces the context’s strong edges and the weak nodes it keeps alive while rendering.
unsafe impl Trace for BaseAudioContext {
    fn trace(&self, visitor: &mut Visitor) {
        self.event_target.trace(visitor);
        self.destination.trace(visitor);
        self.pending_promises.trace(visitor);
        self.listener.trace(visitor);
        self.global_object.trace(visitor);
        self.document_observer.trace(visitor);
        self.audio_worklet.trace(visitor);
        self.playing_sources.trace(visitor);
        self.this.trace(visitor);
        if self.control_thread_state.get() == AudioContextState::Closed {
            return;
        }

        // INTEROP: Blink keeps a ScriptProcessorNode with audioprocess listeners alive until its context is cleared
        //          (ScriptProcessorNode::HasPendingActivity()), whether it is connected or not, so that a node script only
        //          reaches through its listener keeps producing audio.
        for node in &*self.script_processor_nodes.borrow() {
            if let Some(node) = node.get() {
                if node.parent().event_target().has_event_listener("audioprocess") {
                    node.trace(visitor);
                }
            }
        }

        // Keep a source and the nodes it feeds alive while its track is live, even after script drops the source.
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#AudioNode-actively-processing
        // NB: A muted or disabled track only pauses its source, so it stays alive as well.
        for source in &*self.media_stream_sources.borrow() {
            if let Some(source) = source.get() {
                if source.has_live_input_track() {
                    source.trace(visitor);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Wrappable for BaseAudioContext {
    const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event_target.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for BaseAudioContext {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

impl BaseAudioContext {
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createbuffer-numberofchannels
    // > An implementation MUST support at least 32 channels.
    // Other browsers appear to only allow 32 channels - so let's limit ourselves to that too.
    pub(crate) const MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS: u32 = libweb_rust::web_audio::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS as u32;

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#sample-rates
    // Implementations MUST support sample rates between 3000 Hz and 768000 Hz, inclusive. A NotSupportedError MUST
    // be thrown if a sample rate outside this range is specified.
    pub(crate) const MIN_SAMPLE_RATE: f32 = 3000.;
    pub(crate) const MAX_SAMPLE_RATE: f32 = 768000.;

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#render-quantum-size
    pub(crate) const RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE: u32 = 128;

    pub(crate) fn new(_defer_gc: &DeferGc<'_>, global_object: CppCell, sample_rate: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            event_target: CppEventTarget::new(),
            destination: Cell::new(None),
            pending_promises: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            next_node_id: Cell::new(0),
            sample_rate: Cell::new(sample_rate),
            listener: Cell::new(None),
            global_object,
            state: Cell::new(AudioContextState::Suspended),
            control_thread_state: Cell::new(AudioContextState::Suspended),
            rendering_thread_state: Cell::new(AudioContextState::Suspended),
            media_element_event_task_source: MediaElementTaskSource(
                NonNull::new(unsafe { web_audio_context_create_task_source() }).unwrap(),
            ),
            document_observer: GcRefCell::new(None),
            audio_worklet: GcRefCell::new(None),
            control_message_queue: Arc::new(ControlMessageQueue::default()),
            playing_sources: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            script_processor_nodes: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            audio_worklet_pipes: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            media_stream_sources: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            this: Cell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn initialize(&self, vm: &Vm, this: AnyBaseAudioContext) {
        self.this.set(Some(this));
        let observer = unsafe { web_audio_context_observe_document(self.global_object.as_ptr(), this.as_abi()) };
        if !observer.is_null() {
            *self.document_observer.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(observer) });
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn this(&self) -> AnyBaseAudioContext {
        self.this.get().expect("a context knows itself after allocation")
    }

    pub(crate) fn event_target(&self) -> &CppEventTarget {
        &self.event_target
    }

    pub(crate) fn global_event_target(&self) -> &CppCell {
        &self.global_object
    }

    pub(crate) fn realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        unsafe {
            Gc::from_non_null(NonNull::new(web_audio_context_global_realm(self.global_object.as_ptr()).cast()).unwrap())
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn global(&self) -> Gc<Object> {
        unsafe {
            Gc::from_non_null(
                NonNull::new(web_audio_context_global_wrapper(self.global_object.as_ptr()).cast()).unwrap(),
            )
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn document_is_fully_active(&self) -> bool {
        unsafe { web_audio_context_document_is_fully_active(self.global_object.as_ptr()) }
    }

    pub(crate) fn navigable_is_destroyed(&self) -> bool {
        unsafe { web_audio_context_navigable_is_destroyed(self.global_object.as_ptr()) }
    }

    pub(crate) fn sample_rate_value(&self) -> f32 {
        self.sample_rate.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_sample_rate(&self, sample_rate: f32) {
        self.sample_rate.set(sample_rate);
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#--nyquist-frequency
    pub(crate) fn nyquist_frequency(&self) -> f32 {
        self.sample_rate.get() / 2.
    }

    pub(crate) fn state_value(&self) -> AudioContextState {
        self.state.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_state(&self, state: AudioContextState) {
        self.state.set(state);
    }

    pub(crate) fn control_state(&self) -> AudioContextState {
        self.control_thread_state.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_control_state(&self, state: AudioContextState) {
        self.control_thread_state.set(state);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_rendering_state(&self, state: AudioContextState) {
        self.rendering_thread_state.set(state);
    }

    pub(crate) fn destination_value(&self) -> Ref<AudioDestinationNode> {
        self.destination.get().expect("a context has a destination")
    }

    pub(crate) fn listener_value(&self) -> Ref<AudioListener> {
        self.listener.get().expect("a context has a listener")
    }

    pub(crate) fn control_message_queue(&self) -> &Arc<ControlMessageQueue> {
        &self.control_message_queue
    }

    pub(crate) fn next_node_id(&self) -> u64 {
        let id = self.next_node_id.get() + 1;
        self.next_node_id.set(id);
        id
    }

    pub(crate) fn queue_control_message(&self, message: ControlMessage) {
        self.control_message_queue.enqueue(message);

        // FIXME: Should signal the rendering thread when implemented
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_playing_source(&self, vm: &Vm, node: AnyAudioNode) {
        let mut sources = self.playing_sources.borrow_mut(vm);
        if let Some(entry) = sources.iter_mut().find(|entry| entry.0 == node.node_id()) {
            entry.1 = node;
        } else {
            sources.push((node.node_id(), node));
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_script_processor_node(&self, vm: &Vm, node: Ref<ScriptProcessorNode>) {
        let mut nodes = self.script_processor_nodes.borrow_mut();
        nodes.retain(|node| node.get().is_some());
        if !nodes.iter().any(|entry| entry.get() == Some(node)) {
            nodes.push(GcWeak::new(vm.heap(), node));
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_media_stream_source(&self, vm: &Vm, source: Ref<MediaStreamAudioSourceNode>) {
        let mut sources = self.media_stream_sources.borrow_mut();
        sources.retain(|source| source.get().is_some());
        if !sources.iter().any(|entry| entry.get() == Some(source)) {
            sources.push(GcWeak::new(vm.heap(), source));
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_ended_sources(&self, vm: &Vm, ended_nodes: &[u64]) {
        for node_id in ended_nodes {
            let node = {
                let mut sources = self.playing_sources.borrow_mut(vm);
                sources
                    .iter()
                    .position(|entry| entry.0 == *node_id)
                    .map(|index| sources.remove(index).1)
            };
            let Some(node) = node else {
                continue;
            };
            self.queue_a_media_element_task(vm, node, |_, node| {
                node.event_target().dispatch_event(&CppEvent::create(
                    node.context_value().realm(),
                    "ended",
                    false,
                    false,
                    false,
                ));
            });
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn queue_a_media_element_task<C: Trace + Copy + 'static>(
        &self,
        vm: &Vm,
        captures: C,
        steps: fn(&Vm, C),
    ) {
        // Rendering completion callbacks run from the audio thread, outside any
        // JavaScript execution context. Resolve the task target from this context's
        // associated global rather than consulting the thread-local current ESO.
        let cell = pending_steps(vm, captures, steps);
        unsafe {
            web_audio_context_queue_task(
                self.media_element_event_task_source.0.as_ptr(),
                self.global_object.as_ptr(),
                cell,
                run_pending_steps,
            );
        };
    }

    pub(crate) fn dispatch_statechange(&self) {
        self.event_target
            .dispatch_event(&CppEvent::create(self.realm(), "statechange", false, false, false));
    }

    pub(crate) fn audio_worklet_cell(&self, vm: &Vm) -> CppCell {
        if self.audio_worklet.borrow().is_none() {
            let worklet = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(web_audio_context_get_worklet(self.this().as_abi())) };
            *self.audio_worklet.borrow_mut(vm) = Some(worklet);
        }
        self.audio_worklet.borrow().as_ref().unwrap().clone()
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-audioworklet
    pub(crate) fn audio_worklet(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CppInterface> {
        let worklet = self.audio_worklet_cell(cx.vm());
        let wrapper = unsafe { web_audio_context_wrap_worklet(cx.realm().as_ptr().cast(), worklet.as_ptr()) };
        Ok(unsafe { CppInterface::from_wrapper(Gc::<Object>::from_non_null(NonNull::new(wrapper.cast()).unwrap())) })
    }

    pub(crate) fn add_audio_worklet_pipe(&self, pipe: Arc<AudioWorkletPipe>) {
        let mut pipes = self.audio_worklet_pipes.borrow_mut();
        pipes.retain(|pipe| pipe.state() != WorkletPipeState::ShutDown);
        pipes.push(pipe);
    }

    // Marks every worklet node's pipe shut down and drops the pump slots; called when the context
    // closes or its document stops being fully active.
    pub(crate) fn shutdown_audio_worklet(&self) {
        for pipe in self.audio_worklet_pipes.take() {
            pipe.set_client(None);
            pipe.set_state(WorkletPipeState::ShutDown);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn destination(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioDestinationNode>> {
        Ok(self.destination_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn sample_rate(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f32> {
        Ok(self.sample_rate_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn listener(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioListener>> {
        Ok(self.listener_value())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-state
    pub(crate) fn state(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<AudioContextState> {
        // Getting this attribute returns the contents of the [[control thread state]] slot.
        // AD-HOC: The tasks queued by resume(), suspend() and close() set the state attribute after the
        //         [[control thread state]] has changed, so the attribute has its own slot.
        Ok(self.state_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn render_quantum_size(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        Ok(Self::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE)
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_time(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {
        Ok(self.current_time_value())
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_time_value(&self) -> f64 {
        match self.this() {
            AnyBaseAudioContext::AudioContext(context) => context.current_time_value(),
            AnyBaseAudioContext::OfflineAudioContext(context) => context.current_time_value(),
            AnyBaseAudioContext::BaseAudioContext(_) => 0.,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn verify_sample_rate(sample_rate: f32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if sample_rate < Self::MIN_SAMPLE_RATE || sample_rate > Self::MAX_SAMPLE_RATE {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Sample rate is outside of allowed range"),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createbuffer
    pub(crate) fn verify_audio_options_inside_nominal_range(
        number_of_channels: u32,
        length: u32,
        sample_rate: f32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // A NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown if any of the arguments is negative, zero, or outside its nominal range.
        if number_of_channels == 0 {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Number of channels must not be '0'"),
            ));
        }
        if number_of_channels > Self::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Number of channels is greater than allowed range"),
            ));
        }
        if length == 0 {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Length of buffer must be at least 1"),
            ));
        }
        Self::verify_sample_rate(sample_rate)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createbuffer
    pub(crate) fn create_buffer(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        number_of_channels: u32,
        length: u32,
        sample_rate: f32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioBuffer>> {
        // Creates an AudioBuffer of the given size. The audio data in the buffer will be zero-initialized (silent).
        // A NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown if any of the arguments is negative, zero, or outside its nominal range.
        Self::verify_audio_options_inside_nominal_range(number_of_channels, length, sample_rate)?;
        if length as usize > i32::MAX as usize / size_of::<f32>() {
            return Err(cx
                .vm()
                .throw_completion::<()>(ErrorKind::RangeError, ErrorType::InvalidLength, &[&"typed array"])
                .unwrap_err()
                .into());
        }
        AudioBuffer::create(cx.vm(), number_of_channels, length, sample_rate).map_err(|_| {
            cx.vm()
                .throw_completion::<()>(ErrorKind::InternalError, ErrorType::OutOfMemory, &[])
                .unwrap_err()
                .into()
        })
    }
}

impl BaseAudioContext {
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createiirfilter
    pub(crate) fn create_iir_filter(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        feedforward: Vec<f64>,
        feedback: Vec<f64>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<IIRFilterNode>> {
        // Factory method for an IIRFilterNode representing a general IIR Filter.
        let options = IIRFilterOptions {
            parent: super::audio_node::AudioNodeOptions::default(),
            feedforward,
            feedback,
        };
        IIRFilterNode::create(cx, self.this(), &options)
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_periodic_wave(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        real: Vec<f32>,
        imag: Vec<f32>,
        constraints: PeriodicWaveConstraints,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<PeriodicWave>> {
        // 1. If real and imag are not of the same length, an IndexSizeError MUST be thrown.
        // NB: The PeriodicWave constructor checks the lengths.
        // 2. Let o be a new object of type PeriodicWaveOptions.
        // 3. Respectively set the real and imag parameters passed to this factory method to the attributes of the same name on o.
        // 4. Set the disableNormalization attribute on o to the value of the disableNormalization attribute of the constraints attribute passed to the factory method.
        let options = PeriodicWaveOptions {
            parent: constraints,
            real: Some(real),
            imag: Some(imag),
        };

        // 5. Construct a new PeriodicWave p, passing the BaseAudioContext this factory method has been called on as a first argument, and o.
        // 6. Return p.
        PeriodicWave::create(cx, options)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createscriptprocessor
    pub(crate) fn create_script_processor(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        mut buffer_size: u32,
        number_of_input_channels: u32,
        number_of_output_channels: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<ScriptProcessorNode>> {
        // The bufferSize parameter determines the buffer size in units of sample-frames. If it’s not passed in, or if the
        // value is 0, then the implementation will choose the best buffer size for the given environment, which will be
        // constant power of 2 throughout the lifetime of the node.
        if buffer_size == 0 {
            buffer_size = ScriptProcessorNode::DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE as u32;
        }
        ScriptProcessorNode::validate_options(buffer_size as i32, number_of_input_channels, number_of_output_channels)?;
        ScriptProcessorNode::create(
            cx,
            self.this(),
            buffer_size as i32,
            number_of_input_channels,
            number_of_output_channels,
        )
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
#[allow(clippy::enum_variant_names, reason = "the variants have the interfaces’ names")]
pub(crate) enum AnyBaseAudioContext {
    BaseAudioContext(Ref<BaseAudioContext>),
    AudioContext(Ref<AudioContext>),
    OfflineAudioContext(Ref<OfflineAudioContext>),
}

impl Deref for AnyBaseAudioContext {
    type Target = BaseAudioContext;

    fn deref(&self) -> &BaseAudioContext {
        match self {
            Self::BaseAudioContext(context) => context,
            Self::AudioContext(context) => context.parent(),
            Self::OfflineAudioContext(context) => context.parent(),
        }
    }
}

impl ToJs for AnyBaseAudioContext {
    fn to_js(self, cx: &CallContext) -> ThrowCompletionOr<Value> {
        match self {
            Self::BaseAudioContext(context) => context.to_js(cx),
            Self::AudioContext(context) => context.to_js(cx),
            Self::OfflineAudioContext(context) => context.to_js(cx),
        }
    }
}

impl AnyBaseAudioContext {
    pub(crate) fn as_abi(self) -> *mut c_void {
        match self {
            Self::BaseAudioContext(context) => cell_into_abi(context),
            Self::AudioContext(context) => cell_into_abi(context),
            Self::OfflineAudioContext(context) => cell_into_abi(context),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn from_abi(cell: &InterfaceCell) -> Self {
        if let Some(context) = cell.object_if::<BaseAudioContext>() {
            return Self::BaseAudioContext(context);
        }
        if let Some(context) = cell.object_if::<AudioContext>() {
            return Self::AudioContext(context);
        }
        if let Some(context) = cell.object_if::<OfflineAudioContext>() {
            return Self::OfflineAudioContext(context);
        }
        unreachable!("C++ holds a context cell")
    }
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub(crate) extern "C" fn web_rust_audio_context_sample_rate(cell: &InterfaceCell) -> f32 {
    AnyBaseAudioContext::from_abi(cell).sample_rate_value()
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub(crate) extern "C" fn web_rust_audio_context_global(cell: &InterfaceCell) -> *mut c_void {
    AnyBaseAudioContext::from_abi(cell).global_object.as_ptr()
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub(crate) extern "C" fn web_rust_audio_context_global_wrapper(cell: &InterfaceCell) -> *mut c_void {
    AnyBaseAudioContext::from_abi(cell).global().as_ptr().cast()
}

// Called when the associated document is destroyed or otherwise stops being fully active, so rendering resources
// can be released.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub(crate) extern "C" fn web_rust_audio_context_document_inactive(cell: &InterfaceCell) {
    match AnyBaseAudioContext::from_abi(cell) {
        AnyBaseAudioContext::AudioContext(context) => context.document_became_inactive(),
        AnyBaseAudioContext::OfflineAudioContext(context) => context.document_became_inactive(),
        AnyBaseAudioContext::BaseAudioContext(_) => {}
    }
}

struct DecodedAudioData(NonNull<c_void>);

impl Drop for DecodedAudioData {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        unsafe { web_audio_context_decoded_destroy(self.0.as_ptr()) };
    }
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
struct DecodingOperation {
    context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
    promise: WebIdlPromise,
    success_callback: Option<CallbackFunction>,
    error_callback: Option<CallbackFunction>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    decoded: RefCell<Option<DecodedAudioData>>,
}

static DECODING_OPERATION_CLASS: EmbedderClass<DecodingOperation> = EmbedderClass::new("WebAudioDecodingOperation");

impl EmbedderValue for DecodingOperation {
    const CLASS: &'static EmbedderClass<Self> = &DECODING_OPERATION_CLASS;
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
struct DetachedAudioDataError {
    realm: Gc<Realm>,
    callback: CallbackFunction,
    error: Value,
}

static DETACHED_AUDIO_DATA_ERROR_CLASS: EmbedderClass<DetachedAudioDataError> =
    EmbedderClass::new("DetachedAudioDataError");
impl EmbedderValue for DetachedAudioDataError {
    const CLASS: &'static EmbedderClass<Self> = &DETACHED_AUDIO_DATA_ERROR_CLASS;
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_audio_context_decode(data: ak::Span<'_, u8>, sample_rate: u32, operation: *mut c_void);
    fn web_audio_context_decoded_destroy(decoded: *mut c_void);
    fn web_audio_context_decoded_metadata(
        decoded: *mut c_void,
        channels: *mut u32,
        frames: *mut u64,
        sample_rate: *mut u32,
    );
    fn web_audio_context_decoded_channel(decoded: *mut c_void, channel: u32, samples: *mut ak::Span<'_, f32>);
    fn web_audio_context_report_exception(realm: *mut c_void, error: u64);
}

impl BaseAudioContext {
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-decodeaudiodata
    pub(crate) fn decode_audio_data(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        audio_data: Gc<ArrayBuffer>,
        success_callback: Option<Option<CallbackFunction>>,
        error_callback: Option<Option<CallbackFunction>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<WebIdlPromise> {
        let vm = cx.vm();
        let promise = create_promise(vm, self.realm());
        if audio_data.is_detached() {
            let error = exception_value(
                vm,
                promise_realm(promise),
                Exception::Dom("DataCloneError", Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Audio data is detached.")),
            );
            reject_promise(vm, promise, error);
            if let Some(callback) = error_callback.flatten() {
                let state = DETACHED_AUDIO_DATA_ERROR_CLASS.allocate(vm, |_| DetachedAudioDataError {
                    realm: cx.realm(),
                    callback,
                    error,
                });
                self.queue_a_media_element_task(vm, state, |_, state| {
                    if let Err(error) = state.callback.invoke(None, &[state.error]) {
                        unsafe {
                            web_audio_context_report_exception(state.realm.as_ptr().cast(), error.value().to_raw());
                        };
                    }
                });
            }
            return Ok(promise);
        }
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        bytes.try_reserve_exact(audio_data.byte_length()).map_err(|_| {
            Exception::from(
                vm.throw_completion::<()>(ErrorKind::InternalError, ErrorType::OutOfMemory, &[])
                    .unwrap_err(),
            )
        })?;
        bytes.resize(audio_data.byte_length(), 0);
        audio_data.copy_to(0, &mut bytes);
        detach_array_buffer(vm, audio_data, None)?;

        // FIXME: When decodeAudioData is called, the following steps MUST be performed on the control thread:
        // 1. If this's relevant global object's associated Document is not fully active then return a
        //    promise rejected with "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !self.document_is_fully_active() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"The document is not fully active."),
            ));
        }

        // 3. Append promise to [[pending promises]] and queue a decoding operation.
        self.pending_promises.borrow_mut(vm).push(promise);
        let operation = DECODING_OPERATION_CLASS.allocate(vm, |_| DecodingOperation {
            context: self.this(),
            promise,
            success_callback: success_callback.flatten(),
            error_callback: error_callback.flatten(),
            decoded: RefCell::new(None),
        });
        self.queue_a_decoding_operation(vm, operation, &bytes);
        Ok(promise)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-decodeaudiodata
    fn queue_a_decoding_operation(&self, vm: &Vm, operation: Gc<EmbedderCell<DecodingOperation>>, audio_data: &[u8]) {
        // NB: The decoding thread is in the media server, which answers on this thread. Promise settlement and callbacks
        //     are posted to the media element task source below.
        if audio_data.is_empty() {
            queue_decode_error(vm, operation);
            return;
        }

        // The answer arrives outside any task, so the context and callbacks are rooted until it does.
        unsafe {
            web_audio_context_decode(
                ak::Span::new(audio_data),
                self.sample_rate_value() as u32,
                operation.as_ptr().cast(),
            );
        };
    }
}

fn queue_decode_error(vm: &Vm, operation: Gc<EmbedderCell<DecodingOperation>>) {
    operation
        .context
        .queue_a_media_element_task(vm, operation, |vm, operation| {
            let realm = promise_realm(operation.promise);
            with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(realm, || {
                let error = exception_value(
                    vm,
                    realm,
                    Exception::Dom("EncodingError", Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Unable to decode.")),
                );
                reject_promise(vm, operation.promise, error);
                {
                    let mut pending = operation.context.pending_promises.borrow_mut(vm);
                    if let Some(index) = pending.iter().position(|promise| *promise == operation.promise) {
                        pending.remove(index);
                    }
                }
                if let Some(callback) = &operation.error_callback {
                    if let Err(error) = callback.invoke(None, &[error]) {
                        unsafe { web_audio_context_report_exception(realm.as_ptr().cast(), error.value().to_raw()) };
                    }
                }
            });
        });
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub(crate) unsafe extern "C" fn web_rust_audio_context_decoded(vm: &Vm, operation: *mut c_void, decoded: *mut c_void) {
    let operation: Gc<EmbedderCell<DecodingOperation>> =
        unsafe { Gc::from_non_null(NonNull::new(operation.cast()).unwrap()) };
    let Some(decoded) = NonNull::new(decoded) else {
        queue_decode_error(vm, operation);
        return;
    };
    let decoded = DecodedAudioData(decoded);
    let mut channel_count = 0;
    let mut frame_count = 0;
    let mut sample_rate = 0;
    unsafe {
        web_audio_context_decoded_metadata(
            decoded.0.as_ptr(),
            &raw mut channel_count,
            &raw mut frame_count,
            &raw mut sample_rate,
        );
    };
    if frame_count > u64::from(u32::MAX) {
        queue_decode_error(vm, operation);
        return;
    }
    *operation.decoded.borrow_mut() = Some(decoded);
    operation.context.queue_a_media_element_task(
        vm,
        (operation, channel_count, frame_count, sample_rate),
        |vm, (operation, channel_count, frame_count, sample_rate)| {
            let buffer = AudioBuffer::create(vm, channel_count, frame_count as u32, sample_rate as f32);
            let Ok(buffer) = buffer else {
                queue_decode_error(vm, operation);
                return;
            };
            let decoded = operation.decoded.borrow_mut().take().unwrap();
            for channel in 0..channel_count {
                let (channel_data, length) = buffer
                    .channel_data(channel)
                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("the decoded channel exists"));
                let mut samples = ak::Span::default();
                unsafe { web_audio_context_decoded_channel(decoded.0.as_ptr(), channel, &raw mut samples) };
                let samples = samples.as_slice();
                let byte_length = size_of_val(samples);
                assert!(byte_length <= length);

                // SAFETY: The new buffer's channel has no views yet.
                let destination = unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts_mut(channel_data, length) };
                let source = unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(samples.as_ptr().cast::<u8>(), byte_length) };
                destination[..byte_length].copy_from_slice(source);
            }
            let realm = promise_realm(operation.promise);
            with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(realm, || {
                let value = buffer
                    .to_js(&CallContext::new(vm, realm))
                    .expect("an AudioBuffer wraps");
                resolve_promise(vm, operation.promise, value);
                {
                    let mut pending = operation.context.pending_promises.borrow_mut(vm);
                    if let Some(index) = pending.iter().position(|promise| *promise == operation.promise) {
                        pending.remove(index);
                    }
                }
                if let Some(callback) = &operation.success_callback {
                    if let Err(error) = callback.invoke(None, &[value]) {
                        unsafe { web_audio_context_report_exception(realm.as_ptr().cast(), error.value().to_raw()) };
                    }
                }
            });
        },
    );
}

pub(crate) struct BiquadFilterOptions {
    pub parent: AudioNodeOptions,
    pub r#type: BiquadFilterType,
    pub frequency: f32,
    pub detune: f32,
    pub q: f32,
    pub gain: f32,
}

impl BiquadFilterNode {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: &BiquadFilterOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // When the constructor is called with a BaseAudioContext c and an option object option, the user agent
        // MUST initialize the AudioNode this, with context and options as arguments.
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            r#type: Cell::new(options.r#type),
            frequency: AudioParam::create(
                cx.vm(),
                context,
                None,
                options.frequency,
                0.,
                context.nyquist_frequency(),
                AutomationRate::ARate,
                FixedAutomationRate::No,
            ),
            detune: AudioParam::create(
                cx.vm(),
                context,
                None,
                options.detune,
                -1200. * ak::math::log2(f32::MAX),
                1200. * ak::math::log2(f32::MAX),
                AutomationRate::ARate,
                FixedAutomationRate::No,
            ),
            q: AudioParam::create(
                cx.vm(),
                context,
                None,
                options.q,
                f32::MIN,
                f32::MAX,
                AutomationRate::ARate,
                FixedAutomationRate::No,
            ),
            gain: AudioParam::create(
                cx.vm(),
                context,
                None,
                options.gain,
                f32::MIN,
                40. * ak::math::log10(f32::MAX),
                AutomationRate::ARate,
                FixedAutomationRate::No,
            ),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::BiquadFilterNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);
        node.frequency.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::BiquadFilterNode(node));
        node.detune.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::BiquadFilterNode(node));
        node.q.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::BiquadFilterNode(node));
        node.gain.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::BiquadFilterNode(node));

        // Default options for channel count and interpretation
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#BiquadFilterNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Max,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to yes
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(create_biquad_filter_render_node(
            node.node.node_id(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
            Arc::clone(node.frequency.render_param()),
            Arc::clone(node.detune.render_param()),
            Arc::clone(node.q.render_param()),
            Arc::clone(node.gain.render_param()),
        ));
        if options.r#type != BiquadFilterType::Lowpass {
            context.queue_control_message(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::SetBiquadFilterType(
                SetBiquadFilterType {
                    node_id: node.node.node_id(),
                    r#type: options.r#type,
                },
            )));
        }
        Ok(node)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-biquadfilternode-biquadfilternode
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: BiquadFilterOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-biquadfilternode-type
    pub(crate) fn set_type(&self, _: &mut CallContext, r#type: BiquadFilterType) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.r#type.set(r#type);
        self.node
            .context_value()
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::SetBiquadFilterType(
                SetBiquadFilterType {
                    node_id: self.node.node_id(),
                    r#type,
                },
            )));
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-biquadfilternode-type
    pub(crate) fn r#type(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<BiquadFilterType> {
        Ok(self.r#type.get())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-biquadfilternode-frequency
    pub(crate) fn frequency(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.frequency)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-biquadfilternode-detune
    pub(crate) fn detune(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.detune)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-biquadfilternode-q
    pub(crate) fn q(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.q)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-biquadfilternode-gain
    pub(crate) fn gain(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.gain)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-biquadfilternode-getfrequencyresponse
    pub(crate) fn get_frequency_response(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        frequency_hz: Gc<TypedArrayBase>,
        mag_response: Gc<TypedArrayBase>,
        phase_response: Gc<TypedArrayBase>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let length = float32_array_length(&frequency_hz);

        // If these arrays do not have the same length, an InvalidAccessError MUST be thrown.
        if float32_array_length(&mag_response) != length || float32_array_length(&phase_response) != length {
            return Err(Exception::Thrown(
                Exception::Dom(
                    "InvalidAccessError",
                    Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Arrays must have the same length"),
                )
                .throw(&CallContext::new(cx.vm(), self.node.context_value().realm())),
            ));
        }
        let frequencies = copy_float32_array(&frequency_hz);
        let mut magnitudes = vec![0.; length];
        let mut phases = vec![0.; length];

        // The filter response is evaluated with the current parameter values at the context's current time.
        let current_time = self.node.context_value().current_time_value();
        let nyquist_frequency = self.node.context_value().nyquist_frequency();
        let frequency = self.frequency.intrinsic_value_at_time(current_time);
        let detune = self.detune.intrinsic_value_at_time(current_time);
        let computed_frequency = f64::from(frequency) * ak::math::exp2(f64::from(detune) / 1200.);
        let normalized_frequency = computed_frequency / f64::from(nyquist_frequency);
        let normalized_frequency = normalized_frequency.clamp(0., 1.);
        let coefficients = compute_biquad_coefficients(
            self.r#type.get(),
            normalized_frequency,
            f64::from(self.q.intrinsic_value_at_time(current_time)),
            f64::from(self.gain.intrinsic_value_at_time(current_time)),
        );
        for index in 0..length {
            let response_frequency = frequencies[index];

            // Frequencies outside the nominal range produce NaN in both output arrays.
            if response_frequency.is_nan() || response_frequency < 0. || response_frequency > nyquist_frequency {
                magnitudes[index] = f32::NAN;
                phases[index] = f32::NAN;
                continue;
            }
            (magnitudes[index], phases[index]) =
                biquad_frequency_response(&coefficients, f64::from(response_frequency / nyquist_frequency));
        }
        overwrite_float32_array(&mag_response, &magnitudes);
        overwrite_float32_array(&phase_response, &phases);
        Ok(())
    }
}
