// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#ChannelMergerNode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ChannelMergerNode {
    node: AudioNode,
    number_of_inputs: u32,
}

impl Inherits<AudioNode> for ChannelMergerNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for ChannelMergerNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        node.node.finalize_node();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for ChannelMergerNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

pub(crate) struct ChannelMergerOptions {
    pub parent: AudioNodeOptions,
    pub number_of_inputs: u32,
}

impl ChannelMergerNode {
    pub(crate) fn validate_options(options: &ChannelMergerOptions) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createchannelmerger
        // An IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown if numberOfInputs is less than 1 or is greater
        // than the number of supported channels.
        if options.number_of_inputs < 1 || options.number_of_inputs > BaseAudioContext::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Invalid number of inputs"),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: ChannelMergerOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::validate_options(&options)?;
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: &ChannelMergerOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            number_of_inputs: options.number_of_inputs,
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::ChannelMergerNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);

        // Default options for channel count and interpretation
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#ChannelMergerNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 1,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Explicit,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to no
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(create_channel_merger_render_node(
            node.node.node_id(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
            options.number_of_inputs as usize,
        ));
        Ok(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_inputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        self.number_of_inputs
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_outputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        1
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelcount-constraints
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_override(&self, _: &mut CallContext, channel_count: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The channel count cannot be changed, and an InvalidStateError exception MUST be thrown for
        // any attempt to change the value.
        if channel_count != 1 {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Channel count cannot be changed"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_impl(channel_count)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_mode_override(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The channel count mode cannot be changed from "explicit" and an InvalidStateError exception
        // MUST be thrown for any attempt to change the value.
        if channel_count_mode != ChannelCountMode::Explicit {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Channel count mode cannot be changed"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_mode_impl(channel_count_mode)
    }
}

pub(crate) struct ChannelSplitterOptions {

impl ChannelSplitterNode {
    pub(crate) fn validate_options(options: &ChannelSplitterOptions) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createchannelsplitter
        // An IndexSizeError exception MUST be thrown if numberOfOutputs is less than 1 or is greater than the number of supported channels.
        if options.number_of_outputs < 1 || options.number_of_outputs > BaseAudioContext::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Invalid number of outputs"),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: ChannelSplitterOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::validate_options(&options)?;
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: &ChannelSplitterOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            number_of_outputs: options.number_of_outputs,
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::ChannelSplitterNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);

        // Default options for channel count and interpretation
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#ChannelSplitterNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: node.number_of_outputs,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Explicit,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Discrete,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to no
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        node.node
            .queue_render_node_creation(create_channel_splitter_render_node(
                node.node.node_id(),
                BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
                options.number_of_outputs as usize,
            ));
        Ok(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_inputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        1
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_outputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        self.number_of_outputs
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_override(&self, _: &mut CallContext, channel_count: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelcount-constraints
        // The channel count cannot be changed, and an InvalidStateError exception MUST be thrown for any attempt to change the value.
        if channel_count != self.number_of_outputs {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Channel count must be equal to number of outputs"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_impl(channel_count)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_mode_override(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelcountmode-constraints
        // The channel count mode cannot be changed from "explicit" and an InvalidStateError exception MUST be thrown for any attempt to change the value.
        if channel_count_mode != ChannelCountMode::Explicit {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Channel count mode must be 'explicit'"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_mode_impl(channel_count_mode)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_channel_interpretation_override(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelinterpretation-constraints
        // The channel interpretation can not be changed from "discrete" and a InvalidStateError exception MUST be thrown for any attempt to change the value.
        if channel_interpretation != ChannelInterpretation::Discrete {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Channel interpretation must be 'discrete'"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_interpretation_impl(channel_interpretation)
    }
}

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_if, reason = "preserve the C++ branch structure")]

use std::cell::Cell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;
use std::sync::Arc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::Trace;
use libweb_rust::web_audio::control_message::ControlMessage;
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::convolver_kernel::{AudioBufferContents, ConvolverDelayLine, ConvolverKernel};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::node_message::{NodeMessage, SetConvolverKernel};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::render_nodes::create_convolver_render_node;

use super::audio_buffer::AudioBuffer;
use super::audio_node::{
    AnyAudioNode, AudioNode, AudioNodeDefaultOptions, AudioNodeOptions, ChannelCountMode, ChannelInterpretation,
};
use super::base_audio_context::{AnyBaseAudioContext, BaseAudioContext};
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#ConvolverNode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ConvolverNode {
    node: AudioNode,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-convolvernode-buffer
    buffer: Cell<Option<Ref<AudioBuffer>>>,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-convolvernode-normalize
    normalize: Cell<bool>,
}

impl Inherits<AudioNode> for ConvolverNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for ConvolverNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        node.node.finalize_node();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for ConvolverNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

pub(crate) struct ConvolverOptions {
    pub parent: AudioNodeOptions,
    pub buffer: Option<Option<Ref<AudioBuffer>>>,
    pub disable_normalization: bool,
}

impl ConvolverNode {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: &ConvolverOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // NB: The node and its render node are created up front, so that step 2 has something to hand the impulse
        //     response to.
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            buffer: Cell::new(None),
            normalize: Cell::new(!options.disable_normalization),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::ConvolverNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(create_convolver_render_node(
            node.node.node_id(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
        ));

        // 1. Set the attributes normalize to the inverse of the value of disableNormalization.
        // NB: Done by the constructor above, so that step 2 already sees the final value.
        // 2. If buffer exists, set the buffer attribute to its value.
        if let Some(buffer) = options.buffer {
            node.set_buffer(cx, buffer)?;
        }

        // 3. Let o be new AudioNodeOptions dictionary.
        // 4. If channelCount exists in options, set channelCount on o with the same value.
        // 5. If channelCountMode exists in options, set channelCountMode on o with the same value.
        // 6. If channelInterpretation exists in options, set channelInterpretation on o with the same value.
        // 7. Initialize the AudioNode this, with c and o as argument.
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::ClampedMax,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to yes
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        Ok(node)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-convolvernode-convolvernode
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: ConvolverOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-convolvernode-buffer
    pub(crate) fn set_buffer(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, buffer: Option<Ref<AudioBuffer>>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If the buffer number of channels is not 1, 2, 4, or if the sample-rate of the buffer is not the same as the
        //    sample-rate of its associated BaseAudioContext, a NotSupportedError MUST be thrown.
        // AD-HOC: The steps do not cover a null buffer, which clears the impulse response and leaves the node silent.
        if let Some(buffer) = buffer {
            let number_of_channels = buffer.number_of_channels(cx)?;
            if number_of_channels != 1 && number_of_channels != 2 && number_of_channels != 4 {
                return Err(Exception::Dom(
                    "NotSupportedError",
                    Utf16String::from_ascii(b"ConvolverNode buffer must have 1, 2 or 4 channels"),
                ));
            }
            if buffer.sample_rate(cx)? != self.node.context_value().sample_rate_value() {
                return Err(Exception::Dom(
                    "NotSupportedError",
                    Utf16String::from_ascii(b"ConvolverNode buffer must have the same sample rate as its context"),
                ));
            }
        }
        self.buffer.set(buffer);

        // 2. Acquire the content of the AudioBuffer.
        // NB: The acquired content is cut into partitions and transformed here, and the delay line that the rendering
        //     thread pairs those partitions with is sized and allocated alongside it, so that the rendering thread
        //     receives both ready to use and never has to build either during a render quantum.
        let mut kernel = None;
        let mut delay_line = None;
        if let Some(buffer) = buffer {
            if let Some(contents) = AudioBuffer::acquire_contents(buffer, cx.vm()) {
                let channels: Vec<_> = contents.channels.iter().map(|channel| ak::Span::new(channel)).collect();
                kernel = ConvolverKernel::create(
                    &AudioBufferContents {
                        channels: &channels,
                        sample_rate: contents.sample_rate,
                    },
                    BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
                    self.normalize.get(),
                );
            }
            if let Some(kernel) = &kernel {
                delay_line = Some(Arc::new(ConvolverDelayLine::create(kernel)));
            }
        }
        self.node
            .context_value()
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::SetConvolverKernel(
                SetConvolverKernel {
                    node_id: self.node.node_id(),
                    kernel,
                    delay_line,
                },
            )));
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn buffer(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<AudioBuffer>>> {
        Ok(self.buffer.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn normalize(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        Ok(self.normalize.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_normalize(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: bool) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.normalize.set(value);
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelcount-constraints
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_override(&self, _: &mut CallContext, channel_count: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The channel count cannot be greater than two, and a NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown for any attempt
        // to change it to a value greater than two.
        if channel_count > 2 {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"ConvolverNode does not support channel count greater than 2"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_impl(channel_count)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelcountmode-constraints
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_mode_override(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        mode: ChannelCountMode,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // The channel count mode cannot be set to "max", and a NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown for any attempt
        // to set it to "max".
        if mode == ChannelCountMode::Max {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"ConvolverNode does not support 'max' as channelCountMode."),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_mode_impl(mode)
    }
}

pub(crate) struct DelayOptions {
    pub parent: AudioNodeOptions,
    pub delay_time: f64,
    pub max_delay_time: f64,
}

impl DelayNode {
    pub(crate) fn validate_options(options: &DelayOptions) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-delayoptions-maxdelaytime
        // If specified, this value MUST be greater than zero and less than three minutes or a NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown.
        const MAXIMUM_DELAY_TIME_SECONDS: f64 = 180.;
        if options.max_delay_time <= 0.
            || options.max_delay_time >= MAXIMUM_DELAY_TIME_SECONDS
            || options.max_delay_time.is_nan()
        {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Max delay time must be between 0 and 180 seconds exclusive"),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: DelayOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::validate_options(&options)?;
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: &DelayOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            delay_time: AudioParam::create(
                cx.vm(),
                context,
                None,
                options.delay_time as f32,
                0.,
                options.max_delay_time as f32,
                AutomationRate::ARate,
                FixedAutomationRate::No,
            ),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::DelayNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);
        node.delay_time.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::DelayNode(node));

        // Default options for channel count and interpretation
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#DelayNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Max,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to yes
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(create_delay_render_node(
            node.node.node_id(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
            Arc::clone(node.delay_time.render_param()),
            options.max_delay_time,
        ));
        Ok(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn delay_time(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.delay_time)
    }
}

        Ok(self.knee)
    }

    pub(crate) fn ratio(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.ratio)
    }

    pub(crate) fn attack(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.attack)
    }

    pub(crate) fn release(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.release)
    }

    pub(crate) fn reduction(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f32> {
        Ok(self.reduction)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcount
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_override(&self, _: &mut CallContext, channel_count: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if channel_count > 2 {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"DynamicsCompressorNode does not support channel count greater than 2"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_impl(channel_count)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcountmode
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_mode_override(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        mode: ChannelCountMode,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if mode == ChannelCountMode::Max {
            // Return a NotSupportedError if 'max' is used
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"DynamicsCompressorNode does not support 'max' as channelCountMode."),
            ));
        }

        // If the mode is valid, call the base class implementation
        self.node.set_channel_count_mode_impl(mode)
    }
}

pub(crate) struct IIRFilterOptions {
    pub parent: AudioNodeOptions,
    pub feedforward: Vec<f64>,
    pub feedback: Vec<f64>,
}

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createiirfilter
const MAX_COEFFICIENT_COUNT: usize = 20;

impl IIRFilterNode {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: &IIRFilterOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createiirfilter
        // feedforward: An array of the feedforward (numerator) coefficients for the transfer function of the IIR filter.
        // The maximum length of this array is 20. If all of the values are zero, an InvalidStateError MUST be thrown. A
        // NotSupportedError MUST be thrown if the array length is 0 or greater than 20.
        // feedback: An array of the feedback (denominator) coefficients for the transfer function of the IIR filter. The
        // maximum length of this array is 20. If the first element of the array is 0, an InvalidStateError MUST be thrown.
        // A NotSupportedError MUST be thrown if the array length is 0 or greater than 20.
        let feedforward = &options.feedforward;
        let feedback = &options.feedback;
        if feedforward.is_empty() || feedforward.len() > MAX_COEFFICIENT_COUNT {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"The number of feedforward coefficients must be between 1 and 20"),
            ));
        }
        if feedback.is_empty() || feedback.len() > MAX_COEFFICIENT_COUNT {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"The number of feedback coefficients must be between 1 and 20"),
            ));
        }
        if feedforward.iter().all(|coefficient| *coefficient == 0.) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"At least one feedforward coefficient must not be zero"),
            ));
        }
        if feedback[0] == 0. {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"The first feedback coefficient must not be zero"),
            ));
        }

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#IIRFilterNode-filter-definition
        // NB: Dividing every coefficient by a_0 gives the same transfer function with a_0 = 1, which the filter uses.
        let a0 = feedback[0];
        let mut normalized_feedforward = Vec::with_capacity(feedforward.len());
        for coefficient in feedforward {
            normalized_feedforward.push(coefficient / a0);
        }
        let mut normalized_feedback = Vec::with_capacity(feedback.len());
        for coefficient in feedback {
            normalized_feedback.push(coefficient / a0);
        }

        // When the constructor is called with a BaseAudioContext c and an option object option, the user agent MUST
        // initialize the AudioNode this, with context and options as arguments.
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            feedforward: normalized_feedforward.clone(),
            feedback: normalized_feedback.clone(),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::IIRFilterNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#IIRFilterNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Max,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to yes
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(create_iir_filter_render_node(
            node.node.node_id(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
            &normalized_feedforward,
            &normalized_feedback,
        ));
        Ok(node)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-iirfilternode-iirfilternode
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: IIRFilterOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-iirfilternode-getfrequencyresponse
    pub(crate) fn get_frequency_response(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        frequency_hz: Gc<TypedArrayBase>,
        mag_response: Gc<TypedArrayBase>,
        phase_response: Gc<TypedArrayBase>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // Given the current filter parameter settings, synchronously calculates the frequency response for the specified
        // frequencies. The three parameters MUST be Float32Arrays of the same length, or an InvalidAccessError MUST be
        // thrown.
        let length = float32_array_length(&frequency_hz);
        if float32_array_length(&mag_response) != length || float32_array_length(&phase_response) != length {
            return Err(Exception::Thrown(
                Exception::Dom(
                    "InvalidAccessError",
                    Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Arrays must have the same length"),
                )
                .throw(&CallContext::new(cx.vm(), self.node.context_value().realm())),
            ));
        }
        let frequencies = copy_float32_array(&frequency_hz);
        let mut magnitudes = vec![0.; length];
        let mut phases = vec![0.; length];
        let nyquist_frequency = self.node.context_value().nyquist_frequency();

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#IIRFilterNode-filter-definition
        // NB: H(z) = (sum_{m=0}^{M} b_m z^{-m}) / (sum_{n=0}^{N} a_n z^{-n}), evaluated at z = e^{j omega}. A polynomial in
        //     z^-1 is evaluated with Horner's method, from the coefficient of its highest power down.
        #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
        struct ComplexNumber {
            real: f64,
            imaginary: f64,
        }
        let evaluate = |coefficients: &[f64], z_inverse: ComplexNumber| {
            let mut result = ComplexNumber {
                real: 0.,
                imaginary: 0.,
            };
            for index in (0..coefficients.len()).rev() {
                result = ComplexNumber {
                    real: result.real * z_inverse.real - result.imaginary * z_inverse.imaginary + coefficients[index],
                    imaginary: result.real * z_inverse.imaginary + result.imaginary * z_inverse.real,
                };
            }
            result
        };
        for index in 0..length {
            let frequency = f64::from(frequencies[index]);

            // If a value in the frequencyHz parameter is not within [0, sampleRate/2], where sampleRate is the value of
            // the sampleRate property of the AudioContext, the corresponding value at the same index of the magResponse
            // and phaseResponse arrays MUST be NaN.
            if frequency.is_nan() || frequency < 0. || frequency > f64::from(nyquist_frequency) {
                magnitudes[index] = f32::NAN;
                phases[index] = f32::NAN;
                continue;
            }
            let omega = std::f64::consts::PI * frequency / f64::from(nyquist_frequency);
            let z_inverse = ComplexNumber {
                real: ak::math::cos(omega),
                imaginary: -ak::math::sin(omega),
            };
            let numerator = evaluate(&self.feedforward, z_inverse);
            let denominator = evaluate(&self.feedback, z_inverse);
            let denominator_magnitude_squared =
                denominator.real * denominator.real + denominator.imaginary * denominator.imaginary;
            let response = ComplexNumber {
                real: (numerator.real * denominator.real + numerator.imaginary * denominator.imaginary)
                    / denominator_magnitude_squared,
                imaginary: (numerator.imaginary * denominator.real - numerator.real * denominator.imaginary)
                    / denominator_magnitude_squared,
            };
            magnitudes[index] = ak::math::hypot(response.real, response.imaginary) as f32;
            phases[index] = ak::math::atan2(response.imaginary, response.real) as f32;
        }
        overwrite_float32_array(&mag_response, &magnitudes);
        overwrite_float32_array(&phase_response, &phases);
        Ok(())
    }
}

use std::cell::RefCell;

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode {
    node: AudioNode,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-mediastreamaudiodestinationnode-stream
    stream: crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell,
    track: crate::bindings::cpp_cell::CppCell,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    shared_state: RefCell<Option<libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::node_message::SharedCppObject>>,
}

impl Inherits<AudioNode> for MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        // Drop the drain callback — and with it the GC root it holds on the track — on the
        // control thread. Any drain the render node still has queued becomes a no-op.
        if let Some(shared_state) = &*node.shared_state.borrow() {
            unsafe { web_audio_media_destination_clear_drain(shared_state.pointer) };
        }
        node.node.finalize_node();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_audio_media_destination_create_stream(stream: *mut *mut c_void, track: *mut *mut c_void);
    fn web_audio_media_destination_create_state(
        track: *mut c_void,
        node_id: u64,
        channels: u32,
        sample_rate: u32,
        render_node: *mut *mut c_void,
    ) -> FfiSharedCppObject;
    fn web_audio_media_destination_clear_drain(state: *mut c_void);
    fn web_audio_media_destination_wrap_stream(realm: *mut c_void, stream: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
}

impl MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode {
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-mediastreamaudiodestinationnode-mediastreamaudiodestinationnode
    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: Ref<AudioContext>,
        options: &AudioNodeOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-mediastreamaudiodestinationnode-stream
        // A MediaStream containing a single MediaStreamTrack with the same number of channels as
        // the node itself, and whose kind attribute has the value "audio".
        // NB: The track is deviceless — it carries no deviceId, so registering audio sinks on it
        //     never opens a capture stream; it is fed exclusively by this node's render node.
        let mut stream = std::ptr::null_mut();
        let mut track = std::ptr::null_mut();
        unsafe { web_audio_media_destination_create_stream(&raw mut stream, &raw mut track) };
        let stream = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(stream) };
        let track = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(track) };

        // 1. Initialize the AudioNode this, with context and options as arguments.
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, AnyBaseAudioContext::AudioContext(context), 2),
            stream,
            track,
            shared_state: RefCell::new(None),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Explicit,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };
        node.node.initialize_audio_node_options(cx, options, &default_options)?;
        let sample_rate = context.parent().sample_rate_value() as u32;
        let mut render_node = std::ptr::null_mut();
        let shared_state = unsafe {
            web_audio_media_destination_create_state(
                node.track.as_ptr(),
                node.node.node_id(),
                node.node.channel_count_value(),
                sample_rate,
                &raw mut render_node,
            )
        };
        *node.shared_state.borrow_mut() = Some(SharedCppObject {
            pointer: shared_state.pointer,
            retain: shared_state.retain,
            release: shared_state.release,
        });
        node.node
            .queue_render_node_creation(unsafe { Box::from_raw(render_node.cast::<NodeHandle>()) });
        Ok(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: Ref<AudioContext>,
        options: AudioNodeOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-mediastreamaudiodestinationnode-stream
    pub(crate) fn stream(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CppInterface> {
        let wrapper =
            unsafe { web_audio_media_destination_wrap_stream(cx.realm().as_ptr().cast(), self.stream.as_ptr()) };
        Ok(unsafe { CppInterface::from_wrapper(Gc::<Object>::from_non_null(NonNull::new(wrapper.cast()).unwrap())) })
    }
}

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_if, reason = "preserve the C++ branch structure")]

use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::ffi::c_void;

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#MediaStreamAudioSourceNode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct MediaStreamAudioSourceNode {
    node: AudioNode,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-mediastreamaudiosourcenode-mediastream
    media_stream: CppCell,

    // [[input track]]: the first audio track of the input stream, ordered by track id.
    input_track: libjs_rust::api::GcRefCell<Option<CppCell>>,

    // Carries the track's audio from the producing thread to the render thread; the sink is
    // registered on the input track and only ever references the ring, never this GC node.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    ring: RefCell<Option<SharedCppObject>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    sink: RefCell<Option<SharedCppObject>>,
}

impl Inherits<AudioNode> for MediaStreamAudioSourceNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for MediaStreamAudioSourceNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        node.node.finalize_node();

        // NB: Finalizers run before any dead cell is destroyed, so detaching from the input track
        //     is safe even when the track is collected in the same garbage collection cycle.
        if let Some(track) = &*node.input_track.borrow() {
            if let Some(sink) = &*node.sink.borrow() {
                unsafe { web_audio_media_source_detach(track.as_ptr(), sink.pointer) };
            }
        }
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for MediaStreamAudioSourceNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_audio_media_source_stream_from_wrapper(wrapper: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
    fn web_audio_media_source_stream_wrap(realm: *mut c_void, cell: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void;
}

pub(crate) struct MediaStreamAudioSourceOptions {
    pub media_stream: CppInterface,
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn web_audio_media_source_audio_tracks(
        stream: *mut c_void,
        context: *mut c_void,
        callback: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *mut c_void),
    );
    fn web_audio_media_source_track_id_less(a: *mut c_void, b: *mut c_void) -> bool;
    fn web_audio_media_source_track_channels(track: *mut c_void) -> u32;
    fn web_audio_media_source_has_live_track(track: *mut c_void) -> bool;
    fn web_audio_media_source_ring(channels: u32) -> FfiSharedCppObject;
    fn web_audio_media_source_ring_callbacks(callbacks: *mut AudioFrameRingCallbacks);
    fn web_audio_media_source_attach(track: *mut c_void, ring: *mut c_void, sample_rate: f32) -> FfiSharedCppObject;
    fn web_audio_media_source_detach(track: *mut c_void, sink: *mut c_void);
}

impl MediaStreamAudioSourceNode {
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-mediastreamaudiosourcenode-mediastreamaudiosourcenode
    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: Ref<AudioContext>,
        options: &MediaStreamAudioSourceOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // 1. If the mediaStream member of options does not reference a MediaStream that has at least one MediaStreamTrack
        //    whose kind attribute has the value "audio", throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps. Else, let this
        //    stream be inputStream.
        let input_stream = unsafe {
            CppCell::from_raw(web_audio_media_source_stream_from_wrapper(
                options.media_stream.wrapper().as_ptr().cast(),
            ))
        };
        let audio_tracks = MarkedVec::<CppCell>::new(cx.vm());
        unsafe extern "C" fn append(context: *mut c_void, track: *mut c_void) {
            unsafe { &*context.cast::<MarkedVec<'_, CppCell>>() }.push(unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(track) });
        }
        unsafe {
            web_audio_media_source_audio_tracks(
                input_stream.as_ptr(),
                (&raw const audio_tracks).cast_mut().cast(),
                append,
            );
        };
        if audio_tracks.is_empty() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"MediaStream has no audio tracks"),
            ));
        }

        // 2. Let tracks be the list of all MediaStreamTracks of inputStream that have a kind of "audio".
        // 3. Sort the elements in tracks based on their id attribute using an ordering on sequences of code unit values.
        audio_tracks.values_mut().sort_unstable_by(|a, b| {
            if unsafe { web_audio_media_source_track_id_less(a.as_ptr(), b.as_ptr()) } {
                std::cmp::Ordering::Less
            } else if unsafe { web_audio_media_source_track_id_less(b.as_ptr(), a.as_ptr()) } {
                std::cmp::Ordering::Greater
            } else {
                std::cmp::Ordering::Equal
            }
        });

        // 4. Initialize the AudioNode this, with context and options as arguments.
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, AnyBaseAudioContext::AudioContext(context), 2),
            media_stream: input_stream,
            input_track: libjs_rust::api::GcRefCell::new(None),
            ring: RefCell::new(None),
            sink: RefCell::new(None),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::MediaStreamAudioSourceNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#MediaStreamAudioSourceNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Max,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &AudioNodeOptions::default(), &default_options)?;

        // 5. Set an internal slot [[input track]] on this MediaStreamAudioSourceNode to be the first element of tracks.
        //    This is the track used as the input audio for this MediaStreamAudioSourceNode.
        *node.input_track.borrow_mut(cx.vm()) = audio_tracks.get(0);
        let mut callbacks = std::mem::MaybeUninit::uninit();
        unsafe { web_audio_media_source_ring_callbacks(callbacks.as_mut_ptr()) };
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(unsafe {
            create_media_stream_source_render_node(
                node.node.node_id(),
                BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
                callbacks.assume_init(),
            )
        });
        node.attach_input_track();
        context.parent().add_media_stream_source(cx.vm(), node);
        Ok(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: Ref<AudioContext>,
        options: MediaStreamAudioSourceOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    fn attach_input_track(&self) {
        let track = self.input_track.borrow();
        let track = track.as_ref().expect("the input track has been selected");
        let channel_count = if unsafe { web_audio_media_source_track_channels(track.as_ptr()) } == 1 {
            1
        } else {
            2
        };
        let ring = unsafe { web_audio_media_source_ring(channel_count) };
        let ring = SharedCppObject {
            pointer: ring.pointer,
            retain: ring.retain,
            release: ring.release,
        };
        self.node
            .context_value()
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::SetMediaStreamSourceRing(
                SetMediaStreamSourceRing {
                    node_id: self.node.node_id(),
                    ring: Some(ring.clone()),
                    channel_count,
                },
            )));
        let sink = unsafe {
            web_audio_media_source_attach(
                track.as_ptr(),
                ring.pointer,
                self.node.context_value().sample_rate_value(),
            )
        };
        *self.ring.borrow_mut() = Some(ring);
        if !sink.pointer.is_null() {
            *self.sink.borrow_mut() = Some(SharedCppObject {
                pointer: sink.pointer,
                retain: sink.retain,
                release: sink.release,
            });
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_live_input_track(&self) -> bool {
        self.input_track
            .borrow()
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|track| unsafe { web_audio_media_source_has_live_track(track.as_ptr()) })
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-mediastreamaudiosourcenode-mediastream
    pub(crate) fn media_stream(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CppInterface> {
        let wrapper =
            unsafe { web_audio_media_source_stream_wrap(cx.realm().as_ptr().cast(), self.media_stream.as_ptr()) };
        Ok(unsafe { CppInterface::from_wrapper(Gc::<Object>::from_non_null(NonNull::new(wrapper.cast()).unwrap())) })
    }
}

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};

use super::audio_buffer::AudioBuffer;
use crate::bindings::event_target::CppEvent;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::event::EventInit;

pub(crate) struct OfflineAudioCompletionEventInit {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) rendered_buffer: Ref<AudioBuffer>,
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct OfflineAudioCompletionEvent {
    pub(crate) event: CppEvent,
    rendered_buffer: Option<Ref<AudioBuffer>>,
}

impl Wrappable for OfflineAudioCompletionEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl OfflineAudioCompletionEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, event: CppEvent, rendered_buffer: Ref<AudioBuffer>) -> Ref<Self> {
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            event,
            rendered_buffer: Some(rendered_buffer),
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init_dict: OfflineAudioCompletionEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            cx.realm(),
            &r#type,
            event_init_dict.parent.bubbles,
            event_init_dict.parent.cancelable,
            event_init_dict.parent.composed,
        );
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), event, event_init_dict.rendered_buffer))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    pub(crate) fn rendered_buffer(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioBuffer>> {
        Ok(self
            .rendered_buffer
            .expect("the event initializer supplies its required buffer"))
    }
}

pub(crate) struct OfflineAudioContextOptions {
    pub number_of_channels: u32,
    pub length: u32,
    pub sample_rate: f32,
}

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#OfflineAudioContext
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct OfflineAudioContext {
    context: BaseAudioContext,
    length: u32,
    number_of_channels: u32,
    rendering_started: Cell<bool>,
    rendered_buffer: Cell<Option<Ref<AudioBuffer>>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    renderer: RefCell<Option<Arc<OfflineAudioRenderer>>>,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-offlineaudiocontext-suspend, keyed by suspend frame.
    suspend_promises: GcRefCell<Vec<(u64, WebIdlPromise)>>,
}

impl Inherits<BaseAudioContext> for OfflineAudioContext {
    fn parent(&self) -> &BaseAudioContext {
        &self.context
    }
}

impl Wrappable for OfflineAudioContext {
    const TRACED_ON_OWNER_THREAD_ONLY: bool = true;
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.context.cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for OfflineAudioContext {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

struct RendererClient {
    vm: NonNull<Vm>,
    context: CellRoot<EmbedderCell<Wrapped<OfflineAudioContext>>>,
    promise: CellRoot<PromiseCapability>,
}

impl RendererClient {
    fn vm(&self) -> &Vm {
        // SAFETY: The VM of the control thread outlives its audio contexts.
        unsafe { self.vm.as_ref() }
    }
}

impl OfflineAudioRendererClient for RendererClient {
    fn rendering_suspended(&self, suspend_time: f64) {
        self.context.cell().handle_suspended(self.vm(), suspend_time);
    }

    fn rendering_completed(&self, rendered_channels: &[Vec<f32>]) {
        self.context
            .cell()
            .finish_rendering(self.vm(), self.promise.cell(), rendered_channels);
    }

    fn sources_ended(&self, nodes: &[u64]) {
        self.context.cell().context.handle_ended_sources(self.vm(), nodes);
    }
}

impl OfflineAudioContext {
    fn this(&self) -> Ref<Self> {
        let AnyBaseAudioContext::OfflineAudioContext(context) = self.context.this() else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        context
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-offlineaudiocontext-offlineaudiocontext
    pub(crate) fn construct_options(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context_options: OfflineAudioContextOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // AD-HOC: This spec text is currently only mentioned in the constructor overload that takes separate arguments,
        //         but these parameters should be validated for both constructors.
        // A NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown if any of the arguments is negative, zero, or outside its nominal range.
        BaseAudioContext::verify_audio_options_inside_nominal_range(
            context_options.number_of_channels,
            context_options.length,
            context_options.sample_rate,
        )?;
        let window = window_from_global_object(cx.realm().global_object())
            .expect("an OfflineAudioContext is constructed on a Window");
        let global = unsafe { CppCell::from_raw(window.as_event_target().as_ptr()) };

        // Let c be a new OfflineAudioContext object. Initialize c as follows:
        let c = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            context: BaseAudioContext::new(defer_gc, global, context_options.sample_rate),
            length: context_options.length,
            number_of_channels: context_options.number_of_channels,
            rendering_started: Cell::new(false),
            rendered_buffer: Cell::new(None),
            renderer: RefCell::new(None),
            suspend_promises: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
        });
        c.context
            .initialize(cx.vm(), AnyBaseAudioContext::OfflineAudioContext(c));
        c.context.event_target().set_owner(c);
        c.context.listener.set(Some(AudioListener::create(
            cx.vm(),
            AnyBaseAudioContext::OfflineAudioContext(c),
        )));

        // 1. Set the [[control thread state]] for c to "suspended".
        c.context.set_control_state(AudioContextState::Suspended);
        c.context.set_state(AudioContextState::Suspended);

        // 2. Set the [[rendering thread state]] for c to "suspended".
        c.context.set_rendering_state(AudioContextState::Suspended);

        // FIXME: 3. Determine the [[render quantum size]] for this OfflineAudioContext, based on the value of the renderSizeHint:
        // 4. Construct an AudioDestinationNode with its channelCount set to contextOptions.numberOfChannels.
        c.context.destination.set(Some(AudioDestinationNode::create(
            cx,
            AnyBaseAudioContext::OfflineAudioContext(c),
            context_options.number_of_channels,
        )?));

        // FIXME: 5. Let messageChannel be a new MessageChannel.
        // FIXME: 6. Let controlSidePort be the value of messageChannel’s port1 attribute.
        // FIXME: 7. Let renderingSidePort be the value of messageChannel’s port2 attribute.
        // FIXME: 8. Let serializedRenderingSidePort be the result of StructuredSerializeWithTransfer(renderingSidePort, « renderingSidePort »).
        // FIXME: 9. Set this audioWorklet's port to controlSidePort.
        // FIXME: 10. Queue a control message to set the MessagePort on the AudioContextGlobalScope, with serializedRenderingSidePort.
        Ok(c)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-offlineaudiocontext-offlineaudiocontext-numberofchannels-length-samplerate
    pub(crate) fn construct_channels(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        number_of_channels: u32,
        length: u32,
        sample_rate: f32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::construct_options(
            cx,
            OfflineAudioContextOptions {
                number_of_channels,
                length,
                sample_rate,
            },
        )
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-offlineaudiocontext-startrendering
    pub(crate) fn start_rendering(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, promise: WebIdlPromise) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // 1. If this’s relevant global object’s associated Document is not fully active then return a promise rejected with "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        if !self.context.document_is_fully_active() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Document is not fully active"),
            ));
        }

        // AD-HOC: Not in spec explicitly, but this should account for detached iframes too. See /the-offlineaudiocontext-interface/startrendering-after-discard.html WPT.
        if self.context.navigable_is_destroyed() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"The iframe has been detached"),
            ));
        }

        // 2. Let promise be a new promise.
        // NB: The bindings create the promise.

        // FIXME: 3. If the [[control thread state]] on the OfflineAudioContext is closed, reject promise with InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
        // 4. If the OfflineAudioContext’s length is not null and [[committed frames]] is greater than or equal to OfflineAudioContext’s length, reject promise with InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
        // NB: One-shot rendering commits the entire length on success.
        if self.rendering_started.get() {
            reject_promise_with_exception(
                cx.vm(),
                promise,
                Exception::Dom(
                    "InvalidStateError",
                    Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Rendering is already started"),
                ),
            );
            return Ok(());
        }

        // FIXME: 5. Let bufferLength be a number initialized to the value of the chunkSize.
        // FIXME: 5.1. If the OfflineAudioContext’s length is null:
        // FIXME: 5.1.1. If chunkSize is null, set bufferLength to render quantum size.
        // FIXME: 5.2. Otherwise, if the OfflineAudioContext’s length is not null:
        // FIXME: 5.2.1. If chunkSize is not null and [[committed frames]] + chunkSize is less than the OfflineAudioContext’s length, set bufferLength to chunkSize.
        // FIXME: 5.2.2. Otherwise, set bufferLength to length - [[committed frames]].
        // FIXME: 6. If bufferLength is not a multiple of render quantum size, round it up to the next multiple of the render quantum size.

        // 7. Create a new AudioBuffer buffer, with a number of channels and sample rate equal respectively to the numberOfChannels and sampleRate values passed to this instance’s constructor in the contextOptions parameter; and length equal to bufferLength.
        // NB: Without chunked rendering, bufferLength is the context’s length.
        let buffer_result = self.context.create_buffer(
            cx,
            self.number_of_channels,
            self.length,
            self.context.sample_rate_value(),
        );

        // 8. If an exception was thrown during the preceding AudioBuffer constructor call, reject promise with this exception and return promise.
        let buffer = match buffer_result {
            Ok(buffer) => buffer,
            Err(error) => {
                reject_promise_with_exception(cx.vm(), promise, error);
                return Ok(());
            }
        };

        // 9. Set [[rendering started]] to true.
        self.rendering_started.set(true);

        // 10. Set [[committed frames]] to the sum of [[committed frames]] and the buffer’s length.
        // NB: The one-shot rendering guard also records that all frames have been committed.

        // 11. Append buffer to [[rendered buffers]] and begin offline rendering for buffer.
        // NB: The one-shot renderer stores a single buffer.
        self.rendered_buffer.set(Some(buffer));
        self.begin_offline_rendering(cx.vm(), promise);

        // 12. Append promise to [[pending promises]].
        self.context.pending_promises.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).push(promise);

        // 13. Return promise.
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#begin-offline-rendering
    fn begin_offline_rendering(&self, vm: &Vm, promise: WebIdlPromise) {
        // 1. Given the current connections and scheduled changes, start rendering buffer’s length sample-frames of audio into buffer.
        // 2. For every render quantum, check and suspend rendering if necessary.
        // 3. If a suspended context is resumed, continue to render the buffer.
        let renderer = OfflineAudioRenderer::new(
            Arc::clone(self.context.control_message_queue()),
            self.context.destination_value().parent().node_id(),
            self.number_of_channels as usize,
            self.length as usize,
            self.context.sample_rate_value(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
        );
        *self.renderer.borrow_mut() = Some(Arc::clone(&renderer));
        renderer.set_client(Some(Rc::new(RendererClient {
            vm: NonNull::from(vm),
            context: CellRoot::new(self.this()),
            promise: CellRoot::new(promise),
        })));
        for (frame, _) in &*self.suspend_promises.borrow() {
            renderer.request_suspend(*frame);
        }

        // AD-HOC: Other engines transition the context to "running" once rendering starts.
        self.context.set_control_state(AudioContextState::Running);
        self.context.set_state(AudioContextState::Running);
        self.context.set_rendering_state(AudioContextState::Running);
        self.queue_a_statechange_event(vm);
        renderer.start_rendering();
    }

    fn finish_rendering(&self, vm: &Vm, promise: WebIdlPromise, rendered_channels: &[Vec<f32>]) {
        // NB: Copy the rendered samples into [[rendered buffer]].
        let buffer = self.rendered_buffer.get().expect("offline rendering has a buffer");
        let mut cx = CallContext::new(vm, self.context.realm());
        for channel_index in 0..self.number_of_channels {
            let channel_data = AudioBuffer::get_channel_data(&buffer, &mut cx, channel_index)
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("the rendered channel exists"));
            overwrite_float32_array(&channel_data, &rendered_channels[channel_index as usize]);
        }

        // AD-HOC: Other engines transition the context to "closed" once rendering completes.
        self.context.set_control_state(AudioContextState::Closed);
        self.context.set_state(AudioContextState::Closed);
        self.context.set_rendering_state(AudioContextState::Closed);
        self.queue_a_statechange_event(vm);

        // NB: Break the reference cycle between the renderer's callbacks and this context.
        self.renderer.borrow().as_ref().unwrap().set_client(None);

        // 4. Once the rendering is complete, queue a media element task to execute the following steps:
        self.context
            .queue_a_media_element_task(vm, (self.this(), promise), |vm, (context, promise)| {
                let realm = promise_realm(promise);
                with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(realm, || {
                    let buffer = context.rendered_buffer.get().unwrap();

                    // 4.1. Resolve the promise created by startRendering() with buffer.
                    resolve_promise(
                        vm,
                        promise,
                        buffer
                            .to_js(&CallContext::new(vm, realm))
                            .expect("an AudioBuffer wraps"),
                    );

                    // 4.2. Remove the promise from [[pending promises]].
                    context
                        .context
                        .pending_promises
                        .borrow_mut(vm)
                        .retain(|pending| *pending != promise);

                    // FIXME: 4.3. Remove buffer from [[rendered buffers]].
                    // FIXME: 4.4. Set [[rendered frames]] to the sum of [[rendered frames]] and the length of buffer.
                    // 4.5. If length is not null:
                    // NB: One-shot rendering always has a length.
                    // 4.5.1. If [[rendered frames]] is greater than or equal to length, Queue a control message to close the OfflineAudioContext.
                    // NB: The context was closed when rendering completed.
                    // 4.5.2. Queue a media element task to fire an event named complete at the OfflineAudioContext using OfflineAudioCompletionEvent whose renderedBuffer property is set to buffer.
                    context.context.queue_a_media_element_task(vm, context, |vm, context| {
                        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
                            context.context.realm(),
                            &Utf16String::from_ascii(b"complete"),
                            false,
                            false,
                            false,
                        );
                        let event =
                            OfflineAudioCompletionEvent::create(vm, event, context.rendered_buffer.get().unwrap());
                        context.context.event_target().dispatch_event(&event.event);
                    });
                });
            });
    }

    fn handle_suspended(&self, vm: &Vm, suspend_time: f64) {
        self.context.set_control_state(AudioContextState::Suspended);
        self.context.set_state(AudioContextState::Suspended);
        self.context.set_rendering_state(AudioContextState::Suspended);
        let frame = (suspend_time * f64::from(self.context.sample_rate_value())).round() as u64;

        // Suspensions take effect at the beginning of the first render quantum at
        // or after the requested time. Keep the promise keyed by that same frame
        // so the rendering-thread callback can resolve it when it reaches the
        // boundary.
        let quantum_size = u64::from(BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE);
        let frame = (frame.wrapping_add(quantum_size - 1) / quantum_size) * quantum_size;
        let suspend_promise = {
            let mut promises = self.suspend_promises.borrow_mut(vm);
            promises
                .iter()
                .position(|entry| entry.0 == frame)
                .map(|index| promises.remove(index).1)
        };
        self.context.queue_a_media_element_task(
            vm,
            (self.this(), suspend_promise),
            |vm, (context, suspend_promise)| {
                with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(context.context.realm(), || {
                    if let Some(promise) = suspend_promise {
                        resolve_promise(vm, promise, Value::UNDEFINED);
                    }
                    context.context.dispatch_statechange();
                });
            },
        );
    }

    fn queue_a_statechange_event(&self, vm: &Vm) {
        self.context.queue_a_media_element_task(vm, self.this(), |_, context| {
            context.context.dispatch_statechange();
        });
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-offlineaudiocontext-resume
    pub(crate) fn resume(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, promise: WebIdlPromise) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // FIXME: 1. If this’s relevant global object’s associated Document is not fully active then return a promise rejected with "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
        // 2. Let promise be a new Promise.
        // NB: The binding creates promise before calling this method.
        // 3. Abort these steps and reject promise with InvalidStateError when any of following conditions is true:
        if self.renderer.borrow().is_none() || self.context.state_value() != AudioContextState::Suspended {
            reject_promise_with_exception(
                cx.vm(),
                promise,
                Exception::Dom(
                    "InvalidStateError",
                    Utf16String::from_ascii(b"The OfflineAudioContext is not suspended"),
                ),
            );
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.renderer.borrow().as_ref().unwrap().resume();

        // 4. Set the [[control thread state]] flag on the OfflineAudioContext to running.
        self.context.set_control_state(AudioContextState::Running);
        self.context.set_state(AudioContextState::Running);
        self.context.set_rendering_state(AudioContextState::Running);
        self.queue_a_statechange_event(cx.vm());

        // 5. Queue a control message to resume the OfflineAudioContext.
        resolve_promise(cx.vm(), promise, Value::UNDEFINED);

        // 6. Return promise.
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-offlineaudiocontext-suspend
    pub(crate) fn suspend(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, promise: WebIdlPromise, suspend_time: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if !suspend_time.is_finite() || suspend_time < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error(
                "Suspend time must be a finite, non-negative number",
            ));
        }
        let frame = (suspend_time * f64::from(self.context.sample_rate_value())).round() as u64;
        let quantum_size = u64::from(BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE);
        let frame = (frame.wrapping_add(quantum_size - 1) / quantum_size) * quantum_size;
        if frame >= u64::from(self.length) {
            return Err(Exception::range_error(
                "Suspend time must be less than the duration of the context",
            ));
        }
        if self.suspend_promises.borrow().iter().any(|entry| entry.0 == frame) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"A suspension is already scheduled at this time"),
            ));
        }
        self.suspend_promises.borrow_mut(cx.vm()).push((frame, promise));
        if let Some(renderer) = &*self.renderer.borrow() {
            if !renderer.request_suspend(frame) {
                self.suspend_promises
                    .borrow_mut(cx.vm())
                    .retain(|entry| entry.0 != frame);
                return Err(Exception::Dom(
                    "InvalidStateError",
                    Utf16String::from_ascii(b"The rendering thread has already passed the requested suspend time"),
                ));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-currenttime
    pub(crate) fn current_time_value(&self) -> f64 {
        // This is the time in seconds of the sample frame immediately following the last sample-frame in the block of
        // audio most recently processed by the context's rendering graph.
        if let Some(renderer) = &*self.renderer.borrow() {
            return renderer.frames_rendered() as f64 / f64::from(self.context.sample_rate_value());
        }
        0.
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-offlineaudiocontext-length
    pub(crate) fn length(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {
        // The size of the buffer in sample-frames. This is the same as the value of the length parameter for the constructor.
        Ok(self.length)
    }

    pub(crate) fn document_became_inactive(&self) {
        if let Some(renderer) = &*self.renderer.borrow() {
            renderer.stop();
            renderer.set_client(None);
        }
    }
}

use std::cell::Cell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;
use std::sync::Arc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::Trace;
use libweb_rust::web_audio::control_message::ControlMessage;
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::node_message::{NodeMessage, SetOscillatorWaveform};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::render_nodes::create_oscillator_render_node;

use super::audio_node::{
    AnyAudioNode, AudioNodeDefaultOptions, AudioNodeOptions, ChannelCountMode, ChannelInterpretation,
};
use super::audio_param::{AudioParam, AutomationRate, FixedAutomationRate};
use super::audio_scheduled_source_node::AudioScheduledSourceNode;
use super::base_audio_context::{AnyBaseAudioContext, BaseAudioContext};
use super::periodic_wave::PeriodicWave;
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

pub(crate) use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::node_message::OscillatorType;

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#OscillatorNode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct OscillatorNode {
    node: AudioScheduledSourceNode,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-oscillatornode-type
    #[gc(untraced)]
    r#type: Cell<OscillatorType>,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-oscillatornode-frequency
    frequency: Ref<AudioParam>,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-oscillatornode-detune
    detune: Ref<AudioParam>,
    periodic_wave: Cell<Option<Ref<PeriodicWave>>>,
}

impl Inherits<AudioScheduledSourceNode> for OscillatorNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioScheduledSourceNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for OscillatorNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        node.node.parent().finalize_node();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for OscillatorNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

pub(crate) struct OscillatorOptions {
    pub parent: AudioNodeOptions,
    pub r#type: OscillatorType,
    pub frequency: f32,
    pub detune: f32,
    pub periodic_wave: Option<Ref<PeriodicWave>>,
}

impl OscillatorNode {
    fn queue_waveform_update(&self) {
        let periodic_wave = self.periodic_wave.get().map(|wave| wave.render_data());
        self.node
            .parent()
            .context_value()
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::SetOscillatorWaveform(
                SetOscillatorWaveform {
                    node_id: self.node.parent().node_id(),
                    r#type: self.r#type.get(),
                    periodic_wave,
                },
            )));
    }

    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: &OscillatorOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioScheduledSourceNode::new(defer_gc, context),
            r#type: Cell::new(options.r#type),
            frequency: AudioParam::create(
                cx.vm(),
                context,
                None,
                options.frequency,
                -context.nyquist_frequency(),
                context.nyquist_frequency(),
                AutomationRate::ARate,
                FixedAutomationRate::No,
            ),
            detune: AudioParam::create(
                cx.vm(),
                context,
                None,
                options.detune,
                -1200. * ak::math::log2(f32::MAX),
                1200. * ak::math::log2(f32::MAX),
                AutomationRate::ARate,
                FixedAutomationRate::No,
            ),
            periodic_wave: Cell::new(None),
        });
        node.node.parent().set_this(AnyAudioNode::OscillatorNode(node));
        node.node.parent().event_target().set_owner(node);
        node.frequency.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::OscillatorNode(node));
        node.detune.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::OscillatorNode(node));
        if options.r#type == OscillatorType::Custom {
            node.set_periodic_wave_value(options.periodic_wave);
        }

        // Default options for channel count and interpretation
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#OscillatorNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Max,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to no
        node.node
            .parent()
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        node.node
            .parent()
            .queue_render_node_creation(create_oscillator_render_node(
                node.node.parent().node_id(),
                BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
                Arc::clone(node.frequency.render_param()),
                Arc::clone(node.detune.render_param()),
            ));
        node.queue_waveform_update();
        Ok(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn validate_options(options: &OscillatorOptions) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if options.r#type == OscillatorType::Custom && options.periodic_wave.is_none() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Oscillator node type 'custom' requires PeriodicWave to be provided"),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-oscillatornode-oscillatornode
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: OscillatorOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::validate_options(&options)?;
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-oscillatornode-type
    pub(crate) fn r#type(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<OscillatorType> {
        Ok(self.r#type.get())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-oscillatornode-type
    pub(crate) fn set_type(&self, _: &mut CallContext, r#type: OscillatorType) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if r#type == OscillatorType::Custom && self.r#type.get() != OscillatorType::Custom {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Oscillator node type cannot be changed to 'custom'"),
            ));
        }

        // FIXME: An appropriate PeriodicWave should be set here based on the given type.
        self.set_periodic_wave_value(None);
        self.r#type.set(r#type);
        self.queue_waveform_update();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-oscillatornode-setperiodicwave
    pub(crate) fn set_periodic_wave(&self, _: &mut CallContext, wave: Ref<PeriodicWave>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.set_periodic_wave_value(Some(wave));
        Ok(())
    }

    fn set_periodic_wave_value(&self, wave: Option<Ref<PeriodicWave>>) {
        self.periodic_wave.set(wave);
        self.r#type.set(OscillatorType::Custom);
        self.queue_waveform_update();
    }

    pub(crate) fn frequency(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.frequency)
    }

    pub(crate) fn detune(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.detune)
    }
}
