            rolloff_factor: Cell::new(options.rolloff_factor),
            cone_inner_angle: Cell::new(options.cone_inner_angle),
            cone_outer_angle: Cell::new(options.cone_outer_angle),
            cone_outer_gain: Cell::new(options.cone_outer_gain),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::PannerNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);
        node.position_x.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::PannerNode(node));
        node.position_y.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::PannerNode(node));
        node.position_z.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::PannerNode(node));
        node.orientation_x.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::PannerNode(node));
        node.orientation_y.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::PannerNode(node));
        node.orientation_z.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::PannerNode(node));

        // Default options for channel count and interpretation
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#PannerNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::ClampedMax,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to maybe
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        let listener = context.listener_value();
        let params = [
            node.position_x.render_param(),
            node.position_y.render_param(),
            node.position_z.render_param(),
            node.orientation_x.render_param(),
            node.orientation_y.render_param(),
            node.orientation_z.render_param(),
            listener.position_x.render_param(),
            listener.position_y.render_param(),
            listener.position_z.render_param(),
            listener.forward_x.render_param(),
            listener.forward_y.render_param(),
            listener.forward_z.render_param(),
            listener.up_x.render_param(),
            listener.up_y.render_param(),
            listener.up_z.render_param(),
        ];
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(create_panner_render_node(
            node.node.node_id(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
            &params,
        ));
        node.queue_panner_parameters_update();
        Ok(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn validate_options(options: &PannerOptions) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-refdistance
        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if this is set to a negative value.
        if options.ref_distance < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("refDistance cannot be negative"));
        }

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-rollofffactor
        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if this is set to a negative value.
        if options.rolloff_factor < 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("rolloffFactor cannot be negative"));
        }

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-maxdistance
        // A RangeError exception MUST be thrown if this is set to a non-positive value.
        if options.max_distance <= 0. {
            return Err(Exception::range_error("maxDistance must be positive"));
        }

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-coneoutergain
        // It is a linear value (not dB) in the range [0, 1]. An InvalidStateError MUST be thrown if the parameter is outside this range.
        if options.cone_outer_gain < 0. || options.cone_outer_gain > 1. {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"coneOuterGain must be in the range of [0, 1]"),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-pannernode
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: PannerOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::validate_options(&options)?;
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    pub(crate) fn position_x(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.position_x)
    }

    pub(crate) fn position_y(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.position_y)
    }

    pub(crate) fn position_z(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.position_z)
    }

    pub(crate) fn orientation_x(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.orientation_x)
    }

    pub(crate) fn orientation_y(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.orientation_y)
    }

    pub(crate) fn orientation_z(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.orientation_z)
    }

    pub(crate) fn panning_model(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<PanningModelType> {

    pub(crate) fn ref_distance(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {

    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-refdistance

            return Err(Exception::range_error("refDistance cannot be negative"));
        }
        self.ref_distance.set(value);
        self.queue_panner_parameters_update();

    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-maxdistance

        self.queue_panner_parameters_update();
        Ok(())

    pub(crate) fn rolloff_factor(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<f64> {

        Ok(self.cone_outer_gain.get())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-coneoutergain
    pub(crate) fn set_cone_outer_gain(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: f64) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // It is a linear value (not dB) in the range [0, 1]. An InvalidStateError MUST be thrown if the parameter is outside this range.
        if value < 0. || value > 1. {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"coneOuterGain must be in the range of [0, 1]"),
            ));
        }
        self.cone_outer_gain.set(value);
        self.queue_panner_parameters_update();
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-setposition
    pub(crate) fn set_position(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, x: f32, y: f32, z: f32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // This method is DEPRECATED. It is equivalent to setting positionX.value, positionY.value, and positionZ.value
        // attribute directly with the x, y and z parameters, respectively.
        // Consequently, if any of the positionX, positionY, and positionZ AudioParams have an automation curve set using
        // setValueCurveAtTime() at the time this method is called, a NotSupportedError MUST be thrown.
        AudioParam::set_value(&self.position_x, cx, x)?;
        AudioParam::set_value(&self.position_y, cx, y)?;
        AudioParam::set_value(&self.position_z, cx, z)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-pannernode-setorientation
    pub(crate) fn set_orientation(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, x: f32, y: f32, z: f32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // This method is DEPRECATED. It is equivalent to setting orientationX.value, orientationY.value, and
        // orientationZ.value attribute directly, with the x, y and z parameters, respectively.
        // Consequently, if any of the orientationX, orientationY, and orientationZ AudioParams have an automation curve set
        // using setValueCurveAtTime() at the time this method is called, a NotSupportedError MUST be thrown.
        AudioParam::set_value(&self.orientation_x, cx, x)?;
        AudioParam::set_value(&self.orientation_y, cx, y)?;
        AudioParam::set_value(&self.orientation_z, cx, z)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcount
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_override(&self, _: &mut CallContext, channel_count: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if channel_count > 2 {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"PannerNode does not support channel count greater than 2"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_impl(channel_count)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcountmode
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_mode_override(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        mode: ChannelCountMode,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if mode == ChannelCountMode::Max {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"PannerNode does not support 'max' as channelCountMode."),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_mode_impl(mode)
    }
}

 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#![allow(
    clippy::unnecessary_unwrap,
    reason = "preserve the C++ constructor's explicit option cases"
)]

use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::sync::Arc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{ErrorKind, ErrorType, Trace, Vm};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::audio_data::PeriodicWaveData;

use super::base_audio_context::AnyBaseAudioContext;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

pub(crate) struct PeriodicWaveConstraints {
    pub(crate) disable_normalization: bool,
}

pub(crate) struct PeriodicWaveOptions {
    pub(crate) parent: PeriodicWaveConstraints,
    pub(crate) real: Option<Vec<f32>>,
    pub(crate) imag: Option<Vec<f32>>,
}

struct State {
    real: Vec<f32>,
    imag: Vec<f32>,
    normalize: bool,
}

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#PeriodicWave
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct PeriodicWave {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    state: RefCell<State>,
}

impl Wrappable for PeriodicWave {
    const OWNS_EXTERNAL_MEMORY: bool = true;

    fn external_memory_size(&self) -> usize {
        let state = self.state.borrow();
        (state.real.capacity() * size_of::<f32>()).saturating_add(state.imag.capacity() * size_of::<f32>())
    }
}

fn copy_float_vector(vm: &Vm, source: &[f32]) -> WebIdlResult<Vec<f32>> {
    let mut vector = Vec::new();
    vector.try_reserve_exact(source.len()).map_err(|_| {
        Exception::from(
            vm.throw_completion::<()>(ErrorKind::InternalError, ErrorType::OutOfMemory, &[])
                .unwrap_err(),
        )
    })?;
    vector.extend_from_slice(source);
    Ok(vector)
}

fn zeroed_float_vector(vm: &Vm, size: usize) -> WebIdlResult<Vec<f32>> {
    let mut vector = Vec::new();
    vector.try_reserve_exact(size).map_err(|_| {
        Exception::from(
            vm.throw_completion::<()>(ErrorKind::InternalError, ErrorType::OutOfMemory, &[])
                .unwrap_err(),
        )
    })?;
    vector.resize(size, 0.);
    Ok(vector)
}

impl PeriodicWave {
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        _context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: PeriodicWaveOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::create(cx, options)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-periodicwave-periodicwave
    pub(crate) fn create(cx: &mut CallContext, options: PeriodicWaveOptions) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let vm = cx.vm();

        // 1. Let p be a new PeriodicWave object. Let [[real]] and [[imag]] be two internal slots of type Float32Array, and let [[normalize]] be an internal slot.
        let p = allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            state: RefCell::new(State {
                real: Vec::new(),
                imag: Vec::new(),
                normalize: true,
            }),
        });
        let mut state = p.state.borrow_mut();

        // 2. Process options according to one of the following cases:
        {
            // 1. If both options.real and options.imag are present
            if options.real.is_some() && options.imag.is_some() {
                // 1. If the lengths of options.real and options.imag are different or if either length is less than 2, throw an IndexSizeError and abort this algorithm.
                if options.real.as_ref().unwrap().len() != options.imag.as_ref().unwrap().len()
                    || options.real.as_ref().unwrap().len() < 2
                {
                    return Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_ascii(
                        b"Real and imaginary arrays must have the same length and contain at least 2 elements",
                    )));
                }

                // 2. Set [[real]] and [[imag]] to new arrays with the same length as options.real.
                // 3. Copy all elements from options.real to [[real]] and options.imag to [[imag]].
                state.real = copy_float_vector(vm, options.real.as_ref().unwrap())?;
                state.imag = copy_float_vector(vm, options.imag.as_ref().unwrap())?;
            }
            // 2. If only options.real is present
            else if let Some(real) = &options.real {
                // 1. If length of options.real is less than 2, throw an IndexSizeError and abort this algorithm
                if real.len() < 2 {
                    return Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_ascii(
                        b"Real array must contain at least 2 elements",
                    )));
                }

                // 2. Set [[real]] and [[imag]] to arrays with the same length as options.real
                // 3. Copy options.real to [[real]] and set [[imag]] to all zeros.
                state.real = copy_float_vector(vm, real)?;
                state.imag = zeroed_float_vector(vm, real.len())?;
            }
            // 3. If only options.imag is present
            else if let Some(imag) = &options.imag {
                // 1. If length of options.imag is less than 2, throw an IndexSizeError and abort this algorithm.
                if imag.len() < 2 {
                    return Err(Exception::index_size_error(Utf16String::from_ascii(
                        b"Imaginary array must contain at least 2 elements",
                    )));
                }

                // 2. Set [[real]] and [[imag]] to arrays with the same length as options.imag.
                // 3. Copy options.imag to [[imag]] and set [[real]] to all zeros.
                state.real = zeroed_float_vector(vm, imag.len())?;
                state.imag = copy_float_vector(vm, imag)?;
            }
            // 4. Otherwise
            else {
                // 1. Set [[real]] and [[imag]] to zero-filled arrays of length 2.
                state.real = zeroed_float_vector(vm, 2)?;
                state.imag = zeroed_float_vector(vm, 2)?;

                // 2. Set element at index 1 of [[imag]] to 1.
                state.imag[1] = 1.;
            }
        }

        // 3. Set element at index 0 of both [[real]] and [[imag]] to 0. (This sets the DC component to 0.)
        state.real[0] = 0.;
        state.imag[0] = 0.;

        // 4. Initialize [[normalize]] to the inverse of the disableNormalization attribute of the PeriodicWaveConstraints on the PeriodicWaveOptions.
        state.normalize = !options.parent.disable_normalization;
        drop(state);

        // 5. Return p.
        Ok(p)
    }

    pub(crate) fn render_data(&self) -> Arc<PeriodicWaveData> {
        let state = self.state.borrow();
        Arc::new(PeriodicWaveData {
            real: state.real.clone(),
            imag: state.imag.clone(),
            normalize: state.normalize,
        })
    }
}

use std::cell::Cell;
use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::Arc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::Trace;
use libjs_rust::api::Vm;
use libjs_rust::api::{EmbedderCell, GcWeak};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::script_processor_pipe::{
    ScriptProcessorPipe, ScriptProcessorPipeClient, ScriptProcessorPipeConfig,
};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::script_processor_render_node::create_script_processor_render_node;

use super::audio_buffer::AudioBuffer;
use super::audio_node::{AnyAudioNode, AudioNode, ChannelCountMode};
use super::audio_processing_event::AudioProcessingEvent;
use super::base_audio_context::{AnyBaseAudioContext, BaseAudioContext};
use crate::bindings::event_target::CppEvent;
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, Wrapped, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#ScriptProcessorNode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct ScriptProcessorNode {
    node: AudioNode,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pipe: RefCell<Option<Arc<ScriptProcessorPipe>>>,
    buffer_size: Cell<i32>,
    number_of_input_channels: u8,
    number_of_output_channels: u8,
}

impl Inherits<AudioNode> for ScriptProcessorNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for ScriptProcessorNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        if let Some(pipe) = &*node.pipe.borrow() {
            pipe.set_client(None);
            pipe.shut_down();
        }
        node.node.finalize_node();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for ScriptProcessorNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

struct PipeClient {
    vm: NonNull<Vm>,
    node: GcWeak<EmbedderCell<Wrapped<ScriptProcessorNode>>>,
}

impl ScriptProcessorPipeClient for PipeClient {
    fn process(&self, block: usize, start_frame: u64) {
        if let Some(node) = self.node.get() {
            // SAFETY: The VM of the control thread outlives its audio nodes.
            node.process_block(unsafe { self.vm.as_ref() }, block, start_frame);
        }
    }
}

// Other engines have a latency of two buffers. A realtime context needs more when the device pulls a burst of audio
// that is longer than a buffer, since script cannot run in the middle of a burst.
fn block_count_for_context(context: AnyBaseAudioContext, buffer_size: usize) -> usize {
    if matches!(context, AnyBaseAudioContext::OfflineAudioContext(_)) {
        return 2;
    }
    let quantum_size = BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize;
    let sizing = libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::audio_worklet_pipe::ring_sizing_for_device_latency(
        100,
        context.sample_rate_value(),
        quantum_size,
    );
    let lookahead_frames = sizing.prime_level * quantum_size;
    (lookahead_frames.div_ceil(buffer_size) + 1).max(2)
}

impl ScriptProcessorNode {
    pub(crate) const DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE: i32 = 1024;

    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        buffer_size: i32,
        number_of_input_channels: u32,
        number_of_output_channels: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        let script_processor_node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, number_of_input_channels as u8 as u32),
            number_of_input_channels: number_of_input_channels as u8,
            number_of_output_channels: number_of_output_channels as u8,
            buffer_size: Cell::new(0),
            pipe: RefCell::new(None),
        });
        script_processor_node
            .node
            .set_this(AnyAudioNode::ScriptProcessorNode(script_processor_node));
        script_processor_node
            .node
            .event_target()
            .set_owner(script_processor_node);
        script_processor_node.buffer_size.set(buffer_size);

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcountmode
        // The channel count mode cannot be changed from "explicit" and an NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown for
        // any attempt to change the value.
        script_processor_node.set_channel_count_mode_override(cx, ChannelCountMode::Explicit)?;
        let pipe_config = ScriptProcessorPipeConfig {
            buffer_size: buffer_size as usize,
            input_channel_count: number_of_input_channels as usize,
            output_channel_count: number_of_output_channels as usize,
            block_count: block_count_for_context(context, buffer_size as usize),
            waits_for_processing: matches!(context, AnyBaseAudioContext::OfflineAudioContext(_)),
        };
        let pipe = ScriptProcessorPipe::new(pipe_config);
        pipe.set_client(Some(Rc::new(PipeClient {
            vm: NonNull::from(cx.vm()),
            node: GcWeak::new(cx.vm().heap(), script_processor_node),
        })));
        *script_processor_node.pipe.borrow_mut() = Some(Arc::clone(&pipe));
        context.add_script_processor_node(cx.vm(), script_processor_node);
        script_processor_node
            .node
            .queue_render_node_creation(create_script_processor_render_node(
                script_processor_node.node.node_id(),
                BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
                Arc::clone(&pipe),
            ));
        Ok(script_processor_node)
    }

    fn process_block(&self, vm: &Vm, block: usize, start_frame: u64) {
        let pipe = self
            .pipe
            .borrow()
            .as_ref()
            .cloned()
            .expect("a process callback has a pipe");
        let config = pipe.config;
        if !self.node.context_value().document_is_fully_active() {
            unsafe { pipe.hand_block_back_to_rendering_thread(block, false) };
            return;
        }
        let sample_rate = self.node.context_value().sample_rate_value();
        let input_buffer = AudioBuffer::create(
            vm,
            config.input_channel_count as u32,
            config.buffer_size as u32,
            sample_rate,
        )
        .expect("input buffer allocation succeeds");
        for channel in 0..config.input_channel_count {
            let (destination, size) = input_buffer
                .channel_data(channel as u32)
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("the input channel exists"));
            let (source, length) = unsafe { pipe.input_channel(block, channel) };
            assert!(length * size_of::<f32>() <= size);
            unsafe { std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(source.cast::<u8>(), destination, length * size_of::<f32>()) };
        }
        let output_buffer = AudioBuffer::create(
            vm,
            config.output_channel_count as u32,
            config.buffer_size as u32,
            sample_rate,
        )
        .expect("output buffer allocation succeeds");
        let playback_time =
            (start_frame + (config.block_count * config.buffer_size) as u64) as f64 / f64::from(sample_rate);
        let realm = self.node.context_value().realm();
        with_temporary_execution_context_and_callbacks(realm, || {
            let event =
                CppEvent::create_for_owner(realm, &Utf16String::from_ascii(b"audioprocess"), false, false, false);
            let event = AudioProcessingEvent::create(vm, event, playback_time, input_buffer, output_buffer);
            self.node.event_target().dispatch_event(&event.event);
        });

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#acquire-the-content
        // When the dispatch of an AudioProcessingEvent completes, it acquires the contents of its outputBuffer.
        let Some(output) = AudioBuffer::acquire_contents(output_buffer, vm) else {
            unsafe { pipe.hand_block_back_to_rendering_thread(block, false) };
            return;
        };
        for channel in 0..config.output_channel_count {
            let (destination, length) = unsafe { pipe.output_channel(block, channel) };
            assert!(output.channels[channel].len() <= length);
            unsafe {
                std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
                    output.channels[channel].as_ptr(),
                    destination,
                    output.channels[channel].len(),
                );
            };
        }
        unsafe { pipe.hand_block_back_to_rendering_thread(block, true) };
    }

    pub(crate) fn validate_options(
        buffer_size: i32,
        number_of_input_channels: u32,
        number_of_output_channels: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#ScriptProcessorNode
        // It is invalid for both numberOfInputChannels and numberOfOutputChannels to be zero. In this case an
        // IndexSizeError MUST be thrown.
        if number_of_input_channels == 0 && number_of_output_channels == 0 {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(
                    b"Number of input and output channels cannot both be zero in a ScriptProcessorNode",
                ),
            ));
        }

        // This parameter determines the number of channels for this node’s input. The default value is 2. Values of up to
        // 32 must be supported. A NotSupportedError must be thrown if the number of channels is not supported.
        if number_of_input_channels > BaseAudioContext::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Invalid number of input channels"),
            ));
        }

        // This parameter determines the number of channels for this node’s output. The default value is 2. Values of up to
        // 32 must be supported. A NotSupportedError must be thrown if the number of channels is not supported.
        if number_of_output_channels > BaseAudioContext::MAX_NUMBER_OF_CHANNELS {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Invalid number of output channels"),
            ));
        }

        // The size of the buffer (in sample-frames) which needs to be processed each time audioprocess is fired. Legal
        // values are (256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384).
        //
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-baseaudiocontext-createscriptprocessor
        // If the value of this parameter is not one of the allowed power-of-2 values listed above, an IndexSizeError MUST
        // be thrown.
        if !matches!(buffer_size, 256 | 512 | 1024 | 2048 | 4096 | 8192 | 16384) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "IndexSizeError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Unsupported buffer size for a ScriptProcessorNode"),
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn buffer_size(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        Ok(self.buffer_size.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_inputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        1
    }

    pub(crate) fn number_of_outputs_value(&self) -> u32 {
        1
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcount
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_override(&self, _: &mut CallContext, _: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // ScriptProcessorNode: The channel count cannot be changed, and an NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown for
        // any attempt to change the value.
        Err(Exception::Dom(
            "InvalidStateError",
            Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot modify channel count in a ScriptProcessorNode"),
        ))
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_mode_override(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelcountmode-constraints
        // ScriptProcessorNode: The channel count mode cannot be changed from "explicit" and an NotSupportedError exception
        // MUST be thrown for any attempt to change the value.
        if channel_count_mode != ChannelCountMode::Explicit {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Channel count mode must be 'explicit'"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_mode_impl(channel_count_mode)
    }
}

use std::ffi::c_void;

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#stereopannernode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct StereoPannerNode {
    node: AudioNode,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-stereopannernode-pan
    pan: Ref<AudioParam>,
}

impl Inherits<AudioNode> for StereoPannerNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for StereoPannerNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        node.node.finalize_node();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for StereoPannerNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

pub(crate) struct StereoPannerOptions {
    pub parent: AudioNodeOptions,
    pub pan: f32,
}

impl StereoPannerNode {
    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-stereopannernode-stereopannernode
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: StereoPannerOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: &StereoPannerOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // Create the node and allocate memory
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            pan: AudioParam::create(
                cx.vm(),
                context,
                None,
                options.pan,
                -1.,
                1.,
                AutomationRate::ARate,
                FixedAutomationRate::No,
            ),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::StereoPannerNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);
        node.pan.set_owner(AnyAudioNode::StereoPannerNode(node));

        // Default options for channel count and interpretation
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#stereopannernode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::ClampedMax,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to no
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(create_stereo_panner_render_node(
            node.node.node_id(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
            Arc::clone(node.pan.render_param()),
        ));
        Ok(node)
    }

    pub(crate) fn pan(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<AudioParam>> {
        Ok(self.pan)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcount
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_override(&self, _: &mut CallContext, channel_count: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelcount-constraints
        // The channel count cannot be greater than two, and a NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown for any attempt to change it to a value greater than two.
        if channel_count > 2 {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"StereoPannerNode does not support channel count greater than 2"),
            ));
        }

        self.node.set_channel_count_impl(channel_count)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-audionode-channelcountmode
    pub(crate) fn set_channel_count_mode_override(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        mode: ChannelCountMode,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#audionode-channelcountmode-constraints
        // The channel count mode cannot be set to "max", and a NotSupportedError exception MUST be thrown for any attempt to set it to "max".
        if mode == ChannelCountMode::Max {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "NotSupportedError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"StereoPannerNode does not support 'max' as channelCountMode."),
            ));
        }

        // If the mode is valid, call the base class implementation
        self.node.set_channel_count_mode_impl(mode)
    }
}

/*

use std::cell::Cell;
use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;
use std::sync::Arc;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Trace};
use libjs_rust::api::{TypedArrayBase, TypedArrayKind, create_typed_array};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::control_message::ControlMessage;
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::audio_data::WaveShaperCurve;
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::node_message::{NodeMessage, SetWaveShaperParameters};
use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::render_nodes::create_wave_shaper_render_node;

use super::audio_array::{copy_float32_array, float32_array_length, overwrite_float32_array};
use super::audio_node::{
    AnyAudioNode, AudioNode, AudioNodeDefaultOptions, AudioNodeOptions, ChannelCountMode, ChannelInterpretation,
};
use super::base_audio_context::{AnyBaseAudioContext, BaseAudioContext};
use crate::bindings::event_target::{CppEventTarget, GetTheParent};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, Exception, WebIdlResult};

pub(crate) use libweb_rust::web_audio::rendering::node_message::OverSampleType;

// https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#WaveShaperNode
#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WaveShaperNode {
    node: AudioNode,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-waveshapernode-curve
    curve: Cell<Option<Gc<TypedArrayBase>>>,

    // When this attribute is set, an internal copy of the curve is created by the WaveShaperNode.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    curve_copy: RefCell<Option<Arc<WaveShaperCurve>>>,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-waveshapernode-curve-set-slot
    curve_set: Cell<bool>,

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-waveshapernode-oversample
    #[gc(untraced)]
    oversample: Cell<OverSampleType>,
}

impl Inherits<AudioNode> for WaveShaperNode {
    fn parent(&self) -> &AudioNode {
        &self.node
    }
}

impl Wrappable for WaveShaperNode {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.node.cpp_parent()
    }

    const FINALIZES: bool = true;

    fn finalize(node: Ref<Self>) {
        node.node.finalize_node();
    }
}

impl GetTheParent for WaveShaperNode {
    fn get_the_parent(&self) -> Option<CppEventTarget> {
        None
    }
}

pub(crate) struct WaveShaperOptions {
    pub parent: AudioNodeOptions,
    pub curve: Option<Vec<f32>>,
    pub oversample: OverSampleType,
}

impl WaveShaperNode {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: &WaveShaperOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        // When the constructor is called with a BaseAudioContext c and an option object option, the user agent MUST
        // initialize the AudioNode this, with context and options as arguments.
        let node = allocate(cx.vm(), |defer_gc| Self {
            node: AudioNode::new(defer_gc, context, 2),
            curve: Cell::new(None),
            curve_copy: RefCell::new(None),
            curve_set: Cell::new(false),
            oversample: Cell::new(OverSampleType::None),
        });
        node.node.set_this(AnyAudioNode::WaveShaperNode(node));
        node.node.event_target().set_owner(node);

        // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#WaveShaperNode
        let default_options = AudioNodeDefaultOptions {
            channel_count: 2,
            channel_count_mode: ChannelCountMode::Max,
            channel_interpretation: ChannelInterpretation::Speakers,
        };

        // FIXME: Set tail-time to yes when the oversample attribute is "2x" or "4x".
        node.node
            .initialize_audio_node_options(cx, &options.parent, &default_options)?;
        node.node.queue_render_node_creation(create_wave_shaper_render_node(
            node.node.node_id(),
            BaseAudioContext::RENDER_QUANTUM_SIZE as usize,
        ));
        node.oversample.set(options.oversample);

        // Also, let [[curve set]] be an internal slot of this WaveShaperNode. Initialize this slot to false. If options is
        // given and specifies a curve, set [[curve set]] to true.
        // NB: Setting the curve attribute to the curve of options sets [[curve set]] to true.
        if let Some(curve) = &options.curve {
            let array = create_typed_array(cx.vm(), context.realm(), TypedArrayKind::Float32Array, curve.len())?;
            overwrite_float32_array(&array, curve);
            node.set_curve(cx, Some(array))?;
        } else {
            node.send_parameters_to_render_node();
        }
        Ok(node)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-waveshapernode-waveshapernode
    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        context: AnyBaseAudioContext,
        options: WaveShaperOptions,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<Self>> {
        Self::create(cx, context, &options)
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-waveshapernode-curve
    pub(crate) fn set_curve(&self, _: &mut CallContext, new_curve: Option<Gc<TypedArrayBase>>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // A InvalidStateError MUST be thrown if this attribute is set with a Float32Array that has a length less than 2.
        if new_curve.is_some_and(|curve| float32_array_length(&curve) < 2) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"The curve must have at least two values"),
            ));
        }

        // To set the curve attribute, execute these steps:
        // 1. Let new curve be a Float32Array to be assigned to curve or null. .
        // 2. If new curve is not null and [[curve set]] is true, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
        if new_curve.is_some() && self.curve_set.get() {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "InvalidStateError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"The curve has already been set"),
            ));
        }

        // 3. If new curve is not null, set [[curve set]] to true.
        if new_curve.is_some() {
            self.curve_set.set(true);
        }

        // 4. Assign new curve to the curve attribute.
        self.curve.set(new_curve);

        // When this attribute is set, an internal copy of the curve is created by the WaveShaperNode. Subsequent
        // modifications of the contents of the array used to set the attribute therefore have no effect.
        *self.curve_copy.borrow_mut() = new_curve.map(|curve| {
            Arc::new(WaveShaperCurve {
                values: copy_float32_array(&curve),
            })
        });
        self.send_parameters_to_render_node();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn curve(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Gc<TypedArrayBase>>> {
        Ok(self.curve.get())
    }

    pub(crate) fn oversample(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<OverSampleType> {
        Ok(self.oversample.get())
    }

    // https://webaudio.github.io/web-audio-api/#dom-waveshapernode-oversample
    pub(crate) fn set_oversample(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: OverSampleType) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.oversample.set(value);
        self.send_parameters_to_render_node();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn send_parameters_to_render_node(&self) {
        self.node
            .context_value()
            .queue_control_message(ControlMessage::NodeMessage(NodeMessage::SetWaveShaperParameters(
                SetWaveShaperParameters {
                    node_id: self.node.node_id(),
                    curve: self.curve_copy.borrow().clone(),
                    oversample: self.oversample.get(),
                },
            )));
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/web_gl/buffer_kind.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/2.0/#5.1
//!
//! A buffer holds indices or other data, and which of the two is decided by the first target that it is bound to. A
//! target that an operation does not bind buffers to has no kind, so that a bind that fails for its target cannot
//! decide the kind of a buffer.

use core::cell::Cell;

use super::constants::{GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER, GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum BufferKind {
    ElementArray,
    OtherData,
}

impl BufferKind {
    pub(crate) fn of_buffers_at_indexed_target(target: u32) -> Option<Self> {
        matches!(target, GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER | GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER).then_some(Self::OtherData)
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct KindOfFirstBinding(Cell<Option<BufferKind>>);

impl KindOfFirstBinding {
    /// Operations ask before they look at the target, so it can be one that they do not bind buffers to. A buffer of
    /// the wrong kind for it is refused all the same, and only a buffer that is not refused goes on to fail for it.
    pub(crate) fn allows_binding_to(&self, target: u32) -> bool {
        match self.0.get() {
            None => true,
            Some(BufferKind::ElementArray) => target == GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER,
            Some(BufferKind::OtherData) => target != GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn record_binding_as(&self, kind: BufferKind) {
        if self.0.get().is_none() {
            self.0.set(Some(kind));
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::web_gl::constants::GL_ARRAY_BUFFER;

    const TARGET_THAT_NO_OPERATION_BINDS_BUFFERS_TO: u32 = 0x1234;

    #[test]
    fn asking_whether_a_buffer_can_be_bound_does_not_decide_its_kind() {
        let kind = KindOfFirstBinding::default();
        assert!(kind.allows_binding_to(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER));
        assert!(kind.allows_binding_to(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER));
        assert!(kind.allows_binding_to(TARGET_THAT_NO_OPERATION_BINDS_BUFFERS_TO));
        assert!(kind.allows_binding_to(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_buffer_keeps_the_kind_of_its_first_binding() {
        let kind = KindOfFirstBinding::default();
        kind.record_binding_as(BufferKind::ElementArray);
        assert!(kind.allows_binding_to(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER));
        assert!(!kind.allows_binding_to(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER));
        assert!(!kind.allows_binding_to(GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER));

        kind.record_binding_as(BufferKind::OtherData);
        assert!(kind.allows_binding_to(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER));
        assert!(!kind.allows_binding_to(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER));

        let kind = KindOfFirstBinding::default();
        kind.record_binding_as(BufferKind::OtherData);
        assert!(kind.allows_binding_to(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER));
        assert!(kind.allows_binding_to(GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER));
        assert!(!kind.allows_binding_to(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_target_that_binds_no_buffers_refuses_only_a_buffer_of_indices() {
        let kind = KindOfFirstBinding::default();
        kind.record_binding_as(BufferKind::ElementArray);
        assert!(!kind.allows_binding_to(TARGET_THAT_NO_OPERATION_BINDS_BUFFERS_TO));

        let kind = KindOfFirstBinding::default();
        kind.record_binding_as(BufferKind::OtherData);
        assert!(kind.allows_binding_to(TARGET_THAT_NO_OPERATION_BINDS_BUFFERS_TO));
    }

    #[test]
    fn bind_buffer_base_and_range_give_a_kind_only_at_their_indexed_targets() {
        assert_eq!(
            BufferKind::of_buffers_at_indexed_target(GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER),
            Some(BufferKind::OtherData)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            BufferKind::of_buffers_at_indexed_target(GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER),
            Some(BufferKind::OtherData)
        );
        assert_eq!(BufferKind::of_buffers_at_indexed_target(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER), None);
        assert_eq!(BufferKind::of_buffers_at_indexed_target(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER), None);
        assert_eq!(
            BufferKind::of_buffers_at_indexed_target(TARGET_THAT_NO_OPERATION_BINDS_BUFFERS_TO),
            None
        );
    }
}

//! Borrowing and copying the script memory that WebGL operations read and write. Which bytes an operation may have
//! is the arithmetic of byte_ranges.rs.

use core::ops::Range;

use libjs_rust::api::{ArrayBuffer, Gc, TypedArrayBase};

use super::byte_ranges::{
    Extent, GlSize, ListTail, OutOfRange, UploadRange, destination_range, destination_range_of_get_buffer_sub_data,
    list_range, offset_in_buffer_of_checked_write, sequence_list_tail, typed_array_list_range, typed_array_list_tail,
    upload_range, upload_range_of_2d_texture,
};
use super::pixel_unpacking::{ImageUnpackConversion, is_valid_2d_pixel_unpack_state, required_2d_texture_data_size};
use super::proxy::recorder::{PlainNumber, bytes_of};
use super::state::ContextState;
use super::types::Float32List;
use super::web_gl_rendering_context_overloads::Int32List;
use super::web_gl2_rendering_context_base::Uint32List;
use crate::bindings::conversions::{
    ArrayBufferView, BufferSource, BufferSourceExtent, copy_of_bytes_of_buffer, with_bytes_of_buffer,
};

fn buffer_and_extent_of(source: &BufferSource) -> (Gc<ArrayBuffer>, Extent) {
    let BufferSourceExtent {
        buffer,
        is_out_of_bounds,
        byte_offset,
        byte_length,
        element_size,
    } = source.extent();
    let extent = Extent {
        buffer_is_detached: buffer.is_detached(),
        buffer_byte_length: buffer.byte_length(),
        is_out_of_bounds,
        byte_offset,
        byte_length,
        element_size,
    };
    (buffer, extent)
}

fn extent_of(source: &BufferSource) -> Extent {
    let (_, extent) = buffer_and_extent_of(source);
    extent
}

pub(crate) struct SourceBytes {
    buffer: Gc<ArrayBuffer>,
    range: UploadRange,
}

pub(crate) fn source_bytes(
    source: BufferSource,
    src_offset: u64,
    src_length_override: u32,
) -> Result<SourceBytes, OutOfRange> {
    let (buffer, extent) = buffer_and_extent_of(&source);
    let range = upload_range(&extent, src_offset, src_length_override)?;
    Ok(SourceBytes { buffer, range })
}

impl SourceBytes {
    pub(crate) fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.range.length().get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn gl_size(&self) -> i32 {
        self.range.length().as_gl_sizei()
    }

    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// The function must not run script or allocate a cell, either of which could detach, resize or free the buffer
    /// that the bytes are in.
    unsafe fn with<R>(&self, function: impl FnOnce(&[u8]) -> R) -> R {
        // SAFETY: The caller keeps the function from running script and from allocating.
        unsafe { with_bytes_of_buffer(&self.buffer, self.range.bytes_in_buffer(), function) }
            .expect("nothing has run since the bytes were found")
    }

    fn copy(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        copy_of_bytes_of_buffer(&self.buffer, self.range.bytes_in_buffer())
            .expect("nothing has run since the bytes were found")
    }
}

/// The pixels that texImage2D or texSubImage2D upload from an ArrayBufferView.
pub(crate) struct TextureData {
    bytes: SourceBytes,
    /// `None` when GL takes the pixels as they are.
    conversion: Option<ImageUnpackConversion>,
}

impl TextureData {
    pub(crate) fn gl_size(&self) -> i32 {
        self.bytes.gl_size()
    }
}

impl ContextState {
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `record` gets the bytes while they are borrowed from script memory, so it must not run script or allocate a
    /// cell, either of which could detach, resize or free the buffer that they are in. Recording one command with
    /// them does neither.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn upload<R>(&self, bytes: &SourceBytes, record: impl FnOnce(&[u8]) -> R) -> R {
        // SAFETY: The caller keeps `record` from running script and from allocating, and the recorder defers what
        //         would call out of the process until the bytes are given back.
        self.proxy
            .record_with_borrowed_data(bytes.len(), || unsafe { bytes.with(record) })
    }

    /// `record` gets `None` when the source has no bytes from the offset of the upload on, and otherwise the data,
    /// even if the upload records none of it.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// As for upload().
    pub(crate) unsafe fn upload_through_nullable_pointer<R>(
        &self,
        bytes: &SourceBytes,
        record: impl FnOnce(Option<&[u8]>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        let source_has_bytes = bytes.range.source_has_bytes();
        // SAFETY: The caller keeps `record` from running script and from allocating.
        unsafe { self.upload(bytes, |bytes| record(source_has_bytes.then_some(bytes))) }
    }

    pub(crate) fn texture_data_for_2d_upload(
        &self,
        source: ArrayBufferView,
        src_offset: u64,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
    ) -> Result<TextureData, OutOfRange> {
        let unpack_state = self.unpack_state.get();
        if !is_valid_2d_pixel_unpack_state(width, &unpack_state) {
            return Err(OutOfRange);
        }
        let size_that_the_image_takes = required_2d_texture_data_size(width, height, format, r#type, &unpack_state);
        let (buffer, extent) = buffer_and_extent_of(&BufferSource::from(source));
        let range = upload_range_of_2d_texture(&extent, src_offset, size_that_the_image_takes)?;

        let flip_y = self.unpack_flip_y.get();
        let premultiply_alpha = self.unpack_premultiply_alpha.get();
        let conversion = (flip_y || premultiply_alpha).then_some(ImageUnpackConversion {
            width,
            height,
            format,
            r#type,
            unpack_state,
            flip_y,
            premultiply_alpha,
        });
        Ok(TextureData {
            bytes: SourceBytes { buffer, range },
            conversion,
        })
    }

    /// `record` gets `None` when the source has no bytes from the offset of the upload on, and otherwise the pixels,
    /// flipped and premultiplied as UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL and UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL ask. Converted pixels are
    /// a copy, which leaves the memory of script as it is.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// As for upload().
    pub(crate) unsafe fn upload_texture_data<R>(
        &self,
        texture_data: &TextureData,
        record: impl FnOnce(Option<&[u8]>) -> R,
    ) -> R {
        let Some(conversion) = texture_data.conversion else {
            // SAFETY: The caller keeps `record` from running script and from allocating.
            return unsafe { self.upload_through_nullable_pointer(&texture_data.bytes, record) };
        };
        let mut pixels = texture_data.bytes.copy();
        conversion.convert(&mut pixels);
        record(texture_data.bytes.range.source_has_bytes().then_some(&pixels))
    }
}

pub(crate) fn destination_bytes(view: &ArrayBufferView, dst_offset: u64) -> Result<Range<usize>, OutOfRange> {
    destination_range(&extent_of(&BufferSource::from(*view)), dst_offset)
}

pub(crate) fn destination_bytes_of_get_buffer_sub_data(
    dst_buffer: &ArrayBufferView,
    dst_offset: u64,
    length: u32,
) -> Result<Option<Range<usize>>, OutOfRange> {
    destination_range_of_get_buffer_sub_data(&extent_of(&BufferSource::from(*dst_buffer)), dst_offset, length)
}

pub(crate) fn write_checked(view: &ArrayBufferView, bytes: &[u8], starting_offset: usize) -> Result<(), OutOfRange> {
    let (buffer, extent) = buffer_and_extent_of(&BufferSource::from(*view));
    if let Some(write_offset) = offset_in_buffer_of_checked_write(&extent, bytes.len(), starting_offset)? {
        buffer.overwrite(write_offset, bytes);
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// A copy, so the numbers stay what they are whatever script does.
pub(crate) struct ListBytes {
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
    element_count: GlSize,

impl ListBytes {

        self.element_count.as_gl_sizei()
    }

    pub(crate) fn gl_count_of_whole_groups_of(&self, group_size: usize) -> Option<i32> {
        self.element_count.count_of_whole_groups_of(group_size)
    }

    pub(crate) fn as_bytes(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.bytes
    }

pub(crate) trait NumberList {
    type Number: PlainNumber;

    fn typed_array(&self) -> Option<Gc<TypedArrayBase>>;
    fn sequence(&self) -> &[Self::Number];
}

impl NumberList for Float32List {
    type Number = f32;

    fn typed_array(&self) -> Option<Gc<TypedArrayBase>> {
        match self {
            Self::Float32Array(typed_array) => Some(*typed_array),
            Self::Sequence(_) => None,
        }
    }

    fn sequence(&self) -> &[f32] {
        match self {
            Self::Float32Array(_) => &[],
            Self::Sequence(numbers) => numbers,
        }
    }
}

impl NumberList for Int32List {
    type Number = i32;

    fn typed_array(&self) -> Option<Gc<TypedArrayBase>> {
        match self {
            Self::Int32Array(typed_array) => Some(*typed_array),
            Self::Sequence(_) => None,
        }
    }

    fn sequence(&self) -> &[i32] {
        match self {
            Self::Int32Array(_) => &[],
            Self::Sequence(numbers) => numbers,
        }
    }
}

impl NumberList for Uint32List {
    type Number = u32;

    fn typed_array(&self) -> Option<Gc<TypedArrayBase>> {
        match self {
            Self::Uint32Array(typed_array) => Some(*typed_array),
            Self::Sequence(_) => None,
        }
    }

    fn sequence(&self) -> &[u32] {
        match self {
            Self::Uint32Array(_) => &[],
            Self::Sequence(numbers) => numbers,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn list_bytes<L: NumberList>(
    list: &L,
    src_offset: u64,
    src_length_override: u32,
) -> Result<ListBytes, OutOfRange> {
    let Some(typed_array) = list.typed_array() else {
        let numbers = list.sequence();
        let range = list_range(numbers.len(), size_of::<L::Number>(), src_offset, src_length_override)?;
        let numbers = numbers.get(range.elements).ok_or(OutOfRange)?;
        return Ok(ListBytes {
            bytes: bytes_of(numbers).to_vec(),
            element_count: range.element_count,
        });
    };

    let (buffer, extent) = buffer_and_extent_of(&BufferSource::TypedArray(typed_array));
    let range = typed_array_list_range(&extent, src_offset, src_length_override)?;
    let bytes = copy_of_bytes_of_buffer(&buffer, range.bytes_in_buffer).ok_or(OutOfRange)?;
    Ok(ListBytes {
        bytes,
        element_count: range.element_count,
    })
}

enum NumbersOfList<'list, N> {
    Sequence(&'list [N]),
    TypedArray(Gc<ArrayBuffer>),
}

/// For an operation that records only the first few numbers of a list from an offset on. GL is not told how many
/// numbers the list has, so unlike list_bytes() this takes a list of any length, and copies only what is recorded.
pub(crate) struct NumbersFromOffset<'list, N> {
    numbers: NumbersOfList<'list, N>,
    tail: ListTail,
}

pub(crate) fn numbers_from_offset<L: NumberList>(
    list: &L,
    src_offset: u64,
) -> Result<NumbersFromOffset<'_, L::Number>, OutOfRange> {
    let Some(typed_array) = list.typed_array() else {
        let numbers = list.sequence();
        return Ok(NumbersFromOffset {
            tail: sequence_list_tail(numbers.len(), size_of::<L::Number>(), src_offset)?,
            numbers: NumbersOfList::Sequence(numbers),
        });
    };

    let (buffer, extent) = buffer_and_extent_of(&BufferSource::TypedArray(typed_array));
    Ok(NumbersFromOffset {
        tail: typed_array_list_tail(&extent, src_offset)?,
        numbers: NumbersOfList::TypedArray(buffer),
    })
}

impl<N: PlainNumber> NumbersFromOffset<'_, N> {
    /// `None` when the list has fewer numbers from the offset on.
    pub(crate) fn copy_of_first(&self, count: usize) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        let bytes = self.tail.bytes_of_leading_elements(count)?;
        match self.numbers {
            NumbersOfList::Sequence(numbers) => bytes_of(numbers).get(bytes).map(<[u8]>::to_vec),
            NumbersOfList::TypedArray(buffer) => copy_of_bytes_of_buffer(&buffer, bytes),
        }
    }
}

/// `None` when the list has fewer numbers.
pub(crate) fn copy_of_first_numbers<L: NumberList>(list: &L, count: usize) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    numbers_from_offset(list, 0).ok()?.copy_of_first(count)
}
