//! The transport of a context in the product: the CompositorConnection of the page of its canvas, which its messages go
//! through, and the shared memory that they carry.

use core::cell::Cell;

use libcompositing_rust::display_list::canvas_2d_recorder::{AlphaType, ColorSpace};
use libcompositing_rust::display_list::commands::{CanvasId, ImageFrameResourceId, VideoSinkHandle};
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::Compositing_WebGL_WebGLVersion;
use libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::compositor_web_content_server::messages::{
    CreateWebglContext, DestroyWebglContext, WebglClearDrawingBuffer, WebglCommands, WebglCommandsFromSharedBuffer,
    WebglDrainCommandBuffer, WebglPresentCanvas, WebglReadBackDrawingBuffer, WebglReadBufferSubData, WebglReadPixels,
    WebglSetCommandBuffer, WebglSyncCall,
};
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::ImageSource;
use libgfx_rust::image_frame::ImageFrameHandle;
use libgfx_rust::{IntRect, IntSize};

use super::proxy::transport::{ReadPixelsResult, SharedMemory, Transport};
use super::state::MAX_WEBGL_DRAWING_BUFFER_DIMENSION;
use crate::canvas_2d::canvas::CapturedVideoFrame;
use crate::compositor_connection::{CompositorConnection, SharedBuffer};

fn rect_inside_largest_drawing_buffer(x: i32, y: i32, width: i32, height: i32) -> Option<IntRect> {
    let clamp = |coordinate: i32| coordinate.clamp(0, MAX_WEBGL_DRAWING_BUFFER_DIMENSION);
    let (left, top) = (clamp(x), clamp(y));
    let (right, bottom) = (clamp(x.saturating_add(width)), clamp(y.saturating_add(height)));
    (left < right && top < bottom).then_some(IntRect {
        x: left,
        y: top,
        width: right - left,
        height: bottom - top,
    })
}

impl SharedMemory for SharedBuffer {
    fn as_ptr(&self) -> *mut u8 {
        SharedBuffer::as_ptr(self)
    }

    fn len(&self) -> usize {
        SharedBuffer::len(self)
    }
}

pub(crate) enum Frame {
    Image(ImageFrameHandle),
    Video(CapturedVideoFrame),
}

pub(crate) struct ContextCreation {
    pub(crate) webgl2: bool,
    pub(crate) size: IntSize,
    pub(crate) depth: bool,
    pub(crate) stencil: bool,
    pub(crate) antialias: bool,
}

pub(crate) struct RemoteContext {
    connection: CompositorConnection,
    canvas_id: Cell<Option<CanvasId>>,
}

impl RemoteContext {
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// `connection` holds a reference to the connection, which the call takes over.
    pub(crate) unsafe fn create(
        connection: CompositorConnection,
        creation: &ContextCreation,
    ) -> Option<(Self, Vec<Vec<u8>>)> {
        let context = Self {
            connection,
            canvas_id: Cell::new(None),
        };
        let response = connection.send_sync(CreateWebglContext {
            webgl_version: if creation.webgl2 {
                Compositing_WebGL_WebGLVersion::WebGL2
            } else {
                Compositing_WebGL_WebGLVersion::WebGL1
            },
            size: creation.size,
            depth: creation.depth,
            stencil: creation.stencil,
            antialias: creation.antialias,
        })?;
        if !response.success {
            return None;
        }
        context.canvas_id.set(Some(response.canvas_id));
        let supported_extensions = response
            .supported_extensions
            .into_iter()
            .map(|extension| extension.into_bytes())
            .collect();
        Some((context, supported_extensions))
    }

    fn image_sources_of(&self, frames: &[Frame]) -> Option<Vec<ImageSource>> {
        let image_frames: Vec<&ImageFrameHandle> = frames
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|frame| match frame {
                Frame::Image(image_frame) => Some(image_frame),
                Frame::Video(_) => None,
            })
            .collect();
        if !image_frames.is_empty() && !self.connection.register_image_frames(&image_frames) {
            self.connection.lose_compositor();
            return None;
        }
        Some(
            frames
                .iter()
                .map(|frame| match frame {
                    Frame::Image(image_frame) => {
                        ImageSource::RegisteredImageFrame(ImageFrameResourceId(image_frame.id()))
                    }
                    Frame::Video(video_frame) => ImageSource::HeldVideoFrame {
                        sink_handle: VideoSinkHandle(video_frame.sink_handle),
                        generation: video_frame.generation,
                    },
                })
                .collect(),
        )
    }

    fn post_commands(&self, frames: &[Frame], message: impl FnOnce(CanvasId, Vec<ImageSource>) -> bool) {
        let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.get() else {
            return;
        };
        if self.connection.poster_while_compositor_is_reachable().is_none() {
            return;
        }
        let Some(image_sources) = self.image_sources_of(frames) else {
            return;
        };
        if !message(canvas_id, image_sources) {
            return;
        }
        for frame in frames {
            if let Frame::Video(video_frame) = frame {
                video_frame.hold.note_sent_to_compositor();
            }
        }
    }

    fn post_or_lose_compositor<M: libipc_rust::wire::EndpointMessage>(&self, message: M) -> bool {
        match self.connection.poster_while_compositor_is_reachable() {
            Some(poster) => self.connection.post_or_lose_compositor(&poster, message),
            None => false,
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for RemoteContext {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: The value owns a reference to the connection.
        unsafe { self.connection.release() };
    }
}

impl Transport for RemoteContext {
    type SharedMemory = SharedBuffer;
    type Frame = Frame;
    type DrawingBufferPixels = ImageFrameHandle;

    fn create_shared_memory(&self, size: usize) -> Option<SharedBuffer> {
        SharedBuffer::create(size)
    }

    fn canvas_id(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        self.canvas_id.get().map(|canvas_id| canvas_id.0)
    }

    fn destroy_context(&self) {
        if let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.take() {
            self.connection.post(DestroyWebglContext { canvas_id });
        }
    }

    fn set_shared_command_buffer(&self, buffer: &SharedBuffer) {
        if let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.get() {
            self.post_or_lose_compositor(WebglSetCommandBuffer {
                canvas_id,
                command_buffer: buffer.for_message(),
            });
        }
    }

    fn send_commands_from_shared_buffer(
        &self,
        offset: u64,
        size_in_bytes: u64,
        flush_sequence_number: u64,
        frames: &[Frame],
    ) {
        self.post_commands(frames, |canvas_id, image_sources| {
            self.post_or_lose_compositor(WebglCommandsFromSharedBuffer {
                canvas_id,
                offset,
                size_in_bytes,
                flush_sequence_number,
                image_sources,
            })
        });
    }

    fn wait_until_published_commands_executed(&self) -> bool {
        let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.get() else {
            return false;
        };
        self.connection
            .send_sync(WebglDrainCommandBuffer { canvas_id })
            .is_some()
    }

    fn send_commands(&self, commands: &[u8], frames: &[Frame]) {
        let Some(buffer) = SharedBuffer::create(commands.len()) else {
            return;
        };
        // SAFETY: The buffer has room for the commands, and nothing else writes it yet.
        unsafe { core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(commands.as_ptr(), buffer.as_ptr(), commands.len()) };
        self.send_commands_written_to(&buffer, commands.len(), frames);
    }

    fn send_commands_written_to(&self, memory: &SharedBuffer, size_in_bytes: usize, frames: &[Frame]) {
        self.post_commands(frames, |canvas_id, image_sources| {
            self.post_or_lose_compositor(WebglCommands {
                canvas_id,
                commands: memory.for_message(),
                size_in_bytes: size_in_bytes as u64,
                image_sources,
            })
        });
    }

    fn present_canvas(&self, preserve_drawing_buffer: bool) {
        if let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.get() {
            self.connection.post(WebglPresentCanvas {
                canvas_id,
                preserve_drawing_buffer,
            });
        }
    }

    fn clear_drawing_buffer(&self) {
        if let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.get() {
            self.connection.post(WebglClearDrawingBuffer { canvas_id });
        }
    }

    fn sync_call(&self, request: &[u8], reply: &mut Vec<u8>) {
        let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.get() else {
            return;
        };
        if let Some(response) = self.connection.send_sync(WebglSyncCall {
            canvas_id,
            request: request.to_vec(),
        }) {
            reply.extend_from_slice(&response.reply);
        }
    }

    fn read_pixels_robust_angle(
        &self,
        x: i32,
        y: i32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
        buf_size: i32,
        pixels: Option<&SharedBuffer>,
    ) -> ReadPixelsResult {
        let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.get() else {
            return ReadPixelsResult::default();
        };
        let pixels = pixels.map_or(
            libcompositing_rust::ipc_types::Core_AnonymousBuffer { shared_memory: None },
            SharedBuffer::for_message,
        );
        self.connection
            .send_sync(WebglReadPixels {
                canvas_id,
                x,
                y,
                width,
                height,
                format,
                r#type,
                buf_size,
                pixels,
            })
            .map_or_else(ReadPixelsResult::default, |response| ReadPixelsResult {
                length: response.length,
                columns: response.columns,
                rows: response.rows,
            })
    }

    fn read_buffer_sub_data(&self, target: u32, offset: i64, size: i64, data: &SharedBuffer) -> bool {
        let Some(canvas_id) = self.canvas_id.get() else {
            return false;
        };
        self.connection
            .send_sync(WebglReadBufferSubData {
                canvas_id,
                target,
                offset,
                size,
                data: data.for_message(),
            })
            .is_some_and(|response| response.success)
    }

    fn read_back_drawing_buffer(&self, x: i32, y: i32, width: i32, height: i32) -> Option<ImageFrameHandle> {
        let canvas_id = self.canvas_id.get()?;
        let rect = rect_inside_largest_drawing_buffer(x, y, width, height)?;
        let size = usize::try_from(rect.width)
            .ok()?
            .checked_mul(usize::try_from(rect.height).ok()?)?
            .checked_mul(4)?;
        let pixels = SharedBuffer::create(size)?;
        let response = self.connection.send_sync(WebglReadBackDrawingBuffer {
            canvas_id,
            rect,
            pixels: pixels.for_message(),
        })?;
        let IntSize { width, height } = response.size;
        if width <= 0 || height <= 0 {
            return None;
        }
        pixels.into_image_frame(width, height, AlphaType::Premultiplied, ColorSpace::Srgb)
    }
}

//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/extensions/OES_vertex_array_object/

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use super::state::VertexArrayBinding;
use super::state::{ContextRef, ContextState};
use super::web_gl_vertex_array_object_oes::WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES;
use crate::bindings::interface::Inherits;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct OESVertexArrayObject {
    context: ContextRef,
}

impl Wrappable for OESVertexArrayObject {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.context.state().canvas().relevant_realm()
    }
}

impl OESVertexArrayObject {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, context: &ContextState) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            context: context.context_ref(),
        })
    }

    fn is_bound(&self, array_object: Ref<WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES>) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self.context.state().current_vertex_array.get(),
            Some(VertexArrayBinding::Oes(bound)) if bound.as_ptr() == array_object.as_ptr()
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_vertex_array_oes(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES>> {
        let context = self.context.state();
        let mut handle = [0];
        context.proxy.gen_vertex_arrays_oes(&mut handle);
        Ok(WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES::create(cx.vm(), context, handle[0]))
    }

    pub(crate) fn delete_vertex_array_oes(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        array_object: Option<Ref<WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let context = self.context.state();
        let Some(array_object) = array_object else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        // FIXME: An object of another context is an INVALID_OPERATION error.
        let Ok(Some(handle)) = array_object.parent().handle_for_deletion(context) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        context.proxy.delete_vertex_arrays_oes(1, &[handle]);
        if self.is_bound(array_object) {
            context.current_vertex_array.set(None);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_vertex_array_oes(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        array_object: Option<Ref<WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        let context = self.context.state();
        let Some(array_object) = array_object else {
            return Ok(false);
        };
        let Ok(Some(handle)) = array_object.parent().handle_for_query(context) else {
            return Ok(false);
        };
        Ok(context.proxy.is_vertex_array_oes(handle))
    }

    pub(crate) fn bind_vertex_array_oes(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        array_object: Option<Ref<WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let context = self.context.state();
        let mut handle = 0;
        if let Some(array_object) = array_object {
            // FIXME: An object that the context cannot use is an INVALID_OPERATION error.
            let Ok(array_object_handle) = array_object.parent().handle(context) else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            handle = array_object_handle;
        }
        context.proxy.bind_vertex_array_oes(handle);
        context
            .current_vertex_array
            .set(array_object.map(VertexArrayBinding::Oes));
        Ok(())
    }
}

unsafe extern "C" {
    safe fn web_navigator_compatibility_mode() -> u8;
}

/// The navigator compatibility mode, numbered as Web::NavigatorCompatibilityMode is.
const MODE_CHROME: u8 = 0;
const MODE_GECKO: u8 = 1;
const MODE_WEBKIT: u8 = 2;

fn navigator_compatibility_mode() -> u8 {
    web_navigator_compatibility_mode()
}

/// VENDOR, RENDERER, VERSION, and SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION name the browser's WebGL implementation rather than the
/// GPU, whose own strings are only behind WEBGL_debug_renderer_info. Each engine words them its own way, so the answer
/// follows the navigator compatibility mode.
fn masked_string_parameter(context: &ContextState, cx: &CallContext, pname: u32) -> Value {
    let mode = navigator_compatibility_mode();
    let webgl2 = context.is_webgl2();
    let text: &str = match (pname, mode) {
        (GL_VENDOR, MODE_GECKO) => "Mozilla",
        (GL_VENDOR, _) => "WebKit",
        (GL_RENDERER, MODE_GECKO) => return string_value(cx, sanitized_renderer(context)),
        (GL_RENDERER, _) => "WebKit WebGL",
        (GL_VERSION, MODE_CHROME) if webgl2 => "WebGL 2.0 (OpenGL ES 3.0 Chromium)",
        (GL_VERSION, MODE_CHROME) => "WebGL 1.0 (OpenGL ES 2.0 Chromium)",
        (GL_VERSION, _) if webgl2 => "WebGL 2.0",
        (GL_VERSION, _) => "WebGL 1.0",
        (GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION, MODE_CHROME) if webgl2 => "WebGL GLSL ES 3.00 (OpenGL ES GLSL ES 3.0 Chromium)",
        (GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION, MODE_CHROME) => "WebGL GLSL ES 1.0 (OpenGL ES GLSL ES 1.0 Chromium)",
        (GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION, _) if webgl2 => "WebGL GLSL ES 3.00",
        (GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION, MODE_WEBKIT) => "WebGL GLSL ES 1.0 (1.0)",
        (GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION, _) => "WebGL GLSL ES 1.0",
        _ => return string_parameter(context, cx, pname),
    };
    string_value(cx, Utf16String::from_ascii(text.as_bytes()))
}

/// The unmasked vendor: the GPU's, except that a navigator claiming WebKit on macOS answers as that engine does there,
/// and one claiming Gecko answers with the vendor's bare name.
fn unmasked_vendor(context: &ContextState, cx: &CallContext) -> Value {
    let vendor = context.proxy.get_string(GL_VENDOR);
    let text: Option<&str> = match navigator_compatibility_mode() {
        MODE_WEBKIT if cfg!(target_os = "macos") => Some("Apple Inc."),
        MODE_GECKO => gpu_vendor_name(&vendor, &context.proxy.get_string(GL_RENDERER)),
        _ => None,
    };
    match text {
        Some(text) => string_value(cx, Utf16String::from_ascii(text.as_bytes())),
        None => string_value(cx, utf16_string_from_gl_string(&vendor)),
    }
}

/// The unmasked renderer: the GPU's, except that a navigator claiming WebKit on macOS answers as that engine does
/// there, and one claiming Gecko answers with a representative device of the GPU's family.
fn unmasked_renderer(context: &ContextState, cx: &CallContext) -> Value {
    match navigator_compatibility_mode() {
        MODE_WEBKIT if cfg!(target_os = "macos") => string_value(cx, Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Apple GPU")),
        MODE_GECKO => string_value(cx, sanitized_renderer(context)),
        _ => string_parameter(context, cx, GL_RENDERER),
    }
}

/// The GPU vendor's bare name, found in either GL string (an ANGLE renderer string names the vendor in its own
/// way), or None for a vendor without one.
fn gpu_vendor_name(vendor: &[u8], renderer: &[u8]) -> Option<&'static str> {
    let contains = |needle: &str| {
        let needle = needle.as_bytes();
        [vendor, renderer]
            .iter()
            .any(|haystack| haystack.windows(needle.len()).any(|window| window == needle))
    };
    if contains("Apple") {
        Some("Apple")
    } else if contains("NVIDIA") {
        Some("NVIDIA Corporation")
    } else if contains("Intel") {
        Some("Intel")
    } else if contains("AMD") || contains("ATI") {
        Some("AMD")
    } else if contains("Qualcomm") {
        Some("Qualcomm")
    } else if contains("ARM") {
        Some("ARM")
    } else if contains("Mesa") || contains("X.Org") {
        Some("Mesa")
    } else {
        None
    }
}

/// A Gecko-shaped renderer string: a representative device for the GPU's family, marked ", or similar". An Apple GPU
/// of any generation reads "Apple M1, or similar"; another GPU keeps its own string with the same marker.
fn sanitized_renderer(context: &ContextState) -> Utf16String {
    let renderer = context.proxy.get_string(GL_RENDERER);
    if gpu_vendor_name(&context.proxy.get_string(GL_VENDOR), &renderer) == Some("Apple") {
        return Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Apple M1, or similar");
    }
    let mut text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&renderer).into_owned();
    text.push_str(", or similar");
    Utf16String::from_utf8(&text)
}
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, wrap};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

fn is_cube_map_face(target: u32) -> bool {
    (GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_X..=GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_Z).contains(&target)
}

fn is_gl_true(integer_that_gl_returned_for_a_boolean: i32) -> bool {
    u32::try_from(integer_that_gl_returned_for_a_boolean) == Ok(GL_TRUE)
}

fn number_value(unsigned_integer_or_float: impl Into<f64>) -> Value {
    Value::from_f64(unsigned_integer_or_float.into())
}

fn null_with_invalid_enum_error(context: &ContextState) -> Value {
    context.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
    Value::NULL
}

fn integer_parameter(context: &ContextState, pname: u32) -> i32 {
    let mut result = [0];
    context.proxy.get_integerv_robust_angle(pname, 1, &mut result);
    result[0]
}

fn integer64_parameter(context: &ContextState, pname: u32) -> i64 {
    let mut result = [0];
    context.proxy.get_integer64v_robust_angle(pname, 1, &mut result);
    result[0]
}

fn float_parameter(context: &ContextState, pname: u32) -> f32 {
    let mut result = [0.0];
    context.proxy.get_floatv_robust_angle(pname, 1, &mut result);
    result[0]
}

fn boolean_parameter(context: &ContextState, pname: u32) -> bool {
    let mut result = [0];
    context.proxy.get_booleanv_robust_angle(pname, 1, &mut result);
    u32::from(result[0]) == GL_TRUE
}

fn int32_array_parameter<const LENGTH: usize>(context: &ContextState, cx: &CallContext, pname: u32) -> Value {
    let mut result = [0; LENGTH];
    context
        .proxy
        .get_integerv_robust_angle(pname, const { gl_sizei_of_array_length(LENGTH) }, &mut result);
    context.int32_array(cx, &result)
}

fn float32_array_parameter<const LENGTH: usize>(context: &ContextState, cx: &CallContext, pname: u32) -> Value {
    let mut result = [0.0; LENGTH];
    context
        .proxy
        .get_floatv_robust_angle(pname, const { gl_sizei_of_array_length(LENGTH) }, &mut result);
    context.float32_array(cx, &result)
}

fn string_parameter(context: &ContextState, cx: &CallContext, name: u32) -> Value {
    string_value(cx, utf16_string_from_gl_string(&context.proxy.get_string(name)))
}

fn integer_tex_parameter(context: &ContextState, target: u32, pname: u32) -> i32 {
    let mut result = [0];
    context
        .proxy
        .get_tex_parameteriv_robust_angle(target, pname, 1, &mut result);
    result[0]
}

fn integer_vertex_attrib(context: &ContextState, index: u32, pname: u32) -> i32 {
    let mut result = [0];
    context
        .proxy
        .get_vertex_attribiv_robust_angle(index, pname, 1, &mut result);
    result[0]
}

fn parameter_of_either_version(context: &ContextState, cx: &CallContext, pname: u32) -> Option<Value> {
    Some(match pname {
        GL_ACTIVE_TEXTURE
        | GL_ALPHA_BITS
        | GL_BLEND_DST_ALPHA
        | GL_BLEND_DST_RGB
        | GL_BLEND_EQUATION_ALPHA
        | GL_BLEND_EQUATION_RGB
        | GL_BLEND_SRC_ALPHA
        | GL_BLEND_SRC_RGB
        | GL_BLUE_BITS
        | GL_CULL_FACE_MODE
        | GL_DEPTH_BITS
        | GL_DEPTH_FUNC
        | GL_FRONT_FACE
        | GL_GENERATE_MIPMAP_HINT
        | GL_GREEN_BITS
        | GL_IMPLEMENTATION_COLOR_READ_FORMAT
        | GL_IMPLEMENTATION_COLOR_READ_TYPE
        | GL_MAX_COMBINED_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS
        | GL_MAX_CUBE_MAP_TEXTURE_SIZE
        | GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_VECTORS
        | GL_MAX_RENDERBUFFER_SIZE
        | GL_MAX_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS
        | GL_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE
        | GL_MAX_VARYING_VECTORS
        | GL_MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS
        | GL_MAX_VERTEX_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS
        | GL_MAX_VERTEX_UNIFORM_VECTORS
        | GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT
        | GL_RED_BITS
        | GL_SAMPLE_BUFFERS
        | GL_SAMPLES
        | GL_STENCIL_BACK_FAIL
        | GL_STENCIL_BACK_FUNC
        | GL_STENCIL_BACK_PASS_DEPTH_FAIL
        | GL_STENCIL_BACK_PASS_DEPTH_PASS
        | GL_STENCIL_BACK_REF
        | GL_STENCIL_BACK_VALUE_MASK
        | GL_STENCIL_BACK_WRITEMASK
        | GL_STENCIL_BITS
        | GL_STENCIL_CLEAR_VALUE
        | GL_STENCIL_FAIL
        | GL_STENCIL_FUNC
        | GL_STENCIL_PASS_DEPTH_FAIL
        | GL_STENCIL_PASS_DEPTH_PASS
        | GL_STENCIL_REF
        | GL_STENCIL_VALUE_MASK
        | GL_STENCIL_WRITEMASK
        | GL_SUBPIXEL_BITS
        | GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT => Value::from_i32(integer_parameter(context, pname)),

        GL_DEPTH_CLEAR_VALUE
        | GL_LINE_WIDTH
        | GL_POLYGON_OFFSET_FACTOR
        | GL_POLYGON_OFFSET_UNITS
        | GL_SAMPLE_COVERAGE_VALUE => number_value(float_parameter(context, pname)),

        GL_BLEND
        | GL_CULL_FACE
        | GL_DEPTH_TEST
        | GL_DEPTH_WRITEMASK
        | GL_DITHER
        | GL_POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL
        | GL_SAMPLE_ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE
        | GL_SAMPLE_COVERAGE
        | GL_SAMPLE_COVERAGE_INVERT
        | GL_SCISSOR_TEST
        | GL_STENCIL_TEST => Value::from_bool(boolean_parameter(context, pname)),

        GL_ALIASED_LINE_WIDTH_RANGE | GL_ALIASED_POINT_SIZE_RANGE | GL_DEPTH_RANGE => {
            float32_array_parameter::<2>(context, cx, pname)
        }
        GL_BLEND_COLOR | GL_COLOR_CLEAR_VALUE => float32_array_parameter::<4>(context, cx, pname),
        GL_MAX_VIEWPORT_DIMS => int32_array_parameter::<2>(context, cx, pname),
        GL_SCISSOR_BOX | GL_VIEWPORT => int32_array_parameter::<4>(context, cx, pname),
        GL_COLOR_WRITEMASK => {
            let mut result = [0; 4];
            context
                .proxy
                .get_booleanv_robust_angle(GL_COLOR_WRITEMASK, 4, &mut result);
            context.boolean_array(cx, &result.map(|is_written| is_written != 0))
        }

        GL_RENDERER | GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION | GL_VENDOR | GL_VERSION => {
            masked_string_parameter(context, cx, pname)
        }

        GL_ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.array_buffer_binding.get()),
        GL_CURRENT_PROGRAM => object_or_null(cx, context.current_program.get()),
        GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.element_array_buffer_binding.get()),
        GL_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.framebuffer_binding.get()),
        GL_RENDERBUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.renderbuffer_binding.get()),
        GL_TEXTURE_BINDING_2D => object_or_null(cx, context.texture_binding_2d.get()),
        GL_TEXTURE_BINDING_CUBE_MAP => object_or_null(cx, context.texture_binding_cube_map.get()),

        GL_UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL => {
            if context.extension_enabled("WEBGL_debug_renderer_info") {
                unmasked_vendor(context, cx)
            } else {
                null_with_invalid_enum_error(context)
            }
        }
        GL_UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL => {
            if context.extension_enabled("WEBGL_debug_renderer_info") {
                unmasked_renderer(context, cx)
            } else {
                null_with_invalid_enum_error(context)
            }
        }

        // NB: This has the same value as FRAGMENT_SHADER_DERIVATIVE_HINT_OES.
        GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER_DERIVATIVE_HINT => {
            if context.extension_enabled("OES_standard_derivatives") || context.is_webgl2() {
                Value::from_i32(integer_parameter(context, pname))
            } else {
                null_with_invalid_enum_error(context)
            }
        }
        // NB: This has the same value as MAX_COLOR_ATTACHMENTS_WEBGL.
        GL_MAX_COLOR_ATTACHMENTS => {
            if context.extension_enabled("WEBGL_draw_buffers") || context.is_webgl2() {
                Value::from_i32(integer_parameter(context, pname))
            } else {
                null_with_invalid_enum_error(context)
            }
        }
        GL_MAX_DRAW_BUFFERS => {
            // FIXME: Allow this code path for MAX_DRAW_BUFFERS_WEBGL
            if context.is_webgl2() {
                Value::from_i32(integer_parameter(context, pname))
            } else {
                null_with_invalid_enum_error(context)
            }
        }
        GL_MAX_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT => {
            if context.extension_enabled("EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic") {
                number_value(float_parameter(context, pname))
            } else {
                null_with_invalid_enum_error(context)
            }
        }
        // NB: This has the same value as VERTEX_ARRAY_BINDING_OES.
        GL_VERTEX_ARRAY_BINDING => {
            if context.extension_enabled("OES_vertex_array_object") || context.is_webgl2() {
                match context.current_vertex_array.get() {
                    Some(VertexArrayBinding::WebGL2(vertex_array)) => Value::from_object(wrap(cx, vertex_array)),
                    Some(VertexArrayBinding::Oes(vertex_array)) => Value::from_object(wrap(cx, vertex_array)),
                    None => Value::NULL,
                }
            } else {
                null_with_invalid_enum_error(context)
            }
        }

        GL_COMPRESSED_TEXTURE_FORMATS => {
            let formats = context.enabled_compressed_texture_formats.borrow().clone();
            context.uint32_array(cx, &formats)
        }
        GL_UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL => Value::from_bool(context.unpack_flip_y.get()),
        GL_UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL => Value::from_bool(context.unpack_premultiply_alpha.get()),
        GL_UNPACK_COLORSPACE_CONVERSION_WEBGL => number_value(context.unpack_colorspace_conversion.get()),

        _ => return None,
    })
}

fn parameter_of_webgl2(context: &ContextState, cx: &CallContext, pname: u32) -> Option<Value> {
    Some(match pname {
        GL_MAX_SAMPLES
        | GL_MAX_3D_TEXTURE_SIZE
        | GL_MAX_ARRAY_TEXTURE_LAYERS
        | GL_MAX_VERTEX_UNIFORM_COMPONENTS
        | GL_MAX_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDINGS
        | GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER_OFFSET_ALIGNMENT
        | GL_MAX_VERTEX_UNIFORM_BLOCKS
        | GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_INPUT_COMPONENTS
        | GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_COMPONENTS
        | GL_MAX_COMBINED_UNIFORM_BLOCKS
        | GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_BLOCKS
        | GL_MAX_VARYING_COMPONENTS
        | GL_MAX_ELEMENTS_INDICES
        | GL_MAX_ELEMENTS_VERTICES
        | GL_MAX_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_INTERLEAVED_COMPONENTS
        | GL_MAX_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_SEPARATE_ATTRIBS
        | GL_MAX_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_SEPARATE_COMPONENTS
        | GL_MIN_PROGRAM_TEXEL_OFFSET
        | GL_MAX_PROGRAM_TEXEL_OFFSET
        | GL_MAX_VERTEX_OUTPUT_COMPONENTS
        | GL_PACK_ROW_LENGTH
        | GL_PACK_SKIP_ROWS
        | GL_PACK_SKIP_PIXELS
        | GL_UNPACK_IMAGE_HEIGHT
        | GL_UNPACK_ROW_LENGTH
        | GL_UNPACK_SKIP_IMAGES
        | GL_UNPACK_SKIP_PIXELS
        | GL_UNPACK_SKIP_ROWS => Value::from_i32(integer_parameter(context, pname)),

        GL_MAX_UNIFORM_BLOCK_SIZE
        | GL_MAX_COMBINED_VERTEX_UNIFORM_COMPONENTS
        | GL_MAX_COMBINED_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_COMPONENTS
        | GL_MAX_ELEMENT_INDEX
        | GL_MAX_SERVER_WAIT_TIMEOUT => Value::from_f64(integer64_parameter(context, pname) as f64),

        GL_MAX_TEXTURE_LOD_BIAS => number_value(float_parameter(context, pname)),

        GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_ACTIVE | GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_PAUSED | GL_RASTERIZER_DISCARD => {
            Value::from_bool(boolean_parameter(context, pname))
        }

        GL_COPY_READ_BUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.copy_read_buffer_binding.get()),
        GL_COPY_WRITE_BUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.copy_write_buffer_binding.get()),
        GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.pixel_pack_buffer_binding.get()),
        GL_PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.pixel_unpack_buffer_binding.get()),
        GL_TEXTURE_BINDING_2D_ARRAY => object_or_null(cx, context.texture_binding_2d_array.get()),
        GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.transform_feedback_binding.get()),
        GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.transform_feedback_buffer_binding.get()),
        GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDING => object_or_null(cx, context.uniform_buffer_binding.get()),
        // FIXME: Return the sampler that was bound, or null without one, instead of a new object for the name that GL
        //        has bound.
        GL_SAMPLER_BINDING => {
            let handle = integer_parameter(context, pname).cast_unsigned();
            Value::from_object(wrap(cx, WebGLSampler::create(cx.vm(), context, handle)))
        }

        // A page must never be able to block the compositor, so clientWaitSync never waits; the host clamps the
        // timeout to zero to match.
        GL_MAX_CLIENT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_WEBGL => Value::from_i32(0),

        _ => return None,
    })
}

impl<V: Version> RenderingContext<V> {
    pub(crate) fn get_buffer_parameter(&self, _: &mut CallContext, target: u32, pname: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        match pname {
            GL_BUFFER_SIZE | GL_BUFFER_USAGE => {
                let mut result = [0];
                self.proxy
                    .get_buffer_parameteriv_robust_angle(target, pname, 1, &mut result);
                Ok(Value::from_i32(result[0]))
            }
            _ => Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self)),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_parameter(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, pname: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        if let Some(value) = parameter_of_either_version(self, cx, pname) {
            return Ok(value);
        }
        if self.is_webgl2()
            && let Some(value) = parameter_of_webgl2(self, cx, pname)
        {
            return Ok(value);
        }
        Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_framebuffer_attachment_parameter(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        attachment: u32,
        pname: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        if !is_valid_framebuffer_binding_target(self.version(), target) {
            return Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self));
        }

        let Some(framebuffer) = self.framebuffer_binding.get() else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        };

        if !is_valid_framebuffer_attachment(self.version(), self.extension_enabled("WEBGL_draw_buffers"), attachment) {
            return Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self));
        }

        let Some(framebuffer_attachment) = framebuffer.attachment(attachment) else {
            if pname == GL_FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_OBJECT_TYPE {
                return Ok(number_value(GL_NONE));
            }
            if pname == GL_FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_OBJECT_NAME && self.is_webgl2() {
                return Ok(Value::NULL);
            }
            self.set_error(if self.is_webgl2() {
                GL_INVALID_OPERATION
            } else {
                GL_INVALID_ENUM
            });
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        };

        let is_texture_attached = framebuffer_attachment.texture.is_some();
        match pname {
            GL_FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_OBJECT_TYPE => Ok(number_value(if is_texture_attached {
                GL_TEXTURE
            } else {
                GL_RENDERBUFFER
            })),
            GL_FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_OBJECT_NAME => match framebuffer_attachment.texture {
                Some(texture) => Ok(Value::from_object(wrap(cx, texture))),
                None => Ok(object_or_null(cx, framebuffer_attachment.renderbuffer)),
            },
            GL_FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_TEXTURE_LEVEL if is_texture_attached => {
                Ok(Value::from_i32(framebuffer_attachment.texture_level))
            }
            GL_FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_FACE if is_texture_attached => {
                let texture_target = framebuffer_attachment.texture_target;
                Ok(number_value(if is_cube_map_face(texture_target) {
                    texture_target
                } else {
                    0
                }))
            }
            _ => Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self)),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_program_parameter(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
        pname: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        let Some(program_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        };

        let mut result = [0];
        self.proxy
            .get_programiv_robust_angle(program_handle, pname, 1, &mut result);
        let result = result[0];
        match pname {
            GL_ATTACHED_SHADERS | GL_ACTIVE_ATTRIBUTES | GL_ACTIVE_UNIFORMS => Ok(Value::from_i32(result)),

            GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_MODE | GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_VARYINGS | GL_ACTIVE_UNIFORM_BLOCKS => {
                if self.is_webgl2() {
                    Ok(Value::from_i32(result))
                } else {
                    Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self))
                }
            }

            GL_DELETE_STATUS | GL_LINK_STATUS | GL_VALIDATE_STATUS => Ok(Value::from_bool(is_gl_true(result))),
            _ => Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self)),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_renderbuffer_parameter(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        pname: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        match pname {
            GL_RENDERBUFFER_WIDTH
            | GL_RENDERBUFFER_HEIGHT
            | GL_RENDERBUFFER_INTERNAL_FORMAT
            | GL_RENDERBUFFER_RED_SIZE
            | GL_RENDERBUFFER_GREEN_SIZE
            | GL_RENDERBUFFER_BLUE_SIZE
            | GL_RENDERBUFFER_ALPHA_SIZE
            | GL_RENDERBUFFER_DEPTH_SIZE
            | GL_RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES
            | GL_RENDERBUFFER_STENCIL_SIZE => {
                let mut result = [0];
                self.proxy
                    .get_renderbuffer_parameteriv_robust_angle(target, pname, 1, &mut result);
                Ok(Value::from_i32(result[0]))
            }
            // If pname is not in the table above, generates an INVALID_ENUM error.
            _ => Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self)),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_shader_parameter(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        shader: Ref<WebGLShader>,
        pname: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        let Some(shader_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(shader) else {
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        };

        let mut result = [0];
        self.proxy
            .get_shaderiv_robust_angle(shader_handle, pname, 1, &mut result);
        let result = result[0];
        match pname {
            GL_SHADER_TYPE => Ok(Value::from_i32(result)),
            GL_DELETE_STATUS | GL_COMPILE_STATUS => Ok(Value::from_bool(is_gl_true(result))),
            _ => Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self)),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_tex_parameter(&self, _: &mut CallContext, target: u32, pname: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        match pname {
            GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER | GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER | GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S | GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T => {
                return Ok(Value::from_i32(integer_tex_parameter(self, target, pname)));
            }
            GL_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT => {
                if self.extension_enabled("EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic") {
                    return Ok(Value::from_i32(integer_tex_parameter(self, target, pname)));
                }
                return Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self));
            }
            _ => {}
        }

        if self.is_webgl2() {
            match pname {
                GL_TEXTURE_BASE_LEVEL
                | GL_TEXTURE_COMPARE_FUNC
                | GL_TEXTURE_COMPARE_MODE
                | GL_TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_LEVELS
                | GL_TEXTURE_MAX_LEVEL
                | GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_R => {
                    return Ok(Value::from_i32(integer_tex_parameter(self, target, pname)));
                }
                GL_TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_FORMAT => {
                    return Ok(Value::from_bool(is_gl_true(integer_tex_parameter(self, target, pname))));
                }
                // FIXME: Return the level of detail, instead of whether TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_FORMAT is set.
                GL_TEXTURE_MAX_LOD | GL_TEXTURE_MIN_LOD => {
                    let mut result = [0.0];
                    self.proxy
                        .get_tex_parameterfv_robust_angle(target, GL_TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_FORMAT, 1, &mut result);
                    return Ok(Value::from_bool(result[0] == 1.0));
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }

        Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self))
    }

    /// https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#5.14.10
    /// "Return the uniform value at the passed location in the passed program. The type returned is dictated by the
    ///  uniform type."
    pub(crate) fn get_uniform(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
        location: Ref<WebGLUniformLocation>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        let Some(program_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        };
        let Some(location) = location.handle_in(program) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        };
        let mut link_status = [0];
        self.proxy
            .get_programiv(program_handle, GL_LINK_STATUS, &mut link_status);
        if !is_gl_true(link_status[0]) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        }
        let Some(uniform_type) = type_of_uniform_at(self, program_handle, location) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        };
        let Some((kind, count)) = components_of_uniform_type(uniform_type) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(Value::NULL);
        };

        // NB: GL takes the size of the buffer for a uniform's value in bytes, and a matrix has at most 16 numbers.
        let gl_byte_size = i32::try_from(count * 4).expect("a uniform has at most 16 numbers");
        Ok(match kind {
            UniformComponents::Float => {
                let mut numbers = [0.0f32; 16];
                self.proxy
                    .get_uniformfv_robust_angle(program_handle, location, gl_byte_size, &mut numbers[..count]);
                if count == 1 {
                    Value::from_f64(f64::from(numbers[0]))
                } else {
                    self.float32_array(cx, &numbers[..count])
                }
            }
            UniformComponents::Int => {
                let mut numbers = [0i32; 4];
                self.proxy
                    .get_uniformiv_robust_angle(program_handle, location, gl_byte_size, &mut numbers[..count]);
                if count == 1 {
                    Value::from_i32(numbers[0])
                } else {
                    self.int32_array(cx, &numbers[..count])
                }
            }
            UniformComponents::UnsignedInt => {
                let mut numbers = [0u32; 4];
                self.proxy
                    .get_uniformuiv_robust_angle(program_handle, location, gl_byte_size, &mut numbers[..count]);
                if count == 1 {
                    Value::from_f64(f64::from(numbers[0]))
                } else {
                    self.uint32_array(cx, &numbers[..count])
                }
            }
            UniformComponents::Bool => {
                let mut numbers = [0i32; 4];
                self.proxy
                    .get_uniformiv_robust_angle(program_handle, location, gl_byte_size, &mut numbers[..count]);
                if count == 1 {
                    Value::from_bool(numbers[0] != 0)
                } else {
                    let booleans: Vec<bool> = numbers[..count].iter().map(|&number| number != 0).collect();
                    self.boolean_array(cx, &booleans)
                }
            }
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_vertex_attrib(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, index: u32, pname: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        match pname {
            GL_CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB => Ok(match self.current_vertex_attrib_value_type(index) {
                VertexAttribValueType::Float => {
                    let mut result = [0.0; 4];
                    self.proxy
                        .get_vertex_attribfv_robust_angle(index, GL_CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB, 4, &mut result);
                    self.float32_array(cx, &result)
                }
                VertexAttribValueType::Int => {
                    let mut result = [0; 4];
                    self.proxy
                        .get_vertex_attrib_iiv_robust_angle(index, GL_CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB, 4, &mut result);
                    self.int32_array(cx, &result)
                }
                VertexAttribValueType::UnsignedInt => {
                    let mut result = [0; 4];
                    self.proxy
                        .get_vertex_attrib_iuiv_robust_angle(index, GL_CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB, 4, &mut result);
                    self.uint32_array(cx, &result)
                }
            }),
            // FIXME: Return the buffer that was bound, or null without one, instead of a new object for the name that
            //        GL has bound.
            GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING => {
                let handle = integer_vertex_attrib(self, index, pname).cast_unsigned();
                Ok(Value::from_object(wrap(cx, WebGLBuffer::create(cx.vm(), self, handle))))
            }
            // NB: This has the same value as VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_DIVISOR_ANGLE.
            GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_DIVISOR => {
                if self.extension_enabled("ANGLE_instanced_arrays") || self.is_webgl2() {
                    Ok(Value::from_i32(integer_vertex_attrib(self, index, pname)))
                } else {
                    Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self))
                }
            }
            GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_ENABLED | GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_NORMALIZED => {
                Ok(Value::from_bool(is_gl_true(integer_vertex_attrib(self, index, pname))))
            }
            GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_INTEGER => {
                if self.is_webgl2() {
                    Ok(Value::from_bool(is_gl_true(integer_vertex_attrib(self, index, pname))))
                } else {
                    Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self))
                }
            }
            GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_SIZE | GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_STRIDE | GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_TYPE => {
                Ok(Value::from_i32(integer_vertex_attrib(self, index, pname)))
            }
            _ => Ok(null_with_invalid_enum_error(self)),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum UniformComponents {
    Float,
    Int,
    UnsignedInt,
    Bool,
}

/// What a uniform of the type holds, and how many: A sampler holds the int of its texture unit.
#[allow(
    non_upper_case_globals,
    reason = "the matrix constants keep the names the spec gives them"
)]
fn components_of_uniform_type(uniform_type: u32) -> Option<(UniformComponents, usize)> {
    use UniformComponents::{Bool, Float, Int, UnsignedInt};
    Some(match uniform_type {
        GL_FLOAT => (Float, 1),
        GL_FLOAT_VEC2 => (Float, 2),
        GL_FLOAT_VEC3 => (Float, 3),
        GL_FLOAT_VEC4 => (Float, 4),
        GL_FLOAT_MAT2 => (Float, 4),
        GL_FLOAT_MAT3 => (Float, 9),
        GL_FLOAT_MAT4 => (Float, 16),
        GL_FLOAT_MAT2x3 | GL_FLOAT_MAT3x2 => (Float, 6),
        GL_FLOAT_MAT2x4 | GL_FLOAT_MAT4x2 => (Float, 8),
        GL_FLOAT_MAT3x4 | GL_FLOAT_MAT4x3 => (Float, 12),
        GL_INT => (Int, 1),
        GL_INT_VEC2 => (Int, 2),
        GL_INT_VEC3 => (Int, 3),
        GL_INT_VEC4 => (Int, 4),
        GL_UNSIGNED_INT => (UnsignedInt, 1),
        GL_UNSIGNED_INT_VEC2 => (UnsignedInt, 2),
        GL_UNSIGNED_INT_VEC3 => (UnsignedInt, 3),
        GL_UNSIGNED_INT_VEC4 => (UnsignedInt, 4),
        GL_BOOL => (Bool, 1),
        GL_BOOL_VEC2 => (Bool, 2),
        GL_BOOL_VEC3 => (Bool, 3),
        GL_BOOL_VEC4 => (Bool, 4),
        GL_SAMPLER_2D
        | GL_SAMPLER_CUBE
        | GL_SAMPLER_3D
        | GL_SAMPLER_2D_SHADOW
        | GL_SAMPLER_2D_ARRAY
        | GL_SAMPLER_2D_ARRAY_SHADOW
        | GL_SAMPLER_CUBE_SHADOW
        | GL_INT_SAMPLER_2D
        | GL_INT_SAMPLER_3D
        | GL_INT_SAMPLER_CUBE
        | GL_INT_SAMPLER_2D_ARRAY
        | GL_UNSIGNED_INT_SAMPLER_2D
        | GL_UNSIGNED_INT_SAMPLER_3D
        | GL_UNSIGNED_INT_SAMPLER_CUBE
        | GL_UNSIGNED_INT_SAMPLER_2D_ARRAY => (Int, 1),
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// The type of the active uniform that has `location` in the program, or of the element of an array uniform that has
/// it. A location names no uniform itself, so this asks for the location of each element of each active uniform.
fn type_of_uniform_at(context: &ContextState, program: u32, location: i32) -> Option<u32> {
    let mut active_uniforms = [0];
    context
        .proxy
        .get_programiv(program, GL_ACTIVE_UNIFORMS, &mut active_uniforms);
    let mut name = active_name_buffer(context, program, GL_ACTIVE_UNIFORM_MAX_LENGTH);
    for index in 0..u32::try_from(active_uniforms[0]).unwrap_or(0) {
        let outputs = context
            .proxy
            .get_active_uniform(program, index, gl_size_of_buffer(&name), &mut name);
        let length = usize::try_from(outputs.length).unwrap_or(0).min(name.len());
        let name = &name[..length];
        // NB: An array uniform's name ends in "[0]", and each of its elements has a location of its own.
        let base_name = name.strip_suffix(b"[0]").unwrap_or(name);
        for element in 0..outputs.size.max(1) {
            let element_name = if element == 0 {
                name.to_vec()
            } else {
                [base_name, format!("[{element}]").as_bytes()].concat()
            };
            if context.proxy.get_uniform_location(program, &element_name) == location {
                return Some(outputs.r#type);
            }
        }
    }
    None
}
