//! The recorder against a transport that plays the replayer: it logs what it is called with, and reads the region of
//! records the way the replayer does when a range of it is published.

use core::cell::{Cell, RefCell, UnsafeCell};
use core::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::rc::{Rc, Weak};

use super::custom::FrameUpload;
use super::generated::GetActiveAttribOutputs;
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET;
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::vocabulary::{CommandType, SyncCallType, commands, sync_calls};
use libcompositing_rust::webgl::wire::{Command, DataSpan, HEADER_SIZE, WireStruct};

use super::recorder::{MAX_PENDING_COMMAND_BYTES, MAX_PENDING_FRAMES, Proxy, bytes_of};
use super::transport::{ReadPixelsResult, SharedMemory, Transport};
use crate::web_gl::constants::{GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, GL_INVALID_ENUM, GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE};

#[derive(Clone)]
struct MockMemory {
    words: Rc<[UnsafeCell<u64>]>,
    size: usize,
}

impl MockMemory {
    fn new(size: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            words: (0..size.div_ceil(8)).map(|_| UnsafeCell::new(0)).collect(),
            size,
        }
    }

    fn bytes(&self, offset: usize, size: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
        assert!(offset + size <= self.size);
        // SAFETY: The range is inside the memory, which nothing else reads or writes while the test runs this.
        unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(self.as_ptr().add(offset), size) }.to_vec()
    }

    fn fill(&self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        // SAFETY: As above.
        unsafe { core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(bytes.as_ptr(), self.as_ptr(), bytes.len().min(self.size)) };
    }
}

impl SharedMemory for MockMemory {
    fn as_ptr(&self) -> *mut u8 {
        UnsafeCell::raw_get(self.words.as_ptr()).cast::<u8>()
    }

    fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.size
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
struct Record {
    command_type: u16,
    payload: Vec<u8>,
}

fn records_in(mut bytes: &[u8]) -> Vec<Record> {
    let mut records = Vec::new();
    while !bytes.is_empty() {
        let command_type = u16::from_ne_bytes([bytes[0], bytes[1]]);
        let payload_size = u32::from_ne_bytes([bytes[4], bytes[5], bytes[6], bytes[7]]) as usize;
        let (record, rest) = bytes[HEADER_SIZE..].split_at(payload_size);
        records.push(Record {
            command_type,
            payload: record.to_vec(),
        });
        bytes = rest;
    }
    records
}

fn record_of<C: Command>(command: &C) -> Record {
    let mut payload = command.as_bytes().to_vec();
    payload.resize((HEADER_SIZE + payload.len()).next_multiple_of(16) - HEADER_SIZE, 0);
    Record {
        command_type: C::TYPE as u16,
        payload,
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
enum Call {
    DestroyContext,
    SetSharedCommandBuffer {
        size: usize,
    },
    SendFromSharedBuffer {
        offset: u64,
        records: Vec<Record>,
        flush_sequence_number: u64,
        frames: Vec<u32>,
    },
    WaitUntilPublishedCommandsExecuted,
    SendCommands {
        records: Vec<Record>,
        frames: Vec<u32>,
    },
    SendCommandsWrittenToSharedMemory {
        records: Vec<Record>,
        frames: Vec<u32>,
    },
    PresentCanvas {
        preserve_drawing_buffer: bool,
    },
    ClearDrawingBuffer,
    Synchronous {
        request: Vec<u8>,
    },
    ReadPixels {
        buf_size: i32,
        has_pixels: bool,
    },
    ReadBufferSubData {
        target: u32,
        offset: i64,
        size: i64,
    },
    ReadBackDrawingBuffer,
}

struct MockReplayer {
    calls: RefCell<Vec<Call>>,
    shared_command_buffer: RefCell<Option<MockMemory>>,
    last_published_flush_sequence_number: Cell<u64>,
    refuses_shared_memory: Cell<bool>,
    executes_at_once: Cell<bool>,
    wait_succeeds: Cell<bool>,
    sync_replies: RefCell<VecDeque<Vec<u8>>>,
    read_data: RefCell<Vec<u8>>,
    read_pixels_result: Cell<ReadPixelsResult>,
    read_buffer_sub_data_succeeds: Cell<bool>,
    calls_are_forbidden: Cell<bool>,
    recorder_to_lose: RefCell<Weak<Proxy<MockTransport>>>,
}

impl MockReplayer {
    fn new() -> Rc<Self> {
        Rc::new(Self {
            calls: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            shared_command_buffer: RefCell::new(None),
            last_published_flush_sequence_number: Cell::new(0),
            refuses_shared_memory: Cell::new(false),
            executes_at_once: Cell::new(true),
            wait_succeeds: Cell::new(true),
            sync_replies: RefCell::new(VecDeque::new()),
            read_data: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            read_pixels_result: Cell::new(ReadPixelsResult::default()),
            read_buffer_sub_data_succeeds: Cell::new(true),
            calls_are_forbidden: Cell::new(false),
            recorder_to_lose: RefCell::new(Weak::new()),
        })
    }

    fn recorder(self: &Rc<Self>, shared_data_capacity: usize) -> Proxy<MockTransport> {
        Proxy::with_shared_data_capacity(
            MockTransport {
                replayer: Rc::clone(self),
            },
            shared_data_capacity,
        )
    }

    fn called(&self, call: Call) {
        assert!(
            !self.calls_are_forbidden.get(),
            "{call:?} while the calls of the transport are deferred"
        );
        self.calls.borrow_mut().push(call);
        // NB: This is the host finding the replayer gone in the middle of a call.
        let recorder_to_lose = self.recorder_to_lose.borrow().upgrade();
        if let Some(recorder) = recorder_to_lose {
            recorder.set_lost();
        }
    }

    fn take_calls(&self) -> Vec<Call> {
        self.calls.take()
    }

    /// The calls are allowed again even when the function panics, as the recorder calls the transport when it is
    /// dropped.
    fn forbidding_calls<R>(&self, function: impl FnOnce() -> R) -> R {
        struct CallsAreAllowedAgain<'a>(&'a Cell<bool>);
        impl Drop for CallsAreAllowedAgain<'_> {
            fn drop(&mut self) {
                self.0.set(false);
            }
        }

        self.calls_are_forbidden.set(true);
        let _calls_are_allowed_again = CallsAreAllowedAgain(&self.calls_are_forbidden);
        function()
    }

    fn bytes_of_region(&self, offset: usize, size: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
        let shared_command_buffer = self.shared_command_buffer.borrow();
        shared_command_buffer
            .as_ref()
            .expect("a shared command buffer")
            .bytes(SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET + offset, size)
    }

    fn store_executed_flush_sequence_number(&self, flush_sequence_number: u64) {
        let shared_command_buffer = self.shared_command_buffer.borrow();
        let start = shared_command_buffer
            .as_ref()
            .expect("a shared command buffer")
            .as_ptr();
        // SAFETY: The memory is larger than a u64 and aligned for one.
        unsafe { &*start.cast::<AtomicU64>() }.store(flush_sequence_number, Ordering::Release);
    }

    fn queue_reply<R: WireStruct>(&self, reply: &R, inline_data: &[u8]) {
        let mut bytes = reply.as_bytes().to_vec();
        if !inline_data.is_empty() {
            bytes.resize(bytes.len().next_multiple_of(16), 0);
            bytes.extend_from_slice(inline_data);
        }
        bytes.resize(bytes.len().next_multiple_of(16), 0);
        self.sync_replies.borrow_mut().push_back(bytes);
    }
}

struct MockTransport {
    replayer: Rc<MockReplayer>,
}

impl Transport for MockTransport {
    type SharedMemory = MockMemory;
    type Frame = u32;
    type DrawingBufferPixels = (i32, i32, i32, i32);

    fn create_shared_memory(&self, size: usize) -> Option<MockMemory> {
        (!self.replayer.refuses_shared_memory.get()).then(|| MockMemory::new(size))
    }

    fn canvas_id(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        Some(42)
    }

    fn destroy_context(&self) {
        self.replayer.called(Call::DestroyContext);
    }

    fn set_shared_command_buffer(&self, buffer: &MockMemory) {
        self.replayer.shared_command_buffer.replace(Some(buffer.clone()));
        self.replayer.last_published_flush_sequence_number.set(0);
        self.replayer
            .called(Call::SetSharedCommandBuffer { size: buffer.len() });
    }

    fn send_commands_from_shared_buffer(
        &self,
        offset: u64,
        size_in_bytes: u64,
        flush_sequence_number: u64,
        frames: &[u32],
    ) {
        let published = {
            let shared_command_buffer = self.replayer.shared_command_buffer.borrow();
            let shared_command_buffer = shared_command_buffer.as_ref().expect("a shared command buffer");
            shared_command_buffer.bytes(SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET + offset as usize, size_in_bytes as usize)
        };
        self.replayer
            .last_published_flush_sequence_number
            .set(flush_sequence_number);
        if self.replayer.executes_at_once.get() {
            self.replayer
                .store_executed_flush_sequence_number(flush_sequence_number);
        }
        self.replayer.called(Call::SendFromSharedBuffer {
            offset,
            records: records_in(&published),
            flush_sequence_number,
            frames: frames.to_vec(),
        });
    }

    fn wait_until_published_commands_executed(&self) -> bool {
        let wait_succeeds = self.replayer.wait_succeeds.get();
        if wait_succeeds {
            let last_published = self.replayer.last_published_flush_sequence_number.get();
            self.replayer.store_executed_flush_sequence_number(last_published);
        }
        self.replayer.called(Call::WaitUntilPublishedCommandsExecuted);
        wait_succeeds
    }

    fn send_commands(&self, commands: &[u8], frames: &[u32]) {
        self.replayer.called(Call::SendCommands {
            records: records_in(commands),
            frames: frames.to_vec(),
        });
    }

    fn send_commands_written_to(&self, memory: &MockMemory, size_in_bytes: usize, frames: &[u32]) {
        self.replayer.called(Call::SendCommandsWrittenToSharedMemory {
            records: records_in(&memory.bytes(0, size_in_bytes)),
            frames: frames.to_vec(),
        });
    }

    fn present_canvas(&self, preserve_drawing_buffer: bool) {
        self.replayer.called(Call::PresentCanvas {
            preserve_drawing_buffer,
        });
    }

    fn clear_drawing_buffer(&self) {
        self.replayer.called(Call::ClearDrawingBuffer);
    }

    fn sync_call(&self, request: &[u8], reply: &mut Vec<u8>) {
        if let Some(queued_reply) = self.replayer.sync_replies.borrow_mut().pop_front() {
            reply.extend_from_slice(&queued_reply);
        }
        self.replayer.called(Call::Synchronous {
            request: request.to_vec(),
        });
    }

    fn read_pixels_robust_angle(
        &self,
        _x: i32,
        _y: i32,
        _width: i32,
        _height: i32,
        _format: u32,
        _type: u32,
        buf_size: i32,
        pixels: Option<&MockMemory>,
    ) -> ReadPixelsResult {
        if let Some(pixels) = pixels {
            pixels.fill(&self.replayer.read_data.borrow());
        }
        self.replayer.called(Call::ReadPixels {
            buf_size,
            has_pixels: pixels.is_some(),
        });
        self.replayer.read_pixels_result.get()
    }

    fn read_buffer_sub_data(&self, target: u32, offset: i64, size: i64, data: &MockMemory) -> bool {
        data.fill(&self.replayer.read_data.borrow());
        self.replayer.called(Call::ReadBufferSubData { target, offset, size });
        self.replayer.read_buffer_sub_data_succeeds.get()
    }

    fn read_back_drawing_buffer(&self, x: i32, y: i32, width: i32, height: i32) -> Option<(i32, i32, i32, i32)> {
        self.replayer.called(Call::ReadBackDrawingBuffer);
        Some((x, y, width, height))
    }
}

const SMALL_CAPACITY: usize = 4096;
const VIEWPORT: commands::Viewport = commands::Viewport {
    x: 1,
    y: 2,
    width: 3,
    height: 4,
};
const VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE: usize = 32;

fn record_viewport(recorder: &Proxy<MockTransport>) {
    recorder.viewport(VIEWPORT.x, VIEWPORT.y, VIEWPORT.width, VIEWPORT.height);
}

fn sent_from_shared_buffer(offset: u64, records: Vec<Record>, flush_sequence_number: u64) -> Call {
    Call::SendFromSharedBuffer {
        offset,
        records,
        flush_sequence_number,
        frames: Vec::new(),
    }
}

const BUFFER_SUB_DATA_STRUCT_SIZE: usize = 32;

fn buffer_sub_data_record_size(data: &[u8]) -> usize {
    (HEADER_SIZE + BUFFER_SUB_DATA_STRUCT_SIZE + data.len()).next_multiple_of(16)
}

/// `data` is not empty.
fn buffer_sub_data_record(data: &[u8]) -> Record {
    let command = commands::BufferSubData {
        target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
        size: data.len() as i64,
        data: DataSpan {
            offset: BUFFER_SUB_DATA_STRUCT_SIZE as u32,
            size: data.len() as u32,
        },
        ..commands::BufferSubData::ZEROED
    };
    let mut payload = command.as_bytes().to_vec();
    payload.extend_from_slice(data);
    payload.resize(buffer_sub_data_record_size(data) - HEADER_SIZE, 0);
    Record {
        command_type: CommandType::BufferSubData as u16,
        payload,
    }
}

fn record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(
    replayer: &MockReplayer,
    recorder: &Proxy<MockTransport>,
    data_size_hint: usize,
    data: &[u8],
    check_while_data_is_borrowed: impl FnOnce(),
) {
    recorder.record_with_borrowed_data(data_size_hint, || {
        replayer.forbidding_calls(|| recorder.buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, data.len() as i64, data));
        check_while_data_is_borrowed();
    });
}

fn frame_upload() -> FrameUpload {
    FrameUpload {
        destination_size: None,
        flip_y: false,
        premultiply_alpha: false,
    }
}

fn upload_frame(recorder: &Proxy<MockTransport>, frame: u32) {
    recorder.tex_image2d_from_bitmap(1, 0, 3, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, frame, frame_upload());
}

fn frame_record(bitmap_index: u32) -> Record {
    record_of(&commands::TexImage2DFromBitmap {
        target: 1,
        internalformat: 3,
        format: GL_RGBA,
        r#type: GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
        bitmap_index,
        ..commands::TexImage2DFromBitmap::ZEROED
    })
}

#[test]
fn a_command_waits_in_the_shared_buffer_for_a_flush() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [Call::SetSharedCommandBuffer {
            size: SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET + SMALL_CAPACITY
        }]
    );

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    recorder.enable(7);
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);

    recorder.flush_commands();
    let records = vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT), record_of(&commands::Enable { cap: 7 })];
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), [sent_from_shared_buffer(0, records, 1)]);

    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
}

#[test]
fn the_cursor_rewinds_once_everything_published_is_executed() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();

    replayer.executes_at_once.set(false);
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT)], 1),
            sent_from_shared_buffer(VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE as u64, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT)], 2),
        ]
    );

    replayer.store_executed_flush_sequence_number(2);
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT)], 3)]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_full_region_is_published_and_waited_for() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(3 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE);
    replayer.take_calls();
    replayer.executes_at_once.set(false);

    for _ in 0..3 {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);

    recorder.enable(7);
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); 3], 1),
            Call::WaitUntilPublishedCommandsExecuted
        ]
    );
    assert!(!recorder.is_lost());

    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(
            0,
            vec![record_of(&commands::Enable { cap: 7 })],
            2
        )]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_replayer_that_never_executes_what_was_published_loses_the_context() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE);
    replayer.executes_at_once.set(false);
    replayer.wait_succeeds.set(false);

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());
    replayer.take_calls();

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
}

#[test]
fn pending_commands_are_published_at_the_threshold() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(4 * MAX_PENDING_COMMAND_BYTES);
    replayer.take_calls();

    let data = vec![5u8; MAX_PENDING_COMMAND_BYTES / 2];
    recorder.buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, data.len() as i64, &data);
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
    recorder.buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, data.len() as i64, &data);
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    let [
        Call::SendFromSharedBuffer {
            offset: 0,
            records,
            flush_sequence_number: 1,
            ..
        },
    ] = calls.as_slice()
    else {
        panic!("{} calls", calls.len());
    };
    assert_eq!(records.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(records[1].command_type, CommandType::BufferSubData as u16);
    assert_eq!(records[1].payload[32..32 + data.len()], data);
}

#[test]
fn a_record_larger_than_the_region_is_sent_on_its_own() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    let data = vec![5u8; SMALL_CAPACITY];
    recorder.buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 8, data.len() as i64, &data);
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    let [first, Call::SendCommandsWrittenToSharedMemory { records, frames }] = calls.as_slice() else {
        panic!("{} calls", calls.len());
    };
    assert_eq!(*first, sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT)], 1));
    assert!(frames.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(records.len(), 1);
    let command = commands::BufferSubData {
        target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
        offset: 8,
        size: SMALL_CAPACITY as i64,
        data: DataSpan {
            offset: 32,
            size: SMALL_CAPACITY as u32,
        },
        ..commands::BufferSubData::ZEROED
    };
    assert_eq!(records[0].payload[..32], *command.as_bytes());
    assert_eq!(records[0].payload[32..32 + data.len()], data);

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT)], 2)]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_flush_comes_before_the_frame_that_would_exceed_the_pending_frames() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY * 1024);
    replayer.take_calls();

    for frame in 0..=MAX_PENDING_FRAMES as u32 {
        upload_frame(&recorder, frame);
    }
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    let [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer { records, frames, .. }] = calls.as_slice() else {
        panic!("{} calls", calls.len());
    };
    assert_eq!(records.len(), MAX_PENDING_FRAMES);
    assert_eq!(*frames, (0..MAX_PENDING_FRAMES as u32).collect::<Vec<_>>());

    recorder.flush_commands();
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    assert!(
        matches!(calls.as_slice(), [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer { frames, .. }] if *frames == [MAX_PENDING_FRAMES as u32])
    );
}

#[test]
fn without_a_shared_buffer_commands_are_sent_as_bytes() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    replayer.refuses_shared_memory.set(true);
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    upload_frame(&recorder, 70);
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [Call::SendCommands {
            records: vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT), frame_record(0)],
            frames: vec![70]
        }]
    );
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);

    let data = vec![5u8; MAX_PENDING_COMMAND_BYTES];
    recorder.buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, data.len() as i64, &data);
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    assert!(matches!(calls.as_slice(), [Call::SendCommands { records, .. }] if records.len() == 1));
}

#[test]
fn a_frame_is_published_with_the_command_that_names_it() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();

    upload_frame(&recorder, 70);
    recorder.tex_sub_image2d_from_bitmap(
        1,
        0,
        5,
        6,
        GL_RGBA,
        GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
        90,
        FrameUpload {
            destination_size: Some((8, 9)),
            flip_y: true,
            premultiply_alpha: true,
        },
    );
    recorder.flush_commands();
    let sub_image = commands::TexSubImage2DFromBitmap {
        target: 1,
        xoffset: 5,
        yoffset: 6,
        format: GL_RGBA,
        r#type: GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
        bitmap_index: 1,
        has_explicit_destination_size: true,
        destination_width: 8,
        destination_height: 9,
        flip_y: true,
        premultiply_alpha: true,
        ..commands::TexSubImage2DFromBitmap::ZEROED
    };
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer {
            offset: 0,
            records: vec![frame_record(0), record_of(&sub_image)],
            flush_sequence_number: 1,
            frames: vec![70, 90],
        }]
    );

    upload_frame(&recorder, 80);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer {
            offset: 0,
            records: vec![frame_record(0)],
            flush_sequence_number: 2,
            frames: vec![80],
        }]
    );
}

#[test]
fn room_for_the_command_of_a_frame_is_made_before_the_frame_is_pending() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(512);
    replayer.take_calls();

    // NB: This leaves less room than is kept free for a command that names a frame, though the command would fit.
    for _ in 0..9 {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    upload_frame(&recorder, 70);
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); 9], 1)]
    );
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer {
            offset: 0,
            records: vec![frame_record(0)],
            flush_sequence_number: 2,
            frames: vec![70],
        }]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_lost_context_records_nothing_and_answers_with_zeros() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();
    recorder.set_lost();

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    upload_frame(&recorder, 70);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(recorder.get_error(), 0);
    assert!(!recorder.is_buffer(1));
    let mut name = [0xAAu8; 4];
    assert_eq!(
        recorder.get_active_attrib(1, 0, 4, &mut name),
        GetActiveAttribOutputs::default()
    );
    assert_eq!(name, [0xAA; 4]);
    assert!(recorder.get_string(1).is_empty());
    assert_eq!(recorder.get_vertex_attrib_pointerv_robust_angle(0, 1), 0);
    recorder.clear_drawing_buffer();
    assert_eq!(recorder.read_back_drawing_buffer(0, 0, 1, 1), None);
    assert!(!recorder.read_buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, 4, |_| panic!("nothing was read")));
    recorder.read_pixels_robust_angle(0, 0, 1, 1, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, 4, |_, _| {
        panic!("nothing was read")
    });
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);

    // NB: Objects are still created, so that the implementation of the context does not have to tell the cases apart.
    assert_eq!(recorder.create_program(), 1);
    assert_eq!(recorder.create_shader(2), 2);
}

#[test]
fn a_synchronous_call_publishes_what_was_recorded_before_it() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();

    replayer.queue_reply(
        &sync_calls::GetErrorReply {
            return_value: GL_INVALID_ENUM,
        },
        &[],
    );
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    assert_eq!(recorder.get_error(), GL_INVALID_ENUM);

    let mut request = Vec::new();
    request.extend_from_slice(&(SyncCallType::GetError as u16).to_ne_bytes());
    request.extend_from_slice(&[0, 0]);
    request.extend_from_slice(&16u32.to_ne_bytes());
    request.extend_from_slice(&[0; 16]);
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT)], 1),
            Call::Synchronous { request }
        ]
    );
    assert!(!recorder.is_lost());
}

#[test]
fn a_call_without_a_reply_loses_the_context() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    assert_eq!(recorder.get_error(), 0);
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());
}

#[test]
fn a_synchronous_call_returns_its_outputs_and_fills_its_buffers() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);

    let reply = sync_calls::GetActiveAttribReply {
        length: 3,
        size: 1,
        r#type: 0x8B50,
        name: DataSpan { offset: 32, size: 4 },
    };
    replayer.queue_reply(&reply, b"pos\0");
    let mut name = [0xAAu8; 8];
    let outputs = recorder.get_active_attrib(5, 0, 8, &mut name);
    assert_eq!(
        outputs,
        GetActiveAttribOutputs {
            length: 3,
            size: 1,
            r#type: 0x8B50
        }
    );
    assert_eq!(name, *b"pos\0\xAA\xAA\xAA\xAA");

    replayer.queue_reply(&sync_calls::IsBufferReply { return_value: 1 }, &[]);
    assert!(recorder.is_buffer(5));

    let reply = sync_calls::GetIntegervRobustANGLEReply {
        length: 2,
        data: DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 8 },
    };
    replayer.queue_reply(&reply, bytes_of(&[640i32, 480]));
    let mut size = [0i32; 2];
    assert_eq!(recorder.get_integerv_robust_angle(0x0D3A, 2, &mut size), 2);
    assert_eq!(size, [640, 480]);

    replayer.queue_reply(
        &sync_calls::GetUniformIndicesReply {
            uniform_indices: DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 8 },
        },
        bytes_of(&[4u32, 6]),
    );
    let mut indices = [0u32; 2];
    replayer.take_calls();
    recorder.get_uniform_indices(5, &[b"first", b"second\0ignored"], &mut indices);
    assert_eq!(indices, [4, 6]);
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    let [Call::Synchronous { request }] = calls.as_slice() else {
        panic!("{} calls", calls.len());
    };
    assert_eq!(request[HEADER_SIZE + 16..HEADER_SIZE + 29], *b"first\0second\0");
}

#[test]
fn a_string_ends_at_its_first_nul() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();

    recorder.bind_attrib_location(1, 2, b"ab\0cd");
    recorder.shader_source(3, b"void\0main");
    recorder.transform_feedback_varyings(4, &[b"a", b"bc\0d"], 5);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    let [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer { records, .. }] = calls.as_slice() else {
        panic!("{} calls", calls.len());
    };
    let bind = commands::BindAttribLocation {
        program: 1,
        index: 2,
        name: DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 3 },
    };
    assert_eq!(records[0].payload[..16], *bind.as_bytes());
    assert_eq!(records[0].payload[16..], *b"ab\0\0\0\0\0\0");
    // NB: The source of a shader is passed with its length, so a NUL does not end it.
    let source = commands::ShaderSource {
        shader: 3,
        source: DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 10 },
    };
    assert_eq!(records[1].payload[..12], *source.as_bytes());
    assert_eq!(records[1].payload[16..26], *b"void\0main\0");
    let varyings = commands::TransformFeedbackVaryings {
        program: 4,
        count: 2,
        varyings: DataSpan { offset: 32, size: 5 },
        buffer_mode: 5,
    };
    assert_eq!(records[2].payload[..20], *varyings.as_bytes());
    assert_eq!(records[2].payload[32..37], *b"a\0bc\0");
}

#[test]
fn the_replayer_is_asked_for_a_string_once() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();

    replayer.queue_reply(
        &sync_calls::GetStringReply {
            value: DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 6 },
        },
        b"ANGLE\0",
    );
    assert_eq!(*recorder.get_string(0x1F01), *b"ANGLE");
    assert_eq!(*recorder.get_string(0x1F01), *b"ANGLE");
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls().len(), 1);

    // NB: The string that a lost context answers with is not the string of the name.
    recorder.set_lost();
    assert!(recorder.get_string(0x1F00).is_empty());
    recorder.restore(MockTransport {
        replayer: Rc::clone(&replayer),
    });
    replayer.take_calls();
    replayer.queue_reply(
        &sync_calls::GetStringReply {
            value: DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 2 },
        },
        b"X\0",
    );
    assert_eq!(*recorder.get_string(0x1F01), *b"X");
}

#[test]
fn objects_get_their_ids_from_the_recorder() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();

    let mut buffers = [0u32; 3];
    recorder.gen_buffers(&mut buffers);
    assert_eq!(buffers, [1, 2, 3]);
    assert_eq!(recorder.create_shader(0x8B31), 4);
    recorder.gen_textures(&mut []);
    recorder.delete_buffers(2, &buffers);
    recorder.flush_commands();

    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    let [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer { records, .. }] = calls.as_slice() else {
        panic!("{} calls", calls.len());
    };
    assert_eq!(records.len(), 3);
    let gen_buffers = commands::GenBuffers {
        n: 3,
        buffers: DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 12 },
    };
    assert_eq!(records[0].payload[..12], *gen_buffers.as_bytes());
    assert_eq!(records[0].payload[16..28], *bytes_of(&[1u32, 2, 3]));
    assert_eq!(records[1], record_of(&commands::CreateShader { id: 4, r#type: 0x8B31 }));
    let delete_buffers = commands::DeleteBuffers {
        n: 2,
        buffers: DataSpan { offset: 16, size: 8 },
    };
    assert_eq!(records[2].payload[..12], *delete_buffers.as_bytes());
    assert_eq!(records[2].payload[16..24], *bytes_of(&[1u32, 2]));
}

#[test]
fn data_without_bytes_takes_no_room() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();

    recorder.buffer_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 16, None, 9);
    recorder.buffer_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 4, Some(&[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]), 9);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    let [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer { records, .. }] = calls.as_slice() else {
        panic!("{} calls", calls.len());
    };
    let without_data = commands::BufferData {
        target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
        size: 16,
        data: DataSpan { offset: 32, size: 0 },
        usage: 9,
        ..commands::BufferData::ZEROED
    };
    assert_eq!(records[0], record_of(&without_data));
    let with_data = commands::BufferData {
        target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
        size: 4,
        has_data: true,
        data: DataSpan { offset: 32, size: 4 },
        usage: 9,
        ..commands::BufferData::ZEROED
    };
    assert_eq!(records[1].payload[..32], *with_data.as_bytes());
    assert_eq!(records[1].payload[32..], [1, 2, 3, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0]);
}

#[test]
#[should_panic(expected = "as large as the command says")]
fn data_that_is_smaller_than_its_command_says_is_not_recorded() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();

    recorder.uniform2fv(1, 2, bytes_of(&[1.0f32, 2.0, 3.0]));
}

#[test]
fn the_transport_is_not_called_while_data_is_borrowed() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(8 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE);
    replayer.take_calls();
    let record_with_borrowed_data = |data: &[u8]| {
        recorder.record_with_borrowed_data(data.len(), || {
            replayer.forbidding_calls(|| recorder.buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, data.len() as i64, data));
        });
    };

    // Room that the record needs is made before the data is borrowed.
    for _ in 0..7 {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    record_with_borrowed_data(&[5; 16]);
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); 7], 1)]
    );
    recorder.flush_commands();
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    assert!(matches!(calls.as_slice(), [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer { offset: 0, records, .. }] if records.len() == 1));

    // A record that the region is too small for is sent after the data is given back.
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    record_with_borrowed_data(&[5; 1024]);
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    let [first, Call::SendCommandsWrittenToSharedMemory { records, .. }] = calls.as_slice() else {
        panic!("{} calls", calls.len());
    };
    assert_eq!(*first, sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT)], 3));
    assert_eq!(records[0].payload[32..32 + 1024], [5; 1024]);
}

#[test]
fn a_flush_that_is_due_while_data_is_borrowed_follows_the_record() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(4 * MAX_PENDING_COMMAND_BYTES);
    replayer.take_calls();

    let data = vec![5u8; MAX_PENDING_COMMAND_BYTES];
    recorder.record_with_borrowed_data(data.len(), || {
        replayer.forbidding_calls(|| recorder.buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, data.len() as i64, &data));
    });
    let calls = replayer.take_calls();
    assert!(matches!(calls.as_slice(), [Call::SendFromSharedBuffer { offset: 0, records, .. }] if records.len() == 1));
}

#[should_panic(expected = "one command is recorded with borrowed data")]

#[test]
fn data_of_the_expected_size_is_recorded_while_it_is_borrowed() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(8 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE);
    replayer.take_calls();
    replayer.executes_at_once.set(false);

    for _ in 0..7 {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    let data = [5u8; 16];
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, data.len(), &data, || {
        // The room that the record needs was made before the data was borrowed, and the record is in the region
        // before the data is given back.
        assert_eq!(
            replayer.take_calls(),
            [
                sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); 7], 1),
                Call::WaitUntilPublishedCommandsExecuted
            ]
        );
        let record_in_region = replayer.bytes_of_region(0, buffer_sub_data_record_size(&data));
        assert_eq!(records_in(&record_in_region), [buffer_sub_data_record(&data)]);
    });
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);

    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![buffer_sub_data_record(&data)], 2)]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_record_with_less_data_than_expected_gets_its_room_once_the_data_is_given_back() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let capacity = 8 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE;
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(capacity);
    replayer.take_calls();
    replayer.executes_at_once.set(false);

    // NB: This is an upload of the first bytes of a view that is larger than the region of records, with less room
    //     left in the region than the record takes.
    for _ in 0..7 {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    let data = [5u8; 16];
    let size_of_view = 1024 * capacity;
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, size_of_view, &data, || {
        assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
        let room_at_cursor = replayer.bytes_of_region(7 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE, VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE);
        assert_eq!(room_at_cursor, [0; VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE]);
    });
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); 7], 1),
            Call::WaitUntilPublishedCommandsExecuted
        ]
    );
    assert!(!recorder.is_lost());

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(
            0,
            vec![buffer_sub_data_record(&data), record_of(&VIEWPORT)],
            2
        )]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_record_with_more_data_than_expected_gets_its_room_once_the_data_is_given_back() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(8 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE);
    replayer.take_calls();
    replayer.executes_at_once.set(false);

    // NB: The room that is left is enough for a record with as much data as expected, so none is made before the
    //     data is borrowed.
    for _ in 0..4 {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    let data = [5u8; 100];
    assert!(buffer_sub_data_record_size(&data) > 4 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE);
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, 0, &data, || {
        assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
    });
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); 4], 1),
            Call::WaitUntilPublishedCommandsExecuted
        ]
    );

    // A record that the region is too small for is sent on its own, after what was recorded before it.
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    let data_larger_than_region = [6u8; 1024];
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, 0, &data_larger_than_region, || {
        assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
    });
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![buffer_sub_data_record(&data), record_of(&VIEWPORT)], 2),
            Call::SendCommands {
                records: vec![buffer_sub_data_record(&data_larger_than_region)],
                frames: Vec::new()
            }
        ]
    );
}

#[test]
fn the_replayer_is_waited_for_only_when_a_record_with_borrowed_data_finds_the_region_full() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let capacity = 8 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE;
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(capacity);
    replayer.take_calls();
    let data = [5u8; 16];
    let unexpected_data_size = 1024 * capacity;

    // With room where the cursor is, the record is written there while its data is borrowed, whatever was expected.
    replayer.executes_at_once.set(false);
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, unexpected_data_size, &data, || {
        let record_in_region = replayer.bytes_of_region(VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE, buffer_sub_data_record_size(&data));
        assert_eq!(records_in(&record_in_region), [buffer_sub_data_record(&data)]);
    });
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);

    // Without room, what is in the region is published, and the replayer is waited for unless it has executed it.
    for _ in 0..4 {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, unexpected_data_size, &data, || {});
    let mut published_records = vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT), buffer_sub_data_record(&data)];
    published_records.extend(vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); 4]);
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, published_records, 1),
            Call::WaitUntilPublishedCommandsExecuted
        ]
    );

    replayer.executes_at_once.set(true);
    for _ in 0..5 {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, unexpected_data_size, &data, || {});
    let mut published_records = vec![buffer_sub_data_record(&data)];
    published_records.extend(vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); 5]);
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(0, published_records, 2)]
    );

    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![buffer_sub_data_record(&data)], 3)]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_context_that_is_lost_while_room_is_made_for_a_record_with_borrowed_data_drops_the_record() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let capacity = 8 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE;
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(capacity);
    replayer.take_calls();
    replayer.executes_at_once.set(false);
    replayer.wait_succeeds.set(false);

    for _ in 0..7 {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, 1024 * capacity, &[5; 16], || {});
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); 7], 1),
            Call::WaitUntilPublishedCommandsExecuted
        ]
    );
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
}

#[test]
fn a_flush_that_is_due_for_a_record_that_got_its_room_late_is_made() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let viewport_count = 129;
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(MAX_PENDING_COMMAND_BYTES + (viewport_count - 1) * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE);
    replayer.take_calls();

    for _ in 0..viewport_count {
        record_viewport(&recorder);
    }
    let data = vec![5u8; MAX_PENDING_COMMAND_BYTES];
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, 0, &data, || {
        assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
    });
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT); viewport_count], 1),
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![buffer_sub_data_record(&data)], 2),
        ]
    );
}

#[test]
fn without_a_shared_buffer_borrowed_data_of_any_size_is_recorded_in_order() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    replayer.refuses_shared_memory.set(true);
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    let data = [5u8; 16];
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, 1024 * SMALL_CAPACITY, &data, || {});
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, 0, &data, || {});
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [Call::SendCommands {
            records: vec![
                record_of(&VIEWPORT),
                buffer_sub_data_record(&data),
                buffer_sub_data_record(&data),
                record_of(&VIEWPORT)
            ],
            frames: Vec::new()
        }]
    );

    // A flush that is due once the record is made waits for the data to be given back.
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    let data = vec![5u8; MAX_PENDING_COMMAND_BYTES];
    record_borrowed_buffer_sub_data(&replayer, &recorder, 0, &data, || {
        assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
    });
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [Call::SendCommands {
            records: vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT), buffer_sub_data_record(&data)],
            frames: Vec::new()
        }]
    );
}

#[test]
fn what_is_read_back_goes_through_memory_shared_for_the_read() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();
    replayer.read_data.replace(vec![1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]);

    record_viewport(&recorder);
    let mut read = Vec::new();
    assert!(recorder.read_buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 12, 6, |data| read.extend_from_slice(data)));
    assert_eq!(read, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![record_of(&VIEWPORT)], 1),
            Call::ReadBufferSubData {
                target: GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
                offset: 12,
                size: 6
            },
        ]
    );
    assert!(recorder.read_buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 12, 0, |_| panic!("nothing to read")));
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
    replayer.read_buffer_sub_data_succeeds.set(false);
    assert!(!recorder.read_buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 12, 6, |_| panic!("the replayer refused")));

    replayer.read_pixels_result.set(ReadPixelsResult {
        length: 4,
        columns: 1,
        rows: 1,
    });
    let mut read = Vec::new();
    recorder.read_pixels_robust_angle(0, 0, 1, 1, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, 8, |result, pixels| {
        assert_eq!(
            result,
            ReadPixelsResult {
                length: 4,
                columns: 1,
                rows: 1
            }
        );
        read.extend_from_slice(pixels);
    });
    assert_eq!(read, [1, 2, 3, 4]);
    let mut was_called = false;
    recorder.read_pixels_robust_angle(0, 0, 1, 1, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, 0, |_, pixels| {
        was_called = pixels.is_empty();
    });
    assert!(was_called);
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls().last(),
        Some(&Call::ReadPixels {
            buf_size: 0,
            has_pixels: false
        })
    );

    replayer.refuses_shared_memory.set(true);
    assert!(!recorder.read_buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 12, 6, |_| panic!("no memory to read into")));
    recorder.read_pixels_robust_angle(0, 0, 1, 1, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, 8, |_, _| panic!("no memory"));
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), []);
    assert_eq!(recorder.take_pending_local_error(), GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY);
    assert_eq!(recorder.take_pending_local_error(), 0);
}

#[test]
fn the_drawing_buffer_is_presented_after_what_was_recorded() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    replayer.take_calls();

    recorder.set_size(300, 150);
    recorder.present_canvas_for_compositing(true);
    recorder.clear_drawing_buffer();
    assert_eq!(recorder.read_back_drawing_buffer(1, 2, 3, 4), Some((1, 2, 3, 4)));
    assert_eq!(recorder.canvas_id(), Some(42));
    assert_eq!(
        replayer.take_calls(),
        [
            sent_from_shared_buffer(
                0,
                vec![record_of(&commands::SetDrawingBufferSize {
                    width: 300,
                    height: 150
                })],
                1
            ),
            Call::PresentCanvas {
                preserve_drawing_buffer: true
            },
            Call::ClearDrawingBuffer,
            Call::ReadBackDrawingBuffer,
        ]
    );

    drop(recorder);
    assert_eq!(replayer.take_calls(), [Call::DestroyContext]);
}

#[test]
fn a_call_of_the_transport_can_mark_the_context_lost() {
    let replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = Rc::new(replayer.recorder(2 * VIEWPORT_RECORD_SIZE));
    replayer.take_calls();
    let transport_loses_the_context = |loses: bool| {
        replayer
            .recorder_to_lose
            .replace(if loses { Rc::downgrade(&recorder) } else { Weak::new() });
    };
    let restore = || {
        transport_loses_the_context(false);
        recorder.restore(MockTransport {
            replayer: Rc::clone(&replayer),
        });
        assert!(!recorder.is_lost());
        replayer.take_calls();
        transport_loses_the_context(true);
    };

    // While a flush publishes.
    restore();
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());

    // While the region is drained for a record, which is then not written.
    restore();
    transport_loses_the_context(false);
    replayer.executes_at_once.set(false);
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    transport_loses_the_context(true);
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());
    replayer.executes_at_once.set(true);

    // While a call waits for its reply, which is then not read.
    restore();
    replayer.queue_reply(
        &sync_calls::GetErrorReply {
            return_value: GL_INVALID_ENUM,
        },
        &[],
    );
    assert_eq!(recorder.get_error(), 0);
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());

    // While something is read back, which is then not handed out.
    restore();
    assert!(!recorder.read_buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, 4, |_| panic!("the context is lost")));
    restore();
    recorder.read_pixels_robust_angle(0, 0, 1, 1, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, 4, |_, _| {
        panic!("the context is lost")
    });
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());

    // While a record that is too large for the region is sent, and while the canvas is presented.
    restore();
    recorder.buffer_sub_data(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, 128, &[5; 128]);
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());
    restore();
    recorder.present_canvas_for_compositing(false);
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());

    // While the new shared command buffer of a restored context is announced.
    transport_loses_the_context(true);
    recorder.restore(MockTransport {
        replayer: Rc::clone(&replayer),
    });
    assert!(recorder.is_lost());
    transport_loses_the_context(false);
}

#[test]
fn a_restored_context_starts_over_with_its_new_transport() {
    let old_replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    let recorder = old_replayer.recorder(SMALL_CAPACITY);
    assert_eq!(recorder.create_program(), 1);
    upload_frame(&recorder, 70);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    record_viewport(&recorder);
    upload_frame(&recorder, 80);
    recorder.set_lost();
    old_replayer.take_calls();

    let new_replayer = MockReplayer::new();
    recorder.restore(MockTransport {
        replayer: Rc::clone(&new_replayer),
    });
    assert!(!recorder.is_lost());
    assert_eq!(old_replayer.take_calls(), []);
    assert_eq!(
        new_replayer.take_calls(),
        [Call::SetSharedCommandBuffer {
            size: SHARED_DATA_REGION_OFFSET + SMALL_CAPACITY
        }]
    );

    // NB: What the lost context did not publish is gone, and so is the frame that it named.
    assert_eq!(recorder.create_program(), 2);
    recorder.flush_commands();
    let created_program = record_of(&commands::CreateProgram { id: 2 });
    assert_eq!(
        new_replayer.take_calls(),
        [sent_from_shared_buffer(0, vec![created_program], 1)]
    );
}

/// Zeroed when it is created.
pub(crate) trait SharedMemory {
    /// Aligned for a `u64`, and stays where it is for as long as the value lives.
    fn as_ptr(&self) -> *mut u8;
    fn len(&self) -> usize;
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub(crate) struct ReadPixelsResult {
    pub(crate) length: i32,
    pub(crate) columns: i32,
    pub(crate) rows: i32,
}

/// A call can find the replayer gone. The host then marks every context lost before the call returns, the one that
/// made the call included. That is all a call does to the recorder that made it: it neither records, nor flushes,
/// nor runs script.
pub(crate) trait Transport {
    type SharedMemory: SharedMemory;
    /// An image that a command names by its position among the frames sent with the commands.
    type Frame;
    type DrawingBufferPixels;

    fn create_shared_memory(&self, size: usize) -> Option<Self::SharedMemory>;

    fn canvas_id(&self) -> Option<u64>;
    fn destroy_context(&self);

    /// Makes the memory the shared command buffer of the context: a `u64` that the replayer stores the sequence
    /// number of the last flush that it executed in, and a region of records.
    fn set_shared_command_buffer(&self, buffer: &Self::SharedMemory);
    /// `offset` is into the region of records.
    fn send_commands_from_shared_buffer(
        &self,
        offset: u64,
        size_in_bytes: u64,
        flush_sequence_number: u64,
        frames: &[Self::Frame],
    );
    /// Returns once the replayer has executed everything published, or false if it never will.
    fn wait_until_published_commands_executed(&self) -> bool;
    fn send_commands(&self, commands: &[u8], frames: &[Self::Frame]);
    /// Sends the records that the first `size_in_bytes` bytes of memory from `create_shared_memory` hold.
    fn send_commands_written_to(&self, memory: &Self::SharedMemory, size_in_bytes: usize, frames: &[Self::Frame]);

    fn present_canvas(&self, preserve_drawing_buffer: bool);
    fn clear_drawing_buffer(&self);

    /// A call that failed appends nothing to `reply`.
    fn sync_call(&self, request: &[u8], reply: &mut Vec<u8>);
    #[expect(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the arguments of the GL function")]
    fn read_pixels_robust_angle(
        &self,
        x: i32,
        y: i32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
        buf_size: i32,
        pixels: Option<&Self::SharedMemory>,
    ) -> ReadPixelsResult;
    fn read_buffer_sub_data(&self, target: u32, offset: i64, size: i64, data: &Self::SharedMemory) -> bool;
    fn read_back_drawing_buffer(&self, x: i32, y: i32, width: i32, height: i32) -> Option<Self::DrawingBufferPixels>;
}

pub(crate) const MAX_WEBGL_DRAWING_BUFFER_DIMENSION: i32 = 16384;

/// The width or height of the drawing buffer for a canvas of this width or height.
// https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#THE_DRAWING_BUFFER
// A 0x0 canvas yields a 1x1 drawing buffer, and a canvas larger than the implementation supports yields a smaller one.
pub(crate) fn drawing_buffer_dimension(canvas_dimension: i32) -> i32 {
    canvas_dimension.clamp(1, MAX_WEBGL_DRAWING_BUFFER_DIMENSION)
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum WebGLVersion {
    WebGL1,
    WebGL2,
}

pub(crate) trait Version: Sized + 'static {}

pub(crate) struct WebGL1;
pub(crate) struct WebGL2;

impl Version for WebGL1 {}
impl Version for WebGL2 {}

/// The operations that WebGLRenderingContext and WebGL2RenderingContext share are implemented once, for every `V`.
pub(crate) struct RenderingContext<V: Version> {
    state: ContextState,
    version: PhantomData<V>,
}

impl<V: Version> RenderingContext<V> {
    pub(crate) fn new(_: &DeferGc<'_>, state: ContextState) -> Self {
        Self {
            state,
            version: PhantomData,
        }
    }
}

impl<V: Version> Deref for RenderingContext<V> {
    type Target = ContextState;

    fn deref(&self) -> &ContextState {
        &self.state
    }
}

// SAFETY: The state holds every cell that a context can reach.
unsafe impl<V: Version> Trace for RenderingContext<V> {
    fn trace(&self, visitor: &mut Visitor) {
        self.state.trace(visitor);
    }
}

impl<V: Version> Wrappable for RenderingContext<V> {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.state.canvas().relevant_realm()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum ContextRef {
    WebGL1(Ref<RenderingContext<WebGL1>>),
    WebGL2(Ref<RenderingContext<WebGL2>>),
}

impl ContextRef {
    pub(crate) fn state(&self) -> &ContextState {
        match self {
            Self::WebGL1(context) => &context.state,
            Self::WebGL2(context) => &context.state,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) enum VertexArrayBinding {
    WebGL2(Ref<WebGLVertexArrayObject>),
    Oes(Ref<WebGLVertexArrayObjectOES>),
}

pub(crate) type Binding<T> = Cell<Option<Ref<T>>>;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum VertexAttribValueType {
    Float,
    Int,
    UnsignedInt,
}

pub(crate) struct ContextParameters {
    pub(crate) proxy: Proxy<RemoteContext>,
    pub(crate) version: WebGLVersion,
    pub(crate) realm: Gc<Realm>,

impl ContextState {
    pub(crate) fn new(_: &DeferGc<'_>, parameters: ContextParameters) -> Self {
        let canvas_cell = ForeignCellSlot::empty();
        // SAFETY: The canvas is a live cell of the heap that the runtime allocates from.
        unsafe { canvas_cell.set(Some(parameters.canvas.cell)) };
        Self {
            proxy: parameters.proxy,
            version: parameters.version,
            context_ref: Cell::new(None),
            realm: parameters.realm,
            canvas_cell,
            canvas: parameters.canvas,
            context_creation_parameters: parameters.context_attributes,
            actual_context_parameters: parameters.context_attributes,
            supported_opengl_extensions: RefCell::new(parameters.supported_opengl_extensions),
            error: Cell::new(GL_NO_ERROR),
            context_lost: Cell::new(false),
            context_restore_requested: Cell::new(false),
            context_generation: Cell::new(0),
            unpack_state: Cell::new(PixelUnpackState::default()),
            unpack_flip_y: Cell::new(false),
            unpack_premultiply_alpha: Cell::new(false),
            unpack_colorspace_conversion: Cell::new(GL_BROWSER_DEFAULT_WEBGL),
            enabled_compressed_texture_formats: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            enabled_extensions: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            enabled_empty_extensions: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            array_buffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            element_array_buffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            current_program: Cell::new(None),
            framebuffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            renderbuffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            texture_binding_2d: Cell::new(None),
            texture_binding_cube_map: Cell::new(None),
            uniform_buffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            copy_read_buffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            copy_write_buffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            transform_feedback_buffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            pixel_pack_buffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            pixel_unpack_buffer_binding: Cell::new(None),
            texture_binding_2d_array: Cell::new(None),
            texture_binding_3d: Cell::new(None),
            transform_feedback_binding: Cell::new(None),
            any_samples_passed: Cell::new(None),
            any_samples_passed_conservative: Cell::new(None),
            transform_feedback_primitives_written: Cell::new(None),
            current_vertex_array: Cell::new(None),
            current_vertex_attrib_value_types: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),
            max_vertex_attribs: Cell::new(None),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_context_ref(&self, context_ref: ContextRef) {
        self.context_ref.set(Some(context_ref));
    }

    pub(crate) fn context_ref(&self) -> ContextRef {
        self.context_ref
            .get()
            .expect("a context knows its cell from its creation on")
    }

    pub(crate) fn version(&self) -> WebGLVersion {
        self.version
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_webgl2(&self) -> bool {
        self.version == WebGLVersion::WebGL2
    }

    pub(crate) fn realm(&self) -> Gc<Realm> {
        self.realm
    }

    pub(crate) fn canvas(&self) -> Canvas {
        self.canvas
    }

    pub(crate) fn context_generation(&self) -> u64 {
        self.context_generation.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_context_lost(&self) -> bool {
        self.context_lost.get()
    }

    /// Makes `error` the error of the context, unless it has one already.
    // TODO: The specification of glGetError allows for a queue of errors, which this could keep.
    pub(crate) fn set_error(&self, error: u32) {
        if self.error.get() == GL_NO_ERROR {
            self.error.set(error);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn take_error(&self) -> u32 {
        if self.context_lost.get() {
            return self.error.replace(GL_NO_ERROR);
        }
        let local_error = self.proxy.take_pending_local_error();
        if local_error != GL_NO_ERROR {
            return local_error;
        }
        let context_error = self.proxy.get_error();
        if context_error != GL_NO_ERROR {
            return context_error;
        }
        self.error.replace(GL_NO_ERROR)
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_of<O: Interface + Inherits<WebGLObject>>(&self, object: Ref<O>) -> Option<u32> {
        let handle = object.parent().handle(self).ok();
        if handle.is_none() {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
        }
        handle
    }

    /// https://registry.khronos.org/OpenGL/specs/es/3.0/es_spec_3.0.pdf#page=58
    /// "Commands that accept shader or program object names will generate the error INVALID_VALUE if the provided name
    ///  is not the name of either a shader or program object"
    /// NB: So a deleted program or shader is an INVALID_VALUE where every other deleted object is an INVALID_OPERATION.
    pub(crate) fn handle_of_program_or_shader<O: Interface + Inherits<WebGLObject>>(
        &self,
        object: Ref<O>,
    ) -> Option<u32> {
        if object.parent().was_deleted_in(self) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return None;
        }
        self.handle_of(object)
    }

    /// https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/2.0/#3.7.8
    /// The checks that vertexAttribPointer() and vertexAttribIPointer() each make of their offset.
    pub(crate) fn validate_vertex_attrib_offset(&self, offset: i64) -> bool {
        // "If offset is negative, an INVALID_VALUE error will be generated."
        if offset < 0 {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return false;
        }

        // "If no WebGLBuffer is bound to the ARRAY_BUFFER target and offset is non-zero, an INVALID_OPERATION error will
        //  be generated."
        if self.array_buffer_binding.get().is_none() && offset != 0 {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return false;
        }
        true
    }

    /// https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/2.0/#3.7.8
    /// getVertexAttrib() returns the current value of a vertex attribute as the type of the vertexAttrib*() call that
    /// set it last.
    pub(crate) fn note_current_vertex_attrib_value_type(&self, index: u32, value_type: VertexAttribValueType) {
        // NB: GL rejects a call for an attribute that doesn't exist, so it sets no value, and leaves no type to note.
        if index >= self.max_vertex_attribs() {
            return;
        }
        let mut types = self.current_vertex_attrib_value_types.borrow_mut();
        if value_type == VertexAttribValueType::Float {
            types.remove(&index);
        } else {
            types.insert(index, value_type);
        }
    }

    fn max_vertex_attribs(&self) -> u32 {
        if let Some(max_vertex_attribs) = self.max_vertex_attribs.get() {
            return max_vertex_attribs;
        }
        let mut result = [0];
        self.proxy
            .get_integerv_robust_angle(GL_MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS, 1, &mut result);
        let max_vertex_attribs = u32::try_from(result[0]).unwrap_or(0);
        self.max_vertex_attribs.set(Some(max_vertex_attribs));
        max_vertex_attribs
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_vertex_attrib_value_type(&self, index: u32) -> VertexAttribValueType {
        self.current_vertex_attrib_value_types
            .borrow()
            .get(&index)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(VertexAttribValueType::Float)
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_for_deletion_of<O: Interface + Inherits<WebGLObject>>(&self, object: Ref<O>) -> Option<u32> {
        match object.parent().handle_for_deletion(self) {
            Ok(handle) => handle,
            Err(_) => {
                self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
                None
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_for_query_of<O: Interface + Inherits<WebGLObject>>(&self, object: Ref<O>) -> Option<u32> {
        match object.parent().handle_for_query(self) {
            Ok(handle) => handle,
            Err(_) => {
                self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
                None
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn read_texture_image_source(
        &self,
        source: &TexImageSource,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<(Frame, FrameUpload)>> {
        // If this function is called with an HTMLImageElement or HTMLVideoElement whose origin differs from the origin
        // of the containing Document, or with an HTMLCanvasElement, ImageBitmap or OffscreenCanvas whose bitmap's
        // origin-clean flag is set to false, a SECURITY_ERR exception must be thrown. See Origin Restrictions.
        // https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#ORIGIN_RESTRICTIONS
        if tex_image_source_is_not_origin_clean(source) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "SecurityError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot upload a texture source that is not origin-clean"),
            ));
        }

        let format_and_type_upload_images = texture_export_format(format, r#type).is_some();
        let frame = match *source {
            TexImageSource::ImageBitmap(image_bitmap) => match image_bitmap.frame() {
                Some(image_frame) => format_and_type_upload_images.then_some(Frame::Image(image_frame)),
                // If this function is called with an ImageBitmap that has been neutered, an INVALID_VALUE error is
                // generated.
                None => {
                    self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
                    return Ok(None);
                }
            },
            TexImageSource::ImageData(image_data) => match image_data.pixels() {
                Some(_) if !format_and_type_upload_images => None,
                Some(pixels) => {
                    let (width, height) = image_data.size();
                    let pitch = width as usize * 4;
                    // SAFETY: Nothing runs script while the pixels are copied.
                    let Some(image_frame) = (unsafe {
                        image_frame_from_pixels(pixels, pitch, width as i32, height as i32, ColorSpace::Srgb)
                    }) else {
                        self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
                        return Ok(None);
                    };
                    Some(Frame::Image(image_frame))
                }
                // If this function is called with an ImageData whose data attribute has been neutered, an
                // INVALID_VALUE error is generated.
                None => {
                    self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
                    return Ok(None);
                }
            },
            TexImageSource::HTMLImageElement(object) => format_and_type_upload_images
                .then(|| texture_image_frame(object, TexImageSourceKind::HTMLImageElement).map(Frame::Image))
                .flatten(),
            TexImageSource::HTMLCanvasElement(object) => format_and_type_upload_images
                .then(|| texture_image_frame(object, TexImageSourceKind::HTMLCanvasElement).map(Frame::Image))
                .flatten(),
            TexImageSource::OffscreenCanvas(object) => format_and_type_upload_images
                .then(|| texture_image_frame(object, TexImageSourceKind::OffscreenCanvas).map(Frame::Image))
                .flatten(),
            TexImageSource::HTMLVideoElement(object) => format_and_type_upload_images
                .then(|| capture_video_frame(object).map(Frame::Video))
                .flatten(),
        };
        if tex_image_source_is_not_origin_clean(source) {
            return Err(Exception::Dom(
                "SecurityError",
                Utf16String::from_ascii(b"Cannot upload a texture source that is not origin-clean"),
            ));
        }
        let Some(frame) = frame else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        // The first pixel transferred from the source to the WebGL implementation corresponds to the upper left
        // corner of the source. This behavior is modified by the UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL pixel storage parameter,
        // except for ImageBitmap arguments, as described in the abovementioned section.
        let flip_y = self.unpack_flip_y.get() && !matches!(source, TexImageSource::ImageBitmap(_));
        let upload = FrameUpload {
            destination_size: None,
            flip_y,
            premultiply_alpha: self.unpack_premultiply_alpha.get(),
        };
        Ok(Some((frame, upload)))
    }

    /// https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/2.0/#PIXEL_STORE_PARAM_CONSTRAINTS
    /// If UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL or UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL is set to true, texImage3D and texSubImage3D generate
    /// an INVALID_OPERATION error if they upload data from a PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER or a non-null client side
    /// ArrayBufferView.
    pub(crate) fn unpack_flags_allow_3d_upload_from_array_buffer_view(&self) -> bool {
        if self.unpack_flip_y.get() || self.unpack_premultiply_alpha.get() {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return false;
        }
        true
    }

    pub(crate) fn uniform_location_handle(&self, location: Ref<WebGLUniformLocation>) -> Option<i32> {
        let handle = location.handle(self.current_program.get()).ok();
        if handle.is_none() {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
        }
        handle
    }

    pub(crate) fn did_update_canvas_content(&self) {
        self.canvas.did_change_content();
    }

    /// https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#CONTEXT_LOST
    pub(crate) fn mark_lost(&self) -> bool {
        if self.context_lost.replace(true) {
            return false;
        }
        self.proxy.set_lost();
        // NB: The next getError() has to return CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL, once.
        self.error.set(GL_CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL);
        true
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_context_restore_requested(&self, requested: bool) {
        self.context_restore_requested.set(requested);
    }

    pub(crate) fn wants_restoring(&self) -> bool {
        self.context_lost.get() && self.context_restore_requested.get()
    }

    /// The new replayer context has no GL objects: the page creates its objects anew once told of the restore.
    pub(crate) fn restore(&self, transport: RemoteContext, supported_opengl_extensions: Vec<Vec<u8>>) {
        self.proxy.restore(transport);
        self.supported_opengl_extensions.replace(supported_opengl_extensions);

        self.context_generation.set(self.context_generation.get() + 1);
        self.unpack_state.set(PixelUnpackState::default());
        self.unpack_flip_y.set(false);
        self.unpack_premultiply_alpha.set(false);
        self.unpack_colorspace_conversion.set(GL_BROWSER_DEFAULT_WEBGL);
        self.reset_client_side_state();

        self.context_lost.set(false);
        self.context_restore_requested.set(false);
        self.error.set(GL_NO_ERROR);
    }

    fn reset_client_side_state(&self) {
        self.array_buffer_binding.set(None);
        self.element_array_buffer_binding.set(None);
        self.current_program.set(None);
        self.framebuffer_binding.set(None);
        self.renderbuffer_binding.set(None);
        self.texture_binding_2d.set(None);
        self.texture_binding_cube_map.set(None);
        self.uniform_buffer_binding.set(None);
        self.copy_read_buffer_binding.set(None);
        self.copy_write_buffer_binding.set(None);
        self.transform_feedback_buffer_binding.set(None);
        self.pixel_pack_buffer_binding.set(None);
        self.pixel_unpack_buffer_binding.set(None);
        self.texture_binding_2d_array.set(None);
        self.texture_binding_3d.set(None);
        self.transform_feedback_binding.set(None);
        self.current_vertex_array.set(None);
        self.current_vertex_attrib_value_types.borrow_mut().clear();
        self.max_vertex_attribs.set(None);
        self.any_samples_passed.set(None);
        self.any_samples_passed_conservative.set(None);
        self.transform_feedback_primitives_written.set(None);
    }
}

/// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#the-image-argument-is-not-origin-clean
fn tex_image_source_is_not_origin_clean(source: &TexImageSource) -> bool {
    match *source {
        TexImageSource::ImageBitmap(image_bitmap) => !image_bitmap.origin_clean(),
        TexImageSource::ImageData(_) => false,
        TexImageSource::HTMLImageElement(object) => CanvasImageSourceKind::HTMLImageElement.is_not_origin_clean(object),
        TexImageSource::HTMLCanvasElement(object) => {
            CanvasImageSourceKind::HTMLCanvasElement.is_not_origin_clean(object)
        }
        TexImageSource::HTMLVideoElement(object) => CanvasImageSourceKind::HTMLVideoElement.is_not_origin_clean(object),
        TexImageSource::OffscreenCanvas(object) => CanvasImageSourceKind::OffscreenCanvas.is_not_origin_clean(object),
    }
}

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{
    Array, ArrayBuffer, ArrayBufferShared, MarkedVec, PrimitiveString, TypedArrayKind, Value,
    create_typed_array_on_buffer,
};

use super::proxy::recorder::bytes_of;
use super::state::ContextState;
use crate::bindings::CallContext;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Interface, Ref, wrap};

impl ContextState {
    fn typed_array(&self, cx: &CallContext, kind: TypedArrayKind, bytes: &[u8], length: usize) -> Value {
        let array_buffer = ArrayBuffer::create_from_bytes(cx.vm(), self.realm(), bytes, ArrayBufferShared::No);
        Value::from_object(create_typed_array_on_buffer(
            cx.vm(),
            self.realm(),
            kind,
            length,
            array_buffer,
        ))
    }

    pub(crate) fn int32_array(&self, cx: &CallContext, numbers: &[i32]) -> Value {
        self.typed_array(cx, TypedArrayKind::Int32Array, bytes_of(numbers), numbers.len())
    }

    pub(crate) fn uint32_array(&self, cx: &CallContext, numbers: &[u32]) -> Value {
        self.typed_array(cx, TypedArrayKind::Uint32Array, bytes_of(numbers), numbers.len())
    }

    pub(crate) fn float32_array(&self, cx: &CallContext, numbers: &[f32]) -> Value {
        self.typed_array(cx, TypedArrayKind::Float32Array, bytes_of(numbers), numbers.len())
    }

    /// A `sequence<GLboolean>` returned as `any` is a JS array.
    pub(crate) fn boolean_array(&self, cx: &CallContext, booleans: &[bool]) -> Value {
        let elements = MarkedVec::with_capacity(cx.vm(), booleans.len());
        for &boolean in booleans {
            elements.push(Value::from_bool(boolean));
        }
        Value::from_object(Array::create_from_list(cx.vm(), self.realm(), &elements))
    }
}

pub(crate) fn string_value(cx: &CallContext, string: Utf16String) -> Value {
    Value::from_string(PrimitiveString::create(cx.vm(), string))
}

pub(crate) fn object_or_null<T: Interface>(cx: &CallContext, object: Option<Ref<T>>) -> Value {
    object.map_or(Value::NULL, |object| Value::from_object(wrap(cx, object)))
}

//! WebGLContextEvent, https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#5.15

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use crate::bindings::event_target::CppEvent;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};
use crate::dom::event::EventInit;

pub(crate) struct WebGLContextEventInit {
    pub(crate) parent: EventInit,
    pub(crate) status_message: Utf16String,
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLContextEvent {
    event: CppEvent,
    status_message: Utf16String,
}

impl Wrappable for WebGLContextEvent {
    fn cpp_parent(&self) -> Option<NonNull<c_void>> {
        self.event.as_cpp_parent()
    }
}

impl WebGLContextEvent {
    pub(crate) fn create(
        vm: &Vm,
        realm: Gc<Realm>,
        event_name: &Utf16String,
        event_init: &WebGLContextEventInit,
    ) -> Ref<WebGLContextEvent> {
        let event = CppEvent::create_for_owner(
            realm,
            event_name,
            event_init.parent.bubbles,
            event_init.parent.cancelable,
            event_init.parent.composed,
        );
        let object = allocate(vm, |_| WebGLContextEvent {
            event,
            status_message: event_init.status_message.clone(),
        });
        object.event.set_owner(object);
        object
    }

    pub(crate) fn construct(
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        r#type: Utf16String,
        event_init: WebGLContextEventInit,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<WebGLContextEvent>> {
        Ok(Self::create(cx.vm(), cx.realm(), &r#type, &event_init))
    }

    pub(crate) fn event(&self) -> &CppEvent {
        &self.event
    }

    pub(crate) fn status_message(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Utf16String> {
        Ok(self.status_message.clone())
    }
}

//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/extensions/WEBGL_draw_buffers/

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use super::constants::GL_INVALID_VALUE;
use super::proxy::recorder::bytes_of;
use super::state::{ContextRef, ContextState};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLDrawBuffers {
    context: ContextRef,
}

impl Wrappable for WebGLDrawBuffers {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.context.state().canvas().relevant_realm()
    }
}

impl WebGLDrawBuffers {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, context: &ContextState) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            context: context.context_ref(),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn draw_buffers_webgl(&self, _: &mut CallContext, buffers: Vec<u32>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let context = self.context.state();
        let Ok(buffer_count) = i32::try_from(buffers.len()) else {
            context.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        context.proxy.draw_buffers_ext(buffer_count, bytes_of(&buffers));
        Ok(())
    }
}

/*
