//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#5.5

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, GcRefCell, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use super::state::ContextState;
use super::web_gl_object::WebGLObject;
use super::web_gl_renderbuffer::WebGLRenderbuffer;
use super::web_gl_texture::WebGLTexture;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct Attachment {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    attachment: u32,
    pub(crate) texture: Option<Ref<WebGLTexture>>,
    pub(crate) renderbuffer: Option<Ref<WebGLRenderbuffer>>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pub(crate) texture_target: u32,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    pub(crate) texture_level: i32,
}

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLFramebuffer {
    object: WebGLObject,
    attachments: GcRefCell<Vec<Attachment>>,
}

impl Wrappable for WebGLFramebuffer {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.object.relevant_realm()
    }
}

impl Inherits<WebGLObject> for WebGLFramebuffer {
    fn parent(&self) -> &WebGLObject {
        &self.object
    }
}

impl WebGLFramebuffer {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, context: &ContextState, handle: u32) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            object: WebGLObject::new(context, handle),
            attachments: GcRefCell::new(Vec::new()),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn attachment(&self, attachment: u32) -> Option<Attachment> {
        self.attachments
            .borrow()
            .iter()
            .find(|existing| existing.attachment == attachment)
            .copied()
    }

    fn set_attachment(&self, vm: &Vm, attachment: u32, new_attachment: Option<Attachment>) {
        let mut attachments = self.attachments.borrow_mut(vm);
        attachments.retain(|existing| existing.attachment != attachment);
        attachments.extend(new_attachment);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_renderbuffer_attachment(
        &self,
        vm: &Vm,
        attachment: u32,
        renderbuffer: Option<Ref<WebGLRenderbuffer>>,
    ) {
        let new_attachment = renderbuffer.map(|renderbuffer| Attachment {
            attachment,
            texture: None,
            renderbuffer: Some(renderbuffer),
            texture_target: 0,
            texture_level: 0,
        });
        self.set_attachment(vm, attachment, new_attachment);
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_texture_attachment(
        &self,
        vm: &Vm,
        attachment: u32,
        texture: Option<Ref<WebGLTexture>>,
        texture_target: u32,
        texture_level: i32,
    ) {
        let new_attachment = texture.map(|texture| Attachment {
            attachment,
            texture: Some(texture),
            renderbuffer: None,
            texture_target,
            texture_level,
        });
        self.set_attachment(vm, attachment, new_attachment);
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/web_gl/web_gl_object.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#5.3

use core::cell::{Cell, RefCell};

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace};

use super::state::{ContextRef, ContextState};
use crate::bindings::conversions::UsvString;
use crate::bindings::interface::Wrappable;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

pub(crate) struct InvalidOperation;

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLObject {
    context: ContextRef,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    handle: u32,
    /// Restoring a lost context starts a new generation, in which the objects of earlier ones are invalid.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    context_generation: u64,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    invalidated: Cell<bool>,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    label: RefCell<UsvString>,
}

impl Wrappable for WebGLObject {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.context.state().canvas().relevant_realm()
    }
}

impl WebGLObject {
    pub(crate) fn new(context: &ContextState, handle: u32) -> Self {
        Self {
            context: context.context_ref(),
            handle,
            context_generation: context.context_generation(),
            invalidated: Cell::new(false),
            label: RefCell::new(UsvString::from_ascii(b"")),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn label(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<UsvString> {
        Ok(self.label.borrow().clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_label(&self, _: &mut CallContext, value: UsvString) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.label.replace(value);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn validate_context(&self, context: &ContextState) -> Result<(), InvalidOperation> {
        if core::ptr::eq(self.context.state(), context) {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(InvalidOperation)
        }
    }

    /// Whether this object belongs to `context`, and was deleted there rather than lost with an earlier context.
    pub(crate) fn was_deleted_in(&self, context: &ContextState) -> bool {
        self.validate_context(context).is_ok()
            && self.invalidated.get()
            && self.context_generation == context.context_generation()
    }

    pub(crate) fn invalidated_for_context(&self, context: &ContextState) -> bool {
        self.invalidated.get() || self.context_generation != context.context_generation()
    }

    pub(crate) fn invalidate(&self) {
        self.invalidated.set(true);
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle(&self, context: &ContextState) -> Result<u32, InvalidOperation> {
        self.handle_for_query(context)?.ok_or(InvalidOperation)
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_for_deletion(&self, context: &ContextState) -> Result<Option<u32>, InvalidOperation> {
        let handle = self.handle_for_query(context)?;
        if handle.is_some() {
            self.invalidate();
        }
        Ok(handle)
    }

    /// `None` for a deleted or lost object, which a question about it has an answer for without asking GL.
    pub(crate) fn handle_for_query(&self, context: &ContextState) -> Result<Option<u32>, InvalidOperation> {
        self.validate_context(context)?;
        Ok((!self.invalidated_for_context(context)).then_some(self.handle))
    }
}

macro_rules! modules_of_interfaces_that_only_inherit_from_web_gl_object {
    ($(
        $(#[$specification_link:meta])*
        $module:ident :: $interface:ident
    ),+ $(,)?) => {$(
        $(#[$specification_link])*
        pub(crate) mod $module {
            use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

            use $crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
            use $crate::web_gl::state::ContextState;
            use $crate::web_gl::web_gl_object::WebGLObject;

            #[derive(Trace)]
            #[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
            pub(crate) struct $interface {
                object: WebGLObject,
            }

            impl Wrappable for $interface {
                fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
                    self.object.relevant_realm()
                }
            }

            impl Inherits<WebGLObject> for $interface {
                fn parent(&self) -> &WebGLObject {
                    &self.object
                }
            }

            impl $interface {
                pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, context: &ContextState, handle: u32) -> Ref<Self> {
                    allocate(
                        vm,
                        |_| Self {
                            object: WebGLObject::new(context, handle),
                        },
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    )+};
}
pub(crate) use modules_of_interfaces_that_only_inherit_from_web_gl_object;

//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#5.6

use core::cell::Cell;

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use super::state::ContextState;
use super::web_gl_object::WebGLObject;
use super::web_gl_shader::WebGLShader;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLProgram {
    object: WebGLObject,
    pub(crate) attached_vertex_shader: Cell<Option<Ref<WebGLShader>>>,
    pub(crate) attached_fragment_shader: Cell<Option<Ref<WebGLShader>>>,
    /// How many times the program has been linked. A link assigns the program's uniforms their locations anew, so a
    /// location from before the last one names nothing in it.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    link_count: Cell<u32>,
}

impl Wrappable for WebGLProgram {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.object.relevant_realm()
    }
}

impl Inherits<WebGLObject> for WebGLProgram {
    fn parent(&self) -> &WebGLObject {
        &self.object
    }
}

impl WebGLProgram {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, context: &ContextState, handle: u32) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            object: WebGLObject::new(context, handle),
            attached_vertex_shader: Cell::new(None),
            attached_fragment_shader: Cell::new(None),
            link_count: Cell::new(0),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn link_count(&self) -> u32 {
        self.link_count.get()
    }

    pub(crate) fn note_link(&self) {
        self.link_count.set(self.link_count.get().wrapping_add(1));
    }
}

use super::web_gl_texture::WebGLTexture;
use super::web_gl_uniform_location::WebGLUniformLocation;
use crate::bindings::conversions::CppInterface;
use crate::bindings::interface::Ref;
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

/// https://www.khronos.org/registry/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#WEBGLCONTEXTATTRIBUTES
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLContextAttributes {
    pub(crate) alpha: bool,
    pub(crate) depth: bool,
    pub(crate) stencil: bool,
    pub(crate) antialias: bool,
    pub(crate) premultiplied_alpha: bool,
    pub(crate) preserve_drawing_buffer: bool,
    pub(crate) power_preference: WebGLPowerPreference,
    pub(crate) fail_if_major_performance_caveat: bool,
    pub(crate) desynchronized: bool,
}

pub(crate) fn is_valid_framebuffer_binding_target(version: WebGLVersion, target: u32) -> bool {
    if target == GL_FRAMEBUFFER {
        return true;
    }
    version == WebGLVersion::WebGL2 && (target == GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER || target == GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER)
}

pub(crate) fn is_valid_framebuffer_attachment(
    version: WebGLVersion,
    draw_buffers_extension_enabled: bool,
    attachment: u32,
) -> bool {
    if matches!(
        attachment,
        GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 | GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT | GL_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT | GL_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT
    ) {
        return true;
    }
    if version == WebGLVersion::WebGL2 || draw_buffers_extension_enabled {
        return attachment > GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 && attachment <= GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 + 15;
    }
    false
}

fn is_valid_framebuffer_texture_2d_target(target: u32) -> bool {
    matches!(
        target,
        GL_TEXTURE_2D
            | GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_X
            | GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_X
            | GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_Y
            | GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_Y
            | GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_Z
            | GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_Z
    )
}

fn holds_object<T: Trace>(binding: &Binding<T>, object: Ref<T>) -> bool {
    binding.get().is_some_and(|held| held.as_ptr() == object.as_ptr())
}

fn active_info_name(name_buffer: &[u8], length: i32) -> Utf16String {
    let length = usize::try_from(length).expect("the length of a name that GL wrote is not negative");
    utf16_string_from_gl_string(&name_buffer[..length])
}

fn zeroed_gl_string_buffer(size_with_terminating_nul: i32) -> Vec<u8> {
    let size = usize::try_from(size_with_terminating_nul).expect("GL does not report a negative size for a string");
    vec![0; size]
}

/// A buffer that holds the name of any active attribute or uniform of the program, with its terminating NUL: as long
/// as GL reports for `pname`, ACTIVE_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_LENGTH or ACTIVE_UNIFORM_MAX_LENGTH.
pub(super) fn active_name_buffer(context: &ContextState, program: u32, pname: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut size = [0];
    context.proxy.get_programiv(program, pname, &mut size);
    zeroed_gl_string_buffer(size[0].max(1))
}

pub(super) fn gl_size_of_buffer(buffer: &[u8]) -> i32 {
    i32::try_from(buffer.len()).expect("a name buffer is smaller than 2^31 bytes")
}

#[expect(
    clippy::too_many_arguments,
    reason = "the operations have the arguments of the GL functions"
)]
impl<V: Version> RenderingContext<V> {
    // NB: The state has a `canvas()` and an `is_context_lost()` of its own, which a method call on a context does not
    //     reach past the operations of the same names.
    pub(crate) fn canvas(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<CppInterface> {
        Ok(ContextState::canvas(self).wrapper(cx.realm()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn drawing_buffer_width(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        let (width, _) = ContextState::canvas(self).bitmap_size();
        Ok(drawing_buffer_dimension(width))
    }

    pub(crate) fn drawing_buffer_height(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        let (_, height) = ContextState::canvas(self).bitmap_size();
        Ok(drawing_buffer_dimension(height))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_context_attributes(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<WebGLContextAttributes>> {
        if ContextState::is_context_lost(self) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        Ok(Some(self.actual_context_parameters))
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_context_lost(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<bool> {
        Ok(ContextState::is_context_lost(self))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_supported_extensions(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Vec<Utf16String>>> {
        Ok(Some(self.supported_extensions()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_extension(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, name: Utf16String) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Gc<Object>>> {
        Ok(self.extension(cx, &name))
    }

    pub(crate) fn active_texture(&self, _: &mut CallContext, texture: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.active_texture(texture);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn attach_shader(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
        shader: Ref<WebGLShader>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(program_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(shader_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(shader) else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        if holds_object(&program.attached_vertex_shader, shader)
            || holds_object(&program.attached_fragment_shader, shader)
        {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(());
        }

        if shader.r#type() == GL_VERTEX_SHADER && program.attached_vertex_shader.get().is_some() {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(());
        }

        if shader.r#type() == GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER && program.attached_fragment_shader.get().is_some() {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(());
        }

        self.proxy.attach_shader(program_handle, shader_handle);

        match shader.r#type() {
            GL_VERTEX_SHADER => program.attached_vertex_shader.set(Some(shader)),
            GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER => program.attached_fragment_shader.set(Some(shader)),
            _ => unreachable!("a shader is a vertex shader or a fragment shader"),
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn bind_attrib_location(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
        index: u32,
        name: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(program_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy
            .bind_attrib_location(program_handle, index, &utf8_bytes(&name));
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn bind_buffer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        buffer: Option<Ref<WebGLBuffer>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut buffer_handle = 0;
        if let Some(buffer) = buffer {
            let Some(handle) = self.handle_of(buffer) else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            buffer_handle = handle;

            if !buffer.kind_allows_binding_to(target) {
                self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
                return Ok(());
            }
        }

        let (binding, kind_of_buffers_at_target) = match target {
            GL_ARRAY_BUFFER => (&self.array_buffer_binding, BufferKind::OtherData),
            GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER => (&self.element_array_buffer_binding, BufferKind::ElementArray),
            // FIXME: A buffer of indices can be bound to COPY_READ_BUFFER and to COPY_WRITE_BUFFER as well.
            GL_COPY_READ_BUFFER if self.is_webgl2() => (&self.copy_read_buffer_binding, BufferKind::OtherData),
            GL_COPY_WRITE_BUFFER if self.is_webgl2() => (&self.copy_write_buffer_binding, BufferKind::OtherData),
            GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER if self.is_webgl2() => (&self.pixel_pack_buffer_binding, BufferKind::OtherData),
            GL_PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER if self.is_webgl2() => (&self.pixel_unpack_buffer_binding, BufferKind::OtherData),
            GL_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER if self.is_webgl2() => {
                (&self.transform_feedback_buffer_binding, BufferKind::OtherData)
            }
            GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER if self.is_webgl2() => (&self.uniform_buffer_binding, BufferKind::OtherData),
            _ => {
                self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
                return Ok(());
            }
        };
        if let Some(buffer) = buffer {
            buffer.was_bound_as(kind_of_buffers_at_target);
        }
        binding.set(buffer);

        self.proxy.bind_buffer(target, buffer_handle);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn bind_framebuffer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        framebuffer: Option<Ref<WebGLFramebuffer>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut framebuffer_handle = 0;
        if let Some(framebuffer) = framebuffer {
            let Some(handle) = self.handle_of(framebuffer) else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            framebuffer_handle = handle;
        }

        self.proxy.bind_framebuffer(target, framebuffer_handle);
        self.framebuffer_binding.set(framebuffer);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn bind_renderbuffer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        renderbuffer: Option<Ref<WebGLRenderbuffer>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut renderbuffer_handle = 0;
        if let Some(renderbuffer) = renderbuffer {
            let Some(handle) = self.handle_of(renderbuffer) else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            renderbuffer_handle = handle;
        }

        self.proxy.bind_renderbuffer(target, renderbuffer_handle);
        self.renderbuffer_binding.set(renderbuffer);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn bind_texture(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        texture: Option<Ref<WebGLTexture>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut texture_handle = 0;
        if let Some(texture) = texture {
            let Some(handle) = self.handle_of(texture) else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            texture_handle = handle;
        }

        let binding = match target {
            GL_TEXTURE_2D => &self.texture_binding_2d,
            GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP => &self.texture_binding_cube_map,
            GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY if self.is_webgl2() => &self.texture_binding_2d_array,
            GL_TEXTURE_3D if self.is_webgl2() => &self.texture_binding_3d,
            _ => {
                self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
                return Ok(());
            }
        };
        binding.set(texture);

        self.proxy.bind_texture(target, texture_handle);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn check_framebuffer_status(&self, _: &mut CallContext, target: u32) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {

    pub(crate) fn clear(&self, _: &mut CallContext, mask: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {

        self.proxy.compile_shader(shader_handle);
        Ok(())
    }

        _: &mut CallContext,

        height: i32,

    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {

            .copy_tex_image2d(target, level, internalformat, x, y, width, height, border);

    pub(crate) fn create_buffer(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<WebGLBuffer>> {
        let mut handle = [0];
        self.proxy.gen_buffers(&mut handle);
        Ok(WebGLBuffer::create(cx.vm(), self, handle[0]))
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_framebuffer(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<WebGLFramebuffer>> {
        let mut handle = [0];
        self.proxy.gen_framebuffers(&mut handle);
        Ok(WebGLFramebuffer::create(cx.vm(), self, handle[0]))
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_program(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<WebGLProgram>> {
        let handle = self.proxy.create_program();
        Ok(WebGLProgram::create(cx.vm(), self, handle))
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_renderbuffer(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<WebGLRenderbuffer>> {
        let mut handle = [0];
        self.proxy.gen_renderbuffers(&mut handle);
        Ok(WebGLRenderbuffer::create(cx.vm(), self, handle[0]))
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_shader(&self, cx: &mut CallContext, r#type: u32) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<WebGLShader>>> {
        if r#type != GL_VERTEX_SHADER && r#type != GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(None);
        }

        let handle = self.proxy.create_shader(r#type);
        Ok(Some(WebGLShader::create(cx.vm(), self, handle, r#type)))
    }

    pub(crate) fn create_texture(&self, cx: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<Ref<WebGLTexture>> {
        let mut handle = [0];
        self.proxy.gen_textures(&mut handle);
        Ok(WebGLTexture::create(cx.vm(), self, handle[0]))
    }

    pub(crate) fn cull_face(&self, _: &mut CallContext, mode: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.cull_face(mode);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn delete_buffer(&self, _: &mut CallContext, buffer: Option<Ref<WebGLBuffer>>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(buffer) = buffer else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(handle) = self.handle_for_deletion_of(buffer) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.delete_buffers(1, &[handle]);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn delete_framebuffer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        framebuffer: Option<Ref<WebGLFramebuffer>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(framebuffer) = framebuffer else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(handle) = self.handle_for_deletion_of(framebuffer) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.delete_framebuffers(1, &[handle]);

        if holds_object(&self.framebuffer_binding, framebuffer) {
            self.framebuffer_binding.set(None);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn delete_program(&self, _: &mut CallContext, program: Option<Ref<WebGLProgram>>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(program) = program else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(handle) = self.handle_for_deletion_of(program) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.delete_program(handle);

        if holds_object(&self.current_program, program) {
            self.current_program.set(None);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn delete_renderbuffer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        renderbuffer: Option<Ref<WebGLRenderbuffer>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(renderbuffer) = renderbuffer else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(handle) = self.handle_for_deletion_of(renderbuffer) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.delete_renderbuffers(1, &[handle]);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn delete_shader(&self, _: &mut CallContext, shader: Option<Ref<WebGLShader>>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(shader) = shader else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(handle) = self.handle_for_deletion_of(shader) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.delete_shader(handle);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn delete_texture(&self, _: &mut CallContext, texture: Option<Ref<WebGLTexture>>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(texture) = texture else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(handle) = self.handle_for_deletion_of(texture) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.delete_textures(1, &[handle]);

        for binding in [
            &self.texture_binding_2d,
            &self.texture_binding_cube_map,
            &self.texture_binding_2d_array,
            &self.texture_binding_3d,
        ] {
            if holds_object(binding, texture) {
                binding.set(None);
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn depth_func(&self, _: &mut CallContext, func: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.depth_func(func);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn depth_mask(&self, _: &mut CallContext, flag: bool) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.depth_mask(flag);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn depth_range(&self, _: &mut CallContext, z_near: f32, z_far: f32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.depth_rangef(z_near, z_far);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn detach_shader(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
        shader: Ref<WebGLShader>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(program_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(shader_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(shader) else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        self.proxy.detach_shader(program_handle, shader_handle);

        match shader.r#type() {
            GL_VERTEX_SHADER => program.attached_vertex_shader.set(None),
            GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER => program.attached_fragment_shader.set(None),
            _ => {}
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn disable(&self, _: &mut CallContext, cap: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.disable(cap);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn disable_vertex_attrib_array(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.disable_vertex_attrib_array(index);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn draw_arrays(&self, _: &mut CallContext, mode: u32, first: i32, count: i32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.did_update_canvas_content();
        self.proxy.draw_arrays(mode, first, count);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn draw_elements(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        mode: u32,
        count: i32,
        r#type: u32,
        offset: i64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.draw_elements(mode, count, r#type, offset);
        self.did_update_canvas_content();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn enable(&self, _: &mut CallContext, cap: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.enable(cap);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn enable_vertex_attrib_array(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.enable_vertex_attrib_array(index);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn finish(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.finish();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn flush(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.flush();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn framebuffer_renderbuffer(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        attachment: u32,
        renderbuffertarget: u32,
        renderbuffer: Option<Ref<WebGLRenderbuffer>>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if !is_valid_framebuffer_binding_target(self.version(), target) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }

        if !is_valid_framebuffer_attachment(self.version(), self.extension_enabled("WEBGL_draw_buffers"), attachment) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }

        if renderbuffertarget != GL_RENDERBUFFER {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }

        let Some(bound_framebuffer) = self.framebuffer_binding.get() else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(());
        };

        let mut renderbuffer_handle = 0;
        if let Some(renderbuffer) = renderbuffer {
            let Some(handle) = self.handle_of(renderbuffer) else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            renderbuffer_handle = handle;
        }
        self.proxy
            .framebuffer_renderbuffer(target, attachment, renderbuffertarget, renderbuffer_handle);
        bound_framebuffer.set_renderbuffer_attachment(cx.vm(), attachment, renderbuffer);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn framebuffer_texture2d(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        attachment: u32,
        textarget: u32,
        texture: Option<Ref<WebGLTexture>>,
        level: i32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if !is_valid_framebuffer_binding_target(self.version(), target) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }

        if !is_valid_framebuffer_attachment(self.version(), self.extension_enabled("WEBGL_draw_buffers"), attachment) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }

        if !is_valid_framebuffer_texture_2d_target(textarget) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }

        if level < 0 || (self.version() == WebGLVersion::WebGL1 && level != 0) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        }

        let Some(bound_framebuffer) = self.framebuffer_binding.get() else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(());
        };

        let mut texture_handle = 0;
        if let Some(texture) = texture {
            let Some(handle) = self.handle_of(texture) else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            texture_handle = handle;
        }
        self.proxy
            .framebuffer_texture2d(target, attachment, textarget, texture_handle, level);
        bound_framebuffer.set_texture_attachment(cx.vm(), attachment, texture, textarget, level);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn front_face(&self, _: &mut CallContext, mode: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.front_face(mode);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_active_attrib(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
        index: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<WebGLActiveInfo>>> {
        let Some(program_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };

        let mut name = active_name_buffer(self, program_handle, GL_ACTIVE_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_LENGTH);
        let outputs = self
            .proxy
            .get_active_attrib(program_handle, index, gl_size_of_buffer(&name), &mut name);
        Ok(Some(WebGLActiveInfo::create(
            cx.vm(),
            active_info_name(&name, outputs.length),
            outputs.r#type,
            outputs.size,
        )))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_active_uniform(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
        index: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<WebGLActiveInfo>>> {
        let Some(program_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };

        let mut name = active_name_buffer(self, program_handle, GL_ACTIVE_UNIFORM_MAX_LENGTH);
        let outputs = self
            .proxy
            .get_active_uniform(program_handle, index, gl_size_of_buffer(&name), &mut name);
        Ok(Some(WebGLActiveInfo::create(
            cx.vm(),
            active_info_name(&name, outputs.length),
            outputs.r#type,
            outputs.size,
        )))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_attached_shaders<'vm>(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext<'vm>,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<MarkedVec<'vm, Ref<WebGLShader>>>> {
        if self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program).is_none() {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        let attached_shaders = MarkedVec::with_capacity(cx.vm(), 2);
        for shader in [
            program.attached_vertex_shader.get(),
            program.attached_fragment_shader.get(),
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        {
            attached_shaders.push(shader);
        }
        Ok(Some(attached_shaders))
    }

    }

    pub(crate) fn get_error(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<u32> {

    }

    pub(crate) fn get_program_info_log(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        let Some(program_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };

        let mut info_log_length = [0i32; 1];
        self.proxy
            .get_programiv(program_handle, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &mut info_log_length);
        let [info_log_length] = info_log_length;
        if info_log_length == 0 {
            return Ok(Some(Utf16String::from_ascii(b"")));
        }
        let mut info_log = zeroed_gl_string_buffer(info_log_length);
        self.proxy
            .get_program_info_log(program_handle, info_log_length, &mut info_log);
        Ok(Some(utf16_string_from_gl_string(&info_log[..info_log.len() - 1])))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_shader_precision_format(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        shadertype: u32,
        precisiontype: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<WebGLShaderPrecisionFormat>>> {
        let mut range = [0i32; 2];
        let mut precision = [0i32; 1];
        self.proxy
            .get_shader_precision_format(shadertype, precisiontype, &mut range, &mut precision);
        let [range_min, range_max] = range;
        let [precision] = precision;
        Ok(Some(WebGLShaderPrecisionFormat::create(
            cx.vm(),
            range_min,
            range_max,
            precision,
        )))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_shader_info_log(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        shader: Ref<WebGLShader>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        let Some(shader_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(shader) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };

        let mut info_log_length = [0i32; 1];
        self.proxy
            .get_shaderiv(shader_handle, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &mut info_log_length);
        let [info_log_length] = info_log_length;
        if info_log_length == 0 {
            return Ok(Some(Utf16String::from_ascii(b"")));
        }
        let mut info_log = zeroed_gl_string_buffer(info_log_length);
        self.proxy
            .get_shader_info_log(shader_handle, info_log_length, &mut info_log);
        Ok(Some(utf16_string_from_gl_string(&info_log[..info_log.len() - 1])))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_shader_source(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        shader: Ref<WebGLShader>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Utf16String>> {
        if self.handle_of_program_or_shader(shader).is_none() {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        Ok(Some(shader.source()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_uniform_location(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
        name: Utf16String,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Option<Ref<WebGLUniformLocation>>> {
        let Some(program_handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };

        // "This function returns -1 if name does not correspond to an active uniform variable in program or if name
        //  starts with the reserved prefix "gl_"."
        // WebGL Spec: The return value is null if name does not correspond to an active uniform variable in the passed
        // program.
        let location = self.proxy.get_uniform_location(program_handle, &utf8_bytes(&name));
        if location == -1 {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        Ok(Some(WebGLUniformLocation::create(cx.vm(), location, program)))
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_vertex_attrib_offset(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32, pname: u32) -> WebIdlResult<i64> {
        if pname != GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_POINTER {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(0);
        }

        Ok(self
            .proxy
            .get_vertex_attrib_pointerv_robust_angle(index, GL_VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_POINTER))
    }

    pub(crate) fn pixel_storei(&self, _: &mut CallContext, pname: u32, param: i32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let is_defined = match pname {
            GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT
            | GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT
            | GL_UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL
            | GL_UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL
            | GL_UNPACK_COLORSPACE_CONVERSION_WEBGL => true,
            GL_PACK_ROW_LENGTH
            | GL_PACK_SKIP_PIXELS
            | GL_PACK_SKIP_ROWS
            | GL_UNPACK_ROW_LENGTH
            | GL_UNPACK_IMAGE_HEIGHT
            | GL_UNPACK_SKIP_PIXELS
            | GL_UNPACK_SKIP_ROWS
            | GL_UNPACK_SKIP_IMAGES => self.is_webgl2(),
            _ => false,
        };
        if !is_defined {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }

        let mut unpack_state = self.unpack_state.get();
        match pname {
            GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT => {
                let Ok(alignment @ (1 | 2 | 4 | 8)) = usize::try_from(param) else {
                    self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
                    return Ok(());
                };
                unpack_state.alignment = alignment;
            }
            GL_UNPACK_ROW_LENGTH => {
                if let Ok(row_length) = usize::try_from(param) {
                    unpack_state.row_length = row_length;
                }
            }
            GL_UNPACK_SKIP_PIXELS => {
                if let Ok(skip_pixels) = usize::try_from(param) {
                    unpack_state.skip_pixels = skip_pixels;
                }
            }
            GL_UNPACK_SKIP_ROWS => {
                if let Ok(skip_rows) = usize::try_from(param) {
                    unpack_state.skip_rows = skip_rows;
                }
            }
            GL_UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL => {
                self.unpack_flip_y.set(param != 0);
                return Ok(());
            }
            GL_UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL => {
                self.unpack_premultiply_alpha.set(param != 0);
                return Ok(());
            }
            GL_UNPACK_COLORSPACE_CONVERSION_WEBGL => {
                self.unpack_colorspace_conversion.set(param.cast_unsigned());
                return Ok(());
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        self.unpack_state.set(unpack_state);

        self.proxy.pixel_storei(pname, param);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn use_program(&self, _: &mut CallContext, program: Option<Ref<WebGLProgram>>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut program_handle = 0;
        if let Some(program) = program {
            let Some(handle) = self.handle_of_program_or_shader(program) else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            program_handle = handle;
        }

        self.proxy.use_program(program_handle);
        self.current_program.set(program);
        Ok(())
    }

            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.validate_program(program_handle);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn vertex_attrib1fv(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32, values: Float32List) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(values) = copy_of_first_numbers(&values, 1) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.note_current_vertex_attrib_value_type(index, VertexAttribValueType::Float);
        self.proxy.vertex_attrib1fv(index, &values);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn vertex_attrib2fv(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32, values: Float32List) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(values) = copy_of_first_numbers(&values, 2) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.note_current_vertex_attrib_value_type(index, VertexAttribValueType::Float);
        self.proxy.vertex_attrib2fv(index, &values);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn vertex_attrib3fv(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32, values: Float32List) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(values) = copy_of_first_numbers(&values, 3) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.note_current_vertex_attrib_value_type(index, VertexAttribValueType::Float);
        self.proxy.vertex_attrib3fv(index, &values);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn vertex_attrib4fv(&self, _: &mut CallContext, index: u32, values: Float32List) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(values) = copy_of_first_numbers(&values, 4) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.note_current_vertex_attrib_value_type(index, VertexAttribValueType::Float);
        self.proxy.vertex_attrib4fv(index, &values);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn vertex_attrib_pointer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        index: u32,
        size: i32,
        r#type: u32,
        normalized: bool,
        stride: i32,
        offset: i64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if !self.validate_vertex_attrib_offset(offset) {
            return Ok(());
        }

        self.proxy
            .vertex_attrib_pointer(index, size, r#type, normalized, stride, offset);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn viewport(&self, _: &mut CallContext, x: i32, y: i32, width: i32, height: i32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.viewport(x, y, width, height);
        Ok(())
    }
}

//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#5.14
//!
//! The operations of a WebGL 1 context that a WebGL 2 context has more overloads of.

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, TypedArrayBase};

    pub(crate) fn buffer_data_with_size(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        size: i64,
        usage: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.buffer_data(target, size, None, usage);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn buffer_data(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        data: Option<AllowSharedBufferSource>,
        usage: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#5.14.5
        // If the passed data is null then an INVALID_VALUE error is generated.
        let Some(data) = data else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Ok(bytes) = source_bytes(data.into(), 0, 0) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let size = i64::from(bytes.gl_size());
        // SAFETY: Recording the command neither runs script nor allocates a cell.
        unsafe {
            self.upload_through_nullable_pointer(&bytes, |bytes| {
                self.proxy.buffer_data(target, size, bytes, usage);
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn buffer_sub_data(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        offset: i64,
        data: AllowSharedBufferSource,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Ok(bytes) = source_bytes(data.into(), 0, 0) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let size = i64::from(bytes.gl_size());
        // SAFETY: Recording the command neither runs script nor allocates a cell.
        unsafe {
            self.upload(&bytes, |bytes| {
                self.proxy.buffer_sub_data(target, offset, size, bytes);
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn compressed_tex_image2d(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        level: i32,
        internalformat: u32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        border: i32,
        data: ArrayBufferView,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if !self
            .enabled_compressed_texture_formats
            .borrow()
            .contains(&internalformat)
        {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }
        let Ok(bytes) = source_bytes(data.into(), 0, 0) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let size = bytes.gl_size();
        // SAFETY: Recording the command neither runs script nor allocates a cell.
        unsafe {
            self.upload(&bytes, |bytes| {
                self.proxy.compressed_tex_image2d_robust_angle(
                    target,
                    level,
                    internalformat,
                    width,
                    height,
                    border,
                    size,
                    size,
                    bytes,
                );
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn compressed_tex_sub_image2d(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        level: i32,
        xoffset: i32,
        yoffset: i32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        format: u32,
        data: ArrayBufferView,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if !self.enabled_compressed_texture_formats.borrow().contains(&format) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }
        let Ok(bytes) = source_bytes(data.into(), 0, 0) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let size = bytes.gl_size();
        // SAFETY: Recording the command neither runs script nor allocates a cell.
        unsafe {
            self.upload(&bytes, |bytes| {
                self.proxy.compressed_tex_sub_image2d_robust_angle(
                    target, level, xoffset, yoffset, width, height, format, size, size, bytes,
                );
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn read_pixels(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        x: i32,
        y: i32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
        pixels: Option<ArrayBufferView>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(view) = pixels else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Ok(destination_bytes) = destination_bytes(&view, 0) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Ok(buf_size) = i32::try_from(destination_bytes.len()) else {
            self.set_error(GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY);
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy
            .read_pixels_robust_angle(x, y, width, height, format, r#type, buf_size, |_, pixels| {
                if write_checked(&view, pixels, 0).is_err() {
                    self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
                }
            });
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn tex_image2d(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        level: i32,
        internalformat: i32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        border: i32,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
        pixels: Option<ArrayBufferView>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if let Some(pixels) = pixels {
            let Ok(texture_data) = self.texture_data_for_2d_upload(pixels, 0, width, height, format, r#type) else {
                self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
                return Ok(());
            };
            let buf_size = texture_data.gl_size();
            // SAFETY: Recording the command neither runs script nor allocates a cell.
            unsafe {
                self.upload_texture_data(&texture_data, |texture_data| {
                    self.proxy.tex_image2d_robust_angle(
                        target,
                        level,
                        internalformat,
                        width,
                        height,
                        border,
                        format,
                        r#type,
                        buf_size,
                        texture_data,
                    );
                });
            }
            return Ok(());
        }

        if r#type == GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_6_5 && format != GL_RGB {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(());
        }
        if (r#type == GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_4_4_4_4 || r#type == GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_5_5_1) && format != GL_RGBA {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(());
        }
        let bytes_per_pixel: usize = match (format, r#type) {
            (GL_ALPHA | GL_LUMINANCE, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE) => 1,
            (GL_LUMINANCE_ALPHA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE)
            | (GL_RGB | GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_4_4_4_4 | GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_5_5_1 | GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_6_5) => 2,
            (GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE) => 3,
            (GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE) => 4,
            _ => {
                self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
                return Ok(());
            }
        };
        let Ok(size) = size_of_zero_filled_texture(bytes_per_pixel, width, height) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let zeroes = vec![0; size.get()];
        self.proxy.tex_image2d_robust_angle(
            target,
            level,
            internalformat,
            width,
            height,
            border,
            format,
            r#type,
            size.as_gl_sizei(),
            Some(&zeroes),
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn tex_image2d_with_source(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        level: i32,
        internalformat: i32,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
        source: TexImageSource,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some((frame, upload)) = self.read_texture_image_source(&source, format, r#type)? else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy
            .tex_image2d_from_bitmap(target, level, internalformat, format, r#type, frame, upload);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn uniform1fv(

//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#5.12

use libjs_rust::api::{Trace, Vm};

use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};
use crate::bindings::{CallContext, WebIdlResult};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLShaderPrecisionFormat {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    range_min: i32,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    range_max: i32,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    precision: i32,
}

impl Wrappable for WebGLShaderPrecisionFormat {}

impl WebGLShaderPrecisionFormat {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, range_min: i32, range_max: i32, precision: i32) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            range_min,
            range_max,
            precision,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn range_min(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        Ok(self.range_min)
    }

    pub(crate) fn range_max(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        Ok(self.range_max)
    }

    pub(crate) fn precision(&self, _: &mut CallContext) -> WebIdlResult<i32> {
        Ok(self.precision)
    }
}

use core::cell::RefCell;

use ak::Utf16String;
use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use super::state::ContextState;
use super::web_gl_object::WebGLObject;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLShader {
    object: WebGLObject,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    r#type: u32,
    #[gc(untraced)]
    source: RefCell<Utf16String>,
}

impl Wrappable for WebGLShader {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.object.relevant_realm()
    }
}

impl Inherits<WebGLObject> for WebGLShader {
    fn parent(&self) -> &WebGLObject {
        &self.object
    }
}

impl WebGLShader {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, context: &ContextState, handle: u32, r#type: u32) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            object: WebGLObject::new(context, handle),
            r#type,
            source: RefCell::new(Utf16String::from_ascii(b"")),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn r#type(&self) -> u32 {
        self.r#type
    }

    pub(crate) fn source(&self) -> Utf16String {
        self.source.borrow().clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_source(&self, source: Utf16String) {
        self.source.replace(source);
    }
}

/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/2.0/#3.4

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use super::state::ContextState;
use super::web_gl_object::{InvalidOperation, WebGLObject};
use crate::bindings::interface::{Inherits, Ref, Wrappable, allocate};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLSync {
    object: WebGLObject,
    /// The name of the sync object, which is no GL name of the kind that other objects have.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    sync_handle: u32,
}

impl Wrappable for WebGLSync {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.object.relevant_realm()
    }
}

impl Inherits<WebGLObject> for WebGLSync {
    fn parent(&self) -> &WebGLObject {
        &self.object
    }
}

impl WebGLSync {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, context: &ContextState, sync_handle: u32) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            object: WebGLObject::new(context, 0),
            sync_handle,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn sync_handle(&self, context: &ContextState) -> Result<u32, InvalidOperation> {
        self.object.handle(context).map(|_| self.sync_handle)
    }

    pub(crate) fn sync_handle_for_deletion(&self, context: &ContextState) -> Result<Option<u32>, InvalidOperation> {
        Ok(self.object.handle_for_deletion(context)?.map(|_| self.sync_handle))
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/web_gl/web_gl_uniform_location.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#5.10

use libjs_rust::api::{Gc, Realm, Trace, Vm};

use super::web_gl_object::InvalidOperation;
use super::web_gl_program::WebGLProgram;
use crate::bindings::interface::{Ref, Wrappable, allocate};

#[derive(Trace)]
#[gc(crate = libjs_rust)]
pub(crate) struct WebGLUniformLocation {
    #[gc(untraced)]
    handle: i32,
    program: Ref<WebGLProgram>,
    /// The link of the program that the location is from.
    #[gc(untraced)]
    link_count: u32,
}

impl Wrappable for WebGLUniformLocation {
    fn relevant_realm(&self) -> Option<Gc<Realm>> {
        self.program.relevant_realm()
    }
}

impl WebGLUniformLocation {
    pub(crate) fn create(vm: &Vm, handle: i32, program: Ref<WebGLProgram>) -> Ref<Self> {
        allocate(vm, |_| Self {
            handle,
            program,
            link_count: program.link_count(),
        })
    }

    /// The location, if it's a location in `program`.
    pub(crate) fn handle_in(&self, program: Ref<WebGLProgram>) -> Option<i32> {
        (program.as_ptr() == self.program.as_ptr() && self.is_from_last_link()).then_some(self.handle)
    }

    fn is_from_last_link(&self) -> bool {
        self.link_count == self.program.link_count()
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle(&self, current_program: Option<Ref<WebGLProgram>>) -> Result<i32, InvalidOperation> {
        match current_program {
            Some(current_program) if current_program.as_ptr() == self.program.as_ptr() && self.is_from_last_link() => {
                Ok(self.handle)
            }
            _ => Err(InvalidOperation),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) enum Uint32List {
    Uint32Array(Gc<TypedArrayBase>),
    Sequence(Vec<u32>),
}

fn element_count_from_gl(count: i32) -> usize {
    usize::try_from(count).expect("a count that GL returns is not negative")
}

fn clear_value_count(buffer: u32) -> Option<usize> {
    match buffer {
        GL_COLOR => Some(4),
        GL_DEPTH | GL_STENCIL => Some(1),
        _ => None,
    }
}

#[expect(
    clippy::too_many_arguments,
    reason = "the operations have the arguments of the GL functions"
)]
impl RenderingContext<WebGL2> {
    pub(crate) fn copy_buffer_sub_data(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        read_target: u32,
        write_target: u32,
        read_offset: i64,
        write_offset: i64,
        size: i64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy
            .copy_buffer_sub_data(read_target, write_target, read_offset, write_offset, size);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/2.0/#3.7.3
    pub(crate) fn get_buffer_sub_data(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        src_byte_offset: i64,
        dst_buffer: ArrayBufferView,
        dst_offset: u64,
        length: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Ok(destination_bytes) = destination_bytes_of_get_buffer_sub_data(&dst_buffer, dst_offset, length) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(destination_bytes) = destination_bytes else {
            return Ok(());
        };

        // If copyLength is greater than zero, copy copyLength typed elements (each of size elementSize) from buf into
        // dstBuffer, reading buf starting at byte index srcByteOffset and writing into dstBuffer starting at element
        // index dstOffset.
        self.proxy
            .read_buffer_sub_data(target, src_byte_offset, destination_bytes.len(), |data| {
                if write_checked(&dst_buffer, data, destination_bytes.start).is_err() {
                    self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
                }
            });
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn blit_framebuffer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        src_x0: i32,
        src_y0: i32,
        src_x1: i32,
        src_y1: i32,
        dst_x0: i32,
        dst_y0: i32,
        dst_x1: i32,
        dst_y1: i32,
        mask: u32,
        filter: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.did_update_canvas_content();
        self.proxy.blit_framebuffer(
            src_x0, src_y0, src_x1, src_y1, dst_x0, dst_y0, dst_x1, dst_y1, mask, filter,
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn framebuffer_texture_layer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        attachment: u32,
        texture: Option<Ref<WebGLTexture>>,
        level: i32,
        layer: i32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let mut texture_handle = 0;
        if let Some(texture) = texture {
            let Some(handle) = self.handle_of(texture) else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            texture_handle = handle;
        }
        self.proxy
            .framebuffer_texture_layer(target, attachment, texture_handle, level, layer);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn invalidate_framebuffer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        attachments: Vec<u32>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Ok(attachment_count) = i32::try_from(attachments.len()) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy
            .invalidate_framebuffer(target, attachment_count, bytes_of(&attachments));
        self.did_update_canvas_content();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn invalidate_sub_framebuffer(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        attachments: Vec<u32>,
        x: i32,
        y: i32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Ok(attachment_count) = i32::try_from(attachments.len()) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy
            .invalidate_sub_framebuffer(target, attachment_count, bytes_of(&attachments), x, y, width, height);
        self.did_update_canvas_content();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn read_buffer(&self, _: &mut CallContext, src: u32) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        self.proxy.read_buffer(src);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn get_internalformat_parameter(
        &self,
        cx: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        internalformat: u32,
        pname: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<Value> {
        match pname {
            GL_SAMPLES => {
                let mut num_sample_counts = [0];
                self.proxy.get_internalformativ_robust_angle(
                    target,
                    internalformat,
                    GL_NUM_SAMPLE_COUNTS,
                    1,
                    &mut num_sample_counts,
                );
                let [num_sample_counts] = num_sample_counts;
                let mut samples = vec![0; element_count_from_gl(num_sample_counts)];
                self.proxy.get_internalformativ_robust_angle(
                    target,
                    internalformat,
                    GL_SAMPLES,
                    num_sample_counts,
                    &mut samples,
                );
                Ok(self.int32_array(cx, &samples))
            }
            _ => {
                self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
                Ok(Value::NULL)
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn renderbuffer_storage_multisample(
        &self,

    pub(crate) fn tex_image3d_with_source(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        level: i32,
        internalformat: i32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        depth: i32,
        border: i32,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
        source: TexImageSource,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        // https://registry.khronos.org/OpenGL-Refpages/es3.0/html/glTexImage3D.xhtml
        // border: This value must be 0.
        if border != 0 {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        }

        let Some((frame, mut upload)) = self.read_texture_image_source(&source, format, r#type)? else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        upload.destination_size = Some((width, height));
        self.proxy
            .tex_image3d_from_bitmap(target, level, internalformat, depth, format, r#type, frame, upload);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn tex_image3d(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        level: i32,
        internalformat: i32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        depth: i32,
        border: i32,
        format: u32,
        r#type: u32,
        src_data: Option<ArrayBufferView>,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(src_data) = src_data else {
            self.proxy.tex_image3d_robust_angle(
                target,
                level,
                internalformat,
                width,
                height,
                depth,
                border,
                format,
                r#type,
                0,
                None,
            );
            return Ok(());
        };

        if !self.unpack_flags_allow_3d_upload_from_array_buffer_view() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let Ok(bytes) = source_bytes(src_data.into(), 0, 0) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_OPERATION);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let buf_size = bytes.gl_size();
        // SAFETY: Recording the command neither runs script nor allocates a cell.
        unsafe {
            self.upload_through_nullable_pointer(&bytes, |bytes| {
                self.proxy.tex_image3d_robust_angle(
                    target,
                    level,
                    internalformat,
                    width,
                    height,
                    depth,
                    border,
                    format,
                    r#type,
                    buf_size,
                    bytes,
                );
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn compressed_tex_image3d(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        target: u32,
        level: i32,
        internalformat: u32,
        width: i32,
        height: i32,
        depth: i32,
        border: i32,
        src_data: ArrayBufferView,
        src_offset: u64,
        src_length_override: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if !self
            .enabled_compressed_texture_formats
            .borrow()
            .contains(&internalformat)
        {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }

        let Ok(bytes) = source_bytes(src_data.into(), src_offset, src_length_override) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let size = bytes.gl_size();
        // SAFETY: Recording the command neither runs script nor allocates a cell.
        unsafe {
            self.upload(&bytes, |bytes| {
                self.proxy.compressed_tex_image3d_robust_angle(
                    target,
                    level,
                    internalformat,
                    width,
                    height,
                    depth,
                    border,
                    size,
                    size,
                    bytes,
                );
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

        height: i32,
        depth: i32,
        format: u32,
        src_data: ArrayBufferView,
        src_offset: u64,
        src_length_override: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        if !self.enabled_compressed_texture_formats.borrow().contains(&format) {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        }

        let Ok(bytes) = source_bytes(src_data.into(), src_offset, src_length_override) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let size = bytes.gl_size();

        unsafe {
            self.upload(&bytes, |bytes| {
                self.proxy.compressed_tex_sub_image3d_robust_angle(
                    target, level, xoffset, yoffset, zoffset, width, height, depth, format, size, size, bytes,
                );
            });
        }

    pub(crate) fn uniform3ui(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        location: Option<Ref<WebGLUniformLocation>>,
        v0: u32,
        v1: u32,
        v2: u32,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Some(location) = location else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(location_handle) = self.uniform_location_handle(location) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.uniform3ui(location_handle, v0, v1, v2);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn draw_buffers(&self, _: &mut CallContext, buffers: Vec<u32>) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Ok(buffer_count) = i32::try_from(buffers.len()) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.draw_buffers(buffer_count, bytes_of(&buffers));
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn clear_bufferfv(
        &self,
        _: &mut CallContext,
        buffer: u32,
        drawbuffer: i32,
        values: Float32List,
        src_offset: u64,
    ) -> WebIdlResult<()> {
        let Ok(values) = numbers_from_offset(&values, src_offset) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(clear_value_count) = clear_value_count(buffer) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_ENUM);
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(values) = values.copy_of_first(clear_value_count) else {
            self.set_error(GL_INVALID_VALUE);
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.proxy.clear_bufferfv(buffer, drawbuffer, &values);
        self.did_update_canvas_content();
        Ok(())
    }
