// What the Rust bindings of the interfaces implemented in Rust ask of LibWeb's C++ bindings, declared on the Rust
// side in Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/bindings/services.rs.

// The wrapper of an object of an interface implemented in Rust that the C++ bindings name, in the wrapper world of
// the realm, which the Rust bindings generated for those interfaces define.
extern "C" JSObject* web_rust_bindings_wrap(JSVM*, void* realm, u16 interface_name, void* cell);

namespace Web::Bindings {

GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> wrap_rust_interface_object(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, InterfaceName interface_name, RustInterfaceCell& cell)
{
    // NB: The Rust bindings find the wrapper world of an object through the realm that asks for its wrapper.
    VERIFY(&wrapper_world == &host_defined_wrapper_world(preferred_realm));
    auto* wrapper = web_rust_bindings_wrap(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(preferred_realm.vm()), &preferred_realm, to_underlying(interface_name), &cell);
    return as<JS::HostObject>(*JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(wrapper));
}

constexpr JSHostClass web_bindings_rust_interface_wrapper_host_class = JS::make_host_class(JS_HOST_CLASS_OBJECT, "RustInterface"sv,
    nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, JS_HOST_CLASS_IS_PLATFORM_OBJECT);

bool rust_interface_object_implements_interface(JS::Object const& object, StringView interface_name)
{
    auto const* wrapper = as_if<JS::HostObject>(object);
    if (!wrapper || !JS::host_data_of(object))
        return false;
    // NB: The host class of an interface's wrappers is named after it, and chains through the parent interfaces'
    //     classes up to the class of every Rust interface, or else to that of a C++ interface it inherits from.
    for (auto const* host_class = &wrapper->host_class(); host_class && host_class != &web_bindings_rust_interface_wrapper_host_class; host_class = host_class->parent) {
        if (StringView { host_class->name, host_class->name_length } == interface_name)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

JSCompletion completion_to_abi(JS::Realm& realm, WebIDL::ExceptionOr<JS::Value> result)
{
    if (result.is_exception())
        return JS::HostABI::completion_to_abi(JS::ThrowCompletionOr<JS::Value> { WebIDL::exception_to_throw_completion(realm.vm(), realm, result.exception()) });
    return JS::HostABI::completion_to_abi(JS::ThrowCompletionOr<JS::Value> { result.release_value() });
}

    return wrappable_impl_from(JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(wrapper));

    return HTML::WindowProxy::from_object(*JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(object));

JSObject* web_bindings_window_proxy_object_in_realm(JSObject* object, void* realm)
{
    auto& js_realm = *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm);
    auto& window_proxy = *HTML::WindowProxy::from_object(*JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(object));
    if (auto browsing_context = window_proxy.associated_browsing_context())
        return JS::HostABI::object_to_abi(&browsing_context->window_proxy_for(host_defined_wrapper_world(js_realm), js_realm)->object());
    return object;
}

JSObject* web_bindings_create_dom_exception(void* realm, ReadonlyBytes name, FlatPtr message)
{
    auto& js_realm = *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm);
    auto exception = WebIDL::DOMException::create(FlyString::from_utf8_without_validation(name), Utf16String::from_raw(message));
    return JS::HostABI::object_to_abi(wrap(host_defined_wrapper_world(js_realm), js_realm, exception).ptr());
}

JSCompletion web_bindings_perform_a_security_check(void* realm, JSValue platform_object, ReadonlyBytes identifier, u8 type)
{
    auto& vm = static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm)->vm();
    auto identifier_string = Utf16String::from_utf8_without_validation(StringView { identifier });
    auto result = HTML::perform_a_security_check(vm, JS::HostABI::value_from_abi(platform_object), identifier_string.utf16_view(), static_cast<HTML::SecurityCheckType>(type));
    if (result.is_error())
        return JS::HostABI::throw_completion_to_abi(result.error().value());
    return JS::HostABI::normal_completion_to_abi(JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(JS::js_undefined()));
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#extract-an-origin
bool web_bindings_extract_an_origin(JSObject* object, void* ctx, void (*on_origin)(void*, URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const*))
{
    auto* js_object = JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(object);
    Optional<URL::Origin> origin;

    // NB: IDL only ever sees HTML::WindowProxy but we want to use HTML::Window.
    if (auto* window_proxy = HTML::WindowProxy::from_object(*js_object)) {
        if (auto window = window_proxy->window())
            origin = window->extract_an_origin();
    } else if (auto const* wrappable = wrappable_impl_from(js_object)) {
        origin = wrappable->extract_an_origin();
    }

    if (!origin.has_value())
        return false;
    URL::RustIntegration::lend_origin_to_ffi(*origin, [&](URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const& ffi_origin) {
        on_origin(ctx, &ffi_origin);
    });
    return true;
}

void web_bindings_queue_a_microtask(void* realm, JSObject* function)
{
    GC::Ref<JS::Realm> js_realm = *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm);
    GC::Ref<JS::FunctionObject> steps = as<JS::FunctionObject>(*JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(function));
    HTML::queue_a_microtask(nullptr, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(js_realm, steps), [](auto& js_realm, auto& steps) {
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { js_realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };
        // NB: The steps cannot fail, but they can run into the abort of the script that they call.
        auto& vm = steps->vm();
        auto result = JS::call(vm, *steps, JS::js_undefined());
        VERIFY(!result.is_error() || vm.interrupt_requested());
    }));
}

void web_bindings_deferred_invoke(void* cell, void (*steps)(JSVM*, void*))
{
    Platform::EventLoopPlugin::the().deferred_invoke(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref { *static_cast<GC::Cell*>(cell) }, steps), [](auto& cell, auto& steps) {
        steps(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), cell.ptr());
    }));
}

void web_bindings_run_in_parallel(void* realm, void* cell, void (*steps)(JSVM*, void*))
{
    GC::Ref<JS::Realm> js_realm = *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm);
    // NB: The function's captures, which the collector traces, keep the cell alive until the steps run.
    Platform::EventLoopPlugin::the().deferred_invoke(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(js_realm, GC::Ref { *static_cast<GC::Cell*>(cell) }, steps), [](auto& js_realm, auto& cell, auto& steps) {
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { js_realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };
        steps(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(js_realm->vm()), cell.ptr());
    }));
}

void web_bindings_spin_until_promise_is_settled(JSObject* promise)
{
    auto& js_promise = as<JS::Promise>(*JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(promise));
    HTML::main_thread_event_loop().spin_until(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(js_promise), [](auto& js_promise) {
        return js_promise.state() != JS::Promise::State::Pending;
    }));
}

// NB: The task sources of the Rust bindings' TaskSource.
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::Unspecified) == 0);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::UserInteraction) == 2);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::Networking) == 3);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::Geolocation) == 10);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::TimerTask) == 8);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::FileReading) == 13);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::PerformanceTimeline) == 15);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::Clipboard) == 17);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::Permissions) == 18);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::RemoteEvent) == 20);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::WebGL) == 26);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::Crypto) == 27);
static_assert(to_underlying(HTML::Task::Source::Storage) == 29);

void web_bindings_queue_a_task(u8 task_source, void* cell, void (*steps)(JSVM*, void*))
{
    // NB: The task's captures, which the collector traces, keep the cell alive until the steps run.
    HTML::queue_a_task(static_cast<HTML::Task::Source>(task_source), nullptr, nullptr, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref { *static_cast<GC::Cell*>(cell) }, steps), [](auto& cell, auto& steps) {
        steps(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), cell.ptr());
    }));
}

u64 web_bindings_queue_a_global_task(JSObject* global_object, u8 task_source, void* cell, void (*steps)(JSVM*, void*))
{
    auto& global = *JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(global_object);
    // NB: The task's captures, which the collector traces, keep the cell alive until the steps run.
    auto task_id = HTML::queue_global_task(static_cast<HTML::Task::Source>(task_source), global, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(global, GC::Ref { *static_cast<GC::Cell*>(cell) }, steps), [](auto& global, auto& cell, auto& steps) {
        steps(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(global.vm()), cell.ptr());
    }));
    return task_id.value();
}

void web_bindings_remove_tasks(void* realm, ReadonlySpan<u64> task_ids)
{
    auto& event_loop = *HTML::relevant_agent(static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm)->global_object()).event_loop;
    event_loop.task_queue().remove_tasks_matching([&](auto const& task) {
        return task_ids.contains_slow(task.id().value());
    });
}

u64 web_bindings_currently_running_task(void* realm)
{
    auto& event_loop = *HTML::relevant_agent(static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm)->global_object()).event_loop;
    VERIFY(event_loop.currently_running_task());
    return event_loop.currently_running_task()->id().value();
}

void* web_bindings_create_callback_function(JSObject* callable, bool returns_promise)
{
    auto& object = *JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(callable);
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<WebIDL::CallbackType>(object, HTML::incumbent_settings_object(), returns_promise ? WebIDL::OperationReturnsPromise::Yes : WebIDL::OperationReturnsPromise::No).ptr();
}

static GC::RootVector<JS::Value> callback_arguments(ReadonlySpan<JSValue> arguments)
{
    GC::RootVector<JS::Value> values;
    values.ensure_capacity(arguments.size());
    for (auto argument : arguments)
        values.unchecked_append(JS::HostABI::value_from_abi(argument));
    return values;
}

JSCompletion web_bindings_invoke_callback_function(void* callback, bool has_this_value, JSValue this_value, ReadonlySpan<JSValue> arguments)
{
    Optional<JS::Value> this_argument;
    if (has_this_value)
        this_argument = JS::HostABI::value_from_abi(this_value);
    auto completion = WebIDL::invoke_callback(*static_cast<WebIDL::CallbackType*>(callback), this_argument, callback_arguments(arguments));
    if (completion.is_error())
        return JS::HostABI::throw_completion_to_abi(completion.value());
    return JS::HostABI::normal_completion_to_abi(JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(completion.value()));
}

void web_bindings_invoke_callback_function_and_report(void* callback, ReadonlySpan<JSValue> arguments)
{
    (void)WebIDL::invoke_callback(*static_cast<WebIDL::CallbackType*>(callback), {}, WebIDL::ExceptionBehavior::Report, callback_arguments(arguments));
}

JSObject* web_bindings_callback_function_callback(void* callback)
{
    return JS::HostABI::object_to_abi(static_cast<WebIDL::CallbackType*>(callback)->callback.ptr());
}

void* web_bindings_invoke_promise_callback_function(void* callback, bool has_this_value, JSValue this_value, ReadonlySpan<JSValue> arguments)
{
    Optional<JS::Value> this_argument;
    if (has_this_value)
        this_argument = JS::HostABI::value_from_abi(this_value);
    return WebIDL::invoke_promise_callback(*static_cast<WebIDL::CallbackType*>(callback), this_argument, callback_arguments(arguments)).ptr();
}
}

// Defined by the generated Rust bindings.
extern "C" JSObject* web_rust_bindings_wrap(JSVM*, void* realm, u16 interface_name, void* cell);

namespace Web::Bindings {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(RustEventTarget);
GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(RustEvent);

static GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> wrapper_of_owner(JS::Realm& realm, InterfaceName interface_name, RustInterfaceCell& owner)
{
    auto* wrapper = web_rust_bindings_wrap(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(realm.vm()), &realm, to_underlying(interface_name), &owner);
    return as<JS::HostObject>(*JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(wrapper));
}

GC::Ref<RustEventTarget> RustEventTarget::create()
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<RustEventTarget>();
}

void RustEventTarget::set_owner(InterfaceName interface_name, RustInterfaceCell& owner, GetTheParent get_the_parent)
{
    VERIFY(!m_owner);
    m_owner_interface_name = interface_name;
    m_owner = owner;
    m_get_the_parent = get_the_parent;
}

DOM::EventTarget* RustEventTarget::get_parent(DOM::Event const&)
{
    VERIFY(m_owner);
    return m_get_the_parent(m_owner.ptr());
}

void RustEventTarget::event_listener_list_changed()
{
    if (m_event_listener_list_changed)
        m_event_listener_list_changed(m_owner.ptr());
}

GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> RustEventTarget::create_wrapper(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    VERIFY(m_owner);
    return wrapper_of_owner(realm, m_owner_interface_name, *m_owner);
}

void RustEventTarget::visit_edges(Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_owner);
}

GC::Ref<RustEvent> RustEvent::create(Utf16FlyString const& type, DOM::EventInit const& event_init, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<RustEvent>(type, event_init, time_stamp);
}

RustEvent::RustEvent(Utf16FlyString const& type, DOM::EventInit const& event_init, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp time_stamp)
    : DOM::Event(type, event_init, time_stamp)
{
}

void RustEvent::set_owner(InterfaceName interface_name, RustInterfaceCell& owner)
{
    VERIFY(!m_owner);
    m_owner_interface_name = interface_name;
    m_owner = owner;
}

GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> RustEvent::create_wrapper(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    VERIFY(m_owner);
    return wrapper_of_owner(realm, m_owner_interface_name, *m_owner);
}

void RustEvent::visit_edges(Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_owner);
}

RustInterfaceCell* rust_event_owner(DOM::Event const& event, InterfaceName interface_name)
{
    if (!event.is_owned_by_rust_interface_object())
        return nullptr;
    auto const& rust_event = static_cast<RustEvent const&>(event);
    if (rust_event.m_owner_interface_name != interface_name)
        return nullptr;
    return rust_event.m_owner.ptr();
}

}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#event-handler-idl-attributes
JSValue web_bindings_event_handler_attribute(RustEventTarget* event_target, ReadonlyBytes name)
{
    auto* callback = event_target->event_handler_attribute(Utf16FlyString::from_utf8_without_validation(name));
    if (!callback)
        return JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(JS::js_null());
    return JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(callback->callback.ptr());
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#event-handler-idl-attributes
void web_bindings_set_event_handler_attribute(RustEventTarget* event_target, ReadonlyBytes name, JSValue raw_value)
{
    // NB: EventHandler is [LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull], so a value that is not an object sets the handler to null.
    auto value = JS::HostABI::value_from_abi(raw_value);
    GC::Ptr<WebIDL::CallbackType> callback;
    if (value.is_object())
        callback = GC::Heap::the().allocate<WebIDL::CallbackType>(value.as_object(), HTML::incumbent_realm(), WebIDL::OperationReturnsPromise::No);
    event_target->set_event_handler_attribute(Utf16FlyString::from_utf8_without_validation(name), callback);
}

// https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#add-an-event-listener, for a listener whose callback is the function, with no options.
void web_bindings_add_event_listener(void* realm, DOM::EventTarget* target, ReadonlyBytes type, JSObject* callback)
{
    auto& js_realm = *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm);
    auto callback_type = GC::Heap::the().allocate<WebIDL::CallbackType>(*JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(callback), js_realm);
    target->add_event_listener_without_options(Utf16FlyString::from_utf8_without_validation(type), DOM::IDLEventListener::create(callback_type));
}

void web_bindings_add_event_listener_without_options(DOM::EventTarget* target, ReadonlyBytes type, WebIDL::CallbackType* callback)
{
    target->add_event_listener_without_options(Utf16FlyString::from_utf8_without_validation(type), DOM::IDLEventListener::create(*callback));
}

void web_bindings_remove_event_listener_without_options(DOM::EventTarget* target, ReadonlyBytes type, WebIDL::CallbackType* callback)
{
    target->remove_event_listener_without_options(Utf16FlyString::from_utf8_without_validation(type), DOM::IDLEventListener::create(*callback));
}

DOM::Event* web_bindings_create_event(void* realm, ReadonlyBytes type, bool bubbles, bool cancelable, bool composed)
{
    auto& js_realm = *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm);
    DOM::EventInit event_init { .bubbles = bubbles, .cancelable = cancelable, .composed = composed };
    return DOM::Event::create(Utf16FlyString::from_utf8_without_validation(type), event_init, HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(js_realm.global_object())).ptr();
}

RustEvent* web_bindings_create_rust_event(void* realm, FlatPtr type, bool bubbles, bool cancelable, bool composed)
{
    auto& js_realm = *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm);
    DOM::EventInit event_init { .bubbles = bubbles, .cancelable = cancelable, .composed = composed };
    auto type_string = Utf16String::from_raw(type);
    return RustEvent::create(Utf16FlyString::from_utf16(type_string.utf16_view()), event_init, HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(js_realm.global_object())).ptr();
}

#pragma once

#include <LibWeb/Bindings/RustInterface.h>

#include <LibWeb/DOM/EventTarget.h>

namespace Web::Bindings {

// The EventTarget that an object of an interface implemented in Rust owns, whose wrappers are the object's
// (Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/bindings/event_target.rs).
class RustEventTarget final : public DOM::EventTarget {
    WEB_NON_IDL_WRAPPABLE(RustEventTarget, DOM::EventTarget);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(RustEventTarget);

public:
    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#get-the-parent
    using GetTheParent = RustEventTarget* (*)(RustInterfaceCell * owner);
    using EventListenerListChanged = void (*)(RustInterfaceCell* owner);

    static GC::Ref<RustEventTarget> create();

    void set_owner(InterfaceName, RustInterfaceCell&, GetTheParent);
    void set_event_listener_list_changed_steps(EventListenerListChanged steps) { m_event_listener_list_changed = steps; }

private:
    RustEventTarget() = default;

    virtual EventTarget* get_parent(DOM::Event const&) override;
    virtual void event_listener_list_changed() override;
    virtual bool is_owned_by_rust_interface_object() const override { return true; }
    virtual GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> create_wrapper(JS::Realm&) override;
    virtual void visit_edges(Visitor&) override;

    InterfaceName m_owner_interface_name { InterfaceName::Unknown };
    GC::Ptr<RustInterfaceCell> m_owner;
    GetTheParent m_get_the_parent { nullptr };
    EventListenerListChanged m_event_listener_list_changed { nullptr };
};

// The Event that an object of an interface implemented in Rust owns, whose wrappers are the object's.
class RustEvent final : public DOM::Event {
    WEB_NON_IDL_WRAPPABLE(RustEvent, DOM::Event);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(RustEvent);

public:
    static GC::Ref<RustEvent> create(Utf16FlyString const& type, DOM::EventInit const&, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);

    void set_owner(InterfaceName, RustInterfaceCell&);

    // For the init*Event() operations of its owner.
    using DOM::Event::initialize_event;

private:
    RustEvent(Utf16FlyString const& type, DOM::EventInit const&, HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp);

    virtual bool is_owned_by_rust_interface_object() const override { return true; }
    virtual GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> create_wrapper(JS::Realm&) override;
    virtual void visit_edges(Visitor&) override;

    InterfaceName m_owner_interface_name { InterfaceName::Unknown };
    GC::Ptr<RustInterfaceCell> m_owner;

    friend RustInterfaceCell* rust_event_owner(DOM::Event const&, InterfaceName);
};

// The object that owns the event, if the event is owned by an object of the interface.
RustInterfaceCell* rust_event_owner(DOM::Event const&, InterfaceName);

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Concepts.h>
#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <LibGC/Cell.h>
#include <LibGC/Ptr.h>
#include <LibJS/HostObjectABI.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/HostObject.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/IntrinsicDefinitions.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>

namespace Web::Bindings {

// The cell of an object of an interface that is implemented in Rust, which the wrappers of the object hold as their
// host data. The Rust bindings in Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust create these cells and know what they hold.
//
// C++ code that holds or receives objects of such an interface names them through a class that derives from this
// one and uses WEB_RUST_INTERFACE. The class has the name and the header that the implementation class of an
// interface implemented in C++ would have, so the C++ bindings of the interfaces that name the interface convert
// its objects as they convert any other: with impl_from() and wrap(), which are overloaded for these classes below.
class RustInterfaceCell : public GC::ForeignCell {
};

// The class that the wrapper class of every interface implemented in Rust derives from.
extern "C" JSHostClass const web_bindings_rust_interface_wrapper_host_class;

// Says which interface a class that derives from RustInterfaceCell names the objects of. The generated header
// LibWeb/Bindings/<class_>.h, which the header of the class includes, declares the class of the wrappers.
#define WEB_RUST_INTERFACE(class_, snake_name)                                       \
public:                                                                              \
    static constexpr auto s_interface_name = ::Web::Bindings::InterfaceName::class_; \
    static JSHostClass const& wrapper_host_class()                                   \
    {                                                                                \
        return ::Web::Bindings::web_bindings_##snake_name##_wrapper_host_class;      \
    }                                                                                \
                                                                                     \
private:

template<typename T>
concept RustInterfaceHandle = IsBaseOf<RustInterfaceCell, T> && GC::IsForeignCellHandle<T> && requires {
    { T::s_interface_name } -> ConvertibleTo<InterfaceName>;
    { T::wrapper_host_class() } -> SameAs<JSHostClass const&>;
};

WEB_API GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> wrap_rust_interface_object(WrapperWorld&, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, InterfaceName, RustInterfaceCell&);

// Whether the object is a wrapper of an object of an interface implemented in Rust that is or inherits from the
// interface with the name, as Wrappable::implements_interface() says for the objects of the interfaces implemented in
// C++.
WEB_API bool rust_interface_object_implements_interface(JS::Object const&, StringView interface_name);

template<RustInterfaceHandle T>
[[nodiscard]] GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> wrap(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ref<T> object)
{
    return wrap_rust_interface_object(wrapper_world, preferred_realm, T::s_interface_name, *object);
}

template<RustInterfaceHandle T>
[[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> wrap(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ptr<T> object)
{
    if (!object)
        return nullptr;
    return wrap_rust_interface_object(wrapper_world, preferred_realm, T::s_interface_name, *object);
}

// The object that a wrapper of the interface wraps. The cell of an object of an interface implemented in Rust that
// others inherit from can be that of an object of any of them, which the C ABI of the interface accepts.
template<RustInterfaceHandle Impl, typename Object>
[[nodiscard]] CopyConst<Object, Impl>* impl_from(Object* object)
{
    if (!object || !JS::is_host_instance_of(*object, Impl::wrapper_host_class()))
        return nullptr;
    return GC::static_cell_cast<Impl>(JS::host_data_of(*object).ptr());
}

}

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <LibGC/Root.h>
#include <LibGC/WeakInlines.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/Realm.h>

#include <LibWeb/Bindings/WrapperWorld.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Element.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Node.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/CustomElements/CustomElementAlgorithms.h>

#include <LibWeb/HTML/WindowProxy.h>

namespace Web::Bindings {

Wrappable::Wrappable() = default;

struct PreservedWrapper {
    GC::Weak<WrapperWorld> world;
    GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> wrapper;
};

static HashMap<GCAllocatedWrappable*, Vector<PreservedWrapper>>& non_main_world_preserved_wrappers()
{
    static thread_local NeverDestroyed<HashMap<GCAllocatedWrappable*, Vector<PreservedWrapper>>> preserved_wrappers;
    return *preserved_wrappers;
}

void GCAllocatedWrappable::finalize()
{
    Base::finalize();
    if (has_non_main_world_preserved_wrappers())
        non_main_world_preserved_wrappers().remove(this);
}

Optional<URL::Origin> Wrappable::extract_an_origin() const
{
    return {};
}

Vector<Utf16FlyString> Wrappable::supported_property_names() const
{
    return {};
}

bool Wrappable::is_supported_property_name(Utf16FlyString const& name) const
{
    return supported_property_names().contains_slow(name);
}

GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> Wrappable::create_wrapper(JS::Realm& wrapper_realm)
{
    return create_wrapper_for_wrappable(wrapper_realm, GC::Ref { *this });
}

void Wrappable::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
}

void GCAllocatedWrappable::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    if (main_world_wrapper_is_preserved()) {
        VERIFY(m_main_world_wrapper);
        visitor.visit(*m_main_world_wrapper);
    }
    if (has_non_main_world_preserved_wrappers()) {
        auto it = non_main_world_preserved_wrappers().find(this);
        VERIFY(it != non_main_world_preserved_wrappers().end());
        for (auto const& entry : it->value) {
            VERIFY(entry.wrapper);
            visitor.visit(*entry.wrapper);
        }
    }
}

GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> Wrappable::cached_main_world_wrapper(WrapperWorld const& world) const
{
    // NB: set_cached_main_world_wrapper() verified that the wrapper belongs to the main world when it cached it, so a
    //     read only walks to the wrapper's realm again in debug builds.
    VERIFY(world.is_main_world());
    ASSERT(!m_main_world_wrapper || &host_defined_wrapper_world(m_main_world_wrapper->shape().realm()) == &world);
    return m_main_world_wrapper.ptr();
}

GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> Wrappable::cached_main_world_wrapper() const
{
    return m_main_world_wrapper.ptr();
}

void Wrappable::set_cached_main_world_wrapper(JS::HostObject& wrapper)
{
    VERIFY(wrapper.shape().realm().host_defined());
    auto& wrapper_world = host_defined_wrapper_world(wrapper.shape().realm());
    VERIFY(wrapper_world.is_main_world());
    if (m_main_world_wrapper) {
        VERIFY(&host_defined_wrapper_world(m_main_world_wrapper->shape().realm()) == &wrapper_world);
        VERIFY(m_main_world_wrapper.ptr().ptr() == &wrapper);
        return;
    }

    m_main_world_wrapper = wrapper;
}

void Wrappable::clear_cached_main_world_wrapper(JS::HostObject const& wrapper)
{
    if (!m_main_world_wrapper || m_main_world_wrapper.ptr().ptr() == &wrapper)
        m_main_world_wrapper = nullptr;
}

// Until cache_global_object_wrapper() runs for its realm, a new realm is reachable only through the realm execution
// context that creating it returned, which the GC does not see once it is off the execution context stack. Its global
// object wrapper keeps it alive through the wrapper's shape, so the wrapper stays rooted until then. The realm's agent
// holds the root, so that a realm whose setup never finishes does not leave a root behind that outlives its VM's heap.
static Vector<GC::Root<JS::HostObject>>& global_object_wrappers_of_realms_being_set_up(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    return static_cast<HTML::Agent&>(*realm.vm().agent()).global_object_wrappers_of_realms_being_set_up;
}

GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> create_global_object_wrapper(JS::Realm& wrapper_realm, GC::Ref<Wrappable> wrappable)
{
    // This helper is for JS::Realm::initialize_host_defined_realm() global
    // object callbacks. At that point HostDefined is not installed yet, so the
    // wrapper is created first and cache_global_object_wrapper() must be called
    // after the caller installs HostDefined/intrinsics for the new realm.
    VERIFY(!wrapper_realm.host_defined());
    auto wrapper = wrappable->create_wrapper(wrapper_realm);
    global_object_wrappers_of_realms_being_set_up(wrapper_realm).append(GC::make_root(wrapper));
    return wrapper;
}

JS::Realm& wrapper_realm_for_node(WrapperWorld const& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, DOM::Node& node)
{
    auto& relevant_realm = HTML::relevant_realm(node);
    if (relevant_realm.host_defined()) {
        auto& relevant_world = host_defined_wrapper_world(relevant_realm);
        VERIFY(!relevant_world.is_main_world() || &relevant_world == &wrapper_world);
        if (&relevant_world == &wrapper_world)
            return relevant_realm;
    }
    return preferred_realm;
}

JS::Realm& wrapper_realm_for_wrappable(WrapperWorld const& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ref<Wrappable> wrappable)
{
    if (!wrapper_world.is_main_world())
        return preferred_realm;

    if (auto* node = as_if<DOM::Node>(wrappable.ptr()))
        return wrapper_realm_for_node(wrapper_world, preferred_realm, *node);

    if (auto relevant_global_impl = wrappable->relevant_global_impl()) {
        if (auto relevant_global_wrapper = relevant_global_impl->cached_main_world_wrapper(); relevant_global_wrapper && relevant_global_wrapper->shape().realm().host_defined()) {
            auto& relevant_global_world = host_defined_wrapper_world(relevant_global_wrapper->shape().realm());
            if (&relevant_global_world == &wrapper_world)
                return relevant_global_wrapper->shape().realm();
        }
    }

    return preferred_realm;
}

GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> wrap(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ref<Wrappable> wrappable)
{
    if (wrapper_world.is_main_world()) {
        if (auto cached_wrapper = wrappable->cached_main_world_wrapper(wrapper_world))
            return *cached_wrapper;
    }

    auto& actual_wrapper_realm = wrapper_realm_for_wrappable(wrapper_world, preferred_realm, wrappable);
    if (!wrapper_world.is_main_world()) {
        if (auto cached_wrapper = wrapper_world.wrapper_for(wrappable, actual_wrapper_realm))
            return *cached_wrapper;
    }

    auto wrapper = wrappable->create_wrapper(actual_wrapper_realm);
    if (auto* element = as_if<DOM::Element>(wrappable.ptr()))
        set_prototype_from_custom_element_definition_if_needed(*element, wrapper);
    wrapper_world.set_wrapper(wrappable, wrapper);
    return wrapper;
}

GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> wrap(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ptr<Wrappable> wrappable)
{
    if (!wrappable)
        return nullptr;
    return wrap(wrapper_world, preferred_realm, GC::Ref { *wrappable });
}

JS::ThrowCompletionOr<void> set_prototype_of_cached_main_world_wrapper(Wrappable& wrappable, JS::Object& prototype)
{
    if (auto wrapper = wrappable.m_main_world_wrapper.ptr()) {
        // Custom-element construction in an isolated world must not install
        // an isolated-world prototype on any main-world wrapper. The agent
        // ownership invariant guarantees that two main-world cells cannot
        // legitimately meet here.
        if (!wrapper->shape().realm().host_defined() || !prototype.shape().realm().host_defined())
            return {};
        auto& wrapper_world = host_defined_wrapper_world(wrapper->shape().realm());
        auto& prototype_world = host_defined_wrapper_world(prototype.shape().realm());
        if (!wrapper_world.is_main_world() || !prototype_world.is_main_world())
            return {};
        TRY(wrapper->internal_set_prototype_of(&prototype));
    }
    return {};
}

void preserve_wrapper(Wrappable& wrappable, JS::HostObject& wrapper)
{
    // An object of an interface implemented in Rust keeps its wrappers alive itself, as wrapper_is_preserved() says.
    if (wrappable.is_owned_by_rust_interface_object())
        return;

    auto& gc_allocated_wrappable = as<GCAllocatedWrappable>(wrappable);
    auto& world = host_defined_wrapper_world(wrapper.shape().realm());

    // Script can still run against a detached world's realm (e.g. a pending microtask after
    // WrapperWorld::detach()). Nothing in a detached world needs to survive GC, so preservation
    // is a no-op rather than a crash.
    if (world.is_detached())
        return;

    if (world.is_main_world()) {
        VERIFY(wrappable.m_main_world_wrapper.ptr().ptr() == &wrapper);
        gc_allocated_wrappable.set_main_world_wrapper_is_preserved(true);
        return;
    }

    auto& preserved_wrappers = non_main_world_preserved_wrappers().ensure(&gc_allocated_wrappable);
    for (auto const& entry : preserved_wrappers) {
        if (entry.wrapper.ptr() == &wrapper && entry.world.ptr().ptr() == &world)
            return;
    }

    preserved_wrappers.append({ world, &wrapper });
    gc_allocated_wrappable.set_has_non_main_world_preserved_wrappers(true);
    world.register_preserved_wrappable(gc_allocated_wrappable);
}

bool wrapper_is_preserved(JS::HostObject const& wrapper)
{
    // An object of an interface implemented in Rust keeps its wrapper in the main world alive itself. No other
    // world keeps a wrapper of it alive.
    if (JS::is_host_instance_of(wrapper, web_bindings_rust_interface_wrapper_host_class))
        return host_defined_wrapper_world(wrapper.shape().realm()).is_main_world();

    auto const* wrappable = wrappable_impl_from(&wrapper);
    if (!wrappable)
        return false;

    // NB: The wrappers of a Rust object that inherits from a C++ interface hold the C++ object it owns as their
    //     wrappable.
    if (wrappable->is_owned_by_rust_interface_object())
        return host_defined_wrapper_world(wrapper.shape().realm()).is_main_world();
    auto const& gc_allocated_wrappable = as<GCAllocatedWrappable>(*wrappable);

    auto& world = host_defined_wrapper_world(wrapper.shape().realm());
    if (world.is_main_world())
        return gc_allocated_wrappable.main_world_wrapper_is_preserved() && wrappable->m_main_world_wrapper.ptr().ptr() == &wrapper;

    if (gc_allocated_wrappable.has_non_main_world_preserved_wrappers()) {
        auto it = non_main_world_preserved_wrappers().find(const_cast<GCAllocatedWrappable*>(&gc_allocated_wrappable));
        VERIFY(it != non_main_world_preserved_wrappers().end());
        for (auto const& entry : it->value) {
            if (entry.wrapper.ptr() == &wrapper && entry.world.ptr().ptr() == &world)
                return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

void GCAllocatedWrappable::clear_preserved_wrappers(WrapperWorld const& world)
{
    VERIFY(!world.is_main_world());
    if (!has_non_main_world_preserved_wrappers())
        return;

    auto& preserved_wrappers_by_wrappable = non_main_world_preserved_wrappers();
    auto it = preserved_wrappers_by_wrappable.find(this);
    VERIFY(it != preserved_wrappers_by_wrappable.end());
    it->value.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.world.ptr().ptr() == &world; });
    if (it->value.is_empty()) {
        preserved_wrappers_by_wrappable.remove(it);
        set_has_non_main_world_preserved_wrappers(false);
    }
}

void cache_global_object_wrapper(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    auto* platform_object = as_platform_object(realm.global_object());
    VERIFY(platform_object);

    auto* wrappable = wrappable_impl_from(platform_object);
    VERIFY(wrappable);

    host_defined_wrapper_world(realm).set_wrapper(*wrappable, *platform_object);

    global_object_wrappers_of_realms_being_set_up(realm).remove_all_matching([&](auto const& wrapper) {
        return wrapper.ptr() == platform_object;
    });
}

// NB: A WindowProxy is a platform object without a wrappable.
Wrappable* wrappable_impl_from(JS::Object* object)
{
    auto* platform_object = object ? as_platform_object(*object) : nullptr;
    if (!platform_object)
        return nullptr;
    return static_cast<Wrappable*>(platform_object->wrappable().ptr());
}

Wrappable const* wrappable_impl_from(JS::Object const* object)
{
    auto const* platform_object = object ? as_platform_object(*object) : nullptr;
    if (!platform_object)
        return nullptr;
    return static_cast<Wrappable const*>(platform_object->wrappable().ptr());
}

}

template<typename Implementation, typename Call>
decltype(auto) invoke_first_available(Implementation& implementation, Call&& call)
{
    return call(implementation);
}

template<typename Implementation, typename FirstCall, typename SecondCall, typename... RemainingCalls>
decltype(auto) invoke_first_available(Implementation& implementation, FirstCall&& first_call, SecondCall&& second_call, RemainingCalls&&... remaining_calls)
{
    if constexpr (requires { first_call(implementation); })
        return first_call(implementation);
    else
        return invoke_first_available(implementation, second_call, remaining_calls...);
}

template<typename Implementation, typename Call>
decltype(auto) invoke_first_available_static(Call&& call)
{
    return call.template operator()<Implementation>();
}

template<typename Implementation, typename FirstCall, typename SecondCall, typename... RemainingCalls>
decltype(auto) invoke_first_available_static(FirstCall&& first_call, SecondCall&& second_call, RemainingCalls&&... remaining_calls)
{
    if constexpr (requires { first_call.template operator()<Implementation>(); })
        return first_call.template operator()<Implementation>();
    else
        return invoke_first_available_static<Implementation>(second_call, remaining_calls...);
}

// The realm passed to these helpers is the preferred realm for wrapper allocation.
// Wrapper identity is keyed by the caller's WrapperWorld.

WEB_API GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> wrap(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ref<Wrappable>);

#ifndef WEB_WRAPPABLE
#    define WEB_WRAPPABLE(class_, base_class)                                               \
        GC_CELL(class_, base_class)                                                         \
    public:                                                                                 \
        using Base::initialize;                                                             \
        static constexpr auto s_interface_name = Bindings::InterfaceName::class_;           \
        virtual Bindings::InterfaceName interface_name() const override                     \
        {                                                                                   \
            return s_interface_name;                                                        \
        }                                                                                   \
        virtual bool implements_interface(Bindings::InterfaceName interface) const override \
        {                                                                                   \
            if (interface == s_interface_name)                                              \
                return true;                                                                \
            return Base::implements_interface(interface);                                   \
        }                                                                                   \
        virtual bool implements_interface(                                                  \
            String const& interface) const override                                         \
        {                                                                                   \
            if (interface == #class_)                                                       \
                return true;                                                                \
            return Base::implements_interface(interface);                                   \
        }                                                                                   \
                                                                                            \
    public:
#endif

#ifndef WEB_NON_IDL_WRAPPABLE
#    define WEB_NON_IDL_WRAPPABLE(class_, base_class) \
        GC_CELL(class_, base_class)                   \
    public:                                           \
        using Base::initialize;
#endif

// Base class for internal implementation objects that can be reflected into JS
// by a wrapper, a host object that holds the implementation object in its wrappable slot.
class WEB_API Wrappable : public JS::Cell {
    GC_CELL(Wrappable, JS::Cell);

public:
    using JSValueConversionIsForbidden = void;

    virtual ~Wrappable() override = default;

    [[nodiscard]] virtual Bindings::InterfaceName interface_name() const { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); }
    [[nodiscard]] virtual bool implements_interface(Bindings::InterfaceName) const { return false; }
    [[nodiscard]] virtual bool implements_interface(String const&) const { return false; }

    // Whether an object of an interface implemented in Rust owns this object, so that its wrappers are the Rust
    // object's (Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/Rust/src/bindings/event_target.rs).
    [[nodiscard]] virtual bool is_owned_by_rust_interface_object() const { return false; }

    template<typename T>
    requires(IsBaseOf<Wrappable, T> && requires { T::s_interface_name; })
    bool fast_is() const
    {
        return implements_interface(T::s_interface_name);
    }

    template<typename T>
    requires(IsBaseOf<Wrappable, T> && requires { T::s_interface_name; })
    T* fast_as()
    {
        if (!fast_is<T>())
            return nullptr;
        return static_cast<T*>(this);
    }

    template<typename T>
    requires(IsBaseOf<Wrappable, T> && requires { T::s_interface_name; })
    T const* fast_as() const
    {
        if (!fast_is<T>())
            return nullptr;
        return static_cast<T const*>(this);
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#extract-an-origin
    // A wrapper's extract an origin operation is its implementation object's.
    virtual Optional<URL::Origin> extract_an_origin() const;

    // Wrappers forward legacy platform object enumeration hooks here.
    virtual Vector<Utf16FlyString> supported_property_names() const;
    virtual bool is_supported_property_name(Utf16FlyString const& name) const;

    [[nodiscard]] virtual GC::Ptr<Wrappable> relevant_global_impl() const { return nullptr; }

    static constexpr size_t main_world_wrapper_offset() { return offsetof(Wrappable, m_main_world_wrapper); }

protected:
    Wrappable();

    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> cached_main_world_wrapper() const;
    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> cached_main_world_wrapper(WrapperWorld const&) const;

    virtual GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> create_wrapper(JS::Realm& wrapper_realm);
    virtual void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor&) override;

private:
    friend class GCAllocatedWrappable;
    friend class WrapperWorld;
    friend WEB_API GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> create_global_object_wrapper(JS::Realm& wrapper_realm, GC::Ref<Wrappable>);
    friend WEB_API JS::Realm& wrapper_realm_for_wrappable(WrapperWorld const&, JS::Realm&, GC::Ref<Wrappable>);
    friend WEB_API GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> wrap(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ref<Wrappable>);
    friend WEB_API JS::ThrowCompletionOr<void> set_prototype_of_cached_main_world_wrapper(Wrappable&, JS::Object&);
    friend WEB_API void preserve_wrapper(Wrappable&, JS::HostObject&);
    friend WEB_API bool wrapper_is_preserved(JS::HostObject const&);

    void set_cached_main_world_wrapper(JS::HostObject&);
    void clear_cached_main_world_wrapper(JS::HostObject const&);

    // Main-world preservation intentionally survives document navigation: an
    // adopted node may still be observed through its original wrapper realm,
    // and clearing this edge would make wrapper state depend on bfcache-like
    // resurrection timing. Non-main-world entries are removed by detach().
    GC::Weak<JS::HostObject> m_main_world_wrapper;
};

static_assert(sizeof(Wrappable) == 24);

// Current LibWeb implementation objects are GC-owned. Keeping that ownership
// and its preservation flags in a separate base lets classes migrate to other
// ownership models individually.
class WEB_API GCAllocatedWrappable : public Wrappable {
    WEB_NON_IDL_WRAPPABLE(GCAllocatedWrappable, Wrappable);

public:
    virtual ~GCAllocatedWrappable() override = default;

protected:
    GCAllocatedWrappable() = default;

    virtual void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor&) override;
    virtual void finalize() override;

private:
    friend class WrapperWorld;
    friend WEB_API void preserve_wrapper(Wrappable&, JS::HostObject&);
    friend WEB_API bool wrapper_is_preserved(JS::HostObject const&);

    enum PreservationFlag : u8 {
        MainWorldWrapperIsPreserved = 1 << 0,
        HasNonMainWorldPreservedWrappers = 1 << 1,
    };

    bool main_world_wrapper_is_preserved() const { return m_preservation_flags & MainWorldWrapperIsPreserved; }
    void set_main_world_wrapper_is_preserved(bool value)
    {
        if (value)
            m_preservation_flags |= MainWorldWrapperIsPreserved;
        else
            m_preservation_flags &= ~MainWorldWrapperIsPreserved;
    }
    bool has_non_main_world_preserved_wrappers() const { return m_preservation_flags & HasNonMainWorldPreservedWrappers; }
    void set_has_non_main_world_preserved_wrappers(bool value)
    {
        if (value)
            m_preservation_flags |= HasNonMainWorldPreservedWrappers;
        else
            m_preservation_flags &= ~HasNonMainWorldPreservedWrappers;
    }
    void clear_preserved_wrappers(WrapperWorld const&);

    u8 m_preservation_flags { 0 };
};

static_assert(sizeof(GCAllocatedWrappable) == 32);
// GCAllocatedWrappable's dsize is 25 bytes, allowing derived classes to reuse
// the remaining tail padding where supported by the ABI.

static_assert(!IsConstructible<JS::Value, Wrappable*>);
static_assert(!IsConstructible<JS::Value, Wrappable const*>);
static_assert(!IsConstructible<JS::Value, GC::Ptr<Wrappable>>);
static_assert(!IsConstructible<JS::Value, GC::Ref<Wrappable>>);
static_assert(!IsConstructible<JS::Value, GC::Root<Wrappable> const&>);

template<typename T>
requires(IsBaseOf<Wrappable, T> && !IsSameIgnoringCV<T, Wrappable>)
[[nodiscard]] GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> create_global_object_wrapper(JS::Realm& wrapper_realm, GC::Ref<T> wrappable)
{
    return create_global_object_wrapper(wrapper_realm, GC::Ref<Wrappable> { wrappable });
}

WEB_API GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> wrap(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ptr<Wrappable>);

template<typename T>
requires(IsBaseOf<Wrappable, T> && !IsSameIgnoringCV<T, Wrappable>)
[[nodiscard]] GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> wrap(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ref<T> wrappable)
{
    return wrap(wrapper_world, preferred_realm, GC::Ref<Wrappable> { wrappable });
}

template<typename T>
requires(IsBaseOf<Wrappable, T> && !IsSameIgnoringCV<T, Wrappable>)
[[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> wrap(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& preferred_realm, GC::Ptr<T> wrappable)
{
    return wrap(wrapper_world, preferred_realm, GC::Ptr<Wrappable> { wrappable });
}

WEB_API void cache_global_object_wrapper(JS::Realm&);
WEB_API Wrappable* wrappable_impl_from(JS::Object*);
WEB_API Wrappable const* wrappable_impl_from(JS::Object const*);

template<typename Impl, typename Object>
requires(IsBaseOf<Wrappable, Impl>)
[[nodiscard]] CopyConst<Object, Impl>* impl_from(Object* object)
{
    if (!object)
        return nullptr;

    if (auto* wrappable = wrappable_impl_from(object))
        return as_if<Impl>(wrappable);

    return nullptr;
}

template<typename Impl, typename Object>
[[nodiscard]] CopyConst<Object, Impl>& impl_from(Object& object)
{
    auto* impl = impl_from<Impl>(&object);
    VERIFY(impl);
    return *impl;
}

#include <LibGC/Heap.h>
#include <LibGC/WeakInlines.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/Realm.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/HostDefined.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/PlatformObject.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/Wrappable.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/WrapperWorld.h>

namespace Web::Bindings {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(WrapperWorld);

static void verify_cache_entry(WrapperWorld const& world, Wrappable const& wrappable, JS::HostObject const& wrapper)
{
    VERIFY(wrapper.shape().realm().host_defined());
    VERIFY(&host_defined_wrapper_world(wrapper.shape().realm()) == &world);
    VERIFY(wrappable_impl_from(&wrapper) == &wrappable);
}

WrapperWorld::WrapperWorld(Type type)
    : m_type(type)
{
}

WrapperWorld::~WrapperWorld() = default;

void WrapperWorld::finalize()
{
    Base::finalize();
    VERIFY(is_main_world() || is_detached() || m_preserved_wrappables.is_empty() || heap().is_collecting_everything());
}

void WrapperWorld::detach()
{
    VERIFY(!is_main_world());
    if (m_detached)
        return;
    m_detached = true;
    for (auto& wrappable : m_preserved_wrappables)
        wrappable.clear_preserved_wrappers(*this);
    m_preserved_wrappables.clear();
    m_wrappers.clear();
    m_rust_wrappers.clear();
}

void WrapperWorld::register_preserved_wrappable(GCAllocatedWrappable& wrappable)
{
    VERIFY(!is_main_world());
    VERIFY(!is_detached());
    m_preserved_wrappables.set(wrappable);
}

GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> WrapperWorld::wrapper_for(Wrappable const& wrappable, JS::Realm& realm) const
{
    if (is_main_world()) {
        if (auto wrapper = wrappable.cached_main_world_wrapper(*this))
            return wrapper;
        return nullptr;
    }

    if (auto* wrapper = m_wrappers.get(wrappable)) {
        VERIFY(&wrapper->shape().realm() == &realm);
        return const_cast<JS::HostObject*>(wrapper);
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void WrapperWorld::set_wrapper(Wrappable& wrappable, JS::HostObject& wrapper)
{
    VERIFY(!is_detached());
    verify_cache_entry(*this, wrappable, wrapper);

    if (is_main_world()) {
        wrappable.set_cached_main_world_wrapper(wrapper);
        return;
    }

    if (auto* existing = m_wrappers.get(wrappable)) {
        VERIFY(existing == &wrapper);
        VERIFY(&existing->shape().realm() == &wrapper.shape().realm());
        return;
    }
    m_wrappers.set(wrappable, wrapper);
}

void WrapperWorld::clear_wrapper(Wrappable& wrappable, JS::HostObject const& wrapper)
{
    verify_cache_entry(*this, wrappable, wrapper);

    if (is_main_world()) {
        wrappable.clear_cached_main_world_wrapper(wrapper);
        return;
    }

    if (auto* existing = m_wrappers.get(wrappable)) {
        VERIFY(existing == &wrapper);
        m_wrappers.remove(wrappable);
    }
}

GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> WrapperWorld::rust_wrapper_for(RustInterfaceCell const& cell, JS::Realm& realm) const
{
    VERIFY(!is_main_world());
    auto* wrapper = m_rust_wrappers.get(cell);
    if (!wrapper)
        return nullptr;
    VERIFY(&wrapper->shape().realm() == &realm);
    return const_cast<JS::HostObject*>(wrapper);
}

void WrapperWorld::set_rust_wrapper(RustInterfaceCell& cell, JS::HostObject& wrapper)
{
    VERIFY(!is_main_world());
    VERIFY(!is_detached());
    VERIFY(wrapper.shape().realm().host_defined());
    VERIFY(&host_defined_wrapper_world(wrapper.shape().realm()) == this);
    VERIFY(JS::host_data_of(wrapper).ptr() == GC::as_cell(&cell));
    // NB: The entry of a wrapper that was collected stays in the map until the map prunes it. get() does not return
    //     the wrapper of such an entry, and set() replaces it.
    VERIFY(!m_rust_wrappers.get(cell));
    m_rust_wrappers.set(cell, wrapper);
}

WrapperWorld& host_defined_wrapper_world(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    return *host_defined_of(realm).wrapper_world;
}

WrapperWorld const& host_defined_wrapper_world(JS::Realm const& realm)
{
    return *host_defined_of(realm).wrapper_world;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/OwnPtr.h>
#include <LibGC/Cell.h>
#include <LibGC/CellAllocator.h>
#include <LibGC/Ptr.h>
#include <LibGC/Root.h>
#include <LibGC/WeakHashMap.h>
#include <LibGC/WeakHashSet.h>
#include <LibGC/WeakInlines.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/PlatformObject.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/RustInterface.h>
#include <LibWeb/Bindings/Wrappable.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>

namespace Web::Bindings {

class WEB_API WrapperWorld final : public GC::Cell {
    GC_CELL(WrapperWorld, GC::Cell);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(WrapperWorld);

public:
    using Type = WrapperWorldType;

    explicit WrapperWorld(Type);
    // WrapperWorld destruction intentionally does not detach the world. Non-main
    // worlds that may hold preserved wrappers must be explicitly detached before
    // the embedder drops the world; the destructor verifies this except during
    // CollectEverything collection, where it is not safe to walk weak
    // wrappable references and mutate their preserved-wrapper lists.
    virtual ~WrapperWorld() override;

    [[nodiscard]] Type type() const { return m_type; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_main_world() const { return m_type == Type::Main; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_detached() const { return m_detached; }
    // Clear all preservation edges and cache entries owned by this non-main
    // world. Main worlds are agent-lifetime objects and must not detach.
    void detach();

    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> wrapper_for(Wrappable const&, JS::Realm&) const;
    void set_wrapper(Wrappable&, JS::HostObject&);
    void clear_wrapper(Wrappable&, JS::HostObject const&);
    void register_preserved_wrappable(GCAllocatedWrappable&);

    // The wrappers of the objects of the interfaces implemented in Rust. An object keeps its wrapper in the main
    // world itself, so only non-main worlds hold them here.
    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<JS::HostObject> rust_wrapper_for(RustInterfaceCell const&, JS::Realm&) const;
    void set_rust_wrapper(RustInterfaceCell&, JS::HostObject&);

private:
    virtual void finalize() override;

    Type m_type { Type::Main };
    bool m_detached { false };
    // Main-world cache cells are agent-local and may span same-agent realms.
    // Non-main cache cells are realm-local; a logical isolated world that spans
    // multiple realms must allocate one WrapperWorld cell per realm. Both sides
    // are weak; the cache cannot keep either implementation or wrapper alive.
    GC::WeakHashMap<Wrappable, JS::HostObject> m_wrappers;
    GC::WeakHashMap<RustInterfaceCell, JS::HostObject> m_rust_wrappers;
    GC::WeakHashSet<GCAllocatedWrappable> m_preserved_wrappables;
};

WEB_API WrapperWorld& host_defined_wrapper_world(JS::Realm&);
WEB_API WrapperWorld const& host_defined_wrapper_world(JS::Realm const&);

template<typename T>
class WrapperWorldWeakValueCache {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<T> get(WrapperWorld const& wrapper_world)
    {
        return m_values.get(wrapper_world);
    }

    void set(WrapperWorld const& wrapper_world, GC::Ptr<T> value)
    {
        if (value)
            m_values.set(wrapper_world, *value);
        else
            m_values.remove(wrapper_world);
    }

    template<typename Callback>
    void for_each(Callback callback)
    {
        m_values.for_each_live_value([&](T& live_value) {
            auto value = GC::make_root(live_value);
            callback(*value);
        });
    }

    void clear()
    {
        m_values.clear();
    }

private:
    GC::WeakHashMap<WrapperWorld, T> m_values;
};

template<typename Key, typename Value>
class WrapperWorldWeakValueCacheMap {
public:
    // Returned cache references stay valid across rehashes (the caches live behind
    // an OwnPtr), but callers must not hold one across later calls into this map:
    // cache_for() and for_each() prune dead keys and may remove the referenced entry.
    [[nodiscard]] WrapperWorldWeakValueCache<Value>& cache_for(Key& key)
    {
        return *m_entries.ensure(key, [] { return make<WrapperWorldWeakValueCache<Value>>(); });
    }

    template<typename Callback>
    void for_each(Callback callback)
    {
        // The callback must not reenter this map through cache_for() or
        // for_each(); pruning or insertion would invalidate this iteration.
        m_entries.for_each_live_value([&](auto& cache) { callback(*cache); });
    }

    void clear() { m_entries.clear(); }

private:
    // The per-key cache is held behind an OwnPtr so this map can be embedded as a
    // member with only a forward declaration of Value (e.g. WindowProxy in
    // BrowsingContext). Value only needs to be complete where cache_for() is
    // instantiated and where this map is destroyed.
    GC::WeakHashMap<Key, NonnullOwnPtr<WrapperWorldWeakValueCache<Value>>> m_entries;
};

}

#include <LibJS/HostClassBuilder.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/Realm.h>
#include <LibWeb/Clipboard/Clipboard.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Window.h>
#include <LibWeb/Page/Page.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/Clipboard/SystemClipboard.h>

namespace Web::Clipboard {

struct SystemClipboardRepresentationABI {
    ReadonlyBytes name;
    ReadonlyBytes data;
};

extern "C" {
// Defined in Bindings/Rust/src/clipboard/exports.rs.
void* web_rust_clipboard_create_clipboard(JSVM*, void* realm);

// Called by Bindings/Rust/src/clipboard/clipboard.rs.
bool web_clipboard_system_clipboard_data_being_pasted(HTML::Window*, void* data, void (*on_item)(void*), void (*on_representation)(void*, ReadonlyBytes, ReadonlyBytes));
void web_clipboard_request_system_clipboard_data(HTML::Window*, GC::Cell* request, void (*steps)(JSVM*, GC::Cell*, Vector<SystemClipboardItem> const*));
void web_clipboard_for_each_system_clipboard_item(Vector<SystemClipboardItem> const*, void* data, void (*on_item)(void*), void (*on_representation)(void*, ReadonlyBytes, ReadonlyBytes));
void web_clipboard_insert_clipboard_item(HTML::Window*, ReadonlySpan<SystemClipboardRepresentationABI>, ReadonlyBytes presentation_style);
}

GC::Ref<Clipboard> Clipboard::create(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    return *static_cast<Clipboard*>(web_rust_clipboard_create_clipboard(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(realm.vm()), &realm));
}

void web_clipboard_for_each_system_clipboard_item(Vector<SystemClipboardItem> const* system_clipboard_data, void* data, void (*on_item)(void*), void (*on_representation)(void*, ReadonlyBytes, ReadonlyBytes))
{
    for (auto const& system_clipboard_item : *system_clipboard_data) {
        on_item(data);
        for (auto const& system_clipboard_representation : system_clipboard_item.system_clipboard_representations) {
            // AD-HOC: We do not expose file-backed clipboard entries to scripts.
            auto const* representation_data = system_clipboard_representation.data.get_pointer<ByteString>();
            if (!representation_data)
                continue;
            on_representation(data, system_clipboard_representation.name.bytes(), representation_data->bytes());
        }
    }
}

bool web_clipboard_system_clipboard_data_being_pasted(HTML::Window* window, void* data, void (*on_item)(void*), void (*on_representation)(void*, ReadonlyBytes, ReadonlyBytes))
{
    auto const* system_clipboard_data = window->system_clipboard_data_being_pasted();
    if (!system_clipboard_data)
        return false;
    web_clipboard_for_each_system_clipboard_item(system_clipboard_data, data, on_item, on_representation);
    return true;
}

void web_clipboard_request_system_clipboard_data(HTML::Window* window, GC::Cell* request, void (*steps)(JSVM*, GC::Cell*, Vector<SystemClipboardItem> const*))
{
    auto& document = window->associated_document();
    document.page().request_clipboard_entries(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref { *request }, steps), [](auto& request, auto& steps, Vector<SystemClipboardItem> data) {
        steps(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), request.ptr(), &data);
    }),
        document.id());
}

void web_clipboard_insert_clipboard_item(HTML::Window* window, ReadonlySpan<SystemClipboardRepresentationABI> representations, ReadonlyBytes presentation_style)
{
    Vector<SystemClipboardRepresentation> system_clipboard_representations;
    system_clipboard_representations.ensure_capacity(representations.size());
    for (auto const& representation : representations)
        system_clipboard_representations.empend(MUST(String::from_utf8(StringView { representation.name })), ByteString { representation.data });

    window->page().client().page_did_insert_clipboard_item({ move(system_clipboard_representations) }, StringView { presentation_style }, window->associated_document().id());
}

}

ladybird_lib(LibWeb web EXPLICIT_SYMBOL_EXPORT)
# LibJS's C++ API is part of this library, over the Rust runtime that the library's crate builds below
# (Libraries/LibJS/CMakeLists.txt). The API's objects export JS_API, and so does the library's own code that includes
# LibJS's headers.
target_sources(LibWeb PRIVATE $<TARGET_OBJECTS:LibJSObjects>)
target_compile_definitions(LibWeb PRIVATE LibJS_EXPORTS)
target_link_libraries(LibWeb PUBLIC LibCompositing LibWebCommon LibJSHeaders)

target_link_libraries(LibWeb PRIVATE LibCore LibCrypto LibHTTP LibGfx LibIPC LibRegex LibSyntax LibTextCodec LibUnicode LibAudio LibMedia LibMediaClient LibXML LibURL LibRequests LibGC LibImageDecoderClient LibThreading LibWebRTCClient)

# The library's Rust code: the bindings crate, which depends on the LibJS runtime and on libweb_rust, so that one archive
# holds all three and the runtime is in the process once. The runtime's features are LibJS's.
import_rust_crate(
    MANIFEST_PATH Bindings/Rust/Cargo.toml
    CRATE_NAME libweb_bindings_rust
    NO_DEFAULT_FEATURES
    FEATURES ${LIBJS_RUST_FEATURES}
    # The copy of libgfx_rust in this crate, which TestRustCrateCopies reaches by name.
    KEEP_SYMBOLS ladybird_gfx_register_rust_crate_copy
    # The bindings of the interfaces implemented in Rust, which generating the bindings writes and the crate includes.
    ENVIRONMENT "LIBWEB_RUST_BINDINGS=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/RustBindings.rs"
)
# The headers that the build script of libweb_rust, which the archive bundles, writes.
sync_rust_crate_ffi_headers(
    CRATE_NAME libweb_rust
    PRODUCED_BY libweb_bindings_rust
    FFI_OUTPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
    FFI_HEADERS
        HTML/Parser/RustFFI.h
        RustFFI.h
        WebAudio/RustFFI.h
        SVG/ParserRustFFI.h
        SelectorRustFFI.h
        StyleValueRustFFI.h
        ValueParserRustFFI.h
        ComputedValuesRustFFI.h
        StyleEngineRustFFI.h
        StyleEngineStateFactsGenerated.inc
        SelectorStateFactsGenerated.inc
        Layout/TreeBuilderRustFFI.h
        Layout/LayoutRustFFI.h
        Compositor/RenderClockRustFFI.h
        Animations/RustFFI.h
)
add_dependencies(LibWeb libweb_rust-ffi-headers)
target_link_libraries(libweb_bindings_rust INTERFACE LibGfx LibGC LibUnicode)
test_rust_crate(MANIFEST_PATH Bindings/Rust/Cargo.toml CRATE_NAME libweb_bindings_rust)
test_rust_crate(MANIFEST_PATH Rust/Cargo.toml CRATE_NAME libweb_rust)

set(content_blocker_rust_features "")
if (NOT BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    set(content_blocker_rust_features FEATURES allocator)
endif()
import_rust_crate(MANIFEST_PATH ContentBlocker/Rust/Cargo.toml CRATE_NAME libweb_content_blocker_rust ${content_blocker_rust_features} FFI_HEADER ContentBlockerRustFFI.h)
target_link_libraries(LibWeb PRIVATE libweb_bindings_rust libweb_content_blocker_rust)
get_target_property(_libweb_rust_lib libweb_bindings_rust IMPORTED_LOCATION)
get_target_property(_libweb_content_blocker_rust_lib libweb_content_blocker_rust IMPORTED_LOCATION)
set_property(SOURCE HTML/Parser/HTMLTokenizer.cpp APPEND PROPERTY OBJECT_DEPENDS ${_libweb_rust_lib})
set_property(SOURCE HTML/Parser/HTMLParser.cpp APPEND PROPERTY OBJECT_DEPENDS ${_libweb_rust_lib})
set_property(SOURCE HTML/Parser/SpeculativeHTMLParser.cpp APPEND PROPERTY OBJECT_DEPENDS ${_libweb_rust_lib})
if ((LINUX OR BSD) AND NOT BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    target_link_options(LibWeb INTERFACE LINKER:--allow-multiple-definition)
endif()

if(NOT BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    add_custom_command(TARGET LibWeb POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_AR} -x $<TARGET_FILE:libweb_bindings_rust>
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_AR} -x $<TARGET_FILE:libweb_content_blocker_rust>
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_AR} -qS $<TARGET_FILE:LibWeb> *.o
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_RANLIB} $<TARGET_FILE:LibWeb>
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E remove -f *.o
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/rust_merge_tmp
        COMMENT "Merging Rust archive into LibWeb"
    )
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/rust_merge_tmp)

    # POST_BUILD steps don't track inputs, so when a Rust archive changes
    # ninja leaves liblagom-web.a alone and the merged archive ends up with
    # stale Rust objects. Force the C++ FFI bridge files to depend on the
    # Rust archives: when they change, LibWeb re-archives, and POST_BUILD
    # re-merges the fresh Rust objects.
    set_property(SOURCE CSS/Parser/RustSyntaxParsing.cpp APPEND PROPERTY OBJECT_DEPENDS ${_libweb_rust_lib})

void CompositorConnection::die()
{
    did_lose_compositor();
}

void CompositorConnection::ensure_video_presentation_channel()
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor() || !on_request_video_presentation_channel)
        return;

    // Acquiring the client has the Browser connect this process to a media server, which the Browser then connects to
    // the Compositor on request. A replacement server needs a channel of its own.
    auto media_client_or_error = MediaClient::Client::acquire();
    if (media_client_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Failed to reach the media server for a video presentation channel: {}", media_client_or_error.error());
        return;
    }
    auto media_client = media_client_or_error.release_value();
    if (m_video_presentation_channel_media_client_generation == media_client->generation())
        return;

    on_request_video_presentation_channel();
    m_video_presentation_channel_media_client_generation = media_client->generation();
    dbgln_if(VIDEO_PRESENTATION_CHANNEL_DEBUG, "WebContent: asked the Browser for a video presentation channel to the Compositor");
}

void CompositorConnection::attach_render_clock(IPC::TransportHandle handle)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return;
    if (auto result = RenderClock::the().attach(move(handle)); result.is_error())
        dbgln("Failed to attach the render clock to the compositor: {}", result.error());
}

// An image frame carries the descriptor of its shared bitmap. One IPC message holds at most IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT
// of them, so image frames are registered in messages of at most this many image frames each.
static constexpr size_t max_image_frames_per_message = 100;
static_assert(max_image_frames_per_message <= IPC::MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT);

struct ResourcesRegisteredWithCompositor {
    HashTable<u64> typeface_ids;
    HashMap<u64, Gfx::DecodedImageFrame::SharedIdentity const*> image_frame_identities_by_id;
};

struct ResourcesRegisteredWithCompositors {
    Mutex mutex;
    HashMap<IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster*, ResourcesRegisteredWithCompositor> resources_by_poster;
};

static ResourcesRegisteredWithCompositors& resources_registered_with_compositors()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<ResourcesRegisteredWithCompositors> registry;
    return *registry;
}

static void unregister_destroyed_typeface(u64 typeface_id)
{
    auto& registry = resources_registered_with_compositors();
    MutexLocker locker(registry.mutex);
    for (auto& [poster, resources] : registry.resources_by_poster) {
        if (!resources.typeface_ids.remove(typeface_id))
            continue;
        auto encoded_message = MUST(Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::UnregisterTypeface::static_encode(typeface_id));
        (void)poster->try_post(encoded_message);
    }
}

// A frame decoded again takes the id of the frame it replaces, so an id is unregistered only by the identity that is
// registered under it.
static void unregister_destroyed_image_frame(Gfx::DecodedImageFrame::SharedIdentity const& identity)
{
    auto& registry = resources_registered_with_compositors();
    MutexLocker locker(registry.mutex);
    for (auto& [poster, resources] : registry.resources_by_poster) {
        auto registered_identity = resources.image_frame_identities_by_id.find(identity.id());
        if (registered_identity == resources.image_frame_identities_by_id.end() || registered_identity->value != &identity)
            continue;
        resources.image_frame_identities_by_id.remove(registered_identity);
        auto encoded_message = MUST(Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::UnregisterImageFrame::static_encode(Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { identity.id() }));
        (void)poster->try_post(encoded_message);
    }
}

static void start_registering_resources_with_compositor(IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster& poster)
{
    Gfx::Typeface::set_destruction_observer(unregister_destroyed_typeface);
    Gfx::DecodedImageFrame::set_identity_destruction_observer(unregister_destroyed_image_frame);
    auto& registry = resources_registered_with_compositors();
    MutexLocker locker(registry.mutex);
    registry.resources_by_poster.set(&poster, {});
}

static void stop_registering_resources_with_compositor(IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster& poster)
{
    auto& registry = resources_registered_with_compositors();
    MutexLocker locker(registry.mutex);
    registry.resources_by_poster.remove(&poster);
}

// The registration of a typeface is posted while the registry is locked, so that it reaches the compositor ahead of
// whatever any thread then posts that names the typeface.
static bool register_typefaces_of_fonts_with_compositor(IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster& poster, ReadonlySpan<Gfx::Font const*> fonts)
{
    auto& registry = resources_registered_with_compositors();
    MutexLocker locker(registry.mutex);
    auto resources = registry.resources_by_poster.find(&poster);
    if (resources == registry.resources_by_poster.end())
        return false;
    for (auto const* font : fonts) {
        auto const& typeface = font->typeface();
        if (resources->value.typeface_ids.contains(typeface.id()))
            continue;
        auto encoded_message = MUST(Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::RegisterTypeface::static_encode(Compositing::TypefaceRegistration { typeface.id(), typeface }));
        if (!poster.try_post(encoded_message))
            return false;
        resources->value.typeface_ids.set(typeface.id());
    }
    return true;
}

// The image frames stay registered for as long as the caller holds them, which has to be until it has posted whatever
// names them. Their registrations are posted while the registry is locked, as those of typefaces are.
static bool register_image_frames_with_compositor(IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster& poster, ReadonlySpan<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const*> image_frames)
{
    auto& registry = resources_registered_with_compositors();
    MutexLocker locker(registry.mutex);
    auto resources = registry.resources_by_poster.find(&poster);
    if (resources == registry.resources_by_poster.end())
        return false;
    auto& registered_identities = resources->value.image_frame_identities_by_id;
    Vector<Compositing::DisplayListImageFrameResource> batch;
    auto post_batch = [&] {
        auto encoded_message = MUST(Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::RegisterImageFrames::static_encode(batch));
        batch.clear();
        return poster.try_post(encoded_message);
    };
    for (auto const* image_frame : image_frames) {
        if (registered_identities.get(image_frame->id()).value_or(nullptr) == &image_frame->identity())
            continue;
        registered_identities.set(image_frame->id(), &image_frame->identity());
        batch.append({ Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { image_frame->id() }, *image_frame });
        if (batch.size() == max_image_frames_per_message && !post_batch())
            return false;
    }
    return batch.is_empty() || post_batch();
}

static Vector<Compositing::DisplayListFontDescription> descriptions_of_fonts(ReadonlySpan<Gfx::Font const*> fonts)
{
    Vector<Compositing::DisplayListFontDescription> descriptions;
    descriptions.ensure_capacity(fonts.size());
    for (auto const* font : fonts)
        descriptions.unchecked_append(Compositing::DisplayListFontDescription::of(*font));
    return descriptions;
}

// Shared memory Rust writes a message into, which stays mapped until Rust releases it.
struct SharedBufferForRust {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    Core::AnonymousBuffer buffer;
};

// Registers what `fonts` and `image_frames` need registered, posts the descriptions of `fonts` for the context to
// hold, and answers whether the compositor could still be reached.
static bool post_fonts_and_register_image_frames(IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster& poster, Web::CompositorContextId context_id, ReadonlySpan<Gfx::Font const*> fonts, ReadonlySpan<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const*> image_frames)
{
    if (!register_image_frames_with_compositor(poster, image_frames))
        return false;
    if (fonts.is_empty())
        return true;
    if (!register_typefaces_of_fonts_with_compositor(poster, fonts))
        return false;
    auto encoded_message = MUST(Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::DescribeDisplayListFonts::static_encode(context_id, descriptions_of_fonts(fonts)));
    return poster.try_post(encoded_message);
}

static Atomic<u64> s_next_connection_serial { 1 };

CompositorConnection::CompositorConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
    : IPC::ConnectionToServer<CompositorWebContentClientEndpoint, CompositorWebContentServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
    , m_poster(IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster::create(this->transport()))
    , m_serial(s_next_connection_serial++)
{
    start_registering_resources_with_compositor(*m_poster);
}

CompositorConnection::~CompositorConnection()
{
    stop_registering_resources_with_compositor(*m_poster);
    m_poster->detach_from_transport();
}

// Gives the compositor a connection of its own to this process's image decoder, so that an animated image keeps getting
// frames while the main thread is busy.
void CompositorConnection::ensure_image_decoder_channel()
{
    auto& image_codec = Platform::ImageCodecPlugin::the();
    if (m_image_decoder_channel_client_generation == image_codec.client_generation())
        return;

    auto channel_or_error = IPC::TransportHandle::create_pair();
    if (channel_or_error.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Failed to create an image decoder channel for the Compositor: {}", channel_or_error.error());
        return;
    }
    auto channel = channel_or_error.release_value();
    image_codec.connect_frame_client(move(channel.first));
    async_connect_to_image_decoder(channel.second);
    m_image_decoder_channel_client_generation = image_codec.client_generation();
}

void CompositorConnection::add_animated_image(u64 frame_id, AnimatedImageRegistration const& image)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return;
    ensure_image_decoder_channel();
    // NB: Session ids start over with each decoder, so a session of a replaced decoder could name one of another image.
    auto session_id = image.image_decoder_client_generation == Platform::ImageCodecPlugin::the().client_generation() ? image.session_id : 0;
    async_add_animated_image(frame_id, session_id, image.size, image.color_space, image.frame_durations_in_milliseconds, image.loop_count);
}

void CompositorConnection::remove_animated_image(u64 frame_id)
{
    if (can_send_message_to_compositor())
        async_remove_animated_image(frame_id);
}

        async_start_animated_image(frame_id);
}

void CompositorConnection::stop_animated_image(u64 frame_id)
{
    if (can_send_message_to_compositor())
        async_stop_animated_image(frame_id);
}

AnimatedImageState CompositorConnection::animated_image_state_for_testing(u64 frame_id)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return {};
    auto response = send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::AnimatedImageStateForTesting>(frame_id);
    if (!response) {
        did_lose_compositor();
        return {};
    }
    return { .is_animating = response->is_animating(), .frame_index = response->frame_index(), .shown_frame_index = response->shown_frame_index(), .loops_completed = response->loops_completed() };
}

RefPtr<IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster> CompositorConnection::poster_while_compositor_is_reachable()

    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())

bool CompositorConnection::post_canvas_2d_stream_batch_fonts_and_image_frames(ReadonlySpan<Gfx::Font const*> fonts, ReadonlySpan<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const*> image_frames)
{
    if (!register_typefaces_of_fonts_with_compositor(*m_poster, fonts) || !register_image_frames_with_compositor(*m_poster, image_frames)) {
        did_lose_compositor();
        return false;
    }
    if (fonts.is_empty())
        return true;
    auto encoded_message = MUST(Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::DescribeCanvas2dFonts::static_encode(descriptions_of_fonts(fonts)));
    if (!m_poster->try_post(encoded_message)) {
        did_lose_compositor();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void CompositorConnection::did_fail_to_post_canvas_2d_message()
{
    did_lose_compositor();
}

bool CompositorConnection::register_image_frames(ReadonlySpan<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const*> image_frames)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return false;
    return register_image_frames_with_compositor(*m_poster, image_frames);
}

Optional<Web::Compositor::PlaceholderCanvasLink> CompositorConnection::allocate_placeholder_canvas()
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return {};

    auto response = send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::AllocatePlaceholderCanvas>();
    if (!response) {
        did_lose_compositor();
        return {};
    }
    return Web::Compositor::PlaceholderCanvasLink { response->canvas_id(), response->secret() };
}
