Web::Compositor::PlaceholderCanvasPixels CompositorConnection::get_placeholder_canvas_pixels(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, Gfx::IntRect rect)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return {};

    auto response = send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::GetPlaceholderCanvasPixels>(canvas_id, rect);
    if (!response) {
        did_lose_compositor();
        return {};
    }
    auto pixels = response->take_pixels();
    return { pixels.is_valid() ? pixels.bitmap() : nullptr, response->origin_clean() };
}

bool CompositorConnection::rasterize_image(Layout::RustFFI::FfiImageRasterization const& image, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> target)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return false;

    // The compositor draws straight into the target, so it has to be memory both processes can map.
    VERIFY(target->anonymous_buffer().is_valid());
    auto token = m_next_rasterization_token++;
    return did_rasterize(Layout::RustFFI::render_state_rasterize_image(to_ffi_with_one_reference(), m_poster->to_ffi_with_one_reference(), token, &image, target.ptr()));
}

bool CompositorConnection::rasterize_last_recording(Layout::RustFFI::DocumentHost const& document_host, Layout::BegunRead const& read, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> target)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return false;

    // The compositor draws straight into the target, so it has to be memory both processes can map.
    VERIFY(target->anonymous_buffer().is_valid());
    auto token = m_next_rasterization_token++;
    return did_rasterize(Layout::RustFFI::render_state_rasterize_last_recording(to_ffi_with_one_reference(), m_poster->to_ffi_with_one_reference(), token, &document_host, &read, target.ptr()));
}

bool CompositorConnection::did_rasterize(Layout::RustFFI::RasterizationOutcome outcome)
{
    switch (outcome) {
    case Layout::RustFFI::RasterizationOutcome::Rasterized:
        return true;
    case Layout::RustFFI::RasterizationOutcome::NotRasterized:
        return false;
    case Layout::RustFFI::RasterizationOutcome::CompositorLost:
        did_lose_compositor();
        return false;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

void CompositorConnection::bring_video_sink_up_to_date(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, Optional<MonotonicTime> deadline)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return;
    auto token = m_next_video_sink_up_to_date_token++;
    async_bring_video_sink_up_to_date(video_sink_handle, token);
    while (true) {
        OwnPtr<Messages::CompositorWebContentClient::VideoSinkIsUpToDate> answer;
        if (deadline.has_value())
            answer = wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_until<Messages::CompositorWebContentClient::VideoSinkIsUpToDate>(deadline.value());
        else
            answer = wait_for_specific_endpoint_message<Messages::CompositorWebContentClient::VideoSinkIsUpToDate>();
        if (!answer) {
            if (!is_open())
                did_lose_compositor();
            return;
        }
        if (answer->token() == token)
            return;
    }
}

void CompositorConnection::video_sink_is_up_to_date(u64)
{
    // CompositorConnection::bring_video_sink_up_to_date() waits for its answer, and an answer it gave up on goes nowhere.
}

void CompositorConnection::invalidate_keyboard_scroll_state(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, u64 generation)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return;
    // Input acknowledgments travel over a different connection. Finish invalidating before acknowledging an input
    // that changed focus, so the UI cannot admit the next key against the previous target.
    if (!send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::InvalidateKeyboardScrollState>(context_id, generation))
        did_lose_compositor();
}

void CompositorConnection::invalidate_wheel_event_listener_state(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, u64 generation)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return;
    async_invalidate_wheel_event_listener_state(context_id, generation);
}

Compositing::WheelEventAnswer CompositorConnection::take_wheel_event_from_main_thread(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Web::MouseEvent const& event, Compositing::AsyncScrollOperationTracking operation_tracking, Compositing::WheelEventRouting routing)
{

    if (!response) {
        did_lose_compositor();
        return {};
    }
    return response->take_answer();
}

Compositing::PendingAsyncScrollUpdates CompositorConnection::take_pending_async_scroll_updates(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Compositing::AsyncScrollUpdateFreshness freshness)
{
    // The compositor process pushes its scroll updates as it makes them, in order with the input
    // events it forwards, so a rendering update finds the latest ones here. A reader that needs the
    // compositor's state as of this instant asks for what it has not pushed yet, and first merges
    // the pushes that arrived ahead of that answer but were not dispatched during the wait.
    if (freshness == Compositing::AsyncScrollUpdateFreshness::FromCompositor && can_send_message_to_compositor()) {
        auto response = send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::TakePendingAsyncScrollUpdates>(context_id);
        // The pushes that arrived ahead of the answer and the answer itself are publications of the
        // same queue; they merge in the order the compositor published them, whatever order the
        // transport handed them over in, so a gesture state settles as the newest publication says.
        struct Arrival {
            Web::CompositorContextId context_id;
            Compositing::PendingAsyncScrollUpdates updates;
        };
        Vector<Arrival> arrivals;
        for (auto& message : take_unprocessed_messages(Messages::CompositorWebContentClient::AsyncScrollUpdates::ENDPOINT_MAGIC, Messages::CompositorWebContentClient::AsyncScrollUpdates::static_message_id())) {
            auto& pushed = static_cast<Messages::CompositorWebContentClient::AsyncScrollUpdates&>(*message);
            arrivals.append({ pushed.context_id(), pushed.updates() });
        }
        if (!response)
            did_lose_compositor();
        else
            arrivals.append({ context_id, response->take_updates() });
        quick_sort(arrivals, [](auto const& a, auto const& b) { return a.updates.sequence < b.updates.sequence; });
        for (auto& arrival : arrivals)
            merge_async_scroll_updates(arrival.context_id, move(arrival.updates));
    }

    auto pending = m_pending_async_scroll_updates.get(context_id);
    if (!pending.has_value())
        return {};
    Compositing::PendingAsyncScrollUpdates updates;
    updates.sequence = pending->sequence;
    updates.scroll_offsets = move(pending->scroll_offsets);
    updates.completed_operation_ids = move(pending->completed_operation_ids);
    updates.operation_ids_taken_over_by_user_input = move(pending->operation_ids_taken_over_by_user_input);
    updates.started_user_scrolls = move(pending->started_user_scrolls);
    updates.applied_scroll_requests = move(pending->applied_scroll_requests);
    updates.document_id = pending->document_id;
    updates.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture = pending->boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture;
    updates.boxes_whose_user_scroll_gesture_ended = move(pending->boxes_whose_user_scroll_gesture_ended);
    updates.wheel_latched_scroller = pending->wheel_latched_scroller;
    updates.context_user_input_scroll_count = pending->context_user_input_scroll_count;
    // Whether a gesture is in progress is a state the compositor process keeps current; the rest
    // was consumed here.
    pending->scroll_offsets.clear();
    pending->completed_operation_ids.clear();
    pending->operation_ids_taken_over_by_user_input.clear();
    pending->started_user_scrolls.clear();
    pending->applied_scroll_requests.clear();
    pending->boxes_whose_user_scroll_gesture_ended.clear();
    return updates;
}

void CompositorConnection::async_scroll_updates(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Compositing::PendingAsyncScrollUpdates updates)
{
    merge_async_scroll_updates(context_id, move(updates));
}

void CompositorConnection::merge_async_scroll_updates(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Compositing::PendingAsyncScrollUpdates updates)
{
    auto& pending = m_pending_async_scroll_updates.ensure(context_id);
    // Whether a gesture is in progress is a state, not an event: the newest publication decides it.
    bool const is_newest = updates.sequence >= pending.sequence;
    pending.sequence = max(pending.sequence, updates.sequence);
    pending.context_user_input_scroll_count = max(pending.context_user_input_scroll_count, updates.context_user_input_scroll_count);
    for (auto const& scroll_offset : updates.scroll_offsets) {
        auto existing = pending.scroll_offsets.find_if([&](auto const& existing) { return existing.stable_node_id == scroll_offset.stable_node_id; });
        if (existing != pending.scroll_offsets.end()) {
            existing->merge_later_scroll(scroll_offset);
        } else {
            pending.scroll_offsets.append(scroll_offset);
        }
    }
    pending.completed_operation_ids.extend(move(updates.completed_operation_ids));
    pending.operation_ids_taken_over_by_user_input.extend(move(updates.operation_ids_taken_over_by_user_input));
    pending.started_user_scrolls.extend(move(updates.started_user_scrolls));
    pending.applied_scroll_requests.extend(move(updates.applied_scroll_requests));
    if (is_newest) {
        pending.document_id = updates.document_id;
        pending.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture = move(updates.boxes_in_user_scroll_gesture);
        pending.wheel_latched_scroller = updates.wheel_latched_scroller;
    }
    for (auto box : updates.boxes_whose_user_scroll_gesture_ended) {
        if (!pending.boxes_whose_user_scroll_gesture_ended.contains_slow(box))
            pending.boxes_whose_user_scroll_gesture_ended.append(box);
    }
}

void CompositorConnection::request_screenshot(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> target_bitmap, Function<void(ScreenshotResult)>&& callback)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor()) {
        if (callback)
            callback(ScreenshotResult::Failed);
        return;
    }

    // The compositor paints straight into the target, so it has to be memory both processes can map.
    VERIFY(target_bitmap->anonymous_buffer().is_valid());
    auto shareable_bitmap = Gfx::ShareableBitmap { target_bitmap, Gfx::ShareableBitmap::ConstructWithKnownGoodBitmap };
    auto request_id = Compositing::ScreenshotRequestId { m_next_screenshot_request_id++ };
    m_screenshots.set(request_id, PendingScreenshot { move(target_bitmap), move(callback) });
    // The screenshot is of what the compositor composes, so it goes after the frames handed to the Paint thread before.
    paint_stage_request_screenshot(new ScreenshotRequestForPaintThread { context_id, request_id, move(shareable_bitmap) });
}

// NB: A page hosting an isolated iframe paints through the context of that local root, not of a traversable.
void CompositorConnection::request_rendering_update()
{
    for (auto& navigable : Web::HTML::all_local_navigables()) {
        if (navigable.is_local_root() && navigable.has_compositor_context())
            navigable.page().client().request_frame();
    }
}

void CompositorConnection::rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, i64 frame_time_nanoseconds, double frame_interval_milliseconds, double display_interval_milliseconds, Compositing::RenderingOpportunityFrameTime frame_time_kind)
{
    for (auto& navigable : Web::HTML::all_local_navigables()) {
        if (!navigable.is_local_root() || !navigable.has_compositor_context())
            continue;
        if (navigable.compositor_context().id() != context_id)
            continue;
        navigable.page().client().rendering_opportunity(frame_time_nanoseconds, frame_interval_milliseconds, display_interval_milliseconds, frame_time_kind);
        return;
    }
}

void CompositorConnection::animated_content_moved_under_pointer(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, i64 frame_time_nanoseconds)
{
    for (auto& navigable : Web::HTML::all_local_navigables()) {
        if (!navigable.has_compositor_context() || navigable.compositor_context().id() != context_id)
            continue;
        navigable.event_handler().note_animated_content_moved_under_pointer(frame_time_nanoseconds);
        return;
    }
}

void CompositorConnection::overlay_scrollbar_visibilities_changed(Vector<Web::OverlayScrollbarVisibility> visibilities)
{
    // Each scroller belongs to the active document of one of our navigables, which takes its scrollbar's visibility.
    for (auto const& visibility : visibilities) {
        for (auto& navigable : Web::HTML::all_local_navigables()) {
            if (navigable.set_overlay_scrollbar_hidden(visibility.scroller_stable_node_id, visibility.vertical, visibility.hidden))
                break;
        }
    }
}

void CompositorConnection::placeholder_canvas_committed(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, Gfx::IntSize size, bool origin_clean)
{
    Web::HTML::HTMLCanvasElement::placeholder_frame_committed(canvas_id, size, origin_clean);
}

void CompositorConnection::prepare_remote_descendants_for_screenshot(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Function<void()>&& callback)
{
    if (!can_send_message_to_compositor()) {
        callback();
        return;
    }
    auto request_id = m_next_remote_descendant_preparation_id++;
    m_remote_descendant_preparations.set(request_id, move(callback));
    async_prepare_remote_descendants_for_screenshot(context_id, request_id);
}

void CompositorConnection::remote_descendants_prepared_for_screenshot(u64 request_id)
{
    if (auto callback = m_remote_descendant_preparations.take(request_id); callback.has_value())
        (*callback)();
}

void CompositorConnection::paint_contexts_for_screenshot(u64 preparation_id, Vector<Web::CompositorContextId> context_ids)
{
    // The compositor names a context before those below it, and each is painted after them, as a rendering update would.
    GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<Web::HTML::LocalNavigable>> navigables;
    for (auto context_id : context_ids.in_reverse()) {
        for (auto& navigable : Web::HTML::all_local_navigables()) {
            if (navigable.has_been_destroyed() || !navigable.has_compositor_context() || navigable.compositor_context().id() != context_id)
                continue;
            navigables.append(navigable);
            break;
        }
    }
    GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<Web::Page>> prepared_pages;
    for (auto& navigable : navigables) {
        if (any_of(prepared_pages, [&](auto const& page) { return page.ptr() == &navigable->page(); }))
            continue;
        prepared_pages.append(navigable->page());
        navigable->page().prepare_canvas_contexts_for_compositing();
    }
    // A document that has just loaded may not have painted since, and the screenshot would show the frame it painted
    // before, so paint each one.
    for (auto& navigable : navigables)
        navigable->paint_next_frame_if_needed(Web::DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::ProcessScreenshot);
    // The frames reach the compositor on this connection once the Paint thread has handed them over, ahead of the
    // answer.
    Web::HTML::main_thread_event_loop().take_committed_frames_in();
    async_did_paint_contexts_for_screenshot(preparation_id);
}

void CompositorConnection::did_complete_screenshot(Compositing::ScreenshotRequestId request_id)
{
    auto pending_screenshot = take_screenshot(request_id);
    if (!pending_screenshot.has_value())
        return;

    if (pending_screenshot->callback)
        pending_screenshot->callback(ScreenshotResult::Taken);
}

void CompositorConnection::did_fail_screenshot(Compositing::ScreenshotRequestId request_id)
{
    auto pending_screenshot = take_screenshot(request_id);
    if (!pending_screenshot.has_value())
        return;

    if (pending_screenshot->callback)
        pending_screenshot->callback(ScreenshotResult::Failed);
}

void CompositorConnection::did_lose_compositor()
{
    if (m_has_lost_compositor)
        return;
    m_has_lost_compositor = true;
    stop_registering_resources_with_compositor(*m_poster);
    m_poster->detach_from_transport();

    for (auto& entry : m_screenshots) {
        if (entry.value.callback)
            entry.value.callback(ScreenshotResult::Failed);
    }
    m_screenshots.clear();

    // Nothing will answer the preparations now, and a screenshot that waits for one goes on without a compositor.
    for (auto& entry : exchange(m_remote_descendant_preparations, {}))
        entry.value();

    if (on_compositor_lost)
        on_compositor_lost();
}

bool CompositorConnection::can_send_message_to_compositor() const
{
    return !m_has_lost_compositor && is_open();
}

Optional<CompositorConnection::PendingScreenshot> CompositorConnection::take_screenshot(Compositing::ScreenshotRequestId request_id)
{
    return m_screenshots.take(request_id);
}

}

extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_post_fonts_and_image_frames(void* poster, u64 context_id, void const* const* fonts, size_t font_count, void const* const* image_frames, size_t image_frame_count);
extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_create_shared_buffer(size_t size, Web::Compositor::FfiSharedBuffer* out);
extern "C" WEB_API void web_compositor_shared_buffer_release(void* owner);
extern "C" WEB_API int web_compositor_shared_buffer_clone_descriptor(void* owner);
extern "C" WEB_API Gfx::DecodedImageFrame* web_compositor_shared_buffer_image_frame(void* owner, i32 width, i32 height, u8 alpha_type, u8 color_space);
extern "C" WEB_API u64 web_compositor_connection_serial(Web::Compositor::CompositorConnection const*);
extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_connection_for_sync_requests(Web::Compositor::CompositorConnection*, IPC::FfiConnection* out_connection);
extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_connection_register_image_frames(Web::Compositor::CompositorConnection*, void const* const* image_frames, size_t image_frame_count);
extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_post_screenshot_request(void* poster, void* request);
extern "C" WEB_API void web_screenshot_request_destroy(void* request);
extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_stage_rasterization(void* poster, u64 token, void const* const* fonts, size_t font_count, void const* const* image_frames, size_t image_frame_count, void const* target_bitmap);

extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_post_fonts_and_image_frames(void* poster, u64 context_id, void const* const* fonts, size_t font_count, void const* const* image_frames, size_t image_frame_count)
{
    return Web::Compositor::post_fonts_and_register_image_frames(
        *static_cast<IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster*>(poster),
        Web::CompositorContextId { context_id },
        { reinterpret_cast<Gfx::Font const* const*>(fonts), font_count },
        { reinterpret_cast<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const* const*>(image_frames), image_frame_count });
}

extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_create_shared_buffer(size_t size, Web::Compositor::FfiSharedBuffer* out)
{
    // Sealed where the platform supports it, so the receiver cannot be faulted by the file shrinking.
    auto buffer = Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_with_size(size);
    if (buffer.is_error())
        return false;
    auto descriptor = IPC::File::clone_fd(buffer.value().fd());
    if (descriptor.is_error())
        return false;
    auto owner = make<Web::Compositor::SharedBufferForRust>(buffer.release_value());
    *out = {
        .data = owner->buffer.data<u8>(),
        .size = owner->buffer.size(),
        .descriptor = descriptor.value().take_fd(),
        .owner = owner.leak_ptr(),
    };
    return true;
}

extern "C" WEB_API void web_compositor_shared_buffer_release(void* owner)
{
    delete static_cast<Web::Compositor::SharedBufferForRust*>(owner);
}

extern "C" WEB_API int web_compositor_shared_buffer_clone_descriptor(void* owner)
{
    auto descriptor = IPC::File::clone_fd(static_cast<Web::Compositor::SharedBufferForRust*>(owner)->buffer.fd());
    if (descriptor.is_error())
        return -1;
    return descriptor.value().take_fd();
}

// NB: A color space is the underlying value of a Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace.
extern "C" WEB_API Gfx::DecodedImageFrame* web_compositor_shared_buffer_image_frame(void* owner, i32 width, i32 height, u8 alpha_type, u8 color_space)
{
    VERIFY(Gfx::is_valid_alpha_type(alpha_type));
    auto& buffer = static_cast<Web::Compositor::SharedBufferForRust*>(owner)->buffer;
    auto format = static_cast<Gfx::AlphaType>(alpha_type) == Gfx::AlphaType::Unpremultiplied ? Gfx::BitmapFormat::RGBA8888 : Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888;
    auto gfx_color_space = Compositing::gfx_color_space_for(Web::HTML::predefined_color_space_from_underlying(color_space));
    auto frame = Gfx::DecodedImageFrame::create_over_shared_memory(buffer, 0, { width, height }, format, static_cast<Gfx::AlphaType>(alpha_type), move(gfx_color_space));
    if (frame.is_error())
        return nullptr;
    return new Gfx::DecodedImageFrame { frame.release_value() };
}

extern "C" WEB_API u64 web_compositor_connection_serial(Web::Compositor::CompositorConnection const* connection)
{
    return connection->serial();
}

extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_connection_for_sync_requests(Web::Compositor::CompositorConnection* connection, IPC::FfiConnection* out_connection)
{
    if (!connection->can_send_message_to_compositor())
        return false;
    *out_connection = connection->to_ffi_with_one_reference();
    return true;
}

extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_connection_register_image_frames(Web::Compositor::CompositorConnection* connection, void const* const* image_frames, size_t image_frame_count)
{
    return connection->register_image_frames({ reinterpret_cast<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const* const*>(image_frames), image_frame_count });
}

extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_post_screenshot_request(void* poster, void* request_pointer)
{
    auto request = adopt_own(*static_cast<Web::Compositor::ScreenshotRequestForPaintThread*>(request_pointer));
    auto encoded_message = MUST(Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::RequestScreenshot::static_encode(request->context_id, request->request_id, request->target));
    return static_cast<IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster*>(poster)->try_post(encoded_message);
}

extern "C" WEB_API void web_screenshot_request_destroy(void* request)
{
    delete static_cast<Web::Compositor::ScreenshotRequestForPaintThread*>(request);
}

extern "C" WEB_API bool web_compositor_stage_rasterization(void* poster, u64 token, void const* const* fonts, size_t font_count, void const* const* image_frames, size_t image_frame_count, void const* target_bitmap)
{
    auto& message_poster = *static_cast<IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster*>(poster);
    ReadonlySpan<Gfx::Font const*> staged_fonts { reinterpret_cast<Gfx::Font const* const*>(fonts), font_count };
    if (!Web::Compositor::register_typefaces_of_fonts_with_compositor(message_poster, staged_fonts))
        return false;
    ReadonlySpan<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const*> staged_image_frames { reinterpret_cast<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const* const*>(image_frames), image_frame_count };
    if (!Web::Compositor::register_image_frames_with_compositor(message_poster, staged_image_frames))
        return false;
    Vector<Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId> staged_image_frame_ids;
    staged_image_frame_ids.ensure_capacity(staged_image_frames.size());
    for (auto const* image_frame : staged_image_frames)
        staged_image_frame_ids.unchecked_append(Compositing::ImageFrameResourceId { image_frame->id() });
    auto& target = const_cast<Gfx::Bitmap&>(*static_cast<Gfx::Bitmap const*>(target_bitmap));
    auto encoded_message = MUST(Messages::CompositorWebContentServer::StageRasterization::static_encode(token, Web::Compositor::descriptions_of_fonts(staged_fonts), staged_image_frame_ids, Gfx::ShareableBitmap { target, Gfx::ShareableBitmap::ConstructWithKnownGoodBitmap }));
    return message_poster.try_post(encoded_message);
}

// Shared memory made for a message that Rust writes and posts.
struct FfiSharedBuffer {
    u8* data;
    size_t size;
    // A descriptor of the memory of its own, which the caller takes over.
    int descriptor;
    void* owner;
};

class WEB_API CompositorConnection final
    : public IPC::ConnectionToServer<CompositorWebContentClientEndpoint, CompositorWebContentServerEndpoint>
    , public CompositorWebContentClientEndpoint {
    C_OBJECT_ABSTRACT(CompositorConnection)

public:
    explicit CompositorConnection(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport>);
    virtual ~CompositorConnection() override;

    void set_parent_context(Web::CompositorContextId, Optional<Web::CompositorContextId>);
    void stop_presenting_to_client(Web::CompositorContextId);
    void destroy_context(Web::CompositorContextId);
    // Has the Paint thread present frames through this connection from now on.
    void hand_poster_to_paint_thread();
    void add_animated_image(u64 frame_id, AnimatedImageRegistration const&);
    void remove_animated_image(u64 frame_id);
    void start_animated_image(u64 frame_id);
    void stop_animated_image(u64 frame_id);
    AnimatedImageState animated_image_state_for_testing(u64 frame_id);
    void add_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle, NonnullRefPtr<Compositing::VideoFramePresentationPage>);
    void remove_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle);
    void release_video_frame_hold(Media::VideoSinkHandle, u64 generation);
    // Waits for the compositor to say that the sink's frame follows its clock, until the deadline if there is one.
    void bring_video_sink_up_to_date(Media::VideoSinkHandle, Optional<MonotonicTime> deadline);
    RefPtr<IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster> poster_while_compositor_is_reachable();
    bool post_canvas_2d_stream_batch_fonts_and_image_frames(ReadonlySpan<Gfx::Font const*>, ReadonlySpan<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const*>);
    void did_fail_to_post_canvas_2d_message();
    bool register_image_frames(ReadonlySpan<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const*>);
    bool can_send_message_to_compositor() const;
    u64 serial() const { return m_serial; }
    Optional<Web::Compositor::PlaceholderCanvasLink> allocate_placeholder_canvas();
    void release_placeholder_canvas(Compositing::CanvasId);
    void commit_placeholder_canvas(Web::Compositor::PlaceholderCanvasLink, Optional<Compositing::CanvasId> source_canvas_id, Gfx::IntSize, bool origin_clean);
    Web::Compositor::PlaceholderCanvasPixels get_placeholder_canvas_pixels(Compositing::CanvasId, Gfx::IntRect);
    // Has the compositor rasterize `image` into `target`, and waits for it to.
    bool rasterize_image(Layout::RustFFI::FfiImageRasterization const&, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> target);
    // Has the compositor rasterize the recording the document of the host took in last into `target`, and waits for
    // it to.
    bool rasterize_last_recording(Layout::RustFFI::DocumentHost const&, Layout::BegunRead const&, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> target);
    void invalidate_wheel_event_listener_state(Web::CompositorContextId, u64 generation);
    void invalidate_keyboard_scroll_state(Web::CompositorContextId, u64 generation);
    Compositing::WheelEventAnswer take_wheel_event_from_main_thread(Web::CompositorContextId, Web::MouseEvent const&, Compositing::AsyncScrollOperationTracking, Compositing::WheelEventRouting);
    Compositing::WheelEventAnswer wheel_event_let_through(Web::CompositorContextId, Compositing::WheelStepLetThrough const&, Compositing::AsyncScrollOperationTracking);
    void wheel_event_canceled(Web::CompositorContextId, u64 wheel_gesture_id);
    String scroll_state_for_testing(Web::CompositorContextId, Web::AsyncScrollNodeStableID stretched_scroller);
    void synchronize_for_testing();
    Optional<Compositing::FirstWheelStepRouteForTesting> route_first_wheel_step_for_testing(Web::CompositorContextId, Gfx::FloatPoint position, Gfx::FloatPoint delta_in_css_pixels);
    void begin_input_trace_for_testing(Web::CompositorContextId);
    void clear_per_test_input_state_for_testing(Web::CompositorContextId);
    Vector<Web::InputTraceRecord> take_input_trace_for_testing(Web::CompositorContextId);
    Compositing::PendingAsyncScrollUpdates take_pending_async_scroll_updates(Web::CompositorContextId, Compositing::AsyncScrollUpdateFreshness);
    void viewport_size_updated(Web::CompositorContextId, Gfx::IntSize, double device_pixel_ratio, Compositing::WindowResizingInProgress);
    bool request_rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId, double maximum_frames_per_second);
    void hurry_rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId);
    void request_screenshot(Web::CompositorContextId, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap>, Function<void(ScreenshotResult)>&&);
    // Has the processes that own the context's descendants in other processes paint them, and calls `callback` once the
    // compositor has their frames, or once it is lost.
    void prepare_remote_descendants_for_screenshot(Web::CompositorContextId, Function<void()>&& callback);

    void ensure_video_presentation_channel();
    void ensure_image_decoder_channel();
    // Takes up the render clock channel the Browser made between this process and the Compositor, which delivers
    // display ticks over it from then on.
    void attach_render_clock(IPC::TransportHandle);
    Function<void(Web::PageId page_id, Web::MouseEvent)> on_mouse_event;
    Function<void(Web::PageId page_id, Web::KeyEvent)> on_key_event;
    Function<void(Web::PageId page_id, Web::PinchEvent)> on_pinch_event;
    Function<void()> on_compositor_lost;
    // Asks the Browser to connect this process's media server to the Compositor.
    Function<void()> on_request_video_presentation_channel;

private:
    struct PendingScreenshot {
        NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> target_bitmap;

        Function<void(ScreenshotResult)> callback;
    };

    virtual void die() override;

    virtual void mouse_event(u64 page_id, Web::MouseEvent) override;
    virtual void key_event(u64 page_id, Web::KeyEvent) override;
    virtual void pinch_event(u64 page_id, Web::PinchEvent) override;
    virtual void request_rendering_update() override;
    virtual void rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId, i64 frame_time_nanoseconds, double frame_interval_milliseconds, double display_interval_milliseconds, Compositing::RenderingOpportunityFrameTime frame_time_kind) override;
    virtual void async_scroll_updates(Web::CompositorContextId, Compositing::PendingAsyncScrollUpdates) override;
    virtual void animated_content_moved_under_pointer(Web::CompositorContextId, i64 frame_time_nanoseconds) override;
    bool did_rasterize(Layout::RustFFI::RasterizationOutcome);
    virtual void video_sink_is_up_to_date(u64 token) override;
    virtual void did_complete_screenshot(Compositing::ScreenshotRequestId) override;
    virtual void did_fail_screenshot(Compositing::ScreenshotRequestId) override;
    virtual void paint_contexts_for_screenshot(u64 preparation_id, Vector<Web::CompositorContextId>) override;
    virtual void remote_descendants_prepared_for_screenshot(u64 request_id) override;
    virtual void did_lose_compositor() override;
    virtual void placeholder_canvas_committed(Compositing::CanvasId, Gfx::IntSize, bool origin_clean) override;
    virtual void overlay_scrollbar_visibilities_changed(Vector<Web::OverlayScrollbarVisibility>) override;

    void merge_async_scroll_updates(Web::CompositorContextId, Compositing::PendingAsyncScrollUpdates);
    Optional<PendingScreenshot> take_screenshot(Compositing::ScreenshotRequestId);

    // Posts to the transport from any thread: the Paint thread presents through it, and Rust posts what it encodes.
    NonnullRefPtr<IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster> m_poster;

    HashMap<Compositing::ScreenshotRequestId, PendingScreenshot> m_screenshots;
    HashMap<u64, Function<void()>> m_remote_descendant_preparations;
    u64 m_next_remote_descendant_preparation_id { 1 };
    // What the compositor process scrolled since the last rendering update adopted it, per context.
    HashMap<Web::CompositorContextId, Compositing::PendingAsyncScrollUpdates> m_pending_async_scroll_updates;
    u64 m_next_screenshot_request_id { 1 };
    Atomic<u64> m_next_rasterization_token { 1 };
    u64 m_serial { 0 };
    u64 m_next_video_sink_up_to_date_token { 1 };
    bool m_has_lost_compositor { false };
    // The media server whose presentation channel the Compositor holds; a replacement server needs a new channel.
    Optional<u64> m_video_presentation_channel_media_client_generation;
    Optional<u64> m_image_decoder_channel_client_generation;
};

}

extern "C" {

void* web_canvas_2d_stream_create();
void web_canvas_2d_stream_destroy(void* stream);
void web_canvas_2d_stream_flush(void* stream, CompositorConnection* connection);
void web_canvas_2d_stream_discard(void* stream);
}

CompositorHost::CompositorHost()
    : m_canvas_2d_stream(web_canvas_2d_stream_create())
{
}

CompositorHost::~CompositorHost()
{
    web_canvas_2d_stream_destroy(m_canvas_2d_stream);
}

OwnPtr<CompositorContextHandle> CompositorHost::create_context(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    return adopt_own(*new CompositorContextHandle(*this, context_id));
}

Optional<CompositorHost::Canvas2DTransport> CompositorHost::create_canvas_2d_transport()
{
    auto* connection = compositor_connection();
    if (!connection)
        return {};
    connection->ref();
    return Canvas2DTransport { .stream = m_canvas_2d_stream, .connection = connection };
}

void CompositorHost::flush_canvas_2d_stream()
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        web_canvas_2d_stream_flush(m_canvas_2d_stream, connection);
}

void CompositorHost::discard_canvas_2d_stream()
{
    web_canvas_2d_stream_discard(m_canvas_2d_stream);
}

Optional<Web::Compositor::PlaceholderCanvasLink> CompositorHost::allocate_placeholder_canvas()
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        return connection->allocate_placeholder_canvas();
    return {};
}

void CompositorHost::release_placeholder_canvas(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->release_placeholder_canvas(canvas_id);
}

void CompositorHost::commit_placeholder_canvas(Web::Compositor::PlaceholderCanvasLink link, Optional<Compositing::CanvasId> source_canvas_id, Gfx::IntSize size, bool origin_clean)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->commit_placeholder_canvas(link, source_canvas_id, size, origin_clean);
}

Web::Compositor::PlaceholderCanvasPixels CompositorHost::read_placeholder_canvas_pixels(Compositing::CanvasId canvas_id, Gfx::IntRect rect)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        return connection->get_placeholder_canvas_pixels(canvas_id, rect);
    return {};
}

bool CompositorHost::rasterize_image(Layout::RustFFI::FfiImageRasterization const& image, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> target) const
{
    auto* connection = compositor_connection();
    if (!connection)
        return false;
    return connection->rasterize_image(image, move(target));
}

bool CompositorHost::rasterize_last_recording(Layout::RustFFI::DocumentHost const& document_host, Layout::BegunRead const& read, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> target) const
{
    auto* connection = compositor_connection();
    if (!connection)
        return false;
    return connection->rasterize_last_recording(document_host, read, move(target));
}

void CompositorHost::destroy_context(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    paint_stage_forget_destroyed_compositor_context(context_id.value());
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection()) {
        connection->destroy_context(context_id);
        // A connection attached the render clock, whose lanes of the context hear of it no more.
        RenderClock::the().forget_context(context_id);
    }
    context_was_destroyed(context_id);
}

void CompositorHost::set_parent_context(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Optional<Web::CompositorContextId> parent_context_id)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->set_parent_context(context_id, parent_context_id);
}

void CompositorHost::stop_presenting_to_client(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->stop_presenting_to_client(context_id);
}

void CompositorHost::add_animated_image(u64 frame_id, AnimatedImageRegistration image)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->add_animated_image(frame_id, image);
    m_animated_images.set(frame_id, move(image));
}

void CompositorHost::remove_animated_image(u64 frame_id)
{
    m_animated_images.remove(frame_id);
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->remove_animated_image(frame_id);
}

void CompositorHost::start_animated_image(u64 frame_id)
{
    m_animated_images.get(frame_id)->is_started = true;
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->start_animated_image(frame_id);
}

void CompositorHost::stop_animated_image(u64 frame_id)
{
    m_animated_images.get(frame_id)->is_started = false;
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->stop_animated_image(frame_id);
}

AnimatedImageState CompositorHost::animated_image_state_for_testing(u64 frame_id) const
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        return connection->animated_image_state_for_testing(frame_id);
    return {};
}

void CompositorHost::register_animated_images_with_new_compositor()
{
    auto* connection = compositor_connection();
    if (!connection)
        return;
    for (auto const& [frame_id, image] : m_animated_images) {
        connection->add_animated_image(frame_id, image);
        if (image.is_started)
            connection->start_animated_image(frame_id);
    }
}

bool CompositorHost::add_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, NonnullRefPtr<Compositing::VideoFramePresentationPage> presentation_page)
{
    auto* connection = compositor_connection();
    if (!connection)
        return false;
    connection->add_video_sink(video_sink_handle, move(presentation_page));
    return true;
}

void CompositorHost::remove_video_sink(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->remove_video_sink(video_sink_handle);
}

void CompositorHost::bring_video_sink_up_to_date(Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, Optional<MonotonicTime> deadline)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->bring_video_sink_up_to_date(video_sink_handle, deadline);
}

Compositing::VideoFrameHold::ReleaseThroughCompositor CompositorHost::video_frame_hold_releaser_for_current_connection() const
{
    auto* connection = compositor_connection();
    if (!connection)
        return {};
    return [weak_connection = connection->make_weak_ptr<CompositorConnection>()](Media::VideoSinkHandle video_sink_handle, u64 generation) {
        if (auto connection = weak_connection.strong_ref())
            connection->release_video_frame_hold(video_sink_handle, generation);
    };
}

void CompositorHost::viewport_size_updated(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Gfx::IntSize viewport_size, double device_pixel_ratio, Compositing::WindowResizingInProgress window_resize_in_progress)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->viewport_size_updated(context_id, viewport_size, device_pixel_ratio, window_resize_in_progress);
}

bool CompositorHost::request_rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, double maximum_frames_per_second)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        return connection->request_rendering_opportunity(context_id, maximum_frames_per_second);
    return false;
}

void CompositorHost::hurry_rendering_opportunity(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection())
        connection->hurry_rendering_opportunity(context_id);
}

void CompositorHost::prepare_remote_descendants_for_screenshot(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Function<void()>&& callback)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection()) {
        connection->prepare_remote_descendants_for_screenshot(context_id, move(callback));
        return;
    }
    callback();
}

void CompositorHost::request_screenshot(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Bitmap> target_bitmap, Function<void(ScreenshotResult)>&& callback)
{
    if (auto* connection = compositor_connection()) {
        connection->request_screenshot(context_id, move(target_bitmap), move(callback));
        return;
    }
    if (callback)
        callback(ScreenshotResult::Failed);
}

    : m_presenter(Layout::RustFFI::navigable_presenter_create())
{
}

{
    Layout::RustFFI::navigable_presenter_release(m_presenter);
}

static HTML::PaintConfig paint_config_from_ffi(Layout::RustFFI::FfiPaintConfig const& config)
{
    HTML::PaintConfig paint_config;
    paint_config.paint_overlay = config.paint_overlay;
    paint_config.should_show_line_box_borders = config.should_show_line_box_borders;
    paint_config.should_show_caret_hit_test_debug_overlay = config.should_show_caret_hit_test_debug_overlay;
    paint_config.force_dark_enabled = config.force_dark_enabled;
    paint_config.force_dark_foreground_threshold = config.force_dark_foreground_threshold;
    paint_config.force_dark_background_threshold = config.force_dark_background_threshold;
    if (config.has_canvas_fill_rect)
        paint_config.canvas_fill_rect = config.canvas_fill_rect;
    return paint_config;
}

static Layout::RustFFI::FfiPaintConfig paint_config_to_ffi(HTML::PaintConfig const& config)
{
    return {
        .paint_overlay = config.paint_overlay,
        .should_show_line_box_borders = config.should_show_line_box_borders,
        .should_show_caret_hit_test_debug_overlay = config.should_show_caret_hit_test_debug_overlay,
        .force_dark_enabled = config.force_dark_enabled,
        .force_dark_foreground_threshold = config.force_dark_foreground_threshold,
        .force_dark_background_threshold = config.force_dark_background_threshold,
        .has_canvas_fill_rect = config.canvas_fill_rect.has_value(),
        .canvas_fill_rect = config.canvas_fill_rect.value_or({}),
    };
}

Optional<HTML::PaintConfig> NavigablePresenter::compositor_display_list_paint_config() const
{
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiPaintConfig config {};
    if (!Layout::RustFFI::navigable_presenter_compositor_display_list_paint_config(m_presenter, &config))
        return {};
    return paint_config_from_ffi(config);
}

Optional<u64> NavigablePresenter::compositor_display_list_structural_epoch() const
{
    u64 epoch = 0;
    if (!Layout::RustFFI::navigable_presenter_compositor_display_list_structural_epoch(m_presenter, &epoch))
        return {};
    return epoch;
}

void NavigablePresenter::forget_compositor_display_list()
{
    Layout::RustFFI::navigable_presenter_forget_compositor_display_list(m_presenter);
}

Optional<PresentedBy> NavigablePresenter::last_frame_presented_by() const
{
    switch (Layout::RustFFI::navigable_presenter_last_frame_presented_by(m_presenter)) {
    case Layout::RustFFI::FfiPresentedBy::None:
        return {};
    case Layout::RustFFI::FfiPresentedBy::Commit:
        return PresentedBy::Commit;
    case Layout::RustFFI::FfiPresentedBy::Clock:
        return PresentedBy::Clock;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

Optional<u64> NavigablePresenter::last_keyboard_scroll_state_generation() const
{
    u64 generation = 0;
    if (!Layout::RustFFI::navigable_presenter_last_keyboard_scroll_state_generation(m_presenter, &generation))
        return {};
    return generation;
}

template<typename T>
static IPC::MessageBuffer encode_for_rust(T const& value)
{
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder { buffer };
    MUST(encoder.encode(value));
    return buffer;
}

void NavigablePresenter::lend_seal(SealedPresentation const& sealed, Function<void(Layout::RustFFI::FfiSeal const&)> const& take) const
{
    auto scroll_requests = encode_for_rust(sealed.scroll_requests);
    auto keyboard_scroll_state = encode_for_rust(sealed.keyboard_scroll_state);
    Layout::RustFFI::FfiSeal seal {
        .presenter = m_presenter,
        .paint_config = paint_config_to_ffi(sealed.paint_config),
        .has_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch = sealed.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch.has_value(),
        .visual_context_tree_structural_epoch = sealed.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch.value_or(0),
        .sends_visual_context_tree = sealed.sends_visual_context_tree,
        .encoded_scroll_requests = scroll_requests.data().data(),
        .encoded_scroll_requests_size = scroll_requests.data().size(),
        .encoded_keyboard_scroll_state = keyboard_scroll_state.data().data(),
        .encoded_keyboard_scroll_state_size = keyboard_scroll_state.data().size(),
        .context_id = sealed.context_id.value(),
        .has_present_viewport_rect = sealed.present_viewport_rect.has_value(),
        .present_viewport_rect = sealed.present_viewport_rect.value_or({}),
        .generation = sealed.generation,
        .visual_context_tree_mismatches_for_testing = sealed.visual_context_tree_mismatches_for_testing,
    };
    take(seal);
}

#pragma once

struct FfiSeal;
struct NavigablePresenter;

}

namespace Web::Compositor {

// What presented a navigable's last frame: the recording of a frame a rendering update committed, or a tick of the
// document's clock lane.
enum class PresentedBy : u8 {
    Commit,
    Clock,
};

// What a frame is built from that its navigable and document held where the frame began, sealed there: the frame reaches
// neither of them again before it is presented. What presents the frame takes it over as the frame is committed.
struct SealedPresentation {
    // The recording's paint config.
    HTML::PaintConfig paint_config;
    // The structural epoch of the visual context tree a new display list is cut from.
    Optional<u64> visual_context_tree_structural_epoch;
    // Whether the document's tree changed since the compositor took one.
    bool sends_visual_context_tree { false };
    // The scrolls the navigable asked for since the frame before, which the compositor applies once it has the frame's
    // boxes.
    Vector<Compositing::ScrollRequest> scroll_requests;
    // What keyboard scrolling targets, for a top-level traversable.
    Optional<Compositing::KeyboardScrollState> keyboard_scroll_state;
    Web::CompositorContextId context_id;
    Optional<Gfx::IntRect> present_viewport_rect;
    // Whether the frame sends a visual context tree the compositor's display list was not recorded against, for a test.
    bool visual_context_tree_mismatches_for_testing { false };
    // The frame a rendering update committed, counted per navigable.
    u64 generation { 0 };
};

// A navigable's presenter, which keeps what the navigable's compositor context holds. The Paint thread presents through
// it, and the main thread reads what it presented here.
class WEB_API NavigablePresenter {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(NavigablePresenter);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(NavigablePresenter);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    NavigablePresenter();
    ~NavigablePresenter();

    // The paint config of the display list the compositor context holds, and the structural epoch of the visual context
    // tree it was recorded against.
    Optional<HTML::PaintConfig> compositor_display_list_paint_config() const;
    Optional<u64> compositor_display_list_structural_epoch() const;

    // Forgets what the compositor context holds: a new compositor process holds nothing.
    void forget_compositor_display_list();

    Optional<PresentedBy> last_frame_presented_by() const;
    // The generation of the keyboard scroll state the last frame handed the compositor, if it handed one.
    Optional<u64> last_keyboard_scroll_state_generation() const;

    // Lends `take` the seal of a frame of this presenter as Rust takes it, for the call.
    void lend_seal(SealedPresentation const&, Function<void(Layout::RustFFI::FfiSeal const&)> const& take) const;

private:
    Layout::RustFFI::NavigablePresenter const* m_presenter { nullptr };
};

// A navigable's presenter and a frame sealed for it, which what presents the frame beside the event loop takes over as
// the frame is committed.
struct FlightPresentation {
    NavigablePresenter const* presenter;
    SealedPresentation sealed;
};

}

/*

#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <Compositor/RenderClockClientEndpoint.h>
#include <Compositor/RenderClockServerEndpoint.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/ThreadEventQueue.h>
#include <LibGC/HeapAccess.h>
#include <LibIPC/ConnectionToServer.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>
#include <LibWeb/Compositor/RenderClock.h>
#include <LibWeb/Compositor/RenderClockRustFFI.h>

namespace Web::Compositor {

// LibIPC pins a connection to the thread that makes it, so the clock thread makes and destroys every channel.
class RenderClockChannel final : public IPC::ConnectionToServer<RenderClockClientEndpoint, RenderClockServerEndpoint> {
public:
    RenderClockChannel(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport, RenderClock& clock)
        : IPC::ConnectionToServer<RenderClockClientEndpoint, RenderClockServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
        , m_clock(clock)
    {
    }

    // A channel the clock let go of on purpose reports nothing more, not even its own death.
    void detach() { m_detached = true; }

private:
    // The Compositor went away. The main thread learns of it on its own connection.
    virtual void die() override
    {
        if (!m_detached)
            m_clock.did_lose_channel();
    }

    virtual ErrorOr<OwnPtr<IPC::MessageBuffer>> handle_raw(IPC::RawMessage& message) override
    {
        if (m_detached)
            return nullptr;
        auto outcome = message.hand_to_rust([&](IPC::FfiRawMessage raw_message) {
            RustFFI::render_clock_lanes_handle_message(&m_clock.m_lanes, raw_message, m_clock.is_manual_for_testing());
        });
        if (outcome.misbehavior.has_value()) {
            dbgln("RenderClock: Disconnecting the Compositor after {}: {}", message.message_name(), *outcome.misbehavior);
            shutdown();
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    RenderClock& m_clock;
    bool m_detached { false };
};

ClockTicksHandle::~ClockTicksHandle()
{
    if (m_ticks)
        Layout::RustFFI::clock_ticks_release(m_ticks);
}

RenderClock& RenderClock::the()
{
    // The clock lives as long as the process, which ends with its thread still waiting for ticks.
    static RenderClock& clock = *new RenderClock;
    return clock;
}

RenderClock::RenderClock()
    : m_thread(Threading::Thread::construct("RenderClock"sv, [this] {
        return thread_main();
    }))
    , m_lanes(*RustFFI::render_clock_lanes_create())
{
    m_thread->start();
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    m_condition.wait_while([&] { return !m_started; });
}

intptr_t RenderClock::thread_main()
{
    GC::forbid_heap_access_on_this_thread();

    Core::EventLoop event_loop;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
        m_event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();
        m_started = true;
        m_condition.broadcast();
    }

    auto result = event_loop.exec();

    // What is still queued on this thread runs before it returns: a connection's deferred invocations hold references
    // to it, and the last one to go would destroy the channel as the thread exits.
    do {
        drop_channel();
    } while (Core::ThreadEventQueue::current().process() > 0);

    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    m_event_loop.clear();
    return result;
}

bool RenderClock::invoke_on_clock_thread(Function<void()> function)
{
    RefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> event_loop;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
        event_loop = m_event_loop;
    }
    if (!event_loop)
        return false;
    auto strong_event_loop = event_loop->take();
    if (!strong_event_loop)
        return false;
    strong_event_loop->deferred_invoke(move(function));
    return true;
}

ErrorOr<void> RenderClock::attach(IPC::TransportHandle handle)
{
    Mutex result_mutex;
    ConditionVariable result_condition { result_mutex };
    Optional<ErrorOr<void>> result;

    auto invoked = invoke_on_clock_thread([&, handle = move(handle)]() mutable {
        auto channel_result = replace_channel(move(handle));
        MutexLocker locker(result_mutex);
        result = move(channel_result);
        result_condition.broadcast();
    });
    if (!invoked)
        return Error::from_string_literal("RenderClock thread is gone");

    // The clock thread goes away only with this RenderClock, so it runs what was just handed to it.
    MutexLocker locker(result_mutex);
    result_condition.wait_while([&] { return !result.has_value(); });
    return result.release_value();
}

ErrorOr<void> RenderClock::replace_channel(IPC::TransportHandle handle)
{
    // A new channel starts with nothing armed: the contexts armed on the previous one were armed for a Compositor that
    // is gone.
    drop_channel();
    auto transport = TRY(handle.create_transport());
    m_channel = adopt_ref(*new RenderClockChannel(move(transport), *this));
    m_poster_of_channel = IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster::create(m_channel->transport());
    RustFFI::render_clock_lanes_replace_channel(&m_lanes, m_poster_of_channel->to_ffi_with_one_reference());
    return {};
}

void RenderClock::drop_channel()
{
    RustFFI::render_clock_lanes_drop_channel(&m_lanes);
    if (auto poster = move(m_poster_of_channel))
        poster->detach_from_transport();
    if (auto channel = move(m_channel)) {
        channel->detach();
        channel->shutdown();
    }
}

void RenderClock::arm_lane(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, double maximum_frames_per_second, NonnullRefPtr<ClockTicksHandle> ticks, Optional<i64> tick_now_at)
{
    VERIFY(isfinite(maximum_frames_per_second) && maximum_frames_per_second > 0);
    auto arm = [this, context_id, maximum_frames_per_second, ticks = move(ticks), tick_now_at]() mutable {
        RustFFI::render_clock_lanes_arm_lane(&m_lanes, context_id.value(), maximum_frames_per_second, ticks->ticks(), tick_now_at.has_value(), tick_now_at.value_or(0));
    };
    // A test hands the lanes pointer moves by hand, which find the context armed once the rendering update is over.
    if (m_manual_for_testing)
        run_on_clock_thread_and_wait(move(arm));
    else
        (void)invoke_on_clock_thread(move(arm));
}

void RenderClock::forget_context(Web::CompositorContextId context_id)
{
    (void)invoke_on_clock_thread([this, context_id] {
        RustFFI::render_clock_lanes_forget_context(&m_lanes, context_id.value());
    });
}

// Runs `job` on the clock thread, and waits for it. The clock thread never waits for the caller's, and goes away only with
// this RenderClock, so it runs what was just handed to it.
void RenderClock::run_on_clock_thread_and_wait(Function<void()> job)
{
    Mutex done_mutex;
    ConditionVariable done_condition { done_mutex };
    bool done = false;
    auto invoked = invoke_on_clock_thread([&] {
        job();
        MutexLocker locker(done_mutex);
        done = true;
        done_condition.broadcast();
    });
    if (!invoked)
        return;
    MutexLocker locker(done_mutex);
    done_condition.wait_while([&] { return !done; });
}

void RenderClock::disarm_all_for_testing()
{
    run_on_clock_thread_and_wait([this] { RustFFI::render_clock_lanes_disarm_all(&m_lanes); });
}

void RenderClock::hand_pointer_move(Web::CompositorContextId context_id, Optional<Gfx::FloatPoint> device_position, u32 buttons, bool scrolled_since_frame, u64 input_event_id)
{
    auto pointer_move = [this, context_id, device_position, buttons, scrolled_since_frame, input_event_id] {
        auto position = device_position.value_or({});
        RustFFI::render_clock_lanes_pointer_moved(&m_lanes, context_id.value(), device_position.has_value(), position.x(), position.y(), buttons, scrolled_since_frame, input_event_id, m_manual_for_testing);
    };
    if (m_manual_for_testing)
        run_on_clock_thread_and_wait(move(pointer_move));
    else
        (void)invoke_on_clock_thread(move(pointer_move));
}

void RenderClock::did_lose_channel()
{
    RustFFI::render_clock_lanes_drop_channel(&m_lanes);
    if (auto poster = move(m_poster_of_channel))
        poster->detach_from_transport();
    // The channel is dying from inside its own handler, which keeps it alive until it returns.
    m_channel = nullptr;
}

}

extern "C" void web_render_clock_hand_pointer_move(u64, bool, float, float, u32, bool, u64);

// The lane of a document hands the render clock a pointer move over a same-process iframe's compositor context.
extern "C" void web_render_clock_hand_pointer_move(u64 context_id, bool has_position, float x, float y, u32 buttons, bool scrolled_since_frame, u64 input_event_id)
{
    Optional<Gfx::FloatPoint> position;
    if (has_position)
        position = Gfx::FloatPoint { x, y };
    Web::Compositor::RenderClock::the().hand_pointer_move(Web::CompositorContextId { context_id }, position, buttons, scrolled_since_frame, input_event_id);
}

namespace Web::Compositor {

class RenderClockChannel;

// A reference to the ticks of a document's clock lanes, which hands them on to the lane that follows the frame the
// document presented last.
class WEB_API ClockTicksHandle : public RefCounted<ClockTicksHandle> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(ClockTicksHandle);

public:
    explicit ClockTicksHandle(Layout::RustFFI::ClockTicks const* ticks)
        : m_ticks(ticks)
    {
    }
    ~ClockTicksHandle();

    Layout::RustFFI::ClockTicks const* ticks() const { return m_ticks; }

private:
    Layout::RustFFI::ClockTicks const* m_ticks { nullptr };
};

// A thread of its own that asks the Compositor for display ticks for the contexts that are armed, and hands each tick
// it is delivered to what the context was armed with, without passing through the main thread. There is one per
// process; a Compositor reconnect swaps its channel, not its thread.
//
// The main thread reaches the clock thread only through the calls below. The clock thread owns the channel and the
// armed contexts, and is the only one that hands ticks on.
class WEB_API RenderClock {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(RenderClock);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(RenderClock);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    // The process's render clock, made the first time it is asked for.
    static RenderClock& the();

    // Takes up a channel to the Compositor on the clock thread, in place of the previous one and with nothing armed.
    // Blocks until the channel exists.
    ErrorOr<void> attach(IPC::TransportHandle);

    // Asynchronous. Hands the pointer moves over the context to `ticks` from now on, until another document's ticks take
    // their place or the channel is lost, and arms the context's ticks for them where they ask for them; with
    // `tick_now_at`, ticks them at once at that frame time, where no display tick drives them already. A context is
    // armed until it declines a tick or the channel is lost; a tick that arrives for a context that is not armed is
    // dropped.
    void arm_lane(Web::CompositorContextId, double maximum_frames_per_second, NonnullRefPtr<ClockTicksHandle> ticks, Optional<i64> tick_now_at);

    // Asynchronous. Disarms the context, which is destroyed, and lets go of the ticks its pointer moves went to.
    void forget_context(Web::CompositorContextId);

    // Synchronous. Disarms every context, whose ticks a test injects itself from now on: no display tick reaches them
    // after this returns. For a test.
    void disarm_all_for_testing();

    // Hands the ticks that hear of the pointer moves over the context a move, as the compositor hands them those over a
    // page's context, from the lane of the document around a same-process iframe's. Asynchronous, but for a test that
    // ticks by hand, whose ticks hear of it before this returns.
    void hand_pointer_move(Web::CompositorContextId, Optional<Gfx::FloatPoint> device_position, u32 buttons, bool scrolled_since_frame, u64 input_event_id);

    // Has a test tick the lanes by hand, whose pointer moves then arm no context.
    void set_manual_for_testing(bool manual) { m_manual_for_testing = manual; }
    bool is_manual_for_testing() const { return m_manual_for_testing; }

private:
    friend class RenderClockChannel;

    RenderClock();
    intptr_t thread_main();
    [[nodiscard]] bool invoke_on_clock_thread(Function<void()>);
    void run_on_clock_thread_and_wait(Function<void()>);

    // On the clock thread.
    ErrorOr<void> replace_channel(IPC::TransportHandle);
    void drop_channel();
    void did_lose_channel();

    NonnullRefPtr<Threading::Thread> m_thread;
    Atomic<bool> m_manual_for_testing { false };

    Mutex m_mutex;
    ConditionVariable m_condition { m_mutex };
    bool m_started { false };
    RefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> m_event_loop;

    // Owned by the clock thread.
    RefPtr<RenderClockChannel> m_channel;
    RefPtr<IPC::ThreadSafeMessagePoster> m_poster_of_channel;
    RustFFI::RenderClockLanes& m_lanes;
};

}

use std::env;
use std::error::Error;
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env::var("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")?);
    let out_dir = PathBuf::from(env::var("OUT_DIR")?);

    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=build.rs");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=cbindgen.toml");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=src");

    cbindgen::generate(manifest_dir).map_or_else(
        |error| match error {
            cbindgen::Error::ParseSyntaxError { .. } => {}
            other => panic!("{other:?}"),
        },
        |bindings| {
            let header_path = out_dir.join("ContentBlockerRustFFI.h");
            bindings.write_to_file(&header_path);
        },
    );

    Ok(())
}

/*

 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#[cfg(feature = "allocator")]
extern crate ladybird_allocator;

#[path = "../../../../RustDemangle.rs"]
mod rust_demangle;

#[path = "../../../../RustPanic.rs"]
mod rust_panic;

use crate::rust_panic::abort_on_panic;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::collections::HashSet;

#[repr(C)]
pub struct ContentBlockerString {
    data: *mut u8,
    length: usize,
}

pub struct ContentBlockerEngine {
    engine: adblock::engine::Engine,
    generic_selector_list_rules: GenericSelectorListRules,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct GenericSelectorListRules {
    always_needed: HashSet<String>,
    by_class: HashMap<String, Vec<String>>,
    by_id: HashMap<String, Vec<String>>,
}

enum SelectorKey {
    Class(String),
    Id(String),
}

/// The bytes as a string, or none where they are not UTF-8.
fn as_str(bytes: ak::Span<'_, u8>) -> Option<&str> {
    std::str::from_utf8(bytes.as_slice()).ok()
}

fn string_to_ffi(string: String) -> ContentBlockerString {
    if string.is_empty() {
        return ContentBlockerString {
            data: std::ptr::null_mut(),
            length: 0,
        };
    }

    let bytes = Box::leak(string.into_bytes().into_boxed_slice());
    let data = bytes.as_mut_ptr();
    let length = bytes.len();

    ContentBlockerString { data, length }
}

fn for_each_selector_list_item(selector: &str, mut callback: impl FnMut(&str)) {
    let mut start = 0;
    let mut parenthesis_depth: u32 = 0;
    let mut bracket_depth: u32 = 0;
    let mut quote = None;
    let mut escaped = false;

    for (index, character) in selector.char_indices() {
        if escaped {
            escaped = false;
            continue;
        }

        if character == '\\' {
            escaped = true;
            continue;
        }

        if let Some(quote_character) = quote {
            if character == quote_character {
                quote = None;
            }
            continue;
        }

        match character {
            '"' | '\'' => quote = Some(character),
            '(' => parenthesis_depth += 1,
            ')' => parenthesis_depth = parenthesis_depth.saturating_sub(1),
            '[' => bracket_depth += 1,
            ']' => bracket_depth = bracket_depth.saturating_sub(1),
            ',' if parenthesis_depth == 0 && bracket_depth == 0 => {
                callback(&selector[start..index]);
                start = index + character.len_utf8();
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    callback(&selector[start..]);
}

fn selector_key_from_start(selector: &str) -> Option<SelectorKey> {
    let selector = selector.trim_start();
    let marker = selector.chars().next()?;
    if marker != '.' && marker != '#' {
        return None;
    }

    let mut end = marker.len_utf8();
    for (offset, character) in selector[end..].char_indices() {
        if character == '\\' {
            return None;
        }
        if !character.is_alphanumeric() && character != '_' && character != '-' {
            break;
        }
        end = marker.len_utf8() + offset + character.len_utf8();
    }

    if end == marker.len_utf8() {
        return None;
    }

    let key = selector[marker.len_utf8()..end].to_string();
    match marker {
        '.' => Some(SelectorKey::Class(key)),
        '#' => Some(SelectorKey::Id(key)),
        _ => None,
    }
}

impl GenericSelectorListRules {
    fn from_rules(rules: &str) -> Self {
        let mut selector_list_rules = Self::default();

        for line in rules.lines() {
            let trimmed_line = line.trim();
            if trimmed_line.is_empty() || trimmed_line.starts_with('!') || trimmed_line.starts_with('[') {
                continue;
            }

            let Ok(filter) = adblock::filters::cosmetic::CosmeticFilter::parse(
                trimmed_line,
                false,
                adblock::resources::PermissionMask::default(),
            ) else {
                continue;
            };

            let generic_filter = if filter.has_hostname_constraint() {
                filter.hidden_generic_rule()
            } else {
                Some(filter)
            };

            let Some(generic_filter) = generic_filter else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some(selector) = generic_filter.plain_css_selector() else {
                continue;
            };
            selector_list_rules.add_selector(selector);
        }

        selector_list_rules
    }

    fn add_selector(&mut self, selector: &str) {
        let mut selector_list_item_count = 0;
        let mut has_unkeyable_item = false;
        let mut class_keys = HashSet::new();
        let mut id_keys = HashSet::new();
        for_each_selector_list_item(selector, |selector_list_item| {
            selector_list_item_count += 1;

            match selector_key_from_start(selector_list_item) {
                Some(SelectorKey::Class(class)) => {
                    class_keys.insert(class);
                }
                Some(SelectorKey::Id(id)) => {
                    id_keys.insert(id);
                }
                None => has_unkeyable_item = true,
            }
        });

        if selector_list_item_count < 2 {
            return;
        }

        let selector = selector.to_string();
        if has_unkeyable_item {
            self.always_needed.insert(selector);
            return;
        }

        for class in class_keys {
            self.by_class.entry(class).or_default().push(selector.clone());
        }
        for id in id_keys {
            self.by_id.entry(id).or_default().push(selector.clone());
        }
    }

    fn hidden_selectors(
        &self,
        classes: impl IntoIterator<Item = impl AsRef<str>>,
        ids: impl IntoIterator<Item = impl AsRef<str>>,
        exceptions: &HashSet<String>,
    ) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut selectors: Vec<_> = self
            .always_needed
            .iter()
            .filter(|selector| !exceptions.contains(*selector))
            .cloned()
            .collect();

        for class in classes {
            if let Some(class_selectors) = self.by_class.get(class.as_ref()) {
                selectors.extend(
                    class_selectors
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|selector| !exceptions.contains(*selector))
                        .cloned(),
                );
            }
        }

        for id in ids {
            if let Some(id_selectors) = self.by_id.get(id.as_ref()) {
                selectors.extend(
                    id_selectors
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|selector| !exceptions.contains(*selector))
                        .cloned(),
                );
            }
        }

        selectors
    }

    fn has_hidden_selectors_for_class_or_id(
        &self,
        classes: impl IntoIterator<Item = impl AsRef<str>>,
        ids: impl IntoIterator<Item = impl AsRef<str>>,
        exceptions: &HashSet<String>,
    ) -> bool {
        for class in classes {
            if let Some(class_selectors) = self.by_class.get(class.as_ref())
                && class_selectors.iter().any(|selector| !exceptions.contains(selector))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        for id in ids {
            if let Some(id_selectors) = self.by_id.get(id.as_ref())
                && id_selectors.iter().any(|selector| !exceptions.contains(selector))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        false
    }
}

fn cosmetic_css_for_url(engine: &ContentBlockerEngine, url: &str, classes: &[&str], ids: &[&str]) -> String {
    let resources = engine.engine.url_cosmetic_resources(url);
    let mut selectors = resources.hide_selectors;

    if !resources.generichide {
        selectors.extend(engine.engine.hidden_class_id_selectors(
            classes.iter().copied(),
            ids.iter().copied(),
            &resources.exceptions,
        ));
        selectors.extend(engine.generic_selector_list_rules.hidden_selectors(
            classes.iter().copied(),
            ids.iter().copied(),
            &resources.exceptions,
        ));
    }

    let mut selector_styles: Vec<_> = selectors
        .into_iter()
        .map(|selector| (selector, "display: none !important".to_string()))
        .collect();

    for action in resources.procedural_actions {
        let Ok(filter) = serde_json::from_str::<adblock::cosmetic_filter_cache::ProceduralOrActionFilter>(&action)
        else {
            continue;
        };
        if let Some((selector, style)) = filter.as_css() {
            selector_styles.push((selector, style));
        }
    }

    selector_styles.sort_unstable();
    selector_styles.dedup();

    let mut css = String::new();
    for (selector, style) in selector_styles {
        css.push_str(&selector);
        css.push_str(" { ");
        css.push_str(&style);
        if !style.trim_end().ends_with(';') {
            css.push(';');
        }
        css.push_str(" }\n");
    }
    css
}

fn has_generic_cosmetic_selectors_for_url(
    engine: &ContentBlockerEngine,
    url: &str,
    classes: &[&str],
    ids: &[&str],
) -> bool {
    let resources = engine.engine.url_cosmetic_resources(url);
    if resources.generichide {
        return false;
    }

    !engine
        .engine
        .hidden_class_id_selectors(classes.iter().copied(), ids.iter().copied(), &resources.exceptions)
        .is_empty()
        || engine.generic_selector_list_rules.has_hidden_selectors_for_class_or_id(
            classes.iter().copied(),
            ids.iter().copied(),
            &resources.exceptions,
        )
}

/// An engine for `rules`, which C++ frees with `rust_content_blocker_free`, or null where the rules are not UTF-8.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_content_blocker_create(rules: ak::Span<'_, u8>) -> *mut ContentBlockerEngine {
    abort_on_panic(|| {
        let Some(rules) = as_str(rules) else {
            return std::ptr::null_mut();
        };

        let mut filter_set = adblock::lists::FilterSet::new(false);
        filter_set.add_filter_list(rules.to_string(), adblock::lists::ParseOptions::default());
        let engine = adblock::engine::Engine::new_with_filter_set(filter_set);
        let generic_selector_list_rules = GenericSelectorListRules::from_rules(rules);
        let engine = ContentBlockerEngine {
            engine,
            generic_selector_list_rules,
        };
        Box::into_raw(Box::new(engine))
    })
}

/// # Safety
/// - `engine` must be null or a valid pointer returned by `rust_content_blocker_create`
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_content_blocker_free(engine: *mut ContentBlockerEngine) {
    abort_on_panic(|| {
        if !engine.is_null() {
            drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(engine) });
        }
    });
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_content_blocker_matches(
    engine: Option<&ContentBlockerEngine>,
    url: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    source_url: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    request_type: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
) -> bool {
    abort_on_panic(|| {
        let Some(engine) = engine else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(url) = as_str(url) else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(source_url) = as_str(source_url) else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(request_type) = as_str(request_type) else {
            return false;
        };

        // The content blocker interface does not currently provide the request method.
        let Ok(request) = adblock::request::Request::new(url, source_url, request_type, "") else {
            return false;
        };

        engine.engine.check_network_request(&request).should_block()
    })
}

/// C++ frees the returned string with `rust_content_blocker_free_string`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_content_blocker_cosmetic_css(
    engine: Option<&ContentBlockerEngine>,
    url: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    classes: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    ids: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
) -> ContentBlockerString {
    abort_on_panic(|| {
        let Some(engine) = engine else {
            return string_to_ffi(String::new());
        };
        let Some(url) = as_str(url) else {
            return string_to_ffi(String::new());
        };
        let Some(classes) = as_str(classes) else {
            return string_to_ffi(String::new());
        };
        let Some(ids) = as_str(ids) else {
            return string_to_ffi(String::new());
        };

        let classes: Vec<_> = classes.lines().collect();
        let ids: Vec<_> = ids.lines().collect();
        string_to_ffi(cosmetic_css_for_url(engine, url, &classes, &ids))
    })
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_content_blocker_has_generic_cosmetic_selectors(
    engine: Option<&ContentBlockerEngine>,
    url: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    classes: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    ids: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
) -> bool {
    abort_on_panic(|| {
        let Some(engine) = engine else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(url) = as_str(url) else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(classes) = as_str(classes) else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(ids) = as_str(ids) else {
            return false;
        };

        let classes: Vec<_> = classes.lines().collect();
        let ids: Vec<_> = ids.lines().collect();
        has_generic_cosmetic_selectors_for_url(engine, url, &classes, &ids)
    })
}

/// # Safety
/// - `data` and `length` must match a string returned by `rust_content_blocker_cosmetic_css`
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_content_blocker_free_string(data: *mut u8, length: usize) {
    abort_on_panic(|| {
        if !data.is_null() {
            drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(std::ptr::slice_from_raw_parts_mut(data, length)) });
        }
    });
}
