    struct InheritedUIValues : ComputedValuesFFI::InheritedUIValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::InheritedUIValues);

        // An auto caret-color holds `currentcolor`, so it resolves to the element's color too.
        Color caret_color_value(Color current_color) const { return resolve_style_color(caret_color.color, current_color); }
        ReadonlySpan<ComputedValuesFFI::ComputedCursor> cursor_span() const { return { cursor.pointer, cursor.length }; }
        static RefPtr<CursorStyleValue const> cursor_style_value(ComputedValuesFFI::ComputedCursor const& value)
        {
            if (!value.is_cursor_value)
                return nullptr;
            auto style_value = StyleValue::adopt_rust_style_value_data(StyleValueFFI::rust_style_value_retain(
                static_cast<StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData const*>(value.cursor.pointer)));
            return style_value->as_cursor();
        }
        PreferredColorScheme color_scheme_value() const { return static_cast<PreferredColorScheme>(color_scheme); }
        ReadonlySpan<Utf16FlyString> color_schemes_span() const
        {
            static_assert(sizeof(Utf16FlyString) == sizeof(size_t));
            static_assert(alignof(Utf16FlyString) == alignof(size_t));
            return { reinterpret_cast<Utf16FlyString const*>(color_schemes.pointer), color_schemes.length };
        }
    };

    struct InheritedSVGValues : ComputedValuesFFI::InheritedSVGValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::InheritedSVGValues);

        // The paint server a fill or stroke names by URL, if it does.
        static Optional<URL> paint_url_value(ComputedValuesFFI::ComputedSvgPaint const& paint)
        {
            if (paint.kind != 2)
                return {};
            auto const* url = static_cast<StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData const*>(paint.url.pointer);
            VERIFY(url && url->tag == StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData::Tag::Url);
            return url_from_rust_data(url->url._0->url, url->url._0->url_type, url->url._0->modifiers);
        }

        Optional<URL> fill_url_value() const { return paint_url_value(fill); }
        Optional<URL> stroke_url_value() const { return paint_url_value(stroke); }
        ColorInterpolation color_interpolation_value() const { return static_cast<ColorInterpolation>(color_interpolation); }
        ColorInterpolation color_interpolation_filters_value() const { return static_cast<ColorInterpolation>(color_interpolation_filters); }
    };

    struct InheritedTextValues : ComputedValuesFFI::InheritedTextValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::InheritedTextValues);

        CSSPixels letter_spacing_value() const { return letter_spacing; }
        Color color_value() const { return Color::from_bgra(color); }
        Color webkit_text_fill_color_value() const { return Color::from_bgra(webkit_text_fill_color); }
        ReadonlySpan<ShadowData> text_shadow_span() const
        {
            static_assert(sizeof(ShadowData) == sizeof(ComputedValuesFFI::ComputedShadow));
            return { reinterpret_cast<ShadowData const*>(text_shadow.pointer), text_shadow.length };
        }
    };

    // Rust owns the canonical font values and the derived layout-facing facts.
    // The payload holds its own reference to the platform font cascade list.
    struct FontValues : ComputedValuesFFI::FontValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::FontValues);

        WEB_API Gfx::FontCascadeList const& font_list_value() const;
        FontStyleKeyword font_style_keyword() const;
        CSSPixels line_height_used_value() const { return CSSPixels::from_raw(ComputedValuesFFI::rust_font_values_line_height_used_raw(this)); }
        double font_size_for_lengths() const { return ComputedValuesFFI::rust_font_values_font_size_for_lengths(this); }
    };

        StyleStructRef<InheritedListTableValues> list_table;

    };

    InheritedValues m_inherited;

    private:

        {
            static_assert(sizeof(Utf16FlyString) == sizeof(size_t));
            static_assert(alignof(Utf16FlyString) == alignof(size_t));
            return { reinterpret_cast<Utf16FlyString const*>(values.pointer), values.length };

    };

    struct EffectsValues : ComputedValuesFFI::EffectsValues {

        ComputedFilterView backdrop_filter_value() const { return ComputedFilterView { backdrop_filter }; }

        ReadonlySpan<ShadowData> box_shadow_span() const
        {
            static_assert(sizeof(ShadowData) == sizeof(ComputedValuesFFI::ComputedShadow));

    struct MaskValues : ComputedValuesFFI::MaskValues {

        // The mask layer the first mask-image names by URL, if it does.

        }

    struct ContentValues : ComputedValuesFFI::ContentValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::ContentValues);

        NonnullRefPtr<StyleValue const> computed_content_value() const;
        bool content_is_normal() const;
    };

    struct TransformValues : public ComputedValuesFFI::TransformValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::TransformValues);

        static RefPtr<StyleValue const> style_value(ComputedValuesFFI::ComputedStyleValueHandle const& handle)
        {
            if (!handle.pointer)
                return nullptr;
            return StyleValue::adopt_rust_style_value_data(StyleValueFFI::rust_style_value_retain(
                static_cast<StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData const*>(handle.pointer)));
        }

        bool has_transformations() const { return transformations.pointer; }
        template<typename Callback>
        void for_each_transformation(Callback callback) const
        {
            auto value = style_value(transformations);
            if (!value)
                return;
            for (auto const& transformation : transformations_for_style_value(*value))
                callback(*transformation);
        }

        template<typename Callback>
        void for_each_resolved_transform(Callback callback) const
        {
            for (size_t index = 0; index < resolved_transforms.length; ++index) {
                auto const& entry = resolved_transforms.pointer[index];
                if (entry.is_translate) {
                    callback(ResolvedTransform { ResolvedTransform::Translate {
                        .x = { .px = entry.x_px, .percentage_value = style_value(entry.x_percentage) },
                        .y = { .px = entry.y_px, .percentage_value = style_value(entry.y_percentage) },
                        .z = entry.z_px,
                    } });
                    continue;
                }
                auto const& matrix = entry.matrix;
                callback(ResolvedTransform { FloatMatrix4x4(
                    matrix[0], matrix[1], matrix[2], matrix[3],
                    matrix[4], matrix[5], matrix[6], matrix[7],
                    matrix[8], matrix[9], matrix[10], matrix[11],
                    matrix[12], matrix[13], matrix[14], matrix[15]) });
            }
        }

        TransformOrigin transform_origin_value() const
        {
            return {
                LengthPercentage::view(transform_origin_x),
                LengthPercentage::view(transform_origin_y),
                LengthPercentage::view(transform_origin_z),
            };
        }
        TransformStyle transform_style_value() const { return static_cast<TransformStyle>(transform_style); }
        RefPtr<TransformationStyleValue const> rotate_value() const { return transformation_value(rotate); }
        RefPtr<TransformationStyleValue const> translate_value() const { return transformation_value(translate); }
        RefPtr<TransformationStyleValue const> scale_value() const { return transformation_value(scale); }
        Optional<CSSPixels> perspective_value() const
        {
            if (!has_perspective)
                return {};
            return CSSPixels::from_raw(perspective_px);
        }

    private:
        static RefPtr<TransformationStyleValue const> transformation_value(ComputedValuesFFI::ComputedStyleValueHandle const& handle)
        {
            auto value = style_value(handle);
            if (!value)
                return nullptr;
            return value->as_transformation();
        }
    };

    struct BackgroundValues : ComputedValuesFFI::BackgroundValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::BackgroundValues);

        Color background_color_value(Color current_color) const { return resolve_style_color(background_color, current_color); }

        BorderData border_right_value(Color current_color) const { return side(border_right, current_color); }
        BorderData border_bottom_value(Color current_color) const { return side(border_bottom, current_color); }

        static BorderData side(ComputedValuesFFI::ComputedBorderSide const& side, Color current_color)
        {
            return { resolve_style_color(side.color, current_color), static_cast<LineStyle>(side.line_style), bit_cast<CSSPixels>(side.width) };
        }
        RefPtr<AbstractImageStyleValue const> border_image_source_value() const;
    };

    struct AlignmentValues : ComputedValuesFFI::AlignmentValues {

    };

    struct SizingValues : ComputedValuesFFI::SizingValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::SizingValues);
    };

    struct SurroundValues : ComputedValuesFFI::SurroundValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::SurroundValues);
    };

    struct BoxValues : ComputedValuesFFI::BoxValues {
        static constexpr size_t style_group_index = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::BoxValues);
    };

        NonInheritedValues() = default;

        StyleStructRef<AnimationValues> animation;
        StyleStructRef<BoxValues> box;
        // The properties that do not inherit held as bits in the style's root.
        ComputedValuesFFI::ResetBits reset_bits {};
        StyleStructRef<SurroundValues> surround;
        StyleStructRef<SizingValues> sizing;
        StyleStructRef<MiscLayoutValues> misc_layout;
        StyleStructRef<MiscInteractionValues> misc_interaction;

    };

    NonInheritedValues m_noninherited;
    mutable OwnPtr<HashMap<PropertyID, NonnullRefPtr<StyleValue const>>> m_style_value_cache;
    // The style record the values are a view of, or a copy of a view of, which they keep alive
    // and read their longhands from.
    StyleRecordRef m_record;
    RefPtr<ComputedValues const> m_base_values;
    ComputedValues const* m_borrowed_base_values { nullptr };
    RefPtr<AnimatedProperties const> m_animated_properties;
    bool m_depends_on_viewport_metrics { false };
    bool m_font_metrics_depend_on_viewport_metrics { false };
    bool m_in_display_none_subtree { false };
};

// Reads one group of the style whose groups `record` points at: a style record's, or a style layout
// made of its own. This is the only place C++ knows how a style finds a group: the groups from
// ROOT_START on are in the style's root, and a pointer to each of its group sets follows them.
template<size_t index>
void const* style_record_group_payload(ComputedValuesFFI::StyleRecordGroups const* record)
{
    VERIFY(record);
    auto const* slots = reinterpret_cast<void const* const*>(record);
    constexpr auto root_count = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::Count) - ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_ROOT_START;
    if constexpr (index >= ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_ROOT_START)
        return slots[index - ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_ROOT_START];
    else if constexpr (index >= ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_VISUAL_SET_START)
        return static_cast<void const* const*>(slots[root_count + 2])[index - ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_VISUAL_SET_START];
    else if constexpr (index >= ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_RARE_SET_START)
        return static_cast<void const* const*>(slots[root_count + 1])[index - ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_RARE_SET_START];
    else
        return static_cast<void const* const*>(slots[root_count])[index];
}

// Reads what the inherited set of the style whose groups `record` points at holds beside its
// groups, which follow them in the set.
inline ComputedValuesFFI::InheritedSetValues const& style_record_inherited_values(ComputedValuesFFI::StyleRecordGroups const* record)
{
    VERIFY(record);
    auto const* slots = reinterpret_cast<void const* const*>(record);
    constexpr auto root_count = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::Count) - ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_ROOT_START;
    auto const* inherited_set = static_cast<void const* const*>(slots[root_count]);
    return *reinterpret_cast<ComputedValuesFFI::InheritedSetValues const*>(inherited_set + ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_RARE_SET_START);
}

// Reads the reset bits of the style whose groups `record` points at, which follow its set pointers.
inline ComputedValuesFFI::ResetBits style_record_reset_bits(ComputedValuesFFI::StyleRecordGroups const* record)
{
    VERIFY(record);
    auto const* slots = reinterpret_cast<void const* const*>(record);
    constexpr auto root_count = to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::Count) - ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_ROOT_START;
    return *reinterpret_cast<ComputedValuesFFI::ResetBits const*>(slots + root_count + 3);
}

// The groups of a style, laid out as a style record's are, over `payloads`, one per group in group
// order, with `values` beside the inherited ones and `reset` after the set pointers, for a reader of
// a style record's groups to read a style no record holds. It counts no reference, and `payloads`
// must outlive it.
struct StyleRecordGroupsOverPayloads {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(StyleRecordGroupsOverPayloads);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(StyleRecordGroupsOverPayloads);

public:
    StyleRecordGroupsOverPayloads(Array<void const*, to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::Count)> const& payloads, ComputedValuesFFI::InheritedSetValues values, ComputedValuesFFI::ResetBits reset)
        : root { payloads[ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_ROOT_START], payloads[ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_ROOT_START + 1], payloads[ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_ROOT_START + 2] }
        , inherited(inherited_set.groups)
        , rare(payloads.data() + ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_RARE_SET_START)
        , visual(payloads.data() + ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_VISUAL_SET_START)
        , reset(reset)
    {
        static_assert(to_underlying(StyleGroupIndex::Count) - ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_ROOT_START == 3);
        for (size_t index = 0; index < ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_RARE_SET_START; ++index)
            inherited_set.groups[index] = payloads[index];
        inherited_set.values = values;
    }

    void const* root[3];
    void const* const* inherited;
    void const* const* rare;
    void const* const* visual;
    ComputedValuesFFI::ResetBits reset;

private:
    // Laid out as a style's inherited set is: its groups, then what it holds beside them, with no
    // custom properties.
    struct {
        void const* groups[ComputedValuesFFI::STYLE_GROUP_RARE_SET_START];
        ComputedValuesFFI::InheritedSetValues values;
        void const* custom_properties { nullptr };
    } inherited_set;
};

template<typename StyleGroup>
StyleGroup const& style_record_group(ComputedValuesFFI::StyleRecordGroups const* record)
{
    auto const* payload = style_record_group_payload<StyleGroup::style_group_index>(record);
    VERIFY(payload);
    return *static_cast<StyleGroup const*>(payload);
}

// A synchronous, allocation-free compatibility surface over the payloads of
// one authoritative StyleRecord. It owns no group or metadata payload.
class WEB_API ComputedStyleRecordView {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(ComputedStyleRecordView);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(ComputedStyleRecordView);

public:
    ComputedStyleRecordView() = default;
    // Holds `style`, which must be present, for as long as the view reads it.
    explicit ComputedStyleRecordView(InstalledStyle style);
    ~ComputedStyleRecordView();

    explicit operator bool() const { return m_values.has_value(); }
    ComputedValues const* operator->() const
    {
        if (!m_values.has_value())
            return nullptr;
        return &*m_values;
    }
    ComputedValues const& operator*() const { return m_values.value(); }

private:
    Optional<ComputedValues> m_base_values;
    // NB: Only a present view builds its values, so a view of no record costs nothing to make.
    Optional<ComputedValues> m_values;
    InstalledStyle m_style;
};

}

#include "ContainerQuery.h"
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <LibWeb/Dump.h>

namespace Web::CSS {

NonnullRefPtr<ContainerConditions> ContainerConditions::create(Parser::ValueParserFFI::ContainerConditionsData const* data)
{
    return adopt_ref(*new ContainerConditions(data));
}

ContainerConditions::ContainerConditions(Parser::ValueParserFFI::ContainerConditionsData const* data)
    : m_data(Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_container_conditions_retain(data))
{
    VERIFY(m_data);
}

ContainerConditions::~ContainerConditions()
{
    Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_container_conditions_release(m_data);
}

Vector<ContainerConditions::Condition> const& ContainerConditions::entries() const
{
    if (!m_entries.has_value()) {
        Vector<Condition> entries;
        auto count = Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_container_conditions_count(m_data);
        entries.ensure_capacity(count);
        for (size_t index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
            auto name = Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_container_conditions_name(m_data, index);
            auto const* query = Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_container_conditions_query(m_data, index);
            Condition condition;
            // A container name is a nonempty custom identifier; an empty view means it is absent.
            if (name.length)
                condition.container_name = Utf16FlyString::from_utf16({ reinterpret_cast<char16_t const*>(name.utf16), name.length });
            if (query)
                condition.container_query = ContainerQuery::create(RustQueryHandle::retained(query));
            entries.unchecked_append(move(condition));
        }
        m_entries = move(entries);
    }
    return *m_entries;
}

NonnullRefPtr<ContainerQuery> ContainerQuery::create(RustQueryHandle handle)
{
    return adopt_ref(*new ContainerQuery(move(handle)));
}

ContainerQuery::ContainerQuery(RustQueryHandle handle)
    : m_rust_query_handle(move(handle))
{
}

Utf16String ContainerQuery::to_string() const
{
    Utf16String serialized;
    auto set_serialized_query = [](void* context, u16 const* code_units, size_t length) {
        *static_cast<Utf16String*>(context) = Utf16String::from_utf16({ reinterpret_cast<char16_t const*>(code_units), length });
    };
    VERIFY(Parser::ValueParserFFI::css_query_serialize_condition(m_rust_query_handle.data(), &serialized, set_serialized_query));
    return serialized;
}

}

bool innermost_list_item_counter_is_own_forward_counter(DOM::Element const& element)
{
    // A layout tree build resolves the element's counters from the style it has installed.
    auto const& style = element.installed_style();
    if (!style)

    return Layout::RustFFI::style_resets_forward_list_item_counter(style.view().groups);
}

    return *name;
}

static DOM::Document& document_from_abi(void* document)
{
    return *static_cast<DOM::Document*>(static_cast<GC::Cell*>(document));
}

static StyleValueData const* into_rust(RefPtr<StyleValue const> const& value)
{
    return value ? StyleValueFFI::rust_style_value_retain(value->rust_style_value_data()) : nullptr;
}

void* web_css_namespace_highlight_registry(void* document)
{
    return document_from_abi(document).highlight_registry().ptr();
}

bool web_css_namespace_is_registered(void* document, FlatPtr name)
{
    return document_from_abi(document).registered_property_set().contains(Utf16FlyString { Utf16String::adopt_raw(name) });
}

StyleValueData const* web_css_namespace_parse_initial_value_descriptor(void* document, FlatPtr value)
{
    Parser::ParsingParams parsing_params { document_from_abi(document) };
    return into_rust(parse_css_descriptor(parsing_params, AtRuleID::Property, DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::InitialValue), Utf16String::adopt_raw(value)));
}

StyleValueData const* web_css_namespace_parse_with_a_syntax(void* document, FlatPtr value, void const* syntax)
{
    Parser::ParsingParams parsing_params { document_from_abi(document) };
    Parser::RustSyntaxHandle handle { Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_syntax_retain(syntax) };
    return into_rust(Parser::parse_with_a_syntax(parsing_params, Utf16String::adopt_raw(value), handle));
}

void web_css_namespace_register(void* raw_document, FlatPtr name, void const* syntax, bool inherits, StyleValueData const* initial_value)
{
    auto& document = document_from_abi(raw_document);
    CustomPropertyRegistration registered_property {
        .property_name = Utf16FlyString { Utf16String::adopt_raw(name) },
        .syntax = Parser::RustSyntaxHandle { syntax },
        .inherit = inherits,
        .initial_value = initial_value ? RefPtr<StyleValue const> { StyleValue::adopt_rust_style_value_data(initial_value) } : nullptr,
    };
    document.registered_property_set().set(registered_property.property_name, move(registered_property));
    document.did_change_custom_property_registrations();

    // NB: An @property rule reaches the style engine as a rule of its own. CSS.registerProperty() has no rule, so tell
    //     the engine directly.
    StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_record_custom_property_registration_change(document.style_computer().style_engine().host());
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-length
size_t CSSDescriptors::length() const
{

    return m_descriptors.size();
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-item
Utf16String CSSDescriptors::item(size_t index) const
{
    // The item(index) method must return the property name of the CSS declaration at position index.
    // If there is no indexth object in the collection, then the method must return the empty string.
    return m_descriptors.item(index);
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#set-a-css-declaration
bool CSSDescriptors::set_a_css_declaration(DescriptorNameAndID const& descriptor_name_and_id, NonnullRefPtr<StyleValue const> value, Important)
{
    VERIFY(!is_computed());

    prepare_to_update_style_attribute();
    return m_descriptors.set(descriptor_name_and_id, *value);
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-setproperty
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> CSSDescriptors::set_property(Utf16FlyString const& property, Utf16View value, Utf16View priority)
{
    TRY(set_property_internal(property, value, priority));

    if (m_at_rule_id == AtRuleID::FontFace && !value.is_empty()) {
        if (auto* font_face_rule = as_if<CSSFontFaceRule>(parent_rule().ptr()))
            font_face_rule->handle_descriptor_change(property);
    }

    return {};
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-setproperty
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> CSSDescriptors::set_property_internal(Utf16FlyString const& property, Utf16View value, Utf16View priority)
{
    // 1. If the readonly flag is set, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError exception.
    if (is_readonly())
        return WebIDL::NoModificationAllowedError::create("Cannot modify properties of readonly CSSStyleDeclaration"_utf16);

    // 2. If property is not a custom property, follow these substeps:
    Optional<DescriptorNameAndID> descriptor_name_and_id;
    {
        // 1. Let property be property converted to ASCII lowercase.
        // 2. If property is not a case-sensitive match for a supported CSS property, then return.
        descriptor_name_and_id = DescriptorNameAndID::from_name(m_at_rule_id, property);
        if (!descriptor_name_and_id.has_value())
            return {};
    }

    // 3. If value is the empty string, invoke removeProperty() with property as argument and return.
    if (value.is_empty()) {
        auto removed_value = MUST(remove_property(property));
        (void)removed_value;
        return {};
    }

    // 4. If priority is not the empty string and is not an ASCII case-insensitive match for the string "important", then return.
    if (!priority.is_empty() && !priority.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(u"important"sv))
        return {};

    // 5. Let component value list be the result of parsing value for property property.
    RefPtr<StyleValue const> component_value_list = parse_css_descriptor(Parser::ParsingParams {}, m_at_rule_id, *descriptor_name_and_id, value);

    // 6. If component value list is null, then return.
    if (!component_value_list)
        return {};

    // 7. Let updated be false.
    auto updated = false;

    // 8. If property is a shorthand property, then for each longhand property longhand that property maps to, in canonical order, follow these substeps:
    if (is_shorthand(m_at_rule_id, *descriptor_name_and_id)) {
        for_each_expanded_longhand(m_at_rule_id, *descriptor_name_and_id, component_value_list, [this, &updated, priority](DescriptorNameAndID const& longhand_name_and_id, auto longhand_value) {
            VERIFY(longhand_value);

            // 1. Let longhand result be the result of set the CSS declaration longhand with the appropriate value(s)
            //    from component value list, with the important flag set if priority is not the empty string, and unset
            //    otherwise, and with the list of declarations being the declarations.
            auto longhand_result = set_a_css_declaration(longhand_name_and_id, longhand_value.release_nonnull(), priority.is_empty() ? Important::No : Important::Yes);

            // 2. If longhand result is true, let updated be true.
            if (longhand_result)
                updated = true;
        });
    }
    // 9. Otherwise, let updated be the result of set the CSS declaration property with value component value list,
    //    with the important flag set if priority is not the empty string, and unset otherwise, and with the list of
    //    declarations being the declarations.
    else {
        updated = set_a_css_declaration(*descriptor_name_and_id, *component_value_list, !priority.is_empty() ? Important::Yes : Important::No);
    }

    // 10. If updated is true, update style attribute for the CSS declaration block.
    if (updated) {
        update_style_attribute();
        invalidate_owners();
    }

    return {};
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-removeproperty
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Utf16String> CSSDescriptors::remove_property(Utf16FlyString const& property)
{
    // 1. If the readonly flag is set, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError exception.
    if (is_readonly())
        return WebIDL::NoModificationAllowedError::create("Cannot modify properties of readonly CSSStyleDeclaration"_utf16);

    if (!property.is_ascii())
        return Utf16String {};

    // 2. If property is not a custom property, let property be property converted to ASCII lowercase.
    // AD-HOC: We compare names case-insensitively instead.

    // 3. Let value be the return value of invoking getPropertyValue() with property as argument.
    auto value = get_property_value(property);

    // 4. Let removed be false.
    bool removed = false;
    auto descriptor_name_and_id = DescriptorNameAndID::from_name(m_at_rule_id, property);
    prepare_to_update_style_attribute();

    // 5. If property is a shorthand property, for each longhand property longhand that property maps to:
    if (descriptor_name_and_id.has_value() && is_shorthand(m_at_rule_id, *descriptor_name_and_id)) {
        for_each_expanded_longhand(m_at_rule_id, *descriptor_name_and_id, nullptr, [this, &removed](DescriptorNameAndID const& longhand_name_and_id, auto const&) {
            // 1. If longhand is not a property name of a CSS declaration in the declarations, continue.
            // 2. Remove that CSS declaration and let removed be true.
            if (m_descriptors.remove(longhand_name_and_id)) {
                removed = true;
            }
        });
    }
    // 6. Otherwise, if property is a case-sensitive match for a property name of a CSS declaration in the
    //    declarations, remove that CSS declaration and let removed be true.
    else if (descriptor_name_and_id.has_value()) {
        removed = m_descriptors.remove(*descriptor_name_and_id);
    }

    // 7. If removed is true, Update style attribute for the CSS declaration block.
    if (removed) {
        update_style_attribute();
        invalidate_owners();
    }

    if (removed && m_at_rule_id == AtRuleID::FontFace) {
        if (auto* font_face_rule = as_if<CSSFontFaceRule>(parent_rule().ptr()))
            font_face_rule->handle_descriptor_change(property);
    }

    // 8. Return value.
    return value;
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-getpropertyvalue
Utf16String CSSDescriptors::get_property_value(Utf16FlyString const& property) const
{
    // 1. If property is not a custom property, follow these substeps: ...
    // NB: These substeps only apply to shorthands, and descriptors cannot be shorthands.

    // 2. If property is a case-sensitive match for a property name of a CSS declaration in the declarations, then
    //    return the result of invoking serialize a CSS value of that declaration.
    auto descriptor_name_and_id = DescriptorNameAndID::from_name(m_at_rule_id, property);
    if (descriptor_name_and_id.has_value())
        return m_descriptors.property_value(*descriptor_name_and_id);

    // 3. Return the empty string.
    return {};
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-getpropertypriority
Utf16String CSSDescriptors::get_property_priority(Utf16FlyString const&) const
{
    // AD-HOC: It's not valid for descriptors to be !important.
    return {};
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-declaration-block
Utf16String CSSDescriptors::serialized() const
{
    return m_descriptors.serialized();
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-csstext
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> CSSDescriptors::set_css_text(Utf16View value)
{
    // 1. If the readonly flag is set, then throw a NoModificationAllowedError exception.
    if (is_readonly())
        return WebIDL::NoModificationAllowedError::create("Cannot modify properties of readonly CSSStyleDeclaration"_utf16);

    auto previous_src = m_at_rule_id == AtRuleID::FontFace ? get_property_value("src"_utf16_fly_string) : Utf16String {};

    // 2. Empty the declarations.
    prepare_to_update_style_attribute();
    m_descriptors.replace(RustDescriptorBlock { Vector<Descriptor> {} });

    // 3. Parse the given value and, if the return value is not the empty list, insert the items in the list into the
    //    declarations, in specified order.
    auto descriptors = parse_css_descriptor_declaration_block(Parser::ParsingParams {}, m_at_rule_id, value);
    if (descriptors.size() > 0)
        m_descriptors.replace(descriptors);

    // 4. Update style attribute for the CSS declaration block.
    update_style_attribute();
    invalidate_owners();
    if (auto rule = parent_rule(); rule && rule->type() == CSSRule::Type::FontFace)
        static_cast<CSSFontFaceRule&>(*rule).handle_descriptor_block_change(previous_src != get_property_value("src"_utf16_fly_string));

    return {};
}

RefPtr<StyleValue const> CSSDescriptors::descriptor(DescriptorNameAndID const& descriptor_name_and_id) const
{
    return m_descriptors.descriptor(descriptor_name_and_id);
}

void CSSDescriptors::invalidate_owners()
{
    auto rule = parent_rule();
    if (!rule || rule->type() != CSSRule::Type::FunctionDeclarations)
        return;
    if (auto* sheet = rule->parent_style_sheet()) {
        record_style_rule_declarations_changed(*rule);
        sheet->invalidate_owners();
    }
}

RefPtr<StyleValue const> CSSDescriptors::descriptor_or_initial_value(DescriptorNameAndID const& descriptor_name_and_id) const
{
    return m_descriptors.descriptor_or_initial_value(m_at_rule_id, descriptor_name_and_id);
}

bool is_shorthand(AtRuleID at_rule, DescriptorNameAndID const& descriptor)
{
    if (at_rule == AtRuleID::Page && descriptor.id() == DescriptorID::Margin)
        return true;

    return false;
}

void for_each_expanded_longhand(AtRuleID at_rule, DescriptorNameAndID const& descriptor, RefPtr<StyleValue const> value, Function<void(DescriptorNameAndID const&, RefPtr<StyleValue const>)> callback)
{
    if (at_rule == AtRuleID::Page && descriptor.id() == DescriptorID::Margin) {
        if (!value) {
            callback(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::MarginTop), nullptr);
            callback(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::MarginRight), nullptr);
            callback(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::MarginBottom), nullptr);
            callback(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::MarginLeft), nullptr);
            return;
        }

        auto const& shorthand_value = value->as_shorthand();

        callback(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::MarginTop), shorthand_value.longhand(PropertyID::MarginTop));
        callback(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::MarginRight), shorthand_value.longhand(PropertyID::MarginRight));
        callback(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::MarginBottom), shorthand_value.longhand(PropertyID::MarginBottom));
        callback(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::MarginLeft), shorthand_value.longhand(PropertyID::MarginLeft));
    }
}

}

namespace Web::CSS {

GC::Ref<CSSDescriptors> CSSFontFaceRule::descriptors() const
{
    return static_cast<CSSDescriptors&>(*declarations());
}

bool CSSFontFaceRule::is_valid() const
{
    // @font-face rules require a font-family and src descriptor; if either of these are missing, the @font-face rule
    // must not be considered when performing the font matching algorithm.
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#font-face-rule
    RustDescriptorBlock descriptors { Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_descriptor_block_retain(native_rule().payload().descriptors) };
    return !descriptors.descriptor(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::FontFamily)).is_null()
        && !descriptors.descriptor(DescriptorNameAndID::from_id(DescriptorID::Src)).is_null();
}

RefPtr<FontFaceState> CSSFontFaceRule::css_connected_font_face() const
{
    auto* sheet = parent_style_sheet();
    return sheet ? sheet->css_connected_font_face(native_rule().identity()) : nullptr;
}

void CSSFontFaceRule::handle_descriptor_change(Utf16FlyString const& property)
{
    auto descriptor_affects_font_matching = property.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("font-family"_utf16_fly_string)
        || property.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("font-weight"_utf16_fly_string)
        || property.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("font-style"_utf16_fly_string)
        || property.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("font-width"_utf16_fly_string)
        || property.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("font-stretch"_utf16_fly_string);

    handle_descriptor_change(property.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("src"_utf16_fly_string), descriptor_affects_font_matching);
}

void CSSFontFaceRule::handle_descriptor_block_change(bool src_changed)
{
    handle_descriptor_change(src_changed, true);
}

void CSSFontFaceRule::handle_descriptor_change(bool src_changed, bool affects_font_matching)
{
    auto font_face = css_connected_font_face();
    if (!font_face) {
        if (auto* style_sheet = parent_style_sheet())
            style_sheet->synchronize_fonts_after_rule_change();
        return;
    }

    if (!is_valid()) {
        disconnect_font_face();
        return;
    }

    if (src_changed) {
        handle_src_descriptor_change();
        return;
    }

    FontComputer* font_computer = nullptr;
    if (affects_font_matching) {
        if (auto document = parent_style_sheet() ? parent_style_sheet()->owning_document() : nullptr) {
            font_computer = &document->font_computer();
            font_computer->unregister_font_face(*font_face);
        }
    }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#font-face-css-connection
    // any change made to a @font-face descriptor is immediately reflected in the corresponding FontFace attribute
    font_face->reparse_connected_css_font_face_rule_descriptors();

    if (font_computer) {
        font_computer->register_font_face(*font_face);
        return;
    }

    // A descriptor that leaves the face's matching key alone, such as unicode-range or font-display, still changes
    // what selecting the face answers with, in ways a cascade's fonts alone do not show. Such an edit is rare, so every
    // cascade of the family goes.
    if (!font_face->should_be_registered_with_font_computer())
        return;
    if (auto document = parent_style_sheet() ? parent_style_sheet()->owning_document() : nullptr)
        document->font_computer().did_load_font(font_face->family_name());
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#font-face-css-connection
void CSSFontFaceRule::handle_src_descriptor_change()
{
    // If a @font-face rule has its src descriptor changed to a new value, the original connected FontFace object must
    // stop being CSS-connected. A new FontFace reflecting its new src must be created and CSS-connected to the
    // @font-face.

    if (!css_connected_font_face())
        return;

    disconnect_font_face();

    auto* style_sheet = parent_style_sheet();
    if (!style_sheet)
        return;

    auto document = style_sheet->owning_document();
    if (!document)
        return;

    auto new_font_face = FontFaceState::create_css_connected(HTML::relevant_realm(*document), native_rule().identity(), *style_sheet);
    document->fonts()->add_css_connected_font(new_font_face);
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#font-face-css-connection
// If a @font-face rule is removed from the document, its corresponding FontFace object is no longer CSS-connected.
// The connection is not restorable by any means (but adding the @font-face back to the stylesheet will create a
// brand new FontFace object which is CSS-connected).
void CSSFontFaceRule::disconnect_font_face()
{
    auto font_face = css_connected_font_face();
    if (!font_face)
        return;

    font_face->disconnect_from_css_rule();
}

}

#include <LibWeb/CSS/CSSFontFeatureValuesRule.h>

#include <LibWeb/CSS/StyleSheetState.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>

namespace Web::CSS {

Vector<Utf16FlyString> CSSFontFeatureValuesRule::font_families() const
{
    auto const* rule_values = &values();
    Vector<Utf16FlyString> families;
    auto count = Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_font_feature_values_family_count(rule_values);
    for (size_t index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        auto family = Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_font_feature_values_family_at(rule_values, index);
        families.append(Utf16FlyString::from_utf16({ reinterpret_cast<char16_t const*>(family.utf16), family.length }));
    }
    return families;
}

void CSSFontFeatureValuesRule::clear_caches()
{
    auto const* parent_style_sheet = this->parent_style_sheet();

    if (!parent_style_sheet)
        return;

    auto document = parent_style_sheet->owning_document();

    if (!document)
        return;

    for (auto const& family : font_families()) {
        document->font_computer().clear_computed_font_cache(family);
        document->font_computer().clear_font_feature_values_cache(family);
    }
}

}

CSSRuleList& CSSGroupingRule::css_rules() const
{
    return *static_cast<CSSRuleList*>(web_css_rule_child_rules(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), const_cast<CSSGroupingRule*>(this)));
}

static CSSRule& rule_from_cell(void* cell)
{
    return *static_cast<CSSRule*>(cell);
}

static Vector<Parser::RuleContext> rule_context(CSSRule& owner_rule)
{
    Vector<Parser::RuleContext> context;
    for (auto* rule = &owner_rule; rule; rule = rule->parent_rule())
        context.append(Parser::rule_context_type_for_rule(rule->type()));
    context.reverse();
    return context;
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#insert-a-css-rule
NativeRule const* web_css_grouping_rule_parse_rule(void* cell, FlatPtr raw_text, bool* declarations_failed)
{
    auto& owner_rule = rule_from_cell(cell);
    auto text = Utf16String::adopt_raw(raw_text);
    auto rule = text.utf16_view();

    // AD-HOC: The spec doesn't include a declared_namespaces parameter, but we need it to handle parsing of namespaced
    //         selectors.
    RustNamespaceContext declared_namespaces;
    if (auto* sheet = owner_rule.parent_style_sheet())
        declared_namespaces = sheet->declared_namespaces();

    // 3. Set new rule to the results of performing parse a CSS rule on argument rule.
    Parser::ParsingParams parsing_params {};
    parsing_params.rule_context = rule_context(owner_rule);
    parsing_params.declared_namespaces = declared_namespaces;
    auto new_rule = parse_css_rule(parsing_params, rule, true);
    if (!new_rule.has_value()) {
        auto trimmed_rule = rule.trim(" \t\n\f\r"sv, TrimMode::Left);
        if (trimmed_rule.starts_with("@import"sv) || trimmed_rule.starts_with("@namespace"sv)) {
            auto top_level_params = parsing_params;
            top_level_params.rule_context.clear();
            new_rule = parse_css_rule(top_level_params, rule);
        }
    }

    // 4. If new rule is a syntax error, and nested is set, perform the following substeps:
    if (!new_rule.has_value()) {
        // - Set declarations to the results of performing parse a CSS declaration block, on argument rule.
        auto declarations = parse_css_property_declaration_block(parsing_params, rule);

        // - If declarations is empty, throw a SyntaxError exception.
        if (declarations.is_empty()) {
            *declarations_failed = true;
            return nullptr;
        }

        // - Otherwise, set new rule to a new nested declarations rule with declarations as it contents.
        new_rule = RustRule { declarations };
    }

    return Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_rule_retain(new_rule->handle());
}

void web_css_grouping_rule_inserted(void* cell, NativeRule const* inserted)
{
    auto& rule = rule_from_cell(cell);
    auto* sheet = rule.parent_style_sheet();
    if (!sheet)
        return;
    if (auto* function = Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_rule_containing_function(rule.native_rule().handle()))
        record_style_rule_declarations_changed(RustRule { function }, *sheet);
    else
        record_style_rule_inserted(RustRule { inserted }, *sheet);
    sheet->invalidate_owners();
    sheet->synchronize_fonts_after_rule_change();
}

void web_css_grouping_rule_removed(void* cell, NativeRule const* removed)
{
    auto& rule = rule_from_cell(cell);
    auto* sheet = rule.parent_style_sheet();
    if (!sheet)
        return;
    if (auto* function = Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_rule_containing_function(rule.native_rule().handle()))
        record_style_rule_declarations_changed(RustRule { function }, *sheet);
    else
        record_style_rule_removed(*sheet, RustRule { removed });
    sheet->invalidate_owners();
    sheet->synchronize_fonts_after_rule_change();
}

}

public:
    CSSRuleList& css_rules() const;
};

template<>
inline bool CSSRule::fast_is<CSSGroupingRule>() const
{
    switch (type()) {
    case Type::Style:
    case Type::Media:
    case Type::Supports:
    case Type::Container:
    case Type::Scope:
    case Type::LayerBlock:
    case Type::Page:
    case Type::Function:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

namespace Web::CSS {

using Parser::ValueParserFFI::NativeRule;

// NB: What the implementation of CSSKeyframesRule in Rust asks of the C++ code of LibWeb.
extern "C" {
void web_css_keyframes_rule_changed(void* rule);
void web_css_keyframes_rule_will_rename(void* rule);
void web_css_keyframes_rule_renamed(void* rule);
NativeRule const* web_css_parse_keyframe_rule(FlatPtr text);
}

static CSSRule& rule_from_cell(void* cell)
{
    return *static_cast<CSSRule*>(cell);
}

void web_css_keyframes_rule_changed(void* cell)
{
    auto& rule = rule_from_cell(cell);
    record_style_rule_declarations_changed(rule);
    rule.parent_style_sheet()->invalidate_owners();
}

void web_css_keyframes_rule_will_rename(void* cell)
{
    record_style_rule_removed(rule_from_cell(cell));
}

void web_css_keyframes_rule_renamed(void* cell)
{
    auto& rule = rule_from_cell(cell);
    record_style_rule_inserted(rule);
    if (auto* sheet = rule.parent_style_sheet())
        sheet->invalidate_owners();
}

NativeRule const* web_css_parse_keyframe_rule(FlatPtr text)
{
    auto parsed_rule = Parser::parse_keyframe_rule(Parser::ParsingParams {}, Utf16String::adopt_raw(text));
    if (!parsed_rule.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    return Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_rule_retain(parsed_rule->handle());
}

}

#include "CSSNestedDeclarations.h"

namespace Web::CSS {

SelectorList CSSNestedDeclarations::absolutized_selectors() const
{
    return matching_selectors_for_rule(native_rule());
}

RustDeclarationBlock CSSNestedDeclarations::declaration() const
{
    return RustDeclarationBlock { Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_declaration_block_retain(native_rule().payload().declarations) };
}

GC::Ref<CSSStyleProperties> CSSNestedDeclarations::style() const
{
    return static_cast<CSSStyleProperties&>(*declarations());
}

CSSStyleRule const& CSSNestedDeclarations::parent_style_rule() const
{
    for (auto* parent = parent_rule(); parent; parent = parent->parent_rule()) {
        if (auto* style_rule = as_if<CSSStyleRule>(parent))
            return *style_rule;
    }

    dbgln("CSSNestedDeclarations has no parent style rule!");
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

}

#include <LibGC/Heap.h>

#include <LibWeb/CSS/PropertyNameAndID.h>

namespace Web::CSS {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(CSSPositionTryDescriptors);

GC::Ref<CSSPositionTryDescriptors> CSSPositionTryDescriptors::create(RustDeclarationBlock declarations)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<CSSPositionTryDescriptors>(move(declarations));
}

CSSPositionTryDescriptors::CSSPositionTryDescriptors(RustDeclarationBlock declarations)
    : CSSStyleProperties(Computed::No, Readonly::No, move(declarations), OptionalNone {})
{
}

extern "C" void web_css_position_try_descriptors_create(void* vm, void* declaration);

void CSSPositionTryDescriptors::create_owner()
{
    web_css_position_try_descriptors_create(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), static_cast<GC::Cell*>(this));
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#accepted-position-try-properties
static bool is_accepted_position_try_property(PropertyID property_id)
{
    switch (property_id) {
#define __ENUMERATE(name, property_name, property_id) case PropertyID::property_id:
        ENUMERATE_CSS_POSITION_TRY_DESCRIPTORS(__ENUMERATE)
#undef __ENUMERATE
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> CSSPositionTryDescriptors::set_property(Utf16FlyString const& property_name, Utf16View css_text, Utf16View priority)
{
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/#fallback-rule
    // The @position-try rule only accepts the following accepted @position-try properties [...]
    // It is invalid to use !important on the properties in the <declaration-list>.
    auto property = PropertyNameAndID::from_name(property_name);
    if (!property.has_value() || property->is_custom_property() || !is_accepted_position_try_property(property->id()) || !priority.is_empty())
        return {};
    return Base::set_property(property_name, css_text, priority);
}

}

static StyleSheetState& state_of_sheet(void* sheet)
{
    return static_cast<CSSStyleSheet*>(sheet)->state();
}

CSSRule::Type CSSRule::type() const
{
    return Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_rule_type(native_handle());
}

NativeRule const* CSSRule::native_handle() const
{
    return web_css_rule_native(const_cast<CSSRule*>(this));
}

CSSRule* CSSRule::parent_rule() const
{
    return static_cast<CSSRule*>(web_css_rule_parent_rule(const_cast<CSSRule*>(this)));
}

StyleSheetState* CSSRule::parent_style_sheet() const
{
    auto* sheet = web_css_rule_parent_style_sheet(const_cast<CSSRule*>(this));
    return sheet ? &state_of_sheet(sheet) : nullptr;
}

// NB: Read from the native rule when asked, as only DevTools asks.
Optional<SourcePosition> CSSRule::source_location() const
{
    auto payload = native_rule().payload();
    if (!payload.has_source_position)
        return {};
    VERIFY(payload.start_line <= NumericLimits<u32>::max());
    VERIFY(payload.start_column <= NumericLimits<u32>::max());
    return SourcePosition { static_cast<u32>(payload.start_line), static_cast<u32>(payload.start_column) };
}

Utf16String CSSRule::serialized() const
{
    return Utf16String::adopt_raw(web_css_rule_serialized(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), const_cast<CSSRule*>(this)));
}

GC::Ref<CSSStyleDeclaration> CSSRule::declarations() const
{
    auto* declarations = web_css_rule_declarations(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), const_cast<CSSRule*>(this));
    return *static_cast<CSSStyleDeclaration*>(static_cast<GC::Cell*>(declarations));
}

static GC::Ref<CSSStyleDeclaration> create_rust_descriptors(AtRuleID at_rule, Parser::ValueParserFFI::FfiDescriptorBlock const* block, void (*create_owner)(void* vm, void* descriptors))
{
    auto descriptors = CSSDescriptors::create(at_rule, RustDescriptorBlock { Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_descriptor_block_retain(block) });
    create_owner(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), static_cast<GC::Cell*>(descriptors.ptr()));
    return descriptors;
}

void* web_css_rule_create_declarations(void* cell)
{
    using namespace Parser::ValueParserFFI;

    auto& rule = *static_cast<CSSRule*>(cell);
    auto native_rule = rule.native_rule();
    auto payload = native_rule.payload();

    auto declarations = [&]() -> GC::Ref<CSSStyleDeclaration> {
        switch (native_rule.type()) {
        case CSSRule::Type::Style:
            return CSSStyleProperties::create(RustDeclarationBlock { rust_rule_declarations(native_rule.handle()) });
        case CSSRule::Type::NestedDeclarations:
        case CSSRule::Type::Margin:
            return CSSStyleProperties::create(RustDeclarationBlock { rust_declaration_block_retain(payload.declarations) });
        case CSSRule::Type::Keyframe:
            return CSSStyleProperties::create(RustDeclarationBlock { rust_keyframe_declarations(payload.keyframe) });
        case CSSRule::Type::PositionTry:
            return CSSPositionTryDescriptors::create(RustDeclarationBlock { rust_declaration_block_retain(payload.declarations) });
        case CSSRule::Type::FontFace:
            return create_rust_descriptors(AtRuleID::FontFace, payload.descriptors, web_css_font_face_descriptors_create);
        case CSSRule::Type::Page:
            return create_rust_descriptors(AtRuleID::Page, payload.descriptors, web_css_page_descriptors_create);
        case CSSRule::Type::FunctionDeclarations:
            return create_rust_descriptors(AtRuleID::Function, payload.descriptors, web_css_function_descriptors_create);
        default:
            VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        }
    }();
    declarations->set_parent_rule(rule);
    return static_cast<GC::Cell*>(declarations.ptr());
}

FlatPtr web_css_declarations_serialized(void* declarations)
{
    return static_cast<CSSStyleDeclaration*>(static_cast<GC::Cell*>(declarations))->serialized().into_raw();
}

NativeRuleList const* web_css_style_sheet_native_rules(void* sheet)
{
    return state_of_sheet(sheet).native_rules().handle();
}

FlatPtr web_css_selector_list_text(void const* selectors, void* sheet)
{
    auto list = selector_list_from_rust(static_cast<SelectorFFI::RustParsedSelectorList const*>(selectors));
    return serialize_a_group_of_selectors(list, sheet ? &state_of_sheet(sheet) : nullptr).into_raw();
}

void* web_css_style_sheet_import_rule(void* sheet, u64 identity)
{
    auto* import = state_of_sheet(sheet).import_for_rule(identity);
    return import ? &import->cssom_rule() : nullptr;
}

void web_css_style_sheet_disconnect_font_faces(void* sheet, NativeRule const* rule)
{
    state_of_sheet(sheet).disconnect_font_faces_in_rule(RustRule { rule });
}

void web_css_style_sheet_rules_changed(void* sheet)
{
    state_of_sheet(sheet).recalculate_rule_caches();
}

void web_css_counter_style_rule_changed(void* cell)
{
    auto& rule = *static_cast<CSSRule*>(cell);
    auto* parent_style_sheet = rule.parent_style_sheet();

    if (!parent_style_sheet)
        return;

    parent_style_sheet->for_each_owning_style_scope([&](StyleScope& style_scope) {
        style_scope.invalidate_counter_style_cache();
    });
    record_style_rule_declarations_changed(rule);
}

void web_css_font_feature_values_rule_clear_caches(void* rule)
{
    static_cast<CSSFontFeatureValuesRule*>(rule)->clear_caches();
}

void CSSRuleList::set_parent_style_sheet(StyleSheetState* sheet)
{
    web_css_rule_list_set_parent_style_sheet(vm_abi(), this, sheet ? &sheet->cssom_sheet() : nullptr);
}

CSSRule* CSSRuleList::rule_for_identity(u64 identity) const
{
    auto path = native_rules().path_to_rule(identity);
    auto const* list = this;
    CSSRule* rule = nullptr;
    for (size_t depth = 0; depth < path.size(); ++depth) {
        rule = list->item(path[depth]);
        VERIFY(rule);
        if (depth + 1 < path.size())
            list = &as<CSSGroupingRule>(*rule).css_rules();
    }
    return rule;
}

void CSSRuleList::set_rules(Badge<StyleSheetState>, RustRuleList const& rules, GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> document)
{
    web_css_rule_list_set_rules(vm_abi(), this, rules.handle(), document_cell(document));
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#insert-a-css-rule
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<unsigned> CSSRuleList::insert_a_css_rule(RustRuleList& rules, RustRule const& rule, u32 index, Nested nested)
{
    using Result = Parser::ValueParserFFI::RuleInsertionResult;
    switch (Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_rule_list_insert_css_rule(rules.handle(), index, rule.handle(), nested == Nested::Yes)) {
    case Result::Success:
        return index;
    case Result::IndexSizeError:
        return WebIDL::IndexSizeError::create("CSS rule index out of bounds."_utf16);
    case Result::HierarchyRequestError:
        return WebIDL::HierarchyRequestError::create("Cannot insert rule at specified index."_utf16);
    case Result::InvalidStateError:
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("Cannot insert @namespace rule into a stylesheet with non-namespace/import rules"_utf16);
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

void CSSRuleList::remove_a_css_rule_without_validation(Badge<StyleSheetState>, u32 index)
{
    web_css_rule_list_remove_rule(vm_abi(), this, index);
}

}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/cssom/#the-cssrulelist-interface
class WEB_API CSSRuleList final : public Bindings::RustInterfaceCell {
    WEB_RUST_INTERFACE(CSSRuleList, css_rule_list)

public:
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<CSSRuleList> create(RustRuleList const&, GC::Ptr<DOM::Document>);

    CSSRule* item(size_t index) const;
    size_t length() const;
    RustRuleList native_rules() const;
    CSSRule* existing_wrapper(u64 identity) const;
    void set_parent_style_sheet(StyleSheetState*);
    CSSRule* rule_for_identity(u64) const;

    class Iterator {
    public:
        Iterator(CSSRuleList const& list, size_t index)
            : m_list(list)
            , m_index(index)
        {
        }
        GC::Ref<CSSRule> operator*() const { return *m_list->item(m_index); }
        Iterator& operator++()
        {
            ++m_index;
            return *this;
        }
        bool operator==(Iterator const& other) const { return m_list == other.m_list && m_index == other.m_index; }

    private:
        GC::Ref<CSSRuleList const> m_list;
        size_t m_index;
    };

    Iterator begin() const { return { *this, 0 }; }
    Iterator end() const { return { *this, length() }; }

    void remove_a_css_rule_without_validation(Badge<StyleSheetState>, u32 index);
    enum class Nested {
        No,
        Yes,
    };
    static WebIDL::ExceptionOr<unsigned> insert_a_css_rule(RustRuleList&, RustRule const&, u32 index, Nested);

    void set_rules(Badge<StyleSheetState>, RustRuleList const&, GC::Ptr<DOM::Document>);
};

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(CSSStyleDeclaration);

CSSStyleDeclaration::CSSStyleDeclaration(Computed computed, Readonly readonly)
    : m_computed(computed == Computed::Yes)
    , m_readonly(readonly == Readonly::Yes)
{
}

void CSSStyleDeclaration::set_owner(Bindings::InterfaceName interface_name, Bindings::RustInterfaceCell& owner)
{
    VERIFY(!m_rust_owner);
    m_rust_owner_interface_name = interface_name;
    m_rust_owner = owner;
}

Bindings::RustInterfaceCell& CSSStyleDeclaration::ensure_owner()
{
    if (!m_rust_owner)
        create_owner();
    return *m_rust_owner;
}

extern "C" JSObject* web_rust_bindings_wrap(JSVM*, void* realm, u16 interface_name, void* cell);

GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> CSSStyleDeclaration::create_wrapper(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    auto& owner = ensure_owner();
    auto* wrapper = web_rust_bindings_wrap(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(realm.vm()), &realm, to_underlying(m_rust_owner_interface_name), &owner);
    return as<JS::HostObject>(*JS::HostABI::object_from_abi(wrapper));
}

void CSSStyleDeclaration::prepare_to_update_style_attribute()
{
    VERIFY(!is_computed());
    if (!owner_node().has_value()) {
        if (auto rule = parent_rule())
            flush_deferred_style_change_events_for_rule(*rule);
        return;
    }

    // OPTIMIZATION: A geometry read can leave paint-only selector facts pending. An inline
    //               declaration is not a replayable fact, so consume the boundary while the old
    //               declaration block is still authoritative.
    owner_node()->element().document().flush_deferred_style_change_event();
    owner_node()->element().prepare_for_inline_style_change();
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#update-style-attribute-for
void CSSStyleDeclaration::update_style_attribute()
{
    // 1. Assert: declaration block’s computed flag is unset.
    VERIFY(!is_computed());

    // 2. Let owner node be declaration block’s owner node.
    // 3. If owner node is null, then return.
    if (!owner_node().has_value())
        return;

    auto& element = owner_node()->element();
    // OPTIMIZATION: Keep the parsed declaration block authoritative and serialize it only when
    //               something observes the textual attribute value.
    if (element.can_defer_inline_style_attribute_update()) {
        element.did_update_inline_style();
        return;
    }

    // 4. Set declaration block’s updating flag.
    set_is_updating(true);

    // 5. Set an attribute value for owner node using "style" and the result of serializing declaration block.
    element.set_attribute_value(HTML::AttributeNames::style, serialized());

    // 6. Unset declaration block’s updating flag.
    set_is_updating(false);
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-cssstyledeclaration-csstext
Utf16String CSSStyleDeclaration::css_text() const
{
    // 1. If the computed flag is set, then return the empty string.
    if (is_computed())
        return {};

    // 2. Return the result of serializing the declarations.
    return serialized();
}

void CSSStyleDeclaration::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_parent_rule);
    visitor.visit(m_owner_element);
    visitor.visit(m_rust_owner);
}

void CSSStyleDeclaration::set_owner_node(Optional<DOM::AbstractElement> owner_node)
{
    if (!owner_node.has_value()) {
        m_owner_element = nullptr;
        m_owner_pseudo_element = {};
        return;
    }
    m_owner_element = owner_node->element();
    m_owner_pseudo_element = owner_node->pseudo_element();
}

static CSSStyleDeclaration& declaration_from_cell(void* cell)
{
    return *static_cast<CSSStyleDeclaration*>(static_cast<GC::Cell*>(cell));
}

// NB: The bindings only pass static names, so each one is interned once.
static Utf16FlyString property_name_from_static_utf8(u8 const* name, size_t name_length)
{
    static NeverDestroyed<HashMap<StringView, Utf16FlyString>> names;
    StringView key { name, name_length };
    return names->ensure(key, [&] { return Utf16FlyString::from_utf8_without_validation(key); });
}

static Utf16FlyString property_name_from_raw(FlatPtr property)
{
    return Utf16FlyString { Utf16String::adopt_raw(property) };
}

// NB: Every step that throws throws a NoModificationAllowedError, which the Rust bindings recreate from its message.
template<typename T>
static bool succeeded_or_store_message(WebIDL::ExceptionOr<T> const& result, FlatPtr* error_message)
{
    if (!result.is_error())
        return true;
    *error_message = result.exception().template get<GC::Ref<WebIDL::DOMException>>()->message().to_utf16_string().into_raw();
    return false;
}

void web_css_declaration_set_owner(void* declaration, u16 interface_name, void* owner)
{
    declaration_from_cell(declaration).set_owner(static_cast<Bindings::InterfaceName>(interface_name), *static_cast<Bindings::RustInterfaceCell*>(owner));
}

void* web_css_declaration_owner(void* declaration)
{
    return &declaration_from_cell(declaration).ensure_owner();
}

FlatPtr web_css_declaration_get_by_name(void* declaration, u8 const* name, size_t name_length)
{
    return declaration_from_cell(declaration).get_property_value(property_name_from_static_utf8(name, name_length)).into_raw();
}

bool web_css_declaration_set_by_name(void* declaration, u8 const* name, size_t name_length, FlatPtr value, FlatPtr* error_message)
{
    auto text = Utf16String::adopt_raw(value);
    return succeeded_or_store_message(declaration_from_cell(declaration).set_property(property_name_from_static_utf8(name, name_length), text.utf16_view(), u""sv), error_message);
}

FlatPtr web_css_declaration_css_text(void* declaration)
{
    return declaration_from_cell(declaration).css_text().into_raw();
}

bool web_css_declaration_set_css_text(void* declaration, FlatPtr text, FlatPtr* error_message)
{
    auto css_text = Utf16String::adopt_raw(text);
    return succeeded_or_store_message(declaration_from_cell(declaration).set_css_text(css_text.utf16_view()), error_message);
}

size_t web_css_declaration_length(void* declaration)
{
    return declaration_from_cell(declaration).length();
}

FlatPtr web_css_declaration_item(void* declaration, size_t index)
{
    return declaration_from_cell(declaration).item(index).into_raw();
}

FlatPtr web_css_declaration_get_property_value(void* declaration, FlatPtr property)
{
    return declaration_from_cell(declaration).get_property_value(property_name_from_raw(property)).into_raw();
}

FlatPtr web_css_declaration_get_property_priority(void* declaration, FlatPtr property)
{
    return declaration_from_cell(declaration).get_property_priority(property_name_from_raw(property)).into_raw();
}

bool web_css_declaration_set_property(void* declaration, FlatPtr property, FlatPtr value, FlatPtr priority, FlatPtr* error_message)
{
    auto value_text = Utf16String::adopt_raw(value);
    auto priority_text = Utf16String::adopt_raw(priority);
    return succeeded_or_store_message(declaration_from_cell(declaration).set_property(property_name_from_raw(property), value_text.utf16_view(), priority_text.utf16_view()), error_message);
}

bool web_css_declaration_remove_property(void* declaration, FlatPtr property, FlatPtr* removed_value, FlatPtr* error_message)
{
    auto result = declaration_from_cell(declaration).remove_property(property_name_from_raw(property));
    if (!succeeded_or_store_message(result, error_message))
        return false;
    *removed_value = result.release_value().into_raw();
    return true;
}

void* web_css_declaration_parent_rule(void* declaration)
{
    return declaration_from_cell(declaration).parent_rule().ptr();
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#css-declaration-blocks
class CSSStyleDeclaration
    : public Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable {
    WEB_NON_IDL_WRAPPABLE(CSSStyleDeclaration, Bindings::GCAllocatedWrappable);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(CSSStyleDeclaration);

public:
    virtual ~CSSStyleDeclaration() = default;

    virtual size_t length() const = 0;
    virtual Utf16String item(size_t index) const = 0;

    virtual WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_property(Utf16FlyString const& property_name, Utf16View css_text, Utf16View priority) = 0;
    virtual WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Utf16String> remove_property(Utf16FlyString const& property_name) = 0;

    virtual Utf16String get_property_value(Utf16FlyString const& property_name) const = 0;
    virtual Utf16String get_property_priority(Utf16FlyString const& property_name) const = 0;

    Utf16String css_text() const;
    virtual WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_css_text(Utf16View) = 0;

    virtual Utf16String serialized() const = 0;

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-computed-flag
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_computed() const { return m_computed; }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-readonly-flag
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_readonly() const { return m_readonly; }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-parent-css-rule
    GC::Ptr<CSSRule> parent_rule() const { return m_parent_rule; }
    void set_parent_rule(GC::Ptr<CSSRule> parent) { m_parent_rule = parent; }

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-owner-node
    Optional<DOM::AbstractElement> owner_node() const
    {
        if (!m_owner_element)
            return {};
        return DOM::AbstractElement { m_owner_element.as_nonnull(), m_owner_pseudo_element, owner_highlight_name() };
    }
    void set_owner_node(Optional<DOM::AbstractElement>);

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-updating-flag
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_updating() const { return m_updating; }
    void set_is_updating(bool value) { m_updating = value; }

    virtual Utf16FlyString owner_highlight_name() const { return {}; }

    virtual bool has_property(PropertyNameAndID const&) const { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); }
    virtual RefPtr<StyleValue const> get_property_style_value(PropertyNameAndID const&) const { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); }
    virtual WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_property_style_value(PropertyNameAndID const&, NonnullRefPtr<StyleValue const>) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); }

    // The object of an interface implemented in Rust that owns this declaration block, whose wrappers are this block's.
    void set_owner(Bindings::InterfaceName, Bindings::RustInterfaceCell&);
    Bindings::RustInterfaceCell& ensure_owner();

protected:
    enum class Computed : u8 {
        No,
        Yes,
    };
    enum class Readonly : u8 {
        No,
        Yes,
    };
    explicit CSSStyleDeclaration(Computed, Readonly);

    virtual void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor&) override;

    // Creates the object that owns this block, for a block whose owner is created on first use.
    virtual void create_owner() { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); }

    void prepare_to_update_style_attribute();
    void update_style_attribute();

private:
    virtual bool is_owned_by_rust_interface_object() const override { return true; }
    virtual GC::Ref<JS::HostObject> create_wrapper(JS::Realm&) override;

    // NB: The flags come first, so that they fill the padding at the end of the wrappable's fields.

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-computed-flag
    bool m_computed { false };

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-readonly-flag
    bool m_readonly { false };

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-updating-flag
    bool m_updating { false };

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-parent-css-rule
    GC::Member<CSSRule> m_parent_rule;

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#cssstyledeclaration-owner-node
    // NB: The owner node is stored as the parts of an AbstractElement, with a null element for none, which keeps the
    //     element compressed.
    GC::Member<DOM::Element> m_owner_element;
    Optional<PseudoElement> m_owner_pseudo_element;

    Bindings::InterfaceName m_rust_owner_interface_name { Bindings::InterfaceName::Unknown };
    GC::Member<Bindings::RustInterfaceCell> m_rust_owner;
};

GC::Ref<CSSStyleProperties> CSSStyleProperties::create(Vector<StyleProperty> properties, OrderedHashMap<Utf16FlyString, StyleProperty> custom_properties)
{
    return create(RustDeclarationBlock { move(properties), move(custom_properties) });
