static unsigned font_width_bucket_from_percentage(double percentage)
{
    // Maps a font-width Percentage to the nearest standard Gfx::FontWidth bucket.

    struct Bucket {
        double percentage;
        unsigned width;
    };
    static constexpr Array<Bucket, 9> buckets = { {
        { 50.0, Gfx::FontWidth::UltraCondensed },
        { 62.5, Gfx::FontWidth::ExtraCondensed },
        { 75.0, Gfx::FontWidth::Condensed },
        { 87.5, Gfx::FontWidth::SemiCondensed },
        { 100.0, Gfx::FontWidth::Normal },
        { 112.5, Gfx::FontWidth::SemiExpanded },
        { 125.0, Gfx::FontWidth::Expanded },
        { 150.0, Gfx::FontWidth::ExtraExpanded },
        { 200.0, Gfx::FontWidth::UltraExpanded },
    } };
    auto best = buckets[0];
    auto best_distance = AK::fabs(percentage - best.percentage);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < buckets.size(); ++i) {
        auto distance = AK::fabs(percentage - buckets[i].percentage);
        if (distance < best_distance) {
            best_distance = distance;
            best = buckets[i];
        }
    }
    return best.width;
}

static FlyString font_family_name_for_platform(Utf16FlyString const& family_name)
{
    auto family_name_utf8 = MUST(family_name.view().to_utf8());
    return FlyString::from_utf8_without_validation(family_name_utf8.bytes());
}

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
static Optional<Gfx::SystemUIFontKind> macos_system_ui_font_kind_from_family_name(StringView family)
{
    if (family.is_one_of("-apple-system"sv, "-apple-system-font"sv, "-webkit-system-font"sv, "system-ui"sv, "ui-sans-serif"sv))
        return Gfx::SystemUIFontKind::System;
    if (family == "ui-serif"sv)
        return Gfx::SystemUIFontKind::Serif;
    if (family == "ui-monospace"sv)
        return Gfx::SystemUIFontKind::Monospace;
    if (family == "ui-rounded"sv)
        return Gfx::SystemUIFontKind::Rounded;
    return {};
}
#endif

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#font-synthesis-weight
// How a face of the snapshot registered under `key` is synthesized for the request: never bolder where its font-weight
// descriptor claims bold weights, nor slanted where its font-style descriptor claims a slant, whatever its file holds.
// And always bolder for a bold request where its font-weight descriptor claims only weights lighter than bold, since the
// family as declared then has no bold face, even where its file has a weight axis that goes further.
static Gfx::FontSynthesis synthesis_for_face(FontFaceSnapshot::Face const& face, FontFaceKey const& key, Gfx::Typeface const& typeface, Gfx::FontSynthesisRequest const& request, Gfx::FontVariationSettings const& variations)
{
    auto synthesis = typeface.synthesis_for(request, variations);
    if (!face.weight_descriptor_is_auto)
        synthesis.bold = key.weight.max < 600 && request.allows_weight && request.weight >= 600;
    if (key.slope != 0)
        synthesis.oblique_angle = 0;
    return synthesis;
}

struct FontFaceSize {
    float points;
    bool apply_size_adjust;
    bool automatic_optical_size;
};

// What one face of the snapshot renders with. A face still waiting on its load becomes a pending entry: a cascade is
// frozen and laid out on whichever thread resolves it, so the entry reads the snapshot and the typeface the face
// publishes, and only selecting it for a rendered code point, on the document thread, reaches the face, by its number
// through the document's registry.
static RefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> font_for_face(FontFaceSnapshot::Face const& face, FontFaceKey const& key, FontFaceSize size, Gfx::FontVariationSettings const& requested_variations, Gfx::ShapeFeatures const& shape_features, Gfx::FontSynthesisRequest const& synthesis_request)
{
    if (face.is_unusable)
        return {};
    auto point_size = size.points;
    Optional<Gfx::FontVariationSettings> adjusted_variations;
    if (size.apply_size_adjust && face.size_adjust != 1) {
        point_size = clamp(size.points * face.size_adjust, 0.0, CSSPixels::max().to_double() * 0.75);
        if (size.automatic_optical_size) {
            adjusted_variations = requested_variations;
            adjusted_variations->set_optical_sizing(point_size / 0.75f);
        }
    }
    auto const& variations = adjusted_variations.has_value() ? *adjusted_variations : requested_variations;
    auto font_list = Gfx::FontCascadeList::create();
    if (face.typeface) {
        font_list->add(face.typeface->font(point_size, variations, shape_features, synthesis_for_face(face, key, *face.typeface, synthesis_request, variations)), face.unicode_ranges);
    } else if (face.has_urls) {
        font_list->add_pending_face(face.unicode_ranges, [face_id = face.id] {
            if (auto face = FontFaceState::with_id(face_id))
                return face->resolve_for_rendering();
            return Gfx::PendingFontState::Failed; }, [face, key, rendering_typeface = face.rendering_typeface, point_size, variations, shape_features, synthesis_request]() -> RefPtr<Gfx::Font const> {
            if (auto typeface = rendering_typeface->get())
                return typeface->font(point_size, variations, shape_features, synthesis_for_face(face, key, *typeface, synthesis_request, variations));
            return {}; }, [state = face.rendering_state] { return state; }, face.id);
    }
    if (font_list->is_empty())
        return {};
    return font_list;
}

// Whether the "wght" axis of a request carries the value font-weight applies, rather than one font-variation-settings
// set explicitly.
enum class WeightAxisFollowsFontWeight : u8 {
    No,
    Yes,
};

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#apply-font-matching-variations
// If the selected font is defined in an @font-face rule, then the values applied at this step should be clamped to the
// value of the font-weight, font-width, and font-style descriptors in that @font-face rule.
// NB: This returns nothing when clamping leaves the variations as they are.
// FIXME: Clamp the values that font-width and font-style apply as well.
static Optional<Gfx::FontVariationSettings> variations_clamped_to_weight_descriptor(Gfx::FontVariationSettings const& variations, WeightAxisFollowsFontWeight weight_axis_follows_font_weight, FontWeightRange weight_range)
{
    if (weight_axis_follows_font_weight == WeightAxisFollowsFontWeight::No)
        return {};
    auto weight = variations.axes.get(Gfx::FourCC("wght"));
    if (!weight.has_value())
        return {};
    auto clamped_weight = clamp(*weight, static_cast<float>(weight_range.min), static_cast<float>(weight_range.max));
    if (clamped_weight == *weight)
        return {};
    auto clamped_variations = variations;
    clamped_variations.set_weight(clamped_weight);
    return clamped_variations;
}

// NB: A face whose font-weight descriptor is auto takes the weights of its font file, which the font clamps to on its
//     own, rather than the range its matching key carries.
static Gfx::FontVariationSettings const& variations_for_face(FontFaceSnapshot::Face const& face, Gfx::FontVariationSettings const& variations, Optional<Gfx::FontVariationSettings> const& clamped_variations)
{
    if (face.weight_descriptor_is_auto || !clamped_variations.has_value())
        return variations;
    return *clamped_variations;
}

struct MatchingFontCandidate {
    FontFaceKey key;
    unsigned width { Gfx::FontWidth::Normal };
    Gfx::Typeface const* system_typeface { nullptr };

    [[nodiscard]] RefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> font_with_point_size(FontFaceSnapshot const& snapshot, FontFaceSize size, Gfx::FontVariationSettings const& variations, WeightAxisFollowsFontWeight weight_axis_follows_font_weight, Gfx::ShapeFeatures const& shape_features, Gfx::FontSynthesisRequest const& synthesis_request) const
    {
        if (system_typeface) {
            auto font_list = Gfx::FontCascadeList::create();
            font_list->add(system_typeface->font(size.points, variations, shape_features, system_typeface->synthesis_for(synthesis_request, variations)));
            return font_list;
        }

        auto const* faces = snapshot.faces(key);
        if (!faces)
            return {};

        auto clamped_variations = variations_clamped_to_weight_descriptor(variations, weight_axis_follows_font_weight, key.weight);
        auto font_list = Gfx::FontCascadeList::create();
        for (auto const& face : *faces) {
            if (auto face_fonts = font_for_face(face, key, size, variations_for_face(face, variations, clamped_variations), shape_features, synthesis_request)) {
                font_list->extend(*face_fonts);
                continue;
            }
            // Unloaded subset face: surface it as a pending entry so the fetch only
            // fires once font_for_code_point() sees a codepoint in its unicode-range.
            if (face.has_urls && face.has_non_default_unicode_range) {
                font_list->add_pending_face(
                    face.unicode_ranges, [face_id = face.id] {
                        if (auto face = FontFaceState::with_id(face_id))
                            return face->resolve_for_rendering();
                        return Gfx::PendingFontState::Failed; }, {}, [state = face.rendering_state] { return state; }, face.id);
            }
        }
        if (font_list->is_empty())
            return {};
        return font_list;
    }
};

// Partial implementation of the font-matching algorithm: https://www.w3.org/TR/css-fonts-4/#font-matching-algorithm
// FIXME: This should be replaced by the full CSS font selection algorithm.
static RefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> font_matching_algorithm(FontFaceSnapshot const& snapshot, Utf16FlyString const& family_name, int weight, Percentage const& font_width, int slope, FontFaceSize size, Gfx::FontVariationSettings const& variations, WeightAxisFollowsFontWeight weight_axis_follows_font_weight, Gfx::ShapeFeatures const& shape_features, Gfx::FontSynthesisRequest const& synthesis_request)
{
    // If a font family match occurs, the user agent assembles the set of font faces in that family and then
    // narrows the set to a single face using other font properties in the order given below.
    Vector<MatchingFontCandidate> matching_family_fonts;
    for (auto const& [key, faces] : snapshot.table()) {
        if (key.family_name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(family_name)) {
            matching_family_fonts.empend(key);
            matching_family_fonts.last().width = font_width_bucket_from_percentage(key.width);
        }
    }
    if (matching_family_fonts.is_empty()) {
        Gfx::FontDatabase::the().for_each_typeface_with_family_name(font_family_name_for_platform(family_name), [&](Gfx::Typeface const& typeface) {
            matching_family_fonts.append({
                .key = {
                    .family_name = Utf16FlyString::from_fly_string(typeface.family()),
                    // FIXME: Support system fonts that have a range of weights, etc.
                    .weight = { static_cast<int>(typeface.weight()), static_cast<int>(typeface.weight()) },
                    .slope = typeface.slope(),
                },
                .width = typeface.width(),
                .system_typeface = &typeface,
            });
        });
    }

    if (matching_family_fonts.is_empty())
        return {};

    Vector<Parser::ValueParserFFI::FfiFontMatchingCandidate> weighed_candidates;
    weighed_candidates.ensure_capacity(matching_family_fonts.size());
    for (auto const& candidate : matching_family_fonts)
        weighed_candidates.unchecked_append({ candidate.key.weight.min, candidate.key.weight.max, candidate.key.slope, candidate.width });
    Vector<size_t> order;
    order.resize(matching_family_fonts.size());
    auto order_length = Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_font_matching_order(weighed_candidates.span(), weight, font_width_bucket_from_percentage(font_width.value()), slope, order.span());
    for (auto index : order.span().trim(order_length)) {
        if (auto found_font = matching_family_fonts[index].font_with_point_size(snapshot, size, variations, weight_axis_follows_font_weight, shape_features, synthesis_request))
            return found_font;
    }
    return {};
}

static void const* feature_value_data(ComputedFontCacheKey const& key, FontResolutionFeatureInput input)
{
    auto const& value = key.feature_values[to_underlying(input)];
    return value ? value->rust_style_value_data() : nullptr;
}

// The OpenType features a request asks of the fonts of a family, with the family's @font-feature-values, if any.
static Gfx::ShapeFeatures shape_features_for(ComputedFontCacheKey const& key, FontFeatureValues const* family_feature_values)
{
    Array<void const*, font_resolution_feature_input_count> values;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < values.size(); ++index)
        values[index] = feature_value_data(key, static_cast<FontResolutionFeatureInput>(index));
    Gfx::ShapeFeatures features;
    Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_font_shape_features(
        values.data(), family_feature_values,
        [](void const* family_feature_values, Parser::ValueParserFFI::FontFeatureValuesRuleKind kind, Parser::ValueParserFFI::FfiUtf16View name, size_t* count) -> u32 const* {
            auto values = static_cast<FontFeatureValues const*>(family_feature_values)->get({ kind, Utf16FlyString::from_utf16({ reinterpret_cast<char16_t const*>(name.utf16), name.length }) });
            if (!values.has_value())
                return nullptr;
            *count = values->size();
            return values->data();
        },
        &features,
        [](void* features, u32 tag, u32 value, bool set_by_feature_settings) {
            auto four_cc = Gfx::FourCC::from_u32(tag);
            static_cast<Gfx::ShapeFeatures*>(features)->append({ { four_cc.cc[0], four_cc.cc[1], four_cc.cc[2], four_cc.cc[3] }, value, set_by_feature_settings });
        });
    return features;
}

// The metric of a font that font-size-adjust normalizes, divided by the font's size, or zero for a font without a size.
static double font_size_adjust_aspect_value(Gfx::Font const& font, FontSizeAdjustMetric metric)
{
    auto font_size = font.pixel_size();
    if (!(font_size > 0))
        return 0;
    auto const& metrics = font.pixel_metrics();

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-5/#font-size-adjust-prop
    switch (metric) {
    case FontSizeAdjustMetric::ExHeight:
        // Normalize the aspect value of the fonts, using the x-height divided by the font size.
        return metrics.x_height / font_size;
    case FontSizeAdjustMetric::CapHeight:
        // Normalize the cap-height of the fonts, using the cap-height by the font size.
        return metrics.cap_height / font_size;
    case FontSizeAdjustMetric::ChWidth:
        // Normalize the horizontal narrow pitch of the fonts, using the advance width of “0” (ZERO, U+0030) divided by
        // the font size.
        return metrics.advance_of_ascii_zero / font_size;
    case FontSizeAdjustMetric::IcWidth:
        // Normalize the horizontal wide pitch of the font, using the advance width of “水” (CJK water ideograph,
        // U+6C34) divided by the font size.
        // NB: Where the font has no such glyph, this assumes 1em, as the ic unit does:
        //     https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values-4/#ic
        return font.horizontal_advance_of_code_point(0x6C34).value_or(font_size) / font_size;
    case FontSizeAdjustMetric::IcHeight:
        // Normalize the vertical wide pitch of the font, using the advance height of “水” (CJK water ideograph,
        // U+6C34) divided by the font size.
        return font.vertical_advance_of_code_point(0x6C34).value_or(font_size) / font_size;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> resolve_font_cascade(FontFaceSnapshot const& snapshot, ComputedFontCacheKey const& key, FontFeatureValuesProvider const& font_feature_values_for_family)
{
    auto const& font_families = key.font_families;
    auto font_size = key.font_size.to_float();
    auto slope = key.font_slope;
    auto font_weight = key.font_weight;
    auto const& font_width = key.font_width;
    auto font_optical_sizing = key.font_optical_sizing;

    // FIXME: We round to int here as that is what is expected by our font infrastructure below
    auto weight = round_to<int>(font_weight);
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#font-synthesis-style
    // "oblique-only: Synthesis of an oblique face is allowed when the requested style is oblique, but not when it is
    // italic."
    auto synthesis_style = (key.font_synthesis >> StyleEngineFFI::FONT_SYNTHESIS_STYLE_SHIFT) & 3;
    Gfx::FontSynthesisRequest synthesis_request {
        .weight = weight,
        .slope = slope,
        // NB: An italic request is synthesized with the default oblique angle.
        .oblique_angle = slope == 2 ? static_cast<float>(key.font_oblique_angle) : 14.0f,
        .allows_weight = !(key.font_synthesis & StyleEngineFFI::FONT_SYNTHESIS_NO_WEIGHT),
        .allows_style = synthesis_style == 0 || (synthesis_style == StyleEngineFFI::FONT_SYNTHESIS_STYLE_OBLIQUE_ONLY && slope == 2),
    };

    // The size the lookups below select fonts at, which font-size-adjust can change for each family.
    Gfx::FontVariationSettings variation;
    auto weight_axis_follows_font_weight = WeightAxisFollowsFontWeight::Yes;
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-5/#size-adjust-desc
    // The font-size-adjust property cancels the descriptor's scale by normalizing the font's metrics to font-size.
    FontFaceSize face_size { .points = 0, .apply_size_adjust = !key.font_size_adjust.has_value() && !key.is_font_size_adjust_probe, .automatic_optical_size = false };
    auto select_fonts_at = [&](float font_size_used_value) {
        variation = {};
        face_size.automatic_optical_size = font_optical_sizing == FontOpticalSizing::Auto;
        variation.set_weight(font_weight);
        variation.set_width(font_width.value());

        // NB: The spec recommends that we use the 'used value' of font-size for 'opsz' when font-optical-sizing is 'auto'.
        // FIXME: User agents must not select a value for the "opsz" axis which is not supported by the font used for
        //        rendering the text. This can be accomplished by clamping a chosen value to the range supported by the
        //        font. https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-optical-sizing-def
        if (font_optical_sizing == FontOpticalSizing::Auto)
            variation.set_optical_sizing(font_size_used_value);

        struct FontVariationSettingsTarget {
            Gfx::FontVariationSettings& variation;
            WeightAxisFollowsFontWeight& weight_axis_follows_font_weight;
            bool& automatic_optical_size;
        } target { variation, weight_axis_follows_font_weight, face_size.automatic_optical_size };
        weight_axis_follows_font_weight = WeightAxisFollowsFontWeight::Yes;
        Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_font_variation_axes(feature_value_data(key, FontResolutionFeatureInput::FontVariationSettings), &target, [](void* target, u32 tag, double value) {
            auto& [variation, weight_axis_follows_font_weight, automatic_optical_size] = *static_cast<FontVariationSettingsTarget*>(target);
            auto four_cc = Gfx::FourCC::from_u32(tag);
            if (four_cc == Gfx::FourCC("wght"))
                weight_axis_follows_font_weight = WeightAxisFollowsFontWeight::No;
            if (four_cc == Gfx::FourCC("opsz"))
                automatic_optical_size = false;
            variation.axes.set(four_cc, value);
        });

        // FIXME: Implement the full font-matching algorithm: https://www.w3.org/TR/css-fonts-4/#font-matching-algorithm
        face_size.points = font_size_used_value * 0.75f;
    };
    select_fonts_at(font_size);

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-5/#font-size-adjust-prop
    // Each font’s used size is normalized to match the chosen font metric to this specified proportion of the computed
    // 'font-size'. In other words, for each glyph, the adjusted font size to use u is calculated as:
    //     u = ( m / m′ ) s
    // where:
    //     s = computed 'font-size' value
    //     m = metric as specified by the 'font-size-adjust' property
    //     m′ = metric as specified in the actual font
    //     u = adjusted font-size to use
    // NB: This measures m′ in the first font each family resolves to, and sizes all of that family's fonts by it.
    auto adjusted_font_size_for = [&](Gfx::Font const& font) -> Optional<float> {
        if (!key.font_size_adjust.has_value())
            return {};
        auto aspect_value = font_size_adjust_aspect_value(font, key.font_size_adjust->metric);
        // ISSUE(6384): If the required font metric cannot be derived from a font, then that font’s size is not adjusted.
        if (!(aspect_value > 0))
            return {};
        auto adjusted_font_size = CSSPixels::nearest_value_for(key.font_size_adjust->value / aspect_value * font_size).to_float();
        if (adjusted_font_size == font_size)
            return {};
        return adjusted_font_size;
    };
    auto with_font_size_adjust = [&](auto find) -> RefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> {
        auto found_font_list = find();
        if (!key.font_size_adjust.has_value() || !found_font_list)
            return found_font_list;
        Gfx::Font const* first_font = nullptr;
        found_font_list->for_each_font_entry([&](auto const& entry) {
            if (!first_font)
                first_font = entry.font.ptr();
        });
        auto adjusted_font_size = first_font ? adjusted_font_size_for(*first_font) : Optional<float> {};
        if (!adjusted_font_size.has_value())
            return found_font_list;
        select_fonts_at(*adjusted_font_size);
        auto adjusted_font_list = find();
        select_fonts_at(font_size);
        return adjusted_font_list ? adjusted_font_list : found_font_list;
    };

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    auto find_macos_system_ui_font = [&](Gfx::SystemUIFontKind kind, Utf16FlyString const& family) -> RefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> {
        auto shape_features = shape_features_for(key, &font_feature_values_for_family(family));
        auto typeface = Gfx::TypefaceCoreText::system_ui({ kind, static_cast<u16>(weight), static_cast<u16>(font_width_bucket_from_percentage(font_width.value())), static_cast<u8>(slope) });
        if (!typeface)
            return {};

        auto font_list = Gfx::FontCascadeList::create();
        font_list->add(typeface->font(face_size.points, variation, shape_features, typeface->synthesis_for(synthesis_request, variation)));
        return font_list;
    };
#endif

    auto find_font = [&](Utf16FlyString const& family) -> RefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> {
        auto const shape_features = shape_features_for(key, &font_feature_values_for_family(family));

        // OPTIMIZATION: Look for an exact match in loaded fonts first.
        // FIXME: Respect the other font-* descriptors
        FontFaceKey lookup_key {
            .family_name = family,
            .weight = { weight, weight },
            .slope = slope,
            .width = static_cast<int>(font_width.value()),
        };
        if (auto const* faces = snapshot.faces(lookup_key)) {
            auto clamped_variations = variations_clamped_to_weight_descriptor(variation, weight_axis_follows_font_weight, lookup_key.weight);
            auto result = Gfx::FontCascadeList::create();
            for (auto const& face : *faces) {
                if (auto face_fonts = font_for_face(face, lookup_key, face_size, variations_for_face(face, variation, clamped_variations), shape_features, synthesis_request))
                    result->extend(*face_fonts);
            }
            if (!result->is_empty())
                return result;
        }

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
        // Layout tests render system-ui with the test font, as every other platform does, so their dumps match.
        auto platform_family = font_family_name_for_platform(family);
        if (auto system_ui_font_kind = macos_system_ui_font_kind_from_family_name(platform_family.bytes_as_string_view()); system_ui_font_kind.has_value() && !Platform::FontPlugin::the().is_layout_test_mode()) {
            if (auto system_font = find_macos_system_ui_font(system_ui_font_kind.value(), family))
                return system_font;
        }
#endif

        if (auto found_font = font_matching_algorithm(snapshot, family, weight, font_width, slope, face_size, variation, weight_axis_follows_font_weight, shape_features, synthesis_request); found_font && !found_font->is_empty())
            return found_font;

        return {};
    };

    auto find_generic_font = [&](GenericFontFamily family) -> RefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> {
        auto font_id = to_keyword(family);
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
        if (auto system_ui_font_kind = macos_system_ui_font_kind_from_family_name(string_from_keyword(font_id)); system_ui_font_kind.has_value() && !Platform::FontPlugin::the().is_layout_test_mode()) {
            auto family = utf16_fly_string_from_keyword(font_id);
            if (auto system_font = find_macos_system_ui_font(system_ui_font_kind.value(), family))
                return system_font;
        }
#endif

        Platform::GenericFont generic_font {};
        switch (font_id) {
        case Keyword::Monospace:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::Monospace;
            break;
        case Keyword::UiMonospace:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::UiMonospace;
            break;
        case Keyword::Serif:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::Serif;
            break;
        case Keyword::Fantasy:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::Fantasy;
            break;
        case Keyword::Math:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::Math;
            break;
        case Keyword::SansSerif:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::SansSerif;
            break;
        case Keyword::UiSerif:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::UiSerif;
            break;
        case Keyword::UiRounded:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::UiRounded;
            break;
        case Keyword::SystemUi:
        case Keyword::UiSansSerif:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::UiSansSerif;
            break;
        case Keyword::Cursive:
            generic_font = Platform::GenericFont::Cursive;
            break;
        default:
            return {};
        }
        return find_font(Utf16FlyString::from_fly_string(Platform::FontPlugin::the().generic_font_name(generic_font)));
    };

    auto font_list = Gfx::FontCascadeList::create();

    for (auto const& family : font_families) {
        auto other_font_list = with_font_size_adjust([&] {
            if (family.has<GenericFontFamily>())
                return find_generic_font(family.get<GenericFontFamily>());
            return find_font(family.get<ComputedFontFamilyName>().name);
        });

        if (other_font_list)
            font_list->extend(*other_font_list);
    }

    // NB: @font-feature-values can't apply to the default font since it's not loaded from CSS
    auto default_font = Platform::FontPlugin::the().default_font(face_size.points, variation, shape_features_for(key, nullptr));
    if (auto adjusted_font_size = adjusted_font_size_for(*default_font); adjusted_font_size.has_value()) {
        select_fonts_at(*adjusted_font_size);
        default_font = Platform::FontPlugin::the().default_font(face_size.points, variation, shape_features_for(key, nullptr));
        select_fonts_at(font_size);
    }
    if (font_list->is_empty()) {
        if (auto fallback_font_list = with_font_size_adjust([&] { return find_font(Utf16FlyString::from_fly_string(Platform::FontPlugin::the().generic_font_name(Platform::GenericFont::UiSansSerif))); }))
            font_list->extend(*fallback_font_list);
    }
    if (font_list->is_empty()) {
        // This is needed to make sure we check default font before reaching to emojis.
        font_list->add(*default_font);
    }

    // The default font is already included in the font list, but we explicitly set it
    // as the last-resort font. This ensures that if none of the specified fonts contain
    // the requested code point, there is still a font available to provide a fallback glyph.
    font_list->set_last_resort_font(*default_font);

    if (Platform::FontPlugin::the().is_layout_test_mode()) {
        for (auto font_name : Platform::FontPlugin::the().symbol_font_names()) {
            if (auto other_font_list = with_font_size_adjust([&] { return find_font(Utf16FlyString::from_fly_string(font_name)); }))
                font_list->extend_fallback(*other_font_list);
        }
    } else {
        // NB: The system fallback is asked for the style the cascade requests, not that of whichever font comes first,
        //     so a face finishing its load leaves it as it was.
        // FIXME: Normalize the size of each system fallback font by font-size-adjust as well, rather than giving it
        //        the requested size.
        Gfx::FontCascadeList::SystemFallbackRequest request {
            .point_size = face_size.points,
            .weight = static_cast<u16>(clamp(weight, 1, 1000)),
            .width = static_cast<u16>(font_width_bucket_from_percentage(font_width.value())),
            .slope = static_cast<u8>(slope),
            .shape_features = shape_features_for(key, nullptr),
        };
        font_list->set_system_font_fallback_callback(request, [](u32 code_point, Gfx::EmojiPresentation presentation, Gfx::FontCascadeList::SystemFallbackRequest const& request) -> RefPtr<Gfx::Font const> {
            Gfx::SystemFallbackFontKey key {
                .code_point = code_point,
                .weight = request.weight,
                .width = request.width,
                .slope = request.slope,
                .prefer_color_emoji = presentation == Gfx::EmojiPresentation::Emoji,
            };
            return Gfx::system_fallback_font(key, request.point_size, request.shape_features);
        });
    }

    // The cascade is complete. Freeze it here, on the document thread, so that every layout pass that receives it
    // reads a snapshot instead of the live list.
    font_list->freeze();

    return font_list;
}

Vector<ComputedFontFamily> computed_font_families_from_style_value(StyleValue const& font_family)
{
    Vector<ComputedFontFamily> font_families;
    auto const& values = font_family.as_value_list().values();
    font_families.ensure_capacity(values.size());
    for (auto const& value : values) {
        if (value->is_keyword()) {
            auto generic_family = keyword_to_generic_font_family(value->to_keyword());
            VERIFY(generic_family.has_value());
            font_families.unchecked_append(generic_family.release_value());
        } else {
            font_families.unchecked_append(ComputedFontFamilyName {
                .name = string_from_style_value(value),
                .syntax = value->is_string() ? ComputedFontFamilySyntax::String : ComputedFontFamilySyntax::CustomIdent,
            });
        }
    }
    return font_families;
}

NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> resolve_font_for_style_values(FontComputer const& font_computer, ComputedFontCacheKey key)
{
    // Only font-variant-alternates read the tree scope's @font-feature-values, so every other request resolves once for
    // all scopes.
    if (!key.feature_values[to_underlying(FontResolutionFeatureInput::FontVariantAlternates)])
        key.font_feature_values_scope = {};
    return font_computer.font_cascade_memo().resolve(font_computer.font_face_snapshot(), key, font_computer.font_feature_values_provider(key.font_feature_values_scope));
}

NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> FontCascadeMemo::resolve(FontFaceSnapshot const& snapshot, ComputedFontCacheKey const& key, FontFeatureValuesProvider const& font_feature_values_for_family) const
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    // A style update that flew resolves against the snapshot it was sealed with, which a change to the
    // @font-face table beside it leaves older than the memo. Where the memo keeps a cascade that answers for that
    // table as well, it is the answer; any other answer is the transaction's own, and stays out of the memo, retired
    // with the cascades the change forgot.
    if (snapshot.generation() < m_generation) {
        if (auto font_list = cascade_resolved_by(snapshot.generation(), key))
            return font_list.release_nonnull();
        auto font_list = resolve_font_cascade(snapshot, key, font_feature_values_for_family);
        m_retired.append(font_list);
        m_resolutions_against_older_tables.append({ key, font_list });
        return font_list;
    }
    return resolve_into_memo(snapshot, key, font_feature_values_for_family);
}

NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> FontCascadeMemo::resolve_for_fork(FontFaceSnapshot const& snapshot, ComputedFontCacheKey const& key, FontFeatureValuesProvider const& font_feature_values_for_family) const
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    if (snapshot.generation() < m_generation) {
        if (auto font_list = cascade_resolved_by(snapshot.generation(), key))
            return font_list.release_nonnull();
        return resolve_font_cascade(snapshot, key, font_feature_values_for_family);
    }
    return resolve_into_memo(snapshot, key, font_feature_values_for_family);
}

NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> FontCascadeMemo::resolve_into_memo(FontFaceSnapshot const& snapshot, ComputedFontCacheKey const& key, FontFeatureValuesProvider const& font_feature_values_for_family) const
{
    VERIFY(snapshot.generation() >= m_generation);
    m_generation = snapshot.generation();
    auto const& cascade = m_cascades.ensure(key, [&] {
        return MemoizedCascade { resolve_font_cascade(snapshot, key, font_feature_values_for_family), m_generation };
    });
    return cascade.font_list;
}

RefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> FontCascadeMemo::cascade_resolved_by(u64 generation, ComputedFontCacheKey const& key) const
{
    // NB: Each change to the @font-face table since a cascade was resolved forgot it unless it resolves the same under
    //     the changed table, so a cascade the memo keeps answers for every table from the one it was resolved against
    //     on. A transaction that flew, or a fork of the render state, then names the same cascade as the memo.
    auto it = m_cascades.find(key);
    if (it == m_cascades.end() || it->value.resolved_at_generation > generation)
        return {};
    return it->value.font_list;
}

void FontCascadeMemo::forget_matching(u64 environment_generation, Function<bool(ComputedFontCacheKey const&, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> const&)> const& predicate)
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    VERIFY(environment_generation > m_generation);
    m_generation = environment_generation;
    m_cascades.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& key, auto const& cascade) {
        if (!predicate(key, cascade.font_list))
            return false;
        m_retired.append(cascade.font_list);
        return true;
    });
}

void FontCascadeMemo::release_retired() const
{
    // NB: A cascade's destructor releases fonts into the document thread's caches, so it runs outside the lock.
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const>> retired;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
        retired = move(m_retired);
    }
}

Vector<FontCascadeMemo::ResolutionAgainstOlderTable> FontCascadeMemo::take_resolutions_against_older_tables() const
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    return exchange(m_resolutions_against_older_tables, {});
}

bool FontCascadeMemo::adopt_resolution_against_older_table(FontFaceSnapshot const& snapshot, ResolutionAgainstOlderTable const& resolution, FontFeatureValuesProvider const& font_feature_values_for_family) const
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    VERIFY(snapshot.generation() >= m_generation);
    if (auto it = m_cascades.find(resolution.key); it != m_cascades.end())
        return it->value.font_list.ptr() == resolution.font_list.ptr();
    // NB: No element holds a cascade of the memo for the request yet, so the one the transaction resolved, where it
    //     answers the same under the newest table, is the memo's answer from here on, and the elements holding it keep
    //     it.
    m_generation = snapshot.generation();
    auto font_list = resolve_font_cascade(snapshot, resolution.key, font_feature_values_for_family);
    auto adopted = font_list->equals(*resolution.font_list);
    m_cascades.set(resolution.key, MemoizedCascade { adopted ? resolution.font_list : move(font_list), m_generation });
    return adopted;
}

}

namespace Web::CSS {

enum class ResolvedFor : u8 {
    Engine,
    Fork,
};

static StyleEngineFFI::FfiResolvedFont resolve_font_for_style_engine(void const* memo, void const* snapshot, StyleEngineFFI::FfiFontResolutionRequest request, ResolvedFor resolved_for)
{
    auto value_of = [](StyleEngineFFI::FfiHostHandle handle) {
        return StyleValue::adopt_rust_style_value_data(StyleValueFFI::rust_style_value_retain(reinterpret_cast<StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData const*>(handle)));
    };
    auto font_family = value_of(request.font_family);
    ComputedFontCacheKey key {
        .font_families = computed_font_families_from_style_value(*font_family),
        .font_optical_sizing = static_cast<FontOpticalSizing>(request.font_optical_sizing),
        .font_size = CSSPixels::from_raw(request.font_size_raw),
        .font_slope = request.font_slope,
        .font_weight = request.font_weight,
        .font_width = Percentage(request.font_width),
        .feature_values = {},
        .font_feature_values_scope = TreeScopeID { request.font_feature_values_scope },
        .font_oblique_angle = request.font_oblique_angle,
        .font_synthesis = request.font_synthesis,
        .is_font_size_adjust_probe = request.font_size_adjust == StyleEngineFFI::FontSizeAdjustKind::FromFont,
    };
    if (request.font_size_adjust == StyleEngineFFI::FontSizeAdjustKind::Number)
        key.font_size_adjust = FontSizeAdjust { static_cast<FontSizeAdjustMetric>(request.font_size_adjust_metric), request.font_size_adjust_value };
    // The engine names a value for each feature input whose property does not have its initial value.
    for (size_t index = 0; index < key.feature_values.size(); ++index) {
        if (auto handle = request.font_feature_values[index])
            key.feature_values[index] = value_of(handle);
    }
    auto const& font_faces = *static_cast<FontFaceSnapshot const*>(snapshot);
    auto const& cascade_memo = *static_cast<FontCascadeMemo const*>(memo);
    FontFeatureValuesProvider font_feature_values_for_family = [&](Utf16FlyString const& family) -> FontFeatureValues const& { return font_faces.font_feature_values(key.font_feature_values_scope, family); };
    auto resolve = [&] {
        return resolved_for == ResolvedFor::Fork
            ? cascade_memo.resolve_for_fork(font_faces, key, font_feature_values_for_family)
            : cascade_memo.resolve(font_faces, key, font_feature_values_for_family);
    };
    auto font_list = resolve();
    double font_size_adjust_from_font = 0;
    if (request.font_size_adjust == StyleEngineFFI::FontSizeAdjustKind::FromFont) {
        // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-5/#valdef-font-size-adjust-from-font
        // Computes to the <number> corresponding to the specified metric of the first available font, if it exists.
        // Otherwise, the same as none.
        // NB: The element's other fonts are then sized by that number.
        auto metric = static_cast<FontSizeAdjustMetric>(request.font_size_adjust_metric);
        font_size_adjust_from_font = font_size_adjust_aspect_value(font_list->first_available_font(), metric);
        if (font_size_adjust_from_font > 0)
            key.font_size_adjust = FontSizeAdjust { metric, font_size_adjust_from_font };
        key.is_font_size_adjust_probe = false;
        font_list = resolve();
    }
    // The metric probe must not load a face: the first available font answers without one.
    auto const& first_available_font = font_list->first_available_font();
    auto const metrics = first_available_font.pixel_metrics();
    // NB: The engine takes no reference. The memo keeps the cascade alive until the font environment generation
    //     changes, and the engine's resolver cache answers only for the generation it was filled at. A fork of the
    //     render state, which sees no generation change, takes the reference it is handed instead.
    if (resolved_for == ResolvedFor::Fork)
        font_list->ref();
    return {
        // Handles, not pointers: the engine names these host objects and hands them back here.
        .first_available_font = reinterpret_cast<StyleEngineFFI::FfiHostHandle>(&first_available_font),
        .font_cascade_list = reinterpret_cast<StyleEngineFFI::FfiHostHandle>(font_list.ptr()),
        .ascent = metrics.ascent,
        .descent = metrics.descent,
        .line_gap = metrics.line_gap,
        .x_height = metrics.x_height,
        .cap_height = metrics.cap_height,
        .zero_advance = metrics.advance_of_ascii_zero,
        .font_size_adjust_from_font = font_size_adjust_from_font,
    };
}

}

// The style engine resolves a font through this, with nothing but the table and memo it was given and the request: the
// request's family is an opaque handle the engine holds, which becomes a value again here.
extern "C" Web::CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiResolvedFont web_css_resolve_font(void const* memo, void const* snapshot, Web::CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiFontResolutionRequest request)
{
    return Web::CSS::resolve_font_for_style_engine(memo, snapshot, request, Web::CSS::ResolvedFor::Engine);
}

// A fork of the render state resolves a font through this, as the engine does, taking over a reference to the cascade.
extern "C" WEB_API Web::CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiResolvedFont web_css_resolve_font_for_fork(void const* memo, void const* snapshot, Web::CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiFontResolutionRequest request);

extern "C" Web::CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiResolvedFont web_css_resolve_font_for_fork(void const* memo, void const* snapshot, Web::CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiFontResolutionRequest request)
{
    return Web::CSS::resolve_font_for_style_engine(memo, snapshot, request, Web::CSS::ResolvedFor::Fork);
}

#pragma once

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <LibGfx/FontCascadeList.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/FontComputer.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/FontFaceSnapshot.h>
#include <LibWeb/StyleEngineRustFFI.h>

template<>
struct AK::Traits<Web::CSS::ComputedFontCacheKey> : public AK::DefaultTraits<Web::CSS::ComputedFontCacheKey> {
    static unsigned hash(Web::CSS::ComputedFontCacheKey const& key)
    {
        unsigned hash = 0;
        for (auto const& family : key.font_families) {
            if (family.has<Web::CSS::GenericFontFamily>()) {
                hash = pair_int_hash(hash, to_underlying(family.get<Web::CSS::GenericFontFamily>()));
            } else {
                auto const& name = family.get<Web::CSS::ComputedFontFamilyName>();
                hash = pair_int_hash(hash, pair_int_hash(name.name.hash(), to_underlying(name.syntax)));
            }
        }

        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, to_underlying(key.font_optical_sizing));
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, Traits<Web::CSSPixels>::hash(key.font_size));
        if (key.font_size_adjust.has_value())
            hash = pair_int_hash(hash, pair_int_hash(to_underlying(key.font_size_adjust->metric), Traits<double>::hash(key.font_size_adjust->value)));
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, key.is_font_size_adjust_probe);
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, key.font_slope);
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, Traits<double>::hash(key.font_weight));
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, Traits<double>::hash(key.font_width.value()));
        // NB: Which feature values a request names is enough to tell most requests apart, and equality compares them.
        for (auto const& value : key.feature_values)
            hash = pair_int_hash(hash, value ? 1 : 0);
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, key.font_feature_values_scope.value());
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, pair_int_hash(Traits<double>::hash(key.font_oblique_angle), key.font_synthesis));

        return hash;
    }
};

namespace Web::CSS {

// The @font-feature-values a resolution reads for a family, in the tree scope the request comes from.
using FontFeatureValuesProvider = Function<FontFeatureValues const&(Utf16FlyString const&)>;

// Resolve a font cascade from the @font-face snapshot and the process-wide font services alone. It starts no load: a web
// face it selects waits in the cascade until a rendered code point or a font-relative length wants it.
[[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> resolve_font_cascade(FontFaceSnapshot const&, ComputedFontCacheKey const&, FontFeatureValuesProvider const&);

// The font-family list as font matching wants it: generic families kept apart from names, and a name's syntax kept.
[[nodiscard]] Vector<ComputedFontFamily> computed_font_families_from_style_value(StyleValue const& font_family);

using FontResolutionFeatureInput = StyleEngineFFI::FontResolutionFeatureInput;
static_assert(font_resolution_feature_input_count == StyleEngineFFI::FONT_RESOLUTION_FEATURE_INPUT_COUNT);

// Resolve a request against a document's @font-face table, through the cascades it has resolved before. Outside a
// style update, the web faces the resolution selects start loading here.
[[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> resolve_font_for_style_values(FontComputer const&, ComputedFontCacheKey);

// The cascades already resolved for a document, by request: a memo of a pure function of the snapshot and the request,
// which the document forgets entries of when a change to its @font-face table makes them stale.
// The style engine holds a reference beside the document's and resolves through it from whichever thread it runs on,
// so the memo counts references atomically and takes a lock around its table.
class FontCascadeMemo final : public AtomicRefCounted<FontCascadeMemo> {
public:
    static NonnullRefPtr<FontCascadeMemo> create() { return adopt_ref(*new FontCascadeMemo); }

    // NB: A memo of a pure function, so filling it does not change what it answers.
    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> resolve(FontFaceSnapshot const&, ComputedFontCacheKey const&, FontFeatureValuesProvider const&) const;
    // Resolves as resolve() does for a fork of a document's render state, which holds a reference to every cascade it
    // names: an answer against an older table than the memo's that the memo does not keep is the fork's alone, which
    // neither the retired cascades nor the bookkeeping of answers against older tables take in.
    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> resolve_for_fork(FontFaceSnapshot const&, ComputedFontCacheKey const&, FontFeatureValuesProvider const&) const;
    // NB: Only under a font environment generation newer than any resolved against: the style engine names the memo's
    //     cascades without holding a reference to them for as long as a generation stands, so the forgotten ones are
    //     retired, not released, as a style update that flew may still name them.
    void forget_matching(u64 environment_generation, Function<bool(ComputedFontCacheKey const&, NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> const&)> const&);
    // Releases the retired cascades, on the document thread, where the engine is about to resolve against the newest
    // table: what it named from older ones is never read again. An element holding one keeps it alive, and the answers
    // against older tables stay to be taken in.
    void release_retired() const;

    struct ResolutionAgainstOlderTable {
        ComputedFontCacheKey key;
        NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> font_list;
    };
    // The cascades resolved against an older table since last taken, which may answer their requests differently now.
    [[nodiscard]] Vector<ResolutionAgainstOlderTable> take_resolutions_against_older_tables() const;
    // Whether the memo answers the request of a resolution against an older table with its very cascade, against the
    // newest table: where the memo holds no cascade for the request and that one resolves the same under the newest
    // table, the memo takes it in. Elements holding a cascade the memo does not answer with resolve again.
    [[nodiscard]] bool adopt_resolution_against_older_table(FontFaceSnapshot const&, ResolutionAgainstOlderTable const&, FontFeatureValuesProvider const&) const;

private:
    FontCascadeMemo() = default;

    // Resolves against the newest table, through the memo. Called with m_mutex held.
    NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> resolve_into_memo(FontFaceSnapshot const&, ComputedFontCacheKey const&, FontFeatureValuesProvider const&) const;
    // The memo's cascade for the request where it also answers for the table of the generation, or null. Called with
    // m_mutex held.
    RefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> cascade_resolved_by(u64 generation, ComputedFontCacheKey const&) const;

    struct MemoizedCascade {
        NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const> font_list;
        // The generation of the table the cascade was resolved against.
        u64 resolved_at_generation { 0 };
    };

    // Guards the four members below. A resolution runs under it, so a cascade is resolved once however many threads
    // want it.
    mutable Mutex m_mutex;
    mutable HashMap<ComputedFontCacheKey, MemoizedCascade> m_cascades;
    // The newest snapshot generation resolved against or forgotten under. An older one would write a stale cascade
    // where every later request reads it.
    mutable u64 m_generation { 0 };
    // The cascades forgotten, or resolved against an older table, that the engine may still name.
    mutable Vector<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::FontCascadeList const>> m_retired;
    mutable Vector<ResolutionAgainstOlderTable> m_resolutions_against_older_tables;
};

}

// The style engine resolves a font with nothing but the @font-face table and memo it was given, and the request, and
// gives up its references to them through these.
extern "C" WEB_API Web::CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiResolvedFont web_css_resolve_font(void const* memo, void const* snapshot, Web::CSS::StyleEngineFFI::FfiFontResolutionRequest);
extern "C" WEB_API void web_css_font_face_snapshot_unreference(void const*);
extern "C" WEB_API void web_css_font_cascade_memo_unreference(void const*);

Frequency::Frequency(double value, FrequencyUnit unit)
    : m_unit(unit)
    , m_value(value)
{

double Frequency::to_hertz() const
{
    return ratio_between_units(m_unit, FrequencyUnit::Hz) * m_value;

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/StringBuilder.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/SerializationMode.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/Units.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>

namespace Web::CSS {

class Frequency {
public:
    Frequency(double value, FrequencyUnit unit);

    double to_hertz() const;

    double raw_value() const { return m_value; }
    FrequencyUnit unit() const { return m_unit; }
    Utf16FlyString unit_name() const { return CSS::to_string(m_unit); }

    bool operator==(Frequency const& other) const
    {
        return m_unit == other.m_unit && m_value == other.m_value;
    }

    int operator<=>(Frequency const& other) const
    {
        auto this_hertz = to_hertz();
        auto other_hertz = other.to_hertz();

        if (this_hertz < other_hertz)
            return -1;
        if (this_hertz > other_hertz)
            return 1;
        return 0;
    }

private:
    FrequencyUnit m_unit;
    double m_value { 0 };
};

}

GC::Ref<HighlightRegistry> HighlightRegistry::create(DOM::Document& document)
{
    auto* registry = web_highlight_registry_create(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), static_cast<GC::Cell*>(&document));
    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<HighlightRegistry*>(registry) };
}

bool HighlightRegistry::has_highlights()
{
    return web_highlight_registry_has_highlights(this);
}

bool HighlightRegistry::has_ranges()
{
    return web_highlight_registry_has_ranges(this);
}

bool HighlightRegistry::contains_range(DOM::AbstractRange& range)
{
    return web_highlight_registry_contains_range(this, static_cast<GC::Cell*>(&range));
}

void HighlightRegistry::for_each_highlight_in_stacking_order(Function<void(Utf16String const& name, ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<DOM::AbstractRange>> ranges)> const& callback)
{
    auto trampoline = [](void* context, FlatPtr raw_name, void* const* raw_ranges, size_t range_count) {
        auto const& callback = *static_cast<Function<void(Utf16String const&, ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<DOM::AbstractRange>>)> const*>(context);
        auto name = Utf16String::adopt_raw(raw_name);
        GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<DOM::AbstractRange>> ranges;
        ranges.ensure_capacity(range_count);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < range_count; ++i)
            ranges.unchecked_append(*static_cast<DOM::AbstractRange*>(static_cast<GC::Cell*>(raw_ranges[i])));
        callback(name, ranges.span());
    };
    web_highlight_registry_for_each_highlight_in_stacking_order(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), this, const_cast<void*>(static_cast<void const*>(&callback)), trampoline);
}

bool HighlightRegistry::range_is_paintable(DOM::Document const& document, DOM::AbstractRange const& range)
{
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#range-invalidation
    // When computing how to render a document, if start node or end node of any range in the highlight registry
    // associated with that document’s window refer to a Node whose shadow-including root is not that document, the user
    // agent must ignore that range. If any StaticRange in the highlight registry associated with that document’s window
    // is not valid, the user agent must ignore that range.
    if (&range.start_container()->shadow_including_root() != &document || &range.end_container()->shadow_including_root() != &document)
        return false;
    if (auto const* static_range = as_if<DOM::StaticRange>(range); static_range && !static_range->is_valid())
        return false;

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#painting
    // Collapsed ranges are not rendered.
    return !range.collapsed();
}

static DOM::Document& document_from_abi(void* document)
{
    return *static_cast<DOM::Document*>(static_cast<GC::Cell*>(document));
}

void web_css_highlight_registry_invalidate_custom_highlights(void* raw_document)
{
    document_from_abi(raw_document).invalidate_custom_highlights();
}

void* web_css_abstract_range_of_wrapper(void* wrapper)
{
    auto* range = Bindings::impl_from<DOM::AbstractRange>(static_cast<JS::Object*>(wrapper));
    VERIFY(range);
    return static_cast<GC::Cell*>(range);
}

void* web_css_shadow_root_of_wrapper(void* wrapper)
{
    auto* shadow_root = Bindings::impl_from<DOM::ShadowRoot>(static_cast<JS::Object*>(wrapper));
    VERIFY(shadow_root);
    return static_cast<GC::Cell*>(shadow_root);
}

bool web_css_highlight_registry_point_is_in_viewport(void* raw_document, float x, float y)
{
    // FIXME: This should account for the size of the scroll bar.
    auto viewport_rect = document_from_abi(raw_document).viewport_rect();
    CSSPixelPoint position { x, y };
    return !(x < 0 || y < 0 || position.x() > viewport_rect.width() || position.y() > viewport_rect.height());
}

// The shadow root of the tree of the element of the topmost box at the point, if it is in a shadow tree.
void* web_css_highlight_registry_shadow_root_at_point(void* raw_document, float x, float y)
{
    auto& document = document_from_abi(raw_document);
    document.update_layout(DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::HighlightRegistryHighlightsFromPoint);
    Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document };
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Element> hit_element;
    (void)document.hit_test_all(read, CSSPixelPoint { x, y }, [&](Painting::HitTestResult result) {
        auto* node = result.dom_node();
        if (!node)
            return TraversalDecision::Continue;
        hit_element = is<DOM::Element>(*node) ? static_cast<DOM::Element*>(node) : node->parent_element();
        return TraversalDecision::Break;
    });
    if (!hit_element)
        return nullptr;

    // AD-HOC: If the element is inside a UA internal shadow root, retarget to the host, as elementFromPoint()
    //         does. UA internal shadow roots can never be passed in options.shadowRoots.
    hit_element = DOM::retarget_from_ua_internal_shadow_root(*hit_element);
    return static_cast<GC::Cell*>(as_if<DOM::ShadowRoot>(hit_element->root()));
}

bool web_css_highlight_registry_range_is_hit(void* raw_abstract_range, float x, float y)
{
    auto& abstract_range = *static_cast<DOM::AbstractRange*>(static_cast<GC::Cell*>(raw_abstract_range));

    // 1. If abstractRange is an invalid StaticRange, then continue.
    if (auto* static_range = as_if<DOM::StaticRange>(abstract_range); static_range && !static_range->is_valid())
        return false;

    // 2. Let range be a new Range whose start node and end node are set to abstractRange’s start node and end
    //    node respectively, and start offset and end offset are set to abstractRange’s start offset and end
    //    offset respectively.
    // OPTIMIZATION: A live Range already has these boundary points, so we use it instead of creating a new live
    //               Range that every DOM mutation would have to update until it is collected.
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Range> range = as_if<DOM::Range>(abstract_range);
    if (!range)
        range = DOM::Range::create(abstract_range.start_container(), abstract_range.start_offset(), abstract_range.end_container(), abstract_range.end_offset());

    // 3. If the coordinates x,y fall inside at least one of the DOMRects returned by calling getClientRects()
    //    on range, then append abstractRange to result.ranges.
    // NB: A rect is treated as half-open, so that the empty rect of a collapsed range is never hit.
    return any_of(range->client_rects(), [&](Gfx::DoubleRect const& rect) {
        return x >= rect.left() && x < rect.right() && y >= rect.top() && y < rect.bottom();
    });
}

}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-highlight-api-1/#highlightregistry
class WEB_API HighlightRegistry final : public Bindings::RustInterfaceCell {
    WEB_RUST_INTERFACE(HighlightRegistry, highlight_registry)

public:
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<HighlightRegistry> create(DOM::Document&);

    bool has_highlights();
    bool has_ranges();

    // order to the top.
    void for_each_highlight_in_stacking_order(Function<void(Utf16String const& name, ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<DOM::AbstractRange>> ranges)> const&);

    static bool range_is_paintable(DOM::Document const&, DOM::AbstractRange const&);
};

#include "HypotheticalElement.h"
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>

namespace Web::CSS {

DOM::AbstractElement& AbstractOrHypotheticalElement::abstract_element()
{
    return visit(
        [](DOM::AbstractElement& abstract_element) -> DOM::AbstractElement& { return abstract_element; },
        [](HypotheticalElement* hypothetical_element) -> DOM::AbstractElement& { return hypothetical_element->root_element; });
}

DOM::AbstractElement const& AbstractOrHypotheticalElement::abstract_element() const
{
    return const_cast<AbstractOrHypotheticalElement*>(this)->abstract_element();
}

DOM::Document const& AbstractOrHypotheticalElement::document() const
{
    return abstract_element().document();
}

Optional<AbstractOrHypotheticalElement> AbstractOrHypotheticalElement::element_to_inherit_style_from() const
{
    return visit(
        [](DOM::AbstractElement const& abstract_element) -> Optional<AbstractOrHypotheticalElement> {
            auto element_to_inherit_style_from = abstract_element.element_to_inherit_style_from();

            if (!element_to_inherit_style_from.has_value())
                return OptionalNone {};

            return element_to_inherit_style_from.value();
        },
        [](HypotheticalElement* hypothetical_element) -> Optional<AbstractOrHypotheticalElement> {
            return hypothetical_element->parent;
        });
}

Optional<CustomPropertyRegistration const&> AbstractOrHypotheticalElement::get_registered_custom_property(Utf16FlyString const& name) const
{
    return visit(
        [&](DOM::AbstractElement const& abstract_element) {
            return abstract_element.document().get_registered_custom_property(name);
        },
        [&](HypotheticalElement* hypothetical_element) -> Optional<CustomPropertyRegistration const&> {
            return hypothetical_element->custom_property_registry.get(name);
        });
}

RefPtr<StyleValue const> AbstractOrHypotheticalElement::get_custom_property(Utf16FlyString const& name) const
{
    return visit(
        [&](DOM::AbstractElement const& abstract_element) {
            return abstract_element.get_custom_property(name);
        },
        [&](HypotheticalElement* hypothetical_element) -> RefPtr<StyleValue const> {
            if (auto property = hypothetical_element->custom_property_data->get(name); property.has_value())
                return property->value;
            return nullptr;
        });
}

RefPtr<CustomPropertyData const> AbstractOrHypotheticalElement::inheritable_custom_property_data(Layout::BegunRead const& read) const
{
    return visit(
        [&read](DOM::AbstractElement const& abstract_element) -> RefPtr<CustomPropertyData const> {
            auto custom_property_data = abstract_element.custom_property_data();

            if (!custom_property_data)
                return {};

            return abstract_element.custom_property_data()->inheritable(read, abstract_element.document());
        },
        [&read](HypotheticalElement* hypothetical_element) -> RefPtr<CustomPropertyData const> {
            auto inheritable_parent = hypothetical_element->parent.inheritable_custom_property_data(read);

            return hypothetical_element->custom_property_data->inheritable_impl(
                inheritable_parent,
                [&](Utf16FlyString const& name) { return hypothetical_element->custom_property_registry.get(name); });
        });
}

RefPtr<CustomPropertyData const> AbstractOrHypotheticalElement::custom_property_data() const
{
    return visit(
        [](DOM::AbstractElement const& abstract_element) -> RefPtr<CustomPropertyData const> { return abstract_element.custom_property_data(); },
        [](HypotheticalElement* hypothetical_element) -> RefPtr<CustomPropertyData const> { return hypothetical_element->custom_property_data; });
}

StyleScope const& AbstractOrHypotheticalElement::style_scope() const
{
    return visit(
        [](DOM::AbstractElement const& abstract_element) -> StyleScope const& { return abstract_element.style_scope(); },
        [](HypotheticalElement* hypothetical_element) -> StyleScope const& { return hypothetical_element->style_scope; });
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/CSS/ImageStyleValueResourceKey.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashFunctions.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Traits.h>
#include <AK/Utf16FlyString.h>
#include <LibGC/Forward.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/Enums.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/URL.h>

namespace Web::CSS {

// NB: Identifies the image request of a url() value. Besides the URL, this holds the values of the URL request
//     modifiers, which set the mode, credentials mode, integrity metadata and referrer policy of the request. Only
//     url() values with the same key share an ImageStyleValueResource, so that each of them gets the checks for its
//     own kind of request.
struct ImageStyleValueResourceKey {
    ::URL::URL url;
    Optional<CrossOriginModifierValue> cross_origin;
    Optional<Utf16FlyString> integrity;
    Optional<ReferrerPolicyModifierValue> referrer_policy;

    static ImageStyleValueResourceKey create(::URL::URL url, URL const& url_value)
    {
        ImageStyleValueResourceKey key { .url = move(url), .cross_origin = {}, .integrity = {}, .referrer_policy = {} };

        // NB: The modifier steps run in sequence, so a later modifier of a kind overrides an earlier one.
        for (auto const& modifier : url_value.request_url_modifiers()) {
            switch (modifier.type()) {
            case RequestURLModifier::Type::CrossOrigin:
                key.cross_origin = modifier.value().get<CrossOriginModifierValue>();
                break;
            case RequestURLModifier::Type::Integrity:
                key.integrity = modifier.value().get<Utf16FlyString>();
                break;
            case RequestURLModifier::Type::ReferrerPolicy:
                key.referrer_policy = modifier.value().get<ReferrerPolicyModifierValue>();
                break;
            }
        }
        return key;
    }

    bool has_request_url_modifiers() const { return cross_origin.has_value() || integrity.has_value() || referrer_policy.has_value(); }

    bool operator==(ImageStyleValueResourceKey const&) const = default;
};

}

template<>
struct AK::Traits<Web::CSS::ImageStyleValueResourceKey> : public AK::DefaultTraits<Web::CSS::ImageStyleValueResourceKey> {
    static unsigned hash(Web::CSS::ImageStyleValueResourceKey const& key)
    {
        auto hash = Traits<URL::URL>::hash(key.url);
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, key.cross_origin.has_value() ? to_underlying(*key.cross_origin) + 1 : 0);
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, key.integrity.has_value() ? key.integrity->hash() : 0);
        hash = pair_int_hash(hash, key.referrer_policy.has_value() ? to_underlying(*key.referrer_policy) + 1 : 0);
        return hash;
    }
};

GC_UNTRACED_CAPTURE(Web::CSS::ImageStyleValueResourceKey);

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/CSS/InstalledStyle.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/StyleRecordID.h>
#include <LibWeb/StyleEngineRustFFI.h>

namespace Web::CSS {

enum class StyleRecordDependencyFlag : u8;

// The computed style an element or a pseudo-element installed: a counted reference to the record the engine installed
// for it, or to the sample of its animations over that record. Records never change, so reading the installed style
// reads the record and asks nothing of the engine, which may be in a frame in flight.
class InstalledStyle {
public:
    InstalledStyle() = default;
    // Takes a reference to `record`, a record the engine handed out, or none for null.
    explicit InstalledStyle(StyleEngineFFI::Record const* record)
        : m_record(record)
    {
        if (m_record)
            StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_record_retain(m_record);
    }
    // Takes over a reference to `record` the engine handed out, or none for null.
    static InstalledStyle adopt(StyleEngineFFI::Record const* record)
    {
        InstalledStyle installed;
        installed.m_record = record;
        return installed;
    }
    InstalledStyle(InstalledStyle const& other)
        : InstalledStyle(other.m_record)
    {
    }
    InstalledStyle(InstalledStyle&& other)
        : m_record(exchange(other.m_record, nullptr))
    {
    }
    InstalledStyle& operator=(InstalledStyle const& other)
    {
        if (this != &other) {
            InstalledStyle copy { other };
            swap(m_record, copy.m_record);
        }
        return *this;
    }
    InstalledStyle& operator=(InstalledStyle&& other)
    {
        if (this != &other) {
            InstalledStyle moved { move(other) };
            swap(m_record, moved.m_record);
        }
        return *this;
    }
    ~InstalledStyle()
    {
        if (m_record)
            StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_record_release(m_record);
    }

    StyleRecordID record() const { return m_record ? StyleRecordID { StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_record_identity(m_record) } : StyleRecordID {}; }
    StyleEngineFFI::FfiStyleRecordView view() const { return m_record ? StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_record_view(m_record) : StyleEngineFFI::FfiStyleRecordView {}; }
    explicit operator bool() const { return m_record; }
    // Whether both hold the same record, which no other record shares the identity of.
    bool operator==(InstalledStyle const& other) const { return m_record == other.m_record; }

    // What the record's values depend on, or nothing where nothing is installed.
    StyleRecordDependencyFlag dependency_flags() const { return static_cast<StyleRecordDependencyFlag>(view().dependency_flags); }

    // The identity of the custom-property environment the record was resolved in, or 0.
    u64 custom_property_environment() const { return m_record ? StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_record_custom_property_environment(m_record) : 0; }

    // The record itself, as the engine's entries that read a record the host holds take it, or null.
    StyleEngineFFI::Record const* record_pointer() const { return m_record; }

    // The record's groups, which `CSS::style_record_group` reads, or null where nothing is installed. NB: A record's
    // groups are at its head.
    ComputedValuesFFI::StyleRecordGroups const* groups() const { return reinterpret_cast<ComputedValuesFFI::StyleRecordGroups const*>(m_record); }

    // Whether the record's own display, beneath any animation, is none, read straight out of its box group payload.
    bool display_is_none() const;
    bool display_is_none_ignoring_animations() const;

    // Whether `animated_overlay` changes any effective value of the record in place of its own overlay, read from the
    // record itself.
    bool animation_overlay_changed(ComputedValuesFFI::AnimatedOverlay const* animated_overlay) const
    {
        VERIFY(m_record);
        auto view = this->view();
        return StyleEngineFFI::style_engine_animation_overlay_changed(&view, animated_overlay);
    }

private:
    StyleEngineFFI::Record const* m_record { nullptr };
};

// NB: Every element and pseudo-element the host styles holds one of these.
static_assert(sizeof(InstalledStyle) == sizeof(void*));

}

#include <LibWeb/CSS/Invalidation/AdoptedStyleSheetInvalidator.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/StyleSheetInvalidation.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/StyleSheetState.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Node.h>

namespace Web::CSS::Invalidation {

void invalidate_style_after_adopting_style_sheet(DOM::Node& document_or_shadow_root, StyleSheetState& style_sheet)
{
    style_sheet.add_owning_document_or_shadow_root(document_or_shadow_root);

    // Evaluate the sheet's media queries before the next style update so the cascade can see its rules. Otherwise the
    // rule cache may be rebuilt (e.g. via a :has() invalidation pass) before Document::evaluate_media_rules has a
    // chance to populate MediaList::m_matches.
    style_sheet.evaluate_media_queries(document_or_shadow_root.document());

    invalidate_rule_cache_after_style_sheet_change(document_or_shadow_root, style_sheet);
}

void invalidate_style_after_removing_adopted_style_sheet(DOM::Node& document_or_shadow_root, StyleSheetState& style_sheet)
{
    style_sheet.remove_owning_document_or_shadow_root(document_or_shadow_root);
    invalidate_rule_cache_after_style_sheet_change(document_or_shadow_root, style_sheet);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/CSS/Invalidation/AncestorTraversal.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <LibWeb/DOM/Element.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Node.h>
#include <LibWeb/TraversalDecision.h>

namespace Web::CSS::Invalidation {

enum class AncestorTraversal {
    ShadowIncluding,
    FlatTree,
};

template<typename Callback>
void for_each_inclusive_ancestor_element(DOM::Node& start, AncestorTraversal traversal, Callback callback)
{
    if (auto* element = as_if<DOM::Element>(start)) {
        if (callback(*element) == TraversalDecision::Break)
            return;
    }

    auto* ancestor = traversal == AncestorTraversal::FlatTree
        ? start.flat_tree_parent_element()
        : start.parent_or_shadow_host_element();
    for (; ancestor; ancestor = traversal == AncestorTraversal::FlatTree ? ancestor->flat_tree_parent_element() : ancestor->parent_or_shadow_host_element()) {
        if (callback(*ancestor) == TraversalDecision::Break)
            return;
    }
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/CSS/Invalidation/AttributeInvalidator.cpp
/*
