// https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-properties-values-api/#determining-registration
Optional<CSS::CustomPropertyRegistration const&> Document::get_registered_custom_property(Utf16FlyString const& name) const
{
    // If the Document’s [[registeredPropertySet]] slot contains a record with the custom property’s name, the
    // registration is that record.
    if (auto registered_property = m_registered_property_set.get(name); registered_property.has_value())
        return registered_property;

    // Otherwise, if the Document’s active stylesheets contain at least one valid @property rule representing a
    // registration with the custom property’s name, the last such one in document order is the registration.
    if (auto registered_property = m_cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules.get(name); registered_property.has_value())
        return registered_property;

    // Otherwise there is no registration, and the custom property is not a registered custom property.
    return {};
}

void Document::for_each_registered_custom_property(Function<void(CSS::CustomPropertyRegistration const&)> const& callback) const
{
    for (auto const& [name, registration] : m_registered_property_set)
        callback(registration);
    for (auto const& [name, registration] : m_cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules) {
        if (!m_registered_property_set.contains(name))
            callback(registration);
    }
}

void Document::did_change_custom_property_registrations()
{
    ++m_custom_property_registration_generation;
    sync_custom_property_registrations_to_rust();
    // What every environment an element holds hands down follows the registrations. The engine has to be told
    // again, or a child it styles under one registration resolves over an environment the host can't install.
    // That waits for the next style update, which reaches the engine under a read of its own. A change beside
    // a frame in flight leaves the flight alone.
    m_custom_property_environments_need_republishing = true;
}

void Document::republish_custom_property_environments_for_style_update(Layout::BegunRead const& read)
{
    if (!m_custom_property_environments_need_republishing)
        return;
    m_custom_property_environments_need_republishing = false;
    style_computer().style_engine().republish_element_custom_property_environments(read, *this);
}

void Document::sync_custom_property_registrations_to_rust()
{
    m_rust_custom_property_registry_synced = true;
    HashMap<Utf16FlyString, CSS::CustomPropertyRegistration const*> effective_registrations;
    effective_registrations.ensure_capacity(m_registered_property_set.size() + m_cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules.size());
    for (auto const& [name, registration] : m_cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules)
        effective_registrations.set(name, &registration);
    for (auto const& [name, registration] : m_registered_property_set)
        effective_registrations.set(name, &registration);

    Vector<Utf16String> names;
    Vector<Optional<Utf16String>> initial_values;
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const>> computed_initial_values;
    Vector<CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::FfiCustomPropertyRegistration> registrations;
    names.ensure_capacity(effective_registrations.size());
    initial_values.ensure_capacity(effective_registrations.size());
    computed_initial_values.ensure_capacity(effective_registrations.size());
    registrations.ensure_capacity(effective_registrations.size());
    for (auto const& [name, registration] : effective_registrations) {
        names.unchecked_append(name.to_utf16_string());
        initial_values.unchecked_append(registration->initial_value
                ? Optional<Utf16String> { registration->initial_value->to_utf16_string(CSS::SerializationMode::ResolvedValueForReparse) }
                : Optional<Utf16String> {});
        // What the initial value computes to is a fact of the registration, computed against the
        // document rather than any element, and memoized on it for every reader: the style engine
        // takes it from here rather than computing it again.
        computed_initial_values.unchecked_append(CSS::compute_registered_custom_property_initial_value(*this, *registration));
        auto const& name_string = names.last();
        auto const& initial_value = initial_values.last();
        registrations.unchecked_append({
            .name = ffi_utf16_view(name_string),
            .syntax = registration->syntax.data(),
            .inherits = registration->inherit,
            .has_initial_value = initial_value.has_value(),
            .initial_value = initial_value.has_value() ? ffi_utf16_view(*initial_value) : CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::FfiUtf16View {},
            .computed_initial_value = computed_initial_values.last()->rust_style_value_data(),
        });
    }
    auto const& document_url = serialized_url();
    auto const& document_base_url = serialized_base_url();
    CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::FfiCustomPropertyRegistryContext context {
        .document_url = document_url.bytes().data(),
        .document_url_length = document_url.bytes().size(),
        .document_base_url = document_base_url.bytes().data(),
        .document_base_url_length = document_base_url.bytes().size(),
    };
    // A style update may still read the registry this replaces, so the registry is made anew.
    m_rust_custom_property_registry = CSS::ComputedValuesFFI::rust_custom_property_registry_update(
        m_rust_custom_property_registry, &context, registrations.data(), registrations.size());
}

void Document::build_registered_properties_cache()
{
    // The set of effective @property rules can only change when the active stylesheet rule set changes, which also
    // invalidates the document's style cache. Skip the rebuild until that happens.
    if (!m_needs_registered_properties_cache_update)
        return;
    m_needs_registered_properties_cache_update = false;

    HTML::note_rendering_trace_event("registered properties cache rebuilt"sv);

    HashMap<Utf16FlyString, CSS::CustomPropertyRegistration> cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules;
    for_each_active_css_style_sheet([&](CSS::StyleSheetState const& style_sheet) {
        style_sheet.for_each_effective_rule_data(TraversalOrder::Preorder, [&](CSS::RustRuleView const& rule, Utf16View) {
            if (rule.type() != CSS::RustRule::Type::Property)
                return;
            auto property = CSS::Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_property_rule_view(rule.property());
            auto name = Utf16FlyString::from_utf16({ reinterpret_cast<char16_t const*>(property.name.utf16), property.name.length });
            RefPtr<CSS::StyleValue const> initial_value;
            if (property.initial_value)
                initial_value = CSS::StyleValue::adopt_rust_style_value_data(CSS::StyleValueFFI::rust_style_value_retain(static_cast<CSS::StyleValueFFI::StyleValueData const*>(property.initial_value)));
            cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules.set(name, CSS::CustomPropertyRegistration {
                                                                               .property_name = name,
                                                                               .syntax = CSS::Parser::RustSyntaxHandle { CSS::Parser::ValueParserFFI::rust_syntax_retain(property.syntax) },
                                                                               .inherit = property.inherits,
                                                                               .initial_value = move(initial_value),
                                                                           });
        });
    });

    auto registrations_changed = cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules != m_cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules;
    m_cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules = move(cached_registered_properties_from_css_property_rules);
    if (registrations_changed)
        did_change_custom_property_registrations();
}

void Document::ensure_cookie_version_index(URL::URL const& new_url, URL::URL const& old_url)
{
    // NB: A cookie-averse document never uses the index; set_browsing_context() asks for it once it can.
    if (!browsing_context()) {
        m_cookie_version_index = {};
        return;
    }

    auto new_domain = HTTP::Cookie::canonicalize_domain(new_url);
    if (!new_domain.has_value()) {
        m_cookie_version_index = {};
        return;
    }

    if (m_cookie_version_index.has_value() && *new_domain == HTTP::Cookie::canonicalize_domain(old_url))
        return;

    page().client().page_did_request_document_cookie_version_index(relevant_settings_object(), unique_id(), *new_domain);
    m_cookie_version_index = {};
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list-creation-steps
Vector<URL::Origin> Document::internal_ancestor_origin_objects_list_creation_steps(ReferrerPolicy::ReferrerPolicy referrer_policy) const
{
    // 1. Let output be « ».
    Vector<URL::Origin> output;

    // 2. Let parentDoc be document's container document.
    auto parent_doc = container_document();

    // 3. If parentDoc is null, then return output.
    if (!parent_doc)
        return output;

    // 4. Assert: parentDoc is fully active.
    VERIFY(parent_doc->is_fully_active());

    // 5. Let ancestorOrigins be parentDoc's internal ancestor origin objects list.
    auto ancestor_origins = parent_doc->internal_ancestor_origin_objects_list();

    // 6. Let container be document's node navigable's container.
    // AD-HOC: This isn't used, see https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/12566
    // auto container = navigable()->container();

    // 7. Let masked be false.
    auto masked = false;

    // 8. If referrerPolicy is "no-referrer", then set masked to true.
    if (referrer_policy == ReferrerPolicy::ReferrerPolicy::NoReferrer)
        masked = true;

    // 9. Otherwise, if referrerPolicy is "same-origin" and parentDoc's origin is not same origin with document's origin, then set masked to true.
    else if (referrer_policy == ReferrerPolicy::ReferrerPolicy::SameOrigin && !parent_doc->origin().is_same_origin(origin()))
        masked = true;

    // 10. If masked is true, then append a new opaque origin to output.
    if (masked)
        output.append(URL::Origin::create_opaque());

    // 11. Otherwise, append parentDoc's origin to output.
    else
        output.append(parent_doc->origin());

    // 12. For each ancestorOrigin of ancestorOrigins:
    for (auto const& ancestor_origin : ancestor_origins.value()) {
        // 1. If masked is true and ancestorOrigin is same origin with parentDoc's origin, then append a new opaque origin to output and continue.
        if (masked && ancestor_origin.is_same_origin(parent_doc->origin())) {
            output.append(URL::Origin::create_opaque());
            continue;
        }

        // 2. Append ancestorOrigin to output and set masked to false.
        output.append(ancestor_origin);
        masked = false;
    }

    // 13. Return output.
    return output;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#ancestor-origins-list-creation-steps
GC::Ref<HTML::DOMStringList> Document::ancestor_origins_list_creation_steps() const
{
    // 1. Let ancestorOrigins be document's internal ancestor origin objects list.
    auto& ancestor_origins = m_internal_ancestor_origin_objects_list;

    // 2. Assert: ancestorOrigins is not null.
    VERIFY(ancestor_origins.has_value());

    // 3. Let output be « ».
    Vector<Utf16String> output;

    // 4. For each origin of ancestorOrigins:
    for (auto const& origin : ancestor_origins.value()) {
        // 1. Append the serialization of origin to output.
        output.append(Utf16String::from_utf8(origin.serialize()));
    }

    // 5. Return a new DOMStringList object whose associated list is output.
    return HTML::DOMStringList::create(move(output));
}

    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();

void Document::add_pending_css_import_rule(Badge<CSS::StyleSheetImport>, NonnullRefPtr<CSS::StyleSheetImport> rule)
{
    m_pending_css_import_rules.set(rule);
    set_rendering_pending(*this, RenderingPendingReason::StyleSheetLoads, m_number_of_pending_style_sheet_requests + m_pending_css_import_rules.size());
}

void Document::remove_pending_css_import_rule(Badge<CSS::StyleSheetImport>, NonnullRefPtr<CSS::StyleSheetImport> rule)
{
    m_pending_css_import_rules.remove(rule);
    set_rendering_pending(*this, RenderingPendingReason::StyleSheetLoads, m_number_of_pending_style_sheet_requests + m_pending_css_import_rules.size());
    if (m_pending_css_import_rules.is_empty()) {
        set_rendering_pending(*this, RenderingPendingReason::NeedsRenderingUpdate, 1);
        page().client().request_frame_for(*this);
    }
}

static bool contains_named_namespace(CSS::SelectorList const& selectors)
{
    return selectors.contains([](auto const& selector) { return selector->contains_named_namespace(); });
}

RefPtr<SelectorQuery const> Document::selector_query_for(Utf16String const& selector_text) const
{
    static constexpr size_t MAX_SELECTOR_QUERY_CACHE_SIZE = 512;

    auto mark_used = [](SelectorQuery const* query) {
        if (query)
            query->mark_used();
    };

    // NB: A script that builds the same selector text again for each call asks with a string that has no hash yet,
    //     which this answers without hashing it.
    if (m_last_selector_query_text && selector_text == *m_last_selector_query_text) {
        mark_used(m_last_selector_query);
        return m_last_selector_query;
    }

    // NB: A string remembers its hash, so a script asking with the same string again does not hash its text again.
    if (auto it = m_selector_query_cache.find(selector_text); it != m_selector_query_cache.end()) {
        m_last_selector_query_text = &it->key;
        m_last_selector_query = it->value;
        mark_used(it->value);
        return it->value;
    }

    // NB: The cache changes below, which moves its entries.
    m_last_selector_query_text = nullptr;
    m_last_selector_query = nullptr;

    auto maybe_selectors = parse_selector(CSS::Parser::ParsingParams { *this }, selector_text);

    // "Note: Support for namespaces within selectors is not planned and will not be added."
    if (maybe_selectors.has_value() && contains_named_namespace(maybe_selectors.value()))
        maybe_selectors.clear();

    RefPtr<SelectorQuery const> query;
    if (maybe_selectors.has_value())
        query = SelectorQuery::create(maybe_selectors.release_value());

    // Evict the oldest query not used since the cache last came to it, sending the used ones it passes to the back. A
    // page cycling through a working set of selectors that fits the cache then stops missing, instead of evicting
    // members of that set over and over. A selector that did not parse has no query to recompile and gets no second
    // turn. A query goes around once per use at most, so a miss costs a constant amount of work on average.
    if (m_selector_query_cache.size() >= MAX_SELECTOR_QUERY_CACHE_SIZE) {
        while (true) {
            auto oldest = m_selector_query_cache.begin();
            if (!oldest->value || !oldest->value->take_used_mark()) {
                m_selector_query_cache.remove(oldest);
                break;
            }
            auto text = oldest->key;
            auto used_query = oldest->value;
            m_selector_query_cache.remove(oldest);
            m_selector_query_cache.set(move(text), move(used_query));
        }
    }

    m_selector_query_cache.set(selector_text, query);
    return query;
}

QuerySelectorResultCache& Document::query_selector_result_cache()
{
    if (!m_query_selector_result_cache)
        m_query_selector_result_cache = heap().allocate<QuerySelectorResultCache>();
    return *m_query_selector_result_cache;
}

bool Document::tree_references_id_from_aria(Node const& root, Utf16FlyString const& id) const
{
    auto dom_tree_version = root.dom_tree_version();
    if (auto entry = m_ids_referenced_from_aria.get(root); entry.has_value() && entry->dom_tree_version == dom_tree_version)
        return entry->ids.contains(id);

    IdsReferencedFromAria entry { dom_tree_version, {} };
    root.for_each_in_subtree_of_type<HTML::HTMLElement>([&](auto const& element) {
        for (auto& reference : element.parse_id_reference_list(element.aria_labelled_by()))
            entry.ids.set(Utf16FlyString { move(reference) });
        for (auto& reference : element.parse_id_reference_list(element.aria_described_by()))
            entry.ids.set(Utf16FlyString { move(reference) });
        return TraversalDecision::Continue;
    });
    auto is_referenced = entry.ids.contains(id);
    m_ids_referenced_from_aria.set(root, move(entry));
    return is_referenced;
}

JS::Value document(JS::Realm& realm, GC::Ref<DOM::Document> document)
{
    return wrap(host_defined_wrapper_world(realm), realm, document);
}

GC::Ref<CSS::StyleSheetList> style_sheets(DOM::Document& document)
{
    return document.style_sheets();
}

JS::Value adopted_style_sheets(DOM::Document& document)
{
    return DOM::AdoptedStyleSheetsAccess::adopted_style_sheets(document)->array_object();
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> set_adopted_style_sheets(DOM::Document& document, JS::Value new_value)
{
    auto adopted_style_sheets = DOM::AdoptedStyleSheetsAccess::adopted_style_sheets(document);
    adopted_style_sheets->clear();

    auto iterator_record = TRY(JS::get_iterator(document.vm(), new_value, JS::IteratorHint::Sync));
    while (true) {
        auto next = TRY(JS::iterator_step_value(document.vm(), iterator_record));
        if (!next.has_value())
            break;
        TRY(adopted_style_sheets->append(*next));
    }

    return {};
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dynamic-markup-insertion.html#dom-parsehtml
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Root<DOM::Document>> parse_html(JS::Object& global, Utf16String const& html, SetHTMLOptions const& options)
{
    auto& realm = HTML::relevant_realm(global);
    // AD-HOC: Setting the origin to match that of the associated document matches the behavior of existing browsers.
    auto* window = HTML::window_from_global_object(realm.global_object());
    VERIFY(window);

    // 1. Let document be a new Document, whose content type is "text/html" and origin is this's relevant global
    //    object's associated Document's origin.
    // NOTE: Since document does not have a browsing context, scripting is disabled.
    auto document = DOM::Document::create_for_fragment_parsing(window->page(), *window);
    document->set_content_type("text/html"_utf16_fly_string);
    document->set_origin(window->associated_document().origin());

    // 2. Set document's allow declarative shadow roots to true.
    document->set_allow_declarative_shadow_roots(HTML::HTMLParser::AllowDeclarativeShadowRoots::Yes);

    // 3. Let sanitizerConfig be the result of getting a sanitizer config from options given options and true.
    auto sanitizer_config = TRY(HTML::get_a_sanitizer_config_from_options(&options, HTML::SanitizerSafety::Safe));

    // 4. Assert: sanitizerConfig is non-null.
    // NOTE: The sanitizer member of SetHTMLOptions defaults to "default".
    VERIFY(sanitizer_config.has_value());

    // 5. Parse HTML from a string given document, html, and sanitizerConfig.
    [[maybe_unused]] auto wrapper = wrap(host_defined_wrapper_world(realm), realm, GC::Ref { *document });
    document->parse_html_from_a_string(html.utf16_view(), &*sanitizer_config);

    // 6. Return document.
    return document;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dynamic-markup-insertion.html#dom-parsehtmlunsafe
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Root<DOM::Document>> parse_html_unsafe(JS::Realm& realm, TrustedTypes::TrustedHTMLOrString const& html, Variant<ParseHTMLUnsafeOptions, GC::Ref<TrustedTypes::TrustedHTMLParserOptions>> const& options)
{
    // 1. Let (compliantHTML, compliantOptions) be the result of invoking the get trusted type compliant input algorithm
    //    with the current global object, html, options, and "Document parseHTMLUnsafe".
    auto const [compliant_html, compliant_options] = TRY(TrustedTypes::get_trusted_type_compliant_input(
        HTML::current_global_object(),
        html,
        options,
        TrustedTypes::InjectionSink::Document_parseHTMLUnsafe));

    // AD-HOC: Setting the origin to match that of the associated document matches the behavior of existing browsers.
    auto* window = HTML::window_from_global_object(realm.global_object());
    VERIFY(window);

    // 2. Let document be a new Document, whose content type is "text/html" and origin is this's relevant global
    //    object's associated Document's origin.
    // NOTE: Since document does not have a browsing context, scripting is disabled.
    auto document = DOM::Document::create_for_fragment_parsing(window->page(), *window);
    document->set_content_type("text/html"_utf16_fly_string);

    // 3. Set document's allow declarative shadow roots to true.
    document->set_allow_declarative_shadow_roots(HTML::HTMLParser::AllowDeclarativeShadowRoots::Yes);

    // 4. Let sanitizerConfig be the result of getting a sanitizer config from options given compliantOptions and
    //    false.
    auto sanitizer_config = TRY(HTML::get_a_sanitizer_config_from_options(HTML::to_sanitizer_options(compliant_options), HTML::SanitizerSafety::Unsafe));

    // 5. Parse HTML from a string given document, compliantHTML, and sanitizerConfig.
    [[maybe_unused]] auto wrapper = wrap(host_defined_wrapper_world(realm), realm, GC::Ref { *document });
    document->parse_html_from_a_string(compliant_html.utf16_view(), sanitizer_config.has_value() ? &*sanitizer_config : nullptr);

    auto& associated_document = window->associated_document();
    document->set_origin(associated_document.origin());

    // 6. Return document.
    return document;
}

static WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Utf16String> document_write_compliant_string(DOM::Document& document, Vector<TrustedTypes::TrustedHTMLOrString> const& text, TrustedTypes::InjectionSink sink)
{
    // 1. Let string be the empty string.
    Utf16StringBuilder string;

    // 2. Let isTrusted be false if text contains a string; otherwise true.
    auto is_trusted = true;
    for (auto const& value : text) {
        if (value.has<Utf16String>()) {
            is_trusted = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    // 3. For each value of text:
    for (auto const& value : text) {
        string.append(value.visit(
            // 1. If value is a TrustedHTML object, then append value's associated data to string.
            [](GC::Root<TrustedTypes::TrustedHTML> const& value) { return value->to_string(); },
            // 2. Otherwise, append value to string.
            [](Utf16String const& value) { return value; }));
    }

    // 4. If isTrusted is false, set string to the result of invoking the Get Trusted Type compliant string algorithm
    //    with TrustedHTML, this's relevant global object, string, sink, and "script".
    if (!is_trusted) {
        auto const new_string = TRY(TrustedTypes::get_trusted_type_compliant_string(
            TrustedTypes::TrustedTypeName::TrustedHTML,
            HTML::relevant_global_object(document),
            string.to_string(),
            sink,
            TrustedTypes::Script.view()));
        string.clear();
        string.append(new_string);
    }

    return string.to_string();
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> write(DOM::Document& document, Vector<TrustedTypes::TrustedHTMLOrString> const& text)
{
    return document.write(TRY(document_write_compliant_string(document, text, TrustedTypes::InjectionSink::Document_write)));
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> writeln(DOM::Document& document, Vector<TrustedTypes::TrustedHTMLOrString> const& text)
{
    return document.writeln(TRY(document_write_compliant_string(document, text, TrustedTypes::InjectionSink::Document_writeln)));
}

GC::Ptr<ViewTransition::ViewTransition> start_view_transition(DOM::Document& document, GC::Ptr<WebIDL::CallbackType> update_callback)
{
    return document.start_view_transition(
        update_callback,
        WebIDL::create_promise_for(document),
        WebIDL::create_promise_for(document),
        WebIDL::create_promise_for(document));
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#dom-document-nameditem
JS::Value document_named_item_value(WrapperWorld& wrapper_world, JS::Realm& realm, DOM::Document const& document, Utf16FlyString const& name)
{
    // 1. Let elements be the list of named elements with the name name that are in a document tree with the Document as their root.
    // NOTE: There will be at least one such element, since the algorithm would otherwise not have been invoked by Web IDL.
    auto elements = document.named_elements_with_name(name);

    // 2. If elements has only one element, and that element is an iframe element, and that iframe element's content navigable is not null,
    //    then return the active WindowProxy of the element's content navigable.
    if (elements.size() == 1 && is<HTML::HTMLIFrameElement>(*elements.first())) {
        auto& iframe_element = static_cast<HTML::HTMLIFrameElement&>(*elements.first());
        if (iframe_element.content_navigable() != nullptr) {
            auto window_proxy = iframe_element.content_navigable()->active_window_proxy();
            return window_proxy ? JS::Value { &window_proxy->object() } : JS::js_null();
        }
    }

    // 3. Otherwise, if elements has only one element, return that element.
    if (elements.size() == 1)
        return wrap(wrapper_world, realm, elements.first()).ptr();

    // 4. Otherwise return an HTMLCollection rooted at the Document node, whose filter matches only named elements with the name name.
    auto collection = DOM::HTMLCollection::create(*const_cast<DOM::Document*>(&document), DOM::HTMLCollection::Scope::Descendants, GC::create_function(document.heap(), GC::captures(name), [](auto const& name, DOM::Element const& element) { return DOM::Document::is_named_element_with_name(element, name); }), DOM::HTMLCollection::AttributeInvalidationType::IdOrName);
    return wrap(wrapper_world, realm, collection);
}

// The parts of the document's environment a style change moves, as the style engine's StyleEnvironment bits. Each
// restyles the elements whose computation read it.
enum class StyleEnvironmentChange : u8 {
    // The user's preferred color scheme or the schemes the document supports.
    ColorScheme = 1 << 0,
    DevicePixelRatio = 1 << 1,
    // The media features a value's if() or custom function may test.
    MediaFeatures = 1 << 2,
    // The axes of the viewport, which viewport-relative lengths resolve against.
    ViewportWidth = 1 << 3,
    ViewportHeight = 1 << 4,
    // What every element may compute from: the quirks mode, which only the parser and document.open() move, before
    // the document holds an element.
    Everything = 1 << 7,
};
AK_ENUM_BITWISE_OPERATORS(StyleEnvironmentChange);

#define ENUMERATE_UPDATE_LAYOUT_REASON(e, reads_layout_geometry) e,
    ENUMERATE_UPDATE_LAYOUT_REASONS(ENUMERATE_UPDATE_LAYOUT_REASON)
#undef ENUMERATE_UPDATE_LAYOUT_REASON
};

[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool reason_reads_layout_geometry(UpdateLayoutReason reason)
{
    switch (reason) {
#define ENUMERATE_UPDATE_LAYOUT_REASON(e, reads_layout_geometry) \
    case UpdateLayoutReason::e:                                  \
        return reads_layout_geometry;
        ENUMERATE_UPDATE_LAYOUT_REASONS(ENUMERATE_UPDATE_LAYOUT_REASON)
#undef ENUMERATE_UPDATE_LAYOUT_REASON
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

class WEB_API Document
    : public ParentNode
    , public HTML::GlobalEventHandlers {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(Document, ParentNode);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(Document);

public:
    enum class Type {
        XML,
        HTML
    };

    static WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<Document>> create_and_initialize(Type, Utf16FlyString content_type, HTML::NavigationParams const&);

    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<Document> create(Page&, GC::Ref<EventTarget> relevant_global_event_target, URL::URL const& url = URL::about_blank());
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<Document> create_for_constructor(JS::Object&);
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<Document> create_for_fragment_parsing(Page&, GC::Ref<EventTarget> relevant_global_event_target);
    // NB: The animations of the document die when it is swept, not when it is finalized, so that the finalizer of
    //     another dead cell can still reach them.
    GC_ALLOW_CELL_DESTRUCTOR virtual ~Document() override;

    void update_style();
    // update_style(), or a read of style or layout, joins the style update that flew beside the event loop first,
    // and drains its reactions against the inputs it was sealed with: what was written beside it is the next
    // transaction's. Where none flew, that is one test.
    void drain_flown_style_update(Layout::BegunRead const& read)
    {
        if (m_flown_style_update_inputs.has_value()) [[unlikely]]
            drain_style_update_that_flew(read);
    }
    // Whether a style update flew whose reactions have not been drained yet.
    bool has_flown_style_update() const { return m_flown_style_update_inputs.has_value(); }
    // Records what update_style() records before it runs the document's style update, and lets the update fly
    // beside the event loop where `blocker` is none. The next update_style() takes its reactions in. Answers whether
    // the update flies.
    bool let_style_update_fly(Layout::RustFFI::FfiFlightBlocker blocker);
    // Brings the style up to date, and lets the first round of the rendering update's layout fly beside the event loop
    // where `blocker` is none and the layout is not up to date. The next layout update takes it in. Answers whether the
    // round flies.
    bool let_layout_fly(Layout::RustFFI::FfiFlightBlocker blocker);
    // Takes in the layout round that flew, as the frame it flew in left the document, and answers whether that laid the
    // document out: no other round runs, so what was written since the round flew is the next layout update's.
    bool take_flown_layout_in();
    // While one lives, the document reads as the layout that flew left it: the writes made since wait behind those made
    // meanwhile, and its layout is up to date as of the frame.
    class [[nodiscard]] LayoutAsItFlew {
        AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(LayoutAsItFlew);
        AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(LayoutAsItFlew);

    public:
        explicit LayoutAsItFlew(Document&);
        ~LayoutAsItFlew();

    private:
        GC::Ref<Document> m_document;
    };

    // :focus-visible without focus moving.

    // The focusVisible option of the focus() call that last moved focus here, if it had one, for the element it focused.
    // Any other focus move here clears it, and it never applies to another element this document's focus moves to.
    Optional<bool> requested_focus_visibility_for(Node const& node) const
    {
        if (m_focus_visibility_request_target.ptr() != &node)
            return {};
        return m_requested_focus_visibility;
    }
    void set_requested_focus_visibility(GC::Ptr<Node> target, Optional<bool> value)
    {
        m_focus_visibility_request_target = value.has_value() ? target : nullptr;
        m_requested_focus_visibility = value.value_or(false);
    }

    {
        // Whether a document is fully active rarely changes, so the answer is kept until invalidate_full_activity().
        if (m_full_activity_epoch == s_full_activity_epoch) [[likely]]
            return m_is_fully_active;
        return update_is_fully_active();
    }

    // The accessible name and description that the accessibility tree reports for an element, kept from one build of
    // the tree to the next while an assistive technology consumes it, and dropped whenever a change could alter them.
    struct CachedAccessibleText {
        String name;
        String description;
    };
    CachedAccessibleText const* cached_accessible_text(Element const&) const;
    void cache_accessible_text(Element const&, CachedAccessibleText) const;
    void invalidate_cached_accessibility_data(Node const&, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& attribute_name = {}, ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<Node>> added_nodes = {}, ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<Node>> removed_nodes = {});

    // A kept record, with the version it got when it was kept: Every record and geometry kept gets a new version, so
    // the same version means the same data.
    struct KeptAccessibilityRecord {
        WebView::AccessibilityNodeData const* data { nullptr };
        u64 version { 0 };
    };
    KeptAccessibilityRecord kept_accessibility_record(Node const&) const;
    // Returns the version the record gets, or 0 when it isn't kept.
    u64 cache_accessibility_record(Node const&, WebView::AccessibilityNodeData const&) const;
    void invalidate_cached_accessibility_records_after_style_change(Element const&);

    // A text node's character geometry, kept with its record from one build to the next along with what layout
    // computed it from: The same line content at the same positions gives the same geometry, so it's computed again
    // only when one of them changes.
    struct CachedTextGeometry {
        AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(CachedTextGeometry);

    public:
        CachedTextGeometry() = default;
        CachedTextGeometry(CachedTextGeometry&&) = default;
        // Releases the references this held, before taking the other's.
        CachedTextGeometry& operator=(CachedTextGeometry&&);
        ~CachedTextGeometry();

        // A containing block's line content, which each source holds a reference to, and that block's raw
        // document-absolute position.
        struct Source {
            Layout::RustFFI::InlineContent const* line_content { nullptr };
            i32 x { 0 };
            i32 y { 0 };
            bool operator==(Source const&) const = default;
        };
        Vector<Source> sources;
        u64 version { 0 };
        Vector<Gfx::IntPoint> character_offsets;
        Vector<i32> line_break_character_offsets;
        Vector<i32> line_heights;
    };
    CachedTextGeometry const* cached_text_geometry(Node const&) const;
    // Returns the version the geometry gets, or 0 when it isn't kept.
    u64 cache_text_geometry(Node const&, CachedTextGeometry) const;
    // For tests: each text node whose kept geometry differs from what computing it again gives.
    Vector<String> cached_text_geometry_mismatches();

    // For tests: builds that compute every node's data again, without what earlier builds kept.
    bool accessibility_caches_bypassed() const { return m_accessibility_caches_bypassed; }
    // For tests: each node whose kept data differs from what computing it again gives.
    Vector<String> cached_accessibility_record_mismatches();
    // For tests: each cached name or description that differs from what computing it again gives.
    Vector<String> cached_accessible_text_mismatches();

    // What the style updates of the document measured, for the style update capture tools, and how often a style
    // update stopped at its pass guard.
    struct StyleUpdateStatistics {
        // A run consumes one non-empty semantic reaction batch. The element count includes derived
        // inheritance reactions; the published count names reactions emitted at the transaction
        // boundary before that propagation.
        u64 style_engine_reaction_batch_runs { 0 };
        u64 style_engine_reaction_elements { 0 };
        u64 style_engine_published_reactions { 0 };
        u64 style_update_pass_guard_hits { 0 };
        u64 style_engine_transaction_setups { 0 };
        u64 style_engine_transaction_setup_microseconds { 0 };
        // Exclusive intervals within style_update_microseconds. Rust phases subdivide bridge.
        u64 style_update_submission_microseconds { 0 };
        u64 style_update_bridge_microseconds { 0 };
        u64 style_update_apply_microseconds { 0 };
        u64 style_update_remainder_microseconds { 0 };
        u64 style_update_microseconds { 0 };
    };
    StyleUpdateStatistics& style_update_statistics() const { return m_style_update_statistics; }

    Optional<Utf16View> command_value_override(Utf16FlyString const& command) const
    {
        auto value = m_command_value_override.get(command);
        if (!value.has_value())
            return {};
        return value->utf16_view();
    }

    template<typename GetNotifier, typename... Args>
    void notify_each_document_observer(GetNotifier&& get_notifier, Args&&... args)
    {
        GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<DocumentObserver>> document_observers;
        for (auto& observer : m_document_observers)
            document_observers.append(observer);

        for (auto document_observer : document_observers) {
            if (auto notifier = get_notifier(*document_observer))
                notifier->function()(forward<Args>(args)...);
        }
    }

    // The ids that aria-labelledby and aria-describedby reference in a tree, validated lazily against the tree's
    // dom_tree_version. Computing accessible names asks this for the parent and the ancestors of every text node.
    struct IdsReferencedFromAria {
        u64 dom_tree_version { 0 };
        HashTable<Utf16FlyString> ids;
    };
    mutable GC::WeakHashMap<Node, IdsReferencedFromAria> m_ids_referenced_from_aria;

    // https://fullscreen.spec.whatwg.org/#list-of-pending-fullscreen-events
    Vector<PendingFullscreenEvent> m_pending_fullscreen_events;

    // https://w3c.github.io/picture-in-picture/#picture-in-picture-element
    GC::Ptr<Element> m_picture_in_picture_element;

    // https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry
    GC::Ptr<HTML::CustomElementRegistry> m_custom_element_registry;

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#concept-document-internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list
    Optional<Vector<URL::Origin>> m_internal_ancestor_origin_objects_list;

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#concept-document-ancestor-origins-list
    GC::Ptr<HTML::DOMStringList> m_ancestor_origins_list;
};

template<>

bool is_a_registrable_domain_suffix_of_or_is_equal_to(URL::Host const& host_suffix, URL::Host const& original_host);

Document::HighlightStyleObservability& Document::highlight_style_observability(CSS::PseudoElement pseudo_element)
{
    VERIFY(CSS::is_highlight_pseudo_element(pseudo_element));
    switch (pseudo_element) {
    case CSS::PseudoElement::Selection:
        return m_highlight_style_observability[0];
    case CSS::PseudoElement::SpellingError:
        return m_highlight_style_observability[2];
    case CSS::PseudoElement::Highlight:
        return m_highlight_style_observability[3];
    default:
        return m_highlight_style_observability[1];
    }
}

void Document::set_needs_highlight_style_update(CSS::PseudoElement pseudo_element)
{
    highlight_style_observability(pseudo_element).needs_update = true;
}

bool Document::needs_highlight_style_update() const
{
    return any_of(m_highlight_style_observability, [](auto const& state) { return state.needs_update; })
        || custom_highlight_static_ranges_may_have_changed();
}

bool Document::custom_highlight_static_ranges_may_have_changed() const
{
    return m_custom_highlight_observers_read_static_ranges && character_data_version() != m_custom_highlight_observers_character_data_version;
}

static void record_element(Vector<CSS::StyleNodeID>& style_nodes, Node& node)
{
    if (auto* element = as_if<Element>(node); element && element->style_node_id() != CSS::StyleNodeID {})
        style_nodes.append(element->style_node_id());
}

static void record_shadow_including_inclusive_descendants(Vector<CSS::StyleNodeID>& style_nodes, Node& root)
{
    root.for_each_shadow_including_inclusive_descendant([&](Node& node) {
        record_element(style_nodes, node);
        return TraversalDecision::Continue;
    });
}

static void record_node_and_its_shadow_tree(Vector<CSS::StyleNodeID>& style_nodes, Node& node)
{
    record_element(style_nodes, node);
    if (auto* element = as_if<Element>(node); element && element->shadow_root())
        record_shadow_including_inclusive_descendants(style_nodes, *element->shadow_root());
}

static void record_siblings_until(Vector<CSS::StyleNodeID>& style_nodes, Node* first_sibling, Node const* sibling_to_stop_at)
{
    for (auto* sibling = first_sibling; sibling && sibling != sibling_to_stop_at; sibling = sibling->next_sibling())
        record_shadow_including_inclusive_descendants(style_nodes, *sibling);
}

// NB: A range intersects the nodes on the paths from its common ancestor down to its boundary nodes and every node
//     between those paths. Testing each child of the common ancestor for intersection instead would walk its
//     preceding siblings every time, which is quadratic in a wide tree.
static void record_elements_intersecting_range(Vector<CSS::StyleNodeID>& style_nodes, Node& common_ancestor, AbstractRange const& range)
{
    auto& start_node = *range.start_container();
    auto& end_node = *range.end_container();

    record_node_and_its_shadow_tree(style_nodes, common_ancestor);

    Node* first_child_between_paths = nullptr;
    if (&start_node == &common_ancestor) {
        first_child_between_paths = common_ancestor.child_at_index(range.start_offset());
    } else {
        record_node_and_its_shadow_tree(style_nodes, start_node);
        record_siblings_until(style_nodes, start_node.child_at_index(range.start_offset()), nullptr);
        Node* node_on_start_path = &start_node;
        for (; node_on_start_path->parent() != &common_ancestor; node_on_start_path = node_on_start_path->parent()) {
            record_node_and_its_shadow_tree(style_nodes, *node_on_start_path->parent());
            record_siblings_until(style_nodes, node_on_start_path->next_sibling(), nullptr);
        }
        first_child_between_paths = node_on_start_path->next_sibling();
    }

    Node* child_after_children_between_paths = nullptr;
    if (&end_node == &common_ancestor) {
        child_after_children_between_paths = common_ancestor.child_at_index(range.end_offset());
    } else {
        record_node_and_its_shadow_tree(style_nodes, end_node);
        record_siblings_until(style_nodes, end_node.first_child(), end_node.child_at_index(range.end_offset()));
        Node* node_on_end_path = &end_node;
        for (; node_on_end_path->parent() != &common_ancestor; node_on_end_path = node_on_end_path->parent()) {
            record_node_and_its_shadow_tree(style_nodes, *node_on_end_path->parent());
            record_siblings_until(style_nodes, node_on_end_path->parent()->first_child(), node_on_end_path);
        }
        child_after_children_between_paths = node_on_end_path;
    }

    record_siblings_until(style_nodes, first_child_between_paths, child_after_children_between_paths);
}

static void collect_highlight_observing_elements(Vector<CSS::StyleNodeID>& style_nodes, Node& root, AbstractRange const* range)
{
    // NB: Ancestors supply inherited highlight styles, and text controls paint through
    //     their internal shadow trees. Neither requires visiting unrelated subtrees.
    for (auto* ancestor = root.flat_tree_parent(); ancestor; ancestor = ancestor->flat_tree_parent())
        record_element(style_nodes, *ancestor);
    if (range)
        record_elements_intersecting_range(style_nodes, root, *range);
    else
        record_shadow_including_inclusive_descendants(style_nodes, root);
}

struct HighlightStyleInput {
    GC::Ref<Node> root;
    GC::Ptr<AbstractRange> range;

    void visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
    {
        visitor.visit(root);
        visitor.visit(range);
    }
};

static GC::RootVector<HighlightStyleInput, 2> selection_style_inputs(Document& document)
{
    GC::RootVector<HighlightStyleInput, 2> inputs;
    if (auto selection = document.get_selection(); selection && !selection->is_collapsed()) {
        auto range = selection->range();
        inputs.append({ range->common_ancestor_container(), range });
    }
    if (auto* text_control = as_if<HTML::FormAssociatedTextControlElement>(document.focused_area().ptr()); text_control && text_control->selection_start() != text_control->selection_end())
        inputs.append({ *document.focused_area(), nullptr });
    return inputs;
}

static GC::RootVector<HighlightStyleInput, 2> search_text_style_inputs(Document& document)
{
    GC::RootVector<HighlightStyleInput, 2> inputs;
    if (auto active_match = document.find_in_page_active_match(); active_match && !active_match->collapsed())
        inputs.append({ active_match->common_ancestor_container(), active_match });
    GC::RootHashTable<Node*> highlighted_roots;
    for (auto const& match : document.find_in_page_highlighted_matches()) {
        if (match->collapsed())
            continue;
        auto root = match->common_ancestor_container();
        if (highlighted_roots.set(root.ptr()) == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
            inputs.append({ root, nullptr });
    }
    return inputs;
}

static GC::RootVector<HighlightStyleInput, 2> spelling_error_style_inputs(Document& document)
{
    GC::RootVector<HighlightStyleInput, 2> inputs;
    if (!document.has_spelling_markers())
        return inputs;
    GC::RootHashTable<Node*> roots;
    document.spelling_markers().for_each_marked_text([&](Text& text, auto) {
        auto* parent = text.parent();
        if (parent && roots.set(parent) == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
            inputs.append({ *parent, nullptr });
    });
    // A root inside another root's subtree adds nothing, since the outer root's walk visits all of it.
    inputs.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& input) {
        for (auto* ancestor = input.root->parent_or_shadow_host(); ancestor; ancestor = ancestor->parent_or_shadow_host()) {
            if (roots.contains(ancestor))
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    });
    return inputs;
}

static Node& common_ancestor_container(AbstractRange const& range)
{
    if (auto const* live_range = as_if<Range>(range))
        return *live_range->common_ancestor_container();
    Node* container = range.start_container().ptr();
    while (!container->is_inclusive_ancestor_of(*range.end_container()))
        container = container->parent();
    return *container;
}

static bool collect_custom_highlight_observing_elements(Document& document, Vector<CSS::StyleNodeID>& style_nodes, Vector<CSS::StyleAtomID>& names)
{
    auto* registry = document.highlight_registry_if_exists();
    if (!registry)
        return false;
    bool read_static_ranges = false;
    auto& style_engine = document.style_computer().style_engine();
    registry->for_each_highlight_in_stacking_order([&](Utf16String const& name, ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<AbstractRange>> ranges) {
        GC::RootVector<HighlightStyleInput, 2> inputs;
        GC::RootHashMap<Node const*, size_t> input_index_by_root;
        for (auto const& range : ranges) {
            read_static_ranges |= is<StaticRange>(*range);
            if (!CSS::HighlightRegistry::range_is_paintable(document, *range))
                continue;
            auto& root = common_ancestor_container(*range);
            if (auto index = input_index_by_root.get(&root); index.has_value()) {
                inputs[*index].range = nullptr;
                continue;
            }
            input_index_by_root.set(&root, inputs.size());
            inputs.append({ root, range });
        }
        if (inputs.is_empty())
            return;
        GC::RootHashTable<Node const*> roots_walked_in_full;
        for (auto const& input : inputs) {
            if (!input.range)
                roots_walked_in_full.set(input.root.ptr());
        }
        inputs.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& input) {
            for (auto* ancestor = input.root->parent_or_shadow_host(); ancestor; ancestor = ancestor->parent_or_shadow_host()) {
                if (roots_walked_in_full.contains(ancestor))
                    return true;
            }
            return false;
        });
        auto first = style_nodes.size();
        for (auto const& input : inputs)
            collect_highlight_observing_elements(style_nodes, input.root, input.range.ptr());
        auto atom = style_engine.intern_atom(Utf16FlyString { name });
        for (auto i = first; i < style_nodes.size(); ++i)
            names.append(atom);
    });
    return read_static_ranges;
}

void Document::update_highlight_style_observability(CSS::PseudoElement pseudo_element)
{
    // NB: Editing commands temporarily select content to restore its formatting. Style reads
    //     during the action must not activate selection styles throughout the document for these
    //     intermediate ranges. Observe the final selection after the action, including in input
    //     event handlers. Explicit ::selection queries can still compute their style on demand.
    if (pseudo_element == CSS::PseudoElement::Selection && m_running_editing_command_action)
        return;

    // OPTIMIZATION: Whatever moves what shows a highlight notes that it needs an update, so one that needs none has
    //               nothing to collect.
    auto& state = highlight_style_observability(pseudo_element);
    if (pseudo_element == CSS::PseudoElement::Highlight && custom_highlight_static_ranges_may_have_changed())
        state.needs_update = true;
    if (!state.needs_update)
        return;

    if (pseudo_element == CSS::PseudoElement::Highlight) {
        Vector<CSS::StyleNodeID> style_nodes;
        Vector<CSS::StyleAtomID> names;
        m_custom_highlight_observers_read_static_ranges = collect_custom_highlight_observing_elements(*this, style_nodes, names);
        m_custom_highlight_observers_character_data_version = character_data_version();
        state = { .observable = !style_nodes.is_empty(), .needs_update = false };
        style_computer().style_engine().set_custom_highlight_observing_elements(style_nodes, names);
        return;
    }

    auto inputs = [&] {
        switch (pseudo_element) {
        case CSS::PseudoElement::Selection:
            return selection_style_inputs(*this);
        case CSS::PseudoElement::SpellingError:
            return spelling_error_style_inputs(*this);
        default:
            return search_text_style_inputs(*this);
        }
    }();
    bool observable = !inputs.is_empty();
    state = { .observable = observable, .needs_update = false };
    // NB: The style engine restyles the elements that start or stop showing the highlight, which
    //     are the only ones whose highlight styles a style update keeps.
    Vector<CSS::StyleNodeID> style_nodes;
    for (auto const& input : inputs)
        collect_highlight_observing_elements(style_nodes, input.root, input.range.ptr());
    auto& style_engine = style_computer().style_engine();
    style_engine.set_highlight_observing_elements(pseudo_element, style_nodes);
    if (pseudo_element == CSS::PseudoElement::SearchText)
        style_engine.set_highlight_observing_elements(CSS::PseudoElement::SearchTextCurrent, style_nodes);
}

void Document::update_highlight_style_observability()
{
    update_highlight_style_observability(CSS::PseudoElement::Selection);
    update_highlight_style_observability(CSS::PseudoElement::SearchText);
    update_highlight_style_observability(CSS::PseudoElement::SpellingError);
    update_highlight_style_observability(CSS::PseudoElement::Highlight);
}

}

#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>

namespace Web::DOM {

DocumentLoadEventDelayer::DocumentLoadEventDelayer(Document& document, DocumentLoadEventDelayerReason reason)
    : m_document(document)
    , m_reason(reason)
{
    m_document->increment_number_of_things_delaying_the_load_event({});
    if (m_reason == DocumentLoadEventDelayerReason::StyleSheetRequest)
        m_document->increment_number_of_pending_style_sheet_requests({});
}

DocumentLoadEventDelayer::DocumentLoadEventDelayer(DocumentLoadEventDelayer&& delayer)
    : m_document(move(delayer.m_document))
    , m_reason(delayer.m_reason)
{
    delayer.m_document = nullptr;
}

DocumentLoadEventDelayer& DocumentLoadEventDelayer::operator=(DocumentLoadEventDelayer&& delayer)
{
    if (this == &delayer)
        return *this;

    if (m_document) {
        if (m_reason == DocumentLoadEventDelayerReason::StyleSheetRequest)
            m_document->decrement_number_of_pending_style_sheet_requests({});
        m_document->decrement_number_of_things_delaying_the_load_event({});
    }

    m_document = move(delayer.m_document);
    m_reason = delayer.m_reason;
    delayer.m_document = nullptr;

    return *this;
}

DocumentLoadEventDelayer::~DocumentLoadEventDelayer()
{
    if (m_document && !m_document->has_been_destroyed()) {
        if (m_reason == DocumentLoadEventDelayerReason::StyleSheetRequest)
            m_document->decrement_number_of_pending_style_sheet_requests({});
        m_document->decrement_number_of_things_delaying_the_load_event({});
    }
}

}

    Other,
    StyleSheetRequest,

class DocumentLoadEventDelayer {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(DocumentLoadEventDelayer);

    DocumentLoadEventDelayer(DocumentLoadEventDelayer&&);
    DocumentLoadEventDelayer& operator=(DocumentLoadEventDelayer&&);

    ~DocumentLoadEventDelayer();

private:
    GC::Weak<Document> m_document;
    DocumentLoadEventDelayerReason m_reason { DocumentLoadEventDelayerReason::Other };
};
