extern "C" void* web_rust_body_text_stream(JSVM*, void* realm, void* stream);

// convertBytesToJSValue is an algorithm that takes a byte sequence and returns a JavaScript value or throws an exception
using ConvertBytesToJSValueCallback = GC::Ref<GC::Function<WebIDL::ExceptionOr<JS::Value>(ByteBuffer bytes)>>;

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-body-consume-body
static void consume_body(BodyMixin const& object, GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> promise, ConvertBytesToJSValueCallback convert_bytes_to_js_value)
{
    auto& realm = WebIDL::promise_realm(*promise);
    // 1. If object is unusable, then return a promise rejected with a TypeError.
    if (object.is_unusable()) {
        WebIDL::reject_promise(promise, JS::TypeError::create(realm, "Body is unusable"sv));
        return;
    }

    // 3. Let errorSteps given error be to reject promise with error.
    // NOTE: `promise` and `realm` is protected by GC::HeapFunction.
    auto error_steps = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(promise, realm), [](auto& promise, auto& realm, JS::Value error) {
        // AD-HOC: An execution context is required for Promise's reject function.
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm };
        WebIDL::reject_promise(promise, error);
    });

    // 4. Let successSteps given a byte sequence data be to resolve promise with the result of running convertBytesToJSValue
    //    with data. If that threw an exception, then run errorSteps with that exception.
    // NOTE: `promise`, `realm` and `object` is protected by GC::HeapFunction.
    auto success_steps = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(promise, realm, convert_bytes_to_js_value), [](auto& promise, auto& realm, auto& convert_bytes_to_js_value, ByteBuffer data) {
        auto& vm = realm.vm();

        // AD-HOC: An execution context is required for Promise's reject function and JSON.parse.
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm };

        auto value_or_error = WebIDL::throw_dom_exception_if_needed(vm, realm, [&]() -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<JS::Value> {
            return convert_bytes_to_js_value->function()(data);
        });

        if (value_or_error.is_error()) {
            // We can't call error_steps here without moving it into success_steps, causing a double move when we pause error_steps
            // to fully_read, so just reject the promise like error_steps does.
            WebIDL::reject_promise(promise, value_or_error.release_error().value());
            return;
        }

        WebIDL::resolve_promise(promise, value_or_error.release_value());
    });

    // 5. If object’s body is null, then run successSteps with an empty byte sequence.
    auto const& body = object.body_impl();
    if (!body) {
        success_steps->function()(ByteBuffer {});
    }
    // 6. Otherwise, fully read object’s body given successSteps, errorSteps, and object’s relevant global object.
    else {
        body->fully_read(realm, success_steps, error_steps, GC::Ref { realm.global_object() });
    }
}

BodyMixin::~BodyMixin() = default;

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#body-unusable
bool BodyMixin::is_unusable() const
{
    // An object including the Body interface mixin is said to be unusable if its body is non-null and its body’s stream is disturbed or locked.
    auto const& body = body_impl();
    return body && (body->stream()->is_disturbed() || body->stream()->is_locked());
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-body-body
GC::Ptr<Streams::ReadableStream> BodyMixin::body() const
{
    // The body getter steps are to return null if this’s body is null; otherwise this’s body’s stream.
    auto const& body = body_impl();
    return body ? body->stream().ptr() : nullptr;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-body-bodyused
bool BodyMixin::body_used() const
{
    // The bodyUsed getter steps are to return true if this’s body is non-null and this’s body’s stream is disturbed; otherwise false.
    auto const& body = body_impl();
    return body && body->stream()->is_disturbed();
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-body-arraybuffer
void BodyMixin::array_buffer(GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> promise) const
{
    auto& realm = WebIDL::promise_realm(*promise);
    // The arrayBuffer() method steps are to return the result of running consume body with this and
    // the following step given a byte sequence bytes:
    consume_body(*this, promise, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(realm), [](auto& realm, ByteBuffer bytes) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<JS::Value> {
        // return the result of creating an ArrayBuffer from bytes in this’s relevant realm.
        // NOTE: The above method can reject with a RangeError.
        return JS::ArrayBuffer::create(realm, move(bytes));
    }));
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-body-blob
void BodyMixin::blob(GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> promise) const
{
    auto& realm = WebIDL::promise_realm(*promise);
    // The blob() method steps are to return the result of running consume body with this and
    // the following step given a byte sequence bytes:
    consume_body(*this, promise, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(realm, this_impl()), [](auto& realm, auto& object, ByteBuffer bytes) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<JS::Value> {
        // return a Blob whose contents are bytes and whose type attribute is the result of get the MIME type with this.
        // NOTE: If extracting the mime type returns failure, other browsers set it to an empty string - not sure if that's spec'd.
        auto mime_type = as<BodyMixin>(object).mime_type_impl();
        auto mime_type_string = mime_type.has_value() ? mime_type->serialized() : String {};
        auto blob = FileAPI::Blob::create(move(bytes), move(mime_type_string));
        return Bindings::wrap(Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(realm), realm, blob);
    }));
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-body-bytes
void BodyMixin::bytes(GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> promise) const
{
    auto& realm = WebIDL::promise_realm(*promise);
    // The bytes() method steps are to return the result of running consume body with this and
    // the following step given a byte sequence bytes:
    consume_body(*this, promise, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(realm), [](auto& realm, ByteBuffer bytes) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<JS::Value> {
        // return the result of creating a Uint8Array from bytes in this’s relevant realm.
        // NOTE: The above method can reject with a RangeError.
        auto bytes_length = bytes.size();
        auto array_buffer = JS::ArrayBuffer::create(realm, move(bytes));
        return JS::Uint8Array::create(realm, bytes_length, *array_buffer);
    }));
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-body-formdata
void BodyMixin::form_data(GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> promise) const
{
    auto& realm = WebIDL::promise_realm(*promise);
    // The formData() method steps are to return the result of running consume body with this and
    // the following steps given a byte sequence bytes:
    consume_body(*this, promise, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(realm, this_impl()), [](auto& realm, auto& object, ByteBuffer bytes) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<JS::Value> {
        // 1. Let mimeType be the result of get the MIME type with this.
        auto mime_type = as<BodyMixin>(object).mime_type_impl();

        // 2. If mimeType is non-null, then switch on mimeType’s essence and run the corresponding steps:
        if (mime_type.has_value()) {
            // -> "multipart/form-data"
            if (mime_type->essence() == "multipart/form-data"sv) {
                // 1. Parse bytes, using the value of the `boundary` parameter from mimeType, per the rules set forth in Returning Values from Forms: multipart/form-data. [RFC7578]
                auto error_or_entry_list = parse_multipart_form_data(bytes, mime_type.value());

                // 2. If that fails for some reason, then throw a TypeError.
                if (error_or_entry_list.is_error())
                    return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, Utf16String::formatted("Failed to parse multipart form data: {}", error_or_entry_list.release_error().message) };

                // 3. Return a new FormData object, appending each entry, resulting from the parsing operation, to its entry list.
                auto form_data = XHR::FormData::create(error_or_entry_list.release_value());
                return Bindings::wrap(Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(realm), realm, form_data);
            }
            // -> "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
            if (mime_type->essence() == "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"sv) {
                // 1. Let entries be the result of parsing bytes.
                auto entries = DOMURL::url_decode(StringView { bytes });

                // 2. Return a new FormData object whose entry list is entries.
                auto form_data = XHR::FormData::create(move(entries));
                return Bindings::wrap(Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(realm), realm, form_data);
            }
        }

        // 3. Throw a TypeError.
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Mime type must be 'multipart/form-data' or 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'"_utf16 };
    }));
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-body-json
void BodyMixin::json(GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> promise) const
{
    auto& realm = WebIDL::promise_realm(*promise);
    // The json() method steps are to return the result of running consume body with this and parse JSON from bytes.
    // NOTE: The above method can reject with a SyntaxError.
    consume_body(*this, promise, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(realm), [](auto& realm, ByteBuffer bytes) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<JS::Value> {
        return Infra::parse_json_bytes_to_javascript_value(realm, bytes);
    }));
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-body-text
void BodyMixin::text(GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> promise) const
{
    auto& realm = WebIDL::promise_realm(*promise);
    // The text() method steps are to return the result of running consume body with this and UTF-8 decode.
    consume_body(*this, promise, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(realm), [](auto& realm, ByteBuffer bytes) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<JS::Value> {
        auto text = MUST(TextCodec::utf8_decode_to_utf16(bytes));
        return JS::PrimitiveString::create(realm.vm(), move(text));
    }));
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-body-textstream
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream>> BodyMixin::text_stream(JS::Realm& realm) const
{
    // 1. If this is unusable, then throw a TypeError.
    if (is_unusable())
        return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Body is unusable"_utf16 };

    return GC::Ref { *static_cast<Streams::ReadableStream*>(web_rust_body_text_stream(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(realm.vm()), &realm, body().ptr())) };
}

// https://andreubotella.github.io/multipart-form-data/#parse-a-multipart-form-data-name
static MultipartParsingErrorOr<String> parse_multipart_form_data_name(GenericLexer& lexer)
{
    // 1. Assert: The byte at (position - 1) is 0x22 (").
    VERIFY(lexer.peek(-1) == '"');

    // 2. Let name be the result of collecting a sequence of bytes that are not 0x0A (LF), 0x0D (CR) or 0x22 ("), given position.
    auto name = lexer.consume_until(is_any_of("\n\r\""sv));

    // 3. If the byte at position is not 0x22 ("), return failure. Otherwise, advance position by 1.
    if (!lexer.consume_specific('"'))
        return MultipartParsingError { MUST(String::formatted("Expected \" at position {}", lexer.tell())) };

    // 4. Replace any occurrence of the following subsequences in name with the given byte:
    //    - "%0A" with 0x0A (LF)
    //    - "%0D" with 0x0D (CR)
    //    - "%22" with 0x22 (")
    StringBuilder builder;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < name.length(); ++i) {
        // Check for subsequences starting with '%'
        if (name[i] == '%' && i + 2 < name.length()) {
            auto subsequence = name.substring_view(i, 3);
            if (subsequence == "%0A"sv) {
                builder.append(0x0A); // Append LF
                i += 2;               // Skip the next two characters
                continue;
            }
            if (subsequence == "%0D"sv) {
                builder.append(0x0D); // Append CR
                i += 2;               // Skip the next two characters
                continue;
            }
            if (subsequence == "%22"sv) {
                builder.append(0x22); // Append "
                i += 2;               // Skip the next two characters
                continue;
            }
        }

        // Append the current character if no substitution was made
        builder.append(name[i]);
    }

    return builder.to_string_without_validation();
}

// https://andreubotella.github.io/multipart-form-data/#parse-multipart-form-data-headers
static MultipartParsingErrorOr<MultiPartFormDataHeader> parse_multipart_form_data_header(GenericLexer& lexer)
{
    // 1. Let name, filename and contentType be null.
    MultiPartFormDataHeader header;

    // 2. While true:
    while (true) {
        // 1. If position points to a sequence of bytes starting with 0x0D 0x0A (CR LF):
        if (lexer.next_is("\r\n"sv)) {
            // 1. If name is null, return failure.
            if (!header.name.has_value())
                return MultipartParsingError { "Missing name parameter in Content-Disposition header"_string };

            // 2. Return name, filename and contentType.
            return header;
        }

        // 2. Let header name be the result of collecting a sequence of bytes that are not 0x0A (LF), 0x0D (CR) or 0x3A (:), given position.
        auto header_name = lexer.consume_until(is_any_of("\n\r:"sv));

        // 3. Remove any HTTP tab or space bytes from the start or end of header name.
        header_name = header_name.trim(HTTP::HTTP_TAB_OR_SPACE, TrimMode::Both);

        // 4. If header name does not match the field-name token production, return failure.
        if (!HTTP::is_header_name(header_name.bytes()))
            return MultipartParsingError { MUST(String::formatted("Invalid header name {}", header_name)) };

        // 5. If the byte at position is not 0x3A (:), return failure.
        // 6. Advance position by 1.
        if (!lexer.consume_specific(':'))
            return MultipartParsingError { MUST(String::formatted("Expected : at position {}", lexer.tell())) };

        // 7. Collect a sequence of bytes that are HTTP tab or space bytes given position. (Do nothing with those bytes.)
        lexer.ignore_while(HTTP::is_http_tab_or_space);

        // 8. Byte-lowercase header name and switch on the result:
        // -> `content-disposition`
        if (header_name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("content-disposition"sv)) {
            // 1. Set name and filename to null.
            header.name.clear();
            header.filename.clear();

            // 2. If position does not point to a sequence of bytes starting with `form-data; name="`, return failure.
            // 3. Advance position so it points at the byte after the next 0x22 (") byte (the one in the sequence of bytes matched above).
            if (!lexer.consume_specific("form-data; name=\""sv))
                return MultipartParsingError { MUST(String::formatted("Expected `form-data; name=\"` at position {}", lexer.tell())) };

            // 4. Set name to the result of parsing a multipart/form-data name given input and position, if the result is not failure. Otherwise, return failure.
            auto maybe_name = parse_multipart_form_data_name(lexer);
            if (maybe_name.is_error())
                return maybe_name.release_error();
            header.name = maybe_name.release_value();

            // 5. If position points to a sequence of bytes starting with `; filename="`:
            //     1. Advance position so it points at the byte after the next 0x22 (") byte (the one in the sequence of bytes matched above).
            if (lexer.consume_specific("; filename=\""sv)) {
                // 2. Set filename to the result of parsing a multipart/form-data name given input and position, if the result is not failure. Otherwise, return failure.
                auto maybe_filename = parse_multipart_form_data_name(lexer);
                if (maybe_filename.is_error())
                    return maybe_filename.release_error();
                header.filename = maybe_filename.release_value();
            }
        }
        // -> `content-type`
        else if (header_name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("content-type"sv)) {
            // 1. Let header value be the result of collecting a sequence of bytes that are not 0x0A (LF) or 0x0D (CR), given position.
            auto header_value = lexer.consume_until(HTTP::is_http_newline);

            // 2. Remove any HTTP tab or space bytes from the end of header value.
            header_value = header_value.trim(HTTP::HTTP_TAB_OR_SPACE, TrimMode::Right);

            // 3. Set contentType to the isomorphic decoding of header value.
            header.content_type = TextCodec::isomorphic_decode(header_value);
        }
        // -> Otherwise
        else {
            // 1. Collect a sequence of bytes that are not 0x0A (LF) or 0x0D (CR), given position. (Do nothing with those bytes.)
            lexer.ignore_until(HTTP::is_http_newline);
        }

        // 9. If position does not point to a sequence of bytes starting with 0x0D 0x0A (CR LF), return failure. Otherwise, advance position by 2 (past the newline).
        if (!lexer.consume_specific("\r\n"sv))
            return MultipartParsingError { MUST(String::formatted("Expected CRLF at position {}", lexer.tell())) };
    }
    return header;
}

// https://andreubotella.github.io/multipart-form-data/#multipart-form-data-parser
MultipartParsingErrorOr<GC::RootVector<XHR::FormDataEntry>> parse_multipart_form_data(StringView input, MimeSniff::MimeType const& mime_type)
{
    // 1. Assert: mimeType’s essence is "multipart/form-data".
    VERIFY(mime_type.essence() == "multipart/form-data"sv);

    // 2. If mimeType’s parameters["boundary"] does not exist, return failure. Otherwise, let boundary be the result of UTF-8 decoding mimeType’s parameters["boundary"].
    auto maybe_boundary = mime_type.parameters().get("boundary"sv);
    if (!maybe_boundary.has_value())
        return MultipartParsingError { "Missing boundary parameter in Content-Type header"_string };
    auto boundary = maybe_boundary.release_value();

    // 3. Let entry list be an empty entry list.
    GC::RootVector<XHR::FormDataEntry> entry_list;

    // 4. Let position be a pointer to a byte in input, initially pointing at the first byte.
    GenericLexer lexer(input);

    auto boundary_with_dashes = MUST(String::formatted("--{}", boundary));

    // 5. While true:
    while (true) {
        // 1. If position points to a sequence of bytes starting with 0x2D 0x2D (`--`) followed by boundary, advance position by 2 + the length of boundary. Otherwise, return failure.
        if (!lexer.consume_specific(boundary_with_dashes))
            return MultipartParsingError { MUST(String::formatted("Expected `--` followed by boundary at position {}", lexer.tell())) };

        // 2. If position points to the sequence of bytes 0x2D 0x2D 0x0D 0x0A (`--` followed by CR LF) followed by the end of input, return entry list.
        // NOTE: We do not require the input to end with CRLF to match the behavior of other browsers. According to RFC 2046, we are to discard any
        //       text after the terminating `--`. See: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2046#page-22
        if (lexer.next_is("--"sv))
            return entry_list;

        // 3. If position does not point to a sequence of bytes starting with 0x0D 0x0A (CR LF), return failure.
        // 4. Advance position by 2. (This skips past the newline.)
        if (!lexer.consume_specific("\r\n"sv))
            return MultipartParsingError { MUST(String::formatted("Expected CRLF at position {}", lexer.tell())) };

        // 5. Let name, filename and contentType be the result of parsing multipart/form-data headers on input and position, if the result is not failure. Otherwise, return failure.
        auto header = TRY(parse_multipart_form_data_header(lexer));

        // 6. Advance position by 2. (This skips past the empty line that marks the end of the headers.)
        lexer.ignore(2);

        // 7. Let body be the empty byte sequence.
        // 8. Body loop: While position is not past the end of input:
        //      1. Append the code point at position to body.
        //      2. If body ends with boundary:
        //          1. Remove the last 4 + (length of boundary) bytes from body.
        //          2. Decrease position by 4 + (length of boundary).
        //          3. Break out of body loop.
        auto body = lexer.consume_until(boundary_with_dashes.bytes_as_string_view());
        if (lexer.next_is(boundary_with_dashes.bytes_as_string_view())) {
            constexpr size_t trailing_crlf_length = 2;
            if (body.length() >= trailing_crlf_length) {
                body = body.substring_view(0, body.length() - trailing_crlf_length);
                lexer.retreat(trailing_crlf_length);
            }
        }

        // 9. If position does not point to a sequence of bytes starting with 0x0D 0x0A (CR LF), return failure. Otherwise, advance position by 2.
        if (!lexer.consume_specific("\r\n"sv))
            return MultipartParsingError { MUST(String::formatted("Expected CRLF at position {}", lexer.tell())) };

        // 10. If filename is not null:
        Optional<XHR::FormDataEntry::Value> value;
        if (header.filename.has_value()) {
            // 1. If contentType is null, set contentType to "text/plain".
            if (!header.content_type.has_value())
                header.content_type = "text/plain"_string;

            // 2. If contentType is not an ASCII string, set contentType to the empty string.
            if (!header.content_type->is_ascii()) {
                header.content_type = ""_string;
            }

            // 3. Let value be a new File object with name filename, type contentType, and body body.
            auto content_type = header.content_type.release_value();
            value = FileAPI::File::create(body.bytes(), Utf16String::from_utf8(header.filename.release_value()), Utf16String::from_utf8(content_type));
        }
        // 11. Otherwise:
        else {
            // 1. Let value be the UTF-8 decoding without BOM of body.
            value = Utf16String::from_utf8_with_replacement_character(body, Utf16String::WithBOMHandling::No);
        }

        // 12. Assert: name is a scalar value string and value is either a scalar value string or a File object.
        VERIFY(header.name.has_value() && value.has_value());

        // 13. Create an entry with name and value, and append it to entry list.
        entry_list.empend(Utf16String::from_utf8(header.name.release_value()), value.release_value());
    }
}

}

struct BodyInitABI {

        Blob,
        Bytes,
        FormData,
        URLSearchParams,
        String,
    };

    Kind kind;
    void* cell;
    ReadonlyBytes bytes;
    FlatPtr string;
};

extern "C" {

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#bodyinit-safely-extract
Infrastructure::BodyWithType safely_extract_body(JS::Realm& realm, BodyInitOrReadableBytes const& object)
{
    // 1. If object is a ReadableStream object, then:
    if (auto const* stream = object.get_pointer<GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream>>()) {
        // 1. Assert: object is neither disturbed nor locked.
        VERIFY(!((*stream)->is_disturbed() || (*stream)->is_locked()));
    }

    // 2. Return the result of extracting object.
    return MUST(extract_body(realm, object));
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-bodyinit-extract
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Infrastructure::BodyWithType> extract_body(JS::Realm& realm, BodyInitOrReadableBytes const& object, bool keepalive)
{
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };

    // 1. Let stream be null.
    GC::Ptr<Streams::ReadableStream> stream;

    // 2. If object is a ReadableStream object, then set stream to object.
    if (auto const* maybe_stream = object.get_pointer<GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream>>()) {
        stream = *maybe_stream;
    }
    // 3. Otherwise, if object is a Blob object, set stream to the result of running object’s get stream.
    else if (auto* blob = object.get_pointer<GC::Ref<FileAPI::Blob>>()) {
        stream = (*blob)->get_stream(realm);
    }
    // 4. Otherwise, set stream to a new ReadableStream object, and set up stream with byte reading support.
    else {
        stream = Streams::ReadableStream::create(realm);
        stream->set_up_with_byte_reading_support(realm);
    }

    // 5. Assert: stream is a ReadableStream object.
    VERIFY(stream);

    // 6. Let action be null.
    Function<ByteBuffer()> action;

    // 7. Let source be null.
    Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> source;

    // 8. Let length be null.
    Optional<u64> length {};

    // 9. Let type be null.
    Optional<Utf16String> type {};

    // 10. Switch on object.
    TRY(object.visit(
        [&](GC::Ref<FileAPI::Blob> blob) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> {
            // Set source to object.
            source = TRY_OR_THROW_OOM(realm.vm(), blob->immutable_bytes());
            // Set length to object’s size.
            length = blob->size();
            // If object’s type attribute is not the empty byte sequence, set type to its value.
            if (!blob->type().is_empty())
                type = blob->type();
            return {};
        },
        [&](ReadonlyBytes bytes) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> {
            // Set source to object.
            source = MUST(Core::ImmutableBytes::copy(bytes));
            return {};
        },
        [&](Core::ImmutableBytes const& bytes) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> {
            // Set source to object.
            source = bytes;
            return {};
        },
        [&](WebIDL::BufferSourceVariant buffer_source) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> {
            // Set source to a copy of the bytes held by object.
            source = Core::ImmutableBytes::adopt(MUST(WebIDL::get_buffer_source_copy(buffer_source)));
            return {};
        },
        [&](GC::Ref<XHR::FormData> form_data) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> {
            // Set action to this step: run the multipart/form-data encoding algorithm, with object’s entry list and UTF-8.
            auto serialized_form_data = MUST(HTML::serialize_to_multipart_form_data(form_data->entry_list()));
            // Set source to object.
            source = Core::ImmutableBytes::adopt(move(serialized_form_data.serialized_data));
            // FIXME: Set length to unclear, see html/6424 for improving this.
            // Set type to `multipart/form-data; boundary=`, followed by the multipart/form-data boundary string generated by the multipart/form-data encoding algorithm.
            type = Utf16String::formatted("multipart/form-data; boundary={}", serialized_form_data.boundary);
            return {};
        },
        [&](GC::Ref<DOMURL::URLSearchParams> url_search_params) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> {
            // Set source to the result of running the application/x-www-form-urlencoded serializer with object’s list.
            auto search_params_string = url_search_params->serialize_to_byte_string();
            source = MUST(Core::ImmutableBytes::copy(search_params_string.bytes()));
            // Set type to `application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8`.
            type = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8"_utf16;
            return {};
        },
        [&](Utf16String const& scalar_value_string) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> {
            // Set source to the UTF-8 encoding of object.
            auto utf8_scalar_value_string = scalar_value_string.to_utf8();
            source = MUST(Core::ImmutableBytes::copy(utf8_scalar_value_string.bytes()));
            // Set type to `text/plain;charset=UTF-8`.
            type = "text/plain;charset=UTF-8"_utf16;
            return {};
        },
        [&](GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> stream) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> {
            // If keepalive is true, then throw a TypeError.
            if (keepalive)
                return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Cannot extract body from stream when keepalive is set"_utf16 };

            // If object is disturbed or locked, then throw a TypeError.
            if (stream->is_disturbed() || stream->is_locked())
                return WebIDL::SimpleException { WebIDL::SimpleExceptionType::TypeError, "Cannot extract body from disturbed or locked stream"_utf16 };

            return {};
        }));

    // 11. If source is a byte sequence, then set action to a step that returns source and length to source’s length.
    // NB: A Blob source is held as its bytes too, and is not a byte sequence here.
    if (source.has_value() && !object.has<GC::Ref<FileAPI::Blob>>()) {
        action = [bytes = *source] {
            return bytes.copy_to_byte_buffer().release_value_but_fixme_should_propagate_errors();
        };
        length = source->size();
    }

    // 12. If action is non-null, then run these steps in parallel:
    if (action) {
        // AD-HOC: There is a race condition between document population(Ex: load_html_document->fully_read->read_all_bytes->readable_stream_default_reader_read)
        // and stream population. So currently we run stream population synchronously.
        HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };

        // 1. Run action.
        auto bytes = action();

        // Whenever one or more bytes are available and stream is not errored, enqueue the result of creating a
        // Uint8Array from the available bytes into stream.
        if (!bytes.is_empty() && !stream->is_errored()) {
            auto array_buffer = JS::ArrayBuffer::create(realm, move(bytes));
            auto chunk = JS::Uint8Array::create(realm, array_buffer->byte_length(), *array_buffer);

            stream->enqueue(chunk).release_value_but_fixme_should_propagate_errors();
        }

        // When running action is done, close stream.
        stream->close();
    }

    // 13. Let body be a body whose stream is stream, source is source, and length is length.
    auto body = Infrastructure::Body::create(*stream, { move(source), length });

    // 14. Return (body, type).
    return Infrastructure::BodyWithType { .body = body, .type = move(type) };
}

Infrastructure::Body* web_fetch_safely_extract_body(void* realm, BodyInitABI const* object, FlatPtr* out_type)
{
    auto body_init = [&]() -> BodyInitOrReadableBytes {
        switch (object->kind) {
        case BodyInitABI::Kind::Blob:
            return GC::Ref { *static_cast<FileAPI::Blob*>(object->cell) };
        case BodyInitABI::Kind::Bytes:
            return object->bytes;
        case BodyInitABI::Kind::FormData:
            return GC::Ref { *static_cast<XHR::FormData*>(object->cell) };
        case BodyInitABI::Kind::URLSearchParams:
            return GC::Ref { *static_cast<DOMURL::URLSearchParams*>(object->cell) };
        case BodyInitABI::Kind::String:
            return Utf16String::from_raw(object->string);
        }
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }();
    auto body_with_type = safely_extract_body(*static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm), body_init);
    *out_type = body_with_type.type.has_value() ? move(*body_with_type.type).into_raw() : 0;
    return body_with_type.body.ptr();
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <LibCore/ImmutableBytes.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchByteChannel.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

struct NullBody {
    bool operator==(NullBody const&) const = default;
};

inline bool is_present_body_handle(Core::ImmutableBytes const& bytes)
{
    return bytes.is_valid();
}

template<typename T>
bool is_present_body_handle(NonnullRefPtr<T> const&)
{
    return true;
}

template<typename... Ts>
bool is_present_body_handle(Variant<Ts...> const& handle)
{
    return handle.visit([](auto const& arm) { return is_present_body_handle(arm); });
}

// A delivered body is never null.
template<typename Handle>
class Delivered {
public:
    explicit Delivered(Handle handle)
        : m_handle(move(handle))
    {
        VERIFY(is_present_body_handle(m_handle));
    }

    Handle const& handle() const { return m_handle; }

private:
    Handle m_handle;
};

using NonNullLocalBodyHandle = Variant<Core::ImmutableBytes, NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannel>>;

template<typename Handle>
using BodyPresentation = Variant<NullBody, Delivered<Handle>>;

using LocalBodyPresentation = BodyPresentation<NonNullLocalBodyHandle>;

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/BodyPresentation.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchTimingSeed.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/Ids.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/NetworkActivity.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/Responses.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/HighResolutionTime/DOMHighResTimeStamp.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine::Event {

// The response main fetch hands over to the fetch's agent.
struct ResponseDelivery {
    NonnullRefPtr<Infrastructure::Response const> response;
    // The body of the response's internal response. A channel moves out of the response into the delivery.
    LocalBodyPresentation body;
    FetchTimingSeed timing_seed;
    // The manual redirect's continuation that is open at the handover, which waits for the agent's answer.
    Optional<ContinuationId> redirect_continuation_id;
};

// Sent only for a body still arriving at its response's handover, once the network completes it.
struct EndOfBody {
    DeliveryId delivery_id;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp end_time { 0 };
};

struct ConsumeBodyResult {
    struct Null { };
    struct Bytes {
        Core::ImmutableBytes bytes;
    };
    struct Failure { };
    using Outcome = Variant<Null, Bytes, Failure>;

    DeliveryId delivery_id;
    Outcome outcome;
};

struct BodyChannelReadable {
    DeliveryId delivery_id;
    WakeTicket ticket { 0 };
};

// A delivery's end, committed exactly once by the engine.
struct DeliveryEnd {
    struct Released { };
    struct Revoked { };
    using Outcome = Variant<Released, Revoked>;

    DeliveryId delivery_id;
    Outcome outcome;
};

struct RequestTransmissionStarted {
    TransmissionId transmission_id;
    TransmissionGeneration generation;
};

// A timing update: the network phases a load of the fetch's request settled as it finished. Only a load that completes
// sends one.
struct RequestTransmissionEnded {
    FetchNetworkPhases network_phases;
};

// The length of one more chunk of a request's body.
struct RequestBodyProgress {
    u64 length { 0 };
};

// The end of a request's body after its last chunk, or the end of a null body.
struct RequestBodyEndOfBody {
    bool body_is_null { false };
};

// Asks the fetch's agent to read a request's body from its stream, the only place its bytes are.
struct ReadRequestBodyStream { };

// A request's body is sent from its source.
struct RequestBodySentFromSource { };

// The fetch's last event: its engine will send nothing more for it.
struct FetchEnded { };

}

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

using EngineEvent = Variant<
    Event::ResponseDelivery,
    Event::EndOfBody,
    Event::ConsumeBodyResult,
    Event::BodyChannelReadable,
    Event::DeliveryEnd,
    Event::RequestTransmissionStarted,
    Event::RequestTransmissionEnded,
    Event::RequestBodyProgress,
    Event::RequestBodyEndOfBody,
    Event::ReadRequestBodyStream,
    Event::RequestBodySentFromSource,
    Event::NetworkActivity,
    Event::FetchEnded>;

}

/*

#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchBodyDeliveryGate.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

// A command posted after the gate's loop is gone is dropped.
class FetchBodyDeliveryGateSink final : public FetchByteChannelProducerSink {
public:
    explicit FetchBodyDeliveryGateSink(NonnullRefPtr<FetchBodyDeliveryGate> gate)
        : m_producer_loop(Core::EventLoop::current_weak())
        , m_gate(move(gate))
    {
    }

    virtual void grant_credit(u64 byte_count) override
    {
        post([byte_count](FetchBodyDeliveryGate& gate) { gate.grant_credit(byte_count); });
    }

    virtual void consumer_cancelled() override
    {
        post([](FetchBodyDeliveryGate& gate) { gate.consumer_cancelled(); });
    }

private:
    void post(Function<void(FetchBodyDeliveryGate&)> command)
    {
        auto loop = m_producer_loop->take();
        if (!loop)
            return;
        loop->deferred_invoke([gate = m_gate, command = move(command)] { command(*gate); });
    }

    NonnullRefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> m_producer_loop;
    NonnullRefPtr<FetchBodyDeliveryGate> m_gate;
};

NonnullRefPtr<FetchBodyDeliveryGate> FetchBodyDeliveryGate::create(NavigationHold navigation_hold)
{
    return adopt_ref(*new FetchBodyDeliveryGate(navigation_hold));
}

FetchBodyDeliveryGate::FetchBodyDeliveryGate(NavigationHold navigation_hold)
    : m_hold_allowance(navigation_hold == NavigationHold::Held ? 0 : unbounded)
{
}

FetchBodyDeliveryGate::~FetchBodyDeliveryGate()
{
    VERIFY(!m_transport);
}

NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannelProducerSink> FetchBodyDeliveryGate::create_channel_sink()
{
    return adopt_ref(*new FetchBodyDeliveryGateSink(*this));
}

void FetchBodyDeliveryGate::attach_transport(NonnullRefPtr<Transport> transport)
{
    if (m_terminated) {
        transport->stop();
        return;
    }
    m_transport = move(transport);
    apply_to_transport();
}

void FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport::misbehaved(StringView reason)
{
    dbgln("FetchBodyDeliveryGate: The transport misbehaved: {}", reason);
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

FetchBodyDeliveryGate::DeliveryResult FetchBodyDeliveryGate::did_deliver(u64 byte_count)
{
    auto allowance = min(m_channel_allowance, m_hold_allowance);
    if (byte_count > allowance - min(allowance, m_delivered_byte_count)) {
        if (m_transport)
            m_transport->misbehaved("The transport delivered more than it was allowed"sv);
        return DeliveryResult::Rejected;
    }
    m_delivered_byte_count += byte_count;
    return DeliveryResult::Accepted;
}

void FetchBodyDeliveryGate::release_hold_up_to(u64 byte_count)
{
    if (m_hold_allowance == unbounded)
        return;
    m_hold_allowance = max(m_hold_allowance, m_delivered_byte_count + byte_count);
    apply_to_transport();
}

void FetchBodyDeliveryGate::release_hold()
{
    m_hold_allowance = unbounded;
    apply_to_transport();
}

void FetchBodyDeliveryGate::grant_credit(u64 byte_count)
{
    m_channel_allowance += byte_count;
    apply_to_transport();
}

void FetchBodyDeliveryGate::consumer_cancelled()
{
    m_terminated = true;
    if (auto transport = exchange(m_transport, nullptr))
        transport->stop();
}

void FetchBodyDeliveryGate::detach_transport()
{
    m_terminated = true;
    m_transport = nullptr;
}

void FetchBodyDeliveryGate::release_transport()
{
    if (auto transport = exchange(m_transport, nullptr))
        transport->pause_body_delivery();
    m_terminated = true;
}

void FetchBodyDeliveryGate::apply_to_transport()
{
    if (!m_transport)
        return;

    auto allowance = min(m_channel_allowance, m_hold_allowance);
    auto remaining = allowance - min(allowance, m_delivered_byte_count);
    if (remaining > 0)
        m_transport->resume_body_delivery_up_to(remaining);
    else
        m_transport->pause_body_delivery();
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchBodyDeliveryGate.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <AK/RefCounted.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Weakable.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchByteChannel.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

// The transport may deliver only up to the smaller of the channel's credit and the navigation hold. Every method
// runs on the loop the gate was created on.
class WEB_API FetchBodyDeliveryGate final : public AtomicRefCounted<FetchBodyDeliveryGate> {
public:
    enum class NavigationHold : u8 {
        None,
        Held,
    };

    class WEB_API Transport : public RefCounted<Transport>
        , public Weakable<Transport> {
    public:
        virtual ~Transport() = default;
        virtual void resume_body_delivery_up_to(u64 byte_count) = 0;
        virtual void pause_body_delivery() = 0;
        virtual void stop() = 0;

        // Called for a delivery no honest transport could have made.
        virtual void misbehaved(StringView reason);
    };

    [[nodiscard]] static NonnullRefPtr<FetchBodyDeliveryGate> create(NavigationHold);
    ~FetchBodyDeliveryGate();

    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannelProducerSink> create_channel_sink();

    // Allowances granted before the transport exists are applied on attach.
    void attach_transport(NonnullRefPtr<Transport>);

    enum class DeliveryResult : u8 {
        Accepted,
        Rejected,
    };

    // Delivery consumes both allowances; a delivery past them is reported to the transport and rejected.
    [[nodiscard]] DeliveryResult did_deliver(u64 byte_count);

    // Permits this many further bytes from the current delivery point.
    void release_hold_up_to(u64 byte_count);
    void release_hold();

    void consumer_cancelled();

    // A detached transport is never touched again.
    void detach_transport();

    // Pauses the transport and detaches it.
    void release_transport();

    void grant_credit(u64 byte_count);

private:
    explicit FetchBodyDeliveryGate(NavigationHold);

    static constexpr u64 unbounded = NumericLimits<u64>::max();

    void apply_to_transport();

    u64 m_channel_allowance { 0 };
    u64 m_hold_allowance { 0 };
    u64 m_delivered_byte_count { 0 };
    bool m_terminated { false };
    RefPtr<Transport> m_transport;
};

}

/*

#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchByteChannel.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannel> FetchByteChannel::create(Watermarks watermarks, NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannelProducerSink> producer_sink)
{
    return adopt_ref(*new FetchByteChannel(watermarks, move(producer_sink)));
}

FetchByteChannel::FetchByteChannel(Watermarks watermarks, NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannelProducerSink> producer_sink)
    : m_watermarks(watermarks)
    , m_producer_sink(move(producer_sink))
    , m_outstanding_transport_credit(watermarks.high)
{
    VERIFY(m_watermarks.low > 0);
    VERIFY(m_watermarks.low <= m_watermarks.high);
}

// A sink may reenter the channel.
void FetchByteChannel::dispatch(PendingNotifications const& notifications)
{
    for (auto const& notification : notifications) {
        notification.visit(
            [&](Wake const& wake) { m_consumer_sink->wake(wake.ticket); },
            [&](GrantCredit const& grant) { m_producer_sink->grant_credit(grant.byte_count); },
            [&](ConsumerCancelledNotice) { m_producer_sink->consumer_cancelled(); },
            [&](Misbehaved const& misbehaved) { m_producer_sink->misbehaved(misbehaved.reason); });
    }
}

void FetchByteChannelProducerSink::misbehaved(StringView reason)
{
    dbgln("FetchByteChannel: The transport misbehaved: {}", reason);
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

bool FetchByteChannel::is_due_locked(WakeOn const& wake_on) const
{
    if (!m_state.has<Open>())
        return true;
    return wake_on.visit(
        [&](BufferedAtLeast const& buffered_at_least) { return m_buffered_byte_count >= buffered_at_least.byte_count; },
        [](EndOnly) { return false; },
        [&](PrefixOf const& prefix_of) { return m_buffered_byte_count >= prefix_of.byte_count; });
}

void FetchByteChannel::wake_due_waiters_locked(PendingNotifications& notifications)
{
    m_armed_waiters.remove_all_matching([&](ArmedWaiter const& waiter) {
        if (!is_due_locked(waiter.wake_on))
            return false;
        keep_prefix_locked(waiter.ticket, waiter.wake_on);
        notifications.append(Wake { waiter.ticket });
        return true;
    });
}

// A cancelled or transferred channel keeps nothing, so take_prefix() finds no prefix for it.
void FetchByteChannel::keep_prefix_locked(WakeTicket ticket, WakeOn const& wake_on)
{
    auto const* prefix_of = wake_on.get_pointer<PrefixOf>();
    if (!prefix_of || m_state.has<ConsumerCancelled>() || m_state.has<Transferred>())
        return;

    ByteBuffer prefix;
    auto append_up_to_limit = [&](ReadonlyBytes bytes) {
        auto length = min<u64>(bytes.size(), prefix_of->byte_count - prefix.size());
        prefix.append(bytes.trim(static_cast<size_t>(length)));
    };
    for (auto const& chunk : m_chunks) {
        if (prefix.size() == prefix_of->byte_count)
            break;
        append_up_to_limit(chunk.bytes());
    }
    if (prefix.size() < prefix_of->byte_count)
        append_up_to_limit(m_copied_tail.bytes());

    TakeResult kept { .taken = {}, .state = m_state, .buffered_byte_count = m_buffered_byte_count };
    if (!prefix.is_empty())
        kept.taken.append(Core::ImmutableBytes::adopt(move(prefix)));
    m_kept_prefixes.append({ ticket, move(kept) });
}

FetchByteChannel::WriteResult FetchByteChannel::write(Core::ImmutableBytes bytes)
{
    return write_bytes(move(bytes));
}

FetchByteChannel::WriteResult FetchByteChannel::write_copy(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    return write_bytes(bytes);
}

// This implements the buffer-filling steps of HTTP-network fetch's transmission loop.
// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-http-network-fetch
FetchByteChannel::WriteResult FetchByteChannel::write_bytes(Variant<Core::ImmutableBytes, ReadonlyBytes> bytes)
{
    auto size = bytes.visit([](auto const& written) -> u64 { return written.size(); });

    PendingNotifications notifications;
    auto result = WriteResult::Rejected;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        if (m_transport_ended) {
            notifications.append(Misbehaved { "The transport delivered after ending the body"sv });
        } else if (!m_state.has<Open>()) {
            // Before the transport ends the body, a write after a cancellation or a transfer is rejected without a
            // misbehaved() report.
        } else if (size > m_outstanding_transport_credit) {
            notifications.append(Misbehaved { "The transport delivered more than it was granted"sv });
        } else {
            result = WriteResult::Accepted;
            if (size > 0) {
                // 12. Append bytes to buffer.
                m_buffered_byte_count += size;
                bytes.visit(
                    [&](Core::ImmutableBytes& chunk) {
                        seal_copied_tail_locked();
                        m_chunks.append(move(chunk));
                    },
                    [&](ReadonlyBytes copied) { m_copied_tail.append(copied); });

                // 13. If the size of buffer is larger than an upper limit chosen by the user agent, ask the user agent
                //     to suspend the ongoing fetch.
                // Spent credit is the suspension: the transport delivers only what it was granted.
                m_outstanding_transport_credit -= size;
                wake_due_waiters_locked(notifications);
            }
        }
    }
    dispatch(notifications);
    return result;
}

void FetchByteChannel::seal_copied_tail_locked()
{
    if (m_copied_tail.is_empty())
        return;
    m_chunks.append(Core::ImmutableBytes::adopt(move(m_copied_tail)));
    m_copied_tail = {};
}

FetchByteChannel::TerminateResult FetchByteChannel::terminate_locked(State terminal_state, PendingNotifications& notifications)
{
    VERIFY(!terminal_state.has<Open>());
    if (!m_state.has<Open>())
        return TerminateResult::AlreadyTerminated;

    if (terminal_state.has<Errored>()) {
        m_chunks.clear();
        m_copied_tail.clear();
        m_buffered_byte_count = 0;
        m_whole_body.clear();
    }
    m_state = move(terminal_state);
    wake_due_waiters_locked(notifications);
    return TerminateResult::Terminated;
}

FetchByteChannel::TerminateResult FetchByteChannel::close()
{
    PendingNotifications notifications;
    auto result = TerminateResult::AlreadyTerminated;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        if (m_transport_ended) {
            notifications.append(Misbehaved { "The transport ended the body twice"sv });
        } else {
            m_transport_ended = true;
            result = terminate_locked(Closed {}, notifications);
        }
    }
    dispatch(notifications);
    return result;
}

FetchByteChannel::TerminateResult FetchByteChannel::error(Errored errored)
{
    PendingNotifications notifications;
    auto result = TerminateResult::AlreadyTerminated;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        if (m_transport_ended) {
            notifications.append(Misbehaved { "The transport ended the body twice"sv });
        } else {
            m_transport_ended = true;
            result = terminate_locked(move(errored), notifications);
        }
    }
    dispatch(notifications);
    return result;
}

void FetchByteChannel::keep_whole_body(Core::ImmutableBytes whole_body)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    if (m_state.has<Open>() && !m_whole_body.has_value())
        m_whole_body = move(whole_body);
}

Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> FetchByteChannel::whole_body() const
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    return m_whole_body;
}

void FetchByteChannel::set_delivery_id_unless_closed(DeliveryId delivery_id)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    VERIFY(!m_delivery_id.has_value());
    if (!m_state.has<Closed>())
        m_delivery_id = delivery_id;
}

Optional<DeliveryId> FetchByteChannel::delivery_id() const
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    return m_delivery_id;
}

FetchByteChannel::TerminateResult FetchByteChannel::cancel()
{
    PendingNotifications notifications;
    auto result = TerminateResult::AlreadyTerminated;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        m_kept_prefixes.clear();
        // A Closed channel keeps its undrained buffer, which a Streams cancellation may still discard.
        if (m_state.has<Open>() || (m_state.has<Closed>() && m_buffered_byte_count > 0)) {
            m_state = ConsumerCancelled {};
            m_chunks.clear();
            m_copied_tail.clear();
            m_buffered_byte_count = 0;
            m_whole_body.clear();
            wake_due_waiters_locked(notifications);
            if (!m_transport_ended)
                notifications.append(ConsumerCancelledNotice {});
            result = TerminateResult::Terminated;
        }
    }
    dispatch(notifications);
    return result;
}

Vector<Core::ImmutableBytes> FetchByteChannel::transfer_out()
{
    PendingNotifications notifications;
    Vector<Core::ImmutableBytes> undrained_bytes;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        m_kept_prefixes.clear();
        if (!m_state.has<Open>() && !m_state.has<Closed>())
            return {};

        seal_copied_tail_locked();
        undrained_bytes = move(m_chunks);
        m_buffered_byte_count = 0;
        m_whole_body.clear();
        m_state = Transferred {};
        wake_due_waiters_locked(notifications);
    }
    dispatch(notifications);
    return undrained_bytes;
}

// This implements the buffer-draining half of the pullAlgorithm in HTTP-network fetch.
// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-http-network-fetch
FetchByteChannel::TakeResult FetchByteChannel::take_locked(u64 limit, PendingNotifications& notifications)
{
    seal_copied_tail_locked();

    TakeResult result;

    u64 remaining = limit;
    while (remaining > 0 && !m_chunks.is_empty()) {
        auto& front = m_chunks.first();
        auto available = front.size();
        auto length = static_cast<size_t>(min<u64>(available, remaining));

        result.taken.append(front.slice(0, length));
        remaining -= length;
        m_buffered_byte_count -= length;

        if (length == available)
            m_chunks.take_first();
        else
            front = front.slice(length, available - length);
    }

    result.state = m_state;
    result.buffered_byte_count = m_buffered_byte_count;

    // 1. If the size of buffer is smaller than a lower limit chosen by the user agent and the
    //    ongoing fetch is suspended, resume the fetch.
    if (m_state.has<Open>() && m_buffered_byte_count < m_watermarks.low) {
        auto target = m_watermarks.high - m_buffered_byte_count;
        if (target > m_outstanding_transport_credit) {
            notifications.append(GrantCredit { target - m_outstanding_transport_credit });
            m_outstanding_transport_credit = target;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

void FetchByteChannel::attach_consumer(NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannelConsumerSink> consumer_sink)
{
    VERIFY(!m_consumer_sink);
    m_consumer_sink = move(consumer_sink);
}

FetchByteChannel::TakeResult FetchByteChannel::take_up_to(u64 limit)
{
    PendingNotifications notifications;
    TakeResult result;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        result = take_locked(limit, notifications);
    }
    dispatch(notifications);
    return result;
}

FetchByteChannel::TakeResult FetchByteChannel::take_all()
{
    return take_up_to(NumericLimits<u64>::max());
}

FetchByteChannel::TakeResult FetchByteChannel::peek_up_to(u64 limit)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    seal_copied_tail_locked();

    TakeResult result;
    u64 remaining = limit;
    for (auto const& chunk : m_chunks) {
        if (remaining == 0)
            break;
        auto length = static_cast<size_t>(min<u64>(chunk.size(), remaining));
        result.taken.append(chunk.slice(0, length));
        remaining -= length;
    }
    result.state = m_state;
    result.buffered_byte_count = m_buffered_byte_count;
    return result;
}

WakeTicket FetchByteChannel::arm_waiter(WakeOn wake_on)
{
    VERIFY(m_consumer_sink);
    wake_on.visit(
        [](BufferedAtLeast const& buffered_at_least) { VERIFY(buffered_at_least.byte_count > 0); },
        [](EndOnly) { },
        [](PrefixOf const& prefix_of) { VERIFY(prefix_of.byte_count > 0); });

    PendingNotifications notifications;
    WakeTicket ticket { 0 };
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
        ticket = WakeTicket { m_next_ticket++ };
        if (is_due_locked(wake_on)) {
            keep_prefix_locked(ticket, wake_on);
            notifications.append(Wake { ticket });
        } else {
            m_armed_waiters.append({ ticket, move(wake_on) });
        }
    }
    dispatch(notifications);
    return ticket;
}

Optional<FetchByteChannel::TakeResult> FetchByteChannel::take_prefix(WakeTicket ticket)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    auto index = m_kept_prefixes.find_first_index_if([&](KeptPrefix const& kept) { return kept.ticket == ticket; });
    if (!index.has_value())
        return {};
    return m_kept_prefixes.take(*index).prefix;
}

void FetchByteChannel::disarm_waiter(WakeTicket ticket)
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_mutex };
    m_armed_waiters.remove_first_matching([&](ArmedWaiter const& waiter) { return waiter.ticket == ticket; });
    m_kept_prefixes.remove_first_matching([&](KeptPrefix const& kept) { return kept.ticket == ticket; });
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCore/ImmutableBytes.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/Ids.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

// Invoked outside the channel lock, possibly from the peer's thread; holds no GC state.
class WEB_API FetchByteChannelConsumerSink : public AtomicRefCounted<FetchByteChannelConsumerSink> {
public:
    virtual ~FetchByteChannelConsumerSink() = default;

    // The ticket names the arm_waiter() call this wake answers; a stale wake is rejected.
    virtual void wake(WakeTicket) = 0;
};

class WEB_API FetchByteChannelProducerSink : public AtomicRefCounted<FetchByteChannelProducerSink> {
public:
    virtual ~FetchByteChannelProducerSink() = default;

    // Grants the transport permission to deliver this many further bytes.
    virtual void grant_credit(u64 byte_count) = 0;

    virtual void consumer_cancelled() = 0;

    // Called for a delivery or an ending no honest transport could have made.
    virtual void misbehaved(StringView reason);
};

// The buffer HTTP-network fetch keeps between the network layer and a response body's stream; credit grants are
// its suspend and resume.
// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-http-network-fetch
class WEB_API FetchByteChannel final : public AtomicRefCounted<FetchByteChannel> {
public:
    struct Watermarks {
        u64 low { 0 };
        u64 high { 0 };
    };

    struct Open { };
    struct Closed { };
    struct Errored {
        // The error a consumer turns into an exception in its own realm.
        ByteBuffer message;
    };
    struct ConsumerCancelled { };
    struct Transferred { };
    using State = Variant<Open, Closed, Errored, ConsumerCancelled, Transferred>;

    // Snapshotted atomically with the bytes taken or peeked.
    struct TakeResult {
        Vector<Core::ImmutableBytes> taken;
        State state { Open {} };
        u64 buffered_byte_count { 0 };
    };

    [[nodiscard]] static NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannel> create(Watermarks, NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannelProducerSink>);

    // The credit the producer should hand the transport before the first write.
    [[nodiscard]] u64 initial_credit() const { return m_watermarks.high; }

    enum class WriteResult : u8 {
        Accepted,
        Rejected,
    };

    // A close or error is the transport's one ending; cancel() also overrides a Closed channel with undrained bytes.
    enum class TerminateResult : u8 {
        Terminated,
        AlreadyTerminated,
    };

    // Producer side.
    WriteResult write(Core::ImmutableBytes);
    // Copies the bytes; copies written one after another share a buffer until they are taken.
    WriteResult write_copy(ReadonlyBytes);
    TerminateResult close();
    TerminateResult error(Errored);

    // The bytes of a transport that delivers slices of one whole body. The first handed over while the channel is open
    // is kept until it errors, is cancelled or is transferred.
    void keep_whole_body(Core::ImmutableBytes);
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> whole_body() const;

    // The delivery of the handed-over response these bytes are the body of. Set once, unless the channel is Closed.
    void set_delivery_id_unless_closed(DeliveryId);
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<DeliveryId> delivery_id() const;

    // Consumer side.
    // The consumer attaches its sink once, before any arm_waiter() call.
    void attach_consumer(NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannelConsumerSink>);
    [[nodiscard]] TakeResult take_up_to(u64 limit);
    [[nodiscard]] TakeResult take_all();

    // Either side may cancel; the producer hears of it unless it has already ended the body.
    TerminateResult cancel();

    // Ends an open or closed channel for a body that moves to another process, returning its undrained bytes. The
    // transport hears nothing, and later writes and endings do nothing.
    [[nodiscard]] Vector<Core::ImmutableBytes> transfer_out();

    // Returns up to limit bytes from the front of the buffer, removing none and granting no credit.
    [[nodiscard]] TakeResult peek_up_to(u64 limit);

    // A waiter fires once the channel buffers at least byte_count bytes, or ends.
    struct BufferedAtLeast {
        u64 byte_count;
    };
    // A waiter fires only once the channel ends: closes, errors, or is cancelled or transferred.
    struct EndOnly { };
    // Fires as BufferedAtLeast does, and keeps a copy of the first byte_count bytes and the state from the moment it
    // is due, for take_prefix().
    struct PrefixOf {
        u64 byte_count;
    };
    using WakeOn = Variant<BufferedAtLeast, EndOnly, PrefixOf>;

    // Each call adds a waiter that fires at most once, and returns the ticket its wake will carry; a wake already due
    // fires before this returns, outside the lock. Waiters due at the same time fire in the order they were added.
    WakeTicket arm_waiter(WakeOn = BufferedAtLeast { 1 });
    void disarm_waiter(WakeTicket);

    // What a PrefixOf waiter kept, once. A cancellation, a transfer or disarming its ticket drops it unread.
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<TakeResult> take_prefix(WakeTicket);

private:
    FetchByteChannel(Watermarks, NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannelProducerSink>);

    // Sink calls decided under the lock and made after it is released, in order.
    struct Wake {
        WakeTicket ticket { 0 };
    };
    struct GrantCredit {
        u64 byte_count { 0 };
    };
    struct ConsumerCancelledNotice { };
    struct Misbehaved {
        StringView reason;
    };
    using Notification = Variant<Wake, GrantCredit, ConsumerCancelledNotice, Misbehaved>;
    using PendingNotifications = Vector<Notification, 2>;

    [[nodiscard]] WriteResult write_bytes(Variant<Core::ImmutableBytes, ReadonlyBytes>);
    void seal_copied_tail_locked();
    [[nodiscard]] TakeResult take_locked(u64 limit, PendingNotifications&);
    [[nodiscard]] TerminateResult terminate_locked(State, PendingNotifications&);
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_due_locked(WakeOn const&) const;
    void wake_due_waiters_locked(PendingNotifications&);
    void keep_prefix_locked(WakeTicket, WakeOn const&);
    void dispatch(PendingNotifications const&);

    struct ArmedWaiter {
        WakeTicket ticket { 0 };
        WakeOn wake_on;
    };

    // A compact copy, so it holds none of the chunks' storage.
    struct KeptPrefix {
        WakeTicket ticket { 0 };
        TakeResult prefix;
    };

    Watermarks const m_watermarks;
    NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannelProducerSink> const m_producer_sink;
    RefPtr<FetchByteChannelConsumerSink> m_consumer_sink;

    mutable Mutex m_mutex;
    Vector<Core::ImmutableBytes> m_chunks;
    // The write_copy() bytes that follow the last chunk.
    ByteBuffer m_copied_tail;
    u64 m_buffered_byte_count { 0 };
    u64 m_outstanding_transport_credit { 0 };
    State m_state { Open {} };
    bool m_transport_ended { false };
    Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> m_whole_body;
    Optional<DeliveryId> m_delivery_id;
    Vector<ArmedWaiter, 2> m_armed_waiters;
    Vector<KeptPrefix, 1> m_kept_prefixes;
    u64 m_next_ticket { 1 };
};

}

/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/Format.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchEngineRecord.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchExecutor.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

static Atomic<u64> s_next_delivery_id { 1 };
static Atomic<u64> s_next_continuation_id { 1 };

FetchEngineRecord::FetchEngineRecord(FetchEngineRecords& records, FetchId fetch_id, NonnullOwnPtr<EngineEventSink> event_sink, NonnullRefPtr<NetworkActivityObservers const> network_activity_observers)
    : m_records(records)
    , m_fetch_id(fetch_id)
    , m_event_sink(move(event_sink))
    , m_network_activity_observers(move(network_activity_observers))
{
}

FetchEngineRecord::~FetchEngineRecord()
{
    if (auto* records = m_records.ptr())
        records->remove({}, m_fetch_id);
}

void FetchEngineRecord::set_body_transport(FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport& transport)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_body_transport = transport;
}

void FetchEngineRecord::stop_body_transport()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (auto transport = exchange(m_body_transport, nullptr).strong_ref())
        transport->stop();
}

void FetchEngineRecord::set_cors_preflight_body_transport(FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport& transport)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_cors_preflight_body_transport = transport;
}

void FetchEngineRecord::stop_cors_preflight_body_transport()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (auto transport = exchange(m_cors_preflight_body_transport, nullptr).strong_ref())
        transport->stop();
}

void FetchEngineRecord::stop()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_stopped = true;
    if (m_redirect_continuation.has_value())
        abandon_redirect();
    stop_body_transport();
}

void FetchEngineRecord::add_network_transport(NetworkTransportHandle& handle, FetchBodyDeliveryGate& delivery_gate)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (auto* records = m_records.ptr())
        records->add_network_transport(handle, delivery_gate);
}

void FetchEngineRecord::deliver_body(FetchByteChannel& channel)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    channel.set_delivery_id_unless_closed(DeliveryId { s_next_delivery_id.fetch_add(1) });
}

void FetchEngineRecord::open_redirect_continuation(NetworkTransportHandle* network_transport)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    VERIFY(!m_redirect_continuation.has_value());

    ContinuationId continuation_id { s_next_continuation_id.fetch_add(1) };
    if (auto* records = m_records.ptr())
        records->did_offer_redirect_continuation({}, continuation_id);
    m_redirect_continuation = RedirectContinuation { continuation_id, network_transport };
    if (m_stopped)
        abandon_redirect();
}

FetchEngineRecord::RedirectAnswerResult FetchEngineRecord::resolve_redirect(ContinuationId continuation_id, Command::ResolveRedirect::Resolution const& resolution)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (!m_redirect_continuation.has_value() || m_redirect_continuation->id != continuation_id)
        return RedirectAnswerResult::NotOpen;
    if (!m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchEnded>())
        return RedirectAnswerResult::NotHandedOver;

    resolution.visit(
        [&](Command::ResolveRedirect::Follow) {
            // NB: Main fetch runs again before the stop of the body transport can end the redirect's load.
            m_main_fetch = MainFetchRunning {};
            close_redirect_continuation();
        },
        [&](Command::ResolveRedirect::AcceptAsFinal) {
            m_redirect_continuation.clear();
            end_fetch_unless_anything_is_left();
        },
        [&](Command::ResolveRedirect::Abandon) { abandon_redirect(); });
    return RedirectAnswerResult::Settled;
}

Optional<ContinuationId> FetchEngineRecord::open_redirect_continuation_id() const
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (!m_redirect_continuation.has_value())
        return {};
    return m_redirect_continuation->id;
}

void FetchEngineRecord::close_redirect_continuation()
{
    auto continuation = m_redirect_continuation.release_value();
    if (auto network_transport = continuation.network_transport.strong_ref())
        network_transport->release_transfer_lease();
    stop_body_transport();
}

void FetchEngineRecord::abandon_redirect()
{
    close_redirect_continuation();
    end_fetch_unless_anything_is_left();
}

NonnullRefPtr<FetchLoad> FetchEngineRecord::start_load()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    VERIFY(m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchRunning>());
    ++m_live_load_count;
    return adopt_ref(*new FetchLoad(*this));
}

void FetchEngineRecord::main_fetch_hands_over(Event::ResponseDelivery delivery)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchEnded>())
        return;
    VERIFY(m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchRunning>());
    m_main_fetch = MainFetchEnded {};
    m_event_sink->handle_event(move(delivery));
    end_fetch_unless_anything_is_left();
}

void FetchEngineRecord::main_fetch_cannot_hand_over()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchEnded>())
        return;
    end_main_fetch();
}

void FetchEngineRecord::defer(Function<void()> work)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (auto* records = m_records.ptr())
        records->defer(move(work));
}

void FetchEngineRecord::main_fetch_waits_for_preload()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    VERIFY(m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchRunning>());
    m_main_fetch = MainFetchWaitsForPreload {};
}

void FetchEngineRecord::main_fetch_stops_waiting_for_preload()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    VERIFY(m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchWaitsForPreload>());
    m_main_fetch = MainFetchRunning {};
}

bool FetchEngineRecord::abandon_preload_wait()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (!m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchWaitsForPreload>())
        return false;
    end_main_fetch();
    return true;
}

void FetchEngineRecord::did_end_load()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    VERIFY(m_live_load_count > 0);
    --m_live_load_count;
    end_fetch_unless_anything_is_left();
}

void FetchEngineRecord::end_main_fetch()
{
    m_main_fetch = MainFetchEnded {};
    end_fetch_unless_anything_is_left();
}

void FetchEngineRecord::end_fetch_unless_anything_is_left()
{
    if (m_ended || !m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchEnded>() || m_live_load_count > 0 || m_redirect_continuation.has_value())
        return;
    m_ended = true;
    m_event_sink->handle_event(Event::FetchEnded {});
}

FetchLoad::FetchLoad(FetchEngineRecord& record)
    : m_record(record)
{
}

void FetchLoad::did_give_response()
{
    ASSERT(m_record->is_on_owner_thread());
    m_gave_response = true;
}

void FetchLoad::end()
{
    ASSERT(m_record->is_on_owner_thread());
    if (m_ended)
        return;
    m_ended = true;
    m_record->did_end_load();
}

void FetchLoad::end_at_its_last_callback()
{
    end();
    if (!m_gave_response)
        m_record->main_fetch_cannot_hand_over();
}

void FetchEngineRecords::Agent::misbehaved(StringView reason)
{
    dbgln("FetchEngineRecords: The agent misbehaved: {}", reason);
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

FetchEngineRecords::FetchEngineRecords(NonnullOwnPtr<Agent> agent)
    : m_agent(move(agent))
{
}

void FetchEngineRecords::attach_to_executor(FetchExecutor& executor)
{
    VERIFY(!m_executor);
    m_executor = &executor;
}

void FetchEngineRecords::defer(Function<void()> work)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    VERIFY(m_executor);
    m_executor->defer({}, move(work));
}

RefPtr<FetchEngineRecord> FetchEngineRecords::start(FetchId fetch_id, NonnullOwnPtr<EngineEventSink> event_sink, NonnullRefPtr<NetworkActivityObservers const> network_activity_observers)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (fetch_id <= m_last_started_fetch_id) {
        m_agent->misbehaved("The agent started a fetch out of fetch id order"sv);
        return {};
    }
    m_last_started_fetch_id = fetch_id;

    auto record = adopt_ref(*new FetchEngineRecord(*this, fetch_id, move(event_sink), move(network_activity_observers)));
    m_records.set(fetch_id, record.ptr());
    return record;
}

void FetchEngineRecords::stop(FetchId fetch_id)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (fetch_id > m_last_started_fetch_id) {
        m_agent->misbehaved("The agent stopped a fetch it has not started"sv);
        return;
    }
    auto found_record = m_records.get(fetch_id);
    if (!found_record.has_value())
        return;
    NonnullRefPtr record = **found_record;
    record->stop();
}

FetchEngineRecords::RedirectAnswerOutcome FetchEngineRecords::resolve_redirect(Command::ResolveRedirect const& resolve)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (resolve.fetch_id > m_last_started_fetch_id) {
        m_agent->misbehaved("The agent resolved a redirect of a fetch it has not started"sv);
        return RedirectAnswerMisbehaved {};
    }
    if (resolve.continuation_id > m_last_offered_continuation_id) {
        m_agent->misbehaved("The agent resolved a redirect the engine never offered"sv);
        return RedirectAnswerMisbehaved {};
    }

    auto found_record = m_records.get(resolve.fetch_id);
    if (!found_record.has_value())
        return RedirectAnswerDropped {};
    NonnullRefPtr record = **found_record;
    switch (record->resolve_redirect(resolve.continuation_id, resolve.resolution)) {
    case FetchEngineRecord::RedirectAnswerResult::Settled:
        return record;
    case FetchEngineRecord::RedirectAnswerResult::NotOpen:
        return RedirectAnswerDropped {};
    case FetchEngineRecord::RedirectAnswerResult::NotHandedOver:
        m_agent->misbehaved("The agent answered a redirect before it was handed over"sv);
        return RedirectAnswerMisbehaved {};
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

void FetchEngineRecords::did_offer_redirect_continuation(Badge<FetchEngineRecord>, ContinuationId continuation_id)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_last_offered_continuation_id = continuation_id;
}

void FetchEngineRecords::abandon_preload_wait(FetchId fetch_id)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (fetch_id > m_last_started_fetch_id) {
        m_agent->misbehaved("The agent abandoned a preload wait of a fetch it has not started"sv);
        return;
    }

    auto found_record = m_records.get(fetch_id);
    if (!found_record.has_value())
        return;
    NonnullRefPtr record = **found_record;
    if (record->has_ended())
        return;
    if (!record->abandon_preload_wait())
        m_agent->misbehaved("The agent abandoned a preload wait of a fetch that waits for no preload"sv);
}

void FetchEngineRecords::add_network_transport(NetworkTransportHandle& handle, FetchBodyDeliveryGate& delivery_gate)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (m_network_transport_count >= m_network_transport_count_to_sweep_at)
        forget_network_transports_that_are_gone();

    auto& client_transports = m_network_transports.ensure(handle.transport_epoch());
    client_transports.highest_request_id = max(client_transports.highest_request_id, handle.request_id());
    auto result = client_transports.transports.set(handle.request_id(), { handle, delivery_gate });
    if (result == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry)
        ++m_network_transport_count;
}

void FetchEngineRecords::forget_network_transports_that_are_gone()
{
    m_network_transport_count = 0;
    for (auto& [transport_epoch, client_transports] : m_network_transports) {
        client_transports.transports.remove_all_matching([](auto&, auto& transport) { return !transport.handle; });
        m_network_transport_count += client_transports.transports.size();
    }
    m_network_transport_count_to_sweep_at = max(smallest_network_transport_count_to_sweep_at, 2 * m_network_transport_count);
}

void FetchEngineRecords::control_network_transport(Command::TransportControl const& control)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    auto client_transports = m_network_transports.get(control.transport_epoch);
    if (!client_transports.has_value() || control.request_id > client_transports->highest_request_id) {
        m_agent->misbehaved("The agent controlled a network transport the engine never had"sv);
        return;
    }

    auto transport = client_transports->transports.get(control.request_id);
    if (!transport.has_value())
        return;
    auto handle = transport->handle.strong_ref();
    if (!handle)
        return;
    auto delivery_gate = transport->delivery_gate;

    control.operation.visit(
        [&](Command::TransportControl::StopTransport) { handle->stop(); },
        [&](Command::TransportControl::ReleaseNavigationHold) { delivery_gate->release_hold(); },
        [&](Command::TransportControl::ReleaseNavigationHoldUpTo const& release) { delivery_gate->release_hold_up_to(release.byte_count); });
}

void FetchEngineRecords::remove(Badge<FetchEngineRecord>, FetchId fetch_id)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_records.remove(fetch_id);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchEngineRecord.h
/*
