#pragma once

#include <AK/Badge.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/RefCounted.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <AK/ThreadID.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <AK/WeakPtr.h>
#include <AK/Weakable.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/EngineCommand.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/EngineEventSink.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchBodyDeliveryGate.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchByteChannel.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/Ids.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/NetworkActivity.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/NetworkActivityObservers.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/NetworkTransportHandle.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

class FetchEngineRecords;
class FetchExecutor;
class FetchLoad;

// What the fetch engine keeps of a fetch it has started. Every method runs on the engine's loop, and so does the
// record's destruction.
class WEB_API FetchEngineRecord final : public RefCounted<FetchEngineRecord> {
public:
    ~FetchEngineRecord();

    [[nodiscard]] EngineEventSink& event_sink() { return *m_event_sink; }

    // Reports what happened to one of the fetch's RequestServer requests to the agent that started the fetch.
    void report_network_activity(RequestId request_id, Event::NetworkActivity::Activity activity)
    {
        m_event_sink->handle_event(Event::NetworkActivity { .request_id = request_id, .activity = move(activity) });
    }

    // Those of the agent that started the fetch.
    [[nodiscard]] NetworkActivityObservers const& network_activity_observers() const { return m_network_activity_observers; }

    // The transport of the response body the fetch receives, which stopping, aborting or terminating the fetch stops.
    void set_body_transport(FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport&);
    void stop_body_transport();

    // The transport of the response body a CORS preflight for the fetch receives, which stopping, aborting or
    // terminating the fetch leaves alone.
    void set_cors_preflight_body_transport(FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport&);
    void stop_cors_preflight_body_transport();

    // For a stop, abort or termination of the fetch: abandons the redirect continuation that is open, and any opened
    // later, and stops the fetch's body transport.
    void stop();

    void add_network_transport(NetworkTransportHandle&, FetchBodyDeliveryGate&);

    // Marks the channel as the body of a response handed over to the agent that started the fetch, with the id of that
    // delivery. A Closed channel, whose body has arrived whole, is not marked.
    void deliver_body(FetchByteChannel&);

    // Opens the continuation of a manual redirect the fetch hands over, which waits for the agent's answer. The
    // redirect's response arrived through the given network transport, if any.
    void open_redirect_continuation(NetworkTransportHandle*);
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<ContinuationId> open_redirect_continuation_id() const;

    enum class RedirectAnswerResult : u8 {
        Settled,
        // The continuation was settled before, or the id names another one.
        NotOpen,
        // Main fetch has not handed the redirect over yet.
        NotHandedOver,
    };
    // Settles the open continuation with the agent's answer once main fetch has handed the redirect over. Following also
    // lets main fetch run again.
    [[nodiscard]] RedirectAnswerResult resolve_redirect(ContinuationId, Command::ResolveRedirect::Resolution const&);

    // Starts a load of the fetch's request, which main fetch runs.
    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<FetchLoad> start_load();

    // Main fetch hands a response over to the agent that started the fetch, unless main fetch has ended. Main fetch has
    // ended before the agent receives the delivery, and the fetch ends after it if nothing else is left.
    void main_fetch_hands_over(Event::ResponseDelivery);
    [[nodiscard]] bool main_fetch_has_ended() const { return m_main_fetch.has<MainFetchEnded>(); }
    // Main fetch can no longer hand a response over. Does nothing once main fetch has ended.
    void main_fetch_cannot_hand_over();

    // Defers main fetch's work through the engine's executor; work deferred once the engine is gone never runs.
    void defer(Function<void()>);

    // Main fetch waits for a preload's response, until the agent resolves the wait or abandons it.
    void main_fetch_waits_for_preload();
    void main_fetch_stops_waiting_for_preload();
    // Ends main fetch's wait for a preload's response, after which main fetch can no longer hand a response over. Returns
    // whether main fetch was waiting.
    [[nodiscard]] bool abandon_preload_wait();

    // Whether the fetch has ended: main fetch has ended, no load is live and no redirect continuation is open.
    [[nodiscard]] bool has_ended() const { return m_ended; }

private:
    friend class FetchEngineRecords;
    friend class FetchLoad;

    FetchEngineRecord(FetchEngineRecords&, FetchId, NonnullOwnPtr<EngineEventSink>, NonnullRefPtr<NetworkActivityObservers const>);

    [[nodiscard]] bool is_on_owner_thread() const { return m_owner_thread.is_current_thread(); }

    // Closes the open redirect continuation, releasing the lease of its network transport and stopping the body
    // transport.
    void close_redirect_continuation();
    void abandon_redirect();
    void did_end_load();
    void end_main_fetch();
    // Sends the fetch's end as its last event once nothing keeps the fetch from ending.
    void end_fetch_unless_anything_is_left();

    AK::ThreadID m_owner_thread { AK::ThreadID::current() };
    WeakPtr<FetchEngineRecords> m_records;
    FetchId m_fetch_id;
    NonnullOwnPtr<EngineEventSink> m_event_sink;
    NonnullRefPtr<NetworkActivityObservers const> m_network_activity_observers;
    WeakPtr<FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport> m_body_transport;
    WeakPtr<FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport> m_cors_preflight_body_transport;

    struct RedirectContinuation {
        ContinuationId id;
        WeakPtr<NetworkTransportHandle> network_transport;
    };
    Optional<RedirectContinuation> m_redirect_continuation;

    // Whether a stop, abort or termination of the fetch has reached the engine.
    bool m_stopped { false };

    struct MainFetchRunning { };
    struct MainFetchWaitsForPreload { };
    struct MainFetchEnded { };
    Variant<MainFetchRunning, MainFetchWaitsForPreload, MainFetchEnded> m_main_fetch { MainFetchRunning {} };
    size_t m_live_load_count { 0 };
    bool m_ended { false };
};

// One load of a fetch's request: from its start until its transport will deliver nothing more.
class WEB_API FetchLoad final : public RefCounted<FetchLoad> {
public:
    // The load has resolved its pending response, possibly with a network error.
    void did_give_response();
    // Ends the load, unless it has ended already.
    void end();
    // Ends the load at its last callback. Main fetch can no longer hand a response over if the load has not resolved its
    // pending response.
    void end_at_its_last_callback();
    [[nodiscard]] bool has_ended() const { return m_ended; }

private:
    friend class FetchEngineRecord;

    explicit FetchLoad(FetchEngineRecord&);

    NonnullRefPtr<FetchEngineRecord> m_record;
    bool m_gave_response { false };
    bool m_ended { false };
};

// The records of the fetches an engine has started, by fetch id, and the network transports it controls. A record stays
// only while something else holds it. Every method, and each record's destruction, runs on the loop the records were
// created on.
class WEB_API FetchEngineRecords : public Weakable<FetchEngineRecords> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(FetchEngineRecords);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(FetchEngineRecords);

public:
    // The agent whose commands start and stop the fetches.
    class WEB_API Agent {
    public:
        AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

        virtual ~Agent() = default;

        // Called for a command no honest agent could have posted.
        virtual void misbehaved(StringView reason);
    };

    explicit FetchEngineRecords(NonnullOwnPtr<Agent>);

    // The executor that runs the engine, which outlives the records.
    void attach_to_executor(FetchExecutor&);
    void defer(Function<void()>);

    // Reports to the agent a fetch id no higher than that of an earlier start, and returns null for it.
    [[nodiscard]] RefPtr<FetchEngineRecord> start(FetchId, NonnullOwnPtr<EngineEventSink>, NonnullRefPtr<NetworkActivityObservers const>);

    // Handles a stop, abort or termination of the fetch. Does nothing once the fetch's record is gone. Reports to the
    // agent a fetch id above that of every started fetch.
    void stop(FetchId);

    // An answer for a continuation that is not open, or for a fetch whose record is gone, is dropped.
    struct RedirectAnswerDropped { };
    struct RedirectAnswerMisbehaved { };
    using RedirectAnswerOutcome = Variant<NonnullRefPtr<FetchEngineRecord>, RedirectAnswerDropped, RedirectAnswerMisbehaved>;

    // Settles the open continuation the answer names, returning the fetch's record. Reports to the agent a fetch id
    // above every start, a continuation id above every offer, or an answer before the redirect's handover.
    [[nodiscard]] RedirectAnswerOutcome resolve_redirect(Command::ResolveRedirect const&);
    void did_offer_redirect_continuation(Badge<FetchEngineRecord>, ContinuationId);

    // Does nothing once the fetch has ended or its record is gone. Reports to the agent a fetch id above that of every
    // started fetch, or a fetch whose main fetch does not wait for a preload.
    void abandon_preload_wait(FetchId);

    // Records a network transport, which the agent's transport controls name by the id and transport epoch of its
    // request.
    void add_network_transport(NetworkTransportHandle&, FetchBodyDeliveryGate&);
    // Does nothing once the transport is gone. Reports to the agent a client the engine had no transport of, or a request
    // id above every one it had for that client.
    void control_network_transport(Command::TransportControl const&);

    void remove(Badge<FetchEngineRecord>, FetchId);

    // Adding a network transport forgets those that are gone once the records hold twice as many as the last sweep left,
    // and at least this many.
    static constexpr size_t smallest_network_transport_count_to_sweep_at = 32;

private:
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_on_owner_thread() const { return m_owner_thread.is_current_thread(); }

    void forget_network_transports_that_are_gone();

    NonnullOwnPtr<Agent> m_agent;
    FetchExecutor* m_executor { nullptr };
    AK::ThreadID m_owner_thread { AK::ThreadID::current() };
    FetchId m_last_started_fetch_id { 0 };
    ContinuationId m_last_offered_continuation_id { 0 };
    HashMap<FetchId, FetchEngineRecord*> m_records;

    struct NetworkTransport {
        WeakPtr<NetworkTransportHandle> handle;
        NonnullRefPtr<FetchBodyDeliveryGate> delivery_gate;
    };
    // The network transports of the requests of one RequestServer client.
    struct ClientNetworkTransports {
        RequestId highest_request_id { 0 };
        HashMap<RequestId, NetworkTransport> transports;
    };
    HashMap<TransportEpoch, ClientNetworkTransports> m_network_transports;
    size_t m_network_transport_count { 0 };
    size_t m_network_transport_count_to_sweep_at { smallest_network_transport_count_to_sweep_at };
};

}

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchExecutor.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

FetchExecutor::FetchExecutor(FetchExecutorServices services, NonnullOwnPtr<EngineCommandSink> engine)
    : m_services(move(services))
    , m_engine(move(engine))
{
    m_engine->attach_to_executor(*this);
}

FetchExecutor::~FetchExecutor() = default;

void FetchExecutor::post(EngineCommand command)
{
    enqueue(move(command));
}

void FetchExecutor::defer(Badge<FetchEngineRecords>, Function<void()> work)
{
    enqueue(move(work));
}

void FetchExecutor::enqueue(PendingWork work)
{
    if (m_shut_down.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_acquire))
        return;

    // NB: A task runs every pending command and deferred work, oldest first, and not just the one it was posted with. A
    //     task can run in a nested event loop, such as the one a sync XHR spins, while tasks posted before it still wait
    //     in the outer loop. The engine must still see the commands in posting order, and the nested loop must also run
    //     the commands it waits for.
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_pending_work_mutex };
        m_pending_work.enqueue(move(work));
    }

    // The task keeps the executor, and so the engine, alive until it has run or been dropped.
    auto run_pending_work = [self = NonnullRefPtr(*this)] { self->run_pending_work(); };
    if (!post_task(move(run_pending_work)))
        drop_pending_work();
}

void FetchExecutor::run_pending_work()
{
    for (;;) {
        Optional<PendingWork> work;
        {
            MutexLocker locker { m_pending_work_mutex };
            if (m_pending_work.is_empty())
                return;
            work = m_pending_work.dequeue();
        }
        if (m_shut_down.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_acquire))
            continue;
        auto next = work.release_value();
        next.visit(
            [&](EngineCommand& command) { m_engine->handle_command(move(command)); },
            [](Function<void()>& deferred) { deferred(); });
    }
}

void FetchExecutor::drop_pending_work()
{
    // NB: Without a loop to run on, no command or deferred work that is still pending can ever run. They are destroyed
    //     after the lock is released.
    Vector<PendingWork> pending_work;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_pending_work_mutex };
        pending_work.ensure_capacity(m_pending_work.size());
        while (!m_pending_work.is_empty())
            pending_work.unchecked_append(m_pending_work.dequeue());
    }
}

void FetchExecutor::shutdown()
{
    m_shut_down.store(true, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_release);
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/Badge.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/Queue.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/EngineCommand.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/EngineCommandSink.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchExecutorServices.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

class FetchEngineRecords;

// Commands reach the engine on its thread, in posting order, and never after shutdown.
class WEB_API FetchExecutor : public AtomicRefCounted<FetchExecutor> {
public:
    virtual ~FetchExecutor();

    void post(EngineCommand);

    // Runs work of the engine's own on the engine's thread, after the commands posted before it, unless the executor
    // shuts down first.
    void defer(Badge<FetchEngineRecords>, Function<void()>);

    // Drops every command and deferred work that has not started running; one that has started completes.
    void shutdown();

protected:
    FetchExecutor(FetchExecutorServices, NonnullOwnPtr<EngineCommandSink>);

    FetchExecutorServices const& services() const { return m_services; }

    // Answers false if the task can never run, as the loop it would run on is gone.
    virtual bool post_task(Function<void()>) = 0;

private:
    using PendingWork = Variant<EngineCommand, Function<void()>>;

    void enqueue(PendingWork);
    void run_pending_work();
    void drop_pending_work();

    FetchExecutorServices m_services;
    NonnullOwnPtr<EngineCommandSink> m_engine;
    Mutex m_pending_work_mutex;
    Queue<PendingWork> m_pending_work;
    Atomic<bool> m_shut_down { false };
};

}

NonnullRefPtr<InlineFetchExecutor> InlineFetchExecutor::create(FetchExecutorServices services, NonnullOwnPtr<EngineCommandSink> engine)
{
    return adopt_ref(*new InlineFetchExecutor(move(services), move(engine)));
}

InlineFetchExecutor::InlineFetchExecutor(FetchExecutorServices services, NonnullOwnPtr<EngineCommandSink> engine)
    : FetchExecutor(move(services), move(engine))
{
}

bool InlineFetchExecutor::post_task(Function<void()> task)
{
    auto loop = services().event_loop->take();
    if (!loop)
        return false;
    loop->deferred_invoke(move(task));
    return true;
}

// Which observers of network activity an agent has. The agent writes it, and its fetch engine reads it before it
// copies a response's body bytes for them.
class NetworkActivityObservers final : public AtomicRefCounted<NetworkActivityObservers> {
public:
    [[nodiscard]] static NonnullRefPtr<NetworkActivityObservers> create() { return adopt_ref(*new NetworkActivityObservers); }

    // Whether a page of the agent has a DevTools client.
    [[nodiscard]] bool has_devtools_client() const { return m_pages_with_devtools_client.load() > 0; }
    void page_did_gain_devtools_client() { m_pages_with_devtools_client.fetch_add(1); }

        VERIFY(previous_count > 0);
    }

    NetworkActivityObservers() = default;

    Atomic<size_t, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed> m_pages_with_devtools_client { 0 };
};

#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

NonnullRefPtr<NetworkTransportHandle> NetworkTransportHandle::create(NonnullRefPtr<Requests::Request> request)
{
    return adopt_ref(*new NetworkTransportHandle(move(request)));
}

NetworkTransportHandle::NetworkTransportHandle(NonnullRefPtr<Requests::Request> request)
    : m_request(move(request))
{
}

NetworkTransportHandle::~NetworkTransportHandle()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
}

bool NetworkTransportHandle::has_file_backed_response_body() const
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    return m_request->has_file_backed_response_body();
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::resume_body_delivery_up_to(u64 byte_count)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_request->resume_body_delivery_up_to(byte_count);
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::pause_body_delivery()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_request->set_body_delivery_paused(true);
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::stop()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_request->stop();
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::release_transfer_lease()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_request->release_transfer_lease();
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::post_transport_control(FetchExecutor& executor, auto operation)
{
    Command::TransportControl control {
        .request_id = request_id(),
        .transport_epoch = transport_epoch(),
        .operation = move(operation),
    };
    executor.post(move(control));
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::post_stop(FetchExecutor& executor)
{
    NonnullRefPtr protector = *this;
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_stop_requested = true;
    if (auto on_stop_requested = exchange(m_on_stop_requested, nullptr))
        on_stop_requested();
    post_transport_control(executor, Command::TransportControl::StopTransport {});
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::post_release_navigation_hold(FetchExecutor& executor)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    post_transport_control(executor, Command::TransportControl::ReleaseNavigationHold {});
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::post_release_navigation_hold_up_to(FetchExecutor& executor, u64 byte_count)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    post_transport_control(executor, Command::TransportControl::ReleaseNavigationHoldUpTo { .byte_count = byte_count });
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::set_on_stop_requested(Function<void()> on_stop_requested)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_on_stop_requested = move(on_stop_requested);
}

Function<void()> NetworkTransportHandle::take_on_stop_requested()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    return exchange(m_on_stop_requested, nullptr);
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::set_on_requires_network(Function<void()> on_requires_network)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_request->on_requires_network = move(on_requires_network);
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::set_on_upload_progress(Function<void(u64 bytes_sent)> on_upload_progress)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_request->on_upload_progress = move(on_upload_progress);
}

void NetworkTransportHandle::set_on_teardown(Function<void(Requests::Request::TeardownReason)> on_teardown)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    m_request->on_teardown = move(on_teardown);
}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>

#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/Ids.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

class FetchExecutor;

// Controls the RequestServer request a fetch's response arrives through. Every method, and the handle's destruction,
// runs on the loop the handle was created on.
class WEB_API NetworkTransportHandle final : public FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport {
public:
    [[nodiscard]] static NonnullRefPtr<NetworkTransportHandle> create(NonnullRefPtr<Requests::Request>);
    virtual ~NetworkTransportHandle() override;

    [[nodiscard]] RequestId request_id() const { return RequestId { m_request->id() }; }
    [[nodiscard]] TransportEpoch transport_epoch() const { return TransportEpoch { m_request->transport_epoch() }; }

    // The key another client adopts the request by, while this process holds its lease.
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<Requests::RequestTransferLeaseKey> const& transfer_lease() const { return m_request->transfer_lease(); }
    [[nodiscard]] ByteString const& http_version() const { return m_request->http_version(); }

    [[nodiscard]] bool has_file_backed_response_body() const;

    virtual void resume_body_delivery_up_to(u64 byte_count) override;
    virtual void pause_body_delivery() override;
    virtual void stop() override;

    void release_transfer_lease();

    // The agent's controls, which reach the transport through the given executor. A stop is requested from the moment
    // it is posted.
    void post_stop(FetchExecutor&);
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_stop_requested() const { return m_stop_requested; }
    void post_release_navigation_hold(FetchExecutor&);
    void post_release_navigation_hold_up_to(FetchExecutor&, u64 byte_count);

    // Runs in the first post_stop(), unless it was taken before.
    void set_on_stop_requested(Function<void()>);
    [[nodiscard]] Function<void()> take_on_stop_requested();

    void set_on_requires_network(Function<void()>);
    void set_on_upload_progress(Function<void(u64 bytes_sent)>);
    void set_on_teardown(Function<void(Requests::Request::TeardownReason)>);

private:
    explicit NetworkTransportHandle(NonnullRefPtr<Requests::Request>);

    [[nodiscard]] bool is_on_owner_thread() const { return m_owner_thread.is_current_thread(); }
    void post_transport_control(FetchExecutor&, auto operation);

    NonnullRefPtr<Requests::Request> m_request;
    AK::ThreadID m_owner_thread { AK::ThreadID::current() };
    bool m_stop_requested { false };
    Function<void()> m_on_stop_requested;
};

#include <AK/TemporaryChange.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchByteChannel.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/WholeBodyRead.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

namespace {

// Takes a channel's bytes as they arrive, until the channel ends.
class ChannelRead final : public FetchByteChannelConsumerSink {
public:
    ChannelRead(NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannel> channel, Function<void(WholeBodyReadResult)> steps)
        : m_channel(move(channel))
        , m_steps(move(steps))
    {
    }

    void start()
    {
        m_channel->attach_consumer(*this);
        wake({});
    }

    virtual void wake(WakeTicket) override
    {
        NonnullRefPtr protector = *this;

        // An arm_waiter() call can wake the read again before it returns.
        m_woken = true;
        if (m_reading)
            return;
        TemporaryChange reading { m_reading, true };
        while (m_channel && m_woken) {
            m_woken = false;
            take_what_has_arrived();
        }
    }

private:
    void take_what_has_arrived()
    {
        auto taken = m_channel->take_all();
        for (auto const& chunk : taken.taken) {
            if (m_bytes.try_append(chunk.bytes()).is_error()) {
                m_channel->cancel();
                finish(WholeBodyReadFailure {});
                return;
            }
        }

        taken.state.visit(
            [&](FetchByteChannel::Open) { (void)m_channel->arm_waiter(FetchByteChannel::BufferedAtLeast { 1 }); },
            [&](FetchByteChannel::Closed) { finish(move(m_bytes)); },
            [&](FetchByteChannel::Errored const&) { finish(WholeBodyReadFailure {}); },
            [&](FetchByteChannel::ConsumerCancelled) { finish(WholeBodyReadFailure {}); },
            [&](FetchByteChannel::Transferred) { finish(WholeBodyReadFailure {}); });
    }

    void finish(WholeBodyReadResult result)
    {
        m_channel = nullptr;
        auto steps = move(m_steps);
        steps(move(result));
    }

    RefPtr<FetchByteChannel> m_channel;
    Function<void(WholeBodyReadResult)> m_steps;
    ByteBuffer m_bytes;
    bool m_reading { false };
    bool m_woken { false };
};

}

void read_whole_body(Infrastructure::ResponseBody const& body, Function<void(WholeBodyReadResult)> steps)
{
    body.bytes().visit(
        [&](Core::ImmutableBytes const& bytes) {
            auto copy = ByteBuffer::copy(bytes.bytes());
            if (copy.is_error()) {
                steps(WholeBodyReadFailure {});
                return;
            }
            steps(copy.release_value());
        },
        [&](NonnullRefPtr<FetchByteChannel> const& channel) {
            auto read = adopt_ref(*new ChannelRead(channel, move(steps)));
            read->start();
        },
        [](Infrastructure::ResponseBody::ReadThroughStream) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/WholeBodyTransport.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/WholeBodyTransport.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

static HashTable<WholeBodyTransport*>& transports_of_this_thread()
{
    static thread_local NeverDestroyed<HashTable<WholeBodyTransport*>> transports;
    return *transports;
}

NonnullRefPtr<WholeBodyTransport> WholeBodyTransport::create()
{
    return adopt_ref(*new WholeBodyTransport);
}

WholeBodyTransport::~WholeBodyTransport()
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    if (m_attached)
        transports_of_this_thread().remove(this);
}

void WholeBodyTransport::stop_all_on_this_thread()
{
    // Stopping a transport can drop the last reference to it, which removes it from the set.
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<WholeBodyTransport>> transports;
    transports.ensure_capacity(transports_of_this_thread().size());
    for (auto* transport : transports_of_this_thread())
        transports.unchecked_append(*transport);
    for (auto& transport : transports)
        transport->stop();
}

void WholeBodyTransport::forget_all_on_this_thread()
{
    transports_of_this_thread().clear();
}

void WholeBodyTransport::attach_to(FetchBodyDeliveryGate& gate)
{
    ASSERT(is_on_owner_thread());
    VERIFY(!m_attached);
    m_attached = true;
    transports_of_this_thread().set(this);
    gate.attach_transport(*this);
}

void WholeBodyTransport::set_body(Core::ImmutableBytes body, OnData on_data)
{
    VERIFY(m_attached);
    VERIFY(!m_body.has_value());
    m_body = move(body);
    m_on_data = move(on_data);
    schedule_delivery();
}

void WholeBodyTransport::when_delivered(Function<void()> on_delivered)
{
    VERIFY(!m_on_delivered);
    m_on_delivered = move(on_delivered);
    schedule_delivery();
}

void WholeBodyTransport::set_on_stop(Function<void()> on_stop)
{
    m_on_stop = move(on_stop);
}

void WholeBodyTransport::resume_body_delivery_up_to(u64 byte_count)
{
    m_allowance = byte_count;
    schedule_delivery();
}

void WholeBodyTransport::pause_body_delivery()
{
    m_allowance = 0;
}

void WholeBodyTransport::stop()
{
    m_stopped = true;
    m_body.clear();
    m_on_data = nullptr;
    m_on_delivered = nullptr;
    if (auto on_stop = move(m_on_stop))
        on_stop();
}

void WholeBodyTransport::schedule_delivery()
{
    if (m_stopped || m_delivery_scheduled)
        return;

    m_delivery_scheduled = true;
    Core::deferred_invoke([self = NonnullRefPtr(*this)] {
        self->m_delivery_scheduled = false;
        self->deliver();
    });
}

void WholeBodyTransport::deliver()
{
    if (!m_body.has_value())
        return;

    auto body_size = m_body->size();
    while (!m_stopped && m_delivered_byte_count < body_size && m_allowance > 0) {
        auto offset = m_delivered_byte_count;
        auto length = static_cast<size_t>(min<u64>(body_size - offset, m_allowance));
        m_delivered_byte_count += length;
        m_allowance -= length;
        m_on_data(Requests::ResponseData::from_file_backed_payload(*m_body, offset, length));
    }

    if (m_stopped || m_delivered_byte_count < body_size)
        return;

    m_on_data = nullptr;
    m_on_stop = nullptr;
    if (auto on_delivered = move(m_on_delivered))
        on_delivered();
}

}

/*

#pragma once

#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/ThreadID.h>
#include <LibCore/ImmutableBytes.h>
#include <LibRequests/Request.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchBodyDeliveryGate.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Engine {

// Delivers a body that is available all at once, in pieces no larger than the gate allows. Every method, and the
// transport's destruction, runs on the loop the transport was created on.
class WEB_API WholeBodyTransport final : public FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport {
public:
    using OnData = Function<void(Requests::ResponseData)>;

    [[nodiscard]] static NonnullRefPtr<WholeBodyTransport> create();
    virtual ~WholeBodyTransport() override;

    static void stop_all_on_this_thread();
    static void forget_all_on_this_thread();

    void attach_to(FetchBodyDeliveryGate&);
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_attached() const { return m_attached; }

    void set_body(Core::ImmutableBytes, OnData);

    // Runs once every byte of the body has been delivered, or never if the transport stops first.
    void when_delivered(Function<void()>);

    // Runs once if the transport stops before delivering the whole body.
    void set_on_stop(Function<void()>);

    virtual void resume_body_delivery_up_to(u64 byte_count) override;
    virtual void pause_body_delivery() override;
    virtual void stop() override;

private:
    WholeBodyTransport() = default;

    [[nodiscard]] bool is_on_owner_thread() const { return m_owner_thread.is_current_thread(); }
    void schedule_delivery();
    void deliver();

    AK::ThreadID m_owner_thread { AK::ThreadID::current() };
    Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> m_body;
    OnData m_on_data;
    Function<void()> m_on_delivered;
    Function<void()> m_on_stop;
    size_t m_delivered_byte_count { 0 };
    u64 m_allowance { 0 };
    bool m_attached { false };
    bool m_delivery_scheduled { false };
    bool m_stopped { false };
};

}

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <LibGC/Root.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/Error.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Fetching/BodyStreamPullSource.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/FetchController.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/Task.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/EventLoop/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/TemporaryExecutionContext.h>
#include <LibWeb/Streams/ReadableStream.h>
#include <LibWeb/WebIDL/ExceptionOrUtils.h>
#include <LibWeb/WebIDL/Promise.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Fetching {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(BodyStreamPullSource);

// Roots a pull source only while a wake is owed; tokens are never reused, and the consumer loop must outlive every
// source with a wake owed.
class BodyStreamWakeRegistry {
public:
    static BodyStreamWakeRegistry& the()
    {
        static thread_local NeverDestroyed<BodyStreamWakeRegistry> registry;
        return *registry;
    }

    BodyStreamWakeToken allocate_token() { return BodyStreamWakeToken { m_next_token++ }; }

    void arm(BodyStreamWakeToken token, BodyStreamPullSource& source)
    {
        m_armed_sources.ensure(token, [&] { return GC::make_root(source); });
    }
    void disarm(BodyStreamWakeToken token) { m_armed_sources.remove(token); }
    void disarm_all() { m_armed_sources.clear(); }

    void notify(BodyStreamWakeToken token, Engine::WakeTicket ticket)
    {
        auto source = m_armed_sources.take(token);
        if (!source.has_value())
            return;
        if ((*source)->on_wake(ticket) == BodyStreamPullSource::WakeResult::StillAwaited)
            m_armed_sources.set(token, source.release_value());
    }

private:
    u64 m_next_token { 1 };
    HashMap<BodyStreamWakeToken, GC::Root<BodyStreamPullSource>> m_armed_sources;
};

void disarm_all_body_stream_wakes()
{
    BodyStreamWakeRegistry::the().disarm_all();
}

NonnullRefPtr<BodyStreamWakeSink> BodyStreamWakeSink::create()
{
    return adopt_ref(*new BodyStreamWakeSink(BodyStreamWakeRegistry::the().allocate_token()));
}

BodyStreamWakeSink::BodyStreamWakeSink(BodyStreamWakeToken registry_token)
    : m_loop(Core::EventLoop::current_weak())
    , m_registry_token(registry_token)
{
}

void BodyStreamWakeSink::wake(Engine::WakeTicket ticket)
{
    auto loop = m_loop->take();
    if (!loop)
        return;
    loop->deferred_invoke([token = m_registry_token, ticket] {
        BodyStreamWakeRegistry::the().notify(token, ticket);
    });
}

BodyStreamPullSource::BodyStreamPullSource(JS::Realm& realm, GC::Ptr<Infrastructure::FetchController> fetch_controller, GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> stream, NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchByteChannel> channel, BodyStreamWakeSink const& wake_sink)
    : m_realm(realm)
    , m_fetch_controller(fetch_controller)
    , m_stream(stream)
    , m_channel(move(channel))
    , m_registry_token(wake_sink.registry_token())
{
}

BodyStreamPullSource::~BodyStreamPullSource() = default;

void BodyStreamPullSource::visit_edges(Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_realm);
    visitor.visit(m_fetch_controller);
    visitor.visit(m_stream);
    visitor.visit(m_pending_pull_promise);
    visitor.visit(m_on_resource_header);
}

// This implements the pullAlgorithm of HTTP-network fetch.
// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-http-network-fetch
GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> BodyStreamPullSource::pull()
{
    // 1. Let promise be a new promise.
    auto promise = WebIDL::create_promise(*m_realm);

    // 2. Run the following steps in parallel:
    //    1. If the size of buffer is smaller than a lower limit chosen by the user agent and the
    //       ongoing fetch is suspended, resume the fetch.
    //    2. Wait until buffer is not empty.
    VERIFY(!m_pending_pull_promise);
    m_pending_pull_promise = promise;
    if (!m_detached) {
        if (auto push_ticket = exchange(m_push_ticket, {}); push_ticket.has_value())
            m_channel->disarm_waiter(*push_ticket);
        m_pull_ticket = arm_waiter(Engine::FetchByteChannel::BufferedAtLeast { 1 });
    }

    // 3. Return promise.
    return promise;
}

GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> BodyStreamPullSource::cancel(JS::Value reason)
{
    auto& realm = *m_realm;
    m_channel->cancel();
    BodyStreamWakeRegistry::the().disarm(m_registry_token);
    m_detached = true;
    m_end_ticket = {};
    m_pull_ticket = {};
    m_push_ticket = {};
    m_resource_header_ticket = {};

    // A pull promise created before the cancellation still settles, and so does a read of the resource header.
    if (auto promise = exchange(m_pending_pull_promise, nullptr))
        WebIDL::resolve_promise(realm, *promise, JS::js_undefined());
    if (auto on_resource_header = exchange(m_on_resource_header, nullptr))
        on_resource_header->function()({}, Infrastructure::Body::SniffOutcome::Failed);

    // cancelAlgorithm: abort fetchParams's controller with reason, given reason.
    if (m_fetch_controller)
        m_fetch_controller->abort(realm, reason);
    return WebIDL::create_resolved_promise(realm, JS::js_undefined());
}

void BodyStreamPullSource::watch_channel()
{
    m_end_ticket = arm_waiter(Engine::FetchByteChannel::EndOnly {});
    push_while_paused();
}

void BodyStreamPullSource::read_resource_header(Infrastructure::Body::ResourceHeaderCallback on_resource_header)
{
    VERIFY(!m_has_taken_bytes);
    VERIFY(!m_on_resource_header);
    m_on_resource_header = on_resource_header;
    m_resource_header_ticket = arm_waiter(Engine::FetchByteChannel::PrefixOf { Infrastructure::MAX_SNIFF_BYTES });
}

// The channel kept the header from the moment its waiter was due, so a later error does not fail a complete one. A
// cancellation or a transfer keeps none, and fails it.
void BodyStreamPullSource::on_resource_header_wake(Engine::WakeTicket ticket)
{
    auto kept = m_channel->take_prefix(ticket);
    auto outcome = Infrastructure::Body::SniffOutcome::Failed;
    if (kept.has_value()) {
        outcome = kept->state.visit(
            [](Engine::FetchByteChannel::Open) { return Infrastructure::Body::SniffOutcome::Complete; },
            [](Engine::FetchByteChannel::Closed) { return Infrastructure::Body::SniffOutcome::Complete; },
            [](Engine::FetchByteChannel::Errored const&) { return Infrastructure::Body::SniffOutcome::Failed; },
            [](Engine::FetchByteChannel::ConsumerCancelled) { return Infrastructure::Body::SniffOutcome::Failed; },
            [](Engine::FetchByteChannel::Transferred) { return Infrastructure::Body::SniffOutcome::Failed; });
    }

    Core::ImmutableBytes resource_header;
    if (outcome == Infrastructure::Body::SniffOutcome::Complete && !kept->taken.is_empty())
        resource_header = kept->taken.first();
    auto on_resource_header = exchange(m_on_resource_header, nullptr);
    on_resource_header->function()(move(resource_header), outcome);
}

Engine::WakeTicket BodyStreamPullSource::arm_waiter(Engine::FetchByteChannel::WakeOn wake_on)
{
    BodyStreamWakeRegistry::the().arm(m_registry_token, *this);
    return m_channel->arm_waiter(wake_on);
}

BodyStreamPullSource::WakeResult BodyStreamPullSource::on_wake(Engine::WakeTicket ticket)
{
    if (ticket == m_pull_ticket) {
        m_pull_ticket = {};
        on_pull_wake();
    } else if (ticket == m_push_ticket) {
        m_push_ticket = {};
        on_push_wake();
    } else if (ticket == m_end_ticket) {
        m_end_ticket = {};
        on_end_wake();
    } else if (ticket == m_resource_header_ticket) {
        m_resource_header_ticket = {};
        on_resource_header_wake(ticket);
    }

    // The source stays rooted while any of its waiters is still owed a wake.
    if (m_end_ticket.has_value() || m_pull_ticket.has_value() || m_push_ticket.has_value() || m_resource_header_ticket.has_value())
        return WakeResult::StillAwaited;
    return WakeResult::Consumed;
}

void BodyStreamPullSource::on_pull_wake()
{
    if (!m_pending_pull_promise)
        return;

    // AD-HOC: While the HTML event loop is paused, the pull runs now rather than in a fetch task, which would not run
    //         until the loop resumes.
    if (HTML::current_event_loop().execution_paused()) {
        run_pull_task();
        push_while_paused();
        return;
    }

    // 3. Queue a fetch task to run the following steps, with fetchParams’s task destination:
    // NB: This task stays queued when the fetch is stopped.
    auto steps = GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(*this), [](BodyStreamPullSource& self) {
        self.run_pull_task();
    });
    if (m_fetch_controller) {
        Infrastructure::queue_fetch_task(m_fetch_controller->task_destination(), steps);
        return;
    }

    // AD-HOC: The tasks of a navigation body adopted from another process are queued without a document, since the
    //         previous document's tasks stop running once the new document replaces it.
    HTML::queue_a_task(HTML::Task::Source::Networking, HTML::current_event_loop(), nullptr, steps);
}

// AD-HOC: A sync XHR send() pauses the HTML event loop while it waits for exactly these bytes, and a stream set up
//         under that pause never starts pulling: the start promise's reaction is a microtask. So while the loop is
//         paused, bytes are pushed into the stream as they arrive, the way the specification's in-parallel steps
//         would deliver them (see the sync XHR body path in fetch_response_handover()).
void BodyStreamPullSource::push_while_paused()
{
    if (m_detached || m_pending_pull_promise || m_push_ticket.has_value() || !HTML::current_event_loop().execution_paused())
        return;
    if (!m_fetch_controller || m_fetch_controller->control_block().body_intent() != Engine::BodyIntent::SyncAccumulate)
        return;
    m_push_ticket = arm_waiter(Engine::FetchByteChannel::BufferedAtLeast { 1 });
}

void BodyStreamPullSource::on_push_wake()
{
    if (m_detached || m_pending_pull_promise)
        return;
    drain_into_stream();
    push_while_paused();
}

// A pending pull or the push while paused carries the body's end itself.
void BodyStreamPullSource::on_end_wake()
{
    if (m_detached || m_pending_pull_promise || m_push_ticket.has_value())
        return;
    settle_without_reading();
}

// A failed transmission errors the stream regardless of read demand, and an empty completed body closes without one.
void BodyStreamPullSource::settle_without_reading()
{
    auto& realm = *m_realm;
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };

    settle_stream(m_channel->take_up_to(0));
}

// This implements the ending of the in-parallel steps of HTTP-network fetch.
// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-http-network-fetch
void BodyStreamPullSource::settle_stream(Engine::FetchByteChannel::TakeResult const& result)
{
    result.state.visit(
        [](Engine::FetchByteChannel::Open) { },
        [](Engine::FetchByteChannel::ConsumerCancelled) { },
        [](Engine::FetchByteChannel::Transferred) { },
        [&](Engine::FetchByteChannel::Closed) {
            // 2. Otherwise, if the bytes transmission for response’s message body is done normally and stream is
            //    readable, then close stream, and abort these in-parallel steps.
            // AD-HOC: Closing stream while buffer still holds bytes would lose them, so stream closes once they have
            //         been pulled into it.
            if (result.buffered_byte_count == 0 && m_stream->is_readable()) {
                m_stream->close();
                m_detached = true;
            }
        },
        [&](Engine::FetchByteChannel::Errored const& errored) {
            // 2. Otherwise, if stream is readable, error stream with a TypeError.
            if (m_stream->is_readable()) {
                auto message = Utf16String::from_utf8(StringView { errored.message });
                m_stream->error(JS::TypeError::create(*m_realm, message));
            }
            m_detached = true;
        });
}

void BodyStreamPullSource::run_pull_task()
{
    auto promise = exchange(m_pending_pull_promise, nullptr);
    if (!promise)
        return;

    drain_into_stream();

    // 3. Resolve promise with undefined.
    auto& realm = *m_realm;
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };
    WebIDL::resolve_promise(realm, *promise, JS::js_undefined());
}

void BodyStreamPullSource::drain_into_stream()
{
    auto& realm = *m_realm;
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };

    // The slices removed by one take reach the stream as one byte sequence, and a BYOB pull may consume only the
    // current view's length.
    auto result = [&] {
        if (auto byte_length = m_stream->current_byob_request_view_byte_length(); byte_length.has_value())
            return m_channel->take_up_to(*byte_length);
        return m_channel->take_all();
    }();

    // 1. Pull from bytes buffer into stream.
    if (!result.taken.is_empty()) {
        VERIFY(!m_on_resource_header);
        m_has_taken_bytes = true;
        ByteBuffer bytes;
        for (auto const& taken : result.taken)
            bytes.append(taken.bytes());
        if (auto pull_result = m_stream->pull_from_bytes(bytes); pull_result.is_error()) {
            // A failed enqueue ends the whole body.
            auto error = WebIDL::exception_to_throw_completion(realm.vm(), realm, pull_result.release_error());
            if (m_stream->is_readable())
                m_stream->error(error.value());
            if (m_fetch_controller)
                m_fetch_controller->terminate();
            m_channel->cancel();
            m_detached = true;
            return;
        }
    }

    // 2. If stream is errored, then terminate fetchParams’s controller.
    if (m_stream->is_errored() && m_fetch_controller)
        m_fetch_controller->terminate();

    settle_stream(result);
    if (result.state.has<Engine::FetchByteChannel::ConsumerCancelled>() || result.state.has<Engine::FetchByteChannel::Transferred>())
        m_detached = true;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-http-network-fetch
// NB: Steps 10 to 13 of HTTP-network fetch.
GC::Ref<Infrastructure::Body> create_body_from_channel(JS::Realm& realm, GC::Ptr<Infrastructure::FetchController> fetch_controller, NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchByteChannel> channel)
{
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };

    auto wake_sink = BodyStreamWakeSink::create();
    channel->attach_consumer(wake_sink);

    // 10. Let stream be a new ReadableStream.
    auto stream = Streams::ReadableStream::create(realm);
    auto pull_source = GC::Heap::the().allocate<BodyStreamPullSource>(realm, fetch_controller, stream, move(channel), *wake_sink);

    // 11. Let pullAlgorithm be the following steps:
    auto pull_algorithm = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(pull_source), [](GC::Ref<BodyStreamPullSource> pull_source) {
        return pull_source->pull();
    });

    // 12. Let cancelAlgorithm be an algorithm that aborts fetchParams’s controller with reason, given reason.
    auto cancel_algorithm = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(pull_source), [](GC::Ref<BodyStreamPullSource> pull_source, JS::Value reason) {
        return pull_source->cancel(reason);
    });

    // 13. Set up stream with byte reading support with pullAlgorithm set to pullAlgorithm, cancelAlgorithm set to cancelAlgorithm.
    stream->set_up_with_byte_reading_support(realm, pull_algorithm, cancel_algorithm);
    pull_source->watch_channel();

    auto read_resource_header = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(pull_source), [](GC::Ref<BodyStreamPullSource> pull_source, Infrastructure::Body::ResourceHeaderCallback on_resource_header) {
        pull_source->read_resource_header(on_resource_header);
    });
    return Infrastructure::Body::create_over_arriving_bytes(stream, read_resource_header);
}

}

// Never reused within a thread.
AK_TYPEDEF_DISTINCT_ORDERED_ID(u64, BodyStreamWakeToken);

// Delivers a channel's wakes to the pull source registered under its token, on the loop that created it.
// Lets go of every pull source that is waiting for a wake on this thread, for an agent that goes away.
void disarm_all_body_stream_wakes();

class BodyStreamWakeSink final : public Engine::FetchByteChannelConsumerSink {
public:
    static NonnullRefPtr<BodyStreamWakeSink> create();

    BodyStreamWakeToken registry_token() const { return m_registry_token; }

    virtual void wake(Engine::WakeTicket) override;

private:
    explicit BodyStreamWakeSink(BodyStreamWakeToken);

    NonnullRefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> m_loop;
    BodyStreamWakeToken const m_registry_token { 0 };
};

// The pull algorithm of a response stream whose bytes arrive through a FetchByteChannel. The channel's error, or its
// close with no bytes left unread, reaches the stream even when no pull is pending.
class BodyStreamPullSource final : public JS::Cell {
    GC_CELL(BodyStreamPullSource, JS::Cell);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(BodyStreamPullSource);

public:
    BodyStreamPullSource(JS::Realm&, GC::Ptr<Infrastructure::FetchController>, GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream>, NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchByteChannel>, BodyStreamWakeSink const&);
    virtual ~BodyStreamPullSource() override;

    GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> pull();
    GC::Ref<WebIDL::Promise> cancel(JS::Value reason);

    enum class WakeResult : u8 {
        Consumed,
        StillAwaited,
    };
    WakeResult on_wake(Engine::WakeTicket);

    // Waits for the channel to end, and while the HTML event loop is paused for its bytes too.
    void watch_channel();

    // Reads the resource header once the channel buffers it or ends, leaving its bytes in the channel. It is read
    // before any byte is taken from the channel.
    void read_resource_header(Infrastructure::Body::ResourceHeaderCallback);

private:
    virtual void visit_edges(Visitor& visitor) override;

    Engine::WakeTicket arm_waiter(Engine::FetchByteChannel::WakeOn);
    void on_pull_wake();
    void push_while_paused();
    void on_push_wake();
    void on_end_wake();
    void on_resource_header_wake(Engine::WakeTicket);
    void settle_without_reading();
    void settle_stream(Engine::FetchByteChannel::TakeResult const&);
    void run_pull_task();
    void drain_into_stream();

    // The realm the stream is set up in.
    GC::Ref<JS::Realm> m_realm;
    // Null for a navigation body adopted from another process.
    GC::Ptr<Infrastructure::FetchController> m_fetch_controller;
    GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> m_stream;
    NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchByteChannel> m_channel;
    BodyStreamWakeToken const m_registry_token { 0 };

    GC::Ptr<WebIDL::Promise> m_pending_pull_promise;
    Optional<Engine::WakeTicket> m_end_ticket;
    Optional<Engine::WakeTicket> m_pull_ticket;
    Optional<Engine::WakeTicket> m_push_ticket;
    Optional<Engine::WakeTicket> m_resource_header_ticket;
    GC::Ptr<GC::Function<void(Core::ImmutableBytes, Infrastructure::Body::SniffOutcome)>> m_on_resource_header;
    bool m_has_taken_bytes { false };

    // Once set, later pulls stay pending until the stream is cancelled.
    bool m_detached { false };
};

#include <LibWeb/DOMURL/DOMURL.h>

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cors-check
bool cors_check(Infrastructure::Request const& request, Infrastructure::Response const& response)
{
    // 1. Let origin be the result of getting `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` from response’s header list.
    auto origin = response.header_list()->get("Access-Control-Allow-Origin"sv);

    // 2. If origin is null, then return failure.
    // NOTE: Null is not `null`.
    if (!origin.has_value())
        return false;

    // 3. If request’s credentials mode is not "include" and origin is `*`, then return success.
    if (request.credentials_mode() != Infrastructure::Request::CredentialsMode::Include && *origin == "*"sv)
        return true;

    // 4. If the result of byte-serializing a request origin with request is not origin, then return failure.
    if (request.byte_serialize_origin() != *origin)
        return false;

    // 5. If request’s credentials mode is not "include", then return success.
    if (request.credentials_mode() != Infrastructure::Request::CredentialsMode::Include)
        return true;

    // 6. Let credentials be the result of getting `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` from response’s header list.
    auto credentials = response.header_list()->get("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"sv);

    // 7. If credentials is `true`, then return success.
    if (credentials == "true"sv)
        return true;

    // 8. Return failure.
    return false;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tao-check
bool tao_check(Infrastructure::Request const& request, Infrastructure::Response const& response)
{
    // 1. If request’s timing allow failed flag is set, then return failure.
    if (request.timing_allow_failed())
        return false;

    // 2. Let values be the result of getting, decoding, and splitting `Timing-Allow-Origin` from response’s header list.
    auto values = response.header_list()->get_decode_and_split("Timing-Allow-Origin"sv);

    // 3. If values contains "*", then return success.
    if (values.has_value() && values->contains_slow("*"sv))
        return true;

    // 4. If values contains the result of serializing a request origin with request, then return success.
    if (values.has_value() && values->contains_slow(request.serialize_origin()))
        return true;

    // 5. If request’s mode is "navigate" and request’s current URL’s origin is not same origin with request’s origin, then return failure.
    // NOTE: This is necessary for navigations of a nested browsing context. There, request’s origin would be the
    //       container document’s origin and the TAO check would return failure. Since navigation timing never
    //       validates the results of the TAO check, the nested document would still have access to the full timing
    //       information, but the container document would not.
    if (request.mode() == Infrastructure::Request::Mode::Navigate
        && request.origin().has<URL::Origin>()
        && !request.current_url().origin().is_same_origin(request.origin().get<URL::Origin>())) {
        return false;
    }

    // 6. If request’s response tainting is "basic", then return success.
    if (request.response_tainting() == Infrastructure::Request::ResponseTainting::Basic)
        return true;

    // 7. Return failure.
    return false;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#navigation-tao-check
bool navigation_tao_check(Infrastructure::Response const& response, URL::Origin const& destination_origin)
{
    // 1. For each taoValues of response's navigation timing allow values list:
    for (auto const& tao_values : response.navigation_timing_allow_values_list()) {
        // 1. If taoValues contains "*", then continue.
        if (tao_values.contains_slow("*"sv))
            continue;

        // 2. If taoValues contains destinationOrigin, serialized, then continue.
        if (tao_values.contains_slow(destination_origin.serialize()))
            continue;

        // 3. Return failure.
        return false;
    }

    // 2. Return success.
    return true;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cross-origin-resource-policy-internal-check
static Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking cross_origin_resource_policy_internal_check(URL::Origin const& origin, HTML::EmbedderPolicyValue embedder_policy_value, Infrastructure::Response const& response, ForNavigation for_navigation)
{
    // 1. If forNavigation is true and embedderPolicyValue is "unsafe-none", then return allowed.
    if (for_navigation == ForNavigation::Yes && embedder_policy_value == HTML::EmbedderPolicyValue::UnsafeNone)
        return Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Allowed;

    // 2. Let policy be the result of getting `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy` from response's header list.
    // NOTE: This means that `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-site, same-origin` ends up as allowed below as it will
    //       never match anything, as long as embedderPolicyValue is "unsafe-none". Two or more
    //       `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy` headers will have the same effect.
    auto policy = response.header_list()->get("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy"sv);

    // 3. If policy is neither `same-origin`, `same-site`, nor `cross-origin`, then set policy to null.
    if (policy.has_value() && !policy->is_one_of("same-origin"sv, "same-site"sv, "cross-origin"sv))
        policy.clear();

    // 4. If policy is null, then switch on embedderPolicyValue:
    if (!policy.has_value()) {
        switch (embedder_policy_value) {
        // -> "unsafe-none"
        case HTML::EmbedderPolicyValue::UnsafeNone:
            // Do nothing.
            break;
        // -> "credentialless"
        case HTML::EmbedderPolicyValue::Credentialless:
            // Set policy to `same-origin` if:
            // - response's request-includes-credentials is true, or
            // - forNavigation is true.
            if (response.request_includes_credentials() || for_navigation == ForNavigation::Yes)
                policy = "same-origin"sv;
            break;
        // -> "require-corp"
        case HTML::EmbedderPolicyValue::RequireCorp:
            // Set policy to `same-origin`.
            policy = "same-origin"sv;
            break;
        }
    }

    // 5. Switch on policy:
    // -> null
    // -> `cross-origin`
    //    Return allowed.
    if (!policy.has_value() || *policy == "cross-origin"sv)
        return Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Allowed;

    auto const& response_url = response.url().value();

    // -> `same-origin`
    if (*policy == "same-origin"sv) {
        // If origin is same origin with response's URL's origin, then return allowed.
        // Otherwise, return blocked.
        return origin.is_same_origin(response_url.origin()) ? Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Allowed : Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Blocked;
    }

    // -> `same-site`
    //    If all of the following are true
    //    - origin is schemelessly same site with response's URL's origin
    //    - origin's scheme is "https" or response's URL's scheme is not "https"
    //    then return allowed.
    //    Otherwise, return blocked.
    // NOTE: `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-site` does not consider a response delivered via a secure transport to
    //       match a non-secure requesting origin, even if their hosts are otherwise same site. Securely-transported
    //       responses will only match a securely-transported initiator.
    if (origin.is_schemelessly_same_site(response_url.origin())
        && ((!origin.is_opaque() && origin.scheme() == "https"sv) || response_url.scheme() != "https"sv)) {
        return Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Allowed;
    }
    return Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Blocked;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cross-origin-resource-policy-check
// NB: settingsObject is given as its policy container's embedder policy, which is all these steps read of it while
//     violation reports are not queued. destination is only used for reports.
Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking cross_origin_resource_policy_check(URL::Origin const& origin, HTML::EmbedderPolicy const& embedder_policy, Infrastructure::Response const& response, ForNavigation for_navigation)
{
    // 1. Set forNavigation to false if it is not given.
    // 2. Let embedderPolicy be settingsObject's policy container's embedder policy.

    // 3. If the cross-origin resource policy internal check with origin, "unsafe-none", response, and forNavigation
    //    returns blocked, then return blocked.
    // NOTE: This step is needed because we don't want to report violations not related to Cross-Origin Embedder Policy
    //       below.
    if (cross_origin_resource_policy_internal_check(origin, HTML::EmbedderPolicyValue::UnsafeNone, response, for_navigation) == Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Blocked)
        return Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Blocked;

    // FIXME: 4. If the cross-origin resource policy internal check with origin, embedderPolicy's report-only value,
    //           response, and forNavigation returns blocked, then queue a cross-origin embedder policy CORP violation
    //           report with response, settingsObject, destination, and true.

    // 5. If the cross-origin resource policy internal check with origin, embedderPolicy's value, response, and
    //    forNavigation returns allowed, then return allowed.
    if (cross_origin_resource_policy_internal_check(origin, embedder_policy.value, response, for_navigation) == Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Allowed)
        return Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Allowed;

    // FIXME: 6. Queue a cross-origin embedder policy CORP violation report with response, settingsObject, destination,
    //           and false.

    // 7. Return blocked.
    return Infrastructure::RequestOrResponseBlocking::Blocked;
}

#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Fetching/ClientContextSnapshots.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Fetching {

GC::Ptr<HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject> resolve_client(Infrastructure::Request const& request)
{
    auto const& client = request.client();
    if (!client.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    auto const* address = client->get_pointer<HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObjectAddress>();
    if (!address)
        return nullptr;
    auto settings_object = HTML::environment_settings_object_at(*address);
    VERIFY(settings_object);
    return settings_object;
}

RefPtr<HTML::RemoteEnvironmentSettings const> remote_client(Infrastructure::Request const& request)
{
    auto const& client = request.client();
    if (!client.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    if (auto const* settings = client->get_pointer<NonnullRefPtr<HTML::RemoteEnvironmentSettings const>>())
        return *settings;
    return nullptr;
}

Optional<HTML::FetchClient> resolve_fetch_client(Infrastructure::Request const& request)
{
    if (auto settings_object = resolve_client(request))
        return HTML::FetchClient { *settings_object };
    if (auto settings = remote_client(request))
        return HTML::FetchClient { settings.release_nonnull() };
    return {};
}

Infrastructure::Request::ClientType request_client(HTML::FetchClient const& fetch_client)
{
    return fetch_client.visit(
        [](GC::Ref<HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject> const& settings_object) -> Infrastructure::Request::ClientType {
            return settings_object->address();
        },
        [](NonnullRefPtr<HTML::RemoteEnvironmentSettings const> const& settings) -> Infrastructure::Request::ClientType {
            return settings;
        });
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#determine-requests-referrer
// NB: The steps of the "client" case that read environment, for a client another process hosts.
static Optional<URL::URL> referrer_source_of_client(HTML::SerializedEnvironmentSettingsObject const& environment)
{
    // 2. If environment’s global object is a Window object, then
    if (auto const* window = environment.global.get_pointer<HTML::SerializedWindow>()) {
        // 1. Let document be the associated Document of environment’s global object.
        auto const& document = window->associated_document;

        // 2. If document’s origin is an opaque origin, return no referrer.
        // NB: document's origin is environment's origin.
        if (environment.origin.is_opaque())
            return {};

        // FIXME: 3. While document is an iframe srcdoc document, let document be document’s browsing context’s
        //           browsing context container’s node document.

        // 4. Let referrerSource be document’s URL.
        return document.url;
    }

    // 3. Otherwise, let referrerSource be environment’s creation URL.
    return environment.creation_url;
}

// https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#determine-requests-referrer
// NB: The steps of the "client" case that read environment, which is non-null.
static Optional<URL::URL> referrer_source_of_client(HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject& environment)
{
    // 2. If environment’s global object is a Window object, then
    if (auto const* window = HTML::window_from_global_object(environment.global_object())) {
        // 1. Let document be the associated Document of environment’s global object.
        auto const& document = window->associated_document();

        // 2. If document’s origin is an opaque origin, return no referrer.
        if (document.origin().is_opaque())
            return {};

        // FIXME: 3. While document is an iframe srcdoc document, let document be document’s browsing context’s
        //           browsing context container’s node document.

        // 4. Let referrerSource be document’s URL.
        return document.url();
    }

    // 3. Otherwise, let referrerSource be environment’s creation URL.
    return environment.creation_url;
}

NonnullRefPtr<Infrastructure::ClientContextSnapshot const> snapshot_client_context(HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject& client)
{
    using Context = Infrastructure::ClientContext;

    auto& global = client.global_object();
    auto const* window = HTML::window_from_global_object(global);
    auto global_kind = Context::GlobalKind::Other;
    if (window)
        global_kind = Context::GlobalKind::Window;
    else if (Bindings::worker_global_scope_from_global_object(global))
        global_kind = Context::GlobalKind::Worker;
    auto navigable = window ? window->navigable() : nullptr;
    auto document = client.responsible_document();
    auto const* worker = Bindings::worker_global_scope_from_global_object(global);
    auto site_for_cookies = URL::Origin::create_opaque();
    if (document)
        site_for_cookies = document->site_for_cookies();
    else if (worker)
        site_for_cookies = worker->site_for_cookies();

    return make_ref_counted<Infrastructure::ClientContextSnapshot>(Context {
        .origin = client.origin(),
        .site_for_cookies = move(site_for_cookies),
        .creation_url = client.creation_url,
        .top_level_creation_url = client.top_level_creation_url,
        .top_level_origin = client.top_level_origin,
        .global_kind = global_kind,
        .is_window_of_a_top_level_navigable = navigable && navigable->is_top_level_traversable() ? Context::IsWindowOfATopLevelNavigable::Yes : Context::IsWindowOfATopLevelNavigable::No,
        .has_cross_site_ancestor = client.has_cross_site_ancestor() ? Infrastructure::HasCrossSiteAncestor::Yes : Infrastructure::HasCrossSiteAncestor::No,
        .cross_origin_isolated_capability = client.cross_origin_isolated_capability(),
        .is_secure_context = HTML::is_secure_context(client) ? Context::IsSecureContext::Yes : Context::IsSecureContext::No,
        .prohibits_mixed_security_contexts = MixedContent::does_settings_prohibit_mixed_security_contexts(client),
        .cache_mode_while_loading = window ? window->associated_document().cache_mode_while_loading() : HTTP::CacheMode::Default,
        .time_origin = client.time_origin(),
        .navigable_id = navigable ? navigable->id() : Optional<HTML::CrossProcessId> {},
        .referrer_source = referrer_source_of_client(client),
        .content_blocker_source_url = document ? document->fallback_base_url() : client.api_base_url(),
        .keepalive_quota_accountant = client.keepalive_quota_accountant(),
    });
}

NonnullRefPtr<Infrastructure::ClientContextSnapshot const> snapshot_client_context(HTML::RemoteEnvironmentSettings const& client)
{
    using Context = Infrastructure::ClientContext;

    auto const& settings = client.settings;
    auto const* window = settings.global.get_pointer<HTML::SerializedWindow>();
    auto relevant_settings_object_is_secure_context = window
        ? window->associated_document.relevant_settings_object_is_secure_context
        : settings.global.get<HTML::SerializedWorkerGlobalScope>().relevant_settings_object_is_secure_context;

    // NB: A client another process hosts is never treated as loading with the cache mode of its navigation.
    return make_ref_counted<Infrastructure::ClientContextSnapshot>(Context {
        .origin = settings.origin,
        .site_for_cookies = window ? window->associated_document.site_for_cookies : settings.global.get<HTML::SerializedWorkerGlobalScope>().site_for_cookies,
        .creation_url = settings.creation_url,
        .top_level_creation_url = settings.top_level_creation_url,
        .top_level_origin = settings.top_level_origin,
        .global_kind = window ? Context::GlobalKind::Window : Context::GlobalKind::Worker,
        .is_window_of_a_top_level_navigable = window && window->navigable_is_top_level ? Context::IsWindowOfATopLevelNavigable::Yes : Context::IsWindowOfATopLevelNavigable::No,
        .has_cross_site_ancestor = settings.has_cross_site_ancestor ? Infrastructure::HasCrossSiteAncestor::Yes : Infrastructure::HasCrossSiteAncestor::No,
        .cross_origin_isolated_capability = settings.cross_origin_isolated_capability,
        .is_secure_context = relevant_settings_object_is_secure_context ? Context::IsSecureContext::Yes : Context::IsSecureContext::No,
        .prohibits_mixed_security_contexts = settings.prohibits_mixed_security_contexts,
        .time_origin = settings.time_origin,
        .navigable_id = {},
        .referrer_source = referrer_source_of_client(settings),
        .content_blocker_source_url = window ? window->associated_document.url : settings.api_base_url,
        .keepalive_quota_accountant = Infrastructure::KeepaliveQuotaAccountant::create(),
    });
}

static Variant<Infrastructure::ReservedClientContext::Environment, Infrastructure::ReservedClientContext::SettingsObject> reserved_client_kind(HTML::Environment const& reserved_client)
{
    using Context = Infrastructure::ReservedClientContext;

    if (auto const* settings_object = as_if<HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject>(reserved_client)) {
        return Context::SettingsObject {
            .origin = settings_object->origin(),
            .has_cross_site_ancestor = settings_object->has_cross_site_ancestor() ? Infrastructure::HasCrossSiteAncestor::Yes : Infrastructure::HasCrossSiteAncestor::No,
        };
    }

    Context::Environment environment;
    auto const& target_browsing_context = reserved_client.target_browsing_context;
    if (!target_browsing_context)
        return environment;
    environment.target_browsing_context = target_browsing_context->is_top_level() ? Context::TargetBrowsingContext::TopLevel : Context::TargetBrowsingContext::Nested;

    auto const* document = target_browsing_context->active_document();
    auto navigable = document ? document->navigable() : nullptr;
    if (auto parent = navigable ? navigable->parent() : nullptr) {
        environment.parent = Context::Parent {
            .active_document_origin = parent->active_document_origin(),
            .active_document_has_cross_site_ancestor = parent->active_document_has_cross_site_ancestor() ? Infrastructure::HasCrossSiteAncestor::Yes : Infrastructure::HasCrossSiteAncestor::No,
        };
    }
    return environment;
}

NonnullRefPtr<Infrastructure::ReservedClientContextSnapshot const> snapshot_reserved_client_context(HTML::Environment const& reserved_client)
{
    using Context = Infrastructure::ReservedClientContext;

    return make_ref_counted<Infrastructure::ReservedClientContextSnapshot>(Context {
        .creation_url = reserved_client.creation_url,
        .top_level_creation_url = reserved_client.top_level_creation_url,
        .top_level_origin = reserved_client.top_level_origin,
        .is_secure_context = HTML::is_secure_context(reserved_client) ? Context::IsSecureContext::Yes : Context::IsSecureContext::No,
        .kind = reserved_client_kind(reserved_client),
    });
}

#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchEngineRecord.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/InlineFetchExecutor.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Fetching/FetchEngine.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Fetching/Fetching.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Fetching {

FetchEngine::FetchEngine(NonnullRefPtr<Engine::NetworkActivityObservers const> network_activity_observers, NonnullOwnPtr<Engine::FetchEngineRecords::Agent> agent)
    : m_network_activity_observers(move(network_activity_observers))
    , m_records(move(agent))
{
}

void FetchEngine::handle_command(Engine::EngineCommand command)
{
    command.visit(
        [this](Engine::Command::StartFetch& start_fetch) {
            auto record = m_records.start(start_fetch.input.fetch_id, move(start_fetch.input.event_sink), m_network_activity_observers);
            if (!record)
                return;
            run_deferred_main_fetch_steps(start_fetch.input.fetch_id, record.release_nonnull());
        },
        [this](Engine::Command::Abort const& abort) { m_records.stop(abort.fetch_id); },
        [this](Engine::Command::Terminate const& terminate) { m_records.stop(terminate.fetch_id); },
        [this](Engine::Command::Stop const& stop) { m_records.stop(stop.fetch_id); },
        [this](Engine::Command::ResolveRedirect const& resolve) {
            auto outcome = m_records.resolve_redirect(resolve);
            if (!resolve.resolution.has<Engine::Command::ResolveRedirect::Follow>())
                return;
            outcome.visit(
                [&](NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchEngineRecord>& record) { run_deferred_main_fetch_steps(resolve.fetch_id, move(record)); },
                [&](Engine::FetchEngineRecords::RedirectAnswerDropped) { drop_deferred_main_fetch_steps(resolve.fetch_id); },
                [](Engine::FetchEngineRecords::RedirectAnswerMisbehaved) { });
        },
        [](Engine::Command::PreloadResponseResolved const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); },
        [this](Engine::Command::PreloadWaitAbandoned const& abandoned) { m_records.abandon_preload_wait(abandoned.fetch_id); },
        [this](Engine::Command::TransportControl const& control) { m_records.control_network_transport(control); },
        [this](Engine::Command::NavigationBodyAdopted const& adopted) { m_records.add_network_transport(*adopted.handle, *adopted.delivery_gate); },
        [](Engine::Command::AdoptNetworkTransport const&) { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
}

NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchExecutor> create_inline_fetch_executor(NonnullRefPtr<Engine::NetworkActivityObservers const> network_activity_observers)
{
    Engine::FetchExecutorServices services { .event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak() };
    return Engine::InlineFetchExecutor::create(move(services), make<FetchEngine>(move(network_activity_observers), make<Engine::FetchEngineRecords::Agent>()));
}

}
