// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-controller
class WEB_API FetchController : public JS::Cell {
    GC_CELL(FetchController, JS::Cell);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(FetchController);

public:
    using State = FetchControlBlock::State;

    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<FetchController> create(FetchControllerRegistry&);

    [[nodiscard]] FetchControllerToken token() const { return m_token; }
    [[nodiscard]] WeakPtr<FetchControllerRegistry> const& registry() const { return m_registry; }
    [[nodiscard]] FetchControlBlock& control_block() const { return *m_control_block; }

    void set_report_timing_steps(GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(JS::Object&)>> report_timing_steps);
    void set_next_manual_redirect_steps(GC::Ref<GC::Function<void()>> next_manual_redirect_steps);

    [[nodiscard]] State state() const { return m_control_block->state(); }
    [[nodiscard]] RefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> full_timing_info() const { return m_control_block->full_timing_info(); }

    [[nodiscard]] bool has_report_timing_steps() const { return m_report_timing_steps != nullptr; }
    void report_timing(JS::Object&) const;
    void process_next_manual_redirect() const;

    // Posts the answer to the manual redirect handed over last, unless it was answered before.
    void resolve_redirect(Engine::Command::ResolveRedirect::Resolution);
    [[nodiscard]] bool has_unanswered_redirect() const { return m_redirect_continuation_id.has_value(); }
    // The continuation of the manual redirect handed over last, if it waits for an answer.
    void set_redirect_continuation_id(Optional<Engine::ContinuationId> continuation_id) { m_redirect_continuation_id = continuation_id; }

    // Once the network has delivered all of the delivery's body, runs the steps given its end time, unless the fetch has
    // ended. An abort, termination, stop or later call drops it.
    void when_body_ends(Engine::DeliveryId, GC::Ptr<GC::Function<void(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp)>> steps);
    void did_end_body(Engine::Event::EndOfBody const&);
    void did_end_fetch();
    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> extract_full_timing_info() const;
    void abort(JS::Realm&, Optional<JS::Value>);
    Optional<HTML::IPCSerializationRecord> const& serialized_abort_reason() const { return m_serialized_abort_reason; }
    void terminate();

    void set_algorithms(Badge<FetchParams>, GC::Ref<FetchAlgorithms const>);
    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ref<FetchAlgorithms const> algorithms() const;

    // The fetch params created with the controller, for which WebDriver BiDi reports errors and intercepts requests.
    void set_original_fetch_params(Badge<FetchParams>, FetchParams const&);
    [[nodiscard]] RefPtr<FetchParams> original_fetch_params() const;

    // The request the controller's fetch params were created with.
    void set_request(Badge<FetchParams>, NonnullRefPtr<Request>);
    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<Request> request() const;

    // The realm that started the fetch.
    void set_realm(JS::Realm& realm) { m_realm = realm; }
    [[nodiscard]] JS::Realm& realm() const
    {
        VERIFY(m_realm);
        return *m_realm;
    }

    // AD-HOC: Whether the preload whose response the fetch consumes reports its own timing to Resource Timing.
    [[nodiscard]] bool preload_reports_timing() const { return m_preload_reports_timing; }
    void set_preload_reports_timing(bool preload_reports_timing) { m_preload_reports_timing = preload_reports_timing; }

    // The network observation of the request the controller's fetch params were created with.
    void set_network_observation(Badge<FetchParams>, NonnullRefPtr<NetworkObservation>);
    [[nodiscard]] RefPtr<NetworkObservation> const& network_observation() const { return m_network_observation; }

    [[nodiscard]] TaskDestination const& task_destination() const { return m_task_destination; }
    void set_task_destination(TaskDestination task_destination) { m_task_destination = move(task_destination); }

    // The page of the realm that started the fetch.
    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ref<Page> page() const;
    void set_page(Page& page) { m_page = page; }

    // Moves the fetch, before its response has arrived, to another task destination and body intent.
    void retarget(TaskDestination, Engine::BodyIntent);

    [[nodiscard]] bool is_keepalive() const { return m_is_keepalive; }
    void set_keepalive(bool is_keepalive) { m_is_keepalive = is_keepalive; }

    [[nodiscard]] bool response_arrived() const { return m_control_block->response_arrived(); }
    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<Fetching::PendingResponse> pending_preloaded_response() const { return m_pending_preloaded_response; }
    void set_pending_preloaded_response(GC::Ptr<Fetching::PendingResponse> pending_preloaded_response) { m_pending_preloaded_response = pending_preloaded_response; }
    // The handle in the callback of the preload entry whose response the fetch's preloaded response candidate waits for,
    // while that callback lives.
    [[nodiscard]] WeakPtr<Fetching::PreloadWaitHandle> const& preload_wait_handle() const { return m_preload_wait_handle; }
    void set_preload_wait_handle(WeakPtr<Fetching::PreloadWaitHandle> preload_wait_handle) { m_preload_wait_handle = move(preload_wait_handle); }

    bool requires_network() const { return m_control_block->requires_network(); }
    bool has_started_request() const { return m_control_block->has_started_request(); }
    // The fetch this controller's fetch params started, and the executor its start was posted to. The controller's
    // stops and redirect answers are posted there, for that fetch.
    void set_started_fetch(Engine::FetchId, Engine::FetchExecutor&);
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<Engine::FetchId> started_fetch_id() const;
    [[nodiscard]] Engine::FetchExecutor& started_fetch_executor() const;

    void stop_fetch();
    void set_stop_steps(GC::Ref<GC::Function<void()>> stop_steps) { m_stop_steps = stop_steps; }

    u64 next_fetch_task_id() { return m_next_fetch_task_id++; }
    void fetch_task_queued(u64 fetch_task_id, HTML::TaskID event_id);
    void fetch_task_complete(u64 fetch_task_id);

    void add_pending_response(Badge<Fetching::PendingResponse>, GC::Ref<Fetching::PendingResponse>);
    void remove_pending_response(Badge<Fetching::PendingResponse>, GC::Ref<Fetching::PendingResponse>);

private:
    explicit FetchController(FetchControllerRegistry&);

    virtual void visit_edges(JS::Cell::Visitor&) override;
    virtual void finalize() override;

    void report_webdriver_bidi_fetch_error(StringView error_text) const;
    void cancel_webdriver_bidi_network_interception() const;
    void stop_request();

    WeakPtr<FetchControllerRegistry> m_registry;
    FetchControllerToken m_token;
    NonnullRefPtr<FetchControlBlock> m_control_block;
    WeakPtr<FetchParams> m_original_fetch_params;
    RefPtr<Request> m_request;
    GC::Ptr<JS::Realm> m_realm;
    RefPtr<NetworkObservation> m_network_observation;

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-controller-report-timing-steps
    // report timing steps (default null)
    //    Null or an algorithm accepting a global object.
    GC::Ptr<GC::Function<void(JS::Object&)>> m_report_timing_steps;

    struct AwaitedEndOfBody {
        Engine::DeliveryId delivery_id;
        GC::Ptr<GC::Function<void(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp)>> steps;
    };
    Optional<AwaitedEndOfBody> m_awaited_end_of_body;
    bool m_fetch_ended { false };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-controller-report-timing-steps
    // serialized abort reason (default null)
    //     Null or a Record (result of StructuredSerialize).
    Optional<HTML::IPCSerializationRecord> m_serialized_abort_reason;

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-controller-next-manual-redirect-steps
    // next manual redirect steps (default null)
    //     Null or an algorithm accepting nothing.
    GC::Ptr<GC::Function<void()>> m_next_manual_redirect_steps;

    // The continuation of the manual redirect opened last, until it is answered.
    Optional<Engine::ContinuationId> m_redirect_continuation_id;

    // AD-HOC: The fetch params' algorithms are kept on their controller, which every copy of the fetch params shares.
    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-process-request-body
    // process request body chunk length (default null)
    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-process-request-end-of-body
    // process request end-of-body (default null)
    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-process-early-hints-response
    // process early hints response (default null)
    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-process-response
    // process response (default null)
    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-process-response-end-of-body
    // process response end-of-body (default null)
    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-process-response-consume-body
    // process response consume body (default null)
    //     Null or an algorithm.
    GC::Ptr<FetchAlgorithms const> m_algorithms;

    // AD-HOC: The fetch params' task destination is kept on their controller, which every copy of the fetch params
    //         shares.
    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-task-destination
    // task destination (default null)
    //     Null, a global object, or a parallel queue.
    TaskDestination m_task_destination;
    GC::Ptr<Page> m_page;

    bool m_is_keepalive { false };
    bool m_preload_reports_timing { false };

    // NB: Assumes one waiting consumer for a pending preloaded response.
    // Widen this if preload handoff ever supports multiple consumers.
    GC::Ptr<Fetching::PendingResponse> m_pending_preloaded_response;
    WeakPtr<Fetching::PreloadWaitHandle> m_preload_wait_handle;

    struct StartedFetch {
        Engine::FetchId fetch_id;
        NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchExecutor> fetch_executor;
    };
    Optional<StartedFetch> m_started_fetch;

    HashMap<u64, HTML::TaskID> m_ongoing_fetch_tasks;
    u64 m_next_fetch_task_id { 0 };

    // AD-HOC: Run when the fetch is stopped, for whatever was waiting on its response.
    GC::Ptr<GC::Function<void()>> m_stop_steps;

    // The pending responses of this fetch whose callbacks have yet to run.
    Vector<GC::Ref<Fetching::PendingResponse>> m_pending_responses;
};

class FetchControllerHolder : public JS::Cell {
    GC_CELL(FetchControllerHolder, JS::Cell);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(FetchControllerHolder);

public:
    static GC::Ref<FetchControllerHolder> create();

    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<FetchController> const& controller() const { return m_controller; }
    void set_controller(GC::Ref<FetchController> controller) { m_controller = controller; }

private:
    FetchControllerHolder();

    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;

    GC::Ptr<FetchController> m_controller;
};

/*

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <LibGC/WeakInlines.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/FetchController.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/FetchControllerRegistry.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

static Atomic<u64> s_next_registry_id { 1 };
static Atomic<u64> s_next_serial { 1 };
static Atomic<u64> s_next_fetch_id { 1 };

FetchControllerRegistry::FetchControllerRegistry()
    : m_id(s_next_registry_id.fetch_add(1))
{
}

FetchControllerToken FetchControllerRegistry::add(Badge<FetchController>, FetchController& controller)
{
    FetchControllerToken token { m_id, s_next_serial.fetch_add(1) };
    m_controllers.set(token.m_serial, controller);
    return token;
}

void FetchControllerRegistry::remove(Badge<FetchController>, FetchControllerToken token)
{
    VERIFY(token.m_registry_id == m_id);
    m_controllers.remove(token.m_serial);
}

GC::Ptr<FetchController> FetchControllerRegistry::find(FetchControllerToken token) const
{
    VERIFY(token.m_registry_id == m_id);
    auto controller = m_controllers.get(token.m_serial);
    if (!controller.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    return controller->ptr();
}

Vector<GC::Root<FetchController>> FetchControllerRegistry::controllers() const
{
    Vector<GC::Root<FetchController>> controllers;
    controllers.ensure_capacity(m_controllers.size());
    for (auto const& entry : m_controllers) {
        if (auto controller = entry.value.ptr())
            controllers.unchecked_append(GC::make_root(*controller));
    }
    return controllers;
}

Engine::FetchId FetchControllerRegistry::defer_main_fetch_steps(GC::Ref<DeferredMainFetchSteps> steps)
{
    Engine::FetchId fetch_id { s_next_fetch_id.fetch_add(1) };
    defer_main_fetch_steps(fetch_id, steps);
    return fetch_id;
}

void FetchControllerRegistry::defer_main_fetch_steps(Engine::FetchId fetch_id, GC::Ref<DeferredMainFetchSteps> steps)
{
    auto result = m_deferred_main_fetch_steps.set(fetch_id, GC::make_root(steps));
    VERIFY(result == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry);
}

GC::Root<FetchControllerRegistry::DeferredMainFetchSteps> FetchControllerRegistry::take_deferred_main_fetch_steps(Engine::FetchId fetch_id)
{
    return m_deferred_main_fetch_steps.take(fetch_id).release_value();
}

void FetchControllerRegistry::root_fetch(Engine::FetchId fetch_id, GC::Ref<FetchController> controller)
{
    RootedFetch rooted_fetch { .controller = GC::make_root(controller), .cors_preflight_controllers = {} };
    auto result = m_rooted_fetches.set(fetch_id, move(rooted_fetch));
    VERIFY(result == HashSetResult::InsertedNewEntry);
}

void FetchControllerRegistry::root_cors_preflight(Engine::FetchId fetch_id, GC::Ref<FetchController> controller)
{
    auto rooted_fetch = m_rooted_fetches.find(fetch_id);
    VERIFY(rooted_fetch != m_rooted_fetches.end());
    rooted_fetch->value.cors_preflight_controllers.append(GC::make_root(controller));
}

void FetchControllerRegistry::release_fetch(Engine::FetchId fetch_id)
{
    m_rooted_fetches.remove(fetch_id);
}

bool FetchControllerRegistry::roots(FetchControllerToken token) const
{
    VERIFY(token.m_registry_id == m_id);
    for (auto const& [fetch_id, rooted_fetch] : m_rooted_fetches) {
        if (rooted_fetch.controller->token() == token)
            return true;
        for (auto const& cors_preflight_controller : rooted_fetch.cors_preflight_controllers) {
            if (cors_preflight_controller->token() == token)
                return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Badge.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/Weakable.h>
#include <LibGC/Function.h>
#include <LibGC/Ptr.h>
#include <LibGC/Root.h>
#include <LibGC/Weak.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchEngineRecord.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/Ids.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/FetchControllerToken.h>
#include <LibWeb/Forward.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

// The fetch controllers of one agent, by token. It keeps alive the main fetch steps it defers, and the controller of
// each started fetch until the fetch ends, except while main fetch waits for a preload.
class WEB_API FetchControllerRegistry : public Weakable<FetchControllerRegistry> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(FetchControllerRegistry);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(FetchControllerRegistry);

public:
    using DeferredMainFetchSteps = GC::Function<void(NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchEngineRecord>)>;

    FetchControllerRegistry();

    [[nodiscard]] FetchControllerToken add(Badge<FetchController>, FetchController&);
    void remove(Badge<FetchController>, FetchControllerToken);

    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ptr<FetchController> find(FetchControllerToken) const;

    [[nodiscard]] Vector<GC::Root<FetchController>> controllers() const;

    // Keeps main fetch's in-parallel steps alive while they wait to be taken, under a new fetch id, or under the id of
    // the fetch whose manual redirect they follow.
    [[nodiscard]] Engine::FetchId defer_main_fetch_steps(GC::Ref<DeferredMainFetchSteps> steps);
    void defer_main_fetch_steps(Engine::FetchId, GC::Ref<DeferredMainFetchSteps> steps);
    [[nodiscard]] GC::Root<DeferredMainFetchSteps> take_deferred_main_fetch_steps(Engine::FetchId);

    // Keeps the controller of a fetch that has started alive until the fetch is released, and with it the controllers of
    // the fetch's CORS preflights.
    void root_fetch(Engine::FetchId, GC::Ref<FetchController>);
    void root_cors_preflight(Engine::FetchId, GC::Ref<FetchController>);
    // Does nothing for a fetch it does not root.
    void release_fetch(Engine::FetchId);
    [[nodiscard]] bool roots(FetchControllerToken) const;

private:
    u64 m_id { 0 };
    HashMap<u64, GC::Weak<FetchController>> m_controllers;
    HashMap<Engine::FetchId, GC::Root<DeferredMainFetchSteps>> m_deferred_main_fetch_steps;

    struct RootedFetch {
        GC::Root<FetchController> controller;
        Vector<GC::Root<FetchController>> cors_preflight_controllers;
    };
    HashMap<Engine::FetchId, RootedFetch> m_rooted_fetches;
};

}

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

// Names one fetch controller, and only within the registry that issued it.
class FetchControllerToken {
public:
    bool operator==(FetchControllerToken const&) const = default;

private:
    friend class FetchControllerRegistry;

    FetchControllerToken(u64 registry_id, u64 serial)
        : m_registry_id(registry_id)
        , m_serial(serial)
    {
    }

    u64 m_registry_id { 0 };
    u64 m_serial { 0 };
};

#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/FetchParams.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/Responses.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

FetchParams::FetchParams(NonnullRefPtr<Request> request, GC::Ref<FetchAlgorithms const> algorithms, FetchController& controller, NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> timing_info, NonnullRefPtr<LoaderConfigSnapshot const> loader_config)
    : m_request(move(request))
    , m_controller_token(controller.token())
    , m_controller_registry(controller.registry())
    , m_control_block(controller.control_block())
    , m_timing_info(move(timing_info))
    , m_loader_config(move(loader_config))
{
    controller.set_algorithms({}, algorithms);
    controller.set_original_fetch_params({}, *this);
    controller.set_request({}, m_request);
    controller.set_network_observation({}, m_request->ensure_network_observation());
}

FetchParams::FetchParams(FetchParams const& params)
    : RefCounted()
    , m_request(params.m_request)
    , m_cross_origin_isolated_capability(params.m_cross_origin_isolated_capability)
    , m_controller_token(params.m_controller_token)
    , m_controller_registry(params.m_controller_registry)
    , m_control_block(params.m_control_block)
    , m_timing_info(params.m_timing_info)
    , m_preloaded_response_candidate(params.m_preloaded_response_candidate)
    , m_has_response_body_transfer_lease(params.m_has_response_body_transfer_lease)
    , m_blob_url_entry(params.m_blob_url_entry)
    , m_loader_config(params.m_loader_config)
    , m_engine_record(params.m_engine_record)
    , m_is_cors_preflight(params.m_is_cors_preflight)
{
}

NonnullRefPtr<FetchParams> FetchParams::create(FetchController& controller, NonnullRefPtr<Request> request, GC::Ref<FetchAlgorithms const> algorithms, NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> timing_info, NonnullRefPtr<LoaderConfigSnapshot const> loader_config)
{
    return adopt_ref(*new FetchParams(move(request), algorithms, controller, move(timing_info), move(loader_config)));
}

NonnullRefPtr<FetchParams> FetchParams::copy(FetchParams const& params)
{
    return adopt_ref(*new FetchParams(params));
}

Engine::StartFetchInput FetchParams::start_fetch_input(Engine::FetchId fetch_id, NonnullOwnPtr<Engine::EngineEventSink> event_sink) const
{
    return Engine::StartFetchInput { {}, fetch_id, m_control_block->body_intent(), m_blob_url_entry, move(event_sink) };
}

void FetchParams::set_body_transport(Engine::FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport& transport) const
{
    VERIFY(m_engine_record);
    if (m_is_cors_preflight)
        m_engine_record->set_cors_preflight_body_transport(transport);
    else
        m_engine_record->set_body_transport(transport);
}

void FetchParams::stop_body_transport() const
{
    if (!m_engine_record)
        return;
    if (m_is_cors_preflight)
        m_engine_record->stop_cors_preflight_body_transport();
    else
        m_engine_record->stop_body_transport();
}

void FetchParams::discard_response_body(Response const& response) const
{
    response.release_request_transfer_lease();
    stop_body_transport();
}

GC::Ref<FetchController> FetchParams::controller() const
{
    VERIFY(m_controller_registry);
    auto controller = m_controller_registry->find(m_controller_token);
    VERIFY(controller);
    return *controller;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-aborted
bool FetchParams::is_aborted() const
{
    return m_control_block->is_aborted();
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-canceled
bool FetchParams::is_canceled() const
{
    return m_control_block->is_canceled();
}

}

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params
class WEB_API FetchParams
    : public RefCounted<FetchParams>
    , public Weakable<FetchParams> {
public:
    GC_HOLDS_NO_CELL_EDGES;

    struct PreloadedResponseCandidatePendingTag { };
    using PreloadedResponseCandidate = Variant<Empty, PreloadedResponseCandidatePendingTag, NonnullRefPtr<Response>>;

    [[nodiscard]] static NonnullRefPtr<FetchParams> create(FetchController&, NonnullRefPtr<Request>, GC::Ref<FetchAlgorithms const>, NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo>, NonnullRefPtr<LoaderConfigSnapshot const>);
    [[nodiscard]] static NonnullRefPtr<FetchParams> copy(FetchParams const&);

    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<Request> request() const { return m_request; }
    void set_request(NonnullRefPtr<Request> request) { m_request = move(request); }
    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ref<FetchController> controller() const;
    [[nodiscard]] FetchControlBlock& control_block() const { return *m_control_block; }
    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> timing_info() const { return m_timing_info; }
    [[nodiscard]] LoaderConfig const& loader_config() const { return m_loader_config->config; }
    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<LoaderConfigSnapshot const> const& loader_config_snapshot() const { return m_loader_config; }

    [[nodiscard]] HTML::CanUseCrossOriginIsolatedAPIs cross_origin_isolated_capability() const { return m_cross_origin_isolated_capability; }
    void set_cross_origin_isolated_capability(HTML::CanUseCrossOriginIsolatedAPIs cross_origin_isolated_capability) { m_cross_origin_isolated_capability = cross_origin_isolated_capability; }

    [[nodiscard]] PreloadedResponseCandidate& preloaded_response_candidate() { return m_preloaded_response_candidate; }
    [[nodiscard]] PreloadedResponseCandidate const& preloaded_response_candidate() const { return m_preloaded_response_candidate; }
    void set_preloaded_response_candidate(PreloadedResponseCandidate preloaded_response_candidate) { m_preloaded_response_candidate = move(preloaded_response_candidate); }

    [[nodiscard]] bool is_aborted() const;
    [[nodiscard]] bool is_canceled() const;

    [[nodiscard]] bool has_response_body_transfer_lease() const { return m_has_response_body_transfer_lease; }
    void set_has_response_body_transfer_lease(bool value) { m_has_response_body_transfer_lease = value; }

    [[nodiscard]] Optional<FileAPI::SerializedBlobURLEntry> const& blob_url_entry() const { return m_blob_url_entry; }
    void set_blob_url_entry(Optional<FileAPI::SerializedBlobURLEntry> blob_url_entry) { m_blob_url_entry = move(blob_url_entry); }

    [[nodiscard]] Engine::StartFetchInput start_fetch_input(Engine::FetchId, NonnullOwnPtr<Engine::EngineEventSink>) const;

    // Set by the fetch engine when it runs main fetch's in-parallel steps, and shared with copies made after that. A
    // CORS preflight's fetch params share the record of the fetch the preflight is for.
    [[nodiscard]] Engine::FetchEngineRecord* engine_record() const { return m_engine_record; }
    void set_engine_record(NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchEngineRecord> engine_record) const { m_engine_record = move(engine_record); }

    [[nodiscard]] bool is_cors_preflight() const { return m_is_cors_preflight; }
    void set_is_cors_preflight() { m_is_cors_preflight = true; }

    // The transport of the response body these fetch params receive, which the fetch's engine record keeps.
    void set_body_transport(Engine::FetchBodyDeliveryGate::Transport&) const;
    // Stops that transport, if there is one, without ending the fetch.
    void stop_body_transport() const;

    // Ends the delivery of a response's body that the fetch will not read.
    void discard_response_body(Response const&) const;

private:
    FetchParams(NonnullRefPtr<Request>, GC::Ref<FetchAlgorithms const>, FetchController&, NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo>, NonnullRefPtr<LoaderConfigSnapshot const>);
    FetchParams(FetchParams const&);

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-request
    // request
    //     A request.
    NonnullRefPtr<Request> m_request;

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-cross-origin-isolated-capability
    // cross-origin isolated capability (default false)
    //     A boolean.
    HTML::CanUseCrossOriginIsolatedAPIs m_cross_origin_isolated_capability { HTML::CanUseCrossOriginIsolatedAPIs::No };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-controller
    // controller (default a new fetch controller)
    //     A fetch controller.
    FetchControllerToken m_controller_token;
    WeakPtr<FetchControllerRegistry> m_controller_registry;
    NonnullRefPtr<FetchControlBlock> m_control_block;

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-timing-info
    // timing info
    //     A fetch timing info.
    NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> m_timing_info;

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-params-preloaded-response-candidate
    // preloaded response candidate (default null)
    //     Null, "pending", or a response.
    PreloadedResponseCandidate m_preloaded_response_candidate;

    // Non-spec process integration: a navigation response is retained while the UI process selects its document host.
    bool m_has_response_body_transfer_lease { false };

    // The blob URL entry of the request's URL, when that is a blob: URL, as it was when the fetch started.
    Optional<FileAPI::SerializedBlobURLEntry> m_blob_url_entry;

    // The loader configuration as it was when the fetch started.
    NonnullRefPtr<LoaderConfigSnapshot const> m_loader_config;

    mutable RefPtr<Engine::FetchEngineRecord> m_engine_record;

    bool m_is_cors_preflight { false };
};

}

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(FetchRecord);

GC::Ref<FetchRecord> FetchRecord::create(NonnullRefPtr<Infrastructure::Request> request, GC::Ptr<Fetch::Infrastructure::FetchController> fetch_controller)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<FetchRecord>(request, fetch_controller);
}

FetchRecord::FetchRecord(NonnullRefPtr<Infrastructure::Request> request, GC::Ptr<Fetch::Infrastructure::FetchController> fetch_controller)
    : m_request(move(request))
    , m_fetch_controller(fetch_controller)
{

void FetchRecord::visit_edges(Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_fetch_controller);
}

void FetchRecord::finalize()
{
    Base::finalize();

    // NB: A fetch whose client another process hosts has no fetch group here.
    if (m_list_node.is_in_list())
        m_list_node.remove();
}

#include <LibRequests/RequestTimingInfo.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/FetchTimingInfo.h>
#include <LibWeb/HighResolutionTime/TimeOrigin.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

FetchTimingInfo::FetchTimingInfo() = default;

NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> FetchTimingInfo::create()
{
    return adopt_ref(*new FetchTimingInfo);
}

NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> FetchTimingInfo::create(Engine::FetchTimingSeed const& seed)
{
    auto timing_info = create();
    timing_info->m_start_time = seed.start_time;
    timing_info->m_redirect_start_time = seed.redirect_start_time;
    timing_info->m_redirect_end_time = seed.redirect_end_time;
    timing_info->m_post_redirect_start_time = seed.post_redirect_start_time;
    timing_info->m_final_service_worker_start_time = seed.final_service_worker_start_time;
    timing_info->m_server_timing_headers = seed.server_timing_headers;
    timing_info->m_render_blocking = seed.render_blocking;
    return timing_info;
}

Engine::FetchTimingSeed FetchTimingInfo::seed() const
{
    return {
        .start_time = m_start_time,
        .redirect_start_time = m_redirect_start_time,
        .redirect_end_time = m_redirect_end_time,
        .post_redirect_start_time = m_post_redirect_start_time,
        .final_service_worker_start_time = m_final_service_worker_start_time,
        .server_timing_headers = m_server_timing_headers,
        .render_blocking = m_render_blocking,
    };
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#create-an-opaque-timing-info
NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> create_opaque_timing_info(FetchTimingInfo const& timing_info)
{
    // To create an opaque timing info, given a fetch timing info timingInfo, return a new fetch timing info whose start
    // time and post-redirect start time are timingInfo’s start time, end time is timingInfo’s end time, and
    // render-blocking is timingInfo’s render-blocking.
    auto new_timing_info = FetchTimingInfo::create();
    new_timing_info->set_start_time(timing_info.start_time());
    new_timing_info->set_post_redirect_start_time(timing_info.start_time());
    new_timing_info->set_end_time(timing_info.end_time());
    new_timing_info->set_render_blocking(timing_info.render_blocking());

    return new_timing_info;
}

Engine::FetchNetworkPhases FetchTimingInfo::final_network_phases(Requests::RequestTimingInfo const& final_timings, HTML::CanUseCrossOriginIsolatedAPIs cross_origin_isolated_capability) const
{
    // RequestServer measures each hop from the start of its own request, so the final hop's offsets are relative to
    // the post-redirect start time.
    auto final_request_start_time = m_post_redirect_start_time;

    auto domain_lookup_start_time_milliseconds = final_request_start_time + (static_cast<HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp>(final_timings.domain_lookup_start_microseconds) / 1000.0);
    auto coarsened_domain_lookup_start_time = HighResolutionTime::coarsen_time(domain_lookup_start_time_milliseconds, cross_origin_isolated_capability);

    auto domain_lookup_end_time_milliseconds = final_request_start_time + (static_cast<HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp>(final_timings.domain_lookup_end_microseconds) / 1000.0);
    auto coarsened_domain_lookup_end_time = HighResolutionTime::coarsen_time(domain_lookup_end_time_milliseconds, cross_origin_isolated_capability);

    auto connect_start_time_milliseconds = final_request_start_time + (static_cast<HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp>(final_timings.connect_start_microseconds) / 1000.0);
    auto coarsened_connection_start_time = HighResolutionTime::coarsen_time(connect_start_time_milliseconds, cross_origin_isolated_capability);

    auto connect_end_time_milliseconds = final_request_start_time + (static_cast<HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp>(final_timings.connect_end_microseconds) / 1000.0);
    auto coarsened_connection_end_time = HighResolutionTime::coarsen_time(connect_end_time_milliseconds, cross_origin_isolated_capability);

    // A secure connection start of 0 means no TLS handshake took place, which stays 0 rather than becoming the
    // request start.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp coarsened_secure_connection_start_time = 0;
    if (final_timings.secure_connect_start_microseconds != 0) {
        auto secure_connect_start_time_milliseconds = final_request_start_time + (static_cast<HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp>(final_timings.secure_connect_start_microseconds) / 1000.0);
        coarsened_secure_connection_start_time = HighResolutionTime::coarsen_time(secure_connect_start_time_milliseconds, cross_origin_isolated_capability);
    }

    auto request_start_time_milliseconds = final_request_start_time + (static_cast<HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp>(final_timings.request_start_microseconds) / 1000.0);
    auto coarsened_request_start_time = HighResolutionTime::coarsen_time(request_start_time_milliseconds, cross_origin_isolated_capability);

    auto response_start_time_milliseconds = final_request_start_time + (static_cast<HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp>(final_timings.response_start_microseconds) / 1000.0);
    auto coarsened_response_start_time = HighResolutionTime::coarsen_time(response_start_time_milliseconds, cross_origin_isolated_capability);

    return {
        .final_connection_timing_info = {
            .domain_lookup_start_time = coarsened_domain_lookup_start_time,
            .domain_lookup_end_time = coarsened_domain_lookup_end_time,
            .connection_start_time = coarsened_connection_start_time,
            .connection_end_time = coarsened_connection_end_time,
            .secure_connection_start_time = coarsened_secure_connection_start_time,
            .alpn_negotiated_protocol = alpn_http_version_to_byte_string(final_timings.http_version_alpn_identifier),
        },
        .final_network_request_start_time = coarsened_request_start_time,
        .final_network_response_start_time = coarsened_response_start_time,
    };
}

void FetchTimingInfo::set_network_phases(Engine::FetchNetworkPhases network_phases)
{
    m_final_connection_timing_info = move(network_phases.final_connection_timing_info);
    m_final_network_request_start_time = network_phases.final_network_request_start_time;
    m_final_network_response_start_time = network_phases.final_network_response_start_time;
}

void FetchTimingInfo::update_final_timings(Requests::RequestTimingInfo const& final_timings, HTML::CanUseCrossOriginIsolatedAPIs cross_origin_isolated_capability)
{
    set_network_phases(final_network_phases(final_timings, cross_origin_isolated_capability));
}

// The values of a FetchTimingInfo, as Bindings/Rust/src/fetch/infrastructure/fetch_timing_info.rs reads them.
struct FetchTimingInfoABI {
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp start_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp redirect_start_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp redirect_end_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp post_redirect_start_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp final_service_worker_start_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp final_network_request_start_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp first_interim_network_response_start_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp final_network_response_start_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp end_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp domain_lookup_start_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp domain_lookup_end_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp connection_start_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp connection_end_time;
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp secure_connection_start_time;
    bool has_final_connection_timing_info;
    bool render_blocking;
};

extern "C" {
void web_fetch_timing_info_read(FetchTimingInfo const*, FetchTimingInfoABI*);
void web_fetch_timing_info_alpn_negotiated_protocol(FetchTimingInfo const*, void* context, void (*callback)(void*, ReadonlyBytes));
void web_fetch_timing_info_for_each_server_timing_header(FetchTimingInfo const*, void* context, void (*callback)(void*, ReadonlyBytes));
void web_fetch_timing_info_unref(FetchTimingInfo*);
}

extern "C" {

void web_fetch_timing_info_read(FetchTimingInfo const* timing_info, FetchTimingInfoABI* values)
{
    auto const& connection_timing_info = timing_info->final_connection_timing_info();
    *values = {
        .start_time = timing_info->start_time(),
        .redirect_start_time = timing_info->redirect_start_time(),
        .redirect_end_time = timing_info->redirect_end_time(),
        .post_redirect_start_time = timing_info->post_redirect_start_time(),
        .final_service_worker_start_time = timing_info->final_service_worker_start_time(),
        .final_network_request_start_time = timing_info->final_network_request_start_time(),
        .first_interim_network_response_start_time = timing_info->first_interim_network_response_start_time(),
        .final_network_response_start_time = timing_info->final_network_response_start_time(),
        .end_time = timing_info->end_time(),
        .domain_lookup_start_time = connection_timing_info.has_value() ? connection_timing_info->domain_lookup_start_time : 0,
        .domain_lookup_end_time = connection_timing_info.has_value() ? connection_timing_info->domain_lookup_end_time : 0,
        .connection_start_time = connection_timing_info.has_value() ? connection_timing_info->connection_start_time : 0,
        .connection_end_time = connection_timing_info.has_value() ? connection_timing_info->connection_end_time : 0,
        .secure_connection_start_time = connection_timing_info.has_value() ? connection_timing_info->secure_connection_start_time : 0,
        .has_final_connection_timing_info = connection_timing_info.has_value(),
        .render_blocking = timing_info->render_blocking(),
    };
}

void web_fetch_timing_info_alpn_negotiated_protocol(FetchTimingInfo const* timing_info, void* context, void (*callback)(void*, ReadonlyBytes))
{
    auto const& connection_timing_info = timing_info->final_connection_timing_info();
    if (connection_timing_info.has_value())
        callback(context, connection_timing_info->alpn_negotiated_protocol.bytes());
}

void web_fetch_timing_info_for_each_server_timing_header(FetchTimingInfo const* timing_info, void* context, void (*callback)(void*, ReadonlyBytes))
{
    for (auto const& header : timing_info->server_timing_headers())
        callback(context, header.bytes());
}

void web_fetch_timing_info_unref(FetchTimingInfo* timing_info)
{
    timing_info->unref();
}
}

}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info
class WEB_API FetchTimingInfo : public AtomicRefCounted<FetchTimingInfo> {
public:
    GC_HOLDS_NO_CELL_EDGES;

    [[nodiscard]] static NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> create();
    [[nodiscard]] static NonnullRefPtr<FetchTimingInfo> create(Engine::FetchTimingSeed const&);

    [[nodiscard]] Engine::FetchTimingSeed seed() const;

    [[nodiscard]] HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp start_time() const { return m_start_time; }

    [[nodiscard]] HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp redirect_start_time() const { return m_redirect_start_time; }
    void set_redirect_start_time(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp redirect_start_time) { m_redirect_start_time = redirect_start_time; }

    [[nodiscard]] HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp redirect_end_time() const { return m_redirect_end_time; }
    void set_redirect_end_time(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp redirect_end_time) { m_redirect_end_time = redirect_end_time; }

    [[nodiscard]] HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp post_redirect_start_time() const { return m_post_redirect_start_time; }
    void set_post_redirect_start_time(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp post_redirect_start_time) { m_post_redirect_start_time = post_redirect_start_time; }

    [[nodiscard]] HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp final_service_worker_start_time() const { return m_final_service_worker_start_time; }
    void set_final_service_worker_start_time(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp final_service_worker_start_time) { m_final_service_worker_start_time = final_service_worker_start_time; }

    [[nodiscard]] HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp final_network_request_start_time() const { return m_final_network_request_start_time; }
    void set_final_network_request_start_time(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp final_network_request_start_time) { m_final_network_request_start_time = final_network_request_start_time; }

    [[nodiscard]] HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp final_network_response_start_time() const { return m_final_network_response_start_time; }
    void set_final_network_response_start_time(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp final_network_response_start_time) { m_final_network_response_start_time = final_network_response_start_time; }

    [[nodiscard]] HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp first_interim_network_response_start_time() const { return m_first_interim_network_response_start_time; }
    void set_first_interim_network_response_start_time(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp first_interim_network_response_start_time) { m_first_interim_network_response_start_time = first_interim_network_response_start_time; }

    [[nodiscard]] HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp end_time() const { return m_end_time; }
    void set_end_time(HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp end_time) { m_end_time = end_time; }

    [[nodiscard]] Optional<ConnectionTimingInfo> const& final_connection_timing_info() const { return m_final_connection_timing_info; }
    void set_final_connection_timing_info(ConnectionTimingInfo final_connection_timing_info) { m_final_connection_timing_info = move(final_connection_timing_info); }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector<String>& server_timing_headers() { return m_server_timing_headers; }
    [[nodiscard]] Vector<String> const& server_timing_headers() const { return m_server_timing_headers; }
    void set_server_timing_headers(Vector<String> server_timing_headers) { m_server_timing_headers = move(server_timing_headers); }

    [[nodiscard]] bool render_blocking() const { return m_render_blocking; }
    void set_render_blocking(bool render_blocking) { m_render_blocking = render_blocking; }

    [[nodiscard]] Engine::FetchNetworkPhases final_network_phases(Requests::RequestTimingInfo const& final_timings, HTML::CanUseCrossOriginIsolatedAPIs cross_origin_isolated_capability) const;
    void set_network_phases(Engine::FetchNetworkPhases);
    void update_final_timings(Requests::RequestTimingInfo const& final_timings, HTML::CanUseCrossOriginIsolatedAPIs cross_origin_isolated_capability);

private:
    FetchTimingInfo();

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-start-time
    // start time (default 0)
    //     A DOMHighResTimeStamp.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp m_start_time { 0 };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-redirect-start-time
    // redirect start time (default 0)
    //     A DOMHighResTimeStamp.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp m_redirect_start_time { 0 };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-redirect-end-time
    // redirect end time (default 0)
    //     A DOMHighResTimeStamp.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp m_redirect_end_time { 0 };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-post-redirect-start-time
    // post-redirect start time (default 0)
    //     A DOMHighResTimeStamp.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp m_post_redirect_start_time { 0 };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-final-service-worker-start-time
    // final service worker start time (default 0)
    //     A DOMHighResTimeStamp.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp m_final_service_worker_start_time { 0 };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-final-network-request-start-time
    // final network-request start time (default 0)
    //     A DOMHighResTimeStamp.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp m_final_network_request_start_time { 0 };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-first-interim-network-response-start-time
    // first interim network-response start time (default 0)
    //     A DOMHighResTimeStamp.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp m_first_interim_network_response_start_time { 0 };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-final-network-response-start-time
    // final network-response start time (default 0)
    //     A DOMHighResTimeStamp.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp m_final_network_response_start_time { 0 };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-end-time
    // end time (default 0)
    //     A DOMHighResTimeStamp.
    HighResolutionTime::DOMHighResTimeStamp m_end_time { 0 };

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-final-connection-timing-info
    // final connection timing info (default null)
    //     Null or a connection timing info.
    Optional<ConnectionTimingInfo> m_final_connection_timing_info;

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-server-timing-headers
    // server-timing headers (default « »)
    //     A list of strings.
    Vector<String> m_server_timing_headers;

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-render-blocking
    // render-blocking (default false)
    //     A boolean.
    bool m_render_blocking { false };
};

#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/Requests.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/Environments.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#default-user-agent-value
String default_user_agent_value(LoaderConfig const& loader_config, URL::Origin const& top_level_origin, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    // A default `User-Agent` value is an implementation-defined header value for the `User-Agent` header.
    return loader_config.user_agent_for(top_level_origin, origin);
}

// The top-level origin of an environment, or the origin of its top-level creation URL, as the network partition key
// takes it.
template<typename EnvironmentType>
static Optional<URL::Origin> top_level_origin_of(EnvironmentType const& environment)
{
    if (environment.top_level_origin.has_value())
        return environment.top_level_origin;
    if (environment.top_level_creation_url.has_value())
        return environment.top_level_creation_url->origin();
    return {};
}

String default_user_agent_value(LoaderConfig const& loader_config, Request const& request)
{
    auto current_url_origin = request.current_url().origin();

    if (request.mode() == Request::Mode::Navigate) {
        // A top-level navigation request is for the top-level document it creates, whose site is that of the current
        // URL, even after a cross-site redirect.
        if (request.destination() == Request::Destination::Document)
            return default_user_agent_value(loader_config, current_url_origin, current_url_origin);

        // Any other navigation request is for a document under the top-level of its reserved client.
        Optional<URL::Origin> top_level_origin;
        if (auto const& reserved_client = request.reserved_client_snapshot())
            top_level_origin = top_level_origin_of(*reserved_client);
        return default_user_agent_value(loader_config, top_level_origin.value_or(current_url_origin), current_url_origin);
    }

    if (auto const& client = request.client_snapshot()) {
        auto top_level_origin = top_level_origin_of(*client);
        return default_user_agent_value(loader_config, top_level_origin.value_or(client->origin), client->origin);
    }

    return default_user_agent_value(loader_config, current_url_origin, current_url_origin);
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#environment-default-user-agent-value
String environment_default_user_agent_value(LoaderConfig const& loader_config, HTML::EnvironmentSettingsObject const& environment)
{
    // FIXME: Honor WebDriver BiDi emulated User-Agent.
    auto origin = environment.origin();
    auto top_level_origin = top_level_origin_of(environment);
    return default_user_agent_value(loader_config, top_level_origin.value_or(origin), origin);
}

}

#include <LibGC/Heap.h>

#include <LibWeb/Fetch/BodyInit.h>

#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/IncrementalReadLoopReadRequest.h>

extern "C" {

// Called by Bindings/Rust/src/fetch/infrastructure/http/bodies.rs.
bool web_fetch_body_length(Body*, u64* out_length);
}

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(Body);

GC::Ref<Body> Body::create(GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> stream, FetchBody fetch_body)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<Body>(stream, move(fetch_body), NeverSniffed {});
}

GC::Ref<Body> Body::create_over_bytes(JS::Realm& realm, Core::ImmutableBytes bytes)
{
    auto [extracted_body, _] = safely_extract_body(realm, bytes);
    auto resource_header = bytes.slice(0, min(bytes.size(), MAX_SNIFF_BYTES));
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<Body>(extracted_body->stream(), FetchBody {}, ReadResourceHeader { move(resource_header) });
}

GC::Ref<Body> Body::create_over_arriving_bytes(GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> stream, ResourceHeaderReader reader)
{
    return GC::Heap::the().allocate<Body>(stream, FetchBody {}, UnreadResourceHeader { reader });
}

Body::Body(GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> stream, FetchBody fetch_body, ResourceHeader resource_header)
    : m_stream(stream)
    , m_fetch_body(move(fetch_body))
    , m_resource_header(move(resource_header))
{
}

void Body::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_stream);
    if (auto const* unread = m_resource_header.get_pointer<UnreadResourceHeader>())
        visitor.visit(unread->reader);
    visitor.visit(m_sniff_bytes_callback);
}

Optional<Body::SniffBytes> Body::sniff_bytes_if_available() const
{
    VERIFY(!m_resource_header.has<NeverSniffed>());
    if (auto const* read = m_resource_header.get_pointer<ReadResourceHeader>())
        return SniffBytes { read->bytes.bytes(), read->outcome };
    return {};
}

void Body::wait_for_sniff_bytes(SniffBytesCallback on_ready)
{
    if (auto sniff_bytes = sniff_bytes_if_available(); sniff_bytes.has_value()) {
        on_ready->function()(sniff_bytes.value());
        return;
    }

    VERIFY(!m_sniff_bytes_callback);
    m_sniff_bytes_callback = on_ready;

    auto const* unread = m_resource_header.get_pointer<UnreadResourceHeader>();
    if (!unread)
        return;
    auto reader = unread->reader;
    m_resource_header = ReadingResourceHeader {};
    reader->function()(GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(*this), [](Body& body, Core::ImmutableBytes bytes, SniffOutcome outcome) {
        body.did_read_resource_header(move(bytes), outcome);
    }));
}

void Body::did_read_resource_header(Core::ImmutableBytes bytes, SniffOutcome outcome)
{
    VERIFY(m_resource_header.has<ReadingResourceHeader>());
    m_resource_header = ReadResourceHeader { move(bytes), outcome };

    auto steps = GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(*this), [](Body& body) {
        auto callback = exchange(body.m_sniff_bytes_callback, nullptr);
        callback->function()(*body.sniff_bytes_if_available());
    });
    HTML::queue_a_task(HTML::Task::Source::Networking, HTML::current_event_loop(), nullptr, steps);
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-body-clone
GC::Ref<Body> Body::clone(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };

    // To clone a body body, run these steps:
    // 1. Let « out1, out2 » be the result of teeing body’s stream.
    auto [out1, out2] = m_stream->tee().release_value_but_fixme_should_propagate_errors();

    // 2. Set body’s stream to out1.
    m_stream = out1;

    // 3. Return a body whose stream is out2 and other members are copied from body.
    return Body::create(*out2, m_fetch_body);
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#body-fully-read
void Body::fully_read(JS::Realm& realm, Web::Fetch::Infrastructure::Body::ProcessBodyCallback process_body, Web::Fetch::Infrastructure::Body::ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error, TaskDestination task_destination) const
{
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext execution_context { realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };

    // 1. If taskDestination is null, then set taskDestination to the result of starting a new parallel queue.
    if (task_destination.has<Empty>())
        task_destination = HTML::ParallelQueue::create();

    // 2. Let successSteps given a byte sequence bytes be to queue a fetch task to run processBody given bytes, with taskDestination.
    auto success_steps = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(process_body, task_destination), [](ProcessBodyCallback process_body, TaskDestination const& task_destination, ByteBuffer bytes) {
        queue_fetch_task(task_destination, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(process_body, move(bytes)), [](ProcessBodyCallback process_body, ByteBuffer& bytes) {
            process_body->function()(move(bytes));
        }));
    });

    // 3. Let errorSteps optionally given an exception exception be to queue a fetch task to run processBodyError given
    //    exception, with taskDestination.
    auto error_steps = GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(process_body_error, task_destination), [](ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error, TaskDestination const& task_destination, JS::Value exception) {
        queue_fetch_task(task_destination, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(process_body_error, exception), [](ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error, JS::Value exception) {
            process_body_error->function()(exception);
        }));
    });

    // 4. Let reader be the result of getting a reader for body’s stream. If that threw an exception, then run errorSteps
    //    with that exception and return.
    auto reader = m_stream->get_a_reader();

    if (reader.is_exception()) {
        auto throw_completion = WebIDL::exception_to_throw_completion(realm.vm(), realm, reader.release_error());
        error_steps->function()(throw_completion.release_value());
        return;
    }

    // 5. Read all bytes from reader, given successSteps and errorSteps.
    reader.value()->read_all_bytes(success_steps, error_steps);
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#body-incrementally-read
GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStreamDefaultReader> Body::incrementally_read(JS::Realm& realm, ProcessBodyChunkCallback process_body_chunk, ProcessEndOfBodyCallback process_end_of_body, ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error, TaskDestination task_destination)
{
    HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext const execution_context { realm, HTML::TemporaryExecutionContext::CallbacksEnabled::Yes };

    // 1. If taskDestination is null, then set taskDestination to the result of starting a new parallel queue.
    if (task_destination.has<Empty>())
        task_destination = HTML::ParallelQueue::create();

    // 2. Let reader be the result of getting a reader for body’s stream.
    // NOTE: This operation will not throw an exception.
    auto reader = MUST(m_stream->get_a_reader());

    // 3. Perform the incrementally-read loop given reader, taskDestination, processBodyChunk, processEndOfBody, and processBodyError.
    VERIFY(!task_destination.has<Empty>());
    incrementally_read_loop(reader, task_destination, process_body_chunk, process_end_of_body, process_body_error);
    return reader;
}

GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStreamDefaultReader> Body::incrementally_read(ProcessBodyChunkCallback process_body_chunk, ProcessEndOfBodyCallback process_end_of_body, ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error, TaskDestination task_destination)
{
    VERIFY(task_destination.has<GC::Ref<JS::Object>>());
    return incrementally_read(HTML::relevant_realm(*task_destination.get<GC::Ref<JS::Object>>()), move(process_body_chunk), move(process_end_of_body), move(process_body_error), move(task_destination));
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#incrementally-read-loop
void Body::incrementally_read_loop(Streams::ReadableStreamDefaultReader& reader, TaskDestination task_destination, ProcessBodyChunkCallback process_body_chunk, ProcessEndOfBodyCallback process_end_of_body, ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error)
{
    // 1. Let readRequest be the following read request:
    auto read_request = GC::Heap::the().allocate<IncrementalReadLoopReadRequest>(*this, reader, task_destination, process_body_chunk, process_end_of_body, process_body_error);

    // 2. Read a chunk from reader given readRequest.
    reader.read_a_chunk(read_request);
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-as-a-body
GC::Ref<Body> byte_sequence_as_body(JS::Realm& realm, ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    // To get a byte sequence bytes as a body, return the body of the result of safely extracting bytes.
    auto [body, _] = safely_extract_body(realm, bytes);
    return body;
}

void cancel_incremental_read(Streams::ReadableStreamDefaultReader& reader)
{
    reader.cancel({});
}

bool web_fetch_body_length(Body* body, u64* out_length)
{
    if (!body->length().has_value())
        return false;
    *out_length = *body->length();
    return true;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/Forward.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <LibCore/ImmutableBytes.h>
#include <LibGC/Ptr.h>
#include <LibGC/Root.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/FetchBody.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/Task.h>
#include <LibWeb/Streams/ReadableStream.h>
#include <LibWeb/WebIDL/Promise.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#reading-the-resource-header
static constexpr size_t MAX_SNIFF_BYTES = 1445;

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-body
class WEB_API Body final : public JS::Cell {
    GC_CELL(Body, JS::Cell);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(Body);

public:
    // processBody must be an algorithm accepting a byte sequence.
    using ProcessBodyCallback = GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(ByteBuffer)>>;
    // processBodyError must be an algorithm optionally accepting an exception.
    using ProcessBodyErrorCallback = GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(JS::Value)>>;
    // processBodyChunk must be an algorithm accepting a byte sequence.
    using ProcessBodyChunkCallback = GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(ByteBuffer)>>;
    // processEndOfBody must be an algorithm accepting no arguments
    using ProcessEndOfBodyCallback = GC::Ref<GC::Function<void()>>;

    // https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#reading-the-resource-header
    // The resource header is the first 1445 bytes, or all of a shorter body; a body that errored first is Failed.
    enum class SniffOutcome : u8 {
        Complete,
        Failed,
    };
    struct SniffBytes {
        ReadonlyBytes bytes;
        SniffOutcome outcome { SniffOutcome::Complete };
    };
    using SniffBytesCallback = GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(SniffBytes)>>;
    using ResourceHeaderCallback = GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(Core::ImmutableBytes, SniffOutcome)>>;
    using ResourceHeaderReader = GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(ResourceHeaderCallback)>>;

    // A body that extraction made keeps its source and length, and is never sniffed.
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<Body> create(GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream>, FetchBody = {});
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<Body> create_over_bytes(JS::Realm&, Core::ImmutableBytes);
    // The reader reads the resource header from where the body's bytes arrive.
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<Body> create_over_arriving_bytes(GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream>, ResourceHeaderReader);

    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> stream() const { return *m_stream; }
    void set_stream(GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> value) { m_stream = value; }
    [[nodiscard]] FetchBody const& fetch_body() const { return m_fetch_body; }
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> const& source() const { return m_fetch_body.source(); }
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<u64> const& length() const { return m_fetch_body.length(); }

    [[nodiscard]] Optional<SniffBytes> sniff_bytes_if_available() const;
    // A waiter runs at once if the resource header is available, and otherwise once, from a networking task.
    void wait_for_sniff_bytes(SniffBytesCallback on_ready);

    [[nodiscard]] GC::Ref<Body> clone(JS::Realm&);

    void fully_read(JS::Realm&, ProcessBodyCallback process_body, ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error, TaskDestination) const;
    GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStreamDefaultReader> incrementally_read(JS::Realm&, ProcessBodyChunkCallback process_body_chunk, ProcessEndOfBodyCallback process_end_of_body, ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error, TaskDestination);
    GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStreamDefaultReader> incrementally_read(ProcessBodyChunkCallback process_body_chunk, ProcessEndOfBodyCallback process_end_of_body, ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error, TaskDestination);
    void incrementally_read_loop(Streams::ReadableStreamDefaultReader& reader, TaskDestination, ProcessBodyChunkCallback process_body_chunk, ProcessEndOfBodyCallback process_end_of_body, ProcessBodyErrorCallback process_body_error);

    virtual void visit_edges(JS::Cell::Visitor&) override;

private:
    struct NeverSniffed { };
    struct UnreadResourceHeader {
        ResourceHeaderReader reader;
    };
    struct ReadingResourceHeader { };
    struct ReadResourceHeader {
        Core::ImmutableBytes bytes;
        SniffOutcome outcome { SniffOutcome::Complete };
    };
    using ResourceHeader = Variant<NeverSniffed, UnreadResourceHeader, ReadingResourceHeader, ReadResourceHeader>;

    Body(GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream>, FetchBody, ResourceHeader);

    void did_read_resource_header(Core::ImmutableBytes, SniffOutcome);

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-body-stream
    // A stream (a ReadableStream object).
    GC::Ref<Streams::ReadableStream> m_stream;

    FetchBody m_fetch_body;

    ResourceHeader m_resource_header;
    GC::Ptr<GC::Function<void(SniffBytes)>> m_sniff_bytes_callback;
};

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#body-with-type
// A body with type is a tuple that consists of a body (a body) and a type (a header value or null).
struct BodyWithType {
    GC::Ref<Body> body;
    Optional<Utf16String> type;
};

WEB_API GC::Ref<Body> byte_sequence_as_body(JS::Realm&, ReadonlyBytes);
WEB_API void cancel_incremental_read(Streams::ReadableStreamDefaultReader&);

}

/*

#include <AK/Checked.h>
#include <LibHTTP/Header.h>
#include <LibHTTP/HeaderList.h>
#include <LibTextCodec/Decoder.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/CORS.h>
#include <LibWebCommon/MimeSniff/MimeType.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cors-safelisted-request-header
bool is_cors_safelisted_request_header(HTTP::Header const& header)
{
    auto const& [name, value] = header;

    // 1. If value’s length is greater than 128, then return false.
    if (value.length() > 128)
        return false;

    // 2. Byte-lowercase name and switch on the result:
    // `accept`
    if (name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("accept"sv)) {
        // If value contains a CORS-unsafe request-header byte, then return false.
        if (any_of(value, is_cors_unsafe_request_header_byte))
            return false;
    }
    // `accept-language`
    // `content-language`
    else if (name.is_one_of_ignoring_ascii_case("accept-language"sv, "content-language"sv)) {
        // If value contains a byte that is not in the range 0x30 (0) to 0x39 (9), inclusive, is not in the range 0x41 (A) to 0x5A (Z), inclusive, is not in the range 0x61 (a) to 0x7A (z), inclusive, and is not 0x20 (SP), 0x2A (*), 0x2C (,), 0x2D (-), 0x2E (.), 0x3B (;), or 0x3D (=), then return false.
        if (any_of(value, [](auto byte) {
                return !(is_ascii_digit(byte) || is_ascii_alpha(byte) || " *,-.;="sv.contains(byte));
            }))
            return false;
    }
    // `content-type`
    else if (name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("content-type"sv)) {
        // 1. If value contains a CORS-unsafe request-header byte, then return false.
        if (any_of(value, is_cors_unsafe_request_header_byte))
            return false;

        // 2. Let mimeType be the result of parsing the result of isomorphic decoding value.
        auto decoded = TextCodec::isomorphic_decode(value);
        auto mime_type = MimeSniff::MimeType::parse(decoded);

        // 3. If mimeType is failure, then return false.
        if (!mime_type.has_value())
            return false;

        // 4. If mimeType’s essence is not "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", "multipart/form-data", or "text/plain", then return false.
        if (!mime_type->essence().is_one_of("application/x-www-form-urlencoded"sv, "multipart/form-data"sv, "text/plain"sv))
            return false;
    }
    // `range`
    else if (name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("range"sv)) {
        // 1. Let rangeValue be the result of parsing a single range header value given value and false.
        auto range_value = HTTP::parse_single_range_header_value(value, false);

        // 2. If rangeValue is failure, then return false.
        if (!range_value.has_value())
            return false;

        // 3. If rangeValue[0] is null, then return false.
        // NOTE: As web browsers have historically not emitted ranges such as `bytes=-500` this algorithm does not safelist them.
        if (!range_value->start.has_value())
            return false;
    }
    // Otherwise
    else {
        // Return false.
        return false;
    }

    // 3. Return true.
    return true;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cors-unsafe-request-header-byte
bool is_cors_unsafe_request_header_byte(u8 byte)
{
    // A CORS-unsafe request-header byte is a byte byte for which one of the following is true:
    // - byte is less than 0x20 and is not 0x09 HT
    // - byte is 0x22 ("), 0x28 (left parenthesis), 0x29 (right parenthesis), 0x3A (:), 0x3C (<), 0x3E (>), 0x3F (?), 0x40 (@), 0x5B ([), 0x5C (\), 0x5D (]), 0x7B ({), 0x7D (}), or 0x7F DEL.
    return (byte < 0x20 && byte != 0x09)
        || (Array { 0x22, 0x28, 0x29, 0x3A, 0x3C, 0x3E, 0x3F, 0x40, 0x5B, 0x5C, 0x5D, 0x7B, 0x7D, 0x7F }.contains_slow(byte));
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cors-unsafe-request-header-names
Vector<ByteString> get_cors_unsafe_header_names(HTTP::HeaderList const& headers)
{
    // 1. Let unsafeNames be a new list.
    Vector<ByteString> unsafe_names;

    // 2. Let potentiallyUnsafeNames be a new list.
    Vector<ByteString> potentially_unsafe_names;

    // 3. Let safelistValueSize be 0.
    Checked<size_t> safelist_value_size = 0;

    // 4. For each header of headers:
    for (auto const& header : headers) {
        // 1. If header is not a CORS-safelisted request-header, then append header’s name to unsafeNames.
        if (!is_cors_safelisted_request_header(header)) {
            unsafe_names.append(header.name);
        }
        // 2. Otherwise, append header’s name to potentiallyUnsafeNames and increase safelistValueSize by header’s
        //    value’s length.
        else {
            potentially_unsafe_names.append(header.name);
            safelist_value_size += header.value.length();
        }
    }

    // 5. If safelistValueSize is greater than 1024, then for each name of potentiallyUnsafeNames, append name to
    //    unsafeNames.
    if (safelist_value_size.has_overflow() || safelist_value_size.value() > 1024)
        unsafe_names.extend(move(potentially_unsafe_names));

    // 6. Return the result of convert header names to a sorted-lowercase set with unsafeNames.
    return HTTP::convert_header_names_to_a_sorted_lowercase_set(unsafe_names.span());
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cors-non-wildcard-request-header-name
bool is_cors_non_wildcard_request_header_name(StringView header_name)
{
    // A CORS non-wildcard request-header name is a header name that is a byte-case-insensitive match for `Authorization`.
    //
    // AD-HOC: Enforcing this is not yet web-compatible. See:
    //         https://github.com/whatwg/fetch/issues/1278
    //         https://github.com/whatwg/fetch/issues/1919
    //
    //         On the contrary, the use of Authorization with a wildcarded Access-Control-Allow-Headers is rising:
    //         https://chromestatus.com/metrics/feature/timeline/popularity/3873
    (void)header_name;
    return false;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#privileged-no-cors-request-header-name
bool is_privileged_no_cors_request_header_name(StringView header_name)
{
    // A privileged no-CORS request-header name is a header name that is a byte-case-insensitive match for one of
    // - `Range`.
    return header_name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case("Range"sv);
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cors-safelisted-response-header-name
bool is_cors_safelisted_response_header_name(StringView header_name, ReadonlySpan<StringView> list)
{
    // A CORS-safelisted response-header name, given a list of header names list, is a header name that is a byte-case-insensitive match for one of
    // - `Cache-Control`
    // - `Content-Language`
    // - `Content-Length`
    // - `Content-Type`
    // - `Expires`
    // - `Last-Modified`
    // - `Pragma`
    // - Any item in list that is not a forbidden response-header name.
    return header_name.is_one_of_ignoring_ascii_case(
               "Cache-Control"sv,
               "Content-Language"sv,
               "Content-Length"sv,
               "Content-Type"sv,
               "Expires"sv,
               "Last-Modified"sv,
               "Pragma"sv)
        || any_of(list, [&](auto list_header_name) {
               return header_name.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(list_header_name)
                   && !HTTP::is_forbidden_response_header_name(list_header_name);
           });
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#no-cors-safelisted-request-header-name
bool is_no_cors_safelisted_request_header_name(StringView header_name)
{
    // A no-CORS-safelisted request-header name is a header name that is a byte-case-insensitive match for one of
    // - `Accept`
    // - `Accept-Language`
    // - `Content-Language`
    // - `Content-Type`
    return header_name.is_one_of_ignoring_ascii_case(
        "Accept"sv,
        "Accept-Language"sv,
        "Content-Language"sv,
        "Content-Type"sv);
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#no-cors-safelisted-request-header
bool is_no_cors_safelisted_request_header(HTTP::Header const& header)
{
    // 1. If name is not a no-CORS-safelisted request-header name, then return false.
    if (!is_no_cors_safelisted_request_header_name(header.name))
        return false;

    // 2. Return whether (name, value) is a CORS-safelisted request-header.
    return is_cors_safelisted_request_header(header);
}

}

FetchBody::FetchBody(Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> source, Optional<u64> length)
    : m_source(move(source))
    , m_length(length)
{
}

ResponseBody::ResponseBody(Bytes bytes, Optional<u64> length)
    : m_bytes(move(bytes))
    , m_length(length)
{
}

ResponseBody ResponseBody::from_bytes(Core::ImmutableBytes bytes)
{
    auto length = bytes.size();
    return ResponseBody { move(bytes), length };
}

ResponseBody ResponseBody::from_fetch_body(FetchBody const& body)
{
    if (auto const& source = body.source(); source.has_value())
        return ResponseBody { *source, body.length() };
    return ResponseBody { ReadThroughStream {}, body.length() };
}

Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes const&> ResponseBody::source() const
{
    if (auto const* bytes = m_bytes.get_pointer<Core::ImmutableBytes>())
        return *bytes;
    return {};
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-as-a-body
// NB: Each view of the body makes its stream from these bytes.
ResponseBody byte_sequence_as_response_body(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    return ResponseBody::from_bytes(MUST(Core::ImmutableBytes::copy(bytes)));
}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Forward.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <LibCore/ImmutableBytes.h>
#include <LibWeb/Export.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Engine/FetchByteChannel.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

// A body's source and length, without its stream.
class WEB_API FetchBody {
public:
    FetchBody() = default;
    FetchBody(Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> source, Optional<u64> length);

    [[nodiscard]] static FetchBody from_bytes(Core::ImmutableBytes bytes)
    {
        auto length = bytes.size();
        return FetchBody { move(bytes), length };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> const& source() const { return m_source; }
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<u64> const& length() const { return m_length; }

private:
    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-body-source
    // A source (null, a byte sequence, a Blob object, or a FormData object), initially null.
    // NB: A Blob or FormData source is held as its bytes.
    Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes> m_source;

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-body-total-bytes
    // A length (null or an integer), initially null.
    Optional<u64> m_length;
};

// A response's body as fetch keeps it: its length and where its bytes are.
class WEB_API ResponseBody {
public:
    // The bytes are read through the stream of the response's body view.
    struct ReadThroughStream { };
    using Bytes = Variant<Core::ImmutableBytes, NonnullRefPtr<Engine::FetchByteChannel>, ReadThroughStream>;

    ResponseBody(Bytes, Optional<u64> length);

    [[nodiscard]] static ResponseBody from_bytes(Core::ImmutableBytes);
    [[nodiscard]] static ResponseBody from_fetch_body(FetchBody const&);

    [[nodiscard]] Bytes const& bytes() const { return m_bytes; }

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-body-source
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<Core::ImmutableBytes const&> source() const;

    // https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-body-total-bytes
    [[nodiscard]] Optional<u64> const& length() const { return m_length; }

private:
    Bytes m_bytes;
    Optional<u64> m_length;
};

WEB_API ResponseBody byte_sequence_as_response_body(ReadonlyBytes);

}

#include <LibHTTP/HeaderList.h>
#include <LibTextCodec/Decoder.h>
#include <LibWeb/Fetch/Infrastructure/HTTP/MIME.h>

namespace Web::Fetch::Infrastructure {

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-extract-mime-type
Optional<MimeSniff::MimeType> extract_mime_type(HTTP::HeaderList const& headers)
{
    // 1. Let charset be null.
    Optional<String> charset;

    // 2. Let essence be null.
    Optional<String> essence;

    // 3. Let mimeType be null.
    Optional<MimeSniff::MimeType> mime_type;

    // 4. Let values be the result of getting, decoding, and splitting `Content-Type` from headers.
    auto values = headers.get_decode_and_split("Content-Type"sv);

    // 5. If values is null, then return failure.
    if (!values.has_value())
        return {};

    // 6. For each value of values:
    for (auto const& value : *values) {
        // 1. Let temporaryMimeType be the result of parsing value.
        auto temporary_mime_type = MimeSniff::MimeType::parse(value);

        // 2. If temporaryMimeType is failure or its essence is "*/*", then continue.
        if (!temporary_mime_type.has_value() || temporary_mime_type->essence() == "*/*"sv)
            continue;

        // 3. Set mimeType to temporaryMimeType.
        mime_type = temporary_mime_type;

        // 4. If mimeType’s essence is not essence, then:
        if (!essence.has_value() || (mime_type->essence() != *essence)) {
            // 1. Set charset to null.
            charset = {};

            // 2. If mimeType’s parameters["charset"] exists, then set charset to mimeType’s parameters["charset"].
            auto it = mime_type->parameters().find("charset"sv);
            if (it != mime_type->parameters().end())
                charset = it->value;

            // 3. Set essence to mimeType’s essence.
            essence = mime_type->essence();
        }
        // 5. Otherwise, if mimeType’s parameters["charset"] does not exist, and charset is non-null, set mimeType’s parameters["charset"] to charset.
        else if (!mime_type->parameters().contains("charset"sv) && charset.has_value()) {
            mime_type->set_parameter("charset"_string, charset.release_value());
        }
    }

    // 7. If mimeType is null, then return failure.
    // 8. Return mimeType.
    return mime_type;
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#legacy-extract-an-encoding
StringView legacy_extract_an_encoding(Optional<MimeSniff::MimeType> const& mime_type, StringView fallback_encoding)
{
    // 1. If mimeType is failure, then return fallbackEncoding.
    if (!mime_type.has_value())
        return fallback_encoding;

    // 2. If mimeType["charset"] does not exist, then return fallbackEncoding.
    auto charset = mime_type->parameters().get("charset"sv);
    if (!charset.has_value())
        return fallback_encoding;

    // 3. Let tentativeEncoding be the result of getting an encoding from mimeType["charset"].
    auto tentative_encoding = TextCodec::get_standardized_encoding(*charset);

    // 4. If tentativeEncoding is failure, then return fallbackEncoding.
    if (!tentative_encoding.has_value())
        return fallback_encoding;

    // 5. Return tentativeEncoding.
    return *tentative_encoding;
}

}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url
URL::URL& Request::url()
{
    // A request has an associated URL (a URL).
    // NOTE: Implementations are encouraged to make this a pointer to the first URL in request’s URL list. It is provided as a distinct field solely for the convenience of other standards hooking into Fetch.
    VERIFY(!m_url_list.is_empty());
    return m_url_list.first();
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url
URL::URL const& Request::url() const
{
    return const_cast<Request&>(*this).url();
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-current-url
URL::URL& Request::current_url()
{
    // A request has an associated current URL. It is a pointer to the last URL in request’s URL list.
    VERIFY(!m_url_list.is_empty());
    return m_url_list.last();
}

// https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-current-url
URL::URL const& Request::current_url() const
{
    return const_cast<Request&>(*this).current_url();
}

void Request::set_url(URL::URL url)
{
    // Sometimes setting the URL and URL list are done as two distinct steps in the spec,
    // but since we know the URL is always the URL list's first item and doesn't change later
    // on, we can combine them.
    if (!m_url_list.is_empty())
        m_url_list.clear();
    m_url_list.append(move(url));
}
