static void* cell_of(Canvas2DContextBase const& context)
{
    return const_cast<Canvas2DContextBase*>(&context);
}

Canvas2DContextBase& Canvas2DContextBase::create(CanvasHost& canvas_host, GC::Cell& canvas, bool canvas_is_offscreen, CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings const& context_attributes)
{
    auto size = canvas_host.bitmap_size_for_canvas();
    ContextCreationArguments arguments {
        .canvas = &canvas,
        .canvas_host = &canvas_host,
        .canvas_is_offscreen = canvas_is_offscreen,
        .width = size.width(),
        .height = size.height(),
        .alpha = context_attributes.alpha,
        .desynchronized = context_attributes.desynchronized,
        .color_space = context_attributes.color_space,
        .color_type = context_attributes.color_type,
        .will_read_frequently = context_attributes.will_read_frequently,
    };
    return *static_cast<Canvas2DContextBase*>(web_canvas_2d_context_create(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(JS::VM::the()), &arguments));
}

CanvasHost& Canvas2DContextBase::canvas_host() const
{
    return *static_cast<CanvasHost*>(web_canvas_2d_context_canvas_host(cell_of(*this)));
}

bool Canvas2DContextBase::origin_clean() const
{
    return web_canvas_2d_context_origin_clean(cell_of(*this));
}

void Canvas2DContextBase::set_size(Gfx::IntSize const& size)
{
    web_canvas_2d_context_set_size(this, size.width(), size.height());
}

void Canvas2DContextBase::reset_to_default_state()
{
    web_canvas_2d_context_reset_to_default_state(this);
}

void Canvas2DContextBase::prepare_for_compositing()
{
    web_canvas_2d_context_prepare_for_compositing(this);
}

void Canvas2DContextBase::ensure_backing_storage()
{
    web_canvas_2d_context_ensure_backing_storage(this);
}

void Canvas2DContextBase::discard_backing_storage()
{
    web_canvas_2d_context_discard_backing_storage(this);
}

Optional<Compositing::CanvasId> Canvas2DContextBase::canvas_id() const
{
    u64 canvas_id = 0;
    if (!web_canvas_2d_context_canvas_id(cell_of(*this), &canvas_id))
        return {};
    return Compositing::CanvasId { canvas_id };
}

Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace Canvas2DContextBase::color_space() const
{
    return predefined_color_space_from_underlying(web_canvas_2d_context_color_space(cell_of(*this)));
}

Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> Canvas2DContextBase::read_pixels(Gfx::IntRect const& rect, Gfx::AlphaType alpha_type, Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace color_space)
{
    auto frame = adopt_own_if_nonnull(static_cast<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame*>(web_canvas_2d_context_read_pixels(this, rect, to_underlying(alpha_type), to_underlying(color_space))));
    if (!frame)
        return {};
    return move(*frame);
}

bool Canvas2DContextBase::draw_image(ImageBitmap& image_bitmap, float x, float y)
{
    return web_canvas_2d_context_draw_image_bitmap(this, &image_bitmap, x, y);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#concept-canvas-context-lost
void Canvas2DContextBase::notify_backing_storage_lost()
{
    if (!web_canvas_2d_context_has_backing_storage(this))
        return;
    web_canvas_2d_context_drop_cached_readback(this);

    // When the user agent detects that the backing storage associated with a canvas context has been lost, then it
    // must queue a global task on the DOM manipulation task source given canvas's relevant global object to run
    // these steps:
    queue_global_task(HTML::Task::Source::DOMManipulation, canvas_host().canvas_relevant_global_object(), GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref { *this }), [](auto& context) {
        // 1. Let canvas be context's canvas element.
        auto& canvas = context->canvas_host();

        // 2. If context's context lost is true, then abort these steps.
        if (web_canvas_2d_context_is_lost(context.ptr()))
            return;

        // 3. Set context's context lost to true.
        web_canvas_2d_context_set_lost(context.ptr(), true);

        // AD-HOC: Release the remote context backing the lost storage.
        context->discard_backing_storage();

        // 4. Reset the rendering context to its default state given context.
        context->reset_to_default_state();

        // 5. Let shouldRestore be the result of firing an event named contextlost at canvas, with the cancelable
        //    attribute initialized to true.
        DOM::EventInit context_lost_event_init;
        context_lost_event_init.cancelable = true;
        bool should_restore = canvas.canvas_event_target().dispatch_event(DOM::Event::create(canvas.canvas_relevant_global_object(), HTML::EventNames::contextlost, context_lost_event_init));

        // 6. If shouldRestore is false, then abort these steps.
        if (!should_restore)
            return;

        // 7. Attempt to restore context by creating a backing storage using context's attributes and associating
        //    them with context. If this fails, then abort these steps.
        context->ensure_backing_storage();
        if (!web_canvas_2d_context_has_backing_storage(context.ptr()))
            return;

        // 8. Set context's context lost to false.
        web_canvas_2d_context_set_lost(context.ptr(), false);

        // 9. Fire an event named contextrestored at canvas.
        canvas.canvas_event_target().dispatch_event(DOM::Event::create(canvas.canvas_relevant_global_object(), HTML::EventNames::contextrestored));
    }));
}

static CanvasHost& host_from(void* canvas_host)
{
    return *static_cast<CanvasHost*>(canvas_host);
}

void web_canvas_2d_canvas_did_change_content(void* canvas_host)
{
    host_from(canvas_host).did_change_canvas_content();
}

void web_canvas_2d_canvas_did_create_backing_storage(void* canvas_host)
{
    host_from(canvas_host).did_create_canvas_backing_storage();
}

static bool transport_for(Page& page, Compositor::CompositorHost::Canvas2DTransport* out_transport)
{
    if (!page.has_compositor_host())
        return false;
    auto transport = page.compositor_host().create_canvas_2d_transport();
    if (!transport.has_value())
        return false;
    *out_transport = *transport;
    return true;
}

bool web_canvas_2d_canvas_create_transport(void* canvas_host, Compositor::CompositorHost::Canvas2DTransport* out_transport)
{
    return transport_for(host_from(canvas_host).canvas_page(), out_transport);
}

void* web_canvas_2d_canvas_wrapper(void* canvas, bool canvas_is_offscreen, void* realm_pointer)
{
    auto& realm = *static_cast<JS::Realm*>(realm_pointer);
    auto& wrapper_world = Bindings::host_defined_wrapper_world(realm);
    auto* cell = static_cast<GC::Cell*>(canvas);
    if (canvas_is_offscreen)
        return Bindings::wrap(wrapper_world, realm, GC::Ref { *static_cast<OffscreenCanvas*>(cell) }).ptr();
    return Bindings::wrap(wrapper_world, realm, GC::Ref { *static_cast<HTMLCanvasElement*>(cell) }).ptr();
}

void* web_canvas_2d_canvas_relevant_realm(void* canvas_host)
{
    return &host_from(canvas_host).canvas_relevant_global_object().shape().realm();
}

u64 web_canvas_2d_canvas_font_environment_generation(void* canvas_host)
{
    return host_from(canvas_host).canvas_font_computer().environment_generation();
}

bool web_canvas_2d_canvas_directionality_is_rtl(void* canvas, bool canvas_is_offscreen)
{
    // FIXME: Return the inherited direction of an OffscreenCanvas, which OffscreenCanvas does not keep yet. It is
    //        'ltr' unless transferControlToOffscreen() or a transfer set it.
    if (canvas_is_offscreen)
        return false;
    auto& canvas_element = *static_cast<HTMLCanvasElement*>(static_cast<GC::Cell*>(canvas));
    return canvas_element.directionality() == DOM::Element::Directionality::Rtl;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-font
template<typename CanvasType>
static bool resolve_font(CanvasType& canvas_element, Utf16View font, CanvasFontSelection font_selection, ResolvedFont& out_font)
{
    // The font IDL attribute, on setting, must be parsed as a CSS <'font'> value (but without supporting property-independent style sheet syntax like 'inherit'),
    // and the resulting font must be assigned to the context, with the 'line-height' component forced to 'normal', with the 'font-size' component converted to CSS pixels,
    // and with system fonts being computed to explicit values.

    auto const parsing_context = [&]() {
        if constexpr (SameAs<CanvasType, HTML::HTMLCanvasElement>)
            return CSS::Parser::ParsingParams { CSS::Parser::SpecialContext::OnScreenCanvasContextFontValue };
        return CSS::Parser::ParsingParams { CSS::Parser::SpecialContext::CanvasContextGenericValue };
    }();

    auto font_style_value_result = parse_css_value(parsing_context, font, CSS::PropertyID::Font);

    // If the new value is syntactically incorrect (including using property-independent style sheet syntax like 'inherit' or 'initial'), then it must be ignored, without assigning a new font value.
    // NOTE: ShorthandStyleValue should be the only valid option here. We implicitly VERIFY this below.
    if (!font_style_value_result || !font_style_value_result->is_shorthand())
        return false;

    // Load font with font style value properties
    auto const& font_style_value = font_style_value_result->as_shorthand();

    auto computed_math_depth = CSS::InitialValues::math_depth();

    // FIXME: We will need to absolutize this once we support ident() functions
    auto font_family = font_style_value.longhand(CSS::PropertyID::FontFamily);

    Optional<DOM::AbstractElement> inheritance_parent;

    if constexpr (SameAs<CanvasType, HTML::HTMLCanvasElement>) {
        // NB: Once pending style work is settled, the canvas's installed style is current, unless it is below
        //     display:none, where style updates leave it stale. Only then is its style computed again.
        auto& document = canvas_element.document();
        Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document };
        document.update_style_for_element(DOM::AbstractElement { canvas_element }, DOM::Document::StyleUpdateMode::OnlyIfNeeded);
        auto const& style = canvas_element.installed_style();
        if (!style || has_flag(style.dependency_flags(), CSS::StyleRecordDependencyFlag::InDisplayNoneSubtree))
            document.update_style_for_element(DOM::AbstractElement { canvas_element });

        if (canvas_element.navigable() && canvas_element.is_connected()) {
            // NOTE: Since we can't set a math depth directly here we always use the inherited value for the computed value
            computed_math_depth = canvas_element.template style_group<CSS::ComputedValues::FontValues>()->math_depth;

            // NOTE: The canvas itself is considered the inheritance parent
            inheritance_parent = canvas_element;
        }
    }

    auto computation_context = canvas_element.canvas_font_computation_context();

    auto const& computed_font_size = CSS::StyleComputer::compute_font_size(font_style_value.longhand(CSS::PropertyID::FontSize)->absolutized(computation_context), computed_math_depth, inheritance_parent, CSSPixels { 10 });
    auto const& computed_font_style = CSS::StyleComputer::compute_font_style(font_style_value.longhand(CSS::PropertyID::FontStyle)->absolutized(computation_context));
    auto const& computed_font_weight = CSS::StyleComputer::compute_font_weight(font_style_value.longhand(CSS::PropertyID::FontWeight)->absolutized(computation_context), inheritance_parent);
    auto const& computed_font_width = CSS::StyleComputer::compute_font_width(font_style_value.longhand(CSS::PropertyID::FontWidth)->absolutized(computation_context));
    // NB: This doesn't require absolutization since only the font-variant-caps longhand can be set and that can only be
    //     a keyword value
    auto const& computed_font_variant = font_style_value.longhand(CSS::PropertyID::FontVariant).release_nonnull();

    auto resolved_font_style_value = CSS::ShorthandStyleValue::create(
        CSS::PropertyID::Font,
        {
            // Set explicitly https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-prop
            CSS::PropertyID::FontFamily,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontSize,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontWidth,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontStyle,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontVariant,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontWeight,
            CSS::PropertyID::LineHeight,

            // Reset implicitly https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-prop
            CSS::PropertyID::FontFeatureSettings,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontKerning,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontLanguageOverride,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontOpticalSizing,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontVariationSettings,
            CSS::PropertyID::FontSizeAdjust,
        },
        {
            // Set explicitly
            *font_family,
            computed_font_size,
            computed_font_width,
            computed_font_style,
            computed_font_variant,
            computed_font_weight,
            property_initial_value(CSS::PropertyID::LineHeight), // NB: line-height is forced to normal (i.e. the initial value)

            // Reset implicitly
            property_initial_value(CSS::PropertyID::FontFeatureSettings),   // font-feature-settings
            property_initial_value(CSS::PropertyID::FontKerning),           // font-kerning,
            property_initial_value(CSS::PropertyID::FontLanguageOverride),  // font-language-override
            property_initial_value(CSS::PropertyID::FontOpticalSizing),     // font-optical-sizing,
            property_initial_value(CSS::PropertyID::FontVariationSettings), // font-variation-settings
            property_initial_value(CSS::PropertyID::FontSizeAdjust),        // font-size-adjust
        });

    CSS::FontResolutionFeatureValues feature_values;
    if (auto caps = computed_font_variant->as_shorthand().longhand(CSS::PropertyID::FontVariantCaps); caps->to_keyword() == CSS::Keyword::SmallCaps)
        feature_values[to_underlying(CSS::FontResolutionFeatureInput::FontVariantCaps)] = caps;

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#text-preparation-algorithm
    // NB: The text preparation algorithm sets 'font-kerning', 'font-stretch', 'font-variant-caps' and SVG
    //     'text-rendering' from the fontKerning, fontStretch, fontVariantCaps and textRendering attributes of the
    //     context. They select the fonts of the text, so they are applied when the font is resolved.
    // AD-HOC: fontStretch and fontVariantCaps only apply when they are not "normal", so that the font-stretch and
    //         font-variant-caps components of the font still apply when they are.
    auto computed_font_width_percentage = computed_font_width->as_percentage().percentage();
    static constexpr Array<CSS::Keyword, 3> font_kerning_keywords { CSS::Keyword::Auto, CSS::Keyword::Normal, CSS::Keyword::None };
    if (font_selection.font_kerning != 0 && font_selection.font_kerning < font_kerning_keywords.size())
        feature_values[to_underlying(CSS::FontResolutionFeatureInput::FontKerning)] = CSS::KeywordStyleValue::create(font_kerning_keywords[font_selection.font_kerning]);
    static constexpr Array<double, 9> font_stretch_percentages { 50, 62.5, 75, 87.5, 100, 112.5, 125, 150, 200 };
    if (font_selection.font_stretch != 4 && font_selection.font_stretch < font_stretch_percentages.size())
        computed_font_width_percentage = CSS::Percentage { font_stretch_percentages[font_selection.font_stretch] };
    static constexpr Array<CSS::Keyword, 7> font_variant_caps_keywords { CSS::Keyword::Normal, CSS::Keyword::SmallCaps, CSS::Keyword::AllSmallCaps, CSS::Keyword::PetiteCaps, CSS::Keyword::AllPetiteCaps, CSS::Keyword::Unicase, CSS::Keyword::TitlingCaps };
    if (font_selection.font_variant_caps != 0 && font_selection.font_variant_caps < font_variant_caps_keywords.size())
        feature_values[to_underlying(CSS::FontResolutionFeatureInput::FontVariantCaps)] = CSS::KeywordStyleValue::create(font_variant_caps_keywords[font_selection.font_variant_caps]);
    static constexpr Array<CSS::Keyword, 4> text_rendering_keywords { CSS::Keyword::Auto, CSS::Keyword::Optimizespeed, CSS::Keyword::Optimizelegibility, CSS::Keyword::Geometricprecision };
    if (font_selection.text_rendering != 0 && font_selection.text_rendering < text_rendering_keywords.size())
        feature_values[to_underlying(CSS::FontResolutionFeatureInput::TextRendering)] = CSS::KeywordStyleValue::create(text_rendering_keywords[font_selection.text_rendering]);

    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#font-source
    auto& font_computer = canvas_element.canvas_font_computer();

    auto font_size = computed_font_size->as_length().length().absolute_length_to_px();
    auto cascade = CSS::resolve_font_for_style_values(font_computer,
        {
            .font_families = CSS::computed_font_families_from_style_value(*font_family),
            .font_optical_sizing = CSS::FontOpticalSizing::Auto,
            .font_size = font_size,
            .font_slope = computed_font_style->as_font_style().to_font_slope(),
            .font_weight = computed_font_weight->as_number().number(),
            .font_width = computed_font_width_percentage,
            .feature_values = move(feature_values),
            .font_feature_values_scope = {},
        });

    out_font = {
        .cascade = &cascade.leak_ref(),
        .environment_generation = font_computer.environment_generation(),
        .font_size = computed_font_size->as_length().length().absolute_length_to_px_without_rounding(),
        // On getting, the font attribute must return the serialized form of the current font of the context (with no 'line-height' component).
        .serialized = resolved_font_style_value->to_utf16_string(CSS::SerializationMode::ResolvedValue).into_raw(),
    };
    return true;
}

bool web_canvas_2d_canvas_resolve_font(void* canvas, bool canvas_is_offscreen, FlatPtr font, CanvasFontSelection font_selection, ResolvedFont* out_font)
{
    auto font_string = Utf16String::from_raw(font);
    auto* cell = static_cast<GC::Cell*>(canvas);
    if (canvas_is_offscreen)
        return resolve_font(*static_cast<OffscreenCanvas*>(cell), font_string.utf16_view(), font_selection, *out_font);
    return resolve_font(*static_cast<HTMLCanvasElement*>(cell), font_string.utf16_view(), font_selection, *out_font);
}

// What the CSS values of a context are resolved with: the viewport of the canvas, and the font of the context.
static CSS::ComputationContext computation_context_for(CanvasHost& canvas_host, FontMetricsSource font)
{
    auto font_metrics = [&]() {
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#text-styles
        // NB: We lazily initialize the font, so if it hasn't been set yet we generate the font metrics based on the default font
        if (!font.cascade) {
            // When the object implementing the CanvasTextDrawingStyles interface is created, the font of the context must be set to 10px sans-serif.
            return CSS::Length::FontMetrics { 10, Platform::FontPlugin::the().default_font(8)->pixel_metrics(), CSS::InitialValues::line_height() };
        }

        auto const& first_font = font.cascade->first_available_font();
        return CSS::Length::FontMetrics { font.font_size, first_font.pixel_metrics(), CSS::InitialValues::line_height() };
    }();

    return {
        .length_resolution_context = {
            .viewport_rect = canvas_host.canvas_viewport_rect(),
            .font_metrics = font_metrics,
            .root_font_metrics = font_metrics },

        // NB: We don't require an abstract element because tree counting and random() functions aren't allowed in
        //     non-font canvas context values
        .abstract_element = {},

        // FIXME: The spec doesn't specify what color scheme should be used here but other browsers always use light so
        //        we do too for compatibility. See https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/12505
        .color_scheme = CSS::PreferredColorScheme::Light
    };
}

// NB: A color is converted to the color space of a context, and clipped to its gamut, as the 'relative-colorimetric'
//     rendering intent does, which the conversions of the pixels of a context also use.
static Gfx::Color used_color_in_predefined_color_space(CSS::StyleValue const& color, CSS::ColorResolutionStyle const& style, Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace color_space, Gfx::Color srgb_color)
{
    if (color_space == Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb)
        return srgb_color;

    auto ffi_style = style.to_ffi();
    auto resolved = CSS::StyleValueFFI::rust_style_value_to_color_components(color.rust_style_value_data(), &ffi_style, to_underlying(css_color_type_for(color_space)));
    if (!resolved.resolved)
        return srgb_color;
    auto quantize = [](float component) -> u8 {
        if (isnan(component))
            return 0;
        return static_cast<u8>(clamp(roundf(component * 255.0f), 0.0f, 255.0f));
    };
    return Gfx::Color(quantize(resolved.components[0]), quantize(resolved.components[1]), quantize(resolved.components[2]), quantize(resolved.components[3]));
}

void web_canvas_2d_canvas_resolve_color(void* canvas_host, CSS::StyleValue const* color, FontMetricsSource font, u8 color_space, Gfx::Color* out_color, Gfx::Color* out_color_in_color_space)
{
    auto& host = host_from(canvas_host);
    auto computation_context = computation_context_for(host, font);
    auto absolutized_color = color->absolutized(computation_context);
    auto style = host.canvas_color_resolution_style();
    *out_color = absolutized_color->to_color(style).value();
    *out_color_in_color_space = used_color_in_predefined_color_space(*absolutized_color, style, predefined_color_space_from_underlying(color_space), *out_color);
}

float web_canvas_2d_canvas_resolve_length(void* canvas_host, CSS::StyleValue const* length, FontMetricsSource font)
{
    auto absolutized_length = CSS::Length::from_style_value(length->absolutized(computation_context_for(host_from(canvas_host), font)), {});
    return static_cast<float>(absolutized_length.absolute_length_to_px().to_double());
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-filter
bool web_canvas_2d_canvas_parse_filter(void* canvas_host, FlatPtr filter, FontMetricsSource font, void* functions, void (*append_function)(void*, Compositing::RustFFI::FfiFilterFunction const*))
{
    auto& host = host_from(canvas_host);
    auto filter_string = Utf16String::from_raw(filter);
    CSS::Parser::Parser parser { CSS::Parser::ParsingParams { CSS::Parser::SpecialContext::CanvasContextGenericValue } };

    // 2. Let parsedValue be the result of parsing the given values as a <filter-value-list>.
    //    If any property-independent style sheet syntax like 'inherit' or 'initial' is present,
    //    then this parsing must return failure.
    auto style_value = parser.parse_as_css_value(filter_string.utf16_view(), CSS::PropertyID::Filter);
    if (!style_value || !style_value->is_value_list())
        return false;

    auto absolutized_style_value = style_value->absolutized(computation_context_for(host, font));
    for (auto& item : absolutized_style_value->as_value_list().values()) {
        if (item->is_url()) {
            // FIXME: Resolve the SVG filter
            dbgln("FIXME: SVG filters are not implemented for Canvas2D");
            continue;
        }

        auto const& filter_value = item->as_filter();
        Compositing::RustFFI::FfiFilterFunction function {};
        switch (filter_value.kind()) {
        case CSS::FilterStyleValue::Kind::Blur: {
            auto const& blur_filter = static_cast<CSS::BlurFilterStyleValue const&>(filter_value);
            function.kind = Compositing::RustFFI::FfiFilterFunctionKind::Blur;
            function.amount = blur_filter.resolved_radius();
            break;
        }
        case CSS::FilterStyleValue::Kind::Color: {
            auto const& color = static_cast<CSS::ColorFilterStyleValue const&>(filter_value);
            function.kind = Compositing::RustFFI::FfiFilterFunctionKind::Color;
            function.color_operation = color.operation();
            function.amount = color.resolved_amount();
            break;
        }
        case CSS::FilterStyleValue::Kind::HueRotate: {
            auto const& hue_rotate = static_cast<CSS::HueRotateFilterStyleValue const&>(filter_value);
            function.kind = Compositing::RustFFI::FfiFilterFunctionKind::HueRotate;
            function.amount = hue_rotate.angle_degrees();
            break;
        }
        case CSS::FilterStyleValue::Kind::DropShadow: {
            auto const& drop_shadow = static_cast<CSS::DropShadowFilterStyleValue const&>(filter_value);
            function.kind = Compositing::RustFFI::FfiFilterFunctionKind::DropShadow;
            function.offset_x = static_cast<float>(CSS::Length::from_style_value(drop_shadow.offset_x(), {}).absolute_length_to_px());
            function.offset_y = static_cast<float>(CSS::Length::from_style_value(drop_shadow.offset_y(), {}).absolute_length_to_px());
            if (drop_shadow.radius())
                function.amount = static_cast<float>(CSS::Length::from_style_value(*drop_shadow.radius(), {}).absolute_length_to_px());
            function.color = drop_shadow.color() ? drop_shadow.color()->to_color(host.canvas_color_resolution_style()).value_or(Gfx::Color::Black) : Gfx::Color::Black;
            break;
        }
        }
        append_function(functions, &function);
    }
    return true;
}

CSS::StyleValue const* web_canvas_2d_parse_color(FlatPtr color)
{
    auto color_string = Utf16String::from_raw(color);
    auto parsed_color = parse_css_type(CSS::Parser::ParsingParams { CSS::Parser::SpecialContext::CanvasContextGenericValue }, color_string.utf16_view(), CSS::ValueType::Color);
    if (!parsed_color)
        return nullptr;
    return &parsed_color.release_nonnull().leak_ref();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-letterspacing
CSS::StyleValue const* web_canvas_2d_parse_length(FlatPtr length, FlatPtr* out_serialized)
{
    auto length_string = Utf16String::from_raw(length);
    auto parsed = parse_css_type(CSS::Parser::ParsingParams { CSS::Parser::SpecialContext::CanvasContextGenericValue }, length_string.utf16_view(), CSS::ValueType::Length);
    if (!parsed)
        return nullptr;
    Utf16StringBuilder builder;
    parsed->serialize(builder, CSS::SerializationMode::Normal);
    *out_serialized = builder.to_string().into_raw();
    return &parsed.release_nonnull().leak_ref();
}

void web_canvas_2d_style_value_ref(CSS::StyleValue const* style_value)
{
    style_value->ref();
}

void web_canvas_2d_style_value_unref(CSS::StyleValue const* style_value)
{
    style_value->unref();
}

Gfx::DecodedImageFrame* web_canvas_2d_image_frame_from_pixels(u8 const* first_row, size_t pitch, i32 width, i32 height, u8 color_space)
{
    // NB: The bitmap is shareable, so that the frame shares its memory instead of copying the pixels again.
    auto bitmap = Gfx::Bitmap::create_shareable(Gfx::BitmapFormat::RGBA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Unpremultiplied, { width, height });
    if (bitmap.is_error())
        return nullptr;
    auto row_size = static_cast<size_t>(width) * sizeof(Gfx::RawPixel);
    for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y)
        __builtin_memcpy(bitmap.value()->scanline(y), first_row + static_cast<size_t>(y) * pitch, row_size);
    auto frame = Gfx::DecodedImageFrame::create(*bitmap.release_value(), Compositing::gfx_color_space_for(predefined_color_space_from_underlying(color_space)));
    if (frame.is_error())
        return nullptr;
    return new Gfx::DecodedImageFrame { frame.release_value() };
}

static CanvasImageSource image_source_from(void* source_wrapper, CanvasImageSourceKind kind)
{
    auto& wrapper = *static_cast<JS::Object*>(source_wrapper);
    switch (kind) {
    case CanvasImageSourceKind::HTMLImageElement:
        return GC::Ref { Bindings::impl_from<HTMLImageElement>(wrapper) };
    case CanvasImageSourceKind::SVGImageElement:
        return GC::Ref { Bindings::impl_from<SVG::SVGImageElement>(wrapper) };
    case CanvasImageSourceKind::HTMLVideoElement:
        return GC::Ref { Bindings::impl_from<HTMLVideoElement>(wrapper) };
    case CanvasImageSourceKind::HTMLCanvasElement:
        return GC::Ref { Bindings::impl_from<HTMLCanvasElement>(wrapper) };
    case CanvasImageSourceKind::OffscreenCanvas:
        return GC::Ref { Bindings::impl_from<OffscreenCanvas>(wrapper) };
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

// The values of `Usability` of Bindings/Rust/src/canvas_2d/canvas.rs.
static constexpr u8 usability_good = 0;
static constexpr u8 usability_bad = 1;
static constexpr u8 usability_invalid_state = 2;

u8 web_canvas_2d_check_usability_of_image(void* source_wrapper, CanvasImageSourceKind kind, FlatPtr* out_message)
{
    auto usability = check_usability_of_image(image_source_from(source_wrapper, kind));
    if (usability.is_exception()) {
        auto exception = usability.release_error();
        auto& dom_exception = exception.get<GC::Ref<WebIDL::DOMException>>();
        VERIFY(dom_exception->name() == "InvalidStateError"_utf16_fly_string);
        *out_message = Utf16String { dom_exception->message() }.into_raw();
        return usability_invalid_state;
    }
    return usability.value() == CanvasImageSourceUsability::Good ? usability_good : usability_bad;
}

// The size of an image element's image, as drawing it uses it. The default object size is the size of the output bitmap
// of the canvas it's drawn into.
void web_canvas_2d_image_source_size(void* source_wrapper, CanvasImageSourceKind kind, i32 default_width, i32 default_height, i32* out_width, i32* out_height)
{
    auto size = image_source_from(source_wrapper, kind).visit([&](OneOf<GC::Ref<HTMLImageElement>, GC::Ref<SVG::SVGImageElement>> auto const& source) -> Gfx::IntSize {
            // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#drawing-images
            // If the image has no natural dimensions, then the concrete object size must be used instead, as determined
            // using the CSS "Concrete Object Size Resolution" algorithm, with the specified size having neither a definite
            // width nor height, nor any additional constraints, the object's natural properties being those of the image
            // argument, and the default object size being the size of the output bitmap.
            auto size = CSS::run_default_sizing_algorithm({}, {}, { source->intrinsic_width(), source->intrinsic_height(), source->intrinsic_aspect_ratio() }, { default_width, default_height });
            return { size.width().to_int(), size.height().to_int() }; }, [](GC::Ref<HTMLCanvasElement> source) -> Gfx::IntSize {
            // NB: A valid output bitmap of an ImageBitmapRenderingContext has the dimensions of its bitmap data.
            if (auto const* bitmap_renderer = source->canvas_bitmap_renderer_context(); bitmap_renderer && !bitmap_renderer->is_blank())
                return source->bitmap_size_for_canvas();
            return { source->width(), source->height() }; }, [](GC::Ref<OffscreenCanvas> source) -> Gfx::IntSize { return source->bitmap_size_for_canvas(); }, [](GC::Ref<HTMLVideoElement> source) -> Gfx::IntSize { return { source->video_width(), source->video_height() }; }, [](GC::Ref<ImageBitmap>) -> Gfx::IntSize { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
    *out_width = size.width();
    *out_height = size.height();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#the-image-argument-is-not-origin-clean
bool web_canvas_2d_image_is_not_origin_clean(void* source_wrapper, CanvasImageSourceKind kind)
{
    return image_is_not_origin_clean(image_source_from(source_wrapper, kind));
}

// The id of the canvas that a canvas or an OffscreenCanvas draws into, readied to be drawn, if it is drawn by its id.
bool web_canvas_2d_image_source_canvas_id(void* source_wrapper, CanvasImageSourceKind kind, u64* out_canvas_id, bool* out_source_is_2d)
{
    auto& wrapper = *static_cast<JS::Object*>(source_wrapper);
    Optional<Compositing::CanvasId> source_canvas_id;
    if (kind == CanvasImageSourceKind::HTMLCanvasElement) {
        auto& source_canvas = Bindings::impl_from<HTMLCanvasElement>(wrapper);
        if (source_canvas.is_placeholder())
            return false;
        bool const source_is_2d = source_canvas.canvas_rendering_context_2d() != nullptr;
        source_canvas.ensure_backing_storage();
        if (!source_is_2d)
            source_canvas.prepare_for_compositing();
        source_canvas_id = source_canvas.canvas_id();
        *out_source_is_2d = source_is_2d;
    } else if (kind == CanvasImageSourceKind::OffscreenCanvas) {
        auto& source_canvas = Bindings::impl_from<OffscreenCanvas>(wrapper);
        auto const* source_context = source_canvas.context().get_pointer<GC::Ref<OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D>>();
        if (!source_context)
            return false;
        (*source_context)->ensure_backing_storage();
        source_canvas_id = (*source_context)->canvas_id();
        *out_source_is_2d = true;
    }
    if (!source_canvas_id.has_value())
        return false;
    *out_canvas_id = source_canvas_id->value();
    return true;
}

// The frame of an image or a canvas. A vector image is rasterized at the raster size instead of its natural size, if
// that size is not empty and the raster can be made, and out_rasterized says whether it was.
Gfx::DecodedImageFrame* web_canvas_2d_image_source_frame(void* source_wrapper, CanvasImageSourceKind kind, i32 raster_width, i32 raster_height, bool* out_rasterized)
{
    *out_rasterized = false;
    auto frame = image_source_from(source_wrapper, kind).visit([&](OneOf<GC::Ref<HTMLImageElement>, GC::Ref<SVG::SVGImageElement>> auto const& element) -> Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> {
            auto image_data = element->decoded_image_data();
            if (!image_data)
                return {};

            Gfx::IntSize raster_size { raster_width, raster_height };
            if (!raster_size.is_empty() && is<SVG::SVGDecodedImageData>(*image_data)) {
                if (auto raster_frame = image_data->default_frame(raster_size); raster_frame.has_value()) {
                    *out_rasterized = true;
                    return raster_frame;
                }
            }

            Gfx::IntSize size;
            auto intrinsic_width = element->intrinsic_width();
            auto intrinsic_height = element->intrinsic_height();
            if (intrinsic_width.has_value() && intrinsic_height.has_value())
                size = { intrinsic_width->to_int(), intrinsic_height->to_int() };

            return image_data->default_frame(size); }, [](GC::Ref<HTMLCanvasElement> const& canvas) -> Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> {
            canvas->prepare_for_compositing();
            return canvas->get_frame_from_surface(); }, [](GC::Ref<OffscreenCanvas> const& source) -> Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> { return source->get_frame_from_surface(); }, [](OneOf<GC::Ref<HTMLVideoElement>, GC::Ref<ImageBitmap>> auto const&) -> Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> { VERIFY_NOT_REACHED(); });
    if (!frame.has_value())
        return nullptr;
    return new Gfx::DecodedImageFrame { frame.release_value() };
}

bool web_canvas_2d_capture_video_frame(void* source_wrapper, CapturedVideoFrame* out_frame)
{
    auto& video = Bindings::impl_from<HTMLVideoElement>(*static_cast<JS::Object*>(source_wrapper));
    auto captured_frame = video.capture_current_video_frame();
    if (!captured_frame.has_value())
        return false;
    VERIFY(captured_frame->hold);
    *out_frame = {
        .hold = &captured_frame->hold.release_nonnull().leak_ref(),
        .sink_handle = captured_frame->sink_handle.value(),
        .generation = captured_frame->generation,
    };
    return true;
}

bool web_canvas_2d_video_transport(void* source_wrapper, Compositor::CompositorHost::Canvas2DTransport* out_transport)
{
    auto& video = Bindings::impl_from<HTMLVideoElement>(*static_cast<JS::Object*>(source_wrapper));
    return transport_for(video.document().page(), out_transport);
}

void web_canvas_2d_set_video_frame_copy(Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame>* out_frame, Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const* frame)
{
    *out_frame = *frame;
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value
// NB: The color is written in each predefined color space, in the order of Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace.
bool web_canvas_gradient_parse_color(FlatPtr color, Gfx::Color* out_colors)
{
    auto color_string = Utf16String::from_raw(color);
    auto const maybe_color = parse_css_value(CSS::Parser::ParsingParams { CSS::Parser::SpecialContext::CanvasContextGenericValue }, color_string.utf16_view(), CSS::PropertyID::Color);
    if (maybe_color.is_null() || !maybe_color->has_color())
        return false;
    CSS::ColorResolutionStyle style;
    auto srgb_color = maybe_color->to_color(style).value();
    for (u8 color_space = 0; color_space <= to_underlying(Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3Linear); ++color_space)
        out_colors[color_space] = used_color_in_predefined_color_space(*maybe_color, style, predefined_color_space_from_underlying(color_space), srgb_color);
    return true;
}

static bool image_provider_is_usable_for_canvas(Layout::ImageProvider const& image_provider)
{
    if (!image_provider.is_image_available())
        return false;

    // An image without a natural width or height, such as an SVG image without an absolute width and height, is usable:
    // Drawing it uses its concrete object size instead. Only a natural dimension of zero makes it unusable.
    auto intrinsic_width = image_provider.intrinsic_width();
    auto intrinsic_height = image_provider.intrinsic_height();
    return (!intrinsic_width.has_value() || *intrinsic_width > 0) && (!intrinsic_height.has_value() || *intrinsic_height > 0);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#check-the-usability-of-the-image-argument
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<CanvasImageSourceUsability> check_usability_of_image(CanvasImageSource const& image)
{
    // 1. Switch on image:
    auto usability = TRY(image.visit(
        // HTMLOrSVGImageElement
        [](GC::Ref<HTMLImageElement> image_element) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability>> {
            // If image's current request's state is broken, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
            if (image_element->current_request().state() == HTML::ImageRequest::State::Broken)
                return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("Image element state is broken"_utf16);

            // If image is not fully decodable, then return bad.
            // If image has a natural width or natural height (or both) equal to zero, then return bad.
            // NB: An image whose current request is not completely available is not fully decodable, even while the
            //     request still holds image data.
            if (image_element->current_request().state() != HTML::ImageRequest::State::CompletelyAvailable || !image_provider_is_usable_for_canvas(*image_element))
                return { CanvasImageSourceUsability::Bad };
            return Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability> {};
        },
        // FIXME: Don't duplicate this for HTMLImageElement and SVGImageElement.
        [](GC::Ref<SVG::SVGImageElement> image_element) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability>> {
            // FIXME: If image's current request's state is broken, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.

            // If image is not fully decodable, then return bad.
            // If image has a natural width or natural height (or both) equal to zero, then return bad.
            if (!image_provider_is_usable_for_canvas(*image_element))
                return { CanvasImageSourceUsability::Bad };
            return Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability> {};
        },

        [](GC::Ref<HTML::HTMLVideoElement> video_element) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability>> {
            // If image's readyState attribute is either HAVE_NOTHING or HAVE_METADATA, then return bad.
            if (video_element->ready_state() == HTML::HTMLMediaElement::ReadyState::HaveNothing || video_element->ready_state() == HTML::HTMLMediaElement::ReadyState::HaveMetadata) {
                return { CanvasImageSourceUsability::Bad };
            }
            return Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability> {};
        },

        // OffscreenCanvas
        [](GC::Ref<OffscreenCanvas> offscreen_canvas) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability>> {
            // If image has either a horizontal dimension or a vertical dimension equal to zero, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
            if (offscreen_canvas->width() == 0 || offscreen_canvas->height() == 0)
                return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("OffscreenCanvas width or height is zero"_utf16);
            return Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability> {};
        },
        // HTMLCanvasElement
        [](GC::Ref<HTMLCanvasElement> canvas_element) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability>> {
            // If image has either a horizontal dimension or a vertical dimension equal to zero, then throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
            // NB: A valid output bitmap of an ImageBitmapRenderingContext has the dimensions of its bitmap data.
            auto const* bitmap_renderer = canvas_element->canvas_bitmap_renderer_context();
            auto const has_zero_dimension = bitmap_renderer && !bitmap_renderer->is_blank()
                ? canvas_element->bitmap_size_for_canvas().is_empty()
                : canvas_element->width() == 0 || canvas_element->height() == 0;
            if (has_zero_dimension)
                return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("Canvas width or height is zero"_utf16);
            return Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability> {};
        },

        // ImageBitmap
        // FIXME: VideoFrame
        [](GC::Ref<ImageBitmap> image_bitmap) -> WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability>> {
            if (image_bitmap->is_detached())
                return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("Image bitmap is detached"_utf16);
            return Optional<CanvasImageSourceUsability> {};
        }));
    if (usability.has_value())
        return usability.release_value();

    // 2. Return good.
    return { CanvasImageSourceUsability::Good };
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#the-image-argument-is-not-origin-clean
bool image_is_not_origin_clean(CanvasImageSource const& image)
{
    // An object image is not origin-clean if, switching on image's type:
    return image.visit(
        // HTMLOrSVGImageElement
        [](GC::Ref<HTMLImageElement> image) {
            // image's current request's image data is CORS-cross-origin.
            // NB: WebGL asks before it knows that the image has image data.
            auto image_data = image->current_request().image_data();
            return image_data && image_data->is_cors_cross_origin();
        },
        [](GC::Ref<SVG::SVGImageElement> image) {
            // image's current request's image data is CORS-cross-origin.
            auto image_data = image->decoded_image_data();
            return image_data && image_data->is_cors_cross_origin();
        },
        // HTMLVideoElement
        [](GC::Ref<HTMLVideoElement> video) {
            // image's media data is CORS-cross-origin.
            return video->media_data_is_cors_cross_origin();
        },
        // HTMLCanvasElement
        // OffscreenCanvas
        [](OneOf<GC::Ref<HTMLCanvasElement>, GC::Ref<OffscreenCanvas>> auto const& canvas) {
            // image's bitmap's origin-clean flag is false.
            return !canvas->is_origin_clean();
        },
        // ImageBitmap
        [](GC::Ref<ImageBitmap> image_bitmap) {
            // image's bitmap's origin-clean flag is false.
            return !image_bitmap->is_origin_clean();
        });
}

}

#include <AK/Checked.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

Gfx::IntSize CanvasHost::bitmap_size_for_dimensions(u64 width, u64 height)
{
    if (width > NumericLimits<int>::max() || height > NumericLimits<int>::max()) {
        dbgln("Refusing to create {}x{} canvas (exceeds maximum dimensions)", width, height);
        return {};
    }

    Checked<u64> area = width;
    area *= height;

    if (area.has_overflow()) {
        dbgln("Refusing to create {}x{} canvas (overflow)", width, height);
        return {};
    }
    if (area.value() > static_cast<u64>(Compositing::max_canvas_area)) {
        dbgln("Refusing to create {}x{} canvas (exceeds maximum size)", width, height);
        return {};
    }
    return { static_cast<int>(width), static_cast<int>(height) };
}

static Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> transparent_canvas_frame(Gfx::IntSize size)
{
    auto bitmap = Gfx::Bitmap::create_shareable(Gfx::BitmapFormat::BGRA8888, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, size);
    if (bitmap.is_error())
        return {};
    auto frame = Gfx::DecodedImageFrame::create(*bitmap.value());
    if (frame.is_error())
        return {};
    return frame.release_value();
}

Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> CanvasHost::get_srgb_frame_from_surface()
{
    auto const size = bitmap_size_for_canvas();
    if (size.is_empty())
        return {};

    // NB: A blank output bitmap of an ImageBitmapRenderingContext is the transparent bitmap below.
    if (auto* context = canvas_bitmap_renderer_context(); context && !context->is_blank()) {
        // FIXME: Convert bitmap data that isn't in the sRGB color space.
        if (auto const* frame = context->frame(); frame)
            return frame->with_pixels_reinterpreted_in({});
        return {};
    }

    if (auto* webgl_context = canvas_webgl_context())
        return webgl_context->read_back_drawing_buffer({ {}, size });

    if (auto* context = canvas_2d_context()) {
        context->ensure_backing_storage();
        if (auto pixels = context->read_pixels({ {}, size }); pixels.has_value() && pixels->size() == size)
            return pixels;
        return {};
    }

    return transparent_canvas_frame(size);
}

Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> CanvasHost::get_frame_from_surface()
{
    // NB: The output bitmap of an ImageBitmapRenderingContext refers to its bitmap data, with its color space.
    if (auto* context = canvas_bitmap_renderer_context(); context && !context->is_blank()) {
        if (auto const* frame = context->frame())
            return *frame;
        return {};
    }

    if (auto* context = canvas_2d_context(); context && context->color_space() != Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb) {
        auto const size = bitmap_size_for_canvas();
        if (size.is_empty())
            return {};
        context->ensure_backing_storage();
        if (auto pixels = context->read_pixels({ {}, size }, Gfx::AlphaType::Premultiplied, context->color_space()); pixels.has_value() && pixels->size() == size)
            return pixels;
        return {};
    }

    return get_srgb_frame_from_surface();
}

Optional<Gfx::DecodedImageFrame> CanvasHost::get_frame_for_serialization(Utf16View type)
{
    if (serialization_of_the_bitmap_supports_color_profiles(type))
        return get_frame_from_surface();
    return get_srgb_frame_from_surface();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#concept-canvas-origin-clean
bool CanvasHost::is_origin_clean() const
{
    if (auto* context = canvas_2d_context())
        return context->origin_clean();
    if (auto* context = canvas_bitmap_renderer_context())
        return context->origin_clean();
    // NB: The texture uploads of a WebGL context throw a "SecurityError" DOMException for a source that is not
    //     origin-clean, so its bitmap stays origin-clean. A video is the exception, as long as its media data is
    //     never CORS-cross-origin (see image_is_not_origin_clean()).
    return true;
}

}

#include <LibWeb/HTML/Canvas/PredefinedColorSpace.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

static_assert(to_underlying(Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb) == 0);
static_assert(to_underlying(Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::SrgbLinear) == 1);
static_assert(to_underlying(Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3) == 2);
static_assert(to_underlying(Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3Linear) == 3);

CSS::ColorStyleValue::ColorType css_color_type_for(Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace color_space)
{
    switch (color_space) {
    case Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::Srgb:
        return CSS::ColorStyleValue::ColorType::sRGB;
    case Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::SrgbLinear:
        return CSS::ColorStyleValue::ColorType::sRGBLinear;
    case Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3:
        return CSS::ColorStyleValue::ColorType::DisplayP3;
    case Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3Linear:
        return CSS::ColorStyleValue::ColorType::DisplayP3Linear;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace predefined_color_space_from_underlying(u8 value)
{
    VERIFY(value <= to_underlying(Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace::DisplayP3Linear));
    return static_cast<Bindings::PredefinedColorSpace>(value);
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/Canvas/SerializeBitmap.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2025-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Assertions.h>
#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <LibGfx/Bitmap.h>
#include <LibGfx/DecodedImageFrame.h>
#include <LibGfx/ImageFormats/JPEGWriter.h>
#include <LibGfx/ImageFormats/PNGWriter.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Canvas/SerializeBitmap.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

StringView serialized_bitmap_mime_type_to_byte_string(SerializedBitmapMimeType mime_type)
{
    switch (mime_type) {
    case SerializedBitmapMimeType::PNG:
        return "image/png"sv;
    case SerializedBitmapMimeType::JPEG:
        return "image/jpeg"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

Utf16View serialized_bitmap_mime_type_to_utf16_view(SerializedBitmapMimeType mime_type)
{
    switch (mime_type) {
    case SerializedBitmapMimeType::PNG:
        return u"image/png"sv;
    case SerializedBitmapMimeType::JPEG:
        return u"image/jpeg"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static bool type_is_jpeg(Utf16View type)
{
    return type.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(u"image/jpeg"sv);
}

bool serialization_of_the_bitmap_supports_color_profiles(Utf16View type)
{
    // NB: The color space of a canvas is described by coding-independent code points, which PNG can carry and JPEG
    //     cannot. Every type that is not JPEG is serialized as PNG.
    return !type_is_jpeg(type);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#a-serialisation-of-the-bitmap-as-a-file
ErrorOr<SerializeBitmapResult> serialize_bitmap(Gfx::DecodedImageFrame const& frame, Utf16View type, Optional<double> quality)
{
    auto bitmap = frame.bitmap_sharing_pixels();
    Optional<ReadonlyBytes> icc_data;
    Optional<Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints> cicp;
    frame.color_space().data().visit(
        [](Empty) { },
        [&](Gfx::ColorSpace::CICP const& color_space_cicp) {
            cicp = Media::CodingIndependentCodePoints { color_space_cicp.color_primaries, color_space_cicp.transfer_characteristics, Media::MatrixCoefficients::Identity, Media::VideoFullRangeFlag::Full };
        },
        [&](NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::ColorSpace::ICCProfile const> const& icc_profile) {
            icc_data = icc_profile->bytes();
        });

    // If type is an image format that supports variable quality (such as "image/jpeg"), quality is given, and type is not "image/png", then,
    // if quality is a Number in the range 0.0 to 1.0 inclusive, the user agent must treat quality as the desired quality level.
    // Otherwise, the user agent must use its default quality value, as if the quality argument had not been given.
    bool valid_quality = quality.has_value() and quality.value() >= 0.0 && quality.value() <= 1.0;

    // For image types that support color profiles, the serialized image must include a color profile indicating the
    // color space of the underlying bitmap. For image types that do not support color profiles, the serialized image
    // must be converted to the 'srgb' color space using 'relative-colorimetric' rendering intent.
    if (type_is_jpeg(type)) {
        VERIFY(!cicp.has_value());
        AllocatingMemoryStream file;
        Gfx::JPEGWriter::Options jpeg_options;
        jpeg_options.icc_data = icc_data;
        if (valid_quality)
            jpeg_options.quality = static_cast<int>(quality.value() * 100);
        TRY(Gfx::JPEGWriter::encode(file, *bitmap, jpeg_options));
        return SerializeBitmapResult { TRY(file.read_until_eof()), SerializedBitmapMimeType::JPEG };
    }

    // User agents must support PNG ("image/png"). User agents may support other types.
    // If the user agent does not support the requested type, then it must create the file using the PNG format. [PNG]
    return SerializeBitmapResult { TRY(Gfx::PNGWriter::encode(*bitmap, { .icc_data = icc_data, .cicp = cicp })), SerializedBitmapMimeType::PNG };
}

}

#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(CheckUnloadingCanceledState);

CheckUnloadingCanceledState::CheckUnloadingCanceledState(
    GC::Ref<Page> page,
    GC::Ptr<LocalTraversableNavigable> owner,
    GC::Ptr<LocalTraversableNavigable> traversable,
    Optional<UserNavigationInvolvement> user_involvement,
    UnloadPromptShown unload_prompt_shown,
    GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(Result, UnloadPromptShown)>> callback)
    : m_unload_prompt_shown(unload_prompt_shown)
    , m_page(page)
    , m_owner(owner)
    , m_traversable(traversable)
    , m_user_involvement(user_involvement)
    , m_callback(callback)
    , m_timeout(Platform::Timer::create_single_shot(heap(), AK::Duration::from_milliseconds(TIMEOUT_MS), GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(*this), [](auto& self) {
        if (!self.m_completed) {
            if (self.has_pending_before_unload_dialog()) {
                self.m_timeout->restart();
                return;
            }
            dbgln("FIXME: check_if_unloading_is_canceled timed out");
            self.finish(Result::Continue);
        }
    })))
{
    m_page->add_unloading_canceled_check({}, *this);
    m_timeout->start();
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::visit_edges(Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_page);
    visitor.visit(m_phase2_documents);
    visitor.visit(m_documents_already_fired);
    visitor.visit(m_traversable);
    visitor.visit(m_owner);
    visitor.visit(m_callback);
    visitor.visit(m_close_preflight_callback);
    visitor.visit(m_timeout);
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::adopt_for_close(GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(bool)>> callback)
{
    VERIFY(!m_close_preflight_callback);
    m_close_preflight_callback = callback;
    m_adopted_for_close = true;
    ++m_phase2_generation;
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::start(Vector<GC::Root<LocalNavigable>> const& navigables_that_need_before_unload, RefPtr<SessionHistoryEntry> target_entry)
{
    // 1. Let documentsToFireBeforeunload be the active document of each item in navigablesThatNeedBeforeUnload.
    for (auto& navigable : navigables_that_need_before_unload)
        m_phase2_documents.append(*navigable->active_document());

    // 2. Let unloadPromptShown be false.

    // 3. Let finalStatus be "continue".

    // 4. If traversable was given, then:
    if (m_traversable) {
        // 1. Assert: targetStep and userInvolvementForNavigateEvent were given.
        VERIFY(target_entry);
        VERIFY(m_user_involvement.has_value());

        // 2. Let targetEntry be the result of getting the target history entry given traversable and targetStep.
        m_target_entry = move(target_entry);

        // 3. If targetEntry is not traversable's current session history entry, and targetEntry's document state's origin is the same as
        //    traversable's current session history entry's document state's origin:
        if (m_target_entry != m_traversable->current_session_history_entry() && m_target_entry->document_state()->origin() == m_traversable->current_session_history_entry()->document_state()->origin()) {

            // 1. Let eventsFired be false.

            // 2. Let needsBeforeunload be true if navigablesThatNeedBeforeUnload contains traversable; otherwise false.
            m_needs_beforeunload = navigables_that_need_before_unload.find_if([this](auto const& navigable) {
                return navigable.ptr() == m_traversable.ptr();
            }) != navigables_that_need_before_unload.end();

            // 3. If needsBeforeunload is true, then remove traversable's active document from documentsToFireBeforeunload.
            if (m_needs_beforeunload) {
                m_phase2_documents.remove_first_matching([this](auto& document) {
                    return document.ptr() == m_traversable->active_document().ptr();
                });
            }

            start_phase1();
            return;
        }
    }

    start_phase2();
}

bool CheckUnloadingCanceledState::document_was_already_fired(DOM::Document const& document) const
{
    return m_documents_already_fired.find_if([&](auto const& fired_document) {
        return fired_document.ptr() == &document;
    }) != m_documents_already_fired.end();
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::fire_beforeunload(DOM::Document& document, bool unload_prompt_shown, bool& prompt_shown, bool& prompt_canceled)
{
    if (!document_was_already_fired(document))
        m_documents_already_fired.append(document);

    if (m_owner)
        m_owner->set_active_beforeunload_check(Badge<CheckUnloadingCanceledState> {}, this);
    auto [did_show_prompt, did_cancel] = document.steps_to_fire_beforeunload(unload_prompt_shown);
    prompt_shown = did_show_prompt;
    prompt_canceled = did_cancel;
    if (m_owner && m_owner->active_beforeunload_check(Badge<CheckUnloadingCanceledState> {}).ptr() == this)
        m_owner->set_active_beforeunload_check(Badge<CheckUnloadingCanceledState> {}, nullptr);
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::continue_as_close_after_adoption(bool prompt_shown, bool prompt_canceled)
{
    if (prompt_shown)
        m_unload_prompt_shown = UnloadPromptShown::Yes;
    if (prompt_canceled) {
        finish(Result::CanceledByBeforeUnload);
        return;
    }

    m_running_adopted_close = true;
    m_phase2_documents.clear();
    m_remaining_phase2_tasks = 0;
    if (m_owner) {
        if (auto active_document = m_owner->active_document()) {
            for (auto& navigable : active_document->inclusive_descendant_navigables()) {
                auto* local_navigable = as_if<LocalNavigable>(navigable.ptr());
                auto document = local_navigable ? local_navigable->active_document() : GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> {};
                if (document && !document_was_already_fired(*document))
                    m_phase2_documents.append(*document);
            }
        }
    }
    start_phase2();
}

bool CheckUnloadingCanceledState::has_pending_before_unload_dialog() const
{
    if (m_traversable) {
        if (auto active_document = m_traversable->active_document(); active_document && active_document->page().pending_dialog() == Page::PendingDialog::BeforeUnload)
            return true;
    }

    return m_phase2_documents.find_if([](auto const& document) {
        return document->page().pending_dialog() == Page::PendingDialog::BeforeUnload;
    }) != m_phase2_documents.end();
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::start_phase1()
{
    // 4. Queue a global task on the navigation and traversal task source given traversable's active window to perform the following steps:
    VERIFY(m_traversable->active_window());
    queue_global_task(Task::Source::NavigationAndTraversal, relevant_global_object(*m_traversable->active_window()), GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*this), [](auto& self) {
        // 1. if needsBeforeunload is true, then:
        if (self.m_needs_beforeunload) {
            // 1. Let (unloadPromptShownForThisDocument, unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument) be the result of running the steps to fire beforeunload given traversable's active document and false.
            bool unload_prompt_shown_for_this_document;
            bool unload_prompt_canceled_by_this_document;
            self.fire_beforeunload(*self.m_traversable->active_document(), false, unload_prompt_shown_for_this_document, unload_prompt_canceled_by_this_document);
            if (self.m_adopted_for_close && !self.m_running_adopted_close) {
                self.continue_as_close_after_adoption(unload_prompt_shown_for_this_document, unload_prompt_canceled_by_this_document);
                return;
            }

            // 2. If unloadPromptShownForThisDocument is true, then set unloadPromptShown to true.
            if (unload_prompt_shown_for_this_document)
                self.m_unload_prompt_shown = UnloadPromptShown::Yes;

            // 3. If unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument is true, then set finalStatus to "canceled-by-beforeunload".
            if (unload_prompt_canceled_by_this_document)
                self.m_final_status = Result::CanceledByBeforeUnload;
        }

        // 2. If finalStatus is "canceled-by-beforeunload", then abort these steps.
        if (self.m_final_status == Result::CanceledByBeforeUnload) {
            self.finish(self.m_final_status);
            return;
        }

        // 3. Let navigation be traversable's active window's navigation API.
        VERIFY(self.m_traversable->active_window());
        auto navigation = self.m_traversable->active_window()->navigation();

        // 4. Let navigateEventResult be the result of firing a traverse navigate event at navigation given targetEntry and userInvolvementForNavigateEvent.
        VERIFY(self.m_target_entry);
        auto navigate_event_result = navigation->fire_a_traverse_navigate_event(*self.m_target_entry, *self.m_user_involvement);

        // 5. If navigateEventResult is false, then set finalStatus to "canceled-by-navigate".
        if (!navigate_event_result)
            self.m_final_status = Result::CanceledByNavigate;

        // 6. Set eventsFired to true.

        self.phase1_completed();
    }));
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::phase1_completed()
{
    // 5. Wait for eventsFired to be true.

    // 6. If finalStatus is not "continue", then return finalStatus.
    if (m_final_status != Result::Continue) {
        finish(m_final_status);
        return;
    }
    start_phase2();
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::start_phase2()
{
    if (m_phase2_documents.is_empty()) {
        finish(m_final_status);
        return;
    }

    // 5. Let totalTasks be the size of documentsToFireBeforeunload.

    // 6. Let completedTasks be 0.
    m_remaining_phase2_tasks = m_phase2_documents.size();

    // 7. For each document of documentsToFireBeforeunload, queue a global task on the navigation and traversal task source given document's relevant global object to run the steps:
    auto generation = m_phase2_generation;
    for (auto& document : m_phase2_documents) {
        // AD-HOC: Queue with a null document instead of using queue_global_task. Tasks associated with a document
        //         are only runnable when fully active. In the async state machine, documents can become non
        //         fully-active between queue and execution time, causing the task to be permanently stuck.
        //         A null-document task is always runnable; we check validity inside.
        queue_a_task(Task::Source::NavigationAndTraversal, nullptr, nullptr, GC::create_function(heap(), GC::captures(*this, document, generation), [](auto& self, auto& document, auto& generation) {
            if (generation != self.m_phase2_generation)
                return;
            if (document->has_been_destroyed() || !document->is_fully_active()) {
                self.did_complete_phase2_task();
                return;
            }

            // 1. Let (unloadPromptShownForThisDocument, unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument) be the result of running the steps to fire beforeunload given document and unloadPromptShown.
            bool unload_prompt_shown_for_this_document;
            bool unload_prompt_canceled_by_this_document;
            self.fire_beforeunload(*document, self.m_unload_prompt_shown == UnloadPromptShown::Yes, unload_prompt_shown_for_this_document, unload_prompt_canceled_by_this_document);
            if (self.m_adopted_for_close && !self.m_running_adopted_close) {
                self.continue_as_close_after_adoption(unload_prompt_shown_for_this_document, unload_prompt_canceled_by_this_document);
                return;
            }
            if (generation != self.m_phase2_generation)
                return;

            // 2. If unloadPromptShownForThisDocument is true, then set unloadPromptShown to true.
            if (unload_prompt_shown_for_this_document)
                self.m_unload_prompt_shown = UnloadPromptShown::Yes;

            // 3. If unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument is true, then set finalStatus to "canceled-by-beforeunload".
            if (unload_prompt_canceled_by_this_document)
                self.m_final_status = Result::CanceledByBeforeUnload;

            // 4. Increment completedTasks.
            self.did_complete_phase2_task();
        }));
    }
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::did_complete_phase2_task()
{
    VERIFY(m_remaining_phase2_tasks > 0);
    if (--m_remaining_phase2_tasks > 0)
        return;

    // 8. Wait for completedTasks to be totalTasks.

    // 9. Return finalStatus.
    finish(m_final_status);
}

void CheckUnloadingCanceledState::finish(Result final_result)
{
    if (m_completed)
        return;
    m_completed = true;
    m_timeout->stop();
    m_page->remove_unloading_canceled_check({}, *this);
    if (m_adopted_for_close) {
        m_callback->function()(final_result == Result::CanceledByBeforeUnload ? Result::CanceledByBeforeUnload : Result::CanceledByNavigate, m_unload_prompt_shown);
        VERIFY(m_close_preflight_callback);
        m_close_preflight_callback->function()(final_result == Result::Continue);
        return;
    }
    m_callback->function()(final_result, m_unload_prompt_shown);
}

}

namespace Web::HTML {

class CheckUnloadingCanceledState : public GC::Cell {
    GC_CELL(CheckUnloadingCanceledState, GC::Cell);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(CheckUnloadingCanceledState);

public:
    using Result = CheckIfUnloadingIsCanceledResult;
    static constexpr int TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;

    CheckUnloadingCanceledState(
        GC::Ref<Page>,
        GC::Ptr<LocalTraversableNavigable> owner,
        GC::Ptr<LocalTraversableNavigable> traversable,
        Optional<UserNavigationInvolvement> user_involvement,
        UnloadPromptShown unload_prompt_shown,
        GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(Result, UnloadPromptShown)>> callback);

    virtual void visit_edges(Visitor&) override;

    void adopt_for_close(GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(bool)>> callback);
    void start(Vector<GC::Root<LocalNavigable>> const& navigables_that_need_before_unload, RefPtr<SessionHistoryEntry> target_entry);

private:
    bool document_was_already_fired(DOM::Document const&) const;
    void fire_beforeunload(DOM::Document&, bool unload_prompt_shown, bool& prompt_shown, bool& prompt_canceled);
    void continue_as_close_after_adoption(bool prompt_shown, bool prompt_canceled);
    bool has_pending_before_unload_dialog() const;
    void start_phase1();
    void phase1_completed();
    void start_phase2();
    void did_complete_phase2_task();
    void finish(Result);

    Result m_final_status { Result::Continue };
    UnloadPromptShown m_unload_prompt_shown { UnloadPromptShown::No };
    bool m_completed { false };
    GC::Ref<Page> m_page;
    GC::Ptr<LocalTraversableNavigable> m_owner;
    bool m_needs_beforeunload { false };
    size_t m_remaining_phase2_tasks { 0 };
    Vector<GC::Ref<DOM::Document>> m_phase2_documents;
    Vector<GC::Ref<DOM::Document>> m_documents_already_fired;
    GC::Ptr<LocalTraversableNavigable> m_traversable;
    RefPtr<SessionHistoryEntry> m_target_entry;
    Optional<UserNavigationInvolvement> m_user_involvement;
    GC::Ref<GC::Function<void(Result, UnloadPromptShown)>> m_callback;
    GC::Ptr<GC::Function<void(bool)>> m_close_preflight_callback;
    GC::Ref<Platform::Timer> m_timeout;
    u64 m_phase2_generation { 0 };
    bool m_adopted_for_close { false };
    bool m_running_adopted_close { false };
};

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(CloseWatcher);

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#establish-a-close-watcher
GC::Ref<CloseWatcher> CloseWatcher::establish(HTML::Window& window, GetEnabledState get_enabled_state)
{
    // 1. Assert: window's associated Document is fully active.
    VERIFY(window.associated_document().is_fully_active());

    // 2. Let closeWatcher be a new close watcher, with
    //    window: window
    //    cancel action: cancelAction
    //    close action: closeAction
    //    is running cancel action: false
    //    get enabled state: getEnabledState
    auto close_watcher = GC::Heap::the().allocate<CloseWatcher>(window, move(get_enabled_state));
    // FIXME: cancelAction and closeAction are both set by the caller currently.

    // 3. Let manager be window's associated close watcher manager
    auto manager = window.close_watcher_manager();

    // 4 - 6. Moved to CloseWatcherManager::add
    manager->add(close_watcher);

    // 7. Return close_watcher.
    return close_watcher;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#dom-closewatcher
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<CloseWatcher>> CloseWatcher::create(Window& window, Bindings::CloseWatcherOptions const& options)
{
    // NOTE: Not in spec explicitly, but this should account for detached iframes too. See /close-watcher/frame-removal.html WPT.
    auto navigable = window.navigable();
    if (navigable && navigable->has_been_destroyed())
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("The iframe has been detached"_utf16);

    // 1. If this's relevant global object's associated Document is not fully active, then return an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.
    if (!window.associated_document().is_fully_active())
        return WebIDL::InvalidStateError::create("The document is not fully active."_utf16);

    // 2. Let closeWatcher be the result of establishing a close watcher given this's relevant global object, with:
    //    - cancelAction given canPreventClose being to return the result of firing an event named cancel at this, with the cancelable attribute initialized to canPreventClose.
    //    - closeAction being to fire an event named close at this.
    //    - getEnabledState being to return true.
    auto close_watcher = establish(window, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), [] { return true; }));

    // 3. If options["signal"] exists, then:
    if (auto signal = options.signal) {
        // 3.1 If options["signal"]'s aborted, then destroy closeWatcher.
        if (signal->aborted()) {
            close_watcher->destroy();
        }

        // 3.2 Add the following steps to options["signal"]:
        (void)signal->add_abort_algorithm(GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(close_watcher), [](auto& close_watcher) {
            // 3.2.1 Destroy closeWatcher.
            close_watcher->destroy();
        }));
    }

    return close_watcher;
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<CloseWatcher>> CloseWatcher::create_for_constructor(JS::Object& relevant_global_object, Bindings::CloseWatcherOptions const& options)
{
    return create(relevant_window(relevant_global_object), options);
}

CloseWatcher::CloseWatcher(Window& window, GetEnabledState get_enabled_state)
    : DOM::EventTarget()
    , m_get_enabled_state(move(get_enabled_state))
    , m_window(window)
{
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#dom-closewatcher-requestclose
void CloseWatcher::request_close_for_bindings()
{
    // The requestClose() method steps are to request to close this's internal close watcher with false.
    request_close(false);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#close-watcher-request-close
bool CloseWatcher::request_close(bool require_history_action_activation)
{
    // 1. If closeWatcher is not active, then return true.
    if (!m_is_active)
        return true;

    // 2. If the result of running closeWatcher's get enabled state is false, then return true.
    if (!get_enabled_state())
        return true;

    // 3. If closeWatcher's is running cancel action is true, then return true.
    if (m_is_running_cancel_action)
        return true;

    // 4. Let window be closeWatcher's window.
    auto& window = *m_window;

    // 5. If window's associated Document is not fully active, then return true.
    if (!window.associated_document().is_fully_active())
        return true;

    // 6. Let canPreventClose be true if requireHistoryActionActivation is false, or if window's close watcher manager's groups's size is less than window's close watcher manager's allowed number of groups,
    // and window has history-action activation; otherwise false.
    auto manager = window.close_watcher_manager();
    bool can_prevent_close = !require_history_action_activation || (manager->can_prevent_close() && window.has_history_action_activation());
    // 7. Set closeWatcher's is running cancel action to true.
    m_is_running_cancel_action = true;
    // 8. Let shouldContinue be the result of running closeWatcher's cancel action given canPreventClose.
    bool should_continue = dispatch_event(DOM::Event::create(HTML::EventNames::cancel, { .cancelable = can_prevent_close },
        HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(HTML::relevant_global_object(window))));
    // 9. Set closeWatcher's is running cancel action to false.
    m_is_running_cancel_action = false;
    // 10. If shouldContinue is false, then:
    if (!should_continue) {
        // 10.1 Assert: canPreventClose is true.
        VERIFY(can_prevent_close);
        // 10.2 Consume history-action user activation given window.
        window.consume_history_action_user_activation();
        // 10.3 Return false.
        return false;
    }

    // 11. Close closeWatcher.
    close();

    // 12. Return true.
    return true;
}

bool CloseWatcher::get_enabled_state() const
{
    return m_get_enabled_state->function().operator()();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#close-watcher-close
void CloseWatcher::close()
{
    // 1. If closeWatcher is not active, then return.
    if (!m_is_active)
        return;

    // 2. If the result of running closeWatcher's get enabled state is false, then return.
    if (!get_enabled_state())
        return;

    // 3. If closeWatcher's window's associated Document is not fully active, then return.
    if (!m_window->associated_document().is_fully_active())
        return;

    // 4. Destroy closeWatcher.
    destroy();

    // 5. Run closeWatcher's close action.
    dispatch_event(DOM::Event::create(HTML::EventNames::close,
        HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(HTML::relevant_global_object(*m_window))));
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#close-watcher-destroy
void CloseWatcher::destroy()
{
    // 1. Let manager be closeWatcher's window's close watcher manager.
    auto manager = m_window->close_watcher_manager();

    // 2-3. Moved to CloseWatcherManager::remove
    manager->remove(*this);

    m_is_active = false;
}

void CloseWatcher::set_oncancel(WebIDL::CallbackType* event_handler)
{
    set_event_handler_attribute(HTML::EventNames::cancel, event_handler);
}

    visitor.visit(m_get_enabled_state);
    visitor.visit(m_window);

/*
