// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-input-element:dom-input-value-2
HTMLInputElement::ValueAttributeMode HTMLInputElement::value_attribute_mode_for_type_state(TypeAttributeState type_state)
{
    switch (type_state) {
    case TypeAttributeState::Text:
    case TypeAttributeState::Search:
    case TypeAttributeState::Telephone:
    case TypeAttributeState::URL:
    case TypeAttributeState::Email:
    case TypeAttributeState::Password:
    case TypeAttributeState::Date:
    case TypeAttributeState::Month:
    case TypeAttributeState::Week:
    case TypeAttributeState::Time:
    case TypeAttributeState::LocalDateAndTime:
    case TypeAttributeState::Number:
    case TypeAttributeState::Range:
    case TypeAttributeState::Color:
        return ValueAttributeMode::Value;

    case TypeAttributeState::Hidden:
    case TypeAttributeState::SubmitButton:
    case TypeAttributeState::ImageButton:
    case TypeAttributeState::ResetButton:
    case TypeAttributeState::Button:
        return ValueAttributeMode::Default;

    case TypeAttributeState::Checkbox:
    case TypeAttributeState::RadioButton:
        return ValueAttributeMode::DefaultOn;

    case TypeAttributeState::FileUpload:
        return ValueAttributeMode::Filename;
    }

    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

HTMLInputElement::ValueAttributeMode HTMLInputElement::value_attribute_mode() const
{
    return value_attribute_mode_for_type_state(type_state());
}

bool HTMLInputElement::is_focusable() const
{
    return m_type != TypeAttributeState::Hidden
        && enabled()
        && meets_focusable_area_rendering_requirements();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#has-a-reversed-range
bool HTMLInputElement::has_reversed_range() const
{
    auto minimum = min();
    if (!minimum.has_value())
        return false;
    auto maximum = max();
    if (!maximum.has_value())
        return false;
    // An element has a reversed range if it has a periodic domain and its maximum is less than its minimum.
    return has_periodic_domain() && maximum.value() < minimum.value();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#suffering-from-being-missing
bool HTMLInputElement::suffering_from_being_missing() const
{
    bool has_checkedness_false_for_all_elements_in_group = true;
    bool has_required_element_in_group = false;
    switch (type_state()) {
    case TypeAttributeState::Checkbox:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#checkbox-state-(type%3Dcheckbox)%3Asuffering-from-being-missing
        // If the element is required and its checkedness is false, then the element is suffering from being missing.
        if (has_attribute(HTML::AttributeNames::required) && !checked())
            return true;
        break;
    case TypeAttributeState::RadioButton:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#radio-button-state-(type%3Dradio)%3Asuffering-from-being-missing
        // If an element in the radio button group is required, and all of the input elements in the radio button group
        // have a checkedness that is false, then the element is suffering from being missing.
        if (m_radio_button_group_registry)
            return m_radio_button_group_registry->group_is_suffering_from_being_missing(m_radio_button_group_name);
        root().for_each_in_inclusive_subtree_of_type<HTML::HTMLInputElement>([&](auto& element) {
            if (is_in_same_radio_button_group_as(element)) {
                if (element.checked())
                    has_checkedness_false_for_all_elements_in_group = false;
                if (element.has_attribute(HTML::AttributeNames::required))
                    has_required_element_in_group = true;
            }
            return TraversalDecision::Continue;
        });
        if (has_checkedness_false_for_all_elements_in_group && has_required_element_in_group)
            return true;
        break;
    case TypeAttributeState::FileUpload:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#file-upload-state-(type%3Dfile)%3Asuffering-from-being-missing
        // If the element is required and the list of selected files is empty, then the element is suffering from being missing.
        if (has_attribute(HTML::AttributeNames::required) && const_cast<HTMLInputElement&>(*this).files()->length() == 0)
            return true;
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-required-attribute%3Asuffering-from-being-missing
    // If the element is required, and its value IDL attribute applies and is in the mode value, and the element is mutable, and the element's value is the empty
    // string, then the element is suffering from being missing.
    if (has_attribute(HTML::AttributeNames::required) && value_attribute_mode() == ValueAttributeMode::Value && is_mutable() && m_value.is_empty())
        return true;

    return false;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#valid-e-mail-address
static regex::ECMAScriptRegex& valid_email_address_regex()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<regex::ECMAScriptRegex> regex { MUST(regex::ECMAScriptRegex::compile(
        "^[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+\\/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*$"_utf16,
        regex::ECMAScriptCompileFlags {})) };
    return *regex;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#suffering-from-a-type-mismatch
bool HTMLInputElement::suffering_from_a_type_mismatch() const
{
    auto input = value();
    switch (type_state()) {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#url-state-(type%3Durl)%3Asuffering-from-a-type-mismatch
    case TypeAttributeState::URL:
        // While the value of the element is neither the empty string nor a valid absolute URL, the element is suffering from a type mismatch.
        // AD-HOC: https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11083 and https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/51011
        //         We intentionally don't check if the value is a "valid absolute URL", because that's not what other
        //         engines actually do. So we instead just implement what matches the behavior in existing engines.
        return !input.is_empty() && !DOMURL::parse(input.utf16_view()).has_value();

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#email-state-(type%3Demail)%3Asuffering-from-a-type-mismatch
    case TypeAttributeState::Email: {
        // When the multiple attribute is not specified on the element: While the value of the element is neither the
        // empty string nor a single valid email address, the element is suffering from a type mismatch.
        if (!has_attribute(HTML::AttributeNames::multiple))
            return !input.is_empty() && valid_email_address_regex().exec(input.utf16_view(), 0) != regex::MatchResult::Match;

        // When the multiple attribute is specified on the element: While the value of the element is not a valid email
        // address list, the element is suffering from a type mismatch.
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#valid-e-mail-address-list
        // A valid email address list is a set of comma-separated tokens, where each token is itself a valid email
        // address. To obtain the list of tokens from a valid email address list, an implementation must split the
        // string on commas.
        bool valid = true;

        input.for_each_split_view(',', SplitBehavior::Nothing, [&](auto const& address) {
            if (valid_email_address_regex().exec(address, 0) == regex::MatchResult::Match)
                return IterationDecision::Continue;

            valid = false;
            return IterationDecision::Break;
        });

        return !valid;
    }

    default:
        break;
    }

    return false;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-pattern-attribute%3Asuffering-from-a-pattern-mismatch
bool HTMLInputElement::suffering_from_a_pattern_mismatch() const
{
    // If the element's value is not the empty string, and either the element's multiple attribute is not specified or
    // it does not apply to the input element given its type attribute's current state, and the element has a compiled
    // pattern regular expression but that regular expression does not match the element's value, then the element is
    // suffering from a pattern mismatch.

    // If the element's value is not the empty string, and the element's multiple attribute is specified and applies to
    // the input element, and the element has a compiled pattern regular expression but that regular expression does not
    // match each of the element's values, then the element is suffering from a pattern mismatch.

    if (!pattern_applies())
        return false;

    auto value = this->value();
    if (value.is_empty())
        return false;

    auto regexp_object = compiled_pattern_regular_expression();
    if (!regexp_object.has_value())
        return false;

    if (has_attribute(HTML::AttributeNames::multiple) && multiple_applies()) {
        VERIFY(type_state() == HTMLInputElement::TypeAttributeState::Email);
        bool valid = true;

        value.for_each_split_view(',', SplitBehavior::Nothing, [&](auto const& value) {
            if (regexp_object->exec(value, 0) == regex::MatchResult::Match)
                return IterationDecision::Continue;

            valid = false;
            return IterationDecision::Break;
        });

        return !valid;
    }

    return regexp_object->exec(value.utf16_view(), 0) != regex::MatchResult::Match;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#suffering-from-an-underflow
bool HTMLInputElement::suffering_from_an_underflow() const
{
    // and the result of applying the algorithm to convert a string to a number to the string given by the element's
    // value is a number
    auto result = convert_string_to_number(value());
    if (!result.has_value())
        return false;
    auto number = result.value();
    return is_number_underflowing(number);
}

bool HTMLInputElement::is_number_underflowing(double number) const
{
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-min-and-max-attributes%3Asuffering-from-an-underflow-2
    // When the element has a minimum and does not have a reversed range,
    auto minimum = min();
    if (minimum.has_value() && !has_reversed_range()) {
        // and the number obtained from that algorithm is less than the minimum, the element is suffering from an underflow.
        return number < minimum.value();
    }

    if (!minimum.has_value())
        return false;
    auto maximum = max();
    if (!maximum.has_value())
        return false;
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-min-and-max-attributes%3Asuffering-from-an-underflow-3
    // When an element has a reversed range, and the number obtained from that algorithm is more than the maximum and
    // less than the minimum, the element is simultaneously suffering from an underflow and suffering from an overflow.
    return has_reversed_range() && number > maximum.value() && number < minimum.value();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#suffering-from-an-overflow
bool HTMLInputElement::suffering_from_an_overflow() const
{
    // and the result of applying the algorithm to convert a string to a number to the string given by the element's
    // value is a number
    auto result = convert_string_to_number(value());
    if (!result.has_value())
        return false;
    auto number = result.value();
    return is_number_overflowing(number);
}

bool HTMLInputElement::is_number_overflowing(double number) const
{
    auto maximum = max();
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-min-and-max-attributes%3Asuffering-from-an-overflow-2
    // When the element has a maximum and does not have a reversed range,
    if (maximum.has_value() && !has_reversed_range()) {
        // and the number obtained from that algorithm is more than the maximum, the element is suffering from an overflow.
        return number > maximum.value();
    }

    if (!maximum.has_value())
        return false;
    auto minimum = min();
    if (!minimum.has_value())
        return false;
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-min-and-max-attributes%3Asuffering-from-an-underflow-3
    // When an element has a reversed range, and the number obtained from that algorithm is more than the maximum and
    // less than the minimum, the element is simultaneously suffering from an underflow and suffering from an overflow.
    return has_reversed_range() && number > maximum.value() && number < minimum.value();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-step-attribute%3Asuffering-from-a-step-mismatch
bool HTMLInputElement::suffering_from_a_step_mismatch() const
{
    // and the result of applying the algorithm to convert a string to a number to the string given by the element's
    // value is a number,
    auto maybe_number = convert_string_to_number(value());
    if (!maybe_number.has_value())
        return false;
    double number = maybe_number.value();
    return is_number_mismatching_step(number);
}

bool HTMLInputElement::is_number_mismatching_step(double number) const
{
    // When the element has an allowed value step,
    auto maybe_allowed_value_step = allowed_value_step();
    if (!maybe_allowed_value_step.has_value())
        return false;
    double allowed_value_step = *maybe_allowed_value_step;
    // and that number subtracted from the step base is not an integral multiple of the allowed value step, the element
    // is suffering from a step mismatch.
    return !is_integral_multiple(step_base() - number, allowed_value_step);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#suffering-from-bad-input
bool HTMLInputElement::suffering_from_bad_input() const
{
    auto relevant_value = this->relevant_value();

    switch (type_state()) {
    case TypeAttributeState::Email:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#email-state-(type%3Demail)%3Asuffering-from-bad-input
        // While the user interface is representing input that the user agent cannot convert to punycode, the control is suffering from bad input.
        // FIXME: Implement this once email addresses are converted to punycode.

        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#email-state-(type%3Demail)%3Asuffering-from-bad-input-2
        // While the user interface describes a situation where an individual value contains a U+002C COMMA (,) or is representing input that the user agent
        // cannot convert to punycode, the control is suffering from bad input.
        // FIXME: Implement this once email addresses are converted to punycode.
        break;
    case TypeAttributeState::Date:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#date-state-(type%3Ddate)%3Asuffering-from-bad-input
        // While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a valid date string, the control is suffering from bad input.
        if (!m_date_time_fields.is_empty())
            return date_time_fields_describe_bad_input();
        return !relevant_value.is_empty() && !is_valid_date_string(relevant_value);
    case TypeAttributeState::Month:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#month-state-(type%3Dmonth)%3Asuffering-from-bad-input
        // While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a valid month string, the control is suffering from bad input.
        if (!m_date_time_fields.is_empty())
            return date_time_fields_describe_bad_input();
        return !relevant_value.is_empty() && !is_valid_month_string(relevant_value);
    case TypeAttributeState::Week:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#week-state-(type%3Dweek)%3Asuffering-from-bad-input
        // While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a valid week string, the control is suffering from bad input.
        if (!m_date_time_fields.is_empty())
            return date_time_fields_describe_bad_input();
        return !relevant_value.is_empty() && !is_valid_week_string(relevant_value);
    case TypeAttributeState::Time:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/#time-state-(type=time):suffering-from-bad-input
        // While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a valid time string, the control is suffering from bad input.
        if (!m_date_time_fields.is_empty())
            return date_time_fields_describe_bad_input();
        return !relevant_value.is_empty() && !is_valid_time_string(relevant_value);
    case TypeAttributeState::LocalDateAndTime:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#local-date-and-time-state-(type%3Ddatetime-local)%3Asuffering-from-bad-input
        // While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a valid normalized local date and time string, the control is suffering from bad input.
        if (!m_date_time_fields.is_empty())
            return date_time_fields_describe_bad_input();
        return !relevant_value.is_empty() && !is_valid_local_date_and_time_string(relevant_value);
    case TypeAttributeState::Number:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#number-state-(type%3Dnumber)%3Asuffering-from-bad-input
        // While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a valid floating-point number, the control is suffering from bad input.
        return !relevant_value.is_empty() && !is_valid_floating_point_number(relevant_value);
    case TypeAttributeState::Range:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#range-state-(type%3Drange)%3Asuffering-from-bad-input
        // While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a valid floating-point number, the control is suffering from bad input.
        return !relevant_value.is_empty() && !is_valid_floating_point_number(relevant_value);
    case TypeAttributeState::Color:
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#color-state-(type%3Dcolor)%3Asuffering-from-bad-input
        // While the element's value is not the empty string and parsing it returns failure, the control is suffering from bad input.
        return !relevant_value.is_empty() && !parse_a_css_color_value(relevant_value);
    default:
        break;
    }
    return false;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#input-support-picker
bool HTMLInputElement::supports_a_picker() const
{
    // The input element can support a picker. A picker is a user interface element that allows the end user to choose a value.
    // Whether an input element supports a picker depends on the type attribute state and implementation-defined behavior.
    // An input element must support a picker when its type attribute is in the File Upload state.
    return first_is_one_of(type_state(), TypeAttributeState::FileUpload, TypeAttributeState::Color) || has_date_picker();
}

bool HTMLInputElement::has_date_picker() const
{
    return first_is_one_of(type_state(), TypeAttributeState::Date, TypeAttributeState::Time, TypeAttributeState::LocalDateAndTime, TypeAttributeState::Month, TypeAttributeState::Week);
}

void HTMLInputElement::did_pick_date(Optional<Utf16String> picked_value)
{
    set_is_open(false);
    if (!has_date_picker() || !picked_value.has_value() || !is_mutable())
        return;
    commit_date_time_value(value_sanitization_algorithm(*picked_value));
}

void HTMLInputElement::commit_date_time_value(Utf16String new_value)
{
    if (new_value == m_value)
        return;

    // then when the user changes the element's value
    m_dirty_value = true;
    m_value = move(new_value);
    relevant_value_was_changed();
    update_shadow_tree();

    // the user agent must queue an element task on the user interaction task source
    user_interaction_did_change_input_value();

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#common-input-element-events
    // [...] any time the user commits the change, [...] set its user validity to true
    m_user_validity = true;
    CSS::Invalidation::invalidate_style_after_validity_change(*this);

    // and fire an event named change at the input element, with the bubbles attribute initialized to true.
    auto change_event = create_event_for_element(*this, HTML::EventNames::change);
    change_event->set_bubbles(true);
    dispatch_event(*change_event);
}

void HTMLInputElement::set_is_open(bool is_open)
{
    if (is_open == m_is_open)
        return;

    m_is_open = is_open;
    CSS::Invalidation::invalidate_style_after_input_open_state_change(*this, is_open);
}

bool HTMLInputElement::is_mutable() const
{
    return
        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-input-element:concept-fe-mutable-3
        // A select element that is not disabled is mutable.
        enabled()

        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-readonly-attribute:concept-fe-mutable
        // The readonly attribute is a boolean attribute that controls whether or not the user can edit the form control. When specified, the element is not mutable.
        && !(has_attribute(AttributeNames::readonly) && is_allowed_to_be_readonly());
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#button-layout
bool HTMLInputElement::uses_button_layout() const
{
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-input-element-as-a-button:button-layout-2
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Submit Button, Reset Button, or Button state, when it generates a
    // CSS box, is expected to depict a button and use button layout [..]

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-input-element-as-a-colour-well:button-layout-2
    // The element, when it generates a CSS box, is expected to use button layout, that has no child boxes of the
    // anonymous button content box.

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-input-element-as-a-file-upload-control:button-layout-2
    // The button is expected to use button layout and match the '::file-selector-button' pseudo-element.

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#image-button-state-(type=image):concept-button
    // The element is a button, specifically a submit button.
    // NOTE: Although type=image is specified to be a submit button, that does not mean that the type attribute is
    //       Submit Button, so we don't include ::ImageButton below.

    return first_is_one_of(type_state(), TypeAttributeState::SubmitButton, TypeAttributeState::ResetButton,
        TypeAttributeState::Button, TypeAttributeState::Color, TypeAttributeState::FileUpload);
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-ui/#devolvable
bool HTMLInputElement::is_devolvable_widget() const
{
    switch (type_state()) {
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-input-element-as-a-text-entry-widget
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Text, Telephone, URL, or Email state, is a devolvable widget.
    case TypeAttributeState::Text:
    case TypeAttributeState::Telephone:
    case TypeAttributeState::URL:
    case TypeAttributeState::Email:
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Search state is a devolvable widget.
    case TypeAttributeState::Search:
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Password state is a devolvable widget.
    case TypeAttributeState::Password:
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-input-element-as-domain-specific-widgets
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Date state is a devolvable widget [...]
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Month state is a devolvable widget [...]
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Week state is a devolvable widget [...]
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Time state is a devolvable widget [...]
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Local Date and Time state is a devolvable widget [...]
    // An input element whose type attribute is in the Number state is a devolvable widget [...]
    case TypeAttributeState::Date:
    case TypeAttributeState::Month:
    case TypeAttributeState::Week:
    case TypeAttributeState::Time:
    case TypeAttributeState::LocalDateAndTime:
    case TypeAttributeState::Number:
        return true;
    default:
        return HTMLElement::is_devolvable_widget();
    }
}

Optional<Utf16String> HTMLInputElement::selected_text_for_stringifier() const
{
    // https://w3c.github.io/selection-api/#dom-selection-stringifier
    // Used for clipboard copy and window.getSelection().toString() when this element is active.
    if (!has_selectable_text())
        return {};

    size_t start = this->selection_start();
    size_t end = this->selection_end();
    if (start >= end)
        return {};

    switch (type_state()) {
    case TypeAttributeState::Text:
    case TypeAttributeState::Search:
    case TypeAttributeState::Telephone:
    case TypeAttributeState::URL:
    case TypeAttributeState::Email:
        return Utf16String::from_utf16(relevant_value().substring_view(start, end - start));

    case TypeAttributeState::Password:
        return Utf16String::repeated(0x2022, end - start); // 0x2022 is BULLET character
    default:
        return {};
    }
}

}

#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/NativeFunction.h>
#include <LibUnicode/DateTimeFormat.h>
#include <LibUnicode/Locale.h>
#include <LibWeb/CSS/Invalidation/FormControlInvalidator.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/ElementFactory.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/IDLEventListener.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Text.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/HTMLInputElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/Environments.h>
#include <LibWeb/Namespace.h>
#include <LibWeb/UIEvents/EventNames.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

// NB: Date and time inputs show their value as a row of fields, one for each component of the value, in the order
//     and with the separators the user's locale uses. Each field is edited on its own with the keyboard, and the
//     value only becomes non-empty once every field holds a number.

using FieldKind = HTMLInputElement::DateTimeField::Kind;

static constexpr i32 maximum_year = 275760;

// NB: A moment whose components all differ from each other, which tells the formatter's parts apart.
static constexpr double sample_epoch_milliseconds = 1793454965000.0; // 2026-10-31T13:56:05Z

static i32 current_year()
{
    auto days = UnixDateTime::now().seconds_since_epoch() / 86400;
    i32 year = 1970;
    while (days >= static_cast<i64>(days_in_year(year))) {
        days -= days_in_year(year);
        ++year;
    }
    return year;
}

static Optional<FieldKind> field_kind_for_part_type(Utf16View type)
{
    if (type == u"year"sv)
        return FieldKind::Year;
    if (type == u"month"sv)
        return FieldKind::Month;
    if (type == u"day"sv)
        return FieldKind::Day;
    if (type == u"hour"sv)
        return FieldKind::Hour;
    if (type == u"minute"sv)
        return FieldKind::Minute;
    if (type == u"second"sv)
        return FieldKind::Second;
    if (type == u"dayPeriod"sv)
        return FieldKind::DayPeriod;
    return {};
}

static Utf16View field_placeholder(FieldKind kind)
{
    switch (kind) {
    case FieldKind::Year:
        return u"yyyy"sv;
    case FieldKind::Month:
        return u"mm"sv;
    case FieldKind::Day:
        return u"dd"sv;
    case FieldKind::Week:
    case FieldKind::Hour:
    case FieldKind::Minute:
    case FieldKind::Second:
    case FieldKind::DayPeriod:
        return u"--"sv;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

bool HTMLInputElement::date_time_fields_use_12_hour_clock() const
{
    return any_of(m_date_time_fields, [](auto const& field) { return field.kind == FieldKind::DayPeriod; });
}

// NB: Fields the user filled in that do not make a value, because some are still empty or they name a day that does
//     not exist, describe input that cannot be converted to a valid string.
bool HTMLInputElement::date_time_fields_describe_bad_input() const
{
    return m_value.is_empty() && any_of(m_date_time_fields, [](auto const& field) { return field.value.has_value(); });
}

Optional<HTMLInputElement::DateTimeField const&> HTMLInputElement::date_time_field(DateTimeField::Kind kind) const
{
    for (auto const& field : m_date_time_fields) {
        if (field.kind == kind)
            return field;
    }
    return {};
}

Optional<i32> HTMLInputElement::date_time_field_value(DateTimeField::Kind kind) const
{
    if (auto field = date_time_field(kind); field.has_value())
        return field->value;
    return {};
}

i32 HTMLInputElement::date_time_field_minimum(DateTimeField::Kind kind) const
{
    switch (kind) {
    case FieldKind::Year:
    case FieldKind::Month:
    case FieldKind::Day:
    case FieldKind::Week:
        return 1;
    case FieldKind::Hour:
        return date_time_fields_use_12_hour_clock() ? 1 : 0;
    case FieldKind::Minute:
    case FieldKind::Second:
    case FieldKind::DayPeriod:
        return 0;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

i32 HTMLInputElement::date_time_field_maximum(DateTimeField::Kind kind) const
{
    switch (kind) {
    case FieldKind::Year:
        return maximum_year;
    case FieldKind::Month:
        return 12;
    case FieldKind::Day:
        // NB: A day the month does not have leaves the value empty, as the user may change the month next.
        return 31;
    case FieldKind::Week:
        return 53;
    case FieldKind::Hour:
        return date_time_fields_use_12_hour_clock() ? 12 : 23;
    case FieldKind::Minute:
    case FieldKind::Second:
        return 59;
    case FieldKind::DayPeriod:
        return 1;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

bool HTMLInputElement::date_time_fields_want_seconds() const
{
    if (!first_is_one_of(type_state(), TypeAttributeState::Time, TypeAttributeState::LocalDateAndTime))
        return false;

    // NB: The value carries seconds when its time has more than hours and minutes.
    auto value = m_value.utf16_view();
    if (auto separator = value.find_code_unit_offset(u'T'); separator.has_value())
        value = value.substring_view(*separator + 1);
    if (value.length_in_code_units() > 5)
        return true;

    // NB: A step that is not a whole number of minutes lets the user pick seconds.
    if (auto step = get_attribute(AttributeNames::step); step.has_value()) {
        if (auto parsed = step->utf16_view().to_number<double>(); parsed.has_value() && *parsed > 0 && fmod(*parsed, 60) != 0)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void HTMLInputElement::create_date_time_fields()
{
    VERIFY(m_date_time_fields_container);
    m_date_time_fields_container->remove_all_children();
    m_date_time_fields.clear();
    m_day_period_names.clear();
    m_active_date_time_field = 0;
    m_date_time_field_typed_digits = 0;
    m_date_time_fields_show_seconds = date_time_fields_want_seconds();

    Vector<Variant<FieldKind, Utf16String>> parts;

    if (type_state() == TypeAttributeState::Week) {
        parts.append("Week "_utf16);
        parts.append(FieldKind::Week);
        parts.append(", "_utf16);
        parts.append(FieldKind::Year);
    } else {
        Unicode::CalendarPattern pattern;
        if (type_state() != TypeAttributeState::Time) {
            pattern.year = Unicode::CalendarPatternStyle::Numeric;
            pattern.month = Unicode::CalendarPatternStyle::TwoDigit;
            if (type_state() != TypeAttributeState::Month)
                pattern.day = Unicode::CalendarPatternStyle::TwoDigit;
        }
        if (first_is_one_of(type_state(), TypeAttributeState::Time, TypeAttributeState::LocalDateAndTime)) {
            pattern.hour = Unicode::CalendarPatternStyle::TwoDigit;
            pattern.minute = Unicode::CalendarPatternStyle::TwoDigit;
            if (m_date_time_fields_show_seconds)
                pattern.second = Unicode::CalendarPatternStyle::TwoDigit;
        }

        auto formatter = Unicode::DateTimeFormat::create_for_pattern_options(Unicode::default_locale(), u"UTC"sv, pattern);
        for (auto const& part : formatter->format_to_parts(sample_epoch_milliseconds)) {
            if (auto kind = field_kind_for_part_type(part.type); kind.has_value())
                parts.append(*kind);
            else if (part.type == u"literal"sv)
                parts.append(part.value);
        }

        if (pattern.hour.has_value()) {
            // NB: The names of the two day periods, as the formatter writes them for a morning and an afternoon hour.
            for (auto hour : { 1, 13 }) {
                for (auto const& part : formatter->format_to_parts(hour * 3600000.0)) {
                    if (part.type == u"dayPeriod"sv)
                        m_day_period_names.append(part.value);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    auto& realm = HTML::relevant_realm(*this);
    for (auto const& part : parts) {
        if (auto const* literal = part.get_pointer<Utf16String>()) {
            MUST(m_date_time_fields_container->append_child(DOM::Text::create(document(), *literal)));
            continue;
        }

        auto kind = part.get<FieldKind>();
        if (kind == FieldKind::DayPeriod && m_day_period_names.size() != 2)
            continue;

        auto element = MUST(DOM::create_element(document(), HTML::TagNames::span, Namespace::HTML));
        MUST(element->append_child(DOM::Text::create(document(), {})));
        MUST(m_date_time_fields_container->append_child(element));

        auto index = m_date_time_fields.size();
        auto mousedown_function = JS::NativeFunction::create(
            realm, GC::create_function<JS::ThrowCompletionOr<JS::Value>(JS::VM&)>(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(*this, index), [](auto& self, auto& index, JS::VM&) {
                if (index < self.m_date_time_fields.size())
                    self.set_active_date_time_field(index);
                return JS::js_undefined();
            }),
            0, Utf16FlyString {}, &realm);
        auto mousedown_callback = GC::Heap::the().allocate<WebIDL::CallbackType>(*mousedown_function, realm);
        element->add_event_listener_without_options(UIEvents::EventNames::mousedown, DOM::IDLEventListener::create(mousedown_callback));

        m_date_time_fields.append({ .kind = kind, .value = {}, .element = element });
    }

    m_date_time_fields_value = {};
    update_date_time_fields();
}

void HTMLInputElement::update_date_time_fields()
{
    if (!m_date_time_fields_container)
        return;

    // NB: Script and the picker change the value; the fields then show it. Fields the user is still filling in keep
    //     their numbers while the value stays empty.
    if (m_date_time_fields_value != m_value) {
        // NB: Only a value from outside the fields decides whether they show seconds, so that clearing a field the
        //     user is editing does not build the fields again and lose what they typed into the others.
        if (date_time_fields_want_seconds() != m_date_time_fields_show_seconds) {
            create_date_time_fields();
            return;
        }

        m_date_time_fields_value = m_value;
        m_date_time_field_typed_digits = 0;
        for (auto& field : m_date_time_fields)
            field.value = {};

        auto set = [&](FieldKind kind, Optional<i32> value) {
            for (auto& field : m_date_time_fields) {
                if (field.kind == kind)
                    field.value = value;
            }
        };

        // NB: The value is sanitized, so its components are where its type puts them.
        auto value = m_value.utf16_view();
        Utf16View date_part;
        Utf16View time_part;
        switch (type_state()) {
        case TypeAttributeState::Date:
        case TypeAttributeState::Month:
        case TypeAttributeState::Week:
            date_part = value;
            break;
        case TypeAttributeState::Time:
            time_part = value;
            break;
        case TypeAttributeState::LocalDateAndTime:
            if (auto separator = value.find_code_unit_offset(u'T'); separator.has_value()) {
                date_part = value.substring_view(0, *separator);
                time_part = value.substring_view(*separator + 1);
            }
            break;
        default:
            VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        }

        if (!date_part.is_empty()) {
            if (type_state() == TypeAttributeState::Week) {
                auto components = date_part.split_view(u"-W"sv, SplitBehavior::Nothing);
                if (components.size() == 2) {
                    set(FieldKind::Year, components[0].to_number<i32>());
                    set(FieldKind::Week, components[1].to_number<i32>());
                }
            } else {
                auto components = date_part.split_view(u'-', SplitBehavior::Nothing);
                if (components.size() >= 2) {
                    set(FieldKind::Year, components[0].to_number<i32>());
                    set(FieldKind::Month, components[1].to_number<i32>());
                }
                if (components.size() >= 3)
                    set(FieldKind::Day, components[2].to_number<i32>());
            }
        }

        if (!time_part.is_empty()) {
            auto components = time_part.split_view(u':', SplitBehavior::Nothing);
            if (components.size() >= 2) {
                auto hour = components[0].to_number<i32>();
                if (hour.has_value() && date_time_fields_use_12_hour_clock()) {
                    set(FieldKind::DayPeriod, *hour >= 12 ? 1 : 0);
                    hour = *hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : *hour % 12;
                }
                set(FieldKind::Hour, hour);
                set(FieldKind::Minute, components[1].to_number<i32>());
            }
            if (components.size() >= 3)
                set(FieldKind::Second, components[2].substring_view(0, AK::min(2uz, components[2].length_in_code_units())).to_number<i32>());
        }
    }

    update_date_time_field_elements();
}

void HTMLInputElement::update_date_time_field_elements()
{
    bool const is_focused = document().focused_area().ptr() == this;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < m_date_time_fields.size(); ++index) {
        auto const& field = m_date_time_fields[index];

        Utf16String text;
        if (!field.value.has_value())
            text = Utf16String::from_utf16(field_placeholder(field.kind));
        else if (field.kind == FieldKind::DayPeriod)
            text = m_day_period_names[*field.value];
        else if (field.kind == FieldKind::Year)
            text = Utf16String::formatted("{:04}", *field.value);
        else
            text = Utf16String::formatted("{:02}", *field.value);

        auto& text_node = as<DOM::Text>(*field.element->first_child());
        if (text_node.data() != text)
            text_node.set_data(text);

        bool const is_active = is_focused && index == m_active_date_time_field;
        auto style = is_active
            ? "font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border-radius: 2px; background-color: AccentColor; color: AccentColorText;"_utf16
            : "font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border-radius: 2px;"_utf16;
        if (field.element->get_attribute_value(HTML::AttributeNames::style) != style)
            field.element->set_attribute_value(HTML::AttributeNames::style, style);
    }
}

void HTMLInputElement::set_active_date_time_field(size_t index)
{
    VERIFY(index < m_date_time_fields.size());
    m_active_date_time_field = index;
    m_date_time_field_typed_digits = 0;
    update_date_time_field_elements();
}

// NB: A step that is not a whole number of minutes adds a seconds field to a time input, and one that is takes it away.
void HTMLInputElement::update_date_time_fields_for_step()
{
    if (m_date_time_fields_container && date_time_fields_want_seconds() != m_date_time_fields_show_seconds)
        create_date_time_fields();
}

// NB: Moving focus backwards into the input lands on its last field, so that the fields are reached in reverse.
void HTMLInputElement::activate_last_date_time_field()
{
    if (!m_date_time_fields.is_empty())
        set_active_date_time_field(m_date_time_fields.size() - 1);
}

void HTMLInputElement::date_time_fields_did_change()
{
    Utf16String new_value;

    auto all_fields_filled = all_of(m_date_time_fields, [](auto const& field) { return field.value.has_value(); });
    if (all_fields_filled && !m_date_time_fields.is_empty()) {
        auto value_of = [&](FieldKind kind) { return date_time_field_value(kind).value_or(0); };

        auto hour = value_of(FieldKind::Hour);
        if (date_time_fields_use_12_hour_clock())
            hour = (hour % 12) + (value_of(FieldKind::DayPeriod) == 1 ? 12 : 0);
        auto time = date_time_field(FieldKind::Second).has_value()
            ? Utf16String::formatted("{:02}:{:02}:{:02}", hour, value_of(FieldKind::Minute), value_of(FieldKind::Second))
            : Utf16String::formatted("{:02}:{:02}", hour, value_of(FieldKind::Minute));

        switch (type_state()) {
        case TypeAttributeState::Date:
            new_value = Utf16String::formatted("{:04}-{:02}-{:02}", value_of(FieldKind::Year), value_of(FieldKind::Month), value_of(FieldKind::Day));
            break;
        case TypeAttributeState::Month:
            new_value = Utf16String::formatted("{:04}-{:02}", value_of(FieldKind::Year), value_of(FieldKind::Month));
            break;
        case TypeAttributeState::Week:
            new_value = Utf16String::formatted("{:04}-W{:02}", value_of(FieldKind::Year), value_of(FieldKind::Week));
            break;
        case TypeAttributeState::Time:
            new_value = time;
            break;
        case TypeAttributeState::LocalDateAndTime:
            new_value = Utf16String::formatted("{:04}-{:02}-{:02}T{}", value_of(FieldKind::Year), value_of(FieldKind::Month), value_of(FieldKind::Day), time);
            break;
        default:
            VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        }

        // NB: Fields that do not make a valid value together, such as the 31st of a 30-day month, leave the value
        //     empty.
        new_value = value_sanitization_algorithm(new_value);
    }

    // NB: The fields already show the value they make, so it must not be parsed back into them.
    m_date_time_fields_value = new_value;
    update_date_time_field_elements();
    // AD-HOC: Whether the fields describe bad input changes which validity pseudo-classes match, even when the
    //         value stays empty.
    CSS::Invalidation::invalidate_style_after_validity_change(*this);
    commit_date_time_value(move(new_value));
}

bool HTMLInputElement::handle_date_time_field_key(UIEvents::KeyCode key, u32 modifiers, u32 code_point)
{
    if (m_date_time_fields.is_empty())
        return false;
    if (modifiers & (UIEvents::Mod_Ctrl | UIEvents::Mod_Alt | UIEvents::Mod_Super))
        return false;

    auto field_count = m_date_time_fields.size();
    auto move_to = [&](size_t index) {
        set_active_date_time_field(index);
        return true;
    };

    // NB: Tab moves between the fields before it moves focus away from the input.
    if (key == UIEvents::Key_Tab) {
        if (modifiers & UIEvents::Mod_Shift) {
            if (m_active_date_time_field > 0)
                return move_to(m_active_date_time_field - 1);
        } else if (m_active_date_time_field + 1 < field_count) {
            return move_to(m_active_date_time_field + 1);
        }
        return false;
    }
    if (key == UIEvents::Key_Left)
        return move_to(m_active_date_time_field > 0 ? m_active_date_time_field - 1 : 0);
    if (key == UIEvents::Key_Right)
        return move_to(AK::min(m_active_date_time_field + 1, field_count - 1));
    if (key == UIEvents::Key_Home)
        return move_to(0);
    if (key == UIEvents::Key_End)
        return move_to(field_count - 1);

    auto& field = m_date_time_fields[m_active_date_time_field];
    auto minimum = date_time_field_minimum(field.kind);
    auto maximum = date_time_field_maximum(field.kind);

    if (key == UIEvents::Key_Up || key == UIEvents::Key_Down) {
        if (!is_mutable())
            return true;
        bool const up = key == UIEvents::Key_Up;
        if (!field.value.has_value()) {
            // NB: An empty year starts at the current one; other fields start at the end of their range.
            if (field.kind == FieldKind::Year)
                field.value = current_year();
            else
                field.value = up ? minimum : maximum;
        } else if (up) {
            field.value = *field.value >= maximum ? minimum : *field.value + 1;
        } else {
            field.value = *field.value <= minimum ? maximum : *field.value - 1;
        }
        m_date_time_field_typed_digits = 0;
        date_time_fields_did_change();
        return true;
    }

    if (key == UIEvents::Key_Backspace || key == UIEvents::Key_Delete) {
        if (!is_mutable())
            return true;
        field.value = {};
        m_date_time_field_typed_digits = 0;
        date_time_fields_did_change();
        return true;
    }

    if (code_point == 0 || code_point < ' ')
        return false;

    if (!is_mutable())
        return true;

    if (field.kind == FieldKind::DayPeriod) {
        // NB: A day period is chosen by the first letter of its name.
        for (size_t index = 0; index < m_day_period_names.size(); ++index) {
            auto name = m_day_period_names[index].utf16_view();
            if (name.is_empty())
                continue;
            auto first = name.code_point_at(0);
            if (to_ascii_lowercase(first) == to_ascii_lowercase(code_point)) {
                field.value = static_cast<i32>(index);
                date_time_fields_did_change();
                // NB: The change event can change the type of the input, which builds other fields or none.
                if (m_active_date_time_field + 1 < m_date_time_fields.size())
                    set_active_date_time_field(m_active_date_time_field + 1);
                return true;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (is_ascii_digit(code_point)) {
        auto digit = static_cast<i32>(code_point - '0');
        auto maximum_digits = field.kind == FieldKind::Year ? 4 : 2;

        i32 typed = digit;
        if (m_date_time_field_typed_digits > 0 && field.value.has_value())
            typed = *field.value * 10 + digit;
        if (typed > maximum) {
            // NB: A digit that would overflow the field starts the field over.
            typed = digit;
            m_date_time_field_typed_digits = 0;
        }
        ++m_date_time_field_typed_digits;

        // NB: The field is done once no further digit could keep it in range.
        bool const is_complete = m_date_time_field_typed_digits >= maximum_digits || static_cast<i64>(typed) * 10 > maximum;
        field.value = is_complete ? AK::max(typed, minimum) : typed;

        if (is_complete) {
            m_date_time_field_typed_digits = 0;
            if (m_active_date_time_field + 1 < field_count)
                m_active_date_time_field = m_active_date_time_field + 1;
        }
        date_time_fields_did_change();
        return true;
    }

    // NB: A separator ends the field being typed into.
    if (m_date_time_field_typed_digits > 0) {
        if (field.value.has_value())
            field.value = AK::max(*field.value, minimum);
        m_date_time_field_typed_digits = 0;
        if (m_active_date_time_field + 1 < field_count)
            m_active_date_time_field = m_active_date_time_field + 1;
        date_time_fields_did_change();
    }
    return true;
}

}

#include <LibWeb/Bindings/Sanitizer.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/DocumentFragment.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Element.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/HTMLHtmlElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/HTMLInsertion.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/HTMLTemplateElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Parser/HTMLParser.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/SanitizerConfiguration.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/Scripting/Environments.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/TagNames.h>
#include <LibWeb/Namespace.h>
#include <LibWeb/TrustedTypes/TrustedHTMLParserOptions.h>
#include <LibWeb/TrustedTypes/TrustedTypePolicy.h>
#include <LibWeb/XML/XMLFragmentParser.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dynamic-markup-insertion.html#target-for-html-insertion
HTMLInsertionTarget target_for_html_insertion(DOM::Element& element)
{
    // 1. If element is a template element, then return element's template contents.
    if (auto* template_element = as_if<HTMLTemplateElement>(element))
        return GC::Ref { *template_element->content() };

    // 2. Return element.
    return GC::Ref { element };
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dynamic-markup-insertion.html#parent-for-html-insertion
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<Optional<HTMLInsertionTarget>> parent_for_html_insertion(DOM::Node& node)
{
    // 1. Let parent be node's parent.
    auto* parent = node.parent();

    // 2. If parent is null, then return null.
    if (!parent)
        return Optional<HTMLInsertionTarget> {};

    // 3. If parent is a template element, then throw a "HierarchyRequestError" DOMException.
    if (is<HTMLTemplateElement>(*parent))
        return WebIDL::HierarchyRequestError::create("Cannot insert HTML into the children of a template element"_utf16);

    // 4. If parent is an Element, or a DocumentFragment with a non-null host, then return parent.
    if (auto* element = as_if<DOM::Element>(*parent))
        return Optional<HTMLInsertionTarget> { GC::Ref { *element } };
    if (auto* fragment = as_if<DOM::DocumentFragment>(*parent); fragment && fragment->host())
        return Optional<HTMLInsertionTarget> { GC::Ref { *fragment } };

    // 5. Throw a "HierarchyRequestError" DOMException.
    return WebIDL::HierarchyRequestError::create("Cannot insert HTML into this parent"_utf16);
}

static GC::Ref<DOM::Node> target_node(HTMLInsertionTarget const& target)
{
    return target.visit([](auto node) -> GC::Ref<DOM::Node> { return node; });
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dynamic-markup-insertion.html#set-and-filter-html
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> filter_and_set_html(HTMLInsertionTarget target, Utf16View html, SanitizerOptions const& options, FragmentParserMode mode)
{
    // 1. Let fragment be the result of parsing HTML for insertion given target, html, options, and mode.
    auto fragment = TRY(parse_html_for_insertion(target, html, options, mode));

    // 2. If fragment is non-null, then replace all with fragment within target.
    if (fragment)
        target_node(target)->replace_all(fragment);

    return {};
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dynamic-markup-insertion.html#filter-and-pre-insert-html
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> filter_and_pre_insert_html(HTMLInsertionTarget parent, GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> child, Utf16View html, SanitizerOptions const& options, FragmentParserMode mode)
{
    // 1. If parent is an html element, then throw a "HierarchyRequestError" DOMException.
    if (auto element = parent.get_pointer<GC::Ref<DOM::Element>>(); element && is<HTMLHtmlElement>(**element))
        return WebIDL::HierarchyRequestError::create("Cannot insert HTML into an html element"_utf16);

    // 2. Let fragment be the result of parsing HTML for insertion given parent, html, options, and mode.
    auto fragment = TRY(parse_html_for_insertion(parent, html, options, mode));

    // 3. If fragment is non-null, then pre-insert fragment into parent before child.
    if (fragment)
        TRY(target_node(parent)->pre_insert(*fragment, child));

    return {};
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dynamic-markup-insertion.html#filter-and-replace-with-html
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> filter_and_replace_with_html(HTMLInsertionTarget parent, DOM::Node& node, Utf16View html, SanitizerOptions const& options, FragmentParserMode mode)
{
    // 1. If parent is an html element, then throw a "HierarchyRequestError" DOMException.
    if (auto element = parent.get_pointer<GC::Ref<DOM::Element>>(); element && is<HTMLHtmlElement>(**element))
        return WebIDL::HierarchyRequestError::create("Cannot insert HTML into an html element"_utf16);

    // 2. Let fragment be the result of parsing HTML for insertion given parent, html, options, and mode.
    auto fragment = TRY(parse_html_for_insertion(parent, html, options, mode));

    // 3. If fragment is non-null, then replace node with fragment within parent.
    if (fragment)
        TRY(target_node(parent)->replace_child(*fragment, node));

    return {};
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dynamic-markup-insertion.html#parse-html-for-insertion
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ptr<DOM::DocumentFragment>> parse_html_for_insertion(HTMLInsertionTarget target, Utf16View html, SanitizerOptions const& options, FragmentParserMode mode)
{
    // 1. If mode is Safe:
    if (mode == FragmentParserMode::Safe) {
        // 1. Let context be target if target is an Element; otherwise target's host.
        GC::Ptr<DOM::Element> context = target.visit(
            [](GC::Ref<DOM::Element> element) -> GC::Ptr<DOM::Element> { return element; },
            [](GC::Ref<DOM::DocumentFragment> fragment) -> GC::Ptr<DOM::Element> { return fragment->host(); });

        // 2. Assert: context is non-null.
        VERIFY(context);

        // 3. If all of the following are true:
        //    - context's local name is "script"; and
        //    - context's namespace is the HTML namespace or the SVG namespace,
        //    then return null.
        if (context->local_name() == TagNames::script && (context->namespace_uri() == Namespace::HTML || context->namespace_uri() == Namespace::SVG))
            return nullptr;
    }

    // 2. Return the result of invoking the fragment parsing algorithm steps given target, html, options, and mode.
    return TRY(fragment_parsing_algorithm_steps(target, html, options, mode)).ptr();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dynamic-markup-insertion.html#fragment-parsing-algorithm-steps
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<GC::Ref<DOM::DocumentFragment>> fragment_parsing_algorithm_steps(HTMLInsertionTarget target, Utf16View markup, SanitizerOptions const& options, FragmentParserMode mode)
{
    // 1. If mode is Legacy and target's node document is an XML document, then return the result of invoking the XML
    //    fragment parsing algorithm given target and markup.
    // NOTE: Sanitization is not supported for XML documents.
    if (mode == FragmentParserMode::Legacy && target_node(target)->document().is_xml_document())
        return XMLFragmentParser::parse_xml_fragment(target, markup);

    // 2. Let safe be true if mode is Safe; otherwise false.
    auto safety = mode == FragmentParserMode::Safe ? SanitizerSafety::Safe : SanitizerSafety::Unsafe;

    // 3. Let sanitizerConfig be the result of getting a sanitizer config from options given options and safe.
    auto sanitizer_config = TRY(get_a_sanitizer_config_from_options(options, safety));

    // 4. Let scriptingMode be Inert.
    auto scripting_mode = ParserScriptingMode::Inert;

    // 5. Let runScripts be options's runScripts if options is a TrustedHTMLParserOptions; otherwise
    //    options["runScripts"] with default false.
    bool run_scripts = options.visit(
        [](GC::Ref<TrustedTypes::TrustedHTMLParserOptions> trusted_options) { return trusted_options->run_scripts(); },
        [](Bindings::SetHTMLUnsafeOptions const* set_html_unsafe_options) { return set_html_unsafe_options->run_scripts; },
        [](auto const*) { return false; });

    // 6. If runScripts is true:
    if (run_scripts) {
        // 1. Assert: mode is not Safe.
        VERIFY(mode != FragmentParserMode::Safe);

        // 2. Set scriptingMode to Fragment.
        scripting_mode = ParserScriptingMode::Fragment;
    }

    // 7. Let allowDeclarativeShadowRoots be false if mode is Legacy; otherwise true.
    auto allow_declarative_shadow_roots = mode == FragmentParserMode::Legacy ? HTMLParser::AllowDeclarativeShadowRoots::No : HTMLParser::AllowDeclarativeShadowRoots::Yes;

    // 8. Return the result of the HTML fragment parsing algorithm given target, markup, allowDeclarativeShadowRoots,
    //    scriptingMode, and sanitizerConfig.
    // NOTE: Scripts in the returned fragment will only execute once they are inserted into a document, and only if
    //       scriptingMode is Fragment.
    return HTMLParser::parse_html_fragment(target, markup, allow_declarative_shadow_roots, scripting_mode, FragmentFastPath::Allow, sanitizer_config.has_value() ? &*sanitizer_config : nullptr);
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<LegacySinkCompliantInput> get_trusted_type_compliant_input_for_legacy_sink(DOM::Node& node, Variant<GC::Ref<TrustedTypes::TrustedHTML>, Utf16String> const& value, TrustedTypes::InjectionSink sink, LegacySinkRunScripts run_scripts)
{
    // Let (compliantString, compliantOptions) be the result of invoking the get trusted type compliant input algorithm
    // with this's relevant global object, the given value, a new SetHTMLUnsafeOptions dictionary, sink, this's node
    // document's type, and false.
    Bindings::SetHTMLUnsafeOptions options;
    options.run_scripts = run_scripts == LegacySinkRunScripts::Yes;
    auto document_type = node.document().is_xml_document() ? TrustedTypes::DocumentType::XML : TrustedTypes::DocumentType::HTML;
    auto compliant_input = TRY(TrustedTypes::get_trusted_type_compliant_input(
        relevant_global_object(node),
        value,
        TrustedTypes::CompliantParserOptions<Bindings::SetHTMLUnsafeOptions> { move(options) },
        sink,
        document_type,
        TrustedTypes::OptionsFromAuthor::No));

    GC::Ptr<TrustedTypes::TrustedHTMLParserOptions> trusted_options;
    if (auto const* trusted = compliant_input.options.template get_pointer<GC::Ref<TrustedTypes::TrustedHTMLParserOptions>>())
        trusted_options = *trusted;
    return LegacySinkCompliantInput { move(compliant_input.html), trusted_options };
}

}

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(HTMLLabelElement);

HTMLLabelElement::HTMLLabelElement(DOM::Document& document, DOM::QualifiedName qualified_name)
    : HTMLElement(document, move(qualified_name))
{
}

HTMLLabelElement::~HTMLLabelElement() = default;

void HTMLLabelElement::set_being_activated(bool activated)
{
    Base::set_being_activated(activated);
    if (auto labeled_control = control())
        labeled_control->set_being_activated(activated);
}

bool HTMLLabelElement::has_activation_behavior() const
{
    return true;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#the-label-element:activation-behaviour
void HTMLLabelElement::activation_behavior(DOM::Event const& event)
{
    activation_behavior(event, is_interactive_descendant_event_target(event.target().ptr()));
}

bool HTMLLabelElement::is_interactive_descendant_event_target(DOM::EventTarget* click_target) const
{
    if (auto* target = as_if<DOM::Node>(click_target); target && target->is_descendant_of(*this)) {
        for (; target != this; target = target->parent()) {
            auto const* element = as_if<HTMLElement>(*target);
            if (!element)
                continue;
            auto const& name = element->local_name();
            if (name.is_one_of(TagNames::button, TagNames::details, TagNames::embed, TagNames::iframe, TagNames::label, TagNames::select, TagNames::textarea)
                || (name == TagNames::a && element->has_attribute(AttributeNames::href))
                || (name.is_one_of(TagNames::audio, TagNames::video) && element->has_attribute(AttributeNames::controls))
                || (name == TagNames::img && (element->has_attribute(AttributeNames::usemap) || element->has_attribute(AttributeNames::controls))))
                return true;
            if (auto const* input = as_if<HTMLInputElement>(*element); input && input->type_state() != HTMLInputElement::TypeAttributeState::Hidden)
                return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

void HTMLLabelElement::activation_behavior(DOM::Event const& event, bool is_interactive_descendant)
{
    // The label element's exact default presentation and behavior, in particular what its activation behavior might be,
    // if anything, should match the platform's label behavior. The activation behavior of a label element for events
    // targeted at interactive content descendants of a label element, and any descendants of those interactive content
    // descendants, must be to do nothing.
    if (is_interactive_descendant)
        return;

    // AD-HOC: Click and focus the control, matching typical platform behavior.
    //         This matches the behavior of HTMLElement::click(), but the original event properties are preserved.
    if (m_click_in_progress)
        return;

    auto control_element = control();
    if (!control_element)
        return;

    // NB: If a click was fired after a drag selection was made on the label element, do not propagate the click event
    //     to the input element. This allows the user to e.g. copy the label's text.
    if (event.type() == EventNames::click) {
        auto const& mouse_event = as<UIEvents::MouseEvent>(event);
        auto selection = document().get_selection();
        if (mouse_event.detail() == 1 && selection && !selection->is_collapsed())
            return;
    }

    if (auto* form_control = as_if<FormAssociatedElement>(*control_element)) {
        if (!form_control->enabled())
            return;
    }

    {
        m_click_in_progress = true;
        ScopeGuard guard { [this] { m_click_in_progress = false; } };

        auto const& mouse_event = as<UIEvents::MouseEvent>(event);
        auto click_event = UIEvents::MouseEvent::create_from_mouse_event(mouse_event, HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(relevant_global_object(*this)));

        // NB: Ensure layout is up to date before accessing the control's committed box.
        Layout::ForcedReadScope read { document() };
        document().update_layout(DOM::UpdateLayoutReason::HTMLLabelElementActivationBehavior);

        // Recompute offsetX/offsetY relative to the control element, since the original values are relative to the label.
        auto const* layout_node = control_element->layout_node(read);
        if (layout_node && Painting::has_committed_box(*layout_node)) {
            auto offset = Painting::mouse_event_offset(*layout_node, { CSSPixels::nearest_value_for(mouse_event.client_x()), CSSPixels::nearest_value_for(mouse_event.client_y()) });
            click_event->set_offset_x(AK::round(offset.x().to_double()));
            click_event->set_offset_y(AK::round(offset.y().to_double()));
        }

        click_event->set_bubbles(true);
        click_event->set_cancelable(true);
        click_event->set_composed(true);
        click_event->set_is_trusted(event.is_trusted());
        control_element->dispatch_event(click_event);
    }

    HTML::run_focusing_steps(control_element);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#labeled-control
GC::Ptr<HTMLElement> HTMLLabelElement::control() const
{
    GC::Ptr<HTMLElement> control;

    // The for attribute may be specified to indicate a form control with which the caption is
    // to be associated. If the attribute is specified, the attribute's value must be the ID of
    // a labelable element in the same tree as the label element. If the attribute is specified
    // and there is an element in the tree whose ID is equal to the value of the for attribute,
    // and the first such element in tree order is a labelable element, then that element is the
    // label element's labeled control.
    if (auto for_attribute = for_(); for_attribute.has_value()) {
        root().for_each_in_inclusive_subtree_of_type<DOM::Element>([&](auto& element) {
            if (element.id().has_value() && element.id()->view() == for_attribute->utf16_view()) {
                if (auto const* html_element = as_if<HTMLElement>(element); html_element && html_element->is_labelable())
                    control = &const_cast<HTMLElement&>(*html_element);
                return TraversalDecision::Break;
            }
            return TraversalDecision::Continue;
        });
        return control;
    }

    // If the for attribute is not specified, but the label element has a labelable element descendant,
    // then the first such descendant in tree order is the label element's labeled control.
    for_each_in_subtree_of_type<HTMLElement>([&](auto& element) {
        if (element.is_labelable()) {
            control = &const_cast<HTMLElement&>(element);
            return TraversalDecision::Break;
        }
        return TraversalDecision::Continue;
    });

    return control;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#dom-label-form
GC::Ptr<HTMLFormElement> HTMLLabelElement::form() const
{
    auto labeled_control = control();

    // 1. If the label element has no labeled control, then return null.
    if (!labeled_control)
        return {};

    // 2. If the label element's labeled control is not a form-associated element, then return null.
    auto* form_associated_element = as_if<FormAssociatedElement>(*labeled_control);
    if (!form_associated_element)
        return {};

    // 3. Return the label element's labeled control's form owner (which can still be null).
    return form_associated_element->form();
}

}

    : HTMLElement(document, move(qualified_name))
{
}

HTMLLegendElement::~HTMLLegendElement() = default;

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#dom-legend-form
HTMLFormElement* HTMLLegendElement::form()
{
    // The form IDL attribute's behavior depends on whether the legend element is in a fieldset element or not.
    // If the legend has a fieldset element as its parent, then the form IDL attribute must return the same value as the form IDL attribute on that fieldset element.
    if (auto* field_set = as_if<HTML::HTMLFieldSetElement>(parent_element().ptr())) {
        return field_set->form();
    }

    // Otherwise, it must return null.
    return nullptr;
}

CSS::ElementBoxKind HTMLLegendElement::box_kind() const
{
    return CSS::ElementBoxKind::Legend;
}

static void refresh_disabled_state_of_form_controls_under_disabled_field_set(DOM::Node* node)
{
    if (auto* field_set = as_if<HTMLFieldSetElement>(node); field_set && field_set->has_attribute(HTML::AttributeNames::disabled))
        field_set->refresh_disabled_state_of_descendant_form_controls();
}

void HTMLLegendElement::inserted()
{
    Base::inserted();
    refresh_disabled_state_of_form_controls_under_disabled_field_set(parent_element().ptr());
}

void HTMLLegendElement::moved_from(IsSubtreeRoot is_subtree_root, GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> old_ancestor)
{
    Base::moved_from(is_subtree_root, old_ancestor);
    if (is_subtree_root != IsSubtreeRoot::Yes)
        return;
    refresh_disabled_state_of_form_controls_under_disabled_field_set(old_ancestor.ptr());
    if (parent_element().ptr() != old_ancestor.ptr())
        refresh_disabled_state_of_form_controls_under_disabled_field_set(parent_element().ptr());
}

}

    : HTMLElement(document, move(qualified_name))
{
}

void HTMLLIElement::attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& local_name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_)
{
    Base::attribute_changed(local_name, old_value, value, namespace_);

    if (local_name == HTML::AttributeNames::value)
        schedule_list_item_renumber_for_list_owner();
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/grouping-content.html#dom-li-value
WebIDL::Long HTMLLIElement::value()
{
    // The value IDL attribute must reflect the value of the value content attribute.
    // NOTE: This is equivalent to the code that would be generated by the IDL generator if we used [Reflect] on the value attribute.
    //       We don't do that in this case, since this method is used elsewhere.
    auto content_attribute_value = get_attribute(AttributeNames::value).value_or("0"_utf16);
    if (auto maybe_number = HTML::parse_integer(content_attribute_value); maybe_number.has_value())
        return *maybe_number;
    return 0;
}

void HTMLLIElement::set_value(WebIDL::Long value)
{
    set_attribute_value(AttributeNames::value, Utf16String::number(value));
}

bool HTMLLIElement::is_presentational_hint(Utf16FlyString const& name) const
{
    if (Base::is_presentational_hint(name))
        return true;

    return name.is_one_of(HTML::AttributeNames::type, HTML::AttributeNames::value);
}

void HTMLLIElement::apply_presentational_hints(Vector<CSS::StyleProperty>& properties) const
{
    Base::apply_presentational_hints(properties);

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#lists
    // "When an li element has a value attribute, and parsing that attribute's value using the rules
    // for parsing integers doesn't generate an error, the user agent is expected to use the parsed
    // value value as a presentational hint for the 'counter-set' property of the form
    // list-item value."
    if (auto value = get_attribute(AttributeNames::value); value.has_value()) {
        if (auto parsed = parse_integer(*value); parsed.has_value()) {
            CSS::CounterDefinition definition { CSS::list_item_counter_name(), false, CSS::IntegerStyleValue::create(*parsed) };
            properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::CounterSet, .value = CSS::CounterDefinitionsStyleValue::create({ move(definition) }) });
        }
    }

    for_each_attribute([&](Utf16FlyString const& name, Utf16View value) {
        if (name == HTML::AttributeNames::type) {
            if (value == u"1"sv) {
                properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::ListStyleType, .value = CSS::CounterStyleStyleValue::create("decimal"_utf16_fly_string) });
            } else if (value == u"a"sv) {
                properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::ListStyleType, .value = CSS::CounterStyleStyleValue::create("lower-alpha"_utf16_fly_string) });
            } else if (value == u"A"sv) {
                properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::ListStyleType, .value = CSS::CounterStyleStyleValue::create("upper-alpha"_utf16_fly_string) });
            } else if (value == u"i"sv) {
                properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::ListStyleType, .value = CSS::CounterStyleStyleValue::create("lower-roman"_utf16_fly_string) });
            } else if (value == u"I"sv) {
                properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::ListStyleType, .value = CSS::CounterStyleStyleValue::create("upper-roman"_utf16_fly_string) });
            } else if (value.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(u"none"sv)) {
                properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::ListStyleType, .value = CSS::KeywordStyleValue::create(CSS::Keyword::None) });
            } else if (value.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(u"disc"sv)) {
                properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::ListStyleType, .value = CSS::CounterStyleStyleValue::create("disc"_utf16_fly_string) });
            } else if (value.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(u"circle"sv)) {
                properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::ListStyleType, .value = CSS::CounterStyleStyleValue::create("circle"_utf16_fly_string) });
            } else if (value.equals_ignoring_ascii_case(u"square"sv)) {
                properties.append({ .property_id = CSS::PropertyID::ListStyleType, .value = CSS::CounterStyleStyleValue::create("square"_utf16_fly_string) });
            }
        }
    });
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/GenericShorthands.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/HTMLElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/HTMLOListElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/HTMLUListElement.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

class HTMLLIElement final : public HTMLElement {
    WEB_WRAPPABLE(HTMLLIElement, HTMLElement);
    GC_DECLARE_ALLOCATOR(HTMLLIElement);

public:
    virtual ~HTMLLIElement() override;

    // https://www.w3.org/TR/html-aria/#el-li
    virtual Optional<ARIA::Role> default_role() const override
    {
        for (auto ancestor = parent_element(); ancestor; ancestor = ancestor->parent_element()) {
            if (ancestor->role_or_default() == ARIA::Role::list)
                return ARIA::Role::listitem;
        }
        // https://w3c.github.io/core-aam/#roleMappingComputedRole
        // When an element has a role but is not contained in the required context (for example, an orphaned listitem
        // without the required accessible parent of role list), User Agents MUST ignore the role token, and return the
        // computedrole as if the ignored role token had not been included.
        return ARIA::Role::none;
    }

    WebIDL::Long value();
    void set_value(WebIDL::Long value);

    virtual bool is_html_li_element() const override { return true; }

private:
    HTMLLIElement(DOM::Document&, DOM::QualifiedName);
    virtual void attribute_changed(Utf16FlyString const& local_name, Optional<Utf16String> const& old_value, Optional<Utf16String> const& value, Optional<Utf16FlyString> const& namespace_) override;

    virtual bool is_presentational_hint(Utf16FlyString const&) const override;
    virtual void apply_presentational_hints(Vector<CSS::StyleProperty>&) const override;
};

}

namespace Web::HTML {

GC_DEFINE_ALLOCATOR(HTMLLinkElement);

static GC::Ref<DOM::Event> create_event_for_element(HTMLElement& element, Utf16FlyString const& event_name)
{
    return DOM::Event::create(event_name, HighResolutionTime::current_high_resolution_time(relevant_global_object(element)));
}

HTMLLinkElement::HTMLLinkElement(DOM::Document& document, DOM::QualifiedName qualified_name)
    : HTMLElement(document, move(qualified_name))
{
}

HTMLLinkElement::~HTMLLinkElement() = default;

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#blocking-attribute
GC::Ref<DOM::DOMTokenList> HTMLLinkElement::blocking()
{
    if (!m_blocking)
        m_blocking = DOM::DOMTokenList::create(*this, AttributeNames::blocking);
    return *m_blocking;
}

void HTMLLinkElement::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_blocking);
    visitor.visit(m_fetch_controller);
    visitor.visit(m_loaded_style_sheet);
    visitor.visit(m_style_sheet_kept_while_disabled);
    visitor.visit(m_rel_list);
    visitor.visit(m_sizes);
}

void HTMLLinkElement::adopted_from(DOM::Document& old_document)
{
    Base::adopted_from(old_document);

    if (m_document_load_event_delayer.has_value())
        m_document_load_event_delayer.emplace(document(), DOM::DocumentLoadEventDelayerReason::StyleSheetRequest);
}

void HTMLLinkElement::inserted()
{
    HTMLElement::inserted();

    if (!document().browsing_context())
        return;

    if (should_fetch_and_process_resource_type() && is_browsing_context_connected()) {
        // The appropriate times to fetch and process this type of link are:
        //  - When the external resource link is created on a link element that is already browsing-context connected.
        //  - When the external resource link's link element becomes browsing-context connected.
        fetch_and_process_linked_resource();
    }
}

void HTMLLinkElement::removed_from(IsSubtreeRoot is_subtree_root, Node* old_ancestor, Node& old_root)
{
    Base::removed_from(is_subtree_root, old_ancestor, old_root);
    cancel_pending_stylesheet_processing();
    m_style_sheet_kept_while_disabled = nullptr;

    if (m_loaded_style_sheet) {
        // NB: We can't use `old_root` here. When this link element is nested
        //     inside a shadow tree within a larger removed subtree, `old_root`
        //     is the outer subtree's root, not the shadow root that actually
        //     contains our stylesheet. Use the sheet's own tracked owning
        //     root, which is the one whose style scope owns it.
        auto const& owning_roots = m_loaded_style_sheet->owning_documents_or_shadow_roots();
        VERIFY(owning_roots.size() == 1);
        auto& owning_root = **owning_roots.begin();
        auto& style_scope = [&owning_root] -> CSS::StyleScope& {
            if (auto* shadow_root = as_if<DOM::ShadowRoot>(owning_root))
                return shadow_root->style_scope();
            return as<DOM::Document>(owning_root).style_scope();
        }();

        style_scope.remove_a_css_style_sheet(*m_loaded_style_sheet);
        m_loaded_style_sheet = nullptr;
    }
}

void HTMLLinkElement::moved_from(IsSubtreeRoot is_subtree_root, GC::Ptr<Node> old_ancestor)
{
    Base::moved_from(is_subtree_root, old_ancestor);

    if (!m_loaded_style_sheet)
        return;

    auto const& owning_roots = m_loaded_style_sheet->owning_documents_or_shadow_roots();
    VERIFY(owning_roots.size() == 1);
    auto& owning_root = **owning_roots.begin();
    auto& source = [&owning_root] -> CSS::StyleScope& {
        if (auto* shadow_root = as_if<DOM::ShadowRoot>(owning_root))
            return shadow_root->style_scope();
        return as<DOM::Document>(owning_root).style_scope();
    }();
    source.move_sheet(*m_loaded_style_sheet, document_or_shadow_root_style_scope());
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#dom-link-rellist
GC::Ref<DOM::DOMTokenList> HTMLLinkElement::rel_list()
{
    // The relList IDL attribute must reflect the rel content attribute.
    if (!m_rel_list)
        m_rel_list = DOM::DOMTokenList::create(*this, HTML::AttributeNames::rel);
    return *m_rel_list;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#dom-link-sizes
GC::Ref<DOM::DOMTokenList> HTMLLinkElement::sizes()
{
    // The size IDL attribute must reflect the size content attribute.
    if (!m_sizes)
        m_sizes = DOM::DOMTokenList::create(*this, HTML::AttributeNames::sizes);
    return *m_sizes;
}

void HTMLLinkElement::set_media(Utf16View media)
{
    set_attribute_value(HTML::AttributeNames::media, media);
    if (auto sheet = m_loaded_style_sheet)
        sheet->set_media(media);
}

Utf16String HTMLLinkElement::media() const
{
    return get_attribute_value(HTML::AttributeNames::media);
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#dom-linkstyle-sheet
CSS::CSSStyleSheet* HTMLLinkElement::cssom_sheet() const
{
    return m_loaded_style_sheet ? &m_loaded_style_sheet->cssom_sheet() : nullptr;
}

RefPtr<CSS::StyleSheetState> HTMLLinkElement::sheet() const
{
    return m_loaded_style_sheet;
}

void HTMLLinkElement::finished_loading_critical_style_subresources(AnyFailed any_failed)
{
    // NB: The style sheet of an older fetch stays associated until a newer fetch's response is processed. That newer
    //     fetch owns the document load event delayer, so the old sheet's imports must not release it.
    if (m_loaded_style_sheet_fetch_generation != m_current_fetch_generation)
        return;

    m_document_load_event_delayer.clear();

    auto fetch_generation = exchange(m_fetch_generation_waiting_for_critical_subresources, {});
    if (!fetch_generation.has_value())
        return;

    queue_an_element_task(Task::Source::Networking, GC::create_function(GC::Heap::the(), GC::captures(GC::Ref { *this }, *fetch_generation, any_failed), [](auto& link, auto& fetch_generation, auto& any_failed) {
        if (fetch_generation != link->m_current_fetch_generation || !link->m_stylesheet_processing_pending)
            return;

        // 2. Fire an event named load at el.
