#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <LibMedia/FFmpeg/FFmpegAudioConverter.h>
#include <LibMedia/Sinks/AudioOutputFactory.h>
#include <LibMediaCodecs/AudioBlock.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/MediaStreamPlayback.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

static constexpr u32 TARGET_LATENCY_MS = 100;

// Live audio that the output can't keep up with is dropped rather than played late.
static constexpr u32 MAXIMUM_QUEUED_MILLISECONDS = 200;

// Fed on whichever thread produces the track's audio, drained on the audio output's thread.
struct MediaStreamPlayback::TrackInput final : public AtomicRefCounted<TrackInput> {
    Mutex mutex;
    OwnPtr<Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegAudioConverter> converter;
    Audio::SampleSpecification converter_output_specification;
    i64 frames_received { 0 };
    // Interleaved, in the output's sample specification.
    Vector<float> samples;
};

struct MediaStreamPlayback::Mixer final : public AtomicRefCounted<Mixer> {
    Mutex mutex;
    Vector<NonnullRefPtr<TrackInput>> inputs;
    Audio::SampleSpecification output_specification;
    Atomic<bool> playing { false };
};

static void receive_frames(MediaStreamPlayback::Mixer& mixer, MediaStreamPlayback::TrackInput& input, float const* samples, size_t frame_count, u8 channel_count, u32 sample_rate)
{
    if (!mixer.playing.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed) || frame_count == 0 || channel_count == 0 || sample_rate == 0)
        return;

    Audio::SampleSpecification output_specification;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(mixer.mutex);
        output_specification = mixer.output_specification;
    }
    if (!output_specification.is_valid())
        return;

    MutexLocker locker(input.mutex);
    if (!input.converter || input.converter_output_specification != output_specification) {
        auto converter_or_error = Media::FFmpeg::FFmpegAudioConverter::try_create();
        if (converter_or_error.is_error())
            return;
        auto converter = converter_or_error.release_value();
        if (converter->set_output_sample_specification(output_specification).is_error())
            return;
        input.converter = move(converter);
        input.converter_output_specification = output_specification;
        input.samples.clear();
    }

    // FIXME: Downmix sources with more than two channels instead of keeping the first two.
    auto used_channel_count = min<size_t>(channel_count, 2);
    auto channel_map = used_channel_count == 1 ? Audio::ChannelMap::mono() : Audio::ChannelMap::stereo();
    Media::AudioBlock block;
    block.initialize(Audio::SampleSpecification(sample_rate, channel_map), input.frames_received, frame_count);
    input.frames_received += static_cast<i64>(frame_count);
    for (size_t channel = 0; channel < used_channel_count; ++channel) {
        auto destination = block.channel_data(channel);
        for (size_t frame = 0; frame < frame_count; ++frame)
            destination[frame] = samples[(frame * channel_count) + channel];
    }
    if (input.converter->push_block(block).is_error())
        return;

    while (true) {
        Media::AudioBlock converted;
        if (input.converter->retrieve_block(converted).is_error() || converted.is_empty())
            break;
        auto offset = input.samples.size();
        input.samples.resize(offset + converted.sample_count());
        converted.copy_to_interleaved(input.samples.span().slice(offset));
    }

    auto maximum_samples = static_cast<size_t>(output_specification.sample_rate()) * output_specification.channel_count() * MAXIMUM_QUEUED_MILLISECONDS / 1000;
    if (input.samples.size() > maximum_samples)
        input.samples.remove(0, input.samples.size() - maximum_samples);
}

NonnullOwnPtr<MediaStreamPlayback> MediaStreamPlayback::create(NonnullRefPtr<Media::AudioOutputFactory> audio_output_factory)
{
    return adopt_own(*new MediaStreamPlayback(move(audio_output_factory)));
}

MediaStreamPlayback::MediaStreamPlayback(NonnullRefPtr<Media::AudioOutputFactory> audio_output_factory)
    : m_mixer(adopt_ref(*new Mixer))
    , m_audio_output_factory(move(audio_output_factory))
{
}

MediaStreamPlayback::~MediaStreamPlayback()
{
    m_mixer->playing.store(false);
    // This can run while the garbage collector is sweeping, when the tracks may already be gone, so the sinks
    // are only switched off here. Callers stop playback properly through set_tracks({}) beforehand.
    for (auto& subscription : m_subscriptions)
        subscription.sink->deactivate();
}

void MediaStreamPlayback::set_tracks(ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<MediaCapture::MediaStreamTrack>> tracks)
{
    for (size_t index = m_subscriptions.size(); index-- > 0;) {
        auto track = m_subscriptions[index].track.ptr();
        auto still_present = track && any_of(tracks, [&](auto const& candidate) { return candidate.ptr() == track.ptr(); });
        if (!still_present)
            remove_input(index);
    }

    for (auto const& track : tracks) {
        if (!track->is_audio())
            continue;
        if (any_of(m_subscriptions, [&](auto const& subscription) { return subscription.track.ptr().ptr() == track.ptr(); }))
            continue;

        auto input = adopt_ref(*new TrackInput);
        auto sink = adopt_ref(*new MediaCapture::AudioFrameSink);
        sink->on_frames = [mixer = m_mixer, input](float const* samples, size_t frame_count, u8 channel_count, u32 sample_rate) {
            receive_frames(*mixer, *input, samples, frame_count, channel_count, sample_rate);
        };
        {
            MutexLocker locker(m_mixer->mutex);
            m_mixer->inputs.append(input);
        }
        m_subscriptions.append({ track, sink, input });
        track->add_audio_sink(sink);
    }
}

void MediaStreamPlayback::remove_input(size_t index)
{
    auto subscription = m_subscriptions.take(index);
    if (auto track = subscription.track.ptr())
        track->remove_audio_sink(*subscription.sink);
    else
        subscription.sink->deactivate();

    MutexLocker locker(m_mixer->mutex);
    m_mixer->inputs.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& input) { return input.ptr() == subscription.input.ptr(); });
}

void MediaStreamPlayback::play()
{
    if (m_playing)
        return;
    m_playing = true;
    m_playing_since = MonotonicTime::now();
    m_mixer->playing.store(true);

    if (m_output) {
        (void)m_output->resume();
        return;
    }
    if (m_creating_output)
        return;
    m_creating_output = true;

    auto data_callback = [mixer = m_mixer](Span<float> buffer, MonotonicTime) -> ReadonlySpan<float> {
        buffer.fill(0.0f);
        MutexLocker mixer_locker(mixer->mutex);
        for (auto& input : mixer->inputs) {
            MutexLocker input_locker(input->mutex);
            auto sample_count = min(input->samples.size(), buffer.size());
            for (size_t index = 0; index < sample_count; ++index)
                buffer[index] += input->samples[index];
            input->samples.remove(0, sample_count);
        }
        // A short read is padded with silence, so the output keeps asking for more instead of treating the
        // stream as finished.
        return buffer;
    };

    auto promise = m_audio_output_factory->open_output(Audio::OutputState::Suspended, TARGET_LATENCY_MS, move(data_callback));
    promise->when_resolved([weak_self = make_weak_ptr()](auto& stream) {
        if (!weak_self)
            return;
        auto& self = *weak_self;
        self.m_creating_output = false;
        self.m_output = stream;
        {
            MutexLocker locker(self.m_mixer->mutex);
            self.m_mixer->output_specification = stream->sample_specification();
        }
        (void)stream->set_volume(self.m_volume);
        if (self.m_playing)
            (void)stream->resume();
    });
    promise->when_rejected([weak_self = make_weak_ptr()](auto& error) {
        dbgln("MediaStreamPlayback: Unable to open an audio output: {}", error);
        if (weak_self)
            weak_self->m_creating_output = false;
    });
}

void MediaStreamPlayback::pause()
{
    if (!m_playing)
        return;
    m_playing = false;
    if (m_playing_since.has_value())
        m_time_played += MonotonicTime::now() - m_playing_since.release_value();
    m_mixer->playing.store(false);

    if (m_output)
        (void)m_output->discard_buffer_and_suspend();

    // A paused live stream skips what arrived in the meantime rather than resuming from where it stopped.
    MutexLocker locker(m_mixer->mutex);
    for (auto& input : m_mixer->inputs) {
        MutexLocker input_locker(input->mutex);
        input->samples.clear();
    }
}

void MediaStreamPlayback::set_volume(double volume)
{
    m_volume = volume;
    if (m_output)
        (void)m_output->set_volume(volume);
}

double MediaStreamPlayback::current_time() const
{
    auto time = m_time_played;
    if (m_playing_since.has_value())
        time += MonotonicTime::now() - *m_playing_since;
    return time.to_seconds_f64();
}

}

// Plays the audio tracks of a MediaStream assigned to a media element's srcObject, mixed into one output stream.
// https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/#mediastreams-in-media-elements
class MediaStreamPlayback final : public Weakable<MediaStreamPlayback> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(MediaStreamPlayback);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(MediaStreamPlayback);
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

public:
    static NonnullOwnPtr<MediaStreamPlayback> create(NonnullRefPtr<Media::AudioOutputFactory>);
    ~MediaStreamPlayback();

    void set_tracks(ReadonlySpan<GC::Ref<MediaCapture::MediaStreamTrack>>);

    void play();
    void pause();
    void set_volume(double);

    // A MediaStream has no timeline of its own, so the position is the time spent playing.
    double current_time() const;

    struct Mixer;
    struct TrackInput;

private:
    explicit MediaStreamPlayback(NonnullRefPtr<Media::AudioOutputFactory>);

    void remove_input(size_t index);

    NonnullRefPtr<Mixer> m_mixer;
    NonnullRefPtr<Media::AudioOutputFactory> m_audio_output_factory;

    struct Subscription {
        GC::Weak<MediaCapture::MediaStreamTrack> track;
        NonnullRefPtr<MediaCapture::AudioFrameSink> sink;
        NonnullRefPtr<TrackInput> input;
    };
    Vector<Subscription> m_subscriptions;

    RefPtr<Audio::PlaybackStream> m_output;
    bool m_creating_output { false };
    bool m_playing { false };
    double m_volume { 1.0 };

    AK::Duration m_time_played;
    Optional<MonotonicTime> m_playing_since;
};

/*

#include <LibUnicode/Locale.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/HTMLMediaElement.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/MediaTrackBase.h>
#include <LibWeb/MediaSourceExtensions/MediaSource.h>
#include <LibWeb/MediaSourceExtensions/SourceBuffer.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

MediaTrackBase::MediaTrackBase(GC::Ref<HTMLMediaElement> media_element, Media::Track const& track)
    : m_media_element(media_element)
    , m_track_in_playback_manager(track)
    , m_id(Utf16String::number(track.identifier()))
    , m_kind(track.kind())
    , m_label(track.label())
{
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#dom-audiotrack-language
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#dom-videotrack-language
    // The AudioTrack language and VideoTrack language attributes must return the BCP 47 language tag of the language
    // of the track, if it has one, or the empty string otherwise. If the user agent is not able to express that language
    // as a BCP 47 language tag (for example because the language information in the media resource's format is a free-form
    // string without a defined interpretation), then the method must return the empty string, as if the track had no
    // language.
    m_language = [&] {
        auto locale = Unicode::parse_unicode_locale_id(track.language().utf16_view());
        if (!locale.has_value())
            return Utf16String {};
        auto language = locale->to_utf16_string();
        // NOTE: We specifically want to exclude "und" here, as RFC 5646 says:
        //
        //     The 'und' (Undetermined) primary language subtag identifies linguistic content whose language is not
        //     determined. This subtag SHOULD NOT be used unless a language tag is required and language information is
        //     not available or cannot be determined.  Omitting the language tag (where permitted) is preferred.  The 'und'
        //     subtag might be useful for protocols that require a language tag to be provided or where a primary language
        //     subtag is required (such as in "und-Latn").  The 'und' subtag MAY also be useful when matching language tags
        //     in certain situations.
        //
        // Matroska's TrackEntry->Language element is required, and will use "und" as a placeholder as mentioned above. We
        // don't want to return anything when that placeholder is found:
        if (language == "und"_utf16)
            return Utf16String {};
        return language;
    }();
}

MediaTrackBase::~MediaTrackBase() = default;

GC::Ptr<MediaSourceExtensions::SourceBuffer> MediaTrackBase::source_buffer_in_attached_media_source() const
{
    if (!m_source_buffer || m_source_buffer->media_source() != m_media_element->attached_media_source())
        return nullptr;
    return m_source_buffer;
}

void MediaTrackBase::visit_edges(GC::Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_media_element);
    visitor.visit(m_source_buffer);
}

}

/*

#include <LibJS/HostClassBuilder.h>
#include <LibJS/Runtime/Realm.h>
#include <LibURL/RustIntegration.h>
#include <LibWeb/DOM/Event.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/MessageEvent.h>
#include <LibWeb/HTML/MessagePort.h>

namespace Web::HTML {

extern "C" {
// Defined in Bindings/Rust/src/html/exports.rs.
DOM::Event* web_rust_html_create_message_event(JSVM*, void* realm, FlatPtr type, JSValue data, MessagePort* const* ports, size_t count, MessagePort* source, URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const* origin);
DOM::Event* web_rust_html_create_message_event_for_create_event(JSVM*, void* realm);
}

GC::Ref<DOM::Event> create_message_event(JS::Realm& realm, Utf16FlyString const& type, MessageEventInit const& event_init, Optional<URL::Origin> const& origin)
{
    GC::RootVector<MessagePort*> ports;
    ports.ensure_capacity(event_init.ports.size());
    for (auto const& port : event_init.ports)
        ports.unchecked_append(port.ptr());

    auto create = [&](URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const* ffi_origin) {
        return web_rust_html_create_message_event(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(realm.vm()), &realm, type.raw_identity(), JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(event_init.data), ports.data(), ports.size(), event_init.source.ptr(), ffi_origin);
    };
    if (!origin.has_value())
        return *create(nullptr);

    DOM::Event* event = nullptr;
    URL::RustIntegration::lend_origin_to_ffi(*origin, [&](URL::FFI::FfiOrigin const& ffi_origin) {
        event = create(&ffi_origin);
    });
    return *event;
}

GC::Ref<DOM::Event> create_message_event(JS::Realm& realm)
{
    return *web_rust_html_create_message_event_for_create_event(JS::HostABI::vm_to_abi(realm.vm()), &realm);
}

}

struct MessageEventInit {

    GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<MessagePort>> ports {};
    GC::Ptr<MessagePort> source;

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> MessagePort::post_message(JS::Realm& realm, JS::Value message, GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<JS::Object>> const& transfer)
{
    Vector<JSObject*> transfer_abi;
    transfer_abi.ensure_capacity(transfer.size());
    for (auto const& transferable : transfer)
        transfer_abi.unchecked_append(JS::HostABI::object_to_abi(transferable.ptr()));
    TRY(JS::HostABI::completion_from_abi<void>(web_rust_message_port_post_message(vm_abi(), &realm, this, JS::HostABI::value_to_abi(message), transfer_abi.data(), transfer_abi.size())));
    return {};
}

WebIDL::ExceptionOr<MessagePort::TransferredToWorker> MessagePort::transfer_to_worker(JS::Realm& realm, WorkerMayBeInOtherProcess worker_may_be_in_other_process)
{
    TransferDataEncoder* data_holder = nullptr;
    u64 parked_end_token = 0;
    TRY(JS::HostABI::completion_from_abi<void>(web_rust_message_port_transfer_steps(vm_abi(), &realm, this, worker_may_be_in_other_process == WorkerMayBeInOtherProcess::Yes, &data_holder, &parked_end_token)));
    TransferredToWorker result { move(*data_holder), parked_end_token };
    delete data_holder;
    return result;
}

// A reference to the event loop of the calling thread, which any thread may use, handed over.
Core::WeakEventLoopReference* web_bindings_message_port_current_event_loop()
{
    return &Core::EventLoop::current_weak().leak_ref();
}

void web_bindings_message_port_release_event_loop(Core::WeakEventLoopReference* event_loop)
{
    event_loop->unref();
}

void web_bindings_message_port_post_to_event_loop(Core::WeakEventLoopReference* event_loop, void (*steps)(u64), u64 argument)
{
    if (auto strong_event_loop = event_loop->take(); strong_event_loop.is_alive())
        strong_event_loop->deferred_invoke([steps, argument] { steps(argument); });
}

// The rights of the transport's end as a handle, handed over, after its IO thread stops.

{
    return new IPC::TransportHandle(MUST(transport->release_for_transfer()));
}

void web_bindings_message_port_transport_set_up_read_hook(IPC::Transport* transport, void* state, void (*steps)(void*))
{
    transport->set_up_read_hook([state, steps] { steps(state); });
}

{
    return transport->is_open();
}

{
    transport->close();
}

{
    transport->close_after_sending_all_pending_messages();
}

void web_bindings_transport_handle_take(IPC::TransportHandle* handle, void* context, void (*receive)(void*, ReadonlyBytes, TransferAttachment const*, size_t))
{
    auto owner = adopt_own(*handle);
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer;
    IPC::Encoder encoder(buffer);
    MUST(encoder.encode(*owner));
    auto attachments = IPC::release_raw_attachments(buffer.take_attachments());
    receive(context, buffer.data().span(), attachments.data(), attachments.size());
}

IPC::Transport* web_bindings_transport_handle_create_transport(ReadonlyBytes bytes, TransferAttachment const* attachments, size_t count)
{
    FixedMemoryStream stream(bytes);
    Queue<IPC::Attachment> queue;
    for (auto& attachment : IPC::adopt_raw_attachments({ attachments, count }))
        queue.enqueue(move(attachment));
    IPC::Decoder decoder(stream, queue);
    auto handle = MUST(decoder.decode<IPC::TransportHandle>());
    return MUST(handle.create_transport()).leak_ptr();
}

bool web_bindings_message_port_transport_send(IPC::Transport* transport, ReadonlyBytes bytes, TransferAttachment const* attachments, size_t count)
{
    IPC::MessageDataType data;
    MUST(data.try_append(bytes.data(), bytes.size()));
    IPC::MessageBuffer buffer { move(data), IPC::adopt_raw_attachments({ attachments, count }) };
    if (auto result = buffer.transfer_message(*transport); result.is_error()) {
        dbgln("Failed to post message: {}", result.error());
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool web_bindings_message_port_transport_read_messages(IPC::Transport* transport, void* context, bool (*receive)(void*, ReadonlyBytes, TransferAttachment const*, size_t))
{
    bool failed_to_decode = false;
    auto should_shutdown = transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
        // The peer is treated as gone after a malformed record. Later messages still release all their attachments.
        if (failed_to_decode)
            return;
        Vector<IPC::Attachment> attachments;
        while (!message.attachments.is_empty())
            attachments.append(message.attachments.dequeue());
        auto raw_attachments = IPC::release_raw_attachments(move(attachments));
        failed_to_decode = !receive(context, message.bytes.bytes(), raw_attachments.data(), raw_attachments.size());
    });
    return failed_to_decode || should_shutdown == IPC::Transport::ShouldShutdown::Yes;
}

}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#message-ports
class WEB_API MessagePort : public Bindings::RustInterfaceCell {
    WEB_RUST_INTERFACE(MessagePort, message_port)

public:
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<MessagePort> create(JS::Realm&);

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#message-ports:transfer-receiving-steps
    [[nodiscard]] static GC::Ref<MessagePort> create_from_transfer(JS::Realm&, TransferDataEncoder&&);

    static void disentangle_ports_of_realm(JS::Realm&);

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#entangle
    void entangle_with(MessagePort&);

    GC::Ptr<MessagePort> entangled_port();

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#message-event-target
    void set_message_event_target(DOM::EventTarget&);

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#dom-messageport-postmessage
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> post_message(JS::Realm&, JS::Value message, GC::RootVector<GC::Ref<JS::Object>> const& transfer);

    void enable();

    void close();

    void discard_pending_messages();

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#message-ports:transfer-steps
    // For the port of a new channel, whose data holder goes through the browser process to the thread of a worker. As
    // long as nobody took up the other end, it waits in this process, under the token.
    struct TransferredToWorker {
        TransferDataEncoder data_holder;
        u64 parked_end_token { 0 };
    };
    enum class WorkerMayBeInOtherProcess {
        No,
        Yes,
    };
    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<TransferredToWorker> transfer_to_worker(JS::Realm&, WorkerMayBeInOtherProcess);

    // Tells that the data holder is not going to arrive in this process, unless it did already: the port goes on over the
    // socket that the data holder carries, if it may leave the process, and otherwise its peer is gone.
    static void give_up_on_parked_end(u64 parked_end_token);

    StringView entanglement_kind_for_testing() const;
    bool transport_is_closed_for_testing() const;
    size_t pending_outgoing_message_count() const;
    void fail_next_transfer_for_testing();
};

}

#include <LibWeb/DOM/Document.h>

Navigable::Navigable(GC::Ref<Page> page)
    : m_page(page)
{
}

Navigable::~Navigable() = default;

void Navigable::visit_edges(Cell::Visitor& visitor)
{
    Base::visit_edges(visitor);
    visitor.visit(m_parent);
    visitor.visit(m_container);
    visitor.visit(m_page);
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#nav-container
GC::Ptr<NavigableContainer> Navigable::container() const
{
    // The container of a navigable navigable is the navigable container whose nested navigable is navigable, or null if there is no such element.
    return m_container;
}

// The name content attribute of this navigable's container, which another process reports when it holds the container.
Optional<Utf16FlyString> Navigable::container_name() const
{
    if (auto container = this->container())
        return container->name();
    return container_state().name;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#nav-container-document
GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> Navigable::container_document() const
{
    auto container = this->container();

    // 1. If navigable's container is null, then return null.
    if (!container)
        return nullptr;

    // 2. Return navigable's container's node document.
    return container->document();
}

PermissionsPolicy::PermissionsPolicy Navigable::create_a_permissions_policy_from_a_response(URL::Origin const& origin, HTTP::HeaderList const& response_header_list) const
{
    if (!parent())
        return PermissionsPolicy::create_a_permissions_policy_for_a_navigable_from_response({}, origin, response_header_list);

    // NB: The container's node document is the parent's active document. An origin not yet replicated is same origin
    //     with nothing, which withholds features whose default allowlist is 'self'.
    auto container_document_origin = parent()->active_document_origin().value_or_lazy_evaluated([] { return URL::Origin::create_opaque(); });
    auto container_state = this->container_state();
    PermissionsPolicy::NavigableContainerPolicyInputs container { container_state.document_permissions_policy, container_document_origin, container_state.container_policy };
    return PermissionsPolicy::create_a_permissions_policy_for_a_navigable_from_response(container, origin, response_header_list);
}

bool Navigable::is_ancestor_of(Navigable const& other) const
{
    for (auto ancestor = other.parent(); ancestor; ancestor = ancestor->parent()) {
        if (ancestor.ptr() == this)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// The currently focused area of the walk from this navigable down, as far as this page holds it. Other processes can
// host the documents on the way to the tab's focused navigable. The walk then resumes at the nearest navigable above the
// focused navigable that this page hosts, or ends at the nearest container this page holds.
GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> Navigable::currently_focused_area_shown_by_focused_navigable()
{
    if (!page().client().has_focus())
        return nullptr;
    return focused_area_shown_by_focused_navigable_regardless_of_system_focus();
}

GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> Navigable::focused_area_shown_by_focused_navigable_regardless_of_system_focus()
{
    auto focused_navigable = page().focused_navigable();
    if (!focused_navigable || (focused_navigable.ptr() != this && !is_ancestor_of(*focused_navigable)))
        return nullptr;

    for (auto navigable = focused_navigable; navigable; navigable = navigable->parent()) {
        if (auto* local_navigable = as_if<LocalNavigable>(*navigable))
            return local_navigable->focused_area_regardless_of_system_focus();
        if (navigable.ptr() == this)
            return nullptr;
        if (auto container = navigable->container())
            return container;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void Navigable::set_parent(GC::Ptr<Navigable> parent)
{
    m_parent = parent;
    DOM::Document::invalidate_full_activity();
}

// AD-HOC: Destroying a child navigable detaches its subtree from the traversable, although the documents in that
//         subtree keep their navigable until the destruction's unload steps complete. The spec destroys each of those
//         documents from a queued task, so the node navigable of a removed iframe's documents stays non-null — leaving
//         them reporting their child navigables long after the removal. Other engines detach the whole subtree at once.
bool Navigable::is_in_a_destroyed_subtree() const
{
    for (auto navigable = GC::Ptr<Navigable const> { this }; navigable; navigable = navigable->parent()) {
        if (navigable->has_been_destroyed())
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

GC::Ptr<Navigable> Navigable::find(CrossProcessId id)
{
    // AD-HOC: Step 3 of destroy a child navigable, after which the navigable is no longer a child, is deferred until
    //         its document has unloaded. A destroyed navigable is not found, although
    //         Document::document_tree_child_navigables() still includes it until then.
    if (has_been_destroyed())
        return nullptr;
    if (this->id() == id)
        return this;

    for (auto* container : NavigableContainer::all_instances()) {
        auto child = container->content_navigable();
        if (!child || !active_document_is(container->document()))
            continue;
        if (auto navigable = child->find(id))
            return navigable;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#nav-traversable
GC::Ref<Navigable> Navigable::traversable_navigable()
{
    // 1. Let navigable be inputNavigable.
    GC::Ref<Navigable> navigable = *this;

    // 2. While navigable is not a traversable navigable, set navigable to navigable's parent.
    while (!navigable->is_traversable())
        navigable = *navigable->parent();

    // 3. Return navigable.
    return navigable;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#nav-top
GC::Ref<Navigable> Navigable::top_level_traversable()
{
    // 1. Let navigable be inputNavigable.
    GC::Ref<Navigable> navigable = *this;

    // 2. While navigable's parent is not null, set navigable to navigable's parent.
    while (navigable->parent())
        navigable = *navigable->parent();

    // 3. Return navigable.
    return navigable;
}

// INTEROP: The spec only stops a frame from loading the URL of an ancestor, so a page that gives each copy of itself a
//          new URL nests without end. Like other engines, we limit how deep frames can load documents. URLs that fetch
//          nothing stay allowed at any depth.
bool Navigable::is_too_deeply_nested_to_load(URL::URL const& url, MayNavigateToAFragment may_navigate_to_a_fragment) const
{
    static constexpr size_t maximum_depth = 10;

    if (url_matches_about_blank(url) || url_matches_about_srcdoc(url) || url.scheme() == "javascript"sv)
        return false;

    // A navigation to a fragment of the active document stays in that document.
    if (auto active_url = active_document_url(); may_navigate_to_a_fragment == MayNavigateToAFragment::Yes && url.fragment().has_value() && active_url.has_value() && url.equals(*active_url, URL::ExcludeFragment::Yes))
        return false;

    size_t depth = 1;
    for (auto ancestor = parent(); ancestor; ancestor = ancestor->parent())
        ++depth;
    return depth > maximum_depth;
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#navigate
WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> Navigable::navigate(NavigateParams params)
{
    auto source_document = params.source_document;

    // 1. Let cspNavigationType be "form-submission" if formDataEntryList is non-null; otherwise "other".
    auto csp_navigation_type = params.form_data_entry_list.has_value()
        ? ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::NavigationType::FormSubmission
        : ContentSecurityPolicy::Directives::Directive::NavigationType::Other;

    // Steps 2 to 4, 6.3, 6.4, and 7.
    auto snapshots = snapshot_navigation_source(source_document);

    // 5. If sourceDocument is null:
    if (!source_document) {
        // 1. Assert: userInvolvement is "browser UI".
        VERIFY(params.user_involvement == UserNavigationInvolvement::BrowserUI);

        // 2. If url's scheme is "javascript", then set initiatorOriginSnapshot to navigable's active document's origin.
        if (params.url.scheme() == "javascript"sv) {
            auto origin = active_document_origin();
            if (!origin.has_value())
                return {};
            snapshots.initiator_origin_snapshot = origin.release_value();
        }
    }
    // 6. Otherwise:
    else {
        // 1. Assert: userInvolvement is not "browser UI".
        VERIFY(params.user_involvement != UserNavigationInvolvement::BrowserUI);

        // AD-HOC: sourceDocument can have no node navigable, e.g. a document without a browsing context that a form
        //         moved into after it planned a navigation. There is nothing to navigate from.
        auto source_navigable = source_document->navigable();
        if (!source_navigable)
            return {};

        // 2. If sourceDocument's node navigable is not allowed by sandboxing to navigate navigable given
        //    sourceSnapshotParams:
        if (!source_navigable->allowed_by_sandboxing_to_navigate(*this, snapshots.source_snapshot_params)) {
            // 1. If exceptionsEnabled is true, then throw a "SecurityError" DOMException.
            if (params.exceptions_enabled)
                return WebIDL::SecurityError::create("Source document's node navigable is not allowed to navigate"_utf16);

            // 2. Return.
            return {};
        }
    }

    // AD-HOC: See is_too_deeply_nested_to_load(). Only a navigation without a document resource or response can be one
    //         to a fragment; a POST to a URL with a fragment still loads a document.
    auto may_navigate_to_a_fragment = params.document_resource.has<Empty>() && !params.response ? MayNavigateToAFragment::Yes : MayNavigateToAFragment::No;
    if (is_too_deeply_nested_to_load(params.url, may_navigate_to_a_fragment))
        return {};

    // AD-HOC: Nothing the browser process can see names this URL's blob URL entry until the navigation commits, so
    //         ask it to keep the entry until then.
    if (auto const& blob_url_entry = params.url.blob_url_entry(); blob_url_entry.has_value() && source_document) {
        if (auto const* blob = blob_url_entry->object.get_pointer<URL::BlobURLEntry::Blob>())
            source_document->page().client().page_did_retain_blob_url_token(id(), blob->token);
    }

    // 8. If the surrounding agent is equal to navigable's active document's relevant agent, then continue these
    //    steps. Otherwise, queue a global task on the navigation and traversal task source given navigable's active
    //    window to continue these steps.
    // NB: Steps 1 to 7 took everything the remaining steps need from sourceDocument, so they carry no reference to it.
    return continue_navigation_in_active_document_agent({
        .url = move(params.url),
        .document_resource = move(params.document_resource),
        .response = params.response,
        .history_handling = params.history_handling,
        .navigation_api_state = move(params.navigation_api_state),
        .form_data_entry_list = move(params.form_data_entry_list),
        .referrer_policy = params.referrer_policy,
        .user_involvement = params.user_involvement,
        .navigation_id = move(snapshots.navigation_id),
        .source_element = params.source_element,
        .initial_insertion = params.initial_insertion,
        .api_method_tracker = params.api_method_tracker,
        .csp_navigation_type = csp_navigation_type,
        .source_snapshot_params = snapshots.source_snapshot_params,
        .initiator_origin_snapshot = move(snapshots.initiator_origin_snapshot),
        .initiator_base_url_snapshot = move(snapshots.initiator_base_url_snapshot),
    });
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#allowed-to-navigate
bool Navigable::allowed_by_sandboxing_to_navigate(Navigable const& target, SourceSnapshotParams const& source_snapshot_params) const
{
    auto& source = *this;

    // A navigable source is allowed by sandboxing to navigate a second navigable target,
    // given a source snapshot params sourceSnapshotParams, if the following steps return true:

    // 1. If source is target, then return true.
    if (&source == &target)
        return true;

    // 2. If source is an ancestor of target, then return true.
    if (source.is_ancestor_of(target))
        return true;

    // 3. If target is an ancestor of source:
    // AD-HOC: Only for a top-level target, which drops step 1, so that other ancestors reach step 5.
    //         See https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/13150
    if (target.is_top_level_traversable() && target.is_ancestor_of(source)) {
        // 2. If sourceSnapshotParams's has transient activation is true, and sourceSnapshotParams's sandboxing flags's
        //    sandboxed top-level navigation with user activation browsing context flag is set, then return false.
        if (source_snapshot_params.has_transient_activation && has_flag(source_snapshot_params.sandboxing_flags, SandboxingFlagSet::SandboxedTopLevelNavigationWithUserActivation))
            return false;

        // 3. If sourceSnapshotParams's has transient activation is false, and sourceSnapshotParams's sandboxing flags's
        //    sandboxed top-level navigation without user activation browsing context flag is set, then return false.
        if (!source_snapshot_params.has_transient_activation && has_flag(source_snapshot_params.sandboxing_flags, SandboxingFlagSet::SandboxedTopLevelNavigationWithoutUserActivation))
            return false;

        // 4. Return true.
        return true;
    }

    // 4. If target is a top-level traversable:
    if (target.is_top_level_traversable()) {
        // 1. If source is the one permitted sandboxed navigator of target, then return true.
        if (target.active_browsing_context_one_permitted_sandboxed_navigator().ptr() == &source)
            return true;

        // 2. If sourceSnapshotParams's sandboxing flags's sandboxed navigation browsing context flag is set, then return false.
        if (has_flag(source_snapshot_params.sandboxing_flags, SandboxingFlagSet::SandboxedNavigation))
            return false;

        // 3. Return true.
        return true;
    }

    // 5. If sourceSnapshotParams's sandboxing flags's sandboxed navigation browsing context flag is set, then return false.
    // 6. Return true.
    return !has_flag(source_snapshot_params.sandboxing_flags, SandboxingFlagSet::SandboxedNavigation);
}

GC::Ptr<Navigable> navigable_with_id_in_any_page(Page const& preferred_page, CrossProcessId id)
{
    // A local navigable is the navigable itself, so scanning those first stands one in another page ahead of any
    // proxy of it.
    GC::Ptr<Navigable> match;
    auto consider = [&](Navigable& navigable) {
        if (navigable.id() != id || navigable.has_been_destroyed())
            return false;
        if (&navigable.page() == &preferred_page) {
            match = navigable;
            return true;
        }
        if (!match)
            match = navigable;
        return false;
    };

    for (auto& navigable : all_local_navigables()) {
        if (consider(navigable))
            return match;
    }
    for (auto& navigable : all_remote_navigables()) {
        if (consider(navigable))
            return match;
    }
    return match;
}

// The top-level browsing contexts of a group, as the navigables they are active in: the traversables this process
// hosts, and its stand-ins for those other processes host. A traversable hosted here stands ahead of any stand-in.
// A provisional traversable is not active yet: the stand-in for the traversable another process hosts represents it.
Vector<GC::Root<Navigable>> top_level_navigables_in_browsing_context_group(Optional<u64> browsing_context_group_id)
{
    Vector<GC::Root<Navigable>> navigables;
    if (!browsing_context_group_id.has_value())
        return navigables;
    auto consider = [&](Navigable& navigable) {
        if (!navigable.is_top_level_traversable() || navigable.has_been_destroyed() || navigable.browsing_context_group_id() != browsing_context_group_id)
            return;
        if (auto* local_navigable = as_if<LocalNavigable>(navigable); local_navigable && local_navigable->is_provisional())
            return;
        if (any_of(navigables, [&](auto const& seen) { return seen->id() == navigable.id(); }))
            return;
        navigables.append(navigable);
    };
    for (auto& navigable : all_local_navigables())
        consider(navigable);
    for (auto& navigable : all_remote_navigables())
        consider(navigable);
    return navigables;
}

}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#navigable
class WEB_API Navigable : public JS::Cell {
    GC_CELL(Navigable, JS::Cell);

public:
    virtual ~Navigable() override;

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#nav-id
    CrossProcessId id() const { return m_id; }

    GC::Ptr<Navigable> parent() const { return m_parent; }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#nav-container
    GC::Ptr<NavigableContainer> container() const;
    // NB: A page sets the container of the local navigable it created to populate the content navigable's next
    //     document there, before the navigable is the content navigable, and clears it if it never becomes one.
    void set_container(Badge<NavigableContainer, Page>, GC::Ptr<NavigableContainer> container) { m_container = container; }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#nav-container-document
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Document> container_document() const;

    Page& page() { return m_page; }
    Page const& page() const { return m_page; }

    bool is_ancestor_of(Navigable const&) const;

    GC::Ptr<Navigable> find(CrossProcessId);

    template<typename T>
    bool fast_is() const = delete;

    virtual bool has_been_destroyed() const = 0;
    virtual void set_has_been_destroyed() = 0;

    bool is_in_a_destroyed_subtree() const;

    virtual GC::Ptr<WindowProxy> active_window_proxy() = 0;
    virtual Utf16String const& target_name() const = 0;
    virtual bool is_traversable() const { return false; }
    virtual bool is_local_navigable() const { return false; }
    GC::Ref<Navigable> traversable_navigable();
    GC::Ref<Navigable> top_level_traversable();
    virtual bool is_top_level_traversable() const { return false; }
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#tlbc-group
    virtual Optional<u64> browsing_context_group_id() const = 0;
    virtual Optional<URL::URL> active_document_url() const = 0;
    virtual Optional<URL::Origin> active_document_origin() const = 0;
    virtual SandboxingFlagSet active_document_sandboxing_flag_set() const = 0;
    virtual bool active_document_is_fully_active() const = 0;
    virtual bool active_window_has_sticky_activation() const = 0;
    virtual bool active_document_is_completely_loaded() const = 0;
    virtual bool active_document_is(DOM::Document const&) const = 0;

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#inclusive-descendant-navigables
    virtual Vector<GC::Root<Navigable>> active_document_inclusive_descendant_navigables() = 0;

    virtual Optional<URL::URL> active_document_top_level_creation_url() const = 0;
    virtual Optional<URL::Origin> active_document_top_level_origin() const = 0;
    virtual bool active_document_has_cross_site_ancestor() const = 0;
    virtual OpenerPolicy const& active_document_opener_policy() const = 0;
    virtual bool active_browsing_context_is_auxiliary() const = 0;
    virtual GC::Ptr<Navigable> active_browsing_context_opener_navigable() const = 0;
    virtual GC::Ptr<Navigable> active_browsing_context_one_permitted_sandboxed_navigator() const = 0;

    virtual ReplicatedContainerState container_state() const = 0;
    bool container_is_in_document_tree() const { return container_state().is_in_document_tree; }
    SandboxingFlagSet container_iframe_sandboxing_flag_set() const { return container_state().iframe_sandboxing_flag_set; }
    SandboxingFlagSet container_document_active_sandboxing_flag_set() const { return container_state().document_active_sandboxing_flag_set; }
    EmbedderPolicy container_document_embedder_policy() const { return container_state().document_embedder_policy; }

    // https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-permissions-policy/#algo-create-from-response
    // NB: Given this navigable's container, whose state another process can report.
    PermissionsPolicy::PermissionsPolicy create_a_permissions_policy_from_a_response(URL::Origin const&, HTTP::HeaderList const& response_header_list) const;
    Optional<Utf16FlyString> container_local_name() const { return container_state().local_name; }
    Optional<Utf16FlyString> container_name() const;
    ReferrerPolicy::ReferrerPolicy container_iframe_referrer_policy() const { return container_state().iframe_referrer_policy; }

    virtual bool has_session_history_entry_and_ready_for_navigation() const = 0;
    virtual bool delays_the_load_event_of_its_container() const = 0;

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#currently-focused-area-of-a-top-level-traversable
    virtual GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> currently_focused_area() = 0;
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> currently_focused_area_shown_by_focused_navigable();
    GC::Ptr<DOM::Node> focused_area_shown_by_focused_navigable_regardless_of_system_focus();

    WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> navigate(NavigateParams);

    bool allowed_by_sandboxing_to_navigate(Navigable const& target, SourceSnapshotParams const&) const;

    enum class MayNavigateToAFragment : bool {
        No,
        Yes,
    };
    bool is_too_deeply_nested_to_load(URL::URL const&, MayNavigateToAFragment = MayNavigateToAFragment::Yes) const;

protected:
    explicit Navigable(GC::Ref<Page>);
    void set_id(CrossProcessId id) { m_id = id; }
    void set_parent(GC::Ptr<Navigable>);

    virtual WebIDL::ExceptionOr<void> continue_navigation_in_active_document_agent(PreparedNavigation) = 0;

    virtual void visit_edges(Cell::Visitor&) override;

private:
    CrossProcessId m_id;

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#nav-parent
    GC::Ptr<Navigable> m_parent;

    // Implied link between navigable and its container.
    GC::Ptr<NavigableContainer> m_container;

    GC::Ref<Page> m_page;
};

inline bool Navigable::fast_is<LocalNavigable>() const { return is_local_navigable(); }

    return *set;

    : HTMLElement(document, move(qualified_name))
{
    all_instances().set(this);
}

{
    Base::finalize();
    all_instances().remove(this);
