/// Opaque handle for the Rust tokenizer, passed across the FFI boundary.
pub struct RustFfiTokenizerHandle {
    pub(crate) tokenizer: HtmlTokenizer,
    /// Temporary storage for the last token's string data, kept alive
    /// so that pointers in RustFfiToken remain valid until the next call.
    last_tag_name: token::HtmlName,
    last_comment: Vec<u16>,
    last_doctype_name: Vec<u16>,
    last_public_id: Vec<u16>,
    last_system_id: Vec<u16>,
    last_attributes: Vec<RustFfiAttribute>,
    last_attr_names: Vec<token::HtmlName>,
    last_attr_values: Vec<Vec<u16>>,
    last_unparsed_input: Vec<u16>,
}

/// C-compatible token representation.
///
/// Pointer fields borrow into buffers owned by the `RustFfiTokenizerHandle` that
/// produced this token. They remain valid only until the next call into the
/// tokenizer for that handle (any of `next_token`, `insert_input`, `destroy`,
/// etc.). Callers must consume the data before making the next call.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct RustFfiToken {
    pub token_type: u8,
    pub code_point: u32,
    pub self_closing: bool,
    pub had_duplicate_attribute: bool,

    /// Borrowed `AK::Utf16FlyString` identity owned by the tokenizer handle.
    pub tag_name: usize,

    pub comment_ptr: *const u16,
    pub comment_len: usize,

    pub doctype_name_ptr: *const u16,
    pub doctype_name_len: usize,
    pub public_id_ptr: *const u16,
    pub public_id_len: usize,
    pub system_id_ptr: *const u16,
    pub system_id_len: usize,
    pub force_quirks: bool,
    pub missing_name: bool,
    pub missing_public_id: bool,
    pub missing_system_id: bool,

    pub attributes_ptr: *const RustFfiAttribute,
    pub attributes_len: usize,

    pub start_line: u64,
    pub start_column: u64,
    pub end_line: u64,
    pub end_column: u64,
}

/// C-compatible attribute representation.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct RustFfiAttribute {
    /// Borrowed `AK::Utf16FlyString` identity owned by the tokenizer handle.
    pub name: usize,
    pub value_ptr: *const u16,
    pub value_len: usize,
    pub name_start_line: u64,
    pub name_start_column: u64,
    pub name_end_line: u64,
    pub name_end_column: u64,
    pub value_start_line: u64,
    pub value_start_column: u64,
    pub value_end_line: u64,
    pub value_end_column: u64,
}

impl Default for RustFfiToken {
    fn default() -> Self {
        RustFfiToken {
            token_type: TokenType::Invalid as u8,
            code_point: 0,
            self_closing: false,
            had_duplicate_attribute: false,
            tag_name: 0,
            comment_ptr: ptr::null(),
            comment_len: 0,
            doctype_name_ptr: ptr::null(),
            doctype_name_len: 0,
            public_id_ptr: ptr::null(),
            public_id_len: 0,
            system_id_ptr: ptr::null(),
            system_id_len: 0,
            force_quirks: false,
            missing_name: true,
            missing_public_id: true,
            missing_system_id: true,
            attributes_ptr: ptr::null(),
            attributes_len: 0,
            start_line: 0,
            start_column: 0,
            end_line: 0,
            end_column: 0,
        }
    }
}

fn position_to_ffi(pos: Position) -> (u64, u64) {
    (pos.line, pos.column)
}

/// Create a new Rust HTML tokenizer directly from a UTF-16 code unit buffer.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_tokenizer_create_from_utf16(input: ak::Span<'_, u16>) -> *mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle {
    make_handle(HtmlTokenizer::new(input.as_slice().to_vec()))
}

/// Create a new Rust HTML tokenizer directly from a Latin-1 byte buffer.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_tokenizer_create_from_latin1(input: ak::Span<'_, u8>) -> *mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle {
    make_handle(HtmlTokenizer::new(input.as_slice().to_vec()))
}

fn make_handle(tokenizer: HtmlTokenizer) -> *mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle {
    let handle = Box::new(RustFfiTokenizerHandle {
        tokenizer,
        last_tag_name: Default::default(),
        last_comment: Vec::new(),
        last_doctype_name: Vec::new(),
        last_public_id: Vec::new(),
        last_system_id: Vec::new(),
        last_attributes: Vec::new(),
        last_attr_names: Vec::new(),
        last_attr_values: Vec::new(),
        last_unparsed_input: Vec::new(),
    });

    Box::into_raw(handle)
}

/// Get the next token from the tokenizer.
/// Returns true if a token was produced, false if no more tokens.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_tokenizer_next_token(
    handle: Option<&mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle>,
    out: Option<&mut RustFfiToken>,
    stop_at_insertion_point: bool,
    cdata_allowed: bool,
) -> bool {
    let Some(handle) = handle else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some(out) = out else {
        return false;
    };

    // Fast-path text character in the Data state. For ASCII text runs
    // this skips the whole state-machine function call plus Token
    // construction/drop. Most real HTML is dominated by such runs.
    if !stop_at_insertion_point && let Some(cp) = handle.tokenizer.try_fast_data_char() {
        let offset = SourceOffset::new(handle.tokenizer.current_offset);
        let pos = handle.tokenizer.position_at(offset);
        out.token_type = TokenType::Character as u8;
        out.code_point = cp;
        out.start_line = pos.line;
        out.start_column = pos.column;
        out.end_line = pos.line;
        out.end_column = pos.column;
        return true;
    }

    next_token_slow(handle, out, stop_at_insertion_point, cdata_allowed)
}

/// The state-machine and marshalling portion of the FFI token fetch,
/// pulled out of `rust_html_tokenizer_next_token` so that the fast
/// Data-state path in the outer function keeps a tiny stack frame
/// and a short prologue. Marked `#[inline(never)]` so the compiler
/// doesn't re-inline the whole thing and re-inflate the outer frame.
#[inline(never)]
fn next_token_slow(
    handle: &mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle,
    out: &mut RustFfiToken,
    stop_at_insertion_point: bool,
    cdata_allowed: bool,
) -> bool {
    let token = match handle.tokenizer.next_token(stop_at_insertion_point, cdata_allowed) {
        Some(t) => t,
        None => return false,
    };

    // Fast path: Character and EOF tokens only need a few fields.
    // Skip zeroing ~200 bytes of RustFfiToken for 95%+ of all tokens.
    match token.token_type {
        TokenType::Character | TokenType::EndOfFile => {
            out.token_type = token.token_type as u8;
            out.code_point = token.code_point;
            (out.start_line, out.start_column) = position_to_ffi(handle.tokenizer.position_at(token.start_offset));
            (out.end_line, out.end_column) = position_to_ffi(handle.tokenizer.position_at(token.end_offset));
            return true;
        }
        _ => {}
    }

    *out = RustFfiToken::default();
    out.token_type = token.token_type as u8;

    // NB: Positions are asked for in the order they come in the input, which is the order they are cheapest to find.
    let end_offset = token.end_offset;
    (out.start_line, out.start_column) = position_to_ffi(handle.tokenizer.position_at(token.start_offset));

    // Store string data in handle so pointers stay valid.
    match token.payload {
        TokenPayload::Tag {
            tag_name,
            tag_id: _,
            self_closing,
            had_duplicate_attribute,
            attributes,
        } => {
            out.self_closing = self_closing;
            out.had_duplicate_attribute = had_duplicate_attribute;
            handle.last_tag_name = tag_name;
            out.tag_name = handle.last_tag_name.raw_identity();

            // Move names and values into the handle so the borrowed FFI data remains valid until the next call.
            handle.last_attr_names.clear();
            handle.last_attr_values.clear();
            handle.last_attributes.clear();
            handle.last_attr_names.reserve(attributes.len());
            handle.last_attr_values.reserve(attributes.len());
            handle.last_attributes.reserve(attributes.len());
            for attr in attributes {
                let Attribute {
                    local_name,
                    value,
                    name_start_offset,
                    name_end_offset,
                    value_start_offset,
                    value_end_offset,
                } = attr;
                let (name_start_line, name_start_column) =
                    position_to_ffi(handle.tokenizer.position_at(name_start_offset));
                let (name_end_line, name_end_column) = position_to_ffi(handle.tokenizer.position_at(name_end_offset));
                let (value_start_line, value_start_column) =
                    position_to_ffi(handle.tokenizer.position_at(value_start_offset));
                let (value_end_line, value_end_column) =
                    position_to_ffi(handle.tokenizer.position_at(value_end_offset));
                handle.last_attr_names.push(local_name);
                handle.last_attr_values.push(value.to_utf16());
                let last_idx = handle.last_attr_names.len() - 1;
                let name = &handle.last_attr_names[last_idx];
                let value_code_units = &handle.last_attr_values[last_idx];
                handle.last_attributes.push(RustFfiAttribute {
                    name: name.raw_identity(),
                    value_ptr: value_code_units.as_ptr(),
                    value_len: value_code_units.len(),
                    name_start_line,
                    name_start_column,
                    name_end_line,
                    name_end_column,
                    value_start_line,
                    value_start_column,
                    value_end_line,
                    value_end_column,
                });
            }
            out.attributes_ptr = handle.last_attributes.as_ptr();
            out.attributes_len = handle.last_attributes.len();
        }
        TokenPayload::Comment(data) => {
            handle.last_comment = data.to_utf16();
            out.comment_ptr = handle.last_comment.as_ptr();
            out.comment_len = handle.last_comment.len();
        }
        TokenPayload::Doctype(doctype) => {
            handle.last_doctype_name = doctype.name.to_utf16();
            handle.last_public_id = doctype.public_identifier.to_utf16();
            handle.last_system_id = doctype.system_identifier.to_utf16();
            out.doctype_name_ptr = handle.last_doctype_name.as_ptr();
            out.doctype_name_len = handle.last_doctype_name.len();
            out.public_id_ptr = handle.last_public_id.as_ptr();
            out.public_id_len = handle.last_public_id.len();
            out.system_id_ptr = handle.last_system_id.as_ptr();
            out.system_id_len = handle.last_system_id.len();
            out.force_quirks = doctype.force_quirks;
            out.missing_name = doctype.missing_name;
            out.missing_public_id = doctype.missing_public_identifier;
            out.missing_system_id = doctype.missing_system_identifier;
        }
        TokenPayload::None => {}
    }
    (out.end_line, out.end_column) = position_to_ffi(handle.tokenizer.position_at(end_offset));

    true
}

/// Switch the tokenizer to a new state.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_tokenizer_switch_state(handle: Option<&mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle>, state: u8) {
    let Some(handle) = handle else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(state) = State::from_ffi(state) else {
        return;
    };
    handle.tokenizer.switch_to(state);
}

/// Get the tokenizer input that has not been consumed yet.

    handle: Option<&mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle>,
    out_ptr: Option<&mut *const u16>,

}

//! Finds a document's encoding declaration before the HTML parser starts, by tokenizing the document's first bytes as
//! the parser will: the prescan proposed in https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/6962.

use crate::code_units::RustFfiHtmlUtf16View;
use crate::known_names::attribute_name;
use crate::known_names::tag_name;
use crate::preload_scanner::tokenizer_state_after_start_tag;
use crate::token::Attribute;
use crate::token::HtmlName;
use crate::token::KnownName;
use crate::token::TokenPayload;
use crate::token::TokenType;
use crate::tokenizer::HtmlTokenizer;
use ak::Utf16View;
use std::ffi::c_void;

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult {
    /// The bytes so far hold no declaration, but the bytes still to come may.
    NeedMoreInput = 0,
    /// A declaration names an encoding.
    Found = 1,
    /// No declaration can still come.
    NotFound = 2,
}

/// How many bytes the scan covers even once the head has ended: It looks at every token that ends in them.
const UNCONDITIONAL_SCAN_LENGTH: usize = 1024;

/// Tokenizes a document's bytes as they arrive, as the HTML parser will, and finds the first meta element that the tree
/// builder would take as an encoding declaration: one with a charset attribute, or an http-equiv of Content-Type and a
/// content attribute. It looks at every token in the first 1024 bytes, and past them for as long as the head can still
/// hold a declaration: until the tree builder would leave the head, or start a template.
pub struct MetaCharsetScanner {
    tokenizer: HtmlTokenizer,
    scripting_enabled: bool,
    // Whether the tokenizer is in an element whose contents are text, which ends with its end tag.
    in_text_element: bool,
    // Whether the tree builder is in a noscript element in the head, with scripting disabled: in its "in head noscript"
    // insertion mode.
    in_head_noscript: bool,
    // Whether the tree builder is in a frameset, which ignores a meta element.
    in_frameset: bool,
    // Whether the tree builder has left the head, or started a template: what ends the scan past the first 1024 bytes.
    head_ended: bool,
    // The document offset of the tokenizer's input, which the scanner drops once the tokenizer has consumed it.
    input_offset: usize,
    finished: bool,
}

impl MetaCharsetScanner {
    pub fn new(scripting_enabled: bool) -> Self {
        // The bytes arrive in pieces, so the end of the ones so far isn't the end of the input until the caller says so.
        let mut tokenizer = HtmlTokenizer::new(Vec::<u8>::new());
        tokenizer.set_input_stream_closed(false);
        Self {
            tokenizer,
            scripting_enabled,
            in_text_element: false,
            in_head_noscript: false,
            in_frameset: false,
            head_ended: false,
            input_offset: 0,
            finished: false,
        }
    }

    /// Scans the bytes that arrived since the last call. `is_encoding` tells whether an attribute's value names an
    /// encoding: a charset attribute's value, or a content attribute's (marked as such).
    pub fn scan(
        &mut self,
        bytes: &[u8],
        input_complete: bool,
        mut is_encoding: impl FnMut(Utf16View<'_>, bool) -> bool,
    ) -> RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult {
        if self.finished {
            return RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound;
        }
        // Bytes before a declaration only ever matter as ASCII, which every encoding a declaration can name reads the
        // same way, so reading them as Latin-1 tokenizes them as the parser will.
        self.tokenizer.append_input(Utf16View::Latin1(bytes));
        if input_complete {
            self.tokenizer.set_input_stream_closed(true);
        }

        while !self.past_the_scan() {
            let Some(token) = self.tokenizer.next_token(false, false) else {
                break;
            };
            if self.past_the_scan() {
                break;
            }
            let ends_head = match token.token_type {
                TokenType::StartTag => {
                    let name = token.tag_name();
                    if *name == tag_name!("meta")
                        && !self.in_frameset
                        && let TokenPayload::Tag { attributes, .. } = &token.payload
                        && declares_encoding(attributes, &mut is_encoding)
                    {
                        self.finished = true;
                        return RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found;
                    }
                    if *name == tag_name!("frameset") {
                        self.in_frameset = true;
                    }
                    // The tree builder switches the tokenizer out of the data state for these elements, so their
                    // contents are text rather than markup.
                    if let Some(state) = tokenizer_state_after_start_tag(name, self.scripting_enabled) {
                        self.tokenizer.switch_to(state);
                        self.in_text_element = true;
                    }
                    if self.in_head_noscript && *name != tag_name!("head") && *name != tag_name!("noscript") {
                        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inheadnoscript
                        // The tree builder handles these in the noscript, ignores head and noscript there, and for
                        // anything else leaves the noscript and handles the tag in the head.
                        if !start_tag_keeps_head_noscript_open(name) {
                            self.in_head_noscript = false;
                        }
                    } else if *name == tag_name!("noscript") && !self.scripting_enabled && !self.head_ended {
                        self.in_head_noscript = true;
                    }
                    !self.in_head_noscript && !start_tag_keeps_head_open(name)
                }
                TokenType::EndTag => {
                    self.in_text_element = false;
                    let name = token.tag_name();
                    if self.in_head_noscript {
                        // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inheadnoscript
                        // The tree builder goes back to the head after this noscript, leaves the head at a br, and
                        // ignores any other end tag.
                        if *name == tag_name!("noscript") {
                            self.in_head_noscript = false;
                        }
                        *name == tag_name!("br")
                    } else {
                        end_tag_ends_head(name)
                    }
                }
                // Text that isn't whitespace has the tree builder leave the head, unless it's an element's contents.
                TokenType::Character => !self.in_text_element && !is_html_whitespace(token.code_point),
                TokenType::EndOfFile => break,
                _ => false,
            };
            if ends_head {
                self.head_ended = true;
            }
        }

        if input_complete || self.past_the_scan() {
            self.finished = true;
            return RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound;
        }

        // Drop the input the tokenizer has consumed, which it does only once it has consumed all of it.
        let consumed = self.tokenizer.current_offset;
        self.tokenizer.parser_did_run();
        if self.tokenizer.current_offset == 0 {
            self.input_offset += consumed;
        }
        RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NeedMoreInput
    }

    // Whether the tokenizer has gone past the first 1024 bytes once the head has ended.
    fn past_the_scan(&self) -> bool {
        self.head_ended && self.input_offset + self.tokenizer.current_offset > UNCONDITIONAL_SCAN_LENGTH
    }
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inhead (a start tag whose tag name is "meta")
fn declares_encoding(attributes: &[Attribute], is_encoding: &mut impl FnMut(Utf16View<'_>, bool) -> bool) -> bool {
    // If the element has a charset attribute, and getting an encoding from its value results in an encoding, ...
    if let Some(charset) = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("charset"))
        && is_encoding(charset, false)
    {
        return true;
    }
    // Otherwise, if the element has an http-equiv attribute whose value is an ASCII case-insensitive match for the
    // string "Content-Type", and the element has a content attribute, and applying the algorithm for extracting a
    // character encoding from a meta element to that attribute's value returns an encoding, ...
    let Some(http_equiv) = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("http-equiv")) else {
        return false;
    };
    if !http_equiv.eq_ignore_ascii_case("content-type") {
        return false;
    }
    attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("content")).is_some_and(|content| is_encoding(content, true))
}

fn attribute_value(attributes: &[Attribute], name: KnownName) -> Option<Utf16View<'_>> {
    attributes
        .iter()
        .find(|attribute| attribute.local_name == name)
        .map(|attribute| attribute.value.as_slice())
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inhead
/// Whether the head can still be open after a start tag with this name: whether the tree builder handles it in the head.
/// It handles template there too, but a template ends the scan.
fn start_tag_keeps_head_open(name: &HtmlName) -> bool {
    *name == tag_name!("html")
        || *name == tag_name!("head")
        || *name == tag_name!("base")
        || *name == tag_name!("basefont")
        || *name == tag_name!("bgsound")
        || *name == tag_name!("link")
        || *name == tag_name!("meta")
        || *name == tag_name!("noframes")
        || *name == tag_name!("noscript")
        || *name == tag_name!("script")
        || *name == tag_name!("style")
        || *name == tag_name!("title")
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inheadnoscript
/// Whether the head can still be open after a start tag with this name, in a noscript element in the head with
/// scripting disabled.
fn start_tag_keeps_head_noscript_open(name: &HtmlName) -> bool {
    *name == tag_name!("html")
        || *name == tag_name!("basefont")
        || *name == tag_name!("bgsound")
        || *name == tag_name!("link")
        || *name == tag_name!("meta")
        || *name == tag_name!("noframes")
        || *name == tag_name!("style")
}

/// Whether an end tag with this name has the tree builder leave the head. It ignores any other end tag there.
fn end_tag_ends_head(name: &HtmlName) -> bool {
    *name == tag_name!("head") || *name == tag_name!("body") || *name == tag_name!("html") || *name == tag_name!("br")
}

fn is_html_whitespace(code_point: u32) -> bool {
    matches!(code_point, 0x09 | 0x0A | 0x0C | 0x0D | 0x20)
}

/// Creates a scanner, for rust_html_meta_charset_scanner_scan().
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_meta_charset_scanner_create(scripting_enabled: bool) -> *mut MetaCharsetScanner {
    Box::into_raw(Box::new(MetaCharsetScanner::new(scripting_enabled)))
}

/// Destroys a scanner.
///
/// # Safety
/// `scanner` must be a valid pointer from `rust_html_meta_charset_scanner_create`, and must not be used after this
/// call.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_html_meta_charset_scanner_destroy(scanner: *mut MetaCharsetScanner) {
    if !scanner.is_null() {
        drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(scanner) });
    }
}

/// Scans the document bytes that arrived since the last call.
///
/// # Safety
/// `scanner` must be a valid pointer from `rust_html_meta_charset_scanner_create`. `is_encoding` must not retain the
/// value pointer beyond the callback invocation.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_html_meta_charset_scanner_scan(
    scanner: *mut MetaCharsetScanner,
    input: ak::Span<'_, u8>,
    input_complete: bool,
    ctx: *mut c_void,
    is_encoding: unsafe extern "C" fn(ctx: *mut c_void, value: RustFfiHtmlUtf16View, is_content: bool) -> bool,
) -> RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult {
    let scanner = unsafe { &mut *scanner };
    scanner.scan(input.as_slice(), input_complete, |value, is_content| unsafe {
        is_encoding(ctx, value.into(), is_content)
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn is_utf8(value: Utf16View<'_>, _: bool) -> bool {
        String::from_utf16_lossy(&value.to_utf16())
            .to_ascii_lowercase()
            .contains("utf-8")
    }

    fn scan_all(input: &[u8]) -> RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult {
        MetaCharsetScanner::new(true).scan(input, true, is_utf8)
    }

    fn padding() -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut padding = b"<!--".to_vec();
        padding.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(b'a', 1500));
        padding.extend(b"-->");
        padding
    }

    #[test]
    fn finds_a_declaration_after_the_first_kilobyte_in_the_head() {
        let mut input = b"<!DOCTYPE html><head>".to_vec();
        input.extend(padding());
        input.extend(b"<title>caf\xe9</title><meta charset=\"utf-8\"></head>");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found);
    }

    #[test]
    fn finds_an_http_equiv_declaration() {
        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"<meta http-equiv=\"Content-Type\" content=\"text/html; charset=utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ignores_a_declaration_after_the_head_ended() {
        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"<p>text</p><meta charset=\"utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ignores_markup_in_script_style_and_title_text() {
        for (open, close) in [
            ("<script>", "</script>"),
            ("<style>", "</style>"),
            ("<title>", "</title>"),
        ] {
            let mut input = padding();
            input.extend(format!("{open}'<meta charset=\"utf-8\">'{close}</head><body>").bytes());
            assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound, "{open}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn text_ends_the_head_but_text_in_the_head_does_not() {
        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"text<meta charset=\"utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound);

        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b" \n<title>text</title><script>text</script><meta charset=\"utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found);
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_tags_the_head_can_hold_keep_it_open() {
        let head_tags = "<basefont><bgsound><noframes>'<p>'</noframes><link><base>";
        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(format!("{head_tags}<meta charset=\"utf-8\">").bytes());
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found);

        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"<object></object><meta charset=\"utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound);
    }

    #[test]
    fn noscript_with_scripting_disabled_has_rules_of_its_own() {
        let scan_without_scripting = |input: &[u8]| MetaCharsetScanner::new(false).scan(input, true, is_utf8);

        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"<noscript><link></head></body></html></noscript><meta charset=\"utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_without_scripting(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found);

        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"<noscript><meta charset=\"utf-8\"></noscript>");
        assert_eq!(scan_without_scripting(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found);

        // A start tag the noscript can't hold ends it, but not the head, if the head can hold it.
        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"<noscript><title>title</title><meta charset=\"utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_without_scripting(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found);

        for leaves_head in ["<noscript></br>", "<noscript><p>", "<noscript>text"] {
            let mut input = padding();
            input.extend(format!("{leaves_head}<meta charset=\"utf-8\">").bytes());
            assert_eq!(
                scan_without_scripting(&input),
                RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound,
                "{leaves_head}"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_some_end_tags_end_the_head() {
        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"</bogus></p><meta charset=\"utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found);

        for end_tag in ["</head>", "</body>", "</html>", "</br>"] {
            let mut input = padding();
            input.extend(format!("{end_tag}<meta charset=\"utf-8\">").bytes());
            assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound, "{end_tag}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn counts_a_declaration_anywhere_in_the_first_kilobyte() {
        assert_eq!(
            scan_all(b"<p>text</p><meta charset=\"utf-8\">"),
            RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found
        );
        assert_eq!(
            scan_all(b"<template><meta charset=\"utf-8\"></template>"),
            RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn ignores_a_tag_that_ends_past_the_first_kilobyte_after_the_head() {
        let mut input = b"<body><meta data-padding=\"".to_vec();
        input.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(b'a', 2000));
        input.extend(b"\" charset=\"utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound);
    }

    #[test]
    fn stops_inside_a_comment_once_the_head_ended_past_the_first_kilobyte() {
        let mut input = b"<body><!--".to_vec();
        input.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(b'a', 1500));
        assert_eq!(
            MetaCharsetScanner::new(true).scan(&input, false, is_utf8),
            RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_template_ends_the_scan_past_the_first_kilobyte() {
        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"<template></template><meta charset=\"utf-8\">");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound);
    }

    #[test]
    fn stops_without_more_input_once_the_head_ended_past_the_first_kilobyte() {
        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"<p>");
        assert_eq!(
            MetaCharsetScanner::new(true).scan(&input, false, is_utf8),
            RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn keeps_the_document_offset_across_scans() {
        // Each scan drops the input the tokenizer has consumed, but the 1024-byte boundary stays where it is.
        let mut comment = b"<!--".to_vec();
        comment.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(b'a', 400));
        comment.extend(b"-->");
        let mut scanner = MetaCharsetScanner::new(true);
        for _ in 0..3 {
            assert_eq!(
                scanner.scan(&comment, false, is_utf8),
                RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NeedMoreInput
            );
        }
        assert_eq!(
            scanner.scan(b"<p>", false, is_utf8),
            RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_frameset_holds_no_declaration() {
        let mut input = b"<!DOCTYPE html><frameset><meta data-padding=\"".to_vec();
        input.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(b'a', 2000));
        input.extend(b"\" charset=\"utf-8\"></frameset>");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ignores_a_declaration_that_names_no_encoding() {
        let mut input = padding();
        input.extend(b"<meta charset=\"bogus\"></head><body>");
        assert_eq!(scan_all(&input), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound);
    }

    #[test]
    fn waits_for_more_input_in_the_head() {
        let mut scanner = MetaCharsetScanner::new(true);
        assert_eq!(
            scanner.scan(&padding(), false, is_utf8),
            RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NeedMoreInput
        );
        // A tag that hasn't ended yet doesn't count, until it does.
        assert_eq!(
            scanner.scan(b"<meta charset=\"utf-8\"", false, is_utf8),
            RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NeedMoreInput
        );
        assert_eq!(scanner.scan(b">", false, is_utf8), RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found);
    }

    #[test]
    fn resumes_inside_a_comment() {
        for (after_comment, expected) in [
            (
                "<title>title</title><meta charset=\"utf-8\">",
                RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::Found,
            ),
            (
                "<p>text</p><meta charset=\"utf-8\">",
                RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound,
            ),
            (
                "<script>var markup = '<meta charset=\"utf-8\">';</script><p>",
                RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound,
            ),
        ] {
            let mut input = b"<!DOCTYPE html><!-- ".to_vec();
            input.extend("padding ".repeat(95).bytes());
            input.extend(b"caf\xe9 ");
            input.extend("padding ".repeat(250).bytes());
            input.extend(b"-->");
            input.extend(after_comment.bytes());
            let split = 1800;
            let mut scanner = MetaCharsetScanner::new(true);
            assert_eq!(
                scanner.scan(&input[..split], false, is_utf8),
                RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NeedMoreInput
            );
            assert_eq!(
                scanner.scan(&input[split..], true, is_utf8),
                expected,
                "{after_comment}"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_unfinished_tag_at_the_end_of_the_input_does_not_count() {
        let mut scanner = MetaCharsetScanner::new(true);
        assert_eq!(
            scanner.scan(&padding(), false, is_utf8),
            RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NeedMoreInput
        );
        assert_eq!(
            scanner.scan(b"<meta charset=\"utf-8\"", true, is_utf8),
            RustFfiMetaCharsetScanResult::NotFound
        );
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
struct OwnedAttribute {
    local_name: HtmlName,
    prefix: Option<CodeUnits>,
    namespace_: RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace,
    value: CodeUnits,
}

/// The attributes a tag token had, kept for as long as an element made of it can be made again. Every copy shares
/// them, and a tag without attributes keeps nothing.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
struct OwnedAttributes(Option<std::rc::Rc<[OwnedAttribute]>>);

impl From<Vec<OwnedAttribute>> for OwnedAttributes {
    fn from(attributes: Vec<OwnedAttribute>) -> Self {
        Self((!attributes.is_empty()).then(|| attributes.into()))
    }
}

impl std::ops::Deref for OwnedAttributes {
    type Target = [OwnedAttribute];

    fn deref(&self) -> &[OwnedAttribute] {
        self.0.as_deref().unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct StackNode {
    handle: usize,
    local_name: HtmlName,
    namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace,
    namespace_uri: Option<Vec<u16>>,
    attributes: OwnedAttributes,
    template_content: Option<usize>,
}

fn requires_element_popped_callback(node: &StackNode) -> bool {
    node.local_name == tag_name!("style")
        || (node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html && node.local_name == tag_name!("option"))
}

trait HtmlNameMatcher {
    fn matches(&self, name: &HtmlName) -> bool;
}

impl HtmlNameMatcher for str {
    fn matches(&self, name: &HtmlName) -> bool {
        name.equals(self)
    }
}

impl HtmlNameMatcher for &str {
    fn matches(&self, name: &HtmlName) -> bool {
        name.equals(self)
    }
}

impl HtmlNameMatcher for HtmlName {
    fn matches(&self, name: &HtmlName) -> bool {
        self == name
    }
}

impl HtmlNameMatcher for &HtmlName {
    fn matches(&self, name: &HtmlName) -> bool {
        *self == name
    }
}

impl HtmlNameMatcher for KnownName {
    fn matches(&self, name: &HtmlName) -> bool {
        name == self
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct AdjustedInsertionLocation {
    parent: usize,
    offset: usize,
}

const APPEND_CHILD_OFFSET: usize = usize::MAX;

struct FragmentParsingContext {
    root: usize,
    root_insertion_target: usize,
    context_element: StackNode,
    document_quirks_mode: RustFfiHtmlQuirksMode,
    allow_declarative_shadow_roots: bool,
    form_element: usize,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct ActiveFormattingElement {
    handle: usize,
    local_name: HtmlName,
    attributes: OwnedAttributes,
    is_marker: bool,
}

struct ParserState {
    stack_of_open_elements: Vec<StackNode>,
    list_of_active_formatting_elements: Vec<ActiveFormattingElement>,
    stack_of_template_insertion_modes: Vec<InsertionMode>,
    insertion_mode: InsertionMode,
    original_insertion_mode: InsertionMode,
    document_quirks_mode: RustFfiHtmlQuirksMode,
    head_element: Option<usize>,
    form_element: Option<usize>,
    parsing_fragment: bool,
    root_insertion_target: usize,
    context_element: Option<StackNode>,
    allow_declarative_shadow_roots: bool,
    scripting_enabled: bool,
    next_line_feed_can_be_ignored: bool,
    pending_text: PendingText,
    attribute_buffers: AttributeBuffers,
    pending_table_text: Vec<u32>,
    pending_table_text_contains_non_whitespace: bool,
    pending_script: Option<usize>,
    pending_svg_script: Option<usize>,
    parser_pause_requested: bool,
    foster_parenting_enabled: bool,
    frameset_ok: bool,
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parser-sanitizer-configuration
    // NB: The configuration itself lives on the C++ side. These record whether it is non-null and whether it allows
    //     comments.
    sanitizing: bool,
    sanitizer_allows_comments: bool,
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#insertion-target-redirection-map
    // NB: The entry for the root element of the HTML fragment parsing algorithm is represented by root_insertion_target.
    insertion_target_redirection_map: HashMap<usize, RedirectedInsertionLocation>,
}

impl ParserState {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            stack_of_open_elements: Vec::new(),
            list_of_active_formatting_elements: Vec::new(),
            stack_of_template_insertion_modes: Vec::new(),
            insertion_mode: InsertionMode::Initial,
            original_insertion_mode: InsertionMode::Initial,
            document_quirks_mode: RustFfiHtmlQuirksMode::No,
            head_element: None,
            form_element: None,
            parsing_fragment: false,
            root_insertion_target: 0,
            context_element: None,
            allow_declarative_shadow_roots: false,
            scripting_enabled: true,
            next_line_feed_can_be_ignored: false,
            pending_text: PendingText::default(),
            attribute_buffers: AttributeBuffers::default(),
            pending_table_text: Vec::new(),
            pending_table_text_contains_non_whitespace: false,
            pending_script: None,
            pending_svg_script: None,
            parser_pause_requested: false,
            foster_parenting_enabled: false,
            frameset_ok: true,
            sanitizing: false,
            sanitizer_allows_comments: false,
            insertion_target_redirection_map: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-html-fragments
    fn begin_fragment(&mut self, fragment_context: FragmentParsingContext) {
        let context_namespace = fragment_context.context_element.namespace_;
        let context_local_name = fragment_context.context_element.local_name.clone();
        *self = Self::new();
        self.parsing_fragment = true;
        self.root_insertion_target = fragment_context.root_insertion_target;
        self.document_quirks_mode = fragment_context.document_quirks_mode;
        self.allow_declarative_shadow_roots = fragment_context.allow_declarative_shadow_roots;
        self.context_element = Some(fragment_context.context_element);

        // 13. Set up the HTML parser's stack of open elements so that it contains just the single element root.
        self.stack_of_open_elements.push(StackNode {
            handle: fragment_context.root,
            local_name: HtmlName::from_utf8("html"),
            namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html,
            namespace_uri: None,
            attributes: OwnedAttributes::default(),
            template_content: None,
        });
        if fragment_context.form_element != 0 {
            self.form_element = Some(fragment_context.form_element);
        }
        // 16. If context is a template element, then push "in template" onto the stack of template insertion modes
        //     so that it is the new current template insertion mode.
        if context_namespace == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html && context_local_name == tag_name!("template") {
            self.stack_of_template_insertion_modes.push(InsertionMode::InTemplate);
        }
        // 17. Create a start tag token whose name is the local name of context and whose attributes are the attributes
        //     of context.
        //     Let this start tag token be the start tag token of context; e.g. for the purposes of determining if it is
        //     an HTML integration point.
        // NB: The synthetic context token is represented by ParserState::context_element.

        // 18. Reset the parser's insertion mode appropriately.
        self.reset_the_insertion_mode_appropriately();
        self.original_insertion_mode = self.insertion_mode;
    }

    fn visit_edges(&self, visitor: *mut c_void) {
        for node in &self.stack_of_open_elements {
            visit_node(visitor, node.handle);
            if let Some(template_content) = node.template_content {
                visit_node(visitor, template_content);
            }
        }

        for element in &self.list_of_active_formatting_elements {
            visit_node(visitor, element.handle);
        }

        visit_node(visitor, self.head_element.unwrap_or(0));
        visit_node(visitor, self.form_element.unwrap_or(0));
        visit_node(visitor, self.root_insertion_target);
        if let Some(context_element) = &self.context_element {
            visit_node(visitor, context_element.handle);
        }
        visit_node(visitor, self.pending_script.unwrap_or(0));
        visit_node(visitor, self.pending_svg_script.unwrap_or(0));
        for (element, location) in &self.insertion_target_redirection_map {
            visit_node(visitor, *element);
            visit_node(visitor, location.parent);
            visit_node(visitor, location.reference_child);
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately
    fn reset_the_insertion_mode_appropriately(&mut self) {
        let mut last = false;

        for index in (0..self.stack_of_open_elements.len()).rev() {
            if index == 0 {
                last = true;
            }

            let node = if last && self.parsing_fragment {
                self.context_element
                    .as_ref()
                    .unwrap_or(&self.stack_of_open_elements[index])
            } else {
                &self.stack_of_open_elements[index]
            };

            if node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html {
                if !last && node.local_name.is_one_of(&[tag_name!("td"), tag_name!("th")]) {
                    self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InCell;
                    return;
                }

                if node.local_name == tag_name!("tr") {
                    self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InRow;
                    return;
                }

                if node
                    .local_name
                    .is_one_of(&[tag_name!("tbody"), tag_name!("thead"), tag_name!("tfoot")])
                {
                    self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InTableBody;
                    return;
                }

                if node.local_name == tag_name!("caption") {
                    self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InCaption;
                    return;
                }

                if node.local_name == tag_name!("colgroup") {
                    self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InColumnGroup;
                    return;
                }

                if node.local_name == tag_name!("table") {
                    self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InTable;
                    return;
                }

                if node.local_name == tag_name!("template") {
                    self.insertion_mode = self
                        .stack_of_template_insertion_modes
                        .last()
                        .copied()
                        .unwrap_or(InsertionMode::InTemplate);
                    return;
                }

                if !last && node.local_name == tag_name!("head") {
                    self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InHead;
                    return;
                }

                if node.local_name == tag_name!("body") {
                    self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InBody;
                    return;
                }

                if node.local_name == tag_name!("frameset") {
                    self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InFrameset;
                    return;
                }

                if node.local_name == tag_name!("html") {
                    if self.head_element.is_none() {
                        self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::BeforeHead;
                    } else {
                        self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::AfterHead;
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }

            if last {
                self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InBody;
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}

fn visit_node(visitor: *mut c_void, node: usize) {
    if node != 0 {
        unsafe { ladybird_html_parser_visit_node(visitor, node) };
    }
}

struct TreeBuilder {
    tokenizer: NonNull<HtmlTokenizer>,
    host: *mut c_void,
    state: NonNull<ParserState>,
    log_parse_errors: bool,
}

impl Deref for TreeBuilder {
    type Target = ParserState;

    fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target {
        // SAFETY: TreeBuilder is only constructed with a ParserState pointer owned by the
        // C++ HTMLParser handle, and the handle outlives each parser run.
        unsafe { self.state.as_ref() }
    }
}

impl DerefMut for TreeBuilder {
    fn deref_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Self::Target {
        // SAFETY: TreeBuilder is only constructed with a ParserState pointer owned by the
        // C++ HTMLParser handle, and the handle outlives each parser run.
        unsafe { self.state.as_mut() }
    }
}

impl TreeBuilder {
    fn new(tokenizer: NonNull<HtmlTokenizer>, host: *mut c_void, state: NonNull<ParserState>) -> Self {
        let log_parse_errors = unsafe { ladybird_html_parser_parse_errors_enabled() };
        Self {
            tokenizer,
            host,
            state,
            log_parse_errors,
        }
    }

    fn next_token(&mut self, token: &mut Token, stop_at_insertion_point: bool, cdata_allowed: bool) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: TreeBuilder is only constructed with a tokenizer pointer owned by the C++
        // HTMLParser's Rust tokenizer handle, and the handle outlives each parser run.
        unsafe {
            let tokenizer = self.tokenizer.as_mut();
            if !stop_at_insertion_point && let Some(code_point) = tokenizer.try_fast_data_char() {
                *token = Token::new_character(code_point);
                return true;
            }
            tokenizer.next_token_into(token, stop_at_insertion_point, cdata_allowed)
        }
    }

    fn source_line_number_for_script_token(&mut self, token: &Token) -> usize {
        // SAFETY: TreeBuilder is only constructed with a tokenizer pointer owned by the C++
        // HTMLParser's Rust tokenizer handle, and the handle outlives each parser run.
        let end_position = unsafe { self.tokenizer.as_mut().position_at(token.end_offset) };
        end_position.line.saturating_add(1).min(usize::MAX as u64) as usize
    }

    fn switch_tokenizer_to(&mut self, state: State) {
        // SAFETY: TreeBuilder is only constructed with a tokenizer pointer owned by the C++
        // HTMLParser's Rust tokenizer handle, and the handle outlives each parser run.
        unsafe { self.tokenizer.as_mut().switch_to(state) };
    }

    fn run(&mut self, stop_at_insertion_point: bool) {
        // NB: The tokenizer puts every token here, and the rules below read it where it is.
        let mut token = Token::default();
        loop {
            if !stop_at_insertion_point
                && !self.next_line_feed_can_be_ignored
                && self.insertion_mode == InsertionMode::InBody
                && self
                    .adjusted_current_node()
                    .is_some_and(|node| node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html)
            {
                // SAFETY: TreeBuilder is only constructed with a tokenizer pointer owned by the
                // C++ HTMLParser's Rust tokenizer handle, and the handle outlives each parser run.
                let has_fast_data_run = unsafe { self.tokenizer.as_ref().has_fast_data_run() };
                if has_fast_data_run {
                    self.reconstruct_the_active_formatting_elements();
                    // SAFETY: See above.
                    // FIXME: Recheck the tokenizer state after reconstruction; custom element reactions can abort
                    //        the parser, invalidating the previously available Data-state run.
                    let run = unsafe { self.tokenizer.as_mut().try_fast_data_run().unwrap() };
                    // SAFETY: See above.
                    let input = unsafe { &self.tokenizer.as_ref().input };
                    if self.frameset_ok && contains_non_whitespace(input.slice(run.range.clone())) {
                        self.frameset_ok = false;
                    }
                    self.pending_text.push_input_run(run, input);
                    continue;
                }
            }

            // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-incdata
            // OPTIMIZATION: Text of a script, a style element and the like is inserted a run of input at a time, which
            //               is what "insert the token's character" does for each character of it.
            if !stop_at_insertion_point
                && !self.next_line_feed_can_be_ignored
                && self.insertion_mode == InsertionMode::Text
                && self
                    .adjusted_current_node()
                    .is_some_and(|node| node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html)
            {
                // SAFETY: See above.
                if let Some(run) = unsafe { self.tokenizer.as_mut().try_fast_element_text_run() } {
                    // SAFETY: See above.
                    let input = unsafe { &self.tokenizer.as_ref().input };
                    self.pending_text.push_input_run(run, input);
                    continue;
                }
            }

            let cdata_allowed = self
                .adjusted_current_node()
                .is_some_and(|node| node.namespace_ != RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html);
            if !self.next_token(&mut token, stop_at_insertion_point, cdata_allowed) {
                break;
            }
            if self.next_line_feed_can_be_ignored {
                self.next_line_feed_can_be_ignored = false;
                if token.token_type == TokenType::Character && token.code_point == '\n' as u32 {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            let is_character = token.token_type == TokenType::Character;
            if !is_character {
                self.flush_character_insertions();
            }
            let is_eof = token.token_type == TokenType::EndOfFile;
            if self.should_process_token_using_html_rules(&token) {
                self.process_using_the_rules_for(self.insertion_mode, &mut token);
            } else {
                self.process_using_the_rules_for_foreign_content(&mut token);
            }
            if self.pending_script.is_some() || self.pending_svg_script.is_some() || self.parser_pause_requested {
                break;
            }
            if is_eof {
                break;
            }
        }
        self.flush_character_insertions();
    }

    fn process_using_the_rules_for(&mut self, mode: InsertionMode, token: &mut Token) {
        match mode {
            InsertionMode::Initial => self.handle_initial(token),
            InsertionMode::BeforeHtml => self.handle_before_html(token),
            InsertionMode::BeforeHead => self.handle_before_head(token),
            InsertionMode::InHead => self.handle_in_head(token),
            InsertionMode::InHeadNoscript => self.handle_in_head_noscript(token),
            InsertionMode::AfterHead => self.handle_after_head(token),
            InsertionMode::InBody => self.handle_in_body(token),
            InsertionMode::Text => self.handle_text(token),
            InsertionMode::InTemplate => self.handle_in_template(token),
            InsertionMode::InTableText => self.handle_in_table_text(token),
            InsertionMode::InTable => self.handle_in_table(token),
            InsertionMode::InCaption => self.handle_in_caption(token),
            InsertionMode::InColumnGroup => self.handle_in_column_group(token),
            InsertionMode::InTableBody => self.handle_in_table_body(token),
            InsertionMode::InRow => self.handle_in_row(token),
            InsertionMode::InCell => self.handle_in_cell(token),
            InsertionMode::InFrameset => self.handle_in_frameset(token),
            InsertionMode::AfterFrameset => self.handle_after_frameset(token),
            InsertionMode::AfterBody => self.handle_after_body(token),
            InsertionMode::AfterAfterBody => self.handle_after_after_body(token),
            InsertionMode::AfterAfterFrameset => self.handle_after_after_frameset(token),
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#tree-construction-dispatcher
    fn should_process_token_using_html_rules(&self, token: &Token) -> bool {
        if self.stack_of_open_elements.is_empty() || token.token_type == TokenType::EndOfFile {
            return true;
        }

        let Some(adjusted_current_node) = self.adjusted_current_node() else {
            return true;
        };

        if adjusted_current_node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html {
            return true;
        }

        if is_mathml_text_integration_point(adjusted_current_node) {
            if token.is_start_tag() && !token.is_start_tag_one_of(tag_set!["mglyph", "malignmark"]) {
                return true;
            }
            if token.token_type == TokenType::Character {
                return true;
            }
        }

        if adjusted_current_node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::MathMl
            && adjusted_current_node.local_name == tag_name!("annotation-xml")
            && token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("svg"))
        {
            return true;
        }

        if is_html_integration_point(adjusted_current_node)
            && (token.is_start_tag() || token.token_type == TokenType::Character)
        {
            return true;
        }

        false
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#the-initial-insertion-mode
    fn handle_initial(&mut self, token: &mut Token) {
        // -> A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, U+000A LINE FEED (LF),
        //    U+000C FORM FEED (FF), U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN (CR), or U+0020 SPACE
        if token.is_parser_whitespace() {
            return;
        }

        // -> A comment token
        if token.token_type == TokenType::Comment {
            let document = self.document_node();
            self.append_comment_to_node(document, token.comment_data());
            return;
        }

        // -> A DOCTYPE token
        if token.token_type == TokenType::Doctype {
            // If the DOCTYPE token's name is not "html", or the token's public identifier is not missing,
            // or the token's system identifier is neither missing nor "about:legacy-compat", then there is a parse error.
            let doctype = token.doctype_data();
            if doctype.name != "html"
                || !doctype.missing_public_identifier
                || (!doctype.missing_system_identifier && doctype.system_identifier != "about:legacy-compat")
            {
                self.parse_error("unexpected DOCTYPE token");
            }

            // Let doctype be the result of creating a doctype given the Document node, the name given in the DOCTYPE
            // token (or the empty string if the name was missing), the public identifier given in the DOCTYPE token
            // (or the empty string if the public identifier was missing), and the system identifier given in the DOCTYPE
            // token (or the empty string if the system identifier was missing). Then, if the Document node has neither
            // a DocumentType child nor an element child, append doctype to the Document node.
            // FIXME: Check for an existing DocumentType or element child before appending the new doctype.
            fn present(missing: bool, string: &CodeUnits) -> Utf16View<'_> {
                if missing {
                    Utf16View::Latin1(&[])
                } else {
                    string.as_slice()
                }
            }
            let name = present(doctype.missing_name, &doctype.name);
            let public_id = present(doctype.missing_public_identifier, &doctype.public_identifier);
            let system_id = present(doctype.missing_system_identifier, &doctype.system_identifier);
            let document_type = self.create_document_type(name, public_id, system_id);
            let document = self.document_node();
            self.append_child(document, document_type);

            // Then, if the document is not an iframe srcdoc document, and the parser cannot change the mode flag is
            // false, set the Document to quirks or limited-quirks mode where the DOCTYPE token calls for it.
            if !self.document_is_iframe_srcdoc_document() {
                self.set_document_quirks_mode(self.which_quirks_mode(token));
            }
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::BeforeHtml;
            return;
        }

        // -> Anything else
        // If the document is not an iframe srcdoc document, then this is a parse error; if the parser cannot change the
        // mode flag is false, set the Document to quirks mode.
        if !self.document_is_iframe_srcdoc_document() {
            self.parse_error("anything else in initial insertion mode");
            self.set_document_quirks_mode(RustFfiHtmlQuirksMode::Yes);
        }

        // In any case, switch the insertion mode to "before html", then reprocess the token.
        self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::BeforeHtml;
        self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::BeforeHtml, token);
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#the-before-html-insertion-mode
    fn handle_before_html(&mut self, token: &mut Token) {
        // -> A DOCTYPE token
        if token.token_type == TokenType::Doctype {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("DOCTYPE token in before html insertion mode");
            return;
        }

        // -> A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, U+000A LINE FEED (LF),
        //    U+000C FORM FEED (FF), U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN (CR), or U+0020 SPACE
        if token.is_parser_whitespace() {
            return;
        }

        if token.token_type == TokenType::Comment {
            let document = self.document_node();
            self.append_comment_to_node(document, token.comment_data());
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("html")) {
            let document = self.document_node();
            self.insert_html_element_for_document(token, document);
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::BeforeHead;
            return;
        }

        if token.is_end_tag_one_of(tag_set!["head", "body", "html", "br"]) || !token.is_end_tag() {
            let document = self.document_node();
            if let Some(html_element) = self.document_html_element() {
                self.stack_of_open_elements.push(StackNode {
                    handle: html_element,
                    local_name: HtmlName::from_utf8("html"),
                    namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html,
                    namespace_uri: None,
                    attributes: OwnedAttributes::default(),
                    template_content: None,
                });
            } else {
                self.insert_html_element_for_document(&Token::synthetic_start_tag("html"), document);
            }
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::BeforeHead;
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::BeforeHead, token);
            return;
        }

        // -> Any other end tag
        if token.is_end_tag() {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("unexpected end tag in before html insertion mode");
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#the-before-head-insertion-mode
    fn handle_before_head(&mut self, token: &mut Token) {
        // -> A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, U+000A LINE FEED (LF),
        //    U+000C FORM FEED (FF), U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN (CR), or U+0020 SPACE
        if token.is_parser_whitespace() {
            return;
        }

        // -> A DOCTYPE token
        if token.token_type == TokenType::Doctype {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("DOCTYPE token in before head insertion mode");
            return;
        }

        if token.token_type == TokenType::Comment {
            self.insert_comment(token.comment_data(), None);
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("html")) {
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InBody, token);
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("head")) {
            let head = self.insert_html_element_for(token);
            self.head_element = Some(head);
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InHead;
            return;
        }

        if token.is_end_tag_one_of(tag_set!["head", "body", "html", "br"]) || !token.is_end_tag() {
            let head = self.insert_html_element_named("head");
            self.head_element = Some(head);
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InHead;
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InHead, token);
            return;
        }

        // -> Any other end tag
        if token.is_end_tag() {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("unexpected end tag in before head insertion mode");
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inhead
    fn handle_in_head(&mut self, token: &mut Token) {
        // -> A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, U+000A LINE FEED (LF), U+000C FORM FEED (FF),
        //    U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN (CR), or U+0020 SPACE
        if token.is_parser_whitespace() {
            // Insert the character.
            self.insert_character(token.code_point);
            return;
        }

        // -> A comment token
        if token.token_type == TokenType::Comment {
            // Insert a comment.
            self.insert_comment(token.comment_data(), None);
            return;
        }

        // FIXME: -> A processing instruction token
        //     Insert a processing instruction.

        // -> A DOCTYPE token
        if token.token_type == TokenType::Doctype {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("DOCTYPE token in in head insertion mode");
            return;
        }

        // -> A start tag whose tag name is "html"
        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("html")) {
            // Process the token using the rules for the "in body" insertion mode.
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InBody, token);
            return;
        }

        // -> A start tag whose tag name is one of: "base", "basefont", "bgsound", "link"
        if token.is_start_tag_one_of(tag_set!["base", "basefont", "bgsound", "link"]) {
            // Insert an HTML element for the token. Immediately pop the current node off the stack of open elements.
            self.insert_html_element_for(token);
            self.pop_current_node();

            // FIXME: Acknowledge the token's self-closing flag, if it is set.
            return;
        }

        // -> A start tag whose tag name is "meta"
        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("meta")) {
            // Insert an HTML element for the token. Immediately pop the current node off the stack of open elements.
            let element = self.insert_html_element_for(token);
            self.pop_current_node();

            // FIXME: Acknowledge the token's self-closing flag, if it is set.

            unsafe { ladybird_html_parser_process_meta_element(self.host, element) };
            return;
        }

        // -> A start tag whose tag name is "title"
        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("title")) {
            // Follow the generic RCDATA element parsing algorithm.
            self.parse_generic_rcdata_element(token);
            return;
        }

        // -> A start tag whose tag name is "noscript", if scripting mode is not Disabled
        // -> A start tag whose tag name is one of: "noframes", "style"
        if token.is_start_tag_one_of(tag_set!["style", "noframes"])
            || (token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("noscript")) && self.scripting_enabled)
        {
            // Follow the generic raw text element parsing algorithm.
            self.parse_generic_raw_text_element(token);
            return;
        }

        // -> A start tag whose tag name is "noscript", if scripting mode is Disabled
        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("noscript")) && !self.scripting_enabled {
            // Insert an HTML element for the token.
            self.insert_html_element_for(token);

            // Switch the insertion mode to "in head noscript".
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InHeadNoscript;
            return;
        }

        // -> A start tag whose tag name is "script"
        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("script")) {
            // Run these steps:
            //
            // 1. Create an element for the token in the HTML namespace, with the intended parent being the target parent
            //    of the appropriate place for inserting a node.
            // 2. If the scripting mode is not Fragment, then set the element's parser document to the Document and set
            //    its force async to false.
            // NOTE: The Fragment scripting mode treats parser-inserted scripts as if they were not parser-inserted
            //       (so external scripts execute asynchronously), allowing, for example, executing scripts when applying
            //       a fragment created by createContextualFragment().
            // FIXME: Keep force async true in Fragment mode; the C++ element configuration currently clears it.
            // NOTE: Setting force async to false ensures that, if the script is external, any document.write() calls
            //       in the script will execute in-line, instead of blowing the document away, as would happen in most
            //       other cases. It also prevents the script from executing until the end tag is seen.
            // 3. If the parser's scripting mode is Inert, then set the script element's already started to true.
            //    (fragment case)
            // 4. If the parser was invoked via the document.write() or document.writeln() methods, then optionally set
            //    the script element's already started to true. (For example, the user agent might use this clause to
            //    prevent execution of cross-origin scripts inserted via document.write() under slow network conditions,
            //    or when the page has already taken a long time to load.)
            // 5. Insert an element at the adjusted insertion location with the newly created element.
            // 6. Push the newly created element onto the stack of open elements so that it is the new current node.
            // NB: Creation, configuration, insertion, and the stack push are performed by the insertion helper.
            self.insert_html_element_for(token);

            // 7. Switch the tokenizer to the script data state.
            self.switch_tokenizer_to(State::ScriptData);

            // 8. Set the original insertion mode to the current insertion mode.
            self.original_insertion_mode = self.insertion_mode;

            // 9. Switch the insertion mode to "text".
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::Text;
            return;
        }

        // -> An end tag whose tag name is "head"
        if token.is_end_tag_named(tag_id!("head")) {
            // Pop the current node (which will be the head element) off the stack of open elements.
            self.pop_current_node();

            // Switch the insertion mode to "after head".
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::AfterHead;
            return;
        }

        // -> An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "html", "br"
        if token.is_end_tag_one_of(tag_set!["body", "html", "br"]) {
            // Act as described in the "anything else" entry below.
            self.pop_current_node();
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::AfterHead;
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::AfterHead, token);
            return;
        }

        // -> A start tag whose tag name is "template"
        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("template")) {
            self.handle_template_start_tag(token);
            return;
        }

        // -> An end tag whose tag name is "template"
        if token.is_end_tag_named(tag_id!("template")) {
            self.handle_template_end_tag();
            return;
        }

        // -> A start tag whose tag name is "head"
        // -> Any other end tag
        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("head")) || token.is_end_tag() {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("unexpected tag in in head insertion mode");
            return;
        }

        // -> Anything else
        // Pop the current node (which will be the head element) off the stack of open elements.
        self.pop_current_node();

        // Switch the insertion mode to "after head".
        self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::AfterHead;

        // Reprocess the token.
        self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::AfterHead, token);
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inheadnoscript
    fn handle_in_head_noscript(&mut self, token: &mut Token) {
        if token.token_type == TokenType::Doctype {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("DOCTYPE token in in head noscript insertion mode");
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("html")) {
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InBody, token);
            return;
        }

        if token.is_end_tag_named(tag_id!("noscript")) {
            self.pop_current_node();
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InHead;
            return;
        }

        if token.is_parser_whitespace()
            || token.token_type == TokenType::Comment
            || token.is_start_tag_one_of(tag_set!["basefont", "bgsound", "link", "meta", "noframes", "style"])
        {
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InHead, token);
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_one_of(tag_set!["head", "noscript"])
            || (token.is_end_tag() && !token.is_end_tag_named(tag_id!("br")))
        {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("unexpected tag in in head noscript insertion mode");
            return;
        }

        // Parse error.
        self.parse_error("anything else in in head noscript insertion mode");

        // Pop the current node (which will be a noscript element) from the stack of open elements; the new current node will be a head element.
        self.pop_current_node();
        // Switch the insertion mode to "in head".
        self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InHead;
        // Reprocess the token.
        self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InHead, token);
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#the-after-head-insertion-mode
    fn handle_after_head(&mut self, token: &mut Token) {
        if token.is_parser_whitespace() {
            self.insert_character(token.code_point);
            return;
        }

        if token.token_type == TokenType::Comment {
            self.insert_comment(token.comment_data(), None);
            return;
        }

        if token.token_type == TokenType::Doctype {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("DOCTYPE token in after head insertion mode");
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("html")) {
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InBody, token);
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("body")) {
            self.insert_html_element_for(token);
            self.frameset_ok = false;
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InBody;
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("frameset")) {
            self.insert_html_element_for(token);
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InFrameset;
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_one_of(tag_set![
            "base", "basefont", "bgsound", "link", "meta", "noframes", "script", "style", "template", "title"
        ]) {
            // Parse error.
            self.parse_error("head-only start tag in after head insertion mode");
            if let Some(head) = self.head_element {
                self.stack_of_open_elements.push(StackNode {
                    handle: head,
                    local_name: HtmlName::from_utf8("head"),
                    namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html,
                    namespace_uri: None,
                    attributes: OwnedAttributes::default(),
                    template_content: None,
                });
                self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InHead, token);
                self.stack_of_open_elements.retain(|node| node.handle != head);
            }
            return;
        }

        if token.is_end_tag_named(tag_id!("template")) {
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InHead, token);
            return;
        }

        // An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "html", "br"
        if token.is_end_tag_one_of(tag_set!["body", "html", "br"]) {
            // Act as described in the "anything else" entry below.
            // FIXME: Set the frameset-ok flag to "ok" after inserting the implicit body element.
            self.insert_html_element_named("body");
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InBody;
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InBody, token);
            return;
        }

        // A start tag whose tag name is "head"
        // Any other end tag
        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("head")) || token.is_end_tag() {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("unexpected tag in after head insertion mode");
            return;
        }

        // Anything else
        {
            // Insert an HTML element for a "body" start tag token with no attributes.
            self.insert_html_element_named("body");
            // FIXME: Set the frameset-ok flag to "ok".
            // Switch the insertion mode to "in body".
            self.insertion_mode = InsertionMode::InBody;
            // Reprocess the current token.
            self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InBody, token);
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inbody
    fn handle_in_body(&mut self, token: &mut Token) {
        if token.token_type == TokenType::Character {
            if token.code_point == 0 {
                // Parse error. Ignore the token.
                self.parse_error("U+0000 character token in in body insertion mode");
                return;
            }
            self.reconstruct_the_active_formatting_elements();
            self.insert_character(token.code_point);
            if !token.is_parser_whitespace() {
                self.frameset_ok = false;
            }
            return;
        }

        if token.token_type == TokenType::Comment {
            self.insert_comment(token.comment_data(), None);
            return;
        }

        if token.token_type == TokenType::Doctype {
            // Parse error. Ignore the token.
            self.parse_error("DOCTYPE token in in body insertion mode");
            return;
        }

        if token.token_type == TokenType::EndOfFile {
            if !self.stack_of_template_insertion_modes.is_empty() {
                self.process_using_the_rules_for(InsertionMode::InTemplate, token);
                return;
            }
            self.parse_error_if_stack_contains_unexpected_node_at_end_of_body();
            self.stop_parsing();
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("html")) {
            // Parse error.
            self.parse_error("html start tag in in body insertion mode");

            if !self.has_template_element_on_stack_of_open_elements() && !self.stack_of_open_elements.is_empty() {
                let html = self.stack_of_open_elements[0].handle;
                self.add_missing_attributes_to_element(html, token);
            }
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("body")) {
            // Parse error.
            self.parse_error("body start tag in in body insertion mode");

            if self.stack_of_open_elements.len() > 1
                && self.stack_of_open_elements.get(1).is_some_and(|node| {
                    node.local_name == tag_name!("body") && node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html
                })
                && !self.has_template_element_on_stack_of_open_elements()
            {
                let body = self.stack_of_open_elements[1].handle;
                self.add_missing_attributes_to_element(body, token);
                self.frameset_ok = false;
            }
            return;
        }

        if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("frameset")) {
            // Parse error.
            self.parse_error("frameset start tag in in body insertion mode");

            if self.stack_of_open_elements.len() == 1
                || !self.stack_of_open_elements.get(1).is_some_and(|node| {
                    node.local_name == tag_name!("body") && node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html
                })
                || self.has_template_element_on_stack_of_open_elements()
                || !self.frameset_ok
