            // 19. For each replacedElement of pendingRedirects: set the parser's insertion target redirection
            //     map[replacedElement] to (target, refNode).
            for replaced_element in pending_redirects {
                self.set_insertion_target_redirection(replaced_element, adjusted_insertion_location);
            }

            // NB: Steps 20 and 21 implemented on C++ side. Both steps do nothing if lastNode is null.
            if last_node != 0 {
                self.reinsert_last_node_at_insertion_location(adjusted_insertion_location, last_node);
            }

            // 22. Let newElement be the result of creating an element for the token for which formattingElement was
            //     created, in the HTML namespace, with furthestBlock as the intended parent.
            let Some(formatting_element_index) = self
                .list_of_active_formatting_elements
                .iter()
                .position(|entry| entry.handle == formatting_element.handle)
            else {
                return;
            };
            let entry = self.list_of_active_formatting_elements[formatting_element_index].clone();
            let new_element = self.create_html_element_for_active_formatting_element(&entry, furthest_block.handle);

            // FIXME: Perform steps 23 and 24 before the child mutations in step 27.
            // 25. Let sanitizerAction be "Keep".
            // 26. If the parser's parser sanitizer configuration is not null, then set sanitizerAction to the result of
            //     getting the sanitizer action for an element name given newElement's local name, newElement's
            //     namespace, and the parser's parser sanitizer configuration.
            let sanitizer_action = self.sanitizer_action(new_element);

            // 27. Switch on sanitizerAction:
            let furthest_block_location = AdjustedInsertionLocation {
                parent: furthest_block.handle,
                offset: APPEND_CHILD_OFFSET,
            };
            match sanitizer_action {
                // -> "Replace with children"
                //    Set the parser's insertion target redirection map[newElement] to the adjusted insertion location
                //    given (furthestBlock, null).
                SanitizerAction::ReplaceWithChildren => {
                    let location = self.adjusted_insertion_location_for_location(furthest_block_location);
                    self.set_insertion_target_redirection(new_element, location);
                }
                // -> "Remove"
                //    Take all of the child nodes of furthestBlock and append them to newElement.
                SanitizerAction::Remove => self.move_all_children(furthest_block.handle, new_element),
                // -> "Keep"
                SanitizerAction::Keep => {
                    // 1. Take all of the child nodes of furthestBlock and append them to newElement.
                    self.move_all_children(furthest_block.handle, new_element);

                    // 2. Let (newElementParent, newElementRefNode) be the adjusted insertion location given
                    //    (furthestBlock, null).
                    // 3. Insert newElement into newElementParent before newElementRefNode.
                    // NB: Without sanitization, the adjusted insertion location given (furthestBlock, null) is
                    //     (furthestBlock, null).
                    if self.sanitizing {
                        let location = self.adjusted_insertion_location_for_location(furthest_block_location);
                        self.insert_node_at_insertion_location(location, new_element);
                    } else {
                        self.append_child(furthest_block.handle, new_element);
                    }
                }
            }

            // 23. Remove formattingElement from the list of active formatting elements, and insert newElement into the
            //     list of active formatting elements at the position of the aforementioned bookmark.
            if formatting_element_index < bookmark {
                bookmark -= 1;
            }
            self.list_of_active_formatting_elements.remove(formatting_element_index);
            let active_formatting_insertion_index = bookmark.min(self.list_of_active_formatting_elements.len());
            self.list_of_active_formatting_elements.insert(
                active_formatting_insertion_index,
                ActiveFormattingElement {
                    handle: new_element,
                    local_name: entry.local_name.clone(),
                    attributes: entry.attributes.clone(),
                    is_marker: false,
                },
            );

            // 24. Remove formattingElement from the stack of open elements, and insert newElement into the stack of
            //     open elements immediately below the position of furthestBlock in that stack.
            if let Some(formatting_element_stack_index) = self
                .stack_of_open_elements
                .iter()
                .position(|node| node.handle == formatting_element.handle)
            {
                self.stack_of_open_elements.remove(formatting_element_stack_index);
            }
            let Some(furthest_block_stack_index) = self
                .stack_of_open_elements
                .iter()
                .position(|node| node.handle == furthest_block.handle)
            else {
                return;
            };
            self.stack_of_open_elements.insert(
                furthest_block_stack_index + 1,
                StackNode {
                    handle: new_element,
                    local_name: entry.local_name,
                    namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html,
                    namespace_uri: None,
                    attributes: entry.attributes,
                    template_content: None,
                },
            );
            // 28. Let belowNode be the element immediately below newElement in the stack of open elements, if any;
            //     otherwise null.
            // 29. While belowNode is non-null and the parser's insertion target redirection map[belowNode] exists:
            //     1. Set the parser's insertion target redirection map[belowNode] to the adjusted insertion location
            //        given (newElement, null).
            //     2. Set belowNode to the element immediately below belowNode in the stack of open elements, if any;
            //        otherwise null.
            //     NOTE: Elements below furthestBlock in the stack that were replaced with their children now have
            //           newElement between them and furthestBlock. They are usually popped before anything else is
            //           inserted, but if the outer loop reaches its limit they remain on the stack, so their entries are
            //           updated here.
            if !self.insertion_target_redirection_map.is_empty() {
                let new_element_location = AdjustedInsertionLocation {
                    parent: new_element,
                    offset: APPEND_CHILD_OFFSET,
                };
                let mut below_node_index = furthest_block_stack_index + 2;
                while below_node_index < self.stack_of_open_elements.len() {
                    let below_node = self.stack_of_open_elements[below_node_index].handle;
                    if !self.insertion_target_redirection_map.contains_key(&below_node) {
                        break;
                    }
                    let location = self.adjusted_insertion_location_for_location(new_element_location);
                    self.set_insertion_target_redirection(below_node, location);
                    below_node_index += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inbody
    fn process_any_other_end_tag(&mut self, tag_name: impl HtmlNameMatcher + Copy) {
        // Run these steps:
        for index in (0..self.stack_of_open_elements.len()).rev() {
            let node = &self.stack_of_open_elements[index];
            // 1. Initialize node to be the current node (the bottommost node of the stack).
            // 2. If node is an HTML element with the same tag name as the token, then:
            if tag_name.matches(&node.local_name) {
                let node_handle = node.handle;
                // 1. Generate implied end tags, except for HTML elements with the same tag name as the token.
                self.generate_implied_end_tags_except(tag_name);
                // 2. If node is not the current node, then this is a parse error.
                if self.current_node_handle() != node_handle {
                    self.parse_error("matching node is not current node for any other end tag");
                }
                // 3. Pop all the nodes from the current node up to node, including node.
                while self
                    .stack_of_open_elements
                    .last()
                    .is_some_and(|current_node| current_node.handle != node_handle)
                {
                    self.pop_stack_node();
                }
                if self
                    .stack_of_open_elements
                    .last()
                    .is_some_and(|current_node| current_node.handle == node_handle)
                {
                    self.pop_stack_node();
                }
                return;
            }

            // 3. Otherwise, if node is in the special category, then this is a parse error; return.
            if is_special_tag(node) {
                self.parse_error("special element reached while processing any other end tag");
                return;
            }
            // 4. Set node to the previous entry in the stack of open elements.
        }
    }

    fn remove_active_formatting_element(&mut self, handle: usize) {
        self.list_of_active_formatting_elements
            .retain(|entry| entry.handle != handle);
    }
}

/// The text of the character tokens that haven't been inserted yet.
#[derive(Default)]
struct PendingText {
    /// The run of tokenizer input that is all of the text, for as long as the text is exactly that. The run doesn't
    /// outlive a parser run, so the input can't change under it.
    input_run: Option<InputRun>,
    /// The text, once it is anything other than a single run of input.
    code_units: Vec<u16>,
}

impl PendingText {
    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.input_run.is_none() && self.code_units.is_empty()
    }

    fn push_code_point(&mut self, code_point: u32, input: &CodeUnits) {
        let Some(character) = char::from_u32(code_point) else {
            return;
        };
        self.copy_input_run(input);
        self.code_units.extend_from_slice(character.encode_utf16(&mut [0; 2]));
    }

    fn push_input_run(&mut self, run: InputRun, input: &CodeUnits) {
        if self.is_empty() {
            self.input_run = Some(run);
            return;
        }
        if let Some(input_run) = &mut self.input_run
            && input_run.range.end == run.range.start
        {
            input_run.range.end = run.range.end;
            input_run.is_ascii &= run.is_ascii;
            return;
        }
        self.copy_input_run(input);
        input.slice(run.range).append_to(&mut self.code_units);
    }

    fn copy_input_run(&mut self, input: &CodeUnits) {
        if let Some(input_run) = self.input_run.take() {
            input.slice(input_run.range).append_to(&mut self.code_units);
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct AttributeBuffers {
    attributes: Vec<RustFfiHtmlParserAttribute>,
    local_names: Vec<HtmlName>,
}

struct AdjustedAttributeName {
    local_name: HtmlName,
    prefix: Option<&'static str>,
    namespace_: RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace,
}

fn owned_attributes_from_token(token: &Token, namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace) -> OwnedAttributes {
    let TokenPayload::Tag {
        attributes: token_attributes,
        ..
    } = &token.payload
    else {
        return OwnedAttributes::default();
    };

    let mut attributes = Vec::with_capacity(token_attributes.len());
    for attribute in token_attributes {
        let adjusted_name = adjusted_foreign_attribute_name(&attribute.local_name, namespace_);
        attributes.push(OwnedAttribute {
            local_name: adjusted_name.local_name,
            prefix: adjusted_name
                .prefix
                .map(|prefix| CodeUnits::from(prefix.as_bytes().to_vec())),
            namespace_: adjusted_name.namespace_,
            value: attribute.value.clone(),
        });
    }
    attributes.into()
}

unsafe fn utf16_string_from_ffi(ptr: *const u16, len: usize) -> Vec<u16> {
    if ptr.is_null() || len == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }

    unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(ptr, len) }.to_vec()
}

unsafe fn utf16_namespace_uri_from_ffi(
    namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace,
    ptr: *const u16,
    len: usize,
) -> Option<Vec<u16>> {
    if namespace_ != RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Other || ptr.is_null() || len == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(unsafe { utf16_string_from_ffi(ptr, len) })
}

unsafe fn owned_context_attributes_from_ffi(
    attributes: *const RustFfiHtmlParserContextAttribute,
    attribute_count: usize,
) -> Vec<OwnedAttribute> {
    if attributes.is_null() || attribute_count == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }

    let attributes = unsafe { ak::slice_from_raw_parts(attributes, attribute_count) };
    attributes
        .iter()
        .map(|attribute| OwnedAttribute {
            local_name: unsafe { HtmlName::from_borrowed_raw(attribute.local_name) },
            prefix: if attribute.prefix_len == 0 {
                None
            } else {
                Some(unsafe { utf16_string_from_ffi(attribute.prefix_ptr, attribute.prefix_len) }.into())
            },
            namespace_: attribute.namespace_,
            value: unsafe { utf16_string_from_ffi(attribute.value_ptr, attribute.value_len) }.into(),
        })
        .collect()
}

fn active_formatting_element_has_same_attributes(
    active_formatting_element: &ActiveFormattingElement,
    attributes: &[OwnedAttribute],
) -> bool {
    active_formatting_element.attributes.len() == attributes.len()
        && active_formatting_element.attributes.iter().all(|attribute| {
            attributes.iter().any(|other_attribute| {
                attribute.local_name == other_attribute.local_name
                    && attribute.namespace_ == other_attribute.namespace_
                    && attribute.value == other_attribute.value
            })
        })
}

impl AttributeBuffers {
    // The caller keeps the source attributes alive until the synchronous host callback returns.
    fn fill_from_owned_attributes(&mut self, attributes: &[OwnedAttribute]) {
        self.attributes.extend(attributes.iter().map(|attribute| {
            let prefix = attribute
                .prefix
                .as_ref()
                .map_or(Utf16View::Latin1(&[]), CodeUnits::as_slice);
            RustFfiHtmlParserAttribute {
                local_name: attribute.local_name.raw_identity(),
                prefix: prefix.into(),
                namespace_: attribute.namespace_,
                value: attribute.value.as_slice().into(),
            }
        }));
    }

    fn fill_from_token(&mut self, token: &Token, namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace) {
        let TokenPayload::Tag { attributes, .. } = &token.payload else {
            return;
        };
        self.attributes.reserve(attributes.len());
        self.local_names.reserve(attributes.len());
        for attribute in attributes {
            let adjusted_name = adjusted_foreign_attribute_name(&attribute.local_name, namespace_);
            let prefix = adjusted_name.prefix.unwrap_or("");
            self.local_names.push(adjusted_name.local_name);
            self.attributes.push(RustFfiHtmlParserAttribute {
                local_name: self.local_names.last().unwrap().raw_identity(),
                prefix: Utf16View::Latin1(prefix.as_bytes()).into(),
                namespace_: adjusted_name.namespace_,
                value: attribute.value.as_slice().into(),
            });
        }
    }
}

fn adjusted_foreign_tag_name(tag_name: &HtmlName, namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace) -> HtmlName {
    if namespace_ != RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Svg {
        return tag_name.clone();
    }
    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inforeign
    // If the adjusted current node is an element in the SVG namespace, and the token's tag name is one of the ones in
    // the first column of the following table, change the tag name to the name given in the corresponding cell in the
    // second column.
    let adjustments = [
        ("altglyph", "altGlyph"),
        ("altglyphdef", "altGlyphDef"),
        ("altglyphitem", "altGlyphItem"),
        ("animatecolor", "animateColor"),
        ("animatemotion", "animateMotion"),
        ("animatetransform", "animateTransform"),
        ("clippath", "clipPath"),
        ("feblend", "feBlend"),
        ("fecolormatrix", "feColorMatrix"),
        ("fecomponenttransfer", "feComponentTransfer"),
        ("fecomposite", "feComposite"),
        ("feconvolvematrix", "feConvolveMatrix"),
        ("fediffuselighting", "feDiffuseLighting"),
        ("fedisplacementmap", "feDisplacementMap"),
        ("fedistantlight", "feDistantLight"),
        ("fedropshadow", "feDropShadow"),
        ("feflood", "feFlood"),
        ("fefunca", "feFuncA"),
        ("fefuncb", "feFuncB"),
        ("fefuncg", "feFuncG"),
        ("fefuncr", "feFuncR"),
        ("fegaussianblur", "feGaussianBlur"),
        ("feimage", "feImage"),
        ("femerge", "feMerge"),
        ("femergenode", "feMergeNode"),
        ("femorphology", "feMorphology"),
        ("feoffset", "feOffset"),
        ("fepointlight", "fePointLight"),
        ("fespecularlighting", "feSpecularLighting"),
        ("fespotlight", "feSpotLight"),
        ("fetile", "feTile"),
        ("feturbulence", "feTurbulence"),
        ("foreignobject", "foreignObject"),
        ("glyphref", "glyphRef"),
        ("lineargradient", "linearGradient"),
        ("radialgradient", "radialGradient"),
        ("textpath", "textPath"),
    ];
    adjustments
        .iter()
        .find_map(|(name, adjusted_name)| tag_name.equals(name).then(|| HtmlName::from_utf8(adjusted_name)))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| tag_name.clone())
}

fn adjusted_foreign_attribute_name(
    attribute_name: &HtmlName,
    namespace_: RustFfiHtmlNamespace,
) -> AdjustedAttributeName {
    if namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html {
        return AdjustedAttributeName {
            local_name: attribute_name.clone(),
            prefix: None,
            namespace_: RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::None,
        };
    }

    let adjusted_name = if namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::MathMl && attribute_name.equals("definitionurl") {
        HtmlName::from_utf8("definitionURL")
    } else if namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Svg {
        let adjustments = [
            ("attributename", "attributeName"),
            ("attributetype", "attributeType"),
            ("basefrequency", "baseFrequency"),
            ("baseprofile", "baseProfile"),
            ("calcmode", "calcMode"),
            ("clippathunits", "clipPathUnits"),
            ("diffuseconstant", "diffuseConstant"),
            ("edgemode", "edgeMode"),
            ("filterunits", "filterUnits"),
            ("glyphref", "glyphRef"),
            ("gradienttransform", "gradientTransform"),
            ("gradientunits", "gradientUnits"),
            ("kernelmatrix", "kernelMatrix"),
            ("kernelunitlength", "kernelUnitLength"),
            ("keypoints", "keyPoints"),
            ("keysplines", "keySplines"),
            ("keytimes", "keyTimes"),
            ("lengthadjust", "lengthAdjust"),
            ("limitingconeangle", "limitingConeAngle"),
            ("markerheight", "markerHeight"),
            ("markerunits", "markerUnits"),
            ("markerwidth", "markerWidth"),
            ("maskcontentunits", "maskContentUnits"),
            ("maskunits", "maskUnits"),
            ("numoctaves", "numOctaves"),
            ("pathlength", "pathLength"),
            ("patterncontentunits", "patternContentUnits"),
            ("patterntransform", "patternTransform"),
            ("patternunits", "patternUnits"),
            ("pointsatx", "pointsAtX"),
            ("pointsaty", "pointsAtY"),
            ("pointsatz", "pointsAtZ"),
            ("preservealpha", "preserveAlpha"),
            ("preserveaspectratio", "preserveAspectRatio"),
            ("primitiveunits", "primitiveUnits"),
            ("refx", "refX"),
            ("refy", "refY"),
            ("repeatcount", "repeatCount"),
            ("repeatdur", "repeatDur"),
            ("requiredextensions", "requiredExtensions"),
            ("requiredfeatures", "requiredFeatures"),
            ("specularconstant", "specularConstant"),
            ("specularexponent", "specularExponent"),
            ("spreadmethod", "spreadMethod"),
            ("startoffset", "startOffset"),
            ("stddeviation", "stdDeviation"),
            ("stitchtiles", "stitchTiles"),
            ("surfacescale", "surfaceScale"),
            ("systemlanguage", "systemLanguage"),
            ("tablevalues", "tableValues"),
            ("targetx", "targetX"),
            ("targety", "targetY"),
            ("textlength", "textLength"),
            ("viewbox", "viewBox"),
            ("viewtarget", "viewTarget"),
            ("xchannelselector", "xChannelSelector"),
            ("ychannelselector", "yChannelSelector"),
            ("zoomandpan", "zoomAndPan"),
        ];
        adjustments
            .iter()
            .find_map(|(name, adjusted_name)| attribute_name.equals(name).then(|| HtmlName::from_utf8(adjusted_name)))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| attribute_name.clone())
    } else {
        attribute_name.clone()
    };

    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#adjust-foreign-attributes
    // When the steps below require the user agent to adjust foreign attributes for a token, then, if any of the
    // attributes on the token match the strings given in the first column of the following table, let the attribute be
    // a namespaced attribute, with the prefix being the string given in the corresponding cell in the second column,
    // the local name being the string given in the corresponding cell in the third column, and the namespace being the
    // namespace given in the corresponding cell in the fourth column.
    let namespaced_adjustments = [
        (
            "xlink:actuate",
            "actuate",
            Some("xlink"),
            RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::XLink,
        ),
        (
            "xlink:arcrole",
            "arcrole",
            Some("xlink"),
            RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::XLink,
        ),
        (
            "xlink:href",
            "href",
            Some("xlink"),
            RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::XLink,
        ),
        (
            "xlink:role",
            "role",
            Some("xlink"),
            RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::XLink,
        ),
        (
            "xlink:show",
            "show",
            Some("xlink"),
            RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::XLink,
        ),
        (
            "xlink:title",
            "title",
            Some("xlink"),
            RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::XLink,
        ),
        (
            "xlink:type",
            "type",
            Some("xlink"),
            RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::XLink,
        ),
        ("xml:lang", "lang", Some("xml"), RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::Xml),
        ("xml:space", "space", Some("xml"), RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::Xml),
        ("xmlns", "xmlns", None, RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::Xmlns),
        (
            "xmlns:xlink",
            "xlink",
            Some("xmlns"),
            RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::Xmlns,
        ),
    ];
    let adjusted_namespace = namespaced_adjustments
        .iter()
        .find(|(name, ..)| adjusted_name.equals(name));
    let (local_name, prefix, namespace_) = adjusted_namespace.map_or_else(
        || (adjusted_name, None, RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::None),
        |(_, local_name, prefix, namespace_)| (HtmlName::from_utf8(local_name), *prefix, *namespace_),
    );

    AdjustedAttributeName {
        local_name,
        prefix,
        namespace_,
    }
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#mathml-text-integration-point
fn is_mathml_text_integration_point(node: &StackNode) -> bool {
    if node.namespace_ != RustFfiHtmlNamespace::MathMl {
        return false;
    }

    // A node is a MathML text integration point if it is one of the following elements:
    // - A MathML mi element
    // - A MathML mo element
    // - A MathML mn element
    // - A MathML ms element
    // - A MathML mtext element
    node.local_name.is_one_of(&[
        tag_name!("mi"),
        tag_name!("mo"),
        tag_name!("mn"),
        tag_name!("ms"),
        tag_name!("mtext"),
    ])
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#html-integration-point
fn is_html_integration_point(node: &StackNode) -> bool {
    // A node is an HTML integration point if it is one of the following elements:
    // - A MathML annotation-xml element whose start tag token had an attribute with the name "encoding" whose value was an ASCII case-insensitive match for the string "text/html"
    // - A MathML annotation-xml element whose start tag token had an attribute with the name "encoding" whose value was an ASCII case-insensitive match for the string "application/xhtml+xml"
    if node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::MathMl
        && node.local_name == tag_name!("annotation-xml")
        && node
            .attributes
            .iter()
            .find(|attribute| {
                attribute.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlAttributeNamespace::None
                    && attribute.prefix.is_none()
                    && attribute.local_name == "encoding"
            })
            .is_some_and(|attribute| {
                attribute.value.as_slice().eq_ignore_ascii_case("text/html")
                    || attribute.value.as_slice().eq_ignore_ascii_case("application/xhtml+xml")
            })
    {
        return true;
    }

    // - An SVG foreignObject element
    // - An SVG desc element
    // - An SVG title element
    if node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Svg {
        return node
            .local_name
            .is_one_of(&[tag_name!("foreignObject"), tag_name!("desc"), tag_name!("title")]);
    }

    false
}

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#has-an-element-in-the-specific-scope
fn is_scope_boundary(node: &StackNode) -> bool {
    if node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html {
        return node.local_name.is_one_of(&[
            tag_name!("applet"),
            tag_name!("caption"),
            tag_name!("html"),
            tag_name!("table"),
            tag_name!("td"),
            tag_name!("th"),
            tag_name!("marquee"),
            tag_name!("object"),
            tag_name!("select"),
            tag_name!("template"),
        ]);
    }

    is_html_integration_point(node)
        || is_mathml_text_integration_point(node)
        || (node.namespace_ == RustFfiHtmlNamespace::MathMl && node.local_name == tag_name!("annotation-xml"))
}

fn is_foreign_content_breakout_token(token: &Token) -> bool {
    // -> A start tag whose tag name is one of: "b", "big", "blockquote", "body", "br", "center", "code", "dd", "div", "dl", "dt", "em", "embed", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "head", "hr", "i", "img", "li", "listing", "menu", "meta", "nobr", "ol", "p", "pre", "ruby", "s", "small", "span", "strong", "strike", "sub", "sup", "table", "tt", "u", "ul", "var"
    if token.is_start_tag_one_of(tag_set![
        "b",
        "big",
        "blockquote",
        "body",
        "br",
        "center",
        "code",
        "dd",
        "div",
        "dl",
        "dt",
        "em",
        "embed",
        "h1",
        "h2",
        "h3",
        "h4",
        "h5",
        "h6",
        "head",
        "hr",
        "i",
        "img",
        "li",
        "listing",
        "menu",
        "meta",
        "nobr",
        "ol",
        "p",
        "pre",
        "ruby",
        "s",
        "small",
        "span",
        "strong",
        "strike",
        "sub",
        "sup",
        "table",
        "tt",
        "u",
        "ul",
        "var"
    ]) {
        return true;
    }

    // -> A start tag whose tag name is "font", if the token has any attributes named "color", "face", or "size"
    if token.is_start_tag_named(tag_id!("font"))
        && (token.has_attribute(attribute_name!("color"))
            || token.has_attribute(attribute_name!("face"))
            || token.has_attribute(attribute_name!("size")))
    {
        return true;
    }

    // -> An end tag whose tag name is "br", "p"
    token.is_end_tag_one_of(tag_set!["br", "p"])
}

    tag_name.is_one_of(&[
        tag_name!("a"),

        tag_name!("code"),
        tag_name!("em"),
        tag_name!("font"),
        tag_name!("i"),
        tag_name!("nobr"),
        tag_name!("s"),
        tag_name!("small"),
        tag_name!("strike"),
        tag_name!("strong"),
        tag_name!("tt"),
        tag_name!("u"),
    ])
}

            tag_name!("object"),

trait TokenExt {
    fn is_start_tag(&self) -> bool;
    fn is_end_tag(&self) -> bool;
    fn is_start_tag_named(&self, id: TagId) -> bool;
    fn is_end_tag_named(&self, id: TagId) -> bool;
    fn is_start_tag_one_of(&self, names: &TagSet) -> bool;
    fn is_end_tag_one_of(&self, names: &TagSet) -> bool;
    fn is_parser_whitespace(&self) -> bool;
    fn comment_data(&self) -> Utf16View<'_>;
    fn doctype_data(&self) -> &crate::token::DoctypeData;
    fn attribute(&self, name: KnownName) -> Option<Utf16View<'_>>;
    fn has_attribute(&self, name: KnownName) -> bool;
}

impl TokenExt for Token {
    fn is_start_tag(&self) -> bool {
        self.token_type == TokenType::StartTag
    }

    fn is_end_tag(&self) -> bool {
        self.token_type == TokenType::EndTag
    }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn is_start_tag_named(&self, id: TagId) -> bool {
        self.is_start_tag() && self.tag_id() == id
    }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn is_end_tag_named(&self, id: TagId) -> bool {
        self.is_end_tag() && self.tag_id() == id
    }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn is_start_tag_one_of(&self, names: &TagSet) -> bool {
        self.is_start_tag() && names.contains(self.tag_id())
    }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn is_end_tag_one_of(&self, names: &TagSet) -> bool {
        self.is_end_tag() && names.contains(self.tag_id())
    }

    fn is_parser_whitespace(&self) -> bool {
        if self.token_type != TokenType::Character {
            return false;
        }
        matches!(self.code_point, 0x09 | 0x0a | 0x0c | 0x0d | 0x20)
    }

    fn comment_data(&self) -> Utf16View<'_> {
        let TokenPayload::Comment(data) = &self.payload else {
            return Utf16View::Latin1(&[]);
        };
        data.as_slice()
    }

    fn doctype_data(&self) -> &crate::token::DoctypeData {
        let TokenPayload::Doctype(data) = &self.payload else {
            panic!("doctype_data called on non-doctype token");
        };
        data
    }

    fn attribute(&self, name: KnownName) -> Option<Utf16View<'_>> {
        let TokenPayload::Tag { attributes, .. } = &self.payload else {
            return None;
        };
        attributes.iter().find_map(|attribute| {
            if attribute.local_name == name {
                Some(attribute.value.as_slice())
            } else {
                None
            }
        })
    }

    fn has_attribute(&self, name: KnownName) -> bool {
        self.attribute(name).is_some()
    }
}

impl Token {
    fn synthetic_character(code_point: u32) -> Self {
        Self {
            token_type: TokenType::Character,
            code_point,
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    fn synthetic_end_tag(tag_name: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            token_type: TokenType::EndTag,
            payload: TokenPayload::Tag {
                tag_name: HtmlName::from_utf8(tag_name),
                tag_id: TagId::for_name(tag_name),
                self_closing: false,
                had_duplicate_attribute: false,
                attributes: AttributeList::new(),
            },
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    fn synthetic_start_tag(tag_name: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            token_type: TokenType::StartTag,
            payload: TokenPayload::Tag {
                tag_name: HtmlName::from_utf8(tag_name),
                tag_id: TagId::for_name(tag_name),
                self_closing: false,
                had_duplicate_attribute: false,
                attributes: AttributeList::new(),
            },
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }
}

/// Create a new Rust HTML parser.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_parser_create() -> *mut RustFfiHtmlParserHandle {
    Box::into_raw(Box::new(RustFfiHtmlParserHandle {
        state: ParserState::new(),
    }))
}

/// Initialize the Rust HTML parser for the HTML fragment parsing algorithm.
///
/// # Safety
/// `handle` must be a valid pointer from `rust_html_parser_create`.
/// `context_local_name` must be the borrowed identity of a live C++ `Utf16FlyString`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_html_parser_begin_fragment(
    handle: Option<&mut RustFfiHtmlParserHandle>,
    root: usize,
    root_insertion_target: usize,
    context_element: usize,
    context_namespace: RustFfiHtmlNamespace,
    context_namespace_uri_ptr: *const u16,
    context_namespace_uri_len: usize,
    context_local_name: usize,
    context_attributes: *const RustFfiHtmlParserContextAttribute,
    context_attribute_count: usize,
    document_quirks_mode: RustFfiHtmlQuirksMode,
    allow_declarative_shadow_roots: bool,
    form_element: usize,
) {
    let Some(handle) = handle else {
        return;
    };
    if root == 0 {
        return;
    }

    let context_local_name = unsafe { HtmlName::from_borrowed_raw(context_local_name) };
    let context_namespace_uri = unsafe {
        utf16_namespace_uri_from_ffi(context_namespace, context_namespace_uri_ptr, context_namespace_uri_len)
    };
    let context_attributes = unsafe { owned_context_attributes_from_ffi(context_attributes, context_attribute_count) };

    handle.state.begin_fragment(FragmentParsingContext {
        root,
        root_insertion_target,
        context_element: StackNode {
            handle: context_element,
            local_name: context_local_name,
            namespace_: context_namespace,
            namespace_uri: context_namespace_uri,
            attributes: context_attributes.into(),
            template_content: None,
        },
        document_quirks_mode,
        allow_declarative_shadow_roots,
        form_element,
    });
}

/// Record that the parser's parser sanitizer configuration is non-null, and whether it allows comments.
///
/// This must be called after `rust_html_parser_begin_fragment`, which resets the parser state.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_parser_set_sanitizer(
    handle: Option<&mut RustFfiHtmlParserHandle>,
    sanitizing: bool,
    allows_comments: bool,
) {
    let Some(handle) = handle else {
        return;
    };
    handle.state.sanitizing = sanitizing;
    handle.state.sanitizer_allows_comments = allows_comments;
}

/// Run the Rust HTML parser.
///
/// Returns `ExecuteScript` when tree construction reaches a parser-blocking script
/// and the C++ host needs to run the script before tokenization can continue.
///
/// # Safety
/// `handle` must be a valid pointer from `rust_html_parser_create`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_html_parser_run_document(
    handle: *mut RustFfiHtmlParserHandle,
    tokenizer: *mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle,
    host: *mut c_void,
    scripting_enabled: bool,
    allow_declarative_shadow_roots: bool,
    stop_at_insertion_point: bool,
) -> RustFfiHtmlParserRunResult {
    if handle.is_null() || tokenizer.is_null() || host.is_null() {
        return RustFfiHtmlParserRunResult::Unsupported;
    }
    // Do not materialize long-lived `&mut` references to the parser state or tokenizer here. C++ host callbacks can
    // synchronously execute script, and script can re-enter this function through document.write() or document.close().
    // TreeBuilder uses raw pointers internally so those nested parser runs do not alias an outer Rust `&mut` borrow.
    unsafe {
        (*handle).state.scripting_enabled = scripting_enabled;
        (*handle).state.allow_declarative_shadow_roots = allow_declarative_shadow_roots;
        (*handle).state.parser_pause_requested = false;
    }
    let tokenizer = NonNull::new(unsafe { addr_of_mut!((*tokenizer).tokenizer) }).unwrap();
    let state = NonNull::new(unsafe { addr_of_mut!((*handle).state) }).unwrap();
    let mut tree_builder = TreeBuilder::new(tokenizer, host, state);
    tree_builder.run(stop_at_insertion_point);
    if unsafe { (*handle).state.pending_script.is_some() } {
        return RustFfiHtmlParserRunResult::ExecuteScript;
    }
    if unsafe { (*handle).state.pending_svg_script.is_some() } {
        return RustFfiHtmlParserRunResult::ExecuteSvgScript;
    }
    RustFfiHtmlParserRunResult::Ok
}

/// Pop all open elements at the end of parsing.
///
/// # Safety
/// `handle` must be a valid pointer from `rust_html_parser_create`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_html_parser_pop_all_open_elements(handle: *mut RustFfiHtmlParserHandle) {
    if handle.is_null() {
        return;
    }
    while let Some(node) = unsafe { (*handle).state.stack_of_open_elements.pop() } {
        if requires_element_popped_callback(&node) {
            unsafe { ladybird_html_parser_handle_element_popped(node.handle) };
        }
    }
}

/// Visit all DOM nodes that are kept alive by the Rust HTML parser state.
///
/// # Safety
/// `handle` must be a valid pointer from `rust_html_parser_create`.
/// `visitor` must be a valid `GC::Cell::Visitor`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_html_parser_visit_edges(handle: Option<&RustFfiHtmlParserHandle>, visitor: *mut c_void) {
    let Some(handle) = handle else {
        return;
    };
    if visitor.is_null() {
        return;
    }
    handle.state.visit_edges(visitor);
}

/// Take the script element that caused the last Rust HTML parser run to stop.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_parser_take_pending_script(handle: Option<&mut RustFfiHtmlParserHandle>) -> usize {
    let Some(handle) = handle else {
        return 0;
    };
    handle.state.pending_script.take().unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Take the SVG script element that caused the last Rust HTML parser run to stop.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_parser_take_pending_svg_script(handle: Option<&mut RustFfiHtmlParserHandle>) -> usize {
    let Some(handle) = handle else {
        return 0;
    };
    handle.state.pending_svg_script.take().unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Destroy a Rust HTML parser.
///
/// # Safety
/// `handle` must be a valid pointer from `rust_html_parser_create`,
/// and must not be used after this call.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_html_parser_destroy(handle: *mut RustFfiHtmlParserHandle) {
    if !handle.is_null() {
        drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(handle) });
    }
}

/*

//! A fake DOM host that defines the `ladybird_html_parser_*` callbacks so the tree builder can run in Rust tests.

use super::APPEND_CHILD_OFFSET;
use super::RustFfiHtmlNamespace;
use super::RustFfiHtmlParserAttribute;
use super::RustFfiHtmlQuirksMode;
use super::RustFfiHtmlShadowRootMode;
use super::RustFfiHtmlSlotAssignmentMode;
use crate::code_units::RustFfiHtmlUtf16View;
use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::NonNull;

pub(super) const DOCUMENT: usize = 1;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum FakeNodeKind {
    Document,
    DocumentType,
    DocumentFragment,
    ShadowRoot,
    Element(RustFfiHtmlNamespace),
    Text(String),
    Comment,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum FakeInsertionCall {
    InsertNode,
    InsertText,
    ReinsertLastNode,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(super) struct FakeInsertion {
    pub(super) call: FakeInsertionCall,
    pub(super) parent: usize,
    pub(super) explicit_offset: Option<usize>,
}

struct FakeNode {
    kind: FakeNodeKind,
    parent: usize,
    children: Vec<usize>,
    fragment_host: usize,
    template_content: usize,
    shadow_root: usize,
}

struct FakeDom {
    nodes: Vec<FakeNode>,
    insertions: Vec<FakeInsertion>,
}

impl FakeDom {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let mut dom = Self {
            nodes: Vec::new(),
            insertions: Vec::new(),
        };
        let document = dom.create_node(FakeNodeKind::Document);
        assert_eq!(document, DOCUMENT);
        dom
    }

    fn create_node(&mut self, kind: FakeNodeKind) -> usize {
        self.nodes.push(FakeNode {
            kind,
            parent: 0,
            children: Vec::new(),
            fragment_host: 0,
            template_content: 0,
            shadow_root: 0,
        });
        self.nodes.len()
    }

    fn node(&self, handle: usize) -> &FakeNode {
        &self.nodes[handle - 1]
    }

    fn node_mut(&mut self, handle: usize) -> &mut FakeNode {
        &mut self.nodes[handle - 1]
    }

    fn index_in_parent(&self, node: usize) -> usize {
        let parent = self.node(node).parent;
        self.node(parent)
            .children
            .iter()
            .position(|&child| child == node)
            .unwrap()
    }

    fn has_element_child(&self, node: usize) -> bool {
        self.node(node)
            .children
            .iter()
            .any(|&child| matches!(self.node(child).kind, FakeNodeKind::Element(_)))
    }

    fn is_host_including_inclusive_ancestor(&self, ancestor: usize, node: usize) -> bool {
        let mut current = node;
        while current != 0 {
            if current == ancestor {
                return true;
            }
            let current_node = self.node(current);
            current = if current_node.parent != 0 {
                current_node.parent
            } else {
                current_node.fragment_host
            };
        }
        false
    }

    fn record_insertion(&mut self, call: FakeInsertionCall, parent: usize, offset: usize) {
        let explicit_offset = (offset != APPEND_CHILD_OFFSET).then_some(offset);
        if let Some(offset) = explicit_offset {
            assert!(offset <= self.node(parent).children.len());
        }
        self.insertions.push(FakeInsertion {
            call,
            parent,
            explicit_offset,
        });
    }

    fn child_at_offset(&self, parent: usize, offset: usize) -> Option<usize> {
        if offset == APPEND_CHILD_OFFSET {
            return None;
        }
        self.node(parent).children.get(offset).copied()
    }

    fn child_before_offset(&self, parent: usize, offset: usize) -> Option<usize> {
        let children = &self.node(parent).children;
        match offset {
            APPEND_CHILD_OFFSET => children.last().copied(),
            0 => None,
            _ => Some(children[offset - 1]),
        }
    }

    fn remove(&mut self, node: usize) {
        let parent = self.node(node).parent;
        if parent == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let index = self.index_in_parent(node);
        self.node_mut(parent).children.remove(index);
        self.node_mut(node).parent = 0;
    }

    fn insert_before(&mut self, parent: usize, node: usize, reference_child: Option<usize>) {
        self.remove(node);
        let index = match reference_child {
            Some(reference_child) => self.index_in_parent(reference_child),
            None => self.node(parent).children.len(),
        };
        self.node_mut(parent).children.insert(index, node);
        self.node_mut(node).parent = parent;
    }
}

thread_local! {
    static FAKE_DOM: RefCell<FakeDom> = RefCell::new(FakeDom::new());
}

fn with_fake_dom<R>(callback: impl FnOnce(&mut FakeDom) -> R) -> R {
    FAKE_DOM.with_borrow_mut(callback)
}

pub(super) fn fake_parser_host() -> *mut c_void {
    NonNull::<c_void>::dangling().as_ptr()
}

pub(super) fn reset() {
    with_fake_dom(|dom| *dom = FakeDom::new());
}

pub(super) fn insertions() -> Vec<FakeInsertion> {
    with_fake_dom(|dom| dom.insertions.clone())
}

pub(super) fn children(node: usize) -> Vec<usize> {
    with_fake_dom(|dom| dom.node(node).children.clone())
}

pub(super) fn kind(node: usize) -> FakeNodeKind {
    with_fake_dom(|dom| dom.node(node).kind.clone())
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
extern "C" fn ladybird_html_parser_insert_text(
    parent: usize,
    offset: usize,
    text: RustFfiHtmlUtf16View,
    is_ascii: bool,
) {
    let text = text.to_test_string();
    assert!(!is_ascii || text.is_ascii());
    insert_text(parent, offset, &text);
}

fn insert_text(parent: usize, offset: usize, data: &str) {
    with_fake_dom(|dom| {
        dom.record_insertion(FakeInsertionCall::InsertText, parent, offset);
        if dom.node(parent).kind == FakeNodeKind::Document {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(previous_child) = dom.child_before_offset(parent, offset)
            && let FakeNodeKind::Text(previous_text) = &mut dom.node_mut(previous_child).kind
        {
            previous_text.push_str(data);
            return;
        }
        let reference_child = dom.child_at_offset(parent, offset);
        let text = dom.create_node(FakeNodeKind::Text(data.to_string()));
        dom.insert_before(parent, text, reference_child);
    })
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
extern "C" fn ladybird_html_parser_reinsert_last_node(parent: usize, offset: usize, last_node: usize) {
    with_fake_dom(|dom| {
        dom.record_insertion(FakeInsertionCall::ReinsertLastNode, parent, offset);
        let reference_child = dom.child_at_offset(parent, offset);
        dom.remove(last_node);
        let can_be_inserted = !dom.is_host_including_inclusive_ancestor(last_node, parent)
            && (dom.node(parent).kind != FakeNodeKind::Document || !dom.has_element_child(parent))
            && reference_child.is_none_or(|reference_child| dom.node(reference_child).parent == parent);
        if can_be_inserted {
            dom.insert_before(parent, last_node, reference_child);
        }
    })
}

/*

use super::RustFfiHtmlNamespace;
use super::RustFfiHtmlParserHandle;
use super::RustFfiHtmlParserRunResult;
use super::rust_html_parser_create;
use super::rust_html_parser_destroy;
use super::rust_html_parser_pop_all_open_elements;
use super::rust_html_parser_run_document;
use super::test_host;
use super::test_host::FakeInsertion;
use super::test_host::FakeInsertionCall;
use super::test_host::FakeNodeKind;
use crate::RustFfiTokenizerHandle;
use crate::make_handle;
use crate::rust_html_tokenizer_destroy;
use crate::tokenizer::HtmlTokenizer;
use ak::Utf16View;

const HTML_ELEMENT: FakeNodeKind = FakeNodeKind::Element(RustFfiHtmlNamespace::Html);

struct ScriptCreatedParser {
    parser: *mut RustFfiHtmlParserHandle,
    tokenizer: *mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle,
}

impl ScriptCreatedParser {
    fn open() -> Self {
        test_host::reset();
        let mut parser = Self {
            parser: rust_html_parser_create(),
            tokenizer: make_handle(HtmlTokenizer::new(Vec::<u8>::new())),
        };
        parser.tokenizer().set_input_stream_closed(false);
        parser.tokenizer().update_insertion_point();
        parser
    }

    fn tokenizer(&mut self) -> &mut HtmlTokenizer {
        unsafe { &mut (*self.tokenizer).tokenizer }
    }

    fn run(&mut self, stop_at_insertion_point: bool) {
        let result = unsafe {
            rust_html_parser_run_document(
                self.parser,
                self.tokenizer,
                test_host::fake_parser_host(),
                true,
                false,
                stop_at_insertion_point,
            )
        };
        assert_eq!(result, RustFfiHtmlParserRunResult::Ok);
    }

    fn write(&mut self, markup: &str) {
        let code_units: Vec<u16> = markup.encode_utf16().collect();
        self.tokenizer()
            .insert_input_at_insertion_point(Utf16View::Utf16(&code_units));
        self.run(true);
    }

    /// Gives the parser the rest of its input from the network rather than from a script.
    fn append_and_close(&mut self, markup: &str) {
        let code_units: Vec<u16> = markup.encode_utf16().collect();
        if code_units.iter().all(|code_unit| *code_unit <= 0xff) {
            let bytes: Vec<u8> = code_units.iter().map(|code_unit| *code_unit as u8).collect();
            self.tokenizer().append_input(Utf16View::Latin1(&bytes));
        } else {
            self.tokenizer().append_input(Utf16View::Utf16(&code_units));
        }
        self.close();
    }

    fn close(&mut self) {
        self.tokenizer().insert_eof();
        self.run(false);
        unsafe { rust_html_parser_pop_all_open_elements(self.parser) };
    }
}

impl Drop for ScriptCreatedParser {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        unsafe {
            rust_html_parser_destroy(self.parser);
            rust_html_tokenizer_destroy(self.tokenizer);
        }
    }
}

fn body_element() -> usize {
    let html_element = *test_host::children(test_host::DOCUMENT).last().unwrap();
    test_host::children(html_element)[1]
}

fn kinds_of(nodes: &[usize]) -> Vec<FakeNodeKind> {
    nodes.iter().map(|&node| test_host::kind(node)).collect()
}

fn insertions_with_explicit_offset() -> Vec<FakeInsertion> {
    test_host::insertions()
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|insertion| insertion.explicit_offset.is_some())
        .collect()
}

#[test]
fn script_created_parser_appends_every_flat_sibling() {
    const SIBLING_COUNT: usize = 5000;
    let mut parser = ScriptCreatedParser::open();
    parser.write(&format!("{}<span>PASS</span>", "<span></span>".repeat(SIBLING_COUNT)));
    parser.close();

    let body = body_element();
    let insertions_into_body = test_host::insertions()
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|insertion| insertion.parent == body)
        .count();
    assert_eq!(insertions_into_body, SIBLING_COUNT + 1);
    let explicit_offset_insertions = insertions_with_explicit_offset();
    assert!(explicit_offset_insertions.is_empty(), "{explicit_offset_insertions:?}");

    let body_children = test_host::children(body);
    assert_eq!(kinds_of(&body_children), vec![HTML_ELEMENT; SIBLING_COUNT + 1]);
    assert_eq!(
        kinds_of(&test_host::children(body_children[SIBLING_COUNT])),
        [FakeNodeKind::Text("PASS".to_string())]
    );
}

#[test]
fn foster_parented_element_is_inserted_before_the_table_at_an_explicit_offset() {
    let mut parser = ScriptCreatedParser::open();
    parser.write("<table><b>fostered</b></table>");
    parser.close();

    let body = body_element();
    assert_eq!(
        insertions_with_explicit_offset(),
        [FakeInsertion {
            call: FakeInsertionCall::InsertNode,
            parent: body,
            explicit_offset: Some(0),
        }]
    );

    let [fostered_element, table] = test_host::children(body)[..] else {
        panic!("expected the fostered element and the table in body");
    };
    assert_eq!(kinds_of(&[fostered_element, table]), [HTML_ELEMENT, HTML_ELEMENT]);
    assert_eq!(
        kinds_of(&test_host::children(fostered_element)),
        [FakeNodeKind::Text("fostered".to_string())]
    );
    assert!(test_host::children(table).is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn foster_parented_text_is_inserted_before_the_table_at_an_explicit_offset() {
    let mut parser = ScriptCreatedParser::open();
    parser.write("<table>fostered</table>");
    parser.close();

    let body = body_element();
    let fostered_insertions = insertions_with_explicit_offset();
    assert!(!fostered_insertions.is_empty());
    assert!(
        fostered_insertions
            .iter()
            .all(|insertion| insertion.call == FakeInsertionCall::InsertText && insertion.parent == body)
    );

    let body_children = test_host::children(body);
    assert_eq!(
        kinds_of(&body_children),
        [FakeNodeKind::Text("fostered".to_string()), HTML_ELEMENT]
    );
    assert!(test_host::children(body_children[1]).is_empty());
}

fn text_of_each_paragraph(markup: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut parser = ScriptCreatedParser::open();
    parser.append_and_close(markup);
    test_host::children(body_element())
        .into_iter()
        .map(|paragraph| match &test_host::children(paragraph)[..] {
            [text] => match test_host::kind(*text) {
                FakeNodeKind::Text(text) => text,
                kind => panic!("expected text in the paragraph, not {kind:?}"),
            },
            children => panic!("expected one text node in the paragraph, not {} nodes", children.len()),
        })
        .collect()
}

#[test]
fn text_is_inserted_as_one_node_however_the_tokenizer_emits_it() {
    // Text that is taken straight from the input, in both forms the input is stored in.
    assert_eq!(
        text_of_each_paragraph("<p>plain<p>caf\u{e9}\nau lait"),
        ["plain", "caf\u{e9}\nau lait"]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        text_of_each_paragraph("<p>plain<p>wide \u{2014} \u{1f600}!"),
        ["plain", "wide \u{2014} \u{1f600}!"]
    );
    // Text that is put together from runs of input and the characters between them that the tokenizer changes.
    assert_eq!(
        text_of_each_paragraph("<p>a &amp; b &lt;<p>x\r\ny\rz<p>&amp;<p>\u{1f600} first"),
        ["a & b <", "x\ny\nz", "&", "\u{1f600} first"]
    );
    // A surrogate without its other half becomes U+FFFD.
    let mut parser = ScriptCreatedParser::open();
    parser
        .tokenizer()
        .append_input(Utf16View::Utf16(&[0x3C, 0x70, 0x3E, 0x61, 0xD83D, 0x62]));
    parser.close();
    let paragraph = test_host::children(body_element())[0];
    assert_eq!(
        kinds_of(&test_host::children(paragraph)),
        [FakeNodeKind::Text("a\u{fffd}b".to_string())]
    );
}

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RustFfiPreloadScannerAction {
    Base = 0,
    Fetch = 1,
    ModulePreload = 2,
    ModuleScript = 3,
}

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination {
    None = 0,
    Font = 1,
    Image = 2,
    Script = 3,
    Style = 4,
    Track = 5,
    AudioWorklet = 6,
    JSON = 7,
    PaintWorklet = 8,
    ServiceWorker = 9,
    SharedWorker = 10,
    Worker = 11,
    Text = 12,
}

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting {
    NoCors = 0,
    Anonymous = 1,
    UseCredentials = 2,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry {
    pub action: RustFfiPreloadScannerAction,
    pub url: RustFfiHtmlUtf16View,
    pub destination: RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination,
    pub cors_setting: RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting,
    pub nonce: RustFfiHtmlUtf16View,
    pub integrity: RustFfiHtmlUtf16View,
    pub integrity_present: bool,
    pub referrer_policy: RustFfiHtmlUtf16View,
    pub fetch_priority: RustFfiHtmlUtf16View,
    pub media: RustFfiHtmlUtf16View,
}

/// A preload scanner that keeps its place in the parser's input from one run to the next, so that a speculative HTML
/// parser started while another script blocks the parser goes on from where the last one stopped, rather than scanning
/// the same input again.
pub struct RustFfiPreloadScanner {
    tokenizer: HtmlTokenizer,
    template_depth: u64,
    foreign_depth: u64,
    scripting_enabled: bool,
}

impl RustFfiPreloadScanner {
    fn new(scripting_enabled: bool) -> Self {
        let mut tokenizer = HtmlTokenizer::new(Vec::<u8>::new());
        // More input can arrive, so the scanner waits at the end of what it has for the rest of a token.
        tokenizer.set_input_stream_closed(false);
        RustFfiPreloadScanner {
            tokenizer,
            template_depth: 0,
            foreign_depth: 0,
            scripting_enabled,
        }
    }

    fn reset(&mut self) {
        *self = Self::new(self.scripting_enabled);
    }

    fn append_input(&mut self, code_units: Utf16View<'_>) {
        self.tokenizer.append_input(code_units);
    }

    fn scan(&mut self, callback: &mut impl FnMut(&RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool) {
        while let Some(token) = self.tokenizer.next_token(false, false) {
            let should_continue = match token.token_type {
                TokenType::StartTag => {
                    let should_continue =
                        process_start_tag(&token, &mut self.template_depth, &mut self.foreign_depth, callback);

                    // The tree builder switches the tokenizer out of the data state for these elements, so their
                    // contents are text rather than markup. It never does so for foreign content.
                    if self.foreign_depth == 0
                        && let Some(state) = tokenizer_state_after_start_tag(token.tag_name(), self.scripting_enabled)
                    {
                        self.tokenizer.switch_to(state);
                    }
                    should_continue
                }
                TokenType::EndTag => {
                    process_end_tag(&token, &mut self.template_depth, &mut self.foreign_depth);
                    true
                }
                TokenType::EndOfFile => false,
                _ => true,
            };
            if !should_continue {
                break;
            }
        }

        // Drop the input scanned so far, unless a token that isn't finished yet still needs it.
        self.tokenizer.parser_did_run();
    }
}

/// Create a preload scanner for a speculative HTML parser.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_preload_scanner_create(scripting_enabled: bool) -> *mut RustFfiPreloadScanner {
    Box::into_raw(Box::new(RustFfiPreloadScanner::new(scripting_enabled)))
}

/// Destroy a preload scanner.
///
/// # Safety
/// `scanner` must come from `rust_html_preload_scanner_create`, and must not be used afterwards.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_html_preload_scanner_destroy(scanner: *mut RustFfiPreloadScanner) {
    if !scanner.is_null() {
        // SAFETY: The caller passes a scanner from rust_html_preload_scanner_create.
        drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(scanner) });
    }
}

/// Hand the scanner the input of the parser that it hasn't seen yet. Returns false if the scanner had to start over at
/// the parser's current position, because the parser got past where it stopped, input was inserted before there, or
/// the caller asked for it with `start_over`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_html_preload_scanner_append_parser_input(
    scanner: Option<&mut RustFfiPreloadScanner>,
    tokenizer: Option<&mut RustFfiTokenizerHandle>,
    start_over: bool,
) -> bool {
    let (Some(scanner), Some(tokenizer)) = (scanner, tokenizer) else {
        return false;
    };
    if start_over {
        tokenizer.tokenizer.forget_speculative_scan_end();
    }
    let (input, continues) = tokenizer.tokenizer.input_for_speculative_scan();
    if !continues {
        scanner.reset();
    }
    scanner.append_input(input);
    continues
}

/// Scan the input the scanner has for resources the speculative HTML parser can fetch, stopping at the end of it or
/// once `callback` returns false.
///
/// # Safety
/// `callback` must not retain pointers from the provided entry beyond the callback invocation.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn rust_html_preload_scanner_scan(
    scanner: Option<&mut RustFfiPreloadScanner>,
    ctx: *mut c_void,
    callback: unsafe extern "C" fn(ctx: *mut c_void, entry: *const RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool,
) {
    let Some(scanner) = scanner else {
        return;
    };
    scanner.scan(&mut |entry| unsafe { callback(ctx, &raw const *entry) });
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn scan(input: &[u8], scripting_enabled: bool, callback: impl FnMut(&RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool) {
    // SAFETY: The tests pass valid UTF-8.
    let code_units: Vec<u16> = unsafe { std::str::from_utf8_unchecked(input) }.encode_utf16().collect();
    scan_utf16(&code_units, scripting_enabled, callback);
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn scan_utf16(
    input: &[u16],
    scripting_enabled: bool,
    mut callback: impl FnMut(&RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool,
) {
    let mut scanner = RustFfiPreloadScanner::new(scripting_enabled);
    scanner.append_input(Utf16View::Utf16(input));
    scanner.tokenizer.set_input_stream_closed(true);
    scanner.scan(&mut callback);
}

fn process_start_tag(
    token: &Token,
    template_depth: &mut u64,
    foreign_depth: &mut u64,
    callback: &mut impl FnMut(&RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool,
) -> bool {
    let tag_name = token.tag_name();

    if *tag_name == tag_name!("template") {
        *template_depth = template_depth.saturating_add(1);
        return true;
    }

    if *tag_name == tag_name!("svg") || *tag_name == tag_name!("math") {
        // A self-closing svg or math element leaves no element open.
        if !token.is_self_closing() {
            *foreign_depth = foreign_depth.saturating_add(1);
        }
        return true;
    }

    if *template_depth > 0 || *foreign_depth > 0 {
        return true;
    }

    let TokenPayload::Tag { attributes, .. } = &token.payload else {
        return true;
    };

    if *tag_name == tag_name!("base") {
        process_base(attributes, callback)
    } else if *tag_name == tag_name!("script") {
        process_script(attributes, callback)
    } else if *tag_name == tag_name!("link") {
        process_link(attributes, callback)
    } else if *tag_name == tag_name!("img") {
        process_img(attributes, callback)
    } else {
        true
    }
}

fn process_end_tag(token: &Token, template_depth: &mut u64, foreign_depth: &mut u64) {
    let tag_name = token.tag_name();
    if *tag_name == tag_name!("template") && *template_depth > 0 {
        *template_depth -= 1;
    } else if (*tag_name == tag_name!("svg") || *tag_name == tag_name!("math")) && *foreign_depth > 0 {
        *foreign_depth -= 1;
    }
}

pub(crate) fn tokenizer_state_after_start_tag(tag_name: &HtmlName, scripting_enabled: bool) -> Option<State> {
    if *tag_name == tag_name!("script") {
        Some(State::ScriptData)
    } else if *tag_name == tag_name!("title") || *tag_name == tag_name!("textarea") {
        Some(State::RCDATA)
    } else if *tag_name == tag_name!("style")
        || *tag_name == tag_name!("xmp")
        || *tag_name == tag_name!("iframe")
        || *tag_name == tag_name!("noembed")
        || *tag_name == tag_name!("noframes")
        || (*tag_name == tag_name!("noscript") && scripting_enabled)
    {
        Some(State::RAWTEXT)
    } else if *tag_name == tag_name!("plaintext") {
        Some(State::PLAINTEXT)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn process_base(attributes: &[Attribute], callback: &mut impl FnMut(&RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool) -> bool {
    let Some(href) = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("href")) else {
        return true;
    };
    if href.is_empty() {
        return true;
    }

    emit_entry(
        callback,
        RustFfiPreloadScannerAction::Base,
        href,
        RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::None,
        RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting::NoCors,
        None,
    )
}

fn process_script(attributes: &[Attribute], callback: &mut impl FnMut(&RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool) -> bool {
    let Some(src) = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("src")) else {
        return true;
    };
    if src.is_empty() {
        return true;
    }
    let action = match script_type_from_attributes(attributes) {
        // 'If el has a nomodule content attribute and its type is "classic", then return.' — so the script never runs,
        // and preparing it doesn't fetch src.
        Some(ScriptType::Classic) if attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("nomodule")).is_some() => return true,
        Some(ScriptType::Classic) => RustFfiPreloadScannerAction::Fetch,
        Some(ScriptType::Module) => RustFfiPreloadScannerAction::ModuleScript,
        // An import map or speculation-rules script with a src attribute only fires an error event, and a script whose
        // type is null never runs — none of them fetch src.
        Some(ScriptType::ImportMap) | Some(ScriptType::SpeculationRules) | None => return true,
    };
    emit_entry(
        callback,
        action,
        src,
        RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Script,
        cors_setting_from_attribute(attributes),
        Some(attributes),
    )
}

/// The type "prepare the script element" gives a script element from its type and language attributes.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
enum ScriptType {
    Classic,
    Module,
    ImportMap,
    SpeculationRules,
}

// https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type
// A JavaScript MIME type is any MIME type whose essence is one of the following:
const JAVASCRIPT_MIME_TYPE_ESSENCES: [&[u8]; 16] = [
    b"application/ecmascript",
    b"application/javascript",
    b"application/x-ecmascript",
    b"application/x-javascript",
    b"text/ecmascript",
    b"text/javascript",
    b"text/javascript1.0",
    b"text/javascript1.1",
    b"text/javascript1.2",
    b"text/javascript1.3",
    b"text/javascript1.4",
    b"text/javascript1.5",
    b"text/jscript",
    b"text/livescript",
    b"text/x-ecmascript",
    b"text/x-javascript",
];

// https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#prepare-the-script-element
// Steps 8 to 13 of "prepare the script element": the type the element gets from its type and language attributes, or
// None when "no script is executed, and el's type is left as null".
fn script_type_from_attributes(attributes: &[Attribute]) -> Option<ScriptType> {
    let type_attribute = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("type"));
    let language_attribute = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("language"));

    // 8. If any of the following are true:
    //    - el has a type attribute whose value is the empty string;
    //    - el has no type attribute but it has a language attribute and that attribute's value is the empty string; or
    //    - el has neither a type attribute nor a language attribute,
    //    then let the script block's type string for this script element be "text/javascript".
    //    Otherwise, if el has a type attribute, then let the script block's type string be the value of that attribute.
    //    Otherwise, el has a non-empty language attribute; let the script block's type string be the concatenation of
    //    "text/" and the value of el's language attribute.
    // FIXME: Preserve whitespace in the type string; only the classic JavaScript MIME comparison strips it.
    let type_attribute = type_attribute.map(keyword_bytes);
    let language_attribute = language_attribute.map(keyword_bytes);
    let type_string: Cow<'_, [u8]> = match (&type_attribute, &language_attribute) {
        (Some(type_attribute), _) if type_attribute.is_empty() => Cow::Borrowed(b"text/javascript"),
        (None, Some(language)) if language.is_empty() => Cow::Borrowed(b"text/javascript"),
        (None, None) => Cow::Borrowed(b"text/javascript"),
        (Some(type_attribute), _) => Cow::Borrowed(type_attribute.trim_ascii()),
        (None, Some(language)) => Cow::Owned([b"text/".as_slice(), language].concat()),
    };

    // 9. If the script block's type string is a JavaScript MIME type essence match, or el has a type attribute whose
    //    value with leading and trailing ASCII whitespace stripped is a JavaScript MIME type essence match, then set
    //    el's type to "classic".
    if JAVASCRIPT_MIME_TYPE_ESSENCES
        .iter()
        .any(|essence| type_string.eq_ignore_ascii_case(essence))
    {
        return Some(ScriptType::Classic);
    }

    // 10. Otherwise, if the script block's type string is an ASCII case-insensitive match for the string "module", then
    //     set el's type to "module".
    if type_string.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"module") {
        return Some(ScriptType::Module);
    }

    // 11. Otherwise, if the script block's type string is an ASCII case-insensitive match for the string "importmap",
    //     then set el's type to "importmap".
    if type_string.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"importmap") {
        return Some(ScriptType::ImportMap);
    }

    // 12. Otherwise, if the script block's type string is an ASCII case-insensitive match for the string
    //     "speculationrules", then set el's type to "speculationrules".
    if type_string.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"speculationrules") {
        return Some(ScriptType::SpeculationRules);
    }

    // 13. Otherwise, return. (No script is executed, and el's type is left as null.)
    None
}

fn process_link(attributes: &[Attribute], callback: &mut impl FnMut(&RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool) -> bool {
    let Some(href) = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("href")) else {
        return true;
    };
    if href.is_empty() {
        return true;
    }

    let Some(rel) = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("rel")) else {
        return true;
    };
    let rel = keyword_bytes(rel);

    let (action, destination) = if rel_contains_keyword(&rel, b"stylesheet") {
        (
            RustFfiPreloadScannerAction::Fetch,
            RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Style,
        )
    } else if rel_contains_keyword(&rel, b"modulepreload") {
        let Some(destination) = translate_modulepreload_destination(attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("as")))
        else {
            return true;
        };
        (RustFfiPreloadScannerAction::ModulePreload, destination)
    } else if rel_contains_keyword(&rel, b"preload") {
        let Some(destination) = translate_preload_destination(attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("as")))
        else {
            return true;
        };
        (RustFfiPreloadScannerAction::Fetch, destination)
    } else {
        return true;
    };

    emit_entry(
        callback,
        action,
        href,
        destination,
        cors_setting_from_attribute(attributes),
        Some(attributes),
    )
}

fn process_img(attributes: &[Attribute], callback: &mut impl FnMut(&RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool) -> bool {
    let Some(src) = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("src")) else {
        return true;
    };
    if src.is_empty() {
        return true;
    }

    emit_entry(
        callback,
        RustFfiPreloadScannerAction::Fetch,
        src,
        RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Image,
        cors_setting_from_attribute(attributes),
        Some(attributes),
    )
}

fn emit_entry(
    callback: &mut impl FnMut(&RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry) -> bool,
    action: RustFfiPreloadScannerAction,
    url: Utf16View<'_>,
    destination: RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination,
    cors_setting: RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting,
    attributes: Option<&[Attribute]>,
) -> bool {
    let attribute = |name| attribute_value(attributes.unwrap_or_default(), name);
    let attribute_or_empty = |name| attribute(name).unwrap_or(Utf16View::Latin1(&[])).into();
    let entry = RustFfiPreloadScannerEntry {
        action,
        url: url.into(),
        destination,
        cors_setting,
        nonce: attribute_or_empty(attribute_name!("nonce")),
        integrity: attribute_or_empty(attribute_name!("integrity")),
        integrity_present: attribute(attribute_name!("integrity")).is_some(),
        referrer_policy: attribute_or_empty(attribute_name!("referrerpolicy")),
        fetch_priority: attribute_or_empty(attribute_name!("fetchpriority")),
        media: attribute_or_empty(attribute_name!("media")),
    };
    callback(&entry)
}

fn attribute_value(attributes: &[Attribute], name: KnownName) -> Option<Utf16View<'_>> {
    attributes
        .iter()
        .find(|attribute| attribute.local_name == name)
        .map(|attribute| attribute.value.as_slice())
}

/// The code units of an attribute value as bytes, to look for ASCII keywords in. A code unit that doesn't fit in a
/// byte becomes one that is in no keyword and isn't whitespace.
fn keyword_bytes(value: Utf16View<'_>) -> Cow<'_, [u8]> {
    match value {
        Utf16View::Latin1(code_units) => Cow::Borrowed(code_units),
        Utf16View::Utf16(code_units) => Cow::Owned(
            code_units
                .iter()
                .map(|&code_unit| u8::try_from(code_unit).unwrap_or(0xFF))
                .collect(),
        ),
    }
}

fn rel_contains_keyword(rel: &[u8], keyword: &[u8]) -> bool {
    rel.split(|byte| byte.is_ascii_whitespace())
        .any(|token| token.eq_ignore_ascii_case(keyword))
}

fn translate_preload_destination(destination: Option<Utf16View<'_>>) -> Option<RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination> {
    Some(match &*keyword_bytes(destination?) {
        b"fetch" => RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::None,
        b"font" => RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Font,
        b"image" => RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Image,
        b"script" => RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Script,
        b"style" => RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Style,
        b"track" => RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Track,
        _ => return None,
    })
}

fn translate_modulepreload_destination(destination: Option<Utf16View<'_>>) -> Option<RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination> {
    let Some(destination) = destination else {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Script);
    };

    let destination = &*keyword_bytes(destination);

    // A module preload destination is "json", "style", "text", or a script-like destination.
    if destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"audioworklet") {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::AudioWorklet);
    }
    if destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"json") {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::JSON);
    }
    if destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"paintworklet") {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::PaintWorklet);
    }
    if destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"script") {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Script);
    }
    if destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"serviceworker") {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::ServiceWorker);
    }
    if destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"sharedworker") {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::SharedWorker);
    }
    if destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"style") {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Style);
    }
    if destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"text") {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Text);
    }
    if destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"worker") {
        return Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Worker);
    }

    const NON_MODULE_DESTINATIONS: [&[u8]; 15] = [
        b"audio",
        b"document",
        b"embed",
        b"fetch",
        b"font",
        b"frame",
        b"iframe",
        b"image",
        b"manifest",
        b"object",
        b"report",
        b"track",
        b"video",
        b"webidentity",
        b"xslt",
    ];
    if NON_MODULE_DESTINATIONS
        .iter()
        .any(|candidate| destination.eq_ignore_ascii_case(candidate))
    {
        return None;
    }

    // NB: Invalid and empty values put the enumerated as attribute in no state, so step 2 uses "script".
    Some(RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Script)
}

fn cors_setting_from_attribute(attributes: &[Attribute]) -> RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting {
    let Some(crossorigin) = attribute_value(attributes, attribute_name!("crossorigin")) else {
        return RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting::NoCors;
    };

    if crossorigin.eq_ignore_ascii_case("use-credentials") {
        RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting::UseCredentials
    } else {
        RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting::Anonymous
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
    struct ScannedEntry {
        action: RustFfiPreloadScannerAction,
        url: String,
        destination: RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination,
        cors_setting: RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting,
    }

    fn collect(input: &str) -> Vec<ScannedEntry> {
        collect_with_scripting(input, true)
    }

    fn collect_with_scripting(input: &str, scripting_enabled: bool) -> Vec<ScannedEntry> {
        let mut entries = Vec::new();
        scan(input.as_bytes(), scripting_enabled, |entry| {
            entries.push(ScannedEntry {
                action: entry.action,
                url: entry.url.to_test_string(),
                destination: entry.destination,
                cors_setting: entry.cors_setting,
            });
            true
        });
        entries
    }

    fn collect_utf16(input: &str) -> Vec<ScannedEntry> {
        let input = input.encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let mut entries = Vec::new();
        scan_utf16(&input, true, |entry| {
            entries.push(ScannedEntry {
                action: entry.action,
                url: entry.url.to_test_string(),
                destination: entry.destination,
                cors_setting: entry.cors_setting,
            });
            true
        });
        entries
    }

    #[test]
    fn scans_utf16_input() {
        let entries = collect_utf16(r#"<base href="/base/😀"><img src="./photo.png">"#);

        assert_eq!(
            entries,
            vec![
                ScannedEntry {
                    action: RustFfiPreloadScannerAction::Base,
                    url: "/base/😀".to_string(),
                    destination: RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::None,
                    cors_setting: RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting::NoCors,
                },
                ScannedEntry {
                    action: RustFfiPreloadScannerAction::Fetch,
                    url: "./photo.png".to_string(),
                    destination: RustFfiPreloadScannerDestination::Image,
                    cors_setting: RustFfiPreloadScannerCorsSetting::NoCors,
                },
            ]
        );
    }

    #[test]
